Limbum: Ñwaè' ca yi ce suñ aèmboè raèraâ Jisos Kraâis ce e m ba muu Dávïìd, Dávïìd aè ba muu Abraèhaêm.
English: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

Limbum: Abraèham aè m bi Aisïìk, Aisïìk aè bi Jakoèp, Jakoèp aè bi Judaè ba bfúr vi.
English: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

Limbum: Judaè aè m bi Páráès ba Saráè ce yaèp ma aè m ba Tamaèr. Páráès aè bi Ásiroèm, Ásiroèm aè bi Raêm.
English: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

Limbum: Ram aè m bi AÈminadaèp, AÈminadaèp aè bi Nashoèn, Nashoèn aè bi Sarmoèn.
English: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

Limbum: Sarmoèn aè m bi Buwaès ce yïì ma aè m ba Rahaèp, Buwaès aè bi Obáèd ce yïì ma aè m ba Ruêr, Obáèd aè bi Jáásïì.
English: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

Limbum: Jáásïì aè m bi ñkúú Dávïìd. Dávïìd aè bi Solomúèn ce yïì ma aè m ba ñgwa Yurïìyaè naè,
English: Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah.

Limbum: Solomúèn aè bi Rábuèwaèm, Rábuèwaèm aè bi AÈbijaè, AÈbijaè aè bi Asaè.
English: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

Limbum: Asaè aè m bi Jásafaèr, Jásafaèr aè bi Joraèm, Joraèm aè bi OÈsayaè,
English: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

Limbum: OÈsayaè aè bi Jotaèm, Jotaèm aè bi Áhaèr, Áhaèr aè bi Háèsïìkayaè.
English: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

Limbum: Háèsïìkayaè aè m bi Maènasïìs, Maènasïìs aè bi Amoèn, Amoèn aè bi Joèsayaè.
English: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

Limbum: Joèsayaè aè m bi Jáèkonaèr ba bfúr vi aè nfeè' ce a m ce koo beèe Judaè aè rkoèñ ce du aègho aè to' Babiloèn naè.
English: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babylon.

Limbum: A ka' koo woweèe duè aègho aè to' Babiloèn, Jáèkonaèr aè bi Shálatáèr, Shálatáèr aè bi Sáèrobabáèr,
English: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

Limbum: Sáèrobabáèr aè bi AÈbiyuèr, AÈbiyuèr aè bi Álayikïìm, Álayikïìm aè bi Asoèr.
English: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

Limbum: Asoèr aè m bi Sadoèk, Sadoèk aè bi Akïìm, Akïìm aè bi ÁÈliyuèr.
English: Azor became the father of Sadoc. Sadoc became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

Limbum: ÁÈliyuèr aè m bi ÁÈlisaè, ÁÈlisaè aè bi Mataèm, Mataèm aè bi Jakoèp,
English: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

Limbum: Jakoèp aè bi Josáèf ce e m ba nduu yïì Máèári ce e m bi Jisoès ce a ce too ená Kraêis.
English: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

Limbum: Baná ñgúè beèe aè m ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-rrúèú ká' embe nfeè' yïì Abraèhaêm, du ba' mbe nfeè' yïì Dávïìd, a ker ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-rrúèú ká' embe nfeè' yïì Dávïìd du ba' mbe nfeè' a m ce koo beèe ce duè aègho aè to' Babiloèn naè, a ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-rrúèú ká' embe nfeè' ce a m duè neè beèe aè to' Babiloèn du ba' mbe nfeè' yïì Kraâis anaè.
English: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

Limbum: A mboè rbi Jisos Kraâis li m ba aè njáèá enáê. Yïì ma ce aè m ba Máèári aè m koo kwaèñ ese Josáèf ená e bo duè bguèu a ye. Tá a ye a ka' keèe rïìñni mnyor aèmboè nduu a nje, e ba neè rbúè aè ñger Yú' Rara. Josáèf aè lo a riñ ená e yu neè rbúè.
English: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this; for after his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Josáèf ce e m ba nduu yïì aè m ba ñwáâ nyáánïì, a ke' ce koèñ ená e coosi ye aè múè beèe ka', a ce kwaè'shi ená e be kwesi guèu tá ñwáè moè' riñ ka'.
English: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

Limbum: E ka' ce kwaè'shi aè rgeèe wa'a, a yá rlo aèmboè ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè vúè a laa neè ye enáê, “Josáèf muu Dávïìd, fa wáp aè rloèr ñgwa woâ Máèári ka', njobeè' muu ce e yu njep yeâ rbúè naè aè loè ba ese Yú' Rara.
English: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, don't be afraid to take to yourself Mary, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: E be bi muu mbañruè tá aè fa li rlii ená Jisoès, njobeè' e be geèe tá yïì beèe a luñ efa yaèp buu bbebep.”
English: She shall bring forth a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.

Limbum: Buu ca wááwá vi m ba wa'a tá yuu ce Tata Nyúè aè m laèa njïì enjep yïì ñwáè ncep ntuu yi bo ghááte njo. E m laèa enáê,
English: Now all this has happened, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

Limbum: “Muu ñgoèñgoè be ba neè rbúè, bi muu mbañruè tá a fa li rlii ená ÁÈmanuèwáèl.”
English: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son. They shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, God with us.

Limbum: Josáèf aè ka' lá' efa mmirloèè, a gee yuu ce ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè m suñ ye aè rlo naè, a lor ñgwa yïì a du a ye fa yeâ laè'.
English: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

Limbum: A ye a m rïìñni mnyor aèmboè nduu ba nje ka' caar e bi muu mbañruè anaè. E ka' bi, Josáèf aè fa rlii muu ená Jisoès.
English: and didn't know her sexually until she had brought forth her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce a m bi Jisoès aè rla' Bátáèláèháêm, aè ñgoèñ Juèdiyaè aè nfeè' ce Hároèd aè m ba ñkúú, ñgaâa bfee mo' a lo ekuè mbuèuntii a du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm,
English: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

Limbum: a bipshi enáê, “Muu ce a bi ye aè ñkúú Jus naè yuê? Weèr aè yá li rkaèñsïì kuè mbuèuntii, a vú aè rgú'shi neè ye.”
English: Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.

Limbum: Ñkúú Hároèd aè ka' yu' ca, yi fa ye ñgá' seê, a fa ñgá' foñ neè beèe wááwá aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

Limbum: E ká' beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, a bipshi neè woweèe ená yi m ba ená a be bi Kraâis anaè ba fá lá?
English: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “AÈ rla' Bátáèláèháêm, aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè. Ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m sañ enáê,
English: They said to him, In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

Limbum: ‘Wáè ce Bátáèláèháêm, ce aè yu aè ñgoâñ Judaè, aè yu ñwáâ múcaèr aè múè ñgaâa rsa' aè ñgoèñ Judaè ka' koo-múcaèr, njobeè' ñwáè rsa' be fúú efa múè yoè beèe, cïìñ yaè beèe Isráèl aèmboè ñwáè ncïìñ njeèe.’ ”
English: You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come forth a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Israel.'

Limbum: Hároèd aè ká' ñgaâa bfee anaè mbe dïì' ce e m ku ba mimñgi', a bipshi neè woweèe, a yu' nfeè' ce rkaèñsïì li m yááti seeseê.
English: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

Limbum: A ka' yu', a tuu woweèe aè rla' Bátáèláèháêm, a laa enáê, “Duè neè du roo muu anaè boèñboñ, weâe roèo yá ye, weèe gee tá m rïîñ, tá m bo duè caè'ni ye foñ.”
English: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' yuu ce ñkúú aè laèa, a nati a ce duè, a ku yá aèm boè rkaèñsïì ce woweèe a m yá kuè mbuèuntii naè li ce duè kuèntombïì neè woweèe caar a ba' a táá mbe dïì' ce muu anaè aè m ba.
English: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá aèmboè li táá, a lu'shi magoèr seê.
English: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

Limbum: Woweèe a niñ mbe ndaèp, a yá muu a yïì ma ce Máèári, a gú'shi neè ye. A ka' gú'shi neè ye wáá, a mú' waêp bbaèa, a fúr bco' mo' ce a too ená guêl, ba nráèá, ker ba njáèá mgúr mo' ce mi m ce rúèú boèñboñ seê, a fa neè ye.
English: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

Limbum: Nyúè aè báá woweèe aè rlo ená a fa kúti caèa yá Hároèd ka'. Woweèe a kútïì a woâ to' aè njïû jáá.
English: Being warned in a dream that they shouldn't return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè, Tata Nyúè aè tuu yïì ncïìndap neè Josáèf aè rlo a laa neè ye enáê, “Naèti mbekïì lor muu ca ba yïì maê, cañ du aègho aè to' Ijïìp, cu aèfo caar tá m ke laèa neè wáè ená aè kúti, njobeè' Hároèd táá aè rroèo muu ca tá e bo yú.”
English: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

Limbum: Josáèf aè lá' efa mmirloèè, a lor muu ba ma muu neètú', a du aè to' Ijïìp,
English: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt,

Limbum: a cu aèfo caar Hároèd aè ke kwe. Ca yi m ba wa'a tá yuu ce Tata Nyúè aè m laèa njïì enjep yïì ñwáè ncep ntuu enáê, “Máè m ká' muu waè e fúú e aè to' Ijïìp” naè yi bo ghááte njo.
English: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt I called my son.

Limbum: Hároèd aè ka' yá ená ñgaâa bfee ekuè mbuèuntii a bo' ye, ntee yi yañ ye seê, e fa rsa' ená a yúshi boo mmbañruè wááwá ce a káè' embe bfeâ' bbaa kúti njïìnjïì ce a yu aè rla' Bátáèláèháêm, ker ba aè mú mla' ce mi yu aègee rla' ca. E m fa rsa' wa'a, njobeè' bfeè' vi m ba aèmboè bbaa, ká' embe nfeè' ce ñgaâa bfee ekuè mbuèuntii a m yá rkaèñsïì ce a m suñ ye ená a yá naè.
English: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, yuu ce Jáèrïìmiyaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa naè, yi ghááteè njo. E m laèa enáê,
English: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

Limbum: “A m yu' njeèndoñ ñwáè aè rla' Ramaè, ñgaèñ aè ce war a ce koosimnse magoèr seê, Racáèl aè ce war njo' boo vi, a kani ená e be cip ka' njobeè' boo vi a m kweñger wááwá.”
English: A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn't be comforted, because they are no more.

Limbum: Hároèd aè ka' kwe, Josáèf aè yá ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè rlo aè to' Ijïìp.
English: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

Limbum: E laa neè ye enáê, “Naèti, lor muu ba yïì maê, tá weèe woweèe kúti aè ñgoâñ Isráèl, njobeè' beèe ce a m ce roèo aè ryú muu ca, a kweñger.”
English: Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child's life are dead.

Limbum: E natïì a lor muu ba ma a du aègho aè ñgoâñ Isráèl.
English: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

Limbum: E ka' baè' yu' ená AÈkáloè aè ye kúú yïì ta Hároèd a ce sa' aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, e wáp aè rduè cu aèfo. Nyúè aè ka' báá ye aè rlo, e natïì a du aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

Limbum: A ka' baè', a cu aè rla' mo' ce a m too ená Nasaráèt. Yuu ce ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa enáê, “A be too ye ená ñwáâ aè rla' Nasaráèt” naè yi ghááteè njo.
English: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets: He will be called a Nazarene.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe aè ká' a ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè aè ntee rïìñ aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè.
English: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Kupse-neè yeè ndeèe, ma' yeè buu bbebep njobeè' nfeè' ce kúú Nyúè yi be káè', ce gháá.”
English: Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!

Limbum: Ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ce AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa yuu a kuu ye. E m laèa enáê, “Ñwáè moè' ce fuñ aè ntee rïìñ a ce laèa enáê, ‘Kupshi neè nduunjïì neè Tataê, nashi tá yi ba kuèyáá.’ ”
English: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

Limbum: Joân aè m yar bcáè' ce a m ba' neè mnyoâr Kaèmáêl, a cúú ñguèp nyaèa njep mbuèu. Vi byee aè m ba mñguu ba bluè.
English: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

Limbum: Beèe a m ce loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, ba aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, ker ba aè mla' ce mi m ba aègee rdip Jodaèn, a ce duè ce yá ye.
English: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

Limbum: Woweèe a m suñ yaèp buu bbebep ce a m geèe, e baptïìr woweèe njep rdip Jodaèn.
English: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

Limbum: E ka' yá aèmboè beèe magoèr efa múè beèe Farïìsi, ba beèe Saduèsïî, a vúè ená e bo baèptir woweèe, e laa neè woweèe enáê, “Boo bfïî, ñwáè ce e báá weèe tá weèe bo cañ soèrti efa rshentee ce Nyúè be ko'si neè beèe naè aè báá nda?
English: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

Limbum: Geèe laè neè buu ce vi be ce duèñshi ená weèe aè kupse, a ma' yeè buu bbebep.
English: Therefore bring forth fruit worthy of repentance!

Limbum: Weèe fa loèr weená weèe aè ka' ce laèa enáê, ‘Abraèham yu yeèr taê,’ weèe fúr wee btu efa ñgá' ka'. M ce suñ weèe ená aède' Nyúè ku lor bluèr ca beesi aè boo Abraèhaêm.
English: Don't think to yourselves, 'We have Abraham for our father,' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

Limbum: A láè njaèa njep mbuèu ce wáá. Ce ce yi ka' tá yú boèñboñ ka', baná a be gwaèr, maè' njep mor.
English: Even now the axe lies at the root of the trees. Therefore, every tree that doesn't bring forth good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Jisoès aè loâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a du mbaè rdip Jodaèn tá Joân bo baèptir ye.
English: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

Limbum: Joân aè ce roèo njïì aè rkanïì, a laa enáê, “Yu ba wáè ce wáè ba baèptir máè, wáè vú wáná m baptir wáè aè njáâá ká?”
English: But John would have hindered him, saying, I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Maè'shi tá yi ba wa'a seè'ni na. Yi yu boèñboñ ená seèe gee ca tá seèe bo geèe buu wááwá ce vi yu yáánïì.” Joân aè byemïì.
English: But Jesus, answering, said to him, Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he allowed him.

Limbum: E ka' baèptir Jisoès wáá, e ku fúú enjep roè. Awá rbuu li mú'tïì, e yá aèmboè Yú' Nyúè yi suèu mbe yeâ nduèu aèmboè beèñ wa'a.
English: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

Limbum: Njeèndoñ aè laa embe buèu enáê, “Cena yu muu waè ce máè koèñ seê, a ce yu' rboèñ neè ye.”
English: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

Limbum: Awá Yú' Nyúè yi lor Jisoès a du aègho aè ntee rïìñ tá Sataèn bo moèoshi ye.
English: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

Limbum: E ji mdip aè mnoèñ mñkyeèe, njeè aè ká' a ce yañ ye.
English: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

Limbum: Sataèn aè vúê, a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè ka' ba Muu Nyúè, aè laa tá bluèr ca vi beeñger aè bráêd.”
English: The tempter came and said to him, If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Ñwáè e ke cu nteèe ba njo' bráâd caè'caè' ka'. E ke cu ba njo' blaèa ce vi ke fúú ekuèèèè cuâu Nyúè.’ ”
English: But he answered, It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.'

Limbum: Sataèn aè lor ye a du aègho aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm ce yu rla' rrara, a ko' neè ye a tár mbe tu Nyúè ce yi m saèp mbekïì seê, a laa neè ye enáê,
English: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

Limbum: “Wáè ka' ba Muu Nyúè, aè nyáá ka embe na cáá aè nsheè, njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Nyúè be laèa tá vi bcïìndap a ke'ni wáè, yaè wáè mbe mmboè faè dïì' aè láá yo kuèu aè luèr ka'.’ ”
English: and said to him, If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you.' and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don't dash your foot against a stone.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “A ker sañ enáê, ‘Fa moèoshi Tata ce e yu yoè Nyúè ka'.’ “
English: Jesus said to him, Again, it is written, 'You shall not test the Lord, your God.'

Limbum: Sataèn aè ker lor ye a du aègho mbe rtuèu ce li m saèp seê, a duñshi ye bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na, ker ba ku' buu bboèñboñ enjo,
English: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Wáè ka' gú'shi neè máè baná m be fa buu ca wááwá neè wáè.”
English: He said to him, I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Loè efa máâ geñ, Sataèn, njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Gú'shi neè Tata ce e yu yoè Nyúè, fa' ba neè ye caè'caè'.’ ”
English: Then Jesus said to him, Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'

Limbum: Awá Sataèn aè ma'shïì ye a duê, bcïìndap Nyúè a vúê, a ke' aè ye.
English: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu' ená a fa Joân aè shañ, a kúti aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

Limbum: E m loâ aè rla' Nasaráèt, a du a cu aè rla' Kaèpanuèm ce li m ba aèwaâa roè aè ñgoâñ Sábuloèn ba Naptaleè,
English: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

Limbum: tá yuu ce AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa yi bo ghááte njo.
English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Ntáè' Sábuloèn, ba ntáè' Naptaleè ce vi yu aè mbeèp rdip rgoèr, neèñguu rdip Jodaèn, ce vi yu aè ñgoâñ Galeèle yïì beèe enje jáá.
English: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles

Limbum: Beèe ce a m cu aè túè'nji a yá ma rraa. Rraa li raa mbenduè beèe ce a ce cu aè ñgoâñ túè'nji ce e caèa ñger.”
English: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.

Limbum: Ká' embe nfeè' anaè, Jisoès aè ká' a ce feè'shi, a ce laèa enáê, “Kupse-neè, ma' yeè buu bbebep njobeè' nfeè' ce kúú Nyúè yi be káè', ce gháá.”
English: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce jáèr aèwaâa túè ce aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a yá beèe mo' a baa, Saimúèn ce li rlii mo' li m ba ená Pitaè, ba Andruè ce e m ba nfúr yïì. Woweèe a m ba ñgaâa ñkoo nca, a ce maè' rraa njep roè, tá a bo koo nca njo.
English: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Vúè neè fa máâ mbuèu tá m gee tá weèe ba ñgaâa ñkoo nca ce be ba beèe.”
English: He said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.

Limbum: Woweèe a ku lá map mraa, a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

Limbum: E ka' loè embo ce duè, a ker yá beèe mo' a baa ce aè m ba Jáêms, ce e m ba muu yïì Sábáèdïî, ba nfúr yïì ce Joân. Woweèe a m ba mbe keñ a yaèp ta weèe a ce cúúshi map mraa. Jisoès aè ká' woweèe.
English: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ku ma'shi yaèp keñ ba yaèp taê, a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m jáèr aè mú bbu' mla' wááwá aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a ce yá'ni beèe aè mndap mloo, a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè, a ce geèe beèe ce a m ce yañ byañ jáá jáèá jáá a ce keè'se.
English: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

Limbum: Yïì nsuñ aè du aè bbu' mla' wááwá aè ñgoâñ Sirïìyaè, beèe a vú neè beèe wááwá ce a m ce yañ byañ jáá jáèá jáá, ba beèe ce mnyor vi m ce yañ woweèe, ba beèe ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m ba njep woweèe, ba beèe ce a m ce gweè kaè', ker ba beèe ce mñgúè' nyor mo' vi m kweñger. Jisoès aè gee woweèe a ke'seèè.
English: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

Limbum: Bkúr beèe a m loâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, ba aè Mla' Rúêú, ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, ba aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, ba neèñguu Jodaèn, a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá ku' beèe, a ko' mbe rtuèu, a ka' baè' mbo, a cu aè nsheè. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a vúseè,
English: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

Limbum: e ká' a ce yá'ni woweèe a laa enáê,
English: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

Limbum: “Mboâñtu mi yu neè beèe ce a yu ñgaâa fuèp aè yú', njobeè' kúú Nyúè yu yap.
English: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

Limbum: Yu'-neè rboèñ ce lu'shi njobeè' wee blaè' embe buèu vi yu goèr seê. Woweèe a m ku fa ñgá' neè ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè ce a m ba entombïì neè weèe naè wa'a.
English: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

Limbum: “Weèe yu mgwañ enjep ñgoèñ na. Ka' yi yu wa'a, mgwañ mi ka' cir, aède' a gee eká mi ka' ker leêe? Mi be keèr ba yuu ñgeèe yuu ka', tá a cu' tá beèe a ce caèa ce nyáèñshi neè mkuèu.
English: You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená, tá rbuu li ka' keèe mïì, tá ñgoèñ yi mi foñ, aède' mú yuu mo' embe ñwaâ' mncir yi ke du faè yuu ka', caar tá buu wááwá ghááte njo.
English: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ka' lor mú ncir efa mncir ca aètáèr, yá'ni beèe mo' foñ ená a gee wa'a, baná ñgaèñ be keèe ba ñwáâ ñká' mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè. Ñwáè ce e ka' lá mncir ca, ce yá'ni beèe vi, baná ñgaèñ be ba ñwáâ ñgoèr mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.
English: Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná ye ñgeâe yáánïì yi ka' tá caèa yïû ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba yïû beèe Farïìsi ka', baná aède' weèe niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè ka'.
English: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

Limbum: “Weèe aè yu' ená a m laèa neè beèe eluâuñgoèñ enáê, ‘Fa yú ka', ñwáè ce e ka' yú ñwáè baná a be loèr ye aè mnsa'.’
English: You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, 'You shall not murder;' and 'Whoever shall murder shall be in danger of the judgment.'

Limbum: aè lá lo rfa anaè mbe gee dïû' ntoèo rfa, be du yá ye tá weèe ye nashi bcuèu, tá aè ka' kúti fa lo rfa anaè.
English: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

Limbum: “Ñwáè aè ka' somir wáè, weèe ye ce duè mbe koêr, aè yá ená weèe ye aè seèesi a ba cuâu mo'sir, faè dïì' e du neè wáè, fa wáè neè ñwáè nsa' mnsa' tá ñwáè nsa' mnsa' fa wáè neè ñwáè ncir tá ñwáè ncir fa wáè mbe shañ ka'.
English: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are with him in the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

Limbum: M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená aè be kuè cu mbe shañ anaè caar, laè' yi mbaèa ce yi yu neè wáè wááwá, ka' fúú embo.
English: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.

Limbum: “Weèe aè yu' weená a m laèa enáê, ‘Fa koo ñgwa ñwáè moè' káè nduu ñwáè moè' ka'.’
English: You have heard that it was said, 'You shall not commit adultery;'

Limbum: M ce laèa ya neè weèe ená ñwáè aè ka' juu ñgwa yïì, ke' ba njobeè' ñgwa yïì anaè aè noèñ a mbañruèñwáèè moè' ka', baná e geèe ñgwa yïì anaè aè noñ a nduu ñwáè moè'. Ñwáè ce e ka' lor njeñwáè ce e fúú bguèu, baná e koo ñgwa ñwáè moè'.
English: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

Limbum: “Weèe aè ker yu' foñ ená a m laèa neè beèe eluâuñgoèñ enáê, ‘Ñwáè aè ka' ye leè' aè rgeèe yuu mo' neè Tata Nyúè, ñgaèñ fa buu efa rgeèe yuu anaè ka'.’
English: Again you have heard that it was said to them of old time, 'You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,'

Limbum: M ce laèa ya neè weèe ená, ñwáè fa kúúsi yuu bebep neè yuu bebep ka'. Ñwáè aè ka' lip wáè neè bo aè geè', aè beesïì geè' mo' neè ye foñ tá e lïîp.
English: But I tell you, don't resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ce koèñ ená weèe ye sa' mnsa', koo cáè' ese wáè, aè ma'shïì tá e koo yoè kur foñ.
English: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ku koo wáè aè ñger ená weèe ye jár mar moè'sir, aè jár weèe ye mar baa.
English: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' laa ená aè fa ye yuu, aè fa ñgaèñ yuu anaè. Ñwáè aè ka' ce koèñ aè rfoèo yuu ese wáè, aè fa sheè ka'.
English: Give to him who asks you, and don't turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

Limbum: “Weèe aè yu' ená a m laèa enáê, ‘Koèñ nfúroè, baa ñwáè ce e baèa wáè’.
English: You have heard that it was said, 'You shall love your neighbor, and hate your enemy.'

Limbum: Baná weèe aè ka' ce fa yuu neè beèe ce a buu yuu, weèe fa fyáp msoèñ tá beèe a bo rïìñ yuu ce weèe aè geèe ka'. Ñgaâa mbo'ni a ke geèe wa'a aè mndap mloo ker ba aè btase tá beèe a bo ce yoèñshi woweèe. M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená woweèe a koni wap blaè' wáá.
English: Therefore when you do merciful deeds, don't sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

Limbum: Weèe ka' ce fa yuu neè beèe ce a buu, weèe fa maè'shi tá ye bo ñkoèp yi riñ yuu ce ye bo maè' yi ce geèe ka',
English: But when you do merciful deeds, don't let your left hand know what your right hand does,

Limbum: tá ñwáè moè' bo rïìñ yuu ce weèe aè fa ka'. Weèe aè ka' gee wa'a, baná yeè Ta ce e ke yá buu ce beèe a geèe aè bsúèti, be laè' weèe.
English: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

Limbum: “Weèe aè ka' ce geèe rloo, weèe fa geèe aèmboè ñgaâa mbo'ni a ke geèe naè ka'. Woweèe a ke koèñ aè rtáá mbekïì aè mndap mloo ker ba aè btase, gee rloo tá beèe a bo yá woweèe. M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè, woweèe a koo wap blaè' wáá.
English: When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' tá foèosi beèe ce a geèe buu bbebep neè weèe ka', yeè Ta embe buèu foosïì weèe yeè buu bbebep ce weèe aè geèe foñ ka'.
English: But if you don't forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

Limbum: “Weèe aè ka' ce jïì mdip, weèe fa ce koosimnse aèmboè ñgaâa mbo'ni a ke geèe naè ka', njobeè' woweèe a ke jïì mdip wa'a, su'si mmir ka', tá beèe a bo yá ená woweèe a ce jïì mdip. M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená woweèe a koo wap blaè' wáá.
English: Moreover when you fast, don't be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

Limbum: Láè neè wee bkuè' ba mbe buèu mbe dïì' ce aède' mfyáp vi ye ka', nlo ye ka', byáèá vi kep mbo yáá buu ka'.
English: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don't break through and steal;

Limbum: Faèdïì' ce yoè buu yu, a faèdïì' ce yo ntee yi yu foñ.
English: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

Limbum: “Rlir li yu aèmboè lam neè nyor. Me mmir mi ka' ba yáánïì, baná rraa li yu aè yeè nyoèr wááwá.
English: The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

Limbum: “Baná m ce suñ weèe ená mluè mi fa ce koo weèe neè yeè nyor ená weèe be ye ká, káè no ká ka'. Mluè mi fa ce koo weèe neè yeè nyor foñ ená weèe be yar ba ká ka'. Mboè ryoâñ ñwáè li caèa byee, nyor ñwáè aè caa bcáè' a?
English: Therefore, I tell you, don't be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn't life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

Limbum: Fyá' ka neè bsiñ. Vi ke byeè buu káè kep buu káè lá aè bcaèñ ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, yeè Ta embe buèu ku ce nyañ woweèe. Mboè yeè ntaa luèu seê, a caa yïì bsiñ a?
English: See the birds of the sky, that they don't sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren't you of much more value than they?

Limbum: Ñwáè efa weâe mú ce mluè mi ka' ce koo ye, e kyeseè noèñ mo' mbenduè vi mnoèñ enjep ñgoèñ na a nda?
English: Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

Limbum: Beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka' a ke duè yap ba aèmbuèu buu ca, yeè Ta embe buèu aè rïìñ ená weèe aè ba túr buu ca.
English: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

Limbum: Baná weèe roèo entombïì ba kúú Nyúè, gee ñgeâe yáánïì aèmboè e ce koèñ, tá e fa weèe buu ca wááwá foñ.
English: But seek first God's Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

Limbum: Baná mluè mi fa ce koo weèe aè buu ceâ aèyaèñseè ka'. Be ba aèyaèñseè tá buu ku ba ce mluè mi koo weèe aègho. Ñgá' ñwáè ce aè noâñ mo'sir aè ghááte neè ñgaèñ aè noèñ anaè.
English: Therefore don't be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day's own evil is sufficient.

Limbum: “Weèe fa sa' beèe mo' ka', tá a bo sa' weèe ka',
English: Don't judge, so that you won't be judged.

Limbum: “Bipshi neè tá a bo fa neè weèe. Roèo neè tá weèe bo yá. Kuèushi neè tá a bo múè' keèñ neè weèe.
English: Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

Limbum: Cuâu ñka' yïû yi'seè ba nduunjïì yïû yi'seè yi ce duè ba aè dïì' rcu ce nfeseè, beèe ce a ce yá yi, a ba múcaèr.
English: How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.

Limbum: “Loèr neè nfeè' neè beèe ce a ce nya' mnde' ená a woweèe ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè. Woweèe a ce vúè aè ryá weèe, ma' ñguèp njeèe, wáâ fyá' njep mú, woweèe a ba aèmboè bkuura ce vi ce roèo yuu ye.
English: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

Limbum: mbeèñ aè gweê, mdip mi ruu, fu' yi caa a ci' ndap anaè seê, e ke' gwe ka' njobeè' a m boo kuèu efa gho mbenduè ryáá.
English: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn't fall, for it was founded on the rock.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' yu' buu ce máè laèa na, ke' gee vi ka', baná ñgaèñ yu aèmboè lúr ce e m baè'ri yïì ndap mbenduè nsaruñ,
English: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn't do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.

Limbum: mbeèñ aè gweê, mdip mi ruu, fu' yi caa a ci' ndap anaè, e gweê, a koo yuu efa gho ka'.”
English: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell--and great was its fall.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa buu ca mïìsi, ku' beèe anaè a bááñgeèr aè ryá'nïì ce e m yá'ni anaè seê,
English: It happened, when Jesus had finished saying these things, that the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

Limbum: njobeè' e m yá'ni aèmboè ñwáè ce e m túr ñger, a ke' yá'ni aèmboè yaèp beèe ce a m ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir naè ka'.
English: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' suèu embe rtuèu, ku' beèe a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

Limbum: Ka' cu, ñwáè msaèasïì aè vú a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi, a laa enáê, “Tataê, wáè ka' ce koèñ, aè gee m ke'seè, ba nrara.”
English: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.

Limbum: Jisoès aè naa bo a joo ye aègho, a laa enáê, “M ce koèñ wa'a, keè'se, ba nrara.” Ñwáè anaè aè ku ke'se aè nfeè' anaè, a ba nrara.
English: Jesus stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, I want to. Be made clean. Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ciisïì neè ye enáê, “Yáê, fa suñ ñwáè ka'. Duè duñshi yoè nyor neè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì embe Ndaèp Nyúè, gee tañshïì ce Musïìs aè m laèa ená ñwáè yañ msaèasïì gee tá beèe a bo rïìñ ená ñwáè anaè aè keè'se naè.”
English: Jesus said to him, See that you tell nobody, but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' niñ aè rla' Kaèpanuèm, ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè rjeèe aè vúê, a yá ye a bu' mmbo neè ye,
English: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Tataê, yaè ñwáè rfaè' noèñ aè laè', yïì ñgúè' nyor moè' aè kwe, e ce yu' ryañ seê.”
English: and saying, Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “M be vúè geèe tá e ke'se.”
English: Jesus said to him, I will come and heal him.

Limbum: Ñwáâ ñgoèr ca aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, máè ghááte aè ñwáè ce aède' aè niñ mbe máâ ndaèp ka'. Kuè laa ba mbúè nlaèa moè'sir tá yaè ñwáè rfaè' ke'se.
English: The centurion answered, Lord, I'm not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

Limbum: Má máè yu ñwáè ce m ce faè' njeptii beèe ce yap nta' yi caèa ya. M túr bsoogáè ce a yu njep máâ tïìi foñ. M ka' laa neè moè' enáê, ‘Duè’, baná e be duè. M ka' laa neè moè' enáê, ‘Vúè’, baná e be vúè. M ka' laa neè yaè ñwáè rfaè' enáê, ‘Geèe ca’, baná e be geèe yi.”
English: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and tell another, 'Come,' and he comes; and tell my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu' blaèa ca, a bááñger seê, a laa neè beèe ce a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu naè enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená máè be yá ñwáè moè' ce e túr njáèá rbyemïì ca ka', ka' aè to' Isráèl.
English: When Jesus heard it, he marveled, and said to those who followed, Most certainly I tell you, I haven't found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná beèe magoèr a be keèe vúè ekuè mbuèuntii ba embaè mbuèuntii cute a Abraèhaêm, ba Aisïìk, ba Jakoèp weèe aè ñkaè', mbe nto' Nyúè.
English: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè boo ñkúú, a be keèe fúr woweèe embo, maè' aè dïì' ce ku ba ba túè'nji, ce beèe a ce warse ce kúr msoèñ aèfo.”
English: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ñwáè ñgoèr anaè enáê, “Duè, yi be kuè ba aèmboè wáè byemi ená yi be ba naè.” Yïì ñwáè rfaè' aè m ku ke'se aè nfeè' anaè.
English: Jesus said to the centurion, Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed. His servant was healed in that hour.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' duè mbe ndaèp mbe Pitaè, a yá aèmboè malu yïì Pitaè noèñ, tu yi ce luu ye.
English: When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying sick with a fever.

Limbum: Jisoès aè joo bo ese ye, tu anaè yi tetïì, e natïì mbekïì, a fár buu neè ye.
English: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr, beèe a vú neè beèe magoèr ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m ba njep woweèe. Jisoès aè laêa, byú' bbebep anaè vi fúú enjep woweèe, a ker gee beèe wááwá ce a m ce yañ a ke'seè.
English: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick;

Limbum: Ca yi m ba wa'a, tá yuu ce AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa yi bo ghááte njo. E m laèa enáê, “E m koo viseèe bsáè, a ker byá' viseèe byañ.”
English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá ená ku' beèe a sïìr ye, e laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená a woweèe a tuu neèñguu roè.
English: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

Limbum: Ñwáè ryá'ni mncir moè' aè vúê, a laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, wáè ka' ce duè ba fá, baná m be kuè ba fa wáâ mbuèu.”
English: A scribe came, and said to him, Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Bsïìi vi túr bto, bsiñ vi túr mndap, Muu Ñwáè aè ke' túr dïì' ce aède' e lá yi tu ka'.”
English: Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ce e m ba ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu foñ, aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, maè'shi tá m du tuñ yaè ta wáá.”
English: Another of his disciples said to him, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè fa máâ mbuèu, ma'shi tá bgúâú beèe a tuñ waêp bgúâú beèe.”
English: But Jesus said to him, Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa' wáá, a niñ mbe keñ, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du a yeâ mbuèu mbo.
English: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

Limbum: Ka' cu, ma fu' mo' yi ká' a ce caèa aè rdip anaè, mdip mi ce ko' mbekïì, a ce niñ mbe múè keñ, Jisoès aè ce buumi yi yu.
English: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a duê, a yáá ye, a laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, jaè' weèr, seèe aè kwe.”
English: They came to him, and woke him up, saying, Save us, Lord! We are dying!

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce wáp ba ká wa'a? Le rbyemïì li yu múcaèr seê.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a nati mbekïì, a waa fu' ba rdip, ñgoèñ yi táá nyañ.
English: He said to them, Why are you fearful, O you of little faith? Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

Limbum: Woweèe a bááñgeèr seê, a laa enáê, “Njáèá ñwáè ca yu ba njáèá ñwáâ ká, ce ená fu' yi yu'ni neè ye, rdip li yu'nïì neè ye foñ?”
English: The men marveled, saying, What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' tuu neèñguu roè, ba seè'ni ba aè ñgoèñ beèe Gáèrasaè, a yá beèe a mmbaa ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m ba njep woweèe, aèmboè a ce vúè efa dïì' ce a m ce tuñ beèe. Woweèe a m ce fa ñgá' se aèmboè mñgaèa-baa wa', ñwáè aè ker ce baèp njep nduunjïì ce yi m caèa aè dïì' anaè ka'.
English: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

Limbum: Woweèe a waa, a laa enáê, “Muu Nyúè, yuu ce seèe túr a ká? Wáè vúè aèfa aè rfa weèr ñgá' tá nfeè' ka' keèe gháá a?”
English: Behold, they cried out, saying, What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?

Limbum: Kúr ñkuânyaèm mo' goèr seê, yi m ba aèfo a ce yeñger, a ba aè njïìsaèp ka'.
English: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

Limbum: Byú' mnyúâmkaè' anaè vi bu' mmbo neè Jisoès, a laa enáê, “Wáè ka' ce fúr weèr, aè laa tá weèr du niñ njep kúr ñkuânyaèm ca.”
English: The demons begged him, saying, If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.

Limbum: E laa neè vi enáê, “Duè neè.” Byú' anaè vi fúú a du a niñ njep ñkuânyaèm anaè, kúr ñkuânyaèm anaè wááwá yi káátïì a cañ a du mbaè baa, a gweñger njep roè, a no mdip a kweñger.
English: He said to them, Go! They came out, and went into the herd of pigs: and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea, and died in the water.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce cïìñ ñkuânyaèm ca a cañseè, a du aè laè', a suñ buu ca wááwá, a ker suñ yuu ce yi m koni neè beèe ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m ba njep woweèe naè.
English: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

Limbum: A ka' suñ, beèe wááwá aè rla' anaè a fúú, a du aè ryá Jisoès, a ka' yá ye, a bu' mmbo neè ye ená e lo efa yap ñgoèñ.
English: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

Limbum: Jisoès aè niñ mbe keñ, a ker tuu neèñguu roè, a du a ba' fa yeâ laè'.
English: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a vú neè ñwáè moè' ce yïì ñgúè' nyor moè' aè m kwe, e noñ mbe keèñ. Jisoès aè ka' yá lap rbyemïì, a laa neè ñwáè ce yïì ñgúè' nyor moè' aè m kwe naè enáê, “Kur ntee muu waè, máè foèosi wáè efa yoè buu bbebep.”
English: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, beèe mo' efa múè ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a laa fa waâp mú enáê, “Ñwáè ca ce bepsi rlii Nyúè.”
English: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, This man blasphemes.

Limbum: Jisoès aè riñ yuu ce woweèe a m ce kwaè'shi, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce kwaè'shi njáèá buu bbebep ca wa' njoká?
English: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, Why do you think evil in your hearts?

Limbum: Yuu ce yi yu aètáèr yu ba yïû fá? Yu ba aè rlaèa ená, ‘Máè foèosi wáè efa yoè buu bbebep’, káè aè rlaèa ená, ‘Loè mbekïì, jáêr’?
English: For which is easier, to say, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Get up, and walk?'

Limbum: Baná aè rgeèe tá weèe bo rïìñ ená Muu Ñwáè túr ñger njep ñgoèñ aè rfoèosi beèe efa yaèp buu bbebep.” E laa neè ñwáè yañ ca enáê, “Naèti mbekïì, lor yo keèñ, du aè laè'.”
English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins... then he said to the paralytic, Get up, and take up your mat, and go up to your house.

Limbum: E natïì mbekïì, a du aè laè'.
English: He arose and departed to his house.

Limbum: Beèe a ka' yá ca, a wáp seê, a yoñshi Nyúè aè njáèá ñger ce e fa neè beèe naè.
English: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' loè embo ce duè, a yá ñwáè moè' ce a m ce too ená Matïìyoè aèmboè e cu mbe dïì' rfaè' ce e m ce koo mbaèa baèraè'. E laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè fa máâ mbuèu.” Matïìyoè aè ku nati a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, Follow me. He got up and followed him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m duè a cu mbe ndaèp mbe Matïìyoè, a ce yeñger. Ku' ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè', ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep a vúê, a cute, a ce yeñger a Jisoès ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe.
English: It happened as he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' yá, a laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Yeè ñwáè ryá'nïì ce ye buu a ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè', ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep njoká?”
English: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu', a laa enáê, “Beèe ce a ke roèo ñwáè mcáèp e ke ba ñgaâa byañ, ke' ba beâe btatap ka'.
English: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

Limbum: Duè neè du fyá', yá ka ená yuu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi ce laèa enáê, ‘Yuu ce m ce koèñ yu ñkoosimnse, ke' ba ba tañshïì ka'’ naè, yi yu ba ená ká lá? Máè vúè aè rká' beâe byáánïì ka'. Máè vúè aè rká' ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep.”
English: But you go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu vïû Joân, a vúê, a yá ye a bipshi enáê, “Weèr beèe Farïìsi weèe e ke jïì mdip, geewa'a ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu a ce jïì yap ka' njoká?”
English: Then John's disciples came to him, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don't fast?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “AÈde' beèe ce a duè aè ñkaâ' bguèu, a ba aè nduu-guèu weèe ker ce koosimnse aè njáâá ká? Geewa'a, nfeè' moè' be ba ce a be koo nduu- guèu ese woweèe, tá woweèe a ka' koosimnse aè nfeè' anaè.
English: Jesus said to them, Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè saa cáâ' fi, tar mbenduè yïû rúèú ka'. E ka' gee wa'a, baná cáâ' fi ca yi be saèa yïû rúèú tá toto raa caèa yïì entoèmbïì naè.
English: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè lor mruâ' mfi foñ lá njep mñguèp mruè' vïû brúèú ka'. E ka' gee wa'a baná mruâ' mfi anaè mi be loè koo, to'shi mñguèp mruè' anaè, tá mruè' mi kúte aè nsheè, tá mñguèp mruè' anaè vi bú aè cicïì. Yi ke ba ená a lá mruâ' mfi ba njep mñguèp mruè' vïû bfi tá mi bo kúète ka', tá mñguèp mruè' vi to'ñger ka'.”
English: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce laèa buu ca neè woweèe, ñwáâ ñgoèr moè' embe ndaèp rloo aè vúê, a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi, a laa enáê, “Muu waè aè ku kwe seè'ni seè'ni na. Ka' yi yu wa'a, vúè la' mo mmbo mbe yeâ nduèu tá e bo kúti nteèe.”
English: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.

Limbum: Jisoès aè natïì a du a yeâ mbuèu a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe.
English: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' ce e m cu mbe kuèu aè bfeè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, aè vú njïì embe yeâ njïì, a joo mcúèñcúñ cáè' ese ye.
English: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

Limbum: E m laèa neè yïì nyor enáê, “M ka' ku joo ba yi cuèu cáè', m ku ke'se.”
English: for she said within herself, If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.

Limbum: Jisoès aè karsïì nyor, a yá ye, a laa neè ye enáê, “Muu waè, kur ntee, lo rbyemïì li geèe wáè ke'seè.” Njeñwáè anaè aè ku ke'se aè nfeè' anaè.
English: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well. And the woman was made well from that hour.

Limbum: Jisoès aè duê, a ba' mbe ndaèp ñwáâ ñgoèr ca a yá aèmboè ñgaâa mndoñ a ce fyáp mndoñ, beèe a ce warse seê.
English: When Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,

Limbum: E laa enáê, “Duè neè, muunje ca aè kwe kwe ka', e ce buumi buumi.” E ka' laèa wa'a, woweèe a vúshïì ye.
English: he said to them, Make room, because the girl isn't dead, but sleeping. They were ridiculing him.

Limbum: A ka' fúr beèe anaè embe ndaèp, e niñ mbo, a koo muunje anaè aè boè, e natïì mbekïì.
English: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

Limbum: Nsuñ kuu yuu ce Jisoès aè m geèe na aè du aè bdïì' wááwá aè ñgoèñ anaè.
English: The report of this went out into all that land.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' loè embo ce duè, mmbañruè mo' beèe a mbaa ce a m ba mnfeèp, a natïì, a du a yeâ mbuèu a ce waa enáê, “Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè weèr.”
English: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, Have mercy on us, son of David!

Limbum: E ka' niñ mbe ndaèp, mmbañruè ca a vú a yá ye. E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè byemi ená aède' m gee weèe yá buu a?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “ÁÈno, Tataê.”
English: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, Do you believe that I am able to do this? They told him, Yes, Lord.

Limbum: A ka' beèesi wa'a, e joo map mmir neè mmbo, a laa enáê, “Tá yi ku ba neè weèe aèmboè weèe aè byemi ená yi be ba naè.”
English: Then he touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it done to you.

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce yá buu. E laa neè woweèe tatap se enáê, “Weèe fa geèe tá ñwáè moè' riñ ka'.”
English: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, See that no one knows about this.

Limbum: Woweèe a nati a du a du a suñ yap yu yuu ce Jisoès aè m geèe neè woweèe naè aè bdïì' wááwá aè ñgoèñ anaè.
English: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

Limbum: Jisoès weèe a ka' naèti ce duè, beèe a vú neè ñwáè moè' ce e m ba lúr, yú' nyúèrkaè' yi ba njep ye.
English: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' fúr yú' nyúèrkaè' anaè, ñwáè anaè aè ká' a ce laèa. Beèe ce a m ba aèfo a bááñgeèr seê, a laa enáê, “Njáèá yuu ca yi m be koni aè ñgoèñ Isráèl ka'.”
English: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a laa yap enáê, “E ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe ba aè ñger ñkúú mnyúâmkaè'.”
English: But the Pharisees said, By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m jáèr aè mla' mñgoèrñgoèr ba aè mla' mñká'ñká' a ce yá'ni beèe aè wap mndap mloo, a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè, a ce geèe beèe ce a m ce yañ byañ njáèá jáá jáèá jáá, a ce keè'se.
English: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

Limbum: E ka' ce yá ku' beèe, nse yi koo ye neè woweèe, njobeè' woweèe a m jep, a riñ yuu ce a ce geèe ka', aèmboè njeèe ce yi buu ñwáè ncïìñ njeèe wa'a.
English: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

Limbum: E laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Buu aè bi aè mñkúè goèr, ñgaâa rkep a ba múcaèr.
English: Then he said to his disciples, The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

Limbum: Baná weèe loo neè Taèr ce e túr ñkúè ená e tuusi ñgaâa mfaè' tá a du kep yïì buu efa mñkúè.”
English: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ká' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, a fa woweèe ñger ená woweèe a ce fúr byú' bbebep enjep beèe, ker gee tá beèe ce a ce yañ byañ njáèá jáá jáèá jáá a ke'se.
English: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

Limbum: A mlii ñgaâa ntuu ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú anaè na: Ñwáè entombïì aè m ba Saimúèn ce a ce too ená Pitaè, ba nfúr yïì ce Andruè, ba Jáêms, muu Sábáèdïî, ba nfúr yïì ce Joân,
English: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

Limbum: ba Feleêp, ba Baètoèlomïì, ba Tomaês, ba Matïìyoè ce e m ba ñwáè ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè', ba Jáêms, ce e m ba muu Alfïìyoès ba Taèdiyoès,
English: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

Limbum: ba Saimúèn ce e m ba moè' efa múè beèe Siloèt ba Judas IÌskarïìyoèt ce e m loè a fyeni Jisoès naè.
English: Simon the Canaanite; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m tuu beèe ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ca, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa duè aè ñgoâñ beèe enje jáá, káè aè mla' beâe aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè ka'.
English: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, Don't go among the Gentiles, and don't enter into any city of the Samaritans.

Limbum: Duè neè yá ba njeèe embe ndúè' Isráèl ce yi m bú naè.
English: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

Limbum: Weâe ce duè, weèe ce fe'shi weená kúú Nyúè embe buèu yi yu aètútú.
English: As you go, preach, saying, 'The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!'

Limbum: Geèe neè tá ñgaâa byañ a ke'se, gee tá beèe ce a kweñger a kúti bteèe, gee tá ñgaâa byañ msaèasïì a ke'se, raa, fúr neè byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe. Weèe aè m laè' a ka' koni ka', weâe geèe neè beèe wa'a, weèe fa koo blaè' ka'.
English: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

Limbum: Wee ce duè, ñwáè fa loèr mbaèa, ka' múcaèr áè, láè njep posaè tá e bo duè aègho ka'.
English: Don't take any gold, nor silver, nor brass in your money belts.

Limbum: Ñwáè fa loèr baèa káè bcáâ' bbaa, káè blaba' káè mbaèñ ka', njobeè' yi yu yáánïì ená a la' ñwáè rfaè'.
English: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

Limbum: “Weèe aè ka' niñ aè rla' rgoèr, káè aè rla' rká' áè, weèe fyá' ñwáè ce e yu ñwáè nyáánïì aèfo, cu weèe ñwáè anaè weèe caar tá yeè nfeè' ce weèe be loâ aè rla' anaè du gháá.”
English: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' niñ mbe ndaèp, weèe ca'nïì beèe embo.
English: As you enter into the household, greet it.

Limbum: Ndap anaè aè ka' ba ndap nyáánïì, weèe ma'shïì tá yeè cumúnyañ ba mbe ndaèp anaè. Ndap anaè aè ka' tá ba ndap nyáánïì ka', baná e bá bghoènïì anaè.
English: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn't worthy, let your peace return to you.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' tá koni weèe káè yu' yuu ce weèe be laèa ka', weèe ka' ce fúú embe ndaèp ñwáè anaè, káâ aè rla' anaè áè, weèe kashïì nfúènfú efa weâe mkuèu.
English: Whoever doesn't receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake off the dust from your feet.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená be keèe ba aè noâñ mnsa' tá ñgá' aè rla' Sodoèm ba Goèmoraè ba aèndeèe neè ñgá' aè rla' anaè.
English: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

Limbum: “Yáê, m ce tuu weèe tá weèe du ba aèmboè njeèe aè múè bkuura. Baná weèe feese aèmboè mnyo, ba neè rbornïì-ñwáè aèmboè bbeèñ.
English: Behold, I send you out as sheep in the midst of wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a be keèe baèa weèe njo' máè. Geewa'a, ñwáè ce e ka' táá tatap du ba' aè lúèsimbuèu, ñgaèñ be luèñ.
English: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

Limbum: A ka' fa weèe ñgá' aè rla' mo', weèe cañ du aè rla' mo' jáá. M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená weèe be jáèr aè mla' Isráèl wááwá ka', tá Muu Ñwáè vúê.
English: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man has come.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè ce a ce yá'ni ye caa yïì ñwáè ryá'nïì ka'. AÈde' ñwáè rfaè' caa yïì masaè ka'.
English: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

Limbum: Ka' nyúè'tu ce yi yu mbe weâe tuè, a beè' wááwá.
English: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

Limbum: Baná weèe fa wáp ka'. Weèe luèu ntaa aè bsii Nyúè a caa bbe' aèñgoo.
English: Therefore don't be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' suñ aè bsii beèe ená e yu yaè ñwáè baná má máè foñ be suñ aè bsii yaè Ta embe buèu ená e yu yaè ñwáè.
English: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, him I will also confess before my Father who is in heaven.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' máñni máè aè bsii beèe baná má máè foñ be máñni ye aè bsii yaè Ta embe buèu foñ.
English: But whoever denies me before men, him I will also deny before my Father who is in heaven.

Limbum: “Weèe fa ce kwaè'shi ená máè m vúè ba neè cumúnyañ njep ñgoèñ na ka'. Máè m vúè ba neè cumúnyañ ka'. Máè m vúè ba neè kaèafaè'.
English: Don't think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn't come to send peace, but a sword.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' fa ncep neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce ncoèp-ba-aè-rúèú mïìsi, a lo embo, a du a ce yá'ni a ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè aè mlaâ' aè ñgoèñ anaè.
English: It happened that when Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

Limbum: Joân aè m ba mbe shañ. A ka' yu' mfaè' ce Kraâis aè m ce geèe, a tuu ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená,
English: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

Limbum: a du bipshi neè ye enáê, “A wáè ñwáè ce yi m ba ená e be vúè naè káè weèr cu ce ke' ba ñwáâ jáá?”
English: and said to him, Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Kúti neè du suñ Joân buu ce weèe aè yu' a ker yá.
English: Jesus answered them, Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

Limbum: Beèe ce a feèp a ce yá buu, mntáèñ a ce jáèshi yáánïì, ñgaâa msaèasïì a ce keè'se, ce ba brara, mnfuñtuè' a ce yu' buu, beèe ce a kweñger a ce kúti bteèe, ñgaâa fuèp a ce suñ Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ.
English: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

Limbum: Rboâñtu li yu neè ñwáè ce e ce tarni máè tarni ka'.”
English: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Joân a ka' naèti ce duè, Jisoès aè ká' a ce suñ ku' kúr beèe ca buu kuu Joân. E m laèa enáê, “Weèe aè m fúú a du aè ntee rïìñ ba aè ryá ká? Weèe aè m duè aè ryá aèmboè fu' yi ce cïì' ñke' a?
English: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

Limbum: Yi ka' tá ba wa' ka' baná weèe aè m duè aè ryá ká? Weèe aè m duè aè ryá ñwáè ce e suèsi nyor neè bcáè' yoèo, a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Beèe ce a ke suèsi nyor neè bcáâ' yoèo, a ke cu ba aè mnto'.
English: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in king's houses.

Limbum: Baná weèe aè m fúú a du ba aè ryá ká seê? Weèe aè m duè ba aè ryá ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè a? ÁÈno, m ce suñ weèe máná ñwáè ce weèe aè m yá anaè caèa ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

Limbum: E yu ñwáè ce a sañ aèmboè ye mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Yáê, m be tuu yaè ñwáè ntuu tá e du entombïì neè wáè, duè kupshi nduunjïì neè wáè.’
English: For this is he, of whom it is written, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.'

Limbum: “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè máná efa múè beèe wááwá ce bbyeèñge a bi, moè' a be caa Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe ka'. Geewa'a, ñwáè ce e yu yi múcaèr se mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè aè caèa ye.
English: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

Limbum: Ká' embe nfeè' Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe vú ba' seè'ni na, beèe a ce fa ñgá' neè kúú Nyúè, ñgaâa ñger a ce faèp kúú anaè.
English: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

Limbum: Mñwaè' ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè wááwá ba ñwaè' mncir vi m suñ aèmboè buu ce vi be ka' ba caar a ba' aè nfeè' yïì Joân.
English: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce koèñ aè rbyemïì, weèe riñ weená e yu AÈlajaè ce a m laèa ená e be keèe vúè naè.
English: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' túr btuè', ñgaèñ yu'.
English: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

Limbum: “Baná aède' m be'nïì beèe eluèuni na ba aè ká? Woweèe a yu aèmboè bghaèrbeèe ce a cute aè ntaa a ce ká' bghaèrbeèe mo', a ce laèa enáê,
English: But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a ká' a ce lapni mla' faèdïì' ce e m geèe ku' buu bghagha' naè, njobeè' beâe aèfo a m kupse a ma' yaèp buu bbebep ka'.
English: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn't repent.

Limbum: “Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce weèe yu beâe aè rla' Koèrasïìn! Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce weèe yu beâe aè rla' Báètsaidaè, njobeè' a m ba gee buu bghagha' ce a m geèe fa weâe mú naè ba aè rla' Tayaè ba aè rla' Sidoèn, beâe aèfo a m ba neè kupse e sese', a ma' bcáâ' njïì rkwe, a yo' bú aè nyoèr a cute aègho.
English: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Taèr, Tata ce aè túr rbuu ba nshe, m ce yoèñshi wáè njobeè' wáè súèti buu ca ese ñgaâa bfee ba beèe ce a rïìñ buu, a duñshi ba neè boo bká'.
English: At that time, Jesus answered, I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

Limbum: ÁÈno, Taèr, ca yu ba yuu ce wáè m ce yu' rboèñ aè rgeèe.
English: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

Limbum: “Yaè Ta aè fa buu wááwá mba máâ mmboè. Ñwáè moè' rïìñ muu caa efa Taèr ka', ñwáè moè' aè rïìñ Taèr caa efa muu ker ba beèe ce muu aè koèñ aè rduèñshi ye neè woweèe ka'.
English: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

Limbum: Vúè neè yá máè, weèe wááwá ce weèe ce faè' a byá' mntáèr vi ce rïìr weèe, tá m gee tá weèe lúshïî.
English: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nfeè' anaè Jisoès aè ce jáèr nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, a caa aè ñkúè msañ moè'. Njeè aè m ce yañ ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu. Woweèe a tee btu msañ a ce ye.
English: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' yá wa'a, a laa neè ye enáê, “Yáê, ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu a ce geèe yuu ce ncir yi byemi ená a gee nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè ka'.”
English: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè be be' yuu ce Dávïìd aè m geèe aè nfeè' ce njeè aè m ce yañ ye ker ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ba naè ka' a?
English: But he said to them, Haven't you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;

Limbum: E m duè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a lor bráâd ce a m fa neè Nyúè a ye, a fa bár neè beèe ce a woweèe a m ba. Ncir yi m byemi ená e ye ka', káè ená beèe ce e m ba a woweèe a ye foñ ka'. Beèe ce yi m ba ená a ye aè m ku ba ba ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì.
English: how he entered into the house of God, and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

Limbum: Mboè weèe aè be be' foñ mbe ñwaè' mncir ená ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì embe Ndaèp Nyúè a ke bú' ncir mmbomntaa Nyúè ke' ba faèa neè woweèe ka' a?
English: Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbath day, the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are guiltless?

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná yuu mo' ce yi caèa Nyúè yi yu mbena.
English: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

Limbum: Weèe aè m ba riñ mbuèu efa blaèa ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, ‘Yuu ce m ce koèñ yu ñkoosimnse, ke' ba tañshïì ka'’ naè, weèe aè m ba laèa weená ñwáè ce e geèe yuu bebep ka' yu ñwáè mbembep ka'.
English: But if you had known what this means, 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' you would not have condemned the guiltless.

Limbum: Yi yu ená Muu Ñwáè yu Taèr ce e túr mmbomntaa Nyúè.”
English: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

Limbum: E m loè embo, a du a niñ mbe yaèp ndap rloo.
English: He departed there, and went into their synagogue.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba mbo ce li rkoo mo' li m kwe. Beèe mo' ce a m ba mbo a bipshïì neè Jisoès enáê, “Waè' ncir yi byemi ená a gee tá ñwáè ke'se nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè a?” Woweèe a m bipshi wa'a ená e ka' faa nlaèa tá woweèe a bo sa' ye ená e bú' ncir.
English: And behold there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day? that they might accuse him.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yu nda efa weâe mú ce e ka' túr njeèe, e gwe njep beè'teè nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, e ke' koo enjo, fúr mbe ñkúè ka'?
English: He said to them, What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won't he grab on to it, and lift it out?

Limbum: Ñwáè aè luèu ntaa a caa njeèe. Baná ncir yi byemi ená ñwáè gee yuu boèñboñ nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè.”
English: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a laa neè ñwáè ce li rkoo li m kwe naè enáê, “Maè' lo rkoo kuèyáá.” E ma', li kútïì rboèñboñ, a ba aèmboè lïì ce li m kwe yi ka' naè.
English: Then he told the man, Stretch out your hand. He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a fúú njepmbeè a cu mcúè, a seesi aèmboè a be koo Jisoès yú.
English: But the Pharisees went out, and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' rïìñ ená a ce cu mcúè tá a bo yú ye, a loâ aèfo. Beèe magoèr a m duè a yeâ mbuèu, e gee beèe wááwá ce a m ce yañ a ke'seè.
English: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe ená a fa duè suñ beèe ená e yu Muu Nyúè ka'.
English: and commanded them that they should not make him known:

Limbum: Ca yi m ba wa' tá yuu ce AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa, yi bo ghááte njo.
English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Yáê, yaè ñwáè rfaè' ce máè ce, ñwáè ce máè koèñ seê, a ce yu' rboèñ neè ye. M be suèusi ya yú' mbe yeâ nduè tá e suñ aèmboè la rsa' neè beèe enje jáá.
English: Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

Limbum: Beèe a m vúè neè ñwáè moè' ce e m feèp, a ba lúr, yú' nyúèrkaè' yi ba njep ye. Jisoès aè gee e ke'seè, a ká' a ce laèa, a ce yá buu foñ.
English: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m báèáñger seê, a laa enáê, “Waè' ñwáè ca yu Muu Dávïìd a?”
English: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, Can this be the son of David?

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' yu' wa'a, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe ba aè ñger Básábuèl ce e yu ñkúú mnyúâmkaè'.”
English: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ku riñ yuu ce woweèe a ce kwaè'shi, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “To' yi ka' gapni, ke' ba cuâu mo'sir ka' baná to' anaè yi be saè'ñger, gweè. Rla' li ka' gapni, ke' ba cuâu mo'sir ka', ndap gapnïì, ke' ba cuâu mo'sir ka' baná aède' rla' anaè li táá ka', ndap anaè táá ka' foñ.
English: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

Limbum: Sataèn ka' ce fúr Sataèn enjep beèe baná ñgaèpni yi yu nje nyoèr Sataèn. Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná aède' yi to' yi ka' táá aè njáâá ká?
English: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

Limbum: M ka' ba ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' anaè ba aè ñger Básábuèl, baná beèe wee a ce fúr yap byú' anaè enjep beèe ba aè ñger nda? Baná be kuè sa' ba yeè beèe sa' weèe.
English: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

Limbum: M ka' ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe ba aè ñger Yú' Nyúè baná kúú Nyúè yi vúè neè weèe.
English: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come upon you.

Limbum: Yi yu ená aède' ñwáè niñ mbe ndaèp ñwáè ñger kwá' yïì buu du aègho ka', ce ka' tá ba ená e ba ká' a kur ñwáè anaè wáá, ka' niñ mbo kwáè' yïì buu, duè aègho ka'?
English: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' tá ba weèr ye ka', baná ñgaèñ yu yaè ñwáè bbaèa. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá ce baashi weèr ye ka', baná ñgaèñ ce da'si da'si.
English: He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn't gather with me, scatters.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu boo bfïî, aède' weèe ce weèe yu beâe bbebep, laa yuu boèñboñ aè njáâá ká? Yi yu wa' njobeè' ñwáè e ke laèa ba efa ku' buu ce vi ruu njep yeâ ntee.
English: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

Limbum: Ñwáâ mboèñmboñ e ke fúr buu bboèñboñ efa buu bboèñboñ ce vi yu njep yeâ ntee, ñwáâ mbembep fúr buu bbebep efa buu bbebep ce vi yu njep yeâ ntee.
English: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná be keèe ba aè noâñ mnsa' tá beèe a laa yuu kuèu blaèa bcicïì wááwá ce woweèe a m laèa,
English: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

Limbum: njobeè' wo blaèa vi be keèe fúr wáè efa mnsa' tá wo blaèa vi gee tá aè gwe mnsa'.”
English: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba beèe Farïìsi a laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, weèr ce koèñ werná aè duñshi ncoèo moè' tá weèr yá.”
English: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.

Limbum: E beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñgúè beèe ce a yu ñgaâa bsaèrbuu, a ba mini neè Nyúè ka' na a ce laèa ená m duñshi woweèe ncoèo. M be duèñshi woweèe ncoèo moè' caa efa ncoèo yïì Jonaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ka'.
English: But he answered them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

Limbum: AÈmboè Jonaè aè m cu njep rbúâ nca ce e m kuè' seê, aè mnoâñ btaar naè, Muu Ñwáè ye ye be cu njep múè nshe aè mnoâñ btaar.
English: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

Limbum: Beâe aè rla' Nenávïì a be keèe táá aè noèñ mnsa' a ñgúè beèe yïû seè'ni na, laèa ená woweèe a geèe yuu bebep njobeè' Jonaè aè m feè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè woweèe, woweèe a kupseè a ma' yaèp buu bbebep. Yá neè, yuu mo' yi yu mbena seè'ni na ce yi caèa Jonaè.
English: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ce e m ce sa' to' embaè mbuèu-ñgoèñ be keèe naèti táá mbekïì aè noèñ mnsa', laèa ená ñgúè beèe e seè'ni na a geèe yuu bebep, njobeè' e m vúè yi ba aè njïìsaèp seê, aè ryu' blaâa bfee ce Solomúèn aè m ce laèa. Yá neè, yuu mo' yi yu mbena seè'ni na ce yi caèa Solomúèn.
English: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

Limbum: “Yú' bebep yi ke fúú enjep ñwáè kashi aè ñgoâñ yuur aè rroèo dïû' rlúèshïì. Yi ka' roo yá ka',
English: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn't find it.

Limbum: yi laa enáê, ‘M be kúti mbe ndaèp ce máè m fúú embo naè.’ Yi ce kúti, yá ndap anaè ba mboèmmbo, a yáêr, kupshi, e ce raa.
English: Then he says, 'I will return into my house from which I came out,' and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

Limbum: Yi yá wa'a, ker du vú neè byú' mmo' vi saèambaê, ce vi bep a caa yi, a woweèe a niñ cu mbo, ñgaèñ misi bep caa aèmboè e m ba entombïì. A mboè yi be keèe ba neè ñgúè beâe bbebep e seè'ni wa'a.”
English: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kuè bii ce laèa neè beèe, yïì ma ba bfúr vi a vúê, a táá njepmbeè a ce koèñ aè rlaèa yuu neè ye.
English: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè laa neè ye enáê, “Yáê, yoè ma ba bfúr wo a táá njepmbeè a ce roèo aè ryá wáè.”
English: One said to him, Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.

Limbum: E beesïì a laa neè ñwáè anaè enáê, “Yaè ma yu nda, bfúr wa aè ba weèe ká?”
English: But he answered him who spoke to him, Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?

Limbum: E naa yi bo a duñshi ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu aègho, a laa enáê, “Yáê, a yaè ma ba bfúr wa na.
English: He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said, Behold, my mother and my brothers!

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' gee yuu ce yaè Ta ce e yu mbe buèu ce koèñ, baná ñgaèñ yu nfúraè, a ba njar yaè, a ba yaè maê.”
English: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m fúú embe Ndaèp Nyúè anaè a du a cu aèwaâa roè.
English: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.

Limbum: Ku' beèe a vúê, a sir ye a tarte, e niñ mbe keñ a cu mbo, beèe anaè a táá nje waâa túè.
English: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.

Limbum: E suñ woweèe buu magoèr aè mñgaèa. E m laèa enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè m duè aè rbyeè buu,
English: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

Limbum: a ka' ce byeè, ñgúè buu moè' aè gweñgeèr aèwaâa nduunjïì, bsiñ vi vúê, a ye.
English: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu moè' aè gweñgeèr yi ba mbenduè nshe ce e m ba mbenduè ryáá. Ñgúè buu anaè aè yañseè a fúú njobeè' nshe e mbenduè ryáá anaè aè m ba goèr ka'.
English: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn't have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' sañ, a too ñgúè buu anaè, e yoprïì njobeè' mñgaèñ vi m niñ njep nshe boèñboñ ka'.
English: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu moè' aè m gweèñger aè múè msini, msini mi ku', a kur.
English: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu moè' aè gweñgeèr mbe nshe mboèñmboñ, a fúú, a gee mbúè, moè' aè gee mbúè rjeèe, moè' mntuunfu, moè' mntaar.
English: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e túr btuè', ñgaèñ yu'.”
English: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ko'shïì a yeâ geñ a bipshi neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce suñ buu neè beèe ba aè mñgaèa njoká?”
English: The disciples came, and said to him, Why do you speak to them in parables?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Buu ce aède' beèe a riñ kuu kúú Nyúè ka' na, Nyúè aè geèe weèe aè rïîñ. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè woweèe, Nyúè aè geèe woweèe a riñ ka'.
English: He answered them, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' túr yuu, baná a be keèr fa ye buu moè', tá e misi túr buu goèr. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá túr yuu ka', baná a be koo, ka' mú yïì ce e túr naè ese ye.
