English: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn't have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce suñ buu neè woweèe ba aè mñgaèa. M ce geèe wa'a tá woweèe a ce keè' ce yá ka', a ce yu'shi, ce yu' ka', a riñ buu foñ ka'.
English: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don't see, and hearing, they don't hear, neither do they understand.

Limbum: Woweèe a geèe yuu ce AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa naè yi ghááteè njo. E m laèa enáê, ‘Beèe ca a be ce yu', ce rïìñ yuu ce woweèe a ce yu' anaè ka'. Woweèe a be ce yá, ce rïìñ yuu ce a ce yá anaè ka',
English: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, 'By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:

Limbum: njobeè' ntee yi yini woweèe, woweèe a riñ buu ka'. Woweèe a kani aè ryu' buu, a cete map mmir faè dïì' woweèe a bo yá buu neè map mmir, yu' buu neè wap btuè', rïìñ buu, beèeñger vúè yá máè tá m gee tá woweèe a luñ ka'.’
English: for this people's heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and should turn again; and I would heal them.'

Limbum: Mboâñtu mi yu yi neè weèe njobeè' me mmir mi ce yá buu, wee btuè' vi ce yu' buu.
English: But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweñger aèwaâa nduunjïì táá aètu ñwáè ce e m yu' yuu ce a ce laèa aèmboè kúú Nyúè, a ke' yu' ka', Sataèn aè vú a fúr yuu anaè enjep yeâ ntee.
English: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn't understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger yi ba mbe nshe e mbenduè ryáá naè táá aètu ñwáè ce e yu' blaâa Nyúè ku yu' rboèñ aègho seê,
English: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;

Limbum: blaèa anaè vi ke' taa mñgaèñ njep ye ka', ku cu ba aè nfeè' múcaèr. E ba aè nfeè' ce beèe a ce fa ye ñgá', káè buu vi ba btatap neè ye njo' blaèa anaè, e ku kúti njïìnjïì.
English: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger aè múè msini naè, táá aètu beèe ce a yu' blaâa Nyúè, ku byemi, mluè ce aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na, ba broñ buu, vi kur blaèa anaè, yi gee ñgúè ka'.
English: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger yi ba mbe nshe mboèñmboñ naè táá aètu ñwáè ce e yu' blaâa Nyúè, yu' boèñboñ seê, gee ñgúè, moè' ba rjeèe, moè' ba mntuunfu, moè' ba mntaar.”
English: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and brings forth, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker ma' ñgaèa moè' neè woweèe enáê, “Kúú Nyúè embe buèu yi yu aèmboè ñwáè ce e m byeè ñgúè buu bboèñboñ aè mñkúè.
English: He set another parable before them, saying, The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

Limbum: Beèe a ka' ce buumi, yïì ñwáè bbaèa aè vú a bye ñke' aè múè msañ ce ñgaèñ aè m byeè, a du yi yu.
English: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

Limbum: Msañ mi ka' kuè', buèr, ñke' caè yi yáátïì seè'ni aè ñke'.
English: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

Limbum: Ñgaâa mfaè' aè vúê, a laa neè ñwáè ñkúè ca enáê, ‘Masaè, mboè wáè m byeè ñgúè buu bboèñboñ a wáâ ñkúè a? Ñke' yi ka' lo yi ba efá?’
English: The servants of the householder came and said to him, 'Sir, didn't you sow good seed in your field? Where did this darnel come from?'

Limbum: E beesïì neè woweèe enáê, ‘Yuu ca aè geèe yaè ñwáè bbaèa moè'.’ Ñgaâa mfaè' a laa neè ye enáê, ‘AÈ ce koèñ wáná weèr du co'ni ñke' anaè a?’
English: He said to them, 'An enemy has done this.' The servants asked him, 'Do you want us to go and gather them up?'

Limbum: E laa enáê, ‘Máè kani. Weèe aè ka' ce co'ni ñke' anaè, seemoè' weèe co'nïì msañ aè múè mo.
English: But he said, 'No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker ma' ñgaèa moè' neè woweèe enáê, “Kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè ñgúè mostaè ce ñwáè aè m loèr a bye fa yeâ ñkúè.
English: He set another parable before them, saying, The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;

Limbum: Ñgúè mostaè ca ñwáási a caa ñgúè buu wááwá. Ka' yi yu wa'a, a ke byeè, e ku' caa buu wááwá ce a byeè aè mñkúè, ba seè'ni ba aè ce, bsiñ vi vú ba'ri mndap aè mnta' efa gho.”
English: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.

Limbum: E m ker ma' ñgaèa moè' neè woweèe enáê, “Kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè yis ce njeñwáè aè m loèr, a fe' mkúâñ bráâd mñkaâa btaar, a top aègho caar mkúèñ anaè mi ko'.”
English: He spoke another parable to them. The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m suñ buu ca wááwá neè beèe ce a m ba a woweèe, a ma' ba aè mñgaèa. Yuu mo' yi yu ce e m laèa neè woweèe a buu efa rmaè' ba aè ñgaèa ka'.
English: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn't speak to them,

Limbum: E m geèe wa'a tá yuu ce ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa, yi bo ghááte njo. E m laèa enáê, “M be múè' ya cuèu, maè' mñgaèa. M be suñ buu ce Nyúè aè m súèti ese beèe káâ' aè nfeè' ce e m geèe ñgoèñ.”
English: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa' mïìsi, a ma'shi beèe caè, a niñ mbe ndaèp. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du a yá ye mbo, a laa neè ye enáê, “Suñ ka weèr mbuèu efa ñgaèa ñke' ce yi m kuè' aè múè msañ naè.”
English: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè ce e m byeè ñgúè buu bboèñboñ naè a Muu Ñwáè,
English: He answered them, He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

Limbum: ñkúè aè ba ñgoèñ ca, ñgúè buu bboèñboñ aè ba beèe ce Nyúè yu yaèp ñkúú, ñke' aè ba beèe ce a yu beèe Sataèn.
English: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

Limbum: Ñwáè bbaèa ce e m byeè yi ba ñke' naè aè ba Sataèn. Nfeè' ntee msañ yu nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi ce mïì, ñgaâa rtee a ba bcïìndap Nyúè.
English: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

Limbum: AÈmboè a ke baashi ñke' too neè mor naè, yi be keèe ba wa'a aè nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi ce mïì.
English: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

Limbum: Muu Ñwáè be keèe tuu vi bcïìndap tá woweèe a baashi buu ce vi ke geèe beèe a ce geèe buu bbebep, ker ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep wááwá embe dïì' yi kúú,
English: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,

Limbum: maè' njep mor ce beèe a be keèe ce warse ce kúr msoèñ njo.
English: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

Limbum: A ce maè' woweèe njo wa'a tá beèe ce a yu byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè a sañ aèmboè nyúè wa' mbe dïì' kúú yaèp taê. Ñwáè ce e ka' túr btuè', ñgaèñ yu'.
English: Then the righteous will shine forth like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

Limbum: “Kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè yuu boèñboñ ce a súèti aè mñkúè, ñwáè moè' aè ka' vúè yá, a lor a súti foñ, a lu'shi seê, a duê, a fyeni yïì buu wááwá a yuu ñkúè anaè.
English: Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

Limbum: Kùù Nyùè yi yu foñ aèmboè fwàé rntaa ce e m ce roko sibañ.
English: Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls.

Limbum: a ka' yá mo' ce e luèu ntaa seê, a du a fyeni yïì buu wááwá a yuu aègho.
English: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

Limbum: “Kúú Nyúè yi yu foñ aèmboè rraa ce a m maè' njep roè, a koo nca njo njáèá jáá jáèá jáá.
English: Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Waè' weèe aè yu' buu ca wááwá a?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “ÁÈno.”
English: Jesus said to them, Have you understood all these things? They answered him, Yes, Lord.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir wááwá ce a yá'ni buu kúú Nyúè, a yu aèmboè ñwáè ndap ce e fúr buu bfi ba buu brúèú embe dïì' ce e ke láè yïì buu.”
English: He said to them, Therefore, every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' maè' mñgaèa ca neè woweèe mïìsi, a loâ aèfo,
English: It happened that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

Limbum: a duè fa yeâ laè', a yá'ni beâe aèfo mbe yaèp ndap rloo, woweèe a bááñgeèr seê, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè geèe bfee ca ba efá, a koni ñger aè rgeèe buu bghagha' ca ba efá?
English: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?

Limbum: Mboè ñwáè ca yu muu kapintaè caè a? Mboè a too yïì ma ená Máèári a? Mboè bfúr vi aè ba Jáms ba Josáèf, ba Saimúèn ba Judaès a?
English: Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

Limbum: Mboè bjar vi wááwá a ce cu aèfa seèe woweèe a? Baná ñwáè ca aè geèe bfee ca ba ñger ca efá?”
English: Aren't all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?

Limbum: A ka' laèa wa'a, a kanïì ye. Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “A ke yu'ni neè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè bdïì' bsïìp, geewa'a beèe efa yeâ laè' ba beèe embe yeâ ndaèp a ke yu'ni neè ye ka'.”
English: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.

Limbum: E m geèe buu bghagha' aèfo goèr ka' njobeè' woweèe a m byemi neè ye ka'.
English: He didn't do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Hároèd ce e m ce sa' aè ñgoâñ Galeèle aè yu' nsuñ Jisoès,
English: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

Limbum: a laa neè beèe ce a m ce faè' neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè anaè yu Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe. E fúú efa rkwe. A mbuèu ce e túr ñger aè rgeèe njáèá buu bghagha' ca.”
English: and said to his servants, This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.

Limbum: Hároèd aè m koo Joân, a kur, a fa mbe shañ. Hároèd aè m fa ye mbe shañ aètu Háèrodïìyaè ce e m ba ñgwa nfúr yïì ce Feleêp.
English: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

Limbum: Joân aè m ba neè laa neè Hároèd enáê, “Ncir yi byemi ená aè fap ñgwa nfúroè, beesi aè yoè ka'.”
English: For John said to him, It is not lawful for you to have her.

Limbum: Ka' e m ce koèñ aè ryú Joân wa'a, geewa'a njïì yi buêu, njobeè' beèe anaè a m byemi ená Joân yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

Limbum: E m geèe ñkaè' aè rkuushi noèñ ce a m bi ye, muu Háèrodïìyaè aè bii bii aè bsii beèe ce a m vúè ñkaè', nyor aè boñ ye seê,
English: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

Limbum: e ye leè', a ka' ená e be fa ye yuu ce e ka' laa ená e fa ye.
English: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

Limbum: E du a yá yïì maê, yïì ma aè suñ ye yuu ce e geêe. E vúê, a laa enáê, “Fa tu Joân njep kañ seè'ni na.”
English: She, being prompted by her mother, said, Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.

Limbum: Mluè mi koo ñkúú seê, aè ka' ba njobeè' e m ye leè' aè bsii beèe ce a m vúè ñkaè' ca, e laa ená a fa yuu ce e laèa ená a fa neè ye naè.
English: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

Limbum: E m tuu bsoogáè mbe shañ, woweèe a du a tee tu ese Joân,
English: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

Limbum: a vú aègho njep kañ a fa neè muu anaè, e du aègho, a fa neè yïì maê.
English: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Joân a ka' yu' wa'a, a duê, a lor gúèú a tuñ, a du a suñ Jisoès.
English: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kuè yu' yuu ce yi koni, a loâ faèdïì' ce e m ba, a niñ mbe keñ, a du faè dïì' mo' ce ñwáè moè' aè m ker ba aèfo caa efa ye ka'. Beèe a ka' yu', a fúúse efa mla' wááwá, a jár neè mkuèu, a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' duè fúú nje waâa roè, a yá ku' beèe, a koosimnse neè woweèe, a gee beèe efa waâp mú ce a m ce yañ, a ke'seè.
English: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' coo, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du a yá ye, a laa neè ye enáê, “Seèe yu aènjïìsaèp efa mla', nyúè aè ce coo. Laèa tá beèe ca a duse aè mlaè' tá a bo duè yuu byee, ye.”
English: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Mbuèu moè' yu aègho neè woweèe aè rduè ka'. Fa neè woweèe yuu tá a ye.”
English: But Jesus said to them, They don't need to go away. You give them something to eat.

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Yuu ce weèr túr ku ba bráâd taê, ba nca baa.”
English: They told him, We only have here five loaves and two fish.

Limbum: E laa enáê, “Vúè neè aègho fa neè máè.”
English: He said, Bring them here to me.

Limbum: E laa neè beèe ená a cute aè mjáá, a lor bráâd ta ba nca baa caè, a ke' mbe buèu, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi, a fa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a gapshïì neè beèe anaè.
English: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a ye a yu'. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a baashïì bbábá' ce vi m báti, vi ruu aè mñkaèa ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

Limbum: Mmbañruè wááwá ce a m ye, a m ba aèmboè beèe ncúèkïì taê, ka' lor bbyeèñge ba bghaèrbeèe.
English: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

Limbum: E m laèa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená woweèe a niñ mbe keñ, tuu neèñguu roè entombïì, tá e laasi beèe anaè.
English: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

Limbum: E ka' laèasi woweèe, a ko' mbe rtuèu mimñgi' aè rgeèe rloo. AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr e ku bii mbo mimñgi'.
English: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè keñ aè duè neè yi yu aènjïìsaèp seê, mdip mi ce ko' mbekïì ce suèu, a ce túú nyor nje keñ njobeè' fu' yi m ce caèa magoèr.
English: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú', e du a waâp mbuèu, a ce jáèr mbenduè rdip.
English: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yá aèmboè e ce jáèr mbenduè rdip, woweèe a wáp seê, a laa enáê, “Yu nyir”, a ka' laèa wa'a, a waa njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp.
English: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It's a ghost! and they cried out for fear.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ku laèa neè woweèe aè nfeè' anaè enáê, “Kur neè ntee, a máè. Weèe fa wáp ka'.”
English: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying Cheer up! It is I! Don't be afraid.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, ka' ba wáè, aè laa tá m jár mbenduè rdip vúè yá wáè.”
English: Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.

Limbum: E laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè.” Pitaè aè fúú embe keñ a jár mbenduè rdip a ce duè aè ryá Jisoès.
English: He said, Come! Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

Limbum: E ka' yá aèmboè fu' yi ce caèa neè ñger-ñwáè, a wáp, a ká' a ce suèu njep múè roè, a waa a laa enáê, “Tataê, jaè' máè.”
English: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, Lord, save me!

Limbum: Jisoès aè ku fa bo a koo ye aègho, a laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ yu ñwáè ce lo rbyemi li yu múcaèr. Wáè ba ce tarni njoká?”
English: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, You of little faith, why did you doubt?

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' niñ mbe keñ, fu' yi tetïì.
English: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ba yap mbe keñ naè, a gú'shïì neè ye, a laa enáê. “AÈ yu Muu Nyúè ghup.”
English: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, You are truly the Son of God!

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' tuu neèñguu roè wáá, a cúú keñ aèwaâa roè, a ba seè'ni ba aè ñgoâñ Gáènásaráèt.
English: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

Limbum: Beâe aèfo a ka' yá ye a rïîñ, a cep ntuu neè beèe ce a m ba aè mla' wááwá aè ñgoèñ anaè. Woweèe a vú neè beèe wááwá ce a m ce yañ,
English: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick,

Limbum: a bu' mmbo neè ye ená e ma'shi tá woweèe a ku joèo ba yi cuâu cáè'. Ñgaâa byañ wááwá ce a m joèo ye, a m keè'se.
English: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

Limbum: Mú nfeè' moè' aè ka' tuuse, beèe mo' efa múè beèe Farïìsi ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a vú a yá Jisoès, a bipshi neè ye enáê,
English: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

Limbum: “Ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu a fúú enjep ndeèe ce viseèe bta a m yá'ni seèe njoká? Woweèe a ke suè'si mmbo aè njïû yáánïì ka' ye byee ka'.”
English: Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don't wash their hands when they eat bread.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Wee weèe e ke fúú enjep mncir Nyúè njo' ndeèe weêe bta njoká?
English: He answered them, Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

Limbum: Nyúè a m laèa enáê, ‘Yu'ni neè yoè ta ba yoè maê.’ A ker laa enáê, ‘Ñwáè ce e ka' cáp yïì taê, káè yïì ma áè, baná a be yú ñgaèñ.’
English: For God commanded, 'Honor your father and your mother,' and, 'He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.'

Limbum: Weèe ce laèa ye weená, ñwáè aè ka' lor yuu ce yi ba jaè' yïì ma káè yïì ta aègho, laa enáê, ‘Máè fa neè Nyúè’,
English: But you say, 'Whoever may tell his father or his mother, Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,

Limbum: baná ñgaèñ be keèr jaè' yïì ta ba yïì ma aègho ka'. Baná weèe aè loèr ndeèe weêe bta a siñsi mncir Nyúè aègho.
English: he shall not honor his father or mother.' You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa mbo'ni. AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa yuu mini se a kuu weèe aè nfeè' ce e m ce cep ntuu Nyúè,
English: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

Limbum: a laa enáê, ‘Beèe ca a ku ce yu'ni neè máè ba neè cuèu, yap ntee yi ba aènjïìsaèp ese máè.
English: These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

Limbum: Woweèe a ce geèe rloo neè máè ba aè cicïì, njobeè' a ce yá'ni beèe mncir ce aè láè beèe, aèmboè a lá mncir Nyúè wa'a.’ ”
English: And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.'

Limbum: E ká' beèe ce a m ba aèfo, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yu'shi neè boèñboñ.
English: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, Hear, and understand.

Limbum: Yuu ce ñwáè e ke ye, a yuu yi ke geèe ñwáè e bep aè bsii Nyúè ka'. Yuu ce yi ke geèe ñwáè e ba jaèpri e ke ba yuu ce yi ke fúú ekuè cuâu ñwáè.”
English: That which enters into the mouth doesn't defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a vú a yá ye, a laa enáê, “Waè' aè rïìñ wáná beèe Farïìsi a ba yu' yuu ce wáè ba laa naè, ntee yi bep woweèe se a?”
English: Then the disciples came, and said to him, Do you know that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?

Limbum: E beesïì a laa enáê, “Yuu wááwá ce aè byeè ba yaè Ta embe buèu ka', a be keèe co'.
English: But he answered, Every plant which my heavenly Father didn't plant will be uprooted.

Limbum: Maè'shi neè woweèe. Woweèe a yu mnfeèp. Nfeèp ka' ce duèñshi nfeèp moè' nduunjïì, baná woweèe a be gweèñger njep beè'teè bsïìp.”
English: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Saèr mbuèu efa ñgaèa ca neè weèr.”
English: Peter answered him, Explain the parable to us.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Wee weèe aè be riñ buu foñ ka' a?
English: So Jesus said, Do you also still not understand?

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ weená yuu wááwá ce ñwáè e ke ye yi ke duè njep rbúè, lo fúú a?
English: Don't you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?

Limbum: Yuu ce yi ke fúú ekuè cuèu, yi ke loè ba enjep ntee. A njáèá yuu ce yi ke geèe ñwáè e ba jaèpri aè bsii Nyúè.
English: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

Limbum: Buu bbebep aèmboè aè ryú ñwáè, koo ñgwa ñwáè moè' káè nduu ñwáè moè', bsaèkïì, byáèá, táá njïìnsa' mnaèñ, laa yuu bebep kuu ñwáè moè', yu buu ce beèe a ke kwaè'shi aè rgeèe ba enjep ntee.
English: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

Limbum: Buu ca a buu ce vi ke geèe ñwáè, e ba jaèpri. AÈ rye yuu ke' su'si mmbo ka', a yuu ce aède' yi gee ñwáè e ba jaèpri ka'.”
English: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn't defile the man.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m loâ aèfo a du aè ñgoâñ Tayaè ba Sidoèn.
English: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

Limbum: Ka' cu, njeñwáè moâ' aè ñgoèñ anaè ce aè m ku ba njeñwáè efa múè beèe Kánaèn aè vúê, a waa, a laa enáê, “Tataê, Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè máè! Yú' nyúèrkaè' yi m niñ njep muu waè, e ce yu' ryañ seê.”
English: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely demonized!

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa yuu ka'. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ko'shïì a yeâ geñ, a laa neè ye enáê, “Laèa tá e duê, njobeè' e ce war a seâe mbuèu.”
English: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, Send her away; for she cries after us.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “A m tuu máè ená m vú yá ba njeèe embe ndúè' Isráèl ce yi m bú.”
English: But he answered, I wasn't sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè vú a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi, a laa enáê. “Tataê, jaè' máè.”
English: But she came and worshiped him, saying, Lord, help me.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Yi boèñ ená a lor byee boo ma' neè ñgwe ka'.”
English: But he answered, It is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè laa enáê, “Yi yu mini wa'a, Tataê, to ñgwe yi ke kuè ce ye mkúè' baa ce mi gweèñger embe tábuèr yaèp ta foñ.”
English: But she said, Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “Haba! Njeñwáè caê, lo rbyemïì li tap seê. Tá yi ba neè wáè aèmboè aè ce koèñ na.” Muu yïì aè ku ke'se aè nfeè' anaè.
English: Then Jesus answered her, Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire. And her daughter was healed from that hour.

Limbum: Jisoès aè loâ aèfo, a caa aèwaâa roâ aè ñgoèñ Galeèleê, a ko' mbe rtuèu, a cu aè nsheè.
English: Jesus departed there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.

Limbum: Ku' beèe a vúê, a yá ye mbo. Woweèe a m vúè neè beèe ce a m ba mntáèñ, ba beèe ce a m kepñger, ba mnfeèp, ba blúr, ker ba beèe magoèr ce a m ce yañ, a lá njep yeâ tïìi, e gee woweèe a ke'seè.
English: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

Limbum: Beèe a ka' yá aèmboè blúr a ce laèa, beèe ce a m kepñger a ce jáèr, mntáèñ a ce jáèr boèñboñ, mnfeèp a ce yá buu, a bááñgeèr seê, a ku'si Nyúè beèe Isráèl.
English: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, injured whole, lame walking, and blind seeing--and they glorified the God of Israel.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce koosimnse neè beèe ca seê. Weèr woweèe aè cu aè mnoâñ btaar, woweèe a ke' koni yuu ye ka'. M ce koèñ aè rlaèa tá woweèe a du neè njeè ka' faè dïì' woweèe a du gweè njeè aè nduunjïì ka'.”
English: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè ye enáê, “AÈde' weèr konïì bráâd ba efá ka' nyañ ku' beèe ca aègho, ce aèfa ku ba rïìñ na?”
English: The disciples said to him, Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe túr bráâd sá'?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Weèr túr bráâd saèambaê, ba mú nca mo'.”
English: Jesus said to them, How many loaves do you have? They said, Seven, and a few small fish.

Limbum: E laa neè beèe caè ená woweèe a cute aè nsheè.
English: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

Limbum: A ka' cute, e lor bráâd saèambaê ba nca caè, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi a fa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, woweèe a gapshïì neè beèe anaè.
English: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a ye, a yu'. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a baashïì bbábá' ce vi m báti, vi ruu aè mñkaèa saèambaê.
English: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

Limbum: Mmbañruè wááwá ce a m ye, a m ba ncúèkïì kyeèe, ka' lor bbyeèñge ba bghaèrbeèe.
English: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laasïì beèe, a niñ mbe keñ a du aè ñgoâñ Magadaèn.
English: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi ba beèe Saduèsïî, a m duè aè rmoèoshi Jisoès, a laa neè ye ená e duñshi woweèe ncoèo embe buèu.
English: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

Limbum: E beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Wee ke yá aèmboè rbuu li baèñ aè mbuèuñkuèr, weèe laa weená ñgoèñ yi be fúú boèñ,
English: But he answered them, When it is evening, you say, 'It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.'

Limbum: e ba aè ñgaèptú', weèe yá aèmboè rbuu li ce baèñ neè mmbaè'-ñwáè, weèe laa weená, ñgoèñ yi be bep neè fu' ntïìni seê. Weèe rïìñ aè rfyá' rbuu, rïìñ aèmboè ñgoèñ yi be ba. Ka' yi yu wa'a, aède' weèe riñ yuu ce ncoèo yïû seè'ni na táá aètu mo ka'.
English: In the morning, 'It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.' Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can't discern the signs of the times!

Limbum: Ñgúè beèe ce a yu ñgaâa bsaèrbuu, a ba mini neè Nyúè ka' ce a ker ce roèo ená a duñshi woweèe ncoèo. M be duèñshi woweèe ncoèo moè' caa efa ncoèo yïì Jonaè ka'.” Jisoès aè ka' laa wa'a, a ma'shïì woweèe mbo a duê.
English: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah. He left them, and departed.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m tuu neèñguu roè a lese aè rloèr bráêd.
English: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Loèr neè nfeè' neè yis beèe Farïìsi ba beèe Saduèsïî.”
English: Jesus said to them, Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce laèa fa waâp mú enáê, “E laèa wa'a njobeè' seèe aè vúè neè bráâd ka'.”
English: They reasoned among themselves, saying, We brought no bread.

Limbum: Jisoès aè riñ yuu ce woweèe a ce laèa, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce le rbyemïì li yu múcaèr, weèe ce laèa fa weâe mú ená weèe túr bráâd ka' njoká?
English: Jesus, perceiving it, said, Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, 'because you have brought no bread?'

Limbum: Weèe aè be riñ buu ka' a? Mboè weèe ce kuushi bráâd ta ce a m nyañ beèe ncúèkïì ta aègho ker ba mñkaèa ce weèe aè m baashi bbábá' aègho naè ka' a?
English: Don't you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

Limbum: Mboè weèe ce kuushi bráâd saèamba ce a m nyañ beèe ncúèkïì kyeèe aègho naè, ker ba mñkaèa ce weèe aè m baashi bbábá' aègho naè ka' a?
English: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

Limbum: Weèe aè ba riñ weená m ce laèa neè weèe ba aèmboè bráâd ka' ka' njoká? Loèr neè nfeè' neè yis beèe Farïìsi ba beèe Saduèsïî.”
English: How is it that you don't perceive that I didn't speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a riñ seè'ni ená e ba ce laèa neè woweèe ba ená woweèe a lor nfeè' neè yis bráâd ka', e ba ce laèa ba ená woweèe a lor nfeè' neè ryá'nïì beèe Farïìsi ba beèe Saduèsïî.
English: Then they understood that he didn't tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m duè, a ka' baè' aè múè mla' ce mi m ba aègee rla' Sisaèriyaè Fileèpaêi, a bipshi neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Beèe a ce laèa ená Muu Ñwáè yu ba nda?”
English: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Beèe mo' a ce laèa ená yu Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe, beèe mo' a ce laèa ená yu AÈlajaè, beèe mo' a ce laèa ená, ka' tá ba Jáèrïìmiyaè ka' baná yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè moè'.”
English: They said, Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yi yu yi eká aèmboè weèe? Weèe ce laèa ye weená m yu nda?”
English: He said to them, But who do you say that I am?

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “A wáè Kraâis anaè ce e yu Muu Nyúè ce e yu nteèe.”
English: Simon Peter answered, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ yu ñwáè rboâñtu, Saimúèn, muu Jonaè, njobeè' aè geèe ñwáè wáè ka' riñ yuu ce wáè laèa na ka', aè geèe ba yaè Ta ce e yu mbe buèu.
English: Jesus answered him, Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

Limbum: M ce suñ wáâ Pitaè ená aè yu ryáá. M be baè'ri yaè cor mbenduè ryáá anaè ce aède' ka' rkwe áè, li gee yuu mo' aègho ka'.
English: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

Limbum: M be fa wáè bki embe dïû' kúú Nyúè embe buèu. Yuu ce wáè ka' kur njep ñgoèñ na, baná a be kur yi mbe buèu. Yuu ce wáè ka' fyááshi njep ñgoèñ na baná a be fyáèáshi yi mbe buèu.”
English: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

Limbum: E m cïìisi neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená woweèe a fa suñ ñwáè moè' ená e yu Kraâis anaè ka'.
English: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

Limbum: Ká' ese aè nfeè' anaè, Jisoès aè ká' a ce raasi neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená e be kuè duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, yá ñgá' mbaè mmbo bleebeèe ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir goèr seê, tá a yú ye, mnoèñ vi ba btaar e fúú efa rkwe.
English: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

Limbum: Pitaè aè koo ye, a ye a lá'sïì nyor, a ká' a ce lapni ye a ce laèa enáê, “Tataê, Nyúè fáási! AÈde' njáèá yuu ca yi ke' koni neè wáè ka'.”
English: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.

Limbum: E karsïì nyor, a laa neè Pitaè enáê, “Loè efa máâ geñ, Sataèn! AÈ ce jepsi máè. Mo mkwaè'shïì mi yu ba mi ñwáè, yu mi Nyúè ka'.”
English: But he turned, and said to Peter, Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.

Limbum: E ka' laèa neè ye wa' wáá, a laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' ce koèñ aè rvúè a máâ mbuèu baná ñgaèñ kani yïì nyor, byá' yi kïìntaa vú a máâ mbuèu,
English: Then Jesus said to his disciples, If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

Limbum: njobeè' ñwáè ce e ka' ce koèñ aè rboñshi li ryoèñ baná ñgaèñ be bá li. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá boñshi li ryoèñ ka', njo' máè, baná ñgaèñ be koni li.
English: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè konïì ba njáèá sá' ká, ce e ka' túr buu enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá, lo bá li ryoèñ? Yuu ce aède' ñwáè fa aètu li ryoèñ a ká?
English: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe buu ca njobeè' Muu Ñwáè be vúè neè foèo yïì Taê, a vi bcïìndap weèe, laè' ñwáè wááwá aè buu ce e m ce geèe.
English: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená beèe mo' a yu aè múè beèe ce a tááte mbena ce rkwe li be joèo woweèe ka', tá woweèe a ku cu caar, yá Muu Ñwáè aèmboè e ce vúè neè yi kúú-ñwáè.”
English: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi ka' caèa ntuunfu, Jisoès aè lor Pitaè ba Jáêms, ba Joân ce e m ba nfúr Jáêms, a woweèe a ko' mbe rtuâu rsaèsap, aè ku ba woweèe mbo caè'caè'.
English: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

Limbum: A m baè' mbo, Jisoès aè kupseè a ba aè njáâá jáá, vi bsii vi raa aèmboè nyúè, vi bcáè' vi ce laè'ñger.
English: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

Limbum: Ka' cu, AÈlajaè ba Musïìs a nyáá, a ce de' a Jisoès.
English: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Tataê, yi boèñ aèmboè seèe yu aèfa na. Maè'shi tá m ba'ri btaèp vi btaar, tá mo' ba yo, tá mo' ba yïû Musïìs, tá mo' ba yïû AÈlajaè.”
English: Peter answered, and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let's make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

Limbum: E ka' kuè bii ce laèa, mmbaè' ce rraa li m ce fúú enjo vi vú a cete woweèe, njeèndoñ aè laa embe múè mmbaè' anaè enáê, “Cena yu muu waè, ce máè koèñ seê, a ce yu' rboèñ neè ye. Ce yu' neè yuu ce e ce laèa.”
English: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yu', a wáp seê, a gweñger neè bsii njep nsheè.
English: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

Limbum: Jisoès aè vúê, a joo woweèe, a laa enáê, “Naèti neè mbekïì, weèe fa wáp ka'.”
English: Jesus came and touched them and said, Get up, and don't be afraid.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' naèa map mmir, a ker yá ñwáè moè' caa efa Jisoès ka'.
English: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce suèu embe rtuèu, Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa suñ ñwáè moè' yuu ce weèe aè yá ka' caar tá Muu Ñwáè ke fúú efa rkwe.”
English: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Don't tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Baná ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a ce laèa ená AÈlajaè be vúè entoèmbïì njoká?”
English: His disciples asked him, saying, Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?

Limbum: E beesïì a laa enáê, “Rtarnïì li yu njo ka', AÈlajaè be vúè. E be vúè geèe tá buu wááwá kúti aèmboè vi m ba.
English: Jesus answered them, Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe ená AÈlajaè aè vúè wáá, beèe a rïìñ ye ka', a ku ce geèe buu ce a m ce koèñ aè rgeèe neè ye. Yi yu ená Muu Ñwáè ye ye be yá ñgá' mbe waâp mmboè.”
English: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn't recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a riñ seè'ni ená e ba ce laèa neè woweèe ená AÈlajaè aè vúè wáá wa'a, a ce laèa ba aèmboè Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe.
English: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' kúti, yá beèe caè, ñwáè moè' a vúê, a gú'shi njeptii Jisoès,
English: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, saying,

Limbum: a laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, koosimnse neè muu waè, njobeè' e ce gweè kaè', a ce yá ñgá' seê. E ke loè ku gwe njep mor, ba njep mdip.
English: Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

Limbum: Máè ka' vùé neè ye, fa neè figaâa yá’ni yoè buu, woweèe a moo aè rgeèe tá a ka'se laèr.”
English: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa enáê, “Haba! Weâe beèe eluèuni ce weèe buu rbyemïì, a beesi mini tútúèñ na. M be cu weèe seèe duè baè' fá? M be kur ntee neè weèe duè baè' fá? Vúè neè muu anaè fa neè máè mbena.”
English: Jesus answered, Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.

Limbum: Jisoès aè lapnïì yú' nyúèrkaè' anaè, yi fúú enjep muu anaè, e ku ke'seè aè nfeè' anaè.
English: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a vúê, aè ku ba Jisoès a woweèe, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Weèr aè ba moo aè rfúr yú' anaè laèr njoká?”
English: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, Why weren't we able to cast it out?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Weèe aè ba moo laèr njobeè' le rbyemïì li yu múcaèr aèmboè ñgúè mostaè. M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená le rbyemïì li ka' ba múcaèr se aèmboè ñgúè mostaè, aède' weèe ku laa neè rtuèu ca enáê, co'ti embe na, du mbena, tá li ku co'ti, tá yuu mo' yi ker ba tatap neè weèe ka'.
English: He said to them, Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè njáèá yú' ca, aède' a fúr yi enjep ñwáè ka', ce a ka' tá geèe rloo, jïì mdip ka'.”
English: But this kind doesn't go out except by prayer and fasting.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a ka' vúè aèbee aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “A be loèr Muu Ñwáè fa mbaè mmbo beèe,
English: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

Limbum: tá a yú ye, mnoèñ vi ba btaar, tá e fúú efa rkwe.” E ka' laèa wa'a, yi bep woweèe seê.
English: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up. They were exceedingly sorry.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè baè' aè rla' Kaèpanuèm, ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaèa embe Ndaèp Nyúè, a vúê, a yá Pitaè, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Yoè ñwáè ryá'nïì e ke laè' mbaèa embe Ndaèp Nyúè a?”
English: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, Doesn't your teacher pay the didrachma?

Limbum: Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “ÁÈno”. A ka' niñ mbe ndaèp, Jisoès aè ká' a laa yuu neè ye entombïì. E m laèa enáê, “AÈ ce kwaè'shi yo wáná ká Saimúèn? Beèe ce a ke laè' mbaèa neè bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na e ke ba weâe ká? E ke laè' ñgaâa to' káè bkïìloè?”
English: He said, Yes. When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?

Limbum: Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “E ke laè' bkïìloè.” Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Baná aède' ñgaâa to' a la' ka'.
English: Peter said to him, From strangers. Jesus said to him, Therefore the children are exempt.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, seèe ce koèñ ená nyor bep beèe ca neè seèe ka'. Duè mbaè roè, ma' yoè huk njep roè, nca ce wáè ka' koo entombïì, aè mú' cuèu efa gho. Wáâ múè', tá aè yá mbaèa koâo. Wáâ yá, aè fúr, la' mbaèa ya ba yo aègho.”
English: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a vúê, a yá ye, a bipshi enáê, “Ñwáè ce e yu ñwáâ ñgoèr seê mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè yu nda?”
English: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?

Limbum: E ká' mú ghaèrñwáè, a tár mbe waâp mú,
English: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the midst of them,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “M ce laèa neè mini-ñwáè ená weèe aè ka' tá kupse, ba aèmboè boo bká' ka', aède' weèe niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè ka'.
English: and said, Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ka' lor yïì nyor njep nsheè aèmboè muu ñká' ca, ñgaèñ yu ñwáâ ñgoèr se mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.
English: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' koni muu ghaèrñwáè aèmboè ca a máâ rlii, baná ñgaèñ aè koni máè.
English: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

Limbum: Ñwáè a ka' gee moè' efa boo bká' ce a byemi neè máè na a gee yuu bebep, baná yi be ba aèndeèe neè ñgaèñ, ce a ka' lor ma luâr ñgoè' baa, cúú ye kuè ndoñ, ma' ye njep rdip rgoèr, tá e no mdip kwe.
English: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him that a huge millstone should be hung around his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depths of the sea.

Limbum: Ndoèo aè co' ñgoèñ njobeè' buu yu njep ñgoèñ ce vi ke geèe beèe a ce geèe buu bbebep. Buu ca vi be kuè ce ba. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ndoèo be co' ñwáè ce buu ca vi be vúè njo' ye.
English: Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená e ka' roo yá, baná e be lu'shi aè njeèe yïû moè'sir ce e yá na, caèa yïû ncoèp-búè'ú-aè-mmbúè'ú ce yi daè' yi ka' naè.
English: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

Limbum: Yi ku ba wa'a neè yeè Ta ce e yu mbe buèu. E ce koèñ ená moè' efa boo bká' ca bú ka'.
English: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

Limbum: “Nfúroè aè ka' gee yuu bebep neè wáè, aè du yá ye, suñ ye. Suñ ye aè nfeè' ce ku ba weèe ye beèe a mmbaa. E ka' byemïì ená e geèe yuu bebep, baná wáè geèe weèe ye aè ker kúti bfúr.
English: If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, Pitaè aè bipshi neè ye enáê, “Tataê, nfúraè aè ka' ce geèe buu bbebep neè máè, m foosïì bkaâñ sá'? AÈde' m foosïì ye caar ba' ñkaèraè' saèamba a?”
English: Then Peter came and said to him, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “M ce laèa neè wáè ená aè ku foosi ye ba ñkaèraè' saèamba caè'caè' ka'. Foèosi ye ñkaèraè' msaèambaê, bdïì' saèambaê.
English: Jesus said to him, I don't tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a njobeè' kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè ñkúú ce e m ce koèñ aè rfyá' ñwaâ' mñkaa ñgaâa mfaè'.
English: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.

Limbum: E ka' káè' ce fyá', a vú neè ñwáè rfaè' moè' ce e m túr rkaa a ye aè mmalaèr aèñgoo.
English: When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

Limbum: E ka' túr yuu ce e la' rkaa anaè aègho ka', yïì masaè aè laa ená a koo ye ba ñgwa yïì ba boo vi, ker lor yïì buu wááwá, fyeni la' li rkaa aègho.
English: But because he couldn't pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

Limbum: Ñwáè rfaè' anaè aè gwe njep yeâ tïìi, a bu' mmbo neè ye, a laa enáê, ‘Fa máè mú nfeè' moè' tá m roo mbaèa, laè' rkaa anaè wááwá.’
English: The servant therefore fell down and kneeled before him, saying, 'Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!'

Limbum: Yïì masaè aè koosïìmnse neè ye, a laa ená e duê, e maè'shi mbaèa anaè neè ye.
English: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.

Limbum: Ñwáè rfaè' anaè aè ka' fúú embe ndaèp, a tarte a ñwáè rfaè' moè' ce a ye a m ba neè rkaa foñ aè baèa mbaèa, a koo ye, a kaa aè ndoñ, a laa enáê, ‘Laè' ya mbaèa.’
English: But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him, and took him by the throat, saying, 'Pay me what you owe!'

Limbum: E kanïì, a fa ye ba aè shañ ená e keèe laè' yi mbaèa wáá ka' fúú embo.
English: He would not, but went and cast him into prison, until he should pay back that which was due.

Limbum: Ñgaâa mfaè' mo' a ka' yá yuu ce yi m koni na, yi bep woweèe seê, woweèe a duê, a suñ yaèp masaè buu wááwá ce vi m koni anaè.
English: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told to their lord all that was done.

Limbum: Yaèp masaè aè ká' ñwáè rfaè' anaè a laa neè ye enáê, ‘Ñwáè bsaèrbuu caê, wáè ba bu' mmbo neè máè, máè laa máná máè maè'shi ku' mbaèa anaè neè wáè.
English: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, 'You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.

Limbum: AÈde' wáè ke' ba koosimnse foñ neè ñwáè rfaè' moè' ca aèmboè máè ba koosi neè wáè naè ka' a?’
English: Shouldn't you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?'

Limbum: Ntee yi yañ yïì masaè, e fa ye mbe mmbo ñgaâa ñkeè'ni ñgaâa shañ ená a fa ye ñgá' caar tá e la' yi mbaèa wááwá.
English: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.

Limbum: A mboè yaè Ta embe buèu be geèe neè ñwáè wááwá efa weâe mú wa'a, ce weèe a ka' tá ce foèosi bfúr wee enje ntee ka'.”
English: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don't each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa buu ca mïìsi, a loâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a du aè mbeèp ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè ce e yu neèñguu rdip Jodaèn.
English: It happened when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

Limbum: Ku' beèe a du a yeâ mbuèu, a ka' baè' aèfo, e gee ñgaâa byañ a ke'seè.
English: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi mo' a vú a mooshi ye, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ncir yi byemi ená ñwáè juu ñgwa yïì ka' aètu ká a?”
English: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?

Limbum: E beesïì a laa enáê, “Mboè weèe aè beè' Ñwaâ' Nyúè a yá weená ñwáè ce e m boo beèe efa rkáè', e m boo mbañruèñwáè ba njeñwáè a?
English: He answered, Haven't you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, ‘AÈ ka' ba njobeè' máè m boo mbañruèñwáè ba njeñwáè, mbañruèñwáè be maè'shi yïì ta ba yïì maê, cu a ñgwa yïì, tá a ye a ba ñwáè moè'sir.’
English: and said, 'For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall join to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?'

Limbum: Baná woweèe a ker ba a baa ka'. A yu ba ñwáè moè'sir. Baná yuu ce Nyúè aè tarshi, ñwáè moè' fa gaèpse ka'.”
English: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don't let man tear apart.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Musïìs aè m ka' ba laa ená mbañruèñwáè fa ñwaè' neè njeñwáè aè rduèñshi ená e saè'si guèu, ka' juu ye njoká?”
English: They asked him, Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Musïìs aè m maè'shi ená weèe juu wee bbyeèñge njobeè' weèe teèe btu seê. Yi m ba wa'a efa rkáè' ka'.
English: He said to them, Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná ñwáè ka' juu ñgwa yïì, ke' ba njobeè' ená ñgwa yïì aè noèñ a mbañruèñwáè moè' ka', ker lor ñgwa moè', baná ñgaèñ aè koo njeñwáè ce yu ñgwa yïì ka'.”
English: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè ye enáê, “Yi ka' ba wa'a neè mbañruèñwáè ba ñgwa yïì, baná yi boèñ ená ñwáè lor ñgwa ka'.”
English: His disciples said to him, If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “AÈde' ñwáè wááwá byemïì yuu ca ka'. Beèe ce aède' a byemïì ku ba beèe ce Nyúè aè geèe ená woweèe a byemi.
English: But he said to them, Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a yu bkar njobeè' a m bi woweèe a ku ba bkar, beèe mo' a ba bkar njobeè' beèe a geèe woweèe a ba bkar. Beèe mo' a yu bkar njobeè' aè geèe woweèe a gee wap mnyor aè bkar njo' kúú Nyúè. Ñwáè ce aède' e byemïì yuu máè laèa na, ñgaèñ byemi yi.”
English: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother's womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven's sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a m vúè neè bghaèrbeèe ená Jisoès bo la' mmbo mbe waâp nduè, loo neè woweèe. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a lapnïì beèe anaè.
English: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá wa'a, a laa enáê, “Maè'shi neè tá bghaèrbeèe anaè a vú yá máè. Weèe fa jepsi woweèe ka', njobeè' kúú Nyúè yi yu neè beèe ce a yu aèmboè bghaèrbeèe ca.”
English: But Jesus said, Allow the little children, and don't forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.

Limbum: E la' mi mmbo mbe waâp nduè, a loo, a nati a duê.
English: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m vúè a yá Jisoès, a bipshi neè ye enáê. “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, yuu boèñboñ ce aède' m gee ka' koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè yu ba ká?”
English: Behold, one came to him and said, Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

Limbum: E laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè bipshi neè máè aèmboè yuu boèñboñ njoká? Ku ba ñwáè moè'sir ce e yu ñwáâ mboèñmboñ. Wáè ka' ce koèñ aè rkoni ryoèñ ce nfeseè, aè lá mncir.”
English: He said to him, Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.

Limbum: E laa enáê, “Mncir vïû fá?” Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Fa yú ka', fa koo ñgwa ñwáè moè' káè nduu ñwáè moè' ka', fa yáèá ka', fa táá njïìnsa' mnaèñ ka',
English: He said to him, Which ones? Jesus said, 'You shall not murder.' 'You shall not commit adultery.' 'You shall not steal.' 'You shall not offer false testimony.'

Limbum: yu'ni neè yoè ta ba yoè maê, ker ce koñ nfúroè aèmboè aè koèñ yoè nyor.”
English: Honor your father and mother.' And, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'

Limbum: Muu nsuènsuè ca aè laa neè ye enáê, “Máè láè mncir ca wááwá, baná yuu ce aède' m ker gee yu ba ká?”
English: The young man said to him, All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Wáè ka' ce koèñ aè rba yáánïì se aè bsii Nyúè, aè du fyeni yoè buu wááwá, lor mbaèa efa gho, gapshi neè ñgaâa fuèp, tá aè bo túr bkuè' mbe buèu. Wáâ geèe wa' wáá, vú a máâ mbuèu.”
English: Jesus said to him, If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.

Limbum: Muu nsuènsuè ca aè ka' yu' wa'a, a sá seê, a nati a du njobeè' e m túr ku' buu seê.
English: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená yi yu tatap neè ñwáè mbaèa aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.
English: Jesus said to his disciples, Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

Limbum: M ker ce suñ weèe máná yi yu aètáèr neè kaèmál aè rtose njep rlir nsaèraè' neè ñwáè mbaèa aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.”
English: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yu' wa'a, a bááñger seê, a laa enáê, “Baná ñwáè ce aède' e luêñ, yu ba nda?”
English: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, Who then can be saved?

Limbum: Jisoès aè fyá' woweèe, a laa enáê, “Ca yi yu tatap se neè beèe, aè ka' ba yi neè Nyúè, buu wááwá yu aètáèr.”
English: Looking at them, Jesus said, With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

Limbum: Pitaè aè beesïì a laa enáê, “Yáê, weèr aè maè'shi yeèr buu wááwá a vú a wáâ mbuèu. Baná yuu ce weèr be koni yu ba ká?”
English: Then Peter answered, Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená be keèe ba aè nfeè' ce a geèe buu wááwá vi kútïì bfi, a nfeè' ce Muu Ñwáè be keèe cu mbe kaèbaèraè' neè yi foèo embe buèu-ñwáè naè, tá weèe ce weèe aè vúè a máâ mbuèu na, cu mbe bkaèbaèraè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, ce sa' mntáè' Isráèl ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: Jesus said to them, Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' ma'shi vi mndap, káè bfúr vi, káè bjar vi, káè yïì taê, káè yïì maê, káè boo vi, káè yi ñgoèñ ce e túr áè, njo' máè, e be koni ku' buu seê, caèa aèmboè e m túr naè kaèñ rjeèe, keèr koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè foñ.
English: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr ce a yu entombïì seè'ni na, a be keèe ba elúèsimbuèu, tá beèe magoèr ce a yu elúèsimbuèu seè'ni na, a ba entombïì.
English: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.

Limbum: “Kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè ñwáè moè' ce e m fúú aè mú ñgaèptú' moè' a du a roèo beèe tá a bo faè' yi nsuu.
English: For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr, ñwáè nsuu aè laa neè yïì ñwáè rfaè' ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa mfaè' enáê, ‘Ká' ñgaâa mfaè', la' woweèe. Káè' la' beèe ce máè ba lor elúèsimbuèu naè, ka' la' bár beèe, misi neè beèe ce máè ba lor entombïì naè.’
English: When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, 'Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.'

Limbum: Beèe ce a m loèr woweèe aè rfaè' aèmboè aè nyúè ta naè, a vúê, a la' ñwáè wááwá mbúè mbaèa.
English: When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

Limbum: Koo yo mbaèa duê. AÈ kwaè'shi ba máè aè rlaè' weèe ñwáè ce e ba vú rfaè' elúèsimbuèu yáánïì.
English: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

Limbum: Mboè m túr ñger aè rgeèe yuu ce m ce koèñ neè ya mbaèa a? Káè aè ce ko'ndoñ njobeè' m yu mmbo-mtoo láê?’
English: Isn't it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?'

Limbum: Yi yu ená beèe ce a yu entoèmbïì a be keèe ba elúèsimbuèu, tá beèe ce a yu elúèsimbuèu a ba entombïì.”
English: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a ka' ce duè, a lor ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, a woweèe a lá'sïì nyor, e laa neè woweèe enáê,
English: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

Limbum: “Yá neè, Seèe ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, tá a du fa Muu Ñwáè mbaè mmbo beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir. Woweèe a be sa' ye, teni ená a yú ye,
English: Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

Limbum: Ma boo vi Sábáèdi aè m vúè a boo vi weèe, a yá Jisoès. E m gweè njep yeâ tïìi, a laa ená e gee yuu neè ye.
English: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáâ koèñ ená m gee ba ká neè wáè?” E beesïì enáê, “M ce koèñ máná aè laa tá moè' efa boo wa ke cu aè yo bo maè', tá moè' cu aè yo bo ñkoèp, aè nfeè' ce aè ce sa' yo kúú.”
English: He said to her, What do you want? She said to him, Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand, and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Weèe yi yuu ce weèe ce bipshi ka'. AÈde' weèe no enjep ndoñ ce m be no enjo a?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “AÈde' weèr no enjo.”
English: But Jesus answered, You don't know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They said to him, We are able.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe be no enjep ndoñ ce m be no enjo ghup. Ka' yi yu wa'a, máè túr ñger aè rlaèa ená ñwáè cu a máâ bo maè' káè a máâ bo ñkoèp ka'. Bdïì' anaè vi yu ba neè beèe ce yaè Ta aè m kupshi a lá neè woweèe.”
English: He said to them, You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with, but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.

Limbum: Bár ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce beèe nrúú a ka' yu' yuu ce a bipshi na, yi bep woweèe seê.
English: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká'shïì woweèe aèbee, a laa enáê, “Weèe rïìñ weená ñgaâa rsa' beèe enje jáá a ke sa' yap beèe neè ñger-ñwáè seê, beâe bgoèrgoèr mo' a lor yap ñger, nyú' beèe aègho foñ.
English: But Jesus summoned them, and said, You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

Limbum: Njáèá ñgeèe ca yi fa keèe ba fa weâe mú ka'. Yi yu ba ená ñwáè efa weâe mú ce e ka' ce koèñ aè rba ñwáâ ñgoèr, baná ñgaèñ ba ñwáè rfaè' neè weèe,
English: It shall not be so among you, but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

Limbum: tá ñwáè ce e ce koèñ aè rba entombïì ba ye ñkwaèa.
English: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

Limbum: Muu Ñwáè ye ye aè m vúè ená beèe a bo faè' neè ye ka'. E m vúè yi tá e bo faè', keèr fa li ryoèñ, tee beèe magoèr efa rkwe.”
English: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

Limbum: Woweèe a m loâ aè rla' Jáèrikuè a ce duè, beèe magoèr a ce duè a yeâ mbuèu.
English: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

Limbum: Ka' cu, mmbañruè mo' beèe a mmbaa ce a m ba mnfeèp a cu aèwaâa nduunjïì. A ka' yu' ená Jisoès ce caèa, woweèe a waa, a laa enáê, “Tataê, Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè weèr.”
English: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!

Limbum: Beèe caè a lapnïì woweèe, a laa ená woweèe a cu nyañ. Woweèe a ker misi a waa, a laa enáê, “Tataê, Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè weèr.”
English: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!

Limbum: Jisoès aè táá, a ká' woweèe, a laa enáê, “Weèe ce koèñ weená m gee má ká neè weèe?”
English: Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked, What do you want me to do for you?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Tataê, weèr ce koèñ ená aè gee tá weèr yá buu.”
English: They told him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

Limbum: Jisoès aè koosimnse neè woweèe, a joo map mmir, woweèe a ku ká' a ce yá buu, a nati a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúè baè' aètútú rla' Jáèrusaláèm, ba seè'ni ba aè rla' Bátáfáè ce li m ba aègee rtuèu Oleèf. Jisoès aè tuu ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu beèe a mmbaa,
English: When they drew near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Duè neè nje rla' enje weâe cuèu na. Weèe be baè' njo tá weèe ku yá aèmboè a cúú jaèaki', muu aè táá aègee mo. Fyáèá neè vú aègho fa neè máè.
English: saying to them, Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them, and bring them to me.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè ka' laa yuu mo' neè weèe, weèe suñ ye enáê, ‘Tata ce taè' geèe yuu aègho,’ tá e ku maè'shi tá weèe vú aègho.”
English: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, 'The Lord needs them,' and immediately he will send them.

Limbum: Ca yi m koni wa'a, tá yuu ce Nyúè aè m laèa njïì enjep yïì ñwáè ncep ntuu yi bo ghááte njo.
English: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Suñ neè beâe aè rla' Sayoèn enáê, ‘Yáê, yeè ñkúú ce vúè aè ryá weèe, a ba neè rbornïì-ñwáè, a cu mbenduè muu jaèaki'.’ ”
English: Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès, a duê, a gee yuu ce Jisoès aè m laèa neè woweèe.
English: The disciples went, and did just as Jesus commanded them,

Limbum: Woweèe a m vúè neè jaèaki', ba muu, a co'ni bcáè' a laashi mbenduè mo, Jisoès aè ko' a cu mbo.
English: and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

Limbum: Ku' beèe magoèr se a laashïì bcáè' njep nduunjïì, beèe mo' a gwar mnta' ce, a laashi njo.
English: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees, and spread them on the road.

Limbum: Ku' beèe ce a m ce duè entombïì, ker ba ku' beèe ce a m ce vúè embe yeâ njïì, a ká' a ce yoèp enáê, “Seèe ku'si Muu Dávïìd! Nyúè ghoni ñwáè ce e vúè aè rlii Tataê! Seèe ku'si Nyúè embe buèu!”
English: The multitudes who went before him, and who followed kept shouting, Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' niñ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, rla' wááwá li ci'tïì, beèe a ce bipshi enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu nda?”
English: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, Who is this?

Limbum: Beèe ce a woweèe a m ba naè a beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu Jisoès, ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ce aè rla' Nasaráât aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.”
English: The multitudes said, This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m niñ mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a juu beèe wááwá ce a m ce fyeèni buu, ba beèe ce a m ce yuu buu mbo, a bute btábuèr ese beèe ce a m ce kupse mbaèa, a bute mnta' ese beèe ce a m ce fyeèni bbeèñ.
English: Jesus entered into the temple of God, and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘A be too yaè ndap ená ndap rloo.’ Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe aè geèe yaè ndap aè kútïì ba aè mbúè' byáèá.”
English: He said to them, It is written, 'My house shall be called a house of prayer,' but you have made it a den of robbers!

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ba mnfeèp, ba beèe ce a m ba mntáèñ a m vúè a yá ye mbe Ndaèp Nyúè anaè, e gee woweèe a luêñ.
English: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, a ka' yá buu bbáèá ce e m geèe na, keèr yu' aèmboè bghaèrbeèe a ce yoèp mbe Ndaèp Nyúè enáê, “Seèe ku'si Muu Dávïìd”, ntee yi yañ woweèe seê.
English: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the son of David! they were indignant,

Limbum: Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce yu' yuu ce boo ca a ce yoèp a?” Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “ÁÈno, aèmboè weèe aè be be' dïì' mo' embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ce yi ce laèa enáê, ‘Weèe aè yá'ni bghaèrbeèe, ba boo ce a bii nyoñ mmbee, woweèe a ce kuè'si Nyúè boèñboñ se’ naè a?”
English: and said to him, Do you hear what these are saying? Jesus said to them, Yes. Did you never read, 'Out of the mouth of babes and nursing babies you have perfected praise?'

Limbum: E ma'shïì woweèe a fúú efa rla' Jáèrusaláèm a du aè rla' Bátanïì, a noñ aèfo.
English: He left them, and went out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú', e ka' naèti ce kúti aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, njeè aè ce yañ ye.
English: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

Limbum: E m yá ce fik aèwaâa nduunjïì, a du a fyá' mbo, a yá yuu mo' mbo caa efa bfuè caè'caè' ka'. E laa neè yi enáê, “AÈde' aè ke yú mbaèñ aè nfeè' moè' ka'.” Ce fik anaè yi ku yopri.
English: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, Let there be no fruit from you forever! Immediately the fig tree withered away.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yá wa'a, a bááñger seê, a laa enáê, “Ce fik ca yi ba yopri cárcár wa'a ba aè njáâá ká?”
English: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, How did the fig tree immediately wither away?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená, weèe aè ka' byemi ke' ce tarni ka', aède' weèe ku gee ba yuu ce máè geèe neè ce fik na caè'caè' ka', aède' weèe ku laa neè rtuèu ca foñ ená, ‘Co'ti embo naè du gwe njep rdip rgoèr’, yi ku ba wa'a.
English: Jesus answered them, Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith, and don't doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' it would be done.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' byemi, baná weèe be koni buu wááwá ce weèe aè ka' bipshi neè Nyúè aè rloo.”
English: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.

Limbum: E ka' baè' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a niñ mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a ce yá'ni beèe mbo. Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba bleebeèe, a vú a yá ye, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ñger ce aè ce geèe buu ca aègho yi loè efá, ñwáè ce e fa wáè ñger ca aè fa nda?”
English: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “M be bipshi yuu mo' neè weèe foñ. Weèe aè ka' beesïî, baná m be suñ weèe ñwáè ce e fa máè ñger aè rgeèe buu ca.
English: Jesus answered them, I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

Limbum: Ñger ce Joân aè m túr aè rbaèptir beèe naè yi m loè ba efá? Yi m loè ba ese Nyúè káè ese beèe?” Woweèe a du mcúè, a seesi a laa enáê, “Seèe aè ka' laa seenáê, yi ñger anaè yi m loè ese Nyúè, baná e be bipshi neè seèe enáê, ‘Weèe aè m ka' ba byemi yuu ce e m laèa ka' njoká?’
English: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men? They reasoned with themselves, saying, If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask us, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

Limbum: Seèe ka' laa ba seenáê, ‘Yi m loè ese ñwáè’, baná beèe a be baèa seèe njobeè' beèe wááwá a byemi ená Joân aè m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.”
English: But if we say, 'From men,' we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.

Limbum: Woweèe a kútïì a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Weèr rïìñ ka'.” E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná má máè be suñ weèe ñwáè ce e fa máè ñger aè rgeèe buu ca ka'.
English: They answered Jesus, and said, We don't know. He also said to them, Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

Limbum: “Weèe ce kwaè'shi wee ká aèmboè ca? Ñwáè moè' aè m túr boo a baa. E m duè, a yá ñwáâ nlee a laa neè ye enáê, ‘Muu waè, duè fa' nsuu ntïìni.’
English: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, 'Son, go work today in my vineyard.'

Limbum: E beesïì a laa enáê, ‘Yaè taê, m be duè ka',’ a ka' laèa wa'a, a ker lo a kwa'shi a kupse yi ntee, a duê.
English: He answered, 'I will not,' but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

Limbum: E du a yá ñwáè embenjïì ñwáâ nlee, a laa yuu ce e ba laa neè ñwáâ nlee naè neè ye. E beesïì a laa enáê, ‘M be duè.’ A ka' laèa wa'a, a du ka'.
English: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, 'I go, sir,' but he didn't go.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè efa boo a baa ca ce e m geèe yuu ce yïì ta aè m koèñ aè m ba nda?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Muu nlee.” Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' ba bkwaèraè a ce duè mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè entombïì neè weèe.
English: Which of the two did the will of his father? They said to him, The first. Jesus said to them, Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into the Kingdom of God before you.

Limbum: Joân aè m vúè a yá weèe a ce duèñshi weèe nduunjïû yáánïì, weèe aè byemïì yuu ce e m ce laèa ka', ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' ba bkwaèraè, a byemïì yap yu. Weèe aè ka' yá wa'a, a ke' kupse, byemi ka'.
English: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn't believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn't even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

Limbum: “Yu' neè ñgaèa moè'. Ñwáè moè' aè m faè' yi nsuu, a bye njáèá msini ce a ke geèe mruè' aègho mbo, a bee ñka' a sir nsuu anaè aègho, a tuñ dïì' ce a bo geèe mruè' mbo a boo taè'taè' mbo foñ. E ka' geèe wa' wáá, a lá nsuu anaè neè beèe mo', a du aè mbeè.
English: Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a winepress in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “E be yúshi beâe bbebep ca aè njïû mbembep seê, láè yi nsuu anaè neè beâe jáá ce nfeè' ce a ke tee msini aè ka' gháá tá woweèe a bo tee mi fa neè ye.”
English: They told him, He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers, who will give him the fruit in its season.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Mboè weèe aè be be' mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Luèr ce ñgaâa mboo mndap a m maè', aè m kúti ba luèr rbuu ndap’ a? ‘Ca aè m geèe Tata Nyúè, aè ba yuu báèá neè seèe.’
English: Jesus said to them, Did you never read in the Scriptures, 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes?'

Limbum: Baná m ce suñ weèe ená a be koo kúú Nyúè ese weèe, fa neè to' ce yi be geèe ndeèe kúú anaè.
English: Therefore I tell you, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation bringing forth its fruit.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba beèe Farïìsi a ka' yu' mñgaèa ce e maè', a riñ ená e maè' mñgaèa anaè ba aèmboè woweèe.
English: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce roèo aè rkoo ye, a ce wáp beèe njobeè' beèe a m byemi ená e yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker laa buu neè woweèe aè mñgaèa. E m laèa enáê,
English: Jesus answered and spoke again in parables to them, saying,

Limbum: “Kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè ñkúú ce e m geèe ñkaâ' bguèu neè muu yïì.
English: The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè cep, beèe anaè a lor yap yu ntuu anaè aètáèr, a du ba aè rgeèe yaèp ntaè'teè, beèe mo' aè du aè mñkúè, beèe mo' a du aè rkap yaèp ntaa.
English: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,

Limbum: Bár beèe ce a m be naè, a koo ñgaâa mfaè' anaè, a fa ñgá' neè woweèe, a yúshi woweèe.
English: and the rest grabbed his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.

Limbum: Ntee yi yañ ñkúú seê, e tuu vi bsoogáè, woweèe a du a yúshi beèe ce a m yúshi yi ñgaâa mfaè' naè, a too lap rla'.
English: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

Limbum: A ka' geèe wa' wáá, e laa neè yi ñgaâa mfaè' enáê, ‘Máè fáèr buu ñkaè' a misïî, beèe ce máè be a ghááteè aè beèe ce a ba vúè ñkaè' anaè ka'.
English: Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren't worthy.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a m naèti a du a cu mcúè aèmboè a be geèe tá Jisoès ka' faèa nlaèa.
English: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

Limbum: Woweèe a tuu ñgaâa yá'ni yaèp buu, ker ba beèe mo' efa múè beèe vi Hároèd ená woweèe a du laa enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, weèr rïìñ werná aè yu ñwáè mini, a ce yá'ni beèe mnduunjïì Nyúè neè mini-ñwáè. Wá ke loèr ñwáè moè' jáá ka'.
English: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter who you teach, for you aren't partial to anyone.

Limbum: Suñ ka weèr yuu ce aè ce kwaè'shi. Ncir yi byemi ená seèe ma' mbaâa baèraè' neè ñkwe Rum káè seèe ma' ka'?”
English: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

Limbum: Jisoès aè m rïìñ yuu ce woweèe a m túr aè mbúè, a laa enáê, “Weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa mbo'ni, weèe ce moèoshi máè njoká?
English: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

Limbum: Naèa neè mbúè mbaèa ce a ke maè' mbaâa baèraè' aègho.” Woweèe a vú neè mbúè mbaèa, a fa neè ye.
English: Show me the tax money. They brought to him a denarius.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Tu ñwáè embo a yïû nda, rlii ce a sañ mbo aè ba li nda?”
English: He asked them, Whose is this image and inscription?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Tu embo a yïû ñkwe Ruêm, rlii embo aè ba li foñ.” E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná weèe fa buu ñkúú neè ñkúú, fa vïû Nyúè neè Nyúè.”
English: They said to him, Caesar's. Then he said to them, Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a bááñger seê, a ma'shi ye, a duse.
English: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.

Limbum: Beèe Saduèsi ce a ce kani ená aède' ñwáè kwe ker fúú efa rkwe ka' naè, a vú a yá ye nyúè anaè, a bipshi neè ye enáê,
English: On that day Sadducees those who say that there is no resurrection came to him. They asked him,

Limbum: “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, Musïìs aè m laèa ená ñwáè aè ka' lor ñgwa, a ye a bi boo ka', ñgaèñ kwe, baná nfúr yïì be laasi ye, tá a ye a bi boo neè nfúr yïì ce e kwe anaè.
English: saying, Teacher, Moses said, 'If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed for his brother.'

Limbum: Bfúr mo' ce weèr woweèe aè m ce cu, a m ba beèe nsaèambaê. Ñwáâ nlee aè loèr ñgwa, a kwe, a bi boo a ye ka', a ma'shi ñgwa neè nfúr yïì.
English: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no seed left his wife to his brother.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi m koni ñwáâ nlee naè, yi m koni neè ñwáè embe yeâ njïì, a koni neè ñwáè embe njïì ñwáè embe yeâ njïì, a caasi moè' efa bfúr beèe nsaèamba anaè ka'.
English: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè lúèèsimbuèu, njeñwáè ca ye ye aè kwe.
English: After them all, the woman died.

Limbum: Baná be keèe ba aè nfeè' ce beèe a fúú efa rkwe, tá njeñwáè ca ba ñgwa nda, aèmboè yi yu ená bfúr beèe nsaèamba ca wááwá a m ba bduu vi naè?”
