English: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce laèa wa'a, a ce faèa faèa njobeè' weèe rïìñ yuu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi ce laèa ka', a riñ ñger Nyúè foñ ka'.
English: But Jesus answered them, You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

Limbum: Be keèe ba aè nfeè' ce beèe a fúú efa rkwe tá beèe a ker loèr bbyeèñge, káè guèusi boo ka'. Beèe a be keèe ba aèmboè bcïìndap Nyúè embe buèu.
English: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God's angels in heaven.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè rfúú ce beèe ce a kweñger a be keèe fúú efa rkwe, mboè weèe aè be be' yuu ce Nyúè aè m laèa neè weèe a? E m laèa enáê,
English: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven't you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

Limbum: ‘A máè Nyúè Abraèhaêm, a ba Nyúè Aisïìk, a ker ba Nyúè Jakoèp.’ E yu Nyúè bgúâú beèe ka', e yu ba Nyúè beèe ce a cu bteèe.”
English: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?' God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

Limbum: Beèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a bááñger aè ryá'nïì ce e m yá'ni anaè seê.
English: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' yu' ená Jisoès aè cipsi cuèu ese beèe Saduèsïî, woweèe a kuu nyor a vú a yá ye.
English: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

Limbum: Moè' efa woweèe ce e m rïìñ mncir seê, aè mooshïì ye, a bipshi neè ye enáê,
English: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

Limbum: “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, ncir ce yi caèa mncir wááwá embe ñwaè' mncir yu yïû fá?”
English: Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “Koèñ Tata ce e yu yoè Nyúè neè yo ntee- ñwáè, ba neè lo ryoèñ-ñwáè, ker ba neè wo bfee-ñwáè.
English: Jesus said to him, 'You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.'

Limbum: Ncir ca yu ncir ce goèr, aè ba ncir ce entombïì.
English: This is the first and great commandment.

Limbum: Ncir yïì embenjïì mo yi yu aèmboè yi foñ. Yi yu enáê, ‘Koèñ nfúroè aèmboè aè koèñ yoè nyor.’
English: A second likewise is this, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'

Limbum: Buu wááwá ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' mncir ba mbe mñwaè' ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, vi táá ba mbenduè mncir bbaa ca.”
English: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' ce vúè aèbee, Jisoès aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê,
English: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

Limbum: “Weèe ce kwaè'shi wee ká aèmboè Kraâis anaè? E yu muu nda?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “E yu muu Dávïìd.”
English: saying, What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he? They said to him, Of David.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yi ka' ba yi ká ce ená Yú' Nyúè yi m geèe Dávïìd aè too ye ená Tataê? E m laèa enáê,
English: He said to them, How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

Limbum: ‘Tata Nyúè aè m laèa neè Tata yaè enáê, “Cu aè la rkoo maè' caar tá m gee tá aè tár mo mkuèu mbenduè beèe ce a baèa wáè.”’
English: The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet?'

Limbum: Dávïìd aè ka' too ye ená Tataê, baná aède' e ker ba muu yïì aè njáâá ká?”
English: If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè túr yuu mo' aè rbeèesi neè ye ka'. Ká' e nyúè anaè, ñwáè moè' aè ker túr cuèu aè rbipshi yuu mo' neè ye ka'.
English: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forth.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè beèe ker ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê,
English: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

Limbum: “Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba beèe Farïìsi a cu mbe nta' Musïìs.
English: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sat on Moses' seat.

Limbum: Baná weèe yu'ni neè woweèe, gee yuu ce woweèe a ce suñ weèe. Weèe fa geèe yuu ce woweèe a ce geèe ka' njobeè' woweèe a ke geèe yuu ce woweèe a ke feè'shi ka'.
English: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don't do their works; for they say, and don't do.

Limbum: Woweèe a ke kur mntáèr ce vi ce rïìr seê, lá mbe mkáâámbáè' beèe, ke' koñ aè rnaèa ntubo jaè' woweèe aègho ka'.
English: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

Limbum: Buu wááwá ce woweèe a ce geèe, a ce geèe ba ená beèe a bo yá woweèe. Woweèe a loè tar bbaèa guru wap ce a ke láè Blaâa Nyúè njo, cúú nje tuè, vi bárñgeèr seê, gee mcúèñcúñ efa wap bcáè' vi sapñgeèr seê.
English: But all their works they do to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad, enlarge the fringes of their garments,

Limbum: Woweèe a koèñ aè rcu aè mnta' beâe bgoèrgoèr aè mñkaè', a koñ aè rcu aè mnta' bboèñboñ aè mndap mloo.
English: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

Limbum: Woweèe a koèñ ená beèe a ca'ni woweèe aè mntaa, a ker koñ foñ ená beèe a too woweèe ená Rabaèi.
English: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called 'Rabbi, Rabbi' by men.

Limbum: Weèe fa maè'shi tá beèe a too weèe ená Rabaèi ka', njobeè' weèe túr ñwáè ryá'nïì moè'sir caè'caè'. Weèe yu ba bfúr.
English: But don't you be called 'Rabbi,' for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

Limbum: Weèe fa too ñwáè moè' enjep ñgoèñ na ená Taèr ka', njobeè' weèe ku túr Taèr moè'sir caè'caè', e ba mbe buèu.
English: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

Limbum: Weèe fa maè'shi tá ñwáè moè' too weèe ená ñwáè ryá'nïì ka', njobeè' weèe ku túr ñwáè ryá'nïì moè'sir caè'caè', ce yu Kraâis anaè.
English: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

Limbum: Ñwáâ ñgoèr se efa weâe mú be ba ba ñwáè rfaè' neè weèe.
English: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' naa yïì nyor mbekïì baná a be suèusi ñgaèñ njep nsheè. Ñwáè ce e ka' suusi yïì nyor njep nsheè baná a be naèa ye mbekïì.
English: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

Limbum: “Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba beèe Farïìsïî. Weèe yu ñgaâa bo' wee btu njobeè' weèe aè cete ncúèúndúè' ce yi ce duè mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè aè bsii beèe. Weèe ce duè mbo ka', a ma'shi ená beèe ce a ce gheèter aè rduè mbo naè a du ka'.
English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows' houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

Limbum: Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba beèe Farïìsïî. Weèe yu ñgaâa mbo'ni njobeè' weèe ce jáèr aè mñgoèñ a ce jáèr aè bkeñ tá weèe bo geèe ka' ñwáè moè'sir áè, kupse byemi neè Nyúè. E ce kupse, weèe gee ye e misïì bep caa weèe ñkaèraè' baa.
English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much of a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

Limbum: Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce mnfeèp ce weèe ce duèñshi beèe nduunjïì. Weèe ce laèa weená ñwáè aè ka' ye leè', kaa aè rlii Ndap Nyúè, yïì anaè ba yuu ka'; ñwáè aè ka' ye leè', kaa ba aè rlii buu embe Ndaèp Nyúè ce a geèe neè njáèá bco' mo' ce a too ená guêl, baná leè' anaè yi kur ñgaèñ.
English: Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, 'Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.'

Limbum: Weâe mnfeèp ce a ce duèñshi beèe nduunjïì! Wee ke kaèr buu wááwá ce wee ke no, faè dïì' weèe no mú yuu teèe njo ka', ce mïì juè'.
English: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

Limbum: Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, ba beèe Farïìsïî. Weèe yu ñgaâa mbo'ni njobeè' weâe ke suè'si ndoñ ba kañ embe nduè, geewa'a, a fyá' njep mú vi ruu neè buu ce weèe aè koo ese beèe aè ñger, ker ba buu ce weèe ku ce geèe ba aèmboè weèe aè gwáá.
English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

Limbum: A mboè weèe ku ba wa' foñ. Beèe a yá weèe efa mmïìr, weèe yáátïì aè beâe byáánïì, a fyá' enjep mú, weèe ba ñgaâa mbo'ni, a ba ñgaâa bsaèrbuu.
English: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

Limbum: Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, ba beèe Farïìsïî. Weèe yu ñgaâa mbo'ni njobeè' weèe aè boo msheâ mmboèñmboñ neè ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, ba beèe ce a m ce cu rcu yáánïì, a kupshi mi, mi ba yáánïì.
English: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

Limbum: Yáê, a maè' yeè Ndap Nyúè e táá mboèmmbo.
English: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná weèe be keèr yá máè ka', caar tá nfeè' gháá ce weèe be laèa enáê, ‘Nyúè ghoni ñwáè ce e vúè aè rlii Tata Nyúè.” ’
English: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'

Limbum: Jisoès aè m fúú embe Ndaèp Nyúè, a ka' ce duè, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du a yá ye, a duñshi ye Ndap Nyúè.
English: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Mboè weèe ce yá ndap ca a? M ce suñ weèe neè mini- ñwáè ená luèr moè' be cu nje Ndap Nyúè ca ka'. A be káèáshi vi wááwá.”
English: But he answered them, You see all of these things, don't you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.

Limbum: E du a cu mbe rtuèu Oleèf, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du a yá ye, a ku ba a woweèe mbo caè'caè'. Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Suñ weèr nfeè' ce buu ca vi be koni. Yuu ce yi be duèñshi ená aè ce vúè, ñgoèñ yi ce mïì foñ yu ká?”
English: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe lor nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo' weèe ka'.
English: Jesus answered them, Be careful that no one leads you astray.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a be vúè a máâ rlii ce laèa enáê, ‘A máè Kraâis anaè’, bo' beèe magoèr tá a da'.
English: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am the Christ,' and will lead many astray.

Limbum: Weèe be yu' ená a ce maè' bïìr, keèr yu' aè mñoo ená a ce maè' bïìr aè bdïì' mo' foñ. Weèe ka' yu' wa'a, mluè mi fa koo weèe ka'. Buu ca vi be kuè koni, vi koni wa'a, yi ke' ba ba ená nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi be mïì aè gháá ka'.
English: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren't troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

Limbum: To' yi be maè' bïìr a to' mo', ñkúú ma' bïìr a ñkúú moè'. Njeè be koo, tá ñgoèñ yi ci'ti aè bdïì' jáá jáèá jáá.
English: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

Limbum: Buu ca be ba neè beèe aèmboè aè nfeè' ce njeñwáè e ke káè' ce luuti muu naè.
English: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

Limbum: A be koo weèe fa mbe mmbo beèe mo' tá a fa weèe ñgá', yúshi weèe. Beèe wááwá a be baèa weèe njo' máè.
English: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name's sake.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a be kúti njïìnjïì, baèa wap btu, fyeèni wap btu,
English: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

Limbum: tá beèe ce a ce nya' mnde' ená woweèe a yu ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a nyáá, bo' beèe magoèr tá a da'.
English: Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.

Limbum: Buu bbebep vi be kuè' goèr, tá rkoèñnïì beèe magoèr li wánïî.
English: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ku táá tatap du ba' aè lúèsimbuèu baná ñgaèñ be luèñ.
English: But he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

Limbum: A be feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè ca aè ñgoèñ wááwá tá bto' wááwá a yu', tá ñgoèñ yi ka' mïì.
English: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

Limbum: “Baná weèe ka' ke yá yuu bsaèrbuu ce yi bepsi Ndap Nyúè e táá mboèmmbo ce Danïìyáèl ce e m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa aèmboè yi naè, aèmboè yi táá mbe dïû' rara embe Ndaèp Nyúè Ñwáè ce e ce beè' ñwaè' ca rïîñ,
English: When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place let the reader understand,

English: For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

Limbum: Yáê, máè suñ weèe buu ca tá nfeè' ka' gháá.
English: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

Limbum: Baná wee weèe ka' ke yá buu ca ce koni, weèe riñ weená nfeè' anaè yu aètútú seê.
English: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñgúè beèe e seè'ni be kweñger wáá tá buu ca ka' ba ka'.
English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.

Limbum: Rbuu ba nshe a be keèe mïì, geewa'a wa blaèa vi be keèe mïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
English: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

Limbum: “AÈ ka' ba aèmboè noèñ ba nfeè' ce buu ca vi be koni, ñwáè moè' rïìñ ka', ka' bcïìndap Nyúè, káè Muu Nyúè áè. Ñwáè ce e rïìñ, ku ba ba Taèr caè'caè'.
English: But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

Limbum: Nfeè' ce Muu Ñwáè be vúè, be ba aèmboè nfeè' yïì Nowa aè m ba naè.
English: As the days of Noah were, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

Limbum: Rboâñtu li be ba neè ñwáè rfaè' ce yïì masaè aè ka' kúti, yá aèmboè e ce geèe li rfaè' aè njáâá wa'a.
English: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená masaè anaè be fa yïì buu wááwá mbe yeâ mmboè.
English: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

Limbum: Ka' ba ená ñwáè rfaè' anaè yu ñwáâ mbembep, laa neè yïì nyor enáê, ‘Yi be loèr nfeè' seê, tá yaè masaè ka' vúè’,
English: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, 'My lord is delaying his coming,'

Limbum: ká' ce lïìp ñgaâa mfaè' mo', ce yeñger, ce noñger a no ñkoo weèe,
English: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

Limbum: baná yïì masaè be vúè aè noâñ mo', aè nfeè' ce e ba riñ ka',
English: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn't expect it, and in an hour when he doesn't know it,

Limbum: gwaète ye aè btete aè btete, fa ye dïì' ba aè múè beèe ce a yu ñgaâa bo' wap btu. Beèe a be ce warse ce kúr msoèñ aèfo.
English: and will cut him in pieces, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. There is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

Limbum: “Be ba aè nfeè' anaè tá kúú Nyúè yi ba aèmboè nfeè' ce boo mñgoèñgoè mo' beèe nrúú a m loèr wap blaêm, a du aè rkoni nduu-guèu.
English: Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.

Limbum: E m fa buu neè ñwáè aèmboè ñger ñgaèñ yi m ba. E m fa moè' ncúèkïì taê, a fa moè' ncúèkïì baa, a fa moè' ncúèkïì moè'sir. E ka' fa, a du aè mbeè.
English: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m koo ncúèkïì ta naè aè loèr mbaèa anaè a ku ká' a ce geèe ntaa aègho, a ye sá' aè ncúèkïì taê.
English: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m koo ncúèkïì baa naè aè gee ntaa foñ, a ye sá' aè ncúèkïì baa.
English: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m koo yi ncúèkïì moè'sir naè aè du a tuñ beè'teè a súti mbaèa anaè njo.
English: But he who received the one went away and dug in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

Limbum: Yaèp masaè aè m cu aè mbeè seê, a ka' kúti, a fyá' ená woweèe a m di' gee eká neè mbaèa ce e m fa neè woweèe naè lá.
English: Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m koo ncúèkïì baa naè, aè vú foñ, a laa enáê, ‘Masaè, wáè m fa máè ncúèkïì baa. Yáê, máè geèe ntaa aègho a ye sá' aè ncúèkïì baa.’
English: He also who got the two talents came and said, 'Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents besides them.'

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m koo ncúèkïì moè'sir naè aè vú foñ, a laa enáê, ‘Masaè, máè m rïìñ máná aè yu ñwáâ ntatap seê. Wáâ ke kep yuu ce wáè m byeè ka', kap yuu ce wáè m ñwañ ka'.
English: He also who had received the one talent came and said, 'Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter.

Limbum: Baná wáè m ba láè ya mbaèa mbe baêñ, máâ kúti, tá m bo koo ya mbaèa neè sá'- ñwáè.
English: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

Limbum: Baná weèe koo ncúèkïì anaè ese ye, fa neè ñwáè ce e túr ncúèkïì rúú naè.
English: Take away therefore the talent from him, and give it to him who has the ten talents.

Limbum: Yi yu ená ñwáè ce e ka' túr yuu, baná a be keèr fa ye buu moè', tá e misi túr buu goèr. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá túr yuu ka', baná a be koo ka' mú yïì ce e túr naè ese ye.
English: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away.

Limbum: Koo neè ñwáè rfaè' ce e yu ñwáâ cicïì naè, ma' aè dïì' ce ku ba ba túè'nji ce beèe a be ce warse ce kúr msoèñ aèfo.’
English: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

Limbum: “Be keèe be aè nfeè' ce Muu Ñwáè aè vúè neè yi foèo-ñwáè a bcïìndap Nyúè wááwá naè, tá e cu mbe yi kaèbaèraè' foèo,
English: But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

Limbum: Weèr aè m yá wáè ba aè se'ká, wáè ba kïìloè, weèr aè konïì wáè, káè wáè ba mbuèuriñ, weèr aè fa wáè bcáè'?
English: When did we see you as a stranger, and take you in; or naked, and clothe you?

Limbum: Weèr aè m yá wáè ba aè se'ká, wáè ce yañ, káè a ba mbe shañ áè, weèr aè ca'ni wáè?’
English: When did we see you sick, or in prison, and come to you?'

Limbum: Woweèe a ce laèa wa'a, ñkúú beesi neè woweèe enáê, ‘M ce suñ weèe neè mini- ñwáè ená aèmboè weèe aè m geèe buu ca neè ñwáâ ñká' efa múè bfúr wa ca na, weèe aè m geèe ba neè máè.’
English: The King will answer them, 'Most certainly I tell you, inasmuch as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.'

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshi wa'a, tá e beesi enáê, ‘M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená aèmboè weèe aè m jaè' ka' mú ñwáâ ñká' efa múè bfúr wa ca ka' na, baná weèe aè m jaè' máè ka'.’
English: Then he will answer them, saying, 'Most certainly I tell you, inasmuch as you didn't do it to one of the least of these, you didn't do it to me.' Matthew Matïìyoè 25 46 E laèa wa'a, tá woweèe a du niñ njep ñgá' ce nfeseè, tá beâe byáánïì a du cu rcu ce nfeseè.” These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa buu ca mïìsi, a laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê,
English: It happened, when Jesus had finished all these words, that he said to his disciples,

Limbum: “Weèe rïìñ weená ku báti mnoâñ bbaa tá a ye ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap. A be koo Muu Ñwáè fa neè beèe tá a taa mbe kïìntaa.”
English: You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba bleebeèe, a tarteè mbe ndaèp mbe Kaifaès ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì,
English: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

Limbum: a seesi aèmboè a be geèe ka' koo Jisoès aè bfee, yú.
English: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa enáê, “Seèe fa koo ye ba aè múè ñkaè' ka', faè dïì' beèe a lo lapni, reè bkoèr ka'.”
English: But they said, Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ba aè rla' Bátanïì, mbe ndaèp Saimúèn ñwáè msaèasïì.
English: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' aè vúê, a yá ye, a túr mú ntúñ bluèr, njáèá mgúr mo' ce mi luèu ntaa seê, mi ba njo, e cu'nïì ye mbe tuè aè nfeè' ce e m ce ye byee.
English: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yá, nyor aè bep woweèe, woweèe a laa enáê, “A jarsi mgúr ca aè cicïì wa'a njoká?
English: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, Why this waste?

Limbum: A ba fyeèni aè mbaèa goèr seê, loèr mbaèa efa gho fa neè ñgaâa fuèp.”
English: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m rïìñ yuu ce woweèe a m ce laèa, a laa enáê, “Weèe ce fa njeñwáè ca ñgá' wa' njoká? E geèe ba yuu boèñboñ neè máè.
English: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, Why do you trouble the woman? Because she has done a good work for me.

Limbum: Ñgaâa fuèp a ku ba weèe woweèe aè nfeè' sïìp, aè ka' ba yi aèmboè máè, seèe be ba aè nfeè' sïìp ka'.
English: For you always have the poor with you; but you don't always have me.

Limbum: E cuè'ni máè mgúr ca aè nyoèr wa'a, a ce kupshi yaè nyor, tá a ka' tuñ máè.
English: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená faèdïì' wááwá ce a ka' fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca njep ñgoèñ na, a be suñ yuu ce e geèe na, ce kuushi ye.”
English: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.

Limbum: Ca yi ka' mïì, ñwáè moè' efa múè beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, ce a m ce too ená Judas IÌskarïìyoèt, aè du a yá beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì,
English: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ka' fa Jisoès mba weâe mmboè, weèe fa máè ká?” Woweèe a be' mbaèa mntaar a fa neè ye.
English: and said, What are you willing to give me, that I should deliver him to you? They weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

Limbum: E ká' ese aè nfeè' anaè a ce roèo nduunjïì aè rfyeèni Jisoès.
English: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ entombïì efa ñkaè' ce a m ce ye bráâd ce a láè yis njo ka', ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a vú a yá ye, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce koèñ ená weèr fár byee ba fá tá aè bo ye ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap aègho?”
English: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Duè neè du yá ñwáè moè' aè múè rla', laa neè ye enáê, ‘ñwáè ryá'nïì aè laèa enáê, “Yaè nfeè' aè gháá. M be ye ñkaâ' caèasi mndap weèr ñgaâa yá'ni yaè buu mbe wáâ ndaèp.” ’ ”
English: He said, Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, 'The Teacher says, My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.'

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ku gee aèmboè e m laèa, a fár byee ñkaè' anaè.
English: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr, e cu a yïì beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, tá a bo ye byee.
English: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce ye byee, e laa enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená moè' efa weèe be fyeèni máè.”
English: As they were eating, he said, Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.

Limbum: Woweèe a koosimnse seê, a ká' a ce bipshi aè moè'sir aè moè'sir enáê, “Tataê, waè' a máè a?”
English: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, It isn't me, is it, Lord?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè ce yi bo yi be tarte a ya njep kañ, yu ñwáè ce e be fyeèni máè.
English: He answered, He who dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same will betray me.

Limbum: Muu ñwáè be kuè duè aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè naè. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ndoèo be co' ñwáè ce e be fyeèni ye. Yi yu aèndeèe neè ñwáè anaè ená a m ba bi ye ka'.”
English: The Son of Man goes, even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.

Limbum: Judaès ce e m ba aè rfyeèni ye naè, aè laa enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, waè' a máè a?” Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ laèa yo cuèu.”
English: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, It isn't me, is it, Rabbi? He said to him, You said it.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce ye byee, Jisoès aè lor bráêd, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi, a fa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa enáê, “Koè neè ye, ca yu yaè nyor.”
English: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

Limbum: E lor ndoñ, a yoñshi Nyúè, a fa neè woweèe, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè wááwá no mruè' enjep ndoñ na.
English: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, All of you drink it,

Limbum: Ca yu wa bláá ce vi kur leâ' Nyúè, ce vi be fúú, suèu aètu beèe magoèr, tá Nyúè bo foèosi woweèe efa buu bbebep ce woweèe a geèe.
English: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná m be keèr no mruè' ce a geèe neè mbaèñ ce na ka' caar baè' aè noèñ ce m be no mïû mfi weèe seèe weèe mbe dïû' kúú yaè Taê.”
English: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father's Kingdom.

Limbum: Woweèe a yop yáá, a nati a ce duè mbe rtuèu Oleèf.
English: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

Limbum: A ka' ce duè mbo Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Be ba neètú' e ntïìni na, tá weèe wááwá cañse ma' máè. Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, ‘M be lïìp ñwáè ncïìñ njeèe tá njeèe yi da'se.’
English: Then Jesus said to them, All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, m be fúú efa rkwe duè aè ñgoâñ Galeèle tá weèe vú koni máè aèfo.”
English: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa enáê, “Beèe ca wááwá a ka' ma' wáè, m ma' wáè ka'.”
English: But Peter answered him, Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená tá nduñgúp ka' toñ neètú' e ntïìni na, aè be kani ñkaèraè' taar ená aè rïìñ máè ka'.”
English: Jesus said to him, Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.

Limbum: Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “Yi ka' ku ba ba ená soè kwe aèbee, m kanïì ka'.” Bár ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu wááwá a ku laa wa' foñ.
English: Peter said to him, Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you. All of the disciples also said likewise.

Limbum: Jisoès a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe a du mbe dïì' mo' embe rtuèu anaè ce a m ce too ená Gáètsámanïì, e laa neè woweèe enáê, “Cu neè mbena tá m du nje na duè geèe rloo.”
English: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, Sit here, while I go there and pray.

Limbum: E lor Pitaè ba boo Sábáèdi a baa, a du a woweèe. E m káè' a ce señ buu, mluè mi ce koo ye seê,
English: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

Limbum: e laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñkoosimnse ce e yu njep máâ ntee yu ba yïì ce aède' e ku yú máè. Cu neè mbena tá seèe ce keè'ni.”
English: Then he said to them, My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.

Limbum: E lo embo a du aè njïìsaèp ka', a gwe kúkúèp a loo a laa enáê, “Yaè Taê, yi ka' ba aètáèr, aè gee tá ndoñ ñgá' ca caa embe máâ tuè. Geewa'a, ke' ba ená aè gee ba aèmboè m ce koèñ ka', geèe ba aèmboè wáè koèñ.”
English: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.

Limbum: E ka' naèti embe dïì' ce e ba ce geèe rloo naè kúti, a yá ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ce buumi. E laa neè Pitaè enáê, “Baná aède' weèe aè ke' ba cu mbekïì tá seèe ce keè'ni aèmboè awaè moè'sir ka' a?
English: He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, What, couldn't you watch with me for one hour?

Limbum: Ke'ni neè ce loo, faè dïì' weèe gwe rmoèoshïì ka'. Ntee njep rbúè, bsáè nje nyoèr.”
English: Watch and pray, that you don't enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker duê, a loo a laa enáê, “Yaè Taê, yi ka' ba ená aède' ndoñ ca caa embe máâ tuè ka', baná aè gee tá yuu ce aè ce koèñ yi geetïî.”
English: Again, a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, My Father, if this cup can't pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.

Limbum: E ka' kúti, a ker yá woweèe a ce buumi, mmirloè mi ku ce duè neè woweèe duè.
English: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

Limbum: E ker ma'shi woweèe mbo, a ker du a ker loo, a ku laa aèmboè e ba laa naè.
English: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

Limbum: E ka' mïìsi, a kúti a yá ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ku bii ce buumi, a ce lúèshi a? Yáê, nfeè' aè gháá. A be fa Muu Ñwáè mbe mmbo ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep.
English: Then he came to his disciples, and said to them, Sleep on now, and take your rest. Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

Limbum: Loè neè tá seèe ce duè. Ñwáè ce e fyeni máè naè yu aètútú.”
English: Arise, let's be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.

Limbum: E ka' kuè bii mïìsi efa cuèu, Judaès ce e m ba moè' efa beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè- rrúèú, aè toseè. E m ba a ku' beèe ce beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba bleebeèe a m tuu. Woweèe a m túr bsaè' ba mmbaèñ.
English: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priest and elders of the people.

Limbum: Judaès ce e m fyeèni ye naè aè m suñ woweèe wáá enáê, “Ñwáè ce m ka' baa nje nyoèr, baná a ye; weèe koo.”
English: Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.

Limbum: E ka' tose, a ko'shi aègee Jisoès, a laa neè ye enáê, “Máè caè'ni wáè, Rabaèi.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a baa ye nje nyoèr.
English: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, Rabbi! and kissed him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ñkaraè, geèe yuu ce wáè ba vú aèfa aè rgeèe.” Beèe anaè a vúê, a koo ye a ba'ni.
English: Jesus said to him, Friend, why are you here? Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

Limbum: Yi ka' koni wa'a, moè' efa beèe ce a m ba a Jisoès weèe, aè co' yïì saè' a tee tuè' ese ñkwaèa ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì.
English: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa yi yu neè ye enáê, “Kúsi saè' mbaè ruèu njobeè' ñwáè ce e co' saè', be keèe kuè kwe aè saè'.
English: Then Jesus said to him, Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

Limbum: AÈ ce kwaè'shi wáná aède' m ke' laa neè yaè Ta tá e ku tuusi máè vi bcïìndap bkúr aèñgoo ka' a?
English: Or do you think that I couldn't ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

Limbum: Yaè Ta ka' gee wa'a, baná yuu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi ce laèa aèmboè buu ca yi ghááteè njo aè njáâá ká?”
English: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè beèe aè nfeè' anaè enáê, “Weèe aè vúè aè rkoo máè, a túr bsaè' ba mmbaèñ aèmboè m yu lá nyáèá wa'a njoká? Máè m ce vúè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá ce cu aè nsheè ce yá'ni beèe, weèe aè ke' koo máè ka'.
English: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn't arrest me.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, buu ca wááwá vi koni tá yuu ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m sañ yi bo ghááte njo.” Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu wááwá a ma' ye, a cañse.
English: But all this has happened, that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left him, and fled.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m koo Jisoès naè a m loèr ye a du aègho mbe ndaèp Kaifaès ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba bleebeèe a m kaari mbo.
English: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

Limbum: Pitaè aè du a yeâ mbuèu, a ba yi encaèñ. E du a ba' mbe cuèu mambe ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a niñ mbo, a cu aè nsheè a beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Ndap Nyúè, tá e bo yá yuu ce yi be ba.
English: But Peter followed him from a distance, to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa kansuèr, a roo beèe tá a bo vúè táá njïìnsa' mnaèñ, tá a koo ye yú. Geewa'a, a yá faèa ka'.
English: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death;

Limbum: Ku' beèe a vúê, a ke' laa yuu mo'sir ka'. AÈ ka' ba aè lúèsimbuèu, beèe mo' beèe a mmbaa a vúê,
English: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Byá ca aè m laèa ená aède' e ku sa'sïì Ndap Nyúè ca, ker ba'ri aè mnoâñ btaar.”
English: and said, This man said, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.'

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè natïì mbekïì, a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè túr yuu aè rbeèesi kuu buu ce beèe ca a laèa a kuu wáè na ka' a?”
English: The high priest stood up, and said to him, Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa yuu ka'. Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè laa neè ye enáê, “M ce laèa neè wáè ená aè kaa aè rlii Nyúè ce e yu nteèe, suñ ka weèr ená aè yu Kraâis anaè, ce e yu Muu Nyúè naè láê.”
English: But Jesus held his peace. The high priest answered him, I adjure you by the living God, that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ laèa yo cuèu. M ce suñ weèe wááwá máná ká' e seè'ni na, weèe be yá Muu Ñwáè aèmboè e cu aè rkoo maè' Nyúè ce e túr ñger wááwá, keèr yá foñ aèmboè e ce suèu mbenduè mmbaè' embe buèu.”
English: Jesus said to him, You have said it. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè sasïì bcáè' efa nyoèr, a laa enáê, “E bepsi rlii Nyúè. Mbuèu moè' ker ba neè seèe aè rlaèa ená ñwáè moè' ker laa yuu kuu ñwáè ca ka'. To weèe aè yu' aèmboè e bepsi rlii Nyúè.
English: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

Limbum: Weèe aè laèa wee ká?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Yi yu ená a yú ye.”
English: What do you think? They answered, He is worthy of death!

Limbum: A ka' laèa wa'a, a ce ye neè mce nje mmïìr, a túúshi ye neè bdúè'. Beèe mo' a lip ye neè mmbo,
English: Then they spit in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Wáè ce aè yu Kraâis anaè, to' ka ená aè lïìp nda wáè lá.”
English: saying, Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?

Limbum: Pitaè aè m cu njep mambe, muunje moè' ce e m ba ñwáè rfaè' aè vúê, a yá ye, a laa enáê, “Wá wáè aè m ba weèe Jisoès ce aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.”
English: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!

Limbum: E kanïì aè bsii beèe wááwá, a laa enáê, “M rïìñ yuu ce aè ce laèa ka'.”
English: But he denied it before them all, saying, I don't know what you are talking about.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a du a táá njep cuèu ñka' embe mambe anaè, muunje moè' ce e m ba ñwáè rfaè' aè ker yá ye, a laa neè beèe ce a m ba aèfo enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè m ba a Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt.”
English: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him, and said to those who were there, This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ker kani, a kaêa, a laa enáê, “Máè rïìñ ñwáè anaè ka'.”
English: Again he denied it with an oath, I don't know the man.

Limbum: Mú nfeè' moè' aè ka' tuuse, beèe ce a m ba aèfo a ko'shïì aègee Pitaè, a laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ yu moè' efa woweèe ghup njobeè' njáèá njïì ce aè ce laèa yi ce duèñshi wa'a.”
English: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ye leè', a laa enáê, “Ndoèo co' máè ce ka' tá ba ená m ce laèa ba yuu mini ka'. M rïìñ ñwáè anaè ka'.” Nduñgúp aè ku toñ aè nfeè' anaè.
English: Then he began to curse and to swear, I don't know the man! Immediately the rooster crowed.

Limbum: Pitaè aè kuushïì yuu ce Jisoès aè m laèa neè ye enáê, “Tá nduñgúp ka' toñ, aè be kani ñkaèraè' taar ená aè rïìñ máè ka'.” E ka' kuushi wa'a, a fúú njep mbeè, a bú' rwar.
English: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times. He went out and wept bitterly.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú', beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba bleebeèe a cuteè, a seesi aèmboè a be geèe ka' yú Jisoès.
English: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

Limbum: Woweèe a kur ye, a lor ye a du aègho, a fa neè Pailáèt ce e m ba govanoè.
English: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

Limbum: Judaès ce e m fyeèni ye naè, aè ka' yá ená a teni mnsa' ená a yú Jisoès, a kupse yi ntee, a lor mbaèa mntaar caè, a du aègho, a kúsi neè beâe bgoèrgoèr ba bleebeèe caè,
English: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Máè geèe yuu bebep, a fyeni ñwáè ce e geèe yuu mo' bebep ka'.” Woweèe a laa enáê, “Yïì anaè yi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè weèr ka'. A yoè nsa'.”
English: saying, I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood. But they said, What is that to us? You see to it.

Limbum: Judaès aè ma' mbaèa anaè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a fúú, a du a kárnïî.
English: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr ca, a kwá' mbaèa anaè, a laa enáê, “Ncir yi byemi ená a lá mbaèa ca aè múè mbaèa embe Ndaèp Nyúè ka' njobeè' yu mbaèa bláá.”
English: The chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, It's not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.

Limbum: Woweèe a seesïì, a lor mbaèa anaè, a du a yuu ñkúè ñwáè mboo mkïìñ aègho tá a bo ce tuñ bkïìloè aèfo.
English: They took counsel, and bought the potter's field with them, to bury strangers in.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce a ce too ñkúè anaè ená ñkúè bláá, caar ba' ntïìni na.
English: Therefore that field was called The Field of Blood to this day.

Limbum: Ca yi ka' ba wa'a, yuu ce Jáèrïìmiyaè, ñwáè ncep ntuu aè m laèa naè yi ghááteè njo. E m laèa enáê, “Woweèe a m loèr mbaèa mntaar ce aè m ba mbaèa ce beèe Isráèl a m byemi ená a be laè' yi tu aègho,
English: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

Limbum: a yuu ñkúè ñwáè mboo mkïìñ, aèmboè Tata Nyúè aè m laèa neè máè.”
English: and they gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord commanded me.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' táá njeptii govanoè, govanoè aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “A wáè ñkúú Jus a?” Jisoès aè laa enáê, “AÈ laèa wáè wa'a.”
English: Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Jews? Jesus said to him, So you say.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba bleebeèe a ka' toshi ye aè buu moè', e beesïì yuu ka'.
English: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè laa neè ye enáê, “Mboè aè ce yu' ku' buu ce a laèa ená wáè geèe na a?”
English: Then Pilate said to him, Don't you hear how many things they testify against you?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa yuu ka' koo múcaèr, govanoè aè bááñgeèr seê.
English: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

Limbum: A m ce ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap aè bfeè' wááwá baná govanoè be fúr ñwáè shañ moè' embe shañ. E m ce fúr ba ñwáè ce aè laèa beèe ená e fúr.
English: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, ñwáè moè' ce beèe wááwá a m rïìñ ye, aè ba mbe shañ. A m too ye ená Baèrabaès.
English: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

Limbum: Beèe a ka' kaari aèbee, Pailáèt aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè ce weèe ce koèñ ená m fúr embe shañ fa neè weèe yu nda? M fúr ba Baèrabaès káè Jisoès ce a too ená Kraâis naè?”
English: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called Christ?

Limbum: E m rïìñ ená woweèe a m ce ko'ndoñ neè Jisoès, a ka' koo ye a vú aègho a fa neè ye.
English: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

Limbum: Yi m ba foñ ená aè m ba aè nfeè' Pailáèt aè m ce sa' mnsa' ca, ñgwa yïì aè cep ntuu neè ye, a laa enáê, “Fa geèe yuu mo' neè ñwáè ce e geèe yuu bebep ka' naè ka', njobeè' máè yá rlo ntïìni aèmboè ye, li fa máè ñgá' seê.”
English: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr ba bleebeèe ca, a barsïì beèe ená woweèe a laa neè Pailáèt ená e laa tá a fúr Baèrabaès, yú Jisoès.
English: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

Limbum: Govanoè aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè efa beèe a mmbaa ca ce weèe ce koèñ weená m fúr embe shañ fa neè weèe yu nda?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Baèrabaès.”
English: But the governor answered them, Which of the two do you want me to release to you? They said, Barabbas!

Limbum: Pailáèt aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Baná m be geèe má ká neè Jisoès ce a too ená Kraâis na?” Woweèe wááwá a beesïì enáê, “Taa yi mbe kïìntaa.”
English: Pilate said to them, What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ? They all said to him, Let him be crucified!

Limbum: E ker bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “M taa ye mbe kïìntaa njoká? Yuu bebep ce ñwáè ca aè geèe seeseê, yu ba ká?” Woweèe a ku ce waani, a ce laèa enáê, “Taa lá ye mbe kïìntaa.”
English: But the governor said, Why? What evil has he done? But they cried out exceedingly, saying, Let him be crucified!

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ka' yá ená yuu geèe yi ker ba ka', bghaa vi ce roèo ko' aè múè beèe, e lor mdip a su'si mi mmbo aègho aè bsii beèe, a laa enáê, “Ya bo yi yu njep rkwe ñwáè ca ka', kwaè' weèe.”
English: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a beesïì a laa enáê, “Maè'shi tá vi bláá vi ba mbe weâr tuè keèr ba mbe tu boo wer.”
English: All the people answered, May his blood be on us, and on our children!

Limbum: E fúr Baèrabaès embe shañ, a fa neè woweèe, a laêa, a lip Jisoès neè yáánsoè. A ka' lïìp wáá, a fa ená a taa ye mbe kïìntaa.
English: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

Limbum: Bsoogáè vïû govanoè, a lor Jisoès a du aègho mbe dïì' mnsa' embe nto' ce govanoè aè m ce cu mbo, bár bsoogáè wááwá a niñ mbo, a sir ye a tarte,
English: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

Limbum: a co'ni ye bcáè' efa nyoèr, a lor cáâ' beer a yarsi ye aè nyoèr,
English: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.

Limbum: a gee rtaa kúú neè bsoèpsïì a sop ye mbe tuè, a lor mbaèñ a fa neè ye mbaè bo maè'. A ka' geèe wa'a, a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi, a vúshi ye, a ká' a ce buèu ye aèmboè ñkúú wa'a, a ce laèa enáê, “Nyaèr, ñkwe Juês.”
English: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

Limbum: Woweèe a ce ye neè mce, a koo mbaèñ caè ese ye, a lip ye aègho mbe tuè.
English: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúèshi ye wáá, a co' cáâ' beer caè efa yeâ nyoèr, a lor vi bcáè', a kúsi ye aè nyoèr, a lor ye a du aègho aè rtaa mbe kïìntaa.
English: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off of him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce duè, a tarte a ñwáè moâ' aè rla' Saèireên, ce a m ce too ená Saimúèn. A koo ye aè ñger ená e byá' kïìntaa.
English: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' mbe dïì' ce a m ce too ená Golgotaè, ce mbuèu efa rlii ca yu enáê, “Dïû' keèkeèp tu.”,
English: They came to a place called Golgotha, that is to say, The place of a skull.

Limbum: a fa ye mruè' ce a m fïìñshi neè ñgúè-cece' ená e no. E ka' yu'shi, a kani efa rno.
English: They gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' taa ye mbe kïìntaa, a lor vi bcáè' a ma' kaèñ aègho tá a bo yá aèmboè a be gaèp. A ka' gaèp wáá,
English: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

Limbum: a cu aè nsheè a ce keè'ni ye.
English: and they sat and watched him there.

Limbum: A sañ mbuèu ce a taa ye mbe kïìntaa, a la' mbe tu kïìntaa. A m sañ mbo enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu Jisoès ce ñkúú Juês.”
English: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

Limbum: A m taa byáèá a baa a Jisoès weèe mbe bkïìntaa, moè' aè ba aè bo maè', moè' aè ba a yeâ bo ñkoèp.
English: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce caèa yap caèa, a kor btu, a su' ye neè mcáp,
English: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Wáè ce aède' aè sa'sïì Ndap Nyúè, baè'ri aè mnoâñ btaar, jaè' laè yo tu. Yi ka' ba ená aè yu Muu Nyúè, suèu laè embe kïìntaa.”
English: and saying, You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, ba bleebeèe, a ku vúshi ye aè njáâá wa' foñ.
English: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

Limbum: Woweèe aè m laèa enáâ, “E m jaè’ beèe mo’, a moo aè rjaè’ yi tu laè’r. E yu ñkuù beèe Isràèl; e suu laè embe klìntaa seè’ni na, tá seèe bo byemi neè ye.
English: He saved others, but he can't save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

Limbum: E làé ntee njep Nyùk, baná Nyùk ka' koñ ye, e fùr laè ye efa fígà’, njobee’ e m laèa ená è ye Muu Nyùk.
English: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, 'I am the Son of God.'

Limbum: Byáèá ce a m taa a Jisoès weèe mbe bkïìntaa naè, a su' ye neè mcáp aè njáâá wa' foñ.
English: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' kuèu ñgoèñ, túè' aè sii.
English: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè aè nyúè taar wa'a, Jisoès aè waa, a laa enáê, “ÁÈloêi, ÁÈloêi, Lama Saèbaètanïì?” ce mbuèu efa gho yu enáê, “Yaè Nyúè, Yaè Nyúè, wáè leèse máè njoká?”
English: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani? That is, My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?

Limbum: Beèe mo' ce a m tááte aèfo, a ka' yu', a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca ce ká' AÈlajaè.”
English: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, This man is calling Elijah.

Limbum: Moè' efa woweèe aè ka' yu' wa'a, a cañ a lor kúèsha, a fúú njep mruè' ce mi ce bañshi, a fapte aè ñke', a fa neè ye ená e bo nyoñ.
English: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

Limbum: Bár beèe a laa yap enáê, “Beè táá ka wa' láê; seèe yá ka ená waè' AÈlajaè be vúè jaè' ye lá.”
English: The rest said, Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to save him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker waa, a ma'shi li ryoèñ neè Nyúè.
English: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

Limbum: Cáè' ce a m teni dïû' mo' embe Ndaèp Nyúè aègho yi ku sati aè nfeè' anaè tïìtïìyáá, ká' embe tuè, ba' njep mbuèu, ñgoèñ yi ci'tïì, myáá mi wañgeèr,
English: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

Limbum: msheè mi mú'ñgeèr, beèe Nyúè magoèr ce a m kweñger a fúú, a ba bteèe.
English: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' loè fúú efa rkwe, woweèe a fúúseè enjep msheè, a niñ aè Rla' Rrara, a duñshi yaèp nyor neè beèe magoèr.
English: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè rjeèe, ba bsoogáè ce a woweèe a m ce keè'ni Jisoès aè ka' yá aèmboè ñgoèñ yi cïì'ti, keèr yá buu ce vi koni, a wáp seê, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè m ba Muu Nyúè ghup.”
English: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

Limbum: Bbyeèñge a m ba aèfo aèñgoo, a táá aè njïìsaèp a ce fyá'. AÈ m ba bbyeèñge ce a m loâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a du a Jisoès weèe, tá a bo jaè' ye aè buu.
English: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa woweèe aè m ba Máèári ce aè rla' Makdalaè, ba Máèári ce e m ba ma yïì Jáêms ba Josáèf, ker ba ma boo vïû Sábáèdïî.
English: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr, ñwáè mbaèa moè' ce aè rla' AÈrimaètiyaè aè vúê. A m too ye ená Josáèf, ye ye aè ba moè' efa ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès.
English: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus' disciple came.

Limbum: E m duè a yá Pailáèt, a laa neè ye ená e fa gúâú ñwáè neè ye tá e tuñ. Pailáèt aè byemïì.
English: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

Limbum: Josáèf aè koo gúèú ñwáè, a kur njep ma cáâ' boèñboñ,
English: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

Limbum: a lá njep li rsheâ rfi ce e m soè' nje ryáá, a biñsi ma luèr, a cete ncuâu rsheè aègho, a nati a duê.
English: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.

Limbum: Máèári ce aè rla' Makdalaè, ba Máèári moè' caè, a m cu aè ncuâu rsheè.
English: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, ce noèñ ce a m ce fáèr buu mmbomntaa Nyúè yi m caèa yi wáá, beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba beèe Farïìsi a du a yá Pailáèt,
English: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Masaè, weèr ce kuushi ená aè m ba aè nfeè' ce ñwáè mbo' beèe ca aè m bii nteèe, e m laèa enáê, ‘Mnoèñ vi be caâa btaar, tá m fúú efa rkwe.’
English: saying, Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: 'After three days I will rise again.'

Limbum: Baná wáè ba laèa tá a ke'ni rsheè anaè boèñboñ caar tá mnoèñ vi caâa btaar, faè dïì' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a vú yáèá gúâú ñwáè, suñ beèe ená e fúú efa rkwe, tá mnde' ce a nya' elúèsimbuèu na mi caa mïì entoèmbïì ka'.”
English: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, 'He is risen from the dead;' and the last deception will be worse than the first.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Loèr neè ñgaâa rkeè'nïì ca tá weèe woweèe duê, du yá ená woweèe a keè'ni rsheè anaè boèñboñ.”
English: Pilate said to them, You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.

Limbum: Woweèe a duê, a fa ncoèo aè luèr embe nduè ncuâu rsheè, faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo joèo ka', a lá ñgaâa rkeè'nïì caè aèfo.
English: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

Limbum: Mmbomntaa Nyúè mi ka' caèa wáá, ce túè' be raa tá ba noèñ entombïì embe múè ñgaèa naè, aè ku bii aè mú ñgaèptú' seê, Máèári ce aè rla' Makdalaè, ba Máèári moè' caè, a du aè rfyá' rsheè.
English: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

Limbum: Ka' cu, ñgoèñ yi ci'tïì tatap seê, ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè suu embe buèu, a biñsi luèr embe ncuèu rsheè, a cu mbenduè mo.
English: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.

Limbum: E m ce baèpñger aèmboè sa'mbeèñ wa'a, vi bcáè' vi ce fúp aèmboè mmbaè' wa'a.
English: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce keè'ni rsheè a wáp, a kañ seê, a ba aèmboè bgúâú beèe wa'a.
English: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè aè laa neè bbyeèñge anaè enáê, “Weèe fa wáp ka'. M rïìñ máná weèe ce roèo ba Jisoès ce a mú taa mbe kïìntaa naè.
English: The angel answered the women, Don't be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

Limbum: E yu mbena ka'. E fúú efa rkwe aèmboè e m laèa naè. Vúè neè yá mbe dïì' ce yi gúèú yi mú noêñ.
English: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

Limbum: Weèe du cárcár du suñ ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená e fúú efa rkwe. E ce duè lá aè ñgoâñ Galeèle entombïì neè woweèe. Woweèe a be baè' aèfo tá a yá lá ye. A yuu ce máè suñ weèe.”
English: Go quickly and tell his disciples, 'He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.' Behold, I have told you.

Limbum: Woweèe a naètïû aè ncuâu nsheè cárcár seê, neè bwáp-ñwáè ker ba neè rlu'shïì- ñwáè, a cañ a du aè rsuñ ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu.
English: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

Limbum: Ka' cu, Jisoès aè tarteè a woweèe, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè caè'ni weèe.” Woweèe a du a gwe njep yeâ tïìi, a gú'shi neè ye.
English: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, Rejoice! They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa wáp ka'. Duè neè suñ bfúr wa ená woweèe a du aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê. Woweèe a be baè' aèfo, yá máè.”
English: Then Jesus said to them, Don't be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce duè, beèe mo' efa múè beèe ce a m ce keè'ni rsheè a du aè múè rla', a suñ beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì yuu ce yi koni.
English: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu', a yá bleebeèe a woweèe a cuteè a fa ntañ, a lor ku' mbaèa a fa neè bsoogáè caè,
English: When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weâe duè, weèe laa weená ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a vúè neètú' a yáá gúâú ñwáè, weèe aè ce lá buumi.
English: saying, Say that his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

Limbum: Govanoè aè ka' yu' nsuñ ca, weèr yá ye nashi neè ye, faè dïì' weèe niñ aè ñgá' ka'.”
English: If this comes to the governor's ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.

Limbum: Woweèe a koo mbaèa, a gee aèmboè a m laèa neè woweèe. Jus a ku bii ce suñ nsuñ ca aè njáâá wa'a caar ba' ntïìni na.
English: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until this day.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce ncoèp-moè'sir-aè-rrúèú, a du aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a du a ko' mbe rtuèu ce Jisoès aè m laèa ená woweèe a ko' mbo naè.
English: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá ye, a gú'shi neè ye, beèe mo' a tarnïì yap tarni.
English: When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.

Limbum: Jisoès aè vúê, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “A fa ñger embe buèu ba enjep nsheè wááwá neè máè.
English: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

Limbum: Duè neè du gee tá beâe aè bto' wááwá a ba ñgaâa yá'ni yaè buu. Baèptir neè woweèe aè rlii Taèr, ba Muu, ba Yú' Rara,
English: Go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

Limbum: yá'ni woweèe tá a gee buu wááwá ce máè laèa neè weèe. Rïìñ neè ená m be ba weèe seèe aè nfeè' wááwá caar duè baè' aè nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi be mïì.”
English: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age. Amen.

Limbum: Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ kuu Jisoès Kraâis ce e yu Muu Nyúè aè káè' embe na.
English: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

Limbum: A sañ mbe ñwaè' AÈsayaè ce ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè enáê, “M be tuu ya ñwáè ntuu tá e du entombïì neè wáè, duè kupshi nduunjïì neè wáè.
English: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ce fuñ aè ntee rïìñ a ce laèa enáê, ‘Kupshi neè nduunjïì neè Tataê, nashi tá yi ba kuèyáá.’ ”
English: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!'

Limbum: Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe aè m nyáá aè ntee rïìñ, a ce feè'shi ená beèe a kupse, ma' yaèp buu bbebep tá a baptir woweèe, tá Nyúè bo foèosi woweèe.
English: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

Limbum: Beâe aè to' Juèdiyaè ba beâe aè rlaè' Jáèrusaláèm bsïìp a m duè aè ryu' yuu ce e m ce feè'shi. Woweèe a m ce suñ yaèp buu bbebep, e ce baèptir woweèe njep rdip Jodaèn.
English: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

Limbum: Joân aè m yar bcáè' ce a m ba' neè mnyoâr kaèmáêl, a cúú ñguèp nyaèa njep mbuèu. Vi byee aè ba mñguu ba bluè.
English: John was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

Limbum: E m ce feè'shi a ce laèa enáê, “Ñwáè moè' be vúè embe máâ njïì ce e túr ñger a caa máè. AÈde' m ghááteè aè rbaè'shi vi bkúè blaba' ka'.
English: He preached, saying, After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

Limbum: M ce baèptir weèe neè mdip, geewa'a e be baèptir yi weèe ba neè Yú' Rara.”
English: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè Jisoès aè natïû aè rla' Nasaráèt ce aè ñgoèñ Galeèleê, aè du a yá Joân, e baptïìr ye njep rdip Jodaèn.
English: It happened in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kuè fúú enjep roè, a yá aèmboè rbuu li mú'tïì, a ker yá aèmboè Yú' Rara yi ce suèu mbe yeâ nduè aèmboè beèñ wa'a.
English: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

Limbum: Njeèndoñ aè laa embe buèu enáê, “A wáè muu waè ce m koèñ seê. M ce yu' rboèñ neè wáè seê.”
English: A voice came out of the sky, You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

Limbum: E ka' kuè fúú enjep roè, Yú' yi ku lor ye a du aègho aè ntee rïìñ.
English: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

Limbum: E m cu aèfo aè mnoèñ mñkyeèe, Sataèn aè ce moèoshi ye. Mnyaâa aè rïìñ vi m ba aè dïì' anaè, bcïìndap Nyúè vi ce keè'ni ye.
English: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce a m koo Joân a fa aè shañ, Jisoès aè du aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ yïì Nyúè neè beèe.
English: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom of God,

Limbum: E m ce laèa neè beèe enáê, “Nfeè' aè gháá, kúú Nyúè yi yu aètútú seè'ni, kupse neè, ma' yeè buu bbebep, byemi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ.”
English: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the Kingdom of God is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce jáèr aèwaâa rdip rgoèr ce aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a yá Saimúèn ba nfúr yïì ce Andruè, ce a m ba ñgaèa ñkoo nca, aèmboè a ce maè' rraa njep roè.
English: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Vúè neè fa máâ mbuèu, tá m gee weèe tá weèe ba ñgaâa ñkoo nca ce be ba ba beèe.”
English: Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, woweèe a ku lá map mraa caè, a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

Limbum: E ka' duè múcaèr, a ker yá Jáêms, ba Joân ce a m ba boo Sábáèdi mbe keñ, a ce túúshi map mraa. E ká' woweèe.
English: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

Limbum: Woweèe a ma'shïì yaèp ta ce Sábáèdi a yi ñgaâa mfaè' weèe mbe keñ, a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

Limbum: Woweèe a m duè ba' aè rla' Kaèpanuèm. AÈ ka' ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, Jisoès aè ku niñ mbe ndaèp rloo, a ká' a ce yá'ni beèe.
English: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a m báèá li ryá'nïì njobeè' li m ba aèmboè li ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ka', li m túr ñger.
English: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba mbe ndap rloo anaè ce yú' bebep yi m ba njep ye. Yú' ana yi m waa, a laa enáê,
English: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

Limbum: “Habai, Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt, yuu ce aè ce roèo ese weèr yu ba ká? Wáè vúè aè ryúshi weèr a? M rïìñ njáèá ñwáè ce aè yu. AÈ yu ñwáâ nrara ce e loè ese Nyúè.”
English: saying, Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!

Limbum: Jisoès aè lapnïì yú' anaè enáê, “Cu nyañ! Fúú enjep ye!”
English: Jesus rebuked him, saying, Be quiet, and come out of him!

Limbum: Yú' bebep ca yi m nyár ñwáè anaè a ma' aè nsheè, a waa, a fúú enjep ye.
English: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a bááñgeèr, a ce bipshi a waâp mú enáê, “Yu ba njáèá ká ce yi koni na?” Woweèe a m laèa enáê, “Cena yu ryá'nïì ce rfi ce li túr ñger mo'. E ce laèa neè byú' bbebep vi ce yu'ni neè ye.”
English: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, beèe a yu' yïì nsuñ aè bdïì' bsïìp aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

Limbum: Jisoès weèe a m fúú embe Ndaèp Nyúè, a ka' kuè fúú wa'a, e lor Jáms ba Joân a woweèe a du mbe ndaèp mbe Saimúèn ba Andruè.
English: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

Limbum: Malu yïì Saimúèn aè noñ mbe bkuu, tu yi ce luu ye. A ka' kuè niñ wa'a, woweèe a suñ Jisoès.
English: Now Simon's wife's mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

Limbum: E du a koo ye aè boè, a naa mbekïì, mbáp caè aè bornïì, e ká' a ce fáèr byee neè woweèe.
English: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr anaè, beèe mo' a vú neè ñgaèa byañ ba beèe ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m niñ njep woweèe, a vú aègho aè ryá Jisoès.
English: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá efa laè' anaè a vú a táá njep ncúèúndúè'.
English: All the city was gathered together at the door.

Limbum: E gee beèe magoèr ce a m ce yañ byañ njáèá jáá jáèá jáá, a ke'seè, a ker fúshi byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe magoèr. E m sheè ená byú' anaè vi fa laèa yuu ka' njobeè' vi m rïìñ njáèá ñwáè ce e yu.
English: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn't allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú' seê, Jisoès aè nyáá a du aè dïì' mo' ce beèe a m ba ka', a gee rloo aèfo.
English: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

Limbum: Saimúèn ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ba, a fúú a ce roèo ye.
English: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;

Limbum: A ka' yá ye, a laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè wááwá ce roèo wáè.”
English: and they found him, and told him, Everyone is looking for you.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Seèe du aè mla' mo' tá m du feè'shi aèfo foñ. A yuu ce máè m vúè aètu mo.”
English: He said to them, Let's go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.

Limbum: Awá Jisoès aè ce jáèshi aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a ce feè'shi aè mndap rloo, a ce fúshi byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe.
English: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

Limbum: Ñwáè msaèasïì moè' aè m vúè a yá Jisoès, a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi, a loo ye, a laa enáê, “Wáè ka' koêñ, aè gee m ke'seè, ba nrara.”
English: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, If you want to, you can make me clean.

Limbum: Jisoès aè koosïìmnse neè ye, a naa bo a joo ye aègho, a laa enáê, “M koèñ wa'a. Keè'se, ba nrara.”
English: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, I want to. Be made clean.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, msaèasïì mi ku lo ye efa nyoèr, e ba nrara.
English: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

Limbum: E ka' ce duè, Jisoès a ciisïì neè ye enáê,
English: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,

Limbum: “Yáê, fa suñ ñwáè ka'. Duè duñshi yoè nyor neè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì embe Ndaèp Nyúè, gee tañshïì ce Musïìs aè m laèa ená ñwáè yañ msaèasïì gee tá beèe a bo rïìñ ená ñwáè anaè aè keè'se naè.”
English: and said to him, See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

Limbum: Geewa'a ñwáè ca aè duê, a ká' a ce suñ yuu anaè neè beèe aè bdïì' wááwá. Nsuñ ca aè m geèe Jisoès aè ker ce fúú aè múè beèe ka'. E m ce cu aè rïìñ, beèe a ce vúâ aè bdïì' wááwá, a ce yá ye aèfo.
English: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' loè kúti aè rla' Kaèpanuèm, beèe a yu' ená e kúti.
English: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.

Limbum: Ku' beèe a vúseè a ruu mbe ndaèp, fáñ yi ke' ba ka'. E fe'shïì blaâa Nyúè neè woweèe.
English: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

Limbum: Beèe mo' beèe ñkyeèe, a byá' ñwáè ce yïì ñgúè' nyor mo' aè m kwe, a vú aègho.
English: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

Limbum: Beèe a m ba magoèr, woweèe a ke' yi aè rcaèa neè ñgaèñ duè yá Jisoès ka'. Woweèe a ko' a to' toto mbe tu ndap aè ñkeè'nïì embe dïì' ce Jisoès cu. A ka' to', a suusi ye mbe ndaèp njïû aè toto anaè mbe keèñ.
English: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá lap rbyemïì, a laa neè ñwáè ce mbeèp nyor aè m kwe naè enáê, “Muu waè, máè foèosi wáè efa yoè buu bbebep.”
English: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Son, your sins are forgiven you.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'nïì mncir mo' a m cute aèfo, a ce kwaè'shi enáê,
English: But there were some of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

Limbum: “E laèa wa'a njoká? E bepsi rlii Nyúè. Ñwáè ce aède' e foosïì beèe efa buu bbebep caa efa Nyúè, a nda?”
English: Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ku yi enjep yeâ ntee ená a buu ce woweèe a ce kwaè'shi, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce kwaè'shi buu ca njoká?
English: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

Limbum: Yuu ce yi yu aètáèr a yïì efá? Yu ba aè rlaèa neè ñwáè yañ ca ená, ‘Máè foèosi wáè efa yoè buu bbebep’, ká aè rlaèa ená, ‘Lo mbekïì, lor yo keèñ, jáêr.’?
English: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?'

Limbum: M be duèñshi weèe máná Muu Ñwáè túr ñger njep ñgoèñ na aè rfoèosi beèe efa yaèp buu bbebep.”
English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins--he said to the paralytic--

Limbum: E m laèa neè ñwáè yañ ca enáê, “M ce laèa neè wáè máná aè nati mbekïì, lor yo keèñ du aè laè'.”
English: I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.

Limbum: E natïì mbekïì, a lor yi keèñ a ce fúú aègho. Beèe wááwá aè ce fyá', a bááñger, a ku'si Nyúè, a ce laèa enáê, “Weèr a m be yá njáèá yuu ca ka'!”
English: He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw anything like this!

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker du aèwaâa rdip rgoèr, ku' beèe a vúê, e yá'nïì woweèe.
English: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

Limbum: E ka' ce duè, a yá Lávïì ce aè m ba muu Alfïìyoès aèmboè e cu mbe dïì' rfaè' ce e m ce koo mbaèa baèraè'. Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè fa máâ mbuèu.” E natïì a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m duè a cu mbe ndaèp mbe Lávïì a ce yeñger. Ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè', ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep a ce ye byee a ye ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu. Ku' njáèá beèe ca a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu.
English: It happened, that he was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

Limbum: Ñgaèa ryá'ni mncir ce a m ba beèe Farïìsi a ka' yá aèmboè e ce ye byee a ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep, ba ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè', a bipshi neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “E ce ye byee a ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep njoká?”
English: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?

Limbum: E ka' yu' wa'a, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Beèe ce a ke roèo ñwáè ncáèp e ke ba ñgaâa byañ, ke' ba beâe btatap ka'. Máè vúè aè rká' beâe byáánïì ka'. Máè vúè aè rká' ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep.”
English: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu vi Joân ba beèe Farïìsi a ce jïì mdip, awá beèe a du a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Ñgaâa yá'nïì buu vi Joân ba vïû beèe Farïìsi a ke jïì mdip, wo a ke' jïì yap ka' njoká?”
English: John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don't fast?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “AÈde' beèe ce a duè Ñkaâ' bguèu a ba aè nduu-guèu weèe ker ce jïì mdip a? Nduu-guèu aè ka' ku ba a woweèe aède' woweèe a ji mdip ka'.
English: Jesus said to them, Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can't fast.

Limbum: Geewa'a, nfeè' moè' be ba ce a be koo nduu-guèu tá woweèe a ji mdip aè nfeè' anaè.
English: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè saa cáâ' fi tar mbenduè cáâ' rúèú ka'. E ka' gee wa'a baná cáâ' fi caè yi be saèa yïû rúèú tá toto raa caèa yïì entombïì naè.
English: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè lor mruâ' mfi foñ lá njep mñguèp mruè' vïû brúèú ka'. E ka' gee wa'a baná mruâ' mfi anaè mi be loè koo, to'shi mñguèp mruè' anaè, tá mruè' mi kúte aè nsheè tá ñguèp mruè' anaè bú aè cicïì.” Yi ke ba ená a lá mruâ' mfi ba njep mñguèp mruè' vïû bfi tá mi bo kúète ka', tá mñguèp mruè' vi to'ñger ka'.
English: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.

Limbum: Jisoès ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m ce caèa aè ñkúè msañ moè' nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, woweèe a ce tee tu msañ a ce ye.
English: It happened that he was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu a geèe yuu ce ncir yi kani ená ñwáè fa geèe nyúè mmbomntaa nyúè ka' njoká?”
English: The Pharisees said to him, Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?

Limbum: E beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè be be' yuu ce Dávïìd aè m geèe aè nfeè' ce njeè aè m ce yañ ye ker ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ba naè ka' a?
English: He said to them, Did you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry--he, and those who were with him?

Limbum: E m duè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè nfeè' ce AÈbïìyataè aè m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a lor bráâd ce a m fa neè Nyúè, a ye, a fa bár neè beèe ce a woweèe a m ba. Ncir yi m byemi ená ñwáè moè' jáá ye caa efa ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ka'.”
English: How he entered into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Nyúè aè m láè mi mmbomntaa tá mi bo jaè' ñwáè, ke' ba ená ñwáè ba ñkwaèa neè mmbomntaa ka'.
English: He said to them, The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

Limbum: Baná Muu Ñwáè yu Taèr ce e túr mmbomntaa Nyúè.”
English: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker niñ mbe ndap rloo. Ñwáè moè' aè m ba mbo ce li rkoo li m kwe.
English: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there who had his hand withered.

Limbum: Woweèe a roo aè ryá ená Jisoès be geèe tá e ke'se nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè lá, tá woweèe a bo sa' ye ená e bú' ncir.
English: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ñwáè ce rkoo li m kwe ye anaè enáê, “Naèti vú mbena!”
English: He said to the man who had his hand withered, Stand up.

Limbum: E bipshïì neè beèe anaè enáê, “Yiseèe ncir yi byemi ená seèe gee ba yuu boèñboñ nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè káè yuu bebep? Yi byemi ená seèe ja' ñwáè jaè' káè seèe yú ñwáè yú?” Woweèe a beesïì yuu neè ye ka'.
English: He said to them, Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill? But they were silent.

Limbum: Nyor aè bep Jisoès aè ryá njáèá nteèe-tu ca. E fyá' woweèe aè rshentee, a laa neè ñwáè yañ caè enáê, “Maè' lo rkoo kuèyáá.” E ma', li kútïì boèñboñ.
English: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, Stretch out your hand. He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' yá, a ku fúú, a du a yá beèe ñkúú Hároèd moè', a woweèe a ká' a ce seèesi aèmboè a be koo Jisoès yú.
English: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

Limbum: Jisoès a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe a m loè a du aèwaâa rdip rgoèr. Beèe magoèr a du fa waâp mbuèu. AÈ m ba beâe aè ñgoâñ Galeèle ba Juèdiyaè,
English: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

Limbum: ba beâe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, ba beâe aè ñgoâñ IÌdumïìyaè ba mla' mo' ce mi m ba aèñguu rdip Jodaèn, ker ba Tayaè ba Sidoèn. Woweèe a m vúè magoèr se aè ryá ye njo' njáèá mfaè' ce woweèe a m yu' ená e m ce geèe.
