English: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená a fyá' keñ tá e bo niñ mbo faè dïì' ku' beèe anaè a bo fate ye ka'.
English: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn't press on him.

Limbum: E m laèa wa'a njobeè' e m geèe ñgaâa byañ magoèr a ke'se, ñgaâa byañ mo' a ce gheèter aè rjoèo ye ená a bo keè'se foñ.
English: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

Limbum: Byú' bbebep vi m ce yá Jisoès aè nfeè' wááwá ku gweñger aè nsheè kuèntombïì neè ye, ce waani ce laa ená, “A wáè Muu Nyúè.”
English: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, You are the Son of God!

Limbum: Jisoès aè ciisïì neè vi ená vi fa suñ ñwáè ená e yu Muu Nyúè ka'.
English: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ko' mbe rtuèu a ká' beèe ce e m koèñ, woweèe a vú a yá ye.
English: He went up into the mountain, and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúè, e co' beèe ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú aè yi ñgaâa ntuu tá a woweèe a bo ce ba, tá e bo ce tuu woweèe, tá a du ce feè'shi,
English: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach,

Limbum: keèr túr ñger aè rjuèu byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe.
English: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

Limbum: Beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ca aè m ba Saimúèn ce e m too ená Pitaè,
English: Simon, to whom he gave the name Peter;

Limbum: ba Jáms ce e m ba muu yïì Sábáèdïî, ba nfúr yïì Joân ce Jisoès aè m too woweèe ená Boanárgáès, ce mbuèu efa gho yu ená “Boo sa'mbeèñ”,
English: James the son of Zebedee; John, the brother of James, and he surnamed them Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder;

Limbum: Andruè, Feleêp, Baètoèlomïì, Matïìyoè, Tomaês, Jáms ce e m ba muu Alfïìyoès, ba Taèdiyoès. Saimúèn ce e m ba moè' efa múè beèe Siloèt,
English: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

Limbum: ba Judas IÌskarïìyoèt ce e m loè a fyeni Jisoès naè.
English: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. He came into a house.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m kúti mbe ndaèp. A ka' kúti, ku' beèe a ker kaarïì, a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe a ke' túr njïì aè rye yuu ka'.
English: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

Limbum: Yïì beèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a du aè rkoo ye njobeè' woweèe a m ce kwaè'shi ená tu yi ce kar ye.
English: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him: for they said, He is insane.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ce a m vúâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a m laèa ená Básábuèl yu njep ye, a ker ce laèa ená e ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' aè ñger ñkúú mnyúâmkaè'.
English: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, He has Beelzebul, and, By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká' woweèe a laa buu neè woweèe aè mñgaèa enáê, “AÈde' Sataèn fúr Sataèn enjep ñwáè aè njáâá ká?
English: He summoned them, and said to them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

Limbum: Ñgaèpni yi ka' ba aè to', aède' to' anaè yi táá ka'.
English: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

Limbum: Ñgaèpni yi ka' ba mbe ndaèp, aède' ndap anaè táá ka'.
English: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

Limbum: Baná Sataèn ka' ce reè bkoèr a yïì nyor, ñgaèpni yi ba, baná e be táá ka', tá ba yi wa' wáá.
English: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can't stand, but has an end.

Limbum: “Yi ku ba foñ ená aède' ñwáè niñ mbe ndaèp ñwáè ñger, kwá' yïì buu du aègho ka', ce yi ka' tá ba ená e kur ñwáè ñger anaè ka'. E ka' kur ye wáá, e ka' kwá' buu embe yeâ ndaèp.
English: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder, unless he first binds the strong man; and then he will plunder his house.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè máná Nyúè be keèe foèosi buu bbebep ce beèe a m geèe, ka' buu bbebep ce woweèe a laèa.
English: Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

Limbum: Geewa'a, ñwáè aè ka' bepsi rlii Yú' Rara, aède' Nyúè ke foosi ye ka'. Ñgaèñ be niñ aè mnsa' njo' yi yuu bebep, nfeseè.”
English: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa cena njobeè' wee mo' a m ce laèa ená yú' bebep yi yu lá njep ye.
English: --because they said, He has an unclean spirit.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ca ma Jisoès ba bfúr vi a vú a tááte njep ncúèúndúè', a ce ká' ye.
English: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

Limbum: Ku' beèe ce a m cute a Jisoès weèe naè, a m laèa neè ye enáê, “Yáê, yoè ma ba bfúr gho ba bjar gho a yu njepmbeè a ce roèo wáè.”
English: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.

Limbum: E beesïì neè woweèe ená, “Yaè ma a nda? Bfúr wa aè ba weèe ká?”
English: He answered them, Who are my mother and my brothers?

Limbum: E m fyá' beèe ce a m cute a sir ye mbe mú naè, a laa enáê, “Yáê, a yaè ma ba bfúr wa na.
English: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, Behold, my mother and my brothers!

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ce geèe yuu ce Nyúè ce koèñ, baná ñgaèñ yu nfúraè, ba njar yaè, ba yaè maê.”
English: For whoever does the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

Limbum: AÈ ka' keèr ba aè nfeè' moè', Jisoès aè ká' a ce yá'ni beèe aèwaâa roè. Ku' beèe aèñgoo se a vú a sir ye a tarte, e niñ mbe keñ a cu mbo. Beèe anaè a tááteè nje waâa roè.
English: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea, and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

Limbum: E yá'nïì woweèe buu magoèr aè mñgaèa. E m laèa neè woweèe enáê,
English: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

Limbum: “Yu' neè, ñwáè moè' aè m ce duè aè rbyeè buu,
English: Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' túr btuè', ñgaèñ yu'.”
English: He said, Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.

Limbum: E ka' ba mimñgi' beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ba beèe mo' a vúê, a laa neè ye ená e suñ woweèe mbuèu efa ñgaèa ca.
English: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Buu ce aède' beèe a riñ kuu kúú Nyúè ka' naè, Nyúè aè geèe weèe aè rïîñ. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a yu yïìseèe beèe ka' naè, a ce suñ woweèe buu wááwá ba aè mñgaèa.
English: He said to them, To you is given the mystery of the Kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a, tá woweèe a ce keè' keèr keè', yá ka', a ce yu'shi ce yu' ka', faè dïì' a bo kupse, maè' yaèp buu bbebep tá Nyúè foosi woweèe ka'.”
English: that 'seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe yi mbuèu efa ñgaèa ca ka' a? Weèe aè ka' tá yi ka', baná aède' weèe gee wee ká ka' yi mbuèu efa mñgaèa wááwá?
English: He said to them, Don't you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

Limbum: Yuu ce ñwáè mbyeè buu ca ce byeè, yu nlaèa Nyúè.
English: The farmer sows the word.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger aèwaâa nduunjïì naè, yu beèe ce a yu' nlaèa Nyúè, Sataèn ku vú fúr enjep waâp ntee.
English: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger mbenduè nshe ce e m ba mbenduè ryáá naè yu beèe ce a ke yu' nlaèa Nyúè, ku yu' rboèñ aègho seê,
English: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

Limbum: geewa'a vi ke' taa mñgaèñ njep woweèe ka', ku cu ba nfeè' múcaèr. E ba aè nfeè' beèe a ce fa woweèe ñgá', káè buu vi ba btatap neè woweèe njo' nlaèa anaè, woweèe a ku kúti njïìnjïì.
English: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger aè múè msini naè, yu beèe ce a yu' nlaèa Nyúè,
English: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

Limbum: mluè ce aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na, ba broñ buu, ba ntee ce beèe a ke túr aè buu moè', vi kur blaèa anaè, yi ke' gee ñgúè ka'.
English: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

Limbum: Yïì ce e m gweèñger mbe nshe mboèñmboñ táá aètu beèe ce a yu' nlaèa Nyúè, byemi, yi gee ñgúè, moè' ba mntaar, moè' ba mntuunfu, moè' ba rjeèe.”
English: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.

Limbum: E m ker laa neè woweèe foñ enáê, “AÈde' ñwáè cú' laêm, lor ghee kúpshi aègho, káè tár mbaè kaèasi a? AÈmboè e be tár ba mbe dïì' ce lam e ke táá a?
English: He said to them, Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn't it put on a stand?

Limbum: Rïìñ neè ená yuu ce a súèti, yi be keè yááti aèwañ, tá yuu ce a tá'shi yi yááti aèwañ foñ.
English: For there is nothing hidden, except that it should be made known; neither was anything made secret, but that it should come to light.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' túr btuè', ñgaèñ yu'.”
English: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.

Limbum: E m ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yu' neè buu ce a suñ weèe boèñboñ. Nfeè' ce wáè feè' yuu njo, ku ba yïì ce Nyúè be keè feè' njo fa neè wáè, feè' caèase embo.
English: He said to them, Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will be given to you who hear.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' túr yuu, baná a be fa ye buu moè'. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá túr yuu ka' baná a be koo ka' mú yïì ce e ce kwaè'shi ená e túr naè ese ye.”
English: For whoever has, to him will more be given, and he who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

Limbum: E m ker laa enáê, “Kúú Nyúè yi yu aè njáèá enáê, yi yu aèmboè ñwáè ce e m byeè kwaa aè múè nsuu.
English: He said, The Kingdom of God is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

Limbum: E m ku ce noèñ, túè' ce raa, nyúè ce coo. Kwaa ce e m byeè naè aè fúú a ce kuè', e ke' yi aèmboè e geèe a ka' ce kuè' ka'.
English: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he doesn't know how.

Limbum: Yu ba nshe ce e ke geèe kwaa ku', bate. Yuu entoèmbïì e ke ba nceèe, e loè embenjïìmo sop mú saè' ka' bate.
English: For the earth bears fruit: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

Limbum: E ka' bi, baná e be kep njobeè' nfeè' rkep aè gháá.”
English: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts forth the sickle, because the harvest has come.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “AÈde' seèe laa seená kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè ká? Yu njáèá ñgaèa ce efá ce aède' seèe ma' ka' riñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè yi yu?
English: He said, How will we liken the Kingdom of God? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

Limbum: AÈde' seèe laa seená yi yu aèmboè ñgúè mostaè ce e ñwáási seê.
English: It's like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

Limbum: Geewa'a, a byeè e fúú, ku', ntii efa gho ba magoèr, ba seè'ni ba aè ce ce aède' bsiñ vi ba'rïì mndap mbo.”
English: yet when it is sown, grows up, and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m maè' ku' mñgaèa mo' aèmboè bca, a fe'shi nlaèa Nyúè neè woweèe aè ndeèe ce aède' woweèe a m ba yu'.
English: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

Limbum: E m laèa yuu mo' neè woweèe, buu efa rmaè' ba ñgaèa ka', e ba a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe, sar buu wááwá neè woweèe.
English: Without a parable he didn't speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nyúè anaè aè mbuèuñkuèr, Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Seèe tuu neèñguu roè.”
English: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, Let's go over to the other side.

Limbum: Woweèe a ma'shïì ku' beèe ce a woweèe aè m ba naè, a niñ mbe keñ ce Jisoès aè m ba mbo, a woweèe a ce tuu. Bkeñ mo' vi m ce tuu foñ.
English: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

Limbum: Fu' tatap yi ká' a ce caèa, a doo mdip, mi niñ mbe keñ a sáni ruu mbo.
English: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ba mbaè njïì keñ, a lá yi tu mbe mbuu, a ce buumi. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a yáá ye, a laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, aè ce yá wáná weèr ce kweñger njep roè na ka' a?”
English: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, Teacher, don't you care that we are dying?

Limbum: E lá' efa mmirloè, a waa fu', a laa neè rdip enáê, “Táá nyañ, fa cïì'ti ka'.” Fu' yi teetïì, ñgoèñ yi ba neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, Peace! Be still! The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

Limbum: E laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Weèe ce wáp ba ká wa'a? Weèe aè be túr rbyemïì ka' a?”
English: He said to them, Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?

Limbum: Woweèe a wáp seê, a laa fa waâp mú ená, “Ñwáè ca a nda seê, ce fu' yi ce yu'ni neè ye, rdip li ce yu'ni neè ye foñ na?”
English: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

Limbum: Jisoès a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe a m duè ba' aè ñgoèñ beèe Gáèrasaè ce yi m ba neèñguu rdip rgoèr.
English: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

Limbum: E ka' kuè fúú embe keñ, ñwáè moè' ce yú' bebep yi m niñ njep ye aè vú efa dïì' ce a m ce tuñ beèe, aè ryá ye.
English: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè m ce cu ba aè dïì' anaè. Yi ke' ba aètáèr aè rkur ye, ka' neè bkwaèñ ka'.
English: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

Limbum: A m ce loè kur ye mkoo ba mkuèu neè bkwaèñ, e ku ceeshi. Ñwáè moè' aè ker túr ñger aè rkoo ye kur ka'.
English: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

Limbum: E m ce kar aè mnduè sheè ba aè mtuèu neètú' ba neèmootïì a ce war, ker ce sháshi yïì nyor neè bluèr.
English: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

Limbum: E ka' yá Jisoès aèmboè e nyáá, e cañ a du a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi,
English: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

Limbum: a waa, a laa enáê, “Jisoès, Muu Nyúè embe buèu, yuu ce soè túr a ká? M ce loo wáè aè rlii Nyúè ená aè fa fa máè ñgá' ka'.”
English: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don't torment me.

Limbum: E m laèa wa'a njobeè' Jisoès aè m laèa enáê, “Fúú enjep ñwáè ca, wáâ yú' bebep.”
English: For he said to him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Lo rlii a nda?” E beesïì enáê, “La rlii a Ncúèkïì, njobeè' weèr yu aèñgoo.”
English: He asked him, What is your name? He said to him, My name is Legion, for we are many.

Limbum: E m bu' mmbo neè Jisoès ená e fa juèu woweâe aè dïì' anaè ka'.
English: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

Limbum: Kúr ñkuânyaèm mo' goèr se yi m ba aèfo, a ce yeñger aèwaâa rtuèu.
English: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

Limbum: Byú' bbebep ca vi bu' mmbo neè Jisoès enáê, “Maè'shi tá weèr du niñ aè múè ñkuânyaèm ca, niñ njep múè mo.”
English: All the demons begged him, saying, Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè byemïì, byú' ca vi fúú enjep ñwáè ca, a niñ njep múè ñkuânyaèm. Ñkuânyaèm ce yi m ba aèmboè ncúèkïì baa yi káátïì a suu mbaè baa, a gweñger njep rdip rgoèr, a no mdip a kweñger.
English: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

Limbum: Ñgaâa cïìñ ñkuânyaèm ca a m cañ, a du a suñ beèe aè laè', a ker suñ neè beèe ce a m ba aè mñkúè, awá beèe a duseè aè ryá yuu ce yi m koni.
English: Those who fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

Limbum: Woweèe a m duè ba', a yá Jisoès ba ñwáè ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m niñ njep ye aèñgoo naè aèmboè e cu, a yar bcáè' aè nyoèr. Vi bfee vi banïì kúti mbo. Woweèe a m wáp seê.
English: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ba, a yá yuu ce yi m koni neè ñwáè ca ba ñkuânyaèm ca a m suñ neè beèe anaè.
English: Those who saw it declared to them how it happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce bu' mmbo neè Jisoès ená e lo efa yap ñgoèñ duê.
English: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce niñ mbe keñ, ñwáè ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m fúú enjep ye naè aè loo ená e be duè a ye.
English: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

Limbum: E kanïì, a laa neè ye enáê, “Duè fa wáâ laè' du suñ yoè beèe buu ce Tata aè koosimnse a gee neè wáè.”
English: He didn't allow him, but said to him, Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.

Limbum: Ñgaèñ aè du a ce kar aè Mla' ce Rúêú, a ce suñ buu ce Jisoès aè m geèe neè ye. Beèe wááwá a bááñgeèr seê.
English: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker niñ mbe keñ, a tuu neèñguu roè. A ka' baè' njo, ku' beèe a vú a kaari aèwaâa roèo.
English: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ce a m ce too ená Jairoès, ce aè m ba ñwáâ ñgoèr moè' embe ndaèp rloo, aè vúê, a ka' yá Jisoès, a gwe njep yeâ tïìi,
English: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet,

Limbum: a bu' mmbo, a laa neè ye enáê, “Muu waè ce muunje ku ba yïû ñkwe, vúè la' mo mmbo mbe yeâ nduè tá e bo keè'se, cu nteèe.”
English: and begged him much, saying, My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.

Limbum: Jisoès aè du a ye, ku' beèe moè' foñ a du a yeâ mbuèu, a ce nyoèrni, a fate ye.
English: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' aè m ba aèfo ce e m cu mbe kuèu aè bfeè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: A certain woman, who had an issue of blood for twelve years,

Limbum: E m yá ñgá' mbe mmbo ñgaâa mcáèp magoèr, a too mbaa seê, a ke' ke'se ka'. Yañ yi ku ce duè ba kuèntombïì.
English: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

Limbum: E m yu' nsuñ Jisoès, a vú a niñ mbe múè beèe, a vú mbe yeâ njïì, a joo ye cáè',
English: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd, and touched his clothes.

Limbum: njobeè' e m laèa enáê, “Máè ka' ku joo ba yi cáè', m ku ke'se.”
English: For she said, If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.

Limbum: E ka' joèo cáè' Jisoès, yañ ca yi ku borni, e ku yu' nje yeâ nyoèr ená e keè'se.
English: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ku riñ ená ñger mo' yi fúú ye enje nyoèr, a karsi nyor a laa enáê, “AÈ joèo nda wa bcáè'?”
English: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd, and asked, Who touched my clothes?

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáâ yá aèmboè ku' beèe a ce nyoèrni enáê, aè bipshïì wáná aè joèo nda wáè lá a?”
English: His disciples said to him, You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, 'Who touched me?'

Limbum: Geewa'a e m ku ce fyá' aè ryá ñwáè ce e joèo ye anaè.
English: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè m rïìñ yuu ce yi m koni ye, a ká' a wáp, a ce kaèñ, a vú a gwe njeptii Jisoès, a suñ yïì mini.
English: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

Limbum: E laa neè ye enáê, “Muu waè, lo rbyemïì li geèe wáè ke'seè. Duè neè rfúteè- ñwáè, yoè ñgá' aè mïì.”
English: He said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.

Limbum: E ka' bii ce laèa, beèe mo' embe ndaèp Jairoès a vú neè ntuu ená muu yïì aè lá kwe, e fa keèr fa lá Jisoès ñgá' tá e vú aè cicïì ka'.
English: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler's house saying, Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu' yuu ce woweèe a ce laèa, a laa neè Jairoès enáê, “Fa wáp ka', kuè byemi neè máè.”
English: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, Don't be afraid, only believe.

Limbum: E m byemi ená ñwáè moè' du fa yïû mbuèu caa efa Pitaè ba Jáêms, ba Joân ce e m ba nfúr Jáms ka'.
English: He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

Limbum: A ka' baè' aè rla' ñwáâ ñgoèr anaè, a yá bjep vi ba aèfo, beèe a ce warse seê, a ce koosimnse.
English: He came to the synagogue ruler's house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

Limbum: E niñ mbe ndaèp, a laa neè beèe anaè enáê, “Weèe ce warse ba ká, a ce koosimnse? Muu ca aè kwe kwe ka'. E ce buumi buumi.”
English: When he had entered in, he said to them, Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.

Limbum: Beèe a vúshïì ye. E fúshïì woweèe wááwá njepmbeè, a lor tar muu ba ma muu, ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce a woweèe a m ba, a woweèe a du mbe dïì' ce muu anaè aè m noèñ.
English: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

Limbum: E m koo ye aè boè, a laa neè ye ená, “Taèlitaè, kumïì,” ce mbuèu efa gho yu enáê, “Muunje, m ce laa neè wáè, loè mbekïì.”
English: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, Talitha cumi! which means, being interpreted, Girl, I tell you, get up!

Limbum: Muunje anaè aè ku lo mbekïì a ce jáèshi. E m ba bfeè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú. Beèe a m báèáñger seê.
English: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe ená a fa suñ ñwáè moè' ka'. A ker laa neè woweèe ená a fa muu anaè byee tá e ye.
English: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m loâ aè to' anaè, a du fa yeâ laè'. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du fa yeâ mbuu.
English: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, e ká' a ce yá'ni beèe mbe ndaèp rloo. Beèe ce a m yu', a m báèáñger, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè geèe njáèá ryá'nïì ca efá? A njáèá bfee ká ce a m fa neè ye wa'a? E geèe njáèá mfaè' mghagha' ca aè njáâá ká?
English: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, Where did this man get these things? and, What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

Limbum: Mboè a ye kapintaè ce muu Máèári a? Mboè e yu nfúr Jáêms, ba Joseès, ba Jud ker ba Saimúèn a? Mboè bjar vi a yu seèe woweèe aèfa a?” A ka' laèa wa'a, a kani ye.
English: Isn't this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren't his sisters here with us? They were offended at him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “A ke yu'ni neè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè bdïì' wááwá, geewa'a beèe efa yeâ laè', ba yïì ndap, a ke yu'ni neè ye ka'.”
English: Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.

Limbum: AÈtaè e m ba gee mfaè' mghagha' fa yeâ laè' ka'. E m ku naa mi mmbo mbenduè ñgaâa byañ múcaèr, woweèe a ke'seè.
English: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.

Limbum: E m ba neè rgha'nïì-ñwáè aè ryá ená beèe a byemi ka'. E m naèti, a ce kar aè mla' mo', a ce yá'ni beèe blaâa Nyúè.
English: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

Limbum: E m ká' beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ce e m ce naè, a tuu woweèe a baa a baa, a fa woweèe ñger ená woweèe a ce fúr byú' bbebep enjep beèe.
English: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe ená a ku lor ba mbaèñ, a fa loèr byee, ba baèa ba mbaèa ka'.
English: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe ená aètaè a yar blaba', geewa'a, a fa yar bcáè' aè nyoâr bbaa ka'.
English: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè ka' du niñ ka' mbe ndaèp yïû fá áè, weèe ku cu ba mbo caar, ba' aè nfeè' ce weèe be fúú efa rla' anaè.
English: He said to them, Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' niñ aè rla', a ke' koni weèe, káè yu'shi yuu ce weèe ce laèa ka', weèe kashïì nfúènfú efa me mkuèu aè to' anaè, duse, aè rduèñshi ená woweèe a geèe yuu bebep.”
English: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!

Limbum: Woweèe a duê, a ce feè'shi neè beèe ená a kupse, ma' yaèp buu bbebep.
English: They went out and preached that people should repent.

Limbum: Woweèe a m fúshi ku' byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe, a ker yo' ñgaâa byañ magoèr neè mgúr, woweèe a ke'seè.
English: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.

Limbum: Beèe a m ce suñ aèmboè Jisoès goèr, ñkúú Hároèd aè yu'. Beèe moè' a m ce laèa ená a Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe ce e fúú efa rkwe, a mbuèu ce e túr ñger aè rgeèe njáèá buu bghagha' ca wa'a.
English: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a m ce laa yap ená a AÈlajaè; beèe mo' ená a ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ce e yu aèmboè ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè ce entoèmbïì naè.
English: But others said, He is Elijah. Others said, He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.

Limbum: Hároèd aè ka' yu' wa'a, a laa enáê, “Joân ce máè m tee ye tu naè, aè fúú efa rkwe.”
English: But Herod, when he heard this, said, This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.

Limbum: Hároèd ca aè m ba ñwáè ce e m tuu beèe, a du a koo Joân, a kur, a fa ye mbe shañ aètu Háèrodïìyaè ce e m ba ñgwa nfúr yïì ce Feleêp.
English: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, for he had married her.

Limbum: Joân aè m banïì laa neè Hároèd enáê, “Ncir yi byemi ená aè fap ñgwa nfúroè beesïì aè yoè ka'.”
English: For John said to Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife.

Limbum: Háèrodïìyaè aè ka' yu', a baa Joân seê. E m roèo aè ryú Joân, geewa'a njïì yi buu,
English: Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him, but she couldn't,

Limbum: njobeè' Hároèd aè m ce wáp Joân. E m yi ená Joân yu ñwáâ nyáánïì, a ker ba ñwáâ nrara, a ce tá'shi ye. Joân aè m ce laèa yuu, yi ce fa Hároèd ñgá' seê, geewa'a, e ku ce koèñ aè ryu' yuu ce e m ce laèa.
English: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

Limbum: Fáñ yi m loè a yááti mbe nfeè' ce Hároèd aè m ká' ñkaè' yi noèñ ce a m bi ye. E m be beâe bgoèrgoèr embe yeâ nto', ba bsoogáè ce bgoèrgoèr, ba boèo mlii mo' ce aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

Limbum: Muu Háèrodïìyaè ce njeñwáè aè m vúè a bii bii, nyoèr aè boñ Hároèd ba beèe ce a m vúè ñkaè'. Awá Hároèd aè laèa neè muu ana enáê, “Wáè ka' bipshi ka' njáèá ká ce wáè koèñ, m ku fa neè wáè.”
English: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.

Limbum: E m ye leè', a laa enáê, “Wáè ka' bipshi ka' njáèá ká, m ku fa neè wáè, ka' nto'nïì efa ya ñgoèñ.”
English: He swore to her, Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.

Limbum: Muu ca aè duê, a bipshi neè yïì ma enáê, “M be bipshi ba ká?” Yïì ma aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Tu Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe.”
English: She went out, and said to her mother, What shall I ask? She said, The head of John the Baptizer.

Limbum: Muu anaè aè ku cañ a kúti, a du a laa neè ñkúú enáê, “M ce koèñ ená aè fa máè tu Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe njep kañ seè'ni.”
English: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.

Limbum: Mluè mi koo ñkúú seê, aè ka' ba njobeè' e m ye leè' aè bsii beèe ce a m vúè ñkaè' naè, e moo aè rsheè laèr.
English: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn't wish to refuse her.

Limbum: E m ku tuu ñwáè soogáè ená e du vú neè tu Joân. E du mbe shañ, a tee tu ese Joân,
English: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John's head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

Limbum: a vú aègho njep kañ, a fa neè muu anaè, e fa neè yïì maê.
English: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Joân aè ka' yu' wa'a, a du a lor gúèú a tuñ.
English: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a m kúti a yá ye, a suñ ye buu ce woweèe a m geèe, ker ba buu ce woweèe a m duè a yá'ni beèe.
English: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

Limbum: Beèe a ce vúè magoèr, ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a ke' túr njïì aè rye yuu ka'. Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Seèe du aè dïì' mo' ce beèe a yu ka' tá weèe lúshi múcaèr.”
English: He said to them, You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile. For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

Limbum: Woweèe a niñ mbe keñ, a du aè dïì' ce beèe a m ba ka'.
English: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

Limbum: Beèe a yá aèmboè woweèe a ce duè, a riñ woweèe, a fúúse efa mla' wááwá, a cañse a du a ba' aè dïì' anaè entombïì.
English: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kuè fúú embe keñ, a yá ku' beèe aèwaâa roè, a koosimnse neè beèe anaè magoèr njobeè' woweèe a m ba aèmboè njeèe ce yi buu ñwáè rcïìñ wa'a. E ká' a ce yá'ni woweèe ku' buu.
English: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè m káè' a ce caèa, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a vúê, a laa neè ye enáê, “Seèe yu aè njïìsaèp efa mla', nyúè aè ce coo.
English: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

Limbum: Laèa tá woweèe a duse aè mla' ce mi yu aètútú, ba mïì ce mi yu aè mñkúè, duè yuu byee, ye.”
English: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Fa neè woweèe yuu tá a ye.” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Baná weèr lor baèa mbaâa bbaa, du yuu bráâd aègho neè woweèe a?”
English: But he answered them, You give them something to eat. They asked him, Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe túr bráâd yi sá'? Duè fyá' ka neè.” Woweèe a ka' duè fyá', a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr túr bráâd taê, ba nca baa.”
English: He said to them, How many loaves do you have? Go see. When they knew, they said, Five, and two fish.

Limbum: E laa ená woweèe a laa tá beèe anaè a cute aè mjáá aè bkúr aè bkúr.
English: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

Limbum: Woweèe a laêa, beèe anaè a cuteè aè bkúr aè bkúr. Bkúr mo' beèe rjeèe rjeèe; bkúr mo' beèe mta mtaê.
English: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

Limbum: E lor bráâd taê, ba nca baa caè, a ke' mbe buèu, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi bráêd, a fa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená a gapshi neè beèe anaè, a ceeshi nca anaè foñ a gapshi neè woweèe.
English: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá aè ye, a yu'.
English: They all ate, and were filled.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a baashïì bbábá' bráâd ba btete nca, vi ruu aè mñkaèa ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

Limbum: Mmbañruè ce a m ye byee anaè a m ba beèe ncúèkïì taê.
English: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ku laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená a niñ mbe keñ, tuu neèñguu roè entombïì, tá e laasi beèe anaè.
English: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

Limbum: E ka' laèasi woweèe wáá a ko' mbe rtuèu aè rgeèe rloo.
English: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr, keñ aè ba mbe ntee rdip, Jisoès aè ba nje waa ñkúè mimñgi'.
English: When evening had come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

Limbum: E yá aèmboè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ce ni'ni neè keñ, njobeè' fu' yi m ce caèa magoèr. AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú', e du a waâp mbuèu, a ce jáèr mbenduè rdip, a ce roèo caèa woweèe.
English: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and he would have passed by them,

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá aèmboè e ce jáèr mbenduè rdip, a ce kwa'shi ená a nyir, a warse,
English: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

Limbum: njobeè' woweèe wááwá a m yá ye, a ce wáp. E ku laa neè woweèe aè nfeè' anaè enáê, “Kur neè ntee, a máè, fa wáp neè ka'.”
English: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, Cheer up! It is I! Don't be afraid.

Limbum: E niñ a cu a woweèe mbe keñ, awá fu' caè yi teetïì. Woweèe a bááñgeèr seê,
English: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

Limbum: njobeè' woweèe a m be riñ aèmboè Jisoès aè m geèe, a ka' nyañ ku' beèe ca neè bráâd taê, ba nca baa ka'.
English: for they hadn't understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' tuu neèñguu roè, a cúú keñ aèwaâa roè, a ba seè'ni ba aè ñgoâñ Gáènásaráèt.
English: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ku fúú embe keñ, beèe a yá ye, a rïîñ.
English: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

Limbum: E m ce jáèr aè dïì' anaè, beèe a ce yu' faè dïì' e yu, byá'se ñgaâa byañ, vú aègho, yá ye.
English: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.

Limbum: Bdïì' wááwá ce e m duè, káè aè mlaè' mká'ñká' ba aè mla' mñgoèrñgoèr áè, beèe a vúè neè ñgaâa byañ aè ntaa, ce bu' mmbo neè ye ená e ku ma'shi tá a joo ka' yi cuèu cáè'. Ñgaâa byañ wááwá ce a m joèo ye a m ke'seè.
English: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might touch just the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir mo' ce a m vúâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a m vú aè ryá Jisoès.
English: Then the Pharisees, and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

Limbum: Woweèe a m yá aèmboè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu mo' a ce ye byee neè mmbo msii.
English: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is, unwashed, hands, they found fault.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi ba Jus wááwá a ka' tá suè'si mmbo aèmboè ndeèe waêp bta aè m ba ka', a ye yuu ka'.
English: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, don't eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

Limbum: A ka' vú efa ntaa, a ku su'si mmbo wáá ka' ye yuu. Woweèe a ker túr ndeèe moè' foñ ce waêp bta a m kwe, a lá neè woweèe, aèmboè aède' woweèe a su'sïì mndoñ ba mkïìñ, ker ba bkañ aè njïû yáánïì.
English: They don't eat when they come from the marketplace, unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a bipshïì neè Jisoès enáê, “Ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu a láè ndeèe viseèe bta ka', a ce ye buu neè mmbo msii njoká?”
English: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, Why don't your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “AÈsayaè ce ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa yuu mini kuu weèe ce ñgaâa mbo'ni aèmboè a m sañ enáê, ‘Beèe ca a ku ce yu'ni neè máè ba neè cuèu. Yap mntee yi yu aènjïìsaèp ese máè.
English: He answered them, Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, 'This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

Limbum: Woweèe a ce geèe rloo neè máè aè cicïì, njobeè' a ce yá'ni beèe mncir ce aè láè ba beèe.’
English: But in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.'

Limbum: Weèe aè maè' ncir Nyúè a lor ba ndeèe to'.”
English: For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men--the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe túr njïì bfee aè rkani mncir Nyúè tá weèe bo loèr yeè ndeèe to'.
English: He said to them, Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

Limbum: Musïìs aè m laèa enáê, ‘Yu'ni neè yoè ta ba yoè maê.’ A ker laa enáê, ‘Ñwáè ce e ka' cáp yïì ta káè yïì ma áè, baná a be yú ñgaèñ.’
English: For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother;' and, 'He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.'

Limbum: Weèe ce laèa weená ñwáè aè ka' lor yuu ce e ba jaè' yïì ma ba yïì ta aègho, laa ená, ‘Yuu ce máè túr ce máè ba jaè' wáè aègho naè, yu Kobaèn’, ce yi yu enáê, ‘Máè fa neè Nyúè,’
English: But you say, 'If a man tells his father or his mother, Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban, that is to say, given to God;'

Limbum: weèe ker byemi ená e ja' yïì ma ba yïì ta aègho ka'.
English: then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

Limbum: Weâe gee wa'a, baná weèe aè loèr yeè ndeèe a siñsi mncir Nyúè aègho. Ku' buu moè' yu foñ aèmboè bca, ce weâe ke geèe.”
English: making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker ká' ku' beèe ce a m ba aèfo a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yu'shi neè boèñboñ.
English: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, Hear me, all of you, and understand.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi ke niñ njep ñwáè, yi ke geèe ñwáè e ba jaèpri aè bsii Nyúè ka'. Yuu ce yi ke geèe ñwáè e ba jaèpri aè bsii Nyúè yu ba yuu ce yi fúú enjep ye.
English: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' túr btuè', ñgaèñ yu'.”
English: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!

Limbum: E ka' maè'shi beèe, niñ mbe ndaèp, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a bipshïì neè ye ená ñgaèa anaè yu ená ká lá.
English: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

Limbum: E beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Wee weèe aè be riñ buu foñ ka' a? Mboè weèe yi weená aède' yuu ce yi ke niñ njep ñwáè yi gee ñwáè e bep aè bsii Nyúè ka' ka' a?
English: He said to them, Are you thus without understanding also? Don't you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can't defile him,

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a njobeè' yi ke niñ ba njep ntee ka', yi ke niñ ba njep rbúè, fúú enjo.” E ka' laèa wa'a a raasi ená byee wááwá vi yu bboèñboñ aè bsii Nyúè.
English: because it doesn't go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, thus purifying all foods?

Limbum: E m ker laa enáê, “Yuu ce yi ke fúú enjep ñwáè, aè yïì ce e ke geèe ye e ba jaèpri aè bsii Nyúè.
English: He said, That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

Limbum: Njáèá buu bbebep ca vi ke loè ba enjep ntee: bsaèkïì, byáèá, nyúshi beèe, aè rkoo ñgwa ñwáè moè' káè nduu ñwáè moè',
English: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

Limbum: aè rbaèñ mmir aè buu, bsaèrbuu, mbo'ni, ndeâe mbembep, ñko'ndoñ, mnsa'ni, naèanyor ba blúr.
English: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

Limbum: Buu bbebep ca bsïìp vi ke fúú enjep ñwáè, gee ye e ba jaèpri aè bsii Nyúè.”
English: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m naètïû aè aèfo, a du aè dïì' ce rla' Tayaè li m ba. E m duè a ba' aèfo, a niñ mbe ndaèp, a koñ ená ñwáè moè' riñ ená e yu mbo ka'. Geewa'a beèe a ku rïîñ.
English: From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn't want anyone to know it, but he couldn't escape notice.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' ce nyúèrkaè' aè m niñ njep muu yïì, aè m yu' ená Jisoès yu aèfo, a vúê, a gwe njep yeâ tïìi.
English: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè m ba ñwáè enje jáá. A m bi ye aè ñgoâñ Sïìroèfoènisïìyaè. E m bu' mmbo neè Jisoès ená e fúr yú' nyúèrkaè' ca enjep muu yïì.
English: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Maè'shi tá a nyañ boo entoèmbïì njobeè' yi boèñ ená a lor byee boo ma' neè ñgwe ka'.”
English: But Jesus said to her, Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ca aè beesïì enáê, “Yi yu mini wa'a, Tataê, to ñgwe yi ke ye mkúè' baa boo ce mi gweèñger foñ.”
English: But she answered him, Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ ka' ba njo' yuu ce wáè laèa na, yú' nyúèrkaè' ca yi fúú enjep muu ghoè. Duè yo yu.”
English: He said to her, For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.

Limbum: E m kúti aè laè', a yá aèmboè muu yïì noèñ mbe bkuu, yú' nyúèrkaè' anaè yi banïì fúú enjep ye.
English: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m naètïû aè dïì' ce rla' Tayaè li m ba naè, a to'ni rla' Sidoèn, a caa Mla' ce Rúêú, a du a ba' aè rdip rgoèr ce aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the region of Decapolis.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a m vúè neè ñwáè moè' ce e m fuñre a ke' yi aè rlaèa yuu boèñboñ foñ ka', a bu' mmbo neè Jisoès ená e naa mi mmbo mbenduè ñwáè anaè, ja' ye.
English: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè fúr ye embe múè beèe, a fa ye mntummbo mbaè btuè', a ce mce, a joo ye rlee aègho,
English: He took him aside from the multitude, privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue.

Limbum: a ke' mbe buèu a shoo, a laa neè ye enáê, “Efataè.” Efataè ca yu ená, “Múè'ti.”
English: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, Ephphatha! that is, Be opened!

Limbum: Vi btuè' vi mú'ñgeèr, rlee li ba'ñgeèr ye, e ká' a ce laèa yáánïì.
English: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ciisïì neè woweèe ená a fa suñ ñwáè ka'. E ka' cïìisi wa'a woweèe a misïì a suñ beèe goèr.
English: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

Limbum: Beèe a m báèáñger seê, a ce laèa enáê, “E geèe buu wááwá yáánïì; e geèe mnfuñtuè' a ce yu' buu, blúr a ce laèa.”
English: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè mnoèñ anaè, ma kúr beèe yi ker vú a kaari, a ke' koni yuu ye ka'. Jisoès aè ká' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè woweèe enáê,
English: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself, and said to them,

Limbum: “M ce koosimnse neè beèe ca seê, weèr woweèe aè cu aè mnoâñ btaar, woweèe a ke' koni yuu ye ka'.
English: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a beesïì neè ye enáê, “Bráâd yi be ka' loè efá aè ntee rïìñ ca, ce aède' yi ghááteè aè ryañ woweèe?”
English: His disciples answered him, From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe túr bráâd bsá'?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Weèr túr bráâd saèambaê.”
English: He asked them, How many loaves do you have? They said, Seven.

Limbum: Awá e laa beèe anaè a cuteè aè nsheè. E lor bráâd saèamba caè, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi a fa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a gapshïì neè beèe anaè.
English: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

Limbum: Woweèe a m túr mú nca foñ. E yoñshïì Nyúè, a fa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená a gapshi neè beèe anaè foñ.
English: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

Limbum: Woweèe a ye a yu', a baashi bbábá' ce vi m báti, vi ruu aè mñkaèa saèambaê.
English: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ye, a m ba aèmboè ncúèkïì kyeèe. E laa woweèe a duseè,
English: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

Limbum: e niñ mbe keñ a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe, a tuu aè mbeèp Daèlmaènutaè.
English: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a m vúè, a ce taase Jisoès. Woweèe a m ce roèo aè rmoèoshi ye, awá a laa neè ye ená e duñshi woweèe ncoèo embe buèu.
English: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, and testing him.

Limbum: E shoo, a laa enáê, “Beèe e luèuni a ce roèo mncoâo bghagha' wa'a njoká? AÈi', m suñ weèe máná aède' m duñshïì ncoèo neè beèe ca ka'.”
English: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.

Limbum: E ma'shïì woweèe, a niñ mbe keñ, a tuu neèñguu roè.
English: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a m leèse aè rloèr bráêd, a ku túr ba ntu' bráâd mo'sir mbe keñ.
English: They forgot to take bread; and they didn't have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ciisïì neè woweèe enáê, “Loèr neè nfeè' neè yis beèe Farïìsi ba yïì Hároèd.”
English: He warned them, saying, Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce laèa fa waâp mú enáê, “E laèa wa'a njobeè' seèe aè ba vú neè bráâd ka'.”
English: They reasoned with one another, saying, It's because we have no bread.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m yi yuu ce woweèe a ce laèa. A laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce laèa fa weâe mú ená weèe túr bráâd ka' njoká? Weèe aè be riñ buu ka' a? Waè' weèe aè be riñ mbuèu efa gho ka' a? Waè' ku ba nteèe-tu a?
English: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, Why do you reason that it's because you have no bread? Don't you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?

Limbum: Weèe aè túr mmir, a ke' ce yá buu ka' a? A túr btuè', a ke' ce yu' buu ka' a? Káè yu ba ená weèe ce kuushi buu ka' a?
English: Having eyes, don't you see? Having ears, don't you hear? Don't you remember?

Limbum: AÈ nfeè' máè m bá'shi mtu' bráâd taê, a fa neè beèe ncúèkïì ta naè, woweèe a m ye, weèe a kwá' bbábá' aè mñkaâa bsá'?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Weèr aè m kwáè' aè mñkaèa ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.”
English: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? They told him, Twelve.

Limbum: E ker bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “AÈ nfeè' máè m fa mntu' bráâd saèamba neè beèe ncúèkïì kyeèe naè, woweèe a m ye, weèe aè kwá' bbábá' aè mñkaâa bsá'?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Weèr aè m kwáè' bbábá' aè mñkaèa saèambaê.”
English: When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? They told him, Seven.

Limbum: Awá Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná weèe aè be riñ mbuèu efa yuu ce m ce laèa ka' a?”
English: He asked them, Don't you understand, yet?

Limbum: Woweèe a m vúè a ba' aè rlaè' Báètsaidaè, beèe mo' a vú neè nfeèp ená Jisoès joo ye neè bo tá e ke'se.
English: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.

Limbum: E ghashïì ye aè rkoo a ye a fúú efa laè' anaè. A ka' duè baè', a ce ye neè mce nje mmïìr, a la' mmbo mbe yeâ nduè, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce yá buu seè'ni a?”
English: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

Limbum: E fyá' mbekïì, a beesi enáê, “M ce yá aèmboè beèe a ce jáèshi, a ba aèmboè bce wa'a.”
English: He looked up, and said, I see men; for I see them like trees walking.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker la' ye mmbo nje mmïìr, e tuñsïì mmir, a misi a yá buu seè'ni boèñboñ.
English: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ma'shïì ye ená e du mbe yeâ ndaèp, a laa neè ye ená e fa keèr duè aè múè la' ka'.
English: He sent him away to his house, saying, Don't enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.

Limbum: Jisoès a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe a m ce duè aè bu' mla' ce mi m ba aè to' Sisaèriyaè Fïìlepaèï. A ka' duè baè' aè nduunjïì e bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Beèe a ce laèa ená m yu nda?”
English: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, Who do men say that I am?

Limbum: Woweèe a beèesi neè ye enáê, “Beèe mo' a ce laèa ená aè yu Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe, beèe mo' ená aè yu AÈlajaè, beèe mo' ená aè yu moè' efa ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè.”
English: They told him, John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.

Limbum: E ker bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Yi yu yi ká aèmboè weèe, weèe ce laèa ye weená m yu nda?” Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “A wáè Kraâis anaè.”
English: He said to them, But who do you say that I am? Peter answered, You are the Christ.

Limbum: E ciisïì neè woweèe ená a fa suñ ñwáè moè' ená a ye Kraâis anaè ka'.
English: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m káè' a ce yá'ni ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená Muu Ñwáè be kuè yá ñgá' goèr seê, tá bleebeèe ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ker ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a kani ye. A be keè yú ye, mnoèñ vi ba btaar, e fúú efa rkwe.
English: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

Limbum: E m laèa buu ca neè woweèe rara seê. Pitaè aè koo ye, a ye a lá'sïì nyor, a ká' a ce lapni ye kuu yuu ce e laèa anaè.
English: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì nyor a fyá' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè Pitaè enáê, “Loè efa máâ geñ, Sataèn! Mo mkwaè'shïì yu ba mïû ñwáè, yu mïû Nyúè ka'.”
English: But he, turning around, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká' ku' beèe ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' ce koèñ aè rvúè fa máâ mbuèu, baná ñgaèñ kani yïì nyor, byá' yi kïìntaa, ce vú fa máâ mbuèu.
English: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce koèñ aè rboñshi li ryoèñ baná ñgaèñ be bá li, ñwáè ce e ka' tá boñshi li ryoèñ ka' njo' máè, baná ñgaèñ be koni li.
English: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè konïì ba njáèá sá' ká ce e ka' túr buu enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá, bá li ryoèñ?
English: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?

Limbum: Yuu ce aède' ñwáè fa aètu li ryoèñ yu ká?
English: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce rïìtu yi ce koo ye neè máè, ker ba neè wa blaèa embe njáèá nfeè' e seè'ni ce beèe a ce kani Nyúè, a ker ce geèe buu bebep na, baná rïìtu yi be keè koo Muu Ñwáè neè ye foñ mbe nfeè' ce e be keè vúè a bcïìndap Nyúè ce brara weèe neè foèo yïì Taê.”
English: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená beèe mo' a yu aè múè beèe ce a tááte na ce rkwe li be joèo woweèe ka'. Woweèe a be kuè cu caar yá kúú Nyúè aèmboè yi vúè neè ñger-ñwáè.”
English: He said to them, Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see the Kingdom of God come with power.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi ka' caèa ntuunfu, Jisoès aè lor Pitaè ba Jáêms, ker ba Joân, a ko' a woweèe mbe rtuâu rsaèsap, aè ku ba woweèe mbo caè'caè'. A m baè' mbo, Jisoès aè kupseè a ba aè njáâá jáá.
English: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

Limbum: Vi bcáè' vi beetïì bbúú, a ce laè'ñger seê, a fúp ce aède' ñwáè aè m ba su'si vi fúp wa' ka'.
English: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

Limbum: Ka' cu, AÈlajaè ba Musïìs a nyáá, a ce de' a Jisoès.
English: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

Limbum: Awá Pitaè aè laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Rabaèi yi boèñ aèmboè seèe yu aèfa na. Maè'shi tá weèr ba'ri btaâp btaar, tá mo' ba yo, tá mo' ba yi Musïìs, tá mo' ba yi AÈlajaè.”
English: Peter answered Jesus, Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let's make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

Limbum: E m yi yuu ce e laa ka' njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp seê.
English: For he didn't know what to say, for they were very afraid.

Limbum: Mmbaè' vi vúê, a cete woweèe, njeèndoñ aè laa enjep múè mo enáê, “Cena yu muu waè ce m koèñ seê. Ce yu' neè yuu ce e ce laèa.”
English: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ke'seè ñgoèñ, a ker yá ñwáè moè' caa efa Jisoès ka'.
English: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce suèu embe rtuèu, Jisoès aè ciisïì neè woweèe ená a fa suñ ñwáè yuu ce woweèe a yá naè ka', caar tá Muu Ñwáè ke fúú efa rkwe.
English: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

Limbum: Woweèe a m suñ ñwáè ka', geewa'a, a ce tarni ená nfúú efa rkwe ca yu ba ká lá.
English: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the rising from the dead meant.

Limbum: Woweèe a m bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a ce laèa ená AÈlajaè be vúè entombïì njoká?”
English: They asked him, saying, Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?

Limbum: E beesïì a laa enáê, “Rtarnïì li yu njo ka', AÈlajaè be vúè wáá, geèe tá buu wááwá kúti aèmboè vi m ba. Baná a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená Muu Ñwáè be kuè yá ñgá' seê, tá beèe a jaasi ye njoká?
English: He said to them, Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

Limbum: M ce suñ wee máná AÈlajaè aè vúè war, beèe a gee buu ce a m ce koèñ aè rgeèe neè ye, aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè.”
English: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.

Limbum: Woweèe a m vúè a yá bár ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, ku' beèe a sir woweèe, ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a ce sár nsár a woweèe.
English: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

Limbum: Ku' beèe ca a ka' kuè yá ye, a bááñger seê, a cañse a du aè rcaè'ni ye.
English: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him greeted him.

Limbum: E bipshïì neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Weèe ce sár ba ká weèe woweèe?”
English: He asked the scribes, What are you asking them?

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa múè beèe anaè aè beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, máè ba vú neè muu waè aè ryá wáè. Yú' bebep yi yu njep ye, a geêe, e ke' ce laèa ka'.
English: One of the multitude answered, Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

Limbum: Yi loè gee ye, e gwe aè nsheè, bdúdú' vi fúú ye aè cuèu, e ce kúr msoèñ, tee mbaè yáá. Máè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu máná a fúr yú' anaè, woweèe a moo laèr.”
English: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and wastes away. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren't able.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Haba! Weâe beèe e luèuni ce weèe buu rbyemïì! M be cu weèe seèe duè baè' fá? M be kur ntee neè weèe duè baè' fá? Vúè neè muu anaè fa neè máè.”
English: He answered him, Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.

Limbum: A m vúè neè muu anaè a fa neè ye. Yú' caè yi ka' yá Jisoès, a geêe, muu anaè aè gwe kaè', a ce biñri a ce fúr bdúdú' aè cuèu.
English: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshi neè tar muu enáê, “Muu ca aè m káè' yañ ca aè se'ká?” E beesïì enáê, “Yi m ku ká' aè nfeè' e m bii ñká'.
English: He asked his father, How long has it been since this has come to him? He said, From childhood.

Limbum: Yi m loè ku ce maè' ye njep mor ba njep roè aè ryú ye. Ka' ba ená aède' aè gee yuu mo', aè koosïìmnse neè weèr, ja' weèr.”
English: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce laèa wáná, ‘ka' ba ená aède' aè gee yuu mo'’ wa'a, a ce laèa ba ená ká? Buu wááwá yu aètáèr neè ñwáè ce e byemi.”
English: Jesus said to him, If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.

Limbum: Tar muu anaè aè ku waa aè cuèu anaè, a laa enáê, “Máè byemi. Geèe tá la rbyemïì li tap.”
English: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, I believe. Help my unbelief!

Limbum: Jisoès aè m yá ená ku' beèe a ce vúèse, e waa yú' bebep anaè a laa enáê, “Wáâ yú' ce yi ke geèe ñwáè e fuñreè ker ba lúr, máè laa neè wáè: fúú enjep ye. Fa keèr niñ njep ye nyúè moè' ka'.”
English: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!

Limbum: Yú' anaè yi waa, e ker gwe kaè', yi fúú enjep ye, e noñ aèmboè gúèú ñwáè wa'a. Weèe mo' a ce laèa ená e kwe.
English: Having cried out, and convulsed greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead; so much that most of them said, He is dead.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ghashïì ye aè rkoo, a naa mbekïì, e natïì a táá.
English: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.

Limbum: E ka' niñ mbe ndaèp, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu aè ku ba Jisoès a woweèe, woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Weèr aè ba moo a rfúr yú' anaè enjep ye laèr njoká?”
English: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why couldn't we cast it out?

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yuu ce aède' yi fúr njáèá yú' ca enjep ñwáè ku ba rloo rtatap caè'caè'.”
English: He said to them, This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting.

Limbum: Woweèe a m naèti a caa njïû aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê. Jisoès aè koñ ená ñwáè moè' yi ka',
English: They went out from there, and passed through Galilee. He didn't want anyone to know it.

Limbum: njobeè' e m ce yá'ni ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a ce laa neè woweèe enáê, “A be loèr Muu Ñwáè fa mbaè mmbo beèe, tá a yú ye, tá e fúú efa rkwe mbenjïì mnoâñ btaar.”
English: For he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.

Limbum: Geewa'a woweèe a m rïìñ yuu ce e m laèa ka', a ce wáp aè rbipshi neè ye.
English: But they didn't understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

Limbum: Woweèe a m duè a ba' aè rla' Kaèpanuèm, a ka' niñ mbe ndaèp, e bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè ba ce sár ba ká aè nduunjïì?”
English: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì ka', njobeè' woweèe a m ce sár ená ñwáè ce e yu ñwáâ ñgoèr efa woweèe a nda lá?
English: But they were silent, for they had disputed one with another on the way about who was the greatest.

Limbum: E cu aè nsheè, a ká' yïì beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' ce koèñ aè rba ñwáè e kuèntombïì, baná e be loèr yi tu aè ñwáè embaè lúèsimbuèu, ba aè ñwáè rfaè' neè beèe wááwá.”
English: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.

Limbum: E m loèr mú ghaèrñwáè a tár mbe waâp mú, a koo ye nje nyoèr, a laa enáê,
English: He took a little child, and set him in the midst of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

Limbum: “Ñwáè ce e ka' koni mú ghaèrñwáè aèmboè ca fa máâ rlii, baná ñgaèñ aè koni máè. Ñwáè ce e ka' koni máè, baná e koni ba máè ka', e koni ba ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.”
English: Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn't receive me, but him who sent me.

Limbum: Joân aè laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, weèr aè mú yá ñwáè moè' e ce fúshi byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe fa wáâ rlii. Weèr aè laa neè ye ená e fa keèr geèe wa' ka' njobeè' e yu mo' efa seâe mú ka'.”
English: John said to him, Teacher, we saw someone who doesn't follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn't follow us.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa laèa ená ñgaèñ borni ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' gee rfaâ' rghagha' fa máâ rlii baná aède' e laa yuu bebep kuu máè ka'.
English: But Jesus said, Don't forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ba yïìseèe ñwáè bbaèa ka', baná e yu yïìseèe ñwáè.
English: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè máná ñwáè ce e ka' fa weèe ndoñ mdip njobeè' weèe yu beèe Kraêis, aède' e bá vi blaè' ka'.”
English: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you are Christ's, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

Limbum: “Ñwáè ce e ka' gee moè' efa boo bká' ce a byemi neè máè na, e gee yuu bebep, baná yi be ba aèndeèe neè ye ce a ka' lor ma luâr ñgoè' baa cúú ye kuè ndoñ, ma' njep rdip rgoèr.
English: Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he was thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

Limbum: Yo bo yi ka' gee wáè aè gee yuu bebep, aè tee yi ma'; yi yu aèndeèe ená aè niñ mbe dïû' rcu ce nfeseè, buu bo, neè ce ená aè túr mmbo mmbaa duè njep mor ce aètaè a liisïì ka'.
English: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

Limbum: Yo kuèu yi ka' gee wáè aè gee yuu bebep, aè tee yi ma'; yi yu aèndeèe ená aè niñ mbe dïû' rcu ce nfeseè, buu kuèu, neè ce ená aè túr mkuèu mmbaa, tá a ma' wáè njep mor.
English: where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.' If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched--

Limbum: Mor anaè yi be keè liiti nyúè moè' ka'.
English: where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.'

Limbum: Lo rlir li ka' gee wáè aè gee yuu bebep, aè so'ni li enje tuè, ma'; yi yu aèndeèe ená aè ba ntoè' rlir, niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè neè ce aè túr mmir mmbaa tá a ke koo wáè, maè' njep mor.
English: If your eye causes you to stumble, cast it out. It is better for you to enter into the Kingdom of God with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

Limbum: Mñgúâr ce mi ce ye woweèe njo mi be kweñger ka', tá mor anaè yi liiti ka'.
English: where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.'

Limbum: A be keè yo' ñwáè wááwá neè mgwañ ce yu ba mor.
English: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

Limbum: Mgwañ mi boèñ. Geewa'a mi ka' cir, aède' weèe gee weeká mi ka' ker leêe? Baná weèe ba aèmboè mgwañ mleèelee. Cu neè neè rfúteè-ñwáè.”
English: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.

Limbum: Jisoès aè natïì a du aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, a ker du aè ñgoâñ neèñguu rdip Jodaèn. Ku' beèe a ker vúse aè ryá ye, e yá'ni woweèe aèmboè e m ku ce yá'ni beèe naè.
English: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi mo' a vúê, a mooshi ye, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Waè' ncir yi byemi ená ñwáè juu ñgwa yïì a?”
English: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Musïìs aè m laèa neè weèe ená ká?”
English: He answered, What did Moses command you?

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Musïìs aè m fa njïì ená ñwáè aè ka' koèñ aè rjuèu ñgwa yïì, e sañ ñwaè' fa neè ye aè rduèñshi ená e saè'si guèu, ka' juèu ye.”
English: They said, Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.

Limbum: Jisoès aè kúsïì neè woweèe enáê, “Musïìs aè m sañ ncir ca neè weèe njobeè' weèe teèe btu.
English: But Jesus said to them, For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

Limbum: Geewa'a aè m ba efa rkáè' Nyúè aè boo mbañruèñwáè ba njeñwáè.
English: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce yi yu ená mbañruèñwáè be maè'shi yïì ta ba yïì maê, cu a ñgwa yïì,
English: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

Limbum: tá a ye a ba aè ñwáè moè'sir. Baná woweèe a ker ba a baa ka', a yu ba ñwáè moè'sir.
English: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

Limbum: Baná yuu ce Nyúè aè ka' tarshi, ñwáè moè' fa gaèpse ka'.”
English: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' kúti mbe ndaèp, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ker bipshi yuu kuu yuu ce e m laèa anaè.
English: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

Limbum: E beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' juu ñgwa yïì, lor moè', baná e koo njeñwáè ce e yu ñgwa yïì ka',
English: He said to them, Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.

Limbum: njeñwáè ye ye ka' ma'shi nduu yïì du bguèu a mbañruèñwáè moè', baná e noèñ a mbañruèñwáè ce yu nduu yïì ka'.”
English: If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.

Limbum: Beèe a m vúè neè bghaèrbeèe ená Jisoès bo joèo woweèe, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a lapnïì beèe anaè.
English: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá wa'a, nyoèr aè bep ye seê. E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Maè'shi tá boo anaè a vú yá máè, weèe fa jepsi woweèe ka', njobeè' kúú Nyúè yi yu ba neè beèe ce a yu aèmboè boo ca.
English: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, Allow the little children to come to me! Don't forbid them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

Limbum: Máâ suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè máná, ñwáè ce e ka' tá koo kúú Nyúè aèmboè muu ñká' ka', aède' e ke niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè anaè ka'.”
English: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a koo woweèe nje nyoèr, a la' mmbo mbe waâp nduè, a ghoni woweèe.
English: He took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce duè rjáèr, ñwáè moè' aè cañ a vú a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïû mboèñmboñ, yuu ce aède' m gee ka' koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè a ká?”
English: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Wáâ too máè ená ñwáâ mboèñmboñ njoká? Ñwáè moè' yu ñwáâ mboèñmboñ ka', ñwáâ mboèñmboñ ku ba Nyúè caè'caè'.
English: Jesus said to him, Why do you call me good? No one is good except one--God.

Limbum: To aè ku riñ mncir ce vi laèa enáê, ‘Fa yú ka', fa koo ñgwa ñwáè káè noèñ weèe nduu ñwáè ka', fa yáèá ka', fa táá njïìnsa' mnaèñ ka', fa fïìp ñwáè ka', yu'ni neè yoè ta ba yoè maê.” ’
English: You know the commandments: 'Do not murder,' 'Do not commit adultery,' 'Do not steal,' 'Do not give false testimony,' 'Do not defraud,' 'Honor your father and mother.'

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, máè láè mncir ca wááwá káâ' aè nfeè' ce máè m ba muu ñká'.”
English: He said to him, Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.

Limbum: Jisoès aè fyá' ye, a koñ ye. A laa neè ye enáê, “Yuu mo' yi báti ce aè túr aè rgeèe. Duè fyeni yoè buu wááwá, lor mbaèa efa gho gapshi neè ñgaâa fuèp, tá aè bo túr bkuè' mbe buèu. Wá geèe wa' wáá, aè vú fa máâ mbuèu.”
English: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.

Limbum: Ñwáè ca aè ka' yu' yuu ce Jisoès aè laèa, a sá seê, a kar bsii a duê, njobeè' e m túr ku' buu seê.
English: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

Limbum: Jisoès aè fyá' ñgoèñ, a laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Yi yu tatap se neè ñgaâa mbaèa aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.”
English: Jesus looked around, and said to his disciples, How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a bááñgeèr. E ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “Boo waê, yi yu tatap se aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.
English: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, Children, how hard is it for those who trust in riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

Limbum: Yi yu aètáèr neè kaèmáêl aè rtose nje rlir nsaèraè' caa neè ñwáè mbaèa aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.”
English: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, woweèe a bááñgeèr seê, a laa fa waâp mú enáê, “Baná ñwáè ce aède' e luñ yu ba nda?”
English: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, Then who can be saved?

Limbum: Jisoès aè fyá' woweèe, a laa enáê, “Buu ca vi yu btatap se neè ñwáè, ke' ba neè Nyúè ka', njobeè' buu wááwá vi yu aètáèr neè Nyúè.”
English: Jesus, looking at them, said, With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Yáê, weèr aè maè'shi yeèr buu wááwá, a vú fa wáâ mbuèu.”
English: Peter began to tell him, Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “M suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè máná, ñwáè ce e ka' ma'shi yïì ndap, káè bfúr vi, káè bjar vi, káè yïì taê, káè yïì maê, káè boo vi, káè vi mñkúè, aètu máè, ker ba njobeè' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ,
English: Jesus said, Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

Limbum: e be koni buu aè nfeè' e seè'ni caèa aèmboè e m túr naè kaèñ rjeèe. E be koni mndap, bfúr, bjaèr, mma, boo, ba mñkúè. Geewa'a beèe a be kuè ce fa ye ñgá'. E ba mbe nfeè' ce e be keè vúè, e koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time, houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr ce a yu entombïì seè'ni na, a be keè ba elúèsimbuèu, tá beèe magoèr ce a yu lúèsimbuèu seè'ni na, a ba entombïì.”
English: But many who are first will be last; and the last first.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. Jisoès aè ce duè kuèntombïì neè woweèe. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ce báèáñger. Beèe ce a m ce jáèr mbe waâp njïì a ce wáp. Jisoès aè ker fúr yïì beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú embe múè beèe, a ká' a ce suñ woweèe buu ce vi be koni ye.
English: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Seèe ce duè wa'a tá a du fa Muu Ñwáè mbaè mmbo beâe bgoèrgoèr efa mú ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir. Woweèe a be sa' ye, teni ená a yú ye, keèr loèr ye fa mbe mmbo beèe enje jáá.
English: Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

Limbum: Jáms ba Joân ce boo Sábáèdi a vú a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, weèr ce koèñ werná aè gee yuu mo' neè weèr.”
English: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.

Limbum: E beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weâe koèñ ená m gee máká neè weèe?”
English: He said to them, What do you want me to do for you?

Limbum: Woweèe a laèa neè ye enáê, “Wer ce koèñ werná e ba aè nfeè' ce aè cu mbe wáâ kaèbaèraè' naè, tá weèr cute aègee wáè, moè' cu a yo bo maè', tá moè' cu aè yo bo ñkoèp.”
English: They said to him, Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand, and one at your left hand, in your glory.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe yi yuu ce weèe ce bipshi ka'. AÈde' weèe no enjep ndoñ ce m be no enjo a? Káè aède' weèe koo njáèá baèptir ce m be koo a?”
English: But Jesus said to them, You don't know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì neè ye enáê, “AÈde' weèr no.” E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe be no enjep ndoñ ce m be no enjo, koo njáèá baèptir ce m be koo.
English: They said to him, We are able. Jesus said to them, You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, máè túr ñger aè rlaèa ená ñwáè cu a máâ bo maè' káè a máâ bo ñkoèp ka'. Bdïì' anaè vi yu ba neè beèe ce Nyúè aè kupshi a lá neè woweèe.”
English: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.

Limbum: Bár yïì beèe ce rúú a ka' yu' yuu ce Jáms ba Joân a m laèa na, nyor aè bep woweèe seê.
English: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant towards James and John.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká'shïì woweèe aèbee, a laa neè woweèe wááwá enáê, “Weèe yi weená ñgaâa rsa' beèe enje jáá a ke sa' yap beèe neè ñger-ñwáè seê. Beâe bgoèrgoèr mo' a loèr yap ñger nyú' beèe agho foñ.
