English: Jesus summoned them, and said to them, You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

Limbum: Njáèá ñgeèe ca yi fa keè ba fa weâe mú ka'. Yi yu ba ená ñwáè efa weâe mú ce e ka' koèñ aè rba ñwáâ ñgoèr, baná ñgaèñ ba ñwáè rfaè' neè weèe,
English: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

Limbum: tá ñwáè ce e koèñ aè rba entombïì ba ñkwaèa neè beèe wááwá.
English: Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all.

Limbum: Njobeè' Muu Ñwáè ye ye aè m vúè ená beèe a bo ce faè' neè ye ka', e m vúè tá e bo faè', keèr fa li ryoèñ, tee beèe magoèr efa rkwe.”
English: For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

Limbum: Woweèe a m vúè ba' aè rla' Jáèrikuè. E ka' ce loâ aèfo a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ker ba ku' beèe mo', nfeèp moè' aè cu aèwaâa nduunjïì, a ce loo buu. A m too nfeèp ca ená Baètimoès ce muu Timoès.
English: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

Limbum: E ka' yu' ená a Jisoâs aè rla' Nasaráèt, e ká' a ce laèa mbekïì enáê, “Jisoès, Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè máè.”
English: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a m lapni ye ená e cu nyañ. E ker misi a waa seè'ni magoèr seê, a laa enáê, “Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè máè.”
English: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, You son of David, have mercy on me!

Limbum: Jisoès aè táá, a laa enáê, “Ká' neè ye.” Woweèe a laa neè nfeèp anaè enáê, “Kur ntee, nati mbekïì, e ce ká' wáè.”
English: Jesus stood still, and said, Call him. They called the blind man, saying to him, Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!

Limbum: E ma' yi cáè' njep nsheè, a nyáá mbekïì, a du a yá Jisoès.
English: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce koèñ ená m gee ba ká neè wáè?” Nfeèp anaè aè beèesi neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, geèe tá m ker yá buu.”
English: Jesus asked him, What do you want me to do for you? The blind man said to him, Rabboni, that I may see again.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Duè, lo rbyemïì li gee wáè ke'seè.” E ku ká' a ce yá buu, a nati a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: Jesus said to him, Go your way. Your faith has made you well. Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' aètútú rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a ba aè rla' Bátáfáè ker ba aè rla' Bátanïì, ce mi m ba aègee rtuèu Oleèf. Jisoès aè tuu ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a baa,
English: When they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Duè neè nje rla' enje weâe cuèu na. Weèe be duè niñ tá weèe ku yá muu jaèaki' ce ñwáè aè m be cu mbo ka' aèmboè a cúú. Wee yá, weèe fyáá vú aègho.
English: and said to them, Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him, and bring him.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' bipshi ená weèe ce fyáèá njoká lá, weèe suñ ye ená, Tata ce taè' geèe yuu aègho, ka' kúsi.”
English: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord needs him;' and immediately he will send him back here.

Limbum: Woweèe a du a yá muu jaèaki' aèmboè a cúú njep ncúèúndúè', aèwaâa nduunjïì. A ka' ce fyáèá muu jaèaki' ca,
English: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

Limbum: beèe ce a m tááte aèfo a bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce fyáèá muu jaèaki' anaè njoká?”
English: Some of those who stood there asked them, What are you doing, untying the young donkey?

Limbum: Woweèe a suñ beèe anaè yuu ce Jisoès aè m laèa, beèe anaè a ma'shïì, woweèe a du aègho.
English: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

Limbum: A ka' baè' aègho, a co'ni bcáè' a laashi mbenduè mo, Jisoès aè ko' a cu mbo.
English: They brought the young donkey to Jesus, and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a laashïì bcáè' njep nduunjïì, weèe mo' a sañsïì yap ba mmba' ce mká'ñká' ce a m faèashi.
English: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and spreading them on the road.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce duè kuèntombïì ker ba beèe ce a m ce vúè embe yeâ njïì a ce yoèp mbekïì enáê, “Rluèñ li vúè! Nyúè ghoni ñwáè ce e vúè aè rlii Tataê.
English: Those who went in front, and those who followed, cried out, Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

Limbum: Nyúè ghoni kúú yïìseèe ta Dávïìd ce yi ce vúè na! Seèe ku'si Nyúè embe buèu!”
English: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

Limbum: Jisoès aè niñ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a fyá' buu wááwá, a ka' yá ená nyúè ce coo, a nati a yïì beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú weèe, a du aè rla' Bátanïì.
English: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, woweèe a natïû aè rla' Bátanïì, a ka' ce duè, njeè aè ce yañ Jisoès.
English: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

Limbum: E ka' yá ce fik aèmboè yi táá aè njïìsaèp, a túr ku' bfuè seê, e du a fyá' ená yi yú lá. A ka' baè', a yá yuu mbo caa efa bfuè caè'caè' ka', njobeè' nfeè' fik e ke yú aè m gháá ka'.
English: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ce fik anaè enáê, “AÈ be keèr yú mbaèñ tá ñwáè bo ye ka'.” Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a yu' aèmboè e laèa wa'a.
English: Jesus told it, May no one ever eat fruit from you again! and his disciples heard it.

Limbum: Woweèe a du a ba' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, Jisoès aè ka' niñ mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a yá beèe mo' aèmboè a ce fyeèni buu, weèe mo' a ce yuu. E m juèu woweèe e mbo. E m buète btábuèr ese beèe ce a m ce kupse mbaèa, ker ba mnta' ese beèe ce a m ce fyeèni bbeèñ.
English: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple, and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money changers, and the seats of those who sold the doves.

Limbum: E m byemi ená ñwáè ker byá' yuu to'ni aègho aè mambe Ndap Nyúè ka'.
English: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

Limbum: E m yá'ni beèe a laa enáê, “Mboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená, ‘A be too yaè ndap ená ndap rloo neè bto' wááwá’ a? Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe aè gee yaè ndap aè kútïì ba mbúè' byáèá.”
English: He taught, saying to them, Isn't it written, 'My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations?' But you have made it a den of robbers!

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a ka' yu' yuu ce Jisoès aè m geèe na, a ce roèo nduunjïì aè ryú ye, a ker wáp njobeè' beèe wááwá a m túr rgha'nïì aèmboè li ryá'nïì.
English: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' coo, Jisoès weèe a fúú aè múè rla' anaè.
English: When evening came, he went out of the city.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce caèa aè mú ñgaèptú' a yá ce fik caè aèmboè yi ku yopri neè mñgaèñ-ñwáè.
English: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

Limbum: Pitaè aè kuushïì yuu ce yi mú ba, a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Rabaèi, yá ce ce wáè mú cáp naè aèmboè yi yuushi.”
English: Peter, remembering, said to him, Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Byemi neè Nyúè.
English: Jesus answered them, Have faith in God.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè máná ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè Nyúè, ke' ce tarni ka', e ka' laa neè rtuèu ca enáê, ‘Rtuèu caê, co'ti embo naè, du gwe njep rdip rgoèr’, baná yi be kuè ba wa'a.
English: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' and doesn't doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening; he shall have whatever he says.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, máâ suñ weèe máná buu wááwá ce weèe ka' bipshi neè Nyúè aè rloo, byemi weená weèe aè koni, baná Nyúè be fa neè weèe.
English: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce geèe rloo, túr ñwáè moè' aè ntee bebep, weèe foosïì ye tá yeè Ta embe buèu bo foèosi weèe yeè buu bbebep foñ.
English: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

Limbum: Weèe ka' tá foèosi beèe ce a geèe buu bbebep neè weèe ka', baná yeè Ta embe buèu be foèosi weèe yeè buu bbebep foñ ka'.”
English: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.

Limbum: Jisoès a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe a m ker kúti aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. E ka' ce jáèshi mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaèa ryá'ni mncir ker ba bleebeèe a vú a yá ye,
English: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders came to him,

Limbum: a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ñger ce aè ce geèe buu ca aègho li loè efá? Ñwáè ce e fa wáè ñger ca aè fa nda?”
English: and they began saying to him, By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “M be bipshi yuu mo'sir neè weèe. Weèe aè ka' beesïî, baná m suñ weèe ñwáè ce e fa máè ñger aè rgeèe buu ca.
English: Jesus said to them, I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

Limbum: Ñger ce Joân aè m túr aè rbaèptir beèe naè yi m loè ba ese Nyúè káè ese beèe? Beèesi aè neè máè.”
English: The baptism of John--was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.

Limbum: Woweèe a du mcúè, a seesi enáê, “Seèe aè ka' laa seená yi ñger anaè yi m loè ese Nyúè, baná e be bipshi neè seèe enáê, ‘Weèe aè m ka' ba byemi yuu ce e m laèa ka' njoká?’
English: They reasoned with themselves, saying, If we should say, 'From heaven;' he will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

Limbum: Waè' seèe be laèa seená yi m loè ba ese beèe a?” Woweèe a m wáp beèe njobeè' ñwáè nsïìp aè m byemi ená Joân aè m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ghup.
English: If we should say, 'From men'--they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

Limbum: Woweèe a kútïì a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Weèr yi ka'.” Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná má máè foñ be suñ weèe ñwáè ce e m fa máè ñger aè rgeèe buu ca ka'.”
English: They answered Jesus, We don't know. Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká' a ce suñ buu neè beèe ca aè mñgaèa enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè m faè' yi nsuu, a bye njáèá msini ce a ke geèe mruè' aègho, a bee ñka' a sir nsuu anaè aègho, a tuñ dïì' ce a be geèe mruè' mbo, a boo taè'taè' mbo foñ. A ka' geèe wa'a wáá, a lá nsuu anaè neè beèe mo', a du aè mbeè.
English: He began to speak to them in parables. A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the winepress, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

Limbum: Nfeè' ntee msini anaè aè ka' gháá, ñwáè ca aè tuu yïì ñwáè rfaè' moè' ená e du yá beèe ce e m láè nsuu neè woweèe naè, koo msini mi.
English: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

Limbum: E duê, a ka' baè', beèe anaè a koo ye a lïîp, e kútïì mboèmmbo.
English: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

Limbum: Ñwáè nsuu aè ker tuu ñwáè rfaè' moè', woweèe a ker koo a lïîp, a to' tu, a koosi ye rïìtu.
English: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

Limbum: E ker tuu moè', woweèe a koo a yú, awá e ker tuu weèe mo', woweèe a lip weèe mo', a yúshi weèe mo'.
English: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.

Limbum: E m ku túr seè'ni ba ñwáè moè'sir aè rtuu, ce aè m ba muu yïì ce e m koèñ magoèr. E m loè a tuu ye aèlúèsimbuèu, a ce kwaè'shi ená a be yu'ni neè muu yïì ca.
English: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, 'They will respect my son.'

Limbum: Beèe ce a m láè nsuu neè woweèe na, a ka' yá ye, a laa fa waâp mú enáê, ‘A ñwáè ce e be ye bti' na. Seèe koo yú, tá vi bti' vi bo ba viseèe.’
English: But those farmers said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'

Limbum: A koo ye a yú, a fúr embe múè nsuu, a ma' njepmbeè.
English: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

Limbum: Baná yuu ce aède' ñwáè nsuu gee neè woweèe yu ká? E be vúè yúshi woweèe, láè nsuu neè beâe jáá.
English: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

Limbum: Weèe aè m be be' nlaèa Nyúè ca ka' a? Enáê, ‘Luèr ce ñgaâa boo mndap a m maè', aè m kútïì ba luâr rbuundap.
English: Haven't you even read this Scripture: 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.

Limbum: Ca aè m geèe Tata Nyúè, aè ba yuu báèá neè seèe.”m’
English: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes'?

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr anaè a m roèo aè rkoo Jisoès, njobeè' woweèe a m yi ená e m maè' ñgaèa ca ba neè woweèe. Geewa'a woweèe a m wáp beèe, a ma'shi Jisoès a duse.
English: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.

Limbum: Woweèe a lo a tuu beèe Farïìsi mo' ba beèe vi ñkúú Hároèd ená a vú bipshi buu neè Jisoès tá a bo roèo njïì ce a be geèe tá e ka' faèa nlaèa.
English: They sent some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

Limbum: Woweèe a vú a laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, weèr yi werná a wáè ñwáè mini ce wá ke loèr ñwáè moè' jáá ka'. Wá ke yá'ni nduunjïû Nyúè neè mini-ñwáè aèmboè yi yu. Suñ ka neè weèr láê, ncir yi byemi ená seèe ma' mbaâa baèraè' neè ñkwe Rum káè seèe ma' ka'?”
English: When they had come, they asked him, Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don't defer to anyone; for you aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

Limbum: Jisoès aè yá taa ce woweèe a ce leè', a bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce moèoshi máè njoká? Naèa neè mbúè mbaèa ce a ke maè' mbaèa aègho.”
English: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.

Limbum: Woweèe a vú neè mbúè mbaèa a fa neè ye, e bipshïì enáê, “Tu ñwáè embo na a yi nda, rlii ce a sañ mbo na aè ba rlii nda?” Woweèe a beèesi neè ye enáê, “Tu embo a yïû ñkwe Ruêm, rlii embo aè ba li foñ.”
English: They brought it. He said to them, Whose is this image and inscription? They said to him, Caesar's.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Fa neè buu ñkúú neè ñkúú, fa vïû Nyúè neè Nyúè.” Woweèe a ba neè rgha'nïì-ñwáè aè ryu' njáèá laèa ca.
English: Jesus answered them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. They marveled greatly at him.

Limbum: Beèe Saduèsi ce a kani ená aède' ñwáè kwe ker fúú efa rkwe ka' a vú a bipshi neè Jisoès enáê,
English: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,

Limbum: “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, Musïìs aè m sañ ncir neè seèe ená ñwáè aè ka' lor ñgwa, a ye a bi boo ka', ñgaèñ kwe, baná nfúr yïì be laasi ye tá a ye a bi boo neè nfúr yïì ce e kwe naè.
English: Teacher, Moses wrote to us, 'If a man's brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce laèa wa'a, a ce faèa faèa njobeè' weèe yi yuu ÑWaâ' Nyúè yi laèa ka', a riñ ñger Nyúè foñ ka'.
English: Jesus answered them, Isn't this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?

Limbum: Be keè ba aè nfeè' ce beèe a fúú efa rkwe tá beèe a ker loèr bbyeèñge káè guèusi boo ka'; beèe a be keè ba aèmboè bcïìndap Nyúè embe buèu.
English: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a kweñger a be keè fúú efa rkwe, weèe aè m be be' embe ñwaè' Musïìs embe dïì' ce yi ce suñ aèmboè ce ce mor yi m ce káti mbo naè ka' a? Nyúè aè m laèa mbo neè Musïìs enáê, ‘A máè Nyúè Abraèhaêm, a ba Nyúè Aisïìk, a ker ba Nyúè Jakoèp’ a?
English: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven't you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'?

Limbum: E yu Nyúè bgúâú beèe ka', e yu ba Nyúè beèe ce a cu bteèe. Weèe ce faèa seê.”
English: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.

Limbum: Ñwáè ryá'ni mncir moè' ce e m ce yu'shi aèmboè Jisoès ce de' a weèe mo' ca weèe, aè yá ená Jisoès aè beèesi buu neè woweèe yáánïì seê. E bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Ncir ce yi yu kuèntombïì neè mncir wááwá a yïì efá?”
English: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, Which commandment is the greatest of all?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Ncir entombïì yu ca: ‘Beèe Isráèl, yu' neè! Yïìseèe Tata Nyúè ku ba moè'sir.
English: Jesus answered, The greatest is, 'Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:

Limbum: Baná aè koñ Tata ce e yu yoè Nyúè neè yo ntee-ñwáè, ba neè lo ryoèñ-ñwáè, ker ba neè wo bfee-ñwáè wááwá, ker ba neè yo ñger wááwá.’
English: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.' This is the first commandment.

Limbum: Ncir ce embenjïì yi yu enáê: ‘Koèñ nfúroè aèmboè wáè koèñ yoè nyor.’ Ncir mo' yi yu ce yi caèa bca ka'.”
English: The second is like this, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.' There is no other commandment greater than these.

Limbum: Ñwáè ryá'ni mncir anaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè laèa yáánïì seê, ñwáè ryá'nïì. Wáè laèa mini wáná, Nyúè ku ba moè'sir, moè' ker ba ka', ku ba ye.
English: The scribe said to him, Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,

Limbum: Baná ñwáè koñ Nyúè neè yi ntee wááwá, ba neè vi bfee-ñwáè, ker ba neè yi ñger wááwá, koñ nfúr yïì foñ aèmboè e koèñ yïì nyor. Yi boèñ magoèr aè rláè mncir a caa aè rgeèe btañshïì ce btoèo, ker ba btañshïì wááwá.”
English: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá ená ñwáè anaè aè beèesi neè bfee-ñwá, a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè yu njïìsaèp efa kúú Nyúè ka'.” Ká' embo naè ñwáè aè ker túr cuèu aè rbipshi yuu neè ye ka'.
English: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, You are not far from the Kingdom of God. No one dared ask him any question after that.

Limbum: AÈmboè Jisoès aè m ce yá'ni beèe mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, e lo a bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a laèa ená Kraâis anaè yu muu Dávïìd aè njáâá ká?
English: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

Limbum: Yú' Rara yi m geèe Dávïìd aè laèa enáê, ‘Tata Nyúè aè m laèa neè Tata yaè enáê, “Cu aè la rkoo maè' caar tá m gee tá aè tár mo mkuèu mbenduè beèe ce a baèa wáè.” ’
English: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.'

Limbum: Dávïìd ce too ye ená Tataê, baná aède' e ker ba muu yïì aè njáâá ká?” Beèe magoèr a m lu'shi aè ryu' cena.
English: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son? The common people heard him gladly.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce yá'ni beèe, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Lor neè nfeè' neè ñgeèe ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir. Woweèe a koèñ aè ryar mñgaèbúlaè ce kar aègho, ker koñ ená beèe a ce ca'ni woweèe aè mntaa.
English: In his teaching he said to them, Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

Limbum: Woweèe a niñ aè mndap mloo, koñ aè rcu aè mnta' beâe bgoèrgoèr, a baè' aè mñkaè', ce ba mnta' bboèñboñ.
English: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:

Limbum: Woweèe a ke bo' bbyepbkúú, ye yaèp buu wááwá, ce geèe mloo msaèsap aè rduèñshi beèe ená woweèe a rïìñ aè rloo seê. Yap ñgá' be keè ba goèr seê.”
English: those who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m cu aè mbeèp dïì' ce a m ce fa mbaèa mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a ce fyá' aèmboè beèe a ce láè mbaèa njep ñkuèp rfa. Ñgaâa mbaèa a m fa mbaèa seê.
English: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

Limbum: Ñgwañkúñwáè ce e m ba ñwáè fuèp aè vú a fa mbaèa njo baa. Mbaèa baa ca yi yu aèmboè bfraâñ ta wa'a.
English: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

Limbum: Awá Jisoès a ká' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ wee neè mini-ñwáè máná, ñgwañkúñwáè ce yu ñwáè fuèp na aè fa mbaèa a caa beèe wááwá ce a fa mbaèa njo.
English: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

Limbum: Beèe ca wááwá a gaèpni buu moè' efa ku' yaèp buu ce a túr, a fa rfa aègho, ñgwañkúñwáè ca ce e túr yuu ka' aè loèr mú yuu wááwá ce e túr aè ba yïì ce yi ba jaè' ye, a fa.”
English: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce fúú embe Ndaèp Nyúè, moè' efa ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, yá aèmboè bluèr ca ba mndaèp ca vi kuè'ñger naè.”
English: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!

Limbum: Awá Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Wáè yá ku' mndap bgoèrgoèr ca a? Luèr moè' be cu nje ndap ka'. A be káèáshi vi wááwá.”
English: Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.

Limbum: E du a cu mbe rtuèu Oleèf, a ce keè' Ndap Nyúè. Awá Pitaè ba Jáêms, ker ba Joân ba Andruè a ku ba a woweèe mbo caè'caè', a bipshi yuu mo' neè ye.
English: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

Limbum: A m bipshi enáê, “Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, suñ weèr nfeè' ce buu ca be koni. Yuu ce yi be duèñshi ená nfeè' ce buu ca be koni aè gháá, yu ká?”
English: Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká' a ce suñ woweèe enáê, “Lor neè nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo' weèe ka'.
English: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, Be careful that no one leads you astray.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a be vúè a máâ rlii ce laèa enáê, a máè ye, bo' beèe magoèr tá a da'.
English: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he!' and will lead many astray.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' yu' ená a ce maè' bïìr, ker yu' aè mñoo ená a ce maè' bïìr aè bdïì' moè', mluè mi fa koo weèe ka'. Buu ca vi be kuè koni; geewa'a nfeè' ñgoèñ yi be mïì aè be gháá ka'.
English: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a be keè baèa weèe njo' máè. Geewa'a ñwáè ce e ka' táá tatap du ba' aèlúèsimbuèu baná ñgaèñ be luèñ.”
English: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

Limbum: “Weèe aè ka' yá yuu bsaèrbuu ce yi ce bepsi Ndap Nyúè ñwáè ce e ce beè' ñwaè' ca rïìñ, baná beèe ce a yu aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a cañ duse aè mtuèu.
English: But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not let the reader understand, then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ba mbe tu ndap, e fa suèu embo aè rloèr yuu ka' cañ ka'.
English: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e yu aè mñkúè, e fa keèr kúti aè rloèr yi cáè' ka' cañ ka'.
English: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

Limbum: Mluè mi be ba neè bbyeèñge ce a yu neè mmbúè, ba byeèñge ce a ce nyoñsi boo.
English: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

Limbum: Weèe loo weená buu ca vi fa koni aè cuâu saa ka'.
English: Pray that your flight won't be in the winter.

Limbum: Be ba aè nfeè' anaè tá ñgá' ba goèr seê, ba ba njáèá ñgá' ce e m be ba ka', ká' embe nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m geèe ñgoèñ, ba' seè'ni na, ñgá' moè' be keèr ba wa' ka'.
English: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe nfeè' ñgá' e ba nlúè'shi. E m tá baè geèe wa'a ka', mbúè ñwáè aè m ba luèñ ka'. Nyúè aè m geèe nfeè' anaè aè lú'shïì wa'a njobeè' yïì beèe ce e m ce.
English: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ke laa neè weèe aè nfeè' anaè enáê, ‘Yáê, a Kraâis na’, káè enáê, ‘A ye naè’ áè, weèe fa byemi ka',
English: Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there!' don't believe it.

Limbum: njobeè' beèe ce a be bo'shi ená a woweèe Kraêis, káè ená a woweèe ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè áè, a be keè nyáá, duèñshi mncoèo keèr geèe buu bghagha' ená a bo bo' ka' neè beèe ce Nyúè aè m ce naè-ñwáè.
English: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

Limbum: Baná weèe lor nfeè', njobeè' máè suñ weèe buu ca tá nfeè' ka' gháá.
English: But you watch. Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

Limbum: “Be ba aè mnoèñ ce ñgá' ca aè caa tá nyúè liiti, tá ñwáá yi ker sañ ka'.
English: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

Limbum: Mkaèñsïì mi be gweèñger embe buèu, tá buu ñger embe buèu bsïìp vi ci'tïî.
English: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

Limbum: Be ba aè nfeè' anaè tá beèe a yá Muu Ñwáè aèmboè e ce vúè mbe múè mmbaè' embe buèu neè ñger-ñwáè, ker ba neè foèo-ñwáè.
English: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

Limbum: E be tuu bcïìndap aè bdïì' wááwá aè mmbuu ñgoèñ kyeèe tá a baashi yïì beèe ce e m ce naè ñgúè' moè'sir.
English: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

Limbum: “Yá'ni neè yuu ese ce fik ca: Bfuè efa gho vi ke kaèrñger, e ba aè nfeè' ce yi ka' karñger, top, weèe riñ weená nfeè' mbeèñ yu aètútú.
English: Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and puts forth its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

Limbum: Baná weèe fa buumi ka' njobeè' weèe rïìñ nfeè' ce ñwáè ndap be vúè ka'. Seemoè' e be vúè aè mbuèuñkuèr, káè neè ntee-tú', káè aè nfeè' ntooñgúp yi toñ, káè aè nfeè' túè' aè raa áè.
English: Watch therefore, for you don't know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

Limbum: E ka' lá'si vúê, e fa yá weèe aè mmirloè ka'.
English: lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa neè weèe, m ce laèa neè beèe wááwá. Fa buumi neè ka'.”
English: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi m báti bbaa tá a ka' ye Ñkaâ' caèasi mndap, ba ñkaè' ce a ke ye bráâd ce a láè yis njo ka'. Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a ce roèo njïì tá a bo koo Jisoès aè bfee, yú.
English: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Seèe fa koo ye aè múè ñkaè' ka' njobeè' seèe ka' koo ye aè múè ñkaè', beèe a lo ká' ñgá'.”
English: For they said, Not during the feast, because there might be a riot of the people.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ba aè rla' Bátanïì mbe ndaèp mbe Saimúèn ñwáè msaèasïì. A ka' ce ye byee, njeñwáè moè' aè niñ neè mú njáèá ntúñ bluèr moè'. Njáèá mgúr mo' ce mi m ce rúèú boèñboñ, a luu ntaa seê, mi ba njo jiñ. E bú' ndoo mú ntúñ anaè a cu'ni mgúr enjo mbe tu Jisoès.
English: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard--very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

Limbum: Ntee yi yañ beèe mo' ce a m ba mbo, woweèe a ká' a ce laèa a waâp mú enáê, “A jarsi mgúr ca aè cicïì njoká?
English: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, Why has this ointment been wasted?

Limbum: A ba fyeèni mgúr ca tá yi caa btosïìn mjeèe mtaar tá a lor mbaèa anaè fa neè ñgaâa fuèp.” Woweèe a ka' laèa wa'a, a lapni njeñwáè ca seê.
English: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor. They grumbled against her.

Limbum: Awá Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê “Láè neè ye nyañ. Weèe ce fa ye ñgá' njoká? E geèe ba yuu boèñboñ neè máè.
English: But Jesus said, Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

Limbum: Ñgaâa fuèp a be kuè ba weèe woweèe aè nfeè' sïìp. AÈde' weèe ja' woweèe aè nfeè' weèe aè gwáá. Geewa'a, seèe be ba aè nfeè' sïìp ka'.
English: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ca aè geèe yuu ce yi ghááte aè ndeèe yi ñger. E cuè'ni mgúr ca fa máâ nyoèr aè rkupshi yaè nyor tá a ka' tuñ.
English: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená faèdïì' wááwá ce a ka' ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ njep ñgoèñ na, a be suñ yuu ce njeñwáè ca aè m geèe naè, keèr ce kuushi ye.”
English: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.

Limbum: Judas IÌskarïìyoèt ce aè m ba moè' efa beèe ncoèp-baa-aè rrúèú aè m duè a yá beâe bgoèrgoèr efa ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì tá e bo fyeèni Jisoès neè woweèe.
English: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

Limbum: Woweèe a yu' rboèñ neè yuu ce e suñ woweèe, a ka'ni ená a be fa ye mbaèa. Judaès aè ká' a ce roèo nduunjïì aè rfyeèni Jisoès.
English: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

Limbum: Noèñ entombïì efa Ñkaâ' ye bráâd ce a láè yis njo ka' yi m gháá. AÈ m ba noèñ ce a m ce sháshi bya' ce a be ye ñkaè' aègho. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a bipshi neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce koèñ ená weèr fár byee ba fá, tá aè bo ye?”
English: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?

Limbum: E tuu beèe a mmbaa efa waâp mú a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Duè neè aè múè rla', weèe be baè' tá weèe tarte weèe mbañruèñwáè moè' ce e byáè' ntúñ mdip. Duè neè fa yeâ mbuèu,
English: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him,

Limbum: e niñ mbe ndaèp, weèe niñ mbo foñ, laa neè ñwáè ndap ená ñwáè ryá'nïì aè laèa enáê, ‘Dïì' ce m be ye Ñkaâ' caèasi mndap weèr ñgaâa yá'ni yaè buu weèe yi yuê?’
English: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says, Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'

Limbum: Weèe be laèa wa'a, tá e duñshi weèe rum ndap moè' ñgoèr mbenduè ndap anaè, ce a kupshi, a fa buu mbo wááwá. Weèe fár byee ñkaè' ca mbo.”
English: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè, a yá buu wááwá aè ku ba aèmboè Jisoès aè m suñ woweèe naè. Woweèe a fár byee ñkaè' anaè mbo.
English: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr, Jisoès aè vú a yïì beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' cu mbe tábuèr ce ye byee, Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená moè' efa weèe be fyeèni máè, moè' ce e ce ye byee weèr ye.”
English: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me--he who eats with me.

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce koosimnse, a ce bipshi neè ye moè'sir moè'sir enáê, “Waè' yu máè a?”
English: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, Surely not I? And another said, Surely not I?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Moè' efa weèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ce e ce cúè' bráâd weèr ye njep kañ na, be fyeèni máè.
English: He answered them, It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

Limbum: Muu Ñwáè be kuè kwe aèmboè Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ndoèo be co' ñwáè ce e be fyeèni ye. Yi yu aèndeèe ená a m ba bi ñwáè anaè ka'.”
English: For the Son of Man goes, even as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.

Limbum: AÈmboè woweèe a m ce yeñger anaè, e lor bráâd a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi, a fa neè woweèe, a laa enáê, “Koè neè. Ca yu yaè nyor.”
English: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat. This is my body.

Limbum: E lor ndoñ, a ka' yoèñshi Nyúè, a fa neè woweèe, woweèe wááwá a noê.
English: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Cena yu wa bláá ce vi kur leâ' fi ce vi be fúú, suèu aètu beèe magoèr.
English: He said to them, This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená m be keèr no mruè' ce a geèe neè mbaèñ ce na ka', caar duè baè' aè nfeè' ce m be no mïû mfi mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.”
English: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it anew in the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Woweèe a yop yáá, a natïî, a du mbe rtuèu Oleèf.
English: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

Limbum: A ka' baè', Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe wááwá be loè cañse maè' máè aèmboè Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa. Yi laèa enáê, ‘M be lïìp ñwáè ncïìñ njeèe tá njeèe yi da'se.’
English: Jesus said to them, All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, m be fúú efa rkwe, du aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, tá weèe vú koni máè aèfo.”
English: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Beèe ca wááwá a ka' ma' wáè, m ma' wáè ka'.”
English: But Peter said to him, Although all will be offended, yet I will not.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè Pitaè enáê, “M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená tá nduñgúp ka' toñ neètú' e ntïìni nfeè' baa, aè be kani ñkaèraè' taar ená aè rïìñ máè ka'.”
English: Jesus said to him, Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ku luñ enáê, “Yi ka' ku ba ba ená soè kwe aèbee, m kanïì ka'.” Woweèe wááwá a ku laa wa' foñ.
English: But he spoke all the more, If I must die with you, I will not deny you. They all said the same thing.

Limbum: Woweèe a du mbe dïì' mo' ce a m ce too ená Gáètsámanïì. A ka' baè' mbo, Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Cu neè mbena tá m gee rloo.”
English: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, Sit here, while I pray.

Limbum: A ka' laèa wa'a, a lor Pitaè ba Jáêms, ker ba Joân, a woweèe a duê. E ká' a ce señ buu, mluè mi ce koo ye seê.
English: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

Limbum: E laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñkoosimnse ce e yu njep máâ ntee yu yïì ce aède' e ku yú máè. Cu neè mbena ce ke'nïî.”
English: He said to them, My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.

Limbum: E lo embo a du aè njïìsaèp ka', a gwe kúkúèp, a loo neè Nyúè ená yi ka' ba aètáèr e gee tá nfeè' ñgá' ce e ce vúè naè caa embe yeâ tuè.
English: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

Limbum: E loo enáê, “Yaè taê, aède' aè gee buu wááwá. Geèe tá ndoñ ñgá' ca caa embe máâ tuè. Geewa'a, ke' ba ená aè gee ba aèmboè m ce koèñ ka', geèe ba aèmboè wáè koèñ.”
English: He said, Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.

Limbum: E ka' kúti, a yá aèmboè ñgaâa yá'nïì yïì buu a ce buumi. E laa neè Pitaè enáê, “Saimúèn, aè ce buumi a? AÈde' aè ke' ke'seè mú teèteè ka' a?
English: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn't you watch one hour?

Limbum: Keè'se neè ce loo faè dïì' weèe gwe rmoèoshïì ka'. Ntee njep rbúè, bsáè nje nyoèr.”
English: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker du a ker loo aèmboè e ba loo naè.
English: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.

Limbum: E ka' kúti, a ker yá aèmboè woweèe a ce buumi, mmirlo mi ku ce duè neè woweèe duè. Woweèe a túr yuu ce a laa neè ye ka'.
English: Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn't know what to answer him.

Limbum: E ka' keèr duè kúti, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ku bii buumi a ce lúèshi a? Yi gháá seè'ni, nfeè' aè gháá. A be fa Muu Ñwáè mbe mmbo ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep.
English: He came the third time, and said to them, Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

Limbum: Loè neè mbekïì tá seèe duê. Ñwáè ce e fyeèni máè naè yu aètútú.”
English: Arise, let us be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kuè bii mïìsi efa cuèu, Judaès ce e m ba moè' efa yïì beèe ce ncoèp- baa-aè-rrúèú naè aè toseè. E m ba a ku' beèe ce a m túr bsaè' ba mmbaèñ. Beèe ce a m tuu woweèe aè m ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, ker ba bleebeèe.
English: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came--and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

Limbum: Judaès ce e m fyeèni ye naè aè m suñ woweèe wáá enáê, “Ñwáè ce m ka' baa nje nyoèr baná a ye. Koo neè ye du aègho, ke'ni boèñboñ faè dïì' e cañ ka'.”
English: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, Whoever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.

Limbum: A ka' vúè, a ko'shi aègee Jisoès, a laa enáê, “Rabaèi”, a baa ye nje nyoèr.
English: When he had come, immediately he came to him, and said, Rabbi! Rabbi! and kissed him.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a koo Jisoès a ba'ni.
English: They laid their hands on him, and seized him.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa múè beèe ce a m ba a Jisoès aè co' saè', a tee tuè' ese ñkwaèa ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì.
English: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè vúè aè rkoo máè a túr bsaè' ba mmbaèñ aèmboè m yu lá nyáèá wa'a njoká?
English: Jesus answered them, Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

Limbum: To máè m ku ce yá'ni weèe mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá. Weèe aè ke' koo máè mbo ka'. Geewa'a, tá yuu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa yi ghááte njo.”
English: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn't arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.

Limbum: Beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú caè wááwá a ma' ye, a cañse.
English: They all left him, and fled.

Limbum: A ka' koo Jisoès ce duè aègho, muu nsuènsuè moè' ce e m ku wap ba cáè' aè nyoèr aè ce duè a yeâ mbuèu. Beèe ca a koo ye aè cáè',
English: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself, over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

Limbum: e ma'shïì neè woweèe a cañ a du mbuèuriñ.
English: but he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

Limbum: A m duè neè Jisoès njeptii ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba bleebeèe, ker ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, a vú aèbee.
English: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

Limbum: Pitaè aè du a yeâ mbuèu a ba yi encaèñ, a du a ba' mbe mambe ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. E ka' baè' a cu njepmbeè a ce yár mor a beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Ndap Nyúè weèe.
English: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba beèe wááwá embe kansuèr a m roèo beèe tá a bo vúè táá njïìnsa' tá a koo Jisoès, yú. Geewa'a, a yá faèa ka'.
English: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

Limbum: Ku' beèe a m táá njïìnsa' mnaèñ. Nlaèa ñwáè yi tarteè a yi moè' ka'.
English: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn't agree with each other.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a natïì mbekïì a nya' mnde' enáê,
English: Some stood up, and gave false testimony against him, saying,

Limbum: “Weèr aè m yu' aèmboè e ce laèa enáê, ‘M be saè'si Ndap Nyúè ce beèe a baè'ri neè mmbo na, loèr mnoâñ btaar baè'ri njáèá moè' ce aède' ñwáè ba'rïì ka'.” ’
English: We heard him say, 'I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.'

Limbum: Ka' yuu ce woweèe a m laèa foñ na yi m tarte a yi moè' ka'.
English: Even so, their testimony did not agree.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè natïì mbekïì a bipshi neè Jisoès enáê, “AÈ túr yuu aè rbeèesi kuu yuu ce beèe ca a ce laèa kuu wáè na ka' a?”
English: The high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ku cip, a laa yuu ka'. E ker bipshi neè ye enáê, “A wáè Kraêis, Muu Nyúè ce weèr ce gú'shi neè ye naè a?”
English: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “A máè ye. Weèe be yá Muu Ñwáè aèmboè e cu aè bo maè' Nyúè ce e túr ñger wááwá, keèr yá foñ aèmboè e ce suèu aè múè mmbaè'.”
English: Jesus said, I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè shashïì bcáè' efa nyoèr, a laa enáê, “Mbuèu moè' ker ba neè seèe aè rlaèa ená ñwáè moè' ker laa yuu kuu ñwáè ca ka'.
English: The high priest tore his clothes, and said, What further need have we of witnesses?

Limbum: Weèe aè yu' aèmboè e bepsi rlii Nyúè. Weèe aè laèa wee ká?” Beèe wááwá a laa ená a yú ye.
English: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think? They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a ká' a ce ce ye neè mce, a cete ye mmir, a túshi ye neè bdúè' a laa neè ye enáê, “To' ka' ñwáè ce e túshi wáè neè bdúè'.” Beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Ndap Nyúè a koo ye, a lïîp.
English: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, Prophesy! The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ku bii njep mambe anaè, muunje moè' ce e m ce faè' neè ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì,
English: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

Limbum: aè vú a yá Pitaè aèmboè e ce yár mor. A fyá' ye ená ntuñ, a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè m ba weèe Jisoès aè rla' Nasaráèt foñ.”
English: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!

Limbum: Pitaè aè kanïì, a laa neè ye enáê, “M rïìñ ye ka'. M rïìñ yuu ce aè ce laèa anaè ka'.” A ka' laèa wa'a, a lá'si nyor embe mambe a táá njep mntosïì. E ka' táá njo, nduñgúp aè toêñ.
English: But he denied it, saying, I neither know, nor understand what you are saying. He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

Limbum: Muunje ca aè ker yá Pitaè, a ker laa neè beèe ce a m ba aèfo enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu moè' efa woweèe.”
English: The maid saw him, and began again to tell those who stood by, This is one of them.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ker kani. Mú nfeè' aè ka' tuuse, beèe ce a m ba aèfo naè a laa neè Pitaè foñ enáê, “A wáè moè' efa woweèe ghup njobeè' aè yu ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.”
English: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ye leè', a laa enáê, “M rïìñ ñwáè ce weâe laèa na ka'.”
English: But he began to curse, and to swear, I don't know this man of whom you speak!

Limbum: Nduñgúp aè ker toñ aè nfeè' anaè. Pitaè aè kuushïì yuu ce Jisoès aè m suñ ye enáê, “Tá nduñgúp ka' toñ nfeè' baa, aè be kani ená aè rïìñ máè ka', ñkaèraè' taar naè.” E ka' kuushi wa'a, a bú' rwar.
English: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times. When he thought about that, he wept.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú', beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba bleebeâe aè to', ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, ba bár ñgaâa kansuèr wááwá a seesïì aèmboè a be geèe neè Jisoès. A ka' seèesi wáá, a kur ye, a du aègho a fa neè Pailáèt.
English: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “A wáè ñkúú Jus a?” Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “AÈ laèa yo cuèu.”
English: Pilate asked him, Are you the King of the Jews? He answered, So you say.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a toshïì ye aè ku' buu goèr.
English: The chief priests accused him of many things.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ker bipshi neè ye enáê, “AÈ túr yuu laèa ka' a? AÂ yu' ku' buu ce a ce laèa aèmboè wáè na lañ?”
English: Pilate again asked him, Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker laa yi yu yuu ka'. Pailáèt aè bááñgeèr seê.
English: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

Limbum: AÈ m ce ba aè ñkaè' ca, Pailáèt fúr ñwáè shañ moè'sir efa shañ. E m ce fúr ba ñwáè ce beèe a koèñ.
English: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè ñwáè moè' aè ba mbe shañ. A m too ye ená Baèrabaès. E m ba mbe shañ a beèe mo' ce a woweèe a m yúshi beèe aè nfeè' woweèe a m taè' buèr gopmáèn.
English: There was one called Barabbas, bound with those who had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

Limbum: Ku' beèe a vúê, a yá Pailáèt a laa neè ye ená e fúr ñwáè shañ moè' embe shañ aèmboè e ke geèe aè nfeè' ñkaè' ca naè.
English: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

Limbum: E bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weâe koèñ ená m fúr ñkúú Jus fa neè weèe a?”
English: Pilate answered them, saying, Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?

Limbum: E m bipshi wa'a njobeè' e m rïìñ ená beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a m ce ko'-ndoñ neè Jisoès a ka' koo ye a vú aègho a fa neè ye.
English: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr ca a cepshïì beèe ená a laa tá Pailáèt fúr ba Baèrabaès fa neè woweèe.
English: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ker bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Baná m gee má ká neè ñwáè ce weâe too ená ñkúú Jus na?”
English: Pilate again asked them, What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?

Limbum: Woweèe a waa enáê, “Taa ye mbe kïìntaa.”
English: They cried out again, Crucify him!

Limbum: Pailáèt aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “M taa ye mbe kïìntaa njoká? Yuu bebep ce ñwáè ca aè geèe seeseê, yu ba ká?” Woweèe a ku ce waani, a ce laèa enáê, “Taa lá ye mbe kïìntaa.”
English: Pilate said to them, Why, what evil has he done? But they cried out exceedingly, Crucify him!

Limbum: Pailáèt aè m koèñ aè rgeèe tá nyor boñ kúr beèe anaè. E fúr Baèrabaès embe shañ a fa neè woweèe, a laa ená a lip Jisoès. A ka' lïìp ye neè byáánsoè wáá, a fa ye tá a bo duè taa mbe kïìntaa.
English: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

Limbum: Bsoogáè mo' a m loèr Jisoès a niñ aègho mbe dïì' mnsa' embe nto' ce govanoè aè m ce cu mbo, a ká' bsoogáè wááwá mbo.
English: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

Limbum: Beèe a ka' vúè, a lor cáâ' beer a fa ye aè nyoèr, a gee rtaa kúú neè bsoèpsïì a sop ye mbe tuè,
English: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

Limbum: a ká' a ce caè'ni ye, a ce laèa enáê, “Nyaèr, ñkwe Juês.”
English: They began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

Limbum: A ka' laèa wa'a, a lip ye neè ñke' mbe tuè, a ce ye neè mce, a gú'shi a ce bo'shi ená a ce caè'ni ye.
English: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúèshi ye mïìsi, a co' yap cáâ' beer caè, a lor bcáè' vi, a kúsi ye aè nyoèr, a lor ye a du aègho aè rtaa mbe kïìntaa.
English: When they had mocked him, they took the purple off of him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' aè nduunjïì a yá Saimúèn ce aè rla' Saèireên, aèmboè e ce kúti efa mñkúè. AÈ m ba taèr yïì AÈláèksandaè ba Rufoès. Woweèe a koo ye aè ñger ená e koo kïìntaa ese Jisoès byá'.
English: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.

Limbum: A woweèe a du neè Jisoès faèdïì' ce a m ce too ená Golgotaè. Mbuèu efa rlii ca yu enáê, “Dïû' keèkeèp tu.”
English: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

Limbum: A ka' baè', a lor mruè' a fiñshi neè máêr, a fa neè Jisoès ená e no, e kanïì.
English: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn't take it.

Limbum: Woweèe a taa ye mbe kïìntaa, a lor vi bcáè' a ma' kañ aègho, tá a bo yá aèmboè a be gaèp.
English: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

Limbum: A m taa Jisoès mbe kïìntaa aè nyúè búè'ú aè ñgaèptú'.
English: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.

Limbum: A m sañ mbuèu ce a m taa ye mbe kïìntaa. A m sañ enáê, “Ñkúú Juês.”
English: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

Limbum: A m taa byáèá a baa mbe bkïìntaa foñ. Moè' aè ba aè yi bo maè', moè' aè bo ñkoèp.
English: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.

Limbum: A ka' geèe wa'a, blaâa Nyúè ce a sañ enáê, “A m beè' ye aè mú ñgaâa bú'shi mncir” naè vi ghááteè njo.
English: The Scripture was fulfilled, which says, He was numbered with transgressors.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce caèa yap caèa a m ce koèr btu, a ce suè' ye neè mcáp, a ce laèa enáê, “AÈhaê! Wáè ce aède' aè sa'sïì Ndap Nyúè baè'ri aè mnoâñ btaar,
English: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ha! You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days,

Limbum: jaè' laè yo tu suu embe kïìntaa.”
English: save yourself, and come down from the cross!

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a ce vúèshi ye foñ, a ce laèa a waâp mú enáê, “E m jaè' beèe mo' a moo aè rjaè' yi tu laèr.
English: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, He saved others. He can't save himself.

Limbum: Seèe yá ka aèmboè Kraêis, ñkúú aè to' Isráèl be suèu embe kïìntaa seè'ni na tá seèe bo byemi neè ye.” Beèe a mmbaa ce a m taa a Jisoès weèe mbe bkïìntaa naè, a cáp ye foñ.
English: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him. Those who were crucified with him insulted him.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' kuèu ñgoèñ, túè' aè sii, ká' aè nyúè ncoèp-baa du ba' aè nyúè taar.
English: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nyúè taar anaè, Jisoès aè waa enáê, “ÁÈloêi, ÁÈloêi, Lama Saèbaètanïì”, ce e yu enáê, “Yaè Nyúè, yaè Nyúè, wáè leèse máè njoká?”
English: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?

Limbum: Beèe mo' ce a m tááte aèfo a ka' yu', a laa enáê, “Yu' neè, e ce ká' AÈlajaè.”
English: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he is calling Elijah.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè cañ a du a fúú kúèsha njep múè njáèá mruè' mo' ce mi m ce bañshi, a fapte aè ñke', a fa neè Jisoès ená e bo nyoñ. E ka' fa, a laa enáê, “Seèe yá ka ená waè' AÈlajaè be vúè suèusi ye embe kïìntaa na lá.”
English: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to take him down.

Limbum: Jisoès aè waa tatap aè nfeè' anaè, a kwe.
English: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

Limbum: Cáè' ce a m teni dïì' mo' embe Ndaèp Nyúè aègho yi m saèti, ká' embe tuè du a ba' njep mbuèu.
English: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè rjeèe ce e m táá a ce keè'ni Jisoès, aè ka' yá aèmboè e kwe, e laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè m ba Muu Nyúè ghup.”
English: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God!

Limbum: Bbyeèñge mo' a m ba aèfo foñ, a táá aè njïìsaèp a ce fyá'. Máèári aè rla' Makdalaè, ba Máèári ce aè m ba ma yïì Jáms ce ñká' ba Joseès, a m ba aè múè bbyeèñge ca a Saèlomeè weèe.
English: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce kar aèmbuèu Jisoès a ce jaè' ye aè nfeè' e m ba aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê. Ku' bbyeèñge mo' foñ ce a m vúè a Jisoès weâe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a m ba aèfo.
English: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' beèe a m ce tami nyor ená túè' be raa tá a cu mmbomntaa Nyúè, Josáèf ce aè rla' AÈrimaètiyaè aè du aè mbuèuñkuèr anaè, a du a yá Pailáèt. Josáèf ca aè m ba moè' efa múè ñgaâa kansuèr ce beèe a m ce yu'ni neè ye seê. E m ce keè' nfeè' ce Nyúè be vúè sa' aèmboè ñkúú. E kur ntee a du a yá Pailáèt, a laa ená e fa gúâú ñwáè neè ye tá e tuñ.
English: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath, Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for the Kingdom of God, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ka' yu' ená Jisoès aè ba kwe wáá, a tarni seê. A ká' ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè rjeèe caè. E ka' vúè, e bipshïì neè ye ená Jisoès aè ba kwe wáá lá.
English: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

Limbum: E ka' suñ ye ená Jisoès aè ba kwe wáá, e laa neè Josáèf ená e du lor gúâú Jisoès.
English: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

Limbum: Josáèf aè du a yuu cáâ' boèñboñ, a suusi gúâú ñwáè embe kïìntaa, a kur neè cáè' anaè a lá njep rsheè ce a m soè' nje ryáá. A ka' láè a biñsi ma luèr a cete ncuèu rsheè aègho.
English: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

Limbum: Máèári e aè rla' Makdalaè ba Máèári ma yïì Joseès a m ba aèfo, a yá mbe dïì' ce a tuñ Jisoès.
English: Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

Limbum: Noèñ mmbomntaa Nyúè yi ka' caèa, Máèári e aè rla' Makdalaè, ba Máèári ma yïì Jáêms, ba Saèlomeè a yuu njáèá mgúr mo' tá a bo yo' gúâú ñwáè aègho.
English: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ entombïì embe múè ñgaèa, aè nfeè' nyúè aè baèp e kuèmbuèuntii, woweèe a ce du faèdïì' rsheè li m ba naè.
English: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

Limbum: A ka' ce duè a ce bipshi a waâp mú enáê, “Ñwáè ce e be duè biñsi luèr embe ncuèu rsheè neè seèe a nda?”
English: They were saying among themselves, Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?

Limbum: Luèr anaè aè m kuè' seê. Woweèe a ka' vúè baè' aèfo, a yá ená a ba biñsi luèr anaè embe nduè ncuèu rsheè wáá.
English: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' niñ njep rsheè, a yá muu nsuènsuè moè' aèmboè e cu aè ñgúè' bo maè', a yar ñgaèbúlaâ mbúú. Nyor aè bañ woweèe seê.
English: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.

Limbum: Muu nsuènsuè ca aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa wáp ka', m rïìñ máná weèe ce roèo Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt ce a mú taa ye mbe kïìntaa naè. E yu mbena ka'. E fúú efa rkwe. Yá neè, a mbe dïì' a mú lá ye na.
English: He said to them, Don't be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!

Limbum: Baná weèe du suñ ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ba Pitaè ená e duè aè ñgoâñ Galeèle entombïì neè weèe. Weèe be yá ye aèfo aèmboè e m suñ weèe naè.”
English: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.'

Limbum: Woweèe a saa enjep rsheè a cañ, njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp, a ker jep foñ. Woweèe a laa yuu neè ñwáè ka' njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp.
English: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' fúú efa rkwe aè noèñ entombïì embe múè ñgaèa, a duñshi yïì nyor entombïì neè Máèári e aè rla' Makdalaè ce e m fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' saèamba enjep ye naè.
English: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

Limbum: Máèári aè ka' yá ye, a du a suñ beèe ce a m ce ba a Jisoès weèe. Woweèe a m ce cu rkwe, a ce warse.
English: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' ená Máèári aè yá ye e cu nteèe naè, woweèe a byemïì ka'.
English: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' embenjïì, e duñshïì yïì nyor neè beèe a mmbaa ce a m ce duè aè rla' mo', a yááti aè mmïìr aè njáâá jáá.
English: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.

Limbum: Woweèe a kútïì a suñ bár beèe, woweèe a ker byemi ka'.
English: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn't believe them, either.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' elúèsimbuèu, e duñshïì yïì nyor neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce a m báti ncoèp-moè'sir-aè-rrúèú, aè nfeè' ce woweèe a m ce ye byee. E m lapni woweèe njobeè' woweèe a m teèe-btu, a byemi ka'. E m lapni woweèe wa'a njobeè' beèe ce a m yá ye a m suñ woweèe ená e fúú efa rkwe, woweèe a kanïì.
English: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn't believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Duè neè aè bto' wááwá fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè ñwáè wááwá.
English: He said to them, Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi a baptïìr ye, ñgaèñ be luèñ. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá byemi ka', baná ñgaèñ be gweè mnsa'.
English: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

Limbum: Beèe ce a byemi a be geèe buu ghagha' ca. Woweèe a be fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe fa máâ rlii, laèa bli bfi,
English: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

Limbum: koo mnyo neè mmbo, a ka' no nli' e gee yuu neè woweèe ka'. Woweèe a be joèo ñgaâa byañ neè mmbo tá a ke'se.”
English: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.

Limbum: Tata Jisoès aè ka' laèa neè woweèe wa'a, Nyúè aè lor ye a du aègho mbe buèu. E ka' baè' mbo a cu aè bo maè' Nyúè.
English: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

Limbum: Woweèe a duê, a ce fe'shi aè ñgoèñ wááwá. Tata aè m jaè' woweèe a fa woweèe ñger aè rgeèe buu bghagha' tá beèe a bo rïìñ ená blaèa ce woweèe a ce feè'shi vi yu mini.
English: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a loèr nfeè' a sañ buu ce vi m koni a seâe mú.
English: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

Limbum: Buu ce woweèe a sañ, ku ba buu ce beèe ce a m ce yá neè map mmir efa rkáè', ce a m ba ñgaâa feè'shi blaâa Nyúè a m suñ weèr.
English: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

Limbum: Maèsaè Tïìyofiloès, má máè foñ aè ka' fyá' buu ca wááwá boèñboñ aèmboè vi m ba efa rkáè', a yá máná yi yu boèñboñ foñ neè máè aè rsañ buu anaè yáánïì aèmboè vi m ba, fa neè wáè,
English: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

Limbum: tá aè bo rïìñ ená buu ce a yá'ni wáè vi yu mini ghup.
English: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce Hároèd aè m ba ñkúú aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, ñwáè tañshi tañshïì moè' aè ba, a ce too ená Saèkaèriyaè. AÈ m ba ñwáè embe ñgoo ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì embe ndaèp AÈbijaè. A m ce too ñgwa yïì ená ÁÈlisabáèt. Ye ye aè m ba ñwáè embe ndúè' Ároèn ce aè m ba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì.
English: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce cu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè, a ce geèe buu wááwá ce Tata Nyúè aè m laèa, a bár mo' ka'.
English: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

Limbum: Woweèe a m túr boo ka' njobeè' ÁÈlisabáèt aè m ba kar, woweèe a ker rúú seê.
English: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' ce beèe embe ñgoo Saèkaèriyaè a ce faè' mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, Saèkaèriyaè aè ce geèe li rfaè' aèmboè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì neè Nyúè.
English: Now it happened, while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his division,

Limbum: Ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì neè Nyúè a m sañ mlii beèe, a lá njep lá', a cu' aèmboè yaèp ndeèe aè m ba. A ka' cuè', rlii Saèkaèriyaè li fúú enjo ená e niñ mbe Ndaèp Tata Nyúè, too nráèá neè ye.
English: according to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba nfeè' ce a ce too nráèá, beèe wááwá a táá njepmbeè a ce geèe rloo.
English: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

Limbum: Saèkaèriyaè aè ka' ba mbo wa'a, ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè nyáá, a táá aè ñgúè' bo maè' dïû' ntoèo nráèá.
English: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

Limbum: Saèkaèriyaè aè ka' yá ye, mluè mi koo ye, e wáp seê.
English: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Fa wáp ka', Saèkaèriyaè, Nyúè aè yu' lo rloo. Ñgwa woâ ÁÈlisabáèt be bi wáè muu mbañruè. AÈ be fa rlii muu anaè ená Joân.
English: But the angel said to him, Don't be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

Limbum: AÈ be keè lu'shi, yu' rboèñ, tá beèe magoèr a lu'shi foñ, aè nfeè' ce a bi muu anaè,
English: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.

Limbum: njobeè' e be keè ba ñwáâ ñgoèr aè bsii Tata Nyúè. E be keè no mruè' ka', no yuu tatap ka'. E be keè ruu neè Yú' Rara, ká' enjep rbúè yïì maê.
English: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

Limbum: E be keè geèe tá beèe magoèr efa múè beèe Isráèl a kúti njeptii Tata ce e yu yaèp Nyúè.
English: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.

Limbum: E be keè duè entombïû neè ye neè njáèá yú' ker ba ñger ce AÈlajaè aè m túr, tá e bo geèe tá btar boo a boo wap weèe a kúti aèbee, geèe tá beèe ce a teèe btu a túr bfee aèmboè beèe ce a yu yáánïì a túr, tá beèe Nyúè a bo tami nyor aè rkoni Tataê.”
English: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, 'to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,' and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.

Limbum: Saèkaèriyaè aè laa neè ncïìndap Nyúè anaè enáê, “Máè rúèú seê, ñgwa waè foñ aè rúêú. AÈtaè m riñ neè ká ená yuu ce aè ce laèa na yi be ba mini?”
English: Zacharias said to the angel, How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè aè beesïì enáê, “A máè Gaberyaè ce má ke táá aè bsii Nyúè. Nyúè aè tuu máè ená m vú cep ntuu boèñboñ ca neè wáè.
English: The angel answered him, I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.

Limbum: Yuu ce máè suñ wáè na yi be keè geèeti aè nfeè' ce yi ba geèeti, geewa'a, aèmboè wáè byemi ka' baná aè be keèr laèa ka' káâ', ntïìni du ba' mbe nfeè' ce yuu ca yi be geèeti.”
English: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn't believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.

Limbum: Saèkaèriyaè aè m cu mbe Ndaèp Nyúè anaè teèteè seê. Beèe ce a m cu ce keè' ye naè a ce tarni ená aè koni ba ká lá.
English: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

Limbum: Saèkaèriyaè aè ka' fúú embo, a moo aè rlaèa neè woweèe laèr, a ká' a ce suñ buu neè woweèe ba neè mmbo. Woweèe a ka' yá wa' a ku riñ ená e yá njáèá rlo mo'.
English: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

Limbum: Yïì nfeè' rfaè' aè ka' mïì, e kútïì mbe yeâ ndaèp.
English: It happened, when the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

Limbum: Mnoèñ mo' vi ka' caèa, ÁÈlisabáèt aè koo rbúè, a cu mbe ndaèp mñwáá taê, a ker ce fúú aè múè beèe ka'.
English: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Ñwáè ce e geèe ca neè máè aè geèe Tataê. E fyá' máè a bur máè rïìtu ce yi m ce koo máè aè múè beèe naè embe tuè.”
English: Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.

Limbum: Rbúâ ÁÈlisabáèt li ka' ba mñwáá ntuunfu, Nyúè aè tuu yïì ncïìndap ce a too ená Gaberyaè, aè rla' Nasaráèt aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè ca aè m túr ntuu aè rcep neè muunje moè', ce ñwáè moè' ce a m ce too ená Josáèf aè m ce niñ guèu aègho. Josáèf aè m ba ñwáè embe ndúè' ñkúú Dávïìd. A m too rlii muunje anaè ená Máèári.
English: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin's name was Mary.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè vúê, a laa neè ye enáê, “Máè caè'ni wáè! Tata yu weèe ye, aè túr rboâñtu weèe Nyúè!”
English: Having come in, the angel said to her, Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!

Limbum: Máèári aè ka' yu' ntuu ce ncïìndap Nyúè aè m cep na, bfee vi jep ye, e ce señ ená yuu ce ncïìndap Nyúè aè laèa anaè yi yu ba ená ká lá.
English: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Fa wáp ka' Máèári, njobeè' aè túr rboâñtu weèe Nyúè.
English: The angel said to her, Don't be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

Limbum: AÈ be koo rbúè, bi muu mbañruè, fa rlii ená Jisoès.
English: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and bring forth a son, and will call his name 'Jesus.'

Limbum: Muu anaè be keè ba ñwáâ ñgoèr, tá a too ye ená Muu Nyúè embe buèu. Tata Nyúè be fa kúú yïì ta Dávïìd neè ye.
English: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,

Limbum: E be keè sa' mbe ndúè' Jakoèp aè nfeè' wááwá, tá yi kúú yi mi ka'.”
English: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.

Limbum: Máèári aè laa neè ncïìndap Nyúè anaè enáê, “Máè be riñ mbañruèñwáè ka'. Baná aètaè ca yi ba wa' aè njáâá ká?”
English: Mary said to the angel, How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè aè beesïì enáê, “Yú' Rara yi be vúè mbe wáâ nduè, tá ñger Nyúè embe buèu yi tá'shi wáè. Baná a be keè too muu nrara anaè ená Muu Nyúè.
English: The angel answered her, The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

Limbum: Yáê, nfúroâ ÁÈlisabáèt aè koo rbúè aè nfeè' ce e yu nleeñwáè seê. Ñwáè ce a m ce too ená kar yu neè rbúè seè'ni aè mñwáá ntuunfu.
English: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

Limbum: Ca yi yu wa' njobeè' yuu mo' yi yu ce aètaè yi gha' Nyúè aè rgeèe ka'.”
English: For everything spoken by God is possible.

Limbum: Máèári aè laa enáê, “A máè ñwáè rfaè' Tataê. Tá yuu ce wáè laèa anaè yi ku ba aèmboè wáè laèa.” E ka' laèa wa'a, ncïìndap Nyúè aè ma'shïì ye a duê.
English: Mary said, Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me according to your word. The angel departed from her.

Limbum: Mú mnoèñ mo' vi ka' caèa, Máèári aè natïì a du cárcár mbe rla' mo' ce li m ba mbe mtuâu aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè.
English: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

Limbum: E ka' baè', a niñ mbe ndaèp mbe Saèkaèriyaè, a ca'ni ÁÈlisabáèt.
English: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

Limbum: ÁÈlisabáèt aè ka' yu' aèmboè e caè'ni ye, muu enjep yeâ rbúè aè karsïì nyor. ÁÈlisabáèt aè ruusïì neè Yú' Rara,
English: It happened, when Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, that the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: a waa, a laa enáê, “Wáè túr rboâñtu a caa bbyeèñge wááwá. Nyúè aè ghoèni muu ce aè be bi anaè.
English: She called out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

Limbum: Yi loè efa ká, ma yïì Tata yaè aè ka' vú aè rcaè'ni máè?
English: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

Limbum: AÈ ba aè nfeè' ce máè ba yu' aèmboè wáè caè'ni máè naè, muu enjep máâ rbúè aè karsïì nyor neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè.
English: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

Limbum: AÈ yu ñwáè rboâñtu njobeè' wáè byemi ená yuu ce Tata aè laèa neè wáè yi be kuè ba aèmboè e laèa.”
English: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!

Limbum: Máèári aè laa enáê, “Ya ntee yi ce náèsi Tata Nyúè.
English: Mary said, My soul magnifies the Lord.

Limbum: Ya yú' yi ce lu'shi neè Nyúè ce e geèe máè luêñ,
English: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

Limbum: njobeè' e kuushi máè ce m yu yïì ñwáè rfaè', ka' m yu ñwáè aè múè beèe ka' wa'a. Káâ' ntïìni na, ñgúè beèe wááwá enjep ñgoèñ a be ce too máè ená ñwáè rboâñtu,
English: for he has looked at the humble state of his handmaid. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

Limbum: njobeè' Nyúè ce e túr ñger wááwá aè geèe ku' buu bboèñboñ neè máè. Li rlii li yu rrara.
English: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

Limbum: E ke koosimnse neè beèe ce a ce wáp ye ká' embe ñgúè beèe moè' du ba' mbe moè'.
English: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.

Limbum: E duèñshi yi ñger, a da'si ñgaâa naèatu.
English: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

Limbum: E suèusi beâe bgoèrgoèr embe mnta', a ku'si beâe bká'ká'.
English: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.

Limbum: E fa buu bboèñboñ neè beèe ce njeè ce yañ woweèe, a juu ñgaâa mbaèa, woweèe a duseè mboèmmbo.
English: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

Limbum: E m láè mi mkaè'ni ce e m geèe, a ja' Isráèl ce e m ba yïì ñwáè rfaè'.
English: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

Limbum: E m geèe wa'a, a ce kuushi mkaè'ni ce e m geèe neè Abraèham ker ba neè yïì ñgúè beèe aè nfeè' sïìp.”
English: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his seed forever.

Limbum: Máèári aè m cu a ÁÈlisabáèt aèmboè mñwáá btaar wa'a, a ka' kúti fa yeâ laè'.
English: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

Limbum: Nfeè' rbi aè ka' gháá, ÁÈlisabáèt aè bi muu mbañruè.
English: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she brought forth a son.

Limbum: Beèe ce a woweèe a m ce cu, ker ba yïì beèe, a ka' yu' ku' yuu boèñboñ ce Tata Nyúè aè m geèe neè ye na, a lu'shi a woweèe.
English: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.

Limbum: Muu aè ka' baè' mnoèñ waami, a vú aè rgeèe búè muu. Beèe a m ce kwaè'shi ená a be cu' ba yïì taê.
English: It happened on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of the father.

Limbum: Yïì ma aè sheê, a laa enáê, “A be too ye ená Joân.”
English: His mother answered, Not so; but he will be called John.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Rïìñ wáná ñwáè moè' embe wáâ ndúè' túr njáèá rlii ca ka'.”
English: They said to her, There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' laèa wa'a, a de' a Saèkaèriyaè weèe neè mmbo, a bipshi neè ye ená e koèñ aè rcu' ba nda lá.
English: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

Limbum: Saèkaèriyaè aè laa neè mmbo ená a fa ye ñwaè'. A ka' fa ye ñwaè', e sañ mbo enáê, “Li rlii li yu ená Joân.” Beèe wááwá a bááñgeèr seê.
English: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, His name is John. They all marveled.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè ke' tuuse ka', e ker ká' a ce laèa, a ce yoèñshi Nyúè.
English: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

Limbum: Beèe ce a woweèe a m ce cu a m wáp seê. Beèe ce a m ba aè bdïì' wááwá aè rla' embe mtuâu aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a m suñ buu ca.
English: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce a m yu' vi a m ce kuushi vi, a ce laèa enáê, “Njáèá muu ca be keè ba njáèá muu ce ká?” Bo Tata Nyúè yi m ba mbe yeâ nduè neè mini-ñwáè.
English: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, What then will this child be? The hand of the Lord was with him.

Limbum: Saèkaèriyaè ce e m ba tar muu ca, aè m ruu neè Yú' Rara, a cep ntuu Nyúè neè beèe enáê,
English: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

Limbum: “Seèe ku'si Tata ce e yu Nyúè beèe Isráèl. E m vúè a yá yïì beèe, a tee woweèe efa ñgá'.
English: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and worked redemption for his people;

Limbum: Muu ca aè m kuè' aè nyoèr, a ker ku' aè yú'. E ka' kuè', a ku ce cu ba aè rïìñ caar a ba' aè noèñ ce yi m ba ená e be fúú aè múè beèe Isráèl.
English: The child was growing, and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè ñkúú Kayisaro OÈgostoè aè fa rsa' ená beèe wááwá a yeâ ñgoèñ a sañ mlii tá e bo beè' beèe.
English: Now it happened in those days, that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nfeè' entombïì ce a m ce beè' beèe. Kuèránoè aè m ba govanoâ aè ñgoâñ Sirïìyaè aè nfeè' anaè.
English: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá aè m duè fa yeâ laè' aè rsañ li rlii aèfo.
English: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
