Limbum: Josáèf ye ye aè m naètïû aè rla' Nasaráèt aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a du a ba' aè rla' Bátáèláèhám aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè. Rla' ca aè m ba rla' Dávïìd. E m duè aèfo njobeè' e m ba ñwáè embe ndúè' Dávïìd.
English: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;

Limbum: E m duè a Máèári ce e m ce niñ guèu aègho tá a ye a bo duè sañ mlii. Máèári aè m ba neè rbúè.
English: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

Limbum: Woweèe a ba' a cu aè rla' anaè, nfeè' rbi aè gháá.
English: It happened, while they were there, that the day had come that she should give birth.

Limbum: E m bi muu rñgoèo, aè ba muu mbañruè. E m kur muu anaè njep bcáè', a noñsi njep rghii njeèe njobeè' ndap aè m ruu neè woweèe.
English: She brought forth her firstborn son, and she wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

Limbum: Beèe mo' ce a m ce cïìñ yap njeèe a m ba aè rla' anaè a ba aè mñkúè, a ce cïìñ yap njeèe neètú'.
English: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

Limbum: Ncïìndap aè nyáá mbe waâp nduè, rraa Tata li suu mbe waâp nduè, woweèe a wáp seê.
English: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Fa wáp neè ka', máè vúè weèe neè nsuñ mboèñmboñ, aè ba nsuñ ce beèe wááwá a be yu', lu'shi seê.
English: The angel said to them, Don't be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

Limbum: A bi yeè ñwáè rjaè' aè rla' Dávïìd ntïìni na. A ye Kraâis anaè ce e yu Tataê.
English: For there is born to you, this day, in the city of David, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi be geèe tá weèe riñ ená nsuñ ca yu mini yi yu ená, weèe be duè yá muu aèmboè a kur njep bcáè', a noñsi njep rghii njeèe.”
English: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' keè' a yá aèmboè ku' bcïìndap Nyúè a vúè, a kyese nyor aègee ncïìndap Nyúè caè, a ce kuè'si Nyúè, a ce laèa enáê,
English: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,

Limbum: “Foèo yi ba neè Nyúè embe buèu, tá cumúnyañ ba njep ñgoèñ neè beèe ce Nyúè ce yu' rboèñ neè woweèe.”
English: Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.

Limbum: Bcïìndap Nyúè ca a ka' maè'shi woweèe kúti mbe buèu, ñgaâa ncïìñ njeèe ca a ká' a ce laèa fa waâp mú enáê, “Seèe du aè rla' Bátáèláèhám du yá ka yuu ce Tata aè suñ seèe ená yi koni na.”
English: It happened, when the angels went away from them into the sky, that the shepherds said one to another, Let's go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.

Limbum: Woweèe a natïì, a du cárcár seê, a du a yá Máèári ba Josáèf, a yá muu aèmboè e noèñ njep rghii.
English: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

Limbum: A ka' yá muu ca, a suñ Josáèf ba Máèári yuu ce ncïìndap Nyúè aè suñ woweèe aèmboè muu anaè.
English: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce a m yu' nsuñ ce ñgaâa ncïìñ njeèe a m suñ na, a m báèáñger seê.
English: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

Limbum: Máèári ye ye aè m ce kuushi buu ca a ce kwaè'shi aèmboè vi.
English: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ncïìñ njeèe a m kúti, a ce yoèñshi Nyúè, a ker ce kuè'si ye aè buu wááwá ce woweèe a m yu' a ker yá, njobeè' buu anaè aè m ku ba aèmboè ncïìndap Nyúè aè m suñ woweèe.
English: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

Limbum: Ñgaèa aè ka' kuèu, nfeè' ce a be geèe muu búè aè gháá. E ka' gháá, a fa rlii muu ená Jisoès. Rlii ca aè m ku ba rlii ce ncïìndap Nyúè aè m fa muu wáá tá yïì ma ka' keè koo rbúè.
English: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

Limbum: Nfeè' ce a be mïìsi geèe yuu ce ncir yi laèa ená njeñwáè ce e bi muu gee tá e bo ba nrara aè bsii Nyúè aè ka' gháá, Máèári ba Josáèf a lor muu a du aègho aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè rfa neè Tata Nyúè,
English: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord

Limbum: aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Mncir Tata enáê, “A be fa boo rñgoèo ce yu boo mmbañruè wááwá neè Nyúè.”
English: as it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord,

Limbum: Woweèe a m duè foñ aè rgeèe tañshïì aèmboè ncir Tata Nyúè yi ce laèa. Yi yu mbo ená ñwáè ka' tá geèe tañshïì ca neè bbeâñ bbaa ka', e gee neè byoo buâu bbaa.
English: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè nfeè' anaè a ce too ená Simïìyoèn. E m ba ñwáè nyáánïì, a ce wáp Nyúè foñ, a cu a ce keè' nfeè' ce Nyúè be geèe tá beèe Isráèl a túr rfúteè. Yú' Rara yi m ba a ye.
English: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

Limbum: Yú' anaè yi m geèe e riñ ená e be yá Kraâis yïì Tata Nyúè wáá, ka' kwe.
English: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

Limbum: Yú' ca yi lor ye a du aègho mbe Ndaèp Nyúè. Ma muu ba tar muu a ka' vúè neè muu mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè rgeèe yuu ce ncir yi m ce laèa ená a gee aètu muu,
English: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

Limbum: Simïìyoèn aè koo muu mbe mboè, a yoñshi Nyúè a laa enáê,
English: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,

Limbum: “Yaè masaè, wáè láè mo mkaè'ni, maè'shi laè seè'ni tá yoè ñwáè rfaè' du yi yu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

Limbum: Tar muu ba ma muu a m yu' buu ce Simïìyoèn aè m laèa a kuu muu anaè, a bááñger seê.
English: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,

Limbum: Simïìyoèn aè ghonïì woweèe a laa neè yïì ma ce Máèári enáê, “Muu ca aè láè Nyúè tá e bo geèe tá beèe magoâr aè to' Isráèl a kweñger, keèr geèe tá beèe magoâr aè ñgoèñ anaè a natïî. E be ba ncoèo ce beèe magoèr a be koèñ ka', laèa bebep se aèmboè ye.
English: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

Limbum: Yi ba wa'a, tá mkwaè'shïì beèe magoèr mi bo yááti aèwañ. Ñkoosimnse ce e be keè ba aèmboè kaèafaâ' ncáncáp wa'a, be keè soèp yo ntee foñ.”
English: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' aè m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè a ce too ená Anaè. E m ba muu Fánuèwáèr embe ndúè' Ashaè. E m ba nleeñwáè seê. E m duè bguèu, a nduu a ku cu ba aè bfeè' saèamba caè'caè', nduu aè kwe.
English: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

Limbum: E m cu aè ñgwañkúñwáè a ba' bfeè' ncoèp kyeèe-aè-mwaami. E m ce buu mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè nfeè' moè' ka', ka' neètú' áè, ka' neèmootïì áè, e m ku ba mbo a ce jïì mdip, a ce geèe rloo neè Nyúè.
English: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years, who didn't depart from the temple, worshipping with fastings and petitions night and day.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' a m vúè neè muu mbe Ndaèp Nyúè anaè, ye ye aè ku tose foñ, a yoñshi Nyúè, a laa aèmboè muu ca neè beèe wááwá ce a m ce keè' ená Nyúè fúr rla' Jáèrusaláèm efa ñgá'.
English: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' geèe buu wááwá ce ncir Tata Nyúè yi m ce laèa ená a geêe, a kúti aè lap rla' Nasaráèt aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

Limbum: Muu ca aè m kuè' a túr ñger, a ker túr bfee foñ seê. Nyúè aè túr ye aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

Limbum: Yïì ta ba yïì ma a m ce duè ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm njep feè' wááwá.
English: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ba bfeè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, a woweèe a du ñkaè' ce a m ce duè njep feè' njep feè' naè.
English: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,

Limbum: Ñkaè' yi ka' mïì, woweèe a natïì a ce kúti aè laè', Jisoès aè cu yi mbenjïì aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. Yïì ta ba yïì ma a riñ ka'.
English: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn't know it,

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce kwaè'shi ená e yu mbe ñgoo beèe ce a woweèe a m ce duè. A ka' jáèr aè noèñ bïìi, a yá ye ka', a ká' a ce roèo ye aè múè bfúr wap ba bkar wap.
English: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day's journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá ye ka', a kúti aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè rroèo ye.
English: When they didn't find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi ka' caâa btaar woweèe a yá ye mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aèmboè e cu mbe múè ñgaâa ryá'nïì, a ce yu'shi buu ce woweèe a m ce yá'ni, a ce bipshi buu neè woweèe.
English: It happened after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce a m yu' buu ce e m ce laèa, a m báèáñger aè ryu' aèmboè e m ce bipshi buu, a ker ce beèesi buu neè bfee-ñwáè.
English: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

Limbum: Yïì ta ba yïì ma a ka' yá ye a bááñger seê. Yïì ma aè laa neè ye enáê, “Muu waè, wáè geèe neè weèr wa' njoká? Weèr yoè ta aè roèo wáè, tu yi korñgeèr weèr.”
English: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.

Limbum: E laa enáê, “Weèe aè ba ce roèo máè njoká? Weèe aè ba rïìñ weená yu ya dïì' aè rba mbe Ndaèp yaè ta ka' a?”
English: He said to them, Why were you looking for me? Didn't you know that I must be in my Father's house?

Limbum: Woweèe a m rïìñ mbuèu ce e m laèa wa' ka'.
English: They didn't understand the saying which he spoke to them.

Limbum: E natïì a du a woweèe aè rla' Nasaráèt, a cu a woweèe, a ce yu'ni neè woweèe. Yïì ma aè m láè buu ca wááwá njep yeâ ntee.
English: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ce kuè' aè nyoèr ba aè bfee, a túr bsii wañ a Nyúè ker ba beèe.
English: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Tïìbárïìyaès aè m cu mbe kúú, a sa' aè bfeè' ncoèp-ta-aè- rrúèú, Nyúè aè laa neè Joân muu Saèkaèriyaè aè ntee rïìñ. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Pontos Pailáèt aè ba govanoâ aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè. Hároèd aè ce sa' ñgoâñ Galeèleê, Felep ce e m ba nfúr yïì, aè ce sa' ñgoâñ Ituraè ba ñgoâñ Taèkonitïìs, Lesanaès aè ce sa' ñgoâñ Abiláèn.
English: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

Limbum: Anaès ba Kaifaès a m ba btu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì neè Nyúè.
English: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

Limbum: Joân aè m jáèr aè bdïì' wááwá ce vi m ba aè ñgoâñ faèdïì' ce rdip Jodaèn li m ba, a ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè beèe, a ce laèa ená woweèe a kupse, ma' yaèp buu bbebep tá a baptir woweèe, tá Nyúè bo foèosi woweèe.
English: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe ñwaâ' AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Ñwáè moè' ce fuñ aè ntee rïìñ a ce laèa enáê, ‘Kupshi neè nduunjïì neè Tataê, nashi tá yi ba kuèyáá.
English: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

Limbum: A be ruusi mntoèñ wááwá, káèáshi mtuèu wááwá tá mi kúti mmbo'. A be naèshi mnduunjïì ce vi gooñger tá vi ba kuèyáá, kupshi vïì ce vi yu koteè-koteè tá vi ba nfáâñ.
English: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

Limbum: Tá beèe wááwá a bo yá rluèñ Nyúè.’ ”
English: All flesh will see God's salvation.'

Limbum: Beèe a m vúè aè bkúr aè bkúr a yá Joân ená e baptir woweèe. Joân aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Boo bfïî, ñwáè ce e báá weèe ená weèe cañ soèrti efa rshentee ce Nyúè be ko'si neè beèe naè, aè báá nda?
English: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

Limbum: Geèe laè neè buu ce vi be ce duèñshi ená weèe aè kupse, a ma' yeè buu bbebep. Weèe fa ce laèa fa weâe mú enáê, ‘Abraèham yu yeèr taê’ ka'. M ce suñ weèe ená aède' Nyúè ku lor bluèr ca beesi aè boo Abraèhaêm.
English: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and don't begin to say among yourselves, 'We have Abraham for our father;' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

Limbum: A láè njaèa njep mbuèu ce wáá. Ce ce yi ka' tá yú boèñboñ ka', baná a be gwaèr, maè' njep mor.”
English: Even now the axe also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn't bring forth good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.

Limbum: Ku' beèe anaè a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná weèr be geèe wer ká?”
English: The multitudes asked him, What then must we do?

Limbum: Joân aè beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' túr bcáâ' bbaa, e fa mo' neè ñwáè ce e túr ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' túr byee, e ku gee wa' foñ.”
English: He answered them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' a m vúè foñ ená e baptir woweèe, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, weèr be geèe wer ká?”
English: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, Teacher, what must we do?

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ka' ce kuèu mbaâa baèraè', weèe fa koo caèa embe dïì' ce ncir yi laèa ka'.”
English: He said to them, Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.

Limbum: Bsoogáè foñ a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Yuu ce aède' weèr gee foñ yu ká?” E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa koo mbaèa ese ñwáè moè' aè ñger ka', káè nya' mnde' mbe tu ñwáè moè' ka'. Weèe fa cáèñ mbaèa ce a ce laè' weèe aègho ka'.”
English: Soldiers also asked him, saying, What about us? What must we do? He said to them, Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.

Limbum: Beèe a m cu a ce keè', a ce tarni ená Joân yu Kraâis anaè lá.
English: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

Limbum: Joân aè laa neè woweèe wááwá enáê, “M ce baèptir weèe neè mdip, geewa'a, ñwáè moè' ce yi ñger yi caèa ya ce vúè. Máè ghááte aè ñwáè ce aède' m ba'shïì vi bkúè laba' ka'. E be baèptir yi weèe neè Yú' Rara ba mor.
English: John answered them all, I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the latchet of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,

Limbum: Yïì gúè yu mba yeâ boè, ce e be fyápshi msañ aègho, baashi msañ láè njep koo. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè bbúèshïì efa gho, e be baashi toèo njep mor ce aède' yi liitïì ka'.”
English: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

Limbum: Joân aè fa ncep neè beèe aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá wa'a, a ce feè'shi ba Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè woweèe.
English: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

Limbum: E m lapni ñkúú Hároèd njobeè' e m fúr Háèrodïìyaè ce e m ba ñgwa nfúr yïû muu ma naè, ker ba njobeè' ku' buu bbebep mo' ce e m geèe.
English: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother's wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

Limbum: E m ker gee yuu mo' ce yi m bep a caa ñger. E m koo Joân a fa aè shañ.
English: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

Limbum: Joân aè ka' baèptir beèe wááwá, a baptir Jisoès foñ. Jisoès aè ka' ce geèe rloo, rbuu li mú'tïì.
English: Now it happened, when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,

Limbum: Yú' Rara yi suu mbe yeâ nduè, a ba aèmboè beèñ. Njeèndoñ aè laa embe buèu enáê, “AÈ yu muu waè ce m koèñ seê. M ce yu' rboèñ neè wáè seê.”
English: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form as a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ce káè' li rfaè', a ba aèmboè bfeè' mntaar. Beèe a m ce kwaè'shi ená a ye muu Josáèf ce e m ba muu Hálïì.
English: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son as was supposed of Joseph, the son of Heli,

Limbum: Hálïì aè m ba muu Mataèr, Mataèr aè ba muu Lávïì, Lávïì aè ba muu Málákïì, Málákïì aè ba muu Jáènayïì, Jáènayïì aè ba muu Josáèf,
English: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

Limbum: Josáèf aè ba muu Maètaètiyaèr, Maètaètiyaèr aè ba muu Ámoès, Ámoès aè ba muu Nahuèm, Nahuèm aè ba muu Ásileè, Ásileè aè ba muu Naègayïì,
English: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

Limbum: Naègayïì aè ba muu Maêr, Mar aè ba muu Maètaètiyaèr, Maètaètiyaèr aè ba muu Sámáèn, Sámáèn aè ba muu Josáèf, Josáèf aè ba muu Jodaè,
English: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

Limbum: Jodaè aè ba muu Joanaèm, Joanaèm aè ba muu Rásaè, Rásaè aè ba muu Sáèrobabáèr, Sáèrobabáèr aè ba muu Shálatáèr, Shálatáèr aè ba muu Nárïì,
English: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

Limbum: Nárïì aè ba muu Málákïì, Málákïì aè ba muu Adïì, Adïì aè ba muu Kosaèm, Kosaèm aè ba muu ÁÈlimadaèm, ÁÈlimadaèm aè ba muu ÁÊr,
English: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

Limbum: Ár aè ba muu Joshuèwaè, Joshuèwaè aè ba muu ÁÈlisaè, ÁÈlisaè aè ba muu Joraèm, Joraèm aè ba muu Mataèr, Mataèr aè ba muu Lávïì,
English: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

Limbum: Lávïì aè ba muu Simïìyoèn, Simïìyoèn aè ba muu Judaè, Judaè aè ba muu Josáèf, Josáèf aè ba muu Jonaèm, Jonaèm aè ba muu ÁÈliyakïìm,
English: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

Limbum: ÁÈliyakïìm aè ba muu Málïìyaè, Málïìyaè aè ba muu Mánaè, Mánaè aè ba muu Maètataè, Maètataè aè ba muu Nataèn, Nataèn aè ba muu Dávïìd,
English: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

Limbum: Dávïìd aè ba muu Jáásïì, Jáásïì aè ba muu Obáèd, Obáèd aè ba muu Buwaès, Buwaès aè ba muu Salmoèn, Salmoèn aè ba muu Nashoèn,
English: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

Limbum: Nashoèn aè ba muu AÈminadaèp, AÈminadaèp aè ba muu AÈdimïìn, AÈdimïìn aè ba muu Arnïì, Arnïì aè ba muu Hásroèn, Hásroèn aè ba muu Páráès, Páráès aè ba muu Judaè,
English: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

Limbum: Judaè aè ba muu Jakoèp, Jakoèp aè ba muu Aisïìk, Aisïìk aè ba muu Abraèhaêm, Abraèham aè ba muu Táraè, Táraè aè ba muu Nahoèr,
English: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

Limbum: Nahoèr aè ba muu Sáruèk, Sáruèk aè ba muu Rugaè, Rugaè aè ba muu Páláèk, Páláèk aè ba muu Ábáèr, Ábáèèr aè ba muu Shálaè,
English: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

Limbum: Shálaè aè ba muu Kaèyinaèn, Kaèyinaèn aè ba muu AÈfasaèr, AÈfasaèr aè ba muu Sháêm, Shám aè ba muu Nowaè, Nowaè aè ba muu Lamáèk,
English: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

Limbum: Lamáèk aè ba muu Máètusálaè, Máètusálaè aè ba muu Ánoèk, Ánoèk aè ba muu Járáèr, Járáèr aè ba muu Maèhaèláláèr, Maèhaèláláèr aè ba muu Kaèyinaèn,
English: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

Limbum: Kaèyinaèn aè ba muu Ánoès, Ánoès aè ba muu Sáêr, Sár aè ba muu Adaèm ce e m ba muu Nyúè.
English: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ruu neè Yú' Rara. E m kúti efa rdip Jodaèn, Yú' Rara anaè yi lor ye a du aègho aè ntee rïìñ,
English: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

Limbum: e cu aèfo aè mnoèñ mkyeèe, Sataèn aè ce moèoshi ye. E m ye yuu ka' aè mnoèñ anaè. Mnoèñ anaè vi ka' mïì, njeè aè yañ ye seê.
English: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

Limbum: Sataèn aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè ka' ba muu Nyúè, aè laa ka tá bluèr ca vi beeñger aè bráêd.”
English: The devil said to him, If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Ñwáè e ke cu nteèe ba njo' bráâd caè'caè' ka'.’ ”
English: Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.'

Limbum: Sataèn aè lor ye a du aègho mbe tu rtuèu, a duñshi ye bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na njaè' moè'sir,
English: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

Limbum: a laa neè ye enáê, “M be fa wáè ñger ba bkuè' ce aè bto' enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá. A m fa buu ca wááwá neè máè, aède' m fa neè ñwáè ce máè koèñ.
English: The devil said to him, I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.

Limbum: Baná wáè ka' gú'shi neè máè, buu ca wááwá ba wo.”
English: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Gú'shi neè Tata ce e yu yoè Nyúè, fa' ba neè ye caè'caè'.’ ”
English: Jesus answered him, Get behind me Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'

Limbum: Sataèn aè ker lor ye a du aègho aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a du neè ye mbe tu Ndap Nyúè ce yi saèp mbekïì seê, a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè ka' ba Muu Nyúè, aè nyáá ka embe na cáá njep nsheè,
English: He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

Limbum: njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Nyúè be laèa tá vi bcïìndap a ke'ni wáè.’
English: for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;'

Limbum: A ker sañ foñ enáê, ‘Woweèe a be yaè wáè mbe mmboè faè dïì' aè túú yo kuèu aè luèr ka'.’ ”
English: and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, ‘Fa moèoshi Tata ce e yu yoè Nyúè ka'.’ ”
English: Jesus answering, said to him, It has been said, 'You shall not tempt the Lord your God.'

Limbum: Sataèn aè ka' moèoshi ye aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá mïìsi, a ma'shi ye a duê, ená nfeè' moè' e gháá, tá e ka' keèr kúti.
English: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

Limbum: Jisoès aè kútïì aè ñgoâñ Galeèle neè ñger Yú' Rara. Nsuñ aèmboè ye aè duè aè bdïì' wááwá aè ñgoèñ anaè.
English: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

Limbum: E m yá'ni beèe a waâp mndap mloo. Beèe wááwá a yu' rboèñ seê, a ku'si ye.
English: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

Limbum: E m duè foñ aè rla' Nasaráèt faèdïì' ce e m kuè'. AÈ ka' ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, e du mbe ndaèp rloo aèmboè e m ce duè aè nfeè' wááwá naè. A ka' baè' mbo, a nati mbekïì aè rbeè' embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè.
English: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

Limbum: A m fa ye ñwaè' ce AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m sañ. E múè' ñwaè' anaè a fyá' mbe dïì' ce a m sañ enáê,
English: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

Limbum: Yù’ Tata yi yu weèr ye, njobee’ Nyùè aè ce màá ená m fe’shi nsuñ mboèfmbof nneè figaâa fuèp. E tuu màá ená m du suñ beèe ce a yu mbe shaf ená nfeè’ aè gháá ce a be fùr woweèe efa shaf, tá beèe ce a feèp a yá buu, tá beèe ce beèe a ce jar neè woweèe a luñ efa ñga’,
English: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

Limbum: ker suñ aèmboè nfeè’ ce Tata Nyùè be ghoèni yii beèe.
English: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá mbe dïì' ana, beè', a ceteè ñwaè', a kúsi neè ñwáè ce e ba koo ese ye, a cu aè nsheè. Beèe embe ndaèp rloo wááwá a m ku ce fyá' ba ye.
English: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

Limbum: E ká' a ce laèa neè woweèe enáê, “AÈmboè máè beè' nlaâa Nyúè ca neè weèe ntïìni, weèe aè yu' na, yi ku ghááte njo.”
English: He began to tell them, Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a yu' rboèñ neè ye, a bááñger se aè nlaâa boèñboñ ce e m laèa anaè. Woweèe a m laèa enáê, “AÈmboè a ye muu Josáèf a?”
English: All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, Isn't this Joseph's son?

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “M rïìñ máná weèe be maè' ñgaèa ca neè máè, ‘Ñwáè mcáèp báèá mo mcáèp luêñ. Geèe laè njáèá buu ce weèr aè m yu' ená wáè m geèe aè rla' Kaèpanuèm naè fa wáâ laè' na foñ.’ ”
English: He said to them, Doubtless you will tell me this parable, 'Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.'

Limbum: E m ker laa enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená aède' a yu'nïì neè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè fa yeâ laè' ka'.
English: He said, Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ weená byepkúú a m ba aè to' Isráèl aè nfeè' yïì AÈlajaè seê, mbe nfeè' ce mbeèñ aè m gweè ka' aè bfeâ' btaar ba nto', njeè aè koo aè bdïì' wááwá aè ñgoâñ Isráèl aè nfeè' anaè naè.
English: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

Limbum: Geewa'a, Nyúè aè m tuusi ye neè moè' efa woweèe ka'. E m tuusi ye ba neè ñgwañkúñwáè moè' ce e m ba aè rla' Sáráfaèr aè ñgoâñ Sidoèn.
English: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená ku' ñgaâa msaèasïì a m ba aè to' Isráèl aè nfeè' yïì ÁÈleshaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè. Geewa'a, Nyúè aè m geèe moè' efa woweèe aè ke'seè ka'. Ñwáè ce Nyúè aè m geèe e ke'seè aè m ku ba Namaèn ce aè m ba ñwáâ aè to' Sirïìyaè.”
English: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá embe ndaèp rloo a ka' yu' wa'a, nyor aè bep woweèe seê.
English: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.

Limbum: Woweèe a natïì mbekïì, a fúr yeâ aè rla' a ko' aègho mbe tu rtuèu ce a m baè'ri lap rla' mbo naè, tá a bo maè' ye njep rbar.
English: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

Limbum: E toseè yi yu aè btar beèe a duê.
English: But he, passing through the midst of them, went his way.

Limbum: E m ker du aè rla' Kaèpanuèm aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a yá'ni beèe nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè.
English: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

Limbum: Woweèe a bááñgeèr se aè ryu' buu ce e m ce yá'ni, njobeè' vi blaèa vi m ba neè ñger-ñwáè seê.
English: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba mbe ndaèp rloo anaè ce yú' nyúèrkaè' yi m ba njep ye. Ñwáè anaè aè m waa tatap seê, a laa enáê,
English: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,

Limbum: “Habai, Jisoâs aè rla' Nasaráèt, yuu ce aè ce roèo ese weèr yu ba ká? Wáè vúè aè ryúshi weèr a? M rïìñ njáèá ñwáè ce aè yu, aè yu ñwáâ nrara ce e loè ese Nyúè.”
English: saying, Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!

Limbum: Jisoès aè waa yú' anaè enáê, “Cu nyañ, fúú enjep ye.” Yi nyár ñgaèñ a ma' aè nsheè a waâp bsii, a fúú enjep ye, a ke' báási ye ka'.
English: Jesus rebuked him, saying, Be silent, and come out of him! When the demon had thrown him down in their midst, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

Limbum: Woweèe a bááñgeèr seê, a laa a waâp mú enáê, “Blaèa ñwáè ca vi yu ba aè njáâá ká? E ce laèa neè byú' bebep neè ñger-ñwáè, vi ce fúúse enjep beèe.”
English: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!

Limbum: Nsuñ aèmboè Jisoès aè m duè aè bdïì' wááwá aè ñgoèñ anaè.
English: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m fúú embe ndaèp rloo a du mbe ndaèp mbe Saimúèn. Tu yi ce luu malu yïì Saimúèn seê, woweèe a laa neè Jisoès ená e ja' ye.
English: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.

Limbum: E duê, a táá mbenduè njeñwáè anaè a laêa, mbáp anaè aè bornïì. Nfeè' aè ke' tuuse ka', njeñwáè anaè natïì mbekïì a fár byee a fa neè woweèe.
English: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' ce coo, beèe wááwá ce yaèp beèe aè m ce yañ byañ njáèá jáá jáèá jáá a vúseè neè ñgaâa byañ anaè, e lá mi mmbo mbe waâp nduè, a gee woweèe a ke'seè.
English: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

Limbum: Byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m fúse enjep beèe magoèr, a ce waani seê, a ce laèa enáê, “A wáè Muu Nyúè.” Jisoès aè waa byú' ca, a ke' fa vi njïì ená vi laa yuu ka' njobeè' vi m rïìñ ená e yu Kraâis anaè.
English: Demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, You are the Christ, the Son of God! Rebuking them, he didn't allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, Jisoès aè fúú efa rla' anaè a du aè dïì' ce e be kuè ba mimñgi'. Beèe a ká' a ce roèo ye, a ka' yá ye, a koñ ená e ku cu a woweèe.
English: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn't go away from them.

Limbum: Geewa'a, e laa neè woweèe enáê, “M be kuè feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè aè mla' mo' foñ njobeè' a yuu ce Nyúè aè tuu máè ená m vú geêe.”
English: But he said to them, I must preach the good news of the Kingdom of God to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.

Limbum: E m duè a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca aè mndap mloo wááwá ce vi m ba aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè.
English: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè moè' Jisoès aè táá aèwaâa ma túâ Gáènásaráèt, kúr beèe a sir ye a kaari a tarte tá a bo yu' blaâa Nyúè.
English: Now it happened, while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, that he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

Limbum: E m yá bkeñ bbaa aèwaâa túè anaè. Ñgaâa ñkoo nca a m tár bkeñ anaè a du aè rsuè'si map mraa.
English: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

Limbum: E niñ mbe moè' ce aè m ba yïì Saimúèn, a laa neè ye ená e doo du aègho nje múè roè múcaèr. E cu mbo a ce yá'ni ku' beèe ce a m táá nje waâa túè naè.
English: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

Limbum: E ka' yá'ni mïìsi, a laa neè Saimúèn enáê, “Doèo neè keñ du aègho mbe dïì' ce yi coomi, ma' me mraa njep roè, koo nca.”
English: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch.

Limbum: Saimúèn aè beesïì enáê, “Masaè, weèr aè faè' neètú' tatap seê, caar túè' aè raa, a ke' koo yuu ka'. Geewa'a, aèmboè wáè laèa na, baná m be maè' mraa njep roè.”
English: Simon answered him, Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' maè', nca yi niñ njo ku' goèr seê, mraa mi ká' a ce ceeñger.
English: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

Limbum: Woweèe a lap ñgaâa ñkoo nca mo' ce a m ba mbe keñ moè' naè ená woweèe a vú ja' woweèe. Woweèe a vú a ja' woweèe, a woweèe a koo nca yi ruu aè bkeñ bbaa anaè jiñ, keñ aè ce sáni niñ njep múè roè.
English: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè ka' yá yuu ce yi m ba na, a gwe njeptii Jisoès, a laa enáê, “Tataê, naèti efa máâ geñ. M yu ñwáâ ñgeèe buu bbebep.”
English: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.

Limbum: Saimúèn ker ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ce koo nca naè, a bááñgeèr seê, aè ryá ku' njáèá nca ce woweèe a m koo.
English: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

Limbum: Jáms ba Joân ce a m ba boo Sábáèdïî, ce a Saimúèn weèe a m ce koo nca, a m báèáñger foñ seê. Jisoès aè laa neè Saimúèn enáê, “Fa wáp ka', káâ' seè'ni na, aè be ce koo ba beèe.”
English: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, Don't be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, woweèe a doo bkeñ a du aègho aè waâa roè, a ma'shi buu wááwá a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' Jisoès aè ba aè rla' mo', mbañruèñwáè moè' aè ba aèfo ce msaèasïì mi m koo ye aè nyor wááwá. E ka' yá Jisoès a gwe njep nsheè neè bsii, a bu' mmbo neè ye a laa enáê, “Tataê, wáè ka' koêñ, aè gee m ke'seè, ba nrara.”
English: It happened, while he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and begged him, saying, Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.

Limbum: Jisoès aè naa bo a joo ye aègho, a laa enáê, “M ce koèñ wa'a, keè'se, ba nrara.” E ka' laèa wa'a, msaèasïì mi ku lo yeâ aè nyoèr.
English: He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, I want to. Be made clean. Immediately the leprosy left him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ciisïì neè ye enáê, “Fa suñ ñwáè moè' ka'. Duè duñshi yoè nyor neè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì embe Ndaèp Nyúè tá aè bo geèe tañshïì ce Musïìs aè m laèa ená ñwáè gee tá e bo ba nrara, tá beèe a bo rïìñ ená ñwáè anaè aè keè'se naè.”
English: He commanded him to tell no one, But go your way, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

Limbum: Ka' e m laèa ená e fa suñ ñwáè ka' wa'a, nsuñ aè ker misi a du aè bdïì' wááwá, beèe a ce vúè aè bkúr aè bkúr tá a bo yu' buu ce e m ce yá'ni, tá e bo gee woweèe a luñ efa wap byañ.
English: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

Limbum: E m ce fúú efa múè beèe, ce duè aè ntee rïìñ, ce geèe rloo.
English: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba nyúè moè', Jisoès aè ka' ce yá'ni beèe, beèe Farïìsi ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ce a m vúâ aè bu' mla' aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, ba aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè wááwá ker ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a cuteè aèfo. Tata Nyúè aè m fa Jisoès ñger aè rgeèe tá ñgaâa byañ a ke'se.
English: It happened on one of those days, that he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a byá' ñwáè moè' mbe keèñ ce yïì ñgúè' nyor moè' aè m kwe, a gheter aè rniñ neè ye mbe ndaèp, láè njeptii Jisoès.
English: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

Limbum: Beèe a m ruu magoèr, nduunjïì yi ke' ba neè woweèe aè rniñ neè ñwáè ca mbo ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a ko' neè ye mbe tu ndap, a co'ni dïì' mo' embo, a suusi ye mbe keèñ caè mbe múè beèe embe ndaèp, a lá njeptii Jisoès.
English: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst before Jesus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá lap rbyemïì, a laa neè ñwáè yañ anaè enáê, “Ñkaraè, máè foèosi wáè efa yoè buu bbebep.”
English: Seeing their faith, he said to him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba beèe Farïìsi a ká' a ce laèa enjep ntee enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ce bepsi rlii Nyúè na a nda? Ñwáè ce aède' e foosïì ñwáè efa buu bbebep caa efa Nyúè yu nda?”
English: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ku riñ yuu ce woweèe a m ce kwaè'shi, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce kwaè'shi njáèá buu ca wa'a njoká?
English: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

Limbum: Yuu ce yi yu aètáèr yu ba yïû fá? Yu ba aè rlaèa enáê, ‘Máè foèosi wáè efa yoè buu bbebep’ káè aè rlaèa enáê, ‘Loè mbekïì, jáêr’?
English: Which is easier to say, 'Your sins are forgiven you;' or to say, 'Arise and walk?'

Limbum: Baná aè rgeèe tá weèe bo rïìñ weená Muu Ñwáè túr ñger njep ñgoèñ na aè rfoèosi beèe efa yaèp buu bbebep.” E laa neè ñwáè yañ ca enáê, “M ce laèa neè wáè ená aè nati mbekïì, lor yo keèñ du aè laè'.”
English: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins he said to the paralyzed man, I tell you, arise, and take up your cot, and go to your house.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè m tuuse ka', e natïì mbekïì aè bsii beèe wááwá, a lor yi keèñ a ce yoèñshi Nyúè a ce duè fa yeâ laè'.
English: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

Limbum: Woweèe a bááñgeèr seê, a yoñshi Nyúè, a ce wáp seê, a ce laèa enáê, “Weèr aè yá buu bghagha' ntïìni.”
English: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things today.

Limbum: Ca yi ka' mïì wáá, Jisoès aè fúú, a ka' ce duè a yá aèmboè ñwáè ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' moè' ce a m ce too ye ená Lávïì cu mbe yi dïû' rfaè'. Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè fa máâ mbuèu.”
English: After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, Follow me!

Limbum: Lávïì aè natïì, a ma'shi yïì buu wááwá, a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

Limbum: Lávïì aè m geèe ma ñkaè' neè ye mbe yeâ ndaèp. Ku' ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' ker ba beèe mo' a m ba mbo foñ a cute a sir tábuèr a woweèe a ce yeñger.
English: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi ba beèe mo' efa waâp mú ce a m ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a rú'ñgeèr, a laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès enáê, “Weèe ce yeñger a ce noñger weèe ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' weèe ker ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep njoká?”
English: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Beèe ce a ke roèo ñwáè mcáèp e ke ba ñgaâa byañ, ke' ba beâe btatap ka'.
English: Jesus answered them, Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

Limbum: Máè vúè aè rká' beâe byáánïì ka'. Máè vúè aè rká' ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep tá woweèe a bo kupse, maè' yaèp buu bbebep anaè.”
English: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

Limbum: Beèe a m laèa neè Jisoès enáê, “Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Joân ba ñgaâa yá'ni buu beèe Farïìsi, a ke jïì mdip, ce geèe rloo aè nfeè' wááwá, geewa'a ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu a ce yeñger yap ker ce no buu.”
English: They said to him, Why do John's disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Weèe ce kwaè'shi weená aède' weèe ma'shïì beèe ce a vúè ñkaâ' bguèu neè njeè ce nduu-guèu ku ba aèfo a?
English: He said to them, Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

Limbum: Geewa'a, nfeè' moè' be ba ce a be koo nduu ese woweèe tá woweèe a ji mdip aè nfeè' anaè.”
English: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m maè' ñgaèa ca neè woweèe foñ enáê, “AÈde' ñwáè saa cáâ' fi la' mbenduè cáâ' rúèú tarshi ka'. E ka' gee wa'a, baná a saèa cáè' fi anaè aè cicïì. Wáè ka' tar yi mbenduè yïû rúèú, yi ghááte ka'.
English: He also told a parable to them. No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè lor mruâ' mfi lá njep mñguèp mruè' vïû brúèú ka'. E ka' gee wa'a baná mruâ' mfi anaè mi be loè koo, to'shi mñguèp mruè' anaè, tá mruè' mi kúte aè nsheè, tá mñguèp mruè' anaè vi bú aè cicïì.
English: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed.

Limbum: Yi ke ba ená a lá mruâ' mfi ba njep mñguèp mruè' vïû bfi tá mi bo kúète ka', tá mñguèp mruè' vi to'ñger ka'.
English: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená ñwáè aè ka' no mruè' ce mi koo, e ker koñ aè rno msáâñ mruè' ka' njobeè' e ka' no baná e be laèa enáê, ‘Mruè' ce mi koo mi yu aèndeèe neè msáâñ mruè'.’ ”
English: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, 'The old is better.'

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè moè', Jisoès ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a caa aè ñkúè msañ moè'. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a tee msañ anaè a ce si'si mbaè mmboè a ce ye.
English: Now it happened on the second Sabbath after the first, that he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain, and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi mo' a laa enáê, “Weèe ce geèe yuu ce ncir yi kani ená a fa geèe nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè ka' njoká?”
English: But some of the Pharisees said to them, Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Weèe aè be be' yuu ce Dávïìd aè m geèe aè nfeè' ce njeè aè m ce yañ ye ker ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ba naè ka' a?
English: Jesus, answering them, said, Haven't you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;

Limbum: E m duè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a lor bráâd ce a m fa neè Nyúè, a ye, a fa bár neè beèe ce a woweèe a m ba. Ncir yi byemi ená ñwáè moâ' jáá ye caa efa ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ka'.”
English: how he entered into the house of God, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Muu Ñwáè yu Taèr ce e túr mmbomntaa Nyúè.”
English: He said to them, The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.

Limbum: AÈ ka' keèr ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè moè', Jisoès aè du mbe ndaèp rloo, a ce yá'ni beèe mbo. Ñwáè moè' aè m ba mbo, li rkoo maè' li m kwe.
English: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba beèe Farïìsi a ce fyá' ená e be geèe tá ñwáè yañ moè' ke'se nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè lá, tá woweèe a bo sa' ye ená e bú' ncir.
English: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ku riñ yuu ce woweèe a m ce kwaè'shi, a laa neè ñwáè ce li rkoo li m kwe naè enáê, “Naèti mbekïì vú táá mbena.” E natïì a táá mbo.
English: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand in the middle. He arose and stood.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce bip ca neè weèe. Yiseèe ncir yi byemi ená seèe gee ba yuu boèñboñ nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè káè yuu bebep? Yi byemi ená seèe ja' ñwáè jaè' káè ená seèe yú ñwáè yú?”
English: Then Jesus said to them, I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?

Limbum: E ka' bipshi wa'a, a fyá' woweèe wááwá a kaari a tarte, a laa neè ñwáè yañ anaè enáê “Maè' lo rkoo kuèyáá.” E gee wa'a, li rkoo li boêñ, a kúti aèmboè li m ba.
English: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, Stretch out your hand. He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

Limbum: Rshentee li ko' woweèe seê, woweèe a ká' a ce seèesi njáèá yuu ce aède' a gee neè Jisoès.
English: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè mnoèñ anaè, Jisoès aè ko' mbe rtuèu aè rgeèe rloo, a cu mbo, a loo neè Nyúè caar túè' aè raa.
English: It happened in these days, that he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, e ká' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a ce beèe ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú efa waâp mú, a too woweèe ená ñgaâa ntuu.
English: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

Limbum: Beèe anaè aè m ba Saimúèn ce e m too ená Pitaè, ba Andruè ce e m ba nfúr Saimúèn, ba Jáêms, ba Joân, ba Feleêp, ba Baètoèlomïì,
English: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

Limbum: ba Matïìyoè, ba Tomaês, ba Jáms muu Alfïìyoès, ba Saimúèn ce a m ce too ená ñwáè ntee luèu-luu,
English: Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;

Limbum: ba Judaès muu Jáêms, ba Judas IÌskarïìyoèt ce e m loè a fyeni Jisoès naè.
English: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m suèu a woweèe embe rtuèu a táá aè mbo'. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m ba aèfo aè ku' ñgoo seê, beèe a vúâ aè bdïì' wááwá aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, ker ba aè bu' mla', aè mla' Tayaè ba Sidoèn ce mi m ba aèwaâa roè.
English: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;

Limbum: Woweèe a m vúè aè ryu' yuu ce e m ce yá'ni, a ker vú foñ tá e bo geèe woweèe a ke'se efa wap byañ. Beèe ce byú' bbebep vi m ce fa woweèe ñgá' a m vúèse foñ, e gee woweèe a ke'seè.
English: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits, and they were being healed.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m ce gheèter aè rjoèo ye njobeè' woweèe a m rïìñ ená ñger yi m ce fúú ye enje nyoèr, a ce geèe beèe wááwá ce a m joèo ye a ce keè'se.
English: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out from him and healed them all.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' naèa mmir fyá' ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a laa enáê, “Mboâñtu mi yu neè weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa fuèp, njobeè' kúú Nyúè yu ye.
English: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Mboâñtu mi yu neè weèe ce njeè ce yañ weèe seè'ni na, njobeè' weèe be keè ye yu'. Mboâñtu mi yu neè weèe ce weèe ce warse seè'ni na, njobeè' weèe be keè vúèshi.
English: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

Limbum: Mboâñtu mi yu neè weèe ce beèe a ka' baa weèe, beesi njïì neè weèe, cáp weèe, bepsi me mlii njobeè' Muu Ñwáè.
English: Blessed are you when men shall hate you, and when they shall exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man's sake.

Limbum: Lu'shi neè aè njáèá noèñ anaè, nyáshi mbekïì neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè njobeè' wee blaè' embe buèu vi yu magoèr seê. Wap btarkú a m ku gee buu ca neè ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè foñ.
English: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

Limbum: Geewa'a, ndoèo aè co' weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa mbaèa njobeè' weèe aè yu' le rboèñ wáá.
English: But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

Limbum: Laèa neè neè beèe ce a ce laèa ená ndoèo co' weèe naè ená Nyúè ghoni woweèe, ker loo foñ neè beèe ce a ce fa ñgá' neè weèe.
English: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' lip wáè neè bo aè geè', aè beesïì geè' mo' neè ye foñ tá e lïîp. Ñwáè aè ka' koo yoè kuêr, aè ma'shïì e koo cáè' yïì enjep mú foñ.
English: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don't withhold your coat also.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' loo yuu ese wáè, aè fa ye yuu anaè. Ñwáè aè ka' koo yo yuu, aè fa keèr laèa ená ñgaèñ kúsi neè wáè ka'.
English: Give to everyone who asks you, and don't ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

Limbum: Baná weèe gee neè beèe moè' aèmboè weèe ce koèñ ená a gee neè weèe.
English: As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

Limbum: E m maè' ñgaèa neè woweèe foñ enáê, “AÈde' nfeèp duñshïì nfeèp moè' nduunjïì a? E ka' gee wa'a, woweèe bsïìp a ke' gweñger njep beè'teè a?
English: He spoke a parable to them. Can the blind guide the blind? Won't they both fall into a pit?

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè ce a ce yá'ni ye, caa ñwáè ryá'nïì ka'. Geewa'a, a ka' yá'ni ñwáè boèñboñ baná ñgaèñ be ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e yá'ni ye.
English: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

Limbum: Wáè maè'shi ntaañguu nje rlïìr nje wáè, a ce fyá' ba ñkúè' ce ce yi yu nfúroè nje rlïìr njoká?
English: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?

Limbum: AÈde' aè laa neè nfúroè enáê, ‘Nfúraè, naèa rlir tá m koo wáè mú ñkúè' ce enjo,’ ke' yá ntaañguu ce e yu wáè nje rlïìr naè ka' aè njáâá ká? Wáè ce aè yu ñwáè mbo'ni, fúr ntaañguu ce e yu nje rlïìr njep wáè wáá tá aè bo yá mú ñkúè' ce ce yi yu nje rlïìr nje nfúroè boèñboñ, ka' fúr.
English: Or how can you tell your brother, 'Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,' when you yourself don't see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye.

Limbum: “Yi yu ená aède' mbaèñ ce bebep yi yú mbe ce ce boèñboñ ka', a ker ba foñ ená aède' mbaèñ ce boèñboñ yi yú mbe ce ce bebep ka'.
English: For there is no good tree that brings forth rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that brings forth good fruit.

Limbum: A ke rïìñ ce neè mbaèñ ce anaè. AÈde' ñwáè kú rbïì embe ráp ka', káè leèemú embe rgúè ka'.
English: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don't gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

Limbum: Ñwáâ mboèñmboñ e ke fúr buu bboèñboñ efa buu bboèñboñ ce vi yu njep yeâ ntee, ñwáâ mbembep fúr buu bbebep efa buu bbebep ce vi yu njep yeâ ntee. Yi yu wa'a njobeè' ñwáè e ke laèa ba efa ku' buu ce vi ruu njep yeâ ntee.
English: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

Limbum: “Weèe ce ká' máè enáê ‘Tataê, Tataê’, a ce geèe buu ce m ce suñ weèe ka' njoká?
English: Why do you call me, 'Lord, Lord,' and don't do the things which I say?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa buu ca neè beèe anaè mïìsi, a du aè rla' Kaèpanuèm.
English: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè rjeèe aè m ba aèfo, a túr yïì ñwáè rfaè' ce e m koèñ seê, e ce yañ a táá yïû ñkwe.
English: A certain centurion's servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

Limbum: E ka' yu' nsuñ aèmboè Jisoès, a tuu bleebeèe mo' efa múè Juês, ená a du laa neè Jisoès ená e vú gee tá yïì ñwáè rfaè' ke'se.
English: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè yá Jisoès, a bu' mmbo neè ye neè mini-ñwáè a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè ghááte aè ñwáè ce wáè ba geèe yuu ce e laèa na neè ye,
English: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, He is worthy for you to do this for him,

Limbum: njobeè' e koèñ yiseèe to' seê, a ba'ri ndap rloo neè weèr.”
English: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.

Limbum: Jisoès aè du a woweèe, a ka' baè' aètútú ndap ñwáè soogáè anaè, a tarte a beèe ce e ba tuu. E m tuu woweèe ená a du laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, fa fa ñgá' neè yoè nyor ka' njobeè' máè ghááte aè ñwáè ce aède' aè niñ mbe máâ ndaèp ka'.
English: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, Lord, don't trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce máè ba kwa'shi máná máè ghááte aè rvúè yá wáè ka'. Kuè laèa ba mbúè nlaèa moè'sir tá yaè ñwáè rfaè' ke'se.
English: Therefore I didn't even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

Limbum: Má máè yu ñwáè ce m ce faè' njeptii beèe ce yap nta' yi caèa ya, a túr bsoogáè ce a yu njep máâ tïìi. M ka' laa neè moè' ená ‘Duê’, baná e be duè. M ka' laa neè moè' ená ‘Vúè’, baná e be vúè. M ka' laa neè yaè ñwáè rfaè' ená, ‘Geèe ca’, baná e be geèe yuu anaè.”
English: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go!' and he goes; and to another, 'Come!' and he comes; and to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu' blaèa ca, a bááñger seê, a karsi nyor a laa neè kúr beèe ce a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu naè enáê, “M ce suñ weèe ená máè be yá njáèá ñwáè moè' ce e túr njáèá rbyemïì ca ka', ka' aè to' Isráèl.”
English: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m tuu anaè a ka' kúti baè' mbe ndaèp, a yá ená ñwáè rfaè' anaè aè keè'se wáá.
English: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

Limbum: Mú nfeè' aè ka' tuuse, e natïì a du aè rla' mo' ce a m ce too ená Náên. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ba ma kúr beèe a du a woweèe.
English: It happened soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

Limbum: E ka' baè' aètútú cuâu ñka' aè rla' anaè, a yá aèmboè a byáè' gúâú ñwáè a ce fúú aègho. Ñwáè ce e m kwe anaè aè m ku ba muu mbañruè ce yïì ma aè m túr caè'caè'. Yïì ma ca aè m ba ñgwañkúñwáè. Kúr beèe efa rla' anaè ce yi m baè'ti yi m ba a ñgwañkúñwáè anaè weèe.
English: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

Limbum: Tata aè ka' yá ye, nse yi koo ye neè ye seê, e laa enáê, “Fa war ka'.”
English: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, Don't cry.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a du a joo ñkuèp gúâú ñwáè anaè, beèe ce a m byáè' ñkuèp anaè a táá, e laa enáê, “Muu nsuènsuè, m ce laèa neè wáè ená aè nati mbekïì.”
English: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, Young man, I tell you, arise!

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m kwe na aè natïì mbekïì, a ká' a ce laèa. Jisoès aè koo ye a fa neè yïì maê.
English: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a wáp, a ku'si Nyúè, a ce laèa enáê, “Ñwáâ ncep ntuu Nyúâ ñgoèr aè fúú efa seâe mú,” a ker ce laèa enáê, “Nyúè aè vúè aè rjaè' yïì beèe.”
English: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, A great prophet has arisen among us! and, God has visited his people!

Limbum: Nsuñ kuu yuu ce Jisoès aè m geèe na aè m duè aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè wááwá ker ba aè mla' ce mi m sïìr ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a kaari a tarte.
English: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Joân a m yá buu ca a suñ Joân. E ká' beèe a mmbaa efa waâp mú,
English: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

Limbum: a tuu woweèe ená woweèe a du yá Tataê, bipshi neè ye enáê, “A wáè ñwáè ce yi m ba ená e be vúè naè káè weèr cu ce ke' ba ñwáâ jáá?”
English: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúè yá Jisoès, a laa neè ye enáê, “Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe aè tuu weèr ená weèr vú yá wáè, bipshi neè wáè ená a wáè ñwáè ce yi m ba ená e be vúè naè káè weèr cu ce ke' ba ñwáâ jáá lá?”
English: When the men had come to him, they said, John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, 'Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?'

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Jisoès aè gee beèe a ke'seè efa byañ njáèá jáá jáèá jáá, a gee beèe ce a m túr byú' bbebep a ke'seè, a gee beèe ce a m feèp, a ker ce yá buu.
English: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

Limbum: E beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Kúti neè du suñ Joân buu ce weèe aè yá a ker yu'. Beèe ce a feèp a ce yá buu, mntáèñ a ce jáèshi yáánïì, ñgaâa msaèasïì a ce ke'seè, ce ba brara, mnfuñ-tuè' a ce yu' buu, beèe ce a m kweñger a ce kúti bteèe, ñgaâa fuèp a ce suñ Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ.
English: Jesus answered them, Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

Limbum: Rboâñtu li yu neè ñwáè ce e ce tarni máè tarni ka'.”
English: Blessed is he who is not offended by me.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu ce Joân aè m tuu naè a ka' duè, Jisoès aè ká' a ce suñ ku' kúr beèe ca buu kuu Joân. E m laèa enáê, “Weèe aè m fúú a du aè rïìñ ba aè ryá ká? Weèe aè m duè aè ryá aèmboè fu' yi ce cïì' ñke' a?
English: When John's messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

Limbum: Yi ka' tá ba wa' ka', baná weèe aè m duè ba aè ryá ká? Weèe aè m duè aè ryá ñwáè ce e suèsi nyor neè bcáè' yoèo a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Beèe ce a ke suèsi nyor neè bcáâ' bboèñboñ, ce ye rboèñ, a ke cu ba aè nto'.
English: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

Limbum: Baná weèe aè m fúú a du ba aè ryá ká seê? Weèe aè m duè ba aè ryá ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè a? ÁÈno, m ce suñ weèe máná ñwáè ce weèe aè m yá anaè caèa ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

Limbum: E yu ñwáè ce a sañ aèmboè ye mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Yáê, m be tuu yaè ñwáè ntuu tá e du entombïì neè wáè, duè kupshi nduunjïì neè wáè.’
English: This is he of whom it is written, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.'

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná efa beèe wááwá ce bbyeèñge a bi, moè' caèa Joân ka'. Geewa'a, ñwáè ce e yu yi múcaèr se mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè aè caèa ye.”
English: For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than he.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá, ka' neè ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè'-ñwáè, a m yu' yuu ce Jisoès aè m laèa, a byemi ená Nyúè ce geèe yïì buu aè njïû yáánïì, a byemi ená Joân baptir woweèe.
English: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John's baptism.

Limbum: Geewa'a, beèe Farïìsi ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a m kani yuu ce Nyúè aè m koèñ aè rgeèe neè woweèe, a kani foñ ená Joân fa baèptir woweèe ka'.
English: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

Limbum: “Baná aède' m be'nïì beèe eluèuni na ba aè ká? Woweèe a yu aèmboè ká?
English: To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?

Limbum: Ñwáè Farïìsi moè' aè laèa neè Jisoès ená a ye a du yeñger. Jisoès aè du a niñ mbe ndaèp mbe ñwáè anaè, a cu, tá a ye a bo yeñger.
English: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee's house, and sat at the table.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' aè m ba aè rla' anaè ce e m ba ñwáâ ñgeèe buu bbebep. E ka' yu' ená Jisoès ce yeñger mbe ndaèp ñwáè Farïìsi ca, a lor mú ntúñ bluèr ce njáèá mgúr mo' ce mi m ce rúèú boèñboñ seê, mi m ba njo,
English: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee's house, she brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

Limbum: a vú a táá mbe yeâ njïì aègee mi mkuèu a ce war, mñgoommir mi ce cáácá mbe mkuèu Jisoès, e ce siñsi neè yi nyúè'tu. E m nyoè'shi mkuèu Jisoès, a cu'ni mgúr ce e m túr naè aègho.
English: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

Limbum: Ñwáè Farïìsi ce e m be Jisoès naè, aè ka' yá ca, a laa neè yïì nyor enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè ba ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè, e ba rïìñ njáèá ñwáè ce njeñwáè ce e ce joèo ye na yu, njobeè' e yu ñwáâ ñgeèe buu bbebep.”
English: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Saimúèn, m túr yuu aè rsuñ wáè.” E laa enáê, “Suñ laè máè, ñwáè ryá'nïì.”
English: Jesus answered him, Simon, I have something to tell you. He said, Teacher, say on.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Beèe mo' beèe a mmbaa a m túr rkaa a ñwáè moè' ce e m foèosi woweèe mbaèa. Moè' aè m túr rkaa a ye aè bbaèa mbaèa taê, moè' aè túr li a ye aè nto'nïì baèa mbaèa.
English: A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

Limbum: Saimúèn aè beesïì enáê, “M kwaè'shi máná yu ñwáè ce rkaa li li m ba goèr naè.” Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Wáè beèesi yáánïì.”
English: Simon answered, He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most. He said to him, You have judged correctly.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a karsi nyor a ke' njeñwáè ca, a laa neè Saimúèn enáê, “Wáè yá njeñwáè ca a? Máè vúè mbe wáâ ndaèp, wáè fa máè mdip ená m su'si mkuèu aègho ka', geewa'a, njeñwáè ca aè suè'si ma mkuèu neè mñgoommir, a siñsi neè yi nyúè'tu.
English: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

Limbum: Wáè ba koni máè a baa máè nje nyoèr ka', ká' embe nfeè' máè ba niñ mbe ndaèp na njeñwáè ca aè be borni efa rnyoè'shi máè mkuèu ka'.
English: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

Limbum: Wáè ba cu'ni máè mgúr mbe tuè ka', e cu'nïì mgúr ce mi ce rúèú boèñboñ se aè ma mkuèu.
English: You didn't anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

Limbum: Baná m ce suñ wáè máná ku' njáèá rkoèñnïì ce e duèñshi neè máè na li ce duèñshi ená a foèosi ye efa ku' buu bbebep ce e m geèe. Ñwáè ce a foèosi yïì buu bbebep múcaèr ce duèñshi rkoèñnïì múcaèr.”
English: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a laa neè njeñwáè ca enáê, “Máè foèosi wáè efa yoè buu bbebep.”
English: He said to her, Your sins are forgiven.

Limbum: Beèe mo' ce a woweèe a m cute a ce ye byee naè, a ká' a ce laèa a waâp mú enáê, “Njáèá ñwáè ce e ce foèosi beèe efa yaèp buu bbebep na a nda?”
English: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, Who is this who even forgives sins?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè njeñwáè anaè enáê, “Lo rbyemïì li geèe wáè ke'seè, duè yo yu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.”
English: He said to the woman, Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.

Limbum: Mú nfeè' aè ka' tuuse, Jisoès aè jár aè mla' mñgoèrñgoèr ba aè mla' mñká'ñká', a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè. Yïì beèe ce ncoèp baa-aè-rrúèú a m duè a ye.
English: It happened soon afterwards, that he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of the Kingdom of God. With him were the twelve,

Limbum: Bbyeèñge mo' ce e m geèe woweèe a luñ efa byú' bbebep, ba byañ, a m duè foñ a woweèe. Moè' efa woweèe aè m ba Máèári ce a m ce too ená Maèkdaèleên, ce byú' bbebep vi m fúú enjep ye vi saèamba naè,
English: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

Limbum: moè' aè ba Joèanaè ce e m ba ñgwa Kusaè ce e m ba tu rfaè' embe ndaèp Hároèd. Suèsanaè aè ba moè' foñ, ker ba bbyeèñge mo' aèñgoo. Bbyeèñge ca a m jaè' Jisoès weèe neè yap mbaèa ba yaèp buu ce a m túr.
English: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod's steward; Susanna; and many others; who served them from their possessions.

Limbum: Beèe a m ce vúâ aè bbu' mla' jáá jáèá jáá aè ryá Jisoès. A ka' vúè kaari aè ma kúr, Jisoès aè ma' ñgaèa enáê,
English: When a great multitude came together, and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable.

Limbum: “Ñwáè moè' aè m ce duè aè rbyeè yïì buu, a ka' ce byeè, ñgúè buu moè' aè gweñgeèr aèwaâa nduunjïì, beèe a ka' caèa a nyáñshi neè mkuèu, bsiñ vi vú a ye.
English: The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a bipshïì neè ye ená ñgaèa ca yu ba ená ká lá?
English: Then his disciples asked him, What does this parable mean?

Limbum: E laa enáê, “Buu ce aède' beèe a riñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè ka' naè, Nyúè aè geèe weèe aè rïîñ. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe mo', a ce suñ woweèe buu ca ba aè mñgaèa tá woweèe a ce keè' ce yá ka', a ce yu'shi, ce yu' ka'.”
English: He said, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of God, but to the rest in parables; that 'seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.'

Limbum: “Ñgaèa ca yu ená, ñgúè buu yu nlaâa Nyúè.
English: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger aèwaâa nduunjïì naè táá yi ba aètu beèe ce a yu' blaâa Nyúè, Sataèn ku fúr blaèa anaè enjep waâp mntee, faè dïì' woweèe a bo byemi, luèñ ka'.
English: Those along the road are those who hear, then the devil comes, and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger mbenduè ryáá naè táá aètu beèe ce a yu' blaâa Nyúè, yu' rboèñ aègho seê, geewa'a, blaèa anaè vi ke' taa mñgaèñ njep woweèe ka'. Woweèe aè loè ku byemi ba aè mú nfeè' moè', e ba aè nfeè' ce rmoèoshïì li vúè neè woweèe, woweèe a ku kúti njïìnjïì.
English: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root, who believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger aè múè msini naè táá aètu beèe ce a yu' blaâa Nyúè ku byemi, a ce cu, mluè ce aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na, ba broñ buu, ba buu ce beèe a ke yu' rboèñ aègho, vi kur blaèa anaè, vi ke' yú mbaèñ ce yi teèe ka'.
English: That which fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.

Limbum: Ñgúè buu ce e m gweèñger yi ba mbe nshe yïû mboèñmboñ naè táá aètu beèe ce a yu' blaâa Nyúè, lá njep ntee boèñboñ seê, neè mini-ñwáè, ku', táá tatap, gee ñgúè.
English: That in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and bring forth fruit with patience.

Limbum: “AÈde' ñwáè cú' laêm, ker lor ghee kúpshi aègho káè tár mbaè kaèasi ka'. Ñwáè aè ka' cú' laêm, baná ñgaèñ be tár ba mbe tábuèr, tá beèe ce a ce niñ mbe ndaèp a bo yá rraa.
English: No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container, or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

Limbum: Ma yïì Jisoès ker ba bfúr vi a m vúè aè ryá ye, nduunjïì yi ke' ba neè woweèe aè ryá ye ka' njobeè' beèe a m ba goèr seê.
English: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Yoè ma ba bfúr wo a táá njepmbeè a ce koèñ aè ryá wáè.”
English: It was told him by some saying, Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Yaè ma ba bfúr wa yu beèe ce a ce yu' blaâa Nyúè, a ce geèe buu ce Nyúè ce laèa.”
English: But he answered them, My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè moè' Jisoès aè niñ mbe keñ a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Seèe tuu túè ca du neèñguñ.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a woweèe a ká' a ce tuu.
English: Now it happened on one of those days, that he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, Let's go over to the other side of the lake. So they launched out.

Limbum: A ka' ce tuu, e buumïì. Ka' cu, fu' mo' yi vú neè ñger-ñwáè seê, mdip mi ká' a ce niñ mbe keñ, yi ba bebep neè woweèe.
English: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du a yáá ye, a laa enáê, “Masaè, Masaè, seèe aè kwe.” E lá' efa mmirloè, a waa fu' ba rdip, fu' anaè yi tetïì, rdip li táá nyañ, ñgoèñ yi ba seè'ni neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: They came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we are dying! He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it was calm.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Le rbyemïì li yu ba fá?” Woweèe a wáp a ker bááñger foñ seê, a ce laèa fa waâp mú enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu nda seê? E waa fu', yi yu'nïì neè ye, rdip li yu'nïì neè ye foñ.”
English: He said to them, Where is your faith? Being afraid they marveled, saying one to another, Who is this, then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?

Limbum: Woweèe a m tuu, a ba' aè ñgoâñ beèe Gáèrasaè. Wáè ka' táá aè ñgoèñ anaè, ñgoâñ Galeèle yi kútïì neèñguu roè.
English: They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce fúú embe keñ, a yá ñwáè moâ' aè rla' anaè ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m ba njep ye. E m kar mbuèuriñ káâ' aè nfeè' njïìsaèp seê, a ce cu mbe ndaèp ka'. E m ce cu yi ba faèdïì' ce a m ce tuñ beèe.
English: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn't live in a house, but in the tombs.

Limbum: E ka' yá Jisoès, a waa, a gwe njep yeâ tïìi, a ce war enáê, “Jisoès, Muu Nyúè embe buèu, yuu ce soè túr a ká? M ce loo neè wáè ená aè fa fa máè ñgá' ka'.”
English: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don't torment me!

Limbum: E m laèa wa'a njobeè' Jisoès aè m laèa neè yú' bebep caè ená yi fúú enjep ye. Yú' anaè yi m ce loâ koo ye aèmboè mruè' wa'a nfeè' aèñgoo seê. A m ce loâ kur ye neè bshañ aè mkoo ker ba aè mkuèu ce keè'ni ye. Yi geèe wa'a, e ceeshïì bshañ anaè, nyúèrkaè' lor ye du aègho aè ntee rïìñ.
English: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard, and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bands apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Lo rlii a nda?” E beesïì enáê, “La rlii a Mncúèkïì.” E m laèa wa'a njobeè' byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m niñ njep ye aèñgoo.
English: Jesus asked him, What is your name? He said, Legion, for many demons had entered into him.

Limbum: Byú' anaè vi m bu' mmbo neè Jisoès ená e fa laèa ená woweèe a fúú du njep beè'teè ñgá' ka'.
English: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

Limbum: Kúr ñkuânyaèm mo' goèr se yi m ba aèfo a ce yeñger mbe rtuèu. Byú' mnyúâmkaè' ca vi bu' mmbo neè Jisoès ená e ma'shi tá a niñ ba njep ñkuânyaèm anaè. Jisoès aè ma'shïì.
English: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. He allowed them.

Limbum: Byú' anaè vi ka' fúú enjep ñwáè anaè, a niñ njep kúr ñkuânyaèm caè, yi káátïì a cañ a du mbaè baa, a gweñger njep túè, a no mdip, a kweñger.
English: The demons came out from the man, and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake, and were drowned.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce cïìñ ñkuânyaèm ca a ka' yá yuu ce yi m koni, a cañ a duê, a suñ yuu ce yi m koni na aè laè', a ker suñ neè beèe ce a m ba aè mñkúè.
English: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.

Limbum: Beèe a fúú a du aè ryá yuu ce yi m koni. Woweèe a du a yá Jisoès, a ker yá ñwáè ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m fúú enjep ye naè aèmboè e cu njeptii Jisoès neè bcáè' aè nyoèr, vi bfee vi banïì kúti mbo. Woweèe a wáp seê.
English: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus' feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ba aèfo a yá yuu ce yi m koni, a suñ beèe ce a m vúè naè aèmboè a m geèe ñwáè anaè aè luêñ.
English: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá aè ñgoâñ Gáèrasaè a m laèa ená Jisoès duê, njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp magoèr seê. Yi ka' ba wa'a, e niñ mbe keñ tá e bo kúti.
English: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. He entered into the boat, and returned.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi m fúú enjep ye naè aè bu' mmbo neè Jisoès ená a ye a duê. Jisoès aè kanïì, a laa neè ye enáê,
English: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

Limbum: “Kúti fa wáâ laè' du suñ beèe yuu ce Nyúè aè geèe neè wáè.” Ñwáè anaè aè du a jár aè rla' anaè wááwá a ce suñ beèe yuu ce Jisoès aè geèe neè ye.
English: Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you. He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kúti, kúr beèe a konïì ye, njobeè' woweèe wááwá a m cu a ce keè' ye.
English: It happened, when Jesus returned, that the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

Limbum: Ka' cu, ñwáè moè' ce a m ce too ená Jairoès aè vúê. E m ba ñwáâ ñgoèr embe ndaèp rloo. E m vúè a gwe njeptii Jisoès a bu' mmbo neè ye ená e vú mbe yeâ ndaèp,
English: Behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus' feet, and begged him to come into his house,

Limbum: njobeè' e m túr muunje moè'sir caè'caè', e ce yañ, a ba yïû ñkwe. Muu anaè aè m ba aèmboè bfeè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú wa'a. Jisoès aè ka' naèti ce duè, beèe a fateè ye mbetar.
English: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' aè m ba aèfo ce e m cu mbe kuèu aè bfeè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, ñwáè mcáèp moè' aè ke' ba ce aède' e m ba kupshi ye e ke'se ka'.
English: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians, and could not be healed by any,

Limbum: E m vúè njïì embe njïì Jisoès, a joo cuâu cáè' ese ye, a ku ke'se mbe dïì'.
English: came behind him, and touched the fringe of his cloak, and immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshi enáê, “AÈ joèo nda máè?” Beèe wááwá a kanïì ená a joèo ye ka'. Pitaè aè laa enáê, “Masaè, yu ba beèe ce a yu goèr a ce nyoèrni a ka' ce cïìrshi wáè mbetar.”
English: Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, 'Who touched me?'

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè joèo máè, njobeè' máè yu' aèmboè ñger yi fúú máè enje nyoèr.”
English: But Jesus said, Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè ka' yá ená e yááti aèwañ, e ká' a ce kaèñ, a vú a gwe njeptii Jisoès. E m suñ mbuèu ce e m joèo ye a ker suñ aèmboè e m ku ke'se aè nfeè' ce e m joèo ye anaè aè bsii beèe wááwá.
English: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
