Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Muu waè, lo rbyemïì li geèe wáè ke'seè. Duè yo yu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.”
English: He said to her, Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kuè bii laèa, ñwáè moè' embe ndaèp ñwáâ ñgoèr embe ndaèp rloo aè vúê, a laa enáê, “Muu woè aè kwe. Fa keèr fa ñwáè ryá'nïì ñgá' ka'.”
English: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue's house came, saying to him, Your daughter is dead. Don't trouble the Teacher.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu', a laa neè Jairoès enáê, “Fa wáp ka', kuè byemi byemi, muu woè be luèñ.”
English: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, Don't be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.

Limbum: Jisoès aè duê, a ka' baè', a ma'shi ená ñwáè moè' niñ mbe ndaèp a ye caa efa Pitaè ba Joân ba Jáêms, ker ba tar muu ba ma muu ka'.
English: When he came to the house, he didn't allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m ce warse a ce koosimnse. E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Fa war neè ka'. Muu ca aè kwe kwe ka', e ce buumi buumi.”
English: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, Don't weep. She isn't dead, but sleeping.

Limbum: Woweèe a vúshïì ye, njobeè' woweèe a m rïìñ ená muu anaè aè kwe.
English: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

Limbum: Geewa'a, e koo ye aè boè, a laa enáê, “Naèti mbekïì, muu.”
English: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, Child, arise!

Limbum: E kúti nteèe, a nati mbekïì njaè' moè'sir. Jisoès aè laa ená a fa muu anaè yuu tá e ye.
English: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

Limbum: Yïì ma ba yïì ta a bááñgeèr seê. Jisoès aè laa ená woweèe a fa suñ ñwáè moè' yuu ce yi koni anaè ka'.
English: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ká' yïì beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú a fa woweèe ñger aè rfúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe, ker ba aè rgeèe tá ñgaâa byañ a ke'se.
English: He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

Limbum: E m tuu woweèe ená woweèe a du fe'shi aèmboè kúú Nyúè, ker gee tá ñgaâa byañ a ke'se.
English: He sent them forth to preach the Kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Weâe ce duè, ñwáè fa loèr yuu mo' ka', ka' mbaèñ, ka' baèa, ka' bráêd, ka' mbaèa, ka' cáè' áè, ñwáè fa loèr ka'.
English: He said to them, Take nothing for your journey--neither staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats apiece.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' du niñ ka' mbe ndaèp ce efá, weèe ku cu ba mbo, nati ba embo ka' du aè rla' mo'.
English: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

Limbum: Faèdïì' ce beèe a ka' tá koni weèe ka', weèe kashïì nfúènfú efa weâe mkuèu aè nfeè' ce weèe ce loè, aè rduèñshi ená woweèe a geèe yuu bebep.”
English: As many as don't receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

Limbum: Woweèe a natïì a du aè bbu' mla' jáá jáèá jáá a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ, a ce geèe ñgaâa byañ a ce keè'se aè bdïì' wááwá ce woweèe a m ce duè.
English: They departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News, and healing everywhere.

Limbum: Hároèd ce e m ce sa' ñgoâñ Galeèleê, aè m yu' buu ce vi m ce koni na bfee vi jep ye seê, njobeè' beèe mo' a m ce laèa ená Joân aè fúú efa rkwe,
English: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

Limbum: beèe mo' a ce laèa yap ená AÈlajaè aè ker nyáá, beèe mo' a ker ce laèa yap ená ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè moè' eluâuñgoèñ aè fúú efa rkwe.
English: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

Limbum: Hároèd aè laa enáê, “Máè m tee tu ese Joân. Baná ñwáè ce máè ka' ce yu' ku' buu aèmboè ye naè yu ba nda?” E ka' laèa wa'a, a ce gheèter aè ryá ye seê.
English: Herod said, John I beheaded, but who is this, about whom I hear such things? He sought to see him.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a ka' kúti a suñ ye buu wááwá ce woweèe a geèe. E lor woweèe a woweèe a lá'sïì nyor a du aè rla' mo' ce a ce too ená Báèrsaidaè.
English: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them, and withdrew apart to a deserted place of a city called Bethsaida.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a ka' yu' ená e duè aèfo, a du a yeâ mbuèu, e konïì woweèe, a suñ woweèe aèmboè kúú Nyúè, a gee beèe ce a m ce yañ a ke'seè.
English: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, and spoke to them of the Kingdom of God, and he cured those who needed healing.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' káè' ce coo, beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú a vú a yá ye, a laa neè ye enáê, “Laèa tá beèe ca a duse aè mla' ce mi yu aètútú, ker ba aè mla' ce mi yu aè mñkúè, yá ená aède' aè konïì dïì' rnoèñ, ker koni yuu ye foñ lá, njobeè' seèe yu aènjïìsaèp efa mla'.”
English: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said to him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms, and lodge, and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa woweèe yuu tá a ye.” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Weèr ku túr ba mntu' bráâd vi taê, ba nca yi baa. Baná weèr du yuu byee neè ku' beèe ca wááwá a?”
English: But he said to them, You give them something to eat. They said, We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.

Limbum: Mmbañruè ce a m ba aèfo a m ba aèmboè ncúèkïì taê. Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Laèa neè tá woweèe a cute aè nsheè aè bkúr aè bkúr tá beèe a ba mbe kúr e mo'sir aèmboè beèe mta wa'a.”
English: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.

Limbum: Woweèe a gee wa'a, beèe wááwá a cuteè aè nsheè.
English: They did so, and made them all sit down.

Limbum: Jisoès aè lor bráâd ta ba nca baa ca, a ke' mbe buèu, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi, a fa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ená a gapshi neè beèe anaè.
English: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a ye a yu', ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a baashïì bbábá' ce vi m báti, vi ruu aè mñkaèa ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: They ate, and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè moè', Jisoès aè ce geèe rloo mimñgi', ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ba a ye. E bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Ku' beèe ce a ke vúè na, a ke laèa ená m yu nda?”
English: It happened, as he was praying alone, that the disciples were with him, and he asked them, Who do the multitudes say that I am?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Beèe mo' a ce laèa ená aè yu Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe, beèe mo' ená aè yu AÈlajaè, beèe mo' ená aè yu moè' efa ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè eluâuñgoèñ ce e fúú efa rkwe.”
English: They answered, 'John the Baptizer,' but others say, 'Elijah,' and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Yi yu yi ká aèmboè weèe? Weèe ce laèa ye weená m yu nda?” Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “A wáè Kraâis yïì Nyúè.”
English: He said to them, But who do you say that I am? Peter answered, The Christ of God.

Limbum: E ciisïì neè woweèe tatap seê, ená woweèe a fa suñ ñwáè moè' ka',
English: But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Muu Ñwáè be kuè yá ñgá' goèr seê, tá bleebeèe ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a kani ye, a be yú ye, mnoèñ vi ba btaar, tá e fúú efa rkwe.”
English: saying, The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe wááwá enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' ce koèñ aè rvúè fa máâ mbuèu, baná ñgaèñ kani yïì nyor, byá' yi kïìntaa aè mnoèñ wááwá, ce vú fa máâ mbuèu,
English: He said to all, If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

Limbum: njobeè' ñwáè ce e ka' ce koèñ aè rboñshi li ryoèñ baná ñgaèñ be bá li, ñwáè ce e ka' tá boñshi li ryoèñ ka', njo' máè, baná ñgaèñ be koni li.
English: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè konïì ba njáèá sá' ká, ce e ka' túr buu enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá, lo bá li ryoèñ?
English: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce rïìtu yi ce koo ye neè máè, ker ba neè wa blaèa, baná rïìtu yi be koo Muu Ñwáè neè ye foñ, aè nfeè' ce Muu Ñwáè be keè vúè neè yi foèo-ñwáè, ba foèo yïì Taê, ker ba foèo bcïìndap Nyúâ brara.
English: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed, when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe yuu mini ená beèe mo' a táá mbena ce rkwe li be joèo woweèe ka', tá woweèe a cu, caar yá kúú Nyúè.”
English: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here, who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi caa aèmboè waami wa'a, ká' e nyúè ce Jisoès aè m laèa buu ca, e lor Pitaè ba Joân ba Jáêms, a du a woweèe mbe rtuèu aè rgeèe rloo.
English: It happened about eight days after these sayings, that he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

Limbum: E ka' ce loo, vi bsii vi kupseè a ba aè njáâá jáá, vi bcáè' vi fúp a ce laè'ñger.
English: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

Limbum: Ka' cu mmbañruè mo' a baa a ce de' a Jisoès. Mmbañruè ca aè m ba Musïìs ba AÈlajaè.
English: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

Limbum: Woweèe a m nyáá neè foèo-ñwáè a ce de' a Jisoès aèmboè li rkwe ce yi m ba ená e be kwe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, mïìsi li rfaè'.
English: who appeared in glory, and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

Limbum: Mmirloè mi m ce koo Pitaè ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ba naè, a ka' wañ woweèe efa mmïìr boèñboñ, a yá foâo Jisoès, a yá mmbañruè a baa caè aèmboè a táá a Jisoès.
English: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

Limbum: Mmbañruè ca a ka' maè'shi Jisoès ce duè, Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Masaè, yi boèñ aèmboè seèe yu aèfa na. Maè'shi tá weèr ba'ri btaèp vïû btaar, tá moè' ba yo, mo' ba yïì Musïìs, tá mo' ba yïì AÈlajaè.” E m laèa wa'a, a riñ yuu ce e m ce laèa ka'.
English: It happened, as they were parting from him, that Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here. Let's make three tents: one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah, not knowing what he said.

Limbum: E ka' kuè bii ce laèa, mmbaè' vi nyáá, a ce cete woweèe, vi ka' ce cete woweèe wa'a, woweèe a wáp seê.
English: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

Limbum: Njeèndoñ aè laa embe múè mmbaè' ca enáê, “Cena yu muu waè. A ye ñwáè ce máè m ce. Ce yu' neè yuu ce e ce laèa.”
English: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!

Limbum: Njeèndoñ ca aè ka' laèa mïìsi wáá, woweèe a ka' keè' a ku yá Jisoès mimñgi'. Woweèe a m suñ ñwáè moè' yuu ce woweèe a m yá naè ka'.
English: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa woweèe a suu embe rtuèu, ku' beèe a du aè ryá ye.
English: It happened on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, that a great multitude met him.

Limbum: Ka' cu, ñwáè moè' efa múè beèe anaè aè fuñ enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, m ce bu' mmbo neè wáè ená aè fyá' muu waè ca. Ku ba muu ce m túr caè'caè'.
English: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

Limbum: Yú' mo' yi ke loè niñ njep ye, koo ye, e war, yú' anaè yi ma' ye aè nsheè, e búúñgeèr, bdúdú' vi ce fúú ye ekuè cuèu. Yú' anaè yi ke geèe wa'a, e sá seê, yi ce koèñ aè rmaè'shi ye ka'.
English: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams, and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

Limbum: Máè mú bu' mmbo neè ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu ená woweèe a fúr yú' anaè enjep ye, woweèe a moèo aè rfúr yi laèr.”
English: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn't.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa enáê, “Haba! Beèe eluèuni ce weèe buu rbyemïì, a beesi mini tútúèñ na. M be cu weèe seèe, kur ntee neè weèe duè baè' fá? Vúè neè muu woè mbena.”
English: Jesus answered, Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.

Limbum: Muu anaè aè ka' ce vúè, nyúèrkaè' anaè aè ma' ye aè nsheè, e búúñgeèr. Jisoès aè lapnïì yú' bebep anaè a gee muu anaè aè luêñ, e kúsïì ye neè yïì taê.
English: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m báèáñger seê, aè ryá ku' ñger Nyúè ca. Woweèe a ka' ce báèáñger wa'a, Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê,
English: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

Limbum: “Múè' neè wee btuè', yu' yuu ce m ce suñ weèe na boèñboñ. A be loèr Muu Ñwáè fa mbaè mmbo beèe.”
English: Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.

Limbum: Geewa'a, woweèe a m rïìñ yuu ce e m laèa anaè ka'. A m súèti mbuèu efa yuu ce e m laèa anaè ese woweèe faè dïì' woweèe a bo rïìñ yi ka'. Woweèe a wáp aè rbipshi yuu kuu yuu ce e m laèa anaè.
English: But they didn't understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a m káè' a ce sár mnsár ená ñwáè efa waâp mú ce e yu ñwáâ ñgoèr a nda lá.
English: There arose an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.

Limbum: Jisoès aè riñ yuu ce woweèe a m ce kwaè'shi, a koo mú ghaèrñwáè a tár a yeâ geñ,
English: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' koni muu ghaèrñwáè aèmboè ca a máâ rlii, baná ñgaèñ aè koni máè. Ñwáè ce e ka' koni máè, baná ñgaèñ aè koni ñwáè ce e m tuu máè. Yi yu ba ená ñwáè ce e yu ñwáâ ñká' seê a weâe mú wááwá yu ñwáâ ñgoèr.”
English: and said to them, Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.

Limbum: Joân aè beesïì a laa enáê, “Masaè, weèr aè yá ñwáè moè' e ce fúr yú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe a wáâ rlii, weèr aè laa neè ye ená e fa keèr geèe wa' ka' njobeè' e yu moè' efa seâe mú ka'.”
English: John answered, Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn't follow with us.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Weèe fa laèa ená ñgaèñ borni ka' njobeè' ñwáè ce e ka' ba yeè ñwáè bbaèa ka', baná ñgaèñ yu yeè ñwáè.”
English: Jesus said to him, Don't forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.

Limbum: Nfeè' ce a be loèr Jisoès duè aègho mbe buèu aè ka' gháá, e kur ntee a nati a ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem,

Limbum: E m tuu beèe mo' entombïì. Woweèe a du a niñ aè rla' moâ' aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaèè tá a bo fyá' dïì', kupshi buu neè ye.
English: and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

Limbum: Geewa'a, beâe aè ñgoèñ anaè a m kani aè rkoni ye njobeè' e m ce vúè aè rcaèa duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: They didn't receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.

Limbum: Jáms ba Joân ce ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a ka' yá ca, a laa enáê, “Tataê, aâ koèñ ená weèr laa tá mor yi suu embe buèu, toèo woweèe tá a kweñger a?”
English: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?

Limbum: Jisoès aè karsïì nyor a lapni woweèe,
English: But he turned and rebuked them, You don't know of what kind of spirit you are.

Limbum: a woweèe a natïì a du aè rla' jáá.
English: For the Son of Man didn't come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. They went to another village.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce duè, ñwáè moè' aè yá Jisoès a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè ka' ce duè ba fá, baná m be kuè ba fa wáâ mbuèu.”
English: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Bsïìi vi túr bto, bsiñ vi túr mndap, Muu Ñwáè aè ke' túr dïì' ce aède' e lá yi tu ka'.”
English: Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.

Limbum: E m laèa neè ñwáè moè' enáê, “Vúè a máâ mbuèu.” Ñwáè anaè aè beesïì enáê, “Tataê, beè ma'shi tá m du tuñ yaè ta wáá.”
English: He said to another, Follow me! But he said, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye ená, “Maè'shi tá bgúâú beèe a tuñ wap bgúâú beèe. Duè yo du fe'shi kúú Nyúè neè beèe.”
English: But Jesus said to him, Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ye ye aè ker laa enáê, “Tataê, m be duè a wáâ mbuèu. Kuè ma'shi tá m du daèasi beèe embe máâ ndaèp wáá.”
English: Another also said, I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' lor soo ká' rfaè', ker ce keè' mbenjïì, baná ñgaèñ aè ghááte aè rgeèe rfaè' ce li kuèu kúú Nyúè ka'.”
English: But Jesus said to him, No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Ca yi ka' mïì wáá, Tata aè ce ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu moè', beèe ncoèp-baa-aè- msaèambaê, a tuu woweèe a baa a baa ená a du entombïì neè ye, du du aè mla' wááwá ker ba aè bdïì' wááwá ce e m ba aè rduè aèfo.
English: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Buu aè bi aè mñkúè goèr, ñgaâa rkep a ba múcaèr. Baná weèe loo neè Taèr ce e túr ñkúè ená e tuusi ñgaâa mfaè' tá a du kep yïì buu efa mñkúè.
English: Then he said to them, The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

Limbum: Duè neè! M ce tuu weèe tá weèe du ba aèmboè njeèe aè múè bkuura.
English: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

Limbum: Ñwáè fa loèr posaè, káè baèa, káè blaba' ka'. Ñwáè fa caè'ni ñwáè aè nduunjïì ka'.
English: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' du ba', ndap ce weèe aè ka' niñ mbo, weèe ká' laa weenáê, ‘Cumúnyañ ba mbe ndaèp na.’
English: Into whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace be to this house.'

Limbum: Ñwáè cumúnyañ aè ka' ba mbe ndaèp anaè baná yeè cumúnyañ be duè neè ñgaèñ. Ñwáè cumúnyañ aè ka' tá ba mbo ka', yeè cumúnyañ kútïì neè weèe.
English: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

Limbum: Kuè cu neè ba mbe ndaèp anaè, ce ye ker ce no njáèá ká ce a ka' fa weèe, njobeè' yi yu yáánïì ená a la' ñwáè rfaè'. Weèe fa loè embe ndaèp moè' duè mbe moè' ka'.
English: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don't go from house to house.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' du niñ aè rla' mo', káè yu mbe lïû fá áè, beâe aèfo a ka' koni weèe, weèe ye yuu ce a ka' fa weèe.
English: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

Limbum: Geèe neè tá ñgaâa byaâñ aèfo a ke'se, laa neè neè beèe wááwá enáê, ‘Kúú Nyúè yi vúè, a ba aètútú neè weèe.’
English: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, 'The Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' niñ aè rla', káè yu ba lïû fá, a ka' tá koni weèe ka', weèe du aè btase aè múè mla' anaè laa enáê,
English: But into whatever city you enter, and they don't receive you, go out into its streets and say,

Limbum: ‘Weèr ce kashi nfúènfú ce weèr aè koo aè mkuèu fa weâe laè' na, aè rduèñshi ená weèe aè geèe yuu bebep. Ka' yi yu wa'a, rïìñ neè ená kúú Nyúè yi vúè aètútú.’
English: Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná be keè ba aè noèñ anaè tá ñgá' yïì beâe aè rla' Sodoèm ba aèndeèe neè ñgá' yïì beâe aè rla' anaè.
English: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

Limbum: “Ndoèo aè co' weèe ce weèe yu beâe aè rla' Koèrasïìn, ndoèo aè co' weèe ce weèe yu beâe aè rla' Báèrsaidaè njobeè' a m ba gee buu bghagha' ce a m geèe fa weâe mú naè ba aè rla' Tayaè, ker ba aè rla' Sidoèn beâe aèfo a m ba neè kupse e sese', a ma' bcáè' njïì rkwe, a yo' bú aè nyoèr, a cute aègho.
English: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

Limbum: Beèe ncoèp-baa-aè-msaèamba caè a du a kúti neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè a laa enáê, “Tataê, mnyúâmkaè' foñ a yu'ni neè weèr njo' lo rlii.”
English: The seventy returned with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè mú yá aèmboè Sataèn aè gweè embe buèu aèmboè mbeèñ aè baèp wa'a.
English: He said to them, I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

Limbum: Yáê, máè fa weèe ñger aè rnyáèñshi mnyo ba mnyobsaa, a fa weèe ñger mbenduè ñwáè bbaèa. AÈde' yuu mo' yi joo weèe ka'.
English: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe fa ce lu'shi ená mnyúâmkaè' vi yu'ni neè weèe ka', weèe lu'shi ba njobeè' a sañ me mlii mbe buèu.”
English: Nevertheless, don't rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè Yú' Rara yi gee Jisoès aè ce lu'shi seê, a laa enáê, “Taèr, Tata ce e túr rbuu ba nshe, m ce yoèñshi wáè njobeè' wáè súèti buu ca ese ñgaâa bfee, ba beèe ce a rïìñ buu, a duñshi vi ba neè boo bká'. ÁÈno Taèr, ca yu ba yuu ce wáè m ce yu' rboèñ aè rgeèe.”
English: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

Limbum: “Yaè ta aè fa buu wááwá mba máâ mmboè. Ñwáè moè' rïìñ ñwáè ce muu yu caa efa Taèr ka'. Ñwáè moè' rïìñ ñwáè ce Taèr yu caa efa muu ker ba beèe ce muu aè koèñ aè rduèñshi ye neè woweèe ka'.”
English: Turning to the disciples, he said, All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a karsi nyor a laa ca ba neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu caè'caè'. E m laèa neè woweèe aè bsúèti enáê, “Mboâñtu mi yu neè beèe ce a ce yá buu ce weèe ce yá na.
English: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè magoèr ba bkúú magoèr a m ce koèñ aè ryá buu ce weèe ce yá na, a yá ka', a koñ aè ryu' buu ce weèe ce yu' na, a yu' ka'.”
English: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn't see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn't hear them.

Limbum: Ñwáè ryá'ni mncir moè' aè naèti mbekïì aè rmoèoshi Jisoès, a bipshi enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, yuu ce aède' m gee ka' koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè a ká?”
English: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “A sañ mbe ñwaâ' mncir ená ká? Wá ke beè' mbo ená ká?”
English: He said to him, What is written in the law? How do you read it?

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè beesïì a laa enáê, “Koèñ Tata ce e yu yoè Nyúè neè yo ntee-ñwáè, ba neè lo ryoèñ-ñwáè, ba neè yo ñger wááwá, ba neè wo bfee wááwá, ker koñ nfúroè aèmboè wáè koèñ yoè nyor.”
English: He answered, You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè beèesi yáánïì. Geèe wa'a tá aè bo cu nfeseè.”
English: He said to him, You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè a m ce koèñ ená tá beèe a riñ ená yuu ce e bipshi anaè yi yu yáánïì, a bipshi neè Jisoès enáê, “Nfúraè yu ba nda seê?”
English: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, Who is my neighbor?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè m loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a ce duè aè rla' Jáèrikuè, a ka' baè' aè nduunjïì, a gwe mbe mmbo ñgaâa byáèá. Ñgaâa byáèá anaè a fapshïì buu ese ye wááwá, a lip ye, a cañse a duse, e noñ mbo a ba yïû ñkwe.
English: Jesus answered, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

Limbum: Ñwáè tañshi tañshïì moè' aè lo a ce suèu njep nduunjïì anaè aè nfeè' anaè foñ, a ka' yá ye, a lá' yi yu a caa a duê.
English: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' embe ntáè' Lávïì ye ye aè ka' vúè baè' mbo yá ye, a lá' a caa a duê.
English: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.

Limbum: Ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè ce e m ce duè aè mbeèp anaè foñ aè vú a búú a yeâ nduè, a ka' yá aèmboè e noèñ, nse yi koo ye.
English: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

Limbum: E du a su'si vi mnfur neè mruè', a fa mcáèp mbo, a kur. A ka' kur, a ko'si ye mbe yïì jaèaki', a lor a du aègho mbe hoètáêl, a ke'ni ye.
English: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, e fúr mbaèa baa, a fa neè ñwáè ce e m ce faè' mbo, a laa neè ye enáê, ‘Keè'ni ye boèñboñ, ka' ba ená mbaèa ca yi sáè, wáè kyeseè mbaèa mo', baná m be kúti tá m kúúsi yi neè wáè.’
English: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, 'Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.'

Limbum: Baná ñwáè efa beèe a mntaar ca ce aè ce kwaè'shi ená e m ba nfúr neè ñwáè ce e m gweè mbe mmbo byáèá naè aè m ba nda?”
English: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?

Limbum: Ñwáè ryá'ni mncir ca aè beesïì enáê, “Yu ñwáè ce e m koosimnse neè ye naè.” Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Duè gee wa' foñ.”
English: He said, He who showed mercy on him. Then Jesus said to him, Go and do likewise.

Limbum: Jisoès ba yi ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' naèti ce duè, e du a ba' aè rla' mo', njeñwáè moè' ce a m ce too ená Maataè aè konïì ye, a niñ a ye mbe ndaèp.
English: It happened as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

Limbum: E m túr nfúr yïì moè' a ce too ená Máèári. Máèári ca aè cu njeptii Tata Jisoès a ce yu'shi buu ce e m ce laèa.
English: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

Limbum: Maataè aè m láè ntee ba aè rfáèr byee. E vú a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Tataê, nfúraè aè maè'shi mfaè' wááwá ba mbe máâ mmboè, wáè ke' ce loèr aè yuu ka' a? Laèa neè ye ená e vú ja' máè.”
English: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, Lord, don't you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.

Limbum: Tata aè beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “Maataè, Maataè, mluè mi ce koo wáè aè buu magoèr,
English: Jesus answered her, Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

Limbum: geewa'a, yuu mo' yi yu ce ñwáè aè ba túr. Máèári aè ce yuu boèñboñ ce a be keèr koo ese ye ka'.”
English: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè moè' Jisoès aè ce loo mbe dïû' mo', a ka' loo mïìsi, ñwáè moè' efa múè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, yá'ni weèr aè rgeèe rloo aèmboè Joân aè m yá'ni ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu foñ naè.”
English: It happened, that when he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè ka' ce geèe rloo, weèe laa weenáê, ‘Taèr, tá lo rlii li ba rrara, tá yo kúú yi ká'.
English: He said to them, When you pray, say, 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on Earth, as it is in heaven.

Limbum: Fa weèr byee aè mnoèñ wááwá.
English: Give us day by day our daily bread.

Limbum: Foèosi weèr yeèr buu bbebep, njobeè' wer weèr e ke foèosi ñwáè wááwá ce e geèe yuu bebep neè weèr. Fa maè'shi tá rmoèoshïì li vú neè weèr ka'.’ ”
English: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.'

Limbum: E m ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yu nda efa weèe ce e ka' túr ñkar yïì, ñkar yïì anaè vú yá ye neè ntee tú', laa neè ye enáê, ‘Ñkaraè, foèosi máè mntu' baa btaar,
English: He said to them, Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

Limbum: njobeè' ñkaraè moè' ce e ce caèa caèa a niñ máè, máè túr yuu ce m tar ye aègho ka',’
English: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'

Limbum: ñgaèñ beesi embe ndaèp enáê, ‘Fa fa máè ñgá' ka', máè li' ya keèñ wáá, weèr boo wa weèe aè noèñte, aède' m ker nati mbekïì tá m bo fa yuu mo' neè wáè ka'.’
English: and he from within will answer and say, 'Don't bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can't get up and give it to you'?

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná ñgaèñ aè ka' tá naèti mbekïì fa neè ye njobeè' e yu ñkar yïì ka', baná e be naèti mbekïì fa ye yuu wááwá ce e ce roèo njobeè' e laèa a tambú.
English: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

Limbum: Baná m ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe bipshi tá a bo fa neè weèe. Roèo neè tá weèe bo yá. Kuèushi neè tá a bo múè' keèñ neè weèe.
English: I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

Limbum: Waè' muu ka' loo rbuèuñgúp, e fa ye ba ñgaa a?
English: Or if he asks for an egg, he won't give him a scorpion, will he?

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep, aè ka' riñ aè rfa buu bboèñboñ neè boo wee, yi ba yi ká aèmboè yeè Ta embe buèu. Mboè e be fa Yú' Rara neè beèe ce a loo ená e fa woweèe a?”
English: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ce fúr yú' nyúèrkaè' ce yi m geèe ñwáè moè' e ce laèa ka'. Yú' nyúèrkaè' anaè yi ka' fúú, ñwáè anaè aè ká' a ce laèa, ku' beèe ce a m ba aèfo a bááñgeèr seê.
English: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. It happened, when the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “Ñwáè ca ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe ba aè ñger Básábuèl ce e yu ñkúú byú' mnyúâmkaè'.”
English: But some of them said, He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a mooshïì ye, a laa neè ye ená e duñshi woweèe ncoèo embe buèu.
English: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ku riñ yuu ce woweèe a m ce kwaè'shi, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “To' yi ka' gapni, ke' ba cuâu mo'sir ka', baná to' anaè yi be saè'ñger. Ndap ka' gapni, ke' ba cuâu mo'sir ka', baná ndap anaè be gweè.
English: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

Limbum: Baná Sataèn ka' ce fúr Sataèn enjep beèe baná ñgaèpni yi yu nje yeâ nyoèr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, aède' yi to' yi táá aè njáâá ká? M ce laèa wa'a njobeè' weèe aè laèa ená m ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe ba aè ñger Básábuèl.
English: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

Limbum: M ka' ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enjep beèe ba aè ñger Básábuèl baná beèe wee a ke fúr yap byú' anaè ba aè ñger nda? Baná be kuè sa' ba yeè beèe sa' weèe.
English: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.

Limbum: Ka' ba ená m ce fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' ca wa'a, ntubo Nyúè ba njo, baná kúú Nyúè yi vúè neè weèe.
English: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come to you.

Limbum: Ñwáè ñger ce e túr buu bïìr yáánïì aè ka' ce keè'ni yïì ndap, baná yuu mo' embe yeâ ndaèp yi be duè aè yuu ka'.
English: When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

Limbum: Yú' bebep yi ke fúú enjep ñwáè, kashi aè ñgoâñ yuur aè rroèo dïû' rlúèshïì. Yi ka' roo yá ka', yi laa enáê, ‘M be kúti mbe ndaèp ce máè m fúú embo naè.’
English: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, 'I will turn back to my house from which I came out.'

Limbum: Yi ce kúti yá aèmboè a yár ndap, a kupshi e ce raa.
English: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

Limbum: Yi yá wa'a, ker du vú neè byú' mmo' vi saèambaê, ce vi bep a caa yi, a woweèe a niñ cu mbo, ñgaèñ misïì bep caa aèmboè e m ba entombïì naè.”
English: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa buu ca wa'a, njeñwáè moè' aè laa efa múè ku' beèe ca enáê, “Rboâñtu li yu neè ñwáè ce e m bi wáè, a nyoñsi wáè.”
English: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Mboâñtu mi yu ba neè beèe ce a ce yu' blaâa Nyúè, ce geèe yuu ce Nyúè ce laèa.”
English: But he said, On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.

Limbum: Ku' beèe a ka' vúè goèr, e laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñgúè beèe ca yu ñgúè bsaèrbuu. Woweèe a ce roèo ená a duñshi woweèe ncoèo, geewa'a, a be duèñshi woweèe ncoèo moè' caèa efa yïì Jonaè ka'.
English: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.

Limbum: AÈmboè Jonaè aè m ba ncoèo neè beâe aè to' Nenávïì naè, Muu Ñwáè ye ye be ba ncoèo neè ñgúè beâe seè'ni na.
English: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ce e m ba ñkúú embaè mbuèu ñgoèñ, be keè naèti táá aè noèñ mnsa', laèa ená ñgúè beèe yïû seè'ni na aè geèe yuu bebep njobeè' e m vúè yi ba aè njïìsaèp seê, aè ryu' blaèa bfee ce Solomúèn aè m ce laèa. Yá neè! Yuu mo' yi yu mbena seè'ni ce yi caèa Solomúèn.
English: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

Limbum: Beâe aè rla' Nenávïì a be keè naèti táá aè noâñ mnsa', laèa ená a ñgúè beèe yïû seè'ni aè geèe yuu bebep njobeè' Jonaè aè m feè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè woweèe, woweèe a kupse a ma' yaèp buu bbebep. Yá neè! Yuu mo' yi yu mbena seè'ni na ce yi caèa Jonaè.
English: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

Limbum: “AÈde' ñwáè cú' laêm, tár ba mbe dïì' ce beèe a be buu efa ryá káè lor ghee kúpshi aègho ka'. Ñwáè aè ka' cú' laêm, baná e be tár ba mbe tábuèr tá beèe ce a ce niñ mbe ndaèp a bo yá aèmboè ndap ce raa.
English: No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

Limbum: E ka' laèa mïìsi, ñwáè Farïìsi moè' aè be ye ená a ye a du yeñger. E du a niñ mbe ndaèp ñwáè anaè a cu aè nsheè a ye a bo yeñger.

English: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn't enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.

English: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

English: But there is nothing covered up, that will not be revealed, nor hidden, that will not be known.

English: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

English: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don't be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

English: He spoke a parable to them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth abundantly.

English: But God said to him, 'You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared--whose will they be?'

English: Consider the ravens: they don't sow, they don't reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

English: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

English: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' aè m ba mbo ce yú' mo' yi m ba njep ye a gee ye e yañ aè bfeè' ncoèp-waami-aè-rrúèú, a gú'mi seê, a moo aè rnaèa nyor mbekïì laèr.
English: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá ye, a ká' ye a laa neè ye enáê, “Njeñwáè, wáè luèñ efa yo yañ.”
English: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a lá mi mmbo mbe yeâ nduè, e ku naa nyor mbekïì, a yoñshi Nyúè.
English: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.

Limbum: Nyor aè m bep ñwáè ce e m ba ñwáâ ñgoèr embe ndaèp rloo njobeè' Jisoès aè m geèe njeñwáè anaè aè ke'seè nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, e laa neè beèe enáê, “Mnoèñ nfaè' buu vi yu ntuunfu. Baná weèe aè ba vúè aè mnoèñ anaè tá a gee tá weèe ke'se, ke' ba ená weèe vú ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè ka'.”
English: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!

Limbum: Tata aè beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa mbo'ni, waè' ñwáè moè' yu fa weâe mú ce e ke buu efa rfyáèá yi naè' káè yi jaèaki' embe ñka' nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè du aègho aè roè aè rnosïì a?
English: Therefore the Lord answered him, You hypocrites! Doesn't each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?

Limbum: AÈmboè yi ba ba yáánïì ená a fyáèáshi muu Abraèham ca ce Sataèn aè kur neè yañ aè bfeè' ncoèp-waami-aè-rrúèú na efa yi yañ nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè a?”
English: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?

Limbum: E ka' laèa ca, rïìtu yi koo beèe wááwá ce a m baèa ye, bár beèe wááwá a yu' rboèñ aè buu bboèñboñ wááwá ce e m geèe.
English: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Kúú Nyúè yi yu aèmboè ká? AÈde' m be'nïì yi aè káâ naè?
English: He said, What is the Kingdom of God like? To what shall I compare it?

Limbum: Yi yu aèmboè ñgúè mostaè ce ñwáè aè m byeè mbe yeâ ñka', yi lo a ku' a ba aè ce, bsiñ vi ba'rïì mndap aè mnta' efa gho.”
English: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky lodged in its branches.

Limbum: E ker laa enáê, “AÈde' m be'nïì kúú Nyúè ba aè káâ naè?
English: Again he said, To what shall I compare the Kingdom of God?

Limbum: Yi yu aèmboè yes ce njeñwáè aè m loèr a fe' mkúèñ bráâd mñkaâa btaar, a top aègho caar mkúèñ anaè mi ko'.”
English: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker nati a ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. A ka' ce duè, a ce jár aè mla' mñgoèrñgoèr ba aè mla' mká'ká', a ce yá'ni beèe.
English: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Tataê, waè' ku ba ba beèe múcaèr ce a be keè luèñ a? E laa neè woweèe enáê,
English: One said to him, Lord, are they few who are saved? He said to them,

Limbum: Gheèter neè niñ aè ncúèúndúè' ce yi yu yi'seè, njobeè' m ce suñ weèe máná beèe magoèr se a be gheèter aè rniñ, moèo laèr.
English: Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi mo' a ku vú aè nfeè' anaè a yá Jisoès a laa neè ye enáê, “Loâ aèfa du aè dïû' jáá njobeè' ñkúú Hároèd ce taè' aè ryú wáè.”
English: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Duè neè du suñ kwáèá anaè ená m be fúr byú' mnyúâmkaè' enje beèe, geèe tá ñgaâa byañ a ke'se ntïìni na ker ba aèyaèñseè, túè' moè' e keèr raa, tá m misi la rfaè'.
English: He said to them, Go and tell that fox, 'Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

Limbum: M be kuè ce jáèr ce duè ya yu ntïìni na, ba aèyaèñseè, ker ba aèyaèñseè caè njobeè' aède' ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè kwe aè dïì' mo' jáá caa efa aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm ka'.
English: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can't be that a prophet perish outside of Jerusalem.'

Limbum: Jáèrusaláèm, Jáèrusaláèm! Weèe ce weâe ke yúshi ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, ce túúshi beèe ce a tuu ená a vú yá weèe neè bluèr. Yu nfeè' sá' ce máè koèñ aè rbaashi boo wee aèmboè ma ñgúp e ke ku'ri boo naè, weèe aè koñ ka'.
English: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè moè', Jisoès aè du aè ryeñgeèr mbe ndaèp ñwáè Farïìsi moè' ce e m ba ñwáè rlii, beèe a ce ker ye boèñboñ seê.
English: It happened, when he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching him.

Limbum: Mbañruèñwáè moè' ce bko' vi m koo ye aè táá njeptii Jisoès.
English: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè ñwáè Farïìsi anaè ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir enáê, “Ncir yi byemi ená seèe gee tá ñwáè yañ ke'se nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè káè yi byemi ka'?”
English: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?

Limbum: Woweèe a laa yuu ka'. Jisoès aè koo ñwáè anaè a gee e ke'seè, a laa neè ye ená e duê.
English: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

Limbum: E ka' geèe wa' wáá, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Moè' efa weèe aè ka' túr muu mbañruè káè naè' áè, e gwe njep rwee nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, aède' e caasïì nfeè' efa rfúr enjo a?”
English: He answered them, Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn't immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?

Limbum: Woweèe a m túr yuu laèa ka'.
English: They couldn't answer him regarding these things.

Limbum: E ka' yá aèmboè beèe ce a m be naè a ce tañni aè rcu ba mbe mnta' bboèñboñ, e ma' ñgaèa neè woweèe enáê,
English: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

Limbum: “Ñwáè aè ka' be wáè aè Ñkaâ' bguèu, aè fa cu ba mbe nta' yïû boèñboñ ka', njobeè' aède' yi ku ba ená ñgaèñ aè ba be ñwáè moè' ce e yu ñwáâ ñgoèr neè wáè.
English: When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don't sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

Limbum: E m ker laa foñ neè ñwáè ce e ba be ye naè enáê, “Wáè ka' fár byee vïû neèmootïì, káè vïû aè mbuèuñkuèr áè, aè fa be ba bkar wo káè bfúr wo, káè beèe ce weèe woweèe aè raète, káè ñgaâa mbaèa ce weèe woweèe ce cu aè dïû' mo'sir ka'. Wáè ka' be ba woweèe baná aède' woweèe foñ a ku be wáè, tá yi ba seè'ni ená woweèe a laè' yoè ntar ce wáè m tar woweèe aègho naè.
English: He also said to the one who had invited him, When you make a dinner or a supper, don't call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

Limbum: Wáè ka' ce geèe ñkaè', aè be ba ñgaâa fuèp, ba beèe ce a kepñger, ba mntáèñ, ba beèe ce a feèp.
English: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

Limbum: Wáè ka' gee wa' baná aè be ba ñwáè rboâñtu njobeè' woweèe a túr yuu mo' ce aède' a la' wáè aègho ka'. Nyúè be keè laè' wáè aè nfeè' ce beèe ce a yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè a be keè fúú efa rkwe.”
English: and you will be blessed, because they don't have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa múè beèe ce a m cute a sir tábuèr naè aè ka' yu' wa'a, a laa neè ye enáê, “Rboâñtu li yu neè ñwáè ce e be keè ye ñkaè' embe nto' Nyúè embe buèu.”
English: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, Blessed is he who will feast in the Kingdom of God!

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè m ce geèe ma njáèá ñkaè' mo' goèr, a be ku' beèe seê.
English: But he said to him, A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

Limbum: Nfeè' ñkaè' aè ka' gháá, e tuu yïì ñwáè rfaè' ená e du laa neè beèe ce e m be naè ená woweèe a vúse, njobeè' e fár buu ñkaè' a misïî.
English: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, 'Come, for everything is ready now.'

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá aè ká' a ce suñ yuu ce e be jepsi ye efa rduè ñkaè' anaè. Ñwáè entombïì aè laa enáê, ‘Máè yuu ñkúè, aè ba yïì ce m be kuè duè ba seè'ni na duè yá aèmboè ñkúè anaè yu. Duè laa neè ye ená ntee yi fa yañ lá ye ka'.’
English: They all as one began to make excuses. The first said to him, 'I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.'

Limbum: Ñwaè rfaé’ aè kùtí a suñ buu ce woweèe a m laèa neè yii masaè. Ntee yi yañ masaè ñwaè ndap ca, e laa neè yii ñwaè rfaé’ ca enáâ, ‘Duè neè aè btase ba aè btar mndap vù neè ñgaâa fuèp, ba beèe ce a kepñger, ba beèe ce a koo’, ker ba mntàáñ.’
English: That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.'

Limbum: Ñwaè rfaé’ anaè sè sùtí, a laè enáâ, ‘Mmaâ, máè geèe yu ce wáè laèa. Ndap aè ba ruu ka’.’
English: The servant said, 'Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.'

Limbum: Ñwaè rfaé’ aè kùtí a suñ buu ce woweèe a m laèa neè yii masaè. Ntee yi yañ masaè ñwaè ndap ca, e laa neè yii ñwaè rfaé’ ca enáâ, ‘Duè neè aè btase ba aè btar mndap vù neè ñgaâa fuèp, ba beèe ce a kepñger, ba beèe ce a feèp, ker ba mntàáñ.’
English: That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.'

Limbum: Ñwaè rfaé’ anaè sè sùtí, a laè enáâ, ‘Masaè, máè geèe yuu ce wáè laèa. Ndap aè ba ruu ka’.’
English: The servant said, 'Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.'

Limbum: E laa neè ye enáê, ‘Keèr du aè mnduunjïì aè múè rla' ker ba aè mú mnduunjïû aè mñkúè, koo beèe aè ñger, tá a vúê, tá yaè ndap bo ruu.
English: The lord said to the servant, 'Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.'

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná aède’ moè’ efa beèe ce a be anaè joo yuu kùù cubu aè ya fikaè’ ka’.
English: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.

Limbum: Ma kúr beèe yi m ce jáèr a Jisoès weèe, e karsïì nyor a laa neè woweèe enáê,
English: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

Limbum: “Ñwáè aè ka' vú a máâ mbuèu, ke' baa yïì ta ba yïì maê, ba ñgwa yïì, ba boo vi, ba bfúr vi ba bjar vi, ker ba neè yïì nyor-ñwáè foñ ka', baná aède' ñgaèñ ba ñwáè yá'ni yaè buu ka'.
English: If anyone comes to me, and doesn't disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can't be my disciple.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè' ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep a m ce vúè aètútú neè Jisoès aè ryu' buu ce e m ce yá'ni.
English: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a ká' a ce de'ñger a ce laèa enáê, “Ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep a vúè, ñwáè ca aè konïì woweèe, a ce yeñger a woweèe.”
English: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.

Limbum: A ka' laèa wa'a, Jisoès aè ma' ñgaèa neè woweèe enáê,
English: He told them this parable.

Limbum: “Ñwáè efa weâe mú ce e ka' túr njeèe rjeèe, moè' efa gho bú, e ke' ma'shïì njeèe yïû ncoèp-búè'ú-aè-mmbúè'ú aè rtuèu duè roèo yïì ce e bú naè, caar yá ka', a nda?
English: Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn't leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

Limbum: E m ker ma' ñgaèa moè' enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè m túr boo mmbañruè a baa.
English: He said, A certain man had two sons.

Limbum: Ñwáâ ñká' aè laa neè yïì ta enáê, ‘Yaè taê, gaèp bti' fa wa.’ E ka' laèa wa'a, e lor yïì buu a gap neè woweèe.
English: The younger of them said to his father, 'Father, give me my share of your property.' He divided his livelihood between them.

Limbum: Mú mnoèñ vi ka' tuuse, ñwáâ ñká' aè lor buu wááwá ce e m túr, a du aè to' mo' ce yi m ba aènjïìsaèp seê, a jarsi buu anaè aèfo aè buu bcicïì.
English: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

Limbum: E ka' jarsi buu anaè wáá, njeè aè koo aè to' anaè seê, e ke' túr yuu ye ka'.
English: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

Limbum: E du a ce cu a ñwáè moâ' aè to' anaè, ñwáè anaè aè tuu ye ená e du aè mñkúè du ce nyañ yi ñkuânyaèm.
English: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

Limbum: E m ce koèñ aè rye ka' byee ñkuânyaèm, ñwáè moè' aè ke' fa ye ka'.
English: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

Limbum: Bfee vi ka' vúè ye mbo, e laa neè yïì nyor enáê, ‘Ñgaâa mfaè' ce yaè ta e ke laè', ce a ke ye byee vi ce gha' woweèe, a yu beèe a m sá', máè cu ya mbena ce kwe njeè!
English: But when he came to himself he said, 'How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough to spare, and I'm dying with hunger!

Limbum: M be naèti duè yá yaè taê, laèa neè ye enáê, Yaè taê, máè geèe yuu bebep neè Nyúè, ba neè wáè foñ,
English: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.

Limbum: m ker ghááte ce aède' aè too máè ená muu woè ka', loèr máè tá m ba ba aèmboè yoè ñwáè rfaè' moè'.’
English: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.'

Limbum: E ka' laèa neè yïì nyor wa' wáá, a nati a du a yá yïì taê. A ka' nyáá aènjïìsaèp, yïì ta aè yá ye, a koosimnse neè ye, a cañ a baa ye nje nyoèr, a nyo'shi ye.
English: He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

Limbum: Weâe mïìsi wáá, vú neè naè' ce e ruusi, sáá, tá seèe ye ce lu'shi,
English: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat, and celebrate;

Limbum: njobeè' muu waè ca aè m kwe a ker kúti nteèe, e m bú, a ker yááti.’ Woweèe a ka' geèe wa' wáá, a ká' a ce ye ñkaè'.
English: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.' They began to celebrate.

Limbum: “Muu nlee aè m ba yi aè mñkúè aè nfeè' anaè, a ka' vúè baè' aètútú, a yu' aèmboè beèe a ce bu' mncuèu a ce bii bii.
English: Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

Limbum: Yi yu yáánïì ená seèe gee ñkaè', lu'shi njobeè' nfúroè ca aè m kwe a ker kúti nteèe, e m bú a ker yááti.”’
English: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.'

Limbum: E m ker ma' ñgaèa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Ñwáè mbaèa moè' aè m ba a túr yïì ñwáè rfaè' moè', beèe a vú a suñ ye ená yïì ñwáè rfaè' anaè ce jarsi yïì buu.
English: He also said to his disciples, There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

Limbum: E ká' ye a laa neè ye enáê, ‘Yuu ce máè yu' a kuu wáè naè yu ba ká? Beè' yaè buu wááwá, sañ tá m bo rïìñ aèmboè vi yu, njobeè' aè be keèr ba yaè ñwáè rfaè' ka'.’
English: He called him, and said to him, 'What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.'

Limbum: Ñwáè rfaè' ca aè laa neè yïì nyor enáê, ‘Yaè masaè be fúr máè efa rfaè'. M be geèe má ká? M túr ñger aè rfaè' nsuu ka', rïìtu yi ce koo máè aè rloo buu. M be geèe má ká?
English: The manager said within himself, 'What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don't have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

Limbum: Baná m ce suñ weèe máná weèe lor wee bkuè' ce vi bep na, koo bkar aègho, e ba aè nfeè' ce bkuè' anaè vi ker ba ka', tá a bo koni weèe mbe rla' ce a ke cu mbo nfeseè.
English: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

Limbum: “Ñwáè ce e ka' riñ aè rfyá' aè yuu ce yi yu múcaèr neè mini-ñwáè, baná aède' e fyá' aè yïû goèr neè mini-ñwáè foñ. Ñwáè ce e ka' riñ aè rfyá' aè yuu ce yi yu múcaèr ka', baná aède' e riñ aè rfyá' aè yïû goèr foñ ka'.
English: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

Limbum: Baná wáè ka' tá rïìñ aè rfyá' aè bkuè' ce vi bep na neè mini-ñwáè ka', aède' fa nda bkuè' mini neè wáè.
English: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

Limbum: Wáè ka' tá fyá' aè yuu ce yu yïû ñwáè moè' boèñboñ ka', aède' fa nda wáè yuu ce yu yoè neè ñwáè?
English: If you have not been faithful in that which is another's, who will give you that which is your own?

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè rfaè' fa' neè mmasaè bbaa ka'. E ka' gee wa'a, baná e be baèa moè', koèñ moè', yu'ni neè moè', loèr moè' aè yuu ka'. AÈde' aè fa' neè Nyúè ker fa' neè mbaèa ka'.”
English: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. You aren't able to serve God and mammon.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' yu' wa'a, a vúshi ye njobeè' woweèe a m koèñ mbaèa seê.
English: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “A weèe beèe ce weèe ce duèñshi ená weèe yu beâe mini, geewa'a, Nyúè rïìñ yuu ce yi yu njep weâe mntee wááwá. Yuu ce beèe a loèr aè yuu goèr yu yuu ce Nyúè baèa.
English: He said to them, You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

Limbum: Buu ce a sañ mbe ñwaâ' mncir ba mbe mñwaâ' ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè vi m túr ñger a ba' mbe nfeè' yïì Joân ñwáè baèptir beèe. Ká' ese aè nfeè' anaè a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè, ñwáè wááwá aè ce gheèter aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè anaè aè ñger.
English: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

Limbum: Geewa'a, yi yu aètáèr neè rbuu ba nshe aè rmïì, neè yïì ce ená a co' mbúè nlaèa moè' embe Ñwaè' Mncir.
English: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' juu ñgwa yïì, lor ñgwa moè' baná e koo ñgwa ñwáè moè'. Ñwáè ce e ka' lor njeñwáè ce nduu aè juèu, baná e koo ñgwa ñwáè moè' foñ.
English: Everyone who divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

Limbum: “Ñwáè mbaèa moè' aè m ba ce e m ce suèsi nyor neè bcáâ' mbaèa, a ce yu' rboèñ neè yïì nyor aè mnoèñ wááwá.
English: Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená ma beè'teè yi yu mbe seâe tar, tá ñwáè ce e koèñ aè rtuu yá weèe njo naè bo túr njïì ka', tá ñwáè ce e koèñ aè rtuu yá weèr mbena bo túr njïì foñ ka'.’
English: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that none may cross over from there to us.'

Limbum: Ñwáè mbaèa ca aè laa enáê, ‘Yaè taê, baná m ce bu' mmbo neè wáè ená aè tuu Lasoèroès mbe ndaèp yaè taê,
English: He said, 'I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father's house;

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, ‘Yi yu wa' ka', ta Abraèhaêm, ñwáè aè ka' lo ba embaè yir, du suñ woweèe, woweèe a ku kupse ma' yaèp buu bbebep.’
English: He said, 'No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Buu ce aède' vi gee ñwáè gee yuu bebep vi be kuè ce vúè, geewa'a, ndoèo be co' ñwáè ce buu anaè vi ka' vú njo' ye.
English: He said to the disciples, It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

Limbum: Yi yu aèndeèe ená a loèr ñgoè' luèr cúú ye kuè ndoñ, lor ye ma' njep rdip rgoèr, neè yïì ce ená e gee moè' efa boo bká'ká' ca tá e gee yuu bebep.
English: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

Limbum: Baná weèe ke'ni wee btu. Nfúroè aè ka' gee yuu bebep, aè lapnïì ye. E ka' kupse, ma' yi yuu bebep anaè, aè foosïì ye.
English: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

Limbum: E ka' gee yuu bebep neè wáè aè noâñ mo'sir ñkaèraè' saèambaê, ce vúè ce laèa neè wáè aè ñkaèraè' saèamba anaè enáê, ‘Máè kupse a ma' ya yuu bebep,’ aè foosïì ye.”
English: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, 'I repent,' you shall forgive him.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu a laa neè Tata enáê, “Kuè'si ler rbyemïì.”
English: The apostles said to the Lord, Increase our faith.

Limbum: Tata aè beesïì enáê, “Le rbyemïì li ba ba múcaèr se aèmboè ñgúè mostaè, weèe aè ba laèa neè ma ce ca enáê, ‘Co'ti embe na táá njep rdip rgoèr,’ tá yi ku yu'ni neè weèe.
English: The Lord said, If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, 'Be uprooted, and be planted in the sea,' and it would obey you.

Limbum: “Yi ka' ba ená moè' efa weèe túr ñwáè rfaè' ce e ce faè' nsuu, káè e ce cïìñ ba njeèe neè ye áè, e ka' kúti efa mñkúè, waè' aè be laèa neè ye enáê, ‘Vúè cárcár vú cu aè nsheè yeñger’ a?
English: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say, when he comes in from the field, 'Come immediately and sit down at the table,'

Limbum: AÈmboè aè be laèa neè ye ba enáê, ‘Fáèr máè byee, yar cáâ' rfaè' caasi byee neè máè tá m ye no yuu, máâ mïìsi wáá, wá wáè ka' ye yuu, ker no yuu’ a?
English: and will not rather tell him, 'Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me, while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink'?

Limbum: Waè' aè be yoèñshi ñwáè rfaè' anaè njobeè' e ba gee yuu ce wáè ba laa ená e gee a?
English: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

Limbum: Baná wee weèe foñ aè ka' gee buu wááwá ce a laèa ená weèe geêe, weèe laa weenáê, ‘Weèr ku ba ba ñgaâa mfaè', weèr aè ku gee ba yuu ce weèr aè ba geèe.’ ”
English: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, 'We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' naèti ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a caa njep ndeèe ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè ba Galeèleê.
English: It happened as he was on his way to Jerusalem, that he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

Limbum: E ka' ce niñ aè mú rla' mo', ñgaâa yañ msaèasïì beèe nrúêú a vú aè ryá ye. A ka' vúè, a táá encaèñ seê,
English: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

Limbum: a waa, a laa enáê, “Masaè Jisoès, koosimnse neè weèr.”
English: They lifted up their voices, saying, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!

Limbum: E ka' yá woweèe, a laa enáê, “Duè neè du duñshi wee mnyor neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì.” Woweèe a ka' ce duè, a ke'se aè nduunjïì.
English: When he saw them, he said to them, Go and show yourselves to the priests. It happened that as they went, they were cleansed.

Limbum: Moè' efa woweèe aè ka' yá ená e keè'se, a kúti a ce yoèp mbekïì seê, a ce yoèñshi Nyúè.
English: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

Limbum: E m gweè njeptii Jisoès a yoñshi ye. Ñwáè anaè aè m ba ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè.
English: He fell on his face at Jesus' feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

Limbum: Jisoès aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “AÈmboè beèe ce a ba ke'se a ba ba beèe nrúú a? Beèe mbúè'ú a yu ba fá?
English: Jesus answered, Weren't the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

Limbum: Waè' ñwáè moè' aè ba ker ba ce aède' e ba vú yoñshi Nyúè caa efa ñwáè nfuu ca ka' a?”
English: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this stranger?

Limbum: E m laèa neè ye enáê, “Naèti mbekïì du yo yu, lo rbyemïì li geèe wáè, wáè ke'seè.”
English: Then he said to him, Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a m bipshi neè Jisoès ená kúú Nyúè yi be keè vúè ba aè se'ká lá. Jisoès aè beesïì a laa enáê, “Kúú Nyúè yi be vúè aè njáèá njïì ce beèe a ce yá neè mmir ka'.
English: Being asked by the Pharisees when the Kingdom of God would come, he answered them, The Kingdom of God doesn't come with observation;

Limbum: AÈde' beèe a laa enáê, ‘A yi mbena’ na, káè enáê, ‘A yi njena’ na ka', njobeè' kúú Nyúè yi yu fa weâe mú.”
English: neither will they say, 'Look, here!' or, 'Look, there!' for behold, the Kingdom of God is within you.

Limbum: E m laèa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Be keè ba aè nfeè' moè' tá weèe ja'ni mnyor weená weèe aè ba yá noèñ mo' efa mnoèñ ce Muu Ñwáè be keè vúè neè ñger-ñwáè, keè' yá ka'.
English: He said to the disciples, The days will come, when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

Limbum: Beèe a be laèa neè weèe enáê, ‘Yáê, a ye njena’ na, káè ená ‘Yáê, a ye mbena’ na. Weèe fa naèti duè a waâp mbuèu ka',
English: They will tell you, 'Look, here!' or 'Look, there!' Don't go away, nor follow after them,

Limbum: njobeè' noèñ yïû Muu Ñwáè yi be ba aèmboè mbeèñ ce e ke baèp rbuu li raa, káâ' a mbuèu rbuu mo' du ba' aè rmo' naè.
English: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of the one part under the sky, shines to the other part under the sky; so will the Son of Man be in his day.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, e be káè' entombïì yá ñgá' goèr seê, tá ñgúè beâe seè'ni na a kani ye.
English: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

Limbum: Nfeè' yïì Muu Ñwáè be ba aèmboè nfeè' yïì Nowa aè m ba naè.
English: As it happened in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.

Limbum: Beèe a m ce ye buu, a ce no buu, mmbañruè a ce loèr bbyeèñge, bbyeèñge a ce duèse bguèu, ku ce geèe wa' caar a ba' nyúè ce Nowa aè m niñ mbe keñ, mdip mi ruu aè ñgoèñ a yúshi woweèe wááwá naè.
English: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

Limbum: Yi m ku ba aè nfeè' yïì Lot wa' foñ. Beèe a m ce ye buu, a ce no buu, a ce yuu buu, a ce fyeèni buu, a ce byeè buu, a ce baè'ri mndap.
English: Likewise, even as it happened in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ ce Lot aè m fúú aè rla' Sodoèm, mor ba bluâr mor vi she a suu embe buèu aèmboè mbeèñ e ke gweè naè, a yúshi woweèe wááwá.
English: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky, and destroyed them all.

Limbum: Yi be kuè ba wa'a, aè noèñ ce Muu Ñwáè be yááti naè.
English: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

Limbum: Ka' ba aè noèñ anaè, ñwáè aè ka' ba mbe tu ndap, yïì buu ba mbe ndaèp, e fa keèr suèu embo aè rloèr buu anaè ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' ke ba aè mñkúè foñ, e fa keèr kúti aè rloèr yuu mo' embo ka'.
English: In that day, he who will be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

Limbum: Kuushi neè ñgwa Loêt.
English: Remember Lot's wife!

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce boñshi li ryoèñ, baná e be bá li. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá boñshi li ryoèñ ka', baná e be koni li.
English: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe ená be keè ba neètú' anaè, tá beèe a mmbaa a noñ mbe bkuu, tá a lor moè', ma'shi moè'.
English: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. The one will be taken, and the other will be left.

Limbum: Bbyeèñge a baa a be keè ce goè' baa aèbee, tá a lor moè', ma'shi mo'.
English: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken, and the other will be left.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Tataê, ca yi be keè koni ba fá?” E beesïì enáê, “E ke ba faèdïì' ce gúâú yuu yi yu, baná bjïìkaawaè vi be kaari aèfo.”
English: They, answering, asked him, Where, Lord? He said to them, Where the body is, there will the vultures also be gathered together.

Limbum: E m maè' ñgaèa neè woweèe aè ryá'ni woweèe ená woweèe a ba ce loo aè nfeè' wááwá, keè' ce koosi bsáè aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
English: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,

Limbum: E m maè' ñgaèa anaè enáê, “Ñwáè nsa' mnsa' moè' aè m ba aè rla' mo' a ce wáp Nyúè ka', a ker ce loèr beèe aè yuu ka'.
English: saying, There was a judge in a certain city who didn't fear God, and didn't respect man.

Limbum: Ñgwañkúñwáè moè' aè m ba aè rla' anaè foñ. E m ku ce vúè ce bu' mbo neè ye, ce laèa enáê, ‘Jaè' máè sa' mnsa' ce weèr yaè ñwáè bbaèa túr na, teni mi yáánïì.’
English: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, 'Defend me from my adversary!'

Limbum: Ñwáè nsa' mnsa' ca aè ku ce kani. A ka' loè a laa neè yïì nyor enáê, ‘Ka' m ce wáp Nyúè ka', a ce loèr beèe aè yuu ka' wa'a,
English: He wouldn't for a while, but afterward he said to himself, 'Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,

Limbum: aèmboè njeñwáè ca aè fa máè ñgá' goèr na, m be sa' mi mnsa', teni mi yáánïì, buwa'laèr e ku ce vúè, tá m misi sáè.’ ”
English: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.'

Limbum: Tata aè laa enáê, “Yu' yuu ce ñwáè nsa' mnsa' ce e m ba ñwáè mnaèñ na aè m laèa.
English: The Lord said, Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

Limbum: Mboè Nyúè be sa' mnsa' tá vi ba yáánïì aè mbeèp yïì beèe ce a ce war neè ye neèmootïì ba neètú' foñ a? Waè' aède' e caasïì nfeè' efa rteni wap mnsa' a?
English: Won't God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná, e be sa' wap mnsa' tá vi ba yáánïì aè mbeèp yaèp, sa' vi cárcár seê. Ka' yi yu wa'a, waè' Muu Ñwáè be keè vúè, tá e yá beèe enjep ñgoèñ ce a byemi, aèmboè a táá tatap a?”
English: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker ma' ñgaèa neè beèe mo' ce a m rïìñ yap ená woweèe a yu beâe byáánïì, a ce fyá' beèe mo' aè yuu ka' enáê,
English: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.

Limbum: “beèe a mmbaa a m duè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè rgeèe rloo, moè' aè ba ñwáè Farïìsïî, moè' aè ba ñwáè ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè'.
English: Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

Limbum: Beèe a m vúè neè bghaèrbeèe foñ ená Jisoès joo woweèe, ghoni woweèe. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yá wa'a, a lapni beèe anaè.
English: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ká' woweèe a laa enáê, “Maè'shi neè tá boo ca a vú yá máè. Weèe fa jepsi woweèe ka' njobeè' kúú Nyúè yi yu ba neè beèe ce a yu aèmboè boo ca.
English: Jesus summoned them, saying, Allow the little children to come to me, and don't hinder them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè ce e ka' tá koo kúú Nyúè aèmboè muu ñká' ka' baná aède' ñgaèñ niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè anaè ka'.”
English: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn't receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.

Limbum: Ñwáè rsa' moè' aè m bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì ce mboèñmboñ, yuu ce aède' m gee ka' koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè yu ká?”
English: A certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÂ too máè ená ñwáâ mboèñmboñ njoká? Ñwáè moè' yu ñwáâ mboèñmboñ ka', ñwáâ mboèñmboñ ku ba Nyúè caè'caè'.
English: Jesus asked him, Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one--God.

Limbum: To aè ku riñ mncir wááwá. Fa koo ñgwa ñwáè káè noèñ weèe nduu ñwáè ka', fa yú ñwáè ka', fa yáèá ka', fa táá njïìnsa' mnaèñ ka', yu'ni neè yoè ma ba yoè taê.”
English: You know the commandments: 'Don't commit adultery,' 'Don't murder,' 'Don't steal,' 'Don't give false testimony,' 'Honor your father and your mother.'

Limbum: E laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Máè láè mncir ca wááwá ká' aè nfeè' ce máè m ba muu ñká'.”
English: He said, I have observed all these things from my youth up.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu' wa'a, a laa neè ye enáê, “Yuu yi báti yi mo'sir ce wáè ba geèe. Fyeèni buu wááwá ce a túr, lor mbaèa efa gho, gapshi neè ñgaâa fuèp, tá aè bo túr bkuè' mbe buèu. Wáâ geèe wa' wáá, vú fa máâ mbuèu.”
English: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.

Limbum: E ka' yu' wa'a, nyor aè bep ye seê, njobeè' e m túr ku' buu seê.
English: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá wa'a, a laa enáê, “Yi yu tatap seê, neè ñgaâa mbaèa aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.
English: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

Limbum: Yi yu aètáèr neè kaèmál aè rtose nje rlir nsaèraè' neè ñwáè mbaèa aè rniñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.”
English: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m yu' yuu ce e m laèa na, a bipshïì enáê, “Baná ñwáè ce aède' e luñ yu ba nda?”
English: Those who heard it said, Then who can be saved?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Yuu ce yi yu btatap se neè ñwáè, yi yu aètáèr neè Nyúè.”
English: But he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Yáê, weèr aè maè'shi yeèr buu wááwá a vú fa wáâ mbuèu.”
English: Peter said, Look, we have left everything, and followed you.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè ce e ka' ma'shi li rla' káè ñgwa yïì áè, káè bfúr vi áè, káè yïì ma ba yïì ta áè, káè boo vi áè, njobeè' kúú Nyúè,
English: He said to them, Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the Kingdom of God's sake,

Limbum: baná ñgaèñ be koni ku' buu se aè nfeè' e seè'ni na, keèr koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè aè nfeè' ce e bii ka' vúè.”
English: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.

Limbum: E loèr beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, a lá'si nyor a woweèe, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yáê, seèe ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm tá buu wááwá ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m sañ aèmboè Muu Ñwáè naè, vi bo ghááte njo.
English: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

Limbum: A be fa ye mbe mmbo beèe enje jáá. Woweèe a be jaèasi ye, cáp ye, ce ye neè mce.
English: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

Limbum: A be lïìp ye neè byáánsoè, yú ye, mnoèñ vi ba btaar tá e fúú efa rkwe.”
English: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m rïìñ yuu mo' efa buu ce e m laèa anaè ka'. A m súèti mbuèu efa yuu ce e m laèa anaè ese woweèe, woweèe a ke' riñ yuu ce e m ce laèa anaè ka'.
English: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn't understand the things that were said.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m loè a ce duè, a ka' baè' aètútú rla' Jáèrikuè, nfeèp moè' a cu aèwaâa nduunjïì a ce loo buu.
English: It happened, as he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

Limbum: E ka' yu' aèmboè kúr beèe a ce caèa, e bipshïì ená yu ba ká lá?
English: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

Limbum: A suñ ye enáê, “Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt ce caèa.”
English: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

Limbum: E waa, a laa enáê, “Jisoès, Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè máè.”
English: He cried out, Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ba yap entombïì naè, a lapnïì ye a laa ená e cu nyañ. E ker misi yi yu a waa goèr a laa enáê, “Muu Dávïìd, koosimnse neè máè.”
English: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, You son of David, have mercy on me!

Limbum: Jisoès aè táá, a laa ená a vú neè ñwáè anaè fa neè ye. E ka' vúè baè' aètútú, e bipshïì neè ye enáê,
English: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

Limbum: “Wáè ce koèñ ená m gee máká neè wáè?” E beesïì enáê, “Tataê, m ce koèñ máná aè gee tá m ker yá buu.”
English: What do you want me to do? He said, Lord, that I may see again.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Yá buu, lo rbyemïì li geèe wáè, wáè ke'seè.”
English: Jesus said to him, Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.

Limbum: E ku ká' a ce yá buu, a nati a du a yeâ mbuèu, a ce yoèñshi Nyúè. Beèe wááwá a ka' yá, a yoñshi Nyúè foñ.
English: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m niñ aè rla' Jáèrikuè a to'ni rla' anaè a ce caèa.
English: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba aè rla' anaè a ce too ená Saèkiyoès. E m ba tu neè ñgaâa ñkuèu mbaâa baèraè', a túr mbaèa foñ seê.
English: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

Limbum: E m ce gheèter aè ryá njáèá ñwáè ce Jisoès yu, a yá ye ka' njobeè' e m ba ñwáâ nlúè'shi, kúr beèe a tá'shïì ye.
English: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn't because of the crowd, because he was short.

Limbum: E cañ a du entombïì, a ko' mbe ce Sïìkamoè ená Jisoès e ce caèa naè, e bo yá.
English: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was to pass that way.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' vúè baè' mbe dïì' ce ce anaè yi m ba, a ke' mbekïì, a laa neè ye enáê, “Saèkiyoès, suèu embe ce anaè cárcár, njobeè' m be kuè noèñ mbe wáâ ndaèp ntïìni na.”
English: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.

Limbum: Saèkiyoès aè suu embe ce anaè cárcár, a koni ye neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè.
English: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a ka' yá yuu ce yi m koni na, a ká' a ce de'ñger ená, e duè aè rnoèñ mbe ndaèp ñwáè ñgeèe buu bbebep.
English: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.

Limbum: Saèkiyoès aè natïì mbekïì a laa neè Tata enáê, “Tataê, yáê, m be to'ni yaè buu tïìtïìyáánïì, fa mbeèp moè' neè ñgaâa fuèp. Ka' ba ená máè m koo yuu ñwáè moè' aè ñger, baná m be laè' yi yuu ce máè m koo anaè bkaèñ kyeèe.”
English: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ndap ca aè luèñ ntïìni njobeè' ñwáè ca ye ye yu muu Abraèham foñ.
English: Jesus said to him, Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
