Limbum: Yi yu ená Muu Ñwáè aè m vúè aè rroèo beèe ce a m bú, tá e bo geèe tá woweèe a luêñ.”
English: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce yu'shi yuu ce Jisoès aè m laèa na, Jisoès aè ker ma' ñgaèa neè woweèe njobeè' e m baè' aètútú rla' Jáèrusaláèm, woweèe a ce kwaè'shi ená nfeè' be tuuse ka' tá kúú Nyúè yi ká'.
English: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that the Kingdom of God would be revealed immediately.

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Muu ñkúú aè m duè aè to' mo' aènjïìsaèp seê, ená a bo duè ghar ye aè ñkúú tá e ka' kúti.
English: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

Limbum: E m ká' yi ñgaâa mfaè' beèe nrúêú, a fa woweèe ncúèkïì moè'sir, moè'sir, a laa enáê, ‘Geèe neè ntaa neè mbaèa ca caar tá m ke kúti.’
English: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, 'Conduct business until I come.'

Limbum: Yïì beèe aè m baèa ye seê, a tuu beèe a yeâ mbuèu ená a du laa neè ñgaâa ghar kúú enáê, ‘Weèr ce koèñ ená ñwáè ca ba yeèr ñkúú ka'.’
English: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, 'We don't want this man to reign over us.'

Limbum: A m ku ghar ye aè ñkúú. E ka' kúti a ká' ñgaâa mfaè' ce e m fa mbaèa neè woweèe naè, tá e bo yá ená woweèe a m di' gee ntaa neè mbaèa anaè a ye sá' aè mbaèa sá' lá.
English: It happened when he had come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

Limbum: Ñwáè embenjïì mo aè vúê, a laa enáê, ‘Masaè, máè geèe ntaa neè ncúèkïì ce wáè m fa neè máè naè, a ye sá' aè ncúèkïì taê.’
English: The second came, saying, 'Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.' Luke Luêk 19 19 E laa neè ye foñ enáê, ‘Máè fa wáè ñger aè rsa' mla' taê.’ So he said to him, 'And you are to be over five cities.'

Limbum: Ñwáè rfaè' moè' aè ka' vúè, a laa yi enáê, ‘Masaè, a yo mbaèa caè na. Máè m ku kur njep kaâa cáè', a kupshi a noñsïî.
English: Another came, saying, 'Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

Limbum: Máè m ce wáp wáè seê, njobeè' aè yu ñwáâ ntatap. Wáâ ke kep yuu ce wáè m byeè ka', kap yuu ce wáè m ñwañ ka'.’
English: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn't lay down, and reap that which you didn't sow.'

Limbum: Yïì masaè aè laa neè ye enáê, ‘AÈ yu ñwáè rfaè' ce mbembep. M be loèr nlaèa ce yi fúú ekuè wáâ cuèu na, sa' wáè aègho. Wáè m yi wáná a máè ñwáâ ntatap ce má ke yá yuu ce ñwáâ jáá aè láè ku loêr, máâ yá yuu ce ñwáâ jáá aè byeè ku kep.
English: He said to him, 'Out of your own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn't lay down, and reaping that which I didn't sow.

Limbum: ‘M ce suñ weèe máná ñwáè ce e ka' túr yuu, baná a be keèr fa ye buu moè'. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá túr yuu ka', baná a be koo ka' mú yïì ce e túr naè ese ye.
English: For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a baèa máè naè, ce a m ce koèñ ená m ba yaèp ñkúú ka' naè, vúè neè neè woweèe mbena, sháshi a máâ bsii.’ ”
English: But bring those enemies of mine who didn't want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa ca mïìsi, a nati a ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm entombïì neè woweèe.
English: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

Limbum: E ka' duè baè' aètútú rla' Bátáfáè ba rla' Bátanïì aègee rtuèu Oleèf, a tuu ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu beèe aè baa, a laa neè woweèe enáê,
English: It happened, when he drew near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

Limbum: “Duè neè nje rla' rká' enje weâe cuèu na. Weèe be baè' tá weèe yá aèmboè a cúú muu jaèaki' ce ñwáè aè m be cu mbo ka'. Wee yá, weèe fyáá vú aègho mbena.
English: saying, Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat. Untie it, and bring it.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' bipshi neè weèe enáê, ‘Weèe ce fyáèá jaèaki' anaè njoká?’ weèe suñ ye enáê, ‘Tata ce taè' geèe yuu aègho ka' kúsi.” ’
English: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying it?' say to him: 'The Lord needs it.'

Limbum: Beèe ce e m tuu naè a du a yá buu aè ku ba aèmboè e m suñ woweèe naè.
English: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce fyáèá muu jaèaki', ñgaâa jaèaki' a bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce fyáèá muu jaèaki' anaè njoká?”
English: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, Why are you untying the colt?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Tata ce koèñ aè rgeèe yuu aègho.”
English: They said, The Lord needs it.

Limbum: Woweèe a du aègho a fa neè Jisoès, a co'ni bcáè' a laashi mbenduè mo, a ko'si Jisoès mbo.
English: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.

Limbum: E ka' cu mbo ce duè, beèe aè co'nïì bcáè' a laashi njep nduunjïì.
English: As he went, they spread their cloaks in the way.

Limbum: E ka' baè' aètútú rla' Jáèrusaláèm faèdïì' ce nduunjïì yi suèu embe rtuèu Oleèf naè, ku' beèe ce a m ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ká' a ce yu' rboèñ, a ce yáá mbekïì seê, a ce náèsi Nyúè njobeè' ku' buu bghagha' ce woweèe a m yá.
English: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce yoèp enáê, “Nyúè ghoni ñkúú ce e ce vúè aè rlii Tataê, tá cumúnyañ ba mbe buèu. Seèe ku'si Nyúè embe buèu.”
English: saying, Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi mo' ce a m ba aè múè ku' beèe ca, a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, lapni ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu ca.”
English: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, Teacher, rebuke your disciples!

Limbum: Jisoès a beesïì enáê, “M ce suñ weèe máná beèe ca a ka' cumúnyañ, bluèr ca vi ku yoêp.”
English: He answered them, I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.

Limbum: E ka' vúè baè' aètútú, yá rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a war,
English: When he drew near, he saw the city and wept over it,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Wee weèe foñ aè ba riñ yuu ce aède' yi ba gee cumúnyañ ba aègho ntïìni na, geewa'a, a súèti yi ese weèe.
English: saying, If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

Limbum: Mnoèñ mo' vi be keè ba ce beèe ce a baèa weèe a be keè boo ñka' sïìr weèe aègho kaari tarte, gaèñ weèe fa mbetar,
English: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

Limbum: koo weèe, ba boo wee ce weèe woweèe yu mbe ñka', lïìpshi aè nsheè. Woweèe a be maè'shi tá luèr moè' cu mbenduè moè' ka', njobeè' weèe aè m rïìñ nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m vúè aè rfúr weèe efa ñgá' naè ka'.”
English: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn't know the time of your visitation.

Limbum: E m niñ mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a ká' a ce juèu beèe ce a m ce fyeèni buu mbo,
English: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Yaè ndap be ba ndap rloo. Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe aè gee yaè ndap aè kútïì ba mbúè' byáèá.” ’
English: saying to them, It is written, 'My house is a house of prayer,' but you have made it a 'den of robbers'!

Limbum: E m ce yá'ni mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá. Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ker ba beèe ce a m ba boo mlii, a m ce gheèter aè ryú ye.
English: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

Limbum: Geewa'a, woweèe a m koni nduunjïì ka' njobeè' beèe wááwá a m ku ce yu' ba yuu ce e m ce laèa.
English: They couldn't find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè moè' Jisoès aè ka' ce yá'ni beèe mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ, beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a bleebeèe weèe a vúê,
English: It happened on one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, that the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

Limbum: a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Ñger ce aè ce geèe buu ca aègho yi loè efá? Ñwáè ce e fa wáè ñger ca aè fa nda?”
English: They asked him, Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa enáê, “M be bipshi yuu mo' neè weèe foñ.
English: He answered them, I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

Limbum: Ñger ce Joân aè m túr aè rbaèptir beèe naè yi m loè ba ese Nyúè káè ese beèe? Suñ aè neè máè.”
English: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?

Limbum: Woweèe a du mcúè, a seesi enáê, “Seèe ka' laa seená yi ñger anaè yi m loè ese Nyúè, baná e be bipshi neè seèe enáê, ‘Weèe aè m ka' ba byemi yuu ce e m laèa ka' njoká?’
English: They reasoned with themselves, saying, If we say, 'From heaven,' he will say, 'Why didn't you believe him?'

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' laa seená ñger anaè yi m loè ese ñwáè, baná beèe wááwá a be túúshi seèe neè bluèr, njobeè' woweèe a byemi ená Joân aè m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyú.”
English: But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

Limbum: Woweèe a kútïì a beesi enáê, “Weèr rïìñ ka'.”
English: They answered that they didn't know where it was from.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná má máè foñ be suñ weèe ñwáè ce e fa máè ñger aè rgeèe buu ca ka'.”
English: Jesus said to them, Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

Limbum: E m maè' ñgaèa neè beèe enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè m faè' yi nsuu, a bye njáèá msini ce a ke geèe mruè' aègho mbo, a lá neè beèe mo' ená a di' ce fa' nsuu anaè ce fa ye mú yuu. E ka' láè neè woweèe, a du aè mbeè, a du a cu taètaè seê.
English: He began to tell the people this parable. A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

Limbum: Nfeè' tee msini aè ka' gháá, e tuu ñwáè rfaè' ená e du yá beèe anaè, koo msini mi. Beèe anaè a koo ñwáè anaè, a lïîp, a kúsi ye njïìnjïì, e du mboèmmbo.
English: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him, and sent him away empty.

Limbum: E ker tuu ñwáè rfaè' moè', woweèe a ker lip ye foñ, a coosi ye, a koosi ye rïìtu, e du mboèmmbo.
English: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him, and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

Limbum: E ka' keèr tuu moè', woweèe a báásïì ye, a fúr embe múè nsuu a ma'.
English: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.

Limbum: Ñwáè nsuu aè laa seè'ni enáê, ‘M be geèe máká? M be tuu muu waè ce máè koèñ se na. Seemoè' woweèe a be yu'ni neè ye.’
English: The lord of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.'

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá ye, a laa a waâp mú enáê, ‘A ñwáè ce e be ye bti' na. Seèe koo yú, tá vi bti' bo ba viseèe.’
English: But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè fyá' woweèe a laa enáê, “Baná yuu ce a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘Luèr ce ñgaâa mboo mndap a m maè', aè kúti ba luèr rbuu-ndap’ naè yi yu ba ená ká?
English: But he looked at them, and said, Then what is this that is written, 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the chief cornerstone?'

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' gwe mbenduè luèr anaè baná ñgaèñ be ceeñger aè btete aè btete. Ñwáè ce luèr anaè aè ka' gwe mbe yeâ nduè, baná e be bú'shi ye.”
English: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a ce roèo nduunjïì aè rkoo Jisoès aè nfeè' anaè njobeè' woweèe a m rïìñ ená e maè' ñgaèa anaè ba neè woweèe. Geewa'a, woweèe a m wáp beèe.
English: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people--for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce ker ye, a tuu ñgaâa ñker ená a du bo'shi ená a yu ñgaâa laèayá. Woweèe a ka' duè a ce keè' ená Jisoès laa mú yuu mo' bebep, tá a bo koo ye fa mbe mmbo govanoè.
English: They watched him, and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa neè Jisoès enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, weèr rïìñ werná aè ce laèa, ker ce yá'ni ba yuu ce yi yu yáánïì. Weèr rïìñ werná wáâ ke loèr ñwáè moè' jáá ka', a ce yá'ni beèe mnduunjïì Nyúè neè mini-ñwáè.
English: They asked him, Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

Limbum: Suñ ka weèr. Ncir yi byemi ená seèe ma' mbaâa baèraè' neè ñkwe Rum káè seèe ma' ka' aè?”
English: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

Limbum: Jisoès aè yá taa ce a m leè' neè ye, a laa neè woweèe enáê,
English: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, Why do you test me?

Limbum: “Naèa neè mbúè mbaèa ce a ke maè' mbaâa baèraè' aègho.” Woweèe a vú neè mbúè mbaèa a fa neè ye, e laa enáê, “Tu ñwáè embo a yïû nda, rlii ce a sañ mbo aè ba lïû nda?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Tu embo a yi ñkwe Ruêm, rlii embo aè ba li foñ.”
English: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it? They answered, Caesar's.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná weèe fa buu ñkúú neè ñkúú, fa vi Nyúè neè Nyúè.”
English: He said to them, Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's.

Limbum: E m laèa yuu mo' aè múè beèe ce aède' woweèe a m ba koo ye aètu mo ka'. Woweèe a m báèáñger aè njáèá njïì ce e m beèesi yuu ce woweèe a m bipshi, a baate yap cuèu.
English: They weren't able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer, and were silent.

Limbum: Beèe Saduèsi mo' ce a m kani ená aède' ñwáè kwe ker fúú efa rkwe ka', a vú a yá Jisoès tá a bo bipshi yuu neè ye. Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê,
English: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

Limbum: “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, Musïìs aè m sañ ncir neè seèe ená ñwáè aè ka' lor ñgwa, a ye a bi boo ka', ñgaèñ kwe, baná nfúr yïì be laasi ye, tá a ye a bi boo neè nfúr yïì ce e kwe anaè.
English: They asked him, Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man's brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.

Limbum: Bfúr mo' a m ba beèe nsaèambaê. Ñwáâ nlee aè loèr ñgwa a bi boo a ye ka', a kwe.
English: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

Limbum: Ñwáè embe yeâ njïì aè laasïì ye, a kwe foñ.
English: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

Limbum: Ñwáè embenjïì ñwáè embe yeâ njïì aè ker laasi ye, a kwe. Yi m ku koni neè woweèe wááwá wa'a, moè' efa woweèe aè bi boo a njeñwáè anaè ka'.
English: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèlúèsimbuèu, njeñwáè ca aè kwe foñ.
English: Afterward the woman also died.

Limbum: Baná be keè ba aè nfeè' ce beèe a fúú efa rkwe, tá njeñwáè ca ba ñgwa nda, aèmboè yi yu ená bfúr beèe nsaèamba ca wááwá a m ba bduu vi naè?”
English: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Mmbañruè enjep ñgoèñ na a ce loèr bbyeèñge, bbyeèñge a ce duèse bguèu.
English: Jesus said to them, The children of this age marry, and are given in marriage.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a ghááte aè beèe ce a be keè fúú efa rkwe, cu aè ñgoèñ ce yi bii ka' ba naè, a be keèr loèr bbyeèñge káè guusi boo ka',
English: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.

Limbum: njobeè' aède' woweèe a ker kweñger ka'. Woweèe a be keè ba aèmboè bcïìndap Nyúè wa'a. Woweèe a be keè ba boo Nyúè njobeè' woweèe a fúú efa rkwe.
English: For they can't die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè rfúú ce beèe ce a kweñger a be keè fúú efa rkwe, Musïìs ye ye aè m duèñshi ená ca yi yu wa'a. Mbe dïì' ce e m sañ aèmboè ce ce mor yi m ce káti mbo naè, e ce too Tata Nyúè mbo naè ená Nyúè Abraèhaêm, ba Nyúè Aisïìk ker ba Nyúè Jakoèp.
English: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord 'The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

Limbum: E yu Nyúè bgúâú beèe ka', e yu ba Nyúè beèe ce a cu bteèe. E rïìñ yi ená beèe wááwá a cu bteèe.”
English: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa múè ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, wáè laèa boèñboñ.”
English: Some of the scribes answered, Teacher, you speak well.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ker túr cuèu aè rbipshi yuu mo' neè ye ka'.
English: They didn't dare to ask him any more questions.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “AÈde' beèe a laa ená Kraâis anaè yu muu Dávïìd aè njáâá ká,
English: He said to them, Why do they say that the Christ is David's son?

Limbum: ce Dávïìd ce laèa yi mbe Ñwaè' Byáá enáê, ‘Tata Nyúè aè m laèa neè Tata yaè enáê, “Cu aè la rkoo maè',
English: David himself says in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand,

Limbum: caar tá m gee tá aè tár mo mkuèu mbenduè beèe ce a baèa wáè.”’
English: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.'

Limbum: Dávïìd ce too ye ená Tataê, baná aède' e ker ba muu yïì aè njáâá ká?”
English: David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa ca neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, beèe wááwá a ce yu'.
English: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Loèr neè nfeè' neè ñgeèe ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir. Woweèe a ke koèñ aè ryar mñgaèbúlaè ce kar aègho, koñ ená beèe a ca'ni woweèe aè mntaa. Woweèe a niñ aè mndap mloo, ce ba mnta' beâe bgoèrgoèr, a baè' aè mñkaè', ce ba mnta' bboèñboñ.
English: Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

Limbum: Woweèe a ke bo’ byepkùù, ye yaèp buu wáèwá, ce geèe nloo msaèsap aè nduèññi naè beèe aná woweèe a ríñ aè nloo seè. Yaèp fígà’ be keè ba goèr seè.
English: who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.

Limbum: Jisoès aè naa mmir a yá aèmboè ñgaâa mbaèa a ce fa rfa njep ñkuèp rfa embe Ndaèp Nyúè.
English: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

Limbum: E m yá ñgwañkúñwáè moè' ce e m ba ñwáè fuèp aèmboè e fa mbaèa baa njep ñkuèp anaè.
English: Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñgwañkúñwáè ce e yu ñwáè fuèp na, aè fa a caa beèe wááwá.
English: He said, Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

Limbum: Beèe ca wááwá a gaèpni buu moè' efa ku' yaèp buu ce a túr, a fa rfa aègho, ñgwañkúñwáè ca ce e túr yuu ka' aè lor mú yuu wááwá ce e túr, aè ba yïì ce yi ba jaè' ye, a fa.”
English: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a m ce suñ buu aèmboè Ndap Nyúè, a ce laèa ená a baè'ri ndap anaè neè bluâr bboèñboñ, buu ce beèe a m fa neè Nyúè a susi ndap anaè aègho vi boñ foñ seê. Jisoès aè laa enáê,
English: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

Limbum: “Buu wááwá ce weèe ce yá na, nfeè' moè' be keè ba tá luèr mo' cu nje Ndap Nyúè ca ka'. A be keè káèáshi vi wááwá.”
English: As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, buu ca vi be ba ba aè se'ká? Yuu ce yi be duèñshi ená nfeè' ce buu ca be koni aè gháá, be ba ká?”
English: They asked him, Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Loèr neè nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo' weèe ka', njobeè' beèe magoèr a be vúè a máâ rlii ce laèa enáê, ‘A máè Kraâis anaè,’ keèr laèa foñ enáê, ‘Nfeè' ce gháá.’ Weèe fa duè aèmbuèu woweèe ka'.
English: He said, Watch out that you don't get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he,' and, 'The time is at hand.' Therefore don't follow them.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ke yu' ená a ce maè' bïìr, ker yu' aèmboè ñgaâa ñgá' a ce káè' ñgá', weèe fa wáp ka'. Buu ca be kuè ke ká' koni, vi koni wa'a, ke' ba ená nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi be mïì aè gháá ka'.”
English: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don't be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won't come immediately.

Limbum: E m ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “To' yi be maè' bïìr a to' mo', tá ñkúú moè' ma' bïìr a moè'.
English: Then he said to them, Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

Limbum: Ñgoèñ yi be cïì'ti seê, tá njeè koo, tá byañ vi gwe aè nduè beèe aè bdïì' jáá jáèá jáá. Buu bwáp, ker ba mncoâo btatap seê, vi be yááti mbe buèu.
English: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

Limbum: “Tá buu ca ka' koni, a be koo weèe fa weèe ñgá', duè neè weèe aè mndap mloo, fa weèe aè bshañ, duè neè weèe njeptii bkúú ba bgovanoè njo' máè.
English: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name's sake.

Limbum: Ca yi be geèe tá weèe koni fáñ aè rsuñ woweèe buu kuu máè.
English: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

Limbum: Tá nfeè' ka' gháá, weèe fa maè'shi tá mntee vi ce bu' weèe tá weèe ce kwaè'shi ená weèe be duè laèa wee ká lá ka',
English: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

Limbum: njobeè' m be fa weèe blaèa kuè cuèu, ba bfee aè njáèá ce aède' moè' efa beèe ce a baèa weèe riñ yuu ce e beesi ka'.
English: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

Limbum: Weêe bta ba weêe mmaê, ba bfúr wee ba beèe ce weèe woweèe aè raète, ba bkar wee, a be fyeèni weèe, tá a yúshi beèe mo' efa weèe.
English: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a be baèa weèe njo' máè.
English: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake.

Limbum: Geewa'a, mbúè nyúè'tu embe tu moè' efa weèe be bú ka'.
English: And not a hair of your head will perish.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' táá tatap baná weèe be so me myoèñ.
English: By your endurance you will win your lives.

Limbum: Nfeè' anaè aè ka' gháá baná beèe ce a yu aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a cañ duse aè mtuèu, tá beèe ce a yu aè múè la' a fúú, tá beèe ce a yu aè mñkúè a ker kúti aè laè' ka',
English: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the midst of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

Limbum: njobeè' nfeè' ca be ba nfeè' ce Nyúè be kúsi mcucu' aètu buu bbebep ce beèe a m geèe, tá yuu ce a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi bo ghááte njo.
English: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

Limbum: Mluè mi be koo bbyeèñge ce a yu neè mmbúè ba bbyeèñge ce a ce nyoñsi boo. Mluè mi be ba neè beâe aè ñgoèñ ca, tá Nyúè bepsi ntee neè woweèe.
English: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.

Limbum: A be yúshi beèe mo' neè bkaèafaè', tá a koo beèe mo' aè rkoèñ, duè aègho aè bto' jáá jáèá jáá, tá beèe enje jáá a nyáñshi Jáèrusaláèm neè mkuèu caar tá yaèp nfeè' mi tá a ka' borni.
English: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

Limbum: “Mncoèo vi be yááti mbe rlir nyúè, ba mbe ñwáá, ba mbe mkaèñsïì, tá mluè mi ba njep ñgoèñ na, tá bjep vi ba njo' rcoèo ce rdip rgoèr li be ce coèo, keèr ce bañti ce ko' mbekïì ce gweè.
English: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

Limbum: Beèe a be kwe bwáp, aèmboè woweèe a be cu ce fyá' yuu ce yi be koni ñgoèñ aè nfeè' anaè, njobeè' buu ñger embe buèu na vi be cïì'ti.
English: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

Limbum: Buu ca vi ce koni wa'a, tá a lo yá aèmboè Muu Ñwáè ce vúè mbe múè mmbaè' neè ñger-ñwáè ba neè foèo-ñwáè.
English: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

Limbum: Buu ca aè ka' ká' ce koni, weèe táá mbekïì, naa btu, njobeè' nfeè' ce Nyúè be tee weèe efa ñgá' ce gháá.”
English: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.

Limbum: E m maè' ñgaèa neè woweèe enáê, “Fyá' neè ce fïîk, ker ba bce wááwá.
English: He told them a parable. See the fig tree, and all the trees.

Limbum: Weâe ke yá aè nfeè' ce bce anaè vi káè' a ce top, weèe ku riñ weená nfeè' mbeèñ yu aètútú.
English: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

Limbum: Baná weèe aè ka' ke yá aèmboè buu ca vi ce koni, weèe riñ weená nfeè' kúú Nyúè aè gháá.
English: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that the Kingdom of God is near.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñgúè beèe ca be kweñger wáá tá buu ca ka' koni ka'.
English: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

Limbum: Rbuu ba nshe a be keè mïì, geewa'a, wa blaèa vi be keè mïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
English: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

Limbum: Loèr neè nfeè', buwa'laèr weèe lo fa nyor aè buu bcicïì, ba buu mno ba buu ce mluè mi ke koo beèe aègho njep ñgoèñ na, tá noèñ anaè yi lo búèú weèe búèú aèmboè taa yi búèú nyaèa wa'a.
English: So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ce yá'ni mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá, e ba aè mbuèuñkuèr e du mbe rtuèu Oleèf cu mbo túè' raa.
English: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

Limbum: Túè' e raa, beèe wááwá a du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè mú ñgaèptú' tá a bo yu' buu ce e ce yá'ni.
English: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè káè' a ce gháá ce a be ye ñkaè' neè bráâd ce a láè yes njo ka', ce a m ce too ená Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap.
English: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir a m ce roèo mú njáèá nduunjïì mo' aè ryú Jisoès njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp beèe.
English: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

Limbum: Sataèn aè niñ njep Judaès ce a m ce too ená IÌskarïìyoèt, ce e m ba moè' efa beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: Satan entered into Judas, who was surnamed Iscariot, who was numbered with the twelve.

Limbum: Judaès aè natïì a duê, a yá beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba beèe ce a m ba btu neè beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Ndap Nyúè, a seesi a woweèe aèmboè aède' e gee ka' fyeni Jisoès neè woweèe.
English: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

Limbum: Woweèe a yu' rboèñ, a ka'ni ená a be fa ye mbaèa.
English: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

Limbum: E byemïì, a ká' a ce roèo nduunjïì aè rfyeèni Jisoès neè woweèe aè nfeè' ce beèe a yu aèfo ka'.
English: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

Limbum: Noèñ entoèmbïì efa mnoèñ ce a m ce ye bráâd ce a láè yes njo ka' yi m gháá. Noèñ anaè aè m ba noèñ ce a m ce sháshi njeèe ce a be ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap aègho.
English: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

Limbum: Jisoès aè tuu Pitaè ba Joân, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Duè neè fár byee tá seèe bo ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap aègho.”
English: He sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “AÈ ce koèñ ená weèr fár byee ñkaè' anaè ba fá tá aè bo ye?”
English: They said to him, Where do you want us to prepare?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Yáê, weèe be duè niñ aè múè rla', tá weèe tarte weèe mbañruèñwáè moè' ce e byáè' ntúñ mdip. Duè neè fa yeâ mbuèu, niñ mbe ndaèp ce e be niñ,
English: He said to them, Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

Limbum: laa neè ñwáè ndap enáê, ‘Ñwáè ryá'nïì aè laèa ená weèr bipshi neè wáè ená dïì' ce e be ye byee Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap mbo a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe yu ba fá lá?’
English: Tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says to you, Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'

Limbum: E be duèñshi weèe ma rum ndap embe ndap ce a baè'ri mbenduè ndap anaè, a kupshi boèñboñ seê. Fáèr neè byee ñkaè' mbo.”
English: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè, a yá, yi ku ba aèmboè Jisoès aè m suñ woweèe naè. Woweèe a fár byee ñkaè' anaè.
English: They went, found things as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè ka' gháá, Jisoès ba yi ñgaâa ntuu a cuteè a sir tábuèr.
English: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè mú ce koèñ se ená seèe ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap ca, tá m ka' yá ñgá'.
English: He said to them, I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná m be keèr ye ñkaè' ca ka', caar tá yuu ce ñkaè' ca yi táá aètu mo yi ke ghááte mbe rla' Nyúè embe buèu.”
English: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a lor ndoñ, a yoñshi Nyúè, a laa enáê, “Koè neè no.
English: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, Take this, and share it among yourselves,

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe ená m be keèr no mruè' ce a geèe neè mbaèñ ce ca ka', caar baè' aè nfeè' ce kúú Nyúè yi be keè vúè.”
English: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until the Kingdom of God comes.

Limbum: E m loèr bráêd, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi, a fa neè woweèe, a laa enáê, “Ca yu yaè nyor ce máè fa a weâe btuè. Ce gee neè aèmboè seèe ce geèe na tá weèe bo ce kuushi máè.”
English: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and gave to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.

Limbum: A ka' ye byee mïìsi, e lor ndoñ aèmboè e m loèr bráâd naè, a laa enáê, “Ndoñ ca yu leâ' fi ce Nyúè aè kur a beèe neè wa bláá.
English: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

Limbum: Geewa'a, ñwáè ce e be fyeèni máè ce yeñger weèr ye mbe tábuèr na.
English: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

Limbum: Muu Ñwáè be kuè kwe aèmboè yi m ba aè rba, geewa'a, ndoèo be co' ñwáè ce e be fyeèni ye.”
English: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce bipshi fa waâp mú ená ñwáè ce e be geèe njáèá yuu ca yu ba nda lá?
English: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.

Limbum: Woweèe a káè' a ce sár mnsár foñ ená ñwáè ce e yu ñwáâ ñgoèr efa waâp mú yu nda lá?
English: There arose also a contention among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Bkúú beèe enje jáá a ke sa' yap beèe neè ñger- ñwáè, beèe a ce too ñgaâa rsa' anaè ená ñgaâa rjaè'.
English: He said to them, The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called 'benefactors.'

Limbum: Weèe fa ba aè njáâá wa' ka'. Yi yu ba ená ñwáâ ñgoèr se efa weâe mú ba aèmboè muu ñká'. Ñwáè ce e yu tu neè beèe ba aèmboè ñwáè rfaè'.
English: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e yu ñwáâ ñgoèr yu ba nda? Yu ba ñwáè ce e ye byee káè yu ba ñwáè ce e ce caèasi byee neè ye aè? Mboè yu ñwáè ce e ce ye byee a? M yu ya fa weâe mú aèmboè ñwáè rfaè'.
English: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn't it he who sits at the table? But I am in the midst of you as one who serves.

Limbum: A weèe ce weèe aè ku táá tatap, a ma' máè aè nfeè' rmoèoshi ka'.
English: But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

Limbum: Máè fa kúú neè weèe aèmboè yaè Ta aè m fa neè máè naè,
English: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

Limbum: tá weèe bo yeñger keèr noñger mbe yaè tábuèr embe máâ nto', cu mbe bkaèbaèraè' ce sa' mntáè' Isráèl ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

Limbum: “Saimúèn, Saimúèn, yáê, Sataèn aè loo njïì aè rfyápshi weèe aèmboè aè ke fyápshi msañ naè.
English: The Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat,

Limbum: Geewa'a, máè geèe rloo neè wáè ená lo rbyemïì li fa mïì ka'. E ba aè nfeè' ce lo rbyemïì li kúti a ba rtatap, aè tapsi bfúr wo.”
English: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn't fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Tataê, máè tami nyor aè rduè shañ weèe soè, keèr kwe weèe soè.”
English: He said to him, Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Pitaè, m ce suñ wáè máná tá nduñgúp ka' toñ neètú' e ntïìni na, aè be kani ñkaèraè' taar ená aè rïìñ máè ka'.”
English: He said, I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.

Limbum: E m ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce máè m tuu weèe, a laa máná weèe fa loèr posaè káè baèa, káè blaba' ka' naè, waè' weèe aè m buu yuu mo' a?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Weèr aè m buu yuu mo' ka'.”
English: He said to them, When I sent you out without purse, and wallet, and shoes, did you lack anything? They said, Nothing.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce laèa neè weèe seè'ni na ená ñwáè ce e ka' túr posaè káè baèa áè, e loêr. Ñwáè aè ka' tá túr kaèafaè' ka', ñgaèñ fyenïì yi cáè', yuu yïì.
English: Then he said to them, But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe ená yuu ce a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, ‘A m beè' ye aè múè ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep’ naè, yi be koni neè máè, ghááte njo. Neè mini-ñwáè, yuu ce a sañ aèmboè máè yi ce ghááte njo.”
English: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: 'He was counted with transgressors.' For that which concerns me has an end.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa enáê, “Tataê, yáê, a bkaèafaâ' bbaa na.” E beesïì enáê, “Vi gháá wa'a.”
English: They said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. He said to them, That is enough.

Limbum: E fúú efa múè rla' a du mbe rtuèu Oleèf aèmboè e m ce duè aè nfeè' wááwá naè. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

Limbum: E ka' duè baè' mbe dïì' anaè, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Loo neè, faè dïì' weèe gwe rmoèoshïì ka'.”
English: When he was at the place, he said to them, Pray that you don't enter into temptation.

Limbum: E m fúú efa waâp mú a du mbe dïì' ce ñwáè aè m ka' ba ma' luèr e ku ba', a gú'shi neè mñkúúshi, a gee rloo, a laa enáê,
English: He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

Limbum: “Yaè Taê, wáè ka' koêñ, geèe tá ndoñ ñgá' ca caa embe máâ tuè. Geewa'a, ke' ba ená m ce laèa máná aè gee ba aèmboè máè koèñ ka', geèe ba aèmboè wáè koèñ ená yi ba.”
English: saying, Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.

Limbum: Awá ncïìndap Nyúè embe buèu aè yáátïì, a fa ye ñger.
English: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

Limbum: Mluè mi ka' ce koo ye seê, e gee rloo neè yi ntee-ñwáè, mlïì' mi suu ye efa nyoèr aèmboè bláá wa'a, a cáácá aè nsheè.
English: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

Limbum: E ka' natïì embe dïì' ce e ba ce geèe rloo naè, kúti, a yá ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu aèmboè a ce buumi njobeè' woweèe a m koosimnse goèr a sáê.
English: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce buumi ba ká? Naèti neè mbekïì, gee rloo, faè dïì' weèe bo gweè rmoèoshïì ka'.”
English: and said to them, Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.

Limbum: E ka' kuè bii ce laèa, kúr beèe a vúê. Ñwáè ce a m ce too ená Judaès, ce e m ba moè' efa beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú naè, aè táá kuèntombïì neè woweèe. E m vúè a ba' aègee Jisoès tá e bo baa ye nje nyoèr.
English: While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Judaès, aè be fyeèni Muu Ñwáè neè rbaa ce aè ce baa ye nje nyoèr a?”
English: But Jesus said to him, Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?

Limbum: Yïì beèe ce a woweèe a m ba a m yá yuu ce yi be koni, a laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, weèr gwate woweèe neè saè' a?”
English: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, Lord, shall we strike with the sword?

Limbum: Moè' efa woweèe aè co' saè', a tee tuè' maè' ese ñwáè ce e m ba ñkwaèa neè ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Yi gháá wa'a.”
English: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a joo tuè' ñwáè anaè, yi kútïì aèmboè yi m ba.
English: But Jesus answered, Let me at least do this--and he touched his ear, and healed him.

Limbum: E laa neè beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba beèe ce a m ba btu neè beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Ndap Nyúè, ba bleebeèe ce a woweèe a m vúè aè rkoo ye naè enáê, “Weèe aè vúè aè rkoo máè neè bsaè' ba mmbaèñ aèmboè m yu lá nyáèá wa'a njoká?
English: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

Limbum: To máè m ku ba weèe seèe mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá, weèe aè m be naa bo joo máè aègho ka'. Geewa'a, nfeè' ca yu yeè nfeè', nfeè' ce túè'nji be túr ñger.”
English: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn't stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

Limbum: Woweèe a m koo Jisoès, a du aègho mbe ndaèp ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. Pitaè aè m ce duè a waâp mbuèu, a ba yi encaèñ.
English: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest's house. But Peter followed from a distance.

Limbum: A m toèo mor mbe mambe koêr, beèe a cu a ce yár, Pitaè aè cu fa waâp mú foñ.
English: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard, and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

Limbum: Muunje moè' ce e m ba ñwáè rfaè' aè yá aèmboè e cu a ce yár mor, e fyá' ye mbe mmïìr, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè m ba a Jisoès foñ.”
English: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, This man also was with him.

Limbum: Pitaè aè kanïì, a laa enáê, “Njeñwáè caê, m rïìñ ye ka'.”
English: He denied Jesus, saying, Woman, I don't know him.

Limbum: Mú nfeè' aè ka' tuuse, ñwáè moè' aè ker yá ye a laa enáê, “A wáè moè' efa woweèe foñ.” Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “Mbañruèñwáè caê, a máè moè' ka'.”
English: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, You also are one of them! But Peter answered, Man, I am not!

Limbum: Nfeè' aè ka' tuuse aèmboè awaè moè'sir wa'a, ñwáè moè' aè ker laa tatap enáê, “Neè mini-ñwáè, ñwáè ca aè m ba a ye. E yu ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.”
English: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!

Limbum: Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “Mbañruèñwáè caê, máè rïìñ yuu ce aè ce laèa na ka'.” E ka' kuè bii ce laèa wa'a, nduñgúp aè toñ.
English: But Peter said, Man, I don't know what you are talking about! Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

Limbum: Tata aè karsïì nyor a ke' ye mbe mmïìr. E ka' kuushi yuu ce e m laèa neè ye enáê, “Tá nduñgúp ka' toñ neètú' e ntïìni na, aè be kani ñkaèraè' taar ená aè rïìñ máè ka'.” naè.
English: The Lord turned, and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord's word, how he said to him, Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.

Limbum: Pitaè aè fúú njep mbeè a bú' rwar.
English: He went out, and wept bitterly.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Jisoès, a m vúèshi ye, a lip ye.
English: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

Limbum: A m kur ye mmir, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Suñ ka ená aè lïìp nda wáè lá?”
English: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?

Limbum: Woweèe a m suè' ye neè mcáp seê.
English: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, bleebeèe efa múè Juês, ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, a cuteè mbe kansuèr, a lor Jisoès a vú aègho mbo, a laa neè ye enáê,
English: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

Limbum: “Wáè ka' ba Kraâis anaè, aè suñ weèr.” Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “M ka' suñ weèe, weèe byemïì ka'.
English: If you are the Christ, tell us. But he said to them, If I tell you, you won't believe,

Limbum: M ka' bipshi yuu neè weèe, weèe beesïì ka'.
English: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

Limbum: Ká' e seè'ni na, Muu Ñwáè be cu aè rkoo maè' Nyúè ce e túr ñger wááwá.”
English: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a bipshïì enáê, “Baná a wáè Muu Nyúè a?” E laa neè woweèe enáê, “AÈ laèa weèe neè wee bcuèu ená a máè ye.”
English: They all said, Are you then the Son of God? He said to them, You say it, because I am.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “AÈde' seèe ker ce roèo beèe mo' ená a vú táá njïìnsa' aè njáâá ká? To seèe aè yu' yuu ce e laèa neè yi cuèu.”
English: They said, Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a natïì mbekïì, a lor Jisoès a du aègho a fa neè Pailáèt.
English: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

Limbum: Woweèe a m káè' a ce toshi ye enáê, “Weèr aè yá ñwáè ca aè ce karsi btu ese yeèr beèe. E ce laèa neè beèe ená woweèe a fa maè' mbaâa baèraè' neè ñkwe Rum ka', a ce laèa foñ ená a lá ye Kraâis ce e yu ñkúú.”
English: They began to accuse him, saying, We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “A wáè ñkúú Jus a?” Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “AÈ laèa wáè wa'a.”
English: Pilate asked him, Are you the King of the Jews? He answered him, So you say.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè laa neè beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ku' beèe ce a m ba aèfo naè enáê, “Máè yá yuu mo' ce m taa ñwáè ca aètu mo ka'.”
English: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, I find no basis for a charge against this man.

Limbum: Woweèe a ker laa tatap enáê, “E karsi btu beâe aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè wááwá neè li ryá'nïì káè' efa ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a daa aègho a ba' aèfa.”
English: But they insisted, saying, He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ka' yu' wa'a, a bipshi enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèle a?”
English: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

Limbum: E ka' yu' ená e yu ñwáâ aè ñgoèñ ce Hároèd ce sa', e tuusïì ye neè Hároèd ce e m ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè nfeè' anaè foñ.
English: When he found out that he was in Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

Limbum: Hároèd aè ka' yá Jisoès, a yu' rboèñ seê, njobeè' e m ce koèñ aè ryá ye ká' ese aè nfeè' njïìsaèp. E m yu' buu ce Jisoès aè m ce geèe, a ce koèñ aè ryá yuu ghagha' mo' ce e be geèe.
English: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

Limbum: E ka' yá Jisoès wa'a, a bipshi ku' buu neè ye, e laa yuu ka'.
English: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, a m toshi ye neè ñger-ñwáè seê.
English: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

Limbum: Hároèd ba vi bsoogáè a m vúèshi ye, a lor ye aè yuu cicïì, a lor cáâ' boèñboñ a ma' ye aè nyoèr, a kúsi ye neè Pailáèt.
English: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

Limbum: Hároèd ba Pailáèt a m koo ñkar nyúè anaè. Tá a ye a ka' koo ñkar nyúè anaè, a ye a m baèni seê.
English: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ká' beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba ñgaâa rsa', ker ba beèe ce a m ba aèfo,
English: Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

Limbum: a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè vúè neè ñwáè ca ená e ce karsi btu ese beèe. Máè fyá' njep múè mo a weâe bsii, a yá máná e geèe yuu mo' efa buu ce weèe aè laèa ená e geèe na ka'.
English: and said to them, You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and see, I have examined him before you, and found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

Limbum: M rïìñ máná Hároèd ye ye aè yá ená e geèe yuu bebep ka'. A mbuèu ce e kúsi ye neè seèe. Yi yu rara ená e geèe yuu mo' ce aède' a yú ye aètu mo ka'.
English: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

Limbum: Baná a be lip ye, tá m ma'shi tá e duê.”
English: I will therefore chastise him and release him.

Limbum: A m ce ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap, yi ba ená Pailáèt be fúr yaèp ñwáè moè' embe shañ, fa neè woweèe.
English: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

Limbum: Ku' beèe ca wááwá a waa a laa enáê, “Yú ñwáè ca, fúr Baèrabaès embe shañ, fa neè weèr.”
English: But they all cried out together, saying, Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!--

Limbum: A m fa Baèrabaès aè shañ njobeè' e m barsi beâe aè rla' anaè ená a tee tu neè ñkwe Ruêm, a ker yú ñwáè foñ.
English: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè m ce koèñ aè rmaè'shi Jisoès, a ker laa yuu neè woweèe.
English: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

Limbum: Woweèe a waa, a laa enáê, “Taa ye mbe kïìntaa! Taa ye mbe kïìntaa!”
English: but they shouted, saying, Crucify! Crucify him!

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yuu bebep ce ñwáè ca aè geèe seeseê, yu ba ká? Máè yá yuu mo' ce e geèe ce aède' a yú ye aètu mo ka'. Baná a be lïìp ye tá m ma'shi ye.”
English: He said to them the third time, Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ku ce waani, a ce laèa ená a taa lá ye mbe kïìntaa. A ka' waani wa'a, a so.
English: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè boñlaèr a teni mnsa' ená a taa ye mbe kïìntaa aèmboè woweèe a laèa naè.
English: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

Limbum: E m fúr ñwáè ce woweèe a m ce koèñ ená e fúr embe shañ, aè ba ñwáè ce e m duè shañ njobeè' e m barsi beèe ená a tee tu neè ñkwe Ruêm, a ker yú ñwáè foñ naè. E ka' fúr, a fa Jisoès ená a gee yuu ce woweèe a m koèñ naè neè ye.
English: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

Limbum: Woweèe a lor ye a ce duè aègho, a ka' baè' aè nduunjïì, a tarte a ñwáè moè' ce a m ce too ená Saimúèn ce aè rla' Saèireên, ce e m ce vúè efa mñkúè. A m koo ye a fa kïìntaa neè ye ená e byá', ce jár mbenjïì Jisoès.
English: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.

Limbum: Ku' beèe magoèr a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu. Bbyeèñge a m ba a waâp mú, a ce koosimnse a ce warse njo' ñgá' ce Jisoès aè m ce yá.
English: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè karsïì nyor, a laa enáê, “Bbyeèñgeâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, weèe fa war neè máè ka', war neè ba neè wee btu, ker ba neè boo wee,
English: But Jesus, turning to them, said, Daughters of Jerusalem, don't weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

Limbum: njobeè' nfeè' moè' be ba tá beèe a laa enáê, ‘Rboâñtu li yu neè bbyeèñge ce a yu bkar, ce a m be bi boo ka', a ker nyoñsi boo ka'.’
English: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, 'Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.'

Limbum: Woweèe a be keè laèa neè mtuâu mñgoèrñgoèr enáê, ‘Gweèñger neè mbe weâr nduè,’ laèa neè mtuâu mñká'ñká' enáê, ‘Gúèúshi neè weèr.’
English: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and tell the hills, 'Cover us.'

Limbum: Beèe a ka' ce geèe buu ca neè máè aè nfeè' ce ce yi bii coèñ, baná yi ka' yuushi, yi ba aè njáâá ká?”
English: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?

Limbum: A m loèr mmbañruè mo' beèe a mbaa ce a m bú' ncir, a ce duè aègho a Jisoès weèe tá a bo duè taa mbe kïìntaa.
English: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' mbe dïì' ce a m ce too ená Keèkeèp-Tu, a taa Jisoès mbe kïìntaa mbo, a taa beèe moè' ce a m bú' ncir naè mbo foñ. Moè' aè m ba mbe kïìntaa a yeâ bo maè', moè' aè ba mbe kïìntaa a yeâ bo ñkoèp.
English: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Ya Taê, foèosi woweèe, njobeè' woweèe a rïìñ yuu ce a ce geèe ka'.” Woweèe a m loèr vi bcáè', a ma' kaèñ aègho, beèe ce a m so a du neè bcáè' anaè.
English: Jesus said, Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they are doing. Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

Limbum: Beèe a m táá a ce fyá', ñgaâa rsa' a ce vúèshi ye, a ce laèa enáê, “E m jaè' beèe moè' efa ñgá', e ja' laè yi tu foñ, ce e ka' ba Kraâis anaè ce Nyúè aè m ce.”
English: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!

Limbum: Bsoogáè foñ a m coosi ye. Woweèe a m vúè a fa ye mruè' ce mi ce bañshi,
English: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Wáè ka' ba ñkúú Juês, aè ja' ka yo tu efa ñgá'.”
English: and saying, If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!

Limbum: A m sañ mbe yeâ tuè enáê, “A ñkúú Jus naè.”
English: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

Limbum: Moè' efa beèe ce a m bú' ncir a taa woweèe a Jisoès weèe naè, aè m suè' ye neè mcáp. E m laèa enáê, “Mboè a wáè Kraâis anaè a? Jaè' laè yo tu efa ñgá' tá aè bo jaè' weèr foñ.”
English: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ce e m ba mbe kïìntaa foñ naè aè lapnïì ye, a laa enáê, “AÈ ce wáp Nyúè ka' a? To wá wáè ku ba ñwáè rkwe foñ aèmboè ye.
English: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, Don't you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

Limbum: Yi yu yáánïì ená soè yá ñgá'. Soè ce yá ñgá' njo' buu bbebep ce soè aè geèe, ñwáè ca aè geèe yi yu yuu mo' ka'.”
English: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a laa enáê, “Jisoès, kuushi máè aè nfeè' ce wáè ka' vú ce sa' yo kúú.”
English: He said to Jesus, Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená, aè be ba weèe soè aè ñgoâñ Paraèdaêis ntïìni.”
English: Jesus said to him, Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' kuèu ñgoèñ, túè' aè sii caar a ba' aè nyúè taar.
English: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

Limbum: Cáè' ce a m teni dïì' mo' embe Ndaèp Nyúè aègho yi m saè'ti tïìtïìyáá.
English: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

Limbum: Jisoès aè waa tatap seê, a laa enáê, “Yaè Taê, máè fa la ryoèñ mbe wáâ mmboè.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a ko'si ryoèñ, a kwe.
English: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, Father, into your hands I commit my spirit! Having said this, he breathed his last.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè aè ka' yá yuu ce yi m koni na, a ku'si Nyúè, a laa enáê, “Yi yu ghup ená ñwáè ca aè m ba ñwáâ nyáánïì.”
English: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m kaari aèfo aè ryá, a ka' yá yuu ce yi m koni, a la' mmbo mbe waâp mntee a duse.
English: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.

Limbum: Bkar vi wááwá ba bbyeèñge ce a m loâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèle a du a yeâ mbuèu, a m táá aènjïìsaèp, a ce yá buu ca.
English: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba ce a m ce too ená Josáèf. E m ba ñwáâ aè rla' Jus ce a m too ená AÈrimaètiyaè. E m ba moè' efa beèe ce a m ce sa' Kansuèr, a ba ñwáâ mboèñmboñ, a ker ba ñwáâ nyáánïì.
English: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

Limbum: E m cu a ce keè' nfeè' ce kúú Nyúè yi be káè'. E m byemi yuu ce a m geèe neè Jisoès na ka'.
English: he had not consented to their counsel and deed, from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for the Kingdom of God:

Limbum: E m duè a yá Pailáèt, a bu' mmbo neè ye ená e fa gúâú ñwáè neè ye tá e tuñ.
English: this man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè byemïì, e suusïì gúâú ñwáè embe kïìntaa, a kur njep bcáâ' bboèñboñ, a lá njep rsheè ce a m soè' nje ryáá, aè ba rsheè ce a m be tuñ ñwáè njo ka'.
English: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè noèñ ce beèe a m ce tami nyor aè noâñ mmbomntaa Nyúè.
English: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

Limbum: Bbyeèñge ce a m loâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèle a du aèmbuèu Jisoès naè, a m duè a Josáèf weèe, a yá rsheè, a yá aèmboè a m láè gúâú ñwáè njo.
English: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.

Limbum: Woweèe a m kúti aè laè', a kupshi mgúr mo' tá a bo yo' gúâú ñwáè aègho. AÈ m ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, woweèe a lúshïì aèmboè ncir yi m laèa.
English: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ entoèmbïì embe múè ñgaèa, aè mú ñgaèptú' seê, bbyeèñge anaè a lor mgúr ce a m kupshi, a du faèdïì' ce rsheè li m ba.
English: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' a yá aèmboè a biñsi luèr embe nduè ncuâu rsheè.
English: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

Limbum: Woweèe a niñ njo, a yá gúâú Tata Jisoès ka'.
English: They entered in, and didn't find the Lord Jesus' body.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce báèáñger aèmboè ca, beèe a m baa a nyáá, a táá fa waâp geñ. Bcáè' ce beèe anaè a m maè' vi m ce laè'ñger seê.
English: It happened, while they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

Limbum: Bbyeèñge anaè a wáp seê, a búú btu njep nsheè. Beèe a mmbaa anaè a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce roèo ñwáâ nteèe aè múè bgúâú beèe njoká?
English: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. They said to them, Why do you seek the living among the dead?

Limbum: E yu mbena ka'. E fúú efa rkwe. Kuushi neè yuu ce e m laèa neè weèe aè nfeè' ce e m ba aè ñgoâñ Galeèle enáê,
English: He isn't here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

Limbum: ‘A be kuè fa Muu Ñwáè neè ñgaâa geèe buu bbebep, tá woweèe a taa ye mbe kïìntaa, mnoèñ vi ba btaar tá e fúú efa rkwe’ naè.”
English: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?

Limbum: A ka' laèa wa'a, woweèe a kuushïì yuu ce e m laèa anaè.
English: They remembered his words,

Limbum: Woweèe a kútïì, a suñ buu ca neè beèe ce ncoèp-moè'sir-aè-rrúèú, ker ba bár beèe.
English: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m kúti anaè aè m ba Máèári ce aè rla' Makdalaè, ba Joèanaè, ba Máèári ce e m ba ma yïì Jáêms. Woweèe ba bbyeèñge mo' ce a woweèe a m ba naè a m suñ buu ca neè ñgaâa ntuu anaè.
English: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

Limbum: Geewa'a, woweèe a byemïì yuu ce bbyeèñge ca a m suñ woweèe ka' njobeè' yi m ce yááti neè woweèe ená yuu ce a m suñ anaè aè m ba yuu cicïì.
English: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn't believe them.

Limbum: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Pitaè aè natïì a cañ a du faèdïì' ce rsheè li m ba, a ka' fyá' njo, a ku yá bcáè' ce a m kur ye njo naè aèmboè vi noèñte. E natïì a kúti, a ba neè rgha'nïì-ñwáè aè yuu ce yi m koni na.
English: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

Limbum: AÈ m ba nyúè anaè beèe a mmbaa efa waâp mú a ce duè aè mú rla' mo' ce a m ce too ená Ámayoès. AÈ rnaètïû aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm duè aè rla' ca yi yu aèmboè mar saèambaê.
English: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce duè, a ce de' aèmboè buu ca wááwá ce vi m koni.
English: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce duè ce de' aèmboè buu ca, Jisoès aè vúê, a koni woweèe, a ce duè a woweèe.
English: It happened, while they talked and questioned together, that Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

Limbum: Nyúè aè geêe, woweèe a ke' riñ ye ka'.
English: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce jáèr ce de' ba aèmboè ká?” Woweèe a táá neè ñkoosimnse-ñwáè.
English: He said to them, What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa waâp mú ce a m ce too ená Kïìlopaès, aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Waè' ku ba ba wáè efa múè beèe wááwá ce a vúè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm ce e rïìñ buu ce vi koni aèfo aè mnoèñ ca ka' a?”
English: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn't know the things which have happened there in these days?

Limbum: E bipshïì enáê, “AÈ koni ká?” Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Buu ce vi koni yu buu ce vi kuèu Jisoâs aè rla' Nasaráèt ce e m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ce e m ce laèa, ce geèe buu bghagha', a ba ñwáâ ñgoèr aè bsii Nyúè ba beèe.
English: He said to them, What things? They said to him, The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

Limbum: Yïìseèe beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ker ba ñgaâa rsa', a m koo ye a fa ye mbe mmbo govanoè tá a bo sa' ye, yú. A ka' sa', a taa ye mbe kïìntaa.
English: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

Limbum: Weèr aè m ce keè' yer ená a ye ñwáè ce e be tee beèe Isráèl efa ñgá'. Ku ba ca caè'caè' ka', mnoèñ vi yu seè'ni vi btaar káâ' nyúè ce buu ca aè m koni.
English: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

Limbum: Bbyeèñge mo' efa weâr mú a suñ weèr yuu mo' weèr aè bááñgeèr seê. Woweèe a ba du faèdïì' ce rsheè li yu aè ñgaèptú' e ntïìni na,
English: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

Limbum: a ka' baè', a yá gúâú ñwáè njep rsheè ka'. A ka' yá ka', a kúti a laa ená woweèe a yá njáèá rlo mo' aèmboè bcïìndap Nyúè, bcïìndap Nyúè anaè a suñ woweèe ená e ku cu nteèe.
English: and when they didn't find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa weâr mú a ba du faèdïì' rsheè li yu, a ka' baè', a yá buu aè ku ba aèmboè bbyeèñge ca a suñ woweèe naè, a ke' yá ye ka'.”
English: Some of us went to the tomb, and found it just like the women had said, but they didn't see him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' laèa wa'a, e laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe yu blúr, a ce sïìrni aè rbyemi yuu ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m laèa.
English: He said to them, Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

Limbum: Mboè yi m ba yáánïì ená Kraâis anaè yá ñgá' ca, tá a ka' kuè'si ye a?”
English: Didn't the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?

Limbum: E m káè' embe mñwaè' ce Musïìs aè m sañ, a du mbe mñwaè' ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè wááwá a m sañ, a nashi buu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa aèmboè ye neè woweèe.
English: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè baè' aètútú rla' ce woweèe a m ce duè aèfo naè, Jisoès aè gee aèmboè e ce caèa rla' anaè caèa wa'a.
English: They drew near to the village, where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

Limbum: Woweèe a bu' mmbo neè ye ená e fa duè ka', a laa neè ye enáê, “Seèe noñ aèfa njobeè' nyúè aè coo, mraèñrañ mi káè' a ce koshi.” Awá e du mbe ndaèp tá a woweèe a bo noèñ mbo.
English: They urged him, saying, Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over. He went in to stay with them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' cu tá a bo ye byee, e lor bráêd, a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi a fa neè woweèe.
English: It happened, that when he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave to them.

Limbum: Map mmir mi mú'ñgeèr, woweèe a riñ ye. A ka' rïìñ ye wa'a, e bú, woweèe a ker yá ye ka'.
English: Their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Mboè ntee yi ba ce luèu soè se aè nfeè' ce e ba ce laèa neè soè aè nduunjïì, a ce naèshi yuu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa naè a?”
English: They said one to another, Weren't our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?

Limbum: Woweèe a natïì mbekïì njaè' moè'sir, a kúti aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a ka' baè', a yá beèe ce ncoèp-moè'sir-aè-rrúèú, ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ba, aèmboè a cute aèbee,
English: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

Limbum: a ce laèa enáê, “Tata aè fúú efa rkwe neè mini-ñwáè, a duñshi yïì nyor neè Saimúèn.”
English: saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!

Limbum: beèe a mmbaa ca a suñ yuu ce yi m koni woweèe aè nduunjïì, a ker suñ aèmboè woweèe a m rïìñ ye aè nfeè' ce e m bá'shi bráâd a fa neè woweèe naè.
English: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' kuè bii ce suñ buu ca, Jisoès aè ku nyáá mbe waâp tar, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Cumúnyañ ba neè weèe.”
English: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, Peace be to you.

Limbum: Woweèe a m lá', a wáp seê, a ce kwaè'shi ená woweèe a yá ba nyir.
English: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Mluè mi ce koo weèe njoká? Weèe ce tarni njoká?
English: He said to them, Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

Limbum: Fyá' neè ma mmbo ba ma mkuèu tá weèe bo rïìñ ená ku ba máè seeseê. Joèo neè máè, fyá' máè, njobeè' nyir e ke túr nyaèa nyor ba bvúp aèmboè weèe aè yá máè túr na ka'.”
English: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn't have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a duñshi woweèe mi mmbo ba mi mkuèu.
English: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

Limbum: Woweèe a ku bii tarni a ke' be byemi ka', a ce yu' rboèñ, a ce báèáñger seê. E bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe túr yuu ye taâa a?”
English: While they still didn't believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, Do you have anything here to eat?

Limbum: Woweèe a fa ye tete nca ce a m laa.
English: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

Limbum: E koo a ye a waâp bsii.
English: He took them, and ate in front of them.

Limbum: E ka' ye, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Buu ca yu buu ce máè m suñ weèe aè nfeè' ce máè m ku bii weèe seèe naè. Máè m laèa máná buu wááwá ce a sañ aèmboè máè mbe ñwaâ' mncir Musïìs, ba mbe mñwaâ' ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, ker ba mbe mñwaâ' byáá vi be kuè ghááte njo.”
English: He said to them, This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a mú' waêp bfee, tá woweèe a bo rïìñ buu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi ce laèa.
English: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená Kraâis anaè be yá ñgá', mnoèñ vi ba btaar, tá e fúú efa rkwe,
English: He said to them, Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

Limbum: tá a káâ' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm feè'shi neè bto' wááwá aè li rlii ená beèe a kupse, ma' yaèp buu bbebep tá Nyúè bo foèosi woweèe.
English: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

Limbum: Weèe aè yá aèmboè buu ca aè ghááte njo, baná weèe be suñ beèe.
English: You are witnesses of these things.

Limbum: Yáê, m be duè tá m tuusi yuu ce yaè Ta aè m kaè'ni naè neè weèe. Baná weèe cu aè rla' ca, caar tá ñger embe buèu yi suu mbe weâe nduè.”
English: Behold, I send forth the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.

Limbum: E lor woweèe a fúú aègho efa múè rla', a du a ba' aèwaâa rla' Bátanïì. E ka' baè', a naa mi mmbo mbekïì, a ghoni woweèe.
English: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

Limbum: E ka' ghoèni woweèe, a ma'shi woweèe, Nyúè aè lor ye a du aègho mbe buèu.
English: It happened, while he blessed them, that he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.

Limbum: Woweèe a gú'shïì neè ye, a nati a kúti aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè seê.
English: They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

Limbum: Woweèe a m ku cu mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá a ce yoèñshi Nyúè.
English: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

Limbum: AÈ m ba efa rkáè', Nlaèa yi ku ba. Yi m ba aèbee a Nyúè. Nlaèa anaè yi m ba Nyúè.
English: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

Limbum: Yi m ku ba efa rkáè' a Nyúè.
English: The same was in the beginning with God.

Limbum: Buu wááwá aè m geèe yi aè ñger Nyúè. Yuu mo' yi yu ce yi m buu efa rgeèe ka'.
English: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.

Limbum: Ryoèñ li m vúè ba ese yi. Ryoèñ anaè li m ba rraa neè beèe.
English: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

Limbum: Rraa anaè li ke raa aè túè'nji. Túè'nji aè m be liisi rraa anaè ka'.
English: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn't overcome it.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba ce Nyúè aè m tuu. Li rlii li m ba ená Joân.
English: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

Limbum: E m vúè tá e bo suñ beèe aèmboè rraa anaè tá beèe a bo byemi njobeè' e suñ woweèe.
English: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

Limbum: E m ba rraa anaè ka'. E m ku vú yi ba aè rsuñ beèe aèmboè rraa anaè.
English: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

Limbum: Rraa mini ce li ke raa mbenduè beèe wááwá naè li m vúè njep ñgoèñ.
English: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

Limbum: E m ba njep ñgoèñ. Ñgoèñ ca aè m geèe ye aè ñger Nyúè. Ñgoèñ yi m rïìñ ye ka'.
English: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn't recognize him.

Limbum: E m vúè fa yeâ laè', yïì beèe a konïì ye ka'.
English: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn't receive him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a m koni ye a ker byemi neè ye foñ naè, e fa ñger ená woweèe a beeñger ba boo Nyúè.
English: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God's children, to those who believe in his name:

Limbum: Boo ce a bi ba aèmboè a ke bi boo naè ka'. Yu ba boo ce a bi ba aèmboè Nyúè koèñ.
English: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

Limbum: Nlaèa anaè yi m beèeñger aè ñwáè ghup, a cu a weâr mú. Weèr aè m yá yi foèo ce yi m loè ba ese yïì Taê. Nyúè aè m fa njáèá foèo ca ba neè muu yïì ce e ku ba moè'sir. Weèr aè m yá rboâñ Nyúè ba mini Nyúè ba njep ye.
English: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

Limbum: Joân a ñwáè ce e m suñ beèe aèmboè ye. E m laèa enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ce máè m suñ weèe ená e bii ka' vúè naè. Máè m suñ weèe ená nta' ñwáè anaè yi caèa ya, njobeè' tá a ka' keè bi máè, e m ku ba.”
English: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, This was he of whom I said, 'He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.'

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njo' ku' li rboèñ, seèe wááwá aè konïì bghoènïì ese ye ñkaèraè' aèñgoo.
English: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m fa seèe mncir ba njïì enjep Musïìs, aè ka' ba njïì enjep Jisos Kraêis, seèe aè rïìñ rboâñ Nyúè ba mini Nyúè.
English: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m be yá Nyúè ka'. Muu Nyúè ce e ku ba moè'sir, a ker ba mntee Nyúè, a ye ce e duèñshi seèe njáèá ñwáè ce yïì Ta yu.
English: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.

Limbum: Jus ce aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a m tuu beèe moè' efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba beèe Lávïì ená a du yá Joân, bipshi neè ye enáê, “A wáè nda?”
English: This is John's testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you?

Limbum: Joân aè m kani efa rbeèesi yuu ce woweèe a m bipshi na ka'. Cena a yuu ce e m laèa neè woweèe aè bsii beèe wááwá. E m laèa enáê, “A máè Kraâis anaè ka'”
English: He declared, and didn't deny, but he declared, I am not the Christ.

Limbum: Woweèe a ker bipshi neè ye enáê, “Baná a wáè nda? A wáè AÈlajaè a?” E beesïì enáê, “A máè AÈlajaè ka'.” Woweèe a ker bipshi enáê, “A wáè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè anaè a?” Joân aè kanïì.
English: They asked him, What then? Are you Elijah? He said, I am not. Are you the prophet? He answered, No.

Limbum: Woweèe a ker bipshi neè ye enáê, “Baná a wáè nda seê? Suñ weèr njáèá ñwáè ce aè yu tá weèr bo kúti suñ beèe ce a ba tuu weèr.”
English: They said therefore to him, Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?

Limbum: Joân aè beesïì enáê, “A máè ñwáè ce AÈsayaè aè m laèa aèmboè ye eluâuñgoèñ enáê, ‘Njeèndoñ moè' ce fuñ aè ntee rïìñ enáê, Kupshi neè nduunjïì neè Tata.’”
English: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make straight the way of the Lord,' as Isaiah the prophet said.

Limbum: Beèe moè' ce beèe Farïìsi a m tuu
English: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

Limbum: a m bipshi neè Joân enáê, “Wáè ka' tá ba Kraâis anaè ka', ba AÈlajaè ka', ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ce Nyúè aè m laèa ená e be tuu naè ka', wáè ka' ce baèptir beèe njoká?”
English: They asked him, Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?

Limbum: Joân aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “M ce baèptir beèe ba neè mdip. Ñwáè moè' yu a weâe mú, ce weèe aè be riñ ye ka'.
English: John answered them, I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don't know.

Limbum: A ye ce e ce vúè embe máâ njïì. Yi nta' yi caèa ya. Máè ghááte aè ñwáè ce aède' m co'ni vi blaba' ka'.”
English: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I'm not worthy to loosen.

Limbum: Buu ca vi m koni ba aè rla' Bátanïì ce li yu neèñguu rdip Jodaèn. A faèdïì' Joân aè m ce baèptir beèe.
English: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, Joân aè yá aèmboè Jisoès ce vúè aè ryá ye, a laa enáê, “Yá neè Muu Njeèe Nyúè ce e be siñsi buu bbebep enjep ñgoèñ.
English: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

Limbum: A ñwáè ce máè m ce laèa mánáê, ‘Ñwáè moè' ce vúè embe máâ njïì ce yi nta' yi caèa ya njobeè' a m bii ka' bi máè, e ku ba naè.’
English: This is he of whom I said, 'After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.'

Limbum: Máè m rïìñ máná a ye Kraâis anaè ka'. Geewa'a, mbuèu ce máè m vúè ya ce baèptir beèe aè to' Isráèl aè m ba ená woweèe a bo rïìñ ye.”
English: I didn't know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.

Limbum: Joân aè m suñ beèe ba yuu ce e m yá, a laa enáê, “Máè m yá aèmboè Yú' Rara yi ce suèu embe buèu aèmboè beèñ wa'a, a cu mbe yeâ nduè.
English: John testified, saying, I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè máè be riñ ye ka'. Geewa'a Nyúè ce e m tuu máè ená m vú baptir beèe aè m laèa neè máè wáá enáê, ‘Ñwáè ce aè be yá aèmboè Yú' yi be suèu embe buèu, cu mbe yeâ nduè, a ñwáè ce e be baèptir beèe neè Yú' Rara.’
English: I didn't recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, 'On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.'

Limbum: Máè yá neè mini-ñwáè, a ce suñ weèe rara ená ñwáè anaè yu Muu Nyúè.”
English: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' keèr raa, Joân aè táá a beèe a mmbaa ce e m ce yá'ni woweèe.
English: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

Limbum: E ka' yá aèmboè Jisoès ce caèa, a laa enáê, “Yá neè muu njeèe Nyúè.”
English: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, Behold, the Lamb of God!

Limbum: beèe a mmbaa anaè a ka' yu' aèmboè Joân aè laèa wa'a, a nati a du aèmbuèu Jisoès.
English: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' karsi nyor yá aèmboè woweèe a ce vúè a yeâ mbuèu, e bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce roèo ba ká?” Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Rabaèi ce yi yu ená Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, aè ce cu ba fá?”
English: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, What are you looking for? They said to him, Rabbi which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher, where are you staying?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Vúè neè yá.” Woweèe a du a yá faèdïì' e m ce cu, a cu a Jisoès weèe, ká' embe nfeè' nyúè aè m káè' a ce coo.
English: He said to them, Come, and see. They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

Limbum: Moè' efa beèe a mmbaa ca ce e m yu' yuu Joân aè m laèa a du aèmbuèu Jisoès foñ naè aè m ba Andruè nfúr Saimún Pitaè.
English: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

Limbum: E m naèti a du cárcár seê, a du a yá nfúr yïû Saimún Pitaè a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr aè yá Máèsayaè.” Rlii ca li yu ená Kraêis ñwáè ce a ghar.
English: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, We have found the Messiah! which is, being interpreted, Christ.

Limbum: E m loèr ye a ye a du a yá Jisoès. Jisoès aè ke' Saimúèn a laa enáê, “Wáâ Saimúèn ce aè yu muu Joân, a be too wáè ená Káfaès.” Rlii ce ená Káfaès na li ku ba foñ aèmboè rlii ce li yu ená Pitaè naè.
English: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas which is by interpretation, Peter.

Limbum: Túè' moè' aè ka' keèr raa, Jisoès aè natïì ená e ce duè aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê. E m roèo Feleêp, a yá ye, a laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè fa máâ mbuèu.”
