English: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, Follow me.

Limbum: Felep ca aè m ba ñwáâ aè rla' Báètsaidaè aèmboè Andruè ba Saimún Pitaè a m ba.
English: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

Limbum: Felep ye ye aè m yá Naètanïìyáèl a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr aè yá ñwáè ce Musïìs aè m sañ aèmboè ye mbe ñwaè' mncir, ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a ker sañ aèmboè ye foñ naè. A ye Jisoès muu Josáèf ce aè rla' Nasaráèt.”
English: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

Limbum: Naètanïìyáèl aè laa neè ye enáê, “Waè' aède' yuu boèñboñ yi fúú aè rla' Nasaráèt a?” Felep aè laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè yá.”
English: Nathanael said to him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip said to him, Come and see.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá aèmboè Naètanïìyáèl ce vúè aè ryá ye, e laa yuu a kuu ye. E m laèa enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu ñwáè Isráèl ghup, a ba ñwáè nlaèayá.”
English: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!

Limbum: Naètanïìyáèl aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Wáè rïìñ máè aè njáâá ká?” Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Tá Felep ka' ká' wáè, máè ba yá wáè aè nfeè' ce wáè ba cu njep mbuèu ce ce a too ená fik naè.”
English: Nathanael said to him, How do you know me? Jesus answered him, Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.

Limbum: Naètanïìyáèl aè laa neè ye enáê, “Rabaèi, a wáè Muu Nyúè. A wáè ñkúú aè to' Isráèl.”
English: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, Jisoès ye ye aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè ku byemi ba njobeè' máè ba laa máná máè ba yá wáè aè nfeè' wáè ba cu njep mbuèu ce ce a too ená fik naè a? AÈ be yá buu mo' ce vi be caèa cena.”
English: Jesus answered him, Because I told you, 'I saw you underneath the fig tree,' do you believe? You will see greater things than these!

Limbum: E m ker laa enáê, “M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená weèe be yá aèmboè rbuu li be múè'ti tá bcïìndap Nyúè a ce ko' ce suèu mbenduè Muu Ñwáè.”
English: He said to him, Most certainly, I tell you, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi ka' ba btaar, beèe mo' a ce geèe Ñkaâ' bguèu aè rla' Kánaè aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê. Ma yïì Jisoès aè m ba aèfo.
English: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus' mother was there.

Limbum: A m be Jisoès ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu aè ñkaè' ca foñ.
English: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.

Limbum: Mruè' ñkaè' ca mi ka' mïì, ma yïì Jisoès aè laa neè Jisoès enáê, “A no mruè' mi sáê.”
English: When the wine ran out, Jesus' mother said to him, They have no wine.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Njeñwáè, aè ce laèa ba neè máè njoká? Nfeè' yaè aè be gháá ka'.”
English: Jesus said to her, Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.

Limbum: Yïì ma aè laa neè ñgaâa mfaè' enáê, “Geèe neè yuu ce e ka' suñ weèe ená weèe geêe.”
English: His mother said to the servants, Whatever he says to you, do it.

Limbum: Mntúñ bluèr vi m ba aèfo vi ntuunfu. AÈ m ba mntúñ ce Jus a m ce tár mdip njo tá a bo ce suè'si nyor aègho, ce ba brara aè bsii Nyúè. AÈde' bgaloèn mdip vi m ba ku du njep ntúñ moè'sir aèmboè mmbaa du ba' mntaar wa'a.
English: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews' way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa mfaè' enáê, “Tu' neè mdip cu'ni njep mntúñ ca.” Woweèe a m tu' mdip a cu'ni njep mntúñ anaè mi ruu aègho wááwá.
English: Jesus said to them, Fill the water pots with water. They filled them up to the brim.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Sápsi neè mdip anaè du fa neè ñwáè ce e ce gaèpshi buu ñkaè'.” Woweèe a m ku gee aèmboè e m laèa.
English: He said to them, Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast. So they took it.

Limbum: Ñwáè rgaèpshïì aè yu'shïì mdip ce mi m beèeñger aè mruè' na, a riñ faèdïì' mi loè ka'. Geewa'a ñgaâa mfaè' a m rïìñ faèdïì' mi m loè. E ká' nduèu guèu,
English: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn't know where it came from but the servants who had drawn the water knew, the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Beèe a ke tar beèe, vú neè mruâ' mboèñmboñ entombïì, beèe a no yu' wáá, e ka' vú neè mïì ce mi boèñ goèr ka'. Wáè geèe yo jáá. Wáè loèr mruâ' mmboèñmboñ a tar beèe aègho ba aèlúèsimbuèu.”
English: and said to him, Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!

Limbum: Yuu ghagha' ce Jisoès aè m geèe aè rla' Kánaè aè ñgoâñ Galeèle na, aè m ba ncoèo entombïì ce e m duèñshi njáèá foèo ce e túr. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yá, a byemi neè ye.
English: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

Limbum: A ka' ye ñkaè' mïìsi, Jisoès ba yïì ma ba bfúr vi ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a natïì a du aè rla' Kaèpanuèm a cu aèfo aè mú mnoèñ mo'.
English: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè m káè' a ce gháá ce beèe Jus a ke ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap. Jisoès aè du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm tá e bo ye ñkaè' anaè foñ.
English: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

Limbum: E ka' duè baè', a niñ mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a yá aèmboè beèe a ce fyeèni naè', ba njeèe, ba bbeèñ a ker yá aèmboè beèe a ce kupse mbaèa mbo.
English: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

Limbum: E lor kúè a gee ñgwaèa aègho, a juu beèe anaè aègho, a ker juu yap njeèe ba yap naè' embe Ndaèp Nyúè. E m buète btábuèr ese beèe ce a m ce kupse mbaèa naè, a da'si yap mbaèa anaè aè nsheè.
English: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers' money, and overthrew their tables.

Limbum: E m laèa neè beèe ce a m ce fyeèni bbeèñ naè enáê, “Loèr neè buu anaè duse aègho. Weèe aè geèe ndap yaè Ta aè kútïì ndap ntaa njoká?”
English: To those who sold the doves, he said, Take these things out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace!

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu anaè a ka' yá aèmboè e geèe wa'a, woweèe a kuushïì yuu ce a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Njáèá rkoèñnïì ce máè túr neè yoè ndap li be yú máè” naè.
English: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for your house will eat me up.

Limbum: Jus a laa neè ye enáê, “Yuu ce aède' aè gee aèmboè ncoèo aè rduèñshi weèr ená aè túr ñger aè rgeèe buu ca, yu ká?”
English: The Jews therefore answered him, What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ka' sa' Ndap Nyúè ca, m lor mnoâñ btaar ba'rïî.”
English: Jesus answered them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Habai! A m baè'ri Ndap Nyúè ca aè bfeè' ncoèp-ntuunfu- aè-mñkyeèe. AÈde' aè gee wá ká ka' ba'ri aè mnoâñ btaar?”
English: The Jews therefore said, It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?

Limbum: Geewa'a Jisoès aè m ce laèa aèmboè Ndap Nyúè ca, a ce laèa ba aèmboè yïì nyor.
English: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

Limbum: E ka' loâ fúú efa rkwe, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a kuushïì yuu ce e m laèa anaè. A ka' kuushi, a byemi yuu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa, a ker byemi yuu ce Jisoès aè m laèa anaè.
English: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a duñshi mncoèo, vi gee beèe magoèr a byemïì neè ye seê.
English: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

Limbum: Geewa'a, e m fa yïì nyor neè woweèe ka' njobeè' e m rïìñ mntee beèe wááwá.
English: But Jesus didn't trust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

Limbum: Mbuèu moè' aè m ker ba aègho ená a suñ ye aèmboè ñwáè ka', njobeè' e m rïìñ buu ce beèe a ce kwaè'shi wáá.
English: and because he didn't need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

Limbum: Ñwáâ ñgoèr moè' aè m ba aè múè Juês, a too ye ená Nïìkoèdámoès. E m ba moè' efa múè beèe Farïìsïî.
English: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba neètú' moè', e du a yá Jisoès, a laa neè ye enáê, “Rabaèi, weèr rïìñ werná a wáè ñwáè ryá'nïì ce Nyúè aè tuu, njobeè' Nyúè aè ka' tá fa ñwáè ñger ka', aède' ñgaèñ duñshïì mncoèo ce aè ce duèñshi na ka'.”
English: The same came to him by night, and said to him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená a ka' tá bi ñwáè nfeè' baa ka', aède' ñgaèñ yá kúú Nyúè ka'.”
English: Jesus answered him, Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can't see the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Nïìkoèdámoès aè bipshïì enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' ba nleeñwáè wáá, aède' a gee eká ka' ker bi ye? Waè' aède' e ker kúti njep rbúè yïì maê, a bi ye ñkaèraè' baa a?”
English: Nicodemus said to him, How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená a ka' tá bi ñwáè neè mdip ker ba neè yú' ka', aède' ñgaèñ niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè ka'.
English: Jesus answered, Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can't enter into the Kingdom of God!

Limbum: Yuu ce ñwáè aè bi, yu yïû ñwáè. Yuu ce yú' yi bi, aè ba yïû yú'.
English: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

Limbum: Fa báèáñger njobeè' máè laèa neè wáè ená a be kuè keèr bi ñwáè nfeè' baa ka'.
English: Don't marvel that I said to you, 'You must be born anew.'

Limbum: Fu' yi ke caèa, kashi aèmboè yi gwáá, aè yu' aèmboè yi coèo. Wáâ yu' wa', riñ faèdïì' yi loè káè faèdïì' ce yi ce duè ka'. Yi ku ba wa'a neè ñwáè ce Yú' yi bi ye.”
English: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don't know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.

Limbum: Nïìkoèdámoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÈde' buu ca vi ba wa'a aè njáâá ká?”
English: Nicodemus answered him, How can these things be?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè ce aè yu ñwáè ryá'nïû aè to' Isráèl, wáè rïìñ buu ca ka' a?”
English: Jesus answered him, Are you the teacher of Israel, and don't understand these things?

Limbum: “M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená weèr ce laèa ba buu ce weèr rïìñ, a ce suñ weèe ba buu ce weèr aè yá neè mer mmir. Weèr aè ka' ce suñ weèe buu ca, weèe aè ke' byemïì ka'.
English: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don't receive our witness.

Limbum: Máè suñ weèe aèmboè buu enjep ñgoèñ na, weèe aè byemïì ka', m ka' suñ weèe aèmboè buu embe buèu, weèe gee wee ká ka' byemi?
English: If I told you earthly things and you don't believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' yu aègho ce e m be du mbe buèu caa efa Muu Ñwáè ce e m loè embo a suu njep ñgoèñ na ka'.
English: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

Limbum: AÈmboè Musïìs aè m naèa nyo ce a m toèo neè bco' mbekïì aè nfeè' woweèe a m ce jáèr aè rïìñ naè, a mboè a be kuè keè naèa Muu Ñwáè wa'a,
English: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

Limbum: tá ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè ye, e bo koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m koèñ beèe enjep ñgoèñ magoèr seê, a tuu Muu yïì ce e ku ba moè'sir ená ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè ye, e bo kwe ka', koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m tuu Muu yïì njep ñgoèñ ená e vú sa' beèe enjep ñgoèñ ka', e m tuu Muu yi ená woweèe a bo luèñ njo' ye.
English: For God didn't send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè ye, e luèñ efa mnsa'. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá byemi neè ye ka', baná ñgaèñ aè gweè mnsa' njobeè' e kani efa rbyemi neè Muu yïì ce e ku ba moè'sir.
English: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn't believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

Limbum: A mboè mnsa' anaè vi yu aè njáèá enáê: Rraa li vúè njep ñgoèñ, beèe a koñ ba túè'nji a caa rraa njobeè' woweèe a ce geèe buu bbebep.
English: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe buu bbebep baná ñgaèñ koèñ rraa ka', a koñ aè rbaè' faèdïì' rraa li yu ka', tá yïì buu bbebep bo yááti aèwañ ka'.
English: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn't come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ce geèe yuu mini, e ke vúè faèdïì' rraa li yu tá beèe a bo yá rara ená e ce geèe ba yuu ce Nyúè koèñ.”
English: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.

Limbum: Buu ca aè ka' mïì wáá, Jisoès ba ñgaâa yá'nïì yïì buu a natïì a du aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, e cu a woweèe aèfo, a baptir beèe.
English: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Joân aè m ce baèptir beèe aè rla' Ánoèn aègee rla' Salïìm. Mdip mi m ba aèfo seê. Beèe a m ce vúè, e ce baèptir woweèe.
English: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè a be neè fa Joân aè shañ ka'.
English: For John was not yet thrown into prison.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'nïì buu Joân mo' a m káè' a ce sár mnsár a ñwáè moè' efa múè Jus aèmboè aède' ñwáè su'sïì nyor ba nrara aè bsii Nyúè.
English: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification.

Limbum: Woweèe a du a yá Joân a laa neè ye enáê, “Rabaèi, ñwáè ce weèe ye aè m ba neèñguu rdip Jodaèn, wáè suñ beèe aèmboè ye naè, ñwáè anaè ce baèptir beèe, beèe wááwá a ce duè yeâ mbuèu.”
English: They came to John, and said to him, Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.

Limbum: Joân aè beesïì a laa enáê, “AÈtaè ñwáè túr yuu mo' caa efa yïì ce Nyúè aè fa neè ye ka'.
English: John answered, A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.

Limbum: Wee weèe foñ aè m yu' aèmboè máè m laèa ená a máè Kraâis naè ka'. M yu ya ba ñwáè ce a tuu ená e du entombïì neè ye.
English: You yourselves testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ,' but, 'I have been sent before him.'

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ke túr ñgwaguèu yu ba nduu. Ñkar nduu ka' táá ce yu' aèmboè nduu anaè ce laèa, baná e be lu'shi magoèr seê. A mboè yi ku ba neè máè wa'a. M ce lu'shi se njobeè' m yu ñkar nduu anaè.
English: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.

Limbum: Yi nta' yi be kuè ce duè entombïì, tá ya yi ce kúti njïìnjïì.
English: He must increase, but I must decrease.

Limbum: “Ñwáè ce e suèu embe buèu a ñwáè ce e yu mbenduè buu wááwá. Ñwáè enjep ñgoèñ ku ba ñwáè enjep ñgoèñ, a ce laèa yi ba aèmboè buu enjep ñgoèñ. Ñwáè ce e suèu yi ba embe buèu naè yu mbenduè buu wááwá ce Nyúè aè m geèe.
English: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the Earth belongs to the Earth, and speaks of the Earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

Limbum: E ce laèa ba buu ce e m yá neè mi mmir, a yu' neè vi btuè'. Geewa'a beèe a byemi yuu ce e ce laèa ka'.
English: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi yuu ce e laèa, baná ñgaèñ ce duèñshi ená yuu Nyúè aè laèa yi yu mini.
English: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce Nyúè aè tuu ce suñ beèe blaâa Nyúè, njobeè' Nyúè aè loèr yi Yú' a fa neè ye a bár yuu mo' ka'.
English: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

Limbum: Taèr koèñ Muu yïì, a fa buu wááwá mba yeâ mmboè.
English: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè Muu baná ñgaèñ be koni ryoèñ. Ñwáè ce e ka' kani efa rbyemi neè Muu yïì baná ñgaèñ be koni ryoèñ ka'. Nyúè be cápshi nteèe neè ñwáè anaè nfeseè.”
English: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won't see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a m yu' ená ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès ker ba beèe ce Jisoès aè m baèptir naè a m ba goèr a caa ñgaâa yá'ni buu Joân.
English: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

Limbum: Gee ne wa'a, Jisoès a ñwáè ce e m ce baèptir beèe ka'. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ca a beèe ce a m ce baèptir beèe neè ye.
English: although Jesus himself didn't baptize, but his disciples,

Limbum: Tata Jisoès aè ka' rïìñ ená beèe Farïìsi a yu' buu ca, e natïû aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a ce kúti aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.

Limbum: AÈmboè e m ce kúti anaè, yi m ba ená e be kuè duè ba njïû aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè.
English: He needed to pass through Samaria.

Limbum: E ka' ce jáèr ce caèa aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè anaè, a ba' aè rla' mo' ce a m ce too ená Sikaè. Rla' ca li m ba aègee ñkúè ce Jakoèp aè m fa neè muu yïû Josáèf.
English: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.

Limbum: Jakoèp aè m túr rdip rtuñ aèfo. Jisoès aè ka' baè' fa rdip anaè, a lúshi aègee mo njobeè' e m jáèr a sáê. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè nyúè aè ká' a ce kuèu ñgoèñ.
English: Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moâ' aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè aè m vúè aè rtu' mdip. Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Fa máè mdip tá m no.”
English: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, Give me a drink.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a m ba neè du aè ryuu byee aè múè rla'.
English: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Haba! Mboè a wáè ñwáè Jus a? Yi loè efaè ká, wáè ka' ce loo mdip ese máè ce m yu njeñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè?” Jus ba beèe aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè a ke geèe buu aèbee ka'. è
English: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman? For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè ba riñ yuu ce Nyúè e ke fa neè beèe, ker riñ njáèá ñwáè ce e ce loo mdip ese wáè tá e bo no, aè ba loo ba wáè ená e fa wáè mdip ce mi ke mïì ka', tá e fa wáè mdip anaè.”
English: Jesus answered her, If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, 'Give me a drink,' you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè laa enáê, “Yaè taê, rdip rtuñ ca li coomi seê. AÈ túr yuu ce aè be tu' mdip aègho ka', baná aè be tu' mdip ce mi ke mïì ka' efá?
English: The woman said to him, Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. From where then have you that living water?

Limbum: Waè' aè caèa yeèr ta Jakoèp ce e m tuñ rdip ca neè weèr a? E m no mdip enjep rdip rtuñ ca a boo vi weèe ker ba yi nyaèa.”
English: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' no mdip enjep rdip rtuñ ca, ntee mdip yi ku lo luu ye.
English: Jesus answered her, Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' no mdip ce aè fa máè a fa ye, aède' ntee mdip yi ker luu ye aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Mdip ce m be fa ñgaèñ mi be ba neè ye aèmboè rdip ce li be ce fúú aè nfeè' wááwá, geèe tá e koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.”
English: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Yaè taê, fa máè njáèá mdip anaè tá m no, faè dïì' ntee mdip yi bo keèr luèu máè tá m ker ce vúè aè rtu' mdip aèfa ka'.”
English: The woman said to him, Sir, give me this water, so that I don't get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Duè vú neè nduu woè.”
English: Jesus said to her, Go, call your husband, and come here.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè laa enáê, “M túr nduu ka'.” Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÂ laèa mini ghup ená aè túr nduu ka'.
English: The woman answered, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You said well, 'I have no husband,'

Limbum: Wáè m duè bguèu mndap taê. Ñwáè ce weèe ye ce cu seè'ni na, a nduu woè ka'. Wáè laèa yuu mini ghup.”
English: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Masaè, máè yá máná aè yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: The woman said to him, Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

Limbum: Wer btarkú a m ce duè rloo mbe rtuâu aèfa na, weèe a ce laèa ye ená dïì' ce aède' beèe a du rloo ku ba ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.”
English: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Njeñwáè, m ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená nfeè' ce gháá ce beèe a be keèr duè rloo mbe rtuèu ca ka', ka' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: Jesus said to her, Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ñwáè ce weâe ke loo neè ye ka'. Weèr rïìñ ñwáè ce wer ke loo neè ye njobeè' rluèñ li ke loè ba ese Juês.
English: You worship that which you don't know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

Limbum: Nfeè' ce vúè, nfeè' anaè aè ghááte seè'ni na, ce ñgaâa rloo ce mini a be loo neè Taèr aè yú' ker ba aè mini. A njáèá ñgaâa rloo ce Taèr e koèñ.
English: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshippers.

Limbum: Nyúè yu yú'. Baná beèe ce a ce loo neè ye a be kuè loo aè yú' ker ba aè mini.”
English: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Máè rïìñ máná Máèsayaè ce a too ená Kraâis naè be vúè. E be vúè tá e suñ seèe buu wááwá.”
English: The woman said to him, I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Máè ce m ce laèa neè wáè na, a máè ñwáè anaè.”
English: Jesus said to her, I am he, the one who speaks to you.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' anaè, ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a kútïì. A ka' kúti yá aèmboè Jisoès ce de' a njeñwáè, woweèe a bááñgeèr seê. Ñwáè moè' aè m bipshi yuu ce njeñwáè anaè aè m ce roèo káè mbuèu ce Jisoès aè m ce de' a ye ka'.
English: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, What are you looking for? or, Why do you speak with her?

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè m tár ntúñ mdip a kúti aè laè' a laa neè beèe enáê,
English: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,

Limbum: “Vúè neè vú yá ñwáè ce e suñ máè buu wááwá ce máè m ce geèe. Seemoè' ñwáè anaè a Kraêis.”
English: Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?

Limbum: Woweèe a fúú aè rla' anaè a duè aè ryá ye.
English: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

Limbum: AÈmboè njeñwáè ca aè m kúti aè laè' naè, ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès ca a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Rabaèi, ye yuu seè'ni.”
English: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, Rabbi, eat.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “M túr njáèá byee mo' ce weèe rïìñ ka'.”
English: But he said to them, I have food to eat that you don't know about.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu', a laa a waâp mú enáê, “Ñwáè aè vúè neè byee a fa neè ye a?”
English: The disciples therefore said one to another, Has anyone brought him something to eat?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Wa byee yu ená m gee yuu ce Nyúè ce e m tuu máè koèñ, ker misi rfaè' ce e m fa neè máè.
English: Jesus said to them, My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.

Limbum: Weèe ce kwaè'shi ená mñwáá vi báti kyeèe tá a ka' kep kwaa efa mñkúè. M ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe naa me mmir fyá' aè mñkúè. Kwaa aè baèñ, nfeè' rkep aè ce gháá.
English: Don't you say, 'There are yet four months until the harvest?' Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e be kep buu efa mñkúè ce yá sá' efa li rfaè' wáá. E ce baashi byee ce vi bo koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè, tá ñwáè rbyeè ker ba ñwáè rkep a bo lu'shi bsïìp.
English: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

Limbum: Yi ku ba foñ aèmboè a ke maè' ñgaèa ená ñwáè jáá byeê, ñwáè jáá kep naè.
English: For in this the saying is true, 'One sows, and another reaps.'

Limbum: Máè tuu weèe ená weèe du kep buu ce weèe aè m byeè ka'. Beèe mo' a m byeè, weèe aè ye sá' efa rfaè' beèe anaè.”
English: I sent you to reap that for which you haven't labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.

Limbum: Beèe magoâr aè ñgoèñ Saèmarïìyaè ce a m vúâ aè rla' Sikaè a m byemi neè Jisoès njobeè' njeñwáè anaè aè m laèa enáê, “E suñ máè buu wááwá ce máè m geèe.”
English: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, He told me everything that I did.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúè yá Jisoès, a bu' mmbo neè ye ená a woweèe a cu. Jisoès aè byemïì, a cu a woweèe aè mnoâñ bbaa.
English: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

Limbum: Beèe mo' goèr se a ker byemi neè ye njobeè' buu ce e m suñ woweèe.
English: Many more believed because of his word.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa neè njeñwáè anaè enáê, “Weèr aè ku byemi ba njo' yuu ce wáè suñ weèr ka', weèr aè yu' seè'ni neè wer btuè', a riñ neè mini-ñwáè werná ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ce e be geèe tá ñgoèñ yi luêñ.”
English: They said to the woman, Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.

Limbum: Mnoâñ bbaa ca vi ka' caèa, Jisoès aè natïì a ce duè aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

Limbum: Jisoès neè yi tu nyor aè m be laa ená a ke yu'ni neè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè fa yeâ ñgoèñ ka'.
English: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

Limbum: Geewa'a, e ka' baè' aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, beâe aè ñgoâñ Galeèle a konïì ye boèñboñ seê, njobeè' woweèe foñ a m duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap, a yá buu ce Jisoès aè m geèe aè nfeè' ce a m ce ye ñkaè' anaè.
English: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ba aè ñgoâñ Galeèle wa'a, a ker du aè rla' Kánaè faèdïì' ce e m beèesi mdip mi kútïì mruè' naè. Ñwáâ ñgoèr moè' aè m ba aèfo ce muu yïì aè m ce yañ aè rla' ce a m ce too ená Kaèpanuèm.
English: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

Limbum: Ñwáâ ñgoèr ca aè ka' yu' ená Jisoès aè naètïû aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a vú aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, e du a yá ye, a bu' mmbo neè ye ená a ye a du aè rla' Kaèpanuèm tá e bo gee muu yïì ce e m ce yañ a ku ba yïû ñkwe, ke'se.
English: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Weèe ku ce koèñ aè ryá mncoèo ba buu bbáèá ka' byemi neè máè.”
English: Jesus therefore said to him, Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.

Limbum: Ñwáâ ñgoèr anaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Yaè taê, soè ce du faè dïì' muu waè kwe ka'.”
English: The nobleman said to him, Sir, come down before my child dies.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Duè, muu woè be kwe ka'.” Ñwáâ ñgoèr anaè aè byemïì yuu ce Jisoès aè m laèa, a nati a ce kúti.
English: Jesus said to him, Go your way. Your son lives. The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

Limbum: E ka' kúti baè' aèwaâa rla', ñgaâa mfaè' a vú a koni ye a laa neè ye ená muu yïì aè luèñ.
English: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying Your child lives!

Limbum: E bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Muu ca aè mú ká' a ce luèñ ba aè nfeè' efá?” Woweèe a beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “E mú luñ neèñkuèr aè nfeè' nyúè aè mú ká' a ce lá'si nyor.”
English: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.

Limbum: Tar muu aè kuushïì ená nfeè' muu yïì aè mú naa rlir anaè ku ba nfeè' ce Jisoès aè mú laa neè ye ená muu yïì be kwe ka' naè. Ye yi tu nyor ker ba beèe embe yeâ ndaèp wááwá a byemïì neè Jisoès.
English: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, Your son lives. He believed, as did his whole house.

Limbum: Yuu ghagha' ca a ncoèo embenjïì ce Jisoès aè m geèe aè nfeè' ce e m loâ aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a kúti aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

Limbum: Buu ca vi ka' mïì wáá, Jus a ce ye yap ñkaè' mo'. Jisoès aè du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

Limbum: Túè mo' yi m ba aè rla' anaè aègee cuâu ñka' mo' ce a m ce too ená cuèu ñka' njeèe. A too rlii túè anaè aè li Hibruè ená Báètsataè. A m baè'ri btaèp mbuèu too aèwaâa túè anaè vi taê.
English: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, Bethesda, having five porches.

Limbum: Ku' ñgaâa byañ a m noèñte aè btaèp anaè. Beèe mo' efa woweèe a m feèp, beèe mo' a ba mntáèñ, mñgúè' nyor mmo' vi kweñgeèr beèe mo'. Woweèe a m cu a ce keè' nfeè' ce túè be káè' ce bañti.
English: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè aè m ce loâ vúè ce geèe túè anaè yi ce bañti. Túè anaè yi m ce bañti wa'a, ñwáè ce e ka' gwe njo entombïì, e m ka' ce yañ ba njáèá yañ ká, baná e be luèñ.
English: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool, and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was made whole of whatever disease he had.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba aèfo ce e m yañ aè bfeè' ncoèp-waami-aè-mntaar.
English: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' vúè baè' a yá aèmboè ñwáè anaè noèñ. E m rïìñ ená ñwáè anaè aè m yañ nfeè' njïìsaèp seê. E laa neè ye enáê, “Wáâ koèñ aè rluèñ efa yo yañ ca a?”
English: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, Do you want to be made well?

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Masaè, e ke ba aè nfeè' ce túè aè bañti m túr ñwáè ce e lor máè duè aègho njo ka'. Má loâ gheèter aè nfeè' anaè ená m du njo, ñwáè moè' ku du entombïì neè máè.”
English: The sick man answered him, Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I'm coming, another steps down before me.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Naèti mbekïì, lor lo rwaèa ce duê.”
English: Jesus said to him, Arise, take up your mat, and walk.

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè ku luñ aè nfeè' anaè a lor li rwaèa a ce duè. Noèñ ce Jisoès aè m geèe ñwáè anaè e luñ efa yi yañ anaè, aè m ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè.
English: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jus laa neè ñwáè ce Jisoès aè ba gee e luñ naè enáê, “Wáè rïìñ ená ntïìni a mmbomntaa. Wáè byáè' rwaèa anaè wa'a, a bú' ncir.”
English: So the Jews said to him who was cured, It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ba gee máè luñ efa ya yañ aè ba laa neè máè ená m lor la rwaèa ce duê.”
English: He answered them, He who made me well, the same said to me, 'Take up your mat, and walk.'

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ba laa ená aè lor lo rwaèa du aè ba laa nda anaè?”
English: Then they asked him, Who is the man who said to you, 'Take up your mat, and walk'?

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè m rïìñ ñwáè ce e m geèe ye e luñ efa yi yañ ka', njobeè' Jisoès aè m loè a bú aè múè kúr beèe ce a m ba aèfo.
English: But he who was healed didn't know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

Limbum: Mú nfeè' moè' aè ka' tuuse, Jisoès aè yá ñwáè ce e m geèe ye e luñ naè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a laa neè ye enáê, “Yáê, wáè luèñ efa yo yañ. Fa keèr geèe buu bbebep ka', faè dïì' ñgá' moè' goèr lo koni wáè caèa cena ka'.”
English: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè aè du a suñ Jus ená ñwáè ce e geèe ye e luñ aè geèe Jisoès.
English: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

Limbum: Woweèe a ká' a ce fa Jisoès ñgá' njobeè' buu ce e m geèe nyúè mmbomntaa.
English: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Yaè ta ce faè' aè nfeè' wááwá. Má máè ce faè' aè njáâá wa'a.”
English: But Jesus answered them, My Father is still working, so I am working, too.

Limbum: Jus a ka' yu' yuu ce Jisoès aè laèa, a ku ker gheter ba aè se ená a ba yú ye njobeè' e m ku bú' ba ncir mmbomntaa caè'caè' ka', e m ker laa foñ ená Nyúè yu yïì taê. Baná e m ce laèa ená a Nyúè a ku ba yáánïì.
English: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè beèe anaè enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená aède' Muu gee yuu neè yi tu ka'. AÈde' e gee ba yuu ce e yá Taèr aè ce geèe. Yuu ce yïì Ta e ke geèe, a yuu ce ye ye e ke geèe.
English: Jesus therefore answered them, Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

Limbum: Taèr koèñ Muu, a ce duèñshi ye buu wááwá ce e ke geèe. E be duèñshi ye buu bghagha' ce e be geèe ce vi be caèa vïì ce weèe aè yá na, tá weèe yá, báèáñger seê.
English: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

Limbum: AÈmboè Taèr e ke geèe beèe ce a kweñger a fúú efa rkwe, cu bteèe, a mboè Muu ye ye e ke geèe beèe ce e ce, a cu bteèe aè njáâá wa' foñ.
English: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

Limbum: Taèr e ke sa' ñwáè ka', e fa ñger neè muu yïì ená e sa' beèe,
English: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

Limbum: tá beèe a bo yu'ni neè Muu yïì aèmboè a ke yu'ni neè ye foñ naè. Ñwáè aè ka' tá yu'ni neè muu ka', baná aède' ñgaèñ yu'nïì neè Taèr ce e m tuu Muu anaè ka'.
English: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn't honor the Son doesn't honor the Father who sent him.

Limbum: “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè ce e ka' yu' ya nlaèa, byemi neè ñwáè ce e m tuu máè, baná ñgaèñ be koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè. A be sa' ñwáè anaè ka' njobeè' rkwe li keèr túr ñger mbe yeâ nduè ka'. Ñgaèñ be cu nteèe.
English: Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn't come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ku ba ce e ce suñ aèmboè máè. M rïìñ máná yuu ce e ce suñ aèmboè máè yi yu mini.
English: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

Limbum: Weèe aè m tuu yeè beèe ená a du yá Joân. E m suñ weèe yuu mini.
English: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

Limbum: Mbuèu moè' yu aègho neè máè aè rroèo ñwáè tá e bo suñ beèe aèmboè máè ka'. Geewa'a m ce suñ weèe ená Joân aè m laèa aèmboè máè, tá weèe bo byemi, luèñ.
English: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

Limbum: E m ba lam ce a cúè' e ce raa seê. Weèe aè m koni li rraa anaè, a lu'shi neè li aè mú nfeè' moè'.
English: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

Limbum: M túr buu moè' ce vi ce suñ aèmboè máè caa vïû Joân. Mfaè' ce m ce geèe ce yaè Ta aè fa máè ñger ená m gee misi mi ce suñ aèmboè máè, a ce duèñshi ená yaè Ta aè tuu máè.
English: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

Limbum: Yaè Ta ce e m tuu máè aè laèa yuu a kuu máè foñ. Weèe aè m be yu' yïì njeèndoñ ka', a be yá ye ka'.
English: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

Limbum: Weèe aè láè yi nlaèa njep weâe mntee ka' njobeè' weèe aè byemi neè ñwáè ce e m tuu naè ka'.
English: You don't have his word living in you; because you don't believe him whom he sent.

Limbum: Weèe ce yá'ni Ñwaâ' Nyúè njobeè' weèe ce kwaè'shi ená yi be geèe tá weèe koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Ku ba ñwaè' anaè ce yi ce suñ aèmboè máè.
English: You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

Limbum: Weèe aè m ba byemi neè Musïìs, weèe aè ba byemi neè máè njobeè' Musïìs aè m sañ aèmboè máè.
English: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' tá byemi yuu ce e m sañ ka', weèe ka' byemi yuu ce m ce laèa aè njáâá ká?”
English: But if you don't believe his writings, how will you believe my words?

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, Jisoès aè tuu neèñguu túâ Galeèle ce a too foñ ená Tïìbárïìyaès.
English: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a ce duè a yeâ mbuèu njobeè' mncoèo ce e m geèe. E m geèe ñgaâa byañ a ke'seè.
English: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

Limbum: Jisoès ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m ko' mbe rtuèu, a ka' baè' mbo a cu aè nsheè.
English: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, nfeè' ce Jus a m ce ye yap ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap aè ká' a ce gháá.
English: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' naèa mmir yá aèmboè kúr beèe a ce vúè aè ryá ye, e laa neè Felep enáê, “Seèe be yuu byee ba efá tá beèe ca a ka' ye?”
English: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa wa'a a ce taase Felep taase njobeè' e m ku riñ yuu ce e be geèe.
English: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

Limbum: Felep aè beesïì enáê, “Seèe aè ka' yuu byee aè bbaèa mbaâa bbaa vi ghááteè ka'.”
English: Philip answered him, Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little.

Limbum: Ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu moè' ce aè m ba Andruè ce e m ba nfúr Saimún Pitaè aè laa neè Jisoès enáê,
English: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to him,

Limbum: “Muu mbañruè moè' yu mbena, a túr bráâd yi taê, ba nca baa. AÈde' mú byee ca vi ba' aè yuu ka'.”
English: There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Laèa neè tá beèe ca a cu aè nsheè.” Mjáá mi m ba mbe dïì' anaè. Mmbañruè ce a m cute aè nsheè a m ba aèmboè ncúèkïì taê.
English: Jesus said, Have the people sit down. Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

Limbum: Jisoès aè lor mntu' bráâd anaè, a yoñshi Nyúè, a gapshi neè beèe ce a m cute aè nsheè naè. A lor nca a gapshi neè woweèe foñ. Ñwáè wááwá aè ye a yu'.
English: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

Limbum: A ka' ye yu', Jisoès aè laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Baashi neè bbábá' bráâd ce vi báti naè aèbee faè dïì' vi bú aè cicïì ka'.”
English: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.

Limbum: Woweèe a baashïì bbábá' bráâd anaè aèbee. Bbábá' ce vi m báti vi m ruu aè mñkaèa ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a ka' yá ncoèo ce Jisoès aè m duèñshi na, a laa enáê, “Neè mini-ñwáè, ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ce a m laèa ená e be keè vúè njep ñgoèñ naè.”
English: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m rïìñ ená beèe anaè a ce roèo aè rkoo ye aè ñger, ghar aè ñkúú. E ka' rïìñ wa'a, a nati a beeñger aè ñgúè' rtuèu moè' a cu aèfo mimñgi'.
English: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mbuèuñkuèr, ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a du aèwaâa túè,
English: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,

Limbum: a niñ mbe keñ, a ce duè aè rla' Kaèpanuèm ce li m ba neèñguu túè anaè. A ka' ce duè, túè' aè sii woweèe. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Jisoès aè be vú a koni woweèe ka'.
English: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

Limbum: Fu' yi ká' a ce caèa goèr seê, rdip li ce beèeñger ce ko' mbekïì, ce suèu.
English: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè aèmboè bkïìlomátaè ta duè baè' ntuunfu wa'a, a yá aèmboè Jisoès ce jáèr mbenduè rdip a ce vúè aègee keñ. Woweèe a ka' yá wa'a, a wáp seê.
English: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Fa wáp neè ka', a máè.”
English: But he said to them, It is I. Don't be afraid.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce koèñ aè rkoo ye mbe keñ. A ka' keè', a ku yá ená woweèe a baè' neèñguu túè faèdïì' woweèe a m ce duè.
English: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, beèe ce a m ku bii yap nje waâa túè a yá ená keñ aè m ku ba njo moè'sir. A m rïìñ ená ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m niñ mbe keñ anaè a du mapñgi', Jisoès aè ba mbo ka'.
English: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn't entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

Limbum: Bkeñ mo' vi m vúâ aè rla' Tïìbárïìyaès, a vú a ba' faèdïì' ce beèe a m ye bráâd ce Tata Jisoès aè m yoèñshi Nyúè aètu mo naè.
English: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a ka' yá ená ka' Jisoès káè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a yu aèfo ka', woweèe a niñ aè bkeñ anaè a du aè rla' Kaèpanuèm a ce roèo Jisoès.
English: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn't there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá ye neèñguu túè, a laa neè ye enáê, “Rabaèi, wáè vúè aèfa aè se'ká?”
English: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, Rabbi, when did you come here?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená weèe ce roèo máè ba njo' ncoèo ce weèe aè mú yá máè duñshïì naè ka'. Weèe ce roèo máè ba njo' bráâd ce weèe aè mú ye a yu'.
English: Jesus answered them, Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.

Limbum: Weèe fa faè' ba aè rkoni byee ce vi be mïì ka'. Faè' neè ba aè rkoni byee ce vi be cu, fa ryoèñ ce nfeseè. A njáèá byee ce Muu Ñwáè be fa weèe. Nyúè ce e yu yaè Ta aè fa ye yïì ncoèo aè rduèñshi ená e yu muu yïì.”
English: Don't work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Yuu ce aède' weèr geêe, tá yi ka' ba ená weèr ce geèe mfaè' Nyúè yu ká?”
English: They said therefore to him, What must we do, that we may work the works of God?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa enáê, “Yuu ce aède' weèe gee yi yu ená weèe byemi neè ñwáè ce e tuu máè.”
English: Jesus answered them, This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Ncoèo ce aède' aè duñshïì tá weèr bo yá, byemi neè wáè yu ká?
English: They said therefore to him, What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?

Limbum: Viseèe bta a m ye manaè aè rïìñ aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, ‘Nyúè aè m fa woweèe byee ce vi m suèu embe buèu ená woweèe a ye.’ ”
English: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, 'He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.'

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená byee ce a m fa neè wee bta naè, aè m fa Musïìs ka'. Yaè Ta a ñwáè ce e ce fa weèe byee ce mini ce vi suèu embe buèu.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn't Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

Limbum: Byee ce Nyúè ce fa anaè yu byee ce vi suèu embe buèu a ce fa ryoèñ ce mini neè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na.”
English: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Tataê, fa weèr njáèá byee ca aè nfeè' sïìp.”
English: They said therefore to him, Lord, always give us this bread.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M yu byee ce e aè ryoèñ. Ñwáè ce e ka' vú yá máè, aède' njeè ker yañ ye ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè máè aède' ntee yi ker yuushi ye ka'.
English: Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

Limbum: Geewa'a, yi ku ba aèmboè máè m suñ weèe naè, weèe aè yá máè neè me mmir a ke' byemi neè máè ka'.
English: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don't believe.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce yaè Ta aè fa neè máè, a be vúè yá máè. Ñwáè ce e ka' vú yá máè, aède' m ke juu ñgaèñ ka',
English: All those who the Father gives me will come to me. Him who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

Limbum: njobeè' máè suèu embe buèu a rgeèe ba yuu ce m koèñ ka'. Máè vúè a rgeèe ba yuu ce ñwáè ce e m tuu máè koèñ.
English: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

Limbum: Yuu ce ñwáè ce e m tuu máè koèñ, yi yu ená ñwáè moè' efa múè beèe ce e fa mba máâ mmboè bú ka', tá m bo geèe tá woweèe a fúú efa rkwe aè noèñ elúèsimbuèu.
English: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

Limbum: Yuu ce yaè Ta koèñ yi yu ená ñwáè ce e ka' yá muu yïì, byemi neè ye, baná ñgaèñ be koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Be ba aè noèñ elúèsimbuèu, m gee tá ñgaèñ fúú efa rkwe.”
English: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

Limbum: Jus a ká' a ce de'ñger njobeè' Jisoès aè m laèa enáê, “A máè byee ce vi suèu embe buèu.”
English: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, I am the bread which came down out of heaven.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa enáê, “Mboè ñwáè ca a Jisoès muu Josáèf a? To seèe rïìñ yïì ta ba yïì maê. E ka' ce laèa enáê, ‘Máè suèu embe buèu’ njoká?”
English: They said, Isn't this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, 'I have come down out of heaven?'

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa keèr de'ñger ka'.
English: Therefore Jesus answered them, Don't murmur among yourselves.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè moè' vú yá máè caa efa ená Taèr ce e m tuu máè aè geèe e vú a yá máè ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' vú yá máè baná m be geèe tá ñgaèñ fúú efa rkwe aè noèñ elúèsimbuèu.
English: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m sañ enáê, ‘Nyúè be keè yá'ni woweèe wááwá.’ Baná ñwáè ce e ka' yu' nlaâa yaè Taê, yá'ni buu ese ye, baná ñgaèñ be vúè yá máè.
English: It is written in the prophets, 'They will all be taught by God.' Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.

Limbum: M ce laèa ba máná ñwáè moè' aè m be yá Taèr ka', ku ba ñwáè ce e m loè ese Nyúè ce e yá Taèr.
English: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe máná ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè máè, baná ñgaèñ be koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

Limbum: A máè byee ce aè ryoèñ.
English: I am the bread of life.

Limbum: Wee bta a m ye manaè aè rïìñ a ku lo a kweñger.
English: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.

Limbum: Cena a byee ce vi suèu embe buèu, ce ñwáè aè ka' ye, e ke kwe ka'.
English: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

Limbum: A máè byee vïû bteèe ce vi suèu embe buèu, ce vi ke fa beèe ryoèñ. Ñwáè aè ka' ye byee ca baná ñgaèñ be cu nfeseè. Byee ce m be fa neè beèe enjep ñgoèñ tá a bo koni ryoèñ na, yu yaè nyor.”
English: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.

Limbum: Awá Jus a ká' a ce sár mnsár a waâp mú tatap seê, a ce laèa enáê, “AÈde' ñwáè fa yïì nyor neè seèe ená seèe ye aè njáâá ká?”
English: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè, weèe aè ka' tá ye nyor Muu Ñwáè, keèr no vi bláá ka', weèe konïì ryoèñ ka'.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don't have life in yourselves.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ye yaè nyor ker no wa bláá baná e be koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè. M be keè fúr ye efa rkwe aè noèñ elúèsimbuèu.
English: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

Limbum: Yaè nyor yu byee ce mini, wa bláá aè ba yuu no ce mini.
English: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ye yaè nyor, ker no wa bláá baná ñgaèñ be cu njep máè tá má máè cu njep ye.
English: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

Limbum: AÈmboè Taèr ce e yu nteèe aè tuu máè, máè cu nteèe njobeè' ye, baná ñwáè ce e ka' ye yaè nyor, e be cu nteèe njo' máè.
English: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.

Limbum: Ca yu byee ce vi suèu embe buèu, aè ke' ba njáèá byee ce wee bta a m ye a ku lo a kweñger naè ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' ye byee ca baná ñgaèñ be cu nfeseè.”
English: This is the bread which came down out of heaven--not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa buu ca aè nfeè' ce e m ce yá'ni beèe mbe ndaèp rloo aè rla' Kaèpanuèm.
English: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr efa múè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yu' yuu ce e m laèa na, a laa enáê, “Nlaèa ca yi tap seê. Ñwáè ce aède' e byemïì njáèá nlaèa ca a nda?”
English: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' rïìñ ená woweèe a m ce de'ñger njobeè' yuu ce e m laèa na, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Cena yi bep weèe a?
English: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, Does this cause you to stumble?

Limbum: Baná weèe aè ka' ba yá Muu Ñwáè aèmboè e ce ko' mbe dïì' ce e m ba, a ka' vú naè, weèe aè ba laèa wee ká?
English: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

Limbum: Yú' a yuu ce yi ke fa ñwáè ryoèñ. AÈde' nyor gee yuu mo' ka'. Blaèa ce máè laèa neè weèe na, yu yú', aè ker ba ryoèñ.
English: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

Limbum: Geewa'a beèe efa weâe mú a byemi ka'.” Jisoès aè m ku riñ beèe ce a be byemi ka' efa rkáè', a ker riñ foñ ñwáè ce e be fyeèni ye.
English: But there are some of you who don't believe. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn't believe, and who it was who would betray him.

Limbum: E ker laa enáê, “A mbuèu ce máè m suñ weèe ená aède' ñwáè vú yá máè caa efa ená Taèr aè fa ye njïì ená e vú yá máè ka'.”
English: He said, For this cause have I said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.

Limbum: Ká' embe nfeè' anaè, beèe magoèr efa ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ma'shïì ye, a ker ce kar a ye ka'.
English: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

Limbum: Awá Jisoès aè laa neè beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú enáê, “Yi yu yi ká aèmboè weèe, weèe be maè'shi máè duèse foñ a?”
English: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, You don't also want to go away, do you?

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “Tataê, aède' weèr ka' ker du yá ba nda? A wáè ce aè túr blaèa ce vi ke geèe beèe a koni ryoèñ ce li be keè mïì ka'.
English: Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

Limbum: Weèr aè byemi neè wáè, a riñ seè'ni werná aè yu ñwáâ nrara ce e loè ese Nyúè.”
English: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “To a máè ce máè ce weèe beèe ncoèp-baa-aè- rrúèú? Ka' yi yu wa'a, moè' efa weâe mú yu nyúèrkaè'.”
English: Jesus answered them, Didn't I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?

Limbum: E m ce laèa ba aèmboè Judaès muu Saimún IÌskarïìyoèt. Judaès ca ce e m ba moè' efa múè beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú, aè m ba ñwáè ce e be loè fyeèni ye.
English: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

Limbum: Buu ca aè ka' mïì wáá, Jisoès aè ká' a ce karkar aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê. E m koèñ aè rduè aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè ka' njobeè' Jus a m ce koèñ aè ryú ye.
English: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn't walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, nfeè' ce Jus a m ce ye ñkaâ' btaèp aè ká' a ce gháá.
English: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bfúr vi a laa neè ye enáê, “Naètïû aèfa, du aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè tá ñgaâa yá'ni yoè buu a bo yá mfaè' ce aè ce geèe na.
English: His brothers therefore said to him, Depart from here, and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' koèñ ená beèe a riñ ye, aède' ñgaèñ ce geèe buu aè bsúèti ka'. Wáè ka' ce geèe mfaè' ca, aè gee ba aèwañ tá beèe wááwá a bo yá.”
English: For no one does anything in secret, and himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.

Limbum: Bfúr vi a m ce laèa wa'a, a byemi neè ye ka' foñ.
English: For even his brothers didn't believe in him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Yaè nfeè' aè be gháá ka'. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, nfeè' ku ba.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

Limbum: AÈde' ñgoèñ a baa weèe ka'. Woweèe a baèa yi máè njobeè' m ce suñ woweèe ená woweèe a ce geèe buu bbebep.
English: The world can't hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

Limbum: Duè neè ñkaè' anaè. M be duè ya yu ñkaè' anaè ka', njobeè' yaè nfeè' aè be gháá ka'.”
English: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.

Limbum: E ka' laèa neè woweèe wa'a, a cu yi yu aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê.
English: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

Limbum: Bfúr vi a ka' duèse ñkaè' anaè wáá, e lo a du a waâp mbuèu. E m duè aèwañ ka', e m duè ba aè bsúèti.
English: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

Limbum: Jus a m ce roèo ye aè ñkaè' anaè, a ce bipshi enáê, “Ñwáè anaè yu fá?”
English: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a ce cúèúni aèmboè ye. Beèe mo' a ce laèa enáê, “E yu ñwáâ mboèñmboñ.” Beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “AÈi', e ce bo' beèe bo'.”
English: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, He is a good man. Others said, Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m laèa yuu mo' aèwañ a kuu ye ka' njobeè' a m ce wáp Juês.
English: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

Limbum: A ka' ye ñkaè' baè' tïìtïìyáá, Jisoès aè du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a ce yá'ni beèe mbo.
English: But when it was now the midst of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

Limbum: Jus a m báèáñger, a ce laèa enáê, “Ñwáè ca rïìñ buu wa' aè njáâá ká, ce e m be du ñwaè' mncir ka'?”
English: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, How does this man know letters, having never been educated?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Buu ce m ce yá'ni yu wa ka', yu ba vi ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.
English: Jesus therefore answered them, My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce koèñ aè rgeèe ba yuu ce Nyúè ce koèñ, baná ñgaèñ be rïìñ ená yuu ce m ce yá'ni yi loè ba ese Nyúè, káè m ce laèa ba aè ya ñger lá.
English: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' laa yuu ba aè yi ñger, baná ñgaèñ ce roèo ená beèe a ku'si ba ye. Ñwáè aè ka' ce roèo ená beèe a ku'si ba ñwáè ce e tuu ye, seèe riñ seená ñgaèñ yu ñwáè mini, a túr faèa ka'.
English: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

Limbum: “Mboè Musïìs a ñwáè ce e m fa weèe mncir a? Geewa'a, ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú ce láè mncir anaè ka'. Weèe aè ka' ce roèo aè ryú máè njoká?”
English: Didn't Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?

Limbum: Kúr beèe anaè a beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “Hábá, ñwáè ce e ce roèo aè ryú wáè a nda? Yú' nyúèrkaè' yi yu njep wáè.”
English: The multitude answered, You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè m geèe rfaâ' rmo'sir, weèe aè túr rgha'nïì.
English: Jesus answered them, I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.

Limbum: Musïìs aè m fa ncir ená weèe ce gee búè. Ke' ba ená a ye ce e m káè' ka', aè m káè' ba wee btaê. Musïìs aè ka' láè ncir wa'a weèe aè lo a ce geèe búè nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè.
English: Moses has given you circumcision not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers, and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

Limbum: Ka' ba ená weâe ke geèe búè nyúè mmbomntaa faè dïì' weèe bo bú' ncir Musïìs ka', weèe aè ka' ce bepsi ntee neè máè njobeè' máè geèe ñwáè aè luñ boèñboñ efa yi yañ nyúè mmbomntaa njoká?
English: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce sa' mnsa', weèe fa fyá' mmir beèe ka', weèe sa' teni yáánïì.”
English: Don't judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

Limbum: Beèe moâ' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a m laèa enáê, “Mboè ñwáè ca a ñwáè ce a roèo aè ryú naè a?
English: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, Isn't this he whom they seek to kill?

Limbum: Yá neè, e ce laèa buu aèwañ, ñwáè aè ke' ce laèa yuu neè ye ka'. Seemoè' beâe bgoèrgoèr a yá ená e yu Kraâis anaè.
English: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

Limbum: Geewa'a, weèr rïìñ faèdïì' ce ñwáè ca ce vúè, a riñ ená be ba aè nfeè' ce Kraâis anaè aè nyáá, tá ñwáè riñ faèdïì' e loè ka'.”
English: However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.

Limbum: Awá Jisoès aè ka' ce yá'ni mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a laa neè ñger-ñwáè enáê, “Weèe rïìñ máè, a riñ faèdïì' ce m ce vúè. Ka' yi yu wa' máè vúè aèfa ba aè ya ñger ka'. Ñwáè ce e tuu máè yu ñwáè mini. Weèe rïìñ ye ka'.
English: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don't know.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ ya ye, njobeè' máè m vúè ese ye, aè ba ye ce e m tuu máè.”
English: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.

Limbum: Awá woweèe a gheteèr ená a ba koo ye. A ka' gheèter wa'a, ñwáè aè joo ye ka' njobeè' yïì nfeè' aè m be gháá ka'.
English: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a m byemi neè ye, a laa enáê, “Kraâis anaè aè ka' nyáá, aède' e duñshïì mncoèo caa vïì ce ñwáè ca aè duèñshi na a?”
English: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, When the Christ comes, he won't do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a m yu' aèmboè kúr beèe ca a ce cúèúni aèmboè Jisoès. Yi ka' ba wa'a, beèe Farïìsi ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a tuu beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Ndap Nyúè ená a du koo ye.
English: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Seèe be kuè cu seè'ni ba nfeè' múcaèr tá m kúti duè yá ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.
English: Then Jesus said, I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

Limbum: Weèe be roèo máè, yá máè ka', njobeè' aède' weèe vú faèdïì' m be ba ka'.”
English: You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come.

Limbum: Jus a ká' a ce laèa a waâp mú enáê, “Ñwáè ca ce roèo aè rduè ba fá, a ka' ce laèa ená seèe be yá ye ka'? E ce roèo aè rduè yá yïìseèe beèe ce a yu aè bto' mo' tá e bo cu a woweèe, yá'ni beâe aè to' anaè a?
English: The Jews therefore said among themselves, Where will this man go that we won't find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

Limbum: E ce laèa enáê, ‘Weèe be roèo máè yá máè ka', baè' faèdïì' m be ba ka’, baná e laèa ba ená ká?”
English: What is this word that he said, 'You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come'?

Limbum: Noèñ elúèsimbuèu efa ñkaè' anaè aè m ba noâñ goèr. AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ anaè, Jisoès aè natïì mbekïì a laa neè ñger-ñwáè enáê, “Ntee yi ka' ce yuushi ñwáè, ñgaèñ vú yá máè, no yuu.
English: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè máè aèmboè Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa, baná mdip ce mi ke fa beèe ryoèñ mi be fúú enje yeâ nyoèr goèr seê.”
English: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa cena wa'a, a ce laèa ba aèmboè Yú' ce beèe ce a byemi neè ye a be koni. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, beèe a be koni Yú' anaè ka', njobeè' Nyúè aè m bii ka' kuè'si Jisoès.
English: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn't yet glorified.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' blaèa ca, beèe mo' efa waâp mú a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè anaè ghup.”
English: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, This is truly the prophet.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu Kraâis anaè.” Beèe mo' a ker laa yap enáê, “AÈde' Kraâis anaè vúâ aè ñgoèñ Galeèle ka'.
English: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

Limbum: Mboè Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa ená Kraâis anaè be ba ñwáè embe ndúè' Dávïìd, ba ñwáâ aè rla' Bátáèláèhám ce yu rla' Dávïìd a?”
English: Hasn't the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?

Limbum: Beèe a lo a ba bcuèu jáá jáèá jáá njo' ye.
English: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a lo a koñ aè rkoo ye. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, ñwáè moè' aè m joèo ye neè bo ka'.
English: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

Limbum: Ñgaâa keè'ni Ndap Nyúè a m kúti a du a yá beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba beèe Farïìsïî. Woweèe a bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè duè a koo ye a vú aègho ka' njoká?”
English: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, Why didn't you bring him?

Limbum: Ñgaâa keè'ni Ndap Nyúè a beesïì a laa enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè m be laa yuu neè ñger-ñwáè aèmboè ñwáè ca aè laèa na ka'.”
English: The officers answered, No man ever spoke like this man!

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a laa neè woweèe enáê, “A'a, a bo' weèe foñ a?
English: The Pharisees therefore answered them, You aren't also led astray, are you?

Limbum: Weèe aè be riñ ñwáè moè' efa múè ñgaâa rsa', káè beèe Farïìsi áè, ce e byemi neè ye a?
English: Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?

Limbum: Beèe ce a ku ba yap aèwaèa a ke' riñ mncir ka' naè, baná Nyúè aè roè' woweèe.”
English: But this multitude that doesn't know the law is accursed.

Limbum: Nïìkoèdámoès aè m ba moè' efa múè beèe Farïìsïî, a ye ce e m be du yá Jisoès naè. E m laèa neè woweèe enáê,
English: Nicodemus he who came to him by night, being one of them said to them,

Limbum: “Waè' viseèe mncir vi byemi ená a sa' mnsa' ñwáè, fa ñgaèñ aè shañ, ce a be ká' a yu' yuu ce ñgaèñ aè laèa ka' a?”
English: Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Haba! Wá wáè foñ yu ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèle a? Wáè ka' fyá' mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè aè yá ená ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè be vúâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèle ka'.”
English: They answered him, Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a da'seè a duse aè mlaè'.
English: Everyone went to his own house,

Limbum: Jisoès aè du yi ba mbe rtuèu Oleèf.
English: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú', e ker du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè. Beèe wááwá a du a yá ye mbo. E cu aè nsheè a ce yá'ni woweèe.
English: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir ba beèe Farïìsi a vú mbo neè ñgwa ñwáè moè' ce a m koo a mbañruèñwáè, a tár kuèntombïì neè beèe wááwá, a laa neè Jisoès enáê,
English: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the midst,

Limbum: “Ñwáè ryá'nïì, a koo njeñwáè ca a mbañruèñwáè.
English: they told him, Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

Limbum: Musïìs aè m sañ mbe ñwaè' mncir ená a ka' koo njeñwáè a mbañruèñwáè, a túúshïì neè bluèr e kweê. Wáè laèa yo wá ká?”
English: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such. What then do you say about her?

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa wa'a, a ce moèoshi ye ená e ka' faa nlaèa, tá a bo rïìñ yuu ce a be geèe neè ye. Jisoès aè be'tïì nyor aè nsheè a ká' a ce sañ yuu aè nsheè neè ntubo.
English: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.

Limbum: Woweèe a ku ce bipshi neè ye ená e laèa yi ená ká lá? E naa nyor mbekïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè moè' aè ka' ba a weâe mú ce e m be gee yuu bebep ka', baná ñgaèñ túú njeñwáè ca neè luèr entombïì.”
English: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a ker be'ti nyor a ce sañ yuu aè nsheè neè ntubo.
English: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' nlaèa ca a nati a duse moè'sir moè'sir. Bleebeèe a m duè entombïì neè bghaèrbeèe, a ma'shi Jisoès a njeñwáè anaè mbo.
English: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

Limbum: Jisoès aè naa nyor mbekïì a laa enáê, “Njeñwáè, woweèe a yuê? Ñwáè moè' aè geèe yuu neè wáè ka' a?”
English: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?

Limbum: E laa enáê, “Masaè, ñwáè aè geèe yuu neè máè ka'.” Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “M be geèe yuu mo' neè wáè foñ ka'. Duè yo yu, wáâ duè aè fa keèr geèe yuu bebep ka'.”
English: She said, No one, Lord. Jesus said, Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker laa neè beèe enáê, “A máè rraa enjep ñgoèñ na. Ñwáè ce e ka' vú fa máâ mbuèu baná aède' e ker jár aè túè'nji ka', e be koni ba rraa ce li fa ryoèñ.”
English: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a laa neè ye enáê, “Ce suñ wáè aèmboè yo tu; yi ba yáánïì ka'.”
English: The Pharisees therefore said to him, You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ka' ce suñ máè ce suñ aèmboè ya tu wa'a, yuu ce m ce suñ yi yu yáánïì njobeè' máè rïìñ faèdïì' ce máè vúè, a riñ faèdïì' ce m ce duè. Weèe rïìñ faèdïì' ce máè vúè ka', a riñ faèdïì' ce m ce duè ka'.
English: Jesus answered them, Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don't know where I came from, or where I am going.

Limbum: Weèe ce sa' ye ba aèmboè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ke sa'. M ce sa' ya yu ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

Limbum: M ka' ce sa' beèe, m sa' yáánïì njobeè' aède' m sa' neè ya tu ka'. M ce sa' aèbee weèr ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.
English: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

Limbum: A sañ mbe ye ñwaè' mncir enáê, ‘beèe a mmbaa a ka' táá njïìnsa' aè yuu baná yuu anaè yi yu mini.’
English: It's also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

Limbum: M ce suñ aèmboè ya tu, ñwáè ce e ce suñ aèmboè máè foñ yu yaè Ta ce e m tuu máè.”
English: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Yoè Ta yuê?” Jisoès aè beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe rïìñ máè ka', a riñ yaè Ta foñ ka'. Weèe aè ba riñ máè, weèe aè ba rïìñ yaè Ta foñ.”
English: They said therefore to him, Where is your Father? Jesus answered, You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa buu ca neè woweèe aè nfeè' ce e m ce yá'ni mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a ba ba mbe dïì' ce a m ce fa rfa. Ñwáè moè' aè m koo ye ka' njobeè' yïì nfeè' aè m be gháá ka'.
English: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “M be duè ya yu, tá weèe roo máè, yá ka', kwe neè yeè buu bbebep. AÈde' weèe vú faèdïì' ce m ce duè ka'.”
English: Jesus said therefore again to them, I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can't come.

Limbum: Jus a laa enáê, “E laèa ená e ce duè faèdïì' ce aède' seèe vú ka' wa'a, baná e be yú yïì nyor a?”
English: The Jews therefore said, Will he kill himself, that he says, 'Where I am going, you can't come?'

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe yu ye beèe enjep nsheè na, máè lo ya e mbekïì. Weèe yu ye beèe enjep ñgoèñ na, máè ba ya ñwáè enjep ñgoèñ na ka'.
English: He said to them, You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

Limbum: Máè suñ weèe ená weèe be kwe neè yeè buu bbebep, njobeè' weèe aè ka' tá byemi ená m yu ñwáè ce m yu ka', baná weèe be kwe neè yeè buu bbebep.”
English: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “A wáè nda seê?” Jisoès aè laa enáê, “M yu ñwáè ce má ke suñ weèe aè nfeè' wááwá ená m yu naè.
English: They said therefore to him, Who are you? Jesus said to them, Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

Limbum: M túr buu magoèr ce máè ba laèa kuu weèe, keèr sa' weèe njo' buu anaè. Geewa'a, m ce suñ weèe ená ñwáè ce e m tuu máè yu ñwáè mini. M ce suñ ñgoèñ ca ba yuu ce máè yu' ese ye.”
English: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce laèa wa'a woweèe a riñ ená e ce laèa ba aèmboè yïì Ta ka'.
English: They didn't understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Be ba aè nfeè' ce weèe aè naèa Muu Ñwáè mbekïì tá weèe ka' rïìñ ená a máè ye, keèr rïìñ foñ ená m ce geèe yuu mo' a máâ ñger ka'. M ku ce laèa ba buu ce yaè Ta aè yá'ni máè.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e tuu máè yu weèr ye, e maè'shi máè mamñgi' ka' njobeè' máâ ke kuâ geèe ba buu ce nyor ce boèñ ye.”
English: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn't left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.

Limbum: E ka' laèa buu ca wa'a, beèe magoèr a byemïì neè ye.
English: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè Jus ce a m byemi neè ye naè enáê, “Weèe ka' ku ce geèe buu ce máè yá'ni weèe, baná weèe yu ñgaâa yá'ni yaè buu ghup.
English: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

Limbum: Weèe be rïìñ yuu mini, tá mini anaè gee tá weèe luêñ.”
English: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Weèr yu ñgúè Abraèhaêm. Weèr aè m be ba bkwaèa neè ñwáè moè' ka'. Wáè ka' ce laèa wáná aè be geèe tá weèr luñ aè njáâá ká?”
English: They answered him, We are Abraham's seed, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, 'You will be made free?'

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe buu bbebep baná ñgaèñ yu ñkwaèa neè buu bbebep.
English: Jesus answered them, Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

Limbum: AÈde' ñkwaèa yi cu mbe ndaèp ñwáè nfeseè ka'. Ñwáè ce e ke cu mbo nfeseè a muu ñwáè ndaèp anaè.
English: A bondservant doesn't live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

Limbum: Baná Muu Nyúè aè ka' gee weèe luêñ, baná weèe aè luèñ neè mini-ñwáè ghup.
English: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

Limbum: M rïìñ máná weèe yu ñgúè Abraèhaêm. Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe ce roèo aè ryú máè, njobeè' yuu máè suñ weèe yi niñ weèe mbaè tuè' ka'.
English: I know that you are Abraham's seed, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe ba buu ce máè yá ese yaè Taê, weèe aè ce geèe ye ba buu ce weèe aè yá'ni ese yeè taê.”
English: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì neè ye enáê, “Abraèham yu yeèr taê.” Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè ba ba boo Abraèhaêm, weèe aè ba geèe ba buu ce Abraèham aè m ce geèe.
English: They answered him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus said to them, If you were Abraham's children, you would do the works of Abraham.

Limbum: Weèe ce roèo ye seè'ni aè ryú máè ce m yu ñwáè ce máè suñ weèe yuu mini ce máè yu' ese Nyúè. Abraèham aè m be gee yuu mo' wa' ka'.
English: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn't do this.

Limbum: Weèe ce geèe ba yuu ce yeè ta ce geèe.” Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr yu boo ce a bi aè bsaèkïì ka'. Yeèr ta ku ba Nyúè caè'caè'.”
English: You do the works of your father. They said to him, We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Nyúè aè ka' ba ba yeè Taê, weèe aè ba koèñ máè njobeè' máè loè ese Nyúè a ka' vú aèfa. Máè vúè ba aè ya ñger ka'; máè vúè ba aè ñger ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.
English: Therefore Jesus said to them, If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven't come of myself, but he sent me.

Limbum: Weèe ce yu' yuu ce m ce laèa ka' njoká? Weèe ce yu' ka' njobeè' yi yu aètáèr neè weèe aè ryu' ka'.
English: Why don't you understand my speech? Because you can't hear my word.

Limbum: Sataèn yu yeè taê. Weèe ce koèñ aè rgeèe ba buu ce e koèñ. E m ku ba ñwáè nyúshi beèe efa rkáè'. AÈde' e táá aè yuu mini ka', njobeè' e yu ñwáè mini ka'. E ke nya' mnde', ku nya' aèmboè yi ñgeèe yi yu naè njobeè' e yu ñwáè mnde', a ba taèr mnde'.
