English: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn't stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and its father.

Limbum: A yuu ce m ce suñ weèe yuu mini, weèe aè ce byemi neè máè ka'.
English: But because I tell the truth, you don't believe me.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú duñshi yuu bebep ce máè geèe a? Máè ka' ce suñ weèe ba yuu mini, weèe aè byemïì neè máè ka' njoká?
English: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ba ñwáè Nyúè baná ñgaèñ be yu'shi blaâa Nyúè. Mbuèu ce weèe ce yu'shi blaâa Nyúè ka' yu njobeè' weèe yu beèe Nyúè ka'.”
English: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don't hear, because you are not of God.

Limbum: Jus a beesïì neè ye enáê, “To yi yu yáánïì aèmboè weèr ce laèa ená aè yu ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè, yú' nyúèrkaè' yi ba njep wáè.”
English: Then the Jews answered him, Don't we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Yú' nyúèrkaè' yi yu njep máè ka'; m ce yu'ni ba neè yaè Taê, weèe aè ke' ce yu'ni ye yu neè máè ka'.
English: Jesus answered, I don't have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.

Limbum: M ce roèo ba ená beèe a ku'si máè ka'. Ñwáè moè' yu ce e ce roèo ená beèe a ku'si ye, a ba ñwáè sa' mnsa'.
English: But I don't seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè aè ka' ce yu' yuu ce m ce laèa, ce geèe yi, baná rkwe li be joèo ye ka'.”
English: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.

Limbum: Jus a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr rïìñ seè'ni werná yú' nyúèrkaè' yi yu njep wáè. To Abraèham aè m kwe, ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a kweñgeèr foñ. Wáè ka' ce laèa ená ñwáè aè ka' yu' yuu ce aè ce laèa ce geèe yi, rkwe li ke' joo ye ka' aè njáâá ká?
English: Then the Jews said to him, Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, 'If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.'

Limbum: Wáè caèa yeèr ta Abraèham a? E m kwe. Ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè anaè a kweñgeèr foñ. Wáè ka' ce laèa yo ená a wáè nda?”
English: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “M ka' ce kuè'si ya tu, bkuè' anaè ba yuu cicïì. Ñwáè ce e ce kuè'si máè yu yaè Ta ce weèe ce laèa ená a yeè Nyúè naè.
English: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

Limbum: Ka' weèe ce laèa wa'a, weèe rïìñ ye ka'. Máè rïìñ ye. M ka' ba laa máná máè rïìñ ye ka', máè ba ba ñwáè mnde' aèmboè weèe. Máè rïìñ ye, a ce geèe yuu ce e ce laèa.
English: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, 'I don't know him,' I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.

Limbum: Abraèham ce yu yeè ta aè m lu'shi ená e be yá nfeè' yaè. E m yá, a lu'shi.”
English: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.

Limbum: Jus a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè be ba' bfeè' mnta ka', a ce laèa wáná wáè m yá Abraèham ba aè njáâá ká?”
English: The Jews therefore said to him, You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená, tá Abraèham ka' keè ba, m ku ba.”
English: Jesus said to them, Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a kwá' bluèr tá a bo túúshi ye aègho. Yi ka' ba wa'a, e bú a fúú yi yu embe Ndaèp Nyúè.
English: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through the midst of them, and so passed by.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ce caèa, a yá ñwáè moè' ce a m bi ye e ku ba nfeèp.
English: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m bipshi neè ye enáê, “Rabaèi, a m bi ñwáè ca e ku ba nfeèp njo' yïì buu bbebep káè njo' buu bbebep yïì ma ba yïì taê?”
English: His disciples asked him, Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Yi yu ba ená ñwáè ca káè yïì ta ba yïì ma a m geèe buu bbebep ka'. A m bi ye e ku ba nfeèp tá beèe a bo yá rfaè' Nyúè njep yuu ce a be geèe neè ye.
English: Jesus answered, Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.

Limbum: Seè'ni ce seèe bii aè rraa, seèe ku túr aè rgeèe ba mfaè' ce ñwáè ce e m tuu máè aè fa neè seèe ená seèe fa'. Túè' be loè sii, tá ñwáè ker faè' ka'.
English: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

Limbum: AÈ nfeè' ce m yu njep ñgoèñ na, m yu rraa neè ñgoèñ.”
English: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

Limbum: E ka' laèa buu ca wa'a, a ce mce aè nsheè, a top nshe aègho a yo' nfeèp anaè aègho nje mmïìr,
English: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud,

Limbum: a laa neè ye enáê, “Duè su'si mmir njep túâ Sailoèm ce yi yu ená, ‘A tuu’.” Nfeèp anaè aè du a su'si mi mmir njep túè anaè. A ka' ce kúti a ce yá buu.
English: and said to him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam which means Sent. So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

Limbum: Beèe efa yeâ laè' ker ba beèe ce a m yá aè nfeè' ce e m ce loo buu naè, a laa enáê, “A'a! AÈmboè ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ce e m ce cu ce loo buu naè a?”
English: The neighbors therefore, and those who saw that he was blind before, said, Isn't this he who sat and begged?

Limbum: Beèe mo' a laa enáê, “ÁÈno, a ye.” Beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “AÈi', e ku feese ye feese.” E laa yi ená “A máè ñwáè anaè.”
English: Others were saying, It is he. Still others were saying, He looks like him. He said, I am he.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Wáè geèe wá ká a ka' ce yá buu?”
English: They therefore were asking him, How were your eyes opened?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè ce a too ená Jisoès naè, aè topshi nshe a yo' máè nje mmïìr, a laa ená m du su'si mmir njep túâ Siloèm. Máè du a ka' suè'si mmir njo, a ká' a ce yá buu.”
English: He answered, A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, 'Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.' So I went away and washed, and I received sight.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè yi enáê, “Ñwáè anaè yuê?” E beesïì enáê, “M rïìñ faèdïì' e yu ka'.”
English: Then they asked him, Where is he? He said, I don't know.

Limbum: Woweèe a lor ñwáè ce e m ba nfeèp naè, a woweèe a du a yá beèe Farïìsïî.
English: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

Limbum: Noèñ ce Jisoès aè m topshi nshe a gee nfeèp anaè aè ce yá buu naè, aè m ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè.
English: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi foñ a ker bipshi neè ye ená e ba gee eká a ka' ce yá buu lá. E suñ woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè anaè aè ba yo' máè nshe nje mmïìr, máè du a su'si mmir, a ká' a ce yá buu.”
English: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa múè beèe Farïìsi a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ce e loè ese Nyúè ka' njobeè' e cu mmbomntaa Nyúè ka'.” Beèe mo' efa waâp mú a laa yap enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè ba ba ñwáâ mbebep, e ba geèe yuu báèá ca aè njáâá ká?” Woweèe a ká' a ce kwaè'shi jáá jáèá jáá.
English: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, This man is not from God, because he doesn't keep the Sabbath. Others said, How can a man who is a sinner do such signs? There was division among them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ker bipshi neè ñwáè anaè enáê, “AÈmboè ñwáè anaè aè geèe wáè, wáè ce yá buu seè'ni na, wáè laèa yo wá ká aèmboè ye?” E beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè anaè yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.”
English: Therefore they asked the blind man again, What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

Limbum: Jus a m byemi yap yu ená ñwáè anaè aè m be fep a ka' lo a ce yá buu ka', caar woweèe a ká' yïì ta ba yïì maê,
English: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

Limbum: a bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu muu weèe a? Yi yu mini ená e m feèp ká' embe nfeè' a m bi ye a? E geèe eká a ka' ce yá buu?”
English: and asked them, Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?

Limbum: Yïì ta ba yïì ma a beesïì a laa enáê, “Weèr rïìñ ená e yu muu weèr. Weèr aè m bi ye e ku ba nfeèp.
English: His parents answered them, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

Limbum: Weèr aè rïìñ yer yu aèmboè e geèe a ka' ce yá buu ka', a riñ ñwáè ce e geèe e ka' ce yá buu ka'. Bipshi neè neè ye. E yu nleeñwáè. E be suñ weèe neè yi cuèu.”
English: but how he now sees, we don't know; or who opened his eyes, we don't know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.

Limbum: Yïì ta ba yïì ma a m laèa wa'a njobeè' a m ce wáp Juês. A m ce wáp woweèe njobeè' woweèe a m byemi war aèbee ená ñwáè aè ka' laa ená Jisoès yu Kraâis anaè, baná a be juèu ñgaèñ embe ndaèp rloo.
English: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce yïì ta ba yïì ma a m laèa enáê, “E yu nleeñwáè, bipshi neè neè ye.”
English: Therefore his parents said, He is of age. Ask him.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ker ká' ñwáè ce e m ba nfeèp naè, a laa neè ye enáê, “Laèa yuu ce Nyúè rïìñ enjo. Weèr rïìñ werná ñwáè ce e geèe wáè, wáè ce yá buu na yu ñwáè ñgeèe buu bbebep.”
English: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Káè e yu ñwáè ñgeèe buu bbebep áè, káè e yu ñwáè ñgeèe buu bbebep ka' áè, máè rïìñ ya yu ka'. Yuu ce m rïìñ yi ku ba ba ená máè m feèp, a ce yá buu seè'ni.”
English: He therefore answered, I don't know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “E ba gee eká neè wáè? E ba gee aè njáâá ká wáè ka' ce yá buu?”
English: They said to him again, What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?

Limbum: E beesïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè suñ weèe wáá, weèe aè ce yu' ka'. Weèe ce koèñ ená m ker suñ weèe njoká? Weâe koèñ aè rba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu foñ a?”
English: He answered them, I told you already, and you didn't listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don't also want to become his disciples, do you?

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, woweèe a cáp ye a laa enáê, “A wáè ñwáè ce aè yu ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu, weèr yu yer ñgaâa yá'ni buu Musïìs.
English: They insulted him and said, You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

Limbum: Weèr rïìñ ená Nyúè aè m suñ buu neè Musïìs. AÈ ka' ba aèmboè ñwáè ca, weèr rïìñ faèdïì' ce e ce vúè ka'.”
English: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don't know where he comes from.

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Cena yu ba yuu báèá! Ka' weèe rïìñ faèdïì' ce ñwáè ca ce vúè ka' wa'a, ñwáè ce e geèe máè ka' ce yá buu aè geèe ye.
English: The man answered them, How amazing! You don't know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená Nyúè e ke yu' mloo ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep ka'. E ke yu' ba rloo ñwáè nsïìp ce e ke wáp ye, ce geèe yuu ce e koèñ.
English: We know that God doesn't listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshipper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.

Limbum: Ká' ese aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m geèe ñgoèñ, ñwáè aè m be yu' ená ñwáè moè' aè geèe ñwáè ce a m bi ye e ku ba nfeèp e ce yá buu ka'.
English: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

Limbum: Ñwáè ca aè ka' tá baè loè ba ese Nyúè ka', e ba geèe yuu mo' ka'.”
English: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì a laa neè ye enáê, “A m bi wáè njep múè buu bbebep, wáè ce roèo aè ryá'ni weèr a?” A ka' laèa wa'a, a juu ye embe ndaèp rloo.
English: They answered him, You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us? They threw him out.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m yu' ená a juèu ñwáè anaè embe ndaèp rloo. E ka' roèo ye yá, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Wáè byemi neè Muu Ñwáè a?”
English: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, Do you believe in the Son of God?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Masaè, Muu Ñwáè anaè yu nda tá m bo byemi neè ye?”
English: He answered, Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè yá ye wáá, ñwáè ce e ce laèa neè wáè seè'ni na yu ye.”
English: Jesus said to him, You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.

Limbum: E laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Tataê, máè byemi neè wáè.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a gú'shi neè ye.
English: He said, Lord, I believe! and he worshiped him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Máè m vúè njep ñgoèñ na tá m bo teni mnsa' tá beèe ce a ce yá buu ka' a bo yá buu, tá beèe ce a ce yá buu naè a bo kúti mnfeèp.”
English: Jesus said, I came into this world for judgment, that those who don't see may see; and that those who see may become blind.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi mo' ce a m ba aèfo a yu' blaèa ca, a m bipshi neè ye enáê, “Baná weèr aè feèp foñ a?”
English: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, Are we also blind?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè ba ba mnfeèp, weèe aè ba ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep ka'. AÈmboè weèe ce laèa ená weèe ce yá buu, baná weèe ku cu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep.”
English: Jesus said to them, If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, 'We see.' Therefore your sin remains.

Limbum: “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè aè ka' ce niñ mbe ñka' njeèe, ko' aè ñka', ke' du njïì embe cuâu ñka' ka', baná ñgaèñ yu nyáèá a ker ba ñkep.
English: Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn't enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m maè' ñgaèa ca neè woweèe, woweèe a ke' riñ ñgaèa anaè ka'.
English: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn't understand what he was telling them.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce suñ weèe yuu tatap, m yu cuâu ñka' njeèe.
English: Jesus therefore said to them again, Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep's door.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce a duè entombïì neè máè, a yu byáèá, njeèe yi máñnïì yaèp njeèndoñ.
English: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn't listen to them.

Limbum: A máè cuâu ñka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' caa njïì enjep máè baná ñgaèñ be luèñ efa ñgá'. E be niñ mbo aè nfeè' ce e gwáá, koni yuu ye.
English: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.

Limbum: Nyáèá e ke vúè tá e bo yáèá, yú, keèr bepsi buu. Máè vúè ya tá beèe a bo koni ryoèñ, túr buu wááwá.
English: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

Limbum: “M yu gaây mboèñmboñ. Gaây mboèñmboñ e ke tami nyor aè rkwe njo' yi njeèe.
English: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce a loèr ye, e ce jaè' yi jaè', yu gaèy ce e túr njeèe anaè ka'. E ka' yá aèmboè kuura ce vúè, e be cañ maè' njeèe, tá kuura koshi mo', bár yi da' aè rïìñ.
English: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn't own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce a loèr e ce jaè' yi jaè' naè e lo cañ njobeè' njeèe yu yi ka'; e túr yi yu nfeè' aègho ka'.
English: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn't care for the sheep.

Limbum: M yu gaây mboèñmboñ. M rïìñ ya njeèe, ya njeèe yi riñ máè.
English: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I'm known by my own;

Limbum: AÈmboè yaè ta koèñ máè, má máè aè koñ ye naè. Máè tami nyor aè rkwe njo' yi.
English: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

Limbum: M ker túr ya njeèe mo', yi ba mbe ñka' anaè ka'. M be kuè vúè neè njeèe anaè foñ mbe ñka' ca tá yi yu' yaè njeèndoñ, ba kúr e mo'sir, túr ñwáè rcïìñ moè'sir.
English: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

Limbum: Yaè ta koèñ máè njobeè' máè fa la ryoèñ tá m bo keèr loè koni li.
English: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' be koo la ryoèñ ese máè ka'. Ce fa ba máè aè la rkoèñ. M túr ñger aè rfa la ryoèñ, a ker túr ñger aè rkoo li. Cena yu ba yuu ce yaè Ta aè laèa ená m geêe.”
English: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa blaèa ca, beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè Jus a ká' a ce kwaè'shi jáá jáèá jáá njo' blaèa anaè.
English: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a ká' a ce laèa enáê, “Yú' nyúèrkaè' yi karsi ye tu, e ká' a ce baa. Seèe ce yu' yuu ce e ce laèa njoká seê?”
English: Many of them said, He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?

Limbum: Beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “Yú' nyúèrkaè' yi ka' karsi ñwáè tu, e laa njáèá buu ca ka'. AÈde' yú' nyúèrkaè' yi gee nfeèp ce yá buu aè njáâá ká?”
English: Others said, These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn't possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?

Limbum: Nfeè' ce a m ce ye Ñkaâ' Haènukaè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè m gháá. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce saa aè m ya'ni.
English: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. A ka' baè' a du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a ce jáèr mbe dïì' mo' ce a m ce too ená njïì-baaki ñkúú Solomúèn.
English: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch.

Limbum: Jus a vú a sir ye a kaari a tarte, a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr be keè' duè baè' ba fá, tá aè ka' suñ weèr njáèá ñwáè ce aè yu? Wáè ka' ba Kraêis, ce yu ñwáè rjaè' ce Nyúè aè m kaè'ni ená e be tuu naè, aè suñ weèr rara.”
English: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè suñ weèe wáá, weèe aè byemïì ka'. Buu ce m ce geèe aè rlii yaè Taê, vi ce duèñshi njáèá ñwáè ce m yu.
English: Jesus answered them, I told you, and you don't believe. The works that I do in my Father's name, these testify about me.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe aè byemi ená m yu Kraâis ka' njobeè' weèe yu ya njeèe ka'.
English: But you don't believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

Limbum: Ya njeèe yi ke yu' yaè njeèndoñ, rïîñ. Máè rïìñ yi foñ, yi ce vúè a máâ mbuèu.
English: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

Limbum: M ce fa yi ryoèñ ce nfeseè, tá yi ker kwe aè nfeè' moè' ka'. AÈde' ñwáè moè' fúr yi emba máâ mmboè ka'.
English: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

Limbum: Yaè Ta ce e fa yi neè máè, túr ñger a caa buu wááwá. AÈde' ñwáè moè' fúr njeèe ca embaè mmbo yaè Ta ka'.
English: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father's hand.

Limbum: Weèr yaè Ta yu ñwáè moè'sir.”
English: I and the Father are one.

Limbum: Jus a ka' yu' blaèa ca, a kwá' bluèr tá a bo túúshi ye aègho tá e kwe.
English: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè yá ku' buu bboèñboñ ce máè geèe aè rlii yaè Taê. Efa múè buu ca, weèe ce koèñ aè rtúúshi máè neè bluèr ba aètu yïì efá?”
English: Jesus answered them, I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?

Limbum: Beèe anaè a beesïì enáê, “Weèr be túúshi wáè neè bluèr njobeè' buu bboèñboñ ce wáè geèe ka'. Weèr be túúshi wáè neè bluèr njobeè' wáè bepsi rlii Nyúè. AÈ ku ba ba ñwáè, a ce laèa wáná aè yu Nyúè.”
English: The Jews answered him, We don't stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “A sañ mbe ye ñwaè' mncir ená Nyúè aè m laèa enáê, ‘Weèe yu mnyúè.’
English: Jesus answered them, Isn't it written in your law, 'I said, you are gods?'

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená blaâa Nyúè vi ke kupse ka'. Baná aèmboè Nyúè aè m laèa ená beèe ce e laèa blaèa ca neè woweèe a yu aèmboè ye naè,
English: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came and the Scripture can't be broken,

Limbum: weèe aè ka' ce laèa weená m ce laèa máná m yu Nyúè wa'a a ce bepsi rlii Nyúè bepsi njoká? Yu máè ce yaè Ta aè m ce a tuu njep ñgoèñ.
English: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, 'You blaspheme,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God?'

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená m ce geèe ba mfaè' yaè Ta ka', weèe fa byemi neè máè ka'.
English: If I don't do the works of my Father, don't believe me.

Limbum: M ka' ce geèe ba mfaè' yaè Taê, weèe aè ka' tá baè byemi neè máè njo' buu ce m ce laèa ka', weèe aè ba byemi neè máè njo' buu ce m ce geèe tá weèe bo rïìñ rara ená m yu ñgúè' moè' efa yaè Taê, yaè Ta aè ba ñgúè' moè' efa máè.”
English: But if I do them, though you don't believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ker ce roèo aè rkoo ye, e fúú efa waâp mú a duê.
English: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

Limbum: E m ker kúti a tuu rdip Jodaèn a du faèdïì' ce Joân aè m ce baèptir beèe naè, a cu aèfo.
English: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a m vúè a yá ye aèfo, a ká' a ce laèa enáê, “Joân aè m geèe yuu mo' aè rduèñshi ená aè m tuu ba Nyúè a tuu ye ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, buu ce Joân aè m laèa aèmboè ñwáè ca vi yu mini.”
English: Many came to him. They said, John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr ce a m ba aè dïì' anaè a m byemi neè Jisoès.
English: Many believed in him there.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba a ce yañ, ce a too ye ená Lasoèroès. E m ce cu aè rla' Bátanïì a Máèári ba Maataè ce aè m ba bjar vi.
English: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

Limbum: Máèári ce ndur yïû Lasoèroès aè m ce yañ na, aè m ba Máèári ce e m cu'ni mgúr aè mkuèu Tata Jisoès, a siñsi neè yi nyúè'tu naè.
English: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.

Limbum: Bjar vi a m cep ntuu neè ye enáê, “Tataê, ñwáè ce aè koèñ naè ce yañ.”
English: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yu' ntuu ca a laa enáê, “Yañ ca yi be lúèsi ba neè rkwe ka'. Cena yi yu wa'a tá beèe magoèr a bo yá bkuè' Nyúè tá a bo kuè'si Muu Nyúè njobeè' yi.”
English: But when Jesus heard it, he said, This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God's Son may be glorified by it.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m koèñ Maataè ba nfúr yïì ker ba Lasoèroès.
English: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

Limbum: E ka' yu' ená Lasoèroès ce yañ, a ker cu faèdïì' ce e m ba naè aè mnoâñ bbaa.
English: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

Limbum: Mnoèñ anaè vi ka' caèa, e laa neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Seèe kúti aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè.”
English: Then after this he said to the disciples, Let's go into Judea again.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Rabaèi, to mnoèñ vi ku caa múcaèr seê, ce Jus a mú ce roèo aè rtúúshi wáè neè bluèr. Wáè ka' laa wáná aè be kúti aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè njoká?”
English: The disciples told him, Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Nyúè e ke sañ, káâ' aè mú ñgaèptú' du ba' aè mbuèuñkuèr. Ñwáè aè ka' ce jáèr aè nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi ce raa, aède' ñgaèñ koteè aè yuu ka' njobeè' ñgoèñ yi ce raa, e ce yá buu.
English: Jesus answered, Aren't there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn't stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

Limbum: Geewa'a ñwáè aè ka' ce jáèr neètú' baná ñgaèñ be kote njobeè' rraa li yu njep ye ka'.”
English: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn't in him.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a ker suñ woweèe enáê, “Lasoèroès ce yu ñkar yïìseèe ce buumi buumi. M be duè tá m bo yáèá ye efa mmirloè.”
English: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa enáê, “Tataê, e ka' ce buumi baná e be luèñ.”
English: The disciples therefore said, Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce laèa wa'a, a ce kwaè'shi ená Lasoèroès ce buumi aèmboè beèe a ke buumi naè. Geewa'a Jisoès aè m ce laèa ba ená Lasoèroès aè kwe kwe.
English: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m suñ woweèe rara enáê, “Lasoèroès aè kwe.
English: So Jesus said to them plainly then, Lazarus is dead.

Limbum: M ce lu'shi njobeè' weèe, máná máè mú ba aèfo ka', tá weèe bo byemi neè máè. Baná seèe du yá ye.”
English: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let's go to him.

Limbum: Tomas ce a m ce too ye ená rfar naè, aè laa neè beèe ce a woweèe a m ce yá'ni buu Jisoès naè enáê, “Seèe du aèmbuèu Jisoès foñ tá seèe bo duè kwe seèe woweèe.”
English: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, Let's go also, that we may die with him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' baè' aè rla' Bátanïì, a yu' ená yu mnoèñ kyeèe aèmboè a mú tuñ Lasoèroès.
English: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè Jus magoèr se a loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a vú aè rcaè'ni Maataè ba Máèári njo' ndur yaèp ce e m kwe. Loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm du ba' aè rla' Bátanïì yi yu saèsap ka'. Yi ku ba aèmboè bkïìlomátaè vïû btaar wa'a.
English: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away. Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

Limbum: Maataè aè ka' yu' ená Jisoès ce vúè, e natïì a du a koni ye aè nduunjïì. Máèári aè cu yi mbe ndaèp.
English: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

Limbum: Maataè aè ka' koni Jisoès, a laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, wáè mú ba aèfa ndur yaè aè mú kwe ka'.
English: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.

Limbum: Ka' seè'ni na, máè rïìñ máná Nyúè be fa yuu ce wáè ka' bipshi neè ye.”
English: Even now I know that, whatever you ask of God, God will give you.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ndur yoè be fúú efa rkwe.”
English: Jesus said to her, Your brother will rise again.

Limbum: Maataè aè laa neè ye enáê, “M rïìñ máná e be fúú efa rkwe aè noèñ elúèsimbuèu ce beèe wááwá a be keè fúú efa rkwe naè.”
English: Martha said to him, I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “A máè ce máâ ke geèe beèe a ce fúú efa rkwe, a ker ba ñwáè ce e ke fa ryoèñ. Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè máè, ka' ñgaèñ aè ka' kwe, e be cu nfeseè.
English: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' cu nteèe, byemi neè máè, baná ñgaèñ be cu nfeseè. Waè' wáè byemi a?”
English: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?

Limbum: E laa neè ye enáê, “ÁÈno, Tataê, máè byemi máná aè yu Kraêis, Muu Nyúè ce e m ba ená e be vúè njep ñgoèñ naè.”
English: She said to him, Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God's Son, he who comes into the world.

Limbum: Maataè aè ka' laèa wa'a, a du a ká' nfúr yïû Máèári a cúúni neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì aè vúè a ce ká' wáè.”
English: When she had said this, she went away, and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, The Teacher is here, and is calling you.

Limbum: Máèári aè ka' yu', a sa'ti mbekïì a du a koni ye.
English: When she heard this, she arose quickly, and went to him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Jisoès aè be niñ aè múè rla' ka'. E m ku bii ba mbe dïì' ce Maataè aè m duè a yá ye naè.
English: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

Limbum: Jus ce a woweèe a m ce cu rkwe mbe ndaèp naè a ka' yá aèmboè Máèári aè saè'ti a fúú njepmbeè, woweèe a du a yeâ mbuèu njobeè' a m ce kwaè' ená e ce duè aè rwar rkwe faèdïì' rsheè li m ba.
English: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, She is going to the tomb to weep there.

Limbum: Máèári aè du a yá Jisoès, a gú'shi njep yeâ tïìi, a laa enáê, “Tataê, wáè mú ba aèfa, ndur yaè aè mú kwe ka'.”
English: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá aèmboè Máèári ce war, keèr yá aèmboè Jus ce a Máèári weèe a m ce vúè naè a ce warse, yi joo ye seê, mluè mi koo ye.
English: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

Limbum: E bipshïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè mú tuñ ye ba fá?” Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, vúè yá.”
English: and said, Where have you laid him? They told him, Lord, come and see.

Limbum: Jisoès aè suusïì mñgoommir.
English: Jesus wept.

Limbum: Jus anaè a laa enáê, “Yá neè aèmboè e m koèñ ye naè.”
English: The Jews therefore said, See how much affection he had for him!

Limbum: Beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “AÈde' ñwáè ce e m geèe nfeèp aè ce yá buu naè aè ke' ba geèe tá ñwáè ca luñ efa rkwe ka' a?”
English: Some of them said, Couldn't this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?

Limbum: Yi ker joo Jisoès, e du mbe dïì' ce rsheè li m ba. Rsheè anaè aè m ba mbúè' ce a m soè' nje ryáá, a biñsi luèr a cete aègho.
English: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Caè'si neè luèr anaè.” Maataè ce e m ba njar ñkúsheè ñwáè naè, aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, e be rúèú seê, njobeè' yu mnoèñ kyeèe seè'ni aèmboè a mú tuñ ye.”
English: Jesus said, Take away the stone. Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Mboè máè ba suñ wáè ená aè be yá ñger Nyúè ce wáè ka' byemi a?”
English: Jesus said to her, Didn't I tell you that if you believed, you would see God's glory?

Limbum: A m caè'si luèr embe ncuâu rsheè. Jisoès aè ke' mbe buèu a laa enáê, “Taèr, m ce yoèñshi wáè njobeè' wáè yu' la rloo.
English: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ máná wáâ ke yu' la rloo aè nfeè' wááwá. Geewa'a, m ce laèa cena njo' beèe ce a táá na, tá woweèe a bo byemi ená a wáè ce wáè m tuu máè.”
English: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude that stands around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a waa mbekïì enáê, “Lasoèroès, fúú enjo!”
English: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come out!

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m kwe na aè fúú aèmboè a m kur mi mkoo ba mi mkuèu neè bcáè', a boo vi bsii neè bcáè' naè. Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baè'shi neè bcáè' tá e duê.”
English: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, Free him, and let him go.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m vúè a Máèári weèe naè, a m yá yuu ce Jisoès aè m geèe, beèe magoèr efa waâp mú a byemïì neè ye.
English: Therefore many of the Jews, who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did, believed in him.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a natïì yap a du a yá beèe Farïìsi a suñ woweèe yuu ce Jisoès aè m geèe anaè.
English: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, beèe Farïìsi ca ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa mú ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a ká' kansuèr, a laa enáê, “Seèe be geèe seeká? Ñwáè ca ce duèñshi ku' mncoèo seê.
English: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' ma'shi ená e ce gee njáèá buu ca, beèe wááwá a lo byemi neè ye, tá beâe aè to' Rum a lo vúè bepsi yiseèe dïû' rara ba yiseèe to'.”
English: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.

Limbum: Moè' efa woweèe ce a m ce too ená Kaifaès ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì mbe feè' anaè aè m naèti mbekïì a laa enáê, “Weèe rïìñ yuu ka' múcaèr ka'.
English: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, You know nothing at all,

Limbum: Weèe aè ba rïìñ weená yi yu boèñboñ ená ñwáè moè'sir kwe aètu beèe neè ce ená to' sïìp yi bú.”
English: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.

Limbum: Kaifaès aè m ce laèa wa'a, a ce laèa ba aè mkwaè'shïì mi ka'. AÈmboè Kaifaès ca aè m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè feè' anaè, e m suñ beèe yuu ce yi be loè ba. E m laèa ená Jisoès táá aè rkwe aètu to' wááwá.
English: Now he didn't say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

Limbum: Yi m ba ená e be kwe ba aètu to' ca caè'caè' ka'. Yi m ba ená e be kwe aètu beèe Nyúè ce a yu aè bto' wááwá tá e bo vúè neè woweèe aèbee tá woweèe a ba ñwáè moè'sir.
English: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a ká' ese noèñ anaè, a ce seèesi aèmboè a be geèe ka' yú ye.
English: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisoès aè ker kar aèwañ aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè ka'. E m loè a du aè rla' mo' ce a too ená Áfráèm. Rla' anaè li yu aèwaâa rïìñ. E m duè a cu aèfo a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe.
English: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè m káè' a ce gháá ce a be ye ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap. Beèe a m loâ aè bbu' mla' wááwá a du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. Woweèe aè m koèñ aè rgeèe wap mnyor tá vi ba brara aè bsii Nyúè, tá nfeè' ñkaè' ka' gháá.
English: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce roèo Jisoès, a ká' a ce bipshi fa waâp mú mbe Ndaèp Nyúè enáê, “Weèe ce kwaè'shi ená ká? E be vúè ñkaè' ca káè e be vúè ka'?”
English: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as they stood in the temple, What do you think--that he isn't coming to the feast at all?

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba beèe Farïìsi a m fa rsa' aè nfeè' anaè ená ñwáè aè ka' riñ faèdïì' Jisoès yu, ñgaèñ vú suñ woweèe tá woweèe a bo duè koo ye.
English: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

Limbum: Mnoèñ ce a be ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap vi ka' báti ntuunfu, Jisoès aè natïì a du aè rla' Bátanïì. Rla' Bátanïì ca yu faèdïì' ce Lasoèroès ce Jisoès aè m fúr efa rkwe naè aè m ce cu.
English: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

Limbum: A m laa byee a tar ye aègho. Maataè aè m ce caèasi byee. Lasoèroès ye ye aè m ba moè' ce a Jisoès weèe a m ce ye byee mbe tábuèr.
English: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce ye byee, Máèári aè vú neè mgúr ce mi m boèñ seê, ce a m geèe neè njáèá mjáá ce a m ce too ená Naêd. Mgúr anaè mi m luèu ntaa seê. Mi m ba aèmboè nto'nïì litaè wa'a. E m loèr mgúr anaè a cu'ni aè mkuèu Jisoès, a siñsi neè yi nyúè'tu. Ndap aè m ku rúú nsïìp nsïìp neè mgúr anaè.
English: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

Limbum: Judas IÌskarïìyoèt ce e m ba mo' efa ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, ce e m ba ñwáè ce e be loè fyeèni Jisoès naè, aè m laèa enáê,
English: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

Limbum: “Haba! AÈde' a ke' ba fyeèni mgúr ca aè bbaâa mbaâa btaar, loèr mbaèa efa gho fa neè ñgaâa fuèp ka' njoká?”
English: Why wasn't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?

Limbum: E m laèa wa'a, ke' ba njobeè' e m ce koosimnse neè ñgaâa fuèp ka'. E m laèa wa'a njobeè' e m ba nyáèá. A ye ce e m ce láè yap mbaèa, a ce yáèá mo' enjo.
English: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa enáê, “Láè ye nyañ. Maè'shi tá e gee wa'a aè noèñ ce a be keè tuñ máè.
English: But Jesus said, Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

Limbum: Ñgaâa fuèp a ku ba weèe woweèe aè nfeè' wááwá, aè ka' ba aèmboè máè yi, seèe be ba aè nfeè' wááwá ka'.”
English: For you always have the poor with you, but you don't always have me.

Limbum: Ma kúr Jus a ka' yu' ená Jisoès yu aè rla' anaè, a natïì a vúê. Woweèe a m vúè tá a bo kuè yá ba Jisoès caè'caè' ka', a m koèñ foñ aè ryá Lasoèroès ce Jisoès aè m fúr efa rkwe naè.
English: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a seesïì aèmboè a be yú Lasoèroès,
English: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

Limbum: njobeè' Jus magoèr a m maè'shi woweèe a byemïì neè Jisoès njo' ye.
English: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, ku' beèe ce a m vúè aè rye ñkaè' naè, a yu' ená Jisoès ce vúè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a gwar bbaèp mtáá a du a koni ye aègho aè nduunjïì, a ce yoèp enáê, “Hoèsanaè! Bghoènïì vi yu neè ñwáè ce e ce vúè aè rlii Tataê, a ba ñkúú aè to' Isráèl.”
English: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!

Limbum: Jisoès aè m koni muu jaèaki', a ko' a cu mbo, aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè naè. A m sañ mbo enáê,
English: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

Limbum: “Rla' Sayoèn, fa wáp ka'. Yá yoè ñkúú aèmboè e ce vúè, a cu mbenduè muu jaèaki'.”
English: Don't be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey's colt.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a m rïìñ mbuèu efa buu ce vi m koni na efa rkáè' ka'. Woweèe a m loè a riñ ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m kuè'si Jisoès naè. Woweèe a m kuushi buu ce a m sañ a kuu ye aè nfeè' anaè, a kuushi foñ aèmboè a m geèe buu ca neè ye.
English: His disciples didn't understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ba a Jisoès weèe aè nfeè' ce e m fúr Lasoèroès efa rkwe naè a m ce suñ beèe aèmboè yuu ce yi m koni.
English: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce beèe magoèr ce a m yu' yuu báèá ce Jisoès aè m geèe anaè, a m vúè a yá ye.
English: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

Limbum: Beèe Farïìsi a ka' yá wa'a, a ká' a ce laèa a waâp mú enáê, “AÈde' seèe gee yuu mo' ka'. Yá aèmboè beèe wááwá a kuñ nyor a du a yeâ mbuèu.”
English: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, beèe mo' aè to' Greâs a ba aè múè beèe ce a m ce du aè rgeèe rloo aè ñkaè' anaè.
English: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.

Limbum: Beèe Greâs ca a m duè a yá Felep ce aè rla' Báètsaidaè aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a laa neè ye enáê, “Masaè, weèr ce koèñ aè ryá Jisoès.”
English: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we want to see Jesus.

Limbum: Felep aè du a suñ Andruè, a ye a du a suñ Jisoès.
English: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Nfeè' aè gháá ce a be kuè'si Muu Ñwáè.
English: Jesus answered them, The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè máná, mbúè kwaa aè ka' tá gweè aè nsheè kwe ka', baná e be kuè cu moè'sir aèmboè e m ba. E ka' gwe aè nsheè, rlir li fúú, kwaa kwe, baná e be kuè', geèe mbúè kwaa aèñgoo.
English: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

Limbum: Yi yu ená ñwáè ce e ka' boñshi li ryoèñ baná e be bá li. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá boñshi li ryoèñ njep ñgoèñ na ka', baná ñgaèñ be túr li ryoèñ, cu nfeseè.
English: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' koñ aè rfaè' neè máè, ñgaèñ vú fa máâ mbuèu. Faèdïì' ce m ka' ba, baná yaè ñwáè rfaè' be ba aèfo foñ. Ñwáè ce e ka' fa' neè máè baná yaè ta be naèa ye mbekïì.
English: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

Limbum: “Ya ntee yi ce fa máè ñgá' seè'ni seê. M be ka' laa má ká? M laa máná ‘Yaè Taê, fúr máè efa ñgá' ce e yu seè'ni naè’ a? AÈi', m be laèa wa' ka'. Máè m vúè tá m bo yá njáèá ñgá' ca
English: Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? 'Father, save me from this time?' But for this cause I came to this time.

Limbum: Yaè Taê, geèe tá a ku'si lo rlii.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a yu' njeèndoñ aè laa embe buèu enáê, “Máè geèe wa'a, m be keèr geèe.”
English: Father, glorify your name! Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

Limbum: Kúr beèe mo' ce a m ba aèfo a m yu' njeèndoñ anaè a laa ená mbeèñ aè wañger. Beèe mo' a laa yap ená ncïìndap Nyúè aè laèa yuu neè ye.
English: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, An angel has spoken to him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Njeèndoñ ca aè laèa njo' máè ka', e laèa njo' weèe.
English: Jesus answered, This voice hasn't come for my sake, but for your sakes.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè gháá ce Nyúè be sa' ñgoèñ ca. Nfeè' aè gháá ce a be so ñkúú enjep ñgoèñ ca.
English: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè máè, a be naèa máè mbekïì tá m súñ beèe wááwá aè yaè.”
English: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa wa'a tá beèe a bo rïìñ njáèá rkwe ce e be kwe.
English: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

Limbum: Kúr beèe anaè a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr aè m yu' embe Ñwaè' Mncir ená Kraâis anaè be cu nfeseè. Wáè ka' ce laèa wáná a be naèa Muu Ñwáè mbekïì njoká? Muu Ñwáè anaè yu nda seê?”
English: The multitude answered him, We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up?' Who is this Son of Man?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Rraa li be kuè ba weèe woweèe ba aè nfeè' múcaècaèr. Ce jár neè seè'ni aèmboè rraa li bii aègho, faè dïì' túè'nji koni weèe ka'. Ñwáè ce e ke jáèr aè túè'nji e ke rïìñ faèdïì' ce e ce duè ka'.
English: Jesus therefore said to them, Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn't overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn't know where he is going.

Limbum: Byemi neè neè rraa ca aèmboè li ku bii fa weâe mú na, tá weèe bo ba boo ce aè rraa.” Jisoès aè ka' laèa blaèa ca mïìsi, a lá'si nyor efa múè beèe a du a cu mimñgi'.
English: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light. Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

Limbum: Ka' Jisoès aè m duèñshi ku' mncoèo a waâp bsii wa'a, woweèe a m byemi yap yu neè ye ka'.
English: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn't believe in him,

Limbum: Buu ca vi m ku koni aèmboè AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m sañ naè. E m sañ enáê, “Tataê, waè' ñwáè moè' yu ce e byemi blaâa Nyúè ce weèr aè feè'shi na a? Waè' ñwáè moè' yu ce e rïìñ yo ñger a?”
English: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

Limbum: Beèe anaè aè m byemi ka'. Yi ku ba aèmboè AÈsayaè aè m ker sañ naè. E m sañ enáê,
English: For this cause they couldn't believe, for Isaiah said again,

Limbum: “Nyúè aè cete maêp mmir, a teesi wap btu faè dïì' woweèe a bo yá rraa ca neè maêp mmir, rïìñ buu ca, beèesi yap ntee vúè a máâ mbuèu tá m bo geèe woweèe a luñ ka'.”
English: He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.

Limbum: AÈsayaè aè m ce laèa buu ca wa'a njobeè' e m yá foèo Jisoès, a ce laèa ba aèmboè ye.
English: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

Limbum: Geewa'a, beèe magoèr a m byemi neè ye, ka' beèe mo' ce a m ba beâe bgoèrgoèr. Woweèe a m suñ beèe ka', njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp beèe Farïìsïî. Woweèe a m geèe wa'a, faè dïì' a bo juèu woweèe embe ndaèp rloo ka'.
English: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn't confess it, so that they wouldn't be put out of the synagogue,

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce koèñ aè rgeèe ba yuu ce vúse Nyúè vúse woweèe ka'. Woweèe a m ce koèñ aè rgeèe ba yuu ce ku'si ba beèe kuè'si woweèe.
English: for they loved men's praise more than God's praise.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m laèa neè ñger-ñwáè enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' byemi neè máè baná ñgaèñ aè ku byemi ba neè máè ka', e byemi foñ neè ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.
English: Jesus cried out and said, Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' yá máè, baná ñgaèñ aè yá ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.
English: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

Limbum: Máè vúè njep ñgoèñ na aèmboè rraa tá ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè máè, e bo keèr cu aè túè'nji ka'.
English: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' yu' wa blaèa, ke' gee yuu ce máè laèa ka', be sa' máè nsa' ñwáè anaè ka'. Máè m vúè tá m bo sa' beèe ka'. Máè m vúè tá m bo geèe beèe a luêñ.
English: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn't believe, I don't judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' kani máè ker kani wa blaèa foñ, ñgaèñ túr yuu ce yi be sa' ye. Wa blaèa a yuu ce vi be sa' ñwáè anaè aè noèñ elúèsimbuèu.
English: He who rejects me, and doesn't receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a njobeè' m ce laèa buu ca ba aè ñger ya ka'. Yu ba yaè Ta ce e m tuu máè ce e m suñ máè yuu ce m laêa.
English: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ máná vi blaèa vi yu ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Baná blaèa ce m ce laèa neè weèe yu ba blaèa ce máè yu' ese yaè Ta caè'caè'.”
English: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.

Limbum: Tá a ka' ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap, Jisoès aè m rïìñ ená nfeè' aè gháá ce e be maè'shi ñgoèñ ca duè yá yïì Taê. E m koèñ yïì beèe ce a yu njep ñgoèñ na, a koñ woweèe a du a misïî.
English: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce ye byee aè mbuèuñkuèr, Sataèn aè banïì gee Judaès ce muu Saimún IÌskarïìyoèt aè ká' a ce kwaè'shi ená e be fyeèni Jisoès.
English: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him,

Limbum: Jisoès aè m rïìñ ená yïì Ta aè m fa buu wááwá mbe yeâ mmboè. E m rïìñ foñ ená e m loâ ese Nyúè, a ce kúti aè ryá Nyúè,
English: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and was going to God,

Limbum: a nati mbekïì aè nfeè' byee anaè, a co'ni bcáâ' mo' efa nyoèr, a lor baètaèare a cúú njep mbuèu.
English: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

Limbum: E ka' cúú wáá, a lor mdip a cu'ni njep kañ a ká' a ce suè'si mkuâu ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a ce soèr neè baètaèare ce e ba cúú njep mbuèu naè.
English: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

Limbum: E ka' baè' mbe Saimún Pitaè, e laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, a wáè ce aè be suè'si ma mkuèu a?”
English: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, Lord, do you wash my feet?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Wáè be riñ yuu ce m ce geèe seè'ni ka'. AÈ be loè rïìñ ba embenjïì.”
English: Jesus answered him, You don't know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÈde' aè ke' su'si ma mkuèu ka'.” Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “M ka' tá suè'si mo mkuèu ka', baná soè aè mïì.”
English: Peter said to him, You will never wash my feet! Jesus answered him, If I don't wash you, you have no part with me.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè a laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, baná aè fa kuè suè'si ba ma mkuèu caè'caè' ka', suè'si ma mmbo ba ya tu foñ.”
English: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' su'si nyor wáá, baná ñgaèñ be kuè suè'si ba mi mkuèu njobeè' yïì nyor ce raa. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, weèe ce raa, geewa'a ku ba weèe wááwá ce weèe ce raa ka'.”
English: Jesus said to him, Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.

Limbum: E m laèa wa'a, a ku riñ ñwáè ce e be loè fyeèni ye. A mbuèu ce e m laèa enáê, “Ku ba weèe wááwá ce weèe ce raa ka'.”
English: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, You are not all clean.

Limbum: E ka' suè'si woweèe mkuèu wáá, a lor vi bcáè' ce e ba co'ni naè a yar, a du a cu aè nsheè. E ka' cu, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Waè' weèe rïìñ yuu ce máè geèe neè weèe na a?
English: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, Do you know what I have done to you?

Limbum: Weèe ce too máè ená Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, a ker ce too máè ená Tataê. Weèe ce too yáánïì njobeè' m yu wa'a.
English: You call me, 'Teacher' and 'Lord.' You say so correctly, for so I am.

Limbum: AÈmboè máè ce m yu Tataê, a ker ba Ñwáè Ryá'nïì, máè ka' su'si me mkuèu, baná weèe ce su'si mkuâu bfúr wee foñ.
English: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

Limbum: Máè geèe ca aè rduèñshi weèe tá wee weèe foñ bo geèe aèmboè máè geèe na.
English: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená aède' ñwáè rfaè' caa yïì masaè ka'. AÈbaè ñwáè ntuu caa ñwáè ce e tuu ye ka'.
English: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' riñ buu ce máè suñ weèe na, ce geèe vi, baná weèe be koni bghoènïì.
English: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

Limbum: M ce laèa ca ba aèmboè weèe wááwá ka'. M rïìñ beèe ce máè ce. Geewa'a, yuu ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi m laèa yi be kuè ghááte aèmboè a m sañ enáê, ‘Ñwáè ce weèr ye aè m ce ye byee aèbee, aè m kúti yaè ñwáè bbaèa.’
English: I don't speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, 'He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.'

Limbum: Máè suñ weèe buu ca seè'ni tá vi ka' koni, vi ka' lo koni tá weèe bo byemi ená m yu njáèá ñwáè ce m yu.
English: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè ce e ka' koni yaè ñwáè ntuu, baná ñgaèñ aè koni máè. Ñwáè ce e ka' koni máè, baná ñgaèñ aè koni ñwáè ce e m tuu máè.”
English: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa blaèa ca wáá, mluè mi ká' a ce koo ye. E laa rara enáê, “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú be fyeèni máè.”
English: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ká' a ce keè'ni neè mmir, a ce tarni ñwáè ce Jisoès aè m ce laèa.
English: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa woweèe ce Jisoès aè m koèñ se naè aè m cu a kár nyor a yeâ geñ.
English: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus' breast.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè lap ye ená e bipshi neè Jisoès ená e ce laèa ba aèmboè nda lá.
English: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.

Limbum: E yá'tïì yi tu nje ñguèñ Jisoès, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Tataê, ñwáè anaè yu nda?”
English: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus' breast, asked him, Lord, who is it?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Yu ñwáè ce m be bá' bráâd cúè' njep njaèp fa neè ye.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a bá' bráâd a cú' njep njaèp, a fa neè Judaès, muu Saimún IÌskarïìyoèt.
English: Jesus therefore answered, It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it. So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

Limbum: E ka' ye, Sataèn aè niñ njep yeâ ntee. Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Fa caèasi nfeè' ka', geèe yuu ce aè ce koèñ aè rgeèe naè cárcár.”
English: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, What you do, do quickly.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ba mbo a m rïìñ mbuèu ce Jisoès aè m laèa neè ye wa' ka'.
English: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.

Limbum: AÈmboè Judaès aè m ba ñwáè ce e m ce láè yap mbaèa naè, beèe mo' a ce kwaè'shi yap ená Jisoès ce laèa ba ená e du yuu buu ñkaè', káè ená e du fa yuu neè ñgaâa fuèp.
English: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, Buy what things we need for the feast, or that he should give something to the poor.

Limbum: E ka' koo bráâd ca a ku fúú njepmbeè. AÈ m ba neètú'.
English: Therefore, having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

Limbum: E ka' fúú, Jisoès aè laa enáê, “A kuè'si Muu Ñwáè seè'ni. A ku'si Nyúè njïì enjep ye.
English: When he had gone out, Jesus said, Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

Limbum: A ka' ku'si Nyúè njïì enjep ye, baná Nyúè be kuè'si Muu njïì enjep yeâ nyoèr. E be geèe wa'a cárcár seê.
English: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

Limbum: Boo waê, seèe be kuè cu ba aè nfeè' múcaècaèr. Weèe be roèo máè. Yi ku ba aèmboè máè m suñ Jus enáê, ‘AÈde' weèe vú faèdïì' ce m ce duè ka'’ naè.
English: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going, you can't come,' so now I tell you.

Limbum: M ce fa weèe ncir ce fi ená weèe koèñni. Weèe koñni foñ aèmboè máè m koèñ weèe naè.
English: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another, just like I have loved you; that you also love one another.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' koñni wa'a, baná beèe wááwá a be rïìñ ená weèe yu ñgaâa yá'ni yaè buu.”
English: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Tataê, aè ce duè ba fá?” Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “AÈde' aè du faèdïì' ce m ce duè na seè'ni ka'. AÈ be loè ka' vúè a máâ mbuèu.”
English: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered, Where I am going, you can't follow now, but you will follow afterwards.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, aède' m du fa wáâ mbuèu seè'ni ka' njoká? M be kwe njo' wáè.”
English: Peter said to him, Lord, why can't I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Wáná aè be kwe njo' máè lá! M ce suñ wáè neè mini- ñwáè ená tá nduñgúp ka' toñ, aè be kani ená aè rïìñ máè ka' ñkaèraè' taar.
English: Jesus answered him, Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won't crow until you have denied me three times.

Limbum: “Weèe fa maè'shi tá wee mntee vi ce fa weèe ñgá' ka', weèe byemi neè Nyúè, ker byemi neè máè foñ.
English: Don't let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

Limbum: Tomas aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, weèr rïìñ faèdïì' ce aè ce duè ka', baná aède' weèr riñ nduunjïì anaè aè njáâá ká?”
English: Thomas said to him, Lord, we don't know where you are going. How can we know the way?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “A máè nduunjïì, a máè mini, a máè ryoèñ. AÈde' ñwáè moè' du yá yaè Taê, ce e buu efa rcaèa njïì enjep máè ka'.
English: Jesus said to him, I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

Limbum: Weèe aè ba riñ máè, weèe aè ba rïìñ yaè Ta foñ. Ká' e seè'ni na, weèe aè rïìñ ye, a ker yá ye foñ.”
English: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.

Limbum: Felep aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, duèñshi weèr yoè Ta tá yi bo ghááte weèr.”
English: Philip said to him, Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Feleêp, seèe aè cu teèteè wa'a, wáè ke' riñ máè ka' lá? Ñwáè ce e ka' yá máè, baná e yá yaè Taê. Wáè ka' ker ce laèa ená m duñshi wáè yaè Ta njoká?
English: Jesus said to him, Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, 'Show us the Father?'

Limbum: Wáè byemi ená m yu njep yaè Taê, yaè Ta aè ba njep máè a? Blaèa ce m ce laèa neè weèe na, m ce laèa ba aè ñger ya ka'. Yaè Ta ce e yu njep máè a ñwáè ce e ce geèe li rfaè'.
English: Don't you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

Limbum: Byemi neè yuu ce máè suñ weèe ená m yu njep yaè Taê, yaè Ta aè ba njep máè naè. Weèe aè ka' tá byemi njo' blaèa ca ka', weèe aè ba byemi njobeè' mfaè' ce máè geèe na.
English: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works' sake.

Limbum: “M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè máè, baná e be geèe buu ce m ce geèe, keèr geèe buu ce vi caèa vi ce m ce geèe njobeè' m ce duè aè rcu weèr Taèr.
English: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' loo ka' njáèá ká aè máâ rlii, m be geèe yuu anaè, tá beèe a bo kuè'si Taèr njo' Muu yïì.
English: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' loo ka' njáèá ká aè máâ rlii, m be geèe yi.
English: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

Limbum: “Weèe aè ka' koñ máè, weèe yu' wa blaèa.
English: If you love me, keep my commandments.

Limbum: M be loo neè Taèr tá e tuusi weèe Ñwáè Rjaè' moè' tá e bo cu weèe woweèe nfeseè.
English: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,--

Limbum: Ñwáè Rjaè' ca yu Yú' ce yi ke suñ beèe yuu mini. AÈde' beèe enjep ñgoèñ a konïì Ñwáè Rjaè' anaè ka', njobeè' aède' woweèe a yá ye káè riñ ye ka'. Beèe ce a rïìñ ye yu weèe njobeè' e be cu weèe woweèe, ba njep weâe mntee.
English: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can't receive; for it doesn't see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.

Limbum: M be maè'shi weèe neè ye tu ka'. M be duè kúti vúè yá weèe.
English: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

Limbum: Ku báti nfeè' múcaèr tá beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ker yá máè ka'. Geewa'a, weèe be yá máè. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' m cu nteèe, baná weèe be cu bteèe foñ.
English: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

Limbum: Noèñ anaè yi be gháá tá weèe riñ ená m yu njep yaè Taê, weèe aè ba njep máè, má máè aè ba njep weèe.
English: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' yu' wa blaèa, láê, baná a ñwáè ce e koèñ máè. Ñwáè aè ka' koñ máè baná yaè Ta be koèñ ñgaèñ foñ. M be koèñ ñwáè anaè foñ, duèñshi yaè nyor neè ye.”
English: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.

Limbum: Judaès ce aè m ba Judas IÌskarïìyoèt ka', aè laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, aè be duèñshi yoè nyor neè weèr tá weèr yá wáè tá beèe enjep ñgoèñ a yá wáè ka' aè njáâá ká?”
English: Judas not Iscariot said to him, Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' koñ máè baná ñgaèñ be yu' wa blaèa. Yaè Ta be koèñ ye. Weèr yaè Ta be vúè cu weèr ñwáè anaè weèe.
English: Jesus answered him, If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e koèñ máè ka', a ñwáè ce e ce yu' wa blaèa ka'. Blaèa ce weèe ce yu' na, yu wa ka', yu blaèa yaè Ta ce e m tuu máè.
English: He who doesn't love me doesn't keep my words. The word which you hear isn't mine, but the Father's who sent me.

Limbum: “M ce suñ weèe buu ca a ku bii fa weâe mú.
English: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.

Limbum: Ñwáè Rjaè' ce yu Yú' Rara ce Taèr be tuu a máâ rlii, yu ñwáè ce e be vúè yá'ni weèe buu wááwá, geèe tá weèe kuushi buu ce máè suñ weèe wááwá.
English: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

Limbum: “Máè láè cumúnyañ neè weèe, m ce fa yaè cumúnyañ neè weèe. M ce fa ba aèmboè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ke fa ka'. Weèe fa maè'shi tá wee mntee vi ce fa weèe ñgá' ka'. Weèe fa wáp buu ka'.
English: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

Limbum: Weèe aè m yu' aèmboè máè m suñ weèe máná m ce duè kúti yá weèe. Weèe aè ba koñ máè, weèe aè ba lu'shi ená m ce duè aè ryá Taèr, njobeè' e kuè' a caa máè.
English: You heard how I told you, 'I go away, and I come to you.' If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said 'I am going to my Father;' for the Father is greater than I.

Limbum: Máè suñ weèe buu ca seè'ni tá vi ka' koni, vi loè koni naè, tá weèe bo byemi neè máè.
English: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.

Limbum: M be keèr suñ buu weèe seèe weèe goèr ka' njobeè' ñwáè ce e ce sa' ñgoèñ ca ce vúè. E túr ñger mbe máâ nduè ka'.
English: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

Limbum: M ku ce geèe ba aèmboè Taèr aè suñ máè ená m geêe, tá ñgoèñ yi bo rïìñ ená máè koèñ ye. Naèti neè tá seèe du aè dïû' jáá.”
English: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m ker laa enáê, “M yu msini gráâp ce mini. Yaè Ta a ñwáè ce e ke ke' aè msini ca.
English: I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

Limbum: M ku koñ weèe foñ aèmboè yaè Ta koèñ máè. Cu neè njep la rkoèñnïì.
English: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' gee buu ce máè laèa neè weèe, weèe be cu njep la rkoèñnïì aèmboè má máè foñ aè geèe buu ce yaè Ta aè laèa ená m geêe, a cu njep li rkoèñnïì naè.
English: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and remain in his love.

Limbum: Máè laèa buu ca neè weèe tá weèe bo lu'shi foñ aèmboè máè, tá le rlu'shïì anaè li bo mïìsi.
English: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa ená weèe gee yi yu ená weèe koñni aèmboè m koèñ weèe.
English: This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

Limbum: “Ñgoèñ ca yi ka' baa weèe, rïìñ neè ená yi m baa máè entombïû neè weèe.
English: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

Limbum: Weèe aè ba ba beèe enjep ñgoèñ na, woweèe a ba koèñ weèe njobeè' weèe yu yaèp beèe. Geewa'a weèe yu ye beèe enjep ñgoèñ na ka'. Máè ce weèe efa múè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na. A mbuèu ce woweèe a baèa weèe.
English: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

Limbum: Kuushi neè yuu ce máè m suñ weèe ená aède' ñwáè rfaè' caa yïì masaè ka' naè. Woweèe a m ka' ba fa máè ñgá', baná a be fa weèe ñgá' foñ. Woweèe a m ka' ba yu'ni neè wa blaèa baná a be yu'ni neè wee blaèa foñ.
English: Remember the word that I said to you: 'A servant is not greater than his lord.' If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

Limbum: Woweèe a be geèe neè weèe wa'a njobeè' máè, ker ba foñ njobeè' woweèe a rïìñ ñwáè ce e m tuu máè ka'.
English: But all these things will they do to you for my name's sake, because they don't know him who sent me.

Limbum: Máè m tá baè vúè laèa yuu neè woweèe ka', a m ba taèa woweèe aè yuu bebep ka'. AÈmboè máè vúè seè'ni na, yuu mo' yi yu ce aède' yi ker tá'shi yaèp buu bbebep ka'.
English: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' baa máè, baná e baèa yaè Ta foñ.
English: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

Limbum: Máè m ka' tá baè geèe mfaè' ce ñwáè aè m be gee ka' fa waâp mú na ka', a m ba taèa woweèe aè yuu bebep ka'. Woweèe a yá mfaè' ca seè'ni, a ku bii ce baèa máè, ba yaè Ta foñ.
English: If I hadn't done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn't have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.

Limbum: Buu ca vi koni wa'a, tá yi bo kuè ghááte aèmboè a m sañ mbe yap ñwaè' mncir enáê, ‘A m baèa máè aè cicïì.’
English: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, 'They hated me without a cause.'

Limbum: Be keè ba aè nfeè' moè' tá m tuu ñwáè rjaè' moè' neè weèe ese Taèr. Ñwáè anaè yu Yú' ce yi loè ese Taèr, yi ke suñ beèe yuu mini. Yi be vúè tá yi suñ beèe aèmboè máè.
English: When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

Limbum: Beèe a be juèu weèe embe ndaèp rloo. Nfeè' ce gháá ce ñwáè ce e be yú weèe, be kwaè'shi ená e geèe ba rfaè' Nyúè.
English: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

Limbum: Woweèe a be geèe buu ca njobeè' woweèe a rïìñ Taèr ka', a riñ máè foñ ka'.
English: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.

Limbum: Máè suñ weèe buu ca tá nfeè' ka' gháá, vi koni, tá weèe bo kuushi ená máè m suñ weèe. “Máè m suñ weèe buu ca efa rkáè' ka' njobeè' seèe aè m ku ba.
English: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn't tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

Limbum: M ce kúti seè'ni duè yá ñwáè ce e m tuu máè. Ka' yi yu wa'a, moè' efa weèe aè be bipshi neè máè enáê, ‘AÈ ce duè ba fá lá?’ ka'.
English: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'

Limbum: Weèe ce koosimnse njo' buu ce máè suñ weèe na.
English: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

Limbum: Geewa'a, m ce suñ weèe yuu mini. Yi yu boèñboñ neè weèe ená m duê, njobeè' m ka' tá duè ka', Ñwáè Rjaè' vú cu weèe woweèe ka'. M ka' duê, m tuu ye tá e vú cu weèe woweèe.
English: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don't go away, the Counselor won't come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

Limbum: E be vúè tá e gee tá ñgoèñ yi yá yaèp faèa kuèu buu bbebep, ba buu byáánïì ker ba mnsa'.
English: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

Limbum: A be yá yaèp faèa kuèu buu bbebep njobeè' woweèe a byemi neè máè ka'.
English: about sin, because they don't believe in me;

Limbum: Kuèu buu byáánïì njobeè' m ce duè aè ryá yaè Taê, tá weèe ker yá máè ka',
English: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won't see me any more;

Limbum: ker ba mnsa' njobeè' ñkúú enjep ñgoèñ na aè gweè mnsa'.
English: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

Limbum: “Buu yu magoèr ce máè ba suñ weèe, aè ba njobeè' m ka' suñ weèe seè'ni na, vi caa ye ñger.
English: I have yet many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ká' a ce laèa a waâp mú enáê, “Yuu ce e laèa neè seèe na yi yu ba ená ká? E laèa enáê, ‘Nfeè' múcaèr tá weèe yá máè ka', e ba nfeè' múcaèr tá weèe yá máè’, a ker laa foñ enáê, ‘Njobeè' m ce duè aè ryá Taèr’ njoká?”
English: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, What is this that he says to us, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;' and, 'Because I go to the Father?'

Limbum: Woweèe a laa enáê, “Nfeè' múcaèr ce e ce laèa na, yu ba ená ká? Seèe rïìñ njáèá yuu ce e laèa na ka'.”
English: They said therefore, What is this that he says, 'A little while?' We don't know what he is saying.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m rïìñ ená woweèe a koèñ aè rbipshi yuu neè ye, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè laèa enáê, ‘Nfeè' múcaèr tá weèe yá máè ka', e keèr ba nfeè' múcaèr tá weèe yá máè.’ Waè' a yuu ce weèe ce bipshi a weâe mú a?
English: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?'

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe neè mini-ñwáè ená weèe be war ce koosimnse, tá ñgoèñ yi ce lu'shi yi yu. Weèe be señ buu tá yeè nseñ buu anaè lo kúti ba aè rlu'shïì.
English: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

Limbum: E ke ba aè nfeè' ce njeñwáè ce luuti, e ce koosimnse njobeè' nfeè' rbi aè gháá. E ba aè nfeè' ce e bi muu wáá, e ker kuushi ryañ caè ka' njobeè' e ce lu'shi ená e bi muu.
English: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn't remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

Limbum: A mboè weèe ce koosimnse seè'ni wa'a, geewa'a m be keèr yá weèe, tá weèe lu'shi aè nfeè' anaè, tá ñwáè moè' ker jepsi weèe efa rlu'shïì ka'.
English: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

Limbum: “Be ba nyúè anaè tá weèe ker loo yuu mo' ese máè ka'. M ce suñ weèe neè mini- ñwáè ená weèe aè ka' loo ka' njáèá ká ese Taèr fa máâ rlii, e be fa yuu anaè neè weèe.
English: In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a laa enáê, “ÁÈháê! AÈ ce laèa seè'ni rara, aè ker ce maè' ba ñgaèa ka'.
English: His disciples said to him, Behold, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.

Limbum: Weèr aè rïìñ seè'ni na ená aè rïìñ buu wááwá. Mbuèu moè' ker ba aègho neè ñwáè aè rbipshi yuu mo' neè wáè ka'. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' cena, weèr a byemi ená wáè loè ese Nyúè.”
English: Now we know that you know all things, and don't need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came forth from God.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè byemi seè'ni a?
English: Jesus answered them, Do you now believe?

Limbum: Yáê, nfeè' ce gháá, e gháá wáá, ce weèe be da'se, tá ñwáè wááwá kúti fa yeâ laè', maè'shi máè mamñgi'. M be ba mamñgi' ka', njobeè' Taèr ku ba weèr ye.
English: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

Limbum: Máè laèa cena neè weèe tá weèe bo koni cumúnyañ njep máè. Weèe be yá ñgá' njep ñgoèñ na. Ka' yi yu wa'a, kur neè ntee. Máè so ñgoèñ ca.”
English: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa buu ca, a naa mmir a ke' mbe buèu a laa enáê, “Taèr, nfeè' aè gháá. Kuè'si muu woè, tá muu woè ye ye bo kuè'si wáè.
English: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

Limbum: Wáè fa ye ñger mbenduè beèe wááwá tá e bo fa ryoèñ ce nfeseè neè beèe wááwá ce wáè fa mba yeâ mmboè.
English: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

Limbum: Ryoèñ ce nfeseè ca li yu ba ená ñwáè riñ wáè, ce ku ba ba wáè caè'caè' ce aè yu Nyúè mini, ker riñ Jisos Kraâis ce wáè tuu njep ñgoèñ na.
English: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Máè mïìsi rfaè' ce wáè m fa neè máè ená m geêe, a ku'si wáè aègho njep ñgoèñ na.
English: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

Limbum: Wáâ Taèr, kuè'si laè máè seè'ni a wáâ bsii neè bkuè' ce máè m túr weèe soè tá ñgoèñ yi ka' ba.
English: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

Limbum: “Máè geèe yoè beèe ce wáè m fa mba máâ mmboè efa múè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a riñ wáè. Beèe anaè aè m ba yoè beèe, wáè fa woweèe neè máè. Woweèe a yu'ni neè wo blaèa.
English: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

Limbum: Woweèe a rïìñ seè'ni ená buu wááwá ce m túr, vi loè ba ese wáè.
English: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

Limbum: Máè suñ woweèe blaèa ce wáè m fa neè máè. Woweèe a byemi blaèa ca, a riñ foñ neè mini-ñwáè ená máè loè ba ese wáè. Woweèe a byemi ená wáè tuu máè njep ñgoèñ na.
English: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came forth from you, and they have believed that you sent me.

Limbum: “M ce loo neè woweèe. M ce loo ba neè ñgoèñ ca ka', m ce loo ba neè beèe ce wáè fa neè máè na njobeè' woweèe a yu yoè beèe.
English: I pray for them. I don't pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

Limbum: Ya yu yo, yo aè ba ya. A kuè'si máè njo' woweèe.
English: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

Limbum: M be keèr cu njep ñgoèñ ka', woweèe a be kuè cu yap njo, tá m vú ya vúè yá wáè. Taèr ce nrara, keè'ni woweèe neè yo ñger ce wáè m fa neè máè foñ naè, tá woweèe a bo ba ñwáè moè'sir aèmboè soè yu naè.
English: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

Limbum: Máè m ba weèr woweèe, a ke'ni woweèe, woweèe a cu njep lo rlii ce wáè m fa neè máè. Máè cïìñ woweèe, yuu mo' yi ke' joo woweèe ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, moè' efa woweèe aè m bú caa efa ñwáè ce yi yu ená e be bú naè ka'. E m bú tá yuu ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi bo ghááte njo.
English: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

Limbum: M ce vú aè ryá wáè seè'ni, a ce laèa buu ca njep ñgoèñ na, tá la rlu'shïì li bo mïìsi njep woweèe.
English: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

Limbum: Máè suñ woweèe wo blaèa; ñgoèñ yi baèa woweèe njobeè' woweèe a yu beèe enjep ñgoèñ ka', aèmboè má máè yu ñwáè enjep ñgoèñ ka' naè.
English: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

Limbum: M ce loo máná aè fúr woweèe enjep ñgoèñ ka'. M ce loo máná aè ke'ni woweèe faè dïì' Sataèn ce e yu ñwáâ mbebep gee yuu mo' neè woweèe ka'.
English: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

Limbum: Woweèe a yu beèe enjep ñgoèñ na ka', aèmboè má máè yu ñwáè enjep ñgoèñ na ka' naè.
English: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.

Limbum: Ce woweèe, lá woweèe rara neè yoè mini. Wo blaèa yu mini.
English: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

Limbum: AÈmboè wáè m tuu máè njep ñgoèñ na má máè aè tuu woweèe njep ñgoèñ foñ.
English: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

Limbum: Máè ce ya tu, a lá rara njo' woweèe, tá aè bo ce woweèe foñ, láè rara neè yoè mini.
English: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
