Limbum: “M ce loo ba neè woweèe caè'caè' ka', m ce loo foñ neè beèe wááwá ce a be byemi neè máè njobeè' wap blaèa.
English: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who believe in me through their word,

Limbum: M ce loo máná woweèe wááwá a ba ñwáè moè'sir, aèmboè wáâ Taèr, aè yu njep máè, máè ba njep wáè naè, tá woweèe a bo ba njep soè foñ, tá ñgoèñ ca yi bo byemi ená wáè m tuu máè.
English: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

Limbum: Máè kuè'si woweèe aèmboè wáè m kuè'si máè naè, tá woweèe a bo ba ñwáè moè'sir aèmboè soè ku ba ñwáè moè'sir foñ naè.
English: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;

Limbum: M yu njep woweèe aèmboè aè yu njep máè foñ naè, tá woweèe a bo ba ñwáè moè'sir neè mini-ñwáè, tá ñgoèñ yi bo rïìñ ená wáè m tuu máè, keèr rïìñ foñ ená wáè m koèñ woweèe aèmboè wáè m koèñ máè foñ naè.
English: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.

Limbum: Taèr, máè koèñ máná beèe ce wáè fa máè na, a ba weèr woweèe faèdïì' ce m be ba foñ, tá a bo yá wa bkuè' ce wáè m fa neè máè njobeè' wáè m koèñ máè tá a ka' keè geèe ñgoèñ, a ka' fa máè bkuè' anaè.
English: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

Limbum: Taèr, wáè ce aè yu yáánïì, ñgoèñ yi rïìñ wáè ka' máè rïìñ ya yu wáè. Beèe ca a rïìñ ená wáè m tuu máè.
English: Righteous Father, the world hasn't known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

Limbum: Máè geèe woweèe a riñ lo rlii. M be kuè ce geèe wa'a tá lo rkoèñnïì ce wáè túr neè máè li ba njep woweèe, tá m ba njep woweèe foñ.”
English: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa buu ca wáá, a lor ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a woweèe a du a tuu ntoèñ Kádroèn faèdïì' ce ñka' bce yi m ba. E m niñ mbo a ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu anaè.
English: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

Limbum: Judaès ce e m fyeèni ye naè, ye ye aè m rïìñ dïì' anaè njobeè' Jisoès ba ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu weèe a m ce duè mbe dïì' anaè cá'cá'.
English: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, e koo kúr bsoogáè ba ñgaâa rkeè'ni Ndap Nyúè ese ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba Farïìsïî, a woweèe a ka' ce duè, a lor blam a cú', a bársi msuèsuèñ, a lor buu bïìr.
English: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m rïìñ buu ce vi be koni ye wááwá. A ka' rïìñ wa'a, a fúú a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weâe roèo ba nda?”
English: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went forth, and said to them, Who are you looking for?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì neè ye enáê, “Weèr ce roèo ba Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt.” Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “A máè ye.” Judaès ce e m fyeèni ye naè aè m táá a woweèe.
English: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus said to them, I am he. Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa neè woweèe enáê, “A máè ye”, woweèe a kútïì njïìnjïì a gweñger aè nsheè.
English: When therefore he said to them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

Limbum: E ker bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce roèo ba nda?” Woweèe a ker laa enáê, “Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt.”
English: Again therefore he asked them, Who are you looking for? They said, Jesus of Nazareth.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Máè suñ weèe wáá ená a máè ye. Yi ka' ba ená weèe ce roèo ba máè, weèe ma'shïì tá beèe ca a duse.”
English: Jesus answered, I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,

Limbum: E m laèa wa'a tá yi bo kuè ghááte aèmboè e m laèa enáê, “Máè búsi ñwáè moè' efa múè beèe ce wáè m fa neè máè naè ka'.”
English: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.

Limbum: Awá Saimún Pitaè ce e m túr saè', aè co' embaè ruèu, a tee tuè' maè' ese ñkwaèa ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. A m ce too ñkwaèa anaè ená Markuès.
English: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè Pitaè enáê, “Kúsi kaèafaè' mbaè ruèu. M fa no njep ndoñ ce Taèr aè fa neè máè na ka' a?”
English: Jesus therefore said to Peter, Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè ba ñgaâa ke'ni Ndap Nyúè a m koo Jisoès a kur,
English: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,

Limbum: a du aègho a yá Anaès entombïì. Anaès aè m ba talu yïì Kaifaès ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè feè' anaè.
English: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

Limbum: Kaifaès ca a ñwáè ce e m cep Jus ená yi yu boèñboñ ená ñwáè moè'sir kwe aètu beèe naè.
English: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè ba ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu moè' a m duè aèmbuèu Jisoès aè nfeè' anaè. Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè m rïìñ ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès anaè. E niñ a Jisoès mbe mambe ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì anaè.
English: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

Limbum: Pitaè aè m táá yi ba njep ncúèúndúè' njepmbeè. Ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès moè' aè m ba aèfo ce ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè m rïìñ. E m fúú njepmbeè a laa neè muunje ce e m táá aè ncúèúndúè' ená e ma'shi, e lor Pitaè a ye a niñ mbe mambe caè.
English: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

Limbum: Muunje ce e m ke'ni ncúèúndúè' naè aè laa neè Pitaè enáê, “Mboè aè yu moè' efa ñgaâa yá'ni buu ñwáè ca lá?” E laa enáê, “M yu moè' ka'.”
English: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, Are you also one of this man's disciples? He said, I am not.

Limbum: Ñgaâa mfaè' ba ñgaâa rkeè'ni Ndap Nyúè a m fyááshi mor a táá a ce yár njobeè' mbáp aè m ce fute seê. Pitaè ye ye aè m duè a táá a ce yár mor a woweèe.
English: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì na aè m bipshi buu neè Jisoès a kuu ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, ker ba li ryá'nïì.
English: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his teaching.

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Máè laèa buu aèwañ neè beèe wááwá. Máè m ce yá'ni beèe aè nfeè' wááwá aè mndap mloo, ba mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, ce yu bdïì' ce Jus a ke vúè ce tarte. Máè laèa yuu mo' aè bsúèti ka'.
English: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

Limbum: AÈ ce bipshi neè máè njoká? Bipshi ba neè beèe ce a m yu' buu ce máè m ce laèa neè woweèe. Woweèe a rïìñ buu ce máè m laèa.”
English: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa wa'a, ñwáè rkeè'ni Ndap Nyúè moè' ce e m táá a yeâ geñ aè lip ye neè bo a laa neè ye enáê, “Haba! Waè' a njáèá njïì ce aède' aè beesïì yuu neè ñwáè ce e yu tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a?”
English: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, Do you answer the high priest like that?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “M ka' laa wa'a, faèa ba njo, aè suñ faèa anaè. Ka' ba ená máè laèa yáánïì, wáè ka' lip máè njoká?”
English: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?

Limbum: Anaès aè laêa, a lor ye aèmboè a m kur naè, a duè aègho, a yá Kaifaès ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì.
English: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè m ku táá a ce yár mor. Beèe mo' a laa neè ye enáê, “Mboè aè yu moè' efa ñgaâa yá'ni buu ñwáè anaè foñ a?” Pitaè aè kanïì a laa enáê, “M yu moè' ka'.”
English: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, You aren't also one of his disciples, are you? He denied it, and said, I am not.

Limbum: Moè' efa ñgaâa mfaâ' ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì naè, ce e m ba raèraâ ñwáè ce Pitaè aè m tee yi tuè' naè, aè m laèa neè Pitaè enáê, “Mboè máè m yá weèe ye mbe ñka' bce a?”
English: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, Didn't I see you in the garden with him?

Limbum: Pitaè aè ker kani. E ka' kani wa'a, nduñgúp aè ku toñ.
English: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mú ñgaèptú', woweèe a lor Jisoès embe mambe Kaifaès a du aègho mbe nto' yaèp govanoè. Woweèe a ka' vúè, a niñ mbe nto' ka' njobeè' woweèe a m ce koèñ aè rba brara aè bsii Nyúè tá woweèe a bo ye yap Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap.
English: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn't enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pailáèt aè fúú njepmbeè a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè koo ñwáè ca a vú aègho ená e faèa ká?”
English: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, What accusation do you bring against this man?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì neè ye enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè ka' tá baè ba ñwáè ñgeèe buu bbebep ka', weèr aè ba koo ye vúè aègho fa neè wáè ka'.”
English: They answered him, If this man weren't an evildoer, we wouldn't have delivered him up to you.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Loèr neè ye du sa' ye aèmboè ye ncir yi yu.” Woweèe a laa enáê, “Weèr túr ñger aè rsa' ñwáè yú ka'.”
English: Pilate therefore said to them, Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. Therefore the Jews said to him, It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,

Limbum: Cena yi m ba wa'a, tá nlaèa ce Jisoès aè m laèa kuu njáèá rkwe ce e be kwe naè yi bo kuè ghááte njo.
English: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè kútïì mbe nto' a ká' Jisoès a laa neè ye enáê, “A wáè ñkúú Jus a?”
English: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, Are you the King of the Jews?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Yuu ce wáè bipshi na, aè ku kwa'shi ba wáè káè aè suñ beèe mo' a suñ wáè a kuu máè?”
English: Jesus answered him, Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?

Limbum: Pailáèt aè beesïì enáê, “M yu ñwáè Jus ka'. Beèe ce a vúè neè wáè a fa neè máè yu yoè beèe ker ba beèe efa waâp mú ce a ke tañshi tañshïì naè. Wáè geèe ba ká a ka' koo wáè a vú aègho?”
English: Pilate answered, I'm not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “Ya kúú yu yïì enjep ñgoèñ na ka'. Ya kúú aè ba ba yïì enjep ñgoèñ na, yaè beèe a ba beèe yaè njïì, reè bkoèr faè dïì' a fa máè mbaè mmbo Jus ka'. Yi yu ená ya kúú yi loè ba enjep ñgoèñ na ka'.”
English: Jesus answered, My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn't be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè laa neè ye enáê, “Baná aè yu ñkúú a?” Jisoès a beesïì enáê, “To wáè laèa wáná m yu ñkúú. A m bi máè njep ñgoèñ na, máè vúè máná m bo suñ beèe aèmboè yuu mini. A mbuèu ce a m bi máè njep ñgoèñ na. Ñwáè ce e ka' táá njep mini, a ñwáè ce e yu' wa blaèa.”
English: Pilate therefore said to him, Are you a king then? Jesus answered, You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè laa neè ye enáê, “Mini anaè yu ká seê?” E ka' laèa wa'a, a ker fúú embe nto' a yá Juês, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè yá yuu bebep moè' ce ñwáè ca aè geèe ka'.
English: Pilate said to him, What is truth? When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, I find no basis for a charge against him.

Limbum: Yeè ndeèe moè' yu ená a ka' ce ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap, m fúr ñwáè moè' embe shañ, fa neè weèe. Weèe ce koèñ weená m fúr ñkúú Jus fa neè weèe a?”
English: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?

Limbum: Woweèe a waa enáê, “AÈi', fa fúr ba ye ka'. Fúr ba Baèrabaès fa neè weèr.” Baèrabaès ca aè m ba ñkep.
English: Then they all shouted again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas! Now Barabbas was a robber.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pailáèt aè laêa, bsoogáè a lip Jisoès.
English: So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.

Limbum: Woweèe a gee rtaa kúú neè bsoèpsïì a sop ye mbe tuè, a lor cáâ' beer a fa ye aè nyoèr.
English: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

Limbum: a ká' a ce buèu ye aèmboè ñkúú wa'a, a ce laèa enáê, “Nyaèr, ñkwe Juês.” Woweèe a m lïìp ye neè mmbo.
English: They kept saying, Hail, King of the Jews! and they kept slapping him.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ker fúú embe nto' a laa neè Jus enáê, “Yá neè, m be fúr ñwáè ca njepmbeè tá weèe bo rïìñ ená máè yá faèa moè' ce e geèe ka'.”
English: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.

Limbum: Jisoès aè fúú njepmbeè neè rtaa bsoèpsïì ca mbe tuè ba cáâ' beer caè aè nyoèr. Pailáèt aè laa enáê, “Yá laè neè ñwáè anaè.”
English: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, Behold, the man!

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñgaâa keè'ni Ndap Nyúè a ka' yá ye, a waani enáê, “Taa ye mbe kïìntaa! Taa ye mbe kïìntaa!” Pailáèt aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Koo laè neè ye du taa mbe kïìntaa. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè máè, máè yá faèa ce e geèe ka'.”
English: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, Crucify! Crucify! Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves, and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.

Limbum: Jus a ku le' yap enáê, “Weèr túr ncir, aèmboè ncir anaè yi ce laèa, e be kuè kwe njobeè' e ce loèr yïì nyor ená e yu Muu Nyúè.”
English: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ka' yu' blaèa ca, a wáp magoèr seê.
English: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

Limbum: A ker niñ mbe nto' a Jisoès, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “A wáè ñwáè efá?” Jisoès aè laa yuu ka'.
English: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, Where are you from? But Jesus gave him no answer.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pailáèt aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè laèa yuu neè máè ka' a? Mboè wáè rïìñ wáná m túr ñger aè rmaè'shi wáè tá aè du yo yu, a ker túr ñger aè rtaa wáè mbe kïìntaa a?”
English: Pilate therefore said to him, Aren't you speaking to me? Don't you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì enáê, “AÈde' aè túr ñger mbe máâ nduè ka', ce a m ka' tá baè fa ñger anaè neè wáè embe buèu ka'. Baná yuu bebep yi ñwáè ce e koo máè a fa mba wáâ mmboè, yi yu yi goèr a caa yo.”
English: Jesus answered, You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ka' yu' blaèa ca, a koñ ená e ba maè'shi Jisoès tá e duê. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jus a ce waani enáê, “Wáè ka' ma'shi ñwáè ca e duê, baná aè yu ñkar Sisaè ka'. è ka'. Ñwáè aè ka' lor yïì nyor aè ñkúú baná ñgaèñ aè tár Sisaè mkuèu mbe tuè.”
English: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, If you release this man, you aren't Caesar's friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!

Limbum: Pailáèt aè ka' yu' blaèa ca, a fúr Jisoès njepmbeè, a cu mbe dïì' mnsa' tá e bo teni mnsa'. A m ce too dïì' ca ená dïì' ce a feèe neè bluèr. A m ce too dïì' anaè aè li Hibruè enáê, “Gaèbataè.”
English: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.

Limbum: Noèñ anaè aè m ba noèñ ce a m ce tami nyor aè rye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap. Nyúè aè m káè' a ce kuèu ñgoèñ aè nfeè' anaè. Pailáèt aè laa neè beèe enáê, “A yeè ñkúú na.”
English: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, Behold, your King!

Limbum: Woweèe a waanïì enáê, “Mïìsi ye! Mïìsi ye! Taa ye mbe kïìntaa!” Pailáèt aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe ce koèñ ená m taa yeè ñkúú mbe kïìntaa a?” Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaèa tañshi tañshïì a beesïì enáê, “Weèr túr ñkúú moè' caa efa Sisaè ka'.”
English: They cried out, Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him! Pilate said to them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar!

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèlúèsimbuèu, Pailáèt aè boñlaèr a fa ye neè woweèe tá a bo taa ye mbe kïìntaa. Woweèe a m koo Jisoès a du aègho.
English: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

Limbum: E m byáè' yi kïìntaa, a woweèe a du aè dïì' mo' ce a m ce too ená Dïì' keèkeèp tu. A too dïì' anaè aè li Hibruè ená Golgotaè.
English: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called The Place of a Skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha,

Limbum: A faèdïì' ce a m taa Jisoès mbe kïìntaa. A m taa beèe mo' a baa mbe bkïìntaa foñ. Moè' aè m ba aè bo ñkoèp Jisoès moè' aè ba yi aè bo maè', Jisoès aè ba yi mbetar.
English: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

Limbum: Pailáèt aè m sañ ñwaè' foñ a taa mbe tu kïìntaa. E m sañ enáê, “Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt, ñkúú Juês.”
English: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

Limbum: Jus magoèr a m beè' ñwaè' anaè njobeè' faèdïì' ce a m taa Jisoès naè aè m ba aè waâa la'. A m sañ ñwaè' anaè aè li Hibruè, ba aè li Latïìn ker ba aè li Greêk.
English: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr efa ñgaèa tañshi tañshïì efa múè Jus a ka' beè', a du a yá Pailáèt a laa neè ye enáê, “Fa sañ ba ená ‘ñkúú Jus’ ka', sañ ba ená ‘ñwáè ca aè m laèa ená a ye ñkúú Juês.’ ”
English: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, Don't write, 'The King of the Jews,' but, 'he said, I am King of the Jews.'

Limbum: Pailáèt aè beesïì enáê, “Yuu ce máè sañ, a yuu ce máè sañ.”
English: Pilate answered, What I have written, I have written.

Limbum: Bsoogáè a ka' taa Jisoès mbe kïìntaa wáá, a lor vi bcáè' a gap bdïì' kyeèe, ñwáè aè lor vi, ñwáè aè lor vi. Yïì saèaro aè bátïì. Saèaro anaè aè m túr ntar ka'.
English: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat. Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa a waâp mú enáê, “Seèe fa saèa cáè' ca ka', seèe ma' kaèñ tá seèe bo yá ñwáè ce saèaro ca be duè neè ye.” Cena yi m koni tá yi bo ghááte aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “A m gaèp wa bcáè' a waâp mú, a ker ma' kaèñ tá a bo yá ñwáè ce yaè saèaro be duè neè ye.” Bsoogáè a m ku gee aèmboè a m sañ.
English: Then they said to one another, Let's not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, They parted my garments among them. For my cloak they cast lots. Therefore the soldiers did these things.

Limbum: Ma yïì Jisoès, ba nfúr yïì maê, ba Máèári ce e m ba ñgwa Kïìlopaès ba Máèári ce aè rla' Makdalaè, a m táá aègee kïìntaa Jisoès.
English: But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' yá yïì maê, ker ba ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu ce e m koèñ naè aèmboè woweèe a táá aètútú, e laa neè yïì ma enáê, “Njeñwáè yáê, a muu ghoè na.”
English: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, Woman, behold your son!

Limbum: E m ker laa neè ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu enáê, “Yáê, a yoè ma na.” Káâ' aè nfeè' anaè, ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu aè lor yïì maê, a ye a du a ce cu a yeâ laè'.
English: Then he said to the disciple, Behold, your mother! From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì wáá, Jisoès aè riñ seè'ni ená li rfaè' li mïì. E m laèa enáê, “Ntee yi ce yuushi máè.” E m laèa wa'a tá yi bo ghááte aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè.
English: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, I am thirsty.

Limbum: Ghee mo' yi m táá aèfo, mruâ' mcece' mi ba njo jiñ. A m lor kúèsha a fúú njep múè mruè' anaè a kur aè mbaèñ a naa mbekïì, a túr ye aègee cuèu.
English: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m nyoñ mruè' anaè efa kúèsha. E ka' nyoñ wáá, a laa enáê “Yi mïì.” A kár tu, a ma'shi li ryoèñ neè Nyúè.
English: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished. He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.

Limbum: AÈmboè noèñ anaè aè m ba noèñ ce a m ce tami nyor tá a bo fúú cu mmbomntaa Nyúè, Jus a m ce koèñ ená bgúâú beèe vi cu mbe kïìntaa ka'. Mmbomntaa anaè aè m ba mïû goèr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a du a laa neè Pailáèt ená e ma'shi tá woweèe a kepshi mkuèu ese beèe anaè, tá a bo yaèñse kweñger tá a ca'si efa bsii.
English: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn't remain on the cross on the Sabbath for that Sabbath was a special one, asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

Limbum: Bsoogáè a vú a kepshi mkuèu ese ñwáè entombïì a ker kepshi mkuèu ese ñwáè moè' ce a m taa mbe kïìntaa foñ naè.
English: Therefore the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him;

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúè baè' mbe Jisoès a yá ená e ba kwe wáá, a ke' kepshi mkuèu mi ka'.
English: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn't break his legs.

Limbum: Ñwáè soogáè moè' aè sop mbeèp nyor ese Jisoès neè rkoèñ, mdip ba bláá mi ku fúú aè cuèu anaè.
English: However one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m yá buu ca a ñwáè ce e suñ vi. Yuu ce e laèa yi yu mini. Ye ye rïìñ foñ ená yuu ce e ce laèa yi yu mini. E ce suñ weèe buu ca tá weèe bo byemi foñ.
English: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

Limbum: Buu ca vi m koni tá yi bo ghááte aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “A be keè kep yi vúp mo' ka'.”
English: For these things happened, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, A bone of him will not be broken.

Limbum: Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi ker laa mbe dïì' mo' enáê, “Woweèe a be keè yá ñwáè ce a m soèp.”
English: Again another Scripture says, They will look on him whom they pierced.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì wáá, Josáèf ce aè rla' AÈrimaètiyaè aè vú a yá Pailáèt. E m ba ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès a ke' ce koèñ ená beèe a riñ ka' njobeè' e m ce wáp Juês. E m laèa neè Pailáèt ená e fa ye njïì tá e suusi gúâú Jisoès embe kïìntaa, tuñ. Pailáèt aè ka' byemi, e du a suusïî, a du aègho.
English: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

Limbum: Nïìkoèdámoès foñ ce e m be vú a yá Jisoès neètú' naè, aè m duè a ye, a túr njáèá mcáèp mo' ce a m ce too ená máêr, ba aluès ce a m fïìñshi. Mcáèp anaè mi m ba aèmboè bkiluè mñkyeèe wa'a.
English: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

Limbum: A m loèr gúâú Jisoès a kur neè bcáâ' bboèñboñ neè mcáèp anaè-ñwáè aèmboè Jus a m ce geèe.
English: So they took Jesus' body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

Limbum: Ñka' mbyeè buu yi m ba faèdïì' ce a m taa Jisoès mbe kïìntaa anaè. Rsheâ rfi li m ba mbo ce a m be tuñ ñwáè njo ka'.
English: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' Jus a m ce tami nyor nyúè anaè tá a bo fúú cu mmbomntaa, a lá ye njep rsheè anaè, njobeè' li m ba aètútú.
English: Then because of the Jews' Preparation Day for the tomb was near at hand they laid Jesus there.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba noèñ entombïì embe múè ñgaèa, aè mú ñgaèptú', ñgoèñ yi ku bii sii, Máèári ce aè rla' Makdalaè aè du faèdïì' rsheè li m ba naè. E ka' baè' a yá ená a m caè'si luèr ce a m cete ncuâu rsheè aègho naè.
English: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, e natïì a cañ a du a yá Saimún Pitaè ba ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès moè' ce Jisoès aè m koèñ ye se naè, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “A fúr Tata enjep rsheè, a du aègho, weèr aè rïìñ faèdïì' ce a láè ye ka'.”
English: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have laid him!

Limbum: Pitaè ba ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès ca a natïì a cañ a du faèdïì' ce rsheè li m ba naè.
English: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

Limbum: Ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès moè' anaè aè cañ a caa Pitaè, a du a ba' faèdïì' ce rsheè li m ba naè entombïì.
English: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.

Limbum: E ka' be'ti nyor fyá' njep rsheè a ku yá bcáè' ce a m kur gúâú ñwáè aègho naè aèmboè vi noèñ njo, a ke' niñ njo ka'.
English: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn't enter in.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè ka' tose yi a ku niñ ba njep rsheè, a yá bcáè' ce vi m noèñ njo,
English: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

Limbum: a yá yïì ce a m kur yi tu aègho naè. Yi m noèñ aègee vïì anaè ka'. Yi m kashi nyor a noñ jáá.
English: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

Limbum: Ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès ce e m vúè a ba' aè ncuâu rsheè entombïì naè aè m niñ njo foñ a yá, a byemi.
English: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

Limbum: Woweèe a m be riñ yap yu yuu ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená Jisoès be fúú efa rkwe naè ka'.
English: For as yet they didn't know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

Limbum: Woweèe a natïì a kúti aè mlaè'.
English: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

Limbum: Máèári aè m táá aègee rsheè a ce war. E ka' ce war wa'a, a be'ti nyor a fyá' njep rsheè.
English: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

Limbum: E m yá bcïìndap Nyúè a baa. Woweèe a m maè' bcáâ' bbúú, a cu mbe dïì' ce a m láè gúâú ñwáè naè. Moè' aè cu mbe dïì' ce yïì tu yi m noèñ, moè' a cu mbe dïì' ce mi m mkuèu mi m noèñ.
English: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

Limbum: Woweèe a bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Njeñwáè, aè ce war ba ká?” E laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ce war njobeè' a loèr yaè Tata a du aègho, máè ke' riñ faèdïì' ce a láè ye ka'.”
English: They told her, Woman, why are you weeping? She said to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don't know where they have laid him.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a karsi nyor a yá Jisoès aèmboè e táá, a ke' riñ ená a Jisoès ka'.
English: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn't know that it was Jesus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Njeñwáè, aè ce war ba ká? AÈ ce roèo ba nda?” Máèári aè m ce kwaè'shi ená a ye ñwáè ñka' anaè, a laa neè ye enáê, “Yaè Taê, ka' ba ená aè loèr wáè a lor ye a du aègho, aè suñ máè faèdïì' ce wáè loèr ye a láê, tá m bo duè loèr.”
English: Jesus said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for? She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Máèári.” E karsïì nyor a laa neè ye aè li Hibruè enáê, “Raèbonïì”, ce mbuèu efa gho yu enáê, “Ñwáè ryá'nïì”.
English: Jesus said to her, Mary. She turned and said to him, Rabboni! which is to say, Teacher!

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Fa joèo máè ka' njobeè' máè be du a yá Taèr ka'. Duè, du suñ bfúr wa ená m be duè faèdïì' ce yaè Ta ce e yu yeè Taê, a ba yaè Nyúè, a ba yeè Nyúè foñ naè yu.”
English: Jesus said to her, Don't hold me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, 'I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'

Limbum: Máèári ce aè rla' Makdalaè aè duê, a suñ ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès enáê, “Máè yá Tataê.” E m ker suñ woweèe buu ce e m laèa neè ye naè.
English: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ entombïì embe múè ñgaèa anaè aè mbuèuñkuèr, ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a kaarïì aèbee mbe ndaèp, a li' keèñ njobeè' woweèe a m ce wáp Juês. Jisoès aè ku nyáá a waâp mú, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Cumúnyañ ba neè weèe.”
English: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, Peace be to you.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a duñshi woweèe mi mmbo ba yïì mbeèp nyor. Ñgaèa yá'ni yïì buu a ka' yá Tataê, a lu'shi seê.
English: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ker laa neè woweèe enáê, “Cumúnyañ ba neè weèe. AÈmboè yaè Ta aè m tuu máè naè, má máè ce tuu weèe foñ.”
English: Jesus therefore said to them again, Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a yoñse mbe waâp nduè a laa enáê, “Koo neè Yú' Rara.
English: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, Receive the Holy Spirit!

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' foosi ñwáè efa yuu bebep ce ñgaèñ aè geèe, baná Nyúè be foèosi ye foñ. Weèe aè ka' tá foèosi ñwáè efa yuu bebep ce ñgaèñ aè geèe ka' baná Nyúè be foèosi ye foñ ka'.”
English: Whoever's sins you forgive, they are forgiven them. Whoever's sins you retain, they have been retained.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Jisoès aè m vúè a duñshi yïì nyor neè yïì beèe naè, Tomaês, moè' efa múè beâe ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ce a m ce too ená rfar naè, aè m ba aèfo ka'.
English: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn't with them when Jesus came.

Limbum: E ka' vúè, bár ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a suñ ye enáê, “Weèr aè yá Tataê.” Tomas aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “M ka' tá yá bdïì' efa mi mmbo ce a mú ta neè mmbaa naè, joèo neè ntubo, keèr joèo yïì mbeèp nyor neè bo ka', aède' m byemïì ka'.”
English: The other disciples therefore said to him, We have seen the Lord! But he said to them, Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi ka' caèa waami, woweèe a ker kaari aèbee mbe ndaèp, Tomas aè ba a woweèe. Woweèe a m li' keèñ, Jisoès aè ku lo a nyáá a waâp mú, a laa enáê, “Cumúnyañ ba neè weèe.”
English: After eight days again his disciples were inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be to you.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa' wáá, a laa neè Tomas enáê, “Vúè neè yoè ntubo, yu'shi mbena, naèa yo bo joo yaè mbeèp nyor aègho. Fa keèr tarni ka', byemi.”
English: Then he said to Thomas, Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don't be unbelieving, but believing.

Limbum: Tomas aè beesïì neè ye enáê, “Yaè Tata ba yaè Nyúè.”
English: Thomas answered him, My Lord and my God!

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè byemi njobeè' wáè yá máè. Bghoènïì vi yu neè beèe ce a yá ka', a ku byemi.”
English: Jesus said to him, Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m duèñshi ku' mncoèo mo' aè bsii ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' ca ka'.
English: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

Limbum: A sañ buu ca tá weèe bo byemi ená Jisoès yu Kraêis, ce Muu Nyúè. Weèe aè ka' byemi wa'a, weèe bo koni ryoèñ a yeâ rlii.
English: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì wáá, Jisoès aè ker duñshi yïì nyor neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu aèwaâa túè Tïìbárïìyaès. E m duèñshi yïì nyor ba aè njáèá enáê.
English: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè ba Tomas ce a m ce too ená rfar naè, ba Naètanïìyáèl ce aè rla' Kánaè ce aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, ba boo Sábáèdïî, ba beèe mo' a baa efa múè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, a m ba aèbee.
English: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “M be duè koo nca.” Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Seèe be duè.” Woweèe a du a niñ mbe keñ aè rkoo nca, a ke' koo yuu neètú' anaè ka'.
English: Simon Peter said to them, I'm going fishing. They told him, We are also coming with you. They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' ce raa, Jisoès aè táá aèwaâa roè. Ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu a ke' riñ ená a Jisoès ka'.
English: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Boo, weèe aè koo nca ka' a?” Woweèe a beesïì neè ye enáê, “AÈi'.”
English: Jesus therefore said to them, Children, have you anything to eat? They answered him, No.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Maè' neè rraa aè ñgúè' bo maè', weèe be koo yuu.” Woweèe a ma' rraa, a moo aè rsúèñ rraa enjep roè laèr, njobeè' nca yi m ba njep rraa anaè goèr seê.
English: He said to them, Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some. They cast it therefore, and now they weren't able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

Limbum: Ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès ce Jisoès aè m koèñ se naè aè laa neè Pitaè enáê, “A Tataê.” Pitaè aè ka' yu' ená a Tataê, a ma' cáè' aè nyoèr njobeè' e m co'ni bcáè' efa nyoèr. E ka' maè' wáá, a nyáá embe keñ a coo njep roè a du a yá Jisoès.
English: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, It's the Lord! So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him for he was naked, and threw himself into the sea.

Limbum: Bár ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a m vúè yap ba mbe keñ. A ka' ce vúè wa'a, a ce súèñ rraa ce nca yi m ba njo goèr se naè, a ce vúè aègho. Ká' embe dïì' woweèe a m ba anaè du nje waâa roè yi m ba njïìsaèp ka'. Ká' embo naè du nje waâa roè yi m ba aèmboè mkoo mntaê.
English: But the other disciples came in the little boat for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away, dragging the net full of fish.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' nje w a roè, fúú embe keñ, a yá mor, a yá bráâd, a yá nca njep mor anaè.
English: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Loèr neè nca mo' ce weèe aè ku koo seè'ni naè, vú aègho.”
English: Jesus said to them, Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.

Limbum: Saimún Pitaè aè kútïì mbe keñ a súñ rraa a fúr mbe ñkúè. Nca goèrgoèr yi m ba njo seê. Yi m ba rjeèe neè ncoèp-taar-aè-mntaê. Ka' nca yi m ba njo goèr wa'a, rraa li m ceeñger ka'.
English: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn't torn.

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Vúè neè ye yuu.” Ñwáè moè' efa múè woweèe aè túr ntee aè rbipshi neè Jisoès ená a ye nda lá ka'. Woweèe a m rïìñ ená a Tataê.
English: Jesus said to them, Come and eat breakfast. None of the disciples dared inquire of him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord.

Limbum: Jisoès aè du a lor bráâd a vú a gapshi neè woweèe, a ker lor nca a gapshi neè woweèe foñ.
English: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

Limbum: A ñkaèraè' taar seè'ni aèmboè Jisoès aè m duèñshi yïì nyor neè ñgaâa yá'ni yïì buu, káâ' aè nfeè' ce e m fúú efa rkwe.
English: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ye byee mïìsi wáá, Jisoès aè laa neè Saimún Pitaè enáê, “Saimúèn, muu Joân, wáè koèñ máè a caa beèe ca a?” Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “ÁÈno Tataê, aè rïìñ wáná m koèñ wáè.” E laa neè ye enáê, “Nyañ ya njeèe.”
English: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you. He said to him, Feed my lambs.

Limbum: E m ker laa neè Pitaè enáê, “Saimúèn, muu Joân, aè koèñ máè a?” E laa neè ye enáê, “ÁÈno Tataê, aè rïìñ wáná m koèñ wáè.” E laa neè ye enáê, “Nyañ ya njeèe.”
English: He said to him again a second time, Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you. He said to him, Tend my sheep.

Limbum: E ka' laèa neè Pitaè baè' bkaâñ btaar enáê, “Saimúèn, muu Joân, aè koèñ máè a?” Ntee yi bep ye njobeè' e m bipshi neè ye ñkaèraè' taar enáê, “AÈ koèñ máè a?” E laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, aè rïìñ buu wááwá, aè rïìñ wáná m koèñ wáè.” Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Nyañ ya njeèe.
English: He said to him the third time, Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me? Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, Do you have affection for me? He said to him, Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you. Jesus said to him, Feed my sheep.

Limbum: M ce suñ wáè neè mini-ñwáè ená aè m ba aè nfeè' ce wáè m bii nsuènsuè ñwáè, wáè m ce kur yoè ñkaènda ce duè faèdïì' ce wáè gwáá. Be ba aè nfeè' ce aè yu nleeñwáè tá aè naa mmbo, tá ñwáè jáá kur wáè, loèr wáè duè aègho faèdïì' ce aè koèñ aè rduè ka'.”
English: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don't want to go.

Limbum: E m laèa wa'a, aè rduèñshi njáèá rkwe ce Pitaè be keè kwe, kuè'si Nyúè aègho. Cena yi ka' mïì wáá, e laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè fa máâ mbuèu.”
English: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, Follow me.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' karsi nyor a yá ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès moè' ce Jisoès aè m koèñ se naè aèmboè e ce vúè a waâp mbuèu. A ye ce e m káèr nyor aègee Jisoès aè nfeè' woweèe a m ce ye byee, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Tataê, ñwáè ce e be fyeèni wáè a nda?” naè.
English: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus sincerely loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus' breast at the supper and asked, Lord, who is going to betray You?

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' yá ye, a laa neè Jisoès enáê, “Tataê, yi yu yi ká aèmboè ñwáè ca?”
English: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, Lord, what about this man?

Limbum: Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “M ka' koñ ená e ku cu nteèe caar tá m ke kúti, yo enjo ba ká? Vúè yo ba fa máâ mbuèu.”
English: Jesus said to him, If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' laèa wa'a, bfúr a ká' a ce suñ ená ñwáè yá'ni yïì buu ce Jisoès aè m koèñ ye goèr naè be keè lá kwe ka'. Jisoès aè m banïì laa ba ená e be keè kwe ka' ka'. E m banïì laa ba enáê, “M ka' koñ ená e ku cu nteèe caar tá m ke kúti, yo enjo ba ká? Vúè yo ba fa máâ mbuèu.”
English: This saying therefore went out among the brothers, that this disciple wouldn't die. Yet Jesus didn't say to him that he wouldn't die, but, If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?

Limbum: Ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisoès ca a ñwáè ce e ce suñ weèe buu ca. AÈ m sañ ye a sañ buu ca. Weèr rïìñ werná yuu ce e laèa yi yu mini.
English: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

Limbum: Buu moè' ce Jisoès aè m geèe vi yu goèr seê. A m ba sañ buu ca wááwá, m kwaè' máná ñgoèñ ca yi m ba túr dïì' aè rláè mñwaè' ce a sañ buu anaè mbo ka'.
English: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written.

Limbum: Maèsaè Tïìyofiloès, mbe ya ñwaè' entombïì ce máè m sañ neè wáè naè, máè m sañ buu wááwá ce Jisoès aè m geèe ker ba vïì ce e m yá'ni, káâ' aè nfeè' ce e m káè' li rfaè',
English: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

Limbum: du ba' aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m loèr ye a du aègho mbe buèu. Tá e ka' keè duè mbe buèu e m fa ncep neè ñgaâa ntuu ce e m ce naè aè ñger Yú' Rara.
English: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' kwe, fúú efa rkwe a cu aè mnoèñ mkyeèe a yááti fa waâp mú nfeè' aèñgoo, a duñshi yïì nyor neè woweèe aè njáèá njïì ce rtarnïì li m ba njo ka', ená e yu nteèe. E m ce suñ woweèe aèmboè rsa' Nyúè ce e ce sa' aèmboè ñkúú.
English: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days, and speaking about God's Kingdom.

Limbum: Jisoès aè ka' ba a woweèe aè nfeè' anaè, a laa neè woweèe ená woweèe a fa loâ aè rlaè' Jáèrusaláèm ka'. E m laèa enáê, “Cu neè ce ke' yuu ce Nyúè Taèr aè m kaè' neè weèe aè ba yuu ce máè m suñ weèe foñ naè.
English: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, Don't depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

Limbum: Joân aè m baèptir weèe neè mdip, geewa'a, ku báti mnoèñ múcaèr tá a baptir weèe ba neè Yú' Rara.”
English: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a ka' ba a Jisoès weèe, a bipshi neè ye enáê, “Tataê, waè' aè be kúsi ñger neè beèe Isráèl seè'ni na a?”
English: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?

Limbum: Jisoès aè beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Yu ye dïì' aè rrïìñ nfeè' káè mnoèñ ce Taèr aè láè aè yi ñger ka'.
English: He said to them, It isn't for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe be túr ñger aè nfeè' ce Yú' Rara yi suèu mbe weâe nduè, tá weèe bo suñ beèe aèmboè máè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, ba aè ñgoâñ Judaè wááwá, ba Saèmarïìyaè, ker ba aè mñgoèñ wááwá.”
English: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa' mïìsi, Nyúè aè lor ye a du aègho mbe buèu, woweèe a táá a ce fyá', mmbaè' vi vú a cete ye, woweèe a ke' ker yá ye ka'.
English: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ku bii keè' mbe buèu a ce fyá' aèmboè e ce duè, a ka' loè a ku yá mmbañruè a baa aèmboè a táá a waâp geñ, a yar bcáâ' bbúú.
English: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

Limbum: Mmbañruè a baa ca a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Beâe aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, weèe aè táá a ce keè' ba ká mbe buèu? Jisoès ce Nyúè aè loèr ye a du aègho mbe buèu na, e be keè kúti aè njáèá njïì weèe aè yá ye e ce duè na.”
English: who also said, You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a m loè embe rtuèu Oleèf a du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. AÈ rloè embe rtuèu Oleèf duè Jáèrusaláèm e ku ba aèmboè mar moè'sir.
English: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' a ko' mbe rum ndap yïû mbekïì, mbe dïì' ce woweèe a m ce cu. Beèe ce a m ba mbo aè m ba Pitaè ba Joân ba Jáêms, ker ba Andruè ba Feleêp, ker ba Tomas ba Baètoèlomïì ba Matïìyoè ba Jáms muu Alfïìyoès ba Saimúèn ce e m ba moè' efa múè beèe Siloèt ba Judaès muu Jáêms.
English: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room, where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a m ba cuâu mo'sir, a ce loo aèbee. Bbyeèñge mo' ba Máèári ma yïì Jisoès, ker ba bfúr Jisoès, a m ba a woweèe.
English: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè mnoèñ anaè Pitaè aè natïì mbekïì a táá aè múè yïì beèe ce a m ba aèmboè beèe rjeèe neè beèe mmbaa, a laa enáê,
English: In these days, Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples and the number of names was about one hundred twenty, and said,

Limbum: “Yaè beèe, blaâa Nyúè vi be kuè ghááte aèmboè Yú' Rara yi m laèa njïì enjep Dávïìd, kuu Judaès ce e m duèñshi njïì neè beèe ce a m koo Jisoès.
English: Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' laèa mïìsi, woweèe a ce beèe a mmbaa. A m ce Josáèf ce li rlii mo' li m ba ená Baèsabaès, rmo' li ba ená Jostoès, a ker ce Maètiyaès foñ.
English: They put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

Limbum: Woweèe a m loo, a laa enáê, “Tataê, wáè ce wáè rïìñ mntee beèe wááwá. Duèñshi laè weèr ñwáè ce wáè ce efa múè beèe a mmbaa ca,
English: They prayed, and said, You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

Limbum: ená e gee rfaè' ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ce Judaès aè m ce faè', a ka' ma'shi a du faèdïì' ce e ba duè.”
English: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.

Limbum: A m sañ mlii beèe a mmbaa ca ená a bo co' ñwáè ce e be loèr dïì' Judaès. A ka' geèe wa'a, rlii ce li fúú entoèmbïì aè ba li Maètiyaès. Li ka' fúú, a lor ye a fa mbe múè ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ce a m ba beèe ncoèp-moè'sir-aè-rrúèú naè.
English: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

Limbum: Noâñ Ñkaâ' Pántikoès yi ka' gháá, woweèe wááwá a ba aèbee mbe dïû' moè'sir.
English: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

Limbum: Ka' cu, a ku yu' aèmboè yuu mo' yi ce vúè embe buèu, a ce coèo aèmboè fu' tatap wa'a. Yi m ce coèo aè bdïì' wááwá embe ndaèp ce woweèe a m ba.
English: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

Limbum: Yuu mo' yi yáátïì aèmboè mcuèñ mor wa'a, a da' a suu mbenduè ñwáè wááwá.
English: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá aè ruu neè Yú' Rara, a ká' a ce laèa bli ce woweèe a m yá'ni ka', ce Yú' Rara yi m geèe woweèe a ce laèa.
English: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

Limbum: Jus ce a m vúèse aè bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na a m ce cu aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè nfeè' anaè. AÈ m ba beèe ce a fa yap ntee neè Nyúè.
English: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

Limbum: Yuu anaè yi ka' ce coèo wa'a, ku' beèe a kaarïì aèbee. Woweèe a m báèáñger seê, njobeè' ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a m ce laèa, ñwáè nsïìp aè ce yu' aè yïì lïî.
English: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

Limbum: Ca yi m gha' woweèe seê, woweèe a bááñgeèr, a laa enáê, “To beèe ce a laèa na yu beâe Galeèleê!
English: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, Behold, aren't all these who speak Galileans?

Limbum: Yi yu aè njáâá ká ce ená woweèe a ce laèa ñwáè nsïìp aè ce yu' aè yïì lïî?
English: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa weâr mú yu beâe Pátïìyaè ba Mádïìyaè, beâe Álaèm ba Máèsoèpoètámïìyaè, beâe Judaè ba Kaèpaèdosïìyaè, beâe Pontuès ba Ásïìyaè.
English: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

Limbum: Beèe a vúâ aè ñgoâñ Frijïìyaè ba Paèmfilïìyaè ker ba aè ñgoâñ Ijïìp ba bdïì' moâ' aè to' Lebïìyaè ce vi yu aègee Saèireên. Beèe mo' efa weâr mú ce a vúâ aè ñgoâñ Ruêm, yu Juês, ba beèe mo' enje jáá ce a byemi neè Nyúè Juês.
English: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa weâr mú a vúâ aè ñgoâñ Kreêt, ba aè ñgoâñ AÈrábïìyaè. Woweèe a ce suñ njáèá buu bbáèá ce Nyúè aè geèe seèe aè ce yu' aè viseèe bli wááwá.”
English: Cretans and Arabians: we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!

Limbum: Woweèe a m báèáñger seê, a ker jep, a ce bipshi fa waâp mú enáê, “Cena yi yu ba ená ká?”
English: They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, What does this mean?

Limbum: Beèe mo' a m vúèshi woweèe, a laa enáê, “Beèe ca a no mruè' mi koo woweèe.”
English: Others, mocking, said, They are filled with new wine.

Limbum: Pitaè aè natïì mbekïì a ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ce ncoèp moè'sir-aè-rrúèú, a laa mbekïì neè ku' beèe anaè enáê, “Yaè beâe Judaè ker ba beèe wááwá ce a ce cu aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm. Yu'shi neè boèñboñ tá m suñ weèe yuu ce yi yu.
English: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spoke out to them, You men of Judea, and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

Limbum: Weèe ce kwaè'shi ená beèe ca a no mruè' mi koo woweèe. Yi yu wa' ka'. Seè'ni ku bii nyúè búè'ú aè ñgaèptú'.
English: For these aren't drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

Limbum: Cena a yuu ce Jowál ce ñwáè ntuu Nyúè aè m suñ beèe. E m suñ enáê,
English: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

Limbum: ‘Nyúè ce laèa enáê, “Be ba aè mnoèñ elúèsimbuèu tá m fa ya yú' neè beèe wááwá, tá boo wee ce mmbañruè ba bbyeèñge, a cep ya ntuu neè beèe. Tá boo wee boo mnsuènsuèè a yá buu ce vi be loâ koni, tá bleebeèe a yá mlo.
English: It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

Limbum: Noèñ anaè yi be ba tá m fa ya yú' neè ya ñgaâa mfaè' wááwá, mmbañruè ba bbyeèñge, tá woweèe a cep ya ntuu neè beèe.
English: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

Limbum: M be keè geèe buu bghagha' mbe buèu, duèñshi mncoèo njep ñgoèñ na. Bláá vi be keè ba, tá mor yi ba, tá ku' njemor yi dú'.
English: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e ce sañ na be keè liiti, tá ñwáá yi bañ aèmboè bláá. Tá noèñ yïû Tata ce yi be keè ba goèr keèr ba jáá se naè yi ka' gháá.
English: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ka' ke ká' rlii Tata ená e ja' ye, a ñwáè ce e be keè luèñ.” ’
English: It will be, that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.'

Limbum: “Yaè beèe Isráèl, yu' neè yuu ce m be laèa na. Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt aè m ba ñwáè ce Nyúè aè m duèñshi ená e m ce ye. E m duèñshi wa'a neè buu bghagha' ce Jisoès aè m geèe, ba mncoèo ce e m duèñshi a weâe mú aè ñger Nyúè. Wee weèe rïìñ buu ca boèñboñ.
English: Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him in the midst of you, even as you yourselves know,

Limbum: E m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè, a riñ yuu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' neè ye. Nyúè aè m ye leè' ená ñwáè moè' embe ndúè' Dávïìd be keè ye kúú Dávïìd.
English: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

Limbum: Dávïìd aè m yá yuu ce yi be keè ba, a suñ aèmboè nfúú efa rkwe Kraâis enáê, ‘Nyúè aè m maè'shi ená e cu mbaè yir ka', a ma'shi ená yïì nyor búte ka'.’
English: he foreseeing this spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was his soul left in Hades, nor did his flesh see decay.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m fúr Jisoès ca efa rkwe, weèr aè yá ye neè mer mmir foñ.
English: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

Limbum: Nyúè aè naèa ye a cuusi aè li rkoo maè', e koo Yú' Rara ce yïì ta aè m kaè' naè. Baná yuu ce weèe ce yá a ker ce yu' seè'ni na, yu ba yú' anaè ce e ce fa neè weèr.
English: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this, which you now see and hear.

Limbum: Dávïìd aè m be du mbe buèu ka', geewa'a yu ba ye ce e m laèa enáê, ‘Tata aè m laèa neè yaè tata enáê, “Cu aè la rkoo maè' caar tá nfeè' gháá
English: For David didn't ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit by my right hand,

Limbum: tá m ke geèe tá aè tár mkuèu mbenduè beèe ce a baèa wáè.” ’
English: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.'

Limbum: Baná beèe Isráèl wááwá a rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená Jisoès ce woweèe a m taa mbe kïìntaa naè yu ñwáè ce Nyúè aè m geèe e ba Tataê, a ker ba Kraâis anaè.”
English: Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a ka' yu', yi joo yap ntee seê, woweèe a laa neè Pitaè ker ba bár ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès enáê, “Bfúr weêr, yuu ce aède' weèr geêe, yu ba ká?”
English: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brothers, what shall we do?

Limbum: Pitaè aè beesïì enáê, “Kupse neè, ma' yeè buu bbebep tá a bo baèptir weèe wááwá aè rlii Jisos Kraêis, tá Nyúè foosi weèe yeè buu bbebep, tá weèe koni Yú' Rara ce yu rfa ese Nyúè.
English: Peter said to them, Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Mkaè'ni ce Nyúè aè m kaè', mi yu neè weèe ba boo wee, ker ba beèe wááwá ce a yu aènjïìsaèp ba beèe wááwá ce yïìseèe Tata Nyúè aè m ká' ená a ba yïì beèe.”
English: For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.

Limbum: Pitaè aè m ker laa buu moè' magoèr neè woweèe tá woweèe a bo yá rara enjo, a ker loo woweèe enáê, “Tee neè wee btu efa ñgá' ce e ce vúè neè ñgaâa bsaèrbuu ce e seè'ni.”
English: With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, Save yourselves from this crooked generation!

Limbum: A m baèptir beèe ce a m byemi yuu ce Pitaè aè m laèa anaè. Beèe ce a m kyeèse nyor aè múè ñgaâa rbyemïì nyúè anaè a m ba aèmboè beèe ncúèkïì taar wa'a.
English: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

Limbum: Woweèe a m loèr yaèp nfeè' a yu' ryá'nïì ce ñgaâa ntuu Jisos Kraâis a m ce yá'ni, a ce vúè aèbee cá'cá', a ce ye wap byee ker ba byee Nyúè aèbee, a ker ce geèe mloo.
English: They continued steadfastly in the apostles' teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m ce wáp seê, njobeè' ku' buu bbáèá ba mncoèo ce ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a m ce duèñshi aè ñger Nyúè.
English: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

Limbum: Ñgaâa rbyemïì wááwá a m ku ba aèbee, a túr yaèp buu aèbee.
English: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce loè fyeni yaèp buu, ce loèr mbaèa efa gho ce gaèpshi fa waâp mú aèmboè ñwáè aè m buu yuu.
English: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce tarte mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá, a ce bá'shi bráâd fa waâp mndaèp, a ce yeñger aèbee neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè, a ke' ce yu' nyor ka'.
English: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce náèsi Nyúè, beèe a ce yu' rboèñ neè woweèe. Tata aè m ce kyeèse beèe ce a m luèñ efa ñgá' na a múè beèe ca aè mnoèñ wááwá.
English: praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ mo', Pitaè ba Joân a du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè aè nyúè taar neèmootïì. AÈ m ba nfeè' ce a m ce duè mbo ce geèe rloo.
English: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' a yá ñwáè moè' ce e m kepñger, ká' embe nfeè' ce a m bi ye. Ñwáè anaè aè m cu a cuâu ñka' ce a m beèe Ndap Nyúè aègho. A m ce too cuâu ñka' anaè ená Rboèñ. A m ce byáè' ye aè mnoèñ wááwá ce cuusi njep cuâu ñka' anaè tá e bo ce loo mbaèa ese beèe ce a m ce vúè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè.
English: A certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

Limbum: E ka' yá aèmboè woweèe a ce vúè aè rniñ mbe Ndaèp Nyúè e loo mbaèa ese woweèe.
English: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

Limbum: Pitaè ba Joân a ke' ye mbe mmïìr. Pitaè aè laa enáê, “Keè' weèr!”
English: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, Look at us.

Limbum: E ka' keè' woweèe a ce kwaè'shi ená woweèe a be fa ye yuu.
English: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “M túr mbaèa ka', geewa'a, m be fa wáè yuu ce m túr. AÈ rlii Jisos Kraâis ce aè rlaè' Nasaráèt, naèti mbekïì, jáêr.”
English: But Peter said, Silver and gold have I none, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa', a ghashi ye aè rkoo maè', a naa mbekïì. E ka' naèti táá mbekïì, mi mkuèu mi tap, vi byuèñ nyor enje mlir mkuèu vi tap.
English: He took him by the right hand, and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

Limbum: E nyáá mbekïì a táá, a ká' a ce jáèr, a du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a woweèe, a ka' baè' mbo e ce jáèr mbo, a ce nyáshi mbekïì, a ce kuè'si Nyúè.
English: Leaping up, he stood, and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a yá aèmboè e ce jáèr, a ce kuè'si Nyúè.
English: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá, a riñ ená a ñwáè ce e m ce cu njep cuâu ñka' ce a m ce too ená Rboèñ, ce loo buu ese beèe naè. Woweèe a bááñgeèr, a túr yuu laèa ka', njo' yuu ce yi m koni anaè.
English: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

Limbum: AÈmboè ñwáè ca aè m ku bii ghashi rkoo Pitaè ba Joân naè, beèe wááwá a bááñgeèr seê, a cañ a koni woweèe mbe njïì baaki ñkúú Solomúèn.
English: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' yá woweèe, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yaè beèe Isráèl, weèe ce báèáñger njo' yuu ce yi koni na, a ce keè' weèr ntuñ-ñ-ñ njoká? Waè' weèe ce kwaè'shi ená weèr aè geèe ñwáè ca aè jár ba aè yer ñger káè njobeè' weèr rïìñ aè rcaè'ni Nyúè boèñboñ a?
English: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

Limbum: Nyúè Abraèham ce e yu Nyúè Aisïìk a ba Nyúè Jakoèp a ker ba Nyúè viseèe btarkú wááwá, aè kuè'si Jisoès ce e yu yïì ñwáè rfaè'. Weèe aè m fa ye neè beèe ce a m ce sa' weèe, a máñni ye aè bsii Pailáèt, ka' Pailáèt aè m ce koèñ aè rmaè'shi ye wa'a.
English: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up, and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

Limbum: Ka' e m ba ñwáâ nrara a ba ñwáâ nyáánïì wa'a, weèe aè m máñni ye, a laa neè Pailáèt ená e fúr ba ñwáâ nyúshi beèe embe shañ, fa neè weèe.
English: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

Limbum: Weèe aè m yú ye yu ñwáè ce e m múè' nduunjïû ryoèñ. Geewa'a, Nyúè aè m fúr ye efa rkwe, weèr aè yá ye neè mer mmir.
English: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

Limbum: A geèe ñwáè ce weèe aè yá a riñ na aè tap boèñboñ ba aè rbyemïì ce aè rlii Jisoès. AÈ ka' ba njo' rbyemïì ce aè rlii Jisoès, ñwáè ca aè tap boèñboñ a weâe bsii.
English: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

Limbum: “AÈmboè yi yu wa' seè'ni na, bfúr waê, máè rïìñ máná yuu ce weèe ker ba beèe ce a m ce sa' weèe aè m geèe neè Jisoès naè, weèe woweèe aè m ce geèe wa'a, a riñ yuu ce weèe aè m ce geèe ka'.
English: Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

Limbum: tuusi Kraâis ce a láè neè weèe. Jisoès ca yu Kraâis anaè.
English: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

Limbum: E be kuè cu mbe buèu caar baè' aè nfeè' ce Nyúè be geèe tá buu wááwá kúti bfi aèmboè e m laèa njïì enjep yi ñgaâa ntuu eluâuñgoèñ ce aè m ba beâe brara naè.
English: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

Limbum: Musïìs aè m laèa yi enáê, ‘Tata Nyúè be keè fúr ñwáè ntuu efa weâe mú aèmboè e m fúr máè naè. Weèe be keè yu' buu wááwá ce e be keè laèa neè weèe, geèe vi.
English: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, 'The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' tá keè yu' yuu ce ñwáè ntuu Nyúè anaè be keè laèa, geèe yi ka', baná a be keè fúr ñgaèñ efa múè beèe, yú.’
English: It will be, that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.'

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Nyúè wááwá, ká' embe nfeè' yïì Saâmwáèl du ba' mbe nfeè' yïì ñgaâa ntuu wááwá ce a m ba mbenjïì Saâmwáèl a m laèa aèmboè mnoèñ ca.
English: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.

Limbum: Weèe yu boo ñgaâa ntuu Nyúè, a ce ye sá' efa yuu ce woweèe aè m suñ beèe ená yi be keè ba naè. Leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye a weâe bta naè, weèe ce ye sá' efa gho seè'ni. Nyúè aè m laèa neè Abraèham enáê, ‘M be ghoèni mnjáèá enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá njïì enjep yoè ñgúè beèe.’
English: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, 'In your seed will all the families of the earth be blessed.'

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyúè aè fúr yïì ñwáè rfaè' efa weâe mú, a tuu ye neè weèe entombïì, tá e bo ghoèni weèe, geèe tá weèe kupse, maè' wee bsaèrbuu.”
English: God, having raised up his servant, Jesus, sent him to you first, to bless you, in turning away everyone of you from your wickedness.

Limbum: Pitaè ba Joân a ka' kuè bii ce laèa neè beèe, ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè beèe ce a m ce keè'ni Ndap Nyúè, ker ba beèe Saduèsïî, a vúseè.
English: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

Limbum: Ntee yi bep woweèe seê, njobeè' Pitaè ba Joân aè m ce yá'ni beèe ená Jisoès aè m fúú efa rkwe, yi ce duèñshi ená beèe ce a kweñger a be fúú efa rkwe.
English: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

Limbum: A m koo Pitaè ba Joân a li' mbe ndaèp, a lá woweèe mbo caar túè' aè raa, njobeè' nyúè aè m coo.
English: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

Limbum: Geewa'a, beèe magoèr ce a m yu' yuu ce woweèe a m laèa a m byemi. Beèe ce a m byemi a m baè' seè'ni aèmboè ncúèkïì ta wa'a.
English: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, beèe ce a m ce sa' to' ba bleebeèe, ker ba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir, a vúseè aèbee aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: It happened in the morning, that their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

Limbum: Anaès ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, ba Kaifaès, ba Joân ba AÈláèksandaè, ker ba beèe embe ndúè' ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a m ba aèfo foñ.
English: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

Limbum: A m fúr woweèe embe ndaèp, a tár mbe waâp tar, a ká' a ce bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè geèe ca ba aè ñger nda? Weèe aè geèe ba aè rlii nda?”
English: When they had stood them in the middle of them, they inquired, By what power, or in what name, have you done this?

Limbum: Pitaè aè ruu neè Yú' Rara aè nfeè' anaè, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Ñgaâa sa' to' ker ba bleebeèe!
English: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce bipshi buu neè weèr kuu yuu boèñboñ ce weèr aè geèe neè ñwáè ce e kepñger na, ená e geèe eká a ka' ce jáèr lá,
English: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

Limbum: baná weèe ker ba beâe aè to' Isráèl wááwá, aè ba rïìñ ená ñwáè ca aè jáèr boèñboñ ba aè rlii Jisos Kraâis ce aè rla' Nasaráèt. Jisoès ca yu ñwáè ce weèe aè m taa mbe kïìntaa, Nyúè aè fúr ye efa rkwe naè.
English: be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, in him does this man stand here before you whole.

Limbum: E yu aèmboè luèr ce weâe ñgaâa mboo mndap aè m maè', aè ka' ba seè'ni, e kútïì ba aè luâr aè rbuu ndap.
English: He is 'the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.'

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ker ba ce aède' e gee beèe a luñ ka', njobeè' Nyúè aè ker fa ñwáè moè' njep ñgoèñ na ce aède' seèe luñ aè li rlii ka'.”
English: There is salvation in none other, for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, by which we must be saved!

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá njáèá ntee ce Pitaè ba Joân a m túr, a bááñger seê, njobeè' woweèe a m ku ba beâe aètáèr, a riñ ñwaè' ka'. Woweèe a m rïìñ aè nfeè' anaè ená Pitaè ba Joân a m ba a Jisoès weèe neè mini-ñwáè.
English: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a ker túr yuu laèa ka' njobeè' woweèe aè m yá aèmboè ñwáè ce e m kepñger anaè táá aègee Pitaè ba Joân.
English: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

Limbum: A m laèa neè woweèe ená woweèe a fúú embe kansuèr. Woweèe a ka' fúú, ñgaâa kansuèr a ká' a ce seèesi yuu ce a be geèe neè woweèe.
English: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa enáê, “Seèe be geèe seeká neè beèe ca? Beèe wááwá aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a rïìñ ená woweèe a geèe yuu báèá seê. AÈde' seèe kanïì ka'.
English: saying, What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can't deny it.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, seèe laa neè woweèe ená a fa keèr laèa yuu mo' neè ñwáè moè' aè rlii Jisoès ka', faè dïì' ryá'nïì ca li bo keèr duè ntombïì ka'.”
English: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let's threaten them, that from now on they don't speak to anyone in this name.

Limbum: A m ká' woweèe a laa neè woweèe ená a fa ker laèa yuu mo', keèr yá'ni yuu mo' aè rlii Jisoès ka'.
English: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

Limbum: Pitaè ba Joân a beesïì neè woweèe enáê, “Kwaè'shi ka neè boèñboñ ená yi yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ená weèr yu'ni ba neè weèe káè neè Nyúè lá?
English: But Peter and John answered them, Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

Limbum: AÈde' weèr buu yer yu efa rlaèa yuu ce weèr aè yá a ker yu' ka'.”
English: for we can't help telling the things which we saw and heard.

Limbum: Ñgaâa Kansuèr a m ker wápsi woweèe, a ma'shi woweèe. Woweèe a m túr njïì aè rgeèe yuu mo' neè Pitaè weèe ka' njobeè' beèe wááwá a m ce kuè'si Nyúè aè yuu ce yi m koni anaè.
English: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce a m geèe yuu báèá neè ye, e jár anaè, aè m caèa bfeè' mñkyeèe.
English: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

Limbum: A ka' maè'shi woweèe, woweèe a du a yá yaèp beèe a suñ woweèe buu wááwá ce beèe ce a m ba btu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba bleebeèe a m laèa neè woweèe.
English: Being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

Limbum: Yaèp beèe a ka' yu', a loo aèbee enáê, “Taâr ñgoèr ce e m geèe rbuu ba nshe, ba mdip, ker ba buu wááwá ce vi yu aè bdïì' ca!
English: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, O Lord, you are God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

Limbum: Wáè m geèe Dávïìd ce e m ba yoè ñwáè rfaè' aè laa aè ñger Yú' Rara enáê, ‘Ntee yi m ce yañ beèe enje jáá njoká? Beèe a m ce roèo mkuèu beèe mo' aè cicïì njoká?
English: who by the mouth of your servant, David, said, 'Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

Limbum: Bkúú enjep ñgoèñ a m ba'shi nyor, a ñgaâa sa' to' weèe a vúseè aèbee aè rmaè' bïìr a Tata Nyúè, ker ba yïì Kraêis.’
English: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.'

Limbum: Yi yu neè mini-ñwáè ená Hároèd ba Pontiyos Pailáèt a m vúèse aèbee aè rla' ca a beèe enje jáá weèe, ker ba beèe Isráèl, a ce roèo mkuèu Jisoès, ce e yu yoè ñwáè rfaâ' nrara ce wáè m yo'.
English: For truly, in this city against your holy servant, Jesus, whom you anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' loo, mbe dïì' ce woweèe a m ba naè yi ci'tïì, woweèe a ruu neè Yú' Rara, a ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè ntee-ñwáè.
English: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

Limbum: Ñgaâa rbyemïì ca wááwá a m ku túr nteâe mo'sir ba rkwaè'shïû rmo'sir. Ñwáè moè' aè ke' ce laèa ená buu ce e túr ku ba vi caè'caè' ka'. Woweèe a m ku túr yaèp buu aèbee.
English: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ca a m ku ce suñ neè ñger-ñwáè aèmboè nfúú efa rkwe Tata Jisoès. Nyúè aè m geèe woweèe wááwá a túr ntee boèñboñ a waâp mú.
English: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa waâp mú aè ke' ker buu yuu mo' ka'. Beèe ce a m túr mñkúè, káè mndap áè, a m ce fyeèni, ce vúè neè mbaèa efa gho,
English: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

Limbum: ce láè njeptii ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès, woweèe a ce loèr mbaèa anaè ce gaèpshi neè beèe ce a m túr yuu ka'.
English: and laid them at the apostles' feet, and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba fa waâp mú ce a m ce too ená Josáèf. Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a m ce too ye ená Baènabaès. Mbuèu efa rlii ca yu ená, ñwáè nfa ñger. E m ba ñwáè embe ndúè' Lávïì, a ba ñwáè ce a m bi ba aè to' Saiproès.
English: Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement, a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

Limbum: E m fyeèni yïì ñkúè moè', a lor mbaèa efa gho a lá njeptii ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès.
English: having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba yi ce a m ce too li rlii ená AÈnaèniyaès. E m túr ñgwa, rlii ñgwa yïì li ba ená Saèfereèyaè. A ñgwa a m fyeèni yap nsuu mo'.
English: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira, his wife, sold a possession,

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' fyeèni, nduu yïì a gapnïì mbaèa efa gho, a lor bár a du aègho a lá njeptii ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès. Ñgwa yïì aè m rïìñ enjo foñ.
English: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pitaè aè laa enáê, “AÈnaèniyaès, Sataèn aè ruusi yo ntee, a gee wáè nya' mnde' neè Yú' Nyúè, a gapni mbaèa nsuu ce wáè mú fyeni njoká?
English: But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

Limbum: Nsuu ca aè m ku ba yo nsuu tá aè ka' keè fyeèni, wáè ka' fyeèni mbaèa efa gho aè ba yo mbaèa. Wáè kwaè'shi aè rgeèe njáèá yuu ca njoká? Wáè nya' mnde' ba neè beèe ka', wáè nya' mnde' ba neè Nyúè”
English: While you kept it, didn't it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn't it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven't lied to men, but to God.

Limbum: AÈnaèniyaès aè ka' yu', a gwe aè nsheè a kwe. Beèe ce a m yu' yuu ce yi m koni anaè, a m wáp seê.
English: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

Limbum: Boo mnsuènsuè a m vúè, a kur yi gúèú neè bcáè', a byá' a du aègho, a tuñ.
English: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

Limbum: Awaè vi ka' caèa aèmboâ btaar, ñgwa yïì a vúê, a ke' riñ yuu ce yi ba koni ka'.
English: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Suñ ka máè láê, waè' ca yu mbaèa nsuu ce weèe aè mú fyeni naè a?” E beesïì enáê, “ÁÈno, a yi.”
English: Peter answered her, Tell me whether you sold the land for so much. She said, Yes, for so much.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laèa neè ye enáê, “Weèe nduu woè aè kwaè'shi a byemi ená weèe be moèoshi Yú' Tata Nyúè njoká? Yáê! Mkuèu beèe ce a tuñ nduu woè mi yu kuè ncúèúndúè'. Woweèe a be byáè' wáè fúú aègho foñ.”
English: But Peter asked her, How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.

Limbum: Ye ye aè gwe njeptii Pitaè, a kwe. Boo mnsuènsuè a ka' vúè, a yá aèmboè e kwe, woweèe a byá', a du aègho, a tuñ aègee nduu yïì.
English: She fell down immediately at his feet, and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

Limbum: Cor nsïìp ker ba beèe wááwá ce a m yu' buu ce vi m koni na a m wáp seê.
English: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a m geèe ku' buu bbáèá ba buu bghagha' aè múè beèe. Ñgaâa rbyemïì wááwá a m ce vúè aèbee mbe njïì baaki ñkúú Solomúèn.
English: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ker vú yi yu a kyese nyor a waâp mú ka', ka' beèe wááwá a m loèr woweèe aè beâe bboèñboñ se wa'a.
English: None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.

Limbum: Ku' mmbañruè ba bbyeèñge a m ce byemi neè Tataê.
English: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

Limbum: Ca yi m geèe beèe a byá' ñgaâa byañ foñ a vú aègho a lá mbe bkuu ba mbe mwaèa aèwaâa nduunjïì ená Pitaè ka' ce caèa tá li rleèñshi li bo caèa mbenduè beèe mo' efa waâp mú.
English: They even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

Limbum: Beèe aè m kaari aè mú mla' ce mi m ba aègee rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a vú neè yaèp beèe ce a m ce yañse, ker ba beèe ce byú' bbebep vi m ce fa woweèe ñgá', Pitaè weèe a gee woweèe wááwá a luêñ.
English: Multitudes also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people, and those who were tormented by unclean spirits: and they were all healed.

Limbum: Yuu ce ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès aè m ce geèe naè yi m cïì' ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a ci' yïì beèe ce a m ba beèe Saduèsïî, woweèe a ko'ndoñ neè ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès seê.
