English: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him which is the sect of the Sadducees, and they were filled with jealousy,

Limbum: A m koo woweèe a li' mbe shañ.
English: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public custody.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba neètú', ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè vúê, a mú' bkeèñ shañ, a fúr woweèe embo, a laa enáê,
English: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out, and said,

Limbum: “Duè neè mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, suñ beèe buu wááwá ce vi kuèu ryoâñ rfi ca.”
English: Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' wa'a, túè' aè ka' ce raa, woweèe a du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a yá'ni beèe. Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ba yïì beèe a m ká' bleebeèe embe kansuèr wááwá, a tuu beèe ená a du fúr woweèe embe shañ vú aègho.
English: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and those who were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duâ baè', a yá woweèe mbe shañ ka', a kúti a du a suñ beèe ce a m tuu woweèe naè. A m laèa neè woweèe enáê,
English: But the officers who came didn't find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

Limbum: “Weèr aè duè a yá aèmboè a li' shañ boèñboñ seê, ñgaâa ncir a táá njepmbeè a ce keè'ni ñgaâa shañ. Weèr aè ka' múè' shañ, a yá ñwáè mbo ka'.”
English: We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa keè'ni Ndap Nyúè, ker ba beâe bgoèrgoèr efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a ka' yu', bfee vi jep woweèe, woweèe a ká' a ce tarni yuu ce aède' yi lo ba.
English: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè vú a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yáê! Beèe ce weèe aè mú li' mbe shañ naè, a yu mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a ce yá'ni beèe mbo.”
English: One came and told them, Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa keè'ni Ndap Nyúè naè, ker ba yïì beèe, a m duè a vú neè woweèe. A m koo woweèe aè ñger ka', njobeè' ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a m ce wáp ená a ka' koo woweèe aè ñger, seemoè' beèe a túúshïì woweèe neè bluèr.
English: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

Limbum: A ka' vúè neè woweèe, a tár woweèe mbe múè kansuèr. Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè bipshïì buu neè woweèe.
English: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Weèr aè m laèa ená weèe fa yá'ni yuu mo' aè rlii ñwáè anaè ka'. Yá laè neè yuu ce weèe aè geèe. Weèe aè geèe le ryá'nïì li du aè mú bdïì' wááwá aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a koñ seè'ni aè rgeèe tá yi yááti ená beèe ce a m yú ñwáè ca aè m yú weèr.”
English: saying, Didn't we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man's blood on us.

Limbum: Pitaè ba ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a beesïì enáê, “Weèr be kuè yu'ni ba neè Nyúè caèa ce ená weèr yu'ni ba neè ñwáè.
English: But Peter and the apostles answered, We must obey God rather than men.

Limbum: Nyúè viseèe btarkú aè m fúr Jisoès ce weèe aè m káèti mbe ce e kwe naè efa rkwe.
English: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m naèa ye a cusi a yeâ bo maè' aèmboè ñwáè múè' nduunjïì neè beèe, ba ñwáè rjaè', tá e bo fa beèe njïì aè rkupseè, maè' yaèp buu bbebep tá Nyúè bo foèosi woweèe efa yaèp buu bbebep.
English: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

Limbum: A weèr ce weèr ce suñ beèe buu ca, Yú' Rara ce Nyúè aè fa neè beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè ye, yi ce suñ woweèe foñ.”
English: We are His witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu', ntee yi bep woweèe seê, woweèe a ká' a ce kwaè'shi aè ryú ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès.
English: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and determined to kill them.

Limbum: Ñwáè Farïìsi moè' ce a m ce too ená Gaèmalïìyaèl, aè m naèti mbekïì. AÈ m ba ñwáè ce e m ce yá'ni beèe mncir Nyúè, aè ba ñwáè ce beèe wááwá a m ce yu'ni neè ye. E m laèa ená a fúr beèe ca njepmbeè tá a cu njo nfeè' múcaèr.
English: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

Limbum: A ka' fúr, e laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Yaè beèe Isráèl, loèr neè nfeè' aè yuu ce weèe ce koèñ aè rgeèe neè beèe ca.
English: He said to them, You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' moè' Toâdaès aè nyáá a lor yïì nyor aè ñwáâ ñgoèr, mmbañruè ce a m ba aèmboè mjeèe kyeèe a du a yeâ mbuèu. A m yú ye, mmbañruè ce a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu a da'seè, yuu ce woweèe a m ce koèñ aè rgeèe naè yi bú aè cicïì.
English: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nothing.

Limbum: Ca yi ka' caèa wáá, Judaès ce e m ba ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Galeèle aè nyáá mbe nfeè' ce a m ce beè' beèe, a súñ beèe mo' aè mbeèp yïì. Ye ye aè m kwe, beèe ce a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu, a da'seè.
English: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè yi yu seè'ni na, m ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe fa geèe yuu mo' neè beèe ca ka'. Láè neè woweèe nyañ njobeè' yuu ce woweèe a ce kwaè'shi aè rgeèe na, yi ka' lo ba ese ñwáè baná yi be geèeti ka'.
English: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

Limbum: Yi ka' lo ba ese Nyúè, aède' weèe jepsïì woweèe ka'. Weèe ka' jepsi woweèe, seemoè' yi lo ba ená weèe ce maè' bïìr weèe Nyúè weèe.”
English: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!

Limbum: Woweèe a m yu' ncep ce e m fa, a ka' ká' ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès, a lip woweèe, a laa neè woweèe ená woweèe a fa keèr laèa yuu mo' aè rlii Jisoès ka'. A ka' laèa wa'a, a ma'shi woweèe ená woweèe a duê.
English: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

Limbum: Woweèe a fúú embe kansuèr a ce lu'shi ená Nyúè aè yá woweèe a ghááteè aè beèe ce aède' beèe a coosïì njo' rlii Jisoès.
English: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus' name.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce yá'ni a ce feè'shi mbe Ndaèp Nyúè ba aè mla' aè mnoèñ wááwá ená Jisoès yu Kraâis anaè.
English: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè mnoèñ ca ce ñgoo ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès aè m ce kuè', beèe ce a m ce laèa li Greâk a m laèañger a kuu beèe ce a m ce laèa li Hibruè njobeè' a m ce gaèpshi buu neè beèe aè mnoèñ wááwá, a ce fa byepkúú wap ka'.
English: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

Limbum: Beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú a ká' ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yi yu yáánïì ená weèr borni efa rfeè'shi blaâa Nyúè ce gaèpshi ba buu neè beèe ka'.
English: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

Limbum: Bfúr weêr, baná weèe fúr mmbañruè saèambaê, efa weâe mú ce yap ñgeèe yi yu yáánïì, woweèe a ruusïì neè Yú' Rara, a ker riñ buu, tá weèr bo fa rfaè' ca mbe waâp mmboè,
English: Therefore select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

Limbum: loèr yeèr nfeè' ce geèe rloo, keèr ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè.”
English: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.

Limbum: Yuu ce a m laèa, yi m boèñ beèe wááwá, woweèe a ce Stáfaèn ce e m byemi seê, a ker ruusi neè Yú' Rara, ba Feleêp, ba Pukoruès, ba Nikanoè, ba Timúèn, ba Pámánaès, ba Nikoèlaès ñwáâ aè rla' Antïìyoèk, ce e m loè a byemi neè Nyúè beèe Juês.
English: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch;

Limbum: Woweèe a m loèr beèe ca a tár njeptii ñgaâa ntuu, woweèe a loo, a lá map mmbo mbe waâp nduè.
English: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

Limbum: Blaâa Nyúè vi m duè kuèntombïì, ñgoo beèe ce a m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè ku' seê. Ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce a m yu' blaâa rbyemïì ca a byemi, a m ba goèr.
English: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

Limbum: Stáfaèn aè m túr rboâñ Nyúè ba ñger Nyúè seê, a gee buu bghagha' ba buu bbáèá aè múè beèe.
English: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, beèe mo' ce a m ba beèe embe ndap rloo ce a m ce too ená ndap rloo beèe ce a bii faè' bkwaèa ka', ce aè m ba beâe aè rla' Saèiren ba aè rla' AÈláèksandaè ker ba beâe aè ñgoâñ Sïìlesïìyaè ba Áshaè a m ce sár mnsár a Stáfaèn weèe.
English: But some of those who were of the synagogue called The Libertines, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

Limbum: Yap ñger mnsár aè Stáfaèn weèe yi m sáè njobeè' Stáfaèn aè m ce laèa ba neè bfee ba ñger Yú' Rara ce Nyúè aè m fa ye.
English: They weren't able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

Limbum: Woweèe a du embenjïì a cepshi beèe mo' ená woweèe a nya' mnde' mbe tu Stáfaèn. Woweèe a ká' a laa enáê, “Weèr aè yu' aèmboè e ce nya' mnde' a ce bepsi rlii Musïìs ba Nyúè.”
English: Then they secretly induced men to say, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.

Limbum: Ca yi m geèe mntee beèe ba mntee bleebeèe ba mntee ñgaâa yá'ni beèe mncir, vi yááñgeèr, woweèe a vú mbenduè Stáfaèn, a koo ye a du aègho mbe kansuèr.
English: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, and brought him in to the council,

Limbum: A ka' duè aègho, a vú neè beèe ená a vú táá njïìnsa' mnaèñ, laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca aè be buu efa rlaèa yuu bebep aèmboè dïû' rara ca ba mncir Musïìs ka'.
English: and set up false witnesses who said, This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

Limbum: Weèr a yu' aèmboè e ce laèa ená Jisoès ce aè rla' Nasaráèt be saè'si dïì' ca keèr kupse ndeèe to' ce Musïìs aè m fa neè seèe.”
English: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá embe kansuèr a ka' fyá' bsii Stáfaèn, a yá vi ba aèmboè bsii ncïìndap Nyúè wa'a.
English: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aè bipshïì neè Stáfaèn enáê, “Yi yu wa' a?”
English: The high priest said, Are these things so?

Limbum: Stáfaèn aè beesïì enáê, “Bfúr wa ba wa btaê, yu' neè yuu ce m be laèa. Nyúè ce e yu ñwáè foèo aè m yááti neè Abraèham ce e m ba yeèr ta aè nfeè' ce e m ba aè ñgoâñ Máèsoèpoètámïìyaè ka' naètïû aèfo duè cu aè rla' Háraèn naè,
English: He said, Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

Limbum: a laa neè ye enáê, ‘Loè efa wáâ ñgoèñ, fúú efa múè yoè beèe, du aè ñgoèñ ce m be duèñshi wáè.’
English: and said to him, 'Get out of your land, and from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.'

Limbum: E naètïû aè ñgoâñ beèe Kaldïìyaè, a du a cu aè rla' Háraèn. Yïì ta aè ka' kwe, Nyúè aè fúr ye a vú aègho faèdïì' ce weèe ce cu na.
English: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land, where you are now living.

Limbum: E m fa ye ñgúè' moè' efa ñgoèñ ca káè mú bábá' efa gho ka'. Geewa'a, e m ye leè' ená e be loè fa ñgoèñ anaè neè ye, ker ba boo vi, ka' aè m ba mbe nfeè' anaè e túr muu ka' wa'a.
English: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when he still had no child.

Limbum: Yuu ce Nyúè aè m laèa neè ye yi m ba ená yïì ñgúè be loè bkïìloè, cu aè ñgoâñ beèe mo' tá beèe anaè a gee woweèe a kúti bkwaèa, jar neè woweèe aè bfeè' mjeèe kyeèe.
English: God spoke in this way: that his seed would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ker laa foñ enáê, ‘M be sa', fa ñgá' neè to' ce woweèe a ce faè' bkwaèa neè woweèe naè. Máâ geèe wa' wáá, tá woweèe a fúú aèfo, vúè loo neè máè aèfa na.’
English: I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,' said God, 'and after that will they come out, and serve me in this place.'

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ye leè' ce ncoèo efa gho aè m ba búè ce Abraèham aè m geèe naè. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Abraèham aè bi Aisïìk, mnoèñ vi ka' ba waami, e gee ye búè. Aisïìk aè bi Jakoèp, Jakoèp aè bi btu mntáè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

Limbum: Btu mntáè' ca a m ko'ndoñ neè Josáèf, a fyeni ye aè to' Ijïìp. Geewa'a Nyúè aè m ba a ye,
English: The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,

Limbum: caar ñkúú moè' ce e m rïìñ Josáèf ka', aè ko' kúú aè to' Ijïìp.
English: until there arose a different king, who didn't know Joseph.

Limbum: E m bo' yïìseèe beèe, a jar neè viseèe btaê, a gee woweèe a fúr boo wap aèwañ, tá a bo kweñger.
English: The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that they wouldn't stay alive.

Limbum: A m bi Musïìs aè nfeè' ca, e ba mboèñmboñ se aè bsii Nyúè. E m kuè' mbe ndaèp yïì ta aè mñwáá btar.
English: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome. He was nourished three months in his father's house.

Limbum: A ka' fúr ye aèwañ, muu Fároè ce aè m ba muunje, aè lor ye a du aègho, a ke' aègho aèmboè muu yïì.
English: When he was thrown out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and reared him as her own son.

Limbum: A m yá'ni Musïìs bfee beâe aè ñgoâñ Ijïìp wááwá, e ba ñwáâ ñgoèr aè vi blaèa ker ba yi ñgeèe.
English: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

Limbum: “Musïìs aè ka' baè' bfeè' mñkyeèe, a kwa'shi aè rcaè'ni bfúr vi ce a m ba boo Isráèl.
English: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

Limbum: E ka' duè yá aèmboè a ce fa ñgá' neè moè' efa woweèe, e beenjïì nfúr yïì, a lip ñwáâ Ijïìp, e kweê.
English: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

Limbum: Musïìs aè m ce kwaè'shi ená yïì beèe a be rïìñ ená e yu ñwáè ce Nyúè aè tuu ená e fúr woweèe efa ñgá'. Geewa'a, woweèe a riñ yap yu ka'.
English: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn't understand.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, e vú a yá aèmboè beèe mo' efa woweèe a ce reè bkoèr. E gheteèr ená e teni bkoèr anaè, a laa enáê, ‘Bfúr waê, weèe yu bfúr; mbuèu njoká weèe ce reè bkoèr?’
English: The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, 'Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?'

Limbum: E ka' yá, a bááñger seê. E ka' ce ko'shi aètútú aè rfyá', a yu' aèmboè Tata aè laèa enáê,
English: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,

Limbum: ‘A máè Nyúè wee btaê. A máè Nyúè Abraèham ba Aisïìk ba Jakoèp.’ Musïìs aè m kaèñ seê, a wáp aè rfyá'.
English: I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.' Moses trembled, and dared not look.

Limbum: Tata aè laa neè ye enáê, ‘Co'ni blaba' njobeè' mbe dïì' aè táá anaè yu dïû' rara.
English: The Lord said to him, 'Take your sandals off of your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

Limbum: Máè yá neè mini-ñwáè aèmboè a ce jar neè yaè beèe aè to' Ijïìp, a yu' aèmboè woweèe a ce war, a suu tá m bo fúr woweèe efa ñgá'. Baná aè be tami nyor tá m tuu wáè aè to' Ijïìp.’
English: I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.'

Limbum: “Musïìs ca ce woweèe a m máñni a laa enáê, ‘Ñwáè ce e geèe ená aè ba mbe weâr nduè, sa' weèr aè geèe nda’ naè, Nyúè aè m tuu ye ená e ba ñwáè rsa', ker ba ñwáè nfúr beèe efa ñgá'. E m caèasi ntuu neè ye mbe mmbo yïì ncïìndap ce e m nyáá nje múè mcuèñ mor mbe mú ce mo' naè.
English: This Moses, whom they refused, saying, 'Who made you a ruler and a judge?'--God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

Limbum: Wer bta a m vúè aègho aèfa aè nfeè' ce Joshuèwaè aè m ba yap tu, woweèe a vú a so yap ñgoèñ, Nyúè aè juu beèe enje jáá ce a m ba aèfo a waâp bsii naè. Yi m cu neè woweèe caar a ba' mbe nfeè' yïì Dávïìd.
English: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David,

Limbum: E m túr bsii wañ a Nyúè, a loo ená Nyúè fa ye njïì tá e ba'ri ndap neè Nyúè Jakoèp.
English: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

Limbum: Geewa'a, ñwáè ce e m baè'ri ndap neè ye aè m ba Solomúèn.
English: But Solomon built him a house.

Limbum: “Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Nyúè embe buèu e ke cu ba mbe ndap ce a baè'ri neè mmbo ka'. Yi yu aèmboè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè aè m laèa. E m laèa enáê, Tata ce laèa enáê,
English: However, the Most High doesn't dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

Limbum: ‘Rbuu yu ya kaèbaèraè', nshe aè ba ya nta' ntár mkuèu. Tata ce laèa enáê, Njáèá ndap ce aède' weèe ba'rïì neè máè yu ba njáèá ndap ká? Njáèá dïì' ce aède' m lúshïì aèfo, yo njáèá dïì' ká?
English: heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?' says the Lord; 'or what is the place of my rest?

Limbum: AÈmboè buu ca wááwá aè geèe máè neè ma mmbo a?’
English: Didn't my hand make all these things?'

Limbum: “Weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa nteèetu, a ba mbáè'nsúèr aè mntee ker ba aè btuè', weâe ke kuâ reè bkoèr weèe Yú' Rara weèe aè nfeè' wááwá. Yuu ce wee bta a m geèe ku ba yuu ce weèe ce geèe.
English: You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu', ntee yi bep woweèe seê, woweèe a kúr msoèñ.
English: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

Limbum: Yú' Rara yi m ruusi Stáfaèn, e ke' mbe buèu a yá foâo Nyúè, a yá Jisoès aèmboè e táá aè rkoo maâ' Nyúè.
English: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

Limbum: E laa enáê, “Yá neè, máè yá aèmboè rbuu li múè'ti, máè yá Muu Ñwáè aèmboè e táá aè rkoo maâ' Nyúè.”
English: and said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' ca, a ghaa mbekïì, a cete wap btuè', a cañ a gúmi mbe yeâ nduè.
English: But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed at him with one accord.

Limbum: Woweèe a m fúr ye efa múè rla' a túúshi neè bluèr. Beèe ce a m táá njïìnsa' mbe kansuèr naè a m láè wap bcáè' njeptii mbañruèñwáè moè' ce a m ce too ená Soêl.
English: They threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce túúshi Stáfaèn neè bluèr, e loo a laa enáê, “Tata Jisoès, koo la ryoèñ.”
English: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!

Limbum: E m gú'shi neè mkúúshi, a waa mbekïì enáê, “Tataê, fa láè yuu bebep ca mbe waâp nduè ka'.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a kwe.
English: He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, don't hold this sin against them! When he had said this, he fell asleep.

Limbum: Sol aè m byemi ená a yú Stáfaèn. AÈ m ba aè noèñ anaè a ká' a ce fa ñgá' neè cor ce aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm seê. Yi ka' ba wa'a, ñgaâa rbyemïì a da'seè aè bdïì' wááwá aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè ba aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè. Beèe mo' efa waâp mú ce a m ku cu aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè m ku ba ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès.
English: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

Limbum: Beèe mo' ce a m fa yap ntee neè Nyúè a m tuñ Stáfaèn, a war li rkwe seê.
English: Devout men buried Stephen, and lamented greatly over him.

Limbum: Sol aè m fa ñgá' neè cor seê. E m ce duè aè mndap jáá jáèá jáá ce koshi mmbañruè ba bbyeèñge ce fa mbe shañ.
English: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house, and dragged both men and women off to prison.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m da'se yap naè, a m ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè aè bdïì' wááwá ce woweèe a m duè.
English: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

Limbum: Felep aè m duè aè mú bu' rla' mo' aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè, a suñ aèmboè Kraâis anaè neè beâe aèfo.
English: Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed to them the Christ.

Limbum: Bkúr beèe ca a ka' yu' yuu ce Felep aè m laèa, keèr yá mncoèo ce e m duèñshi, a ker lor nfeè' a yu'shi boèñboñ seê.
English: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

Limbum: Byú' bbebep ce vi m niñ njep beèe magoèr, vi m ce waani, ce fúúse enjep beèe anaè. Beèe magoèr ce yaèp ñgúè' nyor moè' aè m kwe, ker ba beèe ce a m ba mntáèñ a m luèñ.
English: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

Limbum: Beâe aè rla' anaè a m lu'shi seê.
English: There was great joy in that city.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba, a too ye ená Saimúèn AÈ m ba ñwáè ce e m be ce geèe fii aè rla' Saèmarïìyaè, beâe aè to' anaè a ce báèáñger seê. E m ce geèe fii anaè a ce naèa nyor ená e yu ñwáè ñger.
English: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city, and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m yu'shi yuu ce e m ce laèa boèñboñ, ká' embe beâe bká'ká' du ba' mbe beâe bgoèrgoèr, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca yu ñger Nyúè ce a ce too ená Ñger Ce Goèr naè.”
English: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is that great power of God.

Limbum: Woweèe a m yu' yuu ce e m ce laèa boèñboñ njobeè' yi fii ce e m geèe aè bfeè' aèñgoo, beèe a bááñgeèr naè.
English: They listened to him, because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

Limbum: Geewa'a, woweèe a ka' byemi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce Felep aè m feè'shi aèmboè kúú Nyúè ker ba aèmboè rlii Jisos Kraêis, a baptïìr woweèe, mmbañruè ba bbyeèñge.
English: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning the Kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

Limbum: Saimúèn ye ye aè m byemi, a ka' baèptir ye, e ku ce kar a Feleêp. E ka' yá mncoèo ba buu bghagha' ce Felep aè m geèe, e bááñgeèr seê.
English: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès e Jáèrusaláèm a ka' yu' ená beâe aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè a yu' blaâa Nyúè a byemi, a tuu Pitaè ba Joân ená a du yá woweèe.
English: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè baè', a loo neè beèe anaè tá woweèe a bo koni Yú' Rara,
English: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

Limbum: njobeè' Yú' Rara yi m be suu mbe waâp nduè ka'. A m ku baptir woweèe ba aè rlii Tata Jisoès.
English: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a lá map mmbo mbe waâp nduè, woweèe a konïì Yú' Rara.
English: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Saimúèn aè ka' yá ená ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a láè mmbo mbenduè beèe, woweèe a konïì Yú' Rara, e vú neè mbaèa ená e bo fa neè woweèe,
English: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles' hands, he offered them money,

Limbum: a laa enáê, “Fa neè máè njáèá ñger ca foñ, má máâ láè mmbo mbenduè ñwáè, ñgaèñ bo koni Yú' Rara.”
English: saying, Give me also this power, that whoever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Weèe yo mbaèa anaè du bú aè cicïì njobeè' aè ce kwaè'shi ená aède' aè yuu rfa Nyúè neè mbaèa!
English: But Peter said to him, May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

Limbum: Rfaè' ca yu lo rfaè' ka'. AÈ túr bo njo ka' njobeè' yo ntee yi yu rara aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn't right before God.

Limbum: Kupse, ma'shi wo bsaèrbuu, loo neè Tata ená káè e be foèosi wáè yuu ce aè ce kwaè'shi njep wáâ ntee naè áè.
English: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

Limbum: Máè yá máná aè yu ñwáè ntee sii, yo ñgeâe bebep yi kur wáè.”
English: For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.

Limbum: Saimúèn aè laa enáê, “Loo neè neè Tata Nyúè neè máè ená yuu mo' efa yuu weèe aè laèa na yi fa koni máè ka'.”
English: Simon answered, Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' suñ beèe aèmboè Jisoès, keèr feè'shi blaèa Tataê, a nati a kúti Jáèrusaláèm. Woweèe a ka' ce kúti a fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca aè ku' mla' magoèr aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè.
English: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè laa neè Felep enáê, “Naèti du mbaè mbuèuñgoèñ, njep nduunjïì ce yi loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a du aè rla' Gaasaè.” Yu nduunjïì ce yi yu aè rïìñ.
English: But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.

Limbum: E natïì a ce duè, a ka' ce duè, a yá ñwáâ aè to' IÌtopïìyaè. AÈ m ba ñwáè ce a m soèñ, ce e m ce faè' njeptii Mayaâa Kandáès ce e m ce sa' to' IÌtopïìyaè. Buu Mayaâa wááwá aè m ba mba yeâ mmboè. E m duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè rgeèe rloo neè Nyúè,
English: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

Limbum: a ka' ce kúti, a cu mbe yïì mutuè ce aè m ce súèñ ba mnyaèabaèraè', a ce beè' ñwaâ' AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

Limbum: Yú' yi laa neè Felep enáê, “Duè tee mutuè ca.”
English: The Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.

Limbum: Felep aè ka' cañ duâ baè', a yu' aèmboè e ce beè' embe ñwaè' AÈsayaè ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè. E bipshïì neè ye enáê, “Wáâ beè' wa'a, a riñ yuu ce yi ce laèa a?”
English: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, Do you understand what you are reading?

Limbum: E laa enáê, “AÈde' m riñ aè njáâá ká ce ñwáè moè' aè ka' tá naèshi neè máè ka'?” E m laèa neè Felep ená e ko' cu a ye mbe mutuè anaè.
English: He said, How can I, unless someone explains it to me? He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

Limbum: Dïì' embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ce e m ce beè' aè m ba dïì' ce a sañ enáê, “AÈmboè njeèe ce a ke duè aègho aè rsáá, káè muu njeèe ce a ke koo mnyoâr efa gho e ce war ka' naè, e m múè' yi cuèu ka'.
English: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn't open his mouth.

Limbum: Beèe a m loèr ye aè yuu cicïì, a sa' vi mnsa' neè mnaèñ-ñwáè. Ñwáè moè' yu ce aède' e suñ aèmboè yi raèraè ka', njobeè' a tee li ryoèñ enjep ñgoèñ.”
English: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.

Limbum: Ñwáâ nsoèñ ca aè laa neè Felep enáê, “Suñ laè máè, ñwáè ce ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè anaè ce laèa du kuu ye yu nda? E ce laèa ba aèmboè yïì nyor káè aèmboè ñwáè moè' lá?”
English: The eunuch answered Philip, Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?

Limbum: Felep aè ká' embe dïì' ce ñwáè anaè aè ba ce beè' naè, a fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ kuu Jisoès neè ye.
English: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him Jesus.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce duè, a yá rdip mo', ñwáâ nsoèñ ca a laa enáê, “Yáê, a rdip na. Yuu ce aède' yi jepsïì wáè efa rbaèptir máè yu ká?”
English: As they went on the way, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?

Limbum: E ka' beèesi wa'a, a laêa, mutuè caè aè táá. E ka' táá, Felep ba ñwáâ nsoèñ anaè a suu njep roè, Felep aè baptïìr ye.
English: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' fúú enjep roè, Yú' Tata yi lor Felep a du aègho, ñwáâ nsoèñ ca aè ker yá ye ka', a nati a ce duè, a ce lu'shi.
English: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn't see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

Limbum: Felep aè ka' loè a ku yá ená e yu aè rla' AÈsotoès, a ka' ce caèa, a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aè mla' wááwá caar a du a ba' Sisaèriyaè.
English: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.

Limbum: Sol aè m ku bii ce wápsi beèe ce a m ce duè aèmbuèu Tata Jisoès ená e be yúshi woweèe. E m duè a yá tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì,
English: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,

Limbum: a laa ená e fa ye ñwaè' tá e bo duè fa neè btu embe mndap mloâo aè rla' Daèmaskoès, e ka' duè yá beèe ce a ce jáèr njep nduunjïì Kraêis, káè yu mmbañruè á, káè yu bbyeèñge áè, e bo kur woweèe vúè aègho aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm tá a bo sa' woweèe.
English: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

Limbum: E ka' koni ñwaè' ce duè aègho duâ baè' aètútú, rraa li ku lo a bap embe buèu a suu mbe yeâ nduè.
English: As he traveled, it happened that he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

Limbum: E gwe aè nsheè a yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ ce laèa neè ye enáê, “Soêl, Soêl, aè ce jar neè máè njoká?”
English: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?

Limbum: E beesïì enáê, “Tataê, a wáè nda?” E laa enáê, “A máè Jisoès ce aè ce jar neè máè naè.
English: He said, Who are you, Lord? The Lord said, I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

Limbum: Naèti mbekïì du aè múè rla', tá a bo suñ wáè yuu ce aè be geèe.”
English: But rise up, and enter into the city, and you will be told what you must do.

Limbum: Beèe ce a woweèe a m ce duè, a m táá, a túr yuu laèa ka'. Woweèe a m yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ ce laèa, a ke' ce yá ñwáè ka'.
English: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

Limbum: Sol aè natïì enjep nsheè, a ka' múè'shi mmir, a ker ce yá buu ka'. A m koo ye aè rkoo a du aègho aè rla' Daèmaskoès.
English: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

Limbum: E m cu aè mnoâñ btaar, a yá yuu ka', a ye yuu ka', a no yuu ka'.
English: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ce e m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès aè m ba aè rla' Daèmaskoès, li rlii li ba ená AÈnaèniyaès. Tata Jisoès aè m laèa neè ye aè rloo enáê, “AÈnaèniyaès.” E beesïì enáê, “Tataê, a máè na.”
English: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, Ananias! He said, Behold, it's me, Lord.

Limbum: Tata Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Naèti du njep nduunjïì ce a too ená Kuèyáá naè, du mbe ndaèp mbe Judaès, laa ená wáâ koèñ aè ryá ñwáâ aè rla' Tasoès ce li rlii li yu ená Sol naè. E ce geèe rloo seè'ni na.
English: The Lord said to him, Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

Limbum: E ce geèe rloo wa'a, Nyúè aè gee e yá ñwáè moè' ce li rlii li yu ená AÈnaèniyaès aèmboè e vúè a niñ mbe ndaèp a lá mmbo mbe yeâ nduè tá e bo yá buu.”
English: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.

Limbum: AÈnaèniyaès aè beesïì enáê, “Tataê, máè yu' beèe a laèa buu magoèr se aèmboè ñwáè ca. Beèe a laèa aèmboè ku' buu bbebep ce e geèe neè yoè beâe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: But Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

Limbum: E yu aèfa seè'ni na wa'a, beèe ce a yu btu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a banïì fa ye ñger wáá ená e vú koo beèe ce a ce loo neè wáè, kur du aègho, fa mbe shañ.”
English: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.

Limbum: Tata Jisoès aè laa neè ye enáê, “Duè yo yu. E yu yaè ñwáè ce máè ce tá e bo suñ aèmboè la rlii neè beèe enje jáá, ba bkúú, ker ba boo Isráèl.
English: But the Lord said to him, Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

Limbum: Ku ba máè ce m be duèñshi ye ku' ñgá' ce e be yá njo' la rlii.”
English: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name's sake.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa' mïìsi, AÈnaèniyaès aè natïì a du a niñ mbe ndaèp, a lá mi mmbo mbenduè Soêl, a laa enáê, “Nfúraâ Soêl, Tata Jisoès ce e m yááti aè nduunjïì ce wáè m vúè njo, aè tuu máè ená m vú gee tá aè ker yá buu, ruusi neè Yú' Rara.”
English: Ananias departed, and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me, that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa' mïìsi, yuu mo' ce yi m ba aèmboè bbap nyor wa'a vi gweñgeèr ye enjep mmïìr njaè' moè'sir, e ker ká' a ce yá buu. E m naèti mbekïì, a baptïìr ye.
English: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

Limbum: E ka' ye byee mïìsi, yi ñger yi kútïì njo. E m cu aè rla' Daèmaskoès a beèe ce a m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès naè aè mú mnoèñ mo'.
English: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

Limbum: E m caèasi nfeè' ka'. E m niñ aè mndap mloo a ce feè'shi aèmboè Jisoès, a ce laèa enáê, “E yu muu Nyúè.”
English: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce a m yu', a m báèáñger seê, a laa enáê, “Mboè ñwáè ca yu ñwáè ce e m ce gheèter aè ryúshi beèe ce a m ce loo neè Jisoès aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm naè a? Mboè e vúè aèfa tá e bo keèr koshi ñgaâa rloo ca kur duè aègho duè fa neè beèe ce a yu btu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a?”
English: All who heard him were amazed, and said, Isn't this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè Soêl, e m ker misi a tap, a ce naèshi ená Jisoès aè m ba Kraâis anaè. Cena yi gee bfee vi jep Jus ce a m ce cu aè rla' Daèmaskoès.
English: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

Limbum: Mnoèñ vi ka' caèa aèñgoo, Jus a cuteè, a fa mntañ a ká' a ce roèo mi mkuèu.
English: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

Limbum: Beèe mo' a m suñ Sol ená beèe a ce roèo mi mkuèu. Woweèe a m ce keè'ni bcuâu ñka' neèmootïì ba neètú', tá a bo koo Sol yú.
English: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, yïì beèe ce a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu a lor ye neètú', a lá njep ma ñkaèa moè', a torsi njïû aè wenduè ñka', a suusi njep nsheè.
English: but his disciples took him by night, and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

Limbum: E ka' duâ baè' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a koñ aè rba a beèe ce a m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès naè aèbee. Woweèe wááwá a m wáp ye, njobeè' woweèe a m byemi ená e yu moè' efa múè beèe ce a m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès ka'.
English: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

Limbum: Geewa'a, Baènabaès aè m loèr ye a du aègho mbe múè ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès. E m suñ neè woweèe ená Sol aè yá Tata Jisoès aè nduunjïì, Tata aè laa neè ye. E m ker suñ woweèe ená Sol aè m feè'shi aè rlii Jisoès, neè ntee-ñwáè aè rla' Daèmaskoès
English: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

Limbum: Sol aè m ku ba aèbee a woweèe, a ce jáèr a woweèe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

Limbum: E m feè'shi aè rlii Jisoès neè ntee-ñwáè. E m de' a Jus ce a m ce laèa li Greêk, a sár mnsár a woweèe. Woweèe a m ce roèo aè ryú ye.
English: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

Limbum: Bfúr ca a ka' rïìñ wa'a, a lor ye a du aègho aè rla' Sisaèriyaè, a ma'shi ye, e natïì a du aè rla' Tasoès.
English: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him off to Tarsus.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a ñgaâa cor ce e m ba aè ñgoâñ Judaè wááwá, ker ba aè ñgoâñ Galeèle ba aè ñgoâñ Saèmarïìyaè a m cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè, a tap foñ. Woweèe a ka' ce wáp Tata Nyúè, Yú' Rara yi ce fa woweèe ñger foñ, cor aè ku' aè beèe.
English: So the assemblies throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' jáèr aè mú bdïì' jáá jáèá jáá, a nati a du aè rla' Lidaè foñ, tá e bo yá beèe Nyúè ce a m ba aèfo.
English: It happened, as Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

Limbum: E ka' baè', a yá ñwáè mo' ce li rlii li m ba ená AÈniyaès. Yïì ñgúè' nyor moè' aè m kwe, e noñ njep keèñ yañ aè bfeè' waami.
English: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa neè ye enáê, “AÈniyaès, Jisos Kraâis ce geèe tá aè bo luèñ; naèti mbekïì, kupshi wo bkuu.” E m naèti mbekïì njaè' moè'sir.
English: Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed! Immediately he arose.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce a m ce cu aè rla' Lidaè ba mbo' Sharoèn wááwá, a m yá ye, a beeñger a byemi neè Tata Jisoès.
English: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ce e m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès aè m ba aè rla' Jopaè. Li rlii li m ba ená Taèbitaè; mbuèu efa rlii anaè aè ba ená Ñgap. E m ce geèe buu bboèñboñ seê, a ba mmbo mtoo.
English: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated, means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

Limbum: E m loè a yañ, a kwe. A ka' suè'si ye, a lá mbe rum ndaèp yïì embekïì.
English: It happened in those days that she fell sick, and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

Limbum: Rla' Jopaè li ku ba aètútú rla' Lidaè. Beèe ce a m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès a ka' yu' ená Pitaè yu aè rla' Lidaè, woweèe a tuu beèe a mmbaa ená a du laa neè ye enáê, “Kyer wáè, vúè cárcár, vú yá weèr.”
English: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

Limbum: Pitaè aè natïì a du a woweèe. E ka' duâ baè', a lor ye a du aègho mbe rum ndap yïì embekïì naè. Byepkúú wááwá a m táá a yeâ geñ, a ce war, a ce duèñshi bcáè' njáèá jáá jáèá jáá ce Dokaès aè m tar aè nfeè' ce e m bii nteèe.
English: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

Limbum: Pitaè aè m fúr woweèe wááwá njepmbeè a gú'shi a loo; a karsi nyor a ke' gúâú ñwáè, a laa enáê, “Taèbitaè, naèti mbekïì.” E m múè' mi mmir a ka' yá Pitaè, a nati a cu mbekïì.
English: Peter put them all out, and kneeled down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, get up! She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ghashïì ye aè rkoo, a naa mbekïì, a ká' beèe Nyúè ker ba byepkúú, a fa ye neè woweèe nteèe.
English: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

Limbum: Beâe aè rla' Jopaè wááwá a m yu', beèe magoèr efa waâp mú a byemïì neè Tata Jisoès.
English: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

Limbum: E m cu aè rla' Jopaè aè mnoèñ aèñgoo a Saimúèn ñwáè yaati mñguâp nyaèa.
English: It happened, that he stayed many days in Joppa with one Simon, a tanner.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba aè rla' Sisaèriyaè ce li rlii li m ba ená Koèniyuès. E m ba tu neè kúr bsoogáè ce a m ba rjeèe. A m ce too kúr bsoogáè anaè ená bsoogáè enje Italeè.
English: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

Limbum: AÈ m ba ñwáè ce a yïì ndap aè m fa yaèp nyor neè Nyúè, a ker ce wáp ye foñ. E m ba mmbo mtoo neè beèe wááwá, a ce loo neè Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ mo', aèmboè aè nyúè taar neèmootïì, e yá yuu mo' aèmboè rlo wa'a. E m yá ncïìndap Nyúè boèñboñ se aèmboè e vúè, a niñ mbe ndaèp, a laa neè ye enáê, “Koèniyuès.”
English: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, Cornelius!

Limbum: Koèniyuès a ke' ye ená ntuñ-ñ-ñ, a kaêñ, a laa neè ye enáê, “Tataê, yu ká?” E laa neè ye enáê, “Nyúè aè yu' lo rloo, a yá ená aè yu mmbo mtoo, a ce kuushi wáè.
English: He, fastening his eyes on him, and being frightened, said, What is it, Lord? He said to him, Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

Limbum: Baná aè tuu beèe aè rla' Jopaè tá woweèe a du vúè neè Saimúèn ce li rlii mo' li yu ená Pitaè naè.
English: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is surnamed Peter.

Limbum: E ce cu a Saimúèn ñwáè yaati mñguâp nyaèa, ce yïì ndap yu aèwaâa rdip rgoèr naè.”
English: He lodges with one Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the seaside.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m laèa neè ye naè aè ka' duè, e ká' boo mfaè' embe yeâ ndaèp a baa ker ba ñwáè soogáè ce e m fa yïì nyor neè Nyúè, ce e m ba moè' efa beèe ce a m ce faè' neè ye.
English: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

Limbum: E ka' suñ woweèe buu wááwá, a tuu woweèe aè rla' Jopaè.
English: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, woweèe a ce duè, a ka' baè' aètútú, Pitaè aè ko' mbe tu ndap aèmboè aè nyúè ncoèp-baa wa'a, aè rgeèe rloo.
English: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

Limbum: E ka' ce loo, njeè aè ka' káè' ce yañ ye, e koñ aè rye yuu. A ka' ce fáèr byee neè ye, e yá njáèá rlo mo'.
English: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

Limbum: E m yá aèmboè rbuu li múè'ti, yuu mo' yi ce suèu embo aèmboè ma cáâ' báèbár wa'a, a ghashïì aè bcuèu kyeèe efa gho a suusi njep nsheè.
English: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

Limbum: Mnyaèa njáèá jáá jáèá jáá vi m ba njep cáè' anaè, ker ba buu moè' aèmboè mnyo, ba bbar, ba bsiñ.
English: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

Limbum: Njeèndoñ aè laa neè ye enáê, “Pitaè, naèti mbekïì, sháshi, ye.”
English: A voice came to him, Rise, Peter, kill and eat!

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa yi yu enáê, “Tataê, máè ka'. Máè m be ye ya yu yuu ce ncir yi kani ka'.”
English: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.

Limbum: Njeèndoñ ca aè ker laa neè ye enáê, “Nyúè aè ka' gee yuu yi ba rara, aè fa loèr yuu anaè aèmboè yuu ce yi raa ka' ka'.”
English: A voice came to him again the second time, What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.

Limbum: Ca yi m koni nfeè' taar, a lor yuu anaè njaè' moè'sir, a kúti aègho mbe buèu.
English: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' ce señ ená rlo ce e yá naè li ce laèa ba ená ká lá, beèe ce Koèniyuès aè m tuu naè a banïì vú a roo ndap yïì Saimúèn a yá, a táá njep cuèu ñka' ce a m sïìr ndap anaè aègho,
English: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon's house, stood before the gate,

Limbum: a bipshi ená, “Saimúèn ce li rlii mo' li yu ená Pitaè naè ce cu mbe ndaèp na a?”
English: and called and asked whether Simon, who was surnamed Peter, was lodging there.

Limbum: Pitaè aè m ku bii ce señ aèmboè rlo ce e m yá naè, Yú' yi laa neè ye enáê, “Yáê, beèe a mntaar a ce roèo wáè.
English: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, Behold, three men seek you.

Limbum: Naèti, suu njep nsheè. Fa wáp aè rduè weèe woweèe ka', njobeè' aè tuu máè a tuu woweèe.”
English: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.

Limbum: Pitaè aè suu a yá woweèe, a laa enáê, “A máè ñwáè ce weèe ce roèo naè. Weèe aè vúè aè rroèo máè ená ká?”
English: Peter went down to the men, and said, Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Koèniyuès ce e yu tu neè bsoogáè rjeèe, aè tuu weèr. E yu ñwáâ nyáánïì, a ce wáp Nyúè, Jus wááwá a ce laèa buu bboèñboñ kuu ye. Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' ce nrara aè laa neè ye ená e ká' wáè tá aè vú mbe yeâ ndaèp, tá e bo yu' yuu ce aè be laèa neè ye.”
English: They said, Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.

Limbum: E laêa, a woweèe a niñ mbe ndaèp a noêñ. Túè' aè ka' raa, e natïì a du a woweèe, bfúr moâ' aè rla' Jopaè a du a yeâ mbuèu.
English: So he called them in and lodged them. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

Limbum: Túè' moè' aè ka' keèr raa, woweèe a ba' aè rla' Sisaèriyaè. Koèniyuès aè m cu a ce keè' woweèe, a ká'shi beèe ce a woweèe a m raète, ba bkar vi vi mntee, woweèe a vú mbe yeâ ndaèp.
English: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' niñ, Koèniyuès aè konïì ye, a gwe njep yeâ tïìi a ca'ni ye aèmboè a ke caè'ni Nyúè naè.
English: When it happened that Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

Limbum: Pitaè aè naa ye mbekïì, a ce laèa neè ye enáê, “Naèti mbekïì, má máè foñ ku ba ñwáè aèmboè wáè.”
English: But Peter raised him up, saying, Stand up! I myself am also a man.

Limbum: E ka' ce de' a ye, a ye a niñ mbe ndaèp, e yá ku' beèe aèmboè a cu mbo.
English: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe rïìñ weená ncir yi yá'ni ená ñwáè ce e yu ñwáè Jus kar káè ca'ni ñwáè enje jáá ka'. Geewa'a, Nyúè aè geèe máè riñ máná aède' m ker lor ñwáè moè' aèmboè ñwáè ce aède' weèr ye buu efa rkar ka'.
English: He said to them, You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn't call any man unholy or unclean.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce wáè ka' tuu beèe ená a vú ká' máè, máè laa yuu mo' ka', a ku nati a ce vúè. M ce bipshi neè wáè ená wáè tuu beèe ená m vú gee ká lá.”
English: Therefore also I came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?

Limbum: Koèniyuès aè laa enáê, “Mnoèñ vi caèa seè'ni kyeèe ce máè mú ba mbe máâ ndaèp, aè nfeâ' seè'ni ce yu nyúè taar neèmootïì na, a ce loo. Ñwáè moè' aè ku lo a táá kuèntombïì neè máè, a yar bcáè' ce vi m ce raa seê,
English: Cornelius said, Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

Limbum: a laa enáê, ‘Koèniyuès, Nyúè aè yu' lo rloo a yá ená aè yu mmbo mtoo, a ce kuushi wáè.
English: and said, 'Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

Limbum: Baná aè tuu beèe aè rla' Jopaè tá woweèe a du vúè neè Saimúèn ce li rlii mo' li yu ená Pitaè naè. E ce cu mbe ndaèp mbe Saimúèn ñwáè yaati mñguâp nyaèa, ndap anaè aè ba aèwaâa rdip rgoèr.’
English: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is surnamed Peter. He lodges in the house of Simon a tanner, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.'

Limbum: Máè caèasi nfeè' ka', a tuu beèe ená a vú ká' wáè. Wáè geèe yuu boèñboñ seê, a vúê. Weèr yu mbena seè'ni aè bsii Nyúè, tá weèr bo yu' yuu ce Tata aè laèa neè wáè ená aè laa neè weèr.”
English: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.

Limbum: Pitaè aè laa enáê, “Máè rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená Nyúè e ke loèr ñwáè moè' jáá ka'.
English: Peter opened his mouth and said, Truly I perceive that God doesn't show favoritism;

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' ce wáp Nyúè, ce geèe yuu ce yi yu yáánïì, káè ñgaèñ yu ñwáâ aè to' efá áè, baná Nyúè be koo ye mmbo mmbaa.
English: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ntuu ce Nyúè aè m cep neè beâe aè to' Isráèl, a ce suñ beèe Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè cumúnyañ ce e ce loè ese ye njïì enjep Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Tata neè beèe wááwá.
English: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ--he is Lord of all--

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ yuu ce yi m koni aè ñgoâñ Judaè wááwá. Yi m káâ' aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, rfeè'shïì ce Joân aè m ce feè'shi tá e bo baèptir beèe naè li m banïì caa wáá.
English: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

Limbum: Yi m ba ená Nyúè aè m suèusi Yú' Rara mbe tu Jisoès, a ce ye, a fa ye ñger. E m duè aè bdïì' wááwá a ce geèe buu bboèñboñ a ce geèe beèe wááwá ce nyúèrkaè' aè m túr ñger mbe waâp nduè a ce luèñ, njobeè' Nyúè aè m ba a ye.
English: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

Limbum: Weèr aè m yá buu wááwá ce e m geèe aè bbu' mla' aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm neè mer mmir. Woweèe a m yú ye, a m káèti ye ba mbe ce, e kweê.
English: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

Limbum: Geewa'a, mnoèñ vi ka' baâ' btaar, Nyúè aè fúr ye efa rkwe, a gee e yáátïì aèwañ.
English: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,

Limbum: E m yááti neè beèe wááwá ka'. E m yááti ba neè weèr ce Nyúè aè m ce ená weèr suñ beèe aèmboè ye, weèr aè ba beèe ce weèr aè m yeñger a ker noñger aèbee weèr woweèe aè nfeè' ce e m fúú efa rkwe.
English: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

Limbum: E m fa rsa' neè weèr ená weèr fe'shi neè beèe, suñ beèe ená yu ye ce Nyúè aè m ce ená e ba ñwáè ce e be keè sa' beèe ce a cu bteèe ker ba beèe ce a m kweñger.
English: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè wááwá a m laèa aèmboè ye, a suñ beèe ená ñwáè ce e ka' byemi, baná Nyúè be foèosi ñgaèñ efa yïì buu bbebep a yeâ rlii.”
English: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' kuè bii ce laèa, Yú' Rara yi suu mbenduè beèe wááwá ce a m yu' blaèa ca.
English: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

Limbum: Ñgaâa rbyemïì efa múè beèe ce a m geèe búè ce a m vúè a Pitaè weèe naè, a m báèáñger se njobeè' Nyúè aè m suèusi yi Yú' mbenduè beèe enje jáá foñ.
English: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

Limbum: Woweèe a m yu' aèmboè woweèe a ce laèa bli ce woweèe a m yá'ni ka', a ce ku'si Nyúè. Pitaè aè laêa enáê,
English: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

Limbum: “Beèe ca a koni Yú' Rara aèmboè see seèe aè m koni naè. AÈde' ñwáè moè' kanïì ená a fa baèptir woweèe ka' a?”
English: Can any man forbid the water, that these who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we should not be baptized?

Limbum: E m laèa ená a baptir woweèe aè rlii Jisos Kraêis. A ka' baèptir woweèe, woweèe a laa neè ye ená e cu a woweèe aè mú mnoâñ mo'.
English: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ker ba bfúr ce a m ba aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a m yu' ená beèe enje jáá a yu' blaâa Nyúè a byemi.
English: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' duè Jáèrusaláèm, beèe ce a m ce laèa ená ñwáè gee búè ka' ba ñwáè rbyemïì naè, a lapnïì Pitaè,
English: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

Limbum: a laa neè ye enáê, “Wáè niñ aè mndap beèe ce a geèe búè ka', a yeñger weèe woweèe njoká?”
English: saying, You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!

Limbum: Pitaè aè lor nfeè' a nashi yuu ce e m geèe anaè neè woweèe boèñboñ seê, a laa enáê,
English: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

Limbum: “Máè m ba aè rla' Jopaè a ce geèe rloo a yá njáèá rlo mo'. Máè m yá aèmboè yuu mo' yi ce suèu embe buèu aèmboè ma cáâ' báèbár wa'a, a ghashïì aè bcuèu kyeèe efa gho a suusi njep nsheè. Yi m suèu a máâ geñ.
English: I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' ca, a ker túr yuu laèa ka', a ku'si Nyúè, a ce laèa enáê, “Baná Nyúè aè maè'shi foñ ená beèe enje jáá a kupse, ma' yaèp buu bbebep tá a bo koni ryoèñ.”
English: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!

Limbum: Beèe ce a m da'se njobeè' a m yú Stáfaèn, ñgá' aè konïì cor naè, a m duè aè bdïì' jáá jáèá jáá. Beèe mo' a m duè aè ñgoâñ Foènishaè, beèe mo' a du aè to' Saiproès, beèe mo' a du aè rla' Antïìyoèk. Woweèe a m duè aè bdïì' ca wa'a, a ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè ba neè Jus caè'caè'.
English: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

Limbum: Geewa'a, beèe mo' efa waâp mú ce a m ba beâe aè to' Saiproès ba rla' Saèiren a m baè' aè rla' Antïìyoèk a fe'shi blaâa Nyúè neè beèe enje jáá foñ. Woweèe a m feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Tata Jisoès neè beèe anaè.
English: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

Limbum: Ñger Nyúè yi m ba a woweèe, beèe magoèr a byemïì neè Tataê, a kupse, a ma' yaèp buu bbebep.
English: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

Limbum: Nsuñ aè m niñ mbaè btuè' ñgaâa cor ce a m ba aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, woweèe a tuu Baènabaès ená e du aè rla' Antïìyoèk.
English: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

Limbum: E ka' duè baè' yá rboèñ Nyúè a waâp mú, a lu'shi, a tapse woweèe, a laa neè woweèe neè ñger-ñwáè ená woweèe a ku ce yu'ni neè Tata neè nteâe mo'sir.
English: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

Limbum: E m tapse beèe anaè wa'a njobeè' e m ba ñwáâ mboèñmboñ, a ruusi neè Yú' Rara, a byemi seê. Ku' beèe magoèr a m byemi neè Tataê.
English: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Baènabaès aè natïì a du aè rla' Tasoès aè rroèo Soêl.
English: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

Limbum: A ka' yá ye, a lor ye a vú aègho aè rla' Antïìyoèk. Woweèe a m cu a ñgaâa cor weèe aè feè' bïìi, a yá'ni beèe magoèr seê. A m káè' a too ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès ená ñgaâa rbyemïì ba aè rla' Antïìyoèk.
English: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. It happened, that for a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè mnoèñ anaè, ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a du aè rla' Antïìyoèk.
English: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

Limbum: Moè' efa woweèe ce a m ce too li rlii ená AÈgaboès aè m naèti mbekïì, a laa aè ñger Yú' rara ená njeè be koo aè ñgoèñ wááwá. Ca yi m koni aè nfeè' ce Klaâdïìyoès aè m ce sa' beèe naè.
English: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a m kaè'ni ená ñwáè wááwá be fa aèmboè yi ñger yi yu, tá a tuusi rfa anaè neè bfúr aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, jaè' woweèe aègho.
English: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

Limbum: Woweèe a m geèe wa'a, a tuusi rfa anaè neè Baènabaès ba Soêl, ená woweèe a du fa neè btu embe coêr.
English: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè ñkúú Hároèd aè koo ñgaâa cor mo' a ce fa woweèe ñgá'.
English: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

Limbum: E m yú Jáms ce e m ba nfúr Joân neè kaèafaè'.
English: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

Limbum: E ka' yá ená e geèe wa' nyor aè boñ Juês, e koo Pitaè foñ. Ca yi m koni aè nfeè' ce a m ce ye Ñkaâ' bráâd ce a láè yes njo ka'.
English: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

Limbum: E ka' koo ye, a fa ye mbe shañ. E m fa ye mbaè mmbo bsoogáè ce a m ba bkúr kyeèe, bsoogáè a ba mbe kúr e mo'sir beèe ñkyeèe, a ce keè'ni ye. E m ce kwaè'shi ená a be ye Ñkaâ' caèasi-mndap tá e ka' fúr ye, sa' aè múè beèe.
English: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

Limbum: E m ku lá Pitaè mbe shañ; yi ka' ba wa'a, ñgaâa cor a ce loo neè ye neè mini- ñwáè.
English: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba neètú' ce túè' be raa tá Hároèd fúr ye embe shañ sa' naè, Pitaè aè noñ mbetar bsoogáè a baa, a cúú ye neè bkwaâñ bbaa aè mkoo. Bsoogáè ce a m ce keè'ni shañ a m táá aè cuâu ñka' shañ.
English: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

Limbum: Ka' cu ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè nyáêá, rraa li raa mbe múè shañ; e lipshïì Pitaè neè bo aè gee nyor, a yáá ye efa mmirloè a laa enáê, “Naèti mbekïì cárcár.” Bkwaèñ caè vi m gweèñger efa yeâ mkoo.
English: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side, and woke him up, saying, Stand up quickly! His chains fell off from his hands.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Kupshi wo bcáè', yar wo blaba'.” Pitaè aè gee wa'a. E ker laa neè ye enáê, “Yar wo mñgaèbúlaè, vú a máâ mbuèu.”
English: The angel said to him, Get dressed and put on your sandals. He did so. He said to him, Put on your cloak, and follow me.

Limbum: Pitaè aè fúú a du a yeâ mbuèu a ke' riñ ená yuu ce ncïìndap Nyúè aè m geèe anaè yi m ba mini ka'. E m kwaè'shi ená e ku yá yá.
English: And he went out and followed him. He didn't know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' caèa bsoogáè ce a m táá entoèmbïì ker ba beèe embenjïì mo, a ba' aè cuèu ñka' bkwaèñ ce a caèa mbo niñ ba aè múè la', yi mú'tïì neè yi bo, woweèe a fúêú, a ka' ce jáèr njep nduunjïì mo', ncïìndap Nyúè aè ma'shïì ye kaâñ mo'sir, a duê.
English: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out, and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

Limbum: Bfee Pitaè vi ka' kúti mbo, e laa enáê, “Máè rïìñ seè'ni neè mini-ñwáè ená Tata aè tuusi yïì ncïìndap e fúr máè embaè mmbo Hároèd, a ker fúr máè efa ñgá' ce Jus a m ce keè' ená e ba koni máè.”
English: When Peter had come to himself, he said, Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ka' rïìñ wa'a, a nati a du mbe ndaèp mbe Máèári, ma yïì Joân. A m ce too rlii Joân mo' ená Maêk. Beèe magoèr a m kaari mbo a ce geèe rloo.
English: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose surname was Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

Limbum: E ka' kuèushi keèñ enjep mbeè, muunje ce e m ce faè' mbe ndaèp anaè ce a m ce too ye ená Rudaè, a yu' a vú aè ryu'shi ená ce kuèu nda lá.
English: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a maid named Rhoda came to answer.

Limbum: E ka' yu' njeèndoñ Pitaè, rïìñ, a lu'shi seê, a mú' keèñ ka', a cañ a kúti ba mbe ndaèp, a laa enáê, “Pitaè táá njep ncuâu ñka'.”
English: When she recognized Peter's voice, she didn't open the gate for joy, but ran in, and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa neè ye enáê, “Tu yi kar wáè embo.” Muu anaè aè laa tatap se ená yi yu mini wa'a. Woweèe a laa enáê, “Yu ncïìndap Nyúè ce e ke keè'ni Pitaè.”
English: They said to her, You are crazy! But she insisted that it was so. They said, It is his angel.

Limbum: Pitaè aè ku ce kuèushi keèñ; woweèe a ka' múè', a yá ye, a bááñger seê.
English: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.

Limbum: E ka' naèa bo mbekïì ená woweèe a cu múnyañ, a suñ woweèe aèmboè Tata aè fúr ye embe shañ. E ka' mïìsi, a laa enáê, “Suñ neè buu ca neè Jáêms, ba bfúr mo' ce a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì.” E laa wa'a, a fúú, a du aè dïû' mo'.
English: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, Tell these things to James, and to the brothers. Then he departed, and went to another place.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, bjep vi ba aè múè bsoogáè se njobeè' woweèe a m rïìñ yuu ce yi m koni Pitaè ka'.
English: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

Limbum: Hároèd aè ka' roèo ye yá ka', a bipshi neè bsoogáè ce a m ce keè'ni ye naè. E ka' bipshi riñ dïì' e yu ka', a laa ená a yúshi woweèe. E ka' laèa wa'a, a natïû aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè a du aè rla' Sisaèriyaè, a cu aèfo.
English: When Herod had sought for him, and didn't find him, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

Limbum: Ntee yi m yañ Hároèd neè beâe aè rla' Tayaè ba Sidoèn woweèe a natïì aèbee a du aè ryá ye. Woweèe a ka' duè baè', a loo Blaâstoès ce e m ba ncïìndap embe nto', a du a yá ñkúú a laa neè ye ená a woweèe a nashi buu, cu neè cumúnyañ- ñwáè. A m laèa wa'a njobeè' yap to' yi m ce koni byee ba ese to' yïû ñkúú anaè.
English: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king's personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king's country for food.

Limbum: Noèñ ce woweèe a m láè yi ka' gháá, Hároèd aè yar bcáâ' kúú a cu mbe kaèbaèraè', a laa neè woweèe.
English: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

Limbum: Woweèe a m fuñ enáê, “Cena yu ba njeèndoñ Nyúè, a yïì ñwáè ka'.”
English: The people shouted, The voice of a god, and not of a man!

Limbum: A ka' laèa wa'a, ncïìndap Tata Nyúè aè túú ye neè yañ kaâñ moè'sir njobeè' e m kuè'si Nyúè ka'; mghoèghoè mi ye ye, e kweê.
English: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn't give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.

Limbum: Blaâa Nyúè vi m duè kuèntombïì, beèe magoèr aè yu' a byemi.
English: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

Limbum: Baènabaès ba Sol a ka' mïìsi yuu ce woweèe a m duè aè rgeèe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, a kúti. A ka' ce kúti, a lor Joèn Maêk.
English: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John whose surname was Mark.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ryá'nïì ba ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè ce a m ba mbe cor aè rla' Antïìyoèk, aè m ba Baènabaès ba Simïìyoèn ce a m ce too ená Ñwáâ Nsii, ker ba Lushoâs aè rla' Saèireên, ba Manáèn ce e m kuè' a Hároèd ce e m be sa' njeptii ñwáâ ñgoèr, ba Soêl.
English: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce loo neè Tataê, ce jïì mdip ce geèe rloo, Yú' Rara yi laa enáê, “Fúr neè Baènabaès ba Sol efa weâe mú, tá a bo geèe rfaè' ce máè fúr woweèe ená a geêe.”
English: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' jïì mdip, ce geèe rloo wáá, a lá map mmbo mbe waâp nduè, a ma'shi woweèe, woweèe a duê.
English: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

Limbum: Yú' Rara yi ka' tuu woweèe, woweèe a natïì a du aè rla' Sáèlushaè, a loâ aèfo a niñ mbe keñ a du aè to' Saiproès.
English: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè baè' aè rla' Saèlamïìs, a fe'shi blaâa Nyúè aè mndap rloo Juês. Joân aè m ba a woweèe, tá e bo ce jaè' woweèe.
English: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. They had also John as their attendant.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' jáèr aè to' ca wááwá, baè' aè rla' Pafoès, a yá ñwáè fii moè' ce a m ce too ená Baâajisoès. E m ba ñwáè Jus ce e m ce bo' beèe ená e yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,

Limbum: E m ce faè' neè govanoè ce a m ce too ená Saèjoès Poloès. AÈ m ba ñwáè ce e m túr bfee seê. E m tuu beèe ená a du ká' Baènabaès ba Soêl, njobeè' e m koèñ aè ryu' blaâa Nyúè.
English: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

Limbum: Ñwáè fii anaè ce a m ce too aè li Greâk ená Álemaès, aè jepsïì woweèe, a koñ ená govanoè byemi blaèa ce woweèe a m feè'shi aèmboè Jisoès naè ka'.
English: But Elymas the sorcerer for so is his name by interpretation withstood them, seeking to turn aside the proconsul from the faith.

Limbum: Sol ce a m ce too ená Pol foñ naè, aè ka' ruu neè Yú' Rara, a ke' ye a laa enáê,
English: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,

Limbum: “Wáè ce aè yu muu nyúèrkaè', a baa buu wááwá ce vi yu yáánïì, a ba ñwáè ye kïìñgaè, a ba ñwáè mbo'ni a misïî, aâ koèñ aè rborni efa rjepsi mini Tata ce e yu kuèyáá na ka' njoká?
English: and said, Full of all deceit and all cunning, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

Limbum: Yáê, Tata be fa wáè ñgá'. AÈ be feèp, keèr yá rlir nyúè ka' aè mú nfeè' moè'.” E ka' laèa wa'a, mbaè' aè tar ye aè mmïìr njaè' moè'sir, mmir mi sii ye, e ká' a ce roèo ñwáè ce e be ghashi ye aè rkoo duè aègho.
English: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season! Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

Limbum: Govanoè aè ka' yá yuu ce yi koni, a byemi yuu ce Sol aè m laèa. E m báèá ryá'nïì ce a m yá'ni du kuu Tata na seê.
English: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

Limbum: Pol ba beèe ce a woweèe a m ce jáèr, a m naètïû aè rla' Pafoès a niñ mbe keñ a du aè rla' Págaè aè ñgoâñ Paèmfilïìyaè. A ka' baè', Joân aè ma'shïì woweèe a kúti aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' naètïû aè rla' Págaè a du a ba' aè rla' Antïìyoèk aè ñgoâñ Pïìsidïìyaè. AÈ ka' ba nyúè mmbomntaa Juês, woweèe a niñ mbe ndaèp rloo a cu aè nsheè.
English: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.

Limbum: Beèe embe ndaèp rloo a ka' beè' embe ñwaâ' mncir keèr beè' embe ñwaâ' ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, beèe ce a m ba btu embe ndaèp rloo a tuu ñwáè ená e laa neè woweèe enáê, “Bfúr weêr, weèe aè ka' túr ncep moè' aè rfa neè beèe, weèe fa.”
English: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.

Limbum: Pol aè natïì mbekïì, a naa bo mbekïì a laa enáê, “Yaè beèe Isráèl ker ba weèe ce weèe ce wáp Nyúè, yu' neè yuu ce m be laèa.
English: Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

Limbum: Nyúè beèe Isráèl ca aè m ce viseèe btaê, a gee ñgúè yïìseèe beèe aè ku' aè nfeè' ce woweèe a m ba bkïìloè aè to' Ijïìp. Nyúè aè m fúr woweâe aè to' anaè aè yi ñger,
English: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

Limbum: a ku ba a woweèe aè rïìñ aè bfeè' mñkyeèe a ce kur ntee neè woweèe aèfo.
English: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

Limbum: E ka' yúshi beâe aè bto' saèamba ce vi m ba aè ñgoâñ Kánaèn, a fa ñgoèñ anaè aè bti' neè yïì beèe,
English: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.

Limbum: aèmboè aè bfeè' mjeèe kyeèe ba nto'. AÈ ka' ba embenjïì ca, e fa woweèe ñgaâa nsa' mnsa', woweèe a sa' caar a ba' mbe nfeè' yïì Saâmwáèl ce e m ba ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè.
English: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' yïì Saâmwáèl, woweèe a laa ená Nyúè fa woweèe ñkúú, Nyúè aè fa woweèe Sol ce e m ba muu Kïîsh, ce e m ba ñwáè embe ntáè' yïì Bánjamáèn. E m sa' kúú aè bfeè' mñkyeèe.
English: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' suèusi ye embe kúú, a ce Dávïìd aè yaèp ñkúú. E m laèa yuu a kuu ye enáê, ‘Máè yá Dávïìd muu Jásïì e ba ñwáè ce e ghááte aè ñwáè ce e be geèe buu wááwá ce m koèñ.’
English: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, 'I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.'

Limbum: Yu ba embe ndúè' ñwáè ca ce Nyúè aè fúr ñwáè ce e be geèe beèe a luêñ, a fa neè beèe Isráèl aèmboè e m kaè' woweèe. Ñwáè rluèñ ca yu Jisoès.
English: From this man's seed, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

Limbum: Tá e ka' keè vúè, Joân aè m feè'shi neè beèe Isráèl wááwá ená woweèe a kupse, ma'shi yaèp buu bbebep tá a baptir woweèe.
English: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

Limbum: Joân aè ka' ce mïìsi li rfaè', a laa enáê, ‘Weèe ce kwaè'shi ená a máè ñwáè anaè a? A máè ye ka'. Ñwáè moè' ce vúè embe máâ njïì, aè ba ñwáè ce máè ghááte aè rbaè'shi vi blaba' ka'.’
English: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, 'What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.'

Limbum: “Bfúr waê, beèe embe ndúè' Abraèham ker ba weèe ce weèe ce wáp Nyúè, a tuusi nsuñ rluèñ ca ba neè seèe.
English: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

Limbum: Beâe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm ker ba beèe ce a ce sa' woweèe a rïìñ njáèá ñwáè ce Jisoès yu ka'. A m beè' blaâa Nyúè ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m sañ aè mmbomntaa Nyúè wááwá, woweèe a yu' a riñ vi ka'. AÈmboè yi yu wa' naè, yuu ce a m beè' anaè yi m ku ghááte mbe nfeè' ce a m sa' vi mnsa' a teni ená a yú ye naè.
English: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn't know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

Limbum: Ka' woweèe a m túr yuu mo' ce aède' a m ba noñ mbenjïì mo, yú ye ka' wa'a, woweèe a m laèa neè Pailáèt ená a yú ye.
English: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' geèe buu wááwá ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená a be keè geèe neè ye naè, a suusi ye embe ce, a lá njep rsheè.
English: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.

Limbum: Geewa'a, Nyúè aè m fúr ye efa rkwe,
English: But God raised him from the dead,

Limbum: e yáátïì neè beèe ce a woweèe a m jáâr aè ñgoâñ Galeèleê, a du a ba' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm naè, aè mnoèñ aèñgoo. Woweèe a ce suñ yïìseèe beèe seè'ni aèmboè ye.
English: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

Limbum: Weèr aè vúè aèfa aè rsuñ weèe Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ená Nyúè aè fúr Jisoès efa rkwe. Baná yuu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be geèe neè viseèe bta naè,
English: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

Limbum: e geèe yuu anaè ba neè seèe ce seèe yu boo wap. Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe bkúèkúâ bbaa embe Ñwaâ' Byáá. A sañ mbo enáê, ‘AÈ yu muu waè, káâ' ntïìni, m yu yo taê.’
English: that God has fulfilled the same to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, 'You are my Son. Today I have become your father.'

Limbum: Ca yu yuu ce Nyúè aè m laa aèmboè rfúú ce yi m ba ená e be keè fúú efa kwe keèr duè mbaè yir búète ka' naè. E m laèa enáê, ‘M be fa wáè buu brara ce máè m kaè' neè Dávïìd, rtarnïì li ba njo ka' naè.’
English: Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: 'I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.'

Limbum: Pol ba Baènabaès a ka' ce fúú embe ndaèp rloo, beèe anaè a bu' mmbo neè woweèe ená woweèe a ker vú aè mmbomntaa Nyúè ekoâ ker suñ woweèe buu anaè.
English: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' fúúse ce duèse, Jus magoèr se ker ba beèe mo' enje jáá ce a m byemi neè Nyúè Juês, a du aèmbuèu Pol ba Baènabaès. Pol ba Baènabaès a de' a woweèe, a fa woweèe ñger ená woweèe a ku ce yu' ba ese Nyúè tá e be túr ntee boèñboñ neè woweèe.
English: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè mmbomntaa Nyúè ekoâ, to' bïìi yi ku roèo fúú wááwá aè ryu' blaâa Nyúè.
English: The next Sabbath almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

Limbum: Jus a ka' yá ku' beèe ca, a ko'ndoñ, a sár yuu ce Pol aè m laèa, a cáp ye.
English: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
