Limbum: Pol ba Baènabaès a ker laa neè ñger-ñwáè enáê, “Yi m ba yáánïì ená weèr fe'shi blaâa Nyúè neè weèe entombïì. AÈmboè weèe aè kani a lor ená weèe aè ghááte aè rkoni ryoèñ ce nfeseè ka' na, baná weèr be maè'shi weèe, feè'shi ba neè beèe enje jáá.
English: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, It was necessary that God's word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

Limbum: Ca yu ba yuu ce Tata Nyúè aè laèa neè weèr enáê, ‘Máè geèe wáè, wáè ba rraa neè beèe enje jáá, tá aè bo ba nduunjïû rluèñ neè ñgoèñ wááwá.’ ”
English: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, 'I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.'

Limbum: Beèe enje jáá a ka' yu' ca, a lu'shi seê, a ku'si Tata aè vi blaèa. Beèe ce Nyúè aè m ce ená a bo koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè a m byemi.
English: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

Limbum: Blaâa Tata vi m duè aè ñgoèñ anaè wááwá.
English: The Lord's word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

Limbum: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Jus a m barsi bbyeèñge ñgaâa mlii ce a m ce loo neè Nyúè ker ba mmbañruè ce a m ba beâe bgoèrgoâr aè rla' anaè, woweèe a fa ñgá' neè Pol ba Baènabaès, a juu woweèe efa yap ñgoèñ.
English: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

Limbum: Pol weèe a ka' ce duè, a kashi nfúènfú efa map mkuèu neè woweèe, a du aè rla' IÌkonïìyoèm.
English: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m byemi neè Jisoès aè rla' Antïìyoèk a m ku lu'shi seê, a ruu neè Yú' Rara.
English: The disciples were filled with joy with the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' aè rla' IÌkonïìyoèm, a niñ mbe ndap rloo Jus aèmboè a m niñ aè rla' Antïìyoèk naè, a fe'shi boèñboñ seê. Jus magoèr seê, ker ba beèe enje jáá a byemïì.
English: It happened in Iconium that they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

Limbum: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Jus ce a m byemi ka', a m barsi beèe enje jáá, a karsi wap btu, a gee woweèe a baa bfúr.
English: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

Limbum: Pol weèe a m loèr nfeè' a cu aèfo a ce feè'shi aèmboè Tataê, neè ntee-ñwáè. Tata aè m fa woweèe ñger, woweèe a duñshïì mncoèo, a gee buu bbáèá aè rduèñshi ená yuu ce woweèe a m ce feè'shi aèmboè rboâñ Nyúè yi yu mini.
English: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

Limbum: Beâe aè rla' anaè a m fúú nto'nïì baa, beèe mo' a du aè ñgúè' yïì Juês, beèe mo' a du aè ñgúè' yïì ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès.
English: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

Limbum: Beèe enje jáá ba Juês, ker ba beèe ce a m ba btu neè woweèe, a kwa'shïì a byemi ená a be jar neè ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès, túúshi woweèe neè bluèr.
English: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu', a cañ a du a ñgoâñ Lïìkonïìyaè, a ka' baè', a du aè rla' Listraè ba Dábeè, ba mla' ce mi m ba aègee mla' ca,
English: they became aware of it, and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

Limbum: a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèfo.
English: There they preached the Good News.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m ba aè rla' Listraè ce e m kepñger. E m ku ba wa'a ká' embe nfeè' ce a m bi ye. E m be jár ka'.
English: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked.

Limbum: E m yu' aèmboè Pol ce laèa. Pol aè ke' ye a yá ená e túr njáèá rbyemïì ce aède' li gee ye e jáêr.
English: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

Limbum: E ka' yá wa'a, a laa mbekïì enáê, “Naèti, táá mbekïì.” Ñwáè anaè a nyáá mbekïì, a ká' a ce jáèr.
English: said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet! He leaped up and walked.

Limbum: Kúr beèe a ka' yá yuu ce Pol aè m geèe na, a waa, a laa aè li Lïìkonïìyaè enáê, “Mnyúè vi kúti aèmboè beèe wa'a, a vú fa seâe mú.”
English: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!

Limbum: Woweèe a m too Baènabaès ená Siyuès, a too Pol ená Hámáè, njobeè' a ye ce e m ce laèa yi buu goèr.
English: They called Barnabas Jupiter, and Paul Mercury, because he was the chief speaker.

Limbum: Ndap Siyuès aè m ba aègee rla'. Ñwáè tañshi tañshïì neè nyúè anaè aè vú neè naè' ba fúèlawaè njep cuâu ñka' njobeè' ye ker ba yïì beèe a m ce koèñ aè rtañshi tañshïì neè ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès.
English: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

Limbum: Baènabaès ba Pol a ka' yu' yuu ce beèe ca a m ce roèo aè rgeèe neè woweèe, a shashi wap bcáè', a cañ a niñ mbe waâp mú, a laa mbekïì enáê,
English: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes, and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

Limbum: “Yeèr beèe, weèe ce geèe wa' njoká? Weèr yu beèe aèmboè weèe. Weèr aè vúè aè rfeè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè weèe tá weèe bo maè'shi buu bcicïì ca, byemi ba neè Nyúè ce e yu nteèe, aè ba Nyúè ce e m boo rbuu ba nshe ba mdip ker ba buu wááwá.
English: Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky and the earth and the sea, and all that is in them;

Limbum: Ka' woweèe a m laèa buu ca wa'a, woweèe a m loèr nfeè' se aè rgeèe ená beèe ca a borni efa rtañshi tañshïì neè woweèe.
English: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

Limbum: Jus mo' a lo a vúâ aè rla' Antïìyoèk ba IÌkonïìyoèm, a ka' beèesi mntee ese beèe, a woweèe bsïìp a túúshïì Pol neè bluèr, a ka' kwaè'shi ená e kwe, a súñ aè nsheè a fúú aègho efa laè'.
English: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

Limbum: Ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a ka' vúè mbe yeâ nduè, e natïì mbekïì a kúti aè múè rla'. Túè' aè ka' raa, a Baènabaès a natïì a du aè rla' Dábeè.
English: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

Limbum: Woweèe a m feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aè rla' anaè, a gee beèe magoèr a byemïì, a ba ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès. A ka' mïìsi, a kúti a caa rla' Listraè ba IÌkonïìyoèm, a ba' aè rla' Antïìyoèk aè ñgoâñ Pïìsidïìyaè.
English: When they had preached the Good News to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

Limbum: Woweèe a m fa ñger neè ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisos aè mla' anaè, a ce laèa neè woweèe ená woweèe a táá tatap njep rbyemïì. A m laèa enáê, “Seèe be kuè yá ñgá' wáá ka' niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè.”
English: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce btu embe cor neè bcor wááwá aè mla' anaè, a ce loo ce jïì mdip, ce fa woweèe mbaè mmbo Tata ce woweèe a m byemi neè ye naè.
English: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' caèa ñgoâñ Pïìsidïìyaè, a ba' aè ñgoâñ Paèmfilïìyaè,
English: They passed through Pisidia, and came to Pamphylia.

Limbum: a fe'shi blaèa Tata aè rla' Págaè, a nati a du aè rla' AÈtalïìyaè.
English: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

Limbum: Woweèe a natïû aèfo, a niñ mbe keñ a du aè rla' Antïìyoèk, faèdïì' ce a m fa woweèe mbaè mmbo Nyúè tá Nyúè bo keè'ni woweèe, tá woweèe a gee rfaè' ce woweèe a m geèe a misi naè.
English: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè', a ká' ñgaâa cor wááwá, a suñ woweèe buu ce woweèe a m geèe aè ñger Nyúè. A m suñ woweèe aèmboè Nyúè aè fa fáñ neè beèe enje jáá aè rbyemïì.
English: When they had arrived, and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

Limbum: Woweèe a m cu aèfo a ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisos weèe aè nfeè' njïìsaèp.
English: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a m loâ Juèdiyaè a vú a ce yá'ni bfúr enáê, “A ka' tá geèe weèe búè aèmboè ncir Musïìs yi laèa ka', aède' weèe konïì rluèñ ka'.”
English: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can't be saved.

Limbum: Ca yi m geèe Pol ba Baènabaès a ba aè yuu yi mo'sir a woweèe ka' koo múcaèr, a sár nsár a woweèe. Yi ka' ba wa'a, ñgaâa cor a ce Pol ba Baènabaès, ba beèe mo', ená a du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, yá ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ba btu embe cor ená a woweèe a seesi yuu ce a be geèe.
English: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and some others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

Limbum: Cor aè ka' tuu woweèe wa'a, woweèe a du a caa aè ñgoâñ Foènishaè ba Saèmarïìyaè, a suñ beèe ená beèe enje jáá a kupse, a byemi neè Nyúè. Nsuñ ca aè m geèe bfúr wááwá a lu'shïì seê.
English: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' baè' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, cor ba ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ker ba btu embe cor a konïì woweèe. Pol weèe a suñ woweèe buu ce Nyúè a geèe njïì enjep woweèe.
English: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported all things that God had done with them.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa múè Farïìsi ce a m byemi, a m natïì mbekïì a laa enáê, “Yi yu ená beèe enje jáá a ku túr aè rgeèe búè, tá a ker suñ woweèe ená woweèe a lá mncir Musïìs.”
English: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ba btu embe cor a m cute, tá a bo seèesi yuu ce a be geèe.
English: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' loèr ku' nfeè', seèesi yuu ce a be geèe, Pitaè aè natïì mbekïì a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Bfúr waê, weèe rïìñ ená aè m ba efa rkáè', Nyúè aè ce máè tá beèe enje jáá a bo yu' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ eku máâ cuèu, byemi.
English: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News, and believe.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e rïìñ yuu ce yi yu njep ntee ñwáè wááwá aè m duèñshi ená e m koo woweèe aè njáèá njïì ce e fa Yú' Rara neè woweèe aèmboè e m fa neè seèe foñ naè.
English: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

Limbum: E m ker yá woweèe a ba jáá efa seèe ka'. E m geèe wap mntee vi ba brara foñ njo' lap rbyemïì.
English: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njoká seè'ni ce weèe ce koèñ aè rmoèoshi Nyúè aè njáèá njïì ce weèe ce láè ntáèr mbenduè ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès, ce ka' weèr káè wer bta áè, a m túr ñger aè rbyáè' ka'.
English: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

Limbum: Seèe aè byemi ená yu ba njo' ntee boèñboñ Tata Jisoès ce seèe be keè luèñ aèmboè woweèe a be keè luèñ njo' li foñ naè.”
English: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m cu múnyañ a ce yu'shi yuu ce Baènabaès ba Pol a m ce suñ kuu mncoèo ba buu bbáèá ce Nyúè aè m geèe aè múè beèe enje jáá njïì enjep woweèe.
English: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' laèa mïìsi, Jáms aè beesïì enáê, “Bfúr waê, yu' neè yuu ce m be laèa.
English: After they were silent, James answered, Brothers, listen to me.

Limbum: Saimúèn aè suñ aèmboè Nyúè aè m káè' a duñshi ntee ce e m láè njep beèe enje jáá a fúr beèe mo' efa woweèe aè yïì beèe.
English: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations, to take out of them a people for his name.

Limbum: Yuu ce e laèa na yi ghááte aè yuu ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m laèa. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê,
English: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

Limbum: Ca yi be caèa wáá, tá m kúti, baè'ri ndap Dávïìd ce e gweè. M be baè'ri ndap ce e saè'ñger na, geèe tá e ba aèmboè e m ba,
English: After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up,

Limbum: tá bár beèe ce yu beèe enje jáèá ce máè geèe woweèe a ba yaè beèe a bo roèo Tataê.
English: That the rest of men may seek after the Lord; All the Gentiles who are called by my name, Says the Lord, who does all these things.

Limbum: Ca ce laèa ba Tata ce e m geèe beèe a riñ ca eluâuñgoèñ seê.
English: All his works are known to God from eternity.'

Limbum: Máè yá ya máná seèe fa geèe tá buu ba btatap neè beèe enje jáá ce a ce kupse ce byemi neè Nyúè naè ka'.
English: Therefore my judgment is that we don't trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ker ba btu embe cor ba cor wááwá, a yá ená yi yu boèñboñ aè rce beèe moè' efa waâp mú, tá a bo tuu woweèe a Pol weèe aè rla' Antïìyoèk. Woweèe a m ce Judaès ce li rlii mo' li m ba ená Baèsabaès, ker ba Silaès. Woweèe a m ba boo mlii aè mú bfúr.
English: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

Limbum: A m tuu woweèe neè ñwaè' ce a m sañ enáê, “Ñgaâa ntuu Jisos ba btu embe cor ce a yu bfúr wee a sañ ñwaè' ca, a ca'ni bfúr enje jáá ce a ce cu aè rla' Antïìyoèk, ba Sirïìyaè, ker ba Sïìlesïìyaè.
English: They wrote these things by their hand: The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

Limbum: Weèr aè yu' werná beèe mo' a loâ efa weâr mú a jepsi weèe neè buu ce woweèe a m laèa, weèe aè riñ yuu ce weèe táá mbenduè mo ka'. Weèr aè m fa woweèe ñger aè rlaèa buu anaè ka'.
English: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, 'You must be circumcised and keep the law,' to whom we gave no commandment;

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' yu', a yá ená yi yu boèñboñ neè weèr aè rce beèe, tuu tá a vú yá weèe. Woweèe a be vúè a Baènabaès ba Pol ce yu bkar wer seê,
English: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

Limbum: aè ba beèe ce a tami nyor aè rkwe aètu yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis.
English: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Baná weèr ce tuu Judaès ba Silaès. Woweèe a be suñ weèe buu ce weèr aè sañ na, neè yap cuèu foñ.
English: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

Limbum: Yú' Rara yi yá, wer weèr foñ aè yá ená yi yu boèñboñ ená weèr ker lá ntáèr mo' mbe weâe nduè caa efa mú mncir ce weèr be suñ weèe ená weèe lá na ka'.
English: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

Limbum: Weèe fa ye byee ce a fa neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na ka'. Weèe fa no bláá ka'. Weèe fa ye mnyaèa ce a toosi mndoñ efa gho vi kweñgeèr ka', ker borni bsaèkïì. Weèe aè ka' borni buu ca, baná weèe aè geèe boèñboñ. Seèe aè bár.”
English: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.

Limbum: A m maè'shi woweèe, woweèe a natïì a du aè rla' Antïìyoèk, a ka' baè', a baashi ñgaâa rbyemïì wááwá mbe dïû' mo'sir, a fa ñwaè' anaè neè woweèe.
English: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' beè', a lu'shi aè njáèá ñger ce ñwaè' anaè yi fa woweèe.
English: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

Limbum: Judaès ba Silaès ce a m ba ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè foñ, a m laèa buu goèr se aè rfa woweèe ñger tá woweèe a bo tap.
English: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words, and strengthened them.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' cu aèfo aè mú nfeè' moè', bfúr a daasïì woweèe ená woweèe a du boèñboñ, du yá beèe ce a m tuu woweèe.
English: After they had spent some time there, they were sent back with greetings from the brothers to the apostles.

Limbum: Pol ba Baènabaès a m cu aè rla' Antïìyoèk a ce yá'ni a ker ce feè'shi blaâa Tata a ku' beèe mo' weèe.
English: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

Limbum: Mú mnoèñ mo' vi ka' tuuse, Pol aè laa neè Baènabaès enáê, “Soè kúti ca'ni bfúr ce a yu aè bbu' mla' ce soè aè m feè'shi blaâa Tata aèfo naè, yá ená woweèe a ku cu yáánïì lá.”
English: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, Let's return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.

Limbum: Baènabaès aè m ce koèñ ená woweèe a du a Joèn Mak weèe.
English: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

Limbum: Pol aè kwa'shïì ená yi yu yáánïì ená a woweèe a du ka' njobeè' Joèn Mak aè m maè'shi woweèe aè ñkúè rfaè' aè ñgoâñ Paèmfilïìyaè a du yi yu.
English: But Paul didn't think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn't go with them to do the work.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ba bcuèu jáá jáèá jáá seê, a gapni. Baènabaès aè lor Joèn Maêk, a ye a niñ mbe keñ a du aè to' Saiproès.
English: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away to Cyprus,

Limbum: Pol aè ce Silaès, a ye a duê. Bfúr a m fa woweèe mbe mmbo Nyúè, tá Tata Nyúè bo keè'ni woweèe.
English: but Paul chose Silas, and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

Limbum: E m duè a caa aè ñgoâñ Sirïìyaè ba Sïìlesïìyaè, a ka' ce caèa a ce fa ñger neè bcoêr.
English: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

Limbum: Pol aè du a ba' aè rla' Dábeè, a du aè rla' Listraè. Ñwáè yá'ni buu Jisos moè' aè m ba aèfo, a too ye ená Timotïì. Yïì ma aè m ba ñwáè Jus ce e m ba ñwáè rbyemïì, yïì ta aè ba yi ñwáè Greês.
English: He came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed; but his father was a Greek.

Limbum: Bfúr ce a m ba aè rla' Listraè ba IÌkonïìyoèm a m laèa buu bboèñboñ aèmboè ye seê.
English: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

Limbum: Pol aè m ce koèñ ená a Timotïì a duê, yi ka' ba wa'a, a gee ye búè njobeè' Jus wááwá ce a m ba aè bdïì' anaè a m rïìñ ená yïì ta yu ñwáè Greês.
English: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts; for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce duè ce caèa aè mla' anaè, a ce suñ beâe aèfo buu ce ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ba btu embe cor aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a m seèesi a laa ená woweèe a geêe. A m laèa neè woweèe ená woweèe a gee buu anaè.
English: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

Limbum: Ca yi m geèe bcor wááwá vi misïì a tap aè rbyemïì, a ce kuè' aè beèe aè mnoèñ wááwá.
English: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

Limbum: Woweèe a m naèti a caa aè ñgoâñ Frijïìyaè ba Gaèláshaè, njobeè' Yú' Rara yi m kani woweèe efa rfeè'shi blaâa Nyúè aè ñgoâñ Áshaè.
English: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce baè' njep ndeèe ñgoâñ Misïìyaè, a ce taè' aè rduè aè ñgoâñ Bïìtinïìyaè, Yú' Jisoès yi ma'shïì ená woweèe a du ka'.
English: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn't allow them.

Limbum: Woweèe a m caèa njïû aè ñgoâñ Misïìyaè a du a ba' aè rla' Trowaès.
English: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba neètú', Pol aè yá yuu mo' aèmboè rlo wa'a. E m yá aèmboè ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè aè táá, a ce bu' mmbo neè ye enáê, “Vúè aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè, ja' weèr.”
English: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him, and saying, Come over into Macedonia and help us.

Limbum: Pol aè ka' yá wa'a, weèr aè roo nduunjïì aè rduè aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè, njobeè' weèr aè m rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená Nyúè aè ká' weèr ená weèr fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè woweèe.
English: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' loâ aè rla' Trowaès, a niñ mbe keñ, a duê, a táá aè dïì' mo' ka', caar a ba' aè rla' Soèmatáráès. Túè' aè ka' raa, weèr aè ba' aè rla' Nïìyapolïìs.
English: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' loâ aèfo, a du a ba' aè rla' Fileèpaêi. AÈ m ba rla' ce baèraè' ce a m vúâ Rum a m ce sa'. AÈ m ba rla' rgoâr aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè. Weèr aè m cu aèfo aè mnoèñ aèñgoo.
English: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba nyúè mmbomntaa, weèr aè fúú efa múè la' a ce du aèwaâa roè, a ce kwaè'shi ená weèr be yá dïì' rloo aèfo. Weèr aè ka' baè', a cu aè nsheè, a laa neè bbyeèñge ce a m vúè aè rgeèe rloo aèfo.
English: On the Sabbath day we went forth outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down, and spoke to the women who had come together.

Limbum: Njeñwáè moè' efa múè bbyeèñge ca ce a m ce too ená Lidïìyaè a m yu' yuu ce weèr aè m laèa. AÈ m ba ñwáâ aè rla' Taèitiraè, a ba ñwáè ce e m ce fyeèni bcáè' ce vi m luèu ntaa. AÈ m ba njeñwáè ce e m ce loo neè Nyúè. Nyúè aè m múè' yi ntee, e byemïì blaâa Nyúè ce Pol aè m feè'shi.
English: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us; whose heart the Lord opened to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

Limbum: A m baèptir ye ker ba beèe embe yeâ ndaèp, a ka' mïìsi, e be weèr ená weèr vú mbe yeâ ndaèp. E m laèa enáê, “Weèe aè ka' yá neè mini-ñwáè ená máè byemi neè Tataê, weèe vú cu mbe máâ ndaèp.” E m laèa neè weèr caar, weèr woweèe a duê.
English: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and stay. So she persuaded us.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba nyúè moè', weèr aè ce duè aè rgeèe rloo. A tarte weèr muunje moè' ce e m ba ñkwaèa. Njáèá yú' mo' yi m ba njep ye, a ce geèe e ce suñ beèe buu ce vi bii ka' ba. E m ce kap ku' mbaèa neè beèe ce a m yuu ye seê, njobeè' e m ce suñ beèe buu anaè.
English: It happened, as we were going to prayer, that a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

Limbum: E m duè aèmbuèu weèr Pol weèe, a ce fuñ enáê, “Beèe ca yu ñgaâa mfaè' neè Nyúâ ñgoèr. A ce suñ weèe njáèá njïì ce aède' weèe gee ka' luêñ.”
English: Following Paul and us, she cried out, These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!

Limbum: E m fuñ wa' aè mnoèñ aèñgoo, ntee yi yañ Poêl, e karsïì nyor a ke' ye, a laa neè yú' ce yi m ba njep ye anaè enáê, “M ce laèa neè wáè aè rlii Jisos Kraâis ená aè fúú enjep ye.” E ka' laèa wa'a, yú' anaè yi ku fúú aè nfeè' anaè.
English: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her! It came out that very hour.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m túr ñkwaèa ca a ka' yá ená njïì moè' ker ba aègho neè woweèe aè rkap mbaèa ka', woweèe a koo Pol ba Silaès a súñ a du aègho aè ntaa, a fa woweèe neè ñgaâa sa' to'.
English: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

Limbum: A m vúè neè woweèe kuèntombïì neè ñgaâa nsa' mnsa' a laa enáê, “Beèe ca yu Juês. Woweèe a ce jepsi liseèe rla'.
English: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, These men, being Jews, are agitating our city,

Limbum: Woweèe a ce yá'ni ndeèe to' moè' ce yiseèe ncir yi byemi ená seèe gee ka'. Seèe yu yiseèe beâe aè to' Ruêm.”
English: and set forth customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.

Limbum: Kúr beèe ce a m ba aèfo a m niñ njep múè mo, a baa Pol weèe foñ. Ñgaâa nsa' mnsa' a m shaèshi bcáè' efa nyoèr Pol ba Silaès, a laa ená a lip woweèe neè mbaèñ.
English: The multitude rose up together against them, and the magistrates tore their clothes off of them, and commanded them to be beaten with rods.

Limbum: A ka' lïìp woweèe boèñboñ, a fa woweèe mbe shañ, a laa neè ñwáè ce e m keè'ni shañ ená e ke'ni woweèe boèñboñ.
English: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely,

Limbum: A ka' laèa neè ye wa'a, e lá woweèe mbaè múè ndap embe shañ, a taa woweèe aè buè'.
English: who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè neè ntee tú' wa'a, Pol ba Silaès a ce geèe rloo a ce yáá byáá neè Nyúè, ñgaâa shañ a cu a ce yu'shi.
English: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

Limbum: Ka' cu ñgoèñ yi ci'tïì, a ci' kuâu shañ foñ. Bkeèñ shañ vi mú'ñgeèr njaè' moè'sir, bkwaèñ vi gweñgeâr aè mkoo ñgaâa shañ wááwá.
English: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone's bonds were loosened.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ce keè'ni shañ aè ka' lá' efa mmirloè yá ená bkeèñ shañ vi múè'ñger, e co' kaèafaè' ená e bo yú yïì nyor aègho njobeè' e m ce kwaè'shi ená ñgaâa shañ a fúúse embe shañ a cañ a duse.
English: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

Limbum: Pol aè waa enáê, “Fa báási yoè nyor ka'! Weèr ku ba taâa wááwá!”
English: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Don't harm yourself, for we are all here!

Limbum: Ñwáè rkeè'ni shañ anaè aè laa ená a bársi mor fa neè ye. A ka' bársi fa neè ye, e cañ a du mbe shañ, a gweè njeptii Pol ba Silaès, a ce kaèñ.
English: He called for lights and sprang in, and, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

Limbum: A ka' naèti mbekïì, a fúr woweèe njepmbeè a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Masaè weèe, yuu ce aède' m gee ka' luñ yu ká?”
English: and brought them out and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

Limbum: Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “Byemi neè Tata Jisoès tá aè bo luñ, wáè ker ba beèe embe wáâ ndaèp.”
English: They said, Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.

Limbum: A m feè'shi blaâa Tata neè ye ker ba neè beèe wááwá embe yeâ ndaèp.
English: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' ana neètú' anaè, e lor woweèe a su'si wap mnfur. E ka' suè'si mïìsi, a baptir ye ker ba beèe wááwá embe yeâ ndaèp.
English: He took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

Limbum: E m loèr Pol ba Silaès a du aègho mbe yeâ ndaèp, a fa woweèe byee. A beèe embe yeâ ndaèp weèe a m lu'shi se njobeè' woweèe a m byemi neè Nyúè.
English: He brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his household, having believed in God.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, ñgaâa teni mnsa' a tuu yap ñgaâa ntuu ená a du laa ená a fúr beèe anaè embe shañ.
English: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, Let those men go.

Limbum: Ñwáè rkeè'ni shañ aè laa neè Pol enáê, “Ñgaâa teni mnsa' a tuu beèe ená a fúr weèe Silaès embe shañ. Baná weèe fúú laè embo, du boèñboñ.”
English: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out, and go in peace.

Limbum: Pol aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè be sa' wer mnsa' ka', a lip weèr aè múèè beèe, a ku lor wer ce weèr yu beâe aè to' Rum a fa mbe shañ. Woweèe a ce roo seè'ni aè rfúr weèr embe shañ ba aè bsúèti njoká? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka'. Laèa neè tá woweèe a vú fúr weèr embo neè yap bo.”
English: But Paul said to them, They have beaten us publicly, without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntuu ca a du a suñ neè ñgaâa teni mnsa'. Woweèe a ka' yu' ená Pol ba Silaès a yu beâe aè to' Rum, a wáp seê,
English: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

Limbum: a duê, a bu' mmbo neè woweèe, a fúr woweèe embe shañ, a laa neè woweèe ená woweèe a fúú efa lap rla' duê.
English: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

Limbum: Pol ba Silaès a ka' fúú embe shañ a du mbe ndaèp mbe Lidïìyaè, a tarte a bfúr weèe, a fa woweèe ñger. A ka' misïì, a duê.
English: They went out of the prison, and entered into Lydia's house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, and departed.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè caèa rla' AÈmfipolïìs ba rla' AÈpoèlonïìyaè, a ba' aè rla' Táèsaèlonikaè. Ndap rloo Jus aè m ba aèfo.
English: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

Limbum: Pol aè niñ mbe ndaèp rloo anaè aèmboè e m geèe aè mla' mo' naè. E m loèr mmbomntaa mi mtaar aè rnaèshi woweèe buu embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè,
English: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

Limbum: a ce saèr buu Nyúè neè woweèe, a ce duèñshi neè woweèe ená yi m ba ená Kraâis anaè aè m túr aè ryá ñgá', kwe, fúú efa rkwe. E m laèa enáê, “Jisoès ce m ce suñ weèe aèmboè ye na, yu Kraâis anaè.”
English: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa woweèe a m byemi, a ba aèbee a Pol ba Silaès. Beèe magoèr efa múè Greâk ce a m ce loo neè Nyúè ker ba bbyeèñge ce a m ba ñgaâa mlii a m byemi foñ a ba aèbee a Pol weèe.
English: Some of them were persuaded, and joined Paul and Silas, of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

Limbum: Jus a m ko'ndoñ neè woweèe, a du a yá ñgaâa bsaèrbuu mo' efa múè ñgaâa fa ñgá', woweèe a baashïì beèe, beèe anaè a ká' ñgá' aè múè la'. A ka' káè' ñgá', a cañ a du mbe ndaèp mbe Jasïìn aè rkoo Pol ba Silaès, fúr woweèe fa neè beèe.
English: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace, and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

Limbum: A ka' yá woweèe ka', a koo Jasïìn ba bfúr mo', a súêñ, a du aègho a fa neè ñgaâa kansuèr, a laa mbekïì enáê, “Beèe ca ce a beèesi ñgoèñ tútúèñ na, a vúè a ba' aèfa foñ.
English: When they didn't find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

Limbum: Jasïìn aè koo woweèe a lá mbe yeâ ndaèp. Woweèe a ce bú' mncir Sisaè aè njïì ce a ce laa ená ñkúú moè' ker ba, a ce too ená Jisoès.”
English: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!

Limbum: Ku' beèe ce a m ba aèfo ker ba ñgaâa kansuèr a ka' yu', ntee yi fúú woweèe.
English: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

Limbum: Woweèe a laa ená Jasïìn ba bfúr ca a tee yap tu. Jasïìn weèe a ka' tee yap tu aèmboè a m laèa, a ma'shïì woweèe a duseè.
English: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' sii, bfúr a lor Pol ba Silaès a du aègho aè rla' Báèriyaè. Woweèe a ka' baè', a du mbe ndaèp rloo Juês.
English: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

Limbum: Ndeèe beèe ca aè boñ a caa ndeèe beèe embe ndaèp rloo ce aè rla' Táèsaèlonikaè, njobeè' woweèe a m koèñ aè ryu'shi blaâa Nyúè seê, a ce beè' Ñwaâ' Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá tá a bo yá ená yuu ce Pol aè m ce laèa yi m ba mini lá.
English: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of the mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a m byemi. Bbyeèñge Greâk ce ñgaâa mlii ba Greâk ce a m ba mmbañruè, a m byemi foñ.
English: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

Limbum: Jus aè rla' Táèsaèlonikaè a ka' yu' ená Pol ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè aè rla' Báèriyaè foñ, woweèe a vú foñ a barsi beèe ce a m ba aèfo ená a woweèe a ká' ñgá'.
English: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bfúr a lor Pol njaè' moè'sir a du aègho aèwaâa rdip rgoèr, Silaès ba Timotïì a cu yap aè rla' Báèriyaè.
English: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m duè a Pol weèe naè, a m duè caar a du a ma'shi ye aè rla' Atáèns. A ka' ce kúti, Pol aè laa neè woweèe ená a du laa neè Timotïì ba Silaès ená a vú cárcár vú yá ye.
English: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

Limbum: Pol aè ka' cu aè rla' Atáèns ce keè' Timotïì ba Silaès, a yá ku' blañ ce beâe aèfo a m ce loo neè vi ená a mnyúè. E ka' yá, nyor aè bep ye.
English: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, e nashïì buu moè' mbe ndaèp rloo neè Jus ba neè Greâk ce a m ce loo neè Nyúè. E m geèe wa' foñ aè mnoèñ wááwá aè ntaa neè beèe ce a m vúè aèfo.
English: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa múè beèe ce a m túr ba bfee ÁÈpáèkuraèn, ba beèe mo' ce a m túr ba bfee Stoyïìk, a m sár mnsár a Poêl. Beèe mo' efa waâp mú a laa yap enáê, “Ñwáè bu' cuèu ca ce roèo aè rlaèa ba ká?” Beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “Yi ce yááti ená e ce laèa ba aèmboè mnyúè mo' ce seèe rïìñ ka'.” Woweèe a m laèa wa'a njobeè' Pol aè m ce feè'shi aèmboè Jisoès ba nfúú efa rkwe.
English: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, What does this babbler want to say? Others said, He seems to be advocating foreign deities, because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

Limbum: Woweèe a lor Pol a du aègho mbe rcuteè ce a m ce cute mbe rtuâu AÈropagoès, a laa neè ye enáê, “Weèr ce koèñ aè rrïìñ njáèá ryá'nïû rfi ce aè ce yá'ni na.
English: They took hold of him, and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new teaching is, which is spoken by you?

Limbum: Buu moè' ce weèe ce laèa vi yu bfi neè weèr, weèr aè ce koèñ aè rrïìñ vi.”
English: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa wa'a njobeè' beèe wááwá aè rla' Atáèns ker ba bkïìloè ce a m ce cu aèfo a m loèr ku' yaèp nfeè' a ce geèe kïìnfáèr ba aèmboè buu bfi, a ker ce yu' buu bfi.
English: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

Limbum: Pol aè natïì mbekïì mbe rcuteè embe AÈropagoès, a laa enáê, “Beâe aè rla' Atáèns! Máè yá boèñboñ máná weèe yu beèe ce weèe ce wáp mnyúè seê.
English: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus, and said, You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a njobeè' máè kar aè múè le rla' ca, a yá bdïì' ce weèe ce geèe mloo. Máè yá foñ dïû' rfa, a sañ mbe dïì' anaè enáê, ‘Neè Nyúè ce a rïìñ ka'.’ Baná Nyúè ce weèe ce loo neè ye, a riñ ye ka' anaè, a yïì ce m be suñ weèe aèmboè ye.
English: For as I passed along, and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription: 'TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.' What therefore you worship in ignorance, this I announce to you.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e m geèe ñgoèñ a ker gee buu enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá yu Nyúè ce e ce sa' mbe buèu ba njep nsheè. E ke cu mbe ndaèp Nyúè ce beèe a baè'ri neè mmbo ka'.
English: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn't dwell in temples made with hands,

Limbum: AÈde' beèe a fa' neè ye aèmboè e buu lá buu wa' ka', njobeè' ku ba ba ye ce e ke geèe beèe a cu bteèe ce yoèñse, ker fa woweèe buu wááwá.
English: neither is he served by men's hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all things.

Limbum: E m geèe mnjáèá wááwá vi fúú enjep ñwáè moè'sir, tá vi bo cu aè bdïì' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na. E m kwaè'shi wáá, a lá mnfeè', a ker lá bdïì' rcu neè woweèe.
English: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons, and the boundaries of their dwellings,

Limbum: E m geèe wa'a tá beèe a bo roèo ye, ce ghaèashi ená káè seemoè' a be yá ye lá. Geewa'a, Nyúè yu aènjïìsaèp ese ñwáè moè' efa seèe ka'.
English: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

Limbum: Seèe cu bteèe a ce jáèr, a ba aègho njo' ye. Yi ku ba aèmboè yeè beèe ce a ke sañ mghaèghar a laèa. Woweèe a laèa enáê, ‘Neè mini-ñwáè, seèe yu boo vi.’
English: For in him we live, and move, and have our being.' As some of your own poets have said, 'For we are also his offspring.'

Limbum: Baná aèmboè seèe yu boo Nyúè na, seèe fa keèr ce kwaè'shi ená Nyúè yu aèmboè blañ ce a loèr ba bco' káè bluèr áè, a gee aègho, aè ba yuu ce ñwáè aè geèe ba neè vi bfee ba mi mmbo naè ka'.
English: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce beèe a m rïìñ yuu ce a m ce geèe ka' naè, Nyúè aè ce fuse. AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na, Nyúè aè ce laèa neè beâe aè bdïì' wááwá ená woweèe a kupse, ma' yaèp buu bbebep,
English: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

Limbum: njobeè' e láè noèñ ce a be sa' beèe wááwá aè njïû yáánïì, a ker ce ñwáè ce e be sa' beèe. Nyúè aè geèe ñwáè wááwá aè riñ ená e be geèe wa'a njobeè' e fúr ñwáè anaè efa rkwe.”
English: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' aèmboè rfúú ce beèe a be keè fúú efa rkwe, beèe mo' efa waâp mú a vúshïì ye, beèe mo' a laa yap enáê, “Weèr be keèr yu' yuu ce aè be laèa kuu yuu ca nyúè moè'.”
English: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, We want to hear you again concerning this.

Limbum: Pol aè fúú efa waâp mú, a duê.
English: Thus Paul went out from among them.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a ba a Pol aèbee, a byemi. Beèe mo' efa beèe ca aè m ba Daèyonishoès ce e m ba ñwáè embe rcuteè AÈropagoès anaè, ker ba njeñwáè ce a m ce too ená Damáreès, ker ba beèe mo'.
English: But certain men joined with him, and believed, among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

Limbum: E ka' mïìsi wáá, a loâ aè rla' Atáèns a du aè rla' Koreèn.
English: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.

Limbum: E ka' baè', a yá ñwáè moè' embe ndúè' Juês, ce a m ce too ená AÈkwilaè. A m bi ye aè rla' Pontuès. E m loâ aè rla' Italeè a ñgwa yïì ce a m ce too ená Preèsilaè njobeè' ñkúú Klaâdïìyoès aè m fa rsa' ená Jus a fúú aè rla' Rum duse. Pol aè m duè aè ryá woweèe,
English: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

Limbum: a ka' yá ená yaèp ntaa aè m ba bcáè' ce woweèe a m ce tar ce geèe btaèp aègho ce fyeèni aèmboè ye ye foñ, e cu a woweèe a ce faè' a woweèe aèbee.
English: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

Limbum: E m ce duè mbe ndaèp rloo Jus aè mmbomntaa wááwá, a ce naèshi woweèe buu tá Jus ba Greâk ce a m ba mbo a bo byemi neè Jisoès.
English: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

Limbum: Silaès ba Timotïì a ka' vúâ aè rla' Máèsáèdonïìyaè, Pol aè lo seè'ni a ku ce feè'shi ba blaâa Nyúè caè'caè', a ce suñ Jus ená Jisoès yu Kraâis anaè.
English: But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' kani yuu ce Pol aè m suñ woweèe, ce cáp ye, e kashïì vi bcáè' a laa enáê, “Máè laèa ya wáá, kwaè' weèe. Ká' e seè'ni na, m be ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè ba neè beèe enje jáá.”
English: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!

Limbum: E m loè a du mbe ndaèp Taitïìyuès ce e m ba aègee ndap rloo. E m ba ñwáè ce e m ce loo neè Nyúè.
English: He departed there, and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

Limbum: Krïûspoès ce e m ba tu embe ndaèp rloo ba beèe wááwá embe yeâ ndaèp a m byemi neè Tata Nyúè. Beèe magoâr aè rla' Koreèn a m yu' yuu ce Pol aè m laèa neè woweèe, a byemi, a baptïìr woweèe.
English: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba neètú' moè', Tata aè laa neè Pol aè rlo enáê, “Fa wáp ka', kuè ce fe'shi blaâa Nyúè, ke' borni aè nfeè' moè' ka',
English: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, Don't be afraid, but speak and don't be silent;

Limbum: njobeè' m ku ba weèe soè. Ñwáè moè' be geèe yuu mo' bebep neè wáè ka', njobeè' ku' yaè beèe a yu aè rla' ca seê.”
English: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.

Limbum: Pol aè m cu a woweèe aè feè' bïìi ba nto' a ce yá'ni woweèe blaâa Nyúè.
English: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce Gaèliyoè aè m ba govanoâ aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè, Jus a m tar cuèu, a koo Pol a du aègho mbe koêr.
English: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

Limbum: A ka' baè' mbo, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ca ce koèñ aè rgeèe tá beèe a loo neè Nyúè aè njáèá njïì ce ncir yi byemi ka'.”
English: saying, This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.

Limbum: Pol aè ka' loè ená e ce laèa, Gaèliyoè aè laa enáê, “Yu' ka neè lá Juês! Weèe aè ka' ba ce laèa ená Pol aè geèe yuu mo' bebep káè e bú' ncir mo' tatap áè, máè ba loèr nfeè', yu' yuu ce weèe ce laèa.
English: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' weèe ce sár mnsár ba aèmboè blaèa ba mlii ker ba ye ncïìr, baná weèe aè ba sa' wee mnsa' mïìsi fa weâe mú. M be sa' njáèá mnsa' anaè ka'.”
English: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don't want to be a judge of these matters.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a juu woweèe embe koêr.
English: He drove them from the judgment seat.

Limbum: Woweèe a koo Soèstánïì ce e m ba tu embe ndaèp rloo a lip aè bsii koêr. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Gaèliyoè aè m loèr yuu ce woweèe a m geèe anaè aè yuu ka'.
English: Then all the Greeks laid hold on Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn't care about any of these things.

Limbum: Pol aè m cu a bfúr weèe aè rla' Koreèn aè mú nfeè' moè', a ma'shi woweèe a niñ mbe keñ a Preèsilaè ba AÈkwilaè a du aè ñgoâñ Sirïìyaè. Tá woweèe a ka' duè, e m ye leè' aè rla' Sinkrïìyaè, a koo yi tu aèmboè ndeèe Jus aè m ba.
English: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' duè baè' aè rla' Áfásoès, Pol aè ma'shïì Preèsilaè ba AÈkwilaè aèfo. E m du mbe ndaèp rloo a suñ Jus buu aèmboè Jisoès.
English: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa ená a woweèe a cu aè mú nfeè' moè'. E kanïì.
English: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

Limbum: E ka' ce duè, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Nyúè aè ka' byemi, m kútïì vú yá weèe.” E ka' laèa wa'a, a naètïû aè rla' Áfásoès a niñ mbe keñ a duê.
English: but taking his leave of them, and saying, I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills, he set sail from Ephesus.

Limbum: E ka' baè' aè rla' Sisaèriyaè, a du Jáèrusaláèm a ca'ni cor yïû aèfo, a nati a kúti aè rla' Antïìyoèk.
English: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

Limbum: E ka' cu aèfo aè mú nfeè' moè', a nati a jár aè ñgoâñ Gaèláshaè ba Frijïìyaè, a ce fa ñger neè ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès ce a m ba aè bdïì' anaè wááwá.
English: Having spent some time there, he departed, and went through the region of Galatia, and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

Limbum: Ñwáè Jus moè' ce a m ce too ená AÈpoloès aè m vúâ aè rla' Áfásoès. A m bi ye aè rla' AÈláèksandaè. AÈ m ba ñwáè ce e m rïìñ aè rlaèa yuu, a riñ Ñwaâ' Nyúè boèñboñ foñ seê.
English: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

Limbum: A m yá'ni ye buu kuu Tata Jisoès. E m laèa neè ntee-ñwáè, a yá'ni beèe buu aèmboè Jisoès yáánïì seê. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, e m ku riñ yi ba baptïìr yïì Joân caè'caè'.
English: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

Limbum: E m niñ mbe ndaèp rloo a ká' a ce laèa neè ñger-ñwáè seê. Preèsilaè ba AÈkwilaè a ka' yu', a lor ye a du aègho mbe waâp ndaèp, a nashi mnduunjïû Nyúè neè ye yáánïì seê.
English: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

Limbum: AÈpoloès aè ka' taè' aè rduè aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè, bfúr ce aè rla' Áfásoès a fa ye ñger, a ker sañ ñwaè' neè ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès ce a m ba aèfo ená woweèe a koni ye. E ka' baè', a ja' beèe ce a m byemi njobeè' Nyúè aè m túr woweèe aè ntee boèñboñ naè.
English: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

Limbum: E m jaè' woweèe a sár mnsár a Jus weèe aèwañ tatap seê, a ce fyá' mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè, a ce duèñshi woweèe ená Jisoès yu Kraâis anaè. E ka' sár wa'a, a so woweèe.
English: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

Limbum: AÈpoloès aè ka' ba aè rla' Koreèn, Pol aè jár neè mkuèu a du a ba' aè rla' Áfásoès. E ka' baè' a yá beèe mo' efa ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès.
English: It happened that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus, and found certain disciples.

Limbum: E m bipshi neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe aè m byemi wa'a, a koni Yú' Rara a?” Woweèe a beesïì neè ye enáê, “Weèr aè m be yu' yuu mo' aèmboè Yú' Rara ka'.”
English: He said to them, Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed? They said to him, No, we haven't even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.

Limbum: E laa neè woweèe enáê, “Baná a m baèptir weèe ba aè njáâá ká?” Woweèe a beesïì enáê, “A m baèptir weèr ba neè baèptir yïì Joân.”
English: He said, Into what then were you baptized? They said, Into John's baptism.

Limbum: Pol aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Joân aè m ce baèptir beèe njobeè' woweèe a m kupse, a ma' yaèp buu bbebep.” E m ker ce suñ beèe ená woweèe a byemi neè ñwáè ce e be vúè embe yeâ njïì. Ñwáè ce e m ce laèa na aè m ba Jisoès.
English: Paul said, John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Jesus.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a byemi, a baptïìr woweèe aè rlii Tata Jisoès.
English: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

Limbum: Pol aè ka' láè mi mmbo mbe waâp nduè, Yú' Rara yi suu mbe waâp nduè, woweèe a laa bli ce a m yá'ni ka', a cep ntuu Nyúè neè beèe.
English: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a m ba aèmboè beèe ncoèp-baa aè-rrúèú wa'a.
English: They were about twelve men in all.

Limbum: Pol aè m niñ mbe ndaèp rloo, a laa neè beèe neè ñger-ñwáè aè mñwáá btaar, a ce naèshi woweèe buu aèmboè Jisoès tá woweèe a bo rïìñ njáèá njïì ce Nyúè ce sa' aèmboè ñkúú.
English: He entered into the synagogue, and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa woweèe a tee btu, a kani aè rbyemïì, a ce laèa bebep aèmboè nduunjïì Tata aè bsii beèe. Pol aè fúú efa waâp mú a lor ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a du aègho mbe ndap ñwaè' Tïìranoès, e ce yá'ni woweèe buu mbo aè mnoèñ wááwá.
English: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

Limbum: E m yá'ni wa'a aè bfeâ' bbaa. Yi ka' ba wa', beèe wááwá aè ñgoâñ Ásïìyaè, Juês, ba beèe enje jáá a yu' blaèa Tataê.
English: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe buu bghagha' ce vi m ba jáá se njïì enjep Poêl.
English: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

Limbum: Beèe a m loèr bbishïîr, ba bcáè' mfaè' ce vi m joèo Poêl, a duè joèo beèe ce a m ce yañse aègho, woweèe a luñ efa waâp byañ, byú' bbebep vi fúú enjep woweèe.
English: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the evil spirits went out.

Limbum: Jus mo' ce a m ce kar ce juèu byú' bbebep enjep beèe, a ká' a ce yoèñ rlii Tata Jisoès mbenduè beèe ce byú' bbebep vi m ba njep woweèe. Woweèe a m ce laèa enáê, “AÈ rlii Jisoès ce Pol e ke feè'shi naè, fúú neè duê.”
English: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.

Limbum: Beèe mo' beèe nsaèambaê ce a m ce geèe wa'a, aè m ba boo Sïìkivaè ce e m ba ñwáè Jus moè' ce e m ba ñwáâ ñgoèr moè' efa múè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì.
English: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

Limbum: Yú' bebep ca yi m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Máè rïìñ Jisoès, a riñ aèmboè Pol foñ, a weèe ye weèká?”
English: The evil spirit answered, Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce yú' bebep ca yi m ba njep ye na aè gwe mbe waâp nduè, a lip woweèe seê, a gha' woweèe. Woweèe a cañ a fúú embe ndaèp mbuèuriñ neè mnfur aè nyoèr.
English: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

Limbum: Jus wááwá ker ba beèe enje jáá ce a m ce cu aè rla' Áfásoès a m yu' ca, a wáp seê, a naa rlii Tata Jisoès mbekïì seê.
English: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr efa múè beèe ce a m byemi, a m vúèse aèwañ, a ce suñ yaèp buu bbebep.
English: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr efa woweèe ce a m ba ñgaâa tú', a m vúè neè wap mñwaè' tú' a lá aèbee, a too aè bsii beèe wááwá. A ka' beè' mbaèa ce a m yuu mñwaè' anaè aègho a yá ená aè m ba mmalaèr mntaê.
English: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted the price of them, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, nlaâa Tata Jisoès yi du aè ñgoèñ neè ñger-ñwáè.
English: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

Limbum: Buu ca aè ka' koni wa'a, Pol aè laa ená aède' e buu efa caèa aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè ba aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè duè Jáèrusaláèm ka'. E m ker laa enáê, “M ka' du ba' aèfo, m ku du aè rla' Rum foñ.”
English: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa'a, a tuu Timotïì ba ÁÈrastoès ce a m ce jaè' ye aè li rfaè', ená a du aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè, a biishi yi aè ñgoâñ Áshaè.
English: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè ku' ñgá' aè ká' aètu buu ce a m ce yá'ni kuu nduunjïû Tataê.
English: About that time there arose no small stir concerning the Way.

Limbum: Ñwáè ntoèo nlaèa moè' aè m ba a ce too ye ená Dáèmitroès. E m ce geèe mú mndap nyúâ bká'ká' neè njáèá bco' mo' ce a m ce too ená Silvaè, vi feeseè ndap nyúè AÈtámïìs. Beèe ce a m ce faè' neè ye a m ce ye sá' enjep rfaè' anaè seê.
English: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

Limbum: E m ká' woweèe a beèe ce a m ce geèe njáèá ntaa anaè foñ aèbee, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Yaè beèe, weèe rïìñ ená see ke yeñger boèñboñ seê, njobeè' liseèe rfaè' ca.
English: whom he gathered together, with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

Limbum: To wee weèe foñ aè yá a ker yu' yuu ce ñwáè ce a too ená Pol na ce geèe aè rla' Áfásoès, ker ba aè ñgoâñ Ásïìyaè wááwá. Byá anaè aè laèa ená mnyúè ce beèe a kupshi kupshi yu lá mnyúè ka'. E geèe wa'a, a beesi mntee ese beèe magoèr.
English: You see and hear, that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods, that are made with hands.

Limbum: Yi ku ba ba ená ñgá' be koni seèe tá liseèe rfaè' ca li kwe ntaa ka', beèe a be keèr loèr ndap nyúè AÈtámïìs anaè aè yuu ka', tá nyúè ca seese ce beâe aè ñgoâñ Áshaè wááwá a ce caè'ni na, ker kúti ba yïì ce aède' beèe a yu'nïì neè ye ka'.”
English: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing, and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu' ca, ntee yi bep woweèe seê, woweèe a ká' a ce ghaa a ce laèa enáê, “AÈtámïìs ce aè rla' Áfásoès yu nyúâ ñgoèr.”
English: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!

Limbum: Nfeè' aè m tuuse ka', ghaa yi ko' aè rla' Áfásoès wááwá. Beèe ca a m koo Gayoès ba AÈristakoès a du aègho mbe mambe ñgoèr. Beèe a mmbaa ca a m ba beâe aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè ce a m ce kar a Pol weèe.
English: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel.

Limbum: Pol aè m ce koèñ ená e du niñ mbe múè beèe anaè, ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a kanïì.
English: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn't allow him.

Limbum: Beèe moâ' aè ñgoâñ Ásïìyaè ce a m ba bkar Poêl, a m cep ntuu neè ye, a laa ená e fa moèo ka'.
English: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m kaari anaè a m jep, a ce ghaa a ce laèa buu jáá jáèá jáá njobeè' beèe magoèr a m rïìñ yap yu mbuèu ce woweèe a m vúè mbo ka'.
English: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn't know why they had come together.

Limbum: Jus a m doèori AÈláèksandaè a tár kuèntombïì neè beèe, a laa neè ye ená e laa yuu. AÈláèksandaè aè naa bo mbekïì ená beèe a cu nyañ tá e laa yuu.
English: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá ená e yu ñwáè Juês, woweèe a ghaa aèbee aèmboè awaè baa wa'a, a ce laèa enáê, “AÈtámïìs ce aè rla' Áfásoès yu nyúâ ñgoèr.”
English: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!

Limbum: Ñwáè nsañ ñwaè' ce aè rla' ca aè gee beèe wááwá a cu nyañ, e laa enáê, “Yaè beâe aè rla' Áfásoès, ñwáè wááwá riñ ená rla' Áfásoès a rla' ce li ke keè'ni ndap nyúè AÈtámïìs ce yu nyúâ ñgoèr, a ker ba rla' ce li ke keè'ni yuu ce yi m gweè embe buèu naè.
English: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn't know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè moè' máñnïì buu ca ka', baná ñwáè moè' fa keèr fa ñgá' ka'. Cu neè múnyañ.
English: Seeing then that these things can't be denied, you ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rash.

Limbum: Weèe aè vúè neè beèe ca mbena ce aèmboè woweèe a yáèá buu embe mndap nyúè ka', a laa yuu mo' bebep aèmboè yïìseèe nyúè ka'.
English: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

Limbum: Dáèmitroès ba yi ñgaâa mfaè' a ka' túr yuu mo' kuu ñwáè moè', baná woweèe a riñ ená bkor vi ku táá btoo, ñgaâa rsa' a ba aègho, baná woweèe a du mbo sa' waêp mnsa'.
English: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open, and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ker túr yuu mo' ce weèe aè ba laèa, weèe laa ba mbe rcuteè ce beèe ce a ce sa' rla' a ká'.
English: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu seè'ni na, aède' a ku koo seèe aètu ñgá' ce e koni ntïìni na. Yi ka' koni wa'a, seèe túr yuu aè rlaèa ka'.”
English: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning this day's riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn't be able to give an account of this commotion.

Limbum: E ka' mïìsi, a laa beèe aè da'seè a duse.
English: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

Limbum: Bjep ca vi ka' mïì, Pol aè ká' ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès a laa buu neè woweèe, a fa woweèe ñger, a daasi woweèe, a nati a ce duè aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè.
English: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

Limbum: E ka' ce jáèr aè ñgoèñ anaè a ce laèa ku' buu neè beèe, a ce fa woweèe ñger neè blaèa anaè. E ka' mïìsi, a du aè ñgoâñ Greês,
English: When he had gone through those parts, and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

Limbum: a cu aèfo aè mñwáá btaar. E ka' ce tami nyor aè rduè aè ñgoâñ Sirïìyaè, a yá ená Jus a cu mncúè aè rkoo ye yú, e kwa'shïì aè rkúti duè njïû aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè.
English: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m duè a Pol weèe aè m ba Soèpataè, muu yïì Pairuâs aè rla' Báèriyaè, ba AÈristakoès ba Sáèkunduâs aè rla' Táèsaèlonikaè, ba Gayoâs aè rla' Dábeè, ba Timotïì, ba Tikikoès a Troâfimoès ce a m ba beâe aè ñgoâñ Áshaè.
English: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea; Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians; Gaius of Derbe; Timothy; and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

Limbum: Woweèe a m duè entombïì a du a táá weèr aè rla' Trowaès.
English: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

Limbum: Mnoèñ ce a m ce ye bráâd ce a láè yes njo ka' vi ka' caèa, weèr aè niñ mbe keñ a loâ aè rla' Fileèpaêi, mnoèñ vi ka' baè' taê, weèr aè konïì woweèe aè rla' Trowaès, a cu aèfo aè mnoèñ saèambaê.
English: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè noèñ entoèmbïì embe múè ñgaèa, weèr a vú aèbee aè rye byee Nyúè. Pol aè fe'shïì blaâa Nyúè, a fe'shi caar a ba' neè ntee tú' njobeè' e m rïìñ ená túè' be raa tá e duê.
English: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day, and continued his speech until midnight.

Limbum: A m cúè'shi ku' blaêm, a tooshi mbe múè ndap embekïì mbe dïì' ce weèr aè m ba anaè.
English: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

Limbum: Muu nsuènsuè moè' ce a m ce too ená Yutikoès aè m cu mbe wenduè. Pol aè ka' feè'shi duèni goèr, e buumïì, a ka' buumi boèñboñ seê, a gwe embe ndaèp ce e m ba mbenduè yïû mbekïì. A ka' naèa ye mbekïì e banïì kwe.
English: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third story, and was taken up dead.

Limbum: Pol aè suu njep nsheè a gwe mbe yeâ nduè, a baa ye nje nyoèr, a laa enáê, “Weèe fa wáp ka', e ku bii nteèe.”
English: Paul went down, and fell upon him, and embracing him said, Don't be troubled, for his life is in him.

Limbum: E ka' geèe wa'a, a kúti mbe dïì' ce e ba ba, a bá' bráâd a ye, a de' a woweèe, caar túè' aè raêa. Túè' aè ka' raa, e ma'shïì woweèe a duê.
English: When he had gone up, and had broken bread, and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

Limbum: Woweèe a m loèr muu nsuènsuè ca nteèe a du aègho, yap ntee yi fúteè seê.
English: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

Limbum: Weèr aè m naèti yer a du entoèmbïì, a du a niñ mbe keñ ñgoèr a du aè rla' Asoès. Yi m ba ená weèr be baè' aèfo koo Pol mbe keñ. Pol aè m seèesi a woweèe wa'a njobeè' e m koèñ aè rduè aèfo neè mkuèu.
English: But we who went ahead to the ship set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there, for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

Limbum: E ka' vúè koni weèr aèfo, weèr aè koo ye mbe keñ weèr woweèe a du aè rla' Mitileèn.
English: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard, and came to Mitylene.

Limbum: Weèr aè natïì a ce duè, túè' aè ka' raa weèr aè ba' a ce yá rla' Kiyoès nje weâr cuèu. Túè' moè' aè ka' raa, weèr aè ba' aè rla' Samoès. Túè' moè' aè ka' keèr raa weèr aè ba' aè rla' Milátoès.
English: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

Limbum: Pol aè m yá ená e be táá aè rla' Áfásoès ka', faè dïì' e bo caèasi nfeè' moè' aè ñgoâñ Áshaè ka', njobeè' e m ce koèñ ená e du cárcár tá e bo yá ená aède' e ba' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè noèñ Pántikoès lá.
English: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

Limbum: Pol aè ka' baè' aè rla' Milátoès, a cep ntuu ená btu embe cor aè rla' Áfásoès a vú yá ye.
English: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' vúè baè', Pol aè laa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe rïìñ njáèá njïì ce máè m cu a weâe mú káâ' aè noèñ ce máè m tár kuèu aè ñgoâñ Áshaè.
English: When they had come to him, he said to them, You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

Limbum: Máè m ce faè' neè Tataê, a ce naèa tu ka', a ce faè' neè mñgoommir-ñwáè, ker ba mmoèoshïì ce mi m vúè neè máè njo' mncúè ce Jus a m cúè máè.
English: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ená máè m buu efa rsuñ weèe yuu mo' ce aède' weèe aè m ba ye sá' enjo ka'. Máè m ce feè'shi, a ker ce yá'ni weèe aè múè beèe ker ba aè mndaèp.
English: how I didn't shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

Limbum: Máè m ce laèa neè Jus ker ba beèe enje jáá tatap se ená a kupse, ma' yaèp buu bbebep, kúti aè mbeèp yïì Nyúè, byemi neè Tata Jisoès.
English: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

Limbum: “M ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm seè'ni na aèmboè Yú' Rara yi laèa ená m duê, a ke' riñ yuu ce yi be duè koni máè aèfo ka'.
English: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

Limbum: Yuu máè rïìñ caè'caè' yi yu ená Yú' Rara yi ce suñ máè aè bbu' mla' wááwá ce m ce duè ená m be duè shañ, keèr yá ñgá'.
English: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, m ce loèr la ryoèñ aèmboè ku' yuu mo' se ka', ku ba ba ená m du gee rfaè' ce Tata Jisoès aè m fa neè máè. Rfaè' anaè li yu ená m suñ beèe Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè ntee boèñboñ ce Nyúè túr neè beèe.
English: But these things don't count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

Limbum: “Máè m jáèr fa weâe mú a ce feè'shi aèmboè kúú Nyúè. M rïìñ seè'ni na máná aède' moè' efa weèe ker yá máè ka'.
English: Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching the Kingdom of God, will see my face no more.

Limbum: E ka' laèa wa' mïìsi, a woweèe a gú'shïì neè mñkúúshi, e gee rloo.
English: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

Limbum: Woweèe a warseè seê, a baa ye nje nyoèr neè ntee-ñwáè.
English: They all wept a lot, and fell on Paul's neck and kissed him,

Limbum: Yuu ce yi m geèe woweèe a koosïìmnse seê, aè m ba blaèa ce e m laèa ená woweèe a be keèr yá ye ka' naè. A woweèe a m duè a ba' aègee keñ ñgoèr.
English: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him to the ship.

Limbum: Weèr Pol weèe aè ka' maè'shi woweèe, a niñ mbe keñ a du a ba' aè rla' Koês, a táá aè dïì' mo' ka'. Túè' aè ka' raa weèr aè ba' aè rla' Rodoèn, a ka' loâ aèfo, a du a ba' aè rlaè' Pataraè.
English: When it happened that we had parted from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' yá keñ ce e m ce duè aè rla' Foènishaè, weèr aè niñ mbo a duê.
English: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' baè' mbe dïì' mo' yá rla' Saiproès, a ma'shi li aè bo ñkoèp a caa a du a ba' aè ñgoâñ Sirïìyaè. Keñ aè du a táá aè rla' Tayaè tá a bo fúshi buu embo aèfo.
English: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre, for there the ship was to unload her cargo.

Limbum: Weèr aè du a yá ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoès aèfo a cu weèr woweèe aè mnoèñ saèambaê. Woweèe a m laèa neè Pol aè ñger Yú' Rara ená e fa duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm ka'.
English: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

Limbum: Geewa'a, yeèr nfeè' rduè aè ka' gháá, weèr aè natïì a ce duè. Woweèe wááwá ba wap bbyeèñge ba boo wap a m fúú efa lap rla' ca a du weèr woweèe. Weèr woweèe aè ka' baè' aèwaâa roè, a gú'shi neè mñkúúshi a loo,
English: When it happened that we had accomplished the days, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

Limbum: a ma'shi mnyor. Weèr aè niñ mbe keñ, woweèe a natïì a kúti.
English: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

Limbum: Weèr aè loâ aè rla' Tayaè a du a ba' aè rla' Toèlemáès, a ca'ni bfúr vïû aèfo, a cu weèr woweèe aè noâñ mo'sir.
English: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers, and stayed with them one day.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, weèr aè natïì a du a ba' aè rla' Sisaèriyaè, a niñ mbe ndaèp Felep ce e m ba ñwáè rfeè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ, a cu weèr woweèe. E m ba moè' efa beèe nsaèamba ce cor aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aè m ce naè.
English: On the next day, we, who were Paul's companions, departed, and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

Limbum: E m túr boo bbyeèñge kyeèe ce a m ce cep ntuu Nyúè neè beèe. Boo ca a m duè bguèu ka'.
English: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' cu aèfo aè mú mnoâñ mo', ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè ce a m ce too ená AÈgaboès aè vúâ aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè.
English: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

Limbum: E ka' vúè yá weèr, a fyáá muu cáè' ce Pol aè m cúú nje bú', a cúú mi mkuèu ba mi mkoo aègho, a laa enáê, “Yú' Rara yi laèa ená Jus aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a be kur ñwáè ce e túr muu cáè' ca aè njáâá wa'a, fa ye neè beèe enje jáá.”
English: Coming to us, and taking Paul's belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, Thus says the Holy Spirit: 'So will the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.'

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' yu' wa'a, weèr beâe aè rla' anaè weèe aè bu' mmbo neè ye ená e fa duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm ka'.
English: When we heard these things, both we and they of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

Limbum: Pol aè laa enáê, “Weèe ce war a ce koosi máè bsáè wa'a njoká? Máè ku tami nyor ba ená a koo máè kur kur caè'caè' ka', máè tami nyor foñ aè rkwe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aètu Tata Jisoès.”
English: Then Paul answered, What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

Limbum: E ka' kani yuu ce weèr aè m laèa, weèr aè bornïì yer yu, a laa wernáê, “Tá Tata Nyúè gee yuu ce e koèñ.”
English: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The Lord's will be done.

Limbum: Mú mnoèñ vi ka' caèa, weèr aè kur buu a du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa ñgaâa yá'ni buu Jisoâs aè rla' Sisaèriyaè anaè a du weèr woweèe, a lor weèr a du aègho mbe ndaèp Nasïìn ce e m ba ñwáâ aè ñgoâñ Saiproès. A ñwáè ce weèr aè m ce duè aè rcu weèr woweèe. E m ba moè' efa beèe entombïì ce a m byemi neè Jisoès.
English: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' baè' aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm, bfúr ce a m ba aèfo a konïì weèr boèñboñ seê.
English: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, weèr Pol weèe aè du aè ryá Jáêms, a ka' baè' a yá btu embe cor wááwá a Jáms weèe mbe dïû' mo'sir.
English: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

Limbum: Pol aè ca'nïì woweèe, a suñ woweèe buu wááwá ce Nyúè aè geèe neè beèe enje jáá njo' rfaè' ce e m geèe fa waâp mú.
English: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yu', a ku'si Nyúè, a laa neè Pol enáê, “Nfúêr, wáè yá aèmboè Jus ce a byemi a yu aè mncúèkïì aè mncúèkïì, woweèe wááwá a túr ntee aè rláè ncir seê.
English: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

Limbum: Beèe a suñ woweèe ená a ce yá'ni Jus ce a ce cu aè bto' beèe enje jáá ená woweèe a fa láè mncir Musïìs ka', a ce laèa neè woweèe ená woweèe a fa geèe búè ese boo ka', ma' lá ndeèe to' foñ.
English: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children neither to walk after the customs.

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu na, baná seèe be geèe seeká? Woweèe a be buu efa ryu' ená weèe aè vúè ka'.
English: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

Limbum: Baná aè gee yuu ce weèr be suñ wáè. Weèr túr beèe moè' beèe ñkyeèe ce a ye leè' neè Nyúè.
English: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

Limbum: Loèr neè beèe ca tá weèe woweèe du geèe yuu ce ncir yi ce laèa ená ñwáè gee tá e bo ba nrara aè bsii Nyúè. Fa woweèe mbaèa tá woweèe a bo koo btu. Wáè ka' gee wa'a, tá ñwáè wááwá bo rïìñ ená buu ce beèe a suñ aèmboè wáè naè, vi yu mini ka', rïìñ seè'ni ená wá wáè foñ ce láè mncir Musïìs.
English: Take them, and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe enje jáá ce a byemi, weèr aè sañ ñwaè' neè woweèe a suñ yuu ce weèr aè cu aèbee a laêa. Weèr aè laèa werná woweèe a fa ye byee ce a fa neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na ka', borni efa rye bláá ba mnyaèa ce a toosi mndoñ efa gho, borni bsaèkïì.”
English: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.

Limbum: Túè' aè ka' raa, Pol aè lor beèe anaè a woweèe a gee yuu ce ncir yi m ce laèa ená a gee tá a bo ba brara aè bsii Nyúè. A woweèe a ka' mïìsi, e du mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a suñ beèe noèñ ce woweèe a be geèe buu anaè mïìsi tá a bo vúè fa rfa aètu ñwáè wááwá.
English: Then Paul took the men, and the next day, purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

Limbum: Mnoèñ saèamba ca vi ka' káè' ce mïì, Jus moâ' aè ñgoâñ Áshaè aè yá Pol mbe Ndaèp Nyúè. Woweèe a ka' yá ye mbo, a barsi beèe fa yeâ mbuèu, a woweèe a koo ye,
English: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

Limbum: a waa enáê, “Beèe Isráèl, jaè' neè weèr! Ñwáè ca a ñwáè ce e ce jáèr ce yá'ni beèe wááwá ená yïìseèe beèe ba viseèe mncir ker ba yïìseèe Ndap Nyúè ca yu yuu ka'. E ker lor beèe enje jáá foñ a niñ aègho mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, a bepsi dïû' rara ca yi ba jaèpri.”
English: crying out, Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple, and has defiled this holy place!

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa wa'a njobeè' a m yá Troâfimoès ce aè rla' Áfásoès a Pol weèe aè rla' anaè, a ce kwaè'shi ená Pol aè m loèr ye a du aègho mbe Ndaèp Nyúè.
English: For they had seen Trophimus, the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

Limbum: Rla' wááwá li ci'tïì, beèe a cañseè a vúse a koo Poêl, a súñ a fúú aègho embe Ndaèp Nyúè, a cete ncúèúndúè',
English: All the city was moved, and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

Limbum: a ce gheèter aè ryú ye. Nsuñ aè vú a ba' ñwáè ce e m ba tu neè bsoogáè ncúèkïì ená rla' Jáèrusaláèm wááwá li jep.
English: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

Limbum: E lor bsoogáè mo' ba btu mo' a woweèe a cañ a du a yá ku' kúr beèe anaè. Woweèe a ka' yá a bsoogáè weèe, a borni efa rlïìp Poêl.
English: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

Limbum: Tu bsoogáè yïû goèr ca aè m koo Poêl, a laa ená a kur ye neè bshañ bbaa, a bipshi neè beèe ená Pol yu nda lá, a ker bipshi ená e geèe ba ká lá?
English: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa múè kúr beèe ca a m laèa yuu jáá, beèe mo' a laa yuu jáá. Bjep vi ba goèr seê, yi ba aètáèr neè ye aè rrïìñ yuu ce yi koni ka', e laa ená a lor Pol du aègho mbe barakïì.
English: Some shouted one thing, and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn't find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

Limbum: Pol aè ka' baè' mbe dïì' ce a be loè embo ce ko' ko', beèe a gúmïì a yeâ nduè, bsoogáè a boñlaèr a byá' ye.
