Limbum: Ñwáè ce e yu ñwáè Jus ghup yu ñwáè ce e yu wa'a ba enjep ntee, búâ mini yu ba yïì enjep ntee. Búè anaè yu ba rfaè' ce aè geèe ba Yú' Rara, a ke' ba yuu ce mncir vi ce laèa ka'. E ke vúse ba beèe vúse njáèá ñwáè anaè ka'. Nyúè a ñwáè ce e ke vúse njáèá ñwáè ca.
English: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

Limbum: Baná mboâñtu ce Jus a túr a caa beèe moè' yu ká? Waè' búè ce ñwáè aè geèe e túr sá' moè' neè ñgaèñ a?
English: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

Limbum: Jus a túr sá' goèr seê. Yuu entombïì yi yu ená Jus a beèe ce Nyúè aè m fa vi blaèa mba waâp mmboè.
English: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the oracles of God.

Limbum: Ka' beèe mo' efa woweèe a m táá njep blaâa Nyúè anaè ka' wa'a, waè' yi yu ená Nyúè aè m buu efa rtáá njep yuu ce e m laèa a?
English: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

Limbum: AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Ñwáè wááwá aè ka' ba ñwáè mnde', Nyúè ku ba yi yu ñwáâ mini. Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Tá beèe a yá ená wáâ ke laèa, ku gee aèmboè wáè laèa. Wáâ ke sa' wo mnsa', ku so.”
English: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, That you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená buu bbebep ce seèe ce geèe, ce geèe beèe a ce yá ená Nyúè yu ñwáâ nyáánïì, seèe ka' laa seená ká? Waè' aède' seèe laa ená Nyúè aè ka' fa seèe ñgá' njo' buu bbebep ce seèe aè geèe baná e geèe yuu yáánïì ka' a? M ce laèa ba aèmboè ñwáè.
English: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

Limbum: AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Yi ka' ba ba wa'a, e ka' sa' ñgoèñ aè njáâá ká?
English: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená m ce nya' mnde', beèe a yá ghup ená Nyúè yu ñwáâ mini, ce kuè'si ye, Nyúè ker taa máè ená m yu ñwáâ ñgeèe buu bbebep aè njáâá ká?
English: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

Limbum: Baná seèe gee buu bbebep tá rboèñ li bo fúú enjo a? Beèe moè' a ce bepsi la rlii, a ce laèa ená máè laèa lá wa'a. Nyúè be fa njáèá beèe ca ñgá' ce e be ghááte aè yuu ce woweèe a laèa.
English: Why not as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say, Let us do evil, that good may come? Those who say so are justly condemned.

Limbum: Seèe be ka' laèa seeká seè'ni aè? Waè' seèe yu jáá efa beèe moè' a? Yi yu wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Máè laèa wáá ená buu bbebep túr ñger mbenduè beèe wááwá, káè yu Jus áè, káè yu beèe enje jáá áè.
English: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè moè' yu ñwáâ nyáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ka', ka' ñwáè moè'sir.
English: As it is written, There is no one righteous; no, not one.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' yu ce e rïìñ buu Nyúè ka'. Ñwáè moè' yu ce e ce koèñ aè rrïìñ Nyúè ka'.
English: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá aè beèesi njïì neè Nyúè. Woweèe wááwá a kúti buu bcicïì. Ñwáè moè' yu ce e ce geèe yuu boèñboñ ka', ka' ñwáè moè'sir.
English: They have all turned aside. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not, so much as one.

Limbum: Blaèa ce vi ce fúú eku waâp bcuèu vi ce vúè neè rkwe neè beèe ce a yu' blaèa anaè. Wap blaèa vi yu aèmboè nli' nyo ce yi ke yú ñwáè naè.
English: Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit. The poison of vipers is under their lips;

Limbum: Blaâa bcece' vi fúú eku waâp bcuèu.
English: whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.

Limbum: Woweèe a ke caèasi nfeè' aè ryú ñwáè ka'.
English: Their feet are swift to shed blood.

Limbum: Woweèe a ce geèe yaèp buu, a ce wáp Nyúè ka'.”
English: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená yuu ce mncir Nyúè vi ce laèa, vi ce laèa ba neè beèe ce Nyúè aè m fa mncir anaè neè woweèe. Yi yu wa'a tá ñwáè moè' bo laèa ená e yu yi jáá ka', tá beèe wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na a bo keè táá kuèntombïì neè Nyúè, tañshi yaèp nsa' neè ye.
English: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' yu ce e láè mncir wááwá tá Nyúè bo laèa ená ñgaèñ yu ñwáâ nyáánïì ka'. Yuu ce mncir vi geèe yi yu ená vi geèe beèe a riñ buu bbebep.
English: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight. For through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na, Nyúè aè geèe beèe a riñ njáèá njïì ce aède' ñwáè ba yáánïì a yeâ bsii. Njïì anaè túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè mncir ka'. Ñwaè' mncir Nyúè ba ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m laèa aèmboè njïì anaè.
English: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

Limbum: Njáèá njïì ce Nyúè ce geèe beèe a ba byáánïì yu ba aè rbyemi neè Jisos Kraêis. Njáèá njïì ca yu neè beèe wááwá ce a ka' byemi, ñwáè moè' ker ba jáá ka',
English: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

Limbum: njobeè' beèe wááwá a geèe buu bbebep, a sá efa foèo ce yi loè ese Nyúè.
English: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

Limbum: Nyúè aè túr woweèe aè ntee boèñboñ, a gee woweèe aè ba byáánïì a yeâ bsii. E m geèe wa'a neè woweèe aè cicïì. Jisoès Kraâis a ñwáè ce e m geèe ená yi ba wa'a, a tee seèe efa ñgá'.
English: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m fa ye tá e bo ba aèmboè mbú tañshïì wa'a, tá li rkwe li bo geèe tá Nyúè foosi beèe ce a byemi neè ye. Nyúè aè m geèe wa'a, tá e bo duèñshi neè beèe ená e yu ñwáâ nyáánïì, njobeè' aè m ba entombïì, e kur ntee a fuse efa buu bbebep ce beèe a m ce geèe.
English: whom God set forth to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God's forbearance;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na e duñshïì beèe ená e ce geèe buu aè njïû yáánïì tá beèe a bo rïìñ ená e yu ñwáâ nyáánïì, a ker gee beèe ce a byemi neè Jisos Kraâis a ba byáánïì foñ.
English: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

Limbum: Baná aède' seèe ker naatu a? Njïì moè' yu ka'. Njoká? Njobeè' Nyúè aè geèe seèe aè ba beâe byáánïì aè ke' ba ba njo' mncir ka', yu ba njo' rbyemïì.
English: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

Limbum: Weèr aè laèa werná ñwáè yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ce ñgaèñ ka' byemi; ca yi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè mncir ka'.
English: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

Limbum: Waè' Nyúè ku ba ba Nyúè Jus caè'caè' a? AÈmboè e yu Nyúè beèe enje jáá foñ a? ÁÈno, e yu Nyúè beèe enje jáá foñ,
English: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn't he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

Limbum: njobeè' Nyúè ku ba moè'sir caè'caè'. E be geèe Jus ce a ke geèe búè naè aèmboè beâe byáánïì, ce woweèe a ka' byemi neè Jisos Kraêis. Yi ku ba wa' foñ neè beèe ce a ke geèe búè ka' naè. Nyúè be geèe woweèe tá a ba byáánïì ce woweèe aè ka' byemi neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.

Limbum: Waè' cena yi yu seè'ni ená seèe lor mncir aè yuu cicïì njo' rbyemïì a? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Yi yu ba ená seèe tapsi mncir.
English: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

Limbum: AÈde' seèe laa seeká aèmboè Abraèham ce e yu tar neè seèe ce seèe yu Juês?
English: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ka' ba gee Abraèham ba yáánïì njobeè' buu ce e m geèe, Abraèham aè m ba túr yuu ce aètaè e m ba naa nyor aègho. Geewa'a, e m túr yuu mo' aè rnaèanyor aègho aè bsii Nyúè ka',
English: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

Limbum: njobeè' Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, “Abraèham aè m byemi neè Nyúè, Nyúè aè lor ye aè ñwáâ nyáánïì njo' li rbyemïì.”
English: For what does the Scripture say? Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' gee rfaè', a la' ye, baná mbaèa ce a laè' ye aègho anaè yu yïì ce a fa ye fa ka', njobeè' e faè' a ka' koni.
English: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' tá fa' ka', byemi ba neè Nyúè ená Nyúè a ñwáè ce e ke geèe beèe ce a geèe buu bbebep a ba byáánïì, baná Nyúè be loèr ñwáè anaè aèmboè ñwáâ nyáánïì neè mini-ñwáè, njobeè' e byemi neè ye.
English: But to him who doesn't work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

Limbum: Dávïìd ye ye aè m laèa foñ wa'a, ená Nyúè aè ka' lor ñwáè aèmboè ñwáâ nyáánïì ke' ba njobeè' rfaè' ce ñgaèñ aè geèe ka', baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè rboâñtu seê.
English: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Beèe ce Nyúè aè foèosi woweèe efa wap bsaèrbuu a ma' yaèp buu bbebep anaè, a yu ñgaâa mboâñtu.
English: Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered. Romans Ruêm 4 8 Ñwáè ce Tata Nyúè be keèr ce beè' buu bbebep ce ñgaèñ aè m geèe ka', yu ñwáâ rboâñtu.” Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.

Limbum: Waè' beèe ce a yu ñgaâa mboâñtu ca ku ba ba beèe ce a geèe búè a? Beèe ce a geèe búè ka' a be ba ñgaâa mboâñtu foñ. Kwaè'shi ka neè aèmboè Abraèhaêm. To seèe ce laèa seená Nyúè aè m loèr Abraèham aè ñwáâ nyáánïì njo' li rbyemïì.
English: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m loèr Abraèham aèmboè ñwáâ nyáánïì naè, Abraèham aè m banïì geèe búè a? Yi yu wa' ka', aè m ba aè nfeè' anaè e be gee búè ka'.
English: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

Limbum: A m geèe ye búè, e ba aèmboè ncoèo wa'a, ce e m ce duèñshi ená e yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njo' li rbyemïì, ka' a m be gee ye búè aè nfeè' anaè ka' wa'a. Yi ka' ba aè njáâá wa'a, Abraèham aè ba seè'ni taèr beèe wááwá ce a byemi, Nyúè aè ce yá woweèe aè beâe byáánïì, ka' woweèe a geèe búè ka' wa'a.
English: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

Limbum: Yïìseèe ta Abraèham ca yu taèr neè beèe wááwá ce a geèe búè, a ke' ku geèe ba búè caè'caè' ka', a ce jáèr njep mi mkuèu, a byemi aèmboè e m byemi tá a ka' keè geèe ye búè naè.
English: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m kaè' Abraèham ker ba ñgúè Abraèham ená e be fa ñgoèñ neè woweèe. Nyúè aè m kaè' neè Abraèham wa'a njobeè' e m ce láè mncir ka'. E m kaè' wa'a njobeè' Abraèham aè m byemi neè ye a ba yáánïì a yeâ bsii.
English: For the promise to Abraham and to his seed that he should be heir of the world wasn't through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

Limbum: Yi m ba ba ená beèe ce a ce láè mncir a beèe ce a be koni buu ce Nyúè aè m kaè', yi ba ba ená rbyemïì li túr sá' ka', tá mkaè'ni anaè mi ba foñ aè cicïì.
English: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

Limbum: Geewa'a, mncir vi ce geèe yi, ntee yi ce bep Nyúè neè beèe bep. Mncir vi ka' tá ba ka', ñwáè bú' mncir ka'.
English: For the law works wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

Limbum: Baná mkaè'ni anaè mi yu ba neè beèe ce a byemi. Yi yu wa'a tá yi bo ba rara ená e ce fa buu ce e m kaè' anaè neè seèe njo' yi ntee boèñboñ, tá buu anaè bo ba aègho neè ñgúè Abraèham wááwá, keè' kuè ba ba neè beèe ce a ce láè mncir ka', vi bo ba aègho neè beèe ce a byemi neè Nyúè aèmboè Abraèham aè m byemi naè foñ. Abraèham yu taèr neè seèe wááwá.
English: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Máè geèe wáè ba taèr neè bto' magoèr” naè. Baná aè bsii Nyúè, Abraèham yu taèr neè seèe. Yu ye ce Abraèham aè m byemi neè ye naè. Yu ye Nyúè ce e ke geèe beèe ce a kweñger, a kútïì bteèe. Yu ye ce e ke laèa, yuu ce yi m be ba ka', yi ku ba.
English: As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations. This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

Limbum: Abraèham aè m ku lá mi mmir mbenduè Nyúè, a byemi yuu ce e m kaè', ka' yi m ce yááti ená yuu ce Abraèham aè m láè mmir mbenduè mo naè yi be geeti ka' wa'a. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Abraèham aè lo a ba taèr neè bto' magoèr. Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaè' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Yo ñgúè be ba goèr aèmboè mkaèñsïì wa'a.”
English: Who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, So will your seed be.

Limbum: Abraèham aè m ba aè nfeè' anaè aèmboè bfeè' rjeèe. E m rïìñ ená e yu gúâú ñwáè, a riñ ená Sáèra yu kar. Ka' e m rïìñ wa'a, e m ku byemi a sá ka'.
English: Without being weakened in faith, he didn't consider his own body, already having been worn out, he being about a hundred years old, and the deadness of Sarah's womb.

Limbum: E m tarni ka', a ku byemi ená Nyúè be geèe yuu ce e m laèa. E m ku táá tatap njo' li rbyemïì, a ce kuè'si Nyúè.
English: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn't waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

Limbum: E m rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená Nyúè túr ñger aè rgeèe yuu ce e m kaè' anaè.
English: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce Nyúè aè m yá ye aè ñwáâ nyáánïì njo' li rbyemïì.
English: Therefore it also was reckoned to him for righteousness.

Limbum: Blaèa ce a sañ enáê, “A m yá ye aè ñwáâ nyáánïì” naè, a m ku sañ ba njo' Abraèham caè'caè' ka',
English: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

Limbum: a m sañ njo' seèe foñ. Tata Nyúè be yá seèe aèmboè beâe byáánïì, ce seèe ka' byemi neè ye ce e m fúr Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe.
English: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,

Limbum: A m yú ye njo' yïìseèe buu bbebep, Nyúè aè fúr ye efa rkwe tá seèe bo ba byáánïì a yeâ bsii.
English: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' seèe yu byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njo' liseèe rbyemïì, seèe ce cu neè rfúteè-ñwáè seèe Nyúè weèe njo' yuu ce yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe.
English: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

Limbum: Yu ye ce e geèe seèe aè konïì fáñ, a riñ rboâñntee Nyúè ce seèe ce yá seè'ni na, a ce lu'shi njobeè' seèe rïìñ seená seèe be koni foèo ce yi loè ese Nyúè.
English: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

Limbum: Mo' foñ yi yu ená seèe ce lu'shi aè ñgá' ce seèe ce yá njobeè' seèe rïìñ seená ñgá' e ke geèe ñwáè e kur ntee;
English: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;

Limbum: ñkur ntee anaè e geèe ñgeèe ñwáè yi boñ Nyúè. Yiseèe ñgeèe yi ka' boñ Nyúè, baná yi be geèe tá seèe lá mmir mbenduè Nyúè.
English: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' lá mmir mbenduè Nyúè wa'a, seèe lá aè cicïì ka' njobeè' seèe rïìñ seená Nyúè aè koèñ seèe magoèr seê. Seèe rïìñ wa'a, ba aè ñger Yú' Rara ce e fa neè seèe naè.
English: and hope doesn't disappoint us, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

Limbum: Yi yu ená aè m ba aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m rïìñ aè rjaè' viseèe btu ka' naè, Kraâis aè vú aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m láè, a kwe a seâe btuè ce seèe yu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep.
English: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená yi yu aètáèr neè ñwáè aè rkwe aètu ñwáè moè' ka'; ka' ñgaèñ aè ka' ba ñwáâ nyáánïì áè. Seemoè' aède' ñwáè ku byemi ená e be kwe aètu ñwáè ce yïì ndeèe boèñ seê.
English: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè Nyúè, e duèñshi seèe ená e koèñ seèe seê, njobeè' aè m ba aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m ku bii ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep naè, Kraâis aè kwe a seâe btuè.
English: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' rkwe Jisos Kraêis, Nyúè aè gee seèe aè ba byáánïì, baná yi yu mini ghup ená Jisoès be jaè' seèe efa rshentee Nyúè foñ.
English: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God's wrath through him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m ku bii ñgaâa bbaèa neè Nyúè, muu yïì aè gee seèe Nyúè weèe aè kútïì aèbee njo' li rkwe. Yi ka' ba ená seèe Nyúè weèe aè kútïì aèbee, baná yi yu mini ená seèe be luèñ njobeè' e cu nteèe.
English: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

Limbum: A yi wa' wáá ka'. Seè'ni na, seèe ce lu'shi njo' yuu ce Nyúè aè geèe neè seèe njo' rkwe yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis, aè ba ye ce e m geèe seèe Nyúè weèe aè kútïì aèbee.
English: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

Limbum: Yi yu ená buu bbebep aè m vúè njep ñgoèñ na njo' ñwáè moè'sir, a vú neè rkwe. Yi ka' ba wa'a, rkwe li vú aènduè beèe wááwá njobeè' beèe wááwá a geèe buu bbebep.
English: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.

Limbum: Buu bbebep aè m ku ba njep ñgoèñ tá Nyúè ka' keè fa vi mncir. Mncir vi ka' tá ba aègho ka', aède' a be' buu bbebep ce ñwáè aè geèe ka'.
English: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, rkwe li m ku ba aè nfeè' ce ncir yi m be ba ka', ká' ese aè nfeè' yïì Adaèm du ba' aè nfeè' yïì Musïìs, rkwe li m ku ba, ka' woweèe a m geèe njáèá yuu bebep ce Adaèm aè m geèe aè nfeè' ce e m teèe tu neè Nyúè naè ka' wa'a. Adaèm yu aèmboè rleèñshi Jisos Kraâis ce e bii ka' vúè.
English: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren't like Adam's disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, rfa ce Nyúè aè m fa njo' ñwáè ce e m bii ka' vúè anaè li yu jáá efa yuu bebep ce Adaèm aè m geèe. Beèe magoèr a m kweñger njo' yuu bebep ce ñwáè moè'sir ce yu Adaèm aè m geèe. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' rboâñntee ñwáè moè'sir foñ ce yu Jisos Kraêis, beèe magoèr se a konïì rboâñntee Nyúè ce yu rfa ce e fa aè cicïì.
English: But the free gift isn't like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

Limbum: Sá' efa rfa Nyúè yu jáá efa sá' efa yuu bebep ce ñwáè moè'sir aè m geèe. Ñwáè moè'sir aè m geèe yuu bebep, Nyúè aè sa' beèe, woweèe a gwe mnsa'. Geewa'a, beèe magoèr a ku ce geèe buu bbebep, Nyúè aè ku fa beèe rfa aè cicïì, a gee woweèe a ba byáánïì a yeâ bsii.
English: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.

Limbum: Ka' ba ená yuu bebep ce ñwáè moè'sir aè m geèe, yi m geèe rkwe li túr ñger mbenduè ñgoèñ wááwá, beèe wááwá a ce kweñger njobeè' ñwáè moè'sir anaè, baná yi yu foñ ená rboâñntee ñwáè moè'sir, ce yu Jisos Kraêis, li be geèe beèe magoèr a koni rfa ce aè cicïì, ba beâe byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè, koni ryoèñ, so buu bbebep.
English: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Baná aèmboè yuu bebep ce ñwáè moè'sir aè m geèe yi m geèe beèe wááwá a gwe mnsa' Nyúè naè, yi yu foñ ená yuu yáánïì ce ñwáè moè'sir aè m geèe naè, yi geèe beèe wááwá a konïì fáñ aè rso mnsa', koni ryoèñ.
English: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

Limbum: AÈmboè beèe magoèr a m ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep njobeè' nteèetu ñwáè moè'sir naè, yi yu foñ ená beèe magoèr a be ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njobeè' ñwáè moè'sir aè m yu'ni neè Nyúè.
English: For as through the one man's disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m fa mncir tá beèe a bo geèe buu bbebep goèr. Ka' yi yu wa'a, faè dïì' ce beèe a m ce geèe buu bbebep goèr, rboâñntee Nyúè li m gha' buu bbebep anaè aèfo goèr seê.
English: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;

Limbum: Baná aèmboè buu bbebep aè túr ñger mbenduè beèe, a vú neè rkwe, yi yu foñ ená rboâñntee Nyúè li túr ñger aè rgeèe beèe tá a ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè, koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè njo' yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis.
English: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

Limbum: Seèe be ka' laèa seeká seè'ni? Waè' yi yu ená seèe be kuè ce geèe buu bbebep tá beèe a bo yá rboâñntee Nyúè goèr a?
English: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

Limbum: AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Seèe yu aèmboè bgúâú beèe ce aède' buu bbebep ker gee yuu mo' neè seèe ka'. AÈde' seèe ker ce geèe buu bbebep aè njáâá ká?
English: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ weená aè m ba aè nfeè' ce a m baèptir seèe aè rlii Jisoès naè, seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè kweñgeèr aèbee a?
English: Or don't you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

Limbum: A tuñ seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aèbee aè baèptir ce a m baèptir seèe naè, yi ba ená seèe woweèe aè kweñger aèbee. A m geèe ená seèe woweèe kweñger aèbee tá seèe bo koni ryoèñ, geèe ba ñgeâe fi aèmboè Jisos Kraâis aè m fúú efa rkwe aè ñger Taèr Nyúè, a koni ryoèñ foñ naè.
English: We were buried therefore with him through baptism to death, that just like Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' ba aèbee seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè li rkwe, baná seèe be keè ba aèbee seèe woweèe, fúú efa rkwe aèmboè e m fúú naè.
English: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená aè m ba aè nfeè' ce a m taa Kraâis mbe kïìntaa naè, a m taa njáèá ñwáè ce seèe aè m ba naè mbo foñ tá a bo yú yïìseèe ndeâe mbembep, faè dïì' seèe bo keèr ba bkwaèa neè buu bbebep ka'.
English: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a njobeè' ñwáè aè ka' kwe wáá, baná ñgaèñ aè luèñ efa buu bbebep.
English: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená aèmboè seèe Kraâis weèe aè kwe aèbee na, seèe aè byemi ená seèe be cu seèe Kraâis weèe foñ,
English: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;

Limbum: njobeè' seèe rïìñ seená aèmboè Nyúè aè m fúr Kraâis efa rkwe naè, aède' e ker kwe ka'. Rkwe li ker túr ñger mbe yeâ nduè ka'.
English: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!

Limbum: E m kwe wa'a, a ker kwe ka', tá yuu bebep yi ker geèe yuu mo' neè ye ka'. Li rcu ce e ce cu seè'ni na, e ce cu a Nyúè.
English: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

Limbum: Baná wee weèe foñ aè ba yá wee mnyor aèmboè beèe ce a kweñger, yuu bebep yi ker ce geèe yuu mo' neè weèe ka', weèe aè ce cu seè'ni weèe Nyúè weèe njobeè' weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe yu aèbee.
English: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Limbum: Baná weèe fa maè'shi tá yuu bebep yi túr ñger mbenduè wee mnyor ce vi be kweñger, tá weèe ce geèe buu bbebep ce weèe ce koèñ na ka'.
English: Therefore don't let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

Limbum: Weèe fa maè'shi tá ñgúè' moè' efa yeè nyor kúti ba yuu ce weèe be ce geèe buu bbebep aègho ka'. Fa neè yeè nyor ba neè Nyúè aèmboè beèe ce a kweñger, a kúti bteèe. Maè'shi neè tá yeè nyor wááwá ba ba yuu ce Nyúè be ce geèe mfaâ' myáánïì aègho.
English: Neither present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

Limbum: Buu bbebep be keèr túr ñger mbe weâe nduè ka' njobeè' weèe ker bii njeptii mncir ka', weèe yu ba njeptii rboâñntee Nyúè.
English: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.

Limbum: Seèe be geèe seeká seè'ni? Waè' seèe be ce geèe buu bbebep njobeè' seèe ker bii njeptii mncir ka', a ba ba njeptii rboâñntee Nyúè a? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr.
English: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ ená weèe aè ka' fa weêe mnyor neè ñwáè tá weèe bo ce yu'ni neè ñgaèñ aèmboè bkwaèa wa'a, baná weèe yu bkwaèa neè ñwáè ce weèe ce yu'ni neè ye anaè a? Weèe aè ka' fa weêe mnyor aè rgeèe buu bbebep, weèe ba bkwaèa neè buu bbebep, sá' efa gho aè ba rkwe. Weèe aè ka' fa weêe mnyor aè rgeèe ñgeèe ryu'nïì, weèe ba bkwaèa neè ñgeèe ryu'nïì, sá' efa gho yu ená weèe be ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: Don't you know that to whom you present yourselves as servants to obedience, his servants you are whom you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

Limbum: Seèe yoñshi Nyúè njobeè' weèe ce weèe aè m ba bkwaèa neè buu bbebep, aè m kupse, a yu'ni ba neè ryá'nïì ce a m yá'ni weèe naè neè ye ntee wááwá.
English: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto you were delivered.

Limbum: Weèe aè luèñ efa buu bbebep, a ba bkwaèa neè ñgeâe yáánïì.
English: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

Limbum: M ce laèa aèmbo ñgeâe bkwaèa tá yuu ce m ce laèa yi bo ba rara njobeè' yi yu tatap neè weèe aè rrïìñ buu ca neè bfee vïû ñwáè. AÈ m ba entombïì weèe aè fa weêe mnyor neè buu bbebep, a ce geèe ba bsaèrbuu. Baná weèe fa weêe mnyor seè'ni na ba neè ñgeâe yáánïì, tá weèe bo ba beèe Nyúè ce weèe yu brara.
English: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce weèe aè m ba bkwaèa neè buu bbebep naè, ñgeâe yáánïì yi m túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè weèe ka'.
English: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.

Limbum: Weèe aè m ye ba njáèá sá' ká efa buu ce rïìtu yi ce koo weèe aègho seè'ni na? Sá' efa buu anaè yu ba rkwe.
English: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na ce weèe aè luèñ efa buu bbebep a ba bkwaèa neè Nyúè na, sá' efa gho yu ená weèe yu beèe Nyúè ce weèe yu brara, loè koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.

Limbum: Blaè' efa buu bbebep yu rkwe, rfa ce Nyúè ce fa neè beèe aè cicïì aè ba ryoèñ ce nfeseè ce seèe aè koni njobeè' seèe yu aèbee seèe Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Tata neè seèe.
English: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce laèa neè weèe ce weèe wááwá rïìñ mncir. Weèe rïìñ ená mncir vi túr ñger mbenduè ñwáè ba aè nfeè' ce ñgaèñ bii nteèe.
English: Or don't you know, brothers for I speak to men who know the law, that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

Limbum: Seèe lor aè rduèñshïì, njeñwáè aè ka' du bguèu, baná e be kuè cu ba a nduu yïì, ce nduu yïì anaè a ka' ku bii nteèe, aèmboè ncir yi laèa. Nduu yïì aè ka' kwe baná e luèñ efa ncir anaè.
English: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

Limbum: E ka' ker du bguèu a mbañruèñwáè moè' ce nduu yïì ku bii nteèe, baná e koo nduu ñwáè moè'. Nduu yi anaè aè ka' kwe baná e luèñ efa ncir. E ka' du bguèu a mbañruèñwáè moè' aè nfeè' anaè, baná e koo nduu ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yi ku ba neè weèe wa' foñ. AÈ ka' ba aèmboè ñger ce mncir vi túr mbe weâe nduè, yi yu seè'ni ená weèe aè kwe, njobeè' weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe yu aè ñwáè moè'sir. Yi yu seè'ni na ená weèe cu njeptii nduu moè' jáá, ce e yu Kraâis ce Nyúè aè m fúr efa rkwe tá seèe bo geèe buu bboèñboñ neè Nyúè.
English: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit to God.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m ce geèe buu ce e ke koèñ ba ñwáè aè rgeèe naè, mncir vi m ce naèashi viseèe mntee, seèe aè ce geèe buu bbebep, buu bbebep anaè aè lúsïì ba neè rkwe.
English: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring forth fruit to death.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na, seèe aè luñ efa mncir. Seèe aè kweñger, yuu ce yi m kur seèe naè, yi ker túr ñger mbe seâe nduè ka'. Seèe ce faè' neè Nyúè seè'ni na, a ce láè mncir vïû brúèú ce a sañ naè ka'. Seèe ce faè' neè Nyúè ba aè njïû nfi, ce Yú' yi ce duèñshi seèe.
English: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

Limbum: Seèe be ka' laèa seeká seè'ni aè? Waè' seèe be laèa seená mncir yu yuu bebep a? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Yuu ce yi m geèe m ka' riñ yuu bebep, aè m ba mncir. Ncir yi m ka' tá baè laèa enáê, “Fa gani ka'” ka', máè m ba rïìñ ená ñwáè e ke gani yuu, baná ñgaèñ aè geèe yuu bebep ka'.
English: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn't have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn't have known coveting, unless the law had said, You shall not covet.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' ncir anaè, yuu bebep yi konïì fáñ a gee máè ce gani buu njáèá jáá jáèá jáá. Mncir vi ka' tá ba aègho ka', buu bbebep yáátïì ka'.
English: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

Limbum: Nfeè' moè' aè m ba ce máè m rïìñ mncir ka', a ku ba nteèe. Mncir vi ka' vúè, yuu bebep yi ba teèe,
English: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

Limbum: máè kwe. Máè yá máná mncir ce a m fa tá beèe a bo koni ryoèñ naè, vi geèe máè kwe kwe.
English: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' mncir anaè, yuu bebep yi konïì fáñ a bo' máè, a yú máè.
English: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

Limbum: Baná buu ca ce duèñshi ená mncir vi yu brara, buu wááwá ce Nyúè aè laèa vi ba brara a ba byáánïì, a boêñ.
English: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

Limbum: Waè' yi yu ená yuu ce yi m ba boèñboñ yi m vúè ba neè rkwe neè máè a? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Yu ba buu bbebep ce vi m loèr mncir ce vi m ba bboèñboñ, a vú ba neè rkwe neè máè. Cena yi m ba wa'a, tá beèe a bo rïìñ yuu bbebep. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' yuu ce Nyúè aè laèa, yuu bebep yi bep ghup neè mini- ñwáè.
English: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená mncir yu ba yuu ce aè yú', máè ba ya ba ñwáè ce a fyeèni aèmboè ñkwaèa wa'a neè buu bbebep.
English: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

Limbum: M rïìñ mbuèu ce m ce geèe buu ce m ce geèe na ka', m ce geèe ba buu ce ya ntee yi ce koèñ aè rgeèe ka'. M ce geèe ba buu ce máè baèa.
English: For I don't know what I am doing. For I don't practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

Limbum: M ka' ce geèe buu ce ya ntee yi koèñ aè rgeèe ka', baná cena yi ce duèñshi ená máè byemi máná mncir vi yu bboèñboñ.
English: But if what I don't desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

Limbum: Baná buu anaè ce geèe ba máè ka', ce geèe ba buu bbebep ce vi yu njep máâ ntee.
English: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

Limbum: M rïìñ máná yuu boèñboñ mo' yi yu njep máâ ntee ka', m ce laèa ba buu ce m ce koèñ aèmboè ñwáè. Ntee aè rgeèe yuu boèñboñ yi yu njep rbúè, mmbo aè rgeèe yuu anaè mi ba ka'.
English: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don't find it doing that which is good.

Limbum: M ce geèe yuu boèñboñ ce m ce koèñ aè rgeèe na ka', a ce geèe ba yuu bebep ce m ce koèñ aè rgeèe ka' naè.
English: For the good which I desire, I don't do; but the evil which I don't desire, that I practice.

Limbum: AÈmboè m ce geèe ba buu ce m ce koèñ aè rgeèe ka' na, ce geèe ba máè ka', ce geèe ba buu bbebep ce vi yu njep máâ ntee.
English: But if what I don't desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

Limbum: Baná máè yá máná yi yu seè'ni aèmboè ncir wa'a ená m ka' ce koèñ aè rgeèe yuu boèñboñ, ku vú ba yïû bebep njep máâ ntee.
English: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

Limbum: M ce yu' rboèñ neè mncir Nyúè enjep máâ mbuèu ntee.
English: For I delight in God's law after the inward man,

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, máè yá máná ncir mo' jáá yi yu njep máâ bláá, a ce maè' bïìr a ncir enjep máâ ntee, a gee máè ba ñkwaèa neè ncir yuu bebep ce yi yu njep máâ bláá naè.
English: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

Limbum: Máè bú ghup. Ñwáè ce e be jaè' máè efa nyor ce e be geèe tá m kwe na yu nda?
English: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

Limbum: Seèe yoñshi Nyúè njo' yuu ce yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe. Baná yi yu ená m yu ñkwaèa neè mncir Nyúè enjep máâ ntee, yaè nyor aè ba ñkwaèa neè ncir yuu bebep.
English: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God's law, but with the flesh, the sin's law.

Limbum: Baná beèe ce a Jisos Kraâis weèe a yu aèbee a be keèr gweè mnsa' ka',
English: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don't walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

Limbum: njobeè' ñger Yú' ce yi vúè neè ryoèñ njo' Jisos Kraâis yi geèe máè luñ efa ñger buu bbebep ba rkwe.
English: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

Limbum: Nyúè aè geèe yuu ce mncir vi túr ñger aè rgeèe ka', njobeè' ñwáè aè moèo aè rláè mncir laèr. E m tuu muu yïì, e beeñgeèr aè ñwáè aèmboè seèe ce seèe yu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep, tá e bo geèe tá buu bbebep mïî. A mboè e m so buu bbebep enjep seâe mntee aè njáâá wa'a.
English: For what the law couldn't do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe wa'a tá seèe ce seèe ce geèe ñgeèe ba aèmboè ñwáè koèñ ka', a ce geèe ba aèmboè Yú' Nyúè yi ce koèñ, bo geèe ba buu byáánïì ce vi ghááte aèmboè mncir vi ce laèa.
English: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ce geèe ba yuu ce yaèp nyor koèñ, a ku ce kwaè'shi ba aèmboè yaèp nyor. Beèe ce a ce geèe ba buu ce Yú' Nyúè yi koèñ, a ku ce kwaè'shi ba aèmboè buu Nyúè.
English: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' lá ntee ba aè yuu ce yïì nyor koèñ, baná e be kwe. Ñwáè aè ka' lá ntee ba aè yuu ce Yú' Nyúè yi koèñ, baná e be koni ryoèñ, cu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' lá ntee ba aè yuu ce yïì nyor koèñ, baná ñgaèñ be ba ñwáè bbaèa neè Nyúè njobeè' e ce yu'ni neè mncir Nyúè ka'. Neè mini-ñwáè, e moèo aè ryu'ni neè mncir anaè laèr.
English: because the mind of the flesh is hostile towards God; for it is not subject to God's law, neither indeed can it be.

Limbum: AÈde' beèe ce a ce geèe ba buu ce ñwáè koèñ, a gee yuu ce nyor boñ Nyúè ka'.
English: Those who are in the flesh can't please God.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, Yú' Nyúè yi ka' ba njep weâe mntee ghup, baná weèe be keèr láè ntee ba aè buu ce ñwáè e ke koèñ aè rgeèe ka', wee be láè ntee ba aè buu Yú' Nyúè. Ñwáè aè ka' tá túr Yú' Kraâis ka', baná ñwáè anaè yu yïì ñwáè ka'.
English: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn't have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

Limbum: Kraâis ka' ba njep weèe, ka' weêe mnyor vi kweñger njobeè' buu bbebep wa'a, weèe yu bteèe aè yú' njobeè' e geèe weèe aè ba byáánïì.
English: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

Limbum: Yú' ñwáè ce e m fúr Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe yi ka' ba njep weèe, baná ñwáè ce e m fúr Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe be geèe foñ tá weêe mnyor ce aètaè vi kweñgeèr na, vi kúti bteèe. E be geèe wa'a aè ñger yi yú' ce yi yu njep weèe naè.
English: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, baná yuu mo' yi yu ce seèe be kuè geèe, aè ke' ba ená seèe yu'ni neè nyor, cu ba aèmboè e ce koèñ ka'.
English: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

Limbum: Wáè ka' cu ba aèmboè ñwáè e ke koèñ, baná aè be kwe. Wáè ka' yú buu ce ñwáè e ke koèñ aè ñger Yú' Nyúè, baná aè be cu.
English: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce Yú' Nyúè yi ce duèñshi woweèe nduunjïì, a yu boo Nyúè.
English: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

Limbum: Yú' ce weèe aè m koni naè yu ba yú' ce yi geèe weèe aè ba bkwaèa tá weèe bo ce wáp buu ka', yu ba yú' ce yi geèe weèe aè ba ba boo Nyúè. Yú' anaè yi geèe seèe aè ce war neè Nyúè enáê, “Abaè, Yaè Taê.”
English: For you didn't receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, Abba! Father!

Limbum: Yú' anaè ba viseèe mntee a ce duèñshi ená seèe yu boo Nyúè.
English: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' ba boo baná seèe yu beèe ce seèe be ye bti'. Seèe yu ñgaâa ye bti' Nyúè. Seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe be ye bti' anaè aèbee. Seèe ka' yá ñgá' seèe Jisoès weèe baná seèe woweèe be keè sa' foèo.
English: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

Limbum: Máè yá máná aède' seèe be'nïì ñgá' ce seèe ce yá seè'ni na aè foèo ce seèe be keè sa' na ka'.
English: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

Limbum: Buu wááwá ce Nyúè aè m geèe vi cu a ce keè' nfeè' ce Nyúè be geèe tá boo vi a yááti.
English: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe buu ca aè lo a kúti aè buu bcicïì. AÈ m koèñ buu ca aè rkúti aè buu bcicïì ka', aè m koèñ Nyúè ená buu anaè ba wa'a, a ce keè' ená,
English: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

Limbum: buu wááwá ce e m geèe be luñ efa rbúèteè, tá vi bo koni rboèñ efa foèo ce boo Nyúè a be koni.
English: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená buu wááwá ce Nyúè aè m geèe vi ce warñger, a ce yu' ryañ aèmboè njeñwáè ce e ce luuti muu wa'a, vú ba' ntïìni na.
English: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

Limbum: Ku ba ba buu ce Nyúè aè m geèe ce vi ce warñger ka'. See seèe ce Nyúè aè fa seèe yi yú' ce yu rfa entombïì naè, seèe ce warñger enjep ntee foñ, a ce keè' nfeè' ce Nyúè be koo seèe aèmboè boo vi, geèe tá viseèe mnyor vi luêñ.
English: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

Limbum: Seèe ce Nyúè aè geèe seèe aè luêñ, seèe ce keè' nfeè' ce seèe be koni buu anaè. Ñwáè aè ka' yá yuu ce e ba ce keè', e ker ce keè' yi ka'. Waè' aède' ñwáè ker cu aè rkeè' yuu ce e yá wáá a?
English: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' ce keè' yuu ce seèe aè be yá ka', baná seèe be kur ntee ce keè' yi.
English: But if we hope for that which we don't see, we wait for it with patience.

Limbum: Yú' Nyúè foñ yi ce jaè' seèe ce seèe yu neè bsáè-ñwáè, njobeè' seèe rïìñ aè rloo aèmboè seèe aè ba loo ka'. Yú' anaè yi ke bu' mmbo neè Nyúè a seâe btuè neè rwarñgeèr-ñwáè, aè njïì ce aède' ñwáè laa ka'.
English: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don't know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can't be uttered.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e ke fyá' viseèe mntee wááwá rïìñ yuu ce Yú' yi ce kwaè'shi, njobeè' yú' yi ce bu' mmbo aètu beèe Nyúè aè buu ce Nyúè koèñ.
English: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit's mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená Nyúè aè geèe buu wááwá ce vi koni aè kútïì ba rboèñ neè beèe ce a koèñ ye, ce yu beèe ce e ká' aèmboè e m koèñ aè rgeèe efa rkáè'.
English: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.

Limbum: Beèe ce Nyúè aè m rïìñ wáá ená a be ba yïì beèe naè, e m laèa ená e be geèe tá woweèe a feese muu yïì, tá muu yïì anaè bo ba muu nlee neè bfúr magoèr.
English: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

Limbum: Beèe ce Nyúè aè m laèa ená woweèe a be feese muu yïì naè, e m ká' woweèe. Beèe ce Nyúè aè m ká' anaè, e m geèe woweèe a ba byáánïì. Beèe ce e m geèe woweèe a ba byáánïì naè, e m kuè'si woweèe foñ.
English: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

Limbum: AÈde' seèe ka' ker laa seeká aèmboè seèe rïìñ buu ca na? Nyúè aè ka' ba aè mbeèp yïìseèe, ñwáè ce aède' e ker gee yuu mo' neè seèe ba nda?
English: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

Limbum: Nyúè aè m kani efa rfa muu yïì ka'. E m fa muu yïì a seâe btuè. E ka' fa muu yïì, baná e be fa seèe buu wááwá foñ aè cicïì.
English: He who didn't spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce aède' e laa ená beèe ce Nyúè aè ce a yu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep yu nda? Nyúè a ñwáè ce e geèe seèe aè ba byáánïì.
English: Who could bring a charge against God's chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e be laèa ená seèe aè gweè nsa' yu nda? Ñwáè moè' yu ka', njobeè' Jisos Kraâis ce e m kwe, a ker lo a fúú efa rkwe foñ, cu seè'ni na aè rkoo maâ' Nyúè, a ce loo a seèe btuè.
English: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce aède' e gapnïì seèe efa rkoèñnïì ce Kraâis koèñ seèe naè, yu nda? Yuu mo' yi yu ka', káè seèe yu aè ñgá' áè, káè buu aè tap neè seèe se áè, káè beèe a ce fa seèe ñgá' áè, káè njeè ce yañ seèe áè, káè seèe aè buu bcáè' áè, káè yu rkwe áè, káè beèe a ce yú seèe áè, aède' seèe Jisoès weèe gapnïì ka'.
English: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “AÈ ka' ba njobeè' weèe, beèe a taè' yúshi weèr aè mnoèñ wááwá, a ce loèr weèr aèmboè njeèe ce a ce duè aègho aè rsáá wa'a.”
English: Even as it is written, For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè buu ce vi koni weèr na, weèr aè so vi wááwá a misïî, njo' ñwáè ce e m koèñ weèr.
English: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

Limbum: M rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená yuu mo' yi yu ce aède' yi gapnïì seèe efa rkoèñnïì ce Nyúè koèñ seèe na ka'. Káè yu rkwe áè, káè yu rluèñ áè, káè yu bcïìndap Nyúè, káè yu mnyúâmkaè' áè, káè yu buu ce vi yu aègho seè'ni na áè, káè yu buu ce vi bii ka' ba áè, káè njáèá ñger ká áè,
English: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

Limbum: káè yu ba vïì embe buèu áè, káè yu ba vïì enjep múè nshe áè, káè yu ba yuu mo' efa buu ce Nyúè aè m geèe áè, yuu mo' yi yu ce aède' yi gapnïì seèe efa rkoèñnïì ce Nyúè koèñ seèe njo' Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Tata neè seèe naè ka'.
English: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Limbum: M ce laèa ba yuu mini aè rlii Kraêis. M ce nya' mnde' ka'. Ya ntee ce Yú' Rara yi yu njo yi táá yaè njïìnsa' ená,
English: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit,

Limbum: m ce koosimnse seê, ntee yi ce yañ máè aè nfeè' wááwá,
English: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

Limbum: neè yaè beèe ce a yu bfúr wa seeseê, weèr woweèe aè ba láá e mo'sir. M ce koèñ máná ndoèo co' máè, tá weèr Jisos Kraâis gapni, ce yi ka' ba ená ñgaèpni anaè yi be jaè' yaè beèe.
English: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers' sake, my relatives according to the flesh,

Limbum: Woweèe a yu beèe Isráèl. Nyúè aè m geèe woweèe a bo ba boo vi, a fa yi foèo neè woweèe. E m ye leè' a woweèe, a fa woweèe mncir. E m suñ woweèe aèmboè aède' woweèe a gee rloo. E m geèe mi mkaè'ni ba neè woweèe.
English: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

Limbum: Woweèe a yu beèe embe ndúè' Abraèham ba Aisïìk ba Jakoèp. A m bi Kraâis aè ñwáè embe ndúè' anaè, e ba Nyúè ce e túr ñger mbenduè buu wááwá. Seèe yoñshi ye aè nfeè' sïìp. Yi yu wa'a.
English: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

Limbum: Waè' yi yááti ená yuu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' neè beèe Isráèl yi buu efa rgeèetïì a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Beèe wááwá embe ndúè' Isráèl a yu beèe Isráèl ka'.
English: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená beèe wááwá a yu boo Abraèham njobeè' woweèe a yu beèe embe ndúè' Abraèham ka'. Nyúè aè m laèa neè Abraèham enáê, “Boo ce a be láè lo rlii be ba boo Aisïìk.”
English: Neither, because they are Abraham's seed, are they all children. But, In Isaac will your seed be called.

Limbum: Cena yi ce duèñshi ená yu boo wááwá ce Abraèham aè m bi ce a yu boo Nyúè ka'; yu ba boo ce a m bi njo' mñkaè'ni ce Nyúè aè m geèe neè Abraèham ce a ce beè' aè boo Abraèhaêm.
English: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as a seed.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe mñkaè'ni anaè, a laa enáê, “Nfeè' be gháá tá m kúti; tá Sáèra bi muu mbañruè.”
English: For this is a word of promise, At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.

Limbum: Yi ku ba ba wa' caè'caè' ka'. Boo Ráèbákaè a m túr taèr moè'sir ce e yu yïìseèe ta Aisïìk.
English: Not only so, but Rebecca also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, aè m ba aè nfeè' ce boo anaè a m ku bii njep rbúè, a ke' be geèe yuu bbebep káè yuu boèñboñ ka', Nyúè aè laa neè Ráèbákaè enáê, “Nlee be faè' neè Ñká'.” Nyúè aè m geèe wa' tá yi bo ba ená aè ce ba ye a ce moè' efa boo ca aèmboè e m kwaè'shi, aè ke' ba ba njobeè' yuu mo' ce ñwáè anaè aè m geèe ka', aè m ba njobeè' aè m káè' ba Nyúè.
English: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls, it was said to her, The elder will serve the younger.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Máè m koèñ Jakoèp a baa Ásoè.” naè.
English: Even as it is written, Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.

Limbum: Baná seèe be laèa seeká? Waè' seèe be laèa seená Nyúè aè m geèe yuu mini ka' a? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr.
English: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

Limbum: Nyúè aè m laèa neè Musïìs enáê, “M be koosimnse neè ñwáè ce máè koèñ. Be kwaè'shi ba máè ñwáè ce m be geèe boèñboñ neè ye.”
English: For he said to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.

Limbum: Baná yi yu ená Nyúè e ke ce ñwáè ba aèmboè ñwáè ce koèñ káè njo' yuu ce ñwáè aè geèe ka'. E ke ce ba njo' yïì ñkoosimnse caè'caè'.
English: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m laèa neè Fároè mbe yeâ ñwaè' enáê, “Máè ko'si wáè mbe kúú, tá m bo duèñshi ya ñger njïì enjep wáè, tá la rlii li bo yu'ti aè ñgoèñ wááwá.”
English: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.

Limbum: Baná Nyúè e ke koosimnse neè ñwáè ce e koèñ aè rkoosimnse neè ye, ker teesi tu ese ñwáè ce e koèñ aè rteèesi tu ese ye.
English: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

Limbum: Seemoè' ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú be laèa neè máè enáê, “Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyúè aè ka' ce taèa ñwáè njoká, aèmboè yi yu ba ená aède' ñwáè kanïì efa rgeèe yuu ce Nyúè ce koèñ ená ñgaèñ gee ka' na?”
English: You will say then to me, Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?

Limbum: Wáè ce aè ku ba ba ñwáè, aè yu nda ka' beèesi cuèu weèe Nyúè? AÈde' rkïìñ li laa neè ñwáè ce e boo li enáê, “Wáè boo máè wa'a njoká” a?
English: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, Why did you make me like this?

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè mboo mkïìñ lor mboo, gee yuu ce e koèñ aègho. AÈde' e lor mboo embe dïû' mo'sir boo mkïìñ aègho mmbaa, rmo' li boñ du misïî, rmo' li ku ba ba aè rkïìñ.
English: Or hasn't the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená Nyúè aè m ce koèñ aè rduèñshi li rshentee, geèe tá beèe a bo yá yi ñger, a lo a kur ba ntee neè beèe ce a m geèe ntee yi bep ye, aè ba beèe ce yi m ba ená e be yúshi woweèe naè,
English: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath made for destruction,

Limbum: baná e m geèe wa'a tá e bo duèñshi rboèñ efa yi foèo neè beèe ce e m ce koosimnse neè woweèe, aè ba beèe ce e m kupshi tá woweèe a bo koni foèo anaè naè.
English: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,

Limbum: A seèe beèe ce Nyúè aè ká' ená a ba yïì beèe anaè. E ku ká' beèe ba efa múè Jus ka', e ká' beèe enje jáá foñ.
English: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

Limbum: Nyúè aè laèa mbe ñwaâ' Hoèsiyaè enáê, “Beèe ce a m ba yaè beèe ka', m be too woweèe ená yaè beèe. M be too to' ce máè m koèñ ka' ená ya to' ce m koèñ seê.”
English: As he says also in Hosea, I will call them 'my people,' which were not my people; and her 'beloved,' who was not beloved.

Limbum: E ker laa foñ enáê, “Mbe dïì' ce a m laèa neè woweèe ená, ‘weèe yu yaè bee ka'’, ku ba mbe dïì' anaè ce a be too woweèe ená boo Nyúè ce e yu nteèe.”
English: It will be that in the place where it was said to them, 'You are not my people,' There they will be called 'children of the living God.'

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe Isráèl, AÈsayaè aè m laèa yuu a kuu woweèe. E m laèa enáê, “Ka' beèe Isráèl a yu goèr aèmboè nsaruñ aèwaâa roè wa'a, ku ba beèe múcaèr efa waâp mú ce a be luèñ.”
English: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

Limbum: Tata be caèasi nfeè' ka', e be sa' mnsa' ñgoèñ, teni.
English: for He will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the LORD will make a short work upon the earth.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè AÈsayaè aè m laèa foñ enáê, “Tata Nyúè ce e túr ñger mbenduè buu wááwá aè m ka' tá baè maè'shi boo moè' neè seèe ka', seèe aè m ba ba aèmboè rla' Sodoèm ba rla' Goèmoraè.” wa'a.
English: As Isaiah has said before, Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.

Limbum: Cena yi yu ba ená ká? Yi yu ená beèe enje jáá ce a m ce gheèter aè rba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ka', a yu seè'ni byáánïì njobeè' lap rbyemïì.
English: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn't follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

Limbum: Beèe Isráèl ce a m ce roèo yap aè rba byáánïì njo' mncir ce a m ce láè, a m moèo laèr.
English: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn't arrive at the law of righteousness.

Limbum: Woweèe a m moèo laèr njoká? AÈ m ba njobeè' woweèe a m gheèter aè rba byáánïì njo' mfaè', ke' ba ba njo' rbyemïì ka'. Woweèe a m kote aè luèr,
English: Why? Because they didn't seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;

Limbum: ce Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa aègho naè. Yi laèa enáê, “Yáê, m ce láè luèr aè rla' Sayoèn, ce e be geèe tá beèe a kote. Luèr anaè be geèe tá woweèe a gweñger. Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè ye, m ke coosi ñgaèñ ka'.”
English: even as it is written, Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce koèñ neè ya ntee-ñwáè, a ker ce loo neè Nyúè ená beèe Isráèl a luêñ.
English: Brothers, my heart's desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ máná woweèe a láè ntee aè rduè aèmbuèu Nyúè, a ke' riñ njïû mini ka'.
English: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

Limbum: Woweèe a m rïìñ njáèá njïì ce Nyúè e ke geèe beèe a ba byáánïì ka', a ce gheèter aè rroèo ba nduunjïì yap aè rba byáánïì, a kani yap yu njïì yïì Nyúè.
English: For being ignorant of God's righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn't subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

Limbum: Kraâis aè m vúè, rfaè' efa mncir li mïî, tá ñwáè wááwá ce e byemi neè ye bo ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

Limbum: Musïìs aè m sañ aèmboè aède' ñwáè ba yáánïì njo' mncir, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' lá mncir wááwá baná ñgaèñ be cu njo' mncir anaè.”
English: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, The one who does them will live by them.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè njïì ce aède' ñwáè ba yáánïì njo' rbyemïì, e laa enáê, “Fa laèa njep wáâ ntee enáê, ‘AÈde' ko' nda mbe buèu lá?’ ka' ce yi yu ená, Be suèu nda neè Kraâis embe buèu lá?.
English: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, Don't say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?' that is, to bring Christ down;

Limbum: Fa laèa njep wáâ ntee enáê, ‘AÈde' ñwáè du mbaè yir lá?’ ka'” ce yi yu ená be vúè nda neè Kraâis embaè yir? lá.
English: or, 'Who will descend into the abyss?' that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.

Limbum: Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa ená ká? Yi laèa ba enáê, “Blaâa Nyúè vi yu aètútú neè wáè; vi yu ku wáâ cuèu, a ba njep wáâ ntee.” Blaèa anaè yu blaèa ce vi ce suñ aèmboè rbyemïì ce weèr ce feè'shi.
English: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart; that is, the word of faith, which we preach:

Limbum: Wáè ka' laèa eku wáâ cuèu ená Jisos yu Tataê, byemi enjep wáâ ntee ená Nyúè aè m fúr ye efa rkwe, baná aè be luèñ.
English: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

Limbum: Ñwáè e ke byemi ba enjep ntee ka' ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè, e ke laèa ba ekuè cuèu ka' luêñ.
English: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

Limbum: Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, “Ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' byemi neè ye, baná e be coosi ñgaèñ ka'.”
English: For the Scripture says, Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.

Limbum: Jus a ker ba jáá efa beèe enje jáá ka'. Kraâis yu Tata neè woweèe wááwá. E ke ghoèni ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' war neè ye.
English: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ enáê, “Ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' war aè rlii Tataê, baná ñgaèñ be luèñ” naè.
English: For, Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.

Limbum: Baná aède' beèe a war neè ye aè njáâá ká ce woweèe a ka' tá byemi neè ye ka'? AÈde' woweèe a byemïì neè ye aè njáâá ká ce woweèe a ka' tá yu' aèmboè ye ka'? AÈde' woweèe a yu' aèmboè ye aè njáâá ká ce ñwáè aè ka' tá feè'shi neè woweèe ka'?
English: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

Limbum: AÈde' beèe a du fe'shi aè njáâá ká ce a ka' tá tuu woweèe ka'? Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Mkuèu beèe ce a vúè a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ mi boèñ aèmboè ká wa'a!”
English: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, beèe wááwá a byemi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca ka'. AÈsayaè aè m laèa enáê, “Tataê, ñwáè moè' yu ce e byemi yuu ce weèr aè laèa ka'.”
English: But they didn't all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has believed our report?

Limbum: Baná yi yu ená beèe a ke yu' wáá ka' byemi; beèe a feè'shi aèmboè Kraâis wáá, beèe a ka' yu'.
English: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

Limbum: M ce bipshi máná woweèe a m yu' nsuñ ca ka' lá? Yi yu mini wa' ka'. Yi yu enáê, “Beèe a yu' yaèp njeèndoñ aè bdïì' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ. Wap blaèa vi baè' aè mmbuu ñgoèñ wááwá.”
English: But I say, didn't they hear? Yes, most certainly, Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.

Limbum: M ker ce bipshi máná beèe Isráèl a m rïìñ ka' lá? M be beèesi neè yuu ce Musïìs aè m sañ eluâuñgoèñ. E m sañ yuu ce Nyúè aè m laèa, enáê, “M be geèe tá weèe ko'ndoñ neè beèe ce a ghááte aè to' ka'. M be geèe tá ntee yi bep weèe neè to' ce yi rïìñ yuu ka'.”
English: But I ask, didn't Israel know? First Moses says, I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.

Limbum: AÈsayaè ye ye aè m raasi seê, a sañ yuu ce Nyúè aè m laèa enáê, “Beèe ce a m ce roèo máè ka', a yá máè. Máè duèñshi yaè nyor neè beèe ce a m ce bipshi ená m yu fá lá ka'.”
English: Isaiah is very bold, and says, I was found by those who didn't seek me. I was revealed to those who didn't ask for me.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè beèe Isráèl, AÈsayaè aè m sañ yuu ce Nyúè aè m laèa enáê, “Máè maè' ma mmbo neè yaè beèe, káâ' aè ñgaèptú' du ba' aè mbuèuñkuèr, woweèe a tee btu, a yu'ni neè máè ka'.”
English: But as to Israel he says, All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.

Limbum: M be keèr bipshi yuu mo'. Waè' Nyúè aè maè' yïì beèe a? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. Má máè yu moè' efa beèe Isráèl. M yu ñwáè embe ndúè' Abraèhaêm, a ba ñwáè embe ntáè' Bánjamáèn.
English: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

Limbum: Nyúè aè maè' yïì beèe ce e m ce efa rkáè' ka'. Mboè weèe rïìñ yuu ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè aèmboè AÈlajaè naè a? AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' moè', e laa bebep aèmboè beèe Isráèl neè Nyúè.
English: God didn't reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don't you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Tataê, beèe ca a yúshi yo ñgaâa ntuu, a kááshi wo bdïû' ntoèo mfa, aè ku báti máè. Woweèe a ce roèo aè ryú máè.”
English: Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

Limbum: Nyúè aè beesïì neè ye ená ká? E m beèesi enáê, “Máè bár yaè beèe ncúèkïì saèambaê, ce woweèe a loo neè Baal ka'.”
English: But how does God answer him? I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.

Limbum: Yi ku ba wa' foñ seè'ni na. Mú beèe moè' a ku ba aè múè beèe Isráèl ce Nyúè aè ce njo' yi ntee boèñboñ.
English: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená Nyúè aè ce woweèe njo' yi ntee boèñboñ baná e ce woweèe ba njo' yuu mo' ce woweèe a geèe ka'. E m ka' ba ce woweèe ba njo' yuu mo' ce woweèe a m geèe, yi ntee boèñboñ anaè aè m ba ba ntee boèñboñ ghup ka'.
English: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

Limbum: Yuu m ce laèa yi yu ba ená ká? Yi yu ená beèe Isráèl wááwá a m koni yuu ce a m ce roèo ese Nyúè ka'. Mú beèe ce Nyúè aè m ce naè a beèe ce a m koni yuu anaè. Nyúè aè m geèe bár beèe a cip btuè'.
English: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn't obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Nyúè aè m geèe woweèe a máñnïì buu, a ce yá buu ka', a ker ce yu' buu ka', caar ba' ntïìni na.”
English: According as it is written, God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.

Limbum: Dávïìd ye ye aè m laèa enáê, “Geèe tá yuu ce woweèe a ce yu' rboèñ aègho naè, yi kúti ba taa ce yi be koo woweèe. Geèe tá woweèe a tañte, keèr kote aè yuu anaè, yá ñgá' njo' yap yuu ce a geèe anaè.
English: David says, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

Limbum: Geèe tá woweèe a faêp, faè dïì' woweèe a bo keèr yá buu ka'. Gúú wap mnjïì nfeseè.”
English: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.

Limbum: Waè' cena yi yu ená woweèe a m kote tá woweèe a bo gweè keèr naèti ka' a? AÈde' yi ba wa' ka' koo múcaèr. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' woweèe a m geèe yuu bebep, Nyúè aè fa fáñ neè beèe enje jáá tá woweèe a bo luèñ, tá beèe Isráèl a ko'ndoñ neè woweèe.
English: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

Limbum: Ka' ba ená yuu bebep ce woweèe a m geèe naè aè m kúti ba bghoènïì neè ñgoèñ, rgweè ce woweèe a m gweè naè aè kútïì ba bghoènïì neè beèe enje jáá, baná bghoènïì ce seèe be keè koni aè nfeè' ce Jus wááwá a yu'ni neè Nyúè foñ naè, vi be keè ba magoèr aèmboè ká?
English: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?

Limbum: M ce laèa seè'ni na ba neè weèe ce weèe yu ye beèe enje jáá. M yu ñwáè ntuu ba neè beèe enje jáá. M ce loèr la rfaè' ca aè mcáâr ka',
English: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;

Limbum: tá m bo yá máná aède' m gee yaè beèe aè ko'ndoñ tá beèe mo' efa woweèe a bo luèñ lá.
English: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ka' ma' woweèe, bár beèe enjep ñgoèñ a konïì fáñ aè rkúti aèbee a Nyúè weèe, baná yi be ba aè njáâá ká aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè ka' koo woweèe aè yïì beèe? Yi be ba aèmboè beèe ce a kweñger a kúti lá bteèe wa'a.
English: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' top mkúâñ bráêd, too bráâd yïì entoèmbïì fa neè Nyúè, baná bráâd wááwá ce e be toèo efa mkúèñ anaè yu yïû Nyúè. Mñgaâñ ce ka' ba vi Nyúè, baná mmba' ce yu vi foñ.
English: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená a m faèrshi mmba' mo' efa ce Oleèf ce a m byeè aè mñkúè, a lor weèe ce weèe yu ye mmba' ce Oleèf ce aè rïìñ a bar nje ce Oleèf ce aè mñkúè, weèe aè ce kuè' neè mdip enje nyoèr ce anaè,
English: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;

Limbum: baná weèe fa naèa tu ená weèe aè caèa mmba' ce ce a m faèrshi efa Oleèf ce aè mñkúè naè ka'. Weèe aè ka' ce naèa nyor, weèe kuushi ená yu ba weèe ce weèe ce geèe mñgaâñ ce vi ce kuè' ka', yu ba mñgaâñ ce ce vi geèe weèe aè ka' ce kuè'.
English: don't boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

Limbum: Seemoè' aè be ce naèa tu enáê, “A m faèrshi mmba' mo' tá a bo bar máè njo.”
English: You will say then, Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.

Limbum: Yi yu mini wa'a. A m faèrshi woweèe njobeè' woweèe a m byemi ka'. Weèe yu ñgúè' moè' efa ce anaè njo' le rbyemïì caè'caè'. Baná weèe fa naèa tu ka', weèe lor nfeè'.
English: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don't be conceited, but fear;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ka' tá koosimnse efa rfaèrshi mmba' ce mo' efa ce Oleèf yïû aè mñkúè ka', baná e be koosimnse efa rfaèrshi weèe foñ ka'.
English: for if God didn't spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

Limbum: Yá ka neè aèmboè Nyúè ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ neè beèe mo', a ker ce jar neè beèe moè'. E ce jar neè beèe ce a gweè, a ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ neè weèe, ce weèe aè ka' ku ce jáèr ba njep yi nduunjïì. Yi ka' tá ba wa' ka' baná e be faèr weèe foñ.
English: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

Limbum: Beèe anaè foñ a ka' kupse byemi, baná Nyúè be bar woweèe nje ce ca. E túr ñger aè rgeèe wa'a.
English: They also, if they don't continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

Limbum: E m loèr weèe ce weèe yu mmba' ce Oleèf efa rïìñ, a bar nje ce Oleèf yïû aè mñkúè, ce yi ke ba wa'a ka', baná neè mini-ñwáè, e túr ñger aè rloèr mmba' ce vïû aè mñkúè ce a m faèrshi naè, bar nje ce anaè.
English: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce koèñ máná weèe riñ yuu ce beèe a m be riñ ka', faè dïì' weèe bo ce kwaè'shi ená weèe túr bfee se ka'. Yi yu ená beèe Isráèl a be kuè cip btuè' nfeseè ka'. A be kuè cip btuè' caar duè baè' aè nfeè' ce beèe wááwá efa múè beèe enje jáá ce a ba byemi, a byemi naè.
English: For I don't desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won't be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

Limbum: Ca yi be keè koni, tá beèe Isráèl wááwá a luêñ. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè ce e be fúr beèe efa ñgá' be vúè efa rla' Sayoèn, fúr ñgeâe bebep embe ndúè' Jakoèp.
English: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

Limbum: Be ba aè nfeè' ce máè siñsi yaèp buu bbebep, tá yi ba ená máè geèe yuu ce máè m ye leè' máná m be geèe naè.”
English: This is my covenant to them, when I will take away their sins.

Limbum: Beèe Isráèl a yu ñgaâa bbaèa neè Nyúè njobeè' woweèe a kani Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ. Cena yu sá' neè weèe ce weèe yu beèe enje jáá. Ka' yi yu wa'a, e m ce woweèe a ku bii koèñ woweèe njobeè' wap btaê.
English: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sake.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' ce beèe, ker ghoni woweèe, aède' e ker kupse yi ntee ka'.
English: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

Limbum: AÈ m ba entoèmbïì, weèe aè tee btu neè Nyúè, aè ka' ba seè'ni, Nyúè aè koosïìmnse neè weèe njobeè' nteèetu beèe Isráèl.
English: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

Limbum: Wowo foñ a teèe btu neè Nyúè seè'ni na tá Nyúè bo koosimnse neè weèe, keèr koosimnse neè woweèe foñ.
English: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

Limbum: Yi yu ená Nyúè aè fa beèe wááwá aè shañ nteèetu, tá e bo koosimnse neè woweèe wááwá.
English: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

Limbum: Yá aèmboè Nyúè yu ñwáâ ñgoèr naè! Yá aèmboè e rïìñ buu, a túr bfee se naè! AÈde' ñwáè riñ aèmboè Nyúè ce kwaè'shi ka'. AÈde' ñwáè riñ aèmboè Nyúè ce geèe yïì buu ka'.
English: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè ce e rïìñ aèmboè Tata e ke kwaè'shi yu nda? Ñwáè ce aède' e cep ye yu nda?”
English: For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?

Limbum: “Ñwáè ce e m be fa Nyúè yuu tá Nyúè bo laè' yuu ce e m fa neè ye anaè yu nda?”
English: Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?

Limbum: Buu wááwá aè m loè ese Nyúè, buu anaè wááwá aè ba aègho njo' ye, buu wááwá aè ba yïì buu. Tá beèe a ku'si ye nfeè' sïìp! Yi yu wa'a.
English: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yi ka' ba wa'a, aèmboè Nyúè aè koosimnse neè seèe na, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe fa weêe mnyor neè Nyúè aèmboè buu tañshïì ce vi yu bteèe, a ba brara, Nyúè aè ce yu' rboèñ aègho. A njáèá njïû yáánïì ce ñwáè aè ba loo neè Nyúè.
English: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

Limbum: Fa beè'ni neè buu ce beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ce geèe ka'. Maè'shi neè tá Nyúè kupse me mkwaè'shïì tá weèe bo geèe ñgeâe fi. Weèe aè ka' gee wa'a, weèe riñ yuu ce Nyúè koèñ. Weèe be rïìñ yuu ce yi yu boèñboñ, aè ba yuu ce Nyúè ce yu' rboèñ aègho, a ba yáánïì.
English: Don't be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' ñger ce Nyúè aè fa neè máè njo' yi ntee boèñboñ, m ce laèa neè weèe wááwá ená ñwáè fa kwaè'shi aèmboè yi tu, caèa embe dïì' ce e ba kwaè'shi ka'. Kwaè'shi aèmboè yo tu ba aè njïû yáánïì. Ñwáè wááwá ku kwa'shi aèmboè yi tu ba aèndeèe rbyemïì ce Nyúè aè fa ye.
English: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

Limbum: Nyor ku ba moè'sir, a túr mñgúè' nyor jáá jáèá jáá, ñgúè' nyor wááwá aè túr li rfaè'.
English: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don't have the same function,

Limbum: Yi ku ba neè seèe wa' foñ. Ka' seèe yu aèñgoo wa'a, seèe ku ba nyor moè'sir njobeè' seèe Kraâis weèe yu aèbee. Yi ka' ba ená seèe yu nyor moè'sir, baná ñgúè' nyor moè' yu neè yi tu ka'.
English: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

Limbum: Seèe wááwá aè koni bfee jáá jáèá jáá ese Nyúè njo' yi ntee boèñboñ ce e túr neè seèe, a ce geèe mfaè' aègho. Baná ñwáè wááwá geèe rfaè' neè bfee anaè. Nyúè aè ka' fa ñwáè bfee ce aède' e cep ntuu Nyúè, baná ñwáè anaè cep aèmboè li rbyemïì li yu.
English: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' fa ñwáè bfee ce aède' e fa' neè beèe, baná ñwáè anaè fa' neè beèe. Ñwáè aè ka' túr bfee aè ryá'nïì, ñgaèñ yá'nïì beèe.
English: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' túr bfee aè rfeè'shi blaâa Nyúè, tapsi beèe aègho, baná ñgaèñ fe'shïî. Nyúè aè ka' gee ñwáè riñ aè rfa beèe buu, baná ñgaèñ fa mmbo mtoo. Ñwáè ka' túr bfee aè rba tu neè beèe, e sa' beèe neè yi ntee-ñwáè. Ñwáè aè ka' túr bfee aè rjaè' beèe, ñgaèñ ja' neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè.
English: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with liberality; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

Limbum: Koèñ neè beèe neè mini-ñwáè, baa yuu bebep, koñ ba yuu boèñboñ.
English: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

Limbum: Weèe koñni aèmboè bfúr. Weèe naa beèe moè' mbekïì caa aèmboè weèe ce naèa wee btu.
English: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate one to another; in honor preferring one another;

Limbum: Fa koosi neè bbor ka', faè' neè tatap. Faè' neè neè Tata Nyúè neè ye ntee-ñwáè.
English: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

Limbum: Láè neè mmir mbenduè buu ce Nyúè aè kaè' neè weèe, ce lu'shi. Táá neè tatap aè nfeè' ñgá', ce loo neè Nyúè, ke' ce sá ka'.
English: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

Limbum: Ñwáè Nyúè aè ka' buu yuu, weèe túr yuu anaè, weèe fa ye. Koni neè beèe ce a niñ weèe, gá' neè woweèe boèñboñ.
English: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.

Limbum: Loo neè ená Nyúè ghoni beèe ce a ce fa weèe ñgá'. Fa loo neè ená ndoèo co' woweèe ka', loo neè ba ená Nyúè ghoni woweèe.
English: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don't curse.

Limbum: Lu'shi neè weèe beèe ce a ce lu'shi, koosimnse weèe beèe ce a ce koosimnse.
English: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

Limbum: Cu neè neè rfúteè-ñwáè weèe beèe wááwá. Fa naèa neè tu ka', koo neè bkar weèe beèe ce a loèr wap mnyor njep nsheè. Fa kwaè'shi neè ená weèe yu ñgaâa bfee ka'.
English: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don't set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don't be wise in your own conceits.

Limbum: Fa kúsi neè yuu bebep neè yuu bebep ka'. Gheèter neè gee ba buu ce vi be ba yáánïì aè bsii beèe wááwá.
English: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

Limbum: Geèe neè yuu wááwá ce aède' weèe geêe, tá weèe bo cu neè rfúteè-ñwáè weèe beèe wááwá.
English: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

Limbum: Bkar waê, ñwáè fa kúsi mcucu' ka', maè'shi yïì anaè ba neè rshentee Nyúè. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè ce e be kúsi mcucu' yu máè. M be laè' woweèe. Cena ce laèa Tata Nyúè.”
English: Don't seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God's wrath. For it is written, Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.

Limbum: Weèe gee ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Njeè aè ka' ce yañ ñwáè ce e baèa wáè, aè fa ye byee. Ntee yi ka' yuushi ye, aè fa ye yuu tá e no. Wáè ka' gee wa'a, baná wáè cuè' mcuèñ mor mbe yeâ tu.”
English: Therefore If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.

Limbum: Fa maè'shi tá yuu bebep yi so wáè ka'; so yuu bebep neè yuu boèñboñ.
English: Don't be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá yu'ni neè beèe ce a ce sa' to' njobeè' Nyúè a ñwáè ce e geèe ená beèe mo' a sa' beèe mo'. Nyúè ka' tá fa ñwáè ñger aè rsa' beèe ka', ñgaèñ túr ñger anaè ka'.
English: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ka' tee tu neè beèe ce a ce sa' beèe, baná ñgaèñ aè teèe tu neè yuu ce Nyúè aè geèe. Beèe ce a ka' gee wa'a, baná woweèe a ce ká' ñgá' mbe waâp btuè.
English: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè ce e ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ wáp ñwáè ce e ce sa' beèe ka'. Ñwáè ce aède' e wáp ye, yu ba ñwáè ce e ce geèe ñgeâe bebep. Wáè ka' ce koèñ aè rwáp ñwáè ce e ce sa' beèe ka', aè gee ñgeâe boèñboñ tá e bo yoèñshi wáè.
English: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,
