Limbum: Ñwáè ca ce faè' ba neè Nyúè tá e bo jaè' wáè. Wáè ka' gee yuu bebep, aè wáp ye, njobeè' ñger ce a fa ye anaè yi yu aè cicïì ka'. Nyúè aè fa ye ñger aè rkúsi mcucu' neè beèe ce a ce geèe buu bbebep.
English: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn't bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

Limbum: Baná yi yu yáánïì aè ryu'ni neè ñgaâa rsa', ke' ku ba ba njobeè' aè ce wáp ñgá' ka'. Geèe wa'a faè dïì' yo ntee yi bo ce sa' wáè ka'.
English: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience' sake.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce weâe ke laè' mbaâa baèraè' foñ, njobeè' beèe ce a ce kuèu mbaâa baèraè' a ce faè' ba neè Nyúè.
English: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God's service, attending continually on this very thing.

Limbum: Fa neè yuu ce weèe aè ba fa neè ñwáè wááwá. Káè yu mbaâa baèraè' áè, káè yu mbaèa ce a laèa ená aè la' aètu buu ce wáè túr áè, laè' yuu ce wáè ba laè'. Wáp beèe ce wáè ba wáp, yu'ni neè beèe ce wáè ba yu'ni neè woweèe.
English: Give therefore to everyone what you owe: taxes to whom taxes are due; customs to whom customs; respect to whom respect; honor to whom honor.

Limbum: Weèe ñwáè moè' fa ba neè rkaa ka'. Rkaa ce aède' aè túr weèe ñwáè li yu ená aè koèñ ñgaèñ. Ñwáè aè ka' koñ beèe, baná e láè mncir wááwá.
English: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

Limbum: Mncir Nyúè vi ce laèa enáê, “Fa koo ñgwa ñwáè moè' káè nduu ñwáè moè' ka', fa yú ka', fa yáèá ka', fa gani ka'.” Mncir ca wááwá ker ba mncir mo' vi táá ba mbenduè ncir e mo'sir. Ncir anaè yi yu enáê, “Koèñ nfúroè aèmboè wáè koèñ yoè nyor.”
English: For the commandments, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not give false testimony, You shall not covet, and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' koñ nfúr yïì, e ker gee yu bebep neè ye ka'. Ñwáè aè ka' koñ ñwáè baná e láè mncir wááwá.
English: Love doesn't harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

Limbum: Weèe ce koñni wa'a njobeè' weèe rïìñ ená nfeè' ce weèe aè ba lá' efa mmirloè aè gháá. Nfeè' ce Nyúè be geèe tá seèe luñ yu seè'ni aètútú a caa aèmboè e m ba aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m káè' byemi neè Jisos Kraâis naè.
English: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

Limbum: Mbeèr aè loè, túè' aè ká' a ce raa. Baná seèe ma' ñgeâe neètú', lor buu bïìr e neèmootïì, yar.
English: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let's therefore throw off the works of darkness, and let's put on the armor of light.

Limbum: Seèe gee ñgeèe aèmboè beèe ce a ce cu ba aè rraa. Seèe fa ce duè mñkaâ' bghaa, káè ce no buu tá vi ce koo seèe ka'. Seèe borni bsaèkïì ba mká'ni. Seèe borni mlap ba ñko'ndoñ.
English: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

Limbum: Loèr neè ba ndeèe Tata Jisos Kraêis. Fa fa neè njïì neè buu bebep ce ñwáè e ke koèñ aè rgeèe naè ka'.
English: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce li rbyemïì li ka' ba wáèni, weèe koo ñgaèñ a weâe mú. Weèe ñwáè anaè weèe fa sár ba mnsár aèmboè yuu ce e byemi ená e ba geèe ka'.
English: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè byemi yi ená aètaè e ye njáèá buu wááwá, ñwáè ce li rbyemïì li yu wáèni aè ku ce ye yi ba njaèp ce a kap kap.
English: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ce ye njáèá buu wááwá fa jaèasi ñwáè ce e kani efa rye njáèá byee mo' naè ka', ñwáè ce e ce ye njáèá byee mo' ka' naè fa laèa ená ñwáè ce e ye njáèá byee wááwá aè geèe yuu bebep ka', njobeè' Nyúè aè koo ñwáè anaè aè yïì ñwáè.
English: Don't let him who eats despise him who doesn't eat. Don't let him who doesn't eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

Limbum: AÈ yu nda, ka' sa' ñwáè rfaè' ñwáè moè'? Ñwáè ce aède' e laa ená ñwáè rfaè' aè geèe boèñboñ káè bebep áè, ku ba yïì masaè. E be gweè ka' njobeè' Tata túr ñger aè rgeèe ye tá e táá tatap.
English: Who are you who judge another's servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

Limbum: Beèe moè' a ce loèr ená noâñ mo' yu noâñ goèr a caa mnoèñ wááwá, beèe mo' a lor yap ená mnoèñ wááwá vi ku ba yáánïì. Ñwáè wááwá aè ba kwaè'shi, rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená yuu ce e ce kwaè'shi yi yu yáánïì.
English: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ce loèr ená noâñ mo' yi yu jáá ce geèe wa'a tá e bo yu'ni neè Tataê. Ñwáè ce e ce ye buu wááwá, ce geèe wa'a njobeè' e ce koèñ aè ryu'ni neè Tata foñ. E ce yoèñshi Nyúè aè byee anaè. Ñwáè ce e kani efa rye njáèá byee mo', ce geèe wa'a njobeè' e ce koèñ aè ryu'ni neè Tata foñ. Ye ye ce yoèñshi Nyúè.
English: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn't eat, to the Lord he doesn't eat, and gives God thanks.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa seâe mú ce cu neè yi tu ka'. Ñwáè moè' efa seâe mú ce kwe neè yi tu ka'.
English: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' cu bteèe, seèe ku ce yu' ba ese Tataê. Seèe aè ka' kwe, baná seèe ku ba ba mba yeâ mmboè. Baná káè seèe aè cu bteèe áè, káè seèe aè kwe áè, seèe ku ba ba mbaè mmbo Tataê.
English: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord's.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce Kraâis aè m kwe a fúú efa rkwe. E m geèe wa'a tá e bo ba Tata neè beèe ce a kweñger ba beèe ce a cu bteèe.
English: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu wa' na, wáè ka' ce sa' nfúroè njoká? AÈ ce jaèasi nfúroè njoká? Seèe wááwá be keè táá kuèntombïì neè Nyúè tá e sa' seèe.
English: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Tata aè laèa enáê, ‘AÈmboè m yu nteèe na ñwáè wááwá be keè gú'shi njep máâ tïìi. Ñwáè wááwá be keè laèa neè yi cuèu ená m yu Nyúè.”
English: For it is written, 'As I live,' says the Lord, 'to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.'

Limbum: Baná ñwáè wááwá be keè táá kuèntombïì neè Nyúè, suñ yuu ce e m geèe.
English: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

Limbum: Baná seèe fa keèr sa' viseèe mnyor ka'. Yuu ce weèe aè ba geèe yi yu ená weèe kani ená weèe be keè geèe yuu mo' ce aède' yi gee nfúr yeè moè' kote káè gwe ka'.
English: Therefore let's not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother's way, or an occasion for falling.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè weèr Tata Jisoès yu aèbee na, máè riñ neè mini-ñwáè ená njáèá byee mo' vi yu ce aède' ñwáè buu efa rye ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ñwáè aè ka' byemi ená njáèá byee mo' vi boèñ aè rye ka', baná byee anaè vi yu boèñboñ neè ye ka'.
English: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

Limbum: Ntee yi ka' ce yañ nfúroè njobeè' aè ce ye njáèá byee mo', baná aè ker ce koèñ ye ka'. Fa maè'shi tá byee vi kúti ba yuu ce yi be geèe tá ñwáè ce Kraâis aè m kwe a yeâ tuè gwe ka'.
English: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don't destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

Limbum: Fa geèe tá yuu ce yi yu boèñboñ neè wáè, yi kúti ba yuu ce beèe a be laèa bebep aègho ka'.
English: Then don't let your good be slandered,

Limbum: Yuu ce yi yu goèr neè beèe ce Nyúè yu yaèp ñkúú yu ba buu bye ba buu mno ka'. Yuu ce yi yu goèr yu ba ñgeâe yáánïì ba cumúnyañ, ker ba rlu'shïì ce li loè ese Yú' Rara.
English: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ce faè' neè Kraâis aè njáâá wa'a, baná Nyúè be yu' rboèñ neè ñgaèñ, tá beèe a vúse ye.
English: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

Limbum: Baná seèe gheter ce gee ba buu ce vi be geèe tá seèe cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè, keèr geèe tá seèe ce kuè' aèbee.
English: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

Limbum: Fa bepsi rfaâ' Nyúè njo' byee ka'. Nyúè aè kani seèe efa rye njáèá byee mo' ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, wáè ka' ye yuu ce yi be geèe tá nfúroè gweê, baná wáè geèe yuu bebep.
English: Don't overthrow God's work for food's sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

Limbum: Yi yu boèñboñ ená aè borni efa rye nyaèa, ker borni efa rno mruè', borni efa geèe njáèá yuu ce aède' yi gee nfúroè koteè.
English: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

Limbum: Wáè ka' byemi ená Nyúè aè kani wáè efa rgeèe buu ca ka', aè ma'shïì tá ku rïìñ ba wáè weèe Nyúè. Ñwáè ce e ka' riñ ená yuu ce e ce geèe yi yu yáánïì, yi ntee yi ce fa ye ñgá' aè yuu anaè ka', baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè rboâñtu.
English: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn't judge himself in that which he approves.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ce tarni aè rye njáèá byee mo', kúti ye byee anaè, baná Nyúè be taèa ye njobeè' e ce ye byee anaè wa'a, a byemi ená yi yu yáánïì neè ye aè rye ka'. Ñwáè aè ka' ce geèe yuu ce e byemi ená yi yu yáánïì ka', baná ñwáè anaè aè geèe yuu bebep.
English: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn't of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

Limbum: Seèe ku'si Nyúè! E túr ñger aè rgeèe tá weèe táá tatap, aèmboè Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce laèa naè. Nsuñ ca a nsuñ ce m ce suñ aèmboè Jisos Kraêis, a ba nsuñ aèmboè buu ce vi m ba aè bsúèti ká' eluâuñgoèñ,
English: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,

Limbum: a yááti aèwañ seè'ni na. Buu ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m sañ vi geèe buu ca aè yááti aèwañ neè beèe enje jáá. Nyúè ce e ce cu nfeseè aè m laèa ená buu ca yááti neè beèe enje jáá wa'a, tá bto' wááwá vi bo byemi, yu'ni neè ye.
English: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;

Limbum: Ku ba ye Nyúè ce e túr bfee. Seèe ku'si ye aè nfeè' sïìp njo' yuu ce Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe! Yi yu wa'a.
English: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.

Limbum: Seèe ce liseèe rbyemïì li tap, seèe aè ba kur ntee neè beèe ce lap rbyemïì li yu wáèni. Seèe fa geèe ba buu ce nyor boñ ba seèe ka'.
English: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá efa seâe mú gee ba yuu ce nyor boñ nfúr yïì tá nfúr yïì bo tap foñ.
English: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

Limbum: Kraâis ye ye aè m geèe ba yuu ce nyor boñ ba ye ka'. Yi ku ba ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Mcáp ce beèe a m cáp wáè aègho naè, mi duè ba mbe máâ tuè.”
English: For even Christ didn't please himself. But, as it is written, The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.

Limbum: Buu ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè wááwá, a m sañ tá vi bo cep seèe, geèe tá seèe kur ntee, táá tatap ce keè' ba buu ce Nyúè aè kaè' neè seèe.
English: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through patience and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

Limbum: Tá Nyúè ce e ke geèe seèe kur ntee, túr ñger, ja' weèe tá weèe be'ni ndeèe Jisos Kraêis, cu weèe bfúr wee weèe neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè,
English: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,

Limbum: tá weèe wááwá bo kuè'si Nyúè ce e yu Taèr neè yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis neè ntee e mo'sir ba cuâu moè'sir.
English: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Baná weèe koo bfúr mo' nje nyoèr a weâe mú aèmboè Kraâis aè m koo seèe foñ na, tá beèe a bo ce kuè'si Nyúè.
English: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè weèe ená Kraâis aè m vúè aè ñwáè rfaè' neè Jus tá Nyúè bo geèe buu ce e m kaè' neè viseèe bta naè, duèñshi ená e yu ñwáè mini.
English: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

Limbum: E m vúè wa' foñ tá beèe enje jáá a bo yá, ku'si Nyúè njo' yïì ñkoosimnse. Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Baná m be suñ aèmboè wáè aè múè beèe enje jáá, yoèp byáá ce ku'si lo rlii aègho.”
English: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.

Limbum: A ker sañ foñ enáê, “Beèe enje jáá, lu'shi neè weèe beèe Nyúè weèe.”
English: Again he says, Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.

Limbum: A ker sañ mbe dïì' mo' enáê, “Beèe enje jáá wááwá, yoèñshi neè Tata. Tá beâe aè bto' wááwá a ku'si ye.”
English: Again, Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.

Limbum: AÈsayaè ye ye aè m laèa enáê, “Ñwáè embe ndúè' Jáásïì be vúè. E be vúè tá e bo sa' beèe enje jáá aèmboè yaèp ñkúú. Beèe enje jáá wááwá a be láè mmir mbe yeâ nduè.”
English: Again, Isaiah says, There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.

Limbum: Tá Nyúè ce e geèe weèe aè lá mi mmir mbenduè buu ce vi bii ka' koni gee tá weèe ce lu'shi seê, cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè njobeè' weèe aè byemi neè ye. E geèe wa'a, tá weèe bo kuè ce láè mmir mbenduè buu anaè aè ñger Yú' Rara.
English: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená weèe yu beâe bboèñboñ seê, a riñ buu seê, a riñ aè rcep weèe btu.
English: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, máè sañ ñwaè' ca a laa buu moè' mbo neè weèe tatap seê, tá weèe bo kuushi buu anaè. Máè geèe wa'a neè ñger ce Nyúè aè fa neè máè njo' yi ntee boèñboñ,
English: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

Limbum: ená m ba ñwáè rfaè' Jisos Kraâis neè beèe enje jáá. M ce geèe rfaè' ca wa'a, a ba aèmboè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì wa'a. M ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce e loè ese Nyúè tá beèe enje jáá a bo ba aèmboè yuu m ce tañshi tañshïì aègho ce yi yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njobeè' Yú' Rara yi geèe yi ba rara.
English: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Baná aède' m naatu aè rfaè' ce máè geèe neè Nyúè njobeè' weèr Jisos Kraâis yu aèbee.
English: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

Limbum: AÈde' m ker naatu aè yuu jáá caa efa rfaè' ce máè geèe aè ñger Kraâis aè múè beèe enje jáá ka'. Woweèe a ce yu'ni neè Kraâis njo' buu ce máè laèa ker ba buu ce máè geèe.
English: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

Limbum: Woweèe a m yu'ni foñ njobeè' máè m duèñshi mncoèo ba buu bbáèá, ker ba njo' ñger Yú' Rara. Káâ' ese aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm du ba' aè rla' IÌlirikoèm, máè feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Kraêis, a bár yuu mo' ka'.
English: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God's Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

Limbum: Máâ ke gheèter aè nfeè' wááwá aè rfeè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ anaè aè bdïì' ce beèe a m be yu' rlii Kraâis ka'. Máâ ke geèe wa'a, faè dïì' m bo baè'ri mbenduè kuèundap ce ñwáè moè' aè boo ka'.
English: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another's foundation.

Limbum: M ku ce geèe ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Beèe ce a m be suñ woweèe yuu mo' aèmboè ye ka' a be yá. Beèe ce a m be yu' yuu mo' aèmboè ye ka' a be rïìñ.”
English: But, as it is written, They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven't heard will understand.

Limbum: A yuu ce yi jepsi máè nfeè' aèñgoo se aè rvúè caè'ni weèe.
English: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

Limbum: Dïì' mo' yi ker ba aègho neè máè seè'ni aè rfaè' aèfa ka'. Yu bfeè' aèñgoo se aèmboè máè m ce koñ aè rvúè caè'ni weèe.
English: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

Limbum: Baná m ka' ce duè aè to' Spáên, tá m lá' caè'ni wee weèe tá seèe ku cu nfeè' múcaèr, tá m bo yu' rboèñ aè rba a weâe mú, tá weèe ka' jaè' máè tá m duê.
English: whenever I journey to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

Limbum: M ce duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm seè'ni na, tá m bo fa mbaèa neè beèe Nyúè ce a yu aèfo.
English: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

Limbum: M ce duè njobeè' ñgaâa rbyemïì ce a yu aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè ba ñgoâñ AÈkayaè a m kwaè'shi ená woweèe a be kuèu mbaèa tá a bo jaè' ñgaâa fuèp ce a yu aè mú beèe Nyúè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

Limbum: Woweèe a m yá ená yi yu yáánïì aè rgeèe wa'a. Neè mini-ñwáè yu yap bdïì' aè rjaè' Juês. Beèe enje jáá a koni bghoènïì efa yuu ce Nyúè aè m geèe neè Juês, baná yi yu boèñboñ ená woweèe a ja' Jus foñ neè buu ce Nyúè aè ghoèni woweèe aègho.
English: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.

Limbum: M ka' du ba' fa mbaèa ce a kuèu anaè neè woweèe, misi rfaè' anaè, tá m lá' caè'ni weèe ka' caèa duè aè to' Spáên.
English: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

Limbum: M rïìñ máná m be vúè caè'ni weèe tá seèe koni bghoènïì ese Kraâis goèr seê.
English: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe aè rlii Tata Jisos Kraêis, a ce bu' mmbo neè weèe njobeè' rkoèñnïì ce seèe aè koni ese yi yú', ená weèe koni máè aè rloo ce m ce loo neè yaè nyor, tá seèe loo aèbee.
English: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

Limbum: Loo neè ená Nyúè fúr máè embaè mmbo beèe aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè ce a byemi neè Jisos Kraâis ka' naè. Loo neè foñ ená beèe Nyúâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a yu' rboèñ neè mbaèa ce m ce duè fa neè woweèe,
English: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

Limbum: tá Nyúè ka' byemi, m bo vúè yá weèe neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè, tá m bo lúèshi, tá seèe yu' rboèñ.
English: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e ke fa beèe cumúnyañ, ba weèe woweèe wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.
English: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

Limbum: M ce koèñ máná weèe riñ Febeè ce e yu njar yïìseèe, ce e yu dikoèn embe cor aè rla' Keñkáèraè.
English: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

Limbum: E ka' vúê, weèe koni ye aèmboè beèe Tata Nyúè a ba koni ñwáè rbyemïì. Fa neè ye yuu ce e ka' buu, njobeè' e jaè' beèe magoèr seê, a ja' máè foñ.
English: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè Prïûskaè ba AÈkwilaè ce weèr woweèe aè m faè' aèbee neè Jisos Kraâis naè neè máè.
English: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

Limbum: Woweèe a m tami nyor aè rkwe njo' máè. AÈ ku yoñshi ba máè woweèe caè'caè' ka', bcor wááwá ce ñgaâa rbyemïì embo yu beèe enje jáá, a yoèñshi woweèe foñ.
English: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè ñgaâa rbyemïì ce a ke niñ cor mbe waâp ndaèp. Caè'ni neè ÁÈpáènitoès ce e yu ñkaraè ce wa mntee naè. E m ba ñwáè entombïì aè rbyemi neè Kraâis aè ñgoâñ Áshaè.
English: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè Máèári ce e m faè' neè weèe tatap se naè.
English: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè AÈndroènikoès ba Juènayaès ce weèr woweèe yu Juês, woweèe foñ a yá ñgá' mbe shañ aèmboè máè. Woweèe a yu boo mlii aè múè ñgaâa ntuu Jisos Kraêis. Woweèe a m ba ñgaâa rbyemïì entombïì neè máè.
English: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè AÈmplatoès ce e yu ñkaraè ce wa mntee, ce weèr ye yu aèbee weèr Tata weèe naè.
English: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè OÈbanuès ce e ce faè' neè Jisos Kraâis aèmboè weèr ce faè' foñ naè, ba Sïìtakïìs ce e yu ñkaraè se naè.
English: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè AÈpáláès ce e ku táá tatap, a duñshi neè mini-ñwáè ená e yu ñwáè Kraêis. Caè'ni neè beèe wááwá embe ndaèp AÈrïìstobuluès.
English: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè Háèrodïìyoèn ce e yu ñwáè Jus aèmboè máè foñ naè. Caè'ni neè beèe embe ndaèp Naèkisoès ce yu beèe Tataê.
English: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè Tïìrfánaè ba Tïìrfosaè ce yu bbyeèñge ce a ce faè' neè Tata naè. Caè'ni neè Pásïìs ce e yu ñkaraè a ba foñ njeñwáè moè' ce e faè' neè Tata tatap se naè.
English: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè Rufoès ce e yu muu rlii efa múè beèe Tata naè, ker ba yïì ma ce e m gá' neè máè aèmboè muu yïì wa'a naè.
English: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè AÈsinkiritoès ba Fïìlágoèn ba Hámïìs ba Paètoèropaès ba Hámaès, ker ba bfúr ce a yu a woweèe wááwá.
English: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè Fïìlologïìs ba Juèliyaè, ba Nárïìyoès a njar yïì, ba OÈlipaès ba beèe Nyúè wááwá ce a yu a woweèe.
English: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè bfúr wee, baa woweèe nje nyoèr aè rlii Jisoès. Bcor wááwá vi caè'ni weèe.
English: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe lor nfeè' neè beèe ce a ce vúè neè ñgaèpni a ker ce daè'si beèe foñ naè. Woweèe a ce geèe jáá efa yuu ce a yá'ni weèe. Sïìr neè njïì neè woweèe.
English: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

Limbum: Geèe neè wa'a njobeè' njáèá beèe ca a ce faè' ba neè Kraâis ce e yu Tata neè seèe ka', woweèe a ce geèe ba yuu ce yi boèñ woweèe. Woweèe a ce bu' cuèu neè blaèa ce vi boèñ a ce foo seê, a ce bo' beèe ce a máñni buu.
English: For those who are such don't serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè weèe, beèe wááwá a rïìñ ená weèe yu beèe ce weèe ce yu'ni neè Tataê. M ce lu'shi neè weèe seê. Ka' yi yu wa'a, m ce koèñ máná weèe riñ yuu boèñboñ, máñni yuu bebep.
English: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

Limbum: Nfeè' báti goèr ka', tá Nyúè ce e ke fa beèe cumúnyañ so Sataèn, maè' njep weâe tïìi tá weèe tár mkuèu mbe yeâ nduè. M ce loo máná tá yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

Limbum: Timotïì ce weèr ye ce faè' aèbee, aè caè'ni weèe. Lushoès ba Jasïìn, ba Soèsipataè ce weèr woweèe yu Jus naè, a caè'ni weèe foñ.
English: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

Limbum: Máâ Táshoès ce máè sañ ñwaè' ca ce caè'ni weèe foñ aè rlii yïìseèe Tataê.
English: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

Limbum: Gayoès, ce m ce cu mbe yeâ ndaèp, ñgaâa rbyemïì a ce niñ cor mbo foñ naè aè caè'ni weèe. ÁÈrastoès ce e ce láè mbaèa to' naè ba Kwatoès a caè'ni weèe.
English: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

Limbum: M ce loo máná tá yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis túr weèe wááwá aè ntee boèñboñ. Yi yu wa'a.
English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Poêl, ce Nyúè aè ce máè ená m ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. Weèr Soèstánïì ce e yu nfúr yïìseèe ce caè'ni weèe.
English: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

Limbum: Weèr ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè ñgaâa cor ce a yu aè rla' Koreèn ce a Jisoès weèe a yu aè ñwáè moè'sir. Nyúè aè ce weèe efa múè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na tá weèe ba yïì beèe. Weèe yu aèbee weèe beèe Nyúè ce a yu aè bdïì' wááwá a ce loo neè yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis. E yu Tata neè woweèe aèmboè e yu neè seèe naè.
English: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth; those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

Limbum: Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, ker ba Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Tata neè weèr foñ, túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Má ke yoèñshi Nyúè a weâe btu aè nfeè' wááwá njobeè' e ghoèni weèe embenjïì Jisos Kraêis.
English: I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;

Limbum: E ghoèni weèe aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá, a gee weèe aè túr bfee bboèñboñ, a ker fa weèe ñger aè rfeè'shi vi blaèa.
English: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;

Limbum: Nsuñ aèmboè Jisos kraâis aè taa mñgaèñ a weâe mú.
English: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèe aè buu mo' efa buu wááwá ce Yú' Tata Nyúè yi ke fa neè beèe ka', aèmboè weèe cu seè'ni ce keè' nfeè' ce weèe be keè yá Jisos Kraâis na.
English: so that you come behind in no gift; waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;

Limbum: Tata Nyúè be fa weèe ñger tá weèe táá tatap baè' aèlúèsimbuèu faè dïì' weèe bo keè gweè mnsa' aè noèñ ce Jisos Kraâis aè vúè ka'.
English: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Nyúè yu mini. Yu ye ce e ká' weèe ená weèe bo ba aèbee weèe muu yïì ce Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Tata neè seèe.
English: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, máè loo weèe aè rlii yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis, ená weèe ba cuâu mo'sir. Weèe fa túr ñgaèpni a weâe mú ka'. Weèe ba aèbee aè yuu weèe ce kwaè'shi ker ba aè yuu weèe ce geèe.
English: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, máè laèa wa'a njobeè' beèe mo' embe ndaèp Kloâo a suñ máè ená weèe yu cuâu mo'sir ka'.
English: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe's household, that there are contentions among you.

Limbum: Máè yu' máná beèe mo' efa weâe mú a ce laèa enáê, “M yu ya weèr Poêl”, moè' enáê, “M yu ya weèr AÈpoloès”, moè' enáê, “M yu ya weèr Sáfaès”, moè' enáê, “M yu ya weèr Jisos Kraêis.”
English: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, I follow Paul, I follow Apollos, I follow Cephas, and, I follow Christ.

Limbum: Waè' weèe aè gaèp Jisoès a? Waè' ñwáè ce a m taa mbe kïìntaa njo' weèe aè m ba Pol a? Waè' a m baèptir weèe aè rlii Pol a?
English: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

Limbum: Máè yoèñshi Nyúè njobeè' máè m baèptir ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú caa efa Krïûspoès ba Gayoès ka',
English: I thank God that I baptized none of you, except Crispus and Gaius,

Limbum: faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo laèa ená máè m baèptir ye a máâ rlii ka'.
English: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

Limbum: Máè kuushi ená máè m baèptir beèe embe ndaèp Stáfánaès foñ. Máè kwaè'shi máná máè m ker baptir ñwáè moè' caa efa beèe ca ka'.
English: I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don't know whether I baptized any other.

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis aè m tuu máè ená m du baptir beèe ka', e m tuu máè ba ená m du fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ. Máè m ce feè'shi nsuñ ca ba neè bfee wa ka'. Máè m geèe wa'a tá ñger efa rkwe ce Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe mbe kïìntaa yi bo buu efa ryáátïì ka'.
English: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News--not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn't be made void.

Limbum: Yi yu ená nsuñ kuu rkwe Jisos Kraâis embe kïìntaa yu blúr neè beèe ce a ce bú njep múè buu bbebep. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè seèe ce seèe ce luèñ, nsuñ ca yu ñger Nyúè.
English: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are saved it is the power of God.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “M be geèe tá bfee ñgaâa bfee vi bú aè cicïì. M be geèe tá beèe ce a feese, a jep.”
English: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.

Limbum: Baná ñgaâa bfee enjep ñgoèñ na a yu ba fá seè'ni? Ñgaâa ñwaè' enjep ñgoèñ na a yu ba fá? Ñgaâa mnsár enjep ñgoèñ na a yu ba fá? Mboè Nyúè aè geèe bfee enjep ñgoèñ aè kútïì ba blúr a?
English: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn't God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

Limbum: Bfee vi Nyúè vi yu jáá. E m geèe ená beèe a riñ ye ba neè bfee wap ka'. E m koèñ ená e gee beèe ce a byemi neè ye a luñ njïì enjep rfeè'shïì ce beèe a loèr aè yuu cicïì naè.
English: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn't know God, it was God's good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

Limbum: Jus a roèo aè ryá ncoèo ka' byemi yuu ce beèe a laèa, Greâk a ce roèo yap ba bfee.
English: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

Limbum: Weèr ce feè'shi ba aèmboè Jisos Kraâis ce a m taa mbe kïìntaa. Rfeè'shïì ca li ce jepsi Jus efa rbyemi neè ye, aè ba blúr neè beèe enje jáá.
English: but we preach Christ crucified; a stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi neè beèe ce Nyúè aè ká', káè yu Jus áè, káè yu Greâk áè, woweèe a rïìñ ená ñger Nyúè yi yááti, bfee Nyúè vi yáátïì foñ embenjïì Jisoès Kraêis.
English: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.

Limbum: Yuu ce beèe a ce kwaè'shi ená yi yu blúr aè ñgúè' yïì Nyúè naè, bfee vi yu njo a caa bfee ce beèe a túr, yuu ce a kwaè'shi ená a bgoè'sïì aè ñgúè' yïì Nyúè naè, ñger yi yu njo a caa ñger ce beèe a túr.
English: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, fyá' ka neè njáèá beèe ce weèe aè m ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m ká' weèe ená weèe ba yïì beèe. Weèe ka' fyá' a weâe mú weèe yá ená beèe ce ñgoèñ ca yi m loèr ená a túr bfee a yu goèr ka'. Beèe ce ñgoèñ ca yi m kwaè'shi foñ ená a yu beâe bgoèrgoèr a ker túr mnta' bgoèrgoèr a yu goèr ka'.
English: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

Limbum: Nyúè aè ce ba beèe ce beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ce kwaè'shi ená a yu blúr tá rïìtu yi bo koo beèe ce a ce kwaè'shi ená a yu ñgaâa bfee. E m ce beèe ce beèe enjep ñgoèñ a kwaè'shi ená a yu bgoè'sïì tá rïìtu yi bo koo beèe ce a túr ñger.
English: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world, that he might put to shame the things that are strong;

Limbum: E m ce buu ce beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a jaèasi a lor aè yuu cicïì, tá e bo suèusi mkwaè'shïì ce beèe a túr aè buu wááwá ce a kwaè'shi ená vi yu btatap se naè njep nsheè.
English: and God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that are not, that he might bring to nothing the things that are:

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a, faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo naèa nyor aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: that no flesh should boast before God.

Limbum: Nyúè a ñwáè ce e geèe weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè ka' ba aèbee. E m geèe ená Jisos Kraâis fa seèe bfee bboèñboñ. E ce yá seèe aèmboè beèe ce a cu rcu yáánïì, a ba brara ba njïì enjep Jisos Kraêis. Ku ba njïì enjep Jisoès ce e tee seèe efa ñgá' buu bbebep.
English: But of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:

Limbum: A mbuèu ce a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená ñwáè ka' ce koèñ ená e naa nyor, baná e naa ba aè yuu ce Tata Nyúè aè geèe neè ye.
English: that, according as it is written, He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, aè m ba mbe nfeè' ce máè m vúè yá weèe tá m bo feè'shi buu ce Nyúè aè m geèe weèr aè riñ kuu Jisos Kraâis naè, máè vú a ke' ce laa ba blaèa ce beèe bo vúse ka' káè feè'shi ba neè bfee ñwáè tá weèe ka' byemi ka'.
English: When I came to you, brothers, I didn't come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

Limbum: Máè m laèa enjep máâ ntee ená m be kuè feè'shi ba aèmboè Jisos Kraâis caè'caè', suñ weèe aèmboè a m taa ye mbe kïìntaa.
English: For I determined not to know anything among you, except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

Limbum: Máè m ba a weâe mú, a go'sïî, a ce wáp buu, ntee yi ce kaèñ máè.
English: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

Limbum: Máè m ce feè'shi blaèa ca neè weèe, a ke' ce feè'shi ba neè bfee enjep ñgoèñ na ka'. Máè m ce feè'shi ba neè ñger Yú' Nyúè ce yi m geèe weèe aè ka' riñ weená blaèa ca vi yu mini.
English: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

Limbum: Máè m geèe wa'a njobeè' máè m koèñ máná weèe byemi ba njo' ñger Nyúè, ke' ba ba njo' bfee ñwáè ka'.
English: that your faith wouldn't stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

Limbum: Ka' máè m ce feè'shi ba neè bfee ñwáè ka' wa'a, weèr ce feè'shi blaèa bfee neè beèe ce a bi njep múè lap rbyemïì. Blaèa ca vi loè enjep ñgoèñ na káè ese beèe ce a ce sa' ñgoèñ ca ka'. Yap ñger yi be mïì.
English: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown; yet a wisdom not of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing.

Limbum: Bfee Nyúè ce weèr ce laèa na yu ba vi bfee ce vi m ba aè bsúèti, beèe a m rïìñ ka'. Tá Nyúè ka' keè geèe ñgoèñ ca, e m kwaè'shi wáá, a lá ená e be geèe buu ca tá seèe bo túr ñgúè' moè' efa yi foèo.
English: But we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

Limbum: Beèe ce a ke sa' ñgoèñ ca a m rïìñ wa' ka'. Woweèe a m ba riñ a m ba taa Tata ce e yu ñwáè foèo mbe kïìntaa ka'.
English: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn't have crucified the Lord of glory.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Buu ce ñwáè aè m be yá káè yu' ka', ker ba buu ce ñwáè aè m be kwa'shi ka', Nyúè aè kupshi vi, a lá neè beèe ce a koèñ ye.”
English: But as it is written, Things which an eye didn't see, and an ear didn't hear, which didn't enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.

Limbum: Nyúè aè geèe seèe aè riñ buu ca njïì enjep yi Yú'. Yú' Nyúè yi rïìñ buu wááwá, a riñ ka' buu Nyúè ce vi yu aè bsúèti.
English: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' e ke rïìñ yuu ce ñwáè moè' ce kwaè'shi ka'. E ke kuâ rïìñ ñwáè yuu ce yi yu njep yeâ ntee. Yi ku ba foñ ená aède' ñwáè moè' riñ yuu ce Nyúè ce kwaè'shi ka'. Ku ba ba Yú' Nyúè ce yi rïìñ yuu ce Nyúè ce kwaè'shi.
English: For who among men knows the things of a man, except the spirit of the man, which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God, except God's Spirit.

Limbum: Yú' ce seèe aè koni yu yú' enjep ñgoèñ na ka'. Yú' ce seèe aè koni yu yú' ce yi loè ese Nyúè. Yú' ca yi ke geèe seèe riñ buu ce Nyúè aè fa neè seèe.
English: But we received, not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, aèmboè weèr ce suñ beèe buu ca, weèr ce suñ ba buu ce beèe a yá'ni weèr neè wap bfee ka'. Weèr ce suñ ba buu ce Yú' Nyúè yi geèe weèr aè rïîñ. Weèr ce yá'ni buu ce aè yú' neè beèe ce a túr Yú' Nyúè njep waâp mntee.
English: Which things also we speak, not in words which man's wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce Yú' Nyúè yi yu njep yeâ ntee ka' e ke byemi buu ce vi loè ese Yú' Nyúè ka' njobeè' buu ca yu neè ye aèmboè blúr wa'a, aède' e riñ buu ca ka' njobeè' ku ba ba ñwáè ce Yú' Nyúè yi yu njep yïû ntee ce aède' e riñ vi.
English: Now the natural man doesn't receive the things of God's Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can't know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce Yú' Nyúè yi yu njep yeâ ntee, e ke fyá' buu wááwá, riñ mbuèu efa gho, ka' beèe a fyá' ye, riñ njáèá ñwáè ce e yu ka' wa'a.
English: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè moè' rïìñ ntee Nyúè ka'. Ñwáè moè' yu ce aède' e cep Tata Nyúè ka'.” AÈ ka' ba aèmboè seèe, seèe túr ntee Jisos Kraêis.
English: For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him? But we have Christ's mind.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, aè m ba mbe nfeè' ce máè m vúè yá weèe naè, aède' máè m ba laa neè weèe aèmboè beèe ce a túr Yú' Nyúè njep waâp mntee ka'. Máè m laèa neè weèe ba aèmboè máâ ke laèa neè beèe ce a ce yu' rboèñ aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na. Máè m laèa wa'a njobeè' weèe aè m bii boo bká' aè buu Jisos Kraêis, weèe aè m ba aèmboè boo ce a bii nyoñ mmbee wa'a.
English: Brothers, I couldn't speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

Limbum: Máè m nyoñsi weèe nyoñsi, a ke' fa weèe ba yuu ye ka' njobeè' weèe aè m be ghááte aè rye yuu ka'. Ka' seè'ni na, weèe aè be ghááte ka'.
English: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren't yet ready. Indeed, not even now are you ready,

Limbum: Weèe ku bii yu' rboèñ aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na. Ñko'ndoñ yu a weâe mú, ñgaèpni yi ba a weâe mú, baná mboè weèe ku bii yu' rboèñ aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na a? Mboè ye ñgeèe yi ku ba aèmboè yi beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a?
English: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren't you fleshly, and don't you walk in the ways of men?

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ka' laa yi enáê. “M yu ya weèr Poêl,” moè' ker laa yi enáê, “M yu ya weèr AÈpoloès.” Waè' baná weèe yu jáá efa beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a?
English: For when one says, I follow Paul, and another, I follow Apollos, aren't you fleshly?

Limbum: AÈpoloès yu nda, Pol aè ba nda? Weèr ku ba ba ñgaâa mfaè' neè Tata Nyúè. Nyúè aè m tuu weèr ená weèr gee tá weèe byemi neè Jisos kraêis. Ñwáè wááwá aè m ku gee ba li rfaè' ce Tata aè m fa neè ye ená e geêe.
English: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed; and each as the Lord gave to him?

Limbum: Máè m byeè ñgúè buu, AÈpoloès aè ñwañshïì mdip aègho. Ñwáè ce e m geèe ñgúè buu ca aè fúú a ku', aè m ba ba Nyúè.
English: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

Limbum: Ñwáè rbyeè yu yuu mo' ka', ñwáè rñwañshi neè mdip aè ba yuu mo' foñ ka'. Ñwáâ ñgoèr ku ba ba Nyúè ce e geèe buu ce a byeè vi ce kuè'.
English: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

Limbum: Ñwáè rbyeè ba ñwáè rñwañshi neè mdip a ku ba yáánïì. Nyúè be laè' ñwáè wááwá aè rfaè' ce ñgaèñ aè geèe.
English: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

Limbum: Weèr yu ñgaâa mfaè', a ce faè' aèbee neè Nyúè. Weèe yu ñkúè Nyúè, a ba ndap ce Nyúè aè baè'ri.
English: For we are God's fellow workers. You are God's farming, God's building.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njo' bfee ce Nyúè aè fa máè, máè boo kuèundap aèmboè ñwáè ce e rïìñ aè rboo yuu seê. Beèe mo' a ce boo ndap mbe kuèundap anaè. Ñwáè wááwá ce e ce boo, lor nfeè'.
English: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè moè' ker boo kuèundap mo' jáá caa efa yïì ce a boo war ce yu Jisos Kraâis na ka'.
English: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè buu ce beèe a be baè'ri ndap anaè aègho, beèe mo' a be baè'ri neè bco' ce a too ená guêl, ba bco' ce a too ená silvaè, ba bluèr ce vi luèu ntaa seê. Beèe mo' a be baè'ri yap neè mntaañguu ba bvúp msañ, ba bbuu.
English: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble;

Limbum: Mfaè' ñwáè wááwá mi be keè yááti aèwañ njobeè' be keè ba aè noèñ mnsa' tá a mooshi mfaè' ñwáè wááwá. Mor yi be keè ce káti aè noèñ anaè, geèe tá a riñ njáèá mfaè' ce ñwáè wááwá aè m ce geèe.
English: each man's work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man's work is.

Limbum: Yuu ce ñwáè aè baè'ri ndap anaè aègho yi ka' tá she ka' baná ñgaèñ be koo blaè'.
English: If any man's work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

Limbum: Yuu anaè yi ka' she, baná ñgaèñ be bú aè cicïì, koni yuu ka'. Geewa'a, ñgaèñ be luèñ, kuè luèñ ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e cañ mor, a coo njep mncuèñ mor a tose.
English: If any man's work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ weená weèe yu Ndap Nyúè, Yú' Nyúè yi ce cu njep weèe a?
English: Don't you know that you are a temple of God, and that God's Spirit lives in you?

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' bepsi Ndap Nyúè baná Nyúè be bepsi ñgaèñ. Yi yu wa'a njobeè' Ndap Nyúè yu nrara, Ndap Nyúè anaè aè ba weèe.
English: If anyone destroys the temple of God, God will destroy him; for God's temple is holy, which you are.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' fa bo' yi tu ka'. Ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú ka' ce kwaè'shi ená e túr njáèá bfee ce ñgoèñ ca yi rïìñ ená a bfee, ñgaèñ aè ba kúti lúr tá e bo túr bfee neè mini-ñwáè.
English: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a njobeè' bfee enjep ñgoèñ na yu ba blúr aè bsii Nyúè. Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Nyúè e ke loèr bfee ñgaâa bfee, koo ñgaâa bfee anaè aègho.”
English: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He has taken the wise in their craftiness.

Limbum: A ker sañ mbo enáê, “Tata Nyúè rïìñ ená mkwaè'shïì beèe ce a túr bfee mi yu aè cicïì.”
English: And again, The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu na baná ñwáè moè' fa keèr kuèu ñguèñ njo' ñwáè moè' ka'. Buu wááwá yu yeè buu.
English: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

Limbum: Pol ba AÈpoloès ba Pitaè a yu yeè beèe, ñgoèñ ca yu ye, ryoèñ yu le, rkwe aè ba le, buu ce vi yu seè'ni na, ba buu ce vi be keè ba, vi wááwá a yeè buu.
English: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

Limbum: Yi yu ená weèe yu beèe Kraêis, Kraâis aè ba ñwáè yïì Nyúè.
English: and you are Christ's, and Christ is God's.

Limbum: Yi boèñ ená weèe aè ba yá weèr aèmboè ñgaâa mfaè' neè Jisos Kraêis. Weèe aè ba rïìñ ená Nyúè aè m loèr buu ce vi yu aè bsúèti a fa mba weâr mmboè ená weèr yá'ni beèe.
English: So let a man think of us as Christ's servants, and stewards of God's mysteries.

Limbum: Yuu goèr ce masaè e ke koèñ ese ñwáè rfaè' yi yu ená e ba mini neè ye.
English: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards, that they be found faithful.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè máè, a ka' ce sa' máè, káè ce sa' weèe áè, káè ce sa' ba kor áè, m lor ya yu yïì anaè aè yuu ka'. Ka' máè foñ, máâ ke sa' ya tu ka'.
English: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man's judgment. Yes, I don't judge my own self.

Limbum: Máè ke' rïìñ ya yu yuu bebep mo' ce máè geèe ka'. Yi ke' ba ená aède' m sa' mnsa' embe máâ tuè, teni ená máè so ka'. Ñwáè ce aède' e sa' wa mnsa' teni, a Tataê.
English: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná weèe fa ce sa' beèe tá nfeè' mnsa' ka' gháá ka'. Be ba aè noèñ ce Tata Jisoès aè kúti, tá e gee buu ce beèe a geèe aè túè'nji vi yááti aèwañ. E be keè geèe tá mkwaè'shïì beèe mi yááti aèwañ foñ. Yu aè noèñ anaè ce Nyúè be keè yoèñshi ñwáè wááwá aèmboè a ba yoèñshi.
English: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, máè laèa buu ca neè weèe, a lor AÈpoloès ba ya tu nyor aèmboè rduèñshïì wa'a, tá weèe bo yá'ni ese weèr aè rcu, aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè faè dïì' ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú bo naèa tu neè ñwáè moè', loèr moè' aè yuu cicïì ka'.
English: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e geèe wáè aè ñwáâ ñgoèr aè geèe nda? Yuu ce aè túr ce wáè koni ba ese Nyúè ka', yu ká? Nyúè aè ka' fa wáè buu ca, wáè ka' ce naèa tu aèmboè wáè túr lá buu ca ba aè yo ñger wa'a njoká?
English: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn't receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

Limbum: Waè' weèe túr buu wááwá a? Waè' weèe yu ñgaâa mbaèa a? Weèr yu yer yu bkúú ka', weèe aè lor wee btu aèmboè bkúú. M ce koèñ máná weèe aè ba ba bkúú ghup tá seèe bo sa' bsïìp?
English: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you.

Limbum: M ce kwaè'shi ená dïì' ce Nyúè aè fa neè weèr ce weèr yu ñgaâa ntuu, yu dïì' elúèsimbuèu. Weèr yu aèmboè beèe ce mnsa' mi koo woweèe, yi ka' táá seè'ni ená a be yú woweèe, a lor woweèe a tár aèwañ tá bcïìndap Nyúè ba beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a bo kaari ce fyá'.
English: For, I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

Limbum: Weèr yu blúr njo' Jisos Kraêis. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, weèe aè túr bfee njep Jisos Kraêis. Weèr túr ñger ka', weèe aè túr ye ñger. Weèe yu beèe ce beèe a ce yu'ni neè weèe, weèr aè ba yer beèe ce beèe a ce jaèasi.
English: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

Limbum: Njeè ku bii yañ weèr vú ba' seè'ni na, ntee-mdip yi ku bii luèu weèr, weèr aè ce yar ba bkaèkaâ cáè'. E ba aè nfeè' moè', a lip weèr. Weèr túr rla' ka'.
English: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

Limbum: Weèr ce faè' neè mer mmbo, ka' ce yeñger. Beèe a ce cáp weèr, weèr ce laèa yer neè woweèe ená Nyúè ghoni woweèe. Beèe a ce fa weèr ñgá' weèr ce kur ntee, ce laèa yuu ka.
English: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

Limbum: Beèe a ce laèa buu bbebep neè weèr, weèr ce kúsi ba blaâa bboèñboñ neè woweèe. Beèe a ce loèr weèr aèmboè yuu cicïì ce ñgoèñ yi ker ce koèñ aè ryá ka'. A ku bii loèr weèr aèmboè bkuèp buu wa'a, vú ba' ntïìni.
English: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

Limbum: M ce sañ buu ca neè weèe tá rïìtu yi bo koo weèe ka'. M ce fa weèe ba ncep njobeè' weèe yu boo wa ce máè koèñ magoèr.
English: I don't write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

Limbum: Ka' beèe ce a ce fa weèe ncep aè rcu aèmboè beèe Jisos Kraâis a yu goèr wa'a, yeè ta ku ba moè'sir. Yu ba máè ce máè m ba aèmboè taèr neè weèe njobeè' máè m feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè weèe tá weèe ka' keè ba beèe Jisoès Kraêis.
English: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, yet not many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a máè loo neè weèe ená weèe ku gee ba yuu ce m ce geèe.
English: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce máè tuu Timotïì ená e vú yá weèe tá e bo keèr suñ weèe aèmboè ñgeâe boèñboñ ce m ce geèe njobeè' m ce duè aèmbuèu Jisos Kraêis. Timotïì yu muu waè ce máè koèñ, njobeè' weèr ye yu ñwáè moè'sir njep Tata Jisos Kraêis. E ke faè' neè yi ntee-ñwáè. Buu ce e be suñ weèe yu buu ce m ce yá'ni aè bcor ce vi yu aè bdïì' wááwá.
English: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa weâe mú a ce kwaè'shi ená m be kúti vúè yá weèe ka', a ce naèa tu.
English: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

Limbum: Nfeè' múcaèr tá m vú yá weèe, ce Tata Nyúè aè ka' koêñ, tá m bo rïìñ máná ñger Nyúè yi yu njep ñgaâa naèatu ca káè woweèe a ku ce bu' ba cuèu lá.
English: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

Limbum: Kúú Nyúè yu ba cuâu bu' ka', yu ba ñger.
English: For the Kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.

Limbum: Weèe ce koèñ ba yïì efá? Weèe ce koèñ ená m vú ba neè ñgwaèa káè neè rkoèñnïì ba ntee bobor?
English: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

Limbum: Máè yu' máná beèe mo' efa weâe mú a ce saèki. Njáèá saèkïì ca yu njáèá yïì ce aède' e ba ka', ka' aè múè beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka'. Máè yu' máná ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú ce koo ñgwa yïì taê.
English: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father's wife.

Limbum: AÈde' weèe ce naèa tu aè njáâá ká ce ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú ka' ce geèe njáèá yuu ca. Weèe aè ba ce war war. Weèe fúr ñwáè ca efa weâe mú.
English: You are puffed up, and didn't rather mourn, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

Limbum: Ka' m yu aènjïìsaèp efa weèe wa'a, seèe ku ba aèbee aè yú'. AÈ rlii Tata Jisos kraêis, máè sa' war yuu ce ñwáè ca ce geèe, a teni mnsa' anaè aèmboè m yu lá a weâe mú wa'a. Geèe neè ba yuu ce m be suñ weèe na. Kaari neè aèbee mbe dïû' mo'sir. Ya yú' yi be kuè ba a weâe mú.
English: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, you being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

Limbum: Wee kaari wáá, lor ñwáè anaè fa mbaè mmbo Sataèn aè ñger Tata Jisoès, tá e bo yá ñgá', tá Nyúè bo jaè' li ryoèñ aè noèñ ce Tata Jisos kraâis be kúti njep ñgoèñ na.
English: are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

Limbum: Yeè naèatu anaè boèñ ka'. Mboè weèe rïìñ ená aède' yuu bebep e moè'sir yi bepsïì cor nsïìp a?
English: Your boasting is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

Limbum: Baná weèe fúr yuu bebep ca efa weâe mú tá weèe bo ba brara. Yi yu mini ená weèe yu war brara njobeè' a m tañshi tañshïì neè Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe njeèe tañshïì.
English: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a baná seèe cu rcu ce mini. Njáèá buu bbebep aèmboè bcena vi fa ba a seâe mú ka'. Ñwáè fa túr mkwaè'shïû mbebep neè nfúr yïì ka'. Ñwáè fa geèe bsaèrbuu ka'.
English: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

Limbum: Máè m sañ mbe ñwaè' ce máè m sañ neè weèe naè ená weèe fa keè kar weèe beèe ce a ce saèki ka'.
English: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

Limbum: Máè m laèa cena a ke' ce laèa ba aèmboè beèe ce a máñni Jisoès ka'. Beèe ce a ke saèki, ce ko'ndoñ, ce yáèá, ker ce loo neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na, a ku ba seèe woweèe njep ñgoèñ na. Tá aè ka' buu efa rkar weèe njáèá beèe ca weèe, baná aè be fúú enjep ñgoèñ na duè faè mo'.
English: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortioners, or with idolaters; for then you would have to leave the world.

Limbum: Ncep ce máè m fa weèe e m ba ba ená weèe fa kar weèe ñwáè ce e ce laèa ená e yu nfúr, a ker ce saèki ka'. Káè yu ñwáè ñko'ndoñ áè, káè nyáèá áè, káè yu ñwáè ce e ce loo neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na áè, káè yu ñwáè ce e ce cáp beèe áè, káè yu no ñkoo áè, weèe woweèe fa keè kar ka'. Fa keè ye byee weèe njáèá beèe anaè weèe ka'.
English: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner. Don't even eat with such a person.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a máñni Jisoès, m túr ñger mo' aè rsa' woweèe ka'. Nyúè a ñwáè ce e ke sa' njáèá beèe ca. Yu ba yiseèe dïì' aè rsa' ñgaâa coêr, yá ená woweèe a geèe boèñboñ káè bebep lá. Yaè beèe, baná weèe gee aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Fúr neè ñwáâ mbembep efa weâe mú.” Máè túr yuu aè rlaèa aèmboè mnsa' ce weâe duè aègho mbe koêr.
English: For what have I to do with also judging those who are outside? Don't you judge those who are within? But those who are outside, God judges. Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.

Limbum: Waè' yi yu boèñboñ ená ñwáè rbyemïì ka' túr mnsa' a ñwáè rbyemïì moè', e lor ye du aègho mbe kor ená beèe ce a yu byáánïì ka' a sa' a? Mboè weèe aè ba sa' wee mnsa' a weâe mú aèmboè beèe Nyúè a?
English: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

Limbum: Mboè weèe aè rïìñ ená beèe Nyúè a be keè sa' ñgoèñ ca a? Ka' ba ená ñgoèñ ca be keè sa' weèe, waè' baná weèe aè ghááte aè rsa' mú mnsa' ce vi yu a weâe mú ka' a?
English: Don't you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ ená seèe be keè sa' bcïìndap Nyúè a? Yi ka' ba wa'a, yi ka' ba eká aèmboè buu ce vi kuèu liseèe rcu enjep ñgoèñ.
English: Don't you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

Limbum: Baná mú mnsa' vi ba a weâe mú, weèe du aègho mbe koêr, fa neè beèe ce cor e ke loèr aè yuu ka', ená a sa' neè weèe njoká?
English: If then, you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

Limbum: Máè laèa cena tá rïìtu yi bo koo weèe. Waè' ñwáè moè' ce e túr bfee yu a weâe mú ce mfúr moè' ka' túr mnsa' a nfúr moè', e sa' mnsa' anaè neè woweèe ka' a?
English: I say this to move you to shame. Isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

Limbum: Mbuèu njoká ce nfúr moè' e loè lor moè' du aègho mbe kor du táá kuèntombïì neè beèe ce a byemi neè Jisos Kraâis ka'?
English: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená ñwáè rbyemïì moè' ka' ce loèr moè' ce duè aègho mbe koêr, baná weèe aè gweè. Yi yu aèndeèe ená weèe aè ba borni ye yu, leèse faèa ce beèe a geèe neè weèe tá a fip weèe, neè ce weèe lor woweèe duè aègho mbe koêr.
English: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you, that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

Limbum: Weèe aè geèe wa' ka'. Yuu weèe aè geèe ye, yi yu ená ñwáè moè' ce geèe faèa neè moè', moè' aè ce fïìp moè', ka' weèe wááwá yu bfúr wa'a.
English: No, but you yourselves do wrong, and defraud, and that against your brothers.

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ weená aède' beèe ce a yu byáánïì ka' a niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè ka' a? Weèe fa bo' wee btu ka'. Rïìñ neè ená beèe ce a ce saèki ba beèe ce a ce loo neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na, ba beèe ce a ce koo bbyeèñge beèe mo', káè mmbañruè mo' áè, ba mmbañruè ce a ce koo mmbañruè mo',
English: Or don't you know that the unrighteous will not inherit the Kingdom of God? Don't be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

Limbum: ka' byáèá áè, káè ñgaâa ñko'ndoñ áè, káè no ñkoo weèe áè, káè ñgaâa mcápni áè, káè ñgaâa faèpshi buu aè ñger áè, aède' a niñ mbo ka'.
English: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortioners, will inherit the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: AÈ m ba entombïì, beèe mo' efa weèe a ce geèe njáèá ñgeèe ca. AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na, Tata Nyúè aè su'sïì weèe, a ker gee weèe aè ba jáá, a ba byáánïì aè ñger Jisoès Kraâis ker ba aè ñger Yú' yïìseèe Nyúè.
English: Such were some of you, but you were washed. But you were sanctified. But you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená yuu mo' yi yu ce aède' m buu efa rgeèe ka'. Geewa'a, yu buu wááwá ce vi ce jaè' ka'. Ka' yuu mo' yi yu ce aède' m buu efa rgeèe ka' wa'a, aètaè m ke' byemi máná yuu mo' yi túr ñger mbe máâ nduè tá m lo ba ñkwaèa neè yuu anaè ka'.
English: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are expedient. All things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

Limbum: AÈde' aè laa wánáê, “Byee vi yu njo' rbúè, rbúè li ba njo' byee.” Ka' yi yu mini wa'a, Nyúè be geèe tá rbúè ba byee a lo mïì. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè nyor, Nyúè aè m geèe nyor tá beèe a bo loèr ce saèki aègho ka'. Nyúè aè m geèe nyor tá ñwáè bo geèe rfaè' aègho neè Tata Jisos Kraêis. Tata Jisos Kraâis aè ce keè'ni nyor anaè.
English: Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods, but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.

Limbum: Nyúè be loèr yi ñger fúr seèe aègho efa rkwe aèmboè e m fúr Tata Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe naè.
English: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ ená weêe mnyor yu ñgúè' moè' efa nyor Jisos kraâis a? Baná aède' ñwáè lor yïì nyor ce yu ñgúè' moè' efa nyor Jisos Kraêis, gee tá e ba ñgúè' moè' efa nyor kwaèraè a? Ka'! AÈtaè yi ba wa' ka'.
English: Don't you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ ená ñwáè ka' lor yïì nyor gee e ba ñgúè' moè' efa nyor kwaèraè baná a ye a yu seè'ni ba ñwáè moè'sir a? A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Mbañruèñwáè ba njeñwáè ca a be ba nyor moè'sir.”
English: Or don't you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, The two, says he, will become one flesh.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' gee yïì nyor ba ñgúè' moè' efa nyor Tata Jisos Kraâis baná Jisos Kraâis a ñwáè anaè a yu ñwáè moè'sir aè yú'.
English: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

Limbum: Cañ neè bsaèkïì. Yuu bebep mo' ce ñwáè e ke geèe e ke túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè yïì nyor ka'. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè ñwáè ce e ce saèki, e ce bepsi ba yïì nyor.
English: Flee sexual immorality! Every sin that a man does is outside the body, but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ ená weêe mnyor yu ndap Yú' Rara a? Yú' Rara anaè yi vúè ese Nyúè a ce cu njep weèe. Mnyor ce weèe túr yu weêe mnyor ka'.
English: Or don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit which is in you, which you have from God? You are not your own,

Limbum: Nyúè aè m yuu weèe aè ntaa nluèuluu. Baná weèe lor weêe mnyor gee rfaè' aègho ba neè ye caè'caè' tá e bo sa' foèo aègho.
English: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God's.

Limbum: M be beèesi buu ce weèe aè m sañ a bipshi neè máè naè. Ñwáè aè ka' tá loèr ñgwa ka' yi ku ba yáánïì.
English: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, yi boèñ ená mbañruèñwáè túr ñgwa yïì, tá njeñwáè túr nduu yïì, faè dïì' woweèe a lo gweè rmoèoshïì, ce saèki ka'.
English: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

Limbum: Nduu fa sheè ñgwa embe bkuu ka'. Ñgwa ye ye fa sheè nduu yïì ka'.
English: Let the husband render to his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife to her husband.

Limbum: AÈde' ñgwa ñwáè cu neè yi tu ka'. Ñwáè ce e túr ñger mbe yeâ nduè yu nduu yïì. AÈde' nduu ñwáè cu neè yi tu ka'. Ñwáè ce e túr ñger mbe yeâ nduè yu ñgwa yïì.
English: The wife doesn't have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise also the husband doesn't have authority over his own body, but the wife.

Limbum: Nduu ñwáè fa kani bkuu ñgwa, káè ñgwa kani bkuu nduu ka'. A ye a ka' tá tarshi bkuu ka' baná a ye a ba byemi aèbee ená a be geèe wa' ka', tá a bo loèr nfeè' anaè geèe ba rloo. Wee loè ker tarshi bkuu faè dïì' Sataèn mooshi weèe tá weèe gwe rmoèoshïì njobeè' weèe aè moèo aè rcu wa' laèr ka'.
English: Don't deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn't tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

Limbum: M ku ce fa ca ba aèmboè ntañ, ke' ba ená a ncir ka'.
English: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

Limbum: AÈ ba ba yi aèmboè máè, beèe wááwá aè ba kuè cu ñkúè aèmboè máè. Ka' m ce laèa wa'a, máè rïìñ máná Nyúè aè fa beèe ñger jáá jáèá jáá. E fa ñwáè mo' ñger ená e fa' neè ye aè njïì moè', a ker fa moè' ñger ená e fa' neè ye aè njïì moè'.
English: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

Limbum: Máâ laèa ca seè'ni ba neè bkúè ker ba byepkúú. Yi yu boèñboñ ená woweèe a ku cu neè yap tu aèmboè má máè cu na.
English: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a ka' moo aè rcu wa' laèr, mbañruèñwáè lor ñgwa yïì, njeñwáè yá nduu yïì a ye a cu. Yi yu aèndeèe ce mbañruèñwáè ka' lor ñgwa, njeñwáè ye ye du bguèu neè ce a ku cu wa'a tá ntee njeñwáè yi ce loè mbañruèñwáè seê, tá ntee mbañruèñwáè yi ce loè njeñwáè seê.
English: But if they don't have self-control, let them marry. For it's better to marry than to burn.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa neè beèe ce a duè bguèu wáá yi yu ená njeñwáè fa fúú ese nduu yïì ka'. Máè laèa cena neè weèe ba neè ya tu ka'. Blaèa ca yu blaèa ce vi vúè ba ese Tataê.
English: But to the married I command--not I, but the Lord--that the wife not leave her husband

Limbum: Njeñwáè ka' fúú bguèu, e fa keèr yá nduu moè' ka'. Ka' ba ená e yá nduu moè', e kútïì ba a nduu yïì caè. Yi yu foñ ená mbañruèñwáè fa juèu ñgwa yïì ka'.
English: but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband, and that the husband not leave his wife.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè mmbañruè ce a túr bbyeèñge ce a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì ka', ker ba bbyeèñge ce a túr bduu ce a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì ka', m be fa woweèe ncep. Ncep ca aè kwaè'shi ba máè, ke' ba ená aè fa Tata Nyúè ka'. Mbañruèñwáè ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka' túr ñgwa ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka', ñgwa yïì anaè ku koñ ená a ye a cu, e fa juèu ye ka'.
English: But to the rest I--not the Lord--say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená njeñwáè ka' túr nduu ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka', nduu anaè koñ ená a ye a ku cu, e fa fúú bguèu ka'.
English: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

Limbum: Nyúè aè geèe ená mbañruèñwáè ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka' koni bghoènïì ese ye njo' ñgwa yïì ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì. E ker gee foñ ená njeñwáè ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka' koni bghoènïì ese ye njo' nduu yïì ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì. Yi ka' tá baè ba wa' ka', boo wap aè ba ba boo bbebep, geewa'a, woweèe a yu brara.
English: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

Limbum: Mbañruèñwáè ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka', ka' koñ ená a ñgwa a gapni, aède' a ye a ku gapni. Njeñwáè ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka', ka' koñ ená a nduu yïì a gapni, aède' a ye a ku gapni. A ye a ka' gapni baná ñwáè ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì, káè yu mbañruèñwáè áè, káè yu njeñwáè áè, e bú' ncir Nyúè ka'. Nyúè aè ká' seèe ená seèe bo cu rcu ce li yu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

Limbum: Wáâ ñgwa, wáè rïìñ neè ká aèmboè aède' Nyúè lo ja' nduu woè njo' wáè? Wáâ nduu, wáè rïìñ neè ká aèmboè aède' Nyúè lo ja' ñgwa woè njo' wáè?
English: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

Limbum: Yá neè ená ñwáè wááwá ku gee ba yuu ce Nyúè aè fa ye ñger ená e geêe. Ñwáè wááwá ku ba aèmboè e m ba tá Tata Nyúè ka' ká' ye. A yuu ce m ce yá'ni aè bcor wááwá.
English: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' ba ce a m geèe ye búè tá Nyúè ka' ká' ye, ñgaèñ fa keèr roèo nduunjïì mo' ená a gee ye e kúti mbáè'-nsúèr ka'. Ñwáè aè m ka' ba ba mbáè'-nsúèr tá Nyúè ka' ká' ye, e fa geèe búè ka'.
English: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

Limbum: Káè ñwáè aè geèe búè áè, káè ñwáè aè geèe búè ka' áè, yïì anaè yi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe ka'. Yuu ce yi yu goèr yi yu ba ená ñwáè lá mncir Nyúè.
English: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná ñwáè wááwá ku ba aèmboè e m ba tá Nyúè ka' ká' ye.
English: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

Limbum: Wáè m ka' ba ba ñkwaèa aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m ká' wáè, aè fa bu' ka', ka' ba ne ená wáè koni fáñ aè rfúú efa bkwaèa, aè fúú yo yu.
English: Were you called being a bondservant? Don't let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

Limbum: Máè laèa wa'a, njobeè' ñwáè ce e m ka' ba ba ñkwaèa aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m ká' ye, e fúú seè'ni efa buu bbebep njobeè' a Tata a yu aèbee. Yi yu foñ ená ñwáè ce e m ba ñkwaèa aè nfeè' Nyúè aè m ká' ye ka', yu seè'ni ba ñkwaèa Jisos Kraêis.
English: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord's free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ's bondservant.

Limbum: Weèe yu bkwaèa Jisos Kraâis njobeè' e m yuu weèe aè ntaa nluèuluu. Weèe fa ba bkwaèa ba neè beèe ka'.
English: You were bought with a price. Don't become bondservants of men.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, baná ñwáè wááwá ku ba a Nyúè, ce cu aèmboè e m ce cu aè nfeè' Nyúè aè m ká' ye.
English: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè beèe ce a be du bguèu káè beèe ce a be lor bbyeèñge ka', ka' Nyúè aè fa máè blaèa mo' ená m laa neè woweèe ka' wa'a, m be suñ woweèe yuu ya ce máâ kwaè'shi. M ce laèa wa'a aèmboè ñwáè ce aètaè weèe yu' yuu ce m ce laèa, njobeè' Tata Jisos Kraâis ce e m koosimnse neè máè.
English: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' ñgá' ce e yu seè'ni na, m ce kwaè'shi máná yi yu boèñboñ ená ñwáè ku cu aèmboè e yu.
English: I think that it is good therefore, because of the distress that is on us, that it is good for a man to be as he is.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' túr ñgwa, e fa taè' nduunjïì aè rjuèu ye ka, ñwáè ka' tá túr ñgwa ka', e fa taè' nduunjïì aè rloèr ñgwa ka'.
English: Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don't seek a wife.

Limbum: Ka' máè laèa wa'a, ñwáè ka' lor ne ñgwa, baná e geèe yuu bebep ka'. Muu ñgoèñgoè ka' du bguèu baná e geèe yuu bebep ka'. Weèe aè rïìñ ená beèe wááwá ce a ke cu aè nduu a ñgwa a ke yá ñgá' njep ñgoèñ na seê. Máè yá ya máná ñwáè aè ba cu ñkúè faè dïì' e bo yá njáèá ñgá' ca ka'.
English: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yuu m ce laèa yi yu ená nfeè' Nyúè aè fa seèe yu nlúè'shi. Baná ká' e seè'ni na, beèe wááwá ce a túr bbyeèñge, a cu aèmboè a yu lá bkúè wa'a.
English: But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

Limbum: Tá beèe ce e koosimnse a cu aèmboè a ce koosi lá mnse ka' wa'a. Tá beèe ce a ce lu'shi a cu aèmboè beèe ce a ce lá lu'shi ka' wa'a. Tá beèe ce a yu ñgaâa ntaa a cu aèmboè beèe ce a túr lá buu ntaa ka' wa'a.
English: and those who weep, as though they didn't weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn't rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn't possess;

Limbum: Tá ñwáè ce e túr rfaè' aè rgeèe njep ñgoèñ na, káè yu ba njáèá rfaè' ká, cu aèmboè ñwáè ce e túr lá mkwaè'shïì aè buu anaè ka' wa'a, njobeè' ñgoèñ ca yi ce mïì.
English: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

Limbum: Máè koèñ máná buu moè' ba ce vi be fa weèe ñgá' ka'. Ñwáè ce e cu ñkúè e ke kwaè'shi aèmboè buu ce Tata Jisoès aè koèñ ená e gee tá nyor boñ ye.
English: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè ñwáè ce e túr ñgwa, e ke kwaè'shi aèmboè buu enjep ñgoèñ ce roèo ená e gee nyor boñ ñgwa yïì.
English: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

Limbum: Yi ba wa'a, baná yi ntee yi gaèp nyor aè buu bbaa. Boo mñgoèñgoè ba bbyeèñge ce a túr bduu ka', a ke kwaè'shi aèmboè buu Tataê. Woweèe a loè lor waêp mntee ba waêp mnyor wááwá fa neè Nyúè. Bbyeèñge ce a túr bduu a loè kwa'shi ba aèmboè buu enjep ñgoèñ na njobeè' woweèe a koèñ ená a gee tá nyor boñ bduu wap.
English: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world--how she may please her husband.

Limbum: Máè laèa buu ca tá m bo jaè' weèe jaè'. Máè koèñ máná m lá weèe ba ntáèr mbenduè nyor ka'. Yuu máè koèñ yi yu ba ená weèe gee buu ce vi yu bboèñboñ a ba byáánïì tá yuu mo' yi bo ba ce aètaè yi jepsïì weèe efa rfaè' neè Tata ka'.
English: This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè mbañruèñwáè ce e fa kwaèñ neè muunje, mbañruèñwáè anaè ka' yá ená e be loèr muunje ca ka' njobeè' e koèñ aè rcu ñkúè tá e bo faè' neè Nyúè boèñboñ, yi bep ka'. E ka' moo aè rcu laèr njo' ntee njeñwáè yi ce loè ye, e ka' koñ e lor ñgwa yïì. E ka' gee wa'a, baná e geèe yuu bebep ka'.
English: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn't sin. Let them marry.

Limbum: Mbañruèñwáè ka' kwa'shi neè yi tu ená e be loèr muunje anaè ka', ce mboè aè laèa ñwáè moè' neè ye ka', e ka' cu ñkúè, riñ ená e be keèr kwaè'shi yuu mo' aèmboè njeñwáè ka', baná e geèe boèñboñ.
English: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own heart, to keep his own virgin, does well.

Limbum: Baná mbañruèñwáè ce e loèr ñgwa, e geèe yáánïì. Mbañruèñwáè ce e loèr ñgwa ka', e geèe yuu boèñboñ a caa mbañruèñwáè ce e loèr ñgwa.
English: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn't give her in marriage does better.

Limbum: Yi yu ená njeñwáè ka' du bguèu baná e be kuè cu a nduu yïì keè caèa kwe. Ka' ba ne ená nduu yïì aè kwe, baná e túr ñger aè ryá nduu moè', ce yu ba ñwáè ce e táá njep múè buu Tataê.
English: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whoever she desires, only in the Lord.

Limbum: Máè yá ya máná e ka' cu neè yi tu, e yu' rboèñ seê. Máè byemi máná yuu máè laèa na, yi vúè ba ese Yú' Nyúè.
English: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God's Spirit.

Limbum: M be laèa yuu aèmboè byee ce beèe a ce geèe tañshïì aègho neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na naè. Seèe rïìñ seená seèe wááwá túr bfee. Bfee anaè vi loè gee ñwáè, e naa tu. Yu ba rkoèñnïì ce li ke kupshi beèe.
English: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e kwaè'shi ená e rïìñ buu seê, ñgaèñ aè be riñ buu aèmboè e ba rïìñ ka'.
English: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn't yet know as he ought to know.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' koñ Nyúè baná Nyúè rïìñ ye.
English: But if anyone loves God, the same is known by him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè nye byee ce beèe a ce geèe tañshïì aègho neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na naè, seèe aè rïìñ ená njáèá mnyúè anaè yu buu bcicïì njobeè' vi túr myoèñ ka'. Seèe rïìñ yiseèe ená Nyúè ku ba moè'sir caè'caè'.
English: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

Limbum: Ka' buu moè' yu goèr mbe buèu ba njep nsheè na ce beèe a ce too ená mnyúè wa'a, ker ce loèr buu anaè aèmboè vi yu lá btaèr neè woweèe wa'a,
English: For though there are things that are called gods, whether in the heavens or on earth; as there are many gods and many lords;

Limbum: seèe aè rïìñ yiseèe ená Nyúè ku ba moè'sir caè'caè', E yu Taèr neè seèe. Yu ye ce e m geèe buu wááwá, a ker gee seèe foñ ená seèe bo ba yïì beèe. Seèe ku túr Tata moè'sir ce yu Jisos Kraêis. Nyúè aè m geèe buu wááwá ba njïì enjep ye. Yu ye ce e fa seèe ryoèñ.
English: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

Limbum: Yu ba ñgaâa rbyemïì wááwá ce a rïìñ ená mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na yu ba buu bcicïì ka'. Geewa'a, beèe mo' a yu ce a m ce loo neè mnyúè ca, e loè ba aè nfeè' ce woweèe a ce ye byee ce a fa neè mnyúè ca, a ku riñ yap ená byee anaè yu ba byee mnyúè. Woweèe a ce ye, yap ntee yi ce fa woweèe ñgá', woweèe a ce kwaè'shi ená woweèe a geèe yuu bebep.
English: However, that knowledge isn't in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

Limbum: Seèe aè rïìñ seená aètaè byee vi gee seèe seèe ba jáá aè bsii Nyúè ka'. Seèe ka' tá ye ka', yïì anaè yi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe ka'. Seèe ka' ye, yïì anaè yi gee seèe seèe ba jáá ka'.
English: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don't eat, are we the worse; nor, if we eat, are we the better.

Limbum: Ka' seèe rïìñ wa'a, ñwáè lor nfeè' faè dïì' njáèá ñger ce Nyúè aè m fa neè ye ená e ye buu naè, yi lo geèe tá bfúr mo' ce map mkwaè'shïì mi ce fa woweèe ñgá' naè, a lo gweè ka'.
English: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce yi ntee yi ka' ku bii fa ye ñgá', ka' yá aèmboè wáè ce wáè túr bfee ce ye byee mbe ndaèp njáèá mnyúè ca, mboè cena yi be fa ye ñger aè rye byee anaè a?
English: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol's temple, won't his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

Limbum: E ka' ye, baná wáè ce wáè túr bfee naè, wáè bepsi nfúroè ce Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe neè ye.
English: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

Limbum: Wáè ka' gee yuu bebep neè bfúr wo, tá yap ntee yi ce fa woweèe ñgá' wa'a, baná wáè geèe yuu bebep neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

Limbum: M ka' yá máná m be ye njáèá byee anaè tá nfúraè gee yuu bebep, gweè, baná m be keèr ye vi ka'.
English: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forevermore, that I don't cause my brother to stumble.

Limbum: M túr ñger aè rgeèe yuu ce máè ka' koñ aè rgeèe. M yu ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. Máèè m yá Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Tata neè seèe neè ma mmir. Weèe yu ya bo rfaè' efa rfaè' ce máè faè' neè Tataê.
English: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven't I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren't you my work in the Lord?
