Limbum: Beèe mo' a ka' tá rïìñ ená m yu ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraâis ka', máè rïìñ máná weèe rïìñ wa'a njobeè' weèe yu ncoèo ce e geèe beèe a riñ ená m yu ñwáè ntuu neè Tataê.
English: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

Limbum: Blaèa ce m be laèa seè'ni na a blaèa ce m ce laèa neè beèe ce a ce tarni ená m yu ñwáè ntuu neè Tataê.
English: My defense to those who examine me is this.

Limbum: Mboè weèr túr ñger aè rkoo byee ker ba buu mno ese beèe njo' rfaè' ce weèr ce geèe neè woweèe a?
English: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

Limbum: Mboè weèr túr ñger aè rloèr wer bbyeèñge ce a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì, tá weèr woweèe ce kar aèmboè Pitaè ba ñgaâa ntuu mo' foñ, ker ba bfúr Tata Jisoès a ce geèe naè a?
English: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

Limbum: Waè' beèe ce aède' a fa', tar buu enjep mmboè ka' ce yeñger, ku ba weèr Baènabaès a?
English: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

Limbum: Waè' aède' ñwáè soogáè ce taèr buu enjep mmboè ka' ce yeñger a? Waè' aède' ñwáè nfaè' byee lo buu efa rye byee ce e faè' a? Mboè beèe ce a ke cïìñ naè' a ke kaa mmbee naè' ce a ce cïìñ, no a?
English: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn't eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn't drink from the flock's milk?

Limbum: M ce laèa buu ca, aè ke' ku laèa ba máè ka', ncir Nyúè yi laèa wa' foñ.
English: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn't the law also say the same thing?

Limbum: A sañ mbe ñwaè' mncir ce Nyúè aè m fa neè Musïìs enáê, “Fa kur cuèu naè' ce e ce bu' msañ ka'.” Nyúè aè m ce laèa buu ca a ke' ce laèa ba aèmboè naè' ka'.
English: For it is written in the law of Moses, You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain. Is it for the oxen that God cares,

Limbum: E m ce laèa ba aèmboè seèe. Ñwáè nfaè' mnsuu aè ba rïìñ ená e be túr ñgúè' moè' efa byee ce e faè', ñwáè rkep riñ foñ ená e be túr ñgúè' moè' efa byee anaè.
English: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' fa' a weâe mú, bye buu ce aè yú' njep weâe mntee, yi ke' ba yáánïì ená weèr aè ba koni buu ce vi be geèe tá weèr cu rcu ryáánïì ese weèe a?
English: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

Limbum: Beèe mo' a ka' túr ñger aè rlaèa ená weèe ja' woweèe, rïìñ neè ená beèe ce weèe aè ba jaè' entombïì yu weèr. Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèr aè be laa ená weèe ja' weèr ka', weèr aè koèñ aè ryá ñgá' faè dïì' weèr bo jepsi beèe efa ryu' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Jisoès ka'.
English: If others partake of this right over you, don't we yet more? Nevertheless we did not use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

Limbum: Kuushi neè ená beèe ce a ke faè' mbe Ndaèp Nyúè a ke ye efa buu ce beèe a fa rfa aègho mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, beèe ce a ke faè' mbe dïû' ntoèo rfa a ke ye ñgúè' moè' efa buu ce a tañshi tañshïì aègho.
English: Don't you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

Limbum: Tata aè m laèa foñ ená beèe a fa ñgaâa rfeè'shïì buu ce aède' vi gee woweèe a cu rcu rboèñboñ.
English: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

Limbum: Ka' máè túr ñger aè rlaèa ená weèe ja' máè wa'a, máè be laa wa' ka'. M ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè weèe seè'ni wa'a, a ke' ce sañ tá weèe bo jaè' máè ka'. Ka' ba ená ñwáè moè' gee tá naèatu ce m ce naèa njobeè' m ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè a ke' ce koo buu ese weèe ka' naè, lo ba yuu cicïì, m boñlaèr kwe kwe.
English: But I have used none of these things, and I don't write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

Limbum: AÈde' m naa tu njobeè' blaâa Nyúè ce m ce feè'shi neè weèe ka' njobeè' Nyúè aè m laèa neè máè ená m fe'shïî. Ndoèo be co' máè ce m ka' tá feè'shi ka'.
English: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me, if I don't preach the Good News.

Limbum: AÈ m ba kwa'shi ba máè ená m be feè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè beèe, máè m ba koo blaè' ese woweèe. Yi ke' ba wa'a ka'. M ku ce geèe ba rfaè' ce Nyúè aè m fa mba máâ mmboè.
English: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

Limbum: Njáèá sá' ce aède' m konïì efa rfaè' ca yu ba ká? Yaè sá' ku ba ba ená m fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè beèe aè cicïì. A mbuèu ce m ce laèa máná beèe a fa laè' máè aèmboè ñwáè rfeè'shïì ka'.
English: What then is my reward? That, when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

Limbum: M yu ñkwaèa neè ñwáè moè' ka'. Ka' m yu ñkwaèa neè ñwáè moè' ka' wa'a, máè geèe yaè nyor aèmboè ñkwaèa neè beèe wááwá tá m bo so beèe magoèr neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

Limbum: Máâ cu weèr Jus weèe, gee ñgeèe aèmboè woweèe wa'a, tá m bo so woweèe neè Jisos Kraêis. Ka' mncir Musïìs vi kur máè ka' wa'a, máâ cu weèr beèe ce mncir ca vi kur woweèe, gee ñgeèe aèmboè mncir ca vi kur lá máè foñ wa'a. M ce geèe wa'a, tá m bo so beèe anaè neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

Limbum: Máâ cu weèr beèe ce mncir vi kur woweèe ka', gee ñgeèe aèmboè woweèe wa'a, tá m bo so woweèe neè Jisos Kraêis. M ce geèe wa'a, ke' ba ená máè loèr mncir ce Nyúè aè m fa aètáèr ka'. M ce yu'ni neè mncir Jisos Kraâis seê.
English: to those who are without law, as without law not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ, that I might win those who are without law.

Limbum: Máâ cu weèr beèe ce map mkwaè'shïì mi ku bii fa woweèe ñgá', m ku ba aèmboè woweèe wa'a tá m bo so woweèe neè Jisos Kraêis. Máâ loè ku gee yaè nyor aèmboè beèe a yu, tá m bo gheèter aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá, geèe tá woweèe a luêñ.
English: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

Limbum: M ce geèe buu ca wa'a, tá beèe a bo yu' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ tá má máè koni bghoènïì ce nsuñ anaè e ke geèe beèe a konïì.
English: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

Limbum: Mboè weèe rïìñ ená e ke ba nfeè' mcañnïì, ñgaèa mcañnïì a cañ wa'a, lo koo blaè' bsïìp ka' a? Baná weèe cañ boèñboñ tá weèe bo koo blaè'.
English: Don't you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá ce e ke koèñ aè rcañ, e ke yá'ni aè rcañ boèñboñ seê. E loè gee wa'a tá e bo koo blaè' ce vi ke cu nfeseè ka'. Blaè' viseèe aè ba blaè' ce vi be cu nfeseè.
English: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

Limbum: Máè ka' ce cañ ya, a ke' ce cañ ba aè nji ka', a ku ce keè' ba kuèntombïì tá m bo cañ mïìsi. M ce maè' dúè' a ke' ce maè' ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e ce maè' aè bjiji ka'.
English: I therefore run like that, as not uncertainly. I fight like that, as not beating the air,

Limbum: M ce fa ñgá' neè yaè nyor, a gee e kútïì aè ñkwaèa faè dïì' m ce feè'shi neè beèe moè', loè gweè, bá blaè' ka'.
English: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be rejected.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m koèñ máná weèe aè ba kuushi buu ce vi m koni viseèe bta aè nfeè' ce woweèe a m ce daè' aè rïìñ naè boèñboñ. Mmbaè' vi m ce keè'ni woweèe. Woweèe a m tuu ma rdip mo' ce a m ce too ená rdip rbeer neè mkuèu.
English: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

Limbum: AÈmboè woweèe a m ce duè aèmbuèu mmbaè', a ker tuu rdip rbeer ca, cena yi m ba neè woweèe aèmboè njáèá baèptir moè' ce e m geèe woweèe a ba beèe Musïìs.
English: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a m ye byee ce Nyúè aè m maè'ri embe buèu,
English: and all ate the same spiritual food;

Limbum: a no mdip ce mi m fúú ba enje ryáá. Ryáá anaè aè m ba Jisos Kraâis ce e m ce jáèr a woweèe.
English: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

Limbum: Ka' woweèe a m yá buu ca neè map mmir wa'a, beèe magoèr efa woweèe a m geèe buu ce ntee yi boñ Nyúè ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a kweñgeèr, bgúèú vi sañsïì nyor aè rïìñ.
English: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

Limbum: Buu ca aè ba geèe tá see seèe foñ riñ ená seèe aè ba koèñ buu bbebep aèmboè viseèe bta a m koèñ naè ka'.
English: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

Limbum: Weèe fa geèe rloo neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na aèmboè beèe moè' efa woweèe a m geèe naè ka'. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Beèe a m cu aè nsheè a ye byee, a no buu, a nati mbekïì a bii bii neè blañ.”
English: Neither be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

Limbum: Seèe fa ce saèki aèmboè beèe mo' efa woweèe a m saèki naè ka'. Woweèe a m saèki wa'a, beèe ncúèkïì-ncoèp-taar-aè-mmbaa a kweñgeèr aè noâñ mo'sir.
English: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

Limbum: Seèe fa moèoshi Tata aèmboè beèe mo' efa woweèe a m moèoshi naè ka'. Mnyo vi m tashi woweèe, woweèe a kweñgeèr.
English: Neither let us test the Lord, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

Limbum: Seèe fa ce rúè'ñger aèmboè beèe mo' efa woweèe a m rúè'ñger naè ka'. Ncïìndap Nyúè ce e ke yúshi beèe naè aè m yúshi woweèe.
English: Neither grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

Limbum: Buu ce vi m koni beèe eluâuñgoèñ, yu buu ce Nyúè aè m báá woweèe aègho. A m sañ buu ca tá seèe ce seèe ce cu ba aè nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi ce mïì na, bo rïìñ, loèr nfeè' faè dïì' buu anaè koni seèe foñ ka'.
English: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ce kwaè'shi ená e táá tatap, lor nfeè' faè dïì' e gwe ka'.
English: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn't fall.

Limbum: Njáèá rmoèoshïì ce li ka' vú neè weèe ku ba njáèá rmoèoshïì ce li vúè neè beèe mo' foñ. Nyúè ce e yu mini be maè'shi tá li vú caèa ye ñger ka'. Rmoèoshïì li ka' vú neè weèe baná e be fa weèe ñger tá weèe táá tatap, so rmoèoshïì anaè.
English: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

Limbum: Bkar waê, baná m ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe fa túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na ka'.
English: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè weèe ce weèe rïìñ buu. Weèe kwa'shi ka ená yuu ce m ce laèa neè weèe yi yu mini lá.
English: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

Limbum: E ke ba aè nfeè' seèe ce ye byee Nyúè, see loo, yoñshi ye aè ndoñ mruè' ce see ke no. Seâe ce no enjep ndoñ anaè yi ce duèñshi ená seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe yu aèbee njo' vi bláá. Seâe ce bá'shi byee, yi ce duèñshi foñ ená seèe woweèe yu aèbee njo' yïì nyor. Mboè yi yu wa' a?
English: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn't it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn't it a sharing of the body of Christ?

Limbum: Ka' seèe ce seèe ce ye efa byee anaè, seèe yu aèñgoo wa'a, ntu' bráâd ku ba moè'sir. Cena yi duèñshi ená seèe wááwá yu ñwáè moè'sir.
English: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

Limbum: Kwaè'shi neè aèmboè ndeèe beèe Isráèl. E ke ba aè nfeè' beèe mo' efa woweèe a ce ye byee ce a tañshi tañshïì aègho neè Nyúè, a Nyúè weèe a ba ñwáè moè'sir.
English: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don't those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa yi yu ba ená ká? Waè' nyúè moè' enjep ñgoèñ na, káè byee ce a ke tañshi tañshïì aègho neè njáèá nyúè ca áè, e ke ba yuu goèr a?
English: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

Limbum: Yi yu wa' ka'. Beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka' a ke tañshi yap tañshïì ba neè mnyúâmkaè'. Woweèe a ke tañshi tañshïì ca ba neè Nyúè ka'. M ce koèñ máná weèe mnyúâmkaè' weèe ba ñwáè moè'sir ka'.
English: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don't desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè no enjep ndoñ Tata Jisos Kraêis, ker no enjep ndoñ mnyúâmkaè' aè njáâá ká? AÈde' ñwáè ye byee ce yu ba byee Tata Jisos Kraêis, ker ye byee ce yu ba byee mnyúâmkaè' aè njáâá ká?
English: You can't both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can't both partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.

Limbum: Seèe lor nfeè' faè dïì' seèe gee yuu mo' ce ntee yi bep Tata Nyúè neè seèe ka'. Waè' seèe túr ñger a caa ye a?
English: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

Limbum: Weèe túr ñger aè rgeèe buu wááwá. Ka' weèe túr ñger ca wa'a, yu buu wááwá ce aède' vi ja' beèe ka'. Yi yu mini ená weèe túr ñger aè rgeèe buu wááwá. Ka' yi yu mini ená weèe túr ñger aè rgeèe buu ca wa'a, yu buu wááwá ce aède' vi gee beèe a táá tatap njep buu ce yu vi Tata Jisos Kraâis ka'.
English: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are profitable. All things are lawful for me, but not all things build up.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá gee yuu ce aède' yi ja' ñwáè moè'. Ñwáè fa geèe ba yuu ce yi ku boèñ ba ye caè'caè' ka'.
English: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor's good.

Limbum: Weèe fa maè'shi tá ye ntee yi ce fa weèe ñgá' aè rye nyaèa ce weèe a yuu efa ntaa ka'. Weèe fa kwaè'shi ená weèe ka' gee wa'a ba yuu bebep ka'.
English: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñgoèñ ca wááwá yu yi Nyúè, ker ba buu wááwá ce vi yu njo.”
English: for the earth is the Lord's, and its fullness.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e yu ñwáè rbyemïì ka', aè ka' be wáè ená aè vú tá weèe ye ye byee, wáè ka' duê, aè ye njáèá byee wááwá ce e ka' fa wáè. Fa maè'shi tá yo ntee yi lo káè' ce fa wáè ñgá' ka'.
English: But if one of those who don't believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, ñwáè moè' aè ka' suñ wáè ená byee ce aè ce ye anaè yu byee ce a tañshi tañshïì aègho, aè fa ye ka'. Fa ye ka' njobeè' ñwáè anaè ka' yá aèmboè aè ce ye, e kwa'shïì yi ená wáè geèe ba yuu bebep.
English: But if anyone says to you, This was offered to idols, don't eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For the earth is the Lord's, and all its fullness.

Limbum: Fa ye ka' njo' mkwaè'shïì mi ñwáè anaè, ke' ba njo' mo ka'. Seemoè' ñwáè moè' be laèa enáê, “AÈde' m bornïì efa rgeèe yuu mo' njobeè' ñwáè moè' ce kwaè'shi ená yuu anaè yi yu bebep njoká?
English: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other's conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

Limbum: M ka' ce yoèñshi Nyúè aè byee ce m ce ye, beèe mo' a laa bebep aèmboè máè aè njáâá ká?”
English: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for that for which I give thanks?

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' laa wa'a, m beesïì mánáê, “Yuu wááwá ce wáè ka' ce geèe, káè aè ce ye ye áè, káè aè ce no no áè, geèe ba aè njáèá njïì ce beèe mo' a ka' yá, tá woweèe a bo kuè'si Nyúè.”
English: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

Limbum: Loèr nfeè' faè dïì' aè gee yuu mo' ce yi gee tá ñwáè moè' gweê, káè yu Jus áè, káè yu beèe enje jáá áè, káè yu ñgaâa cor áè, fa keè moèo ka'.
English: Give no occasions for stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

Limbum: Má máè ce gheèter aè rgeèe tá nyor boñ ñwáè wááwá aè buu wááwá ce m ce geèe. Má ke kwaè'shi ba aè yuu ce aètaè yi ja' ba máè caè'caè' ka'. Má ke kwaè'shi ba aèmboè yuu ce aètaè yi ja' beèe wááwá, tá woweèe a bo luèñ efa buu bbebep.
English: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

Limbum: Kuè ce gee neè ba yuu ce m ce geèe aèmboè má máè ce geèe ba buu ce Jisos Kraâis aè m ce geèe.
English: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

Limbum: Máè yoèñshi weèe njobeè' weèe ce kuushi buu ce máè m yá'ni weèe, a ker ce geèe buu anaè yáánïì seê.
English: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

Limbum: Máâ koèñ tá weèe riñ boèñboñ ená Jisos Kraâis yu tu neè mbañruèñwáè, mbañruèñwáè aè ba tu neè njeñwáè, Nyúè aè ba tu neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

Limbum: Ka' ba aè nfeè' ce mbañruèñwáè ce geèe rloo, ker ba aè nfeè' ce e ce cep ntuu Nyúè, e ka' sop rtaa mbe tuè baná e coosi Jisos Kraâis ce e yu tu neè ye.
English: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ye ye ka' ce geèe rloo, káè ce cep ntuu Nyúè áè, ke' señ rtaa mbe tuè ka' baná e coosi mbañruèñwáè ce e yu tu neè ye. Njeñwáè ka' tá señ rtaa mbe tuè ka' baná e yu aèmboè njeñwáè ce a kwaèa ye tu wa'a.
English: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head unveiled dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ka' kani aè rseñ rtaa mbe tuè baná e ba boèñlaèr koo tu anaè koo. AÈ ka' ba ená yu rïìtu neè njeñwáè aè rkwaèa tu káè koo tu áè, baná njeñwáè señ rtaa mbe tuè.
English: For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn. But if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.

Limbum: Yi yu boèñboñ ená mbañruèñwáè sop rtaa mbe tuè ka', njobeè' e yu rfeese Nyúè, a ba foâo Nyúè, njeñwáè aè ba foâo mbañruèñwáè.
English: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená Nyúè aè m loèr nfaèñ njeñwáè a boo mbañruèñwáè aègho ka'. E m loèr nfaèñ mbañruèñwáè a boo njeñwáè aègho.
English: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m boo mbañruèñwáè a fa neè njeñwáè ka', e m boo ba njeñwáè a fa neè mbañruèñwáè.
English: for neither was man created for the woman, but woman for the man.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce njeñwáè aè ba señ rtaa mbe tuè faè dïì' ntee yi bo yañ bcïìndap Nyúè ka'.
English: For this cause the woman ought to have authority on her head, because of the angels.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè seèe ce seèe ce cu seèe Tata Jisos Kraâis weèe, njeñwáè yu neè yi tu ka', mbañruèñwáè aè ba neè yi tu ka'.
English: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m loèr nfaèñ mbañruèñwáè a boo njeñwáè aègho, njeñwáè ye ye aè ba ñwáè ce e ke bi mbañruèñwáè. Buu ca wááwá aè m geèe ba Nyúè.
English: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

Limbum: Kwaè'shi ka neè ená waè' yi yu yáánïì ená njeñwáè gee rloo neè Nyúè ce e señ rtaa mbe tuè ka' lá.
English: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a ku riñ ená mbañruèñwáè ka' ko'si tu, baná e coosi yi tu.
English: Doesn't even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi neè njeñwáè, tu ko'si aè ba yuu boèñboñ njobeè' Nyúè aè m fa ye nyúè'tu saèsap tá e bo tá'shi yi tu aègho.
English: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè ka' ba ce e ce sár yi ená buu ca yu wa' ka', baná ñgaèñ aè ba rïìñ ená weèr ce geèe ba buu ca, bcor wááwá vi ce geèe wa' foñ.
English: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God's assemblies.

Limbum: Yuu ce m be fa weèe ncep aègho na yu ba yuu ce m be yoèñshi weèe aègho yoèñshi ka'. E ke ba aè nfeè' weèe aè vúè aèbee aè rgeèe rloo neè Nyúè, weèe ce geèe ba ñgeâe bebep caa ñgeâe boèñboñ.
English: But in giving you this command, I don't praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.

Limbum: Yuu entombïì ce máè yu' yi yu ená e ke ba aè nfeè' ce weèe aè vúè aèbee aè rgeèe rloo neè Nyúè, ñgaèpni yi ba a weâe mú. Máè yá máná seemoè' yi yu mini wa'a.
English: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

Limbum: Yi yu yáánïì ená ñgaèpni yi ba a weâe mú, njobeè' e ke ba ne aè nfeè' ce ñgaèpni yi niñ wa'a, weèe ka' yá beèe ce a yuu beâe mini.
English: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

Limbum: Máè yá máná wee ke vúè aèbee, vú ba aè rye byee Tata Nyúè ka'.
English: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord's supper that you eat.

Limbum: Máè laèa wa'a njobeè' e ke ba aè nfeè' ce a ce ye byee, ñwáè ku ce ye vi byee, ke' ce kwaè'shi aèmboè beèe mo' ka'. Yi loè ba wa'a, njeè ce yañ beèe moè', beèe moè' a no mruè' mi koo woweèe.
English: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

Limbum: Njáèá yuu ce yi koni weèe na yu ba njáèá ká? Mboè weèe túr mndap ce wee ke fúú embo weèe aè banïì yeñger, a ker noñger a? Yi yu boèñboñ ená weèe lor cor Nyúè aè yuu cicïì ker gee tá rïìtu yi koo beèe ce a buu byee ba buu mno ka'. Yuu ce m be laèa neè weèe yu ká? Waè' m be yoèñshi weèe a? Ka', aède' m yoñshïì weèe ka'.
English: What, don't you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God's assembly, and put them to shame who don't have? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don't praise you.

Limbum: Máè m yá'ni weèe buu ce Tata aè m geèe máè rïîñ. Buu anaè yu ená, aè m ba neètú' ce a be fyeèni Tata Jisoès naè, e lor bráêd,
English: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

Limbum: a yoñshi Nyúè, a bá'shi, a laa enáê, “Ca yu yaè nyor ce máè fa a weâe btuè. Ce gee neè aèmboè seèe ce geèe na tá weèe bo ce kuushi máè.”
English: When he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ye wáá, e lor ndoñ a laa enáê, “Ndoñ ca táá aètu leâ' fi ce Nyúè aè ye a beèe neè wa bláá. Kuushi neè máè aè nfeè' wááwá ce weèe ka' ce no enjep ndoñ ca.”
English: In the same way he also took the cup, after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.

Limbum: Baná ka' ba aè nfeè' efá ce weèe ce ye byee ca, ce no enjep ndoñ ca, weèe ce suñ beèe aèmboè rkwe Tata Jisoès, caar tá e ke vúè.
English: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ka' tá ye bráâd ca, ker ce no enjep ndoñ ca aè njïû yáánïì ka', baná ñgaèñ aè loèr nyor ba bláá Tata aè yuu cicïì.
English: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord's cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

Limbum: Tá ñwáè ka' ye bráâd ca, keèr no enjep ndoñ ca, ñgaèñ fyá' yïì nyor boèñboñ ka' gee wa'a.
English: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ye bráêd, ker no enjep ndoñ ca, ke' ce kuushi ená buu ca táá aètu nyor ba bláá Tata Jisoès ka', baná ñgaèñ aè loèr ndoèo mbe yeâ tuè.
English: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself, if he doesn't discern the Lord's body.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce beèe magoèr a weâe mú a sáè, beèe mo' a ce yañ, beèe mo' a kweñgeèr.
English: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

Limbum: Seèe ka' fyá' viseèe mnyor ka' ye bráâd ca, ker no enjep ndoñ ca, Nyúè sa' seèe aèmboè beèe ce a geèe yuu bebep ka'.
English: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn't be judged.

Limbum: Tata Nyúè e ke sa' seèe wa'a ce naèshi seèe naèshi faè dïì' seèe bo keè gweè mnsa', yá ñgá' aè nfeè' ce e be sa' ñgoèñ naè ka'.
English: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yi ka' ba wa'a, ka' ba aè nfeè' weèe aè vúè aèbee aè rye byee Nyúè, beèe mo' a fa kuè káè' ce ye entombïì neè beèe moè' ka'.
English: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

Limbum: Njeè ka' ce yañ ñwáè, baná ñgaèñ ye byee mbe yeâ ndaèp ka' vúê, faè dïì' weèe vú aèbee loè geèe ñgeâe bebep tá Nyúè sa' weèe ka'. M be fa weèe ncep aè buu mo' foñ, aè nfeè' ce m ka' vú ca'ni weèe.
English: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce koèñ máná weèe riñ buu moè' kuu bfee ce Yú' Nyúè yi ke fa neè beèe.
English: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don't want you to be ignorant.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' weèe aè m ku bii aè túè'nji, Sataèn aè m ce bo' weèe aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá, a gee weèe aè ce caè'ni mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na ce vi ke laèa ka'.
English: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

Limbum: Baná m ce koèñ ená weèe riñ ená Yú' Nyúè yi ka' ba njep ñwáè, aède' ñgaèñ laa enáê, “Ndoèo co' Jisoès” ka'. Yú' Nyúè yi ka' tá ba njep ñwáè ka', aède' ñgaèñ laa enáê, “Jisoès yu Tataê” ka'.
English: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God's Spirit says, Jesus is accursed. No one can say, Jesus is Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Yú' Nyúè yi ke fa beèe bfee jáá jáèá jáá aè rgeèe buu. Ka' yi yu wa'a, Yú' anaè yi ku ba yi mo'sir.
English: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

Limbum: Mfaè' ce beèe a ke geèe mi ku ba jáá jáèá jáá foñ. Ka' yi yu wa'a, Tata Jisoès ce a ce faè' neè ye ku ba moè'sir.
English: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

Limbum: Mfaè' mi yu jáá jáèá jáá ce beèe a ke geèe, aè ku ba Nyúè moè'sir ce e fa beèe wááwá bfee aè rgeèe mfaè' anaè.
English: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.

Limbum: Bfee Yú' Nyúè yi ke yááti njep beèe aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá tá ñwáè bo loèr bfee anaè jaè' beèe Nyúè aègho.
English: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

Limbum: Yú' Nyúè yi ke fa beèe mo' bfee aè rfa beèe ncep mboèñmboñ, ker fa beèe mo' bfee aè rfeè'shi blaâa Nyúè aè njáèá njïì ce aède' beèe a riñ Nyúè boèñboñ. Yú' ca yi ku ba yi mo'sir.
English: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;

Limbum: Yi ke fa beèe mo' bfee aè rláè ntee aè buu Nyúè, ker fa beèe mo' bfee aè rgeèe ñgaâa byañ a ke'se. Ku ba Yú' yi mo'sir ce yi geèe buu ca wááwá.
English: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;

Limbum: Yi ke fa beèe mo' bfee aè rgeèe buu bghagha', ker fa beèe mo' bfee aè rcep ntuu Nyúè. Yi ke fa beèe mo' bfee aè rrïìñ buu ce vi loè ese Yú' Nyúè, ker riñ vïì ce vi loè ese Yú' Nyúè ka'. Yi ke fa beèe mo' bfee aè rlaèa bli ce a m be yá'ni ka', ker fa beèe mo' bfee aè rsuñ beèe buu ce a laèa aè bli anaè.
English: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another the interpretation of languages.

Limbum: Yú' Nyúè anaè yi ke fa beèe ñger aè rgeèe buu ca wááwá. Yi ke fa ñwáè wááwá yuu ce yi ce koèñ aè rfa.
English: But the one and the same Spirit works all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè nyor e ke ba moè'sir, mñgúè' nyor vi ku ba jáá jáèá jáá naè. Mñgúè' nyor ca vi ke tarshi nyor aèbee, gee nyor moè'sir. Jisos Kraâis ku ba wa' foñ.
English: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

Limbum: Ka' beèe mo' efa seèe a yu Juês, beèe mo' a ba beèe enje jáá, beèe mo' a ba bkwaèa, beèe mo' a ba bkwaèa ka' wa'a, seèe wááwá aè m kúti ñwáè moè'sir aè nfeè' ce a m baèptir seèe neè Yú' Nyúè. Ku ba Yú' Nyúè ca ce Nyúè aè m fa neè seèe wááwá ená yi niñ njep viseâe mntee.
English: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

Limbum: Nyor e ke túr ñgúè' nyor moè'sir ka', e ke túr mñgúè' nyor jáá jáèá jáá.
English: For the body is not one member, but many.

Limbum: Kuèu yi ka' laa enáê, “M yu ñgúè' moè' efa nyor ka, njobeè' m yu bo ka',” waè' baná kuèu yi buu efa rba ñgúè' moè' efa nyor a?
English: If the foot would say, Because I'm not the hand, I'm not part of the body, it is not therefore not part of the body.

Limbum: Tuè' yi ka' laa enáê, “M yu ñgúè' moè' efa nyor ka', njobeè' m yu rlir ka',” waè' aède' blaèa anaè vi gee tuè' yi buu efa rba ñgúè' moè' efa nyor a?
English: If the ear would say, Because I'm not the eye, I'm not part of the body, it's not therefore not part of the body.

Limbum: Nyor aè m ba ku ba rlir, ñwáè aè m ba ce yu' buu ba neè ká? Nyor aè m ba ku ba tuè', ñwáè aè m ba ce yu' rúèú yuu ba neè ká?
English: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

Limbum: Gee ne wa'a, yi yu ená Nyúè aè m geèe mñgúè' nyor jáá jáèá jáá vi ce faè' buu jáá jáèá jáá aèmboè e m koèñ.
English: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

Limbum: Nyor wááwá aè m ba ku ba ñgúè' nyor moè'sir, yïì anaè aè ba ba nyor ka'.
English: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

Limbum: Yi yu ená mñgúè' nyor vi yu jáá jáèá jáá wa'a, nyor aè ku ba moè'sir.
English: But now they are many members, but one body.

Limbum: Baná aède' rlir li laa neè bo enáê, “M túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè wáè ka'” ka'. AÈde' tu foñ yi laa neè mkuèu enáê, “M túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè weèe ka'” ka'.
English: The eye can't tell the hand, I have no need for you, or again the head to the feet, I have no need for you.

Limbum: Mñgúè' nyor mo' ce seèe ce yá yiseèe ená vi túr mfaè' ka' naè, vi ka' buu, seèe yu' rboèñ ka'.
English: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

Limbum: Mñgúè' nyor ce seèe ce kwaè'shi ená vi ku ba aè cicïì naè, a vïì ce see ke gá' aègho seê. Mñgúè' nyor ce see ke koèñ ená vi yááti aèwañ ka', a vïì ce see ke tá'shi boèñboñ.
English: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant propriety;

Limbum: See ce tá'shi wa'a, ma'shi mñgúè' nyor bboèñboñ vi yáátïì aèwañ. Yi yu wa'a njobeè' Nyúè aè m geèe viseèe mnyor aè njáâá ená mñgúè' nyor ce vi ke yááti aè vïû bcicïì naè, vi ba vïì ce a be gá' aègho seê.
English: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu wa'a, baná mñgúè' nyor wááwá vi ku ce fa' aèbee njobeè' mñgúè' nyor wááwá ku túr yuu aè rgeèe neè ñgúè' nyor moè'.
English: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

Limbum: Ñgúè' nyor moè' ka' ce yá ñgá', baná mñgúè' nyor wááwá vi be yá ñgá'. Ñgúè' nyor moè' ka' ce yu' rboèñ baná mñgúè' nyor wááwá vi be yu' rboèñ.
English: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

Limbum: Weèe yu nyor Jisos Kraêis, ñwáè wááwá aè ba ñgúè' moè' efa nyor anaè.
English: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

Limbum: Nyúè aè fa beèe embe cor bfee jáá jáèá jáá ená a gee rfaè' aègho. Rfaè' entombïì ce e fa neè beèe mo' li yu ená woweèe a ba ñgaâa ntuu Jisos Kraêis, lïì embenjïì li ba ená beèe mo' a ba ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè. Lïì embenjïì mo li ba ená beèe mo' a yá'ni vi blaèa neè beèe, rmo' li ba ená beèe mo' a gee buu bbáèá, rmo' li ba ená beèe mo' a gee tá ñgaâa byañ a ke'se, rmo' li ba ená beèe mo' a ja' beèe, rmo' li ba ená beèe mo' a sa' beèe, rmo' li ba ená beèe mo' a laa bli ce woweèe a m be yá'ni ka'.
English: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

Limbum: Waè' beèe wááwá a yu ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès a? Waè' beèe wááwá a yu ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a? Waè' beèe wááwá a yu ñgaâa ryá'nïì a? Waè' beèe wááwá a yu ñgaâa rgeèe buu bghagha' a?
English: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

Limbum: Waè' Nyúè aè fa beèe wááwá bfee aè rgeèe tá ñgaâa byañ a ke'se a? Waè' beèe wááwá a ke laèa bli ce a be yá'ni ka' a? Waè' beèe wááwá a rïìñ aè rsuñ beèe buu ce beèe mo' a laèa aè bli ce a m be yá'ni ka' a?
English: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

Limbum: Weèe lá ntee aè rkoni bfee ce vi be geèe tá weèe ja' cor goèr, caa bfee mo'. Baná m be suñ weèe yuu ce yi caèa buu ca wááwá seè'ni.
English: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' riñ aè rlaèa bli enjep ñgoèñ na, ker laa bli ce bcïìndap Nyúè a ke laèa, ke' koñ beèe ka', baná ñgaèñ ku ba aèmboè mbee ce e ke laèa ñooñ-ñooñ naè.
English: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don't have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' túr ñger aè rcep ntuu Nyúè, ker túr ñger aè rrïìñ buu Nyúè ce vi yu aè bsúèti, ker riñ buu wááwá, ker byemi neè Nyúè btatap seê, ce aède' e laêa, rtuèu li co'tïì embe dïì' li táá, du táá aè dïû' jáá, e ka' tá koèñ beèe ka', baná e ku ba ñwáè cicïì.
English: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don't have love, I am nothing.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' lor yïì buu wááwá gapshi neè beèe, ker ma'shi ená beèe a koo ye too neè mor, e ka' tá koèñ beèe ka', sá' moè' ba njo ka'.
English: If I dole out all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don't have love, it profits me nothing.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e koèñ beèe e ke kur ntee, ker ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ. Ñwáè anaè e ke ba ñwáè ñko'ndoñ ka'. E ke yu' nyor káè naa tu ka'.
English: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud,

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè e ke geèe ñgeâe bebep neè beèe ka', e ke weti ka', e ke cápñger ka', e ke láè yuu bebep njep ntee ka'.
English: doesn't behave itself inappropriately, doesn't seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè e ke yu' rboèñ aè yuu bbebep ka', e ke yu' rboèñ ba aè yuu ce yi yu mini.
English: doesn't rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

Limbum: AÈde' yuu mo' yi caa rkoèñnïì ka'. Rkoèñnïì li ke yá faèa ñwáè ka', li ke kwaè'shi boèñboñ aèmboè beèe mo', ker táá tatap aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

Limbum: Bfee ce Nyúè aè fa neè beèe mo' aè rcep yi ntuu vi be keè caèa, tá bfee ce e fa neè beèe mo' aè rlaèa bli ce a m be yá'ni ka', vi mïî, tá bfee ce e fa neè beèe mo' aè rrïìñ buu, vi ker ba ka'. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè rkoèñnïì, aède' li ke mi ka'.
English: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ buu aè bbábá', a ce cep ntuu Nyúè aè bbábá'.
English: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;

Limbum: Be ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè geèe seèe aè riñ buu wááwá tá buu ca mïî.
English: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' máè m ba munte, máè m ce laèa buu aèmboè munte, a ce kwaè'shi buu aèmboè munte, a riñ buu aèmboè munte, máè ka' ba nleeñwáè, a borni buu bbonte.
English: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

Limbum: Seèe ce yá buu seè'ni na laè'rïì laè'rïì. Be keè ba aè nfeè' moè' tá seèe yá vi boèñboñ. Seèe rïìñ buu aè bbábá' seè'ni na, be ba aè nfeè' anaè, tá seèe riñ buu wááwá aèmboè Nyúè ye ye aè rïìñ seèe naè.
English: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

Limbum: Buu vi yuâ btaar ce vi be cu. Mo' yu rbyemïì, mo' aè ba rkeè' ce seèe ce keè' ená Nyúè gee yuu ce e m kaè', mo' aè ba rkoèñnïì. Yuu goèr efa múè buu ca yu rkoèñnïì.
English: But now faith, hope, and love remain--these three. The greatest of these is love.

Limbum: Weèe lá rkoèñnïì kuèntombïì neè buu wááwá, lá ntee foñ a bfee ce Nyúè aè fa neè beèe, lañlañ bfee ce e fa neè beèe aè rcep yi ntuu.
English: Follow after love, and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' ce laèa njáèá li ce e m be yá'ni ka', baná e ce laèa ba neè beèe ka', e ce laèa ba neè Nyúè njobeè' aède' ñwáè moè' yu' yuu e ce laèa ka'. E ce laèa buu ce aè bsúèti aè ñger Yú' Nyúè.
English: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God; for no one understands; but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

Limbum: Ñwáè e ke cep ntuu Nyúè, yi ja' beèe, fa beèe ñger, ker gee mntee beèe vi fúteè.
English: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

Limbum: Ñwáè e ke laèa li ce e m be yá'ni ka', ja' ba yi tu. Ñwáè e ke cep ntuu Nyúè, ja' ñgaâa cor wááwá.
English: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

Limbum: Máâ koèñ máná weèe wááwá laa njáèá bli ce weèe aè m be yá'ni ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, yi yu aèndeèe ená weèe cep ntuu Nyúè, neè ce ená weèe ku ce laa ba li ce weèe aè m be yá'ni ka'. Ñwáè ce e ce cep ntuu Nyúè aè caèa ñwáè ce e ce laèa li ce e m be yá'ni ka'. Ka' ba ená ñwáè moè' ce beesi buu ce ñwáè anaè aè laèa aè li ce e m be yá'ni ka' na, vi ka' ja' coêr.
English: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but rather that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ka' vú aè rcaè'ni weèe, laa neè weèe ba aè li ce máè m be yá'ni ka', waè' aède' yïì anaè yi ja' weèe a? Ka' ba ená máè vúè a suñ weèe yuu mo' fi, káè a gee buu Nyúè vi ba rara neè weèe áè, káè a cep ntuu Nyúè neè weèe, káè a yá'ni weèe áè, yïì anaè yi be jaè' weèe.
English: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

Limbum: Kwaè'shi ka neè aèmboè ndoñ ce a ke fyáp, ker ba rluñ ce a ke bu', ce mi túr myoèñ ka'. Ñwáè ka' fyáp ndoñ aè nji, káè bu' rluñ aè nji áè, aède' ñwáè riñ yuu ce e fyáp, káè yuu ce e bu' aè njáâá ká?
English: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn't give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' fyáp rsoèñ bïìr aè nji, waè' aède' beèe a ba'shïì nyor du bïìr a?
English: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

Limbum: Yi yu neè weèe wa' foñ. Weèe aè ka' ce laèa neè beèe ba aè li ce a rïìñ ka', aède' woweèe a yu' yuu ce weèe ce laèa aè njáâá ká? Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná weèe ce búsi yeè mbáp aè cicïì.
English: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

Limbum: Bli vi yu njep ñgoèñ na jáá jáèá jáá, li moè' aè ke' ba ce ñwáè buu efa ryu' ka'.
English: There are, it may be, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

Limbum: M ka' tá yu' li ce ñwáè ce laèa ka', baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè nfuu neè máè, má máè aè ba ñwáè nfuu neè ye.
English: If then I don't know the meaning of the sound, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

Limbum: A mboè aè rlaèa bli ce weèe aè be yá'ni ka', yi ku ba wa'a. Baná weèe aè ka' ce koèñ ená Yú' Nyúè yi fa weèe bfee aè rfaè' neè Nyúè, weèe koñ goèr ba njáèá bfee ce aède' vi gee tá cor du kuèntombïì.
English: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ka' ce laèa buu neè beèe aè njáèá li ce e m be yá'ni ka', ñgaèñ loo ená Yú' Nyúè yi fa ye bfee aè rbeèesi buu anaè aè li ce aède' beèe a yu'.
English: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' ce loo neè Nyúè aè njáèá li anaè baná ñgaèñ ku ce loo ba enjep ntee, a ke' riñ yuu ce e ce loo ka'.
English: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

Limbum: Yuu ce aède' ñwáè gee yi yu ená ká? Yi yu ená ñwáè loo neè Nyúè aè li ce e m be yá'ni ka', ker loo aè li ce e rïìñ, ñwáè yop neè Nyúè aè li ce e m be yá'ni ka', ker yop neè ye aè li ce e rïìñ.
English: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' ce loo ce yoèñshi Nyúè aè njáèá li ce e m be yá'ni ka', aède' ñwáè ce e rïìñ buu Nyúè boèñboñ ka' gee eká ka' byemi aè yuu ce e laèa, laa enáê, “Yi yu wa'a”, ce aèmboè e ce yu' yuu ce ñgaèñ aè laèa ka'.
English: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the Amen at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn't know what you say?

Limbum: Wáè ka' ce loo aè njáèá li anaè, ce yoèñshi Nyúè aèmboè ká, aède' yïì anaè yi ja' ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

Limbum: M ce yoèñshi Nyúè njobeè' m ce laèa bli ce máè m be yá'ni ka', a caa weèe wááwá.
English: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, m ka' ba niñ coêr, m koñ máná m laa mbúè laèa ta aè li ce beèe a rïìñ, tá m bo yá'ni beèe, neè ce ená m laa mmbúè laèa ncúèkïì aè li ce aède' ñwáè yu' ka'.
English: However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe fa ce kwaè'shi buu aèmboè weèe yu lá bbonte wa' ka'. Weèe ba aèmboè bbonte ba aè njïì ce weèe be ce kwaè'shi buu bbebep ka'. Kwaè'shi neè buu ba aèmboè bleebeèe.
English: Brothers, don't be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Tata Nyúè aè m laèa enáê, ‘M be tuusi beèe ce a ce laèa li moè' jáá, tá a du suñ wa blaèa neè yaè beèe. Ka' m be geèe wa'a, yaè beèe ca a be yu' yuu ce máè laèa neè woweèe ka'.’ ”
English: In the law it is written, By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. Not even thus will they hear me, says the Lord.

Limbum: Yi yu ená aè rlaèa li moè' ce ñwáè aè m be yá'ni ka', yu ba ncoèo neè beèe ce a byemi neè ye ka', ke' ba ba ená yu ncoèo ba neè beèe ce a byemi wáá ka'. AÈ rcep ntuu Nyúè yu ncoèo ba neè beèe ce a byemi neè ye, ke' ba ená yu ncoèo ba neè beèe ce a byemi neè ye ka' ka'.
English: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

Limbum: Weèe ce kwaè'shi ená aède' yi ba aè njáâá ká ce beèe a ka' niñ coêr, ñwáè wááwá ku ce laèa ba aè li ce e m be yá'ni ka'? Beèe mo' ce a be riñ buu Nyúè boèñboñ ka', ker ba beèe ce a be byemi ka', a ka' niñ, aèmboè a be kwaè'shi yap ená weèe ce baa baa a?
English: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won't they say that you are crazy?

Limbum: Beèe a ka' niñ coêr, ñwáè wááwá ce cep ntuu Nyúè, njáèá beèe ca a ka' niñ, yuu ce woweèe a yu' yi be geèe tá woweèe a yá yaèp buu bbebep, keèr geèe tá yap ntee ye sa' woweèe,
English: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

Limbum: keèr geèe tá buu ce woweèe a m ce súèti njep ntee naè vi yááti aèwañ, tá woweèe a gú'shi, yoèñshi Nyúè, laèa neè yap cuèu enáê, “Nyúè yu a weâe mú neè mini-ñwáè.”
English: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yuu ce m ce laèa aèlúèsimbuèu du kuu buu ce máè suñ na yi yu ba ená weèe ka' niñ coêr, ñwáè wááwá tami nyor aè rgeèe yuu ce Nyúè aè fa ye bfee aè rgeèe. Ñwáè ce e rïìñ aè ryoèp yáá, e yoêp, ñwáè ce e rïìñ aè ryá'ni beèe blaâa Nyúè, e yá'nïì, ñwáè ce e rïìñ aè rsuñ beèe buu ce Nyúè aè geèe vi ba brara neè ye, e suêñ, ñwáè ce e rïìñ aè rlaèa neè beèe aè njáèá li ce e m be yá'ni ka', e laêa, ñwáè ce e rïìñ aè rbeèesi blaèa ce ñwáè ca aè laèa aè li anaè, e beesïî. Seèe gee buu ca wááwá ba aè njáèá njïì ce aède' buu anaè ja' ñgaâa coêr.
English: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

Limbum: Weèe ka' niñ coêr, beèe ce a rïìñ aè rlaèa li ce woweèe a m be yá'ni ka', a ka' ba a weâe mú aèñgoo seê, woweèe a fa laèa bsïìp ka'. Beèe a mmbaa káè beèe a mntaar áè, efa woweèe a ka' laêa, yi ba yáánïì. Moè' e laèa mïìsi wáá, moè' ka' laêa, ker ba ená a ka' ce laèa, ñwáè moè' beesi blaèa anaè aè li ce aède' beèe a yu'.
English: If any man speaks in another language, let it be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' tá ba ce aède' e beesïì ka, baná beèe anaè a fa laèa mbe cor ka'. Woweèe a ku ce laa neè Nyúè ba enjep ntee.
English: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.

Limbum: beèe a mmbaa káè beèe a mntaar áè, a ka' suñ beèe buu ce Nyúè aè geèe woweèe a rïîñ, baná bár beèe a fyá' ka ená buu woweèe a laèa anaè vi yu mini lá.
English: Let the prophets speak, two or three, and let the others discern.

Limbum: Nyúè ka' ker gee ñwáè moè' ye ye riñ yuu mo' ce aède' e suñ beèe, baná ñwáè ce e ba ce laèa naè fa ye njïì foñ tá e laêa.
English: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

Limbum: Weèe ka' ce geèe wa'a baná ñwáè wááwá be túr fáñ aè rlaèa aè nfeè' yïì ka'. Weèe ka' ce geèe wa'a baná beèe a be rïìñ buu goèr seê, keèr túr ntee aè buu Nyúè.
English: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ke suñ beèe buu ce Nyúè aè geèe woweèe aè rïîñ, a ke túr ñger aè rfaè' neè bfee ce Nyúè aè fa woweèe anaè boèñboñ.
English: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

Limbum: Nyúè e ke fa woweèe njáèá ñger ca njobeè' e koèñ bjep ka'. E koèñ beèe ce a túr cumúnyañ. AÈmboè yi yu aè bcor wááwá, baná wee bbyeèñge a ka' niñ coêr, a fa laèa yuu ka', njobeè' ncir Nyúè yi byemi ená woweèe a ka' niñ coêr, a lor yaèp nyor njep nsheè aèmboè ncir Nyúè yi laèa.
English: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace. As in all the assemblies of the saints, let your wives keep silent in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to speak; but let them be in subjection, as the law also says.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce koèñ aè rrïìñ yuu mo', woweèe a bipshïì neè bduu wap aè mlaè'. Yu yuu ncoosi tu neè bbyeèñge aè rlaèa yuu mbe múè coêr.
English: If they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to chatter in the assembly.

Limbum: Weèe ka' kani, baná weèe aè ba rïìñ ená blaâa Nyúè vi ku ká' ba neè weèe káè mi neè weèe ka'.
English: What? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e kwaè'shi ená e túr bfee aè rsuñ beèe buu ce Nyúè aè geèe e rïîñ, a ker ce kwaè'shi ená Yú' Nyúè yi fa ye bfee aè rgeèe buu mo' foñ, aè ba rïìñ ená buu ce máè suñ neè weèe na yu buu ce aè laèa Tata Jisoès ená seèe geêe.
English: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' kani yuu ce máè laèa na weèe kanïì vi blaèa foñ.
English: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yi ka' ba wa'a, m ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe aè ba láè ntee goèr ba aè rsuñ beèe buu ce Nyúè aè geèe weèe aè rïîñ. Yi ka' ba ne wa'a, weèe fa kani ená beèe mo' efa weâe mú ce a rïìñ aè rlaèa aè li ce a m be yá'ni ka' naè a fa laèa ka'.
English: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don't forbid speaking with other languages.

Limbum: Weèe gee buu wááwá aè njïû yáánïì.
English: Let all things be done decently and in order.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, tá m kuushi weèe aèmboè Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce máè m feè'shi neè weèe naè. Nsuñ ca yu nsuñ ce weèe aè m yu' a byemi, a táá njo.
English: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

Limbum: Weèe ka' ku táá njo tatap, weèe luñ njo' nsuñ ca. Yi ka' tá ba wa' ka' baná weèe aè m byemi ba aè cicïì.
English: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you--unless you believed in vain.

Limbum: Yuu tatap ce máè m suñ weèe aè m ba yuu ce a m suñ máè foñ. Nsuñ anaè yu ená Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe njo' yïìseèe buu bbebep aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená yi be ba naè.
English: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

Limbum: E m kwe, a tuñ ye, mnoèñ vi ka' baâ' btaar, e fúú efa rkwe aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè.
English: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

Limbum: E ka' fúú efa rkwe a duñshi yïì nyor neè Sáfaès, a ker lo a duñshi yïì nyor neè yïì beèe ce ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

Limbum: AÈ ka' keèr ba aè nfeè' moè', e duñshïì yïì nyor neè beèe ce a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu. Beèe anaè a m caèa beèe mjeèe taê. Beèe magoèr efa woweèe a cu bteèe, ka' beèe mo' a kweñger wa'.
English: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

Limbum: AÈ ka' keèr ba aè nfeè' moè' e duñshïì yïì nyor neè Jáêms, a ker lo a duñshi yïì nyor neè yi ñgaâa ntuu.
English: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèlúèsimbuèu e duñshïì yïì nyor neè máè aè njáèá njïì ce aède' ñwáè aè m ba kwa'shi ka'.
English: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

Limbum: M yu ñwáâ ñká' efa múè beèe wááwá ce a yu ñgaâa ntuu neè Jisoès. Máè ghááte aè njáèá ñwáè ce aède' beèe a ba loèr máè ená m yu ñwáè ntuu neè Jisoès ka' njobeè' máè m fa ñgá' neè ñgaâa coêr.
English: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' Nyúè aè m túr ntee boèñboñ neè máè, e gee máè ba njáèá ñwáè ce m yu seè'ni na. Yuu ce e m geèe neè máè anaè yi m bú aè cicïì ka' njobeè' máè m faè' a caa beèe wááwá ce a m ba ñgaâa ntuu neè Jisoès. Yi ke' ba ba ená máè m faè' neè ya ñger ka'. AÈ m ba njobeè' Nyúè aè m túr máè aè ntee boèñboñ, a ka' fa máè ñger anaè.
English: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was bestowed on me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, káè aè feè'shi ba máè áè, káè aè feè'shi ba beèe mo' ce a yu ñgaâa ntuu neè Jisoès foñ áè, weèr wááwá ku ce feè'shi ba yuu yi mo'sir kuu Jisos Kraêis, aè ba yuu ce weèe aè byemi foñ.
English: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

Limbum: Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce weèr ce feè'shi neè beèe yu ená Jisoès aè m fúú efa rkwe. Weèr aè ka' ce feè'shi wa'a, beèe mo' efa weèe a ce laèa yap ená beèe a be keè fúú efa rkwe ka' njoká?
English: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená beèe a be keè fúú efa rkwe ka', baná Jisoès Kraâis aè m fúú efa rkwe foñ ka'.
English: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

Limbum: Yi ba ba ená Jisos Kraâis aè m fúú efa rkwe ka', yi ba ba ená blaèa ce weèr ce feè'shi neè weèe na vi yu aè cicïì, le rbyemïì li ba foñ aè cicïì.
English: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, and your faith also is in vain.

Limbum: Yi ba ba foñ ená weèr aè nya' mnde' a kuu Nyúè, njobeè' weèr aè suñ beèe ená Nyúè aè m fúr Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe.
English: Yes, we are found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn't raise up, if it is so that the dead are not raised.

Limbum: Beèe ce a kweñger a ka' tá keè fúú efa rkwe ka', baná Nyúè aè m fúr Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe foñ ka'.
English: For if the dead aren't raised, neither has Christ been raised.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ba fúr Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe ka' yi ba ba ená le rbyemïì li yu aè cicïì, yeè buu bbebep aè ku bii mbe weâe btuè.
English: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

Limbum: Yi ba ba wa'a, yi ba ba ená beèe ce a m byemi neè Jisos Kraâis foñ, a kweñger naè a bú aè cicïì.
English: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' ce láè mmir mbenduè Jisos Kraâis ená e be kuè jaè' seèe ba njep ñgoèñ na caè'caè', baná seèe yu beèe ce a ba koosimnse neè seèe caèa beèe enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá.
English: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená Jisos Kraâis aè m fúú efa rkwe. Efa múè beèe ce a m kweñger, a ye ce e m káè' a fúú efa rkwe.
English: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.

Limbum: Rkwe li m vúè njep ñgoèñ na njo' yuu ce ñwáè moè'sir aè m geèe. Beèe a be keè fúú efa rkwe foñ njo' yuu ce ñwáè moè'sir aè m geèe.
English: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

Limbum: Yi yu ená beèe wááwá a ce kweñger njobeè' a yu raèraè Adaèm, a ba ená Nyúè be keè fúr beèe ce a yu a Jisoès weèe aèbee efa rkwe.
English: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá be kuè fúú efa rkwe aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè lá. Jisos Kraâis a ñwáè ce e m fúú efa rkwe entombïì. Be keè ba aè nfeè' ce Jisos Kraâis aè kúti naè, tá yïì beèe a fúú efa rkwe.
English: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ's, at his coming.

Limbum: Yïì anaè yi mïì wáá, tá ñgoèñ yi mïî, tá Jisos Kraâis so mnyúâmkaè' ker ba beèe wááwá ce a ce sa', loèr yi kúú fa neè Nyúè ce e yu yïì Taê.
English: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

Limbum: Tá Jisos Kraâis ka' keè fa yi kúú neè yïì Taê, e be kuè sa' duè baè' aè nfeè' ce Nyúè be so beèe ce a baèa ye, láè woweèe wááwá njep yeâ tïìi.
English: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

Limbum: Ñwáè bbaèa ce elúèsimbuèu ce Nyúè be keè so, yu rkwe.
English: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Nyúè aè láè buu wááwá njep yeâ tïìi.” Ka' buu wááwá be keè ba njeptii Jisos Kraâis wa'a, yi yu rara ená Nyúè be keè ba njeptii Jisos Kraâis foñ ka' njobeè' yu ba ye ce e geèe buu ca wááwá aè ba njeptii Jisoès.
English: For, He put all things in subjection under his feet. But when he says, All things are put in subjection, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

Limbum: Buu ca wááwá e ba njep yeâ tïìi tá ye Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Muu Nyúè lá yïì nyor njeptii Nyúè, tá Nyúè ce e láè buu wááwá njeptii Jisos Kraâis bo túr ñger mbenduè buu wááwá.
English: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

Limbum: Yi ba ba mini ená beèe ce a kweñger a be fúú efa rkwe ka', a ka' ce baèptir beèe aètu beèe ce a m kweñger njoká?
English: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren't raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

Limbum: Yi ka' tá baè ba ená beèe ce a kweñger a be fúú efa rkwe ka', weèr aè ba kuè ce yá ñgá' nfeè' sïìp njoká?
English: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ku ba ñwáè rkwe aè nfeè' wááwá. Máè laèa wa'a njo' naèatu ce m ce naèa neè weèe njobeè' seèe yu aèbee seèe Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tataê.
English: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

Limbum: Máè m ba aè rla' Áfásoès, beâe aèfo a fa máè ñgá' seê. Beèe a m loè beeñger a vú mbe máâ nduè, a ce geèe ñgeèe aèmboè mnyaèa wa'a. Yi m ba ba ená beèe a be fúú efa rkwe ka', yaè sá' aè ba ba ká? Yi ba ba wa'a, yi ba ba boèñboñ ená m laa neè weèe enáê, “Seèe yeñger ce noñger njobeè' ku báti nfeè' múcaèr tá seèe kweñger.”
English: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.

Limbum: Fa maè'shi neè tá ñwáè moè' bo' weèe ka'. Weèe ka' ce kar weèe beèe ce a ce geèe ñgeâe bebep, weèe ku lo gee ñgeâe bebep foñ.
English: Don't be deceived! Evil companionships corrupt good morals.

Limbum: Borni mkwaè'shïì blúr, borni efa rgeèe buu bbebep. Máè yá máná beèe mo' efa weèe a rïìñ Nyúè ka' koo múcaèr. M ce laèa wa' tá rïìtu yi bo koo weèe.
English: Wake up righteously, and don't sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè moè' bipshïì enáê, “AÈde' beèe ce a kweñger a fúú efa rkwe aè njáâá ká? Woweèe a be fúú efa rkwe ba neè njáèá nyor ce e yu aè njáâá ká?”
English: But someone will say, How are the dead raised? and, With what kind of body do they come?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' bipshi wa'a, baná ñgaèñ yu lúr. Mboè wáè rïìñ ená a ke byeè ñgúè yuu njep nsheè e búteè wáá ka' fúú a?
English: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

Limbum: E ba aè nfeè' ce yuu ce wáè byeè anaè yi fúú, a ku', yi ba jáá efa ñgúè yuu ce wáè byeè, káè yu ñgúè kwaa áè, káè ñgúè ká áè.
English: That which you sow, you don't sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

Limbum: Nyúè e loè gee yuu anaè yi túr njáèá nyor ce e koèñ ená yi ba túr. E loè gee buu jáá jáèá jáá vi túr nyor jáá jáèá jáá.
English: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

Limbum: Buu ce vi túr myoèñ vi túr nyor njáèá moè'sir ka'. Nyor ñwáè yu jáá efa yïì nyaèa, nyor siñ aè ba jáá efa yïì nca.
English: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

Limbum: Nyor buu embe buèu yu jáá efa nyor buu enjep ñgoèñ. Rboèñ buu embe buèu li yu jáá efa rboèñ buu enjep ñgoèñ.
English: There are also celestial bodies, and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e ke sañ, túr rboèñ li, ñwáá yi túr rboèñ li, mkaèñsïì mi túr rboèñ lap, lap rboèñ anaè li ba jáá jáèá jáá.
English: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

Limbum: Yi ku ba foñ ená nyor ce beèe a be keè fúú aègho efa rkwe be keè ba jáá. A ke tuñ ñwáè, nyor búteè. E fúú efa rkwe, yïì nyor anaè ker búte ka'.
English: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption.

Limbum: A ke tuñ ñwáè, nyor ce keè' mboèñmboñ ka', túr ñger ka'. E fúú efa rkwe, yïì nyor ba mboèñmboñ, túr ñger.
English: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

Limbum: E ke ba aè nfeè' ce a ce tuñ ñwáè, e túr ba njáèá nyor ce seèe túr na. E ba aè nfeè' ce e fúú efa rkwe e túr ba nyor ce aè yú'. Nyor moè' ka' ba ce e yu nyor ce seèe túr na, baná nyor moè' ku ba ce e yu nyor ce aè yú'.
English: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè entombïì ce a m too ená Adaèm naè aè m beèeñger aè yuu teèe.” Adaèm embenjïì ce yu Adaèm elúèsimbuèu yu yi ba yú' ce yi ke fa beèe ryoèñ.
English: So also it is written, The first man, Adam, became a living soul. The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

Limbum: Nyor ce aè yú' a yïì ce e ke ba entoèmbïì ka', yïì ce e ke ba entombïì e ke ba nyor ce seèe túr na tá nyor ce aè yú' ka' ba.
English: However that which is spiritual isn't first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m boo ñwáè entombïì ba neè nshe, ñwáè embenjïì aè vú yi ba embe buèu.
English: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

Limbum: Beèe enjep ñgoèñ wááwá a ku ba aèmboè ñwáè entombïì ce a m boo neè nshe, beèe embe buèu a ku ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e m suèu embe buèu.
English: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

Limbum: Seèe ce seèe yu seè'ni aèmboè ñwáè ce Nyúè aè m boo neè nshe, seèe be keè ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e m suèu embe buèu aè noèñ mo'.
English: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let's also bear the image of the heavenly.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce suñ weèe ená aède' njáèá nyor ce seèe túr na niñ mbe dïû' kúú Nyúè ka'. AÈde' yuu ce yi ke kwe yi ye bti' yuu ce yi ke cu nfeseè ka'.
English: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can't inherit the Kingdom of God; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.

Limbum: Yáê, m be suñ weèe yuu ce weèe aè m be riñ ka'. Seèe wááwá be keè kweñger ka'. Seèe wááwá be keè kupse kupse.
English: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

Limbum: Seèe be keè kupse nfeè' moè'sir. Tá ñwáè ka' keè búèr rlir seèe aè kupse neè wáá. Be ba aè nfeè' elúèsimbuèu tá rsoèñ li laêa, tá buu ca koni. Li be keè laèa, tá beèe ce a m kweñger a fúú efa rkwe neè njáèá nyor ce aètaè e ke kwe ka', tá seèe ce a cu bteèe, kupse.
English: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

Limbum: Viseèe mnyor ce vi ke kwe búte na, vi be keè kuè kúti ba a njáèá mnyor ce vi ke kwe ka', búte ka'.
English: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

Limbum: Be keè ba aè nfeè' ce viseèe mnyor vi kúti aè njáâá wa'a, tá yuu ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “A so rkwe” naè, yi ghááte njo.
English: But when this corruptible will have put on incorruption, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: Death is swallowed up in victory.

Limbum: “AÈ wáâ rkweê, yo ñger yi yuê? AÈ wáâ rkweê, yoè nsïìi yuê?”
English: Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?

Limbum: Nsïìi rkwe yu buu bbebep, ñger buu bbebep aè ba mncir.
English: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

Limbum: Seèe yoñshi Tata Nyúè ce e ke fa seèe ñger aè rso buu bbebep, ker ba rkwe, njïì enjep Jisos Kraêis.
English: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Bfúr wa ce máè koèñ seê, yi ka' ba wa'a, táá neè tatap, ke' ce ci'ti ka', ce fa' neè Tata Jisos Kraâis neè ye ntee-ñwáè aè nfeè' wááwá, njobeè' weèe rïìñ ená rfaè' ce weèe ce geèe neè Tata Jisos Kraâis li be keè bú aè cicïì ka'.
English: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord's work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè mbaèa ce weèe ce kuèu tá weèe bo jaè' beèe Nyúè ce aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm aègho naè, weèe ku kuu ba aè njáèá njïì ce máè m laèa neè bcor aè ñgoâñ Gaèláshaè ená a kuu naè.
English: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

Limbum: E ba aè noèñ entoèmbïì enjep ñgaèa ñwáè wááwá lor ñgúè' moè' efa mbaèa ce Nyúè aè ghoèni ye aègho, láê, faè dïì' m ka' vú tá beèe a bo keèr loèr nfeè' moè' aè rkuèu mbaèa ka'.
English: On the first day of the week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.

Limbum: Geèe neè wa'a, má vúè bo sañ ñwaè', loèr mbaèa ce weèe aè kuèu naè kyeèse aègee ñwaè' anaè tuusi neè beèe ce weèe aè ce tá woweèe a du aègho aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm.
English: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba yáánïì ená má máè duê, weèr woweèe du bsïìp.
English: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

Limbum: M ce kwaè'shi aè rduè njïû aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè ka' vúè caè'ni weèe.
English: But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

Limbum: M ce kwaè'shi máná m ka vúê, seèe cu aè mú nfeè' moè', seemoè' aède' seèe ku cu nfeè' kïìntoèo mïî. E mïì wáá, weèe ja' máè m du faèdïì' m koèñ aè rduè.
English: But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

Limbum: M koèñ máná m ka' ba vú ba' yá weèe m ku caèa ce duè ka'. M ce kwaè'shi máná m ka' vúê, seèe cu nfeè' njïìsaèp, ce Tata Nyúè ka' fa ñger.
English: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

Limbum: M be cu aè rla' Áfásoès na baè' aè noèñ Ñkaâ' Pántikoès.
English: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

Limbum: M túr fáñ aè rgeèe rfaâ' rboèñboñ aèfa, ka' beèe magoèr a yu ce a koèñ aè rjepsi la rfaè' wa'a.
English: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

Limbum: Timotïì ka' vúê, weèe konïì ye boèñboñ seê, tá e bo wáp yuu mo' ka', njobeè' ye ye ce faè' foñ ba neè Tata aèmboè máè.
English: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' fa loèr ye aètáèr ka'. Jaè' neè ye tá e jár boèñboñ duè faèdïì' e ce duè tá e bo kúti vúè yá máè aèfa. Weèr bfúr ce aèfa weèe ce keè' ye.
English: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè nfúr weâr AÈpoloès, máè loo ye se ená e vú a bfúr mo' weèe vú ca'ni weèe, e yá yi ená yi yu boèñboñ ená e vú seè'ni ka'. E ka' lo koni nfeè', e ka' vúê.
English: Now concerning Apollos, the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

Limbum: Tami nyor, táá tatap aè lo rbyemïì. Fa wáp yuu ka', ba neè ñger-ñwáè.
English: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

Limbum: Geèe neè buu wááwá neè rkoèñnïì-ñwáè.
English: Let all that you do be done in love.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe rïìñ ená Stáfánaès ba beèe embe yeâ ndaèp a m ba beèe entombïì efa múè beâe aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè ce a m beèeñger aè ñgaâa rbyemïì. Woweèe a m fa waêp mnyor aè rjaè' beèe Nyúè.
English: Now I beg you, brothers you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints,

Limbum: M ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe yu'ni neè njáèá beèe ce a yu aèmboè woweèe. Ker yu'ni neè beèe ce a woweèe a ce faè' aèbee.
English: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

Limbum: M ce lu'shi njobeè' Stáfánaès, Foètunatoès ba AÈkaikoès a vúè a yá máè aèfa. M ce lu'shi njobeè' máè yá woweèe, yi ba aèmboè máè yá lá ba weèe wááwá wa'a.
English: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

Limbum: Woweèe a m fa máè ñger aèmboè a m ce fa weèe naè. Njáèá beâe wa'a yu beèe ce a ba yu'ni neè woweèe.
English: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

Limbum: Bcor aè ñgoâñ Áshaè wááwá vi caè'ni weèe. AÈkwilaè ba Prïûskaè ker ba beèe ce a ke niñ cor mbe waâp ndaèp a caè'ni weèe se aè rlii Tataê.
English: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

Limbum: Bfúr ce aèfa wááwá a caè'ni weèe. Caè'ni neè bfúr mo' ba mo', baa woweèe nje nyoèr neè rkoèñnïì-ñwáè.
English: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

Limbum: Rcaè'nïì ca aè sañ máâ Pol neè ya bo.
English: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' tá koèñ Tata Jisoès ka', ndoèo co' ye. Yeèr Tataê, vúè.
English: If any man doesn't love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. Come, Lord!

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Jisoès túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

Limbum: Máè koèñ weèe wááwá njobeè' seèe wááwá yu aèbee seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe. Yi yu wa'a.
English: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Poêl, ce m yu ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. Nyúè a ñwáè ce e m geèe ená m ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisoès. Weèr Timotïì ce e yu nfúr yïìseèe ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè cor Nyúè ce e yu aè rla' Koreèn, ker ba neè beèe Nyúè wááwá ce a yu aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè wááwá.
English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

Limbum: Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, ker ba Tata Jisos Kraêis, túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Seèe yoñshi Nyúè ce e yu Taèr neè yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis. E yu Taèr ce e ke koosimnse neè beèe, ker ce fa beèe ñger aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;

Limbum: E ke fa seèe ñger aè nfeè' wááwá ce seèe ka' ce yá ñgá'. E ke geèe wa'a ená ñwáè moè' foñ aè ka' ce yá ñgá', seèe bo fa ñgaèñ ñger neè ñger ce seèe aè koni ese ye.
English: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

Limbum: Ndeèe ce seèe aè ka' yá njáèá ñgá' ce Jisos Kraâis aè m yá, ka' ñgá' anaè aè ka' ba goèr se áè, baná a ndeèe ce seèe be koni ñger njo' ye.
English: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

Limbum: Weèr ka' ce yá mluè, weèe riñ ená weèr ce yá tá mi bo fa weèe ñger, keèr geèe tá weèe luêñ. Nyúè aè ka' fa weèr ñger, baná wee weèe foñ be koni ñger anaè tá weèe bo kur ntee, táá tatap njep ñgá' ce weèe ce yá aèmboè weèr ce yá na.
English: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

Limbum: Weèr túr ntee njep weèe seê, a riñ neè mini-ñwáè ená aèmboè weèe ce yá ñgá' aèmboè wer weèr ce yá na, weèe be koni ñger ce weèr aè koni foñ naè ese Nyúè.
English: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so also are you of the comfort.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèr ce koèñ ená weèe riñ njáèá ñgá' ce weèr aè m yá aè ñgoâñ Áshaè. Ñgá' anaè aè m tap seê, a ba aèmboè ntáèr ce yi m rïìr a caa yer ñger wa'a, wer aè lo a ce kwaè'shi ená ñwáè be cu nteèe ka'.
English: For we don't desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

Limbum: Weèr aè m ce kwaè'shi ená weèr aè kweñger wáá. Geewa'a, ñgá' ca aè m koni weèr tá weèr bo kuè láè buu wááwá mbe mmbo Nyúè ce e ke fúr beèe efa rkwe, ke' ba mbe weâr mmboè ka'.
English: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

Limbum: E fúr weèr efa ñgá' ce e m ba yú weèr. E be keèr fúr weèr. Weèr aè láè mmir ba mbe yeâ nduè ená ku ba ye ce e be kuè ce fúr weèr efa njáèá ñgá' anaè.
English: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;

Limbum: Wee weèe foñ aè ba jaè' aè rloo neè weèr. Weèe aè ka' loo, baná beèe magoèr a be yoèñshi Nyúè njo' yuu boèñboñ ce Nyúè aè yu' miseèe mloo, a geèe neè weèr.
English: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift bestowed on us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

Limbum: Yuu mo' yi yu ce weèr ce naèa tu aègho, a ke' ce tarni ka'. Yuu anaè yi yu ená weèr aè cu njep ñgoèñ na, lañlañ aè nfeè' weèr aè m ba a weâe mú neè ntee rara ba mini ce e loè ese Nyúè. Weèr aè cu wa'a ba neè bfee enjep ñgoèñ na ka', weèr aè cu ba njo' ntee boèñboñ ce Nyúè túr neè weèr.
English: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

Limbum: Mñwaè' ce weèr aè sañ neè weèe naè, buu embo wááwá vi yu brara, a ba kuèyáá. Weèe aè be riñ weèr seè'ni na boèñboñ ka'. Baná m ce kwaè'shi máná weèe be loè rïìñ weèr boèñboñ tá weèe bo loè naèa tu neè weèr aèmboè weèr be loè naèa neè weèe foñ aè noèñ ce Tata Jisoès be vúè.
English: For we write no other things to you, than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end; as also you acknowledged us in part, that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

Limbum: M rïìñ máná weèe be loè rïìñ weèr boèñboñ. Yi ka' ba wa'a, máè kwaè'shi máná m be caè'ni weèe entoèmbïì tá weèe bo lu'shi ñkaèraè' baa.
English: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit;

Limbum: Máè m kwaè'shi máná m be ce duè aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè tá m caa caè'ni weèe má ce kúti, ker ca'ni weèe, tá weèe bo maè'shi máè tá m du aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè.
English: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

Limbum: Seemoè' aèmboè máè m kúti a vú ka' naè, weèe ce kwaè'shi ená m yu njáèá ñwáè ce e ke kupse ntee aèfo aèfo. Waè' m ka' ce kwaè'shi yuu ce m be geèe, m kwa'shïì aèmboè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na ce a ke byemi yuu, ker lo kani naè a?
English: When I therefore was thus determined, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the Yes, yes and the No, no?

Limbum: Yi yu wa' ka'. AÈmboè seèe rïìñ ená Nyúè yu ñwáè mini, baná aède' weèr byemïì aè rgeèe yuu ker lo kani efa rgeèe yi ka'.
English: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not Yes and no.

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Muu Nyúè, yu ñwáè ce e ke byemi ker kani ka'. Yu ye ce weèr Timotïì ba Silaès aè m ce feè'shi aèmboè ye aè nfeè' ce weèr aè m ba a weâe mú naè. E yu ñwáè ce e ce duèñshi ená Nyúè e ke laèa ená áèno, ku táá ba njo,
English: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, by me, Silvanus, and Timothy, was not Yes and no, but in him is Yes.

Limbum: njobeè' e ce duèñshi ená Nyúè aè byemi ená e be geèe buu wááwá ce e kaè'. Baná seèe ce laèa enáê, “Yi yu wa'a” ba njo' ye. Seâe laèa wa'a, ce ku'si ba Nyúè.
English: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the Yes. Therefore also through him is the Amen, to the glory of God through us.

Limbum: Yu ye Nyúè ce e geèe seèe aè táá tatap njep Kraêis. Yu ye ce e ce seèe aè yïì beèe,
English: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;

Limbum: a ker fa seèe ncoèo ce e ce duèñshi ená seèe yu yïì beèe. E fa yi Yú' njep seâe mntee, yi ba aèmboè yuu ce e tár neè seèe ená seèe be koni buu wááwá ce e kaè' ená e be keè fa neè seèe.
English: who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

Limbum: Máè m vúè aè rla' Koreèn ka' faè dïì' m bo loè geèe tá nyor bep weèe ka'. M ce ká' Nyúè ená e táá yaè njïìnsa' ená yuu ce m ce laèa na yi yu mini.
English: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn't come to Corinth to spare you.

Limbum: Yi yu ená weèr be vúè loèr ba ñger ka' suñ weèe yuu ce weèe byemi ka', njobeè' weèe aè táá tatap njep le rbyemïì. Ler rfaè' li yu ba ená weèr ja' weèe tá weèe bo yu' rboèñ.
English: Not that we have lordship over your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce máè m kwaè'shi máná aède' m ker vú ca'ni weèe ka', faè dïì' m lo geèe tá nyor bep weèe ka'.
English: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

Limbum: M ka' gee nyor bep weèe, ñwáè ce aède' e ka' gee nyor boñ máè ba nda, caa efa weèe ce máè geèe nyor aè bep weèe naè?
English: For if I make you sorry, then who will make me glad but he who is made sorry by me?

Limbum: A mbuèu ce máè m sañ ñwaè' anaè neè weèe, faè dïì' m ka' vú ca'ni weèe tá yi lo ba ená beèe ce m ce kwaè'shi máná woweèe a ba geèe nyor boñ máè, a lo ba ba beèe ce a be geèe tá m lo yu' ba ryañ ka'. M rïìñ máná m ka' ce yu' rboèñ baná weèe ce yu' rboèñ foñ.
English: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn't have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy would be shared by all of you.

Limbum: Máè m sañ ñwaè' anaè neè weèe, a ce koosimnse, ntee yi ce fa máè ñgá', mñgoommir mi ce suèu máè ekuè tuè. Máè m ce sañ yi tá m bo geèe tá nyor bep weèe bep ka'. Máè m sañ yi tá weèe bo rïìñ ená m koèñ weèe seê.
English: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made sorry, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' gee yuu ce ntee yi bep beèe, baná ñgaèñ aè geèe ba neè máè ka'. E geèe yuu anaè goèr ba neè weèe wááwá. Baná m ker laa tatap aèmboè yuu anaè ka'.
English: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part that I not press too heavily to you all.

Limbum: Ñgá' ce beèe magoèr efa weâe mú a fa neè ñgaèñ aè gháá.
English: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was inflicted by the many;
