Limbum: Baná yuu ce weèe aè ba geèe neè ñwáè anaè seè'ni yi yu ená weèe aè ba foèosi ye, fa ye ñger faè dïì' bsáè vi lo koo ye ka'.
English: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

Limbum: M ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe gee tá ñgaèñ riñ ená weèe ku bii koèñ ye.
English: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

Limbum: Máè m sañ ñwaè' anaè tá m bo moèoshi weèe, yá máná waè' weèe ce yu'ni neè máè aè buu bsïìp lá.
English: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' foosi ñwáè, baná máè foèosi ye foñ. Yi ka' ba ená ñwáè aè geèe yuu ce m foosi ye, m foosïì ye aè bsii Kraâis njo' weèe,
English: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

Limbum: faè dïì' Sataèn lo túr ñger mbe seâe nduè ka'. Seèe rïìñ ená Sataèn yu kwáèá.
English: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

Limbum: Máè m duè aè rfeè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Jisos Kraâis aè rla' Trowaès, a ka' ba aèfo, a yá máná Tata Nyúè aè múè' nduunjïì neè máè aèfo aè rfaè' neè ye.
English: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

Limbum: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, ntee yi bu' máè se njobeè' máè m yá nfúr yaè ce Taitoès ka'. Máè ka' yá ye ka', a daasi woweèe a du aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè.
English: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn't find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

Limbum: Baná seèe yoñshi Nyúè njobeè' seèe aè ka' ce duè ba fá, e ku táá kuèntombïì neè seèe. E táá wa'a, seèe ce jáèr aèmboè beèe ce a ce jáèr mbe ñgoo beèe Jisoès, Jisoès aè táá entombïì a ce vúni. Nyúè aè loèr seèe a gee nsuñ aèmboè Jisoès aè du aè bdïì' wááwá aèmboè nráèá ce a too e rúú boèñboñ seê, a du aè bdïì' wááwá.
English: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

Limbum: Nráèá ce Jisoès ce toèo neè Nyúè anaè yuu seèe. Nráèá anaè yi ce rúèú aè múè beèe wááwá, káè yu beèe ce a be luèñ áè, káè yu beèe ce a be bú áè.
English: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved, and in those who perish;

Limbum: Rúèú efa gho yi yu neè beèe ce a ce bú aèmboè rúèú ce aède' yi yú ñwáè, a ba neè beèe ce a be luèñ aèmboè yuu ce aède' yi gee ñwáè e cu nteèe. AÈmboè yi yu wa' na, baná ñwáè ce e ghááte aè rgeèe njáèá rfaè' ca yu nda?
English: to the one a stench from death to death; to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèr, weèr yu aèmboè beèe mo' ce a loèr blaâa Nyúè aè ba yuu ntaa naè ka'. AÈ tuu ba Nyúè a tuu weèr, weèr aè ce feè'shi vi blaèa a yeâ bsii neè mini-ñwáè, aè rlii Kraêis.
English: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

Limbum: Waè' weèr ce laèa buu ca wa'a tá weèe bo rïìñ ená weèr yu ba beâe mini a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Waè' yi yu ená wer aè ba fa ba ñwaè' neè weèe tá wee weèe sañ ñwaè' neè weèr tá beèe a riñ aèmboè weèr ce faè' a weâe mú, aèmboè beèe mo' a ke geèe naè a? Yi yu wa' ka'.
English: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

Limbum: Weèe yu njep weâr mntee aèmboè ñwaè' ce a sañ, ñwáè wááwá aè ce beè', a riñ yuu ce a sañ mbo wa'a,
English: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men;

Limbum: a ce yá boèñboñ ená weèe yu ñwaè' ce aè sañ ba Jisos Kraêis, a ka' tuu weèr aègho. Ñwaè' ca yu ñwaè' ce a sañ ba neè mdip ñwaè' ka'. A sañ ba neè Yú' Nyúâ nteèe. A sañ ba mbe luâr mbáèmbár ka', a sañ ba njep mntee beèe.
English: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

Limbum: Weèr ce laèa buu ca aèmboè beèe ce a Jisos Kraâis weèe a yu aèbee, a riñ werná ku ba Nyúè ce e be jaè' weèr tá weèr ka' geèe buu ca.
English: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God;

Limbum: Weèr túr ñger aè rgeèe yuu mo' neè yer tu ka'. Yer ñger yi loè ba ese Nyúè.
English: not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;

Limbum: E geèe seèe aè ghááteè aè ñgaâa mfaè' ce a ce feè'shi aèmboè leâ' fi. Leâ' fi ca yi ce laèa ená seèe yu' seè'ni ba ese Yú' Nyúè, ke' yu' ba ese mncir ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' ka'. Ncir yi vúè neè rkwe, Yú' Nyúè yi ce fa rluèñ.
English: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m láè mncir a duñshi yi foèo. E m sañ mncir mbe luâr mbáèmbár a fa neè Musïìs. E ka' ce vúè neè mncir ca, rraa Nyúè li raa a yeâ bsii seê, ce aède' beèe Isráèl a m ba fyá' neè mmir ka'. Ka' rraa anaè li m loè a ker ce raa aèmboè li m ce raa naè ka' wa'a. AÈmboè yi yu seè'ni ená rsa' rrúèú ce li m ce vúè ba neè rkwe li m ce duèñshi foèo Nyúè na,
English: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face; which was passing away:

Limbum: baná rsa' rfi ce li vúè yi ba neè Yú' Rara, li caèa lïû rrúèú aè njáèá njïì ce e ce duèñshi foèo Nyúè.
English: won't service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

Limbum: Ka' ba ená rsa' rrúèú ce li m ce geèe beèe a gwe mnsa' Nyúè naè li m ce duèñshi foèo Nyúè, baná rsa' rfi ce li ce geèe beèe a ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè li caèa lïû rrúèú aè njáèá njïì ce e ce duèñshi foèo Nyúè.
English: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

Limbum: AÈde' seèe laa seè'ni ená rraa ce li m ba njep rsa' rrúèú na li ker ce yááti aè yuu ka' njobeè' seèe ce jáèr seè'ni ba njep rsa' rfi ce li ce raa a caa ñger.
English: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

Limbum: Yi yu ená aèmboè rsa' rrúèú anaè li m cu njïìsaèp ka', a ku ce duèñshi foèo Nyúè naè, baná rsa' rfi ce li be cu yi nfeseè na, li be duèñshi foèo Nyúè caèa lïû rrúèú anaè.
English: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' weèr rïìñ buu ca, weèr ce suñ beèe buu Nyúè rara seê, a ke' ce súèti yuu mo' ka'.
English: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

Limbum: Weèr yu aèmboè Musïìs ka'. Musïìs aè m ce loè cete vi bsii neè cáè' faè dïì' beèe Isráèl a bo yá aèmboè rraa efa yeâ bsii anaè li ce liiti ka'.
English: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face, that the children of Israel wouldn't look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

Limbum: Yap ntee yi yinïì. Ká' ese aè nfeè' anaè vú ba' seè'ni na, yuu mo' yi ce cete wap bfee. E ke ba aè nfeè' ce a ce beè' ñwaè' mncir embe ñwaâ' rúèú neè woweèe, woweèe a ke' ce yu' yuu ce a ce beè' ka'. Bfee ñwáè vi ke múè'ti ba aè nfeè' ce ñwáè anaè ba Kraâis a yu aèbee.
English: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

Limbum: Yi yu mini wa'a ená ká' ese aè nfeè' anaè vú ba' seè'ni na, woweèe a ke beè' mncir Musïìs, yuu mo' yi ce cete wap bfee, woweèe a ke' riñ yuu ce a ce beè' ka'.
English: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

Limbum: Geewa'a, ñwáè aè ka' beesi yi ntee byemi neè Tata Jisoès baná Nyúè be caè'si yuu ce yi cete ye bfee anaè.
English: But whenever one turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

Limbum: Tata ce seèe ce laèa na yu Yú'. Faè dïì' wááwá ce Yú' Tata yi ka' ba, baná beèe anaè a luèñ.
English: Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' yuu mo' yi ker ce cete seèe mmir ka', baná rraa Nyúè ca li ce raa seèe aè nyoèr, seèe aè ce raa, a ká' a ce kupse, kuè ce kupse caar, loè ba foñ aèmboè Tata Jisoès, ba ñgaâa foèo aèmboè Kraâis yu naè. Cena yu ba rfaè' Tata ce e yu Yú'.
English: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m túr ntee boèñboñ neè weèr, a fa weèr rfaè' ená weèr gee buu ca neè beèe. Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèr aè ce geèe li, a ke' ce koosi bsáè ka'.
English: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don't faint.

Limbum: Weèr aè maè' buu bbebep ce beèe a ke geèe aè bsúèti njo' rïìtu. Weèr ce bo' beèe ka', a ce kupse blaâa Nyúè ka'. Weèr ce feè'shi buu mini aèwañ, aè bsii Nyúè. Weèr ce geèe wa'a, ñwáè wááwá aè ce kwaè'shi boèñboñ aèmboè weèr.
English: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

Limbum: Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca ka' ba neè beèe mo' aèmboè yuu ce a cete, baná e yu wa'a ba neè beèe ce a ce bú.
English: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who perish;

Limbum: Woweèe a byemi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca ka' njobeè' Sataèn ce e yu nyúè enjep ñgoèñ na aè geèe woweèe a feêp. AÈde' woweèe a yá rraa ce li ce raa mbe waâp nduè ka'. Rraa ca yu rraa ce li vúè njo' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè foèo ce Kraâis túr ce e ku ba aèmboè Nyúè ye ye yu naè.
English: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

Limbum: Weèr ce feè'shi ba aèmboè weêr mnyor ka'. Weèr ce feè'shi neè beèe ená Jisos Kraâis yu Tataê. Weèr yu ñgaâa mfaè' neè weèe ba njo' Jisoès.
English: For we don't preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake;

Limbum: Nyúè ce e m laèa enáê, “Maè'shi tá rraa li raa aè túè'nji,” yu ye ce e geèe li rraa li ce raa njep seâe mntee, tá seèe bo koni rraa, yá foèo Nyúè aèmboè yi ce raa aè bsii Kraêis.
English: seeing it is God who said, Light will shine out of darkness, who has shone in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Seèe ce seèe túr yuu boèñboñ ca, seèe yu aèmboè mkïìñ nshe. Seèe yu wa'a tá yi bo duèñshi ená njáèá ñger ce yi caèa ñger na, yu yiseèe ñger ka'. Ñger anaè yu ba ñger Nyúè.
English: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.

Limbum: Ñgá' ce koni weèr aè mnjïì wááwá, weèr aè ke' bornïì rfaè' ca ka'. E ba aè nfeè' moè' bfee vi jep weèr, ntee yi ke' kwe weèr efa rfaè' ca ka'.
English: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

Limbum: Beèe a ce fa weèr ñgá', weèr aè ke' ba mer mñgi' ka'. Beèe a ce lïìp weèr, weèr aè ce gweèñger aè nsheè, a ke' ce kweñger ka'.
English: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

Limbum: Weèr aè byáè' rkwe Jisoès nje weâr mnyoèr aè nfeè' wááwá, tá li ryoèñ li bo yááti nje weâr mnyoèr foñ.
English: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèr ce cu njep ñgoèñ na, rkwe li ce rúèú wer aè nfyeènyú aè nfeè' wááwá njo' Kraêis, tá li ryoèñ li bo yááti nje weâr mnyoèr ce vi be loè kweñger naè.
English: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

Limbum: Baná weèr aè byemi yer ba rkwe, tá weèe bo koni ryoèñ.
English: So then death works in us, but life in you.

Limbum: Weèr aè láè ntee njep Nyúè aèmboè ñwáè ce e m laèa mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Máè m byemi a ka' laêa.” Baná wer weèr foñ aè byemi a ka' laêa.
English: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, I believed, and therefore I spoke. We also believe, and therefore also we speak;

Limbum: Weèr rïìñ werná Nyúè ce e m fúr Tata Jisoès efa rkwe be fúr weèr ce weèr yu beèe Jisoès efa rkwe, loèr weèr, keèr loèr weèe foñ duè aègho, tár aè bsii Kraêis.
English: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.

Limbum: Weèr ce yá ñgá' ca tá weèe bo koni sá' efa gho, tá beèe magoèr a koni rboèñ Nyúè, ce kuè'si ye goèr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, beèe magoèr a násïì ye.
English: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

Limbum: A mbuèu ntee yi ce kwe weèr ka'. Ka' wer mnyor vi káè' a ce sáè wa'a, ryoâñ rfi ce li yu njep weèr naè, li ce top aè mnoèñ wááwá.
English: Therefore we don't faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.

Limbum: Ñgá' ce weèr ce yá, ce e be cu njïìsaèp ka' naè, yu aèmboè yuu ce yi fáp wa'a, a ce geèe tá seèe bo ghááte aè rkoni foèo ce yi be cu nfeseè. Foèo anaè yi caèa ñgá' anaè goèr seê.
English: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèr aè ke' ce láè mer mmir ba mbenduè buu ce beèe a ce yá neè mmir ka'. Weèr aè láè mer mmir ba mbenduè buu ce aède' ñwáè yá ka', njobeè' buu ce aède' ñwáè yá, vi be cu nfeseè ka'. Vïì ce vi be cu nfeseè yu vïì ce aède' ñwáè yá ka' naè.
English: while we don't look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

Limbum: Weèr rïìñ werná yeèr nyor ce weèr ce cu aègho njep ñgoèñ na yu aèmboè taèp ce weèr ce cu mbo wa'a. A ka' sa'si taèp anaè, seèe ku riñ seená ndap yu mbe buèu ce aè baè'ri ba ñwáè ka'. Ndap anaè aè baè'ri Nyúè, aè ba ndap ce e be cu nfeseè.
English: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

Limbum: Weèr ce shooñger seè'ni njobeè' weèr ce koèñ se aè ryar ndap ce e yu mbe buèu naè aèmboè cáè' ce ñwáè aè yar aè nyoèr wa'a.
English: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven;

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' ke yar, weèr bo ba mbuèuriñ ka'.
English: if so be that being clothed we will not be found naked.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèr ce cu neè nyor ca njep ñgoèñ na, weèr ce shooñger aèmboè weèr aè byáè' lá ntáèr yi ce rïìr se wa'a. Yi yu ba ená weèr ce koèñ aè rco' cáâ' rúèú ca ka', weèr ce koèñ ba aè ryar cáâ' fi, tá cáâ' rúèú yi kupse dúèdúè.
English: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened; not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

Limbum: Nyúè a ñwáè ce e geèe seèe aè tamïì nyor aè rkupseè ca, a ker fa yú' neè seèe, aèmboè btár, yi ce duèñshi ená seèe be koni buu ce Nyúè aè kaè' seèe.
English: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

Limbum: Baná weèr ce koosi bsáè aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Weèr rïìñ ená aèmboè weèr ce cu neè nyor ca njep ñgoèñ na, weèr yu njïìsaèp ese Tataê.
English: Therefore, we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

Limbum: AÈmboè weèr ce cu neè nyor ca njep ñgoèñ na, weèr ce cu ba njobeè' weèr aè láè ntee neè ye, ke' ba njobeè' weèr aè yá ye ka'.
English: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

Limbum: Weèr ce koosi bsáè ka', a koñ yer aè rmaè'shi nyor ca duè cu aè laè' weèr Tata weèe.
English: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu na, yuu ce weèr túr nje tuè yi yu ená weèr fa' tá nyor boñ ye, káè weèr cu neè nyor ca njep ñgoèñ na áè, káè weèr aè fúú enjo áè.
English: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

Limbum: Seèe wááwá be keè táá kuèntombïì neè Kraêis, tá e bo sa' seèe, tá ñwáè wááwá koo yuu ce yi ghááte aè yuu ce e m geèe aè nfeè' ce e m ce cu neè nyor ca njep ñgoèñ na, káè yuu anaè yi m boèñ áè, káè yi m bep áè.
English: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèr aè rïìñ aèmboè mnsa' Tataê, a ce wáp ye, weèr ce gheèter aè rgeèe tá beèe a kupse. Nyúè rïìñ njáèá beèe ce weèr yu, máè ce kwaè'shi máná wee weèe foñ aè rïìñ njáèá beèe ce weèr yu.
English: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God; and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

Limbum: Weèr ce laèa wa'a, a ke' ce gheèter ba aè rgeèe tá weèe bo rïìñ ená weèr yu beâe mini ka'. Weèr ce taè' ba ená weèe koni yuu ce aède' weèe yu' rboèñ aègho neè weèr, tá weèe bo túr yuu aè rlaèa neè beèe ce a ce yu' rboèñ neè ñwáè njo' nta' ce ñgaèñ túr, ke' ba ba njo' njáèá ñwáè ce e yu ka'.
English: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance, and not in heart.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' ce yááti aèmboè beèe ce btu vi ce kar embo wa'a, baná weèr yu wa'a njo' Nyúè. Weèr aè ka' ba beèe ce yap tu yi yu mbo, baná weèr yu wa'a njo' weèe.
English: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

Limbum: Yu ba rkoèñnïì Kraâis ce li geèe ntee yi ce luèu weèr aè rgeèe njáèá buu ca, njobeè' weèr rïìñ ená ñwáè moè'sir ka' kwe aè btu beèe wááwá, baná beèe wááwá aè kweñger.
English: For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.

Limbum: E m kwe aè btu beèe wááwá, tá beèe ce a cu bteèe a bo cu neè yap tu ka', cu ba aètu ñwáè ce e m kwe a waâp tuè, a fúú efa rkwe.
English: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

Limbum: Baná weèr ker ce yá beèe ba aè mmïìr, aèmboè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ke geèe naè ka'. Weèr aè m ce yá Kraâis wa'a aè nfeè' moè', aè ka' ba seè'ni na, weèr aè ker ce yá ye wa' ka'.
English: Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ba aèbee a Kraêis, baná e kúti ñwáâ nfi; buu brúèú aè mïì, aè ba ba buu bfi seè'ni.
English: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

Limbum: Cena yu ba rfaè' Nyúè. E m geèe seèe woweèe aè kútïì aèbee njo' Kraêis, a fa weèr rfaè' ená weèr suñ beèe ená aède' a Nyúè weèe a kútïì aèbee.
English: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa yi yu ená Nyúè aè m caèa embenjïì Kraâis a gee a beèe enjep ñgoèñ na weèe a kútïì aèbee, a ke' ce beè' yaèp buu bbebep ka'. E fa nsuñ ca mba weâr mmboè ená weèr suñ neè beèe.
English: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

Limbum: Weèr táá aètu Kraêis, a ce laèa buu ca aèmboè ce laèa lá ba Nyúè seese neè weèe wa'a. Weèr ce bu' mmbo neè weèe aètu Kraâis ená weèe kúti aèbee weèe Nyúè weèe.
English: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

Limbum: Kraâis aè m geèe yuu bebep ka', geewa'a, Nyúè aè m geèe e ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e m geèe lá yuu bebep wa'a, tá seèe bo ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè aèmboè Nyúè yu, njo' ye.
English: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèr ce faè' aèbee weèr Nyúè weèe na, weèr ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe fa maè'shi tá rboèñ Nyúè ce weèe aè koni na li bú aè cicïì ka'.
English: Working together, we entreat also that you not receive the grace of God in vain,

Limbum: Nyúè aè laèa mbe yeâ Ñwaè' enáê, “Nfeè' ce máè m ba aè rgeèe yuu boèñboñ neè wáè aè m gháá, máè fa wa btuè' neè wáè. Noèñ ce máè m ba aè rjaè' wáè tá aè bo luèñ, yi m gháá, máè ja' wáè.” Rïìñ neè ená nfeè' ce aède' Nyúè gee yuu boèñboñ neè seèe, yu ba seè'ni na. Nfeè' ce aède' Nyúè gee beèe a luêñ, yu seè'ni na.
English: for he says, At an acceptable time I listened to you, in a day of salvation I helped you. Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

Limbum: Weèr ce jepsi ñwáè moè' ka', faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo laèa yuu mo' bebep aèmboè ler rfaè' ka'.
English: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba koni ká koni weèr, weèr ce duèñshi ená weèr yu ñgaâa mfaè' neè Nyúè. Weèr ce duèñshi wa'a aè njáèá njïì ce weèr aè kur ntee seê, a táá tatap aè nfeè' ce weèr ce yá ñgá', ba aè nfeè' ce fuèp aè koo weèr, ker ba aè nfeè' ce buu aè ka' tap neè weèr.
English: but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

Limbum: Beèe a lïìp weèr, a fa weèr aè shañ. E ba aè nfeè' moè' beèe a gañ weèr. E ba aè nfeè' moè' weèr fa' jorni, e ba aè nfeè' moè' weèr túr nfeè' aè rbuumïì ka', e ba aè nfeè' moè' weèr túr yuu ye ka'.
English: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

Limbum: Weèr aè duèñshi ená weèr yu ñgaâa mfaè' neè Nyúè aè yer ñgeâe rara, ba aè buu Nyúè ce weèr aè rïìñ, ba aè njáèá njïì ce weèr ce kur ntee, ker ba foñ aè njáèá njïì ce weèr ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ neè beèe. Weèr aè ruusi ba neè Yú' Rara, a koñ beèe neè mini-ñwáè.
English: in pureness, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

Limbum: Weèr ce suñ nsuñ mini aè nfeè' wááwá, a ce geèe buu ba aè ñger Nyúè. Yer ñgeâe yáánïì yi yu aèmboè buu bïìr ce weèr bo maè' bïìr aègho neè Nyúè, keèr tá'shi yeèr nyor aègho.
English: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

Limbum: E ba aè nfeè' moè' beèe a naa weèr, e ba aè nfeè' moè' a coosïì weèr. E ba aè nfeè' moè' beèe a laa buu bbebep aèmboè weèr, e ba aè nfeè' moè' a laa buu bboèñboñ. Beèe a loè lor weèr aèmboè ñgaâa mnde' wa'a, weèr ku ce laèa yer yu ba yuu mini.
English: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;

Limbum: E ba aè nfeè' moè' beèe a lor weèr aè buu bcicïì, geewa'a, beèe a rïìñ weèr aè bdïì' wááwá. E ba aè nfeè' moè' a yá weèr aèmboè bgúâú beèe wa'a, geewa'a weèr ku ba bteèe. Beèe a fa weèr ñgá', a ke' yú ne weèr ka'.
English: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;

Limbum: Weèr yu aèmboè beèe ce a ce koosimnse wa'a, geewa'a weèr ce lu'shi aè nfeè' wááwá. Weèr yu aèmboè ñgaâa fuèp wa'a, geewa'a weèr ce geèe beèe magoèr a ce koni bkuè'. Weèr yu aèmboè beèe ce a túr buu ka' wa'a, geewa'a weèr a túr buu wááwá.
English: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

Limbum: Beâe aè rla' Koreèn, weèr aè súèti yuu mo' ese weèe ka'. Weèr aè múè' yer ntee a lá too neè weèe.
English: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

Limbum: Weèr aè cete yer ntee ese weèe ka', yu ba weèe ce weèe aè cete ye ntee ese weèr.
English: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

Limbum: Kúúsi neè rboèñ ce weèr aè m ce geèe neè weèe naè, mú' wee mntee lá btoo foñ. M ce laèa neè weèe aèmboè boo wa.
English: Now in return, I speak as to my children, you also be open wide.

Limbum: Weèe fa ba aèbee weèe beèe ce a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì ka' ka'. AÈde' yuu yáánïì ba yuu bebep a koo ñkar aè njáèá ká? Yuu ce rraa li túr aè rgeèe a túè'nji yu ká?
English: Don't be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?

Limbum: AÈde' Kraâis ba Báèlayaèl a ba cuâu mo'sir aè njáâá ká? AÈde' ñwáè rbyemïì táá kuèu a ñwáè ce e byemi ka' aè njáèá ká?
English: What agreement has Christ with Belial? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?

Limbum: AÈde' Ndap Nyúè ba yïì mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na a ba aè yuu mo'sir aè njáâá ká? Seèe yu ndap neè Nyúè ce e yu nteèe. Yi ku ba aèmboè Nyúè aè laèa. E laèa enáê, “M be cu a waâp mú, jáèr a waâp mú, ba yaèp Nyúè tá woweèe a ba yaè beèe.
English: What agreement has a temple of God with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.

Limbum: Baná weèe fúú efa waâp mú, táá jáá. Weèe fa joèo yuu ce yi yu rara ka' ka', tá m bo koni weèe.
English: Therefore, 'Come out from among them, and be separate,' says the Lord. 'Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

Limbum: M be ba taèr neè weèe tá weèe ba boo wa, boo mmbañruè ba boo bbyeèñge. Cena aè laèa Tata ce e túr buu wááwá.”
English: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,' says the Lord Almighty.

Limbum: Bkar waê, aèmboè Nyúè aè geèe mkaè'ni ca neè seèe, seèe raasi viseèe btu efa buu wááwá ce vi ce bepsi viseèe mnyor ba viseèe byú'. Seèe ce wáp Nyúè, fa viseèe btu wááwá neè ye, ce gee ñgeâe rara aè buu wááwá.
English: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

Limbum: Múè' neè wee mntee neè weèr. Weèr aè geèe faèa neè ñwáè moè' ka', weèr aè daè'si ñwáè moè' ka', weèr aè ye sá' efa ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a, a ke' ce lapni weèe lapni ka'. Weèr túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ aèmboè weèr aè m suñ weèe naè. Káè yu rkwe áè, káè yu rluèñ á, seèe ku ba aèbee.
English: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

Limbum: M túr ntee njep weèe neè mini-ñwáè, a ce naèa tu neè weèe. Weèe ce geèe ya ntee yi ce fúte. Ka' weèr yu njep ñgá' wa'a, m be kuè ce lu'shi lu'shi njo' weèe.
English: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

Limbum: Weèr aè m baè' aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè a lúshi ka', mluè mi ku bii neè weèr. Ñgá' aè konïì weèr aè mnjïì wááwá, beèe a ce káè' weèr msïì'si, weèr a ce wáp.
English: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

Limbum: Geewa'a, Nyúè aè m fa weèr ñger aèmboè e ke fa neè beèe ce a sáè. E m fa weèr ñger ca aè nfeè' ce Taitoès aè m vúè.
English: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

Limbum: Yi yu ená weèr aè m ku túr ñger ba njobeè' Taitoès aè m vúè ka, weèr m túr yi foñ njobeè' Taitoès aè m suñ weèr ená weèe aè m fa ye ñger. E m suñ weèr ená weèe ce koèñ aè ryá máè seê, a ker suñ máè ená weèe ce koosimnse aè yuu ce weèe aè m geèe. E m suñ weèr aèmboè weèe túr ntee aè rgeèe buu ce máè laèa. Máè ka' yu' buu ce e suñ anaè, a lu'shi neè weèe goèr seê.
English: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you, while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced still more.

Limbum: Weèe aè m ka' ba koosimnse njo' ñwaè' ce máè m sañ naè, yi bep máè ka'. Nyor aè m bep máè aè nfeè' entoèmbïì ce máè m yá ená ñwaè' anaè yi m geèe weèe aè koosimnse aè mú nfeè' moè'.
English: For though I made you sorry with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you sorry, though just for a while.

Limbum: Geewa'a, m ce lu'shi seè'ni, a ke' ce lu'shi njobeè' máè m geèe weèe aè koosïìmnse ka', m ce lu'shi njobeè' weèe aè m koosimnse wa'a, a kupse, a ma' yeè buu bbebep. Ñkoosimnse ce weèe aè m túr, yu njáèá ñkoosimnse ce Nyúè koèñ. Weèr aè m bepsi weèe bepsi ka' koo múcaèr.
English: I now rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you were made sorry to repentance. For you were made sorry in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' koosimnse aè njáèá njïì ce Nyúè koèñ, baná ñkoosimnse ca be geèe tá ñgaèñ kupse, ma' yïì buu bbebep, luèñ. AÈde' ñwáè señ buu ená e geèe yuu bebep aè njáèá njïì ce e ce koosimnse wa' ka'. Ñkoosimnse yïì beèe enjep ñgoèñ na e ke vúè ba neè rkwe.
English: For godly sorrow works repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world works death.

Limbum: Yá neè yuu ce njáèá ñkoosimnse ce Nyúè koèñ na aè geèe neè weèe. E geèe weèe aè lor buu tatap seê, a ka yeè njo. E geèe nyor aè bep weèe, weèe a ce báèáñger, a ce koèñ ená seèe ba cuâu mo'sir, ntee yi ce luèu weèe aè rgeèe buu bboèñboñ. E geèe weèe aè tamïì nyor aè rsa' ñwáè ce e geèe yuu bebep. Weèe aè duèñshi ená weèe túr bo njep yuu bebep anaè ka' koo múcaèr.
English: For behold, this same thing, that you were made sorry in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vengeance! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

Limbum: Máè m ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè weèe wa'a, a ke' ce sañ ba ená m ce sa' ñwáè ce e geèe yuu bebep, káè beèenjïì ñwáè ce a m geèe yuu bebep neè ye ka'. Máè m sañ tá weèe bo yá rara aè bsii Nyúè ená weèe aè fa weêe mnyor neè weèr neè mini- ñwáè.
English: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèe aè gee ntee yi fúteè weèr. Kyese aègee ntee ce yi m fúte weèr na, weèr aè m yu' rboèñ se aè ryá njáèá njïì ce Taitoès aè m ce lu'shi, njobeè' weèe aè m geèe yi ntee yi ke' ce bu' ka'.
English: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

Limbum: Máè m naèa tu neè Taitoès njo' weèe, weèe a ke' coosi máè ka'. AÈmboè yuu wááwá ce weèr aè m suñ weèe yi m ba mini naè, buu ce weèr ce naèa tu aègho neè Taitoès njo' weèe naè, aè yáátïì mini foñ.
English: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

Limbum: Taitoès ce kuushi aèmboè weèe wááwá aè m tami nyor aè ryu'nïì, ker ba njáèá njïì ce weèe aè m koni ye neè rwáp-ñwáè, cena yi gee e ker koñ weèe a caa aèmboè e m koèñ.
English: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

Limbum: M ce lu'shi njobeè' aède' m lá ntee njep weèe neè mini-ñwáè.
English: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèr ce koèñ ená weèe riñ yuu boèñboñ ce Nyúè aè m geèe bcor ce vi yu aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè vi geêe.
English: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia;

Limbum: Ñgá' ce woweèe a m yá, aè m moèoshi woweèe seê. Geewa'a woweèe a m ce lu'shi seê, a ba mmbo mtoo seê, ka' fuèp aè m koo woweèe se wa'a.
English: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their liberality.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ máná woweèe a m ku fa ba aèmboè aède' woweèe a m ba fa ka', woweèe a m fa a caa embo. AÈ m laèa ba ñwáè neè woweèe ená woweèe a fa wa' ka', aè m ku kwa'shi ba woweèe a fa wa'a.
English: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

Limbum: Woweèe a m loo weèr, a loo neè mini-ñwáè ená weèr gee yuu boèñboñ neè woweèe, fa woweèe njïì foñ tá a ja' beèe Nyúè ce a yu aè ñgá'.
English: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

Limbum: Yuu mo' ce weèr aè m ce kwaè'shi ená aède' yi ba ka', yi yu ená woweèe a m fa wap mnyor neè Tataê, a ker fa neè weèr foñ aèmboè Nyúè e koèñ.
English: This was not as we had hoped, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' yá wa'a, a loo Taitoès ce e m káè' rfaè' rjaè' ca ená e du neè rfaè' ca kuèntombïì, ja' weèe tá weèe misi rfaâ' rboèñboñ ce Nyúè aè fa weèe na.
English: So we urged Titus, that as he made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

Limbum: Weèe ce geèe buu wááwá boèñboñ. Weèe túr rbyemïì tatap. Weèe rïìñ aè rsuñ buu Nyúè, weèe túr bfee aè buu mini, weèe aè koèñ aè rjaè' beèe, weèe aè koèñ weèr. Baná weèr ce koèñ werná weèe gee rfaâ' rboèñboñ ca boèñboñ foñ.
English: But as you abound in everything, in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us, see that you also abound in this grace.

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a a ce fa ba rsa' ka'. M ce koèñ ba aè rfeè' le rkoèñnïì aè rkoèñnïì lïû beèe mo', tá m bo yá máná le rkoèñnïì anaè li yu mini lá.
English: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

Limbum: Kuushi neè njáèá ntee boèñboñ ce Tata Jisoès aè m túr. E m ba ñwáè bkuè', a lo a kúti ñwáè fuèp njo' weèe, tá yïì fuèp ca bo geèe tá weèe túr bkuè'.
English: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

Limbum: Cena yu ba yaè ncep ce m ce fa neè weèe aèmboè buu ca. Yi boèñ ená weèe misi yuu ce weèe aè m káè' ha' ñgaèani naè seè'ni na. Weèe aè m ba beèe entombïì, a ke' ku ba ba beèe entombïì aè rfa caè'caè' ka', weèe aè m ba beèe entombïì ce a m káè' a tami nyor aè rfa.
English: I give a judgment in this: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

Limbum: Baná weèe gee rfaè' ca misïî. Weèe gee li neè ntee boèñboñ aèmboè weèe aè m káè' neè ntee boèñboñ foñ naè. Geèe neè li neè yuu ce weèe aè túr.
English: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' túr ntee aè rfa, Nyúè be koo ba yuu ce ñwáè anaè túr, ke' ba ba yuu ce e buu ka'.
English: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don't have.

Limbum: M ce laèa ba ená weèe fa goèr seê, lo bá buu, tá beèe mo' a bo yu' rboèñ aègho ka'. M ce laèa ba ená beèe wááwá a túr yuu ce yi gháá woweèe, tá beèe wááwá a bo ba yáánïì, tá moè' buu yuu ka'.
English: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

Limbum: Weèe ja' beèe ce a buu yuu, neè ku' buu ce weèe túr seè'ni na, wee weèe aè ka' buu yuu, woweèe a túr, tá a bo jaè' weèe aègho foñ. Yi ba seè'ni ená ñwáè wááwá aè túr yuu ce e buu.
English: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack; that there may be equality.

Limbum: Yi yu aèmboè a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè ce e m kwáè' goèr aè m túr goèr se ka'. Ñwáè ce e m kwáè' múcaèr aè m túr múcaèr se ka'.”
English: As it is written, He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.

Limbum: M ce yoèñshi Nyúè ená e geèe Taitoès aè koñ aè rjaè' weèe aèmboè wer weèr foñ aè koèñ aè rjaè' naè.
English: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

Limbum: Taitoès aè m ku byemi ba yuu ce weèr aè m laèa neè ye ka', e koèñ aè rjaè' weèe seê, a kwa'shi seè'ni neè yi tu ená e be vúè yá weèe.
English: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

Limbum: Weèr ce tuu nfúr moè' ená e du a Taitoès. Nfúr ca túr rlii rboèñboñ aè bcor wááwá njo' blaâa Nyúè ce e ce feè'shi.
English: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known through all the assemblies.

Limbum: E yu ñwáè ce bcor wááwá a ce, a tuu ená weèr woweèe jár koo rfa ca. Cena yu rfaè' ce li be geèe tá beèe a ku'si Tata Nyúè, keèr rïìñ foñ ená weèr ce koèñ aè rjaè' bfúr wer.
English: Not only so, but who was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

Limbum: Weèr ce loèr nfeè' neè ku' rfa ca, faè dïì' beèe mo' a lo ce de'ñger kuèu rfa anaè ka'.
English: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

Limbum: Weèr ce gheèter aè rgeèe ba yuu ce yi yu boèñboñ aè bsii Tataê, ker ba aè bsii beèe foñ.
English: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

Limbum: Baná weèr ce tuu nfúr weèr moè' foñ ená e du a woweèe. Nfúr ca yu ñwáè ce weèr aè fyá' ye nfeè' aèñgoo seê, a yá ená e túr ntee aè rgeèe rfaè' Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá. E túr ntee aè rjaè' weèe seè'ni na seê, njobeè' e túr ntee njep weèe goèr seê.
English: We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè Taitoès, e yu ñwáè ce weèr ye ce faè' aèbee tá weèr bo jaè' weèe. AÈ ka' ba aèmboè bfúr mo' ce a woweèe a ce duè naè, woweèe a táá aètu bcor wááwá. Woweèe a be geèe tá beèe a nási Kraêis.
English: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

Limbum: Duèñshi neè neè beèe ca ená weèe aè koèñ woweèe neè mini-ñwáè. Weèe ka' gee wa'a, baná bcor wááwá a be yu', rïìñ ená naèatu ce weèr aè m naèa neè weèe naè, aè m ba naèatu mini.
English: Therefore show the proof of your love to them in front of the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

Limbum: Mbuèu moè' ker ba aègho neè má aè rsañ neè weèe kuu rfa ce weèe aè ba fa tá a bo jaè' beèe Nyúè aègho naè ka'.
English: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

Limbum: Máè rïìñ máná weèe aè tami nyor a ce lu'shi aè rjaè' woweèe. A mbuèu ce m ce naèa tu neè weèe aè bsii beèe Nyúâ aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè máná weèe ce beâe aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè aè m tami nyor aè rfa ká' ha' ñgaèani. Ye ntee ce weèe aè túr aè rfa yuu yi geèe beèe magoèr efa waâp mú a koñ aè rfa foñ.
English: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to them of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for a year past. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

Limbum: M ku ce koèñ aè rtuu bfúr ca neè weèe tá naèatu ce weèr ce naèa neè weèe naè bo bú aè cicïì ka'. M ce tuu woweèe tá weèe bo tami nyor aèmboè máè m laèa naè,
English: But I have sent the brothers that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

Limbum: njobeè' m ka' vú weèr beèe mo' e aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè, woweèe a vú yá ená weèe aè tami nyor ka', rïìtu yi koo weèr. Rïìtu yi ka' koo weèr, yi ba eká aèmboè weèe ce weèr aè láè ntee njep weèe.
English: so that I won't by any means, if there come with me any of Macedonia and find you unprepared, we to say nothing of you should be disappointed in this confident boasting.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce máè m kwaè'shi máná m loo bfúr ca tá woweèe a du entombïì yá weèe, tá a bo baashi rfa ce weèe aè m kaè'ni aè rfa na mbe dïû' mo'sir tá m ka' vúè. Weèe aè ka' gee wa'a, yi duñshïì ená weèe aè fa njobeè' weèe aè koèñ aè rfa ke' ba njobeè' a taèa weèe taèa ka'.
English: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you, and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

Limbum: Kuushi neè ená ñwáè ce e ka' bye múcaèr baná ñgaèñ be kep múcaèr, tá ñwáè ce e byeè goèr kep goèr.
English: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá fa aèmboè e kwaè'shi enjep yeâ ntee aè rfa. E fa, e fa ce de'ñger káè fa njobeè' a taèa ye taèa ka' njobeè' Nyúè koèñ ñwáè ce e ce fa neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè.
English: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart; not grudgingly, or under compulsion; for God loves a cheerful giver.

Limbum: Nyúè túr ñger aè rghoèni weèe goèr seê, tá weèe ke' buu yuu mo' aè nfeè' moè' ka', tá weèe bo loèr buu anaè geèe mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ aègho.
English: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

Limbum: Yi yu aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “E láè mi mmbo mtoo neè ñgaâa fuèp, yi ñgeâe boèñboñ yi ce kupse aè nfeè' moè' ka'.”
English: As it is written, He has scattered abroad, he has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e ke fa ñgúè buu neè ñwáè rbyeè, ker fa yuu ye, be fa weèe ku' ñgúè buu, geèe tá ye ñgeâe boèñboñ yi fa sá' goèr.
English: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;

Limbum: E be geèe tá weèe túr buu goèr aè nfeè' wááwá, ba mmbo mtoo a nfeè' wááwá tá beèe magoèr a bo yoèñshi Nyúè njo' le rfa ce woweèe a ce koo ese weèr.
English: you being enriched in everything to all liberality, which works through us thanksgiving to God.

Limbum: Rfaè' ce weèe ce geèe na li ce jaè' beèe Nyúè ce a buu yuu, a ker ce geèe beèe magoèr a ce yoèñshi Nyúè.
English: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through many givings of thanks to God;

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' gee njáèá rfaè' ca, baná weèe ce duèñshi beèe njáèá beèe ce weèe yu. Beèe a be yá, kuè'si Nyúè njobeè' weèe ku ce geèe ba buu ce weèe aè laèa aèmboè Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ kuu Jisos Kraêis.
English: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ, and for the liberality of your contribution to them and to all;

Limbum: A be yoèñshi ye foñ njobeè' weèe yu mmbo mtoo neè woweèe, ker ba neè beèe wááwá.
English: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

Limbum: Seâe yoèñshi Nyúè aè ku' li rfa ce aède' seèe túr cuèu aè rsuñ ka' naè.
English: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

Limbum: Máâ Poêl, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe. Beèe a ce laèa ená má ke ba a weâe mú ce wáp, e ba aè nfeè' m yu aèfo ka', m sañ ñwaè' tatap neè weèe. M ce loo neè weèe aè rlii Jisoès ce e túr rbonïì, a ba múnyañ ená,
English: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ; I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

Limbum: weèe fa geèe tá m lo laèa neè njeèndoñ ntatap neè weèe aè nfeè' ce máè vúè ka'. AÈde' m laa tatap ba neè beèe ce a ce laèa ená weèr ce geèe rfaè' tá weèr bo ye sá' enjo, aèmboè beèe enjep ñgoèñ a ke geèe naè.
English: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená weèr ce cu njep ñgoèñ na. Weèr ce cu njo wa'a, a ke' ce maè' bïìr ba aèmboè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ke maè' naè ka'.
English: For though we walk in the flesh, we don't wage war according to the flesh;

Limbum: Buu bïìr ce weèr ce maè' bïìr aègho yu ba buu bïìr enjep ñgoèñ na ka'. Weèr ce maè' ba neè buu bïìr vïû Nyúè ce vi túr ñger, a ce saè'si bdïì' ce yer ñgaâa bbaèa a cu.
English: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

Limbum: Weèr ce loèr buu bïìr ca ce siñsi bfee beèe enjep ñgoèñ na aègho, ker ba njáèá buu ce beèe a ce kwaè'shi, ce vi geèe woweèe a máñnïì bfee Nyúè. Weèr ce loèr vi ce so mkwaè'shïì beèe aègho tá woweèe a bo yu'ni neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;

Limbum: Weèe a ka' duñshi ená weèe aè yu'ni neè Jisos Kraâis neè ye ntee-ñwáè, weèr fa ñgá' neè beèe ce a teèe btu.
English: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience will be made full.

Limbum: Weèe ce fyá' buu ba efa mmïìr. Ñwáè moè' aè ka' ce loèr yi tu ená ku ba ye ñwáè yïì Jisos Kraêis, ñwáè anaè a ba kwaè'shi nfeè' baa, rïìñ ená wer weèr foñ yu beèe vi Jisos Kraêis.
English: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ's, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ's, so also we are Christ's.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce kwaè'shi ená m ce yu' nyor magoèr neè ñger ce Tata Jisos Kraâis aè fa weèr naè, baná aède' m koosïì rïìtu ka'. E fa máè ñger anaè tá m bo tapsi weèe aègho, ke' ba ba ená weèr sáási weèe aègho ka'.
English: For though I should boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down I will not be disappointed,

Limbum: Weèe fa kwaè'shi ená m ku ce wápsi weèe ba neè mñwaè' ce m ce sañ na caè'caè' ka'.
English: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

Limbum: Máè laèa wa'a njobeè' beèe a ce laèa ená mñwaè' ce m ce sañ neè weèe vi tap, a ce' seê, máâ ba fa weâe mú, yááti aèmboè ñwáè ce e goè'si, la rfeè'shïì li túr ñger ka'.
English: For, His letters, they say, are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a ba rïìñ ená buu ce weèr ce sañ neè weèe aè mñwaè' njo' weèr yu aèfo ka' naè vi yu jáá efa vïì ce weèr be geèe aè nfeè' ce weèr aè vúè a yá weèe naè ka'.
English: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

Limbum: AÈde' weèr ke laa nyúè moè' ená weèr yu aèmboè beèe ce a ce kwaè'shi ená a yu beâe bgoèrgoèr naè ka'. AÈde' weèr fe'nïì yer ñger aè yap ka'. Woweèe a ce feè'ni yap ñger fa waâp mú wa'a, baná woweèe a yu blúr.
English: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

Limbum: Weèr be naèa tu caa embe dïì' ce weèr aè ba naèa ka'. Weèr be naèa tu ba aè rfaè' ce Nyúè aè fa neè weèr. Rfaè' ce weèr ce geèe fa weâe mú yu mbeèp moè' efa rfaè' anaè.
English: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

Limbum: Weèr aè m naèti a jár seê, a vú a yá weèe a fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Jisos Kraâis neè weèe. AÈmboè wee yu mbeèp mo' efa ler rfaè' na, weèr aè ka' ce naèa tu neè weèe baná weèr ce naèa tu a caa embe dïì' ce weèr aè ba naèa ka'. Weèr aè m ka' tá baè faè' fa weâe mú ka', weèr aè m ba naèa tu caèa embo.
English: For we don't stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn't reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

Limbum: Weèr aè naèa tu a caa embe dïì' weèr aè ba naèa ka' njobeè' weèr aè naèa tu neè rfaè' ce beèe mo' a geèe ka'. Weèr ce kwaè'shi ba ená le rbyemïì li be kuè ce kuè' tá ler rfaè' ce weèr ce geèe fa weâe mú li ku' foñ seê.
English: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men's labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèr ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca aè bdïì' mo' foñ, ke' ce naèa tu aè rfaè' ce ñwáè moè' aè geèe fa yeâ ñkúè ka'.
English: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

Limbum: Yi ba enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' ce naèa tu, e naa ba aè yuu ce Tata aè geèe.”
English: But he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.

Limbum: Yu ba ñwáè ce e ce laèa ená e yu yáánïì ce aède' e ba yáánïì ghup aè bsii Tata ka'. Ñwáè ce e yu yáánïì aè bsii Tata yu ñwáè ce Tata rïìñ ená e yu yáánïì.
English: For it isn't he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

Limbum: M be loo aè rlaèa mú laèa blúr. Baná weèe ku fa mú nfeè' moè' yu'shi blaèa anaè.
English: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

Limbum: M ce ko'ndoñ neè weèe neè njáèá ñko'ndoñ ce Nyúè túr. Weèe yu aèmboè muunje ce e be riñ mbañruèñwáè ka', máè kanïì máná m be guèusi ye neè mbañruèñwáè moè'sir caè'caè'. Mbañruèñwáè ca yu Jisos Kraêis.
English: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu wa' na, m ce wáp máná Sataèn be jepsi btu ese weèe aèmboè e m loèr vi bkwáèá a bo' Ef aègho naè, tá weèe ker láè ntee njep Jisos Kraêis, fa wee mnyor neè ye ka'.
English: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a njobeè' máè yá máná ñwáè moè' aè ka' vú fe'shi aèmboè Jisoès moè' caa efa yïì ce weèr aè m feè'shi naè, weèe ku byemi. Ñwáè moè' ka' laa aèmboè yú' mo' ce yu yú' jáá, weèe ku byemi. Ñwáè moè' ka' fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ moè' ce e yu jáá efa yïì ce weèr aè m feè'shi aèmboè Jisos Kraâis naè, weèe ku byemi, koo buu ca wááwá mmbo mmbaa.
English: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you did not receive, or a different good news, which you did not accept, you put up with that well enough.

Limbum: Weèe ce loèr beèe ce a loèr wap btu ená a yu ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès naè aè beèe ce a yuu jáá. Weèe aè ka' fe'ni máè weèr woweèe m kwa'shïì máná aède' m ba mbaè njïì ka'.
English: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

Limbum: M ka' tá rïìñ aè rlaèa yuu ka', m máñnïì yuu Nyúè ka'. Weèr aè geèe ca yi ba rara neè weèe aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá.
English: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce máè m ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè weèe, máè m bipshi blaè' efa gho ka'. Máè m suèusi yaè nyor njep nsheè tá m bo naèa weèe mbekïì. Waè' máè m geèe wa'a, aè ba ba yuu bebep a?
English: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God's Good News free of charge?

Limbum: Máè m ce faè' neè weèe, bcor mo' efaè jáá vi ce laè' máè. Baná máè m ce yáèá ese bcor anaè tá m bo jaè' weèe.
English: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená aè m ba aè nfeè' seèe aè m ce cu naè, máè m ka' ba buu yuu, m ke' ba ntáèr neè ñwáè moè' ka'. Beèe ce a m vúè embe cor aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè a m fa máè buu ce máè m túr ka'. Máè m laèa máná weèe la' máè ka', m be keè laèa máná weèe la' máè ka', faè dïì' m bo ba ntáèr neè weèe ka'.
English: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn't a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

Limbum: M ce laèa mini aèmboè ñwáè Jisos Kraâis ená aède' ñwáè moè' ce aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè jepsïì máè faè dïì' m yu' nyor aè yuu ce máè geèe na ka'.
English: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

Limbum: Waè' m ce geèe wa'a njobeè' m koèñ weèe ka' a? Nyúè rïìñ ená m koèñ weèe.
English: Why? Because I don't love you? God knows.

Limbum: M be kuè ce geèe yuu ce m ce geèe seè'ni na, faè dïì' beèe ce a ce koèñ aè ryu' nyor ená lap rfaè' li ku ba aèmboè ler naè a bo túr njïì moè' aè ryu' ka'.
English: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion, that in which they boast, they may be found even as we.

Limbum: Woweèe a yu ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès ce mini ka'. Woweèe a yu ñgaâa ñkuèprïì ce a ce yááti foñ aèmboè ñgaâa ntuu Jisos Kraêis.
English: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ's apostles.

Limbum: Ca yu yuu báèá ka', njobeè' Sataèn ye ye e ke loè yááti aèmboè ncïìndap Nyúè ce e yu ñwáè rraa.
English: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

Limbum: Yi ñgaâa mfaè' a ka' yááti foñ ba aèmboè beèe ce a ke faè' aè ryá ená beèe a geèe ñgeâe yáánïì naè, ker ba yuu báèá ka'. Yaèp ñgá' be loè kuè ba aèmboè map mfaè' mi m ba.
English: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

Limbum: M ker ce laèa ená ñwáè moè' fa kwaè'shi ená m yu lúr ka'. Weèe ka' ce kwaè'shi ená m yu lúr, weèe ku ma'shi tá m laa nlaâa nyu' nyor aèmboè aède' lúr laêa.
English: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa na, aè laèa Tata ená m laa ka'. M ka' ce yu' nyor, m ce laèa ba aèmboè lúr.
English: That which I speak, I don't speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

Limbum: AÈmboè beèe magoèr a ce yu' nyor neè buu enjep ñgoèñ na, baná má máè be yu' nyor foñ.
English: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

Limbum: Weèe aè laèa ená weèe yu ñgaâa bfee seê, a ku ce byemi yuu ce blúr a ce geèe naè neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè.
English: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

Limbum: Weèe aè maè'shi ená beèe a gee weèe aè wap bkwaèa, sop sá' efa weèe, nyúè' weèe, ko' weèe neè mkuèu mbe tuè, lip weèe neè mmbo nje mmïìr.
English: For you bear with a man, if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, if he strikes you on the face.

Limbum: Rïìtu yi ce koo máè ená weèr aè m ba yer bgoè'sïì, a gee buu ca neè weèe ka'. Koosi neè mnse neè weèr aè buu ce weèr aè m geèe ka'. Ñwáè aè ka' túr yuu ce aède' e lip ñguèñ aègho, baná má máè túr yuu anaè foñ. M be lïìp ñguèñ aègho. M ku bii ce laèa aèmboè lúr.
English: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet however any is bold I speak in foolishness, I am bold also.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ba beèe Hibruès, baná m yu moè' foñ. Woweèe a ka' ba' beèe Isráèl, baná m yu moè' foñ. Woweèe a ka' ba beèe embe ndúè' Abraèhaêm, baná m yu moè' foñ.
English: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? So am I.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ba ñgaâa mfaè' neè Jisos Kraêis, baná máè gha' woweèe. M ce laèa seè'ni aèmboè ñgaèabaa wa'a. Máè faè' a caa woweèe, a du shañ a caa woweèe, beèe a lïìp máè a caa woweèe, rkwe li rúèú máè a nfyeènyú nfeè' aèñgoo.
English: Are they servants of Christ? I speak as one beside himself I am more so; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths often.

Limbum: Jus a m lïìp máè neè ñgwaèa ce woweèe a ke lïìp beèe aègho ñkaèraè' ncoèp- búè'ú-aè-mntaar naè, nfeè' taê.
English: Five times from the Jews I received forty stripes minus one.

Limbum: Beèe enje jáá a m lïìp máè neè mmbaèñ nfeè' taar, beèe a túúshïì máè neè bluèr nfeè' moè'sir. Weèr aè ka' ce jáèr njep mdip mñgoèrñgoèr mbe bkeñ bgoèrgoèr, bkeñ anaè vi bep neè weèr, a coo njep roè nfeè' taar. Máè m cu njep rdip rgoèr káâ' aèñgaèptú' du ba' aèñgaèptú' moè'.
English: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

Limbum: Máè m jáèr seê. Mdip mi sáni loèr máè, byáèá a fa máè ñgá', yaè beèe efa máâ to' a fa máè ñgá', beèe enje jáá a fa máè ñgá'. Máè m yá ñgá' aè múè la', a yá ñgá' aè rïìñ, a yá ñgá' njep rdip rgoèr, a ker yá ñgá' mbe mmbo beèe ce a bo' beèe ená a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì naè.
English: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

Limbum: Máè faè' a tee rlïì', a sáê, mmirlo mi gaa máè mnoèñ aèñgoo. Njeè aè yañ máè, ntee yi yuushïì, máè konïì yuu ye ka' nfeè' aèñgoo. Mbáp aè m fúte máè, máè túr yuu yar foñ ka'.
English: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

Limbum: Kyese aègee buu ca wááwá, ya ntáèr yu mkwaè'shïì ce m ce kwaè'shi aèmboè bcor wááwá aè mnoèñ wááwá.
English: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily, anxiety for all the assemblies.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ba goè'sïì aè buu Nyúè, máâ kwaè'shi aèmboè ye, ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e goè'sïì wa'a foñ. Ñwáè aè ka' gee yuu bebep, mluè mi koo máè seê.
English: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don't burn with indignation?

Limbum: Ka' ba ená m yu' nyor baná m be yu' nyor ba aè buu ce vi duèñshi wa bgoè'sïì.
English: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e yu Taèr neè Tata Jisos Kraêis, aè ba ye ce beèe a be ce yoèñshi aè nfeè' sïìp, rïìñ ená m ce nya' mnde' ka'.
English: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forevermore, knows that I don't lie.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè rla' Daèmaskoès ñwáâ ñgoèr ce e m ce faè' njeptii AÈrátaè aè laa bsoogáè a sir rla' Daèmaskoès tá a bo koo máè.
English: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the city of the Damascenes desiring to arrest me.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, beèe mo' a fa máè njep ñkaèa, a torsi njïû aè wenduè a suusi njepmbeè, máè cañ a duê.
English: Through a window I was let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.

Limbum: M be kuè ce yu' nyor, ka' sá' moè' yu njo ka' wa'a. M be ce yu' nyor seè'ni ce suñ beèe ba buu ce Tata Jisos Kraâis aè m suñ máè aè njáèá mlo mo' ker ba vïì ce e múè' ma mmir máè yáê.
English: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ ñwáè Jisos Kraâis moè' ce a m loèr ye a du aègho mbe laèlaè rbuu. Káè ñwáè anaè aè m duè ba neè yïì nyor áè, káè e m duè ba neè yïì nyor ka' áè, m rïìñ ka'. Ñwáè ce e rïìñ ku ba Nyúè caè'caè'. Yu seè'ni bfeè' ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-rrúèú aèmboè ca yi m koni.
English: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago whether in the body, I don't know, or whether out of the body, I don't know; God knows, such a one caught up into the third heaven.

Limbum: M rïìñ máná a m loèr mbañruèñwáè anaè a du aègho aè ñgoâñ Paraèdaêis. Káè e m duè neè yïì nyor áè, ká e m duè aègho ka' áè, m rïìñ ka'. Ñwáè ce e rïìñ ku ba Nyúè caè'caè'.
English: I know such a man whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don't know; God knows,

Limbum: E ka' baè' mbo a yu' buu ce aède' e suñ ka'. Nyúè aè maè'shi ená ñwáè suñ buu anaè neè beèe ka'.
English: how he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

Limbum: M be yu' nyor neè njáèá ñwáè ca, ke' ba ba neè yaè nyor ka'. Yuu ce aède' m yu' nyor aègho neè yaè nyor ku ba wa bgoè'sïì caè'caè'.
English: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

Limbum: M ka' ba ce kwaè'shi aè ryu' nyor, m ba lúr ka', njobeè' m be kuè ce laèa ba yuu ce yi yu mini. Ka' yi yu wa'a, m be yu' nyor ka' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo kwaè'shi aèmboè máè caèa buu ce m ce geèe, ker ba vïì ce m ce laèa na ka'.
English: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me, or hears from me.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ce koèñ ená m naatu neè ku' buu bbáèá ce e m múè' ma mmir máè yá naè ka'. E m fa máè yuu mo' nje nyoèr, yi ba aèmboè msini wa'a, aè ba yuu ce aè m tuusi Sataèn. Yuu anaè yi m ce yañ máè tá m bo ce naèa tu ka'.
English: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

Limbum: Máè m loo neè Tata nfeè' taar máná e fúr máè yuu anaè enje nyoèr.
English: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

Limbum: Máè ka' loo wa'a, Tata aè beesïì enáê, “Ya ñger ce máè fa neè wáè yi ghááte yi ba aè rjaè' wáè tá aè cu neè yuu anaè nje nyoèr. Ya ñger yi ce yááti boèñboñ ba njep ñwáè ce e goè'si.” Baná m be yu' nyor neè wa bgoè'sïì neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè tá ñger Jisos Kraâis yi bo ba mbe máâ nduè.
English: He has said to me, My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce máè byemi buu ca. Káè bgoè'sïì áè, káè mcáp áè, káè bjep ce vi vúè neè máè áè, káè yu buu ce vi tap neè máè áè, káè yu ñgá' áè, máè byemi buu ca wááwá njo' Jisos Kraêis, a ce bu' ka'. Máè byemi wa'a njobeè' e ke ba aè nfeè' ce m goè'si, m ka' túr ñger.
English: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè weèe aèmboè lúr wa'a, aè gee ba weèe máè ka' ce laèa wa'a. Yi yu ená weèe aè ba ce yu' nyor neè máè njobeè' a ka' ba ce feè'ni máè weèr beèe ce a loèr wap btu aèmboè ñgaâa ntuu Jisos Kraâis ce a yu yap jáá naè, m ba ba mbe waâp njïì ka', ka' m yu yuu cicïì wa'a.
English: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for in nothing was I inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

Limbum: Máè m geèe buu bghagha' ce vi ke duèñshi ená ñwáè yu ñwáè ntuu Jisoès naè a weâe mú, a ke' borni aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
English: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all patience, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

Limbum: Yuu ce máè m geèe neè bcor mo' a ke' gee neè weèe ka', yu ká? Yuu ce máè m geèe neè weèe ka' ku ba ba ená máè m ba ntáèr neè weèe ka'. Máè geèe faèa. Foèosi neè máè.
English: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.

Limbum: Máè tami nyor aè rvúè caè'ni weèe. M ka' vú ca'ni weèe baná máè caè'ni weèe seè'ni nfeè' taar. M be vúè tá m ba ntáèr neè weèe ka' njobeè' yuu ce m ce roèo yu ba yeè buu ka', m ce roèo ba weèe. Yi yu ená boo a fyá' aè wap mma ba wap bta ka'. Yi yu ba ená mma ba btaèr a fyá' aè boo wap.
English: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

Limbum: Baná m be bepsi yaè buu wááwá njo' weèe, fa yaè nyor foñ neè weèe neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè. M ka' koñ weèe goèr aèmboè m koèñ naè, weèe koñ ye máè múcaèr a?
English: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

Limbum: Weèe ce laèa weenáê, “Yi yu mini ená e ke vúè ba ntáèr neè weèr ka'. Yi ku ba ba ená e yu kwáèá. Weèr rïìñ ená e ye sá' efa weèr aè mú mnjïì mo'.”
English: But be it so, I did not myself burden you. But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.

Limbum: Ca yu ba njáèá ká? Waè' beèe ce máè m tuu máná a vú yá weèe naè, a m vúè wa'a ená m bo bo' weèe koshi buu ese weèe a?
English: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of them whom I have sent to you?

Limbum: Máè m bu' mmbo neè Taitoès ená e vú yá weèe, a laa neè nfúr moè' ená e du a ye. Waè' Taitoès aè m bo' weèe a koshi buu ese weèe a? Weèr Taitoès ku ba ñwáè moè'sir, a ce geèe yeèr buu neè ntee e mo'sir.
English: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn't we walk in the same spirit? Didn't we walk in the same steps?

Limbum: Seemoè' weèe ce kwaè'shi ená weèr ce laèa ená weèr yu ñgaâa ntuu Jisos Kraâis wa'a, a ce tá'shi ba yer tu. Yi yu wa' ka'. Weèr ce laèa buu ca ba aè bsii Nyúè aèmboè beèe Jisos Kraêis. Bkar waê, buu ce weèr ce geèe na, weèr ce geèe vi wááwá tá weèe bo táá tatap njep Jisos Kraêis.
English: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

Limbum: M ce wáp máná m be vúè yá weèe, tá weèe ba jáá efa yuu ce m ce kwaè'shi, tá má máè ba jáá efa yuu ce weèe ce kwaè'shi. M ce wáp máná m be vúè baè' tá mlap ba ñko'ndoñ ba mshentee ba ñgaèpni ba mbepsi beèe, ba mnsa'ni, ba naèanyor ker ba bjep vi ba fa weâe mú.
English: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don't desire; that by any means there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots;

Limbum: M ce wáp máná m be vúè, tá Nyúè gee tá rïìtu yi koo máè fa weâe bsii, tá nyor bep máè, tá m war njo' beèe ce cu rcu rrara ka', a kupse ka' naè. M be war njobeè' woweèe a ce saèki, a kúti aè bbáp.
English: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness which they committed.

Limbum: M ka' vú ca'ni weèe baná a nfeè' taar seè'ni aèmboè máè caè'ni weèe. Kuushi neè enáê, “A ka' vú neè mnsa' ená ñwáè aè geèe yuu bebep, baná a be sa' mnsa' anaè ce beèe a mmbaa káè beèe a mntaar áè, a ka' táá njïìnsa' ená ñgaèñ aè geèe faèa anaè ghup.”
English: This is the third time I am coming to you. At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

Limbum: Máè m báá weèe mbe nfeè' ce máè m ker vú a ca'ni weèe naè, a ker ce báá weèe seè'ni na tá nfeè' ce m be keèr vúè caè'ni weèe ka' gháá. M ce laèa neè beèe ce a geèe buu bbebep naè ker ba bár beèe ená m be vúè tá m koosimnse neè woweèe ka'.
English: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;

Limbum: Baná weèe be rïìñ ená ya nlaèa yi loè ese Jisos Kraêis. Jisoès Kraâis ye ye ghashi weèe neè mmbo ce mi yu mwáèni ka', e ce faè' a weâe mú neè ñger-ñwáè.
English: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená e m goè'si aè nfeè' ce a m taa ye mbe kïìntaa. Geewa'a, e cu nteèe seè'ni aè ñger Nyúè. AÈmboè weèr yu bgoè'sïì foñ aèmboè Jisos Kraâis aè m ba naè, baná weèr be cu bteèe foñ weèr Jisos Kraâis weèe aè ñger Nyúè, a ce faè' neè weèe neè ñger-ñwáè.
English: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

Limbum: Fyá' neè wee mnyor yá ka ená weèe ce cu ba rcu ñgaâa rbyemïì a ba cu lá? Moèoshi neè weêe mnyor. Mboè weèe aè rïìñ weená Jisos Kraâis yu njep weèe, ce weèe ka' tá gweè rmoèoshïì ka' a?
English: Test your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don't you know as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?--unless indeed you are disqualified.

Limbum: M ce kwaè'shi máná weèe be loè yá ená weèr aè gweè rmoèoshïì ka'.
English: But I hope that you will know that we aren't disqualified.

Limbum: Yuu ce weèr ce loo neè Nyúè yi yu ená weèe fa geèe yuu bebep ka'. Weèr ce loo wa'a, a ke' ce loo tá beèe a bo yá ená weèr aè so ka'. Weèr ce loo ba ená weèe gee yuu ce yi yu yáánïì, ka' yi ce yááti aèmboè weèr aè lá gweè wa'a.
English: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we are as reprobate.

Limbum: Yi yu ená aède' weèr gee yuu mo' ce aèbaè yi jepsïì yuu mini ka'. Weèr be kuè geèe ba yuu ce yi be geèe tá mini du ba entoèmbïì.
English: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' ba bgoè'sïì, weèe ba btatap, nyor boñ weèr seê. Weèr ku ce loo neè Nyúè ba ená weèe kupse, ba yáánïì.
English: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. And this we also pray for, even your perfecting.

Limbum: Baná a mbuèu ce m ce sañ buu ca neè weèe ka' loè vúè caè'ni weèe. M ce sañ wa'a faè dïì' m bo loèr ñger ce Tata Nyúè aè fa máè, ghashi weèe ba neè mmbo mtatap aè nfeè' ce m ka' vú ka'. Nyúè aè m fa máè ñger anaè tá m bo tapsi weèe aègho, ke' ba ba ená m sáási weèe aègho ka'.
English: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for tearing down.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce mïìsi ya ñwaè' ca a ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe cu boèñboñ. Gheèter neè kupse, ba yáánïì. Yu' neè yuu ce m ce laèa. Túr neè ntee e mo'sir, cu neè neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè. Weèe aè ka' gee wa'a, Nyúè ce rkoèñnïì li ke loè ese ye, cumúnyañ lo ese ye foñ naè ba weèe woweèe.
English: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè bfúr wee, baa woweèe nje nyoèr aè rlii Jisoès.
English: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

Limbum: Beèe Nyúè wááwá a caè'ni weèe.
English: All the saints greet you.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Jisos Kraâis túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, tá Nyúè koñ weèe, tá Yú' Rara yi gee weèe ba aèbee.
English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pol ce m yu ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. AÈ m ce ñwáè a ce máè ená m gee rfaè' ca ka'. Máè m koo ñger ese ñwáè moè' aè rgeèe rfaè' ca foñ ka'. AÈ m ce ba Jisos Kraâis ba Taèr Nyúè ce e m fúr Jisoès efa rkwe.
English: Paul, an apostle not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead,

Limbum: Weèr bfúr wááwá ce a yu aèfa aè caè'ni bcor ce vi yu aè ñgoâñ Gaèláshaè.
English: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

Limbum: Tá Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, ba Tata Jisos Kraêis, túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ ker fa wee cumúnyañ.
English: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis aè m fa yïì nyor a seâe tuè, tá Nyúè bo foèosi seèe efa yïìseèe buu bbebep, tee seèe efa ñgeâe bbebep enjep ñgoèñ na. E m geèe ba yuu ce Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Ta aè m koèñ ená yi ba.
English: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father--

Limbum: Tá beèe a ku'si Nyúè aè nfeè' bsïìp. Yi yu wa'a.
English: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Máè yu' yuu ce weèe ce geèe, a bááñger seê. Nyúè aè m ká' weèe ená weèe ba yïì beèe njo' yuu boèñboñ ce Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe neè weèe. Ka' Nyúè aè m geèe wa'a, weèe aè beesïì njïì neè ye cárcár seê, a ce duè ba aèmbuèu nsuñ moè' ce weèe ce kwaè'shi ená a nsuñ mboèñmboñ.
English: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different good news;

Limbum: Nsuñ mboèñmboñ moè' ce e yu mini ker ba aègho caa efa yïì máè m suñ weèe naè ka'. Beèe mo' a ce jepsi weèe, a ce koèñ ená a ba kupse nsuñ mboèñmboñ ce e yu aèmboè Jisos Kraêis.
English: and there isn't another good news. Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ka' ker fe'shi nsuñ mboèñmboñ moè' ce e yu jáá efa yïì ce weèr aè m feè'shi neè weèe naè, ndoèo co' ye. Ka' aè ba fe'shi ba weèr áè, káè ncïìndap Nyúè embe buèu áè, ndoèo co' ñgaèñ.
English: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any good news other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe ba yuu ce weèr aè m suñ weèe naè. Ñwáè moè' aè ka' ker fe'shi nsuñ mboèñmboñ moè' ce e yu jáá efa yïì ce weèr aè m feè'shi neè weèe, weèe aè yu' a byemi naè, ndoèo co' ye.
English: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any good news other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

Limbum: Waè' m ce laèa buu ca tá beèe a bo koèñ máè, káè yu' rboèñ neè yuu ce m ce laèa a? Yi yu wa' ka'. M ce koèñ máná yu' ba Nyúè yu' rboèñ neè máè. Máè m ba ce koèñ máná yu' ba beèe yu' rboèñ neè máè, máè m ba ba ñwáè rfaè' neè Jisos Kraâis ka'.
English: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn't be a servant of Christ.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce koèñ ená weèe riñ boèñboñ ená nsuñ mboèñmboñ ce máè m feè'shi neè weèe naè aè m ba nsuñ ñwáè ka'.
English: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

Limbum: Máè m yu' nsuñ ca ba ekuèè cuèu ñwáè ka'. AÈ m yá'ni ñwáè a yá'ni máè nsuñ ca ka'. Yu ba Jisos Kraâis ce e m geèe máè riñ buu ca.
English: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ aèmboè ya ñgeèe yi m ba aè nfeè' ce máè m ce geèe ba ndeèe Jus naè. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè máè ce fa ñgá' neè ñgaâa cor seê. Máè m ce koèñ máná cor ba aègho ka'.
English: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.

Limbum: Máè m caèa beèe magoèr seê, efa múè yaè waè', aè njáèá njïì ce máè m ce geèe ndeèe Juês. Máè m túr ntee luèulu njep ndeèe wa btarkú seê.
English: I advanced in the Jews' religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

Limbum: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Nyúè aè m túr ntee boèñboñ neè máè, a ce máè tá yaè ma ka' keè bi máè.
English: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me through his grace,

Limbum: Nfeè' aè ka' gháá, e gee máè riñ muu yïì tá m bo suñ beèe enje jáá aèmboè muu yïì anaè. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè máè ke' cu máná ñwáè moè' suñ máè yuu ce m gee ka'.
English: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn't immediately confer with flesh and blood,

Limbum: Máè m duè aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm tá m bo yá beèe ce a m ba ñgaâa ntuu neè Jisoès entombïì neè máè naè ka'. Máè m naèti cárcár seê, a du aè ñgoâñ AÈrábïìyaè, a ka' loâ aèfo a ku kúti ba aè rla' Daèmaskoès.
English: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

Limbum: Bfeè' vi ka' caâa btaar, máè du aè rlaè' Jáèrusaláèm tá m bo lááte weèr Pitaè. Máè m cu weèr ye aè mnoèñ ncoèp-ta-aè-rrúèú.
English: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

Limbum: Máè m ker yá ñwáè ntuu moè' efa múè ñgaâa ntuu entombïì naè ka'. Máè m ku yá ba Jáms ce e yu nfúr Tata Jisoès.
English: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord's brother.

Limbum: Buu ce m ce sañ na vi yu mini. Nyúè rïìñ ená m ce nya' ba mnde' ka'.
English: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I'm not lying.

Limbum: Máè ka' loâ aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm a du aè bdïì' mo' aè ñgoâñ Sirïìyaè ba aè ñgoâñ Sïìlesïìyaè.
English: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè bcor Jisos Kraâis ce vi m ba aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, a be riñ máè ka'.
English: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

Limbum: Woweèe a m ku yu' ba buu ce beèe a m ce laèa aèmboè máè. Beèe a m ce laèa enáê, “Ñwáè ce e m ce fa ñgá' neè seèe naè ce feè'shi seè'ni ba aèmboè rbyemïû neè Jisos Kraêis, ce e m ce koèñ ená li ba ka' naè.”
English: but they only heard: He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce ku'si rlii Nyúè njo' máè.
English: And they glorified God in me.

Limbum: Bfeè' vi ka' caèa ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-rrúèú, máè ker du aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm weèr Baènabaès. Máè m loèr Taitoès, weèr woweèe aè duê.
English: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

Limbum: Máè m duè njobeè' Nyúè aè m laèa neè máè ená m duê. Máè ka' duè baè', a suñ woweèe yuu ce máè m ce feè'shi neè beèe enje jáá. Máè m ku suñ ba beèe ce a m ba btu embe cor caè'caè'. Máè m suñ woweèe faè dïì' rfaè' ce máè m geèe ker ba lïì ce m ce geèe seè'ni, mi bo bú aè cicïì ka'.
English: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

Limbum: Woweèe a byemïì yuu ce máè m suñ woweèe anaè. Ka' Taitoès ce weèr woweèe aè m vúè naè aè m ba ñwáâ aè to' Greâs wa'a, a m taèa ye ená e geèe búè ka'.
English: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

Limbum: A m seèesi yuu a kuu búè ba njo' beèe mo' ce a m ce bo'shi ená a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì. Beèe anaè a m la' kuèu a vú a weâr mú tá a bo yá ka njáèá njïì ce weèr ce geèe buu waèrwaèr njobeè' weèr Jisoès weèe yu aèbee naè. Woweèe a m koèñ ená mncir Jus vi kur weèr.
English: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

Limbum: Weèr aè m fa njïì neè woweèe koo múcaèr ka', faè dïì' a kupse nsuñ mboèñmboñ ca, jepsi weèe ka'.
English: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè beèe ce a m ce aè btu embe cor naè, woweèe a m ker kyese yuu mo' mbenduè blaèa ce máè m ce feè'shi ka'. Ka' beèe ca a m ba btu wa'a, máè m loèr yap nta' anaè aè yuu goèr ka', njobeè' beèe wááwá a yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: But from those who were reputed to be important whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn't show partiality to man--they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

Limbum: Woweèe a m yá yap ená blaèa ce máè m ce feè'shi anaè aè m fa Nyúè a fa neè máè neè mini-ñwáè. A m yá ená Nyúè aè m tuu máè ená m du fe'shi blaèa ca neè beèe enje jáá, aèmboè Nyúè aè m fa blaèa ca foñ neè Pitaè ená e du fe'shi yi ba neè Jus naè.
English: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcision, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcision

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m fa Pitaè ñger ená e gee rfaè' ca neè Jus aè m ku ba ñwáè ce e m fa máè ñger foñ ená m gee rfaè' ca neè beèe enje jáá.
English: for he who appointed Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision appointed me also to the Gentiles;

Limbum: Jáms ba Pitaè ba Joân ce a m ba aèmboè btu btatap embe coêr, a ka' yá ená Nyúè aè fa máè njáèá rfaè' ca ghup, weèr woweèe ba Baènabaès aè fanïì mmbo aè rduèñshi ená weèr ce faè' aèbee. Weèr woweèe aè m byemi aèbee ená weèr Baènabaès du fe'shi yer ba neè beèe enje jáá, tá woweèe a fe'shi yap ba neè Juês.
