English: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ku fa weèr ncep ba aè yuu mo'sir caè'caè'. Woweèe a m laèa ená weèr fa leèse efa rjaè' ñgaâa fuèp ka'. Woweèe a m ku laa ba yuu ce máè m ce koèñ aè rgeèe seê.
English: They only asked us to remember the poor--which very thing I was also zealous to do.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce Pitaè aè m vúè aè rla' Antïìyoèk, máè lapnïì ye aè múè beèe njobeè' e m geèe faèa.
English: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

Limbum: Pitaè aè m káè' a ce ye byee a beèe enje jáá weèe. Jáms aè ka' tuu Jus mo' ená a vú yá Pitaè, Pitaè aè bornïì efa rye byee a beèe enje jáá caè, a fúr yïì nyor efa múè woweèe. E m geèe wa'a njobeè' e m ce wáp Jus mo' ce a m ce laèa ená ñwáè aè ka' tá geèe búè ka', ñgaèñ ba ñwáè rbyemïì ka'.
English: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

Limbum: Jus ce a m ce cu aè rla' Antïìyoèk a ba ñgaâa rbyemïì foñ naè, a m koni ñgeâe cicïì ce Pitaè aè m ce geèe naè. Baènabaès ye ye aè m loè a ce geèe njáèá yap ñgeèe anaè.
English: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

Limbum: Máè ka' yá máná woweèe a ce geèe ba yuu jáá efa yuu ce nsuñ mboèñmboñ ce laèa, máè laa neè Pitaè aè bsii beèe wááwá enáê, “AÈ yu ñwáè Juês, a ce cu aèmboè beèe enje jáá a ce cu naè. Wáè ka' ce taèa beèe enje jáá ená a geèe ba ndeèe Jus njoká?”
English: But when I saw that they didn't walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèr ce weèr yu Jus seese naè, weèr yu aèmboè beèe enje jáá ce a ke láè yap yu mncir Nyúè ka' naè ka'.
English: We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,

Limbum: Beâe aè ñgoâñ Gaèláshaè, weèe yu blúr a? Ñwáè ce e roè' weèe aè roè' nda? Mboè weèr aè m suñ weèe mbuèu efa rkwe Jisos Kraâis embe kïìntaa rara se a?
English: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth among you as crucified?

Limbum: Kuè suñ neè máè ba yuu mo'sir. Yú' Rara yi m niñ njep weâe mntee njo' mncir ce weèe aè m ce láè, káè njo' blaâa Nyúè ce weèe aè m yu' a byemi?
English: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

Limbum: Weèe aè m káè' neè Yú' Nyúè, a ce taè' mïìsi ba aè ye ñger njoká? Weèe yu blúr wa' njoká?
English: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

Limbum: Waè' ku' buu ce Yú' anaè yi geèe weèe aè riñ na vi ku bú aè cicïì a? M ce kwaè'shi wa' ka'.
English: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

Limbum: Weèe aè yá aèmboè Nyúè aè fa weèe yi Yú', a ker ce geèe buu bbáèá a weâe mú njïì enjep Yú' anaè. Nyúè ce geèe buu ca njobeè' weèe ce láè mncir, káè njobeè' weèe aè yu' nsuñ mboèñmboñ, a byemi?
English: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

Limbum: Kwaè'shi ka neè aèmboè Abraèhaêm. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Abraèham aè m byemi yuu ce Nyúè aè m laèa, li rbyemïì anaè li gee e ba ñwáâ nyáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.”
English: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.

Limbum: Baná weèe riñ ená beèe ce a byemi neè Nyúè a beèe ce a yu boo Abraèhaêm.
English: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.

Limbum: A m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená Nyúè be keè geèe tá beèe enje jáá a ba byáánïì a yeâ bsii njobeè' woweèe a byemi neè ye. A m sañ eluâuñgoèñ aèmboè Nyúè aè m feè'shi nsuñ mboèñmboñ neè Abraèhaêm. E m laèa neè ye enáê, “M be ghoèni bto' enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá njo' wáè.”
English: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, In you all the nations will be blessed.

Limbum: Baná aèmboè Nyúè aè m ghoèni Abraèham njobeè' e m byemi neè ye naè, e be ghoèni beèe wááwá ce a byemi neè ye foñ.
English: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè beèe ce a foèosi ba neè mncir naè, ndoèo yu mbe waâp tuè, njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' tá yu'ni neè mncir wááwá ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' mncir ka', baná ndoèo aè co' ye.”
English: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, Cursed is everyone who doesn't continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená aède' mncir vi gee ñwáè e ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ka', njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè ce e yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njobeè' e byemi neè ye, ñgaèñ be luèñ.”
English: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, The righteous will live by faith.

Limbum: Mncir vi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè rbyemïì ka'. Mncir vi laèa yi ená ñwáè yu'ni neè vi yu'ni. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè aè ka' lá mncir wááwá, ñgaèñ ka' koni ryoèñ.”
English: The law is not of faith, but, The man who does them will live by them.

Limbum: Ndoèo aè co' seèe wááwá njobeè' seèe aè láè mncir wááwá ka'. Jisos Kraâis aè tee seèe efa ndoèo ca. E m loèr yiseèe dïì', a kwe mbe ce, a lo a ba ñwáè ndoèo aè bsii Nyúè. Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ñwáè ce a ka' káti mbe ce baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè ndoèo aè bsii Nyúè.”
English: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis aè m yá ñgá' ca tá beèe enje jáá a bo koni efa bghoènïì ce Nyúè aè m fa neè Abraèhaêm, tá seèe ce seèe aè byemi neè Jisoès bo koni Yú' ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè yïì beèe naè njo' ye.
English: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m be feè'ni yuu ce m ce laèa aè yuu ce beèe a ke geèe. Beèe a mmbaa a ka' ye leè', aède' moè' bú' leè' anaè ka'. AÈde' moè' ker kyese yuu mo' mbenduè leè' anaè ka', njobeè' a kur wáá.
English: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man's covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.

Limbum: Leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye eluâuñgoèñ naè yi ku ba wa' foñ. E m ye leè' anaè, a gee mkaè'ni anaè ba neè Abraèham ba yïì ñgúè. Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, “Neè yoè ñgúè”, ce yi yu ená e m ce laèa ba aèmboè beèe aèñgoo ka', e m ce laèa ba aèmboè ñwáè moè'sir, ñwáè anaè aè ba Jisos Kraêis.
English: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn't say, To seeds, as of many, but as of one, To your seed, which is Christ.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa yi yu ená Nyúè aè m ye leè' a Abraèham wa'a, bfeè' mjeèe- kyeèe-ba-bfeè'-mntaar vi ka' caèa, e ka' fa mncir neè Juês. Mncir anaè vi túr ñger aè rbú' leè' tá yuu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' yi kúti aè yuu cicïì ka'.
English: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' koni bghoènïì ese Nyúè njo' mncir ce e ce láè, yi ba ba ená Nyúè ce fa seèe bghoènïì anaè njo' leè' ce e m ye ka'. Geewa'a, seèe rïìñ seená Nyúè aè m ghoèni Abraèham njobeè' e m kaè' ená e be ghoèni ye.
English: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu wa' na baná Nyúè aè m fa seèe mncir njoká? E m fa seèe mncir tá seèe bo rïìñ yuu ce yi yu bebep. Mncir anaè vi m ba, duè baè' aè nfeè' ce ñwáè ce e m ba ñgúè Abraèham ca aè vúè. Ñwáè anaè a ñwáè ce Nyúè aè m ye leè' a Abraèham ená e be ghoèni ye. Nyúè aè lor mncir anaè, a fa neè bcïìndap Nyúè, bcïìndap Nyúè wo wo a fa mncir anaè neè ñwáè ce e m táá mbetar Nyúè ba ñwáè.
English: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' táá mbetar beèe, baná ñgaèñ táá aè btu beèe aèñgoo. AÈ ka' ba aèmboè Nyúè, e ku ba moè'sir.
English: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

Limbum: Waè' mncir vi jepsi leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye naè a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Mncir vi m ka' ba túr ñger aè rfa ñwáè ryoèñ ce nfeseè, aè ba kuè ba vi ce vi m ba geèe tá beèe a ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

Limbum: Geewa'a, aède' mncir vi fa ñwáè ryoèñ ce nfeseè ka'. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená buu bbebep vi túr ñger mbenduè ñgoèñ ca wááwá. Baná yu ba beèe ce a byemi neè Jisos Kraâis naè, ce a be túr buu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè beèe ce a byemi neè ye.
English: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce Jisos Kraâis aè m be vú ka' naè, mncir vi kur seèe aèmboè ñgaâa shañ wa'a caar a du a ba' aè nfeè' ce e m vúè, seèe aè byemïì neè ye naè.
English: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

Limbum: Mncir vi m ce naèshi seèe tá Jisos Kraâis ka' vúè, tá seèe ce seèe aè byemi neè ye naè bo ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni ce seèe aè byemi neè Jisoès na yuu mo' yi ker ce naèshi seèe aèmboè yi m ce naèshi naè ka'.
English: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

Limbum: Weèe wááwá yu boo Nyúè njobeè' weèe aè byemi neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá ce a baèptir ye, a Jisos Kraâis a ba aèbee, ñwáè anaè aè loèr ba ñgeèe Jisos Kraêis.
English: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

Limbum: Baná káè aè yu Jus áè, káè aè yu ñwáè enje jáá áè, káè aè yu ñkwaèa áè, káè aè yu muu áè, káè aè yu mbañruèñwáè áè, káè aè yu njeñwáè áè, jáá jáèá jáá yu aègho ka' njobeè' weèe wááwá yu ñwáè moè'sir njep Jisos Kraêis.
English: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Wáè ka' ba ñwáè Jisos Kraêis, baná aè yu moè' efa ñgúè Abraèham ce e be koni buu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè ñgúè Abraèham naè.
English: If you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed and heirs according to promise.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa yi yu ba ená muu ce e be ye bti' yïì taê, ka' bii munte, e ku ba aèmboè ñkwaèa, ka' bti' anaè yu vi wa'a.
English: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;

Limbum: E ke ba aè nfeè' anaè, beèe a ba ce a be ce keè'ni muu anaè, keèr ce fyá' buu ce yu vi naè neè ye caar tá bfeè' ce yïì ta aè m láè naè vi gháá.
English: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

Limbum: Yi ku ba neè seèe wa' foñ. AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce seèe aè m be riñ buu Nyúè boèñboñ ka' naè, seèe aè ce faè' bkwaèa neè byú' enjep ñgoèñ na.
English: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

Limbum: Nfeè' aè ka' gháá, Nyúè aè tuu muu yïì njep ñgoèñ na. AÈ m bi njeñwáè a bi muu anaè. A m bi ye aè ñwáè Judaè, e ce láè mncir Juês.
English: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe wa'a tá e bo tee beèe ce mncir vi m kur woweèe naè, tá seèe bo ba boo Nyúè.
English: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' weèe yu boo Nyúè, Nyúè aè tuusïì Yú' muu yïì ená yi vú niñ njep viseèe mntee. Yú' ca yi geèe seèe ce ká' Nyúè enáê, “Baâa, Taèr.”
English: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father!

Limbum: Baná weèe ker bii bkwaèa ka'. Weèe yu seè'ni ba boo. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' weèe yu boo Nyúè, baná weèe be koni buu wááwá ce e kupshi a lá neè boo vi naè.
English: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce weèe aè m rïìñ Nyúè ka' naè, weèe aè m ba bkwaèa neè buu ce yu mnyúè ka'.
English: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni aèmboè weèe aè rïìñ Nyúè na, káè seè'ni ce Nyúè aè rïìñ weèe na, weèe aè ker ce koèñ aè rkúti aèmbuèu byú' enjep ñgoèñ na njoká? Njáèá byú' anaè vi yu aè cicïì, a túr ñger ka'. Weèe ker ce koèñ aè rkúti ba bkwaèa neè byú' anaè njoká?
English: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

Limbum: Weèe ce loèr mnoèñ mo', ba mñwáá mo', ba nfeè' moè', ba bfeè' mo' ená vi yu jáá njoká?
English: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

Limbum: Ye ñgeèe anaè yi ce wápsi máè seê. Yi ce yááti aèmboè la rfaè' ce máè m geèe a weâe mú naè li bú aè cicïì wa'a.
English: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe lor ba ya ñgeèe aèmboè má máè aè loèr ñgeèe ye naè. Weèe aè m be gee yuu bebep neè máè ka' koo múcaèr.
English: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ená aè m ba aè nfeè' entombïì ce máè m feè'shi nsuñ mboèñmboñ neè weèe naè, máè m ce cu a weâe mú njobeè' máè m ce yañ.
English: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

Limbum: Ka' ya yañ aè m ba yïì ce weèe aè m ba cañ efa máâ geñ wa'a, weèe aè m loèr máè aè yuu cicïì ka'. Weèe aè m gá' neè máè aèmboè weèe ce gá' lá ba neè ncïìndap Nyúè wa'a. Neè mini-ñwáè, weèe aè m gá' neè máè aèmboè weèe ce gá' lá ba neè Jisos Kraâis wa'a.
English: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn't despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' máè m vúè yá weèe naè, weèe aè lu'shïì seê. Yuu ce yi koni seè'ni aè koni ká? Máè rïìñ máná aè m ba mbe nfeè' anaè, weèe aè koñ máè seê. A m ba laa mbe nfeè' anaè ená ñwáè co'ni mmir enje tuè fa neè máè, ñgaèñ aè m ba kuè geèe wa'a.
English: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

Limbum: Waè' máè kúti ñwáè bbaèa neè weèe njobeè' m ce suñ weèe yuu mini a?
English: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

Limbum: Beèe ca a ce koèñ ená a so weèe, koo weèe aè mbeèp yaèp. A ce koèñ aè rso weèe ba aè yuu boèñboñ ka'. Woweèe a ce koèñ ená seèe gaèpni tá weèe bo koèñ ba woweèe.
English: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

Limbum: Yi yu boèñboñ ená ñwáè so ñwáè aè mbeèp yïì ba aètu yuu boèñboñ. Cena yu yuu yáánïì aè nfeè' wááwá, káè yu aè nfeè' m yu a weâe mú áè, káè m yu a weâe mú ka' áè.
English: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

Limbum: Boo wa ce máè koèñ neè ya ntee wááwá, m ker ce yá ñgá' a weâe btuè aèmboè njeñwáè ce e ce luuti wa'a. M be kuè ce yá ñgá' wa'a caar tá weèe lor ba ñgeèe Jisos Kraêis.
English: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you--

Limbum: Máè ba ba a weâe mú, máè ba rïìñ yuu ce m be laèa. Njáèá yuu ce weèe aè geèe na, yi geèe bfee vi bú máè.
English: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

Limbum: Weèe ce weâe koèñ ená weèe ba njeptii mncir, waè' weèe ce yu' yuu ce mncir vi ce laèa a?
English: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don't you listen to the law?

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ená Abraèham aè m túr boo mmbañruè a baa. E m bi moè' a ñkwaèa, a bi moè' a njeñwáè ce e m ba ñkwaèa ka'.
English: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.

Limbum: Ñkwaèa ca yi m bi muu yïì ca aèmboè a ke bi boo wááwá naè. Njeñwáè ce e m ba ñkwaèa ka' naè aè m bi muu yïì ba njo' mkaè'ni ce Nyúè aè m geèe neè Abraèhaêm.
English: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

Limbum: AÈde' seèe lor cena ba aèmboè ñgaèa wa'a. Bbyeèñge a baa ce a too ená Hagaè ba Sáèra na a táá aètu bleâ' bbaa. Hagaè táá aètu leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye a Musïìs mbe rtuèu Sinaèi aè nfeè' ce e m fa mncir neè Musïìs naè. Boo wááwá ce a yu njeptii leè' ca a ku ba bkwaèa.
English: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

Limbum: Hagaè táá aètu leè' ce a m ye mbe rtuèu Sinaèi ce li yu ba aè ñgoâñ AÈrábïìyaè, a ker táá foñ aètu rla' Jáèrusaláèm lïû seè'ni na, njobeè' beâe aè rla' Jáèrusaláèm wááwá a yu bkwaèa neè mncir.
English: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe embe Jáèrusaláèm ce embe buèu, woweèe a yu bkwaèa ka'. Jáèrusaláèm ca yu yïìseèe maê.
English: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

Limbum: Yuu ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè aèmboè buu ca yi yu mini. A m sañ enáê, “Wáâ njeñwáè ce wáè be bi muu ka', lu'shi. Wáè ce wáè be riñ aèmboè a ke luuti muu ka', waa mbekïì ce lu'shi, njobeè' boo njeñwáè ce nduu aè maè' ye, a be loè caèa boo njeñwáè ce e cu a nduu”
English: For it is written, Rejoice, you barren who don't bear. Break forth and shout, you that don't travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, aè ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, weèe yu boo Nyúè njo' mkaè'ni ce Nyúè aè m geèe, aèmboè a m bi Aisïìk aè muu Abraèham njo' mkaè'ni ce Nyúè aè m geèe naè.
English: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, muu ce a m ku bi aèmboè beèe wááwá a ke bi boo naè, aè lo a ce fa ñgá' neè muu ce a m bi ba aè ñger Yú' Nyúè naè. Yi ku ba seè'ni wa' foñ.
English: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè aèmboè ñgá' ca ená ká? A sañ mbo enáê, “Juèu njeñwáè ce e yu ñkwaèa naè a muu yïì bsïìp. Yi yu boèñboñ ená muu ñkwaèa anaè ye bti' a muu njeñwáè ce e yu ñkwaèa ka' naè ka'.”
English: However what does the Scripture say? Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, baná seèe yu boo njeñwáè ce e yu ñkwaèa naè ka', seèe yu ba boo njeñwáè ce e yu ñkwaèa ka' naè.
English: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis aè m fúr seèe efa bkwaèa faè dïì' seèe bo ker faè' bkwaèa neè yuu mo' ka'. Baná weèe táá tatap. Weèe fa keèr byemi aè rfaè' bkwaèa neè yuu mo' ka'.
English: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don't be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

Limbum: Yu' neè boèñboñ. Máâ Poêl, m ce suñ weèe ená weèe ka' byemi ená a gee weèe búè tá weèe ka' ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè, baná yuu ce Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe neè weèe naè yi bú aè cicïì.
English: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

Limbum: M ce koèñ máná weèe riñ boèñboñ ená ñwáè aè ka' byemi ená a gee ye búè, baná ñgaèñ túr aè rláè mncir Jus wááwá foñ.
English: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe ce koèñ ená weèe ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njobeè' weèe ce láè mncir, weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè gaèpni. Weèe aè bá yuu boèñboñ ce Nyúè aè ba geèe neè weèe.
English: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè seèe, Yú' Rara yi geèe seèe aè ce keè' ba ená Nyúè be loèr seèe aèmboè beâe byáánïì a yeâ bsii njobeè' seèe aè byemi neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

Limbum: Seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe ka' ba ñwáè moè'sir, káè ñwáè aè geèe búè áè, káè ñwáè aè geèe búè ka' áè, yi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè liseèe rbyemïì ka'. Yuu tatap yi yu ená seèe byemi neè Jisos Kraêis, duñshi liseèe rbyemïì anaè aè liseèe rkoèñnïì.
English: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

Limbum: AÈ m ba efa rkáè' weèe aè ce geèe boèñboñ seê. AÈ geèe ba nda, weèe aè ka' borni efa rgeèe yuu mini?
English: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e doèoshi weèe, weèe aè ka' ce geèe njáèá ñgeèe ca aè doèoshi Nyúè ce e m ká' weèe ená tá weèe ba yïì beèe ka'.
English: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

Limbum: Kuushi neè ená koè' e mo'sir yi ke bepsi ncwa'.
English: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe yu ñwáè moè'sir, máè byemi máná weèe be yu' buu ce máè laèa na. Ñwáè ce e ce jepsi weèe naè, káè yu nda áè, Tata Nyúè be fa ye ñgá'.
English: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, aè ka' ba yi aèmboè máè, yi yu rara ená m ker bii feè'shi ená beèe ce a byemi neè Jisos Kraâis a gee búè ka'. Máè ka' ba ce feè'shi wa'a, beèe a ba keèr ce fa máè ñgá' ka'. Yi ka' ba ba mini wa'a, yuu ce m ce feè'shi ená Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe mbe kïìntaa na yi ba geèe tá beèe a bepsi ntee neè máè ka'.
English: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè beèe ce a ce jepsi weèe naè, maè'shi neè tá woweèe a soñ wap mnyor.
English: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, Nyúè aè ká' weèe faè dïì' weèe bo keèr ce faè' bkwaèa neè mncir ka'. AÈmboè weèe ker bii ce faè' bkwaèa neè mncir ka' naè, weèe fa laèa weená aède' weèe ku gee yuu ce weèe koèñ ka'. Yuu ce weèe aè ba geèe yi yu ená weèe koñ bfúr mo', ce fa' neè woweèe.
English: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don't use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

Limbum: Weèe gee wa'a njobeè' laèa ce enáê, “Koèñ nfúroè aèmboè wáè koèñ yoè nyor” naè, yi kur mncir wááwá.
English: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce luuni aèmboè mnyaèa, baná weèe lor nfeè' faè dïì' weèe yúshi wee btu ka'.
English: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don't consume one another.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa yi yu ená weèe ma'shi tá Yú' Nyúè yi ke'ni weèe faè dïì' weèe bo geèe ba yuu ce yeè nyor ce koèñ ka'.
English: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won't fulfill the lust of the flesh.

Limbum: Yuu ce nyor koèñ, a yuu ce Yú' Nyúè yi koèñ ka'. Yuu ce Yú' Nyúè yi koèñ, a yuu ce nyor ce koèñ ka'. Buâu bbaa ca vi yu aè yuu mo'sir ka'. A mbuèu ce aède' aè gee yuu ce wáâ koèñ aè rgeèe ka'.
English: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

Limbum: Yú' Nyúè yi ka' ce keè'ni wáè, baná mncir vi ker túr ñger mbe wáâ nduè ka'.
English: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

Limbum: Buu ce ñwáè e ke geèe yu buu ce beèe a máñni ka'. Buu ca yu mká'ni ba bsaèkïì, mkwaè'shïì aèmboè mká'ni ba bsaèkïì, bsaèkïì ce e duè ba aè yañ,
English: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

Limbum: rloo neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na, tú', bbaènïì ba mlap, ñko'ndoñ, ntee yayañ, bwer, ñgaèpni ba rcu jáá jáèá jáá,
English: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

Limbum: gháè', no buu vi koo, ñañ ker ba buu moè' ce vi ku ba aèmboè bca. M ce laèa neè weèe tatap aèmboè máè m laèa neè weèe naè, ená aède' beèe ce a ce geèe njáèá buu ca a konïì ñgúè' moè' efa kúú Nyúè ka'.
English: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.

Limbum: Buu ce vi loè ese Yú' Nyúè yu buu ca: rkoèñnïì, rlu'shïì, cumúnyañ, ñkur ntee, ñgeâe boèñboñ neè beèe, aè rba mini,
English: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

Limbum: aè rba neè rbonïì-ñwáè, aè rmaè'shi yoè nyor aèwaèa ka'. Ncir mo' yi yu ce yi kani beèe efa rgeèe buu ca ka'.
English: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

Limbum: Beèe ce a yu beèe Jisos Kraâis a maè' buu ce nyor ce koèñ. Cena yi yu aèmboè a taa lá vi mbe kïìntaa wa'a.
English: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

Limbum: AÈmboè seèe ce cu aè ñger Yú' Nyúè na, baná seèe ce gee buu aè ñger Yú' Nyúè.
English: If we live by the Spirit, let's also walk by the Spirit.

Limbum: Seèe fa naèa tu ka', seèe fa geèe tá ntee yi bep ñwáè moè' ka', seèe fa ko'ndoñ neè ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: Let's not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe aè ka' yá aèmboè ñwáè aè geèe yuu bebep, weèe ce weèe ce geèe buu aè ñger Yú' Nyúè naè, weèe ja' ye tá e bo kúti njep nduunjïû yáánïì. Wee ce jaè' ñwáè anaè, weèe fa ce naèa tu ka'. Weèe fyá' weêe mnyor boèñboñ faè dïì' weèe lo gweè rmoèoshïì foñ ka'.
English: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren't tempted.

Limbum: Weèe koni bfúr wee aè ñgá' ce woweèe a ce yá. Weèe ka' gee wa'a, baná weèe aè láè ncir Jisos Kraêis.
English: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' lor yi tu ená e yu ñwáè, ce e yu ñwáè ka', baná ñgaèñ ce bo' yi tu.
English: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

Limbum: Tá ñwáè wááwá fyá' yïì ndeèe; yïì ndeèe ka' ba yáánïì, baná ñgaèñ be yu' nyor njobeè' buu bboèñboñ ce e geèe, ke' ba njobeè' e yá ená e geèe buu anaè a caa ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá be kuè byáè' yi ntáèr.
English: For each man will bear his own burden.

Limbum: Tá beèe wááwá ce a ce yá'ni woweèe buu Nyúè a fa buu moè' efa buu bboèñboñ ce a túr neè ñwáè ce e ce yá'ni woweèe.
English: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

Limbum: Fa bo' yo tu, loèr Nyúè aè lúr ka'. Yuu ce ñwáè aè byeè ku ba yuu ce e be kep.
English: Don't be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ce geèe ba buu ce yïì nyor koèñ, baná ñgaèñ be koni rbep ba rkwe. Ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe ba buu ce Yú' Nyúè yi koèñ, baná ñgaèñ be koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

Limbum: Baná seèe fa koosi bsáè, borni efa rgeèe yuu boèñboñ ka', njobeè' seèe ka' tá borni ka', nfeè' ka' gháá, seèe ye sá' efa liseèe rfaè' anaè.
English: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don't give up.

Limbum: Baná aè nfeè' wááwá ce seèe aè ka' koni fáñ, seèe gee yuu boèñboñ neè beèe wááwá, lañlañ ñgaâa rbyemïì.
English: So then, as we have opportunity, let's do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

Limbum: Yá neè mbúâ ñwaè' goèrgoèr ce m ce sañ neè ya bo na.
English: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ce koèñ aè ryááti boèñboñ aè bsii beèe naè, a beèe ce a ce taèa weèe ená weèe gee búè. Woweèe a ce geèe wa'a faè dïì' beèe a bo fa woweèe ñgá' njobeè' woweèe a ce feè'shi aèmboè rkwe ce Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe mbe kïìntaa ka'.
English: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

Limbum: Ka' beèe ce a geèe búè wáá naè, a ce láè mncir wááwá ka'. Woweèe a ku koñ ená weèe gee búè tá a bo naèa tu ená weèe aè yu'ni neè woweèe.
English: For even they who receive circumcision don't keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè máè, aède' m naatu aè yuu mo' caa efa rkwe ce Tata Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe mbe kïìntaa naè ka'. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' li rkwe anaè, buu enjep ñgoèñ na aè kúti buu bcicïì neè máè. Buu anaè yu neè máè aèmboè bgúâú buu wa'a, má máè aè ba aèmboè gúâú yuu wa'a, neè buu anaè.
English: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

Limbum: Káè ñwáè aè geèe búè áè, káè ñwáè aè geèe búè ka' áè, yi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè liseèe rbyemïì ka'. Yuu goèr yi yu ená Nyúè gee tá seèe ba beâe bfi.
English: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

Limbum: Tá Nyúè fa cumúnyañ, ker koosimnse neè beèe ce a ce cu aèmboè beâe bfi, a ba beèe Isráèl mini ce a yu beèe Nyúè.
English: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God's Israel.

Limbum: Káâ' seè'ni na, ñwáè fa keèr fa máè ñgá' ka', njobeè' ncoèo ce e yu a máâ nyoèr ce duèñshi ená m yu ñwáè Jisos Kraêis.
English: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce loo máná Tata Jisoès túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ. Yi yu wa'a.
English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pol ce Nyúè aè ce máè ená m ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. M ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè beèe Nyúè ce a yu aè to' Áfásoès. Beèe Nyúè ca yu beèe ce a duè aèmbuèu Jisos Kraâis neè mini-ñwáè.
English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

Limbum: M ce loo máná Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, ba Tata Jisos Kraêis, túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, gee tá weèe cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Seèe yoñshi Tata Nyúè ce e yu Taèr neè Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tataê. Yu ye ce e ghoèni seèe neè buu embe buèu. E ghoèni seèe neè buu ca njobeè' seèe yu beèe Jisos Kraêis.
English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;

Limbum: Tá Nyúè ka' keè geèe ñgoèñ, e m ce seèe ená seèe ba aèbee seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe tá seèe bo ba yïì beèe, ba brara, ba yáánïì a yeâ bsii. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' Nyúè aè koèñ seèe,
English: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without blemish before him in love;

Limbum: e m kwaè'shi war, a gee ená seèe ba boo vi njo' rfaè' ce Jisos Kraâis be vúè geèe neè seèe. Nyúè aè m geèe ca njobeè' aè m ba yuu ce yi m boèñ ye, e koñ aè rgeèe.
English: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

Limbum: E m geèe ená seèe ba boo vi tá seèe bo kuè'si ye njobeè' e m geèe yuu boèñboñ neè seèe. E m geèe yuu anaè neè seèe aè cicïì. Seèe aè koni yi njo' muu yïì ce e koèñ se naè.
English: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' Jisoès aè m fa vi bláá aè rtee seèe efa ñgá', Nyúè aè foosïì seèe efa yïìseèe buu bbebep. E m túr ntee boèñboñ neè seèe neè mini-ñwáè,
English: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

Limbum: a ka' gee yuu anaè neè seèe aè njïì ce aède' ñwáè laa ka'. E m túr bfee, a riñ buu wááwá, a ka' gee wa'a.
English: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

Limbum: E m geèe yuu ce e m ce yu' rboèñ aègho, a gee seèe aè riñ buu ce aède' seèe aè m ba riñ ka', ce yu buu ce e m kwaè'shi ená e be loèr Jisos Kraâis geèe aègho.
English: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

Limbum: E m kwaè'shi ená e be geèe buu ca ce nfeè' aè ka' gháá, vúè neè buu embe buèu ba buu enjep nsheè wááwá tarshi aèbee, láè njeptii Jisos Kraêis.
English: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;

Limbum: Yu ba njo' Jisos Kraâis ca ce Nyúè aè m ce weèr ená weèr ba yïì beèe. E ke geèe buu wááwá ba aèmboè e láè ená e be geèe.
English: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;

Limbum: E m ce weèr wa'a tá weèr ce weèr aè m ba beèe entoèmbïì aè rláè mmir mbenduè Jisos Kraâis bo geèe tá beèe a yá yi foèo, ce kuè'si ye.
English: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

Limbum: Wee weèe foñ yu aèbee weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe. Weèe aè m yu' nsuñ kuu yuu mini, ce e yu ená aède' weèe luêñ, a byemi neè Jisoès. Weèe aè ka' byemi wa'a, Nyúè aè fa weèe ncoèo ce e ce duèñshi ená weèe yu yïì beèe. Ncoèo anaè yu Yú' Rara ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè yïì beèe.
English: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation--in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

Limbum: Yú' Rara ca yi yu aèmboè yuu ce Nyúè aè tár lá neè seèe wa'a, caar tá Nyúè tee seèe efa ñgá', tá seèe koni buu wááwá ce e be fa neè yïì beèe, tá beèe wááwá a yá yi foèo, kuè'si ye.
English: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God's own possession, to the praise of his glory.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njo' buu ce Nyúè aè geèe neè weèe na, m ce loo neè weèe káâ' aè nfeè' ce beèe a m suñ máè ená weèe aè byemi neè Tata Jisoès, a ker koñ beèe Nyúè wááwá.
English: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,

Limbum: M ce yoèñshi Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá njo' weèe, a ker ce loo neè weèe aè nfeè' ce m ka' ce loo.
English: don't cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

Limbum: M ce loo neè Nyúè ce e yu Nyúè neè yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis a ker ba Taèr ce e yu ñwáè foèo, ená e fa weèe yi yú', tá weèe túr bfee, rïìñ njáèá ñwáè ce Nyúè yu neè mini-ñwáè.
English: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

Limbum: M ce loo máná Nyúè mú' wee bfee tá weèe bo yá li rraa, rïìñ buu wááwá ce weèe aè láè mmir mbenduè mo njobeè' e m ká' weèe, ker riñ ená bti' ce Nyúè aè láè neè yïì beèe vi boèñ a caa ñger.
English: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

Limbum: M ce loo ená e mú' wee bfee tá weèe bo rïìñ yi ñger ce yi caèa ñger bsïìp. Yu ñger ca ce e loèr a ce geèe rfaè' aègho njep viseâe mntee, ce seèe yu beèe ce seèe aè byemi neè ye. Ñger ce yi caèa ñger anaè ku ba ñger
English: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

Limbum: ce e m loèr a gee Jisos Kraâis aè fúú efa rkwe, e lor ye a cuusi a yeâ rkoo maè' mbe buèu.
English: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

Limbum: A mbe dïì' ce Jisos Kraâis yu, a ce sa' buu wááwá ce vi túr ñger mbe buèu; e yu ñwáâ ñgoèr a caa byú' wááwá, ba bcïìndap Nyúè wááwá, a ker túr ñger a caa beèe wááwá ce a túr mlii njep ñgoèñ na seè'ni. E túr ñger seè'ni na, keèr loè túr aè nfeè' ce e bii ka' ba.
English: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m loèr buu wááwá a lá njeptii Jisoès, a ker gee ená e ba tu neè coêr, ce sa' buu wááwá.
English: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

Limbum: Cor yu nyor Jisos Kraêis, ce e geèe Jisoès aè misïì a ghááte, Jisoès ye ye aè gee buu ce vi yu aè bdïì' wááwá vi misïì a ghááte.
English: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' weèe aè ba aèmboè beèe ce a kweñger wa'a, njobeè' weèe aè m geèe faèa ba buu bbebep.
English: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè weèe aè ce geèe ñgeèe ce beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a ce geèe, a ker ce yu'ni ba neè ñkúú embe dïì' ce byú' bbebep vi ce cu, aè ba dïì' ce yi yu ba mbekïì. Ñkúú ca yu yú' ce yi ce faè' njep mntee beèe ce a teèe btu neè Nyúè.
English: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience;

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' see seèe aè ba aèmboè beèe ca, a ce geèe buu ce yïìseèe nyor aè m ce koèñ aè rgeèe ker ba vïì ce seèe aè m ce kwaè'shi aè rgeèe. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' seèe aè m ku túr ba njáèá ntee ce beèe ca a m túr, yi ba ená Nyúè be ko'si rshentee neè seèe woweèe wááwá.
English: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

Limbum: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, ñkoosimnse Nyúè aè m caèa ñger, e ker koñ seèe magoèr.
English: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m ce geèe buu bbebep, a ba aèmboè beèe ce a kweñger naè, Nyúè aè gee seèe aè kútïì bteèe seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe. Yu njobeè' ntee boèñboñ ce Nyúè aè m túr neè seèe, ce seèe aè luèñ efa rkwe.
English: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ by grace you have been saved,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njo' Jisos Kraêis, Nyúè aè naa seèe mbekïì aèbee seèe woweèe, a gee seèe woweèe aè cu mbe buèu.
English: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

Limbum: E m geèe buu ca tá beèe wááwá a bo yá buu boèñboñ ce e m geèe neè seèe ce seèe yu aèbee seèe Jisoès weèe, rïìñ yi ntee boèñboñ ce yi caèa ñger.
English: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

Limbum: Yu njo' ntee boèñboñ ca ce weèe aè m luèñ efa rkwe aè nfeè' ce weèe aè m byemi neè Jisoès. Cena yi m loè ba ese weèe ka'. Nyúè aè m fa neè weèe aè cicïì.
English: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

Limbum: Seèe aè koni rboèñ ca njo' yuu mo' ce seèe aè geèe ka', faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo naèa nyor ená e geèe yuu mo' a ka' koni ka'.
English: not of works, that no one would boast.

Limbum: Seèe yu bo rfaâ' Nyúè. E geèe seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè ba aèbee tá seèe bo geèe mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ ce Nyúè aè m láè ená seèe geêe.
English: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu beèe enje jáá naè, kuushi neè njáèá beèe ce weèe aè m ba. Jus ce a ce too wap btu ená ñgaâa ñgeèe búè naè, a ce too weèe ená mmbáè'nsúèr. Búè ca ku ba búè ce beèe a geèe neè mmbo.
English: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called uncircumcision by that which is called circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;

Limbum: Kuushi neè ená weèe aè m túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè Kraâis ka'. Weèe aè m ba ñgúè beèe Isráèl ce Nyúè aè m ce naè ka'. Weèe aè m túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye a yi beèe njo' mkaè'ni ce e m geèe a woweèe naè ka'. Weèe aè m ce cu le rcu enjep ñgoèñ na, a túr yuu mo' ce aède' weèe lá mmir mbenduè mo ka', a riñ Nyúè ka'.
English: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

Limbum: Weèe aè m ba aènjïìsaèp ese Nyúè, aè ka' ba seè'ni ce weèe yu aèbee weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe na, wee weèe aè vú aètútú njobeè' e m kwe a weâe btuè.
English: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

Limbum: Yu ye ce e geèe seèe aè ce cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè. E m geèe beèe ce a yu Juês, ker ba beèe ce a yu Jus ka' a ba ñwáè moè'sir. E m loèr yïì nyor a ca'si buu ce vi m gaèpni seèe, a gee seèe aè banïì naè, aègho.
English: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of partition,

Limbum: E m siñsi mncir Musïìs ce vi m ce suñ beèe buu ce beèe a ba ce geèe. E m geèe wa'a tá e bo loèr beèe embe mnjáâá bbaa ca, ba a woweèe aèbee, tá a ba njáèá moè'sir, cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè.
English: having abolished in the flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace;

Limbum: E m kwe mbe kïìntaa, a gee seèe Nyúè weèe aè kútïì aèbee. E m geèe mmbaèni anaè yi mïî,
English: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility thereby.

Limbum: e vúê, a fe'shi nsuñ cumúnyañ neè weèe ce weèe aè m ba aènjïìsaèp ker ba neè beèe ce a m ba aètútú.
English: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

Limbum: Yu njo' Jisoès ce seèe wááwá aè túr yú' e mo'sir, a koni fáñ aè rtáá aè bsii Taèr.
English: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

Limbum: Baná weèe ce weèe yu Jus ka' na, weèe ker bii bkïìloè káè beèe ce a ce caèa caèa ka', weèe yu boo ñgaâa nshe weèe beèe Nyúè weèe, a ba beèe embe ndaèp Nyúè.
English: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

Limbum: Weèe yu ñgúè' moè' efa ndaèp Nyúè ce a boo. Beèe ce a m ba ñgaâa ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis, ba ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, a ba kuèundap anaè. Jisos Kraâis yu luèr rbuu ndap anaè,
English: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

Limbum: aè ba ye ce e geèe ndap anaè aè táá yáánïì, a ku', a ba ndap nrara.
English: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe yu ñwáè moè'sir seè'ni na, e geèe weèe beèe ca weèe aè ba aèbee aèmboè ndap ce a baè'ri wa'a, tá Yú' Nyúè yi bo cu mbo.
English: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' Nyúè aè geèe wa'a, máâ Poêl, m ce loo neè weèe. M yu ñwáè shañ njobeè' m yu ñwáè rfaè' neè Jisos Kraêis, a ce faè' neè weèe ce weèe yu beèe enje jáá.
English: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

Limbum: M ce kwaè'shi máná weèe aè m yu' wáá ená Nyúè aè m ce máè ená m suñ weèe aèmboè ntee boèñboñ ce e túr neè weèe.
English: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m duèñshi máè buu ce aède' ñwáè aè m ba riñ ka', máè riñ vi. Máè sañ a suñ weèe mú mmo' efa gho.
English: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

Limbum: Wee aè ka' be' buu ce máè sañ neè weèe na, weèe yá ená yuu ce aède' beèe a riñ kuu Kraâis ka' naè, m rïìñ yi boèñboñ seê.
English: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

Limbum: AÈ m ba entoèmbïì, Nyúè aè gee beèe a riñ yuu anaè ka'. AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na e tuu yi yú' yi gee yïì beèe ce e m ce aè ñgaâa ntuu, ker ba beèe ce a ce suñ beèe buu ce Nyúè aè geèe woweèe a riñ naè, a riñ yuu anaè.
English: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

Limbum: Yuu anaè yi yu ená beèe enje jáá a be koni bghoènïì ce Jus a koni naè foñ. Woweèe foñ a yu ñgúè' moè' efa nyor Jisos Kraêis. Woweèe a be koni buu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' neè yïì beèe ce a yu aèbee a Jisos Kraâis weèe. Yuu ce yi geèe beèe aè ka' riñ buu ca yu Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Jisos Kraêis.
English: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ce máè ená m fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ anaè. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e m túr ntee boèñboñ neè máè, e m loèr yi ñger a fa' njep máâ ntee, a fa máè rfaè' ca ená m geêe.
English: of which I was made a servant, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

Limbum: Ka' m yu ñwáâ ñká' efa múè beèe Nyúè wa'a, e fa máè rfaè' ca ená m fe'shi neè beèe enje jáá wááwá, suñ woweèe buu bboèñboñ ce vi loè ese Kraêis, ce yu buu ce aède' ñwáè riñ ka'.
English: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

Limbum: E m ce máè ená m gee tá beèe wááwá a riñ buu ca, ce yu buu ce vi m ba tá ñgoèñ yi ka' keè ba. Nyúè ce e m geèe buu wááwá aè m kupshi buu ca a láê, beèe a riñ vi ka',
English: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ;

Limbum: ená nfeè' e seè'ni na ka' gháá aèmboè e gháá na tá e bo loèr cor geèe tá beèe embe buèu ce a yu btu, ba bcïìndap Nyúè ce bgoèrgoèr a riñ bfee ce Nyúè túr aè buu wááwá.
English: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

Limbum: A mboè Nyúè aè m geèe buu ce e m kupshi a lá efa rkáè' wa'a, buu anaè aè geetïì aè nfeè' ce e m tuu Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tataê.
English: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

Limbum: Yu njo' ye ce seèe ce seèe woweèe yu ñwáè moè'sir aè koni fáñ aè rvúè aègee Nyúè, táá a yeâ bsii neè ñger-ñwáè njobeè' seèe aè byemi neè ye.
English: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, máè ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe fa sáè njo' ñgá' ce m ce yá fa weâe btuè na ka'. Weèe be koni sá' efa ñgá' anaè.
English: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce gúè'shi njeptii Taèr
English: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

Limbum: ce beèe embe buèu ba beèe enjep nsheè wááwá a yu aègho njo' ye.
English: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

Limbum: M ce loo neè Nyúè ce e túr bkuè' seê, ená e fa weèe yi yú' tá yi bo geèe tá wee mntee vi ba btatap,
English: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

Limbum: tá Jisos Kraâis cu njep weâe mntee aèmboè weèe aè byemi neè ye na. M ce loo máná weèe taa mñgaèñ, táá tatap aè rkoèñnïì,
English: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

Limbum: tá weèe ker ba beèe Nyúè wááwá bo rïìñ ku' njáèá rkoèñnïì ce li báèr aè bke', a sap kuèyáá, a sap a ko' mbekïì, a coomi a caa ñger.
English: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

Limbum: Ka' njáèá rkoèñnïì anaè li caèa ñger ñwáè aè rrïìñ wa'a, m ce loo máná weèe riñ li, tá buu bboèñboñ ce vi ruu njep ntee Nyúè naè vi bo ruu njep weâe mntee foñ.
English: and to know Christ's love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

Limbum: Wáâ Nyúè ce wáè loèr yo ñger a ce faè' aègho njep weâr mntee goèr seê, Wáâ Nyúè ce wáè túr ñger aè rgeèe caa embe dïì' weèr aè bipshi káè embe dïì' weèr ce kwaè'shi áè,
English: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

Limbum: tá beèe a ku'si wáè njo' cor ker ba njo' Jisos Kraâis aè nfeè' wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.
English: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Máè ce m yu ñwáè shañ njo' Tata Jisoès, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe gee ñgeèe ce yi ghááte aè ñgeèe beèe ce Nyúè aè ká' ená a ba yïì beèe.
English: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

Limbum: Loèr neè wee mnyor njep nsheè, ba múnyañ, kur ntee. Koo neè faèa ce bfúr a geèe, nje nyor, njo' weèe koèñni.
English: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;

Limbum: Gheèter neè cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè tá weèe bo cu aèbee aèmboè beèe ce Yú' Nyúè yi geèe a ba ñwáè moè'sir.
English: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

Limbum: Nyor Jisos Kraâis yu moè'sir. Yú' Nyúè yi ba e mo'sir. Yuu ce Nyúè aè m ká' seèe, seèe aè lá mmir mbenduè mo yi ku ba e mo'sir foñ.
English: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;

Limbum: Tata yu moè'sir, rbyemïì li ba rmo'sir, baèptir aè ba moè'sir,
English: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

Limbum: Nyúè ce e yu Taèr neè beèe wááwá aè ba moè'sir foñ. Yu ye ce e túr ñger mbenduè beèe wááwá, aè ba ye ce e loèr beèe wááwá a ce geèe mi mfaè' aègho, a ker ba foñ njep beèe wááwá.
English: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.

Limbum: Geewa'a, ñwáè wááwá aè koni ñger aè ndeèe ce Jisoès Kraâis aè fa.
English: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “E m ko' mbekïì a gee beèe ce e m so a du a yeâ mbuèu, a fa mfa neè beèe foñ.”
English: Therefore he says, When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.

Limbum: AÈmboè a sañ enáê, “E m ko' mbekïì” na, baná yi yu ba ená ká? Yi yu ba ená e m káè' entombïì a suu embe dïì' ce e m ba, a ba'si njep nsheè.
English: Now this, He ascended, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m suèu anaè ku ba ye ce e m ko' mbekïì a caa rbuu tá e bo ba aè bdïì' wááwá, tá buu wááwá ghááte aèmboè vi ba ba.
English: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

Limbum: Ku ba ye ce e m fa mfa neè beèe. E m fa rfa neè beèe mo' ená woweèe a ba ñgaâa ntuu, a fa neè beèe mo' ená woweèe a suñ beèe buu ce Nyúè aè geèe woweèe a rïîñ, a fa neè beèe mo' ená woweèe a kar mbekïì fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ, a fa neè beèe mo' ená woweèe a ke'ni ñgaâa rbyemïì, ker yá'ni woweèe.
English: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

Limbum: E m fa mfa ca tá beèe Nyúè a bo rïìñ aè rgeèe li rfaè', tá ñgaâa rbyemïì ce a yu nyor Jisos Kraâis naè a bo tap,
English: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;

Limbum: caar duè baè' aè nfeè' ce seèe be ba ñwáè moè'sir aè liseèe rbyemïì ker ba aè buu ce seèe aè rïìñ aèmboè Muu Nyúè. Seèe ka' cu wa'a, yi gee seèe gháá, misi ba yáánïì aèmboè Kraâis yu naè.
English: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná seèe be keèr ba aèmboè bghaèrbeèe ka'. Beèe a ka' ce bo' seèe neè ryá'nïì mnde', seèe bo daè' ka'. Woweèe a ka' lor ba bfee kwáèá ce taè' tuè'si seèe aègho, seèe bo cïì'ti aèmboè yuu ce yi ke cïì'ti aè nfeè' fu' yi ce caèa naè ka'.
English: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

Limbum: Baná seèe aè ba ce koèñ beèe, ce laèa ba yuu ce yi yu mini, ce geèe yi, tá seèe bo kuè' ba aèmboè Jisos Kraâis ce e yu tu naè, aè mnjïì wááwá.
English: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;

Limbum: Tu yi ka' túr nyor aèmboè byuèñ nyor vi ke cú'te nyor, gee nyor ba moè'sir naè, mñgúè' nyor wááwá vi ce faè' aèmboè vi ba ce faè', baná nyor wááwá be ku', tap. A mboè nyor Jisos Kraâis yu wa'a, ce ñwáè wááwá aè ka' koñ beèe moè'.
English: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

Limbum: Baná m ce laèa neè weèe tatap seê, aè rlii Tata Jisoès ená weèe fa cu njáèá rcu ce beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka' a ce cu naè ka'. Map mkwaè'shïì yu mkwaè'shïû cicïì.
English: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

Limbum: Woweèe a ce cu aè túè'nji, a túr ka' mú bábá' efa ryoèñ ce li loè ese Nyúè ka', njobeè' woweèe a teèe btu, a riñ yuu ka'.
English: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;

Limbum: Woweèe a ker túr rïìtu ka'. Woweèe a niñ njep múè bsaèrbuu, a koñ aè rgeèe vi aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, cena yu yuu ce a yá'ni weèe a kuu Jisos Kraâis ka'.
English: But you did not learn Christ that way;

Limbum: M ce kwaè'shi máná weèe aè yu' yïì nsuñ, a yá'nïì weèe buu ce vi yu mini, aè ba buu ce vi kuèu ye.
English: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

Limbum: Baná weèe co' ñguâp nrúèú ce e m geèe weèe aè ce geèe njáèá ñgeèe ce weèe aè m geèe naè. Buu bbebep ce vi bo' weèe, weèe aè ce koèñ aè rgeèe vi naè vi bepsi weèe.
English: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

Limbum: Maè'shi neè tá Nyúè kupse wee mntee tá weèe bo túr mkwaè'shïû mfi.
English: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

Limbum: Yar neè ñguâp nfi ce Nyúè aè geèe e feeseè ye. Ñguâp nfi ca yu ñgeâe mini ce yi yu yáánïì a ker ba rara.
English: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

Limbum: Baná weèe fa ce nya' mnde' ka'. Ñwáè wááwá laa ba yuu mini neè nfúr yïì njobeè' seèe wááwá yu mñgúè' nyor efa nyor Jisos Kraêis.
English: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

Limbum: Ntee yi ka' bep wáè, aè fa maè'shi yi gee tá aè gee yuu bebep ka'. Fa cu neè ntee bebep ca caar nyúè coo ka'.
English: Be angry, and don't sin. Don't let the sun go down on your wrath,

Limbum: Fa fa fáñ neè Sataèn ka'.
English: neither give place to the devil.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m ba nyáèá borni byáèá, ce fa' neè mi mmbo aè njïû yáánïì, tá e bo koni yuu ce aède' e ja' ñgaâa fuèp aègho.
English: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

Limbum: Fa laèa blaâa bebep ka'. Laèa ba yuu boèñboñ ce aède' yi ja' ñwáè, tá wo blaèa anaè vi bo vúè neè rboèñ neè beèe ce a yu' vi.
English: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

Limbum: Fa geèe tá ntee yi yañ Yú' Rara ce yu Yú' Nyúè naè ka'. Nyúè aè fa yi neè weèe aèmboè ncoèo, yi ce duèñshi ená be ba aè noèñ mo' tá Nyúè tee weèe efa ñgá'.
English: Don't grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

Limbum: Maè' neè ncápntee, ba rshentee, ba ntee bebep, ba mlap, ba mnsa'ni. Ñwáè fa keèr yu' ryañ neè nfúr yïì ka'.
English: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.

Limbum: Geèe neè ñgeâe boèñboñ neè beèe moè', koosimnse neè woweèe, foosi woweèe foñ aèmboè Nyúè aè m foèosi weèe njo' Jisos Kraâis naè.
English: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu boo ce Nyúè koèñ seê, beè'ni neè gee ñgeèe ce Nyúè ce geèe.
English: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

Limbum: Cu neè neè rkoèñnïì-ñwáè aèmboè Jisos Kraâis ye ye aè m koèñ seèe, a fa li ryoèñ a seâe btuè naè. Li ryoèñ ce e m fa na, li m ba aèmboè rfa ce a fa, Nyúè aè yu' rboèñ aègho seê.
English: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

Limbum: Njáèá buu aèmboè bsaèkïì ba mká'ni, ba ñgeâe ñgwe, ba mbaèñ mmir aè buu yi fa keèr yu'ti a weâe mú ka', njobeè' weèe yu beèe Nyúè.
English: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

Limbum: Blaâa bbebep, bde' bcicïì ba ñkáèrbuu mbembep fa keè fúú eku weâe cuèu ka'. Buu ca yu yáánïì ka'. Weèe aè ba ce yoèñshi ba Nyúè.
English: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.

Limbum: Rïìñ neè neè mini-ñwáè ená ñwáè ce e ce saèki, ba ñwáè ce e ce ká'ni, ker ba ñwáè ce e túr yuu, yi gháá ye ka', ce e loèr buu ca aèmboè yïì Nyúè wa'a, aède' e konïì buu bboèñboñ ce beèe ce a túr dïì' mbe dïû' kúú Jisos Kraâis ba Nyúè a koni naè ka'.
English: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

Limbum: Weèe fa maè'shi tá ñwáè moè' bo' weèe neè blaâa bcicïì tá weèe gee njáèá buu ca ka'. Yu njo' buu anaè ce ená Nyúè be ko'si rshentee, fa ñgá' neè beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè ye ka'.
English: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

Limbum: Baná weèe fa táá kuèu weèe njáèá beèe ca weèe ka'.
English: Therefore don't be partakers with them.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' weèe aè ce cu aè túè'nji, aè ka' ba seè'ni na, weèe aè ce cu ba aè rraa njobeè' weèe yu beèe Tata Jisoès. Geèe neè ñgeèe aèmboè beèe ce a ce cu aè rraa.
English: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

Limbum: Rraa ca li geèe beèe a gee buu wááwá ce vi yu bboèñboñ, a ba yáánïì, a ker ba mini.
English: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

Limbum: Gheèter neè riñ buu ce vi boèñ Tata Jisoès.
English: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

Limbum: Fa túr neè yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè buu bcicïì ce beèe a ce geèe aè túè'nji na ka'. Geèe neè tá buu anaè yááti aèwañ.
English: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

Limbum: Yi yu neè rïìtu-ñwáè aè rlaèa aèmboè buu ce woweèe a ce geèe aè bsúèti.
English: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.

Limbum: A ka' nyáá neè yuu aè rraa, baná yuu anaè yi yááti aèwañ.
English: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

Limbum: Yuu yi ka' yááti aèwañ yi kútïì ba ba yuu ce aè rraa. A mbuèu ce a laèa enáê, “Wáè ce aè ce buumi, lá' efa mmirloè, fúú efa rkwe, tá rraa Kraâis li sañ mbe wáâ nduè.”
English: Therefore he says, Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.

Limbum: Baná weèe lor nfeè' neè ye ñgeèe. Weèe fa geèe ñgeèe aèmboè beèe ce a máñni buu ka', geèe neè ba aèmboè beèe ce a rïìñ buu.
English: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' koni fáñ aè rgeèe yuu boèñboñ weèe gee yi, njobeè' buu bbebep aè kuè' aè ñgoèñ seè'ni na.
English: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

Limbum: Baná weèe fa ba blúr ka'. Rïìñ neè ba buu ce Tata Jisoès ce koèñ ená weèe geêe.
English: Therefore don't be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

Limbum: Weèe fa ce no mruè' tá mi ce koo weèe ka'. Mi ka' ce koo weèe baná mi be ce bepsi weèe bepsi. Fa neè wee mnyor ba neè Yú' Nyúè tá yi bo ruu njep weâe mntee.
English: Don't be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

Limbum: Yoèp byáá njáèá jáá jáèá jáá, laa buu neè beèe neè byáá ca. Yoèp byáá, ku'si Tata Jisoès neè yo ntee wááwá.
English: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

Limbum: Yoèñshi Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, aè rlii yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis. Yoèñshi ye aè buu wááwá aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

Limbum: Yu'ni neè neè wee btu, njobeè' weèe yu beèe ce weèe ce gú'shi neè Kraêis.
English: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

Limbum: Bbyeèñgeê, yu'ni neè neè bduu wee aèmboè weèe ce yu'ni neè Tata Jisoès naè.
English: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

Limbum: Nduu yu tu neè ñgwa aèmboè Kraâis ye ye yu tu neè cor naè. Yu ye ce e geèe cor aè luêñ, cor ca aè ba yïì nyor.
English: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

Limbum: Baná aèmboè cor ce yu'ni neè Kraâis naè, yi yu yáánïì ená bbyeèñge a yu'ni neè bduu wap aè buu wááwá.
English: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

Limbum: Mmbañruè, koèñ neè wee bbyeèñge aèmboè Kraâis ye ye aè m koèñ coêr, a fa yi tu aètu mo naè,
English: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

Limbum: tá cor anaè bo ba jáá. E m loèr mdip ce yu blaâa Nyúè a gee cor aè ba nrara aègho,
English: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

Limbum: tá e lor fa neè yïì nyor aèmboè ñgwaguâu mboèñmboñ ce e yu nyáánïì, a ba nrara, a túr faèa koo múcaèr ka'.
English: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

Limbum: Mmbañruè foñ a ba koèñ wap bbyeèñge aèmboè a koèñ wap mnyor naè. Ñwáè aè ka' koñ ñgwa yïì, baná e koèñ yïì nyor.
English: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè m be baa yïì nyor ka'. Ñwáè e loè nyañ yi tu, ker fyá' aè yïì nyor aèmboè Kraâis e ke geèe neè cor naè.
English: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;

Limbum: E ke geèe wa'a njobeè' cor yu yïì nyor. Seèe ce seèe yu ñgaâa coêr, seèe yu mñgúè' mo' efa yïì nyor.
English: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná mbañruèñwáè be maè'shi yïì ta ba yïì maê, cu a ñgwa yïì, tá a ye a ba ñwáè moè'sir” naè.
English: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.

Limbum: Yi yu aètáèr aè ryu' blaèa ca ka'. Máè yá ya máná vi kuèu Kraâis ba yïì coêr.
English: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.

Limbum: Vi kuèu nduu a nje foñ. Baná mbañruèñwáè koñ ñgwa yïì aèmboè e koèñ yïì nyor, tá njeñwáè yu'ni neè nduu yïì.
English: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

Limbum: Boo, yu'ni neè neè weêe bta ba weêe mmaê. Yi yu yáánïì ená beèe ce a yu aèbee a Tata Jisoès weèe a gee wa'a.
English: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

Limbum: Ncir entoèmbïì ce mkaè'ni mi yu aègee mo yi yu enáê, “Yu'ni neè yo ta ba yo maê.” Mkaè'ni anaè mi yu enáê,
English: Honor your father and mother, which is the first commandment with a promise:

Limbum: “Tá buu bo ba yáánïì neè wáè, tá aè cu aè ñgoèñ ca njïìsaèp.”
English: that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.

Limbum: Btar boo, weèe fa geèe tá ntee yi ce yañ boo wee ka'. Weèe yá'ni woweèe, cep woweèe aè njáèá njïì ce Tata Jisoès koèñ.
English: You fathers, don't provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu bkwaèa, yu'ni neè neè wee mmasaè enjep ñgoèñ na; wáp woweèe. Yu'ni neè neè woweèe neè ntee e mo'sir aèmboè weèe ce yu'ni neè Kraâis naè.
English: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

Limbum: Weèe fa kuè ce faè' ba aè nfeè' ce woweèe a ce yá weèe tá woweèe a bo yu' rboèñ neè weèe ka'. Weèe aè ba kuushi ba ená weèe yu ñgaâa mfaè' neè Kraêis, loèr ye ntee wááwá geèe ba yuu ce Nyúè koèñ.
English: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

Limbum: Geèe neè le rfaè' neè ntee boèñboñ. Weèe fa geèe aèmboè weèe ku ce faè' ba neè ñwáè wa' ka', weèe gee li ba neè Tata Jisos Kraêis.
English: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men;

Limbum: Rïìñ neè ená Tata be laè' ñwáè wááwá aè yuu boèñboñ ce e geèe, káè ñgaèñ yu ñkwaèa áè, káè e yu ñkwaèa ka' áè.
English: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu mmasaè, geèe neè ñgeâe boèñboñ foñ neè bkwaèa. Weèe fa ce wápsi woweèe ka'. Weèe aè ba kuushi ená weèe bkwaèa ca weèe wááwá túr Masaè moè'sir ce e ce cu mbe buèu. E ke so'niñgoèñ ka'.
English: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa elúèsimbuèu yi yu ená aèmboè weèe Tata Jisoès weèe yu aèbee na, táá neè tatap, koni ñger ese ye ce e túr ñger goèr.
English: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

Limbum: Yar neè buu bïìr wááwá ce Nyúè aè fa weèe tá weèe bo tami nyor aè rmaè' bïìr aègho, faè dïì' Sataèn bo' weèe neè bfee kwáèá ka'.
English: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

Limbum: Seèe ce maè' bïìr ca ba seèe beèe weèe ka'. Seèe ce maè' ba seèe byú' bbebep wááwá ce vi túr ñger mbekïì. Byú' bbebep ca yu byú' ce vi ce sa', a túr ñger, a tap njep ñgoèñ ce yi yu aè túè'nji na.
English: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world's rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

Limbum: Baná weèe lor buu bïìr ce Nyúè aè fa neè weèe naè, tami nyor aègho, tá Sataèn e vúè naè, weèe bo maè' bïìr boèñboñ, gweè ka'. Bïìr ca ka' mïî, tá weèe bo kuè táá tatap.
English: Therefore, put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

Limbum: Táá tatap, tami nyor aèmboè ñwáè mini tá mini ca ba aèmboè ñkaènda ce ñwáè maè' bïìr aè kur njep mbuèu. Maè'shi tá yo ñgeèe yi ba yáánïì. Njáèá ñgeèe ca yi tá'shi weèe aèmboè yuu ce ñwáè maè' bïìr aè yar a tá'shi yïì ñguèñ aègho wa'a.
English: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

Limbum: Loèr Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce e ce suñ aèmboè cumúnyañ ce Nyúè ce fa neè beèe, tá e ba aèmboè blaba' ce ñwáè maè' bïìr aè yar, faè dïì' aè bo gweè ka'.
English: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;

Limbum: Mo' foñ yi yu ená aè láè ntee neè Tata Jisoès, tá ntee ce wáè láè anaè yi ba aèmboè byáá bïìr, tá mjáá Sataèn ce mor yi yu aè cuèu mo mi bo koo njo.
English: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

Limbum: Loèr neè rluèñ tá li ba aèmboè rtaa ñwáè maè' bïìr wa'a. Loèr neè kaèafaè' ce aè fa ba Yú' Nyúè a fa neè weèe. Kaèafaè' ca yu blaâa Nyúè.
English: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

Limbum: Loo neè neè Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá. Weèe aè ka' ce loo wa'a, weèe ma'shi tá Yú' Rara yi gee tá weèe riñ aè rloo. Cu neè njo, ke' sá ka'. Loo neè neè beèe Nyúè wááwá aè nfeè' wááwá,
English: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:

Limbum: ker loo neè máè ená Nyúè fa máè blaèa ce vi yu yáánïì aè nfeè' ce m ka' ce suñ beèe buu ce aède' beèe aè m ba riñ ka' kuu nsuñ mboèñmboñ. Loo neè ená m ka' ce suñ beèe buu ca, m suñ neè ñger-ñwáè.
English: on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

Limbum: Nsuñ ca yu nsuñ ce Jisos Kraâis aè m ce máè ená m táá a yeâ tuè, suñ beèe, ka' m yu mbe shañ seè'ni wa'a. Loo neè ená m suñ beèe buu ca neè ñger-ñwáè, suñ vi aèmboè máè ba suñ.
English: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

Limbum: M ce koèñ máná weèe riñ foñ yuu ce yi koni máè tá weèe bo rïìñ aèmboè m yu. Tikikoès be suñ weèe buu ca. E yu nfúr yïìseèe, seèe aè koñ ye seê. E yu ñwáè rfaè' ce e ce faè' neè Tata Jisoès neè mini-ñwáè.
English: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things;

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce tuu ye ená e vú yá weèe tá e bo suñ weèe aèmboè weèr yu tá ye ntee yi bo fúte tá weèe yu' rboèñ.
English: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, ba Tata Jisos Kraêis, fa cumúnyañ neè beèe Nyúè wááwá, gee tá woweèe a koñni, láè ntee neè Jisoès.
English: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Nyúè túr ntee boèñboñ neè beèe wááwá ce a koèñ Tata Jisos Kraâis neè mini-ñwáè, a ku cu ba njep rkoèñnïì anaè.
English: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pol weèr Timotïì ce weèr yu ñgaâa mfaè' neè Jisos Kraêis. Weèr ce sañ neè weèe ce weèe yu beèe Nyúè aè rla' Fileèpaêi, ce weèe aè tarshi weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe, a ker ce sañ neè wee btu embe coêr, ker ba bdikïìn.
English: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

Limbum: Weèr ce loo werná Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Ta ker ba Tata Jisos Kraêis, túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: Grace to you, and peace from God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Máâ ke yoèñshi yaè Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá ce m ce kwaè'shi aèmboè weèe.
English: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

Limbum: Máâ ke loo neè weèe, ce loo neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè.
English: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all making my requests with joy,

Limbum: Máâ loo wa'a ce yoèñshi Nyúè njobeè' m ce kuushi aèmboè weèe aè koni máè aè rfaè' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ, ká' embe nfeè' ce weèe aè m byemi neè Nyúè vú gháá seè'ni na.
English: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

Limbum: M rïìñ boèñboñ máná Nyúè ce e m káè' a gee li rfaè' ce rboèñboñ ca njep weâe mntee be kuè duè kuèntombïì neè rfaè' anaè, caar duè baè' aè nfeè' ce li be keè mïì aè noèñ ce Jisoès be vúè naè.
English: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Yi boèñ ená m túr njáèá mkwaè'shïì ca kuu weèe, njobeè' m túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ. Weèe aè m koni máè aè rfaâ' rboèñboñ ce Nyúè aè m fa máè. Weèe aè m koni máè aè nfeè' ce máè m táá a ce feè'shi, a ker ce saèr Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè beèe, ker ba seè'ni ce m yu mbe shañ na.
English: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because, both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

Limbum: Nyúè rïìñ ená ya ntee yi ce luèu aè ryá weèe. Njáèá njïì ce m koèñ weèe, ku ba aèmboè Jisoès ye ye koèñ weèe naè.
English: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

Limbum: M ce loo neè weèe ená le rkoèñnïì li ku' du kuèntombïì, gee tá weèe yi buu Nyúè, keèr rïìñ jáá jáá efa yuu boèñboñ ba yuu bebep,
English: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;

Limbum: tá weèe bo co' yuu ce yi boèñ a caa mo', e keè ba aè noèñ ce Kraâis be keèr vúè naè wee mntee vi bo ba brara tá yuu yi ke' ba ce e taa weèe aègho ka'.
English: so that you may approve the things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ;

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis be geèe tá weèe túr ba ndeâe mboèñmboñ ce beèe a yá bo kuè'si Nyúè, keèr náèsi ye.
English: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce koèñ tá weèe riñ ená ñgá' ce e koni máè na aè geèe Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aè misïì a du kuèntombïì.
English: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News;

Limbum: Ñgaâa ncïìñ nto', ba beèe wááwá ce aèfa a riñ seè'ni ená m yu mbe shañ njobeè' m yu ñwáè rfaè' neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ;

Limbum: Beèe magoèr efa múè bfúr viseèe a ka' yá máè mbe shañ wa'a, Tata aè geêe, woweèe a misïì a túr ntee, a ce feè'shi Blaâa Nyúè neè ñger-ñwáè a ke' ce wáp yuu ka'.
English: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

Limbum: Weè mo' efa woweèe a feè'shi buu kuu Jisos Kraâis njobeè' a ce ko'-ndoñ neè máè, a ce roèo aè rcaèa máè, weè mo' a ce feè'shi yap ba aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

Limbum: Beèe ca a ce feè'shi njobeè' woweèe a koèñ máè. Woweèe a rïìñ ená m yu mbe shañ tá m bo tome Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ.
English: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

Limbum: Beèe mo' ca a feè'shi buu kuu Jisos Kraâis njobeè' woweèe a ce koèñ aè rba beâe bgoèrgoèr. Yuu ce woweèe a ce feè'shi yu ba yuu ce woweèe a túr njep ntee ka'. Woweèe a ku ce roèo ená mluè mi ku ce koo máè aèmboè m yu mbe shañ na.
English: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

Limbum: Yi geèe mnsa' ka'. Káè woweèe aè ce feè'shi ba aè ntee bebep áè, káè a ce geèe ba aè ntee boèñboñ áè, beèe a ce yu' aèmboè Jisos Kraêis. A yuu ce yi geèe m ku ce lu'shi.
English: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

Limbum: Neè mini-ñwáè, m be kuè ce lu'shi wa'a duè kuèntombïì, njobeè' m rïìñ máná le rloo ba rjaè' ce li loè ese Yú' Jisoès Kraâis li be geèe tá m luêñ.
English: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

Limbum: Yuu mo'sir ce m ce roèo, a ce keè' máná yi koni neè máè yi yu ená m fa keè geèe yuu ce yi be koosi máè rïìtu ka'. Yi yu ená m túr ba ntee tatap seè'ni aèmboè máè m ku túr naè aè nfeè' sïìp tá m bo kuè fa rlii rgoèr neè Jisos Kraâis neè yaè nyor. Káè m be cu nteèe áè, káè m be kwe áè, m ku ce roèo ba aè rfa rlii rgoèr neè ye.
English: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè máè, m ka' cu mbe tunshe na m ku ce láè mmir ba mbenduè Jisos Kraâis. Máè ka' kwe, ba sá' neè máè.
English: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

Limbum: Máè ka' cu mbe tunshe na m gee rfaè' ce li be jaè' beèe. Yi ka' ba wa' máè ke' riñ yïì ce m co' ka'.
English: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don't know what I will choose.

Limbum: M táá mbetar. M ce koèñ máná máè ba maè'shi tunshe duè cu weèr Jisos Kraêis. Yïì anaè yi boèñ a caa rcu embe tunshe na.
English: But I am in a dilemma between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

Limbum: Geewa'a, yi boèñ magoèr ená m cu mbe tunshe njo' weèe.
English: Yet, to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

Limbum: Máè yá máná yi boèñ wa'a. Máè rïìñ máná m be cu weèe seèe, tá m bo jaè' weèe tá weèe du kuèntombïì neè le rbyemïì, keèr ce lu'shi,
English: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith,

Limbum: máâ keèr vúè yá weèe, tá weèe bo yoèñshi Jisos Kraâis njo' máè.
English: that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

Limbum: Yuu mo'sir yi yu ená yeè ndeèe ba le rcu li ku ba yáánïì aèmboè Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ Jisoès ce roèo ená li ba, ka' máè ka' vú yá weèe, káè máè vúè ka' áè, m bo kuè yu' máná weèe táá tatap, a túr rkwaè'shïû rmo'sir, a ker ce reè neè ntee mo'sir tá Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce weèe aè byemi aègho bo duè kuèntombïì.
English: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that, whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

Limbum: Weèe ka' tá ce wáp ye ñgaâa bbaèa ka', ca yi be ba ncoâo nrara neè woweèe ená woweèe a be kwe, bú, keèr duèñshi ená Nyúè be geèe tá weèe luêñ.
English: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

Limbum: Nyúè aè fa weèe njïì ená weèe fa kuè byemi neè Jisos Kraâis byemi ka', e fa ená weèe yá ñgá' a yeâ tuè foñ.
English: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

Limbum: E geèe ená wee weèe niñ njep múè bkoèr ce weèe aè m yá máè ce reè, a ker ce yu' seè'ni ená m ku bii reè na.
English: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear is in me.
