Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ená weèe aè tarshi weèe Kraâis weèe. Mboè rtarshïì anaè li geèe weèe aè túr ñger a? Mboè ntee yi fúte weèe njobeè' Kraâis koèñ weèe a? Mboè weèe yu aèbee weèe Yú' Rara weèe a? Mboè weèe túr mntee bboèñboñ a ce koosimnse aègho a?
English: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

Limbum: Baná weèe kwa'shi yuu yi mo'sir, koñni a weâe mú, túr cuâu mo'sir; wee geèe wa' naè, m bo mïìsi lu'shi.
English: make my joy full, by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

Limbum: Weèe fa geèe yuu njo' ñwáè ce roèo aè rcaèa ñwáè ka', káè njo' ñwáè ce koèñ aè rnaèa nyor ka'. Ñwáè wááwá lor yi tu njep nsheè, yá ená ñwáè moè' aè caèa ye.
English: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

Limbum: Ñwáè fa kuè ce kwaè'shi ba aèmboè yi tu ka', ñwáè wááwá kwa'shi aèmboè beèe mo' foñ.
English: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

Limbum: Yeè ndeèe aè ba ba aèmbo yïì Jisos Kraêis.
English: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

Limbum: E m ba aèmboè Nyúè yu naè, a ka' ba wa'a, a ke' ce gheèter ená e be kuè cu aèmboè Nyúè yu naè ka'.
English: who, existing in the form of God, didn't consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

Limbum: E m maè'shi nta' goèr ca, a lor yi tu njep nsheè a ba aèmboè ñkwaèa wa'a. A m bi ye aè ñwáè.
English: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

Limbum: E ka' ba ñwáè wa'a, a ker lor yi tu njep nsheè a yu'ni neè Nyúè a byemi aè rkwe; a ka' kwe a kwe ba rkwe ce embe kïìntaa.
English: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, yes, the death of the cross.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce Nyúè aè naèa ye mbekïì, a fa ye rlii ce li caèa mlii wááwá,
English: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name;

Limbum: ená buu wááwá ba beèe wááwá ce a yu mbe buèu, a ker ba mbe tunshe, ker ba beèe ce a yu mbaè yir a yu' rlii Jisoès bo gú'shi,
English: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

Limbum: suñ ená Jisos Kraâis yu Taèr, tá bkuè'sïì vi ba neè Nyúè Taèr.
English: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

Limbum: Bkar waê, baná yi boèñ ená weèe yu'ni neè máè seè'ni ce m yu njïìsaèp na, yu'ni neè caa aèmboè weèe aè m ce yu'ni neè máè aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m ba naè. Weèe ku ce fa', ce kañ neè rwáp-ñwáè tá weèe bo mïìsi koni rluèñ.
English: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

Limbum: Yu Nyúè ce e ce faè' njep weâe mntee, a ce geèe ená weèe koñ aè rgeèe yuu ce e ce roèo, aè ker ba ye ce e ce fa weèe ñger aè rgeèe yuu anaè.
English: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.

Limbum: Weèe ka' ce geèe ka' njáèá ká, weèe fa ce rúèúrú ka',
English: Do all things without murmurings and disputes,

Limbum: faè dïì' yuu yi bo ba ce a taa weèe aètu mo ka', tá wee mntee vi ba brara. Geèe neè wa'a tá weèe bo ba boo Nyúè ce a túr faèa ka', a ce cu aè múè ñgaâa bsaèrbuu, a ce raa aè waâp mú aèmboè mkaèñsïì wa'a.
English: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

Limbum: Weèe ce gee tá woweèe a yu' nsuñ ce e yu aèmboè ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Weèe gee wa'a tá m bo koni yuu ce m naatu aègho, aè noèñ ce Kraâis aè vúè, faè dïì' yi bo keè ba ená máè m yú nyor aè cicïì ka'.
English: holding up the word of life; that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn't run in vain nor labor in vain.

Limbum: Yuu ce weèe aè m geèe njo' le rbyemïû neè Jisos Kraâis yi yu aèmboè tañshïì ce weèe aè geèe neè Nyúè. Máè ka' ba kwe, wa bláá vi misïì tañshïì anaè, m ku ce lu'shi lu'shi.
English: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.

Limbum: Wee weèe ce lu'shi, tá seèe lu'shi bsïìp.
English: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.

Limbum: Tata Jisoès aè ka' byemi, baná m be tuu Timotïì nfeè' múcaèr, tá e vú yá weèe, e kúti suñ máè nsuñ aèmboè weèe tá má máè bo lu'shi.
English: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ker ba ce e túr weèe njep ntee aèmboè máè, caa efa Timotïì ka'.
English: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a ku ce kwaè'shi ba aèmboè wap btu, a ke' ce kwaè'shi aèmboè yuu ce Jisoès ce roèo ka'.
English: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè Timotïì, weèe ku riñ yïì ndeèe. Weèe rïìñ ená e faè' weèr ye aèmboè muu e ke faè' a yïì ta naè, aè rgeèe ená Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ du kuèntombïì.
English: But you know the proof of him, that, as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce ke' máná a ka' teni mnsa' m riñ aèmboè buu yu, m ka' tuu ye tá e vú yá weèe.
English: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

Limbum: M rïìñ máná nfeè' múcaèr tá Tata ma'shi tá má máè vú yá weèe.
English: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

Limbum: Máè yá máná yi yu boèñboñ ená m tuu nfúr yïìseèe ce ÁÈpafroèditoès tá e kúti vúè yá weèe. E yu ñwáè ce weèr ye ce faè' aèbee, a ce maè' bïìr Nyúè aèbee. E yu foñ ñwáè ntuu ce weèe aè m tuu ená e vú ja' máè.
English: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need;

Limbum: Cuèu yi ce luèu ye aè ryá weèe, mluè mi ce koo ye njobeè' e rïìñ ená weèe aè yu' yi yañ.
English: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled, because you had heard that he was sick.

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená e m yañ, a ku táá yïû ñkwe, Nyúè aè ke' byemïì ka'. Nyúè aè ka' kani wa'a, a koosi ba mnse neè ye, a koosi neè máè foñ, njobeè' e m ba kwe kwe, yaè ñgá' aè ba báèr.
English: For indeed he was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce koèñ ená m tuu ye tá e vú yá weèe, tá weèe bo lu'shi aè ryá ye tá ntee yi bo fúte máè foñ.
English: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

Limbum: Koni neè ye boèñboñ neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè aèmboè nfúr weèe ce weèe woweèe yu aèbee weèe Tata Jisoès weèe. Yi boèñ ená weèe gú'shi neè njáèá ñwáè aèmboè ye anaè.
English: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,

Limbum: AÈ m bár múcaèr e m ba kwe njo' rfaè' ce e m ce geèe neè Jisos Kraêis. E m tami nyor aè rkwe tá e bo jaè' máè a weâe btuè.
English: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

Limbum: Baná aè rmïìsïì, bfúr waê, weèe lu'shi njobeè' weèe yu weèe Tata weèe. Yi geèe mnsa' neè máè aè ker sañ buu ca neè weèe ka'. Buu anaè be jaè' weèe tá weèe ke' bo lá'ti ka'.
English: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

Limbum: Loèr neè nfeè' weèe beèe ce a yu aèmboè ñgwe. Loèr neè nfeè' weèe beâe bbebep ca weèe. Weèe lor nfeè' weèe woweèe ce a ce yá'ni ená ñwáè wááwá túr aè rgeèe búè ka' ba ñwáè Nyúè naè.
English: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the false circumcision.

Limbum: Yu ba seèe ce seèe aè geèe búè ce mini, njobeè' seèe ce loo neè Nyúè aèmboè Yú' Rara yi ce roèo, a ce lu'shi aè rcu ce seèe Jisoès weèe ce cu, a ke' ce láè yiseèe ntee aè buu ce aè nyoèr ka'.
English: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

Limbum: Máè ba ce koèñ aè rláè ntee aè buu ce aè nyoèr, máè ba láè. Ñwáè moè' ka' ce kwaè' ená e túr yuu ce aède' yi gee ená e lá ntee aè njáèá buu anaè, m túr buu anaè a caa ye.
English: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

Limbum: A m bi máè aè ñwáè Isráèl mbe ntáè' Bánjamáèn, yaè ta ba yaè ma a ba beèe Hibruès ce mini, máè ka' baè' ñgaèa moè'sir, a gee máè búè. AÈ ka' ba aèmboè mncir ce a láè, máè m ba ñwáè Farïìsïî.
English: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè buu Nyúè ce Jus a byemi aègho, máè m faè' neè ya ntee wááwá aè rfa ñgá' neè ñgaâa coêr. Baná aèmboè mncir Jus anaè vi yu, máè m bú' mo' ka'.
English: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

Limbum: Káè yu ba njáèá sá' ká ce máè m túr enjep múè buu anaè áè, máè yá seè'ni máná buu anaè wááwá vi m ce búsi máè búsi, a ma'shi vi wááwá tá m bo duè ba aèmbuèu Jisos Kraêis.
English: However, what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ.

Limbum: AÈ ke' ku ba cena caè' ka', máè loèr buu wááwá aè buu ce vi ce búsi máè búsi, a ma' vi wááwá tá m bo yi yaè Tata Jisos Kraêis, njobeè' yïì anaè a yuu ce yi yu goèr a caa buu wááwá. Máè búsi buu wááwá njo' ye. Máè loèr vi seè'ni aè buu bcicïì tá m bo ba aèbee weèr Kraêis,
English: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

Limbum: ba yïì ñwáè, ba yáánïì njobeè' máè byemi neè ye, ke' ba njobeè' máè láè mncir ka'. Yu Nyúè ce e ke geèe ñwáè ba yáánïì njo' e byemi.
English: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith;

Limbum: Yuu mo'sir ce m ce roèo yi yu ená m riñ Kraêis, ker yá yi ñger ce e m túr aè nfeè' ce e m fúú efa rkwe. M ce roèo foñ máná m yá ñgá' aèmboè e m yá, byemi rkwe aèmboè e m byemi,
English: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death;

Limbum: tá yi ka' ba aètáèr Nyúè bo fúr máè efa rkwe, fa máè ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

Limbum: Yi yu ba ená máè koni yuu ce máè ce roèo aè rkonïì naè ka', a ke' ba ená máè buu faèa dúèdúè ka'. M ku bii gheèter ce duè kuèntombïì máná m bo koni yuu anaè, ce yu yuu ce Jisos Kraâis aè koo máè mba yeâ boè aètu mo.
English: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, if it is so that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce kwaè' máná máè be koni yuu anaè ka', yuu mo'sir yi yu ená máè maè'shi buu ce vi m caèa, a ce duè ba aèmbuèu yuu ce yi bii kuèntombïì.
English: Brothers, I don't regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,

Limbum: M ce faè' ce duè kuèntombïì máná m bo duè koni blaè' embe buèu ce Nyúè aè ká' máè ená e bo fa máè njo' yuu ce Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe.
English: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Yi boèñ ená seèe ce seèe yu bleebeèe aè buu Nyúè seèe túr njáèá mkwaè'shïì ca. Yuu mo' yi ka' ba aègho ce weèe ce kwaè'shi jáá baná Nyúè be naèshi yuu anaè neè weèe.
English: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

Limbum: Yi ba ená seèe ku ce jár seè'ni ba njep mkuèu ce seèe ce jáèshi njo na.
English: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule. Let us be of the same mind.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe wááwá ce be'ni ba yuu ce m ce geèe. Weèr aè duèñshi ndeâe mboèñmboñ. Weèe be'ni yuu ce beèe ce a beè'ni yeèr ndeèe anaè, a ce geèe.
English: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

Limbum: Máè suñ weèe nfeè' aèñgoo, a ker ce suñ weèe seè'ni neè mñgoommir-ñwáè máná beèe magoèr a yu a weâe mú ce yaèp ndeèe ce duèñshi ená woweèe a baèa rkwe ce Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe mbe kïìntaa naè.
English: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

Limbum: Woweèe a be kwe, bú njobeè' woweèe a koèñ buu ce aè nyoèr a caa Nyúè. A loèr yuu ce rïìtu yi ba koo woweèe aètu mo a beesi aè yuu naèatu, a lá yap ntee wááwá ba njep buu embe tunshe.
English: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè seèe, liseèe rla' li yu ba mbe buèu mbe dïì' ce seèe ce keè' seená yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis be vúè embo, geèe tá seèe luêñ.
English: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;

Limbum: E be vúè beèesi bjaèprïì nyor viseèe ca tá vi ba aèmboè ku' yïì nyor mboèñmboñ ce e m túr aè nfeè' ce e m fúú efa rkwe naè. Ñger ce e be geèe yuu ca aègho ku ba ñger ce aède' e loêr, beesi buu wááwá ce aè ñgoèñ na tá vi ba njep yeâ tïìi.
English: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

Limbum: Baná weèe ku táá tatap weèe Tata weèe, bfúr waê. M koèñ weèe magoèr seê, bkar waê. Ya ntee yi ce luèu máè aè ryá weèe. Yu weèe ce weèe ce geèe m ce lu'shi, a ce naèa tu neè weèe.
English: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

Limbum: M ce loo neè ÁÈvodïìyaè ba Sïìntikáè máná woweèe a ba tarte, ba cuâu mo'sir njobeè' woweèe a tarshi a Tata weèe.
English: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

Limbum: Kyer wáè Sisiguès ce aè yu mini aè rfaè' ce soè ce faè' aèbee, jaè' bbyeèñge ca, njobeè' weèr woweèe aè m ce reè aèbee tá m bo feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè beèe. Kláâmáèn ye ye aè m ce reè weèr ye, ker ba beèe mo' ce a m ce faè' weèr woweèe naè; mlii beèe anaè mi yu mbe ñwaè' Ryoèñ.
English: Yes, I beg you also, true yokefellow, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

Limbum: Weèe ce lu'shi nfeè' sïìp njobeè' weèe yu weèe Tata weèe; m ker ce laèa máná weèe lu'shi.
English: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, Rejoice!

Limbum: Weèe gee buu wááwá aè nduunjïì ce ñwáè wááwá bo yá ená weèe yu neè rbornïì-ñwáè. Kuushi neè ená nfeè' múcaèr tá Tata vúê.
English: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

Limbum: Weèe fa bu' ka'. Yuu yi ka' buu weèe, weèe loo yi ese Nyúè ker yoñshi ye aètu mo.
English: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' gee wa'a, Nyúè fa weèe rfúteè ce li caèa bfee ñwáè, ba rfúteè ce li be ba njep weâe mntee ba njep weâe mkwaè'shïì njobeè' weèe yu aèbee weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe.
English: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Baná aè rmïìsïì, bfúr waê, weèe ce kwa'shi aèmboè buu wááwá ce vi yu bboèñboñ, a ghááte aè buu ce aède' beèe a násïì. Buu anaè yu buu ce vi yu mini, buu ce vi yu neè foèo-ñwáè, ce vi yu kuèyáá a ba brara, buu ce aède' beèe a koêñ, buu ce vi ce keè' bboèñboñ.
English: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.

Limbum: Geèe neè buu wááwá ce weèe aè yá'ni ese máè, a koo ese máè, a yu' ese máè, a ker yá ese máè tá Nyúè ce e yu ñwáè cumúnyañ bo ba weèe woweèe.
English: The things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me: do these things, and the God of peace will be with you.

Limbum: M ce lu'shi magoèr aèmboè ñwáè Tataê, njobeè' máè yá ená weèe aè ker kuushi a ja' máè aèmboè weèe aè m ce jaè' entoèmbïì naè. Weèe aè m ku ce ne kuushi máè, a ka' buu ba njïì aè rjaè' máè.
English: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

Limbum: Ke' ba ená m ce laèa njobeè' yuu mo' yi buu máè ka'; máè lááte aè rcu, mú yïì ce máè túr yi ghááteè máè.
English: Not that I speak in respect to lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ yuu ce m gee aè nfeè' ce buu vi gha' máè, a riñ yuu ce m gee aè nfeè' ce máè túr buu goèr. Máè lááte aè buu anaè wááwá, a tami nyor, ka' aè se'ká, káè máè ye áè, káè máè ye ka' áè; káè máè túr áè, káè máè túr ka' áè!
English: I know how to be humbled, and I know also how to abound. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

Limbum: AÈde' m gee buu wááwá, ce ñwáè ce e ke fa máè ñger aè ka' táá mbe máâ njïì.
English: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

Limbum: Máè ka' laa aèmboè máè laèa na, m ku riñ máná weèe aè geèe yáánïì seê, aè rjaè' máè seè'ni ce m yu aè ñgá' na.
English: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

Limbum: Weèe ce beâe aè rla' Fileèpaêi, weèe ku riñ yáánïì ená aè m ba aè nfeè' ce máè m naètïû aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè a ká' a ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ naè, cor moè' aè m ker ba ce weèr woweèe aè m ce tarte mmbo ker caa efa weèe ka'.
English: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

Limbum: Káâ' aè nfeè' ce máè m ba aè rla' Táèsaèlonikaè weèe aè m tuusi buu a ja' máè aègho bkaèñ aèñgoo.
English: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

Limbum: Yu ba buu ce weèe aè m tuusi ce m ce loèr aè yuu goèr ka'. Yuu ce m ce loèr aè yuu goèr yu ba ku' sá' ce weèe be túr njo' buu anaè.
English: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

Limbum: M ker buu yuu seè'ni ka', m túr buu vi ce gha' máè gha'. M túr buu wááwá seè'ni njobeè' máè koo buu ce weèe a m tuusi neè máè mbe bo ÁÈpafroèditoès. Buu anaè yu aèmboè njáèá yuu mo' ce yi ce rúèú boèñboñ, a ba aèmboè tañshïì ce Nyúè aè koèñ, a byemi.
English: But I have all things, and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e túr ku' buu bboèñboñ be fa weèe buu wááwá ce weèe buu. E be caèasi buu anaè mbe bo Jisos Kraêis.
English: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Bkuè'sïì vi ba neè Nyúè ce yïìseèe ta seè'ni ba aè nfeè' sïìp. Yi yu wa'a.
English: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè ñwáè wááwá ce e yu aèbee a Jisos Kraêis. Bfúr ce a yu weèr woweèe aèfa a caè'ni weèe.
English: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

Limbum: Beèe Nyúè ce aèfa wááwá a caè'ni weèe, lañlañ beèe ce a ce faè' mbe ndaèp Sisaè.
English: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar's household.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Jisos Kraâis túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pol ce Nyúè aè ce máè ená m ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. M ce sañ ñwaè' ca weèr Timotïì ce e yu nfúr yïìseèe.
English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

Limbum: Weèr ce sañ neè weèe ce weèe yu beèe ce Nyúè aè ce, a ce cu aè rla' Koèlosïì, weèe Jisoès weèe aè ba aèbee, weèe aè ce duè a yeâ mbuèu neè ntee mo'sir. Weèr ce loo neè Nyúè ce e yu yeèr ta ená e túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: E ke ba aè nfeè' wááwá ce weèr ce loo neè weèe, weèr ce yoèñshi Nyúè ce e yu Taèr neè yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis,
English: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

Limbum: njobeè' weèr aè yu' ená weèe aè láè ntee neè Jisos Kraêis, a ker koñ beèe Nyúè wááwá.
English: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

Limbum: Weèr aè rïìñ ená weèe aè túr njáèá ntee ca njobeè' weèe ce keè' ba buu ce Nyúè aè kupshi a lá neè weèe mbe buèu. AÈ m ba njobeè' nsuñ mboèñmboñ ce e yu mini ce a m feè'shi, weèe aè ka' riñ aèmboè buu ca.
English: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,

Limbum: Nsuñ anaè aè baè' aè bdïì' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na. E geèe beèe a ce kupse yap ñgeâe bebep a ce geèe ba ñgeâe boèñboñ. Beèe magoèr se a ce byemi nsuñ ca. Nsuñ ca aè geèe weèe aè ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ foñ káâ' aè noèñ ce weèe aè m káè' yu', a riñ neè mini-ñwáè ená Nyúè túr ntee boèñboñ neè beâe bbebep.
English: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;

Limbum: Weèe aè m yu' nsuñ mboèñmboñ anaè ese ÁÈpafraès ce e yu ñwáè rfaè' neè Jisos Kraâis aèmboè weèr. Weèr koèñ ye seê. E yu weèe woweèe wa'a, a táá ba a weâr tuè, a ce faè' neè Jisos Kraâis neè nteâe mo'sir.
English: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,

Limbum: E suñ weèr aèmboè njáèá njïì ce weèe koèñ beèe neè rkoèñnïì ce li loè ese Yú' Nyúè.
English: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce káâ' aè noèñ ce weèr aè m yu' buu ca, weèr aè be borni efa rloo neè weèe aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Weèr ce loo neè Nyúè ená e gee tá weèe koni bfee ce vi loè ese yi Yú', rïìñ buu ce yu vi wááwá, tá weèe bo rïìñ buu ce e koèñ boèñboñ.
English: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don't cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' riñ wa'a, baná weèe be túr ndeèe ce beèe Tata Jisoès a ba túr, geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá, keèr rïìñ buu ce yu vi Nyúè goèr.
English: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

Limbum: Weèr ce loo foñ ená Nyúè lor yi ñger ce yi caèa buu wááwá gee tá weèe túr ntee tatap, ka' aè ka' ba ba ká, tá weèe bo kur ntee, táá tatap keèr ce lu'shi,
English: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;

Limbum: ce yoñshi Nyúè Taèr ce e yu yïìseèe ta aè nfeè' wááwá. Yu ye ce e geèe weèe aè ghááteè aè rkoni ñgúè' moè' efa buu ce e kupshi a lá neè yïì beèe mbe dïû' kúú ce yu dïû' rraa.
English: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;

Limbum: E fúr seèe efa túè'njïì, a lor seèe a lá ba aè dïì' ce muu yïì ce e koèñ se naè ce sa' aèmboè ñkúú.
English: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;

Limbum: Muu yïì anaè a ñwáè ce e geèe Nyúè aè foosïì yïìseèe buu bbebep, a tee seèe efa ñgá'.
English: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins;

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m be yá Nyúè neè mmir ka'. Muu yïì ce beèe a yá neè mmir, a ñwáè ce e geèe seèe aè riñ njáèá ñwáè ce Nyúè yu. E yu entoèmbïì neè buu wááwá ce Nyúè aè m geèe.
English: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe buu wááwá njïì enjep ye, káè yu buu embe buèu áè, káè yu vïì enjep ñgoèñ áè, káè yu buu ce aède' beèe a yá áè, káè yu buu ce aède' beèe a yá ka' áè, buu ca wááwá yu aègho njo' Jisos Kraêis. Ka' byú' njáèá jáá jáèá jáá ce vi túr ñger áè, Nyúè aè m geèe buu ca wááwá neè muu yïì, njïì enjep muu yïì anaè.
English: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce yuu mo' yi m be ba ka', muu anaè aè ku ba. Buu wááwá yu aèmboè vi ba ba njo' ye.
English: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

Limbum: E yu tu neè coêr. Cor anaè aè ba yïì nyor. Ñwáè ce e m káè' cor aè m káè' ye njobeè' e m ba ñwáè entombïì aè rfúú efa rkwe neè nyor ce aède' e ker kwe ka'. Buu ca yu wa'a tá e bo ba ñwáè ce e táá kuèntombïì neè buu wááwá.
English: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe ená buu ca ba wa'a njobeè' e m koèñ ená muu yïì ba yáánïì aèmboè ye ye yu naè aè buu wááwá.
English: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;

Limbum: E m koèñ ená buu wááwá ce e m geèe káè yu vïì embe buèu áè, káè yu vïì enjep ñgoèñ áè, a kúti aèbee njïì enjep muu yïì. AÈ ka' ba njo' rkwe ce muu yïì anaè aè m kwe mbe kïìntaa, Nyúè aè gee buu enjep ñgoèñ ba vïì embe buèu, vi kútïì bkar a ye, a cu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' weèe aè ba aènjïìsaèp ese Nyúè, a ba ñgaâa bbaèa neè ye, njobeè' weèe aè m ce kwaè'shi buu bbebep, a ce geèe buu bbebep.
English: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil works,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' e seè'ni Nyúè aè gee weèe woweèe aè kútïì bkar njo' rkwe ce muu yïì ce e m ba ñwáè aè m kwe a seâe tuè naè. Nyúè aè m geèe wa'a, tá e bo tár weèe a yeâ bsii aèmboè yïì beèe ce a yu brara, a túr faèa ka'.
English: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and blameless before him,

Limbum: Weèe be táá aè bsii Nyúè wa'a, ce weèe ka' ku lá ntee neè Jisos kraâis aè nfeè' wááwá, táá tatap keè' ce cïì'ti ka', kuè ce keè' ba buu ce beèe ce a m feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca neè weèe a m suñ weèe ená weèe be koni naè. Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca yu ba nsuñ ce a feè'shi neè beèe wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na. Rfaè' ce má máâ Pol ce geèe foñ li yu ená m suñ Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca neè beèe.
English: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

Limbum: AÈmboè m ce yá ñgá' a weâe btuè seè'ni na, m ce lu'shi. M ce yá ñgá' aèmboè Jisos Kraâis aè m yá aètu cor ce e yu yïì nyor naè. M ce yá ñgá' ca wa'a, ryañ ce m ce yu' li ce mïìsi ñgá' ce Jisoès aè m yá, e bátïì naè.
English: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the assembly;

Limbum: La rfaè' li yu ená m fa' neè coêr. Nyúè a ñwáè ce e fa rfaè' ca mba máâ mmboè tá m bo jaè' weèe. Yu ya dïì' ená m gee tá beèe a riñ Nsuñ Nyúè boèñboñ.
English: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,

Limbum: A m súèti nsuñ anaè ese beèe wááwá. AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' e seè'ni, Nyúè aè gee yïì beèe a rïîñ.
English: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

Limbum: Nyúè aè m koèñ ená e gee tá yïì beèe a yá ená rboèñ efa nsuñ ce e caèa buu wááwá na li yu neè beèe enje jáá foñ. Nsuñ ce e geèe seèe aè riñ na yu ená Jisos Kraâis yu njep weâe mntee, yi ka' ba wa'a, weèe aè riñ ená weèe be koni ñgúè' moè' efa foèo Nyúè.
English: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;

Limbum: Weèr ce suñ ñwáè wááwá aèmboè Jisoès ca. Weèr ce báá ñwáè wááwá, a ker ce loèr bfee ce Nyúè aè fa weèr a ce yá'ni beèe aèmboè Jisos Kraâis tá ñwáè wááwá ce e yu aèbee a Jisoès bo ba aèmboè Nyúè ce koèñ ená e ba ba.
English: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce gheèter, a ce faè' neè ñger wááwá ce Jisos Kraâis aè fa máè tá m bo mïìsi li rfaè' aègho.
English: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

Limbum: M ce koèñ máná weèe riñ aèmboè m ce gheèter neè weèe, ker ba beâe aè rla' Laèodisïìyaè ker ba beèe wááwá ce weèr woweèe aè m be tarte ka'.
English: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

Limbum: Máè koèñ ená wee mntee vi ba btatap tá weèe koñ bfúr wee, ba aèbee weèe woweèe. M ce koèñ máná yuu ce yi m ba aè bsúèti, Nyúè aè gee seèe aè riñ naè, yi ba rara neè weèe tá weèe bo rïìñ yi boèñboñ. Yuu ce yi m ba aè bsúèti anaè yu nsuñ aèmboè Jisos Kraêis.
English: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e geèe seèe aè túr bfee bboèñboñ ku ba Jisoès caè'caè'. Njáèá bfee ca vi túr sá' seê.
English: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.

Limbum: M ce suñ weèe buu ca faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo bo' wee neè cuèu ka'.
English: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

Limbum: Ka' m yu aènjïìsaèp wa'a, seèe ku ba aèbee enjep ntee. M ce lu'shi njobeè' máè yu' máná weèe yu aèbee, a ku táá tatap aè rbyemïì ce weèe aè m byemi neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

Limbum: Weèe aè byemi Jisos Kraâis aèmboè ye Tataê, baná weèe ce gee ba ñgeèe ce beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Jisos Kraâis a ba ce geèe.
English: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

Limbum: Taa neè mñgaèñ njep ye, ku' njep ye, táá tatap aè rbyemïì ce a m yá'ni weèe naè, ker ce yoñshi Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

Limbum: Loèr neè nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo' weèe neè bfee enjep ñgoèñ na, koo weèe aè bkwaèa ka'. Ndeèe to' ker ba mncir ce byú' bebep vi láè, a buu ce vi vúè neè njáèá bfee ca. Ñwáè ce e fa beèe njáèá bfee ca aè fa Jisos Kraâis ka'.
English: Be careful that you don't let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

Limbum: Rïìñ neè ená Jisos Kraâis ce e yu ñwáè, yu yáánïì a Nyúè aè buu wááwá.
English: For in him all the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily,

Limbum: Rïìñ neè ená weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe ka' ba aèbee, weèe túr buu wááwá njobeè' e yu tu neè byú' wááwá ce vi túr ñger.
English: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè m ba aèbee naè, Nyúè aè fa weèe njáèá ncoèo moè' ce e ce duèñshi ená weèe yu yïì beèe. Ncoèo anaè yu ba búè ce a geèe neè mmbo aèmboè Jus a ce geèe naè ka', yu ba njáèá ncoèo yïì Jisos Kraêis. Njáèá ncoèo ca yu ba ncoèo enjep ntee, ce e yu ená weèe bii geèe buu bbebep aèmboè weèe aè m ce geèe naè ka'.
English: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce a m baèptir weèe, yi duñshïì ená a tuñ weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aèbee. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè foñ Nyúè aè fúr weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe efa rkwe. E m geèe wa'a njobeè' weèe aè m byemi ená Nyúè ce e m fúr Jisos Kraâis efa rkwe, túr ñger aè rfúr weèe efa rkwe foñ.
English: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' entombïì weèe aè ba aèmboè bgúâú beèe wa'a, njobeè' weèe aè m ce geèe buu bbebep, a ke' túr ncoèo ce yu ba ncoèo beèe Nyúè ka'. Seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè ka' ba aèbee, Nyúè aè foosïì seèe efa yïìseèe buu bbebep wááwá, a gee seèe aè kútïì bteèe seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe.
English: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

Limbum: Seèe aè m bú' mncir Nyúè, seèe Nyúè weèe aè túr mnsa', Nyúè aè ca'sïì buu bbebep ca embe seâe tuè. E m caè'si wa'a, yi ba seè'ni ená e láè mbe tu Jisoès aè nfeè' ce a m taa ye mbe kïìntaa naè.
English: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis aè m kwe mbe kïìntaa wa'a, a so byú' bbebep wááwá ce vi túr ñger, a duñshi neè beèe rara se ená e túr ñger a caa byú' ca.
English: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

Limbum: AÈmboè buu ca yu wa'a, fa maè'shi neè tá ñwáè moè' gee mncir neè weèe aèmboè buu ce aède' weèe ye, ker ba buu ce aède' weèe no ka'. Fa maè'shi neè foñ tá ñwáè moè' gee mncir neè weèe aèmboè njáèá njïì ce aède' weèe gee mñkaè' ka', káè yu ñkaè' enjep feè' áè, káè yu Ñkaâ' ñwáá fi áè, káè yu Ñkaâ' mmbomntaa áè.
English: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

Limbum: Buu ca vi m ba aèmboè rleèñshi ce li m ce duèñshi beèe yuu ce yi be keè ba. Yuu ce buu ca vi m ce duèñshi anaè aè ba Jisos Kraêis.
English: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ's.

Limbum: Fa yu'shi yuu ce beèe mo' a ce laèa ená weèe lor wee mnyor njep nsheè, a ker ce laèa ená weèe gú'shi neè bcïìndap Nyúè naè ka'. Woweèe a ce laèa wa'a, a ce bepsi weèe bepsi. Njáèá beèe anaè a ce laèa ená Nyúè aè geèe woweèe a yá rlo. Woweèe a laèa wa'a, a ce naèa ba tu aè cicïì, bfee wap aè ba bfee enjep ñgoèñ na.
English: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

Limbum: Cena yi ce duèñshi ená woweèe ker ba Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yiseèe tu, a yu aèbee ka'. Ku ba ba beèe ce a yu aèbee a Jisos Kraâis weèe, ce a yu aèbee aè nyor moè'sir, a koni byee, a ce kuè' aèmboè Nyúè ce koèñ.
English: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God's growth.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe rïìñ wáá ená weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe aè kwe aèbee, baná byú' bbebep enjep ñgoèñ na vi ker túr ñger mbe weâe nduè ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèe aè ce láè mncir ce beèe a laèa ená weèe lá njoká?
English: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

Limbum: Woweèe a ce laèa neè weèe enáê, “Weèe fa geèe cena ka', weèe fa ye cena ka', weèe fa joèo cena ka'.”
English: Don't handle, nor taste, nor touch

Limbum: Mncir ca aè láè ba beèe, a lá ba aè buu ce vi be cu nfeseè ka'.
English: all of which perish with use, according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

Limbum: Njáèá mncir ca vi loè gee beèe a yu'nïì aègho, lor wap mnyor njep nsheè ker fa ñgá' neè yaèp nyor. E ba aè nfeè' ce beèe a káè' ce láè mncir anaè yi yáátïì aèmboè vi geèe beèe a túr lá bfee wa'a, vi banïì túr ñger aè rjaè' ñwáè tá e borni yuu ce yïì nyor ce koèñ ená e gee ka'.
English: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren't of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ená Nyúè aè gee weèe aè fúú efa rkwe weèe Jisoès Kraâis weèe, baná weèe lá ntee ba aè buu embe buèu, mbe dïì' Jisos Kraâis yu, a cu aè rkoo maè' Nyúè.
English: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

Limbum: Kuè ce kwa'shi neè ba aèmboè buu embe buèu, ke' ba aèmboè buu enjep ñgoèñ ka'.
English: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

Limbum: Weèe kwa'shi wa'a njobeè' weèe aè m kwe, le ryoèñ li ba njep Jisos Kraâis ce e yu a Nyúè, Nyúè aè kupshïì ryoèñ anaè a lá neè weèe.
English: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

Limbum: Le ryoèñ yu Jisos Kraêis. Be keè ba aè nfeè' ce e nyáá, tá weèe woweèe ba aèbee, tá weèe túr ñgúè' moè' efa foèo ce Nyúè aè fa neè ye.
English: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

Limbum: Baná weèe borni njáèá buu ce weèe aè m ce geèe aè nfeè' weèe aè m ce cu ba rcu enjep ñgoèñ na naè. Loèr neè buu anaè aèmboè buu ce vi kwe wa'a. Maè'shi neè bsaèkïì ba mká'ni, borni ñgeâe bebep wááwá, ba mkwaè'shïû mmbembep. Fa baèñ mmir aè buu ka', njobeè' aè ka' ce baèñ mmir aè buu baná wáè loèr buu anaè aèmboè yu Nyúè wa'a.
English: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

Limbum: Njáèá buu bbebep ca vi geèe Nyúè ce ko'si rshentee neè beèe.
English: for which things' sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' entombïì weèe aè ce geèe njáèá ñgeèe ca, njáèá mkwaè'shïì aè rgeèe buu ca mi túr ñger mbe weâe nduè.
English: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni ce weèe Jisos Kraâis weèe yu aèbee na, baná weèe borni ñgeâe bebep. Fa ba ñwáè rshentee káè ñwáè ncápntee ka'. Fa kwaè'shi bebep aèmboè ñwáè moè' ka'. Fa ba ñwáè mnsa'ni ka'. Fa maè'shi tá blaâa bbebep vi fúú eku wáâ cuèu ka'.
English: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

Limbum: Fa nya' neè mnde' neè ñwáè moè' ka', njobeè' weèe aè maè' ye ñgeâe rúèú ce weèe aè m ce geèe naè,
English: Don't lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

Limbum: a lor seè'ni ba ñgeâe fi. Nyúè ce e m boo weèe aè beâe bfi ca ce kupshi ye ñgeèe ca tá yi bo ba aèmboè ñgeèe yi, tá weèe bo rïìñ ye boèñboñ.
English: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

Limbum: AÈ ka ba njobeè' weèe aè túr ba ñgeâe fi seè'ni na, jáá jáèá jáá ker ba fa weâe mú ka'. Jus a yu jáá efa beèe enje jáá ka'. Beèe ce a geèe búè a yu jáá efa beèe ce a yu mbáè'nsúèr ka'. Ñwáâ aè rïìñ yu jáá ka'. Nfuu bkaè' a yu jáá ka. Jáá jáèá jáá yu aègho mbetar bkwaèa ba boo ka'. Woweèe wááwá a ku ba byáánïì njobeè' a ce yá seè'ni ba Jisos Kraêis, aè ba ye ce e túr beèe wááwá.
English: where there can't be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ce weèe ená weèe ba yïì beèe. E koèñ weèe seê. Baná weèe gee ba ñgeèe ce yi duèñshi ená weèe yu yïì beèe. Ce koosi neè mnse neè beèe mo', gee ñgeâe boèñboñ neè woweèe. Loèr neè wee mnyor njep nsheè, ba neè rbonïì- ñwáè, ker kur ntee.
English: Put on therefore, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

Limbum: Fa bepsi neè ntee cárcár ka'. Ñwáè moè' ka' gee yuu bebep neè weèe, weèe foosïì ye. Tata Jisoès aè foèosi weèe efa yeè buu bbebep, baná weèe foosi beèe mo' foñ.
English: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi yu lulu seê, yi yu ená weèe koñ beèe, njobeè' rkoèñnïì a yuu ce yi kur buu ca wááwá aèbee, tá weèe bo ba aèmboè Nyúè ce koèñ ená weèe ba.
English: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

Limbum: Yá neè ená cumúnyañ ce e loè ese Jisos Kraâis ba njep weâe mntee aè buu wááwá ce weèe ce geèe, njobeè' Nyúè aè ká' weèe ená weèe ba aèbee aèmboè ñwáè moè'sir, neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè. Ce yoñshi neè Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

Limbum: Yá neè ená blaâa Jisoès vi cu njep weâe mntee aè nfeè' wááwá. Loèr bfee ce Nyúè aè fa weèe, yá'ni ker cep aègho. Ku'si Nyúè neè byáá njáèá jáá jáèá jáá. Wee yoèp wa'a, weèe ce yoñshi Nyúè enjep ntee.
English: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

Limbum: Buu wááwá ce weèe ce geèe, káè weèe ce laèa áè, geèe neè buu anaè wááwá ba aè rlii Tata Jisoès, ker ce yoñshi Nyúè Taèr a yeâ rlii.
English: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

Limbum: Bbyeèñgeê, yu'ni neè neè bduu wee aèmboè beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Tata Jisoès a ba geèe.
English: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

Limbum: Mmbañruè, koèñ neè wee bbyeèñge. Fa nyúè' neè woweèe ka'.
English: Husbands, love your wives, and don't be bitter against them.

Limbum: Boêo, yu'ni neè neè weêe bta ba weêe mma aè buu wááwá, njobeè' weèe ka' ce geèe wa'a, Tata yu' rboèñ.
English: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

Limbum: Btar boo, weèe fa geèe ñgeèe aè njáèá njïì ce ntee yi lo yañ boo wee tá bsáè vi lo koo woweèe ka'.
English: Fathers, don't provoke your children, so that they won't be discouraged.

Limbum: Bkwaèa, yu'ni neè neè wee mmasaè enjep ñgoèñ na. Weèe fa kuè ce faè' ba aè nfeè' ce woweèe a ce yá weèe tá woweèe a bo yu' rboèñ neè weèe ka'. Faè' neè neè woweèe neè nteâe mo'sir njobeè' weèe ce wáp Tata Nyúè.
English: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

Limbum: Weèe ka' ce geèe ba njáèá ká, weèe gee neè ye ntee wááwá njobeè' weèe ce geèe yuu anaè ba neè ñwáè ka, weèe ce geèe ba neè Tata Jisoès.
English: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e yu yeè masaè yu Tata Jisos Kraêis. E be keè laè' weèe. E be keè fa weèe buu ce e kupshi a lá neè yïì beèe.
English: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

Limbum: Nyúè be laè' beèe ce a ce geèe buu bbebep aè buu bbebep anaè. E ke so'niñgoèñ ka'.
English: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

Limbum: Mmasaè, geèe neè ñgeâe boèñboñ neè wee bkwaèa. Kuushi neè ená wee weèe túr masaè ce e yu mbe buèu.
English: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

Limbum: Weèe ce loo neè Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá. Wee loo, weèe ce kwa'shi ba aè yuu ce weèe ce loo anaè, ce yoñshi ye aè buu wááwá ce e geèe neè weèe.
English: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

Limbum: Loo neè neè weèr tá weèr bo koni njïì aè rsuñ nsuñ ce e m ba aè bsúèti aèmboè Jisos Kraâis naè, neè beèe. M yu mbe shañ seè'ni na njobeè' máè m ce suñ nsuñ anaè neè beèe.
English: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

Limbum: Loo neè ená Nyúè ja' máè tá m gee tá beèe a riñ nsuñ anaè boèñboñ aèmboè máè ba geèe.
English: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

Limbum: Weèe ka' cu weèe beèe ce a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì ka', weèe cu neè bfee-ñwá. Weèe fa maè'shi tá nfeè' ce weèe yu weèe woweèe anaè bú aè cicïì ka'.
English: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

Limbum: Yá neè ená wee blaèa vi yu bboèñboñ, a ker ce leèe aèmboè mgwañ wa'a. Ñwáè ka' bipshi yuu neè weèe, weèe gheteèr beesi ye aè njïû mboèñmboñ.
English: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

Limbum: Tikikoès be suñ weèe buu wááwá ce vi koni máè. E yu nfúr ce weèr koèñ ye seê. E ce geèe rfaè' Tata Nyúè neè yi ntee wááwá. Weèr ye ce faè' neè Tata Jisoès aèbee.
English: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

Limbum: Máâ tuu ye ená e vú yá weèe tá e bo suñ weèe aèmboè weèr yu, keèr fa weèe ñger foñ.
English: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

Limbum: Yuènismoès ce e yu muu weèe aè vúè a ye. E yu nfúr ce weèr koèñ seê. E ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès neè yi ntee wááwá. Woweèe a be suñ weèe buu ce vi koni weèr aèfa wááwá.
English: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

Limbum: AÈristakoès ce weèr ye yu mbe shañ, aè caè'ni weèe. Mak ce e yu nfúr Baènabaès aè caè'ni weèe foñ. Máè fa weèe ncep aèmboè Mak wáá. Máè suñ weèe ená e ka' vúê, weèe konïì ye boèñboñ.
English: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas concerning whom you received commandments, if he comes to you, receive him,

Limbum: Jisoès ce a too li rlii mo' ená Jostoès aè caè'ni weèe foñ. Ku ba beèe a mntaar ca ce a yu Jus aè múè beèe ce weèr woweèe ce faè'. Weèr woweèe ce faè' wa'a tá beèe a bo rïìñ aèmboè kúú Nyúè. Woweèe a fa máè ñger magoèr seê.
English: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

Limbum: ÁÈpafraès ce e yu muu weèe, a ker ba ñwáè rfaè' neè Jisos Kraêis, aè caè'ni weèe. E ce loo neè weèe aè nfeè' wááwá ená Nyúè gee tá weèe táá tatap, ba aèmboè Nyúè ce koèñ ená weèe aè ba ba, rïìñ buu ce Nyúè ce koèñ ená weèe aè ba geèe, geèe buu anaè wááwá.
English: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

Limbum: Máè yá neè ma mmir ená e ce faè' tatap seê, tá e bo jaè' weèe, jaè' beâe aè rla' Laèodisïìyaè ker ba beâe aè rla' Hïìrapolïìs.
English: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

Limbum: Luk ce weèr koèñ seê, ce e ke fa beèe mcáèp naè, ker ba Dimaès, a caè'ni weèe.
English: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè bfúr ce aè rla' Laèodisïìyaè neè máè, ker ca'ni Nimfaè ba beèe ce a ke niñ cor mbe yeâ ndaèp naè foñ.
English: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.

Limbum: Wee beè' ñwaè' ca, weèe tuusïì neè cor ce aè rla' Laèodisïìyaè tá woweèe a bo beè' foñ. Wee weèe be' ñwaè' ce máè tuusi neè cor ce aè rla' Laèodisïìyaè naè foñ.
English: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

Limbum: Laèa neè neè AÈkiboès ená e ce gee rfaè' ce Nyúè aè fa neè ye ená e gee naè.
English: Tell Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.

Limbum: AÈ sañ máâ Poêl, a sañ rcaè'ni ca neè ya bo. Kuushi neè yaè ñgá' ce m ce yá mbe shañ. M ce loo máná Nyúè túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Poêl, ba Silaès ba Timotïì neè ñgaâa cor ce a yu aè rla' Táèsaèlonikaè. Beèe ca yu beèe Nyúè Taèr, a ker ba beèe Jisos Kraâis foñ. M ce loo máná Nyúè túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Wer ke loo aè nfeè' wááwá ce kuushi weèe ker ce yoèñshi Nyúè njo' weèe.
English: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

Limbum: Wer ke loo neè Tata Nyúè wa'a ce kuushi njáèá rbyemïì ce weèe aè túr neè Jisos Kraêis, a ce faè' aègho. Wer ke loo wa'a ce kuushi mfaè' ce weèe ce geèe njo' le rbyemïì, ba le rkoèñnïì ce weèe túr neè Jisos Kraêis, a ker ce kuushi aèmboè weèe aè táá tatap a ce keè' nfeè' ce e be vúè.
English: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

Limbum: Bfúr weêr, weèr rïìñ ená Nyúè aè koèñ weèe, a ce weèe.
English: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

Limbum: Weèr rïìñ wa'a njobeè' weèr aè m ku fe'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca neè weèe ba neè cuèu caè' ka'. Weèr aè m feè'shi neè weèe neè ñger-ñwáè aè ñger Yú' Rara, a riñ ená yuu ce weèr ce laèa yi yu mini. Weèe rïìñ njáèá rcu ce weèr aè m ce cu a weâe mú. Weèr aè m ce cu wa'a njo' weèe.
English: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

Limbum: Weèe aè m koni yuu ce weèr aè m ce geèe, a koni yuu ce Tata Jisoès aè m ce geèe. Ka' a m fa weèe ñgá' goèr wa'a, weèe aè m ku yu' blaèa ca a byemi, Yú' Rara yi gee weèe aè ce lu'shi.
English: You became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' byemi wa'a, a ba rduèñshïì neè ñgaâa rbyemïì ce aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè ba aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè.
English: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

Limbum: Blaèa aèmboè Tata ce vi loè ese weèe vi ku ba' ba aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè ba aè ñgoâñ AÈkayaè ka', beâe aè bto' wááwá a yu' aèmboè le rbyemïì ce weèe túr neè Nyúè. Yi ka' ba wa'a, yuu mo' ce aède' weèr ker suñ beèe aèmboè weèe yi yu ka'.
English: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out; so that we need not to say anything.

Limbum: Beèe a ce suñ aèmboè weèe aè m koni weèr aè nfeè' ce weèr aè m vúè ca'ni weèe naè. A ce suñ foñ aèmboè weèe aè m maè'shi mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na a ce faè' ba neè Nyúè ce e yu nteèe, aè ba Nyúâ mini,
English: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you; and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,

Limbum: a ker ce keè' nfeè' ce muu yïì be suèu embe buèu. Muu yïì anaè yu Jisoès ce e m fúú efa rkwe, aè ba ye ce e be fúr seèe efa ku' ñgá' ce e be vúè aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè sa' ñgoèñ ca.
English: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead--Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, wee weèe aè rïìñ ená rcaè'nïì ce weèr aè m vúè ca'ni weèe naè li m ba aè cicïì ka'.
English: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn't in vain,

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ wáá aèmboè weèr a m yá ñgá', beèe a jar neè weèr aè rla' Fileèpaêi. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, weèr aè m kur ntee aè ñger yeèr Nyúè a suñ weèe Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce e loè ba ese ye, ka' beèe aè m ker ku jepsi weèr se wa'a.
English: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' vúè yá weèe, a ce feè'shi aènji káè neè ntee sii ka', a ce bo' ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m yá ená weèr aè ghááte, a ka' fa Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca mba weâr mmboè. Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèr aè ce feè'shi blaèa ca tá nyor bo boèñ ñwáè ka'; wer ce feè'shi tá nyor bo boèñ ba Nyúè ce e ke fyá' wer mntee.
English: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ boèñboñ ená weèr aè m vúè tá weèr bo bu' cuèu koni yuu ese weèe ka'. Weèr aè m vúè tá weèr bo bo' beèe, koni bkuè' ka'. Nyúè rïìñ wa' foñ.
English: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness God is witness,

Limbum: Weèr aè m ce roèo ená beèe a ku'si weèr ka', ka' weèe áè, káè beèe mo' áè, weèr aè m ce roèo wa' ka'.
English: nor seeking glory from men neither from you nor from others, when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

Limbum: AÈ m ku ba yer dïì' ená weèr aè m ba laèa ená weèe nási weèr njobeè' weèr yu ñgaâa ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. Weèr aè ka' ba a weâe mú, a ba ba aèmboè ma muu ce e ke gá' neè boo vi naè.
English: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

Limbum: Weèr aè m ka' baè koèñ weèe wa'a, a ke' koñ ená weèr ku suñ weèe ba Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce e loè ese Nyúè ka', weèr aè m koèñ aè rfa wer mnyor neè weèe foñ, njobeè' weèr aè m koèñ weèe seê.
English: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe ku bii ce kuushi njáèá mfaè' ce weèr aè m ce geèe aè nfeè' seèe aè m ba weèr aè ce suñ Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè weèe naè. Weèr aè m ce faè' neètú' ba neèmootïì faè dïì' weèr bo ba ntáèr neè ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ aèmboè Nyúè ye ye rïìñ foñ naè ená yer ñgeèe ce weèr aè m ce geèe neè weèe ce weèe aè byemi, yi m ba yáánïì. Weèr aè m geèe yuu bebep ka'.
English: You are witnesses with God, how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

Limbum: Weèe ku bii ce kuushi ená weèr aè m gá' neè weèe aèmboè tar muu e ke gá' neè boo vi naè.
English: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

Limbum: Weèr aè m laèa ba buu ce vi fa weèe ñger keèr geèe tá wee mntee vi ce fúte. Weèr aè m cep weèe ená weèe gee ba ñgeèe ce Nyúâ koèñ. Ku ba ye ce e ká' weèe tá weèe bo ye rboèñ ba foèo efa yi kúú.
English: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

Limbum: Mbuèu moè' ce wer ke yoèñshi Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá yu njobeè' weèr aè m feè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè weèe, weèe aè yu' a byemi. Weèe aè m byemi ená blaèa ca aè m ba blaâa ñwáè moè' ka', aè m ba ba blaâa Nyúè. Yi yu mini wa'a. Weèe aè ka' ce byemi blaèa ca wa'a, vi ce kupseè me myoèñ.
English: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi m koni weèe, ku ba yuu ce yi m koni ñgaâa cor ce a yu aè ñgoâñ Juèdiyaè, ce a yu beèe Jisos Kraêis. Yeè beèe a m fa weèe ñgá' aèmboè Jus a m fa woweèe ñgá' foñ naè.
English: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews;

Limbum: Jus ca yu beèe ce a m yú Tata Jisoès, a ker yúshi ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè. Woweèe a m fa weèr ñgá', a juu weèr, a ce geèe ñgeèe ce yi boèñ Nyúè ka', a ker baa beèe wááwá.
English: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and didn't please God, and are contrary to all men;

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce jepsi weèr efa rfeè'shi blaâa Nyúè neè beèe enje jáá. A m ce geèe wa'a a ce jepsi beèe enje jáá anaè efa ryu' nsuñ ce e be geèe tá woweèe a luêñ. AÈmboè woweèe a ce geèe wa' naè, yaèp buu bbebep aè ku ce kuè'. AÈ ka' ba aèlúèsimbuèu Nyúè aè ma' ñgá' mbe waâp nduè.
English: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, káâ' aè nfeè' weèr aè m vúè ca'ni weèe, seèe aè lo a gaèpni naè, nfeè' aè be du se ka. Seèe aè m gaèpni ba enjep ntee ka, seèe aè m ku gapni ba efa nyoèr. Weèr aè canïì efa ryá weèe, a ce koèñ se ená weèr aè ba vúè tá seèe ker yáni.
English: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

Limbum: Weèr aè m gheèter se ená weèr aè ba koni fáñ vúè caè'ni weèe. Máâ Poêl, máè gheteèr nfeè' aèñgoo seê, Sataèn aè ka' jepsi weèr efa rvúè.
English: because we wanted to come to you--indeed, I, Paul, once and again--but Satan hindered us.

Limbum: Yuu ce aède' weèr kwa'shïì aègho, lu'shi aègho, ker naatu aègho kuèntombïì neè yïìseèe Tata Jisoès aè nfeè' ce e be vúè naè, yu ba ká caa efa weèe?
English: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn't it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

Limbum: Weèe yu beèe ce weèr be naèa tu, keèr lu'shi aègho aè nfeè' anaè.
English: For you are our glory and our joy.

Limbum: Weèr aè ka' caèni aè ryá weèe goèr wa'a, a moo aè rcu laèr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, weèr aè kwa'shïì ená weèr be tuu Timotïì tá e vú yá weèe tá weèr ku di' boèñlaèr cu aè rla' Atáèn. Timotïì yu nfúr weèr ce weèr woweèe e ke faè' neè Nyúè. Ye ye e ke feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Jisos Kraâis neè beèe. Weèr aè tuu ye ená e vú yá weèe tá e bo fa weèe ñger, geèe tá weèe táá tatap njep le rbyemïì,
English: Therefore, when we couldn't stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

Limbum: faè dïì' ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú lo jep njo' ñgá' ce beèe a ce fa weèe na ka'. Weèe aè rïìñ foñ ená ñgá' ca yu ñgá' ce e be kuè ba neè beèe wááwá ce a byemi neè Jisoès.
English: that no one be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

Limbum: Weèr aè m suñ weèe wáá aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m ba naè ená ñgá' be koni. Weèe aè riñ foñ ená ñgá' anaè aè koni weèe wáá.
English: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce máè tuu Timotïì ená e vú yá weèe. Máè tuu ye ená e vú yá ená weèe ku táá tatap njep le rbyemïì lá. Máè geèe wa'a njobeè' máè kwaè'shi aèmboè buu ce vi koni weèe na, vi caa ya ñger, máè riñ aèmboè m ku cu wa' ka'. Máè m ce wáp máná seemoè' Sataèn aè moèoshi weèe goèr seê, tá yi lo ba seè'ni ená rfaè' ce weèr aè m geèe li bú aè cicïì.
English: For this cause I also, when I couldn't stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

Limbum: Timotïì aè kúti a vú a yá weèr a suñ weèr nsuñ mboèñmboñ. E suñ weèr ená le rbyemïì li ku bii tatap, weèe aè ku koñ Nyúè aèmboè weèe aè m koèñ naè. E suñ foñ ená weèe túr weèr aè ntee boèñboñ, a ce koèñ aè ryá weèr aèmboè weèr ce koèñ aè ryá weèe foñ naè.
English: But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you;

Limbum: Bfúr weêr, aèmboè yi yu wa' seè'ni na, weèr ka' ce yá ñgá' ce weèr ce yá na, ce yu' ryañ ce weèr ce yu' na, weèr ce yu' rboèñ neè weèe, ntee yi fúte weèr njobeè' weèe ku táá tatap njep le rbyemïì.
English: for this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèr aè rïìñ seè'ni ená weèe táá tatap njep Tata na, weèr be cu seè'ni yáánïì.
English: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

Limbum: Nyúè aè geèe weèr aè ce yu' rboèñ aè njáèá beèe ce weèe yu seê. Weèr aè rïìñ aèmboè aède' weèr yoñshïì ye ka'.
English: For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God;

Limbum: Weèr ce loo neè Nyúè neètú' ba neèmootïì ená e fa weèr fáñ tá weèr vúê, tá seèe yáni, tá weèr yá'ni weèe buu moè' ce weèe aè be riñ ka' naè, tá le rbyemïì li bo ruusi.
English: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

Limbum: Weèr ce loo ená Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Ta ker ba Tata Jisoès, gee tá weèr koni fáñ vúè yá weèe.
English: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you;

Limbum: Tá Tata Jisoès gee tá rkoèñnïì ce weèe túr a weâe mú naè, li du kuèntombïì, ker gee tá weèe koñ beèe wááwá aèmboè weèr aè koèñ weèe foñ naè.
English: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' gee wa'a, Nyúè gee wee mntee vi tap. E keè ba aè nfeè' ce Tata Jisoès aè vúè a yïì beèe weèe naè, tá weèe bo ba brara, keè' túr faèa aè bsii Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Ta ka'.
English: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèr ker túr yuu mo' aè rkyeèse mbenduè buu ce weèr aè suñ weèe wáá na. Weèr ce bu' mmbo neè weèe aè rlii Tata Jisoès ená weèe ce gee ba ñgeèe ce Nyúè aè koèñ, aèmboè weèe ce geèe naè, ke' borni aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Njáèá ñgeèe ca a yïì ce weèr aè m yá'ni weèe.
English: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ncep ce weèr aè m fa neè weèe aè rlii Tata Jisoès naè.
English: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

Limbum: Yuu ce Nyúè ce koèñ ese weèe yi yu ená weèe cu ba njáèá rcu ce li ce duèñshi ená weèe aè fa wee mntee neè Nyúè. Weèe fa ba ñgaâa mká'ni ka'.
English: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá efa weâe mú cep yi tu tá e bo geèe ba yuu ce Nyúè koèñ ená e gee neè yïì nyor, aè ba yuu ce beèe wááwá a ce yu' rboèñ aègho.
English: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,

Limbum: Ñwáè fa kuè loèr njeñwáè ba njo' rboèñ ce a ye a be yu' mbe bkuu, aèmboè beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka' a ke geèe naè ka'.
English: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don't know God;

Limbum: Ñwáè fa geèe yuu bebep neè nfúr yïì aè njáèá yuu ca ka'. Weèr aè m cïìisi neè weèe wáá ená Tata Jisoès be keè kúsi mcucu' neè beèe ce a ce geèe njáèá buu ca.
English: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ká' seèe tá seèe bo ce geèe ba njáèá ñgeâe bebep ca ka'. E m ká' seèe tá seèe bo cu ba rcu rrara.
English: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè ce e ka' kani ncep ca, baná ñgaèñ aè kani ba ñwáè ka', e kani ba Nyúè ce e fa weèe yi Yú' ce yi yu rara.
English: Therefore he who rejects this doesn't reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè rkoèñnïì ce e neè nfúr moè' ce e byemi neè Jisoès, mbuèu moè' ker ba neè weèr aè rsañ neè weèe aèmboè li ka' njobeè' Nyúè aè yá'ni weèe njáèá rkoèñnïì ca wáá.
English: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

Limbum: Weèe aè duèñshi njáèá rkoèñnïì ca neè bfúr wee wááwá ce a yu aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè. Bfúr waê, weèr ce tapsi weèe ená weèe gee tá njáèá rkoèñnïì ca li du ba kuèntombïì.
English: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

Limbum: Gheèter neè cu ba rcu ce li yu yáánïì. Ñwáè fa ce fúèúshi cuèu aè buu beèe moè' ka'. Ñwáè wááwá ce fa' yuu ce yi be jaè' ye. Weèr aè m suñ weèe wáá ená weèe gee wa'a.
English: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you;

Limbum: Weèe ka' gee wa'a beèe ce a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì ka' naè, a vúseè weèe, wee weèe ker ke' ená ñwáâ jáá be faè' tá weèe ka' ye ka'.
English: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

Limbum: Bfúr weêr, weèr ce koèñ ená weèe riñ yuu ce yi be loè koni beèe ce a kweñger wáá naè, faè dïì' weèe bo ce koosimnse aèmboè beèe ce a ke keè' rcu ce nfeseè ka' naè ka'.
English: But we don't want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don't grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

Limbum: AÈmboè seèe aè byemi ená Jisoès aè m kwe a fúú efa rkwe, seèe aè byemi foñ ená e ba aè nfeè' ce e vúè, tá Nyúè fúr beèe wááwá ce a m byemi neè Jisoès naè efa rkwe, aèmboè e fúr Jisoès efa rkwe naè.
English: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

Limbum: Weèr ce suñ weèe ba yuu ce Tata aè laèa. Yi yu ená be ba aè nfeè' ce Tata aè vúè, seèe ce seèe bii bteèe seèe ke' du yá ye entombïì neè beèe ce a kweñger ka'.
English: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left to the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

Limbum: Tata be keè suèu embe buèu, tá beèe a yu' ma njeèndoñ aèmboè e waa, tá ncïìndap Nyúâ ñgoèr waa foñ, tá rsoèñ Nyúè li laêa. Be keè ba aè nfeè' anaè tá beèe ce a m byemi neè Jisos Kraâis a ka' kweñger, a fúú efa rkwe wáá,
English: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with God's trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

Limbum: tá seèe ce seèe cu bteèe a ba' aè nfeè' anaè, ka' tarshi nyor seèe woweèe mbe múè mmbaè', duè koni Tata mbekïì tá seèe woweèe cu nfeseè.
English: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

Limbum: Baná weèe lor blaèa ca, gee tá mntee beèe efa weâe mú vi fúte.
English: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, mbuèu moè' ker ba aègho neè weèr aè rsañ neè weèe aèmboè nfeè' káè noèñ ce Jisoès be vúè ka'.
English: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

Limbum: Weèe aè rïìñ boèñboñ ená noèñ ce Tata Jisoès be vúè yi be keè ba aèmboè nyáèá ce e ke búèú ñwáè neètú' naè.
English: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

Limbum: Be ba aè nfeè' ce beèe a ce laèa ená buu wááwá yu yáánïì, cumúnyañ aè ba se naè, tá ñgá' moè' lo vúè neè woweèe. Ñgá' ca be keè lá'si woweèe aèmboè aè nfeè' ce njeñwáè e ke káè' ce luuti muu naè, tá woweèe a túr njïì moè' ce aède' a cañ ka'.
English: For when they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman; and they will in no way escape.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, bfúr waê, weèe yu beèe ce weèe ce cu aè túè'nji tá noèñ anaè yi bo búèú weèe aèmboè nyáèá e ke búèú ñwáè naè ka'.
English: But you, brothers, aren't in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

Limbum: Weèe yu beèe ce weèe ce cu ba aè rraa, a ker ba aèmboè beèe ce a ce jáèr ba neèmootïì. Seèe yu beèe ce seèe ce cu ba aè túè'nji ka'. Seèe túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè túè'nji ka'.
English: You are all children of light, and children of the day. We don't belong to the night, nor to darkness,

Limbum: Baná seèe fa ce buumi aèmboè beèe mo' a ce geèe naè ka'. Seèe ce ke'se, tami nyor.
English: so then let's not sleep, as the rest do, but let's watch and be sober.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ke buumi a ke buumi ba neètú', buu mno vi ke gha' koo ñgaâa no buu ba neètú'.
English: For those who sleep, sleep in the night, and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

Limbum: AÈmboè seèe yu yi seèe beèe ce seèe ce cu ba aè rraa, baná seèe tami nyor. Seèe tá'shi viseèe mnyor aèmboè bsoogáè a ke tá'shi wap mnyor aè ñkúè bïìr naè. Seèe lá viseèe mntee njep Nyúè, ker koñ ye foñ tá cena yi bo ba aèmboè kañ ce seèe aè tá'shi viseèe mñguèñ aègho. Yi yu foñ ená aèmboè seèe cu a ce keè' nfeè' ce Nyúè be jaè' seèe, cena yi yu neè seèe aèmboè rtaa bco' ce seèe aè soèp mbe tuè tá li bo tá'shi tu wa'a.
English: But let us, since we belong to the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and, for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ce seèe tá e bo maè' ñgá' mbe seâe nduè ka'. E m ce seèe ená seèe bo koni rluèñ njïì enjep Tata Jisos Kraêis,
English: For God didn't appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

Limbum: ce e m kwe neè seèe. E m kwe neè seèe tá seèe woweèe bo cu aèbee aè nfeè' wááwá. E ka' vúê, káè seèe cu bteèe áè, káè seèe aè kweñger áè, tá seèe woweèe bo cu aèbee.
English: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe aè rïìñ buu ca wáá na, weèe ku ce gee boèñboñ aèmboè weèe ce geèe naè. Ñwáè wááwá efa weâe mú fa ñger neè nfúr moè', ja' nfúr moè' tá e táá tatap.
English: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèr ce loo neè weèe ená weèe yu'ni neè beèe ce a ce faè' a weâe mú, aè ba beèe ce Tata Nyúè aè ce ená woweèe a ke'ni ker ce yá'ni weèe naè.
English: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you,

Limbum: Yu'ni neè neè woweèe boèñboñ seê, koñ woweèe neè ye ntee-ñwáè njo' rfaè' ce woweèe a ce geèe. Cu neè rcu ce li yu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: and to respect and honor them in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèr ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe fa ncep neè beèe ce a yu bbor, fa ñger neè beèe ce wap mntee vi ce bu', ja' beèe ce a sáè, túr ntee boèñboñ neè ñwáè wááwá.
English: We exhort you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.

Limbum: Yá neè ená ñwáè fa kúsi yuu bebep neè yuu bebep ka'. Gheèter neè aè rgeèe ba buu bboèñboñ. Geèe neè buu bboèñboñ ca neè ñwáè wááwá ce e yu a weâe mú ker ba beèe enjepmbeè foñ.
English: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good, for one another, and for all.

Limbum: Lu'shi neè aè nfeè' wááwá,
English: Rejoice always.

Limbum: loo neè neè Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá,
English: Pray without ceasing.

Limbum: yoñshi neè Nyúè aè buu wááwá ce vi ka' koni weèe. Buu ca a buu ce Nyúè ce koèñ ená beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Jisos Kraâis a geêe.
English: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

Limbum: Fa kani neè Yú' Rara efa rfaè' njep weèe ka',
English: Don't quench the Spirit.

Limbum: weèe fa jaèasi ñwáè ce e ce suñ buu ce Yú' Rara yi geèe e riñ ka'.
English: Don't despise prophesies.

Limbum: Taase neè buu wááwá ce beèe a ce laèa neè weèe, koo vïû bboèñboñ,
English: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

Limbum: ba aènjïìsaèp efa buu bbebep wááwá.
English: Abstain from every form of evil.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e ke fa seèe cumúnyañ, gee tá weèe cu rcu rrara, túr faèa koo múcaèr ka', ker gee tá faèa ba aè yuu ce weèe ce geèe káè aè yuu ce weèe ce kwaè'shi ka', kuè ba bboèñboñ aè buu wááwá du ba' aè nfeè' ce Tata Jisos Kraâis be vúè.
English: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Nyúè ce e ká' weèe, yu ñwáâ mini. E be geèe tá yi ba wa'a.
English: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, loo neè neè weèr.
English: Brothers, pray for us.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè bfúr wer wááwá neè weèr. Baa woweèe nje nyoèr aè beèe Nyúè.
English: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè weèe aè rlii Tata Jisoès ená weèe be' ñwaè' ca neè bfúr wááwá.
English: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Jisoès túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca a sañ máâ Pol ba Silaès ba Timotïì neè ñgaâa cor ce a yu aè rla' Táèsaèlonikaè, ce yu beèe yïìseèe Ta Nyúè, a ker ba beèe Tata Jisos Kraêis.
English: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ:

Limbum: M ce loo máná Taèr Nyúè ba Tata Jisos Kraâis a túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yu yer dïì' aè ryoèñshi Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá njo' weèe. Yi boèñ ená weèr gee wa'a njobeè' ler rbyemïì li ce tap, a caa aèmboè li m ba, ñwáè wááwá aè ce koèñ nfúr yïì a caa aèmboè e m koèñ.
English: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you towards one another abounds;

Limbum: A mbuèu ce wer ke laèa neè bcor mo', ce naèa tu neè weèe njobeè' beèe a ke nyúè' weèe, ker fa weèe ñgá', weèe ku táá tatap, byemi ba neè Nyúè.
English: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

Limbum: Ca yi ce duèñshi ená buu ce Nyúè e ke geèe vi yu yáánïì, njobeè' yi be geèe tá weèe ghááte aè beèe ce a be ye rboèñ embe dïû' kúú Nyúè. A mbuèu ce weèe ce yá ñgá' seè'ni.
English: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of the Kingdom of God, for which you also suffer.

Limbum: Nyúè yu ñwáè mini. E be kúsi mcucu' neè beèe ca njobeè' a ce fa weèe ñgá',
English: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

Limbum: jaè' weèe efa ñgá' ce weèe ce yá anaè, keèr jaè' weèr foñ efa ñgá'. E be geèe cena aè nfeè' ce Tata Jisoès ce vúè embe buèu neè ñger-ñwáè, a bcïìndap Nyúè weèe.
English: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

Limbum: E be vúè njeè múè mcuèñ mor, fa ñgá' neè beèe ce a máñni Nyúè a kani efa rgeèe yuu ce Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Tata Jisoès ce laèa ená a geêe.
English: giving vengeance to those who don't know God, and to those who don't obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

Limbum: Woweèe a be bú nfeseè, gaèpni a Tata Nyúè weèe, bá foèo efa yi ñger.
English: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

Limbum: E be keè vúè aè noèñ anaè tá yïì beèe ce a byemi neè ye a ku'si ye keèr vúse ye. Weèe be keè ba aè múè beèe ca njobeè' weèe aè byemi blaâa Nyúè ce weèr aè m feè'shi neè weèe.
English: when he comes to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired among all those who have believed because our testimony to you was believed in that day.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce wer ke loo neè weèe aè nfeè' wááwá ená Nyúè gee tá weèe cu njáèá rcu ce e koèñ ená yïì beèe a cu. Tá yïìseèe Nyúè gee aè yi ñger tá buu bboèñboñ ce weèe ce kwaè'shi aè rgeèe vi geetïî, ker gee tá mfaè' ce weèe ce geèe njo' le rbyemïì mi geetïî.
English: To this end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith, with power;

Limbum: Yi ba wa'a, a ku'sïì Jisos Kraâis njo' weèe, ku'si wee weèe foñ njo' ye. Bkuè' ca vi be ba wa'a njobeè' ntee boèñboñ ce yïìseèe Nyúè ba Tata Jisos Kraâis a túr neè seèe.
English: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Bfúr weêr, aè ka' ba aèmboè rvúè Tata Jisos Kraêis, ker ba nfeè' ce seèe Jisoès weèe be tarte, weèr ce laèa neè weèe ená,
English: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together to him, we ask you

Limbum: ntee yi fa yaèñse bu' weèe, káè weèe fa yaèñse tuè'te njobeè' beèe moè' a ce laèa ená noèñ Tata anaè yi yu aètútú ka'. Seemoè' káè aè laèa ñwáè ce e ce suñ beèe buu ce Yú' Rara yi geèe e riñ áè, káè ñwáè ce e ce feè'shi ba blaâa Nyúè áè, káè beèe mo' a ce laèa ená weèr aè sañ ñwaè' áè,
English: not to be quickly shaken in your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by letter as from us, saying that the day of Christ had come.

Limbum: weèe fa maè'shi tá ñwáè moè' bo' weèe ka' aè njáâá ká ka'. Tá noèñ ca yi ka' ba, nteèetu ce aèlúèsimbuèu be ba, tá ñwáè ce e baèa Kraâis vúê. Ca yu ñwáè ce e bú yi wáá.
English: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the departure comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction,

Limbum: E be naèa tu ená e caèa buu wááwá ce beèe a ce gú'shi aègho ená a Nyúè. E geèe wa'a, du niñ mbe Ndaèp Nyúè, cu mbo, lor yi tu ená a ye Nyúè.
English: he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped; so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

Limbum: Mboè weèe bii kuushi ená aè m ba mbe nfeè' ce seèe aè m ba naè, máè suñ weèe buu ca a?
English: Don't you remember that, when I was still with you, I told you these things?

Limbum: Weèe aè rïìñ yuu ce yi geèe ená ñwáè anaè fa vúè seè'ni ka', tá e bo loè vúè ba aè nfeè' yïì.
English: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

Limbum: Bsaèrbuu vi yu aègho wáá, a ka' ba ba aè bsúèti. Ñwáè ce e geèe bsaèrbuu anaè vi ke' ce yááti aèwañ ka' yu aègho. Be ba aè nfeè' ce a fúr ñwáè anaè,
English: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

Limbum: tá ñwáè bsaèrbuu ca yááti aèwañ. E yááti aèwañ tá Tata Jisos Kraâis lo vúè neè ñger-ñwáè, fyáp ye neè mbáp, tá e kwe, mïìsi bú aè noèñ anaè.
English: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth, and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

Limbum: Ñwáè bsaèrbuu anaè be vúè neè ñger ce yi loè ese Sataèn, geèe ku' mncoèo ba buu bbáèá ce bo' beèe aègho ená a ku'si ye.
English: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

Limbum: E be geèe ku' buu goèr se tá e bo bo' beèe ce a ce bú aègho. Woweèe a ce bú njobeè' a m kani aè rkoèñ mini ce e m ba geèe tá woweèe a luêñ.
English: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn't receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' woweèe a m koèñ mini ca ka', Nyúè ce geèe woweèe a ce jep, a ce koñ ba mnde'.
English: Because of this, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie;

Limbum: Nyúè ce geèe wa'a, tá mnsa' mi bo koo beèe ce a byemi yuu mini ka', a ce yu' yap rboèñ ba neè bsaèrbuu.
English: that they all might be judged who didn't believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
