Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, bfúr weêr, Tata Nyúè aè koèñ weèe. Yu yer dïì' aè ryoèñshi Nyúè aè njáèá beèe ce weèe yu njobeè' Nyúè aè m ce weèe efa rkáè' tá weèe bo koni ryoèñ. Weèe aè m koni ryoèñ ca njïì enjep yú' Nyúè. Yi m geèe weèe aè ba brara, ker byemi blaâa mini ce weèe aè m byemi aègho.
English: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ká' weèe, weèe aè konïì ryoèñ ca aè nfeè' ce weèr aè m feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè weèe naè. E m ká' weèe tá weèe bo sa' foèo ce yu foèo Tata Jisoès.
English: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a bfúr weêr, táá neè tatap, ku lá ba ryá'nïì ce weèr aè m yá'ni weèe a ker sañ neè weèe naè nje tuè.
English: So then, brothers, stand firm, and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word, or by letter.

Limbum: Tata Jisos Kraâis ba Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, fa weèe cumúnyañ. Nyúè aè m koèñ seèe a fa seèe ñger nfeseè, a ker ka'ni seèe buu ce seèe aè rïìñ ená vi be ba. E m geèe buu ca njo' yi ntee boèñboñ ce e m túr neè seèe. M ce loo máná Nyúè ca fa weèe cumúnyañ, gee tá weèe táá tatap, ce geèe ba buu bboèñboñ keèr ce laèa ba buu bboèñboñ.
English: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace, comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèr ce laèa neè weèe aèlúèsimbuèu ená weèe loo neè weèr. Loo neè ená blaèa aèmboè Tata vi du aè ñgoèñ cárcár tá beèe a byemi ce yu'ni neè Nyúè aèmboè weèe aè m byemi a ce yu'ni naè.
English: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you;

Limbum: Loo neè foñ ená Nyúè fúr weèr embaè mmbo ñgaâa bsaèrbuu. Weèr ce laèa wa' njobeè' beèe wááwá a ce byemi blaèa ca ka'.
English: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, Tata Jisoès yu ñwáè mini. E be fa weèe ñger, keè'ni weèe ese Sataèn ce e yu ñwáè bsaèrbuu.
English: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njo' yïì mini ca weèr aè byemi ená weèe ce geèe buu ce weèr aè suñ weèe, kuè ce geèe ba vi aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

Limbum: Tata Nyúè beesi wee mntee tá weèe riñ njáèá rkoèñnïì ce e túr neè weèe, keèr rïìñ njáèá ñkur ntee ce Jisos Kraâis túr.
English: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèr ce cïìisi neè weèe aè rlii Tata Jisos Kraâis ená nfúr moè' ka' ba a weâe mú ce e ce koèñ aè rfaè' ka', a ce cu aèmboè weèr aè m yá'ni weèe ená weèe cu naè ka', weèe woweèe fa kar ka'.
English: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion, and not after the tradition which they received from us.

Limbum: Wee weèe rïìñ ená weèe aè ba geèe ba ñgeèe ce weèr aè m ce geèe. Weèr aè m ba a weâe mú a ce koosi bbor ka'.
English: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn't behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

Limbum: Weèr aè m ye yuu mo' a buu efa rlaè' ka'. Weèr aè m ce faè' ce lïì'mi neètú' ba neèmootïì faè dïì' weèr bo ba ntáèr neè ñwáè moè' ka'.
English: neither did we eat bread from anyone's hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you;

Limbum: Weèr aè m ce geèe wa'a yi ke' ba ená weèr aè m buu ñger aè rlaèa ená weèe ja' weèr ka'. Weèr aè m geèe wa'a tá weèe bo yá'ni, ce faè' aèmboè weèr aè m ce faè'.
English: not because we don't have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

Limbum: Weèr aè m laèa neè weèe aè nfeè' ce seèe aè m ba naè wáá ená ñwáè ka' tá faè' ka', e fa ye ka'.
English: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: If anyone will not work, neither let him eat.

Limbum: Weèr ce laèa wa'a, njobeè' weèr aè yu' ená beèe moè' efa weèe a yu bbor. Woweèe a koèñ aè rfaè' ka' a ce kar a ce jepsi ba ntaè'teè beèe moè'.
English: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don't work at all, but are busybodies.

Limbum: Weèr ce cïìisi a ker ce bu' mmbo neè beèe anaè aè rlii Tata Jisoès Kraâis ená woweèe a cu aè nsheè ce fa' tá a bo túr yuu ye.
English: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe fa sáè aè rgeèe yuu boèñboñ ka'.
English: But you, brothers, don't be weary in doing well.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ka' kani aè rgeèe yuu ce weèr aè sañ neè weèe na, weèe fyá' ñgaèñ boèñboñ. Weèe fa túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe weèe ñwáè anaè weèe ka' tá e bo ghaèani.
English: If any man doesn't obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe fa loèr ne ye aè ñwáè bbaèa ka'. Cep neè ye ba aèmboè nfúr weèe.
English: Don't count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

Limbum: Tata ce e ke fa seèe cumúnyañ, fa weèe cumúnyañ ca aè nfeè' wááwá, ka' aè ba koni ká koni weèe áè. Tata ba a ñwáè wááwá efa weâe mú.
English: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

Limbum: Rcaè'nïì ca aè sañ máâ Pol neè ya bo. Máè ku sañ aèmboè má ke sañ mbe wa mñwaè' wááwá naè, tá weèe bo rïìñ ená aè sañ máè.
English: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Jisos Kraâis túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pol ce m yu ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. M yu ñwáè ntuu ba aè ñger Nyúè ce e geèe seèe aè luñ ker ba aè ñger Jisos Kraâis ce e geèe seèe aè lá mmir mbenduè buu ce vi be keè ba.
English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Savior, and Christ Jesus our hope;

Limbum: M ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè Timotïì ce e yu muu waè ce mini njobeè' e byemi neè Jisos Kraêis. M ce loo máná Taèr ba Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tata túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, koosimnse neè weèe, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

Limbum: AÈmboè máè m laèa neè wáè aè nfeè' ce máè m ce duè aè ñgoâñ Máèsáèdonïìyaè naè, m ker ce laèa neè wáè ená aè ku cu aè rla' Áfásoès, tá aè bo laèa neè beèe mo' ce a ce yá'ni ryá'nïì mnde' naè ená woweèe a borni njáèá ryá'nïì anaè.
English: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

Limbum: Laèa neè woweèe ená woweèe a fa loèr yaèp nfeè' ce suñ ba mghaèghar káè ce naèshi ba bfúr ce baè' aèfo ka' ka'. Buu ca vi geèe beèe a ce sár ba mnsár a ke' ce jaè' beèe aè rrïìñ buu ce vi yu a kuu mfaè' Nyúè ka'. Beèe a ke rïìñ buu ca ba njobeè' woweèe a byemi yuu ce Nyúè aè laèa.
English: neither to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God's stewardship, which is in faith--

Limbum: Mbuèu ce wáè ba laèa buu ca neè woweèe yu ená woweèe a bo koèñ beèe. Rkoèñnïì ca li ba ba aè nfeè' ce ñwáè aè ka' túr ntee rara, yi ntee yi ke' ce fa ye ñgá' ka' njobeè' e geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ, a byemi neè mini-ñwáè.
English: but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith;

Limbum: Beèe mo' a maè' buu ca a da' nduunjïì a du ba aèmbuèu bde' bcicïì.
English: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned aside to vain talking;

Limbum: Woweèe a koèñ aè rba ñgaâa ryá'ni mncir Nyúè, a ke' riñ buu ce woweèe a ce laèa neè ntee-ñwáè ená vi yu mini naè ka'.
English: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor about what they strongly affirm.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená mncir Nyúè vi yu bboèñboñ ce ñwáè aè ka' gee rfaè' ce a ba geèe aègho.
English: But we know that the law is good, if a man uses it lawfully,

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená Nyúè aè fa mncir ca ba njo' beâe bboèñboñ ka'. E fa vi njo' beèe ce a teèe btu, a ce bú' mncir, ker ba beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè Nyúè ka', a ba ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep. E fa vi foñ njo' beèe ce yap ñgeèe yi yu rara ka', woweèe a ce jaèasi buu Nyúè. E fa vi njo' beèe ce a ce yúshi wap bta ba wap mmaê, ker ba beèe mo' foñ ce a yu ñgaâa nyúshi beèe.
English: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

Limbum: E fa vi njo' bee ce a ce saèki, ba mmbañruè ce a ce noèñ a mmbañruè mo', ba beèe ce a ce yáèá beèe ce fyeèni aè bkwaèa, ba ñgaâa nya' mnde', ker ba ñgaâa ntáá njïìnsa' mnaèñ, ker ba njáèá ñgeèe wááwá ce beèe a ce geèe yi ba jáá efa ryá'nïì mini.
English: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;

Limbum: Ryá'nïì mini ca yu ryá'nïì ce li ghááte a ke' ba jáá efa Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce Nyúè aè fa mba máâ mmboè ka'. Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca ce geèe beèe a ce rïìñ foèo Nyúè ce e yu ñwáè bghoèo.
English: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

Limbum: M ce yoèñshi Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tataê, aè ba ye ce e fa máè ñger ená m gee rfaè' ca. M ce yoèñshi ye njobeè' e m yá ená m yu ñwáâ mini, a ka' ce máè ená m fa' neè ye.
English: And I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;

Limbum: Máè m ba ñwáè ce máè m ce bepsi rlii Jisos Kraêis, a ce fa yïì beèe ñgá', a ce geèe bsaèrbuu neè beèe. Ka' máè m ba njáèá ñwáâ wa'a, Nyúè aè koosïìmnse neè máè njobeè' máè m ce geèe buu ca wa'a, a be byemi neè Jisos Kraâis ka', a riñ ená a buu bbebep ka'.
English: although I was before a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tata aè m geèe yuu boèñboñ neè máè seê. E m geèe máè byemïì neè ye, a ker koñ beèe foñ. Jisos Kraâis e ke fa rbyemïì ca ba rkoèñnïì neè beèe ce a woweèe a yu ñwáè moè'sir.
English: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Nlaèa ca yu nlaèa mini, rtarnïì li ke' ba njo ka', aè ba nlaèa ce beèe a ba byemi neè yap ntee-ñwá. Nlaèa anaè yi yu ená Jisos Kraâis aè m vúè njep ñgoèñ na aè rgeèe tá ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep a luêñ. Ñkúú efa múè beâe bbebep ca yu máè.
English: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

Limbum: Mbuèu ce Nyúè aè m koosimnse neè máè aè m ba tá Jisos Kraâis bo duèñshi beèe ená e yu ñwáè ce aède' e kur ntee seê. E m geèe wa'a tá beèe a bo yá aèmboè e kur ntee neè máè ce m yu ñkúú efa múè ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep, tá m bo ba rduèñshïì neè beèe ce a be byemi neè ye, koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience, for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

Limbum: Ha wáâ Nyúè! Ñkúú ce aè ce cu nfeseè, ce aède' aè kwe ka', ce aède' ñwáè yá wáè neè mmir ka', ce nyúè moè' ker ba caa efa wáè ka', tá beèe a yu'ni neè wáè, tá aè sa' foèo nfeseè. Yi yu wa'a.
English: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Muu waè ce Timotïì, m ce laèa buu ca neè wáè. Buu ce m ce laèa neè wáè na yu buu ce vi ghááte aè buu ce Nyúè aè m geèe aè nfeè' moè', beèe a riñ a laa aèmboè wáè naè. Wáâ ce geèe buu anaè, vi bo fa wáè ñger aè rmaè' bïìr ce mboèñmboñ.
English: This instruction I commit to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to you, that by them you may wage the good warfare;

Limbum: Kuè táá tatap njep lo rbyemïì, lá yo ntee rara. Beèe mo' a kani yuu ce yap ntee yi ce suñ woweèe, a sa'si lap rbyemïì.
English: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith;

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa múè beèe ca yu Hïìminaès ba AÈláèksandaè. Máè fa woweèe mbaè mmbo Sataèn tá woweèe a bo yá ñgá', rïìñ buu, borni efa rbepsi rlii Nyúè.
English: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

Limbum: Yuu entombïì ce m ce laèa neè wáè yi yu ená weèe loo neè beèe wááwá, yoñshi Nyúè, loo buu ce weèe aè buu ese ye. Loo ená e ja' beèe mo' foñ.
English: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men:

Limbum: Loo neè neè bkúú ba beèe wááwá ce a ce sa' beèe tá seèe bo cu neè cumúnyañ- ñwáè, tá ñgá' ba ka', cu ba rcu ce Nyúè koèñ, ba beâe byáánïì aè bsii beèe aè buu wááwá.
English: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

Limbum: AÈ rloo wa'a yu yuu boèñboñ, aè ba yuu ce Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè' e ke yu' rboèñ aègho.
English: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;

Limbum: E ke koèñ aè rjaè' beèe tá woweèe a bo rïìñ yuu ce yi yu mini.
English: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

Limbum: Nyúè yu moè'sir, ñwáè ce e yu mbetar Nyúè ba beèe, a ce geèe tá beèe a ba aèbee a Nyúè aèmboè seèe yu, aè ba moè'sir foñ. Ñwáè ca yu Jisos Kraâis ce e m ba ñwáè aèmboè seèe.
English: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis ca aè m fa yïì nyor aè rtee beèe wááwá efa yaèp ñgá'. Yuu ce e m geèe na yi ce duèñshi ená Nyúè aè m ce koèñ aè rgeèe tá beèe wááwá a luêñ. Cena yi ku koni ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m láè.
English: who gave himself as a ransom for all; the testimony in its own times;

Limbum: A mbuèu ce Nyúè aè m ce máè ená m ba ñwáè rfeè'shïì ker ba ñwáè ntuu foñ. Yuu ce m ce laèa na yu yuu mini, m ce nya' ba mnde' ka'. Nyúè aè m ce máè wa'a tá m bo yá'ni beèe enje jáá yuu mini, tá woweèe a riñ foñ aèmboè aède' ñwáè byemïì neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying, a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

Limbum: M ce koèñ ená mmbañruè ce a yu aè bdïì' wááwá a loo. Woweèe a ce loo, a naa mmbo mrara mbekïì, ke' túr ntee yayañ neè beèe moè', káè ba ñgaâa mntañshïì ka'.
English: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

Limbum: M ce koèñ foñ ená bbyeèñge a yar buu aè njïû yáánïì tá vi ba yáánïì, keè' ba ba buu rñgoèo ka', keè' ba' ba tu rñgoèo ka', káè yar ba bsa' káè btee káè bcaèñ rñgoèo, káè bcáè' ce vi luèu ntaa ka'.
English: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety; not just with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing;

Limbum: Woweèe a susi nyor ba neè mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ, ce yu mfaè' ce mi ghááte neè bbyeèñge ce a ce laèa ená woweèe a rïìñ Nyúè.
English: but which becomes women professing godliness with good works.

Limbum: Ka' ba aè nfeè' ce a ce yá'ni beèe, njeñwáè cu múnyañ, cu neè ryu'nïì-ñwáè.
English: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.

Limbum: Máè byemi ená njeñwáè yá'ni káè túr ñger mbenduè mbañruèñwáè ka'. Njeñwáè túr aè rcu múnyañ.
English: But I don't permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

Limbum: Cena yi yu wa'a njobeè' a m boo Adaèm entombïì neè EÊf.
English: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

Limbum: Yi ba foñ ená ñwáè ce a m bo' aè m ba Adaèm ka'. Ñwáè ce a m bo', e bú' ncir, aè m ba njeñwáè.
English: Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

Limbum: Geewa'a, njeñwáè aè ka' táá tatap njep li rbyemïì ba rkoèñnïì, gee ñgeâe rara, cu yáánïì, baná Nyúè be jaè' ye embenjïì boo ce e ce bi.
English: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and sanctification with sobriety.

Limbum: Nlaèa ce m be laèa na yu nlaèa mini. Nlaèa anaè yi yu ená ñwáè aè ka' koñ aè rba tu-nta', baná ñgaèñ aè koèñ ba rfaâ' rboèñboñ.
English: This is a faithful saying: if a man seeks the office of an overseer, he desires a good work.

Limbum: Tu embe cor yi túr aè rba ñwáè ce aède' a taa ye aètu yuu mo' ka'. E be kuè túr ñgwa moè'sir, túr ntee bobor, túr bfee. E fa ba ñwáâ aèwaèa ka'. E be ba ñwáè ce aède' e sa' beèe yáánïì, riñ aè ryá'ni beèe yáánïì foñ.
English: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

Limbum: E túr aè rba no-ñkoo ka', ce geèe buu ba aè ñger ka'. E be ce geèe buu neè rbonïì- ñwáè. E túr aè rba ñwáè mntañshïì ka'. E fa roñ mbaèa ka'.
English: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

Limbum: Ñgaèñ túr aè rba ñwáè ce e ce keè' aè yïì ndap boèñboñ, ker ce yá'ni boo vi tá woweèe a ce yu'ni neè ye, ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ neè beèe wááwá.
English: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' tá rïìñ aè rkeè'ni aè yïì ndap boèñboñ ka', aède' e gee eká ka' ke'ni aè cor Nyúè?
English: but if a man doesn't know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the assembly of God?

Limbum: E túr aè rba ba ñwáè rbyemïû nfi ka', buwa'laèr e lo naatu, gwe mnsa' aèmboè Sataèn aè m gweè naè.
English: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

Limbum: E túr aè rba ñwáè ce beèe ce a yu ñgaâa cor ka' a be ce laèa yáánïì aèmboè ye foñ faè dïì' beèe a lo taèa ye, tá e kwe aè taa Sataèn ka'.
English: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

Limbum: Bdikïìn foñ a túr aè rba beèe ce a ke loèr buu aètáèr ka', keèr ba foñ beèe ce a nya' mnde' ka'. Woweèe a túr aè rba beèe ce a ce no mruè' goèr ka', káè beèe ce a roñ mbaèa ka'.
English: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money;

Limbum: Woweèe a túr aè ce táá njep buu ce vi kuèu rbyemïì ce yu buu ce vi caèa bfee ñwáè naè neè ntee rara.
English: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

Limbum: Tá woweèe a ka' keè faè' rfaè' bdikïìn, baná a be fyá' woweèe boèñboñ seê. A ka' fyá' woweèe wa'a, yá ená woweèe a ghááte, woweèe a fa'.
English: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

Limbum: Bbyeèñge foñ a túr aè rba ba beèe ce a ce loèr buu aètáèr ka', ba ñgaâa mnsa'ni foñ ka'. A túr aè rba beèe ce a túr ntee bobor, ba foñ beèe ce a yu mini aè buu wááwá.
English: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.

Limbum: Bdikïìn a túr aè rba beèe ce a túr bbyeèñge aèñgoo ka', ba beèe ce a ce keè' aè boo wap ba wap mndap boèñboñ.
English: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ka' fa' rfaè' bdikïìn ca boèñboñ, baná a be naèa woweèe mbekïì, woweèe a ce laèa aèmboè rbyemïì ce e neè Jisos Kraêis, laa neè ñger-ñwáè.
English: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: AÈmboè m ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè wáè seè'ni na, m ce kwaè'shi ená ku báti nfeè' múcaèr tá m vú yá wáè.
English: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly;

Limbum: Geewa'a, m ka' caasi nfeè', tá ñwaè' ca yi bo geèe tá beèe a riñ njáèá ñgeèe ce a ba geèe aè múè beèe Nyúè. Beèe Nyúè ca yu cor Nyúè ce e yu nteèe. Cor ca yu aèmboè rkïì ce li ghashi buu ce vi yu mini.
English: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in the house of God, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

Limbum: AÈde' beèe a kanïì ená buu ce vi kuèu Nyúè, ce e múè' miseèe mmir seèe aè yá naè vi buu efa rba bghagha' ka'. E m vúè aèmboè ñwáè, beèe a yá ye. Yú' Nyúè yi m duèñshi ená yi yu yáánïì. Bcïìndap Nyúè a m yá ye. Beèe a m feè'shi aèmboè ye aè bto' wááwá. Ñgoèñ ca yi m byemi neè ye. Nyúè aè m loèr ye a du aègho mbe buèu, e cu mbo neè foèo-ñwáè.
English: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

Limbum: Yú' Rara yi ce laèa rara ená be keè ba aè nfeè' moè' tá beèe mo' a ma' yuu ce a m byemi, ce yu'ni ba neè byú' ce vi ke bo' beèe, keèr ce yu' ba buu ce mnyúâmkaè' vi ce yá'ni.
English: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

Limbum: Yi be keè ba wa'a njobeè' ñgaâa nya' mnde' ce a yu ñgaâa mbo'ni a be keè yá'ni njáèá ryá'nïì ca. Woweèe a be keè rïìñ jáá jáèá jáá efa yuu boèñboñ ba yuu bebep ka' njobeè' wap mntee vi yini.
English: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron;

Limbum: Woweèe a be keè yá'ni ená mbañruèñwáè fa loèr ñgwa ka', keèr yá'ni ená njeñwáè du bguèu foñ ka'. Woweèe a be keè yá'ni beèe ená woweèe a fa ye njáèá byee mo' ka'. Geewa'a, Nyúè aè m geèe byee tá beèe ce a byemi a riñ yuu mini a bo ye ce yoèñshi ye.
English: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

Limbum: Buu wááwá ce Nyúè aè m gee vi yu yáánïì, mo' efa gho aè ke' ba yïì ce ñwáè kani ka'. Yi yu ená beèe aè ka' koni buu ca, a yoñshïì Nyúè.
English: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.

Limbum: Blaâa Nyúè ba rloo vi geèe buu ca vi ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

Limbum: Wáè ka' suñ buu ca neè bfúr enjep Jisos Kraâis baná aè yu ñwáè rfaâ' mboèñmboñ neè Jisoès, a ce duèñshi ená aè ce nyañ yoè nyor neè blaèa ce vi kuèu rbyemïì, ker ba ryá'nïû rboèñboñ ce wáè ku táá njo naè.
English: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith, and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

Limbum: Fa túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè mghaèghar cicïì ka'. Mi túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe neè Nyúè ka'. Yá'ni yoè nyor aè rcu ba rcu ce Nyúè koèñ.
English: But refuse profane and old wives' fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' yá'ni yïì nyor aè rgeèe mcáâr, mú sá' ku ba njo. Geewa'a, ñwáè aè ka' yá'ni yïì nyor aè rkwaè'shi ba aèmboè buu Nyúè, sá' ba njo aè buu wááwá njobeè' njáèá mkwaè'shïì ca mi kaè'ni seèe rcu rboèñboñ seè'ni na, ker ba rcu rboèñboñ aè nfeè' ce e bii ka' ba.
English: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now, and of that which is to come.

Limbum: Nlaèa ca yu nlaâa mini, rtarnïì li ke' ba njo ka', aè ba nlaèa ce beèe a ba byemi neè yap ntee-ñwáè.
English: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce weèr ce faè', a ce faate msoèñ. Weèr ce geèe wa'a njobeè' weèr aè láè mer mmir ba mbenduè Nyúè ce e yu nteèe. E yu Nyúè ce e be geèe tá beèe wááwá a bo luèñ, lañlañ beèe ce a byemi neè ye.
English: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

Limbum: Laèa buu ca ker yá'ni vi.
English: Command and teach these things.

Limbum: Fa maè'shi tá ñwáè moè' lor wáè aètáèr njobeè' aè yu ghaèrñwáè ka'. Ba rduèñshïì neè beèe ce a byemi, aè wo blaèa, ba a yo ñgeèe, ba aè lo rkoèñnïì, ba a lo rbyemïì, ker ba aè lo rcu rrara.
English: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

Limbum: Tá m ka' vúè, loèr yoè nfeè' ce be' blaâa Nyúè neè beèe, cep woweèe, ker ce yá'ni woweèe.
English: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

Limbum: Fa maè' bfee rfaè' ce Nyúè aè fa neè wáè ka'. Nyúè aè m fa wáè bfee ca njo' buu ce e m geèe aè nfeè' moè', beèe mo' a yu' ese ye a laa aèmboè wáè, btu embe cor foñ a la' mmbo mbe wáâ nduè naè.
English: Don't neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

Limbum: Láè ntee aè buu ca, ce gee vi tá ñwáè wááwá bo yá aèmboè aè ce kuè' aè buu Nyúè.
English: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

Limbum: Keè'ni yo tu, lor nfeè' aè yuu ce aè ce yá'ni. Ce gee ba buu ca aè nfeè' wááwá, njobeè' wáè ka' ce geèe vi, baná aè be tee yo tu efa ñgá', keèr tee btu beèe ce a ce yu' buu ce aè ce laèa.
English: Pay attention to yourself, and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

Limbum: Fa lapni nleeñwáè ka', cep ye aèmboè aède' aè cep yoè taê. Geèe yuu ce aède' aè gee neè bfúr wo neè boo mnsuènsuè.
English: Don't rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

Limbum: Geèe yuu ce aède' aè gee neè yo maê, neè bbyeèñge ce a yu bleebeèe, gee yuu ce aède' aè gee neè bjar wo neè bbyeèñge ce a yu bleebeèe ka' naè. Cu weèe woweèe aè njïû yáánïì.
English: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

Limbum: Jaè' byepkúú ce a yu byepkúú neè mini-ñwáè.
English: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

Limbum: Ñgwañkúñwáè aè ka' túr boo káè mmbishïì áè, baná boo ca káè mmbishïì ca áè, a ba ba beèe entombïì aè rjaè' ye. Woweèe a ka' ja' ye baná woweèe a ce geèe yuu ce woweèe a yá'ni a kuu Nyúè, tá yi ba ená njeèe aè rúèú a ce nyoñ muu. Cena yu yuu ce Nyúè e ke yu' rboèñ aègho.
English: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety towards their own family, and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

Limbum: Ñgwañkúñwáè ce e yu ñgwañkúñwáè neè mini-ñwáè, a ke' túr ñwáè ce e ja' ye ka', yu ñgwañkúñwáè ce e láè mi mmir mbenduè Nyúè a ce loo neè ye aè nfeè' wááwá ená e ja' ye.
English: Now she who is a widow indeed, and desolate, has her hope set on God, and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

Limbum: Ñgwañkúñwáè ce e ka' ce ye yi ba rboèñ enjep ñgoèñ na, baná ka' e yu nteèe wa'a, e kwe.
English: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

Limbum: Laèa buu ca neè beèe tá woweèe a bo cu rcu ryáánïì, faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo laèa yuu bebep kuèu woweèe ka'.
English: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' tá jaè' yïì beèe ka', lañlañ beèe embe yeâ ndaèp, baná ñgaèñ aè kani buu ce e byemïì, a bep a caa ñwáè ce e byemi ka'.
English: But if anyone doesn't provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.

Limbum: Ñgwañkúñwáè aè ka' tá caèa bfeè' mntuunfu keèr ba foñ ba njeñwáè ce e m ku túr nduu moè'sir ka', weèe fa sañ li rlii aè múè mlii byepkúú ka'.
English: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

Limbum: E be ba njeñwáè ce beèe a rïìñ ye aè mi mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ. E be ba njeñwáè ce e m ce keè' aè boo vi boèñboñ, a ce koni beèe mbe yeâ ndaèp boèñboñ, a ce su'si mkuèu beèe Nyúè, a ce jaè' ñgaâa ñgá', a ce fa nyor aè rgeèe mfaè' wááwá ce mi yu mmboèñmboñ.
English: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints' feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

Limbum: Weèe fa sañ mlii byepkúú ce a yu bleebeèe ka' naè ka', njobeè' woweèe a ka' lo ce kwaè'shi goèr ba aèmboè rboèñ nyor caa rfaè' e neè Jisos Kraêis, woweèe a lo koñ ba aè rduè bguèu.
English: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;

Limbum: Woweèe a duè bguèu baná woweèe a bú' mkaè'ni ce woweèe a m geèe naè, a ká' ñgá' mbe waâp nduè.
English: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

Limbum: Woweèe a lo koèñ ba aè rcu aè cicïì, ce kar aè mndap beèe mo' foñ. Yi ka' ba wa'a, woweèe a lo káè' mnsa'ni, keèr ce jepsi ntaè'teè beèe mo', ce laèa buu ce woweèe a ba laèa ka'.
English: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

Limbum: M ce cep byepkúú ce a yu bleebeèe ka' naè ená woweèe a du bguèu, bi boo, fyá' wap mndap boèñboñ faè dïì' ñwáè bbaèa koni fáñ aè rlaèa yuu bebep kuèu woweèe ka'.
English: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa woweèe a daè' njïì wáá, a du ba aèmbuèu Sataèn.
English: For already some have turned aside after Satan.

Limbum: Baná ñwáè rbyemïì aè ka' túr byepkúú mbe yeâ ndaèp, e fyá' aè byepkúú anaè. E fa láè ntáèr ca mbenduè cor ka', tá cor bo fyá' aè byepkúú ce a yu byepkúú neè mini-ñwáè.
English: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don't let the assembly be burdened; that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

Limbum: Btu embe cor ce a ka' ce geèe lap rfaè' boèñboñ baná woweèe a ghááte aè beèe ce cor aè ba yu'ni neè woweèe jáá, keèr fyá' aè woweèe boèñboñ. M ce laèa lañlañ ñgaâa rfeè'shïì ce a ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè, a ker ce yá'ni vi boèñboñ se naè.
English: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

Limbum: Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, “Fa kur cuèu naè' ce e ce bu' msañ ka'.” Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi ker laa foñ enáê, “Ñwáè rfaè' aè ghááte aè rkoo vi blaè'.”
English: For the Scripture says, You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain. And, The laborer is worthy of his wages.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' laa ená tu embe cor yi geèe faèa, weèe fa byemi ka'. Geewa'a, beèe a mmbaa káè beèe a mtaar áè, a ka' vú suñ ená e geèe faèa ghup weèe ka' byemi.
English: Don't receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ka' gee buu bbebep, baná a be lapni woweèe aèwañ tá bár a bo wáp.
English: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

Limbum: M ce laèa cena neè wáè aè bsii Nyúè, ba aè bsii Jisos Kraêis, ker ba foñ aè bsii bcïìndap Nyúè ce Nyúè aè ce. M ce laèa tatap seê, ená aè gee buu ce m ce laèa neè wáè na, ke' ce so'niñgoèñ ka'. Gee neè beèe wááwá yáánïì.
English: I command you in the sight of God, and Christ Jesus, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

Limbum: Fa kaèka aè rla' mmbo mbenduè ñwáè ka'. Fa túr bo njep yuu bebep ce beèe mo' a geèe ka'. Geèe ñgeâe rara.
English: Lay hands hastily on no one, neither be a participant in other men's sins. Keep yourself pure.

Limbum: Fa kuè no ba mdip caè'caè' ka', no mú mruè' múcaèr tá mi bo jaè' wáè a rbúè ce li ce fa wáè ñgá', aè ce yañ cá'cá' se naè.
English: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake and your frequent infirmities.

Limbum: Buu bbebep beèe moè' vi ke yaèñse yááti, beèe aè riñ ená woweèe a be gweè mnsa'. Buu bbebep vi beèe moè' vi loè lor nfeè' seê, ka' yááti.
English: Some men's sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

Limbum: Yi ku ba wa' foñ neè buu bboèñboñ ce beèe a ce geèe. Buu bboèñboñ ce beèe mo' a ce geèe vi loè yañse yááti. Buu bboèñboñ ce beèe mo' a ce geèe vi loè lor nfeè' ka' yááti. Geewa'a aède' vi lo buu efa ryáátïì ka'.
English: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can't be hidden.

Limbum: Beèe ce a yu bkwaèa, a ce yá ñgá', a ba loèr wap mmasaè aèmboè beèe ce woweèe a ba yu'ni neè woweèe boèñboñ seê, faè dïì' ñwáè lo laèa yuu bebep kuèu Nyúè ker ba buu ce weèr ce yá'ni beèe na ka'.
English: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

Limbum: Bkwaèa ce wap mmasaè a yu ñgaâa rbyemïì naè a fa loèr wap mmasaè aètáèr njobeè' woweèe a yu bfúr enjep Jisos Kraâis ka'. Woweèe a ba faè' neè wap mmasaè anaè boèñboñ seê, njobeè' beèe ce a ce ye sá' efa lap rfaè' yu beèe ce a ku ba ñgaâa rbyemïì aèmboè woweèe, aè ba beèe ce woweèe a koèñ. Yá'ni beèe buu ca, cep woweèe tá a bo geèe vi.
English: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' yá'ni yuu mo' jáá, ke' byemi blaèa ce Jisoès aè m laèa ker ba ryá'nïì ce li geèe beèe a ce rïìñ Tata Nyúè ka',
English: If anyone teaches a different doctrine, and doesn't consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

Limbum: baná ñwáè anaè ce naèa tu, a riñ yuu ka'. E ce señ buu, a ce sár mnsár aè mú blaèa jáá jáèá jáá. Cena yi geèe beèe a ce ko'ndoñ, a ce lapni, a ce cápni, beèe a ce kwaè'shi bebep kuu beèe mo'.
English: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

Limbum: Cena foñ yi geèe beèe ce map mkwaè'shïì mi jep a ker riñ yuu mini ka', a ce sár mnsár. Woweèe a ce kwaè'shi ba ená buu Nyúè yu buu ce a be koni sá' enjo.
English: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

Limbum: Geewa'a, ñwáè aè ka' ce cu rcu ce Nyúè koèñ, yuu ce e túr yi ghááteè ye, baná ñgaèñ aè koni sá' seê.
English: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

Limbum: Seèe aè m ce vúè njep ñgoèñ na, a túr yuu mo' ka'. Seèe be keè ce duè tá seèe lor yuu mo' enjo ka'.
English: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can't carry anything out.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' túr bcáè' ba byee, seèe ma'shïì tá vi ghááte seèe.
English: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

Limbum: Beèe ce a koèñ aè rkuè' aè buu a lo gwe rmoèoshïì, kwe aè taa. Taa ce woweèe a loè kwe aègho na, yu ba buu ce woweèe a koèñ neè blúr-ñwáè, ñgá' aè ba njo. Buu ce woweèe a koèñ neè blúr-ñwáè na yu buu ce vi ke suèusi beèe njep nsheè, bepsi woweèe dúèdúè.
English: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation and a snare and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

Limbum: Broñ mbaèa yu mñgaèñ efa buu bbebep wááwá. Beèe mo' a koèñ aè rtúr mbaèa seê, a ka' ce koèñ wa'a, a da' njïì rbyemïì, a ce señ ba buu, wap ntee vi ce fa woweèe ñgá'.
English: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè wáè ce aè yu ñwáè Nyúè, cañ efa gee buu ca. Láè ntee ce gee ba ñgeâe yáánïì, cu ba rcu ce Nyúè koèñ, lá ntee neè Nyúè, koñ beèe, táá tatap, ba múfáèá aè yo ñgeèe.
English: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and gentleness.

Limbum: Cañ mcañnïû mboèñmboñ ce aè rbyemïì, so ryoèñ ce nfeseè ce Nyúè aè m ká' wáè ená aè bo koni. Nyúè aè m ká' wáè ená aè bo koni njáèá ryoèñ ca, wáè konïì li nyúè ce wáè m laèa aè múè beèe ená wáè byemi, Nyúè aè yu' rboèñ naè.
English: Fight the good fight of faith. Lay hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè wáè aè bsii Nyúè ce e ke geèe buu wááwá ba bteèe, ba aè bsii Jisos Kraâis ce e m laèa boèñboñ aè bsii Pontos Pailáèt.
English: I command you before God, who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

Limbum: M ce laèa ená aè gee buu ce máè laèa na, ke' co' mo' embo ka'. Geèe vi yáánïì caar du ba' aè nfeè' ce Tata Jisos Kraâis be vúè.
English: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ;

Limbum: Nyúè be geèe tá Jisos Kraâis vú aè nfeè' ce e m láè. Nyúè ca yu Nyúè ce beèe a ba ce náèsi, yu ye ce e ce sa' caè'caè'. E yu ñkúú neè bkúú wááwá, a ba Taèr neè btaèr wááwá.
English: which in its own times he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

Limbum: Ku ba ye ce aède' e kwe ka', a ce cu ba aè rraa ce aède' ñwáè ba' aètútú efa gho ka'. Ñwáè aè m be yá ye ka', aède' ñwáè yá ye ka'. Tá beèe a yu'ni neè ye, tá yi ñger yi cu nfeseè. Yi yu wa'a.
English: who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light; whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

Limbum: Laèa neè beèe ce a kuè' aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na ená woweèe a fa naèa tu káè láè mmir mbenduè bkuè' ka', njobeè' ñwáè moè' rïìñ aèyaèñseè ka'. Laèa neè woweèe ená woweèe a lá map mmir ba mbenduè Nyúè ce e yu mmbo mntoo a ce fa seèe buu wááwá tá seèe bo yu' rboèñ aègho.
English: Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be haughty, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

Limbum: Laèa neè woweèe ená woweèe a gee buu bboèñboñ, ku' aè mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ, ba mmbo mntoo, koñ foñ aè rgaèp yaèp buu a beèe mo' weèe.
English: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' gee wa'a tá yi bo ba ená woweèe a kupshi buu ce vi be jaè' woweèe aè nfeè' ce e bii ka' vúè naè, a lá boèñboñ, tá woweèe a bo so ryoèñ ce yu ryoâñ mini.
English: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

Limbum: Timotïì, ke'ni buu ce Nyúè aè fa mba wáâ mmboè na boèñboñ. Fa fa yo cuèu njep múè bde' bcicïì ba mnsár ce beèe a ce kwaè'shi ená yu bfee naè ka'.
English: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of the knowledge which is falsely so called;

Limbum: Beèe mo' aè laèa ená a túr njáèá bfee ca, a ka' ce laèa wa', a da' njïì rbyemïì. M ce loo máná Nyúè túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pol ce Nyúè aè m ce aèmboè e m koèñ, ená m ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis, tá m bo suñ beèe ená Nyúè aè kaè' ená e be fa beèe ryoèñ ce nfeseè njïì enjep Jisos Kraêis.
English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

Limbum: M ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè Timotïì ce e yu muu waè ce máè koèñ neè ya ntee-ñwáè. M ce loo máná Nyúè Taèr, ker ba Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tataê, túr wáè aè ntee boèñboñ, koosimnse neè wáè, fa wáè cumúnyañ.
English: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

Limbum: M ce loo neè wáè aè mnoèñ wááwá, a ce yoèñshi Nyúè ce m ce faè' neè ye neè ntee rara aèmboè wa bta a m ce faè' naè.
English: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

Limbum: Máâ kuushi mñgoommir ce wáè m suèusi naè, a ce koèñ aè ryá wáè tá m bo lu'shi.
English: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

Limbum: M ce kuushi lo rbyemïì ce wáè byemi neè Jisoès neè yo ntee wááwá. Yoè makú Lowáès, ba yoè ma Yunïìs, a m túr njáèá rbyemïì ca. Máè rïìñ máná aè túr njáèá rbyemïì ca seè'ni.
English: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you; which lived first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice, and, I am persuaded, in you also.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce kuushi wáè ená aè yáási bfee rfaè' ce Nyúè aè m fa neè wáè aè noèñ ce máè m la' mmbo mbe wáâ tuè naè.
English: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a njobeè' Nyúè aè fa seèe ba yú' ce yi geèe seèe ce wáp buu ka', e fa seèe ba yú' ce yi geèe seèe túr ñger ba ntee rkoèñnïì ker ba ntee ce aètaè yi gee seèe túr ñger mbenduè yïìseèe nyor.
English: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

Limbum: Baná aè fa koosi rïìtu aè rsuñ beèe aèmboè yïìseèe Tata Jisoès, káè koosi rïìtu njo' máè ce m yu mbe shañ njo' ye ka'. Yá ñgá' njo' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aè ñger Nyúè.
English: Therefore don't be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

Limbum: E geèe seèe aè luêñ, a ká' seèe ená seèe cu rcu rrara, aè ke' ba njo' rfaè' mo' ce seèe aè geèe neè ye ka'. E m ká' seèe ba aèmboè e m láè ená yi ba, ker ba njobeè' Jisos Kraêis. E m kwaè'shi buu ca tá ñgoèñ yi ka' keè ba.
English: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na ce Jisos Kraâis ce e geèe seèe aè luêñ, aè vúè na, buu ca aè yáátïì aèwañ. Jisos Kraâis ca aè m so rkwe a vú neè ryoèñ ce aètaè li ke mi ka'. Seèe yi buu ca njo' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce a ce feè'shi.
English: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ce máè njo' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca, ená m fe'shïî, ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisoès, ker ba ñwáè ryá'nïì.
English: For this, I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

Limbum: M ce yá ñgá' njo' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ca, a ka' ce yá wa'a, a ce koosi rïìtu ka' njobeè' m rïìñ ñwáè ce máè byemi neè ye, a riñ máná e be kupshi mfaè' ce e fa mba máâ mmboè naè láè duè baè' noèñ ce Jisoès be vúè.
English: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

Limbum: Kuè táá ba njep blaâa mini aèmboè Jisos Kraâis ce wáè m yu' ese máè naè. Geèe tá lo rbyemïì ba rkoèñ ce wáè koèñ beèe njo' Jisos Kraâis naè li yááti.
English: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Nyúè aè fa nsuñ ca ce yu nsuñ mboèñmboñ seê, mba wáâ mmboè. Loèr nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' kupse nsuñ anaè ka'. Lor nfeè' ba aè ñger Yú' Rara ce yi yu njep wáâ ntee.
English: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

Limbum: Wáè rïìñ wáná beâe aè ñgoèñ Áshaè wááwá a maè'shi máè, máè ba mamñgi'. Beèe mo' efa woweèe aè m ba Fugáloès ba ÁÈmogánïìs.
English: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Nyúè koosimnse neè ndap OÈnisiforoès wááwá, njobeè' a ñwáè ce e m maè'shi máè ka', a ke' koosi rïìtu njobeè' máè m ba mbe shañ ka'. E m baè' aè to' Rum, a lor nfeè' a roo máè a yá. E m yá máè wa'a a fa má ñger seê.
English: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain, but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Nyúè geèe tá Tata Jisos Kraâis koosimnse neè ye aè noèñ ce e ka' vúê. Wáè rïìñ ená e m jaè' máè aè to' Áfásoès aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá.
English: the Lord grant to him to find the Lord's mercy in that day; and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

Limbum: Wáâ Timotïì ce aè yu muu waè, Nyúè aè túr wáè aè ntee boèñboñ. Wáè konïì sá' efa gho njo' Jisos Kraêis. Baná aè táá tatap.
English: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Buu wááwá ce wáè m yu' aèmboè m ce yá'ni beèe naè, loèr vi fa mbaè mmbo beèe ce wáè rïìñ ená a yu mini, a riñ foñ ená woweèe a ghááte aè ryá'ni beèe mo'.
English: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.

Limbum: Loèr yo dïì' yá ñgá' aèmboè ñwáè soogáâ mboèñmboñ neè Jisos Kraêis.
English: You therefore must endure hardship, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè soogáâ mboèñmboñ cu aèmboè beâe aè laè' a ke cu naè ka', njobeè' yi yu ená e gee ba yuu ce yi boèñ yïì ñwáâ ñgoèr.
English: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

Limbum: Kwaè'shi ka aèmboè ñwáè mcañnïì, e ka' tá láè mncir ce a láè neè ñgaâa mcañnïì ka', e so ka'.
English: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn't crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

Limbum: Ñwáè nfaè' mnsuu ce e faè' tatap aè ba ba ñwáè entombïì aè rye efa buu ce e faè' aè mñkúè.
English: The farmers who labor must be the first to get a share of the crops.

Limbum: Kwaè'shi aèmboè buu ce máè suñ wáè na, tá Tata ku gee tá aè riñ vi.
English: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

Limbum: Kuushi ená Jisos Kraâis ce e m ba ñwáè embe ndúè' Dávïìd aè m fúú efa rkwe. Ca yu Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce m ce feè'shi neè beèe.
English: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my Good News,

Limbum: M ce yá ñgá' ca mbe shañ aèmboè ñwáè ce e bú' lá ncir wa'a njo' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ anaè. Ka' a kur máè neè bkwaèñ wa'a, aède' a kur blaâa Nyúè ka'.
English: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God's word isn't chained.

Limbum: M ce yá ñgá' ca tá beèe ce Nyúè aè ce a bo byemi neè Jisos Kraêis, koni ryoâñ rfi, koni bkuè' ce vi be keè mïì ka'.
English: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones' sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

Limbum: Blaèa ca vi yu mini. “Seèe ka' kwe seèe Jisoès weèe, seèe ke cu seèe woweèe.
English: This saying is faithful: For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

Limbum: Seèe ka' táá tatap du ba' aèlúèsimbuèu, seèe Jisoès weèe ke sa' aèbee. Seèe ka' kani ye, ye ye ke kani seèe.
English: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

Limbum: Seèe ka' tá ba mini neè ye ka', aède' e kupse efa rba njáèá ñwáè ce e yu na ka'. E be kuè ba yi yu mini aè nfeè' wááwá.”
English: If we are faithless, he remains faithful. He can't deny himself.

Limbum: Kuushi beèe buu ca, ker cep woweèe aè rlii Tata Nyúè ená a fa ce sár mnsár aè mú blaèa jáá jáèá jáá ka'. Njáèá mnsár anaè vi túr sá' ka', vi ke bepsi beèe ce a ce yu'.
English: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don't argue about words, to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

Limbum: Gheèter gee ñgeâe boèñboñ neè Nyúè tá e bo yu' rboèñ neè wáè. Ba ñwáè rfaè' ce aède' rïìtu yi koo ye ka', ker ba ñwáè ce e be ce yá'ni beèe blaâa mini yáánïì.
English: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn't need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

Limbum: Fa fa yo cuèu njep múè mnsár ka'. AÈde' mnsár anaè vi gee ñwáè riñ Nyúè ka', vi loè gee beèe ce a ce sár vi a misïì máñni Nyúè máñni.
English: But shun empty chatter, for they will proceed further in ungodliness,

Limbum: Njáèá mnsár ca vi loè ba aèmboè nfur ce e ke loè beeñger aè koètá naè. Beèe mo' efa múè ñgaâa mnsár ca yu Haèmáneyoès ba Fïìlátoès.
English: and their word will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

Limbum: Woweèe a daè' njïì, a ce yá'ni beèe ená beèe aè m fúú efa rkwe war. Woweèe a yá'ni wa'a a ce geèe beèe mo' a ce tarni yuu ce woweèe a m byemi.
English: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

Limbum: Ka' beèe anaè a ce tarni wa'a, blaâa Tata Nyúè vi yu mini, aètaè vi kupseè ka'. Vi yu aèmboè kuèundap wa'a, a sañ mbo enáê, “Tata Nyúè rïìñ beèe ce a yu yïì beèe.” A ker sañ mbo enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' ce laèa ená e ce duè aèmbuèu Tata Jisoès baná ñgaèñ fa keèr geèe buu bbebep ka'.”
English: However God's firm foundation stands, having this seal, The Lord knows those who are his, and, Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.

Limbum: E ke ba mbe ndaèp ñwáâ ñgoèr, bghee bboèñboñ ba mkïûñ mmboèñmboñ ce a geèe neè bco', ker ba mkïìñ ce a ku boo ba neè mboo mi ku ba mbo. A loè lor bghee ba mkïûñ mmboèñmboñ lá byee njo neè bkeèe, lor mkïìñ ce a ku boo ba neè mboo naè lá byee njo neè ñgaâa ndap.
English: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor, and some for dishonor.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' borni efa rgeèe buu bbebep, e ba aèmboè bghee bboèñboñ ba mkïûñ mmboèñmboñ caè. E yu ñwáâ nrara ce aède' Nyúè lor gee rfaè' aègho, njobeè' e tami nyor aè rgeèe mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ ce Nyúè ce koèñ ená e gee naè aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master's use, prepared for every good work.

Limbum: Fa keè geèe ñgeèe rnsuèu ka'. Geèe ba ñgeâe yáánïì, foosi neè Tata Nyúè, túr ntee rkoèñnïì ba ntee cumúnyañ. Wá geèe wa'a, yi ba ená aè ce geèe aèmboè beèe wááwá ce a ce ká' rlii Jisoès neè ntee rara a ce geèe naè.
English: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

Limbum: Fa fa yo cuèu njep mnsár ka'. Nsár yu yuu blúr ce vi ke vúè ba neè mlap.
English: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' ba ñwáè rfaè' neè Tataê, ñgaèñ fa ba ñwáè mnsár ka'. E ba ba ñwáâ nyáánïì, ba ñwáè ce e rïìñ aè ryá'nïì, ba ñwáè ce e kur ntee.
English: The Lord's servant must not quarrel, but be gentle towards all, able to teach, patient,

Limbum: Beèe mo' a ka' kani yuu ce e ce suñ woweèe, e lor nfeè' nashi neè woweèe njobeè' aède' Nyúè gee woweèe a kupseè yap ntee lo byemi yuu ce yi yu mini,
English: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

Limbum: tá wap bfee vi bo kúti woweèe mbo, tá woweèe a fúú enjep taa Sataèn ce yi m koo woweèe, a gee woweèe a ce yu'ni ba neè ye naè.
English: and they may recover themselves out of the devil's snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.

Limbum: Rïìñ ená be keè ba aè nfeè' elúèsimbuèu tá ñgá' ba seê.
English: But know this, that in the last days, grievous times will come.

Limbum: Beèe a be keè koèñ wap mnyor, koèñ mbaèa seê, ce yu' nyor, keèr ce suñni nyor, ce cápni. Boo foñ a be keè teèe btu neè wap mma ba wap btaê. Beèe a be keè ce yoèñshi beèe aè buu bboèñboñ ce a geèe neè woweèe ka', ce geèe mntuèp buu.
English: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

Limbum: Beèe a be keè ce koèñni ka', túr ntee rfoèosïì ka', ce tee mnde' mbe tu beèe moè', geèe yuu ce yaèp nyor ce koèñ ená a geêe, ce geèe ñgeèe mnyaèa, koèñ buu bboèñboñ ka'.
English: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,

Limbum: Beèe a be keè ce ye mcúè mbe btu beèe moè', ce geèe buu aèwaèa, ce naèa nyor, koèñ aè rye ñgoèñ, keè' koèñ Nyúè ka'.
English: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

Limbum: Woweèe a be keè rïìñ Nyúè ba aè mñguèpcuèu keè' rïìñ ye enjep ntee ka', Fa táá kuèu weèe njáèá beèe anaè ka'.
English: holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa waâp mú a lo la' kuèu du aè mndap beèe mo', bo' bbyeèñge ce a yu blúr a ce wáp buu njo' yaèp buu bbebep ce woweèe a jep njep múè mo.
English: For some of these are people who creep into houses, and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

Limbum: Njáèá bbyeèñge anaè a koèñ aè ryá'ni buu seê, a ce gheèter seê, a ke' riñ yuu mini ka'.
English: always learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

Limbum: Njáèá mmbañruè ce a bo' bbyeèñge na a baèa yuu ce yi yu mini aèmboè Jánïìs ba Jámbráès a m geèe neè Musïìs naè. Wap mntee vi yu bsii, lap rbyemïì li ba mini ka'.
English: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so do these also oppose the truth; men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith, are rejected.

Limbum: Beèe a be loè tee yaèp mbuèu tá woweèe a yááti aèwañ aèmboè Jánïìs ba Jámbráès a m yááti naè.
English: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

Limbum: Wáâ Timotïì, wáè rïìñ la ryá'nïì ba njáèá njïì ce m ce cu la rcu, a riñ yuu ce m ce koèñ aè rgeèe njep ñgoèñ na, a yá la rbyemïì, a yá njáèá njïì ce m ce kur ntee, a yá la rkoèñnïì, a yá foñ aèmboè máè táá tatap neè Jisoès,
English: But you did follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

Limbum: a yá ñgá' ce beèe a m ce fa neè máè, a yá mluè ce máè m ce yá. Wáè m yá yuu ce yi m koni máè aè rla' Antïìyoèk ba aè rla' IÌkonïìyoèm ker ba aè rla' Listraè. Beèe a m fa má ñgá' seê, máè ku táá tatap, Tata Jisos aè ja' má efa ñgá' anaè wááwá.
English: persecutions, and sufferings: those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. Out of them all the Lord delivered me.

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená beèe a be fa ñgá' neè beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès, a ce koèñ aè rcu lap rcu aèmboè Nyúè ce koèñ.
English: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

Limbum: Ñgeèe beèe ce a yu yap ba beâe bbebep, a ce bo'shi ená a rïìñ Nyúè se naè, yi be bep caèa ñger. Woweèe a be keè ce bo' beèe, ce bo' wap btu foñ.
English: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

Limbum: Kuè táá yo ba njep buu ce a m yá'ni wáè, wáè rïîñ, a byemi ená vi yu mini naè, kuushi beèe ce a m yá'ni wáè buu anaè.
English: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

Limbum: Wáè rïìñ ená káâ' aè nfeè' ce wáè m ba ghaèrñwáè vú gháá seè'ni na, wáè rïìñ blaèa embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè seê. AÈde' blaèa anaè vi gee aè túr bfee, byemi neè Jisos Kraêis, luêñ.
English: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Blaèa wááwá ce vi yu mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè, vi loè ese Nyúè, a túr sá' seê. Vi yu aè ryá'ni beèe, a ba aè rlapni beèe ce a ce yá'nïì ryá'nïì mnde', a ba aè rnaèshi beèe, a ker ba aè rcep beèe tá a bo cu rcu ryáánïì,
English: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

Limbum: tá ñwáè ce e ce faè' neè Nyúè bo túr buu wááwá, ghááte aè rgeèe mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ.
English: that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè wáè tatap aè bsii Nyúè, ker ba aè bsii Jisos Kraâis ce e be keè sa' beèe wááwá ce a cu bteèe ker ba beèe ce a kweñger. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e be vúè tá e bo sa' woweèe aèmboè ñkúú, m ce laèa neè wáè ená,
English: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

Limbum: aè fe'shi blaâa Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá, káè yu aè nfeâ' mbembep áè, káè yu a nfeâ' mboèñmboñ áè, geèe tá woweèe a riñ yaèp buu bbebep, lapni woweèe, fa woweèe ñger, yá'ni woweèe neè ntee múfáèá.
English: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with all patience and teaching.

Limbum: Yá'ni woweèe njobeè' nfeè' moè' be ba ce beèe a be keèr koèñ aè ryu' ryá'nïì ce li yu mini ka', koèñ ba aè rgeèe buu ce woweèe aè gwáá. Yi ba wa'a tá woweèe a ká' ku' ñgaâa ryá'nïì mo' ená a vú yá'ni woweèe ba buu ce woweèe a koèñ.
English: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but, having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts;

Limbum: Woweèe a be keè koèñ aè ryu' yuu ce yi yu mini ka', koèñ ba aè ryu' mghaèghar ce beèe a ce suñ aèmboè buu enjep ñgoèñ na.
English: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside to fables.

Limbum: Timotïì, táá yo yáánïì aè nfeè' wááwá, táá tatap aè nfeè' ñgá', gee rfaè' ce ñwáè ce e ce feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aè ba geèe, geèe rfaè' wááwá ce Nyúè aè fa neè wáè.
English: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè máè, nfeè' ce gháá ce m be fa la ryoèñ neè Nyúè aèmboè tañshïì wa'a. Nfeè' ce m be maè'shi aè gháá.
English: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

Limbum: Máè gheèter a cañ mcañnïì ce mmboèñmboñ a misïî, a táá ba njep mini a ba' aèlúèsimbuèu.
English: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ seè'ni máná blaè' ce a kupshi a lá neè máè njo' ya ñgeâe yáánïì vi yu aègho. Ñwáè ce e be keè fa máè blaè' anaè be keè fa Tata Jisoès ce e ke sa' vi mnsa' yáánïì. E be keè fa máè blaè' ca aè noèñ ce e vúè. E be keè fa ba neè máè caè' ka. E be keè fa neè beèe wááwá ce a ce nyaèñnyañ aè ryá noèñ ce e be vúè anaè.
English: From now on, there is stored up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

Limbum: Gheèter vú ghaèagheèr vú yá máè,
English: Be diligent to come to me soon,

Limbum: njobeè' Dimaès aè koèñ yi yu ba buu enjep ñgoèñ, a ma'shi máè a du aè to' Táèsaèlonikaè. Krïûsáèn aè du yi ba aè ñgoâñ Gaèláshaè, Taitoès aè du yi ba aè ñgoâñ Daèlmashaè.
English: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e yu weèr ye ku ba Luêk. Loèr Mak tá weèe ye vú tá e bo jaè' máè aè rfaè' ce m ce geèe.
English: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

Limbum: Máè tuu Tikikoès aè rla' Áfásoès.
English: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

Limbum: Wá vúè aè túr kur ce máè m láè neè Kapoès aè rla' Trowaès, ker ba wa mñwaè', lañlañ wa mñwaâ' bboèñboñ caè.
English: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come, and the books, especially the parchments.

Limbum: AÈláèksandaè ñwáè ntoèo nlaèa aè m geèe buu bbebep neè máè seê. Tata Nyúè be laè' ye aè buu ce e geèe neè máè anaè.
English: Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his works,

Limbum: Loèr nfeè' neè ye njobeè' e m jepsi blaâa Nyúè ce weèr aè m ce feè'shi naè seê.
English: of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.

Limbum: A m duè neè máè mbe kor aè nfeè' entoèmbïì, beèe wááwá a cañ a ma' máè, ñwáè ce e táá yaè njïìnsa' aè ke' ba ka'. M ce loo máná Nyúè fa baèa woweèe njobeè' woweèe a m geèe neè máè wa' ka'.
English: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

Limbum: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Tata Jisoès aè ku ba weèr ye a fa máè ñger, tá m bo feè'shi buu Nyúè wááwá neè beèe enje jáá tá woweèe a yu'. Nyúè aè m fúr máè ekuè cuèu búrúè'.
English: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

Limbum: Tata Jisoès be jaè' máè efa ñgá' wááwá, loèr máè duè aègho mbe buèu mbe dïì' ce e ce sa' yi kúú. Seèe ku'si ye aè nfeè' wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.
English: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom; to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Caè'ni Prïûskaè ba AÈkwilaè ker ba beèe embe ndaèp OÈnisiforoès.
English: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

Limbum: IÌrastoès aè m cu aè rla' Koreèn, máè ma'shïì Troâfimoès aè rla' Milátáèns njobeè' e m ce yañ.
English: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

Limbum: Gheèter vú tá ñgoèñ yi ka' fúte. Yuèbuloès ba Pudaèn ba Lainoès ba Klaâudïìyaè ker ba bfúr wááwá, a caè'ni wáè.
English: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Nyúè ke'ni lo ryoèñ, túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pol ce m yu ñwáè rfaè' neè Nyúè a ker ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. Nyúè aè m ce máè tá m bo jaè' beèe ce e ce, tá woweèe a bo byemi neè ye, rïìñ yuu mini ce aède' yi gee ñwáè cu rcu ce Nyúè koèñ.
English: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's chosen ones, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè cu njáèá rcu ca njobeè' e ce keè' ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Tá ñgoèñ yi ka' keè ba, Nyúè ce e ke nya' mnde' ka' aè m kaè' ená e be fa beèe njáèá ryoèñ ca.
English: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can't lie, promised before time began;

Limbum: Nfeè' aè ka' gháá, Nyúè aè gee yi nlaèa yi yáátïì aèwañ, beèe a riñ buu ca. Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè' aè fa blaèa ca mba máâ mmboè ená m fe'shi neè beèe.
English: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior;

Limbum: M ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè Taitoès ce e yu muu waè ce mini njobeè' e byemi neè Jisos Kraâis aèmboè seèe aè byemi naè. M ce loo máná Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Ta ker ba Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè', túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

Limbum: Máè m maè'shi ená aè cu aè to' Kreât tá aè bo naèshi buu embe cor ce vi yu yáánïì ka' naè, keèr ce btu embe cor aè bcor ce vi yu aè bu' mla' wááwá. Kuushi ená máè m laèa neè wáè ená,
English: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you;

Limbum: aè ka' ce ce tu embe coêr, aè ce ba ñwáè ce beèe a rïìñ ená e yu ñwáâ mboèñmboñ, a túr ñgwa moè'sir caè'caè', boo vi foñ a ba ñgaâa rbyemïì, yap ñgeèe aè ba njáèá ñgeèe ce aède' beèe a yá laa ená woweèe a ce geèe buu bbebep káè ená a teèe btu ka'.
English: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ce fyá' beèe Nyúè yu ñwáè ce mfaè' Nyúè mi yu mba yeâ mmboè. Baná yi ñgeèe yi ba boèñboñ. E fa naèa tu káè túr ntee cácáp ka'. E fa lá ntee aè buu mno ka'. E fa ba ñwáè ce e ce geèe buu ba aè mntee ka'. E fa ba ñwáè roñ mbaèa ka'.
English: For the overseer must be blameless, as God's steward; not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

Limbum: E ba ba ñwáè ce e yu mmbo mtoo, a ba ñwáè ce e koèñ ba yuu boèñboñ. E ba ñwáè ce e be kwaè'shi buu neè bfee-ñwáè, ba ñwáè nyáánïì, ba ñwáè nrara aè bsii Nyúè, ker ba ñwáè ce e maè'shi yïì nyor aèwaèa ka'.
English: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled;

Limbum: E ba ñwáè ce e be táá njep ryá'nïì mini ce a yá'ni ye, tá ye ye foñ bo rïìñ aè ryá'ni beèe mo' boèñboñ, keèr gee tá yi yááti rara ená beèe ce a ce kani ryá'nïì ca naè a ce jep jep.
English: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

Limbum: M ce laèa wa'a njobeè' beèe ce a teèe btu a yu goèr seê, lañlañ beâe aè múè ñgaâa ñgeèe búè. Njáèá beèe ca a yu ñgaâa laèa buu bcicïì, a ce bo' beèe neè wap blaèa anaè.
English: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

Limbum: Geèe tá woweèe a baate yap cuèu njobeè' woweèe a ce yá'ni ba yuu ce yi yu yáánïì ka'. A ku ce roèo ba nduunjïì aè rkoni mbaèa aè njáèá njïì ce e yu neè rïìtu- ñwáè. Woweèe a jepsi rbyemïì embe mndap beèe mo' neè wap blaèa anaè.
English: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain's sake.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa múè beâe aè to' Kreât anaè, ce e m ce yá buu ce vi be keè ba, aè m laèa enáê, “Beâe aè to' Kreât a yu ñgaâa mnde'. Woweèe a yu aèmboè mnyaèa efa rïìñ wa'a, a ba mñkuñri ce a yu bbor.”
English: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.

Limbum: Yuu ce e m laèa anaè yi yu mini. Baná aè lapni woweèe tatap seê, tá woweèe a bo byemi ba yuu ce yi yu mini.
English: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

Limbum: Fa maè'shi tá woweèe a ker du aèmbuèu mghaèghar Juês, káè keèr yu'ni neè rsa' ce beèe ce a kani yuu mini a fa naè ka'.
English: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' túr ntee rara, baná buu wááwá be ba brara a yeâ bsii. Ñwáè aè ka' túr ntee sii, ke' byemi ka' baná buu wááwá vi be ba brara neè ye ka' njobeè' mi mkwaè'shïì mi yu msii, e ke' ker rïìñ jáá jáá efa yuu boèñboñ ba yuu bebep ka'.
English: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

Limbum: Njáèá beèe ca a loèr ená a rïìñ Nyúè seê, buu ce woweèe a ce geèe vi ce duèñshi ená woweèe a máñni Nyúè. Woweèe a yu beâe bcicïì, a tee btu. AÈde' woweèe a geèe yuu boèñboñ ka'.
English: They profess that they know God, but by their works they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè wáè, yá'ni beèe ba ñgeâe boèñboñ ce ryá'nïû rboèñboñ li laèa ená beèe a geêe.
English: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

Limbum: Laèa neè mmbañruè ce a yu bleebeèe ená woweèe a túr ba ntee bobor, ke' lor buu aètáèr ka; kwa'shi buu neè bfee-ñwáè; byemi neè Jisos Kraâis neè mini- ñwáè, koñ beèe, táá tatap.
English: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in patience:

Limbum: Laèa neè bbyeèñge ce a yu bleebeèe foñ ená woweèe a gee ñgeèe ce yi yu neè ryu'nïì-ñwáè. Woweèe a fa tee mnde' mbe tu beèe mo', káè ba bkwaèa neè mruè' ka'. Woweèe a yá'ni beèe ba buu bboèñboñ,
English: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;

Limbum: tá ryá'nïì ca li bo geèe tá bbyeèñge ce a bii bghaèrbeèe naè a bo koèñ bduu wap ba boo wap,
English: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

Limbum: geèe buu neè bfee-ñwáè, ba brara enjep ntee, fyá' wap mndap boèñboñ, geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ neè beèe mo', yu'ni neè bduu wap. Woweèe a gee wa'a faè dïì' ñwáè moè' bo koni njïì aè rlaèa yuu bebep aèmboè blaâa Nyúè njo' yap ñgeèe ka'.
English: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God's word may not be blasphemed.

Limbum: Cep boo mnsuènsuè foñ ená woweèe a fa maè'shi wap mnyor aèwaèa ka'.
English: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè wáè, yuu wááwá ce wáè ka' ce geèe, aè gee ba yuu boèñboñ tá beèe mo' a bo yá beè'ni. Yá'ni beèe neè mini-ñwáè, fa geèe ñkáèrbuu neè lo ryá'nïì ka'.
English: in all things showing yourself an example of good works; in your teaching showing integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

Limbum: Laèa ba blaâa bboèñboñ ce aède' ñwáè moè' jaasïì ka', tá rïìtu yi bo koo beèe ce a kani liseèe rfaè'. Rïìtu yi be koo woweèe njobeè' woweèe a yá yuu bebep ce aède' a suñ aèmboè seèe ka'.
English: and soundness of speech that can't be condemned; that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

Limbum: Laèa neè bkwaèa ená woweèe a yu'ni neè waêp mmasaè, gee buu wááwá ce wap mmasaè a koèñ ená woweèe a geêe. Woweèe a fa sár mnsár ka'.
English: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing in all things; not contradicting;

Limbum: Woweèe a fa cwaèr mmbo ka'. Woweèe a fa' neè wap mmasaè neè ntee mo'sir aè nfeè' wááwá tá yap ñgeèe yi bo geèe tá beèe a vúse buu ce seèe ce yá'ni aèmboè Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè'.
English: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

Limbum: Kuushi ená Nyúè aè m geèe yi ñgeâe boèñboñ yi yáátïì aèwañ tá beèe wááwá a bo luèñ.
English: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

Limbum: Yi ñgeâe ca yi ce yá'ni seèe ená seèe borni ñgeèe ce beèe ce a máñni Nyúè a ke geèe, ker borni efa rláè ntee aè buu enjep ñgoèñ na. Yi ce yá'ni seèe foñ ená seèe cu rcu ce li yu neè bfee-ñwáè, ba mini tá yiseèe ñgeèe enjep ñgoèñ na yi bo ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world;

Limbum: Seâe ce cu wa'a, ce keè' nfeè' ce Jisos Kraâis be vúè neè vi bghoènïì, tá yi foèo yi yááti aèwañ. E yu yïìseèe Nyúâ ñgoèr, a ker ba ñwáè rjaè'.
English: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ;

Limbum: E m kwe a seâe btuè tá e bo fúr seèe efa buu bbebep, keèr geèe tá seèe ba brara enjep ntee, ba yïì beèe ce a ce lu'shi aè rgeèe ba buu bboèñboñ.
English: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

Limbum: Suñ beèe buu ca. Cep, ker lapni beèe neè ñger-ñwáè. Fa maè'shi tá ñwáè moè' lor wáè aètáèr ka'.
English: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise you.

Limbum: Kuushi beèe ená woweèe a yu'ni neè beèe ce a ce sa' woweèe ba beèe ce a yu btu mnta' neè woweèe. Woweèe a yu'ni neè beèe ca ker tami nyor aè rgeèe njáèá rfaè' ce li ka' ba yáánïì.
English: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

Limbum: Woweèe a fa laèa yuu bebep aèmboè ñwáè moè' ka, borni mlap, gee buu neè rbonïì-ñwáè, ba múfáèá aè yap ñgeèe neè beèe wááwá, aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

Limbum: AÈ m ba entombïì wer weèr foñ aè ba blúr, a tee btu. Weèr aè m daè' nduunjïì. Weèr aè m ba bkwaèa neè buu wááwá ce yeèr nyor aè m koèñ. Mer mkwaè'shïì mi m ba mmbembep, weèr aè ce ko'ndoñ neè beèe, beèe a mmbaa weèr, weèr aè baa woweèe foñ.
English: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba mbe nfeè' moè', Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè' aè duñshïì seèe yi ñgeâe boèñboñ ba li rkoèñnïì,
English: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

Limbum: a ja' seèe. E m jaè' seèe njo' buu bboèñboñ mo' ce seèe aè m geèe ka'. AÈ m ba njo' yïì ñkoosimnse. E m suè'si viseèe mntee vi ba brara, a fa seèe ryoâñ rfi, yi yú' yi gee seèe aè ba beâe bfi.
English: not by works of righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njo' yuu ce Jisoès Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè' aè m geèe, e fa seèe yi yú' seê,
English: whom he poured out on us richly, through Jesus Christ our Savior;

Limbum: tá seèe bo ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njo' yi ñgeâe boèñboñ, loè koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè ce seèe ce keè' naè.
English: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

Limbum: Nlaèa ca yu nlaâa mini. M ce koèñ ená aè laa buu ca tatap seê, tá beèe ce a byemi neè Nyúè a bo loèr nfeè' ce geèe ba buu bboèñboñ. Buu ca vi yu byáánïì, sá' aè ba njo neè ñwáè wááwá.
English: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you affirm confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

Limbum: Fa sár mnsár blúr ka'. Fa caèasi nfeè' aè rbeè' braèraè beèe ce a m kweñger ka', fa ba ñwáè mlap ka', fa ce sár mnsár aèmboè mncir ce Nyúè aè m fa neè Musïìs naè ka'. Njáèá buu ca yu buu bcicïì, sá' aè ba njo ka'.
English: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' sár yuu ce aè ce yá'ni, aè cep ye. E ka' tá yu' ka' aè ker cep ye. Wáè ka' cep ye nfeè' baa e ke' yu' ka', aè fa túr yuu mo' aè rgeèe weèe ye ka'.
English: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning;

Limbum: Rïìñ ená mkwaè'shïì njáèá ñwáè ca mi jep, e ce geèe buu bbebep, a lor ndoèo mbe yeâ tuè.
English: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sins, being self-condemned.

Limbum: M be tuu AÈtimaè ká Taèikokoès áè, tá e vú yá wáè. E ka' vú ba', aè vú cárcár seê, vú yá máè aè rla' Nïìkapolïìs njobeè' máè kwaè'shi ená m be cu aè rla' ca tá luèu yi she.
English: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

Limbum: Gheèter ja' Sánaès ce e riñ mncir se naè, ker ja' AÈpoloès aè rjáèr ce woweèe a ce tami nyor aè rjáèr naè, yá ená woweèe a túr buu ce vi be jaè' woweèe aè rjáèr anaè.
English: Send Zenas, the lawyer, and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

Limbum: Geèe tá yïìseèe beèe a lor yaèp nfeè' ce geèe ba buu bboèñboñ tá woweèe a bo koni buu ce vi be jaè' woweèe keèr jaè' beèe mo' foñ. Woweèe a fa loèr yaèp nfeè' búsi ba aè cicïì ka'.
English: Let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá ce weèr woweèe yu aèfa a caè'ni wáè. Caè'ni beèe wááwá ce seèe woweèe aè byemi neè Jisos Kraêis, woweèe a koèñ weèr naè. M ce loo máná Nyúè túr weèe wááwá aè ntee boèñboñ.
English: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Poêl, ce m yu mbe shañ aètu Jisos Kraêis. M ce sañ yi weèr Timotïì ce e yu nfúr yïìseèe. Weèr ce sañ neè wáè ce Fïìlemúèn ce weèr koèñ seê, seèe aè ce faè' aè yuu mo'sir, ba beèe Nyúè wááwá ce a ke tarshi mbe wáâ ndaèp.
English: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

Limbum: Weèr ce sañ yi foñ neè wáè, AÈfiyaè ce aè yu njar yeèr, ker ba wáè ce AÈcipoès ce seèe aè reè bsïìp a rfeè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ.
English: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

Limbum: M ce loo máná Ta Nyúè, ba Tata Jisos Kraâis túr weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Má ke kuushi wáè aè nfeè' m ce loo, ker ce yoèñshi Nyúè a wáâ tuè,
English: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

Limbum: njobeè' m ce yu' aèmboè aè koèñ beèe Nyúè wááwá, a ker byemi neè Tata Jisos Kraêis.
English: hearing of your love, and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;

Limbum: M ce loo máná liseèe rtarshïû aèbee aèmboè ñgaâa rbyemïì li gee tá aè rïìñ boèñboñ aèmboè bghoènïì ce seèe aè koni aèmboè beèe Jisos Kraêis.
English: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

Limbum: Nfúraè, njáèá rkoèñnïì ce aè túr neè beèe Nyúè li geèe máè ce lu'shi, a ker tapsi máè. Wáè koèñ woweèe wa'a, a gee wap mntee vi fúteè.
English: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

Limbum: AÈmboè m yu ñwáè ntuu Jisos Kraêis, aède' m laa neè wáè a máâ ñger máná aè gee yuu ce aè túr aè rgeèe.
English: Therefore, though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

Limbum: A ka' ba njobeè' rkoèñnïì ce aè túr na, m be loo wáè loo. Kuushi wáná ce loo máè e loo wáè, máè ce Pol ce m yu nleeñwáè seè'ni, a ba mbe shañ aètu Jisos Kraêis.
English: yet for love's sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

Limbum: M ce loo máná aè koo muu waè OÈnásimoès ce máè beèeti yi ta seè'ni ce m yu mbe shañ na.
English: I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' entombïì e ba yuu cicïì neè wáè; seè'ni e yu lulu neè wáè ker ba neè máè foñ.
English: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

Limbum: M ce kúsi ye ce e yu wa mntee neè wáè.
English: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

Limbum: Seè'ni ce máè niñ shañ njobeè' Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ na, máè ba koèñ aè rláè ye aèfa tá e lor yo dïì', ce jaè' máè.
English: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

Limbum: Máè ke' geèe wa' ka', njobeè' m ce koèñ aè rgeèe yuu ce aè buu efa rrïìñ enjo ka'. M ce koèñ ba máná aè ka' ce gee yuu boèñboñ neè máè aè gee ba aèmboè wáè gwáá.
English: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

Limbum: Seemoè' yi yu ená ye ce OÈnásimoès aè m cañ ese wáè duè cu nfeè' múcaèr, e kúti bo cu weèe ye nfeseè.
English: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while, that you would have him forever,

Limbum: E be kúti keèr cu weèe ye seè'ni ba aèmboè ñkwaèa ka', e gha' ñkwaèa seè'ni. E be cu weèe ye seè'ni ba aèmboè nfúr ce weèe ye koèñni. E yu yuu goèr neè máè seê. E ka' ba neè máè wa'a, yi ka' ba yi ká aèmboè wáè ce e yu yoè ñwáè rfaè' a ker ba nfúroè ce weèe ye yu beèe Tataê?
English: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

Limbum: Baná yi ka' ba mini ená soè yu aè ñwáè moè'sir, aè konïì ye aèmboè wáè ba koni máè.
English: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba ená e m faèa yuu mo' neè wáè, káè e m ye wáè ba rkaa áè, aè suñ máè tá m la'.
English: But if he has wronged you at all, or owes you anything, put that to my account.

Limbum: Ce sañ máâ Pol neè ya bo, m be laè'. Baná m ker laèa yuu aèmboè rkaa ce wáè túr máè ka', rkaa ce yu ba yo tu nyor.
English: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides.

Limbum: Nfúraè, m ce loo wáè aè rlii Tata máná aè ja' máè, gee yuu boèñboñ ca neè máè. Geèe wa' njobeè' Jisos Kraêis, tá ya ntee yi bo keèr tap.
English: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce m ce sañ na, máè rïìñ máná aè be geèe yuu ce máè laèa na, keèr geèe caa embo naè.
English: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
