Limbum: M ce laèa foñ ená aè kupshi dïì' rnoèñ neè máè, njobeè' m ce kwaè'shi máná le rloo li be geèe tá Nyúè ker tuusi máè neè weèe.
English: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

Limbum: ÁÈpafraès ce weèr ye aè niñ shañ bsïìp aètu Jisos Kraêis, aè caè'ni wáè.
English: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

Limbum: Mak ba AÈristakoès, Demaès, ker ba Lukas ce weèr woweèe ce faè', a caè'ni wáè foñ.
English: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Jisos Kraâis túr weèe a ntee boèñboñ.
English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

Limbum: AÈ m ba eluâuñgoèñ, Nyúè aè laa neè viseèe bta nfeè' aèñgoo aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá. E m laèa njïì enjep beèe ce a m ce cep yi ntuu neè beèe.
English: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' e seè'ni ce yu ba mnoèñ elúèsimbuèu, Nyúè aè laa neè seèe njïì enjep muu yïì. Nyúè aè m geèe ñgoèñ ca wááwá ba njïì enjep muu yïì anaè. Nyúè aè m ce ye tá e bo fa buu wááwá mba yeâ mmboè.
English: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

Limbum: Foèo Nyúè yi ce yááti ba njïì enjep muu yïì, seèe aè riñ njáèá ñwáè ce Nyúè yu ba njïì enjep ye, njobeè' e ku ba aèmboè Nyúè yu. Muu yïì ca ce loèr vi blaèa ce vi túr ñger seê, a ce geèe ñgoèñ ca yi ku bii aègho. E m loèr yïì nyor a gee tañshïì aègho tá e bo geèe tá Nyúè foosi seèe efa yïìseèe buu bbebep. E ka' geèe wa'a, a ko' mbe buèu, a cu aè bo maè' Nyúè ce yi kúú yi táá kuèntombïì.
English: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself made purification for our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m fa muu yïì nta' ce yi caèa mnta' bcïìndap Nyúè. Cena yi ku ba foñ aèmboè rlii ce Nyúè aè fa neè ye li caa mlii bcïìndap Nyúè naè.
English: having become so much better than the angels, as he has inherited a more excellent name than they have.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ wa'a njobeè' Nyúè aè m be laa yuu ce e m laèa aèmboè muu yïì neè yïì ncïìndap moè' ka'. E m laèa aèmboè muu yïì enáê, “AÈ yu muu waè, ká' e ntïìni m yu yoè taê.” E m ker laa aèmboè muu yïì enáê, “M be ba yïì taê, tá e ba muu waè.” Nyúè aè m be laa aèmboè yïì ncïìndap moè' wa' ka'.
English: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, You are my Son. Today have I become your father? and again, I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m ba ená e be fa muu yïì ce aè m ba muu rñgoèo njep ñgoèñ, a laa enáê, “Tá bcïìndap Nyúè wááwá a gú'shi neè ye.”
English: Again, when he brings in the firstborn into the world he says, Let all the angels of God worship him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè bcïìndap, e a laa enáê, “Nyúè aè m geèe vi bcïìndap a ba aèmboè fu', yi ñgaâa mfaè' anaè a ba aèmboè mcuèñ mor.”
English: Of the angels he says, Who makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè muu, Nyúè aè laa enáê, “Wáâ Nyúè, yo kúú yi be cu nfeseè. AÈ be sa' yo to' neè mini-ñwáè.
English: But of the Son he says, Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

Limbum: Wáè koèñ ñgeâe boèñboñ, a baa ñgeâe bebep. A mbuèu ce Nyúè ce e yu yoè Nyúè aè ce wáè ená aè ba ñwáâ ñgoèr ce lu'shi caa bfúr wo.”
English: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

Limbum: E ker laa enáê, “Wáâ Tataê, aè m ba efa rkáè', wáè gee ñgoèñ ba buu embe buèu wááwá neè mo mmbo.
English: And, You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

Limbum: Buu ca vi be keè bú tá aè ku cu nfeseè. Vi be kúti brúèú aèmboè bcáè' wa'a.
English: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

Limbum: AÈ be kashi buu ca aèmboè a ke kashi cáè' naè. Vi be kupse aèmboè cáè' yi ke kwe ncoèo, kupse naè. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè wáè, aè be kupse ka', aède' aè ke kwe ka'.”
English: As a mantle, you will roll them up, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years will not fail.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' yu ce Nyúè aè m be laa yuu ce e m laèa neè muu yïì neè ye ka'. E m laèa neè muu yïì enáê, “Cu a máâ bo maè' caar tá m gee tá aè tár mkuèu mbenduè beèe ce a baèa wáè.”
English: But which of the angels has he told at any time, Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?

Limbum: Baná bcïìndap Nyúè ku ba ba byú' ce vi ke geèe rfaè' neè Nyúè. E ke tuu vi ená vi du ja' beèe ce e be geèe tá woweèe a luêñ.
English: Aren't they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

Limbum: AÈmboè seèe rïìñ buu ca wa'a, baná seèe aè ba loèr blaèa ce seèe aè yu' aèmboè ye na tatap seê, faè dïì' seèe lo fúú enjo ka'.
English: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

Limbum: Seèe aè rïìñ seená blaèa ce bcïìndap Nyúè a m suñ neè viseèe bta vi m túr ñger seê. Ñwáè ce e m ka' tee tu, yu'ni neè blaèa anaè ka', e m ku yá ñgá' ce e m ba yá.
English: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense;

Limbum: AÈmboè yi yu wa'a, seèe aè ka' lor blaèa ce vi yu aèmboè rluèñ ce li vúè ese Nyúè na aètáèr, seèe gee seeká ka' fúú efa ñgá'. Tata Jisoès aè m káè' a suñ beèe blaèa ca, beèe ce a m yu' blaèa ca ese ye a geèe seèe aè riñ ená blaèa anaè vi yu mini.
English: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation--which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe buu bbáèá, a duñshi yi ñger aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá, a ker lor ñger ce yi ke vúè ese yi Yú' Rara, a gapshi neè beèe aèmboè e m koèñ, tá beèe a bo rïìñ foñ ená blaèa ca vi yu mini.
English: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe ená ñgoèñ mo' ce weèr aè suñ weèe ená yi be vúè naè, be sa' ba bcïìndap Nyúè ka'.
English: For he didn't subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

Limbum: E m geèe ba aèmboè a sañ mbe dïì' mo' embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè. A sañ mbo enáê, “Tataê, muu ñwáè yu ká tá aè ka' kwaè'shi aèmboè ye? E yu ká tá aè ka' jaè' ye.
English: But one has somewhere testified, saying, What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

Limbum: Wáè m geèe yi nta' yi sáteè embe nta' bcïìndap Nyúè aè mú nfeè' moè', mú nfeè' anaè aè ka' caèa, wáè fa ye nta' kúú ba ryu'nïì,
English: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

Limbum: a gee e túr ñger mbenduè buu wááwá foñ.” AÈmboè e túr ñger mbenduè buu wááwá wa'a, baná yuu mo' yi yu ce e be buu efa rtúr ñger mbenduè mo ka'. AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' e seè'ni na, seèe aè ke' be yá ne aèmboè ñwáè túr ñger mbenduè buu wááwá ka'.
English: You have put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don't see all things subjected to him, yet.

Limbum: Ka' aèmboè weèr aè yá ñwáè ka' na, weèr aè yá Jisoès. AÈ m ba aè mú nfeè' moè' Nyúè aè gee nta' Jisoès yi sáteè embe nta' bcïìndap Nyúè. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' ñgá' ce Jisoès aè m yá, a kwe, Nyúè aè lo a fa ye nta' kúú, a gee ená beèe a yu'ni neè ye. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' Nyúè aè m túr ntee boèñboñ, yi ba ená Jisoès aè kwe aètu beèe wááwá.
English: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

Limbum: Buu wááwá aè geèe Nyúè, aè ba yïì buu. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e m roèo ená beèe magoèr a koni fáñ aè rba boo vi, sa' foèo, yi m ba yáánïì ená e gee tá ñwáè ce e be múè' njïì naè yá ñgá', ghááte aè ñwáè ce aède' e gee woweèe a luêñ.
English: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

Limbum: Yi yu ená Jisoès ce e ke geèe beèe a ba brara aè bsii Nyúè, ker ba beèe ce e ke geèe woweèe a ba brara anaè, a ku túr taèr moè'sir. A mbuèu ce rïìtu yi ce koo Jisoès aè rtoo woweèe ená bfúr vi ka'.
English: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' e laa enáê, “Nyúè, m be suñ bfúr wa aèmboè njáèá ñwáè ce aè yu; m be táá aè múè yoè beèe, yoèp yáá, náèsi wáè.”
English: saying, I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the congregation I will sing your praise.

Limbum: E keèr laèa aèmboè ñwáè e ke laèa, laa enáê, “M be láè buu wááwá mbe mmbo Nyúè.” E m ker laa foñ enáê, “Yá laè máè weèr boo ce Nyúè aè fa neè máè.”
English: Again, I will put my trust in him. Again, Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.

Limbum: Boo vi anaè ku ba beèe ce a túr láá foñ. Jisoès ye ye aè m vúè a ku ba ñwáè aèmboè woweèe tá e bo kwe, bepsi ñger Sataèn, njobeè' Sataèn a ñwáè ce e túr ñger aè rvúè neè rkwe mbenduè beèe.
English: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

Limbum: E m geèe wa'a, a ja' beèe ce a m ba bkwaèa njobeè' a m ce wáp rkwe.
English: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

Limbum: Yi yu rara ená e m vúè ba aè rjaè' bcïìndap Nyúè ka', e m vúè ba aè rjaè' ñgúè Abraèhaêm.
English: For most certainly, he doesn't give help to angels, but he gives help to the seed of Abraham.

Limbum: Yi m ba yáánïì ená e beeñger ba aèmboè bfúr vi aè mnduunjïì wááwá, tá e bo ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce e be faè' neè Nyúè neè mini-ñwáè, koosimnse neè beèe, tá e bo maa yaèp buu bbebep.
English: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

Limbum: E ghááte aè rjaè' beèe ce rmoèoshïì li vúè neè woweèe njobeè' rmoèoshïì li m vúè neè ye ye, e riñ ñgá' efa rmoèoshïì foñ.
English: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, Nyúè aè m ká' weèe ená weèe bo ba yïì beèe. Baná weèe kwa'shi aèmboè ñwáè ce Jisoès yu. A ye ce e táá aètu Nyúè, a ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì efa buu Nyúè ce seèe aè byemi aègho.
English: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;

Limbum: E m geèe rfaè' ce Nyúè aè m ce ye ená e gee naè neè mini-ñwáè. E m ku gee rfaè' anaè neè mini-ñwáè aèmboè Musïìs ye ye aè m geèe neè beèe Nyúè naè.
English: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

Limbum: Jisoès yu ñwáè ce beèe a ba kuè'si ye caèa Musïìs, aèmboè beèe a ke kuè'si ñwáè ce e baè'ri ndap caa ndap ce e baè'ri naè.
English: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who built the house has more honor than the house.

Limbum: Ndap moè' yu ce aè buu efa rbaè'ri ñwáè ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ñwáè ce e m geèe buu wááwá yu Nyúè.
English: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

Limbum: Musïìs aè m geèe rfaè' neè beèe Nyúè neè mini-ñwáè. E m geèe rfaè' ca wa'a a ku ba ba ñwáè rfaè' neè Nyúè. Li rfaè' anaè li m táá ba aètu yuu ce Nyúè aè m bii ka' geèe tá beèe a rïîñ.
English: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis yu yi ba muu ce e túr ñger mbenduè beèe Nyúè aèmboè muu ñwáè ndap e ke túr ñger mbenduè buu yïì ta naè. E ce geèe rfaè' anaè neè mini-ñwáè. See seèe yu beèe Nyúè, ce seèe aè ka' ku táá tatap, lá mmir mbenduè buu ce Nyúè a kaè' neè seèe, ce yu' rboèñ aè rsuñ beèe buu anaè.
English: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

Limbum: Baná weèe aè ba yu' yuu ce Yú' Rara yi laèa. Yi laèa enáê, “Weèe aè ka' yu' njeèndoñ Nyúè ntïìni,
English: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, Today if you will hear his voice,

Limbum: weèe fa teèe btu aèmboè weêe bta a m teèe neè Nyúè, a kani efa rgeèe yuu ce e m laèa naè ka'. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce woweèe a m ce jáèr aè rïìñ naè, woweèe a m teèe btu neè máè. Woweèe a m teèe wa'a a mooshi máè.
English: don't harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

Limbum: Woweèe a m moèoshi máè aè rïìñ anaè wa'a, a yá buu ce máè m geèe neè woweèe aè bfeè' mñkyeèe.
English: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce ntee yi m bep máè neè beèe anaè, máè laa máná woweèe a kani efa ryu'ni neè máè, a ker riñ ya nduunjïì ka'.
English: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, 'They always err in their heart, but they didn't know my ways;'

Limbum: Ntee yi m bep máè neè woweèe, máè ye leè' máná aède' woweèe a ke ba' a ya dïû' rlúèshïì tá a bo lúèshi ka'.”
English: as I swore in my wrath, 'They will not enter into my rest.'

Limbum: Bfúr waê, loèr neè nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú túr ntee bebep, kani efa rfoèosi neè Nyúè, maè'shi Nyúè ka'. Kuushi neè ená Nyúè ca yu Nyúè ce e yu nteèe.
English: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

Limbum: Yuu ce weèe aè ba geèe yi yu ená weèe aè ba cep wee btu faè dïì' ntee bebep anaè yi bo' ñwáè moè' tá e tee tu neè Nyúè ka'. Kuè ce gee neè wa'a aè mnoèñ wááwá aèmboè nfeè' ku bii aègho ntïìni na.
English: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called today; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

Limbum: Seèe Jisos Kraâis weèe yu ñwáè moè'sir, ce seèe ka' ku táá tatap ba aè yuu ce seèe aè byemi naè du ba' aèlúèsimbuèu.
English: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Weèe ka' yu' njeèndoñ Nyúè ntïìni, weèe fa teèe tu aèmboè weêe bta a m teèe neè Nyúè, a kani efa rgeèe yuu ce e m laèa naè ka'.”
English: while it is said, Today if you will hear his voice, don't harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m yu' njeèndoñ Nyúè a tee btu neè Nyúè aè m ba weèe ká? AÈ m ba beèe ce Musïìs aè m fúr efa bkwaèa aè to' Ijïìp eluâuñgoèñ naè.
English: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn't all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?

Limbum: Beèe ce Nyúè aè m bepsi ntee neè woweèe aè bfeè' mñkyeèe naè aè m ba weèe ká? AÈ m ba beèe ce a m geèe buu bbebep a kweñger aè rïìñ naè.
English: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn't it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m ye leè' ená aède' woweèe a vú ba' fa yeâ dïû' rlúèshïì ka' naè, e m ye leè' anaè aètu weèe ká? AÈ m ba beèe ce a m teèe tu neè Nyúè naè.
English: To whom did he swear that they wouldn't enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

Limbum: Baná seèe aè yá seè'ni ená woweèe a m duè ba' aè dïì' ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená woweèe a be duè baè' naè ka', njobeè' woweèe a m byemi neè ye ka'.
English: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.

Limbum: Nyúè ku bii kaè' ená aède' seèe vú mbe yïû dïû' rlúèshïì foñ. Baná seèe lor nfeè' faè dïì' moè' efa seèe lo buu efa rbaè' aè dïû' rlúèshïì anaè ka'.
English: Let us fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

Limbum: Weèr aè yu' blaâa Nyúè ce a feè'shi neè weèr aèmboè woweèe foñ a m yu' naè. Weèr aè yá werná blaâa Nyúè ce a m yu' anaè vi m túr sá' neè woweèe ka' njobeè' woweèe a m yu' wa'a, a byemi ka'.
English: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn't profit them, because it wasn't mixed with faith by those who heard.

Limbum: Beèe ce a be baè' mbe dïì' ce Nyúè e ke lúèshi anaè, lúèshi mbo foñ, yu ba seèe ce seèe aè yu' blaâa Nyúè a byemi. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a m yu' blaâa Nyúè a byemi ka' naè, Nyúè aè sañ mbe yeâ ñwaè' enáê, “Ntee yi m bep máè neè woweèe, máè ka' máná aède' woweèe a vú ba' mbe ya dïû' rlúèshïì tá a bo lúèshi ka'.” Yi yu ená dïû' rlúèshïì yi m buu ka', njobeè' e m ce laèa wa'a, e m banïì gee ñgoèñ wáá a lúshi yi yu.
English: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest; although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

Limbum: A sañ mbe dïì' mo' embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè aèmboè noèñ ce Nyúè aè m mïìsi li rfaè', enáê, “Nyúè aè m geèe li rfaè' aè mnoèñ ntuunfu a misïî, túè' aè ka' raa ce ená a mnoèñ saèambaê, e lúshïì.”
English: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, God rested on the seventh day from all his works;

Limbum: Ka' dïû' rlúèshïì anaè yi m ba aègho wáá wa'a, Nyúè aè ku ker laa enáê, “AÈde' woweèe a ba' mbe ya dïû' rlúèshïì tá a bo lúèshi ka'.”
English: and in this place again, They will not enter into my rest.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu rara ená beèe mo' a be baè' aè dïû' rlúèshïì anaè wa'a, yi ku ba rara foñ ená beèe ce a m yu' blaâa Nyúè a byemi ka' naè, a m baè' aè dïû' rlúèshïì anaè ka'.
English: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter therein, and they to whom the good news was before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyúè aè lá nfeè' moè' ce beèe a be lúèshi ce yu nfeè' e seè'ni na. Bfeè' vi ka' caèa aèñgoo seê, Nyúè aè laa njïì enjep Dávïìd. E m ku laa ba blaèa ce weèr aè sañ neè weèe wáá naè. E m laèa enáê, “Wáè ka' yu' njeèndoñ Nyúè ntïìni na, aè fa teèe tu ka'.”
English: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through David so long a time afterward just as has been said, Today if you will hear his voice, don't harden your hearts.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ wáá ená Joshuèwaè aè m loèr viseèe btarkú a du aègho aè to' Kánaèn. To' Kánaèn anaè aè m ba ba dïû' rlúèshïì anaè, Nyúè aè m ba ker laa aèmboè nfeè' rlúèshïì ce e bii ka' ba ka'.
English: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

Limbum: Yi yu rara ená nfeè' rlúèshïì ce beèe Nyúè a be lúèshi naè bii ka' ba. Nfeè' anaè be keè ba aèmboè noèñ ce Nyúè aè m geèe li rfaè' a ka' mïìsi wáá a lúshi naè.
English: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' baè' mbe dïû' rlúèshïì ca lúshi mbo, baná ñgaèñ be keèr faè' ka', aèmboè Nyúè ye ye aè m mïìsi li rfaè' a lúshïî, a ker fa' ka' naè.
English: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

Limbum: Baná seèe gheter ba' mbe dïû' rlúèshïì anaè. Ñwáè fa ba ce e be buu efa rbaè' aè dïì' anaè njobeè' e teèe tu aèmboè viseèe bta a m teèe naè ka'.
English: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

Limbum: Blaâa Nyúè vi yu bteèe, a túr ñger, vi cáp a caa sa' mbyáèráñ. Vi loè niñ njep ntee ñwáè ker niñ njep mi mkwaè'shïì caa aèmboè saè' mbyáèráñ e ke niñ nje yuu naè. Blaâa Nyúè ca vi ke geèe buu ce ñwáè ce kwaè'shi njep yeâ ntee vi yáátïì aèwañ.
English: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

Limbum: Yuu mo' yi yu efa buu ce Nyúè aè m geèe ce aède' Nyúè buu efa ryá ka'. Buu wááwá vi yu aèwañ aè bsii Nyúè ce e yu ñwáè ce seèe be keè táá kuèntombïì neè ye aè noèñ mo', suñ buu wááwá ce seèe aè m geèe.
English: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

Limbum: Seèe táá tatap ba aè buu mini ce seèe aè yu' a byemi naè njobeè' seèe túr tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce e yu ñgoèr, ce e cu mbe buèu a táá a seâe btuè. Ñwáè tañshïû ñgoèr ca yu Jisoès ce e yu muu Nyúè.
English: Having then a great high priest, who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold tightly to our confession.

Limbum: E yu ñwáè ce e rïìñ buu ce vi yu btatap neè seèe, a ce koosimnse neè seèe njobeè' ye ye ku ba aèmboè seèe. Rmoèoshïì li m vúè neè ye foñ aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá aèmboè li ke vúè neè seèe, geewa'a e ke' gwe ka'.
English: For we don't have a high priest who can't be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

Limbum: Baná vúè aègee kaèbaèraè' Nyúè, ke' ce tarni ka', yá ntee boèñboñ ce e túr neè seèe, njobeè' a mbe dïì' ce Nyúè be koosimnse neè seèe, jaè' seèe aè nfeè' ce yi yu ená e ba jaè' seèe.
English: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.

Limbum: Seèe riñ ená a ke ce tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì efa múè beèe tá e bo táá aètu beèe kuèntombïì neè Nyúè, koo buu ce beèe a fa neè Nyúè, keèr tañshi btañshïì aètu yaèp buu bbebep.
English: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e túr njáèá ntee ce aède' yi gee ye e gee yuu bebep, e riñ foñ yuu yáánïì ce aède' e gee neè beèe ce a ku ba aènji, a ce daè'.
English: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e túr njáèá ntee ca, baná e túr aè rtañshi tañshïì aètu yïì buu bebep aèmboè e ke tañshi aètu buu bbebep beèe mo' naè.
English: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená ñwáè tañshi tañshïì e ke ce yi tu tá beèe a bo ce yu'ni neè ye ka'. Nyúè a ñwáè ce e ke ce ñwáè tañshi tañshïì aèmboè e m ce Ároèn naè.
English: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis ye ye aè m ce yi tu aè ñwáè tañshi tañshïû ñgoèr ka'. Nyúè a ñwáè ce e m ce ye. E m ce ye wa'a, a laa enáê, “AÈ yu muu waè, máè ba yoè ta ká' e ntïìni na.”
English: So also Christ didn't glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, You are my Son. Today I have become your father.

Limbum: E ker laa mbe dïì' mo' foñ enáê, “Máè ce wáè ená aè ba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì aè nfeè' wááwá aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk aè m ba naè.”
English: As he says also in another place, You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.

Limbum: Jisoès aè m loo neè Nyúè aè nfeè' ce e m ba njep ñgoèñ na. E m loo wa'a a ce warñger a ce suèusi mñgoommir. E m loo neè Nyúè njobeè' Nyúè aè m túr ñger aè rjaè' ye efa rkwe. Nyúè aè m yu' li rloo njobeè' e m ce loo neè ryu'nïì-ñwáè.
English: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

Limbum: Ka' e m ba muu Nyúè wa'a, e m rïìñ aèmboè aède' e yu'nïì neè Nyúè ba njo' ñgá' ce e m loè a yá.
English: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe ye e ba yáánïì seê, a ba seè'ni na ba ñwáè ce e ce fa ryoèñ ce nfeseè neè beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè ye.
English: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

Limbum: E m ghááte aè rgeèe wa'a njobeè' Nyúè aè m kuè'si ye aè tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk aè m ba naè.
English: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

Limbum: Weèr túr buu magoèr se aè rlaèa aèmboè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì ca, geewa'a weèr aè rïìñ aèmboè aède' weèr nashïì vi neè weèe ka' njobeè' weèr ka' nashi weèe yu' ka'.
English: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

Limbum: Weèe aè yá'ni a riñ buu seê, nfeè' aè ka' gháá ce weèe aè ba yá'ni beèe mo' foñ, weèr aè yá werná ñwáè moè' aè ba keèr yá'ni weèe buu Nyúè ce weèe aè m rïìñ efa rkáè' naè. Weèe ku bii nyoñ ba mmbee, ce weèe aè ba ghááte aè rye ba buu.
English: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce nyoñ ba mmbee, baná ñgaèñ ku bii munte, a be lááte aè ryá'nïì ce li yu aèmboè aède' ñwáè ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce aède' e ye yuu yu ba nleeñwáè. A ñwáè ce e yá'ni, a lááte a riñ yuu boèñboñ ba yuu bebep.
English: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

Limbum: Baná seèe yá'ni riñ buu btatap ce vi yu aèmboè Jisos Kraâis tá seèe bo ba bleebeèe aè buu Nyúè. Seèe fa kuè cu ba aè ryá'nïì ce a m káè' a yá'ni seèe naè ka'. Seèe aè yá'ni a riñ wáá ená beèe a ba kupse, borni efa rgeèe buu ce aède' vi vú neè rkwe, byemi ba neè Nyúè.
English: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection--not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

Limbum: Seèe aè yá'ni aèmboè baèptïîr, ker ba aèmboè a ke la' beèe mmbo mbe tuè, a ker yá'ni aèmboè Nyúè be keè fúr beèe efa rkwe, a yá'ni aèmboè mnsa' ce a be keè sa', teni nfeseè.
English: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

Limbum: Baná Nyúè aè ka' byemi, seèe yá'nïì buu mo' bfi.
English: This will we do, if God permits.

Limbum: Beèe a ka' riñ njáèá ñwáè ce Nyúè yu, lo beesi njïì neè ye, njïì moè' ker ba aègho ce aède' ñwáè geêe, woweèe a beesïì yap ntee aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Woweèe a m yá rraa ce li m loè ese Nyúè, a riñ bghoènïì ce Nyúè aè fa woweèe, a koni Yú' Rara njep waâp mntee.
English: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

Limbum: A yu'shi blaâa Nyúè, a riñ ená vi ke leèe seê, a ker riñ foñ njáèá ñger ce yi be ba aè ñgoâñ fi ce yi bii ka' ba naè.
English: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,

Limbum: Beèe a ka' riñ buu Nyúè ca wa'a, beesi njïì neè ye, baná njïì moè' ker ba aègho ce aède' ñwáè geêe, woweèe a beesïì yap ntee aè nfeè' moè' ka', njobeè' woweèe a ka' beesi njïì wa'a, baná woweèe a ker taa Jisos Kraâis mbe kïìntaa, a ker coosi ye aè múè beèe, a bá sá' efa li rkwe.
English: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

Limbum: Mbeèñ aè ka' gweê, nshe nyoñ mbeèñ anaè, byee ce beèe a byeè vi ku' ja' beèe anaè baná Nyúè be ghoèni nshe anaè.
English: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it, and brings forth a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

Limbum: Yuu ce yi ka' fúú ku' mbe dïì' anaè aè ka' ku ba ba ñgúú ba msini, baná nshe anaè yu aè cicïì. Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná nfeè' aè gháá ce Nyúè be bepsi nshe anaè tá a too neè mor.
English: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

Limbum: Bkar waê, weèr ce báá weèe wa'a a ku riñ werná weèe ce jáèr ba njep nduunjïû yáánïì, a ce luèñ.
English: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

Limbum: Nyúè e ke geèe buu aè njïû yáánïì. E be maè' weèe ka'. E be leèse rfaè' ce weèe aè geèe, káè leèse njáèá rjaè' ce weèe aè m jaè' yïì beèe a ku bii jaè' naè ka'. Weèe aè m jaè' woweèe njobeè' weèe koèñ Nyúè.
English: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

Limbum: Weèr ce koèñ werná weèe wááwá ku ce gee rfaè' ca neè ye ntee-ñwáè caar du ba' aèlúèsimbuèu, tá weèe bo koni buu ce weèe cu ce keè' naè.
English: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

Limbum: Weèr ce koèñ ená weèe koosi bbor ka'. Weèr ce koèñ ená weèe ba ba aèmboè beèe ce a ce byemi yuu ce yi yu mini, a ke' ce bu' ka'. Weèe aè ba ba wa'a njobeè' njáèá beèe ca yu beèe ce a be koni buu ce Nyúè aè kaè' neè yïì beèe.
English: that you won't be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherited the promises.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m geèe mkaè'ni neè Abraèham naè, ñwáè moè' aè m ker ba ce e caèa ye ce Nyúè ka'. AÈ ka' ba wa'a, e kaa ba aè li rlii ená e be geèe yuu ce e laèa.
English: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he swore by himself,

Limbum: E m laèa enáê, “Rbuu ba nshe a ka' ba ce tarte, m buu efa rghoèni wáè keèr geèe tá yoè ñgúè yaa ka'.”
English: saying, Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.

Limbum: Abraèham aè ka' kur ntee, ce bu' ka', a koni buu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè ye naè.
English: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

Limbum: Seèe aè rïìñ seená beèe a ke kaèa aè rlii ñwáè ce e caèa woweèe. Beèe a ke kaèa wa'a, yi ce geèe mntañshïì vi ce mïì efa múè beèe.
English: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

Limbum: Nyúè ye ye aè koèñ ená beèe ce a be loè koni yuu ce e m kaè' neè woweèe naè, a riñ ghup ená e be kupse yuu ce e m laèa ka'. A mbuèu ce e m kaèa aè li rlii.
English: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, buu bbaa vi yu ce aède' vi kupseè ka' njobeè' aède' Nyúè laa wa'a nya' ba mnde' ka'. Buu bbaa anaè a buu ce vi ce fa seèe ñger tá seèe ce seèe aè cañ a súni njeptii Nyúè seèe bo rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená seèe be koni buu ce Nyúè aè kaè' neè seèe.
English: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

Limbum: AÈmboè seèe aè rïìñ seená Nyúè e ke kupse mi mkaè'ni ka' naè, aède' viseèe mntee vi ker bu' ka'. Baná seèe aè tii ndaèñ a niñ mbe dïû' rara embe Ndaèp Nyúè.
English: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil;

Limbum: Jisoès aè duè a niñ mbe dïû' rara anaè entombïì neè seèe a táá mbo a seâe btuè, a ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì nfeseè aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk aè m ba naè.
English: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

Limbum: Máèlkisidáèk ca aè m ba ñkúú aè to' Saláèm, a ba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì neè Nyúè embe buèu. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' Abraèham aè ka' duè maè' bïìr a bkúú mo', a so woweèe. A ka' ce kúti, Máèlkisidáèk aè du a koni ye a ghoni ye.
English: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

Limbum: Abraèham ye ye aè lor buu ce e m koo aè ñkúè bïìr a gap bdïì' rúêú, a lor dïû' mo'sir a fa neè Máèlkisidáèk. Mbuèu efa rlii Máèlkisidáèk ca yu enáê, “Ñkúú ce e ke geèe ñgeâe yáánïì.” Mbuèu efa rlii yi to' yu enáê, “Cumúnyañ” Baná li rlii li yu foñ enáê, “Ñkúú cumúnyañ”
English: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all being first, by interpretation, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace;

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' yu ce e rïìñ yïì ma káè yïì ta ka'. A laèa yuu mo' aèmboè yi raèraè ka'. Seèe rïìñ nfeè' a m bi ye káè nfeè' ce e m kwe ka'. E yu aèmboè muu Nyúè, e yu ñwáè tañshi tañshïì nfeseè.
English: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, remains a priest continually.

Limbum: Yá neè aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk aè m ba ñwáâ ñgoèr. Abraèham ce e m ba taèr beâe aè to' Isráèl aè m loèr buu ce e m koo aè ñkúè bïìr a gaèp bdïì' rúêú, a lor dïû' mo'sir a fa neè Máèlkisidáèk.
English: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best spoils.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce a yu raèraâ Lávïì naè, ncir yi byemi ená woweèe a koo dïû' mo'sir efa bdïì' rúú efa buu jáá jáèá jáá ce beâe aè to' Isráèl a túr. Yuu ce seèe rïìñ yi yuu ená woweèe a ce koo buu ca ba ese bfúr wap, ka' woweèe wááwá a yu ñgúè Abraèham wa'a.
English: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest's office have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

Limbum: Ka' Máèlkisidáèk aè m ba raèraâ Lávïì ka' wa'a, e m koni buu ese Abraèham ce e yu ñwáè ce Nyúè aè m kaè' buu neè ye, a ghoni ye.
English: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè sánïì ená ñwáè ce e ke ghoèni ñwáè, yu ñwáâ ñgoèr a caa ñwáè ce e ghoèni naè ka'.
English: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

Limbum: Ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce a yu raèraâ Lávïì ce beèe a ke fa woweèe dïû' mo'sir efa buu ce woweèe a túr naè, a ke loè kweñger. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk, Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa ená e ku cu nteèe.
English: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' Abraèham aè m gaèp buu bdïì' rúêú, lor dïû' mo'sir a fa neè Máèlkisidáèk naè, yi m ba aèmboè Lávïì ce boo vi a ke koo dïû' mo'sir efa buu rúú naè aè m lá fa foñ wa'a.
English: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

Limbum: AÈde' seèe laa wa'a njobeè' Máèlkisidáèk aè m duè aè rkoni Abraèham ce e m ba tarkú Lávïì, a be bi Lávïì ka'.
English: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m geèe raèraâ Lávïì a ba ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì naè, e m fa mncir neè beâe aè to' Isráèl tá a bo rïìñ aè rloo neè ye. Rfaè' ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ca li m ka' ba ghááte aè rgeèe tá beèe a ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè, mbuèu moè' aè m ba keèr ba ená seèe túr ñwáè tañshi tañshïì moè' ce e yu ba aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk ce e yu jáá efa Ároèn naè ka'.
English: Now if there was perfection through the Levitical priesthood for under it the people have received the law, what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

Limbum: Yi yu rara ená ñwáè tañshi tañshïì moè' ka vúê, ce geèe tañshïì yi aè njáâá jáá, baná mncir vi be kupse foñ.
English: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè Tata Jisoès ce seèe ce laèa aèmboè ye na, e m ba yi ba raèraâ jáá. Ñwáè ce e yu raèraè anaè aè m be fa' aè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì ka'.
English: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená e m ba yi ba raèraâ Judaè. Musïìs aè m laèa yuu mo' a kuu raèraè ca aè nfeè' ce e m ce laèa aèmboè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ka'.
English: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi geèe yuu seèe ce laèa aèmboè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì na yi ba rara seê, yi yu ená ñwáè tañshi tañshïì moè' aè vúè a ba yi ba aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk.
English: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

Limbum: E yu ñwáè tañshi tañshïì, a ke' ba ba aèmboè ncir kuu raèraè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì yi ce laèa ka'. E yu ñwáè tañshi tañshïì njobeè' e túr ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Ku ba ñger efa ryoèñ anaè ce e geèe e ba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì.
English: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life:

Limbum: Seèe aè rïìñ wa'a njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Máè ce wáè ená aè ba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì aè nfeè' wááwá aèmboè Máèlkisidáèk aè m ba naè.”
English: for it is testified, You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.

Limbum: Baná a m maè' mncir ce vi m ba entombïì njobeè' vi m túr ñger aè rjaè' beèe ka'.
English: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

Limbum: Vi m túr ñger aè rgeèe ñwáè tá e ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ka'. Yuu ce seèe ce laèa aègho seè'ni yi yu aèndeèe njobeè' a yuu ce aède' yi vú neè seèe aègee Nyúè.
English: for the law made nothing perfect, and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená aè m ba aè nfeè' Nyúè aè m laèa ená e be geèe Jisoès aè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì nfeseè naè, a kaêa. AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' e m geèe raèraâ Lávïì aè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì naè, e kaa ka'.
English: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ka' geèe Jisoès aè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì, a kaêa, a laa neè ye enáê, “Máâ Taèr, máè kaèa ená aè be ba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì nfeseè. AÈde' ya nlaèa ca yi kupseè ka'”
English: for they indeed have been made priests without an oath, but he with an oath by him that says of him, The Lord swore and will not change his mind, 'You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.'

Limbum: Cena yi yu ená Jisoès yu ñwáè ce e geèe leè' ce Nyúè aè ye seèe woweèe naè yi tap a caa leâ' rúèú.
English: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce aè m ba raèraâ Lávïì naè a m ba aèñgoo njobeè' aè m ba beèe ce a be loè kweñger, tá lap rfaè' li mïì.
English: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

Limbum: Jisoès yu yi ba ñwáè ce e cu nteèe nfeseè, aède' e ke buu efa rba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
English: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce e túr ñger aè rgeèe tá beèe ce a vúè kuèntombïì neè Nyúè aè li rlii a luñ dúèdúè njobeè' e cu nteèe nfeseè a ce loo a seâe btuè.
English: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

Limbum: Baná Jisoès a tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce e ghááte neè seèe. E ghááte njobeè' e yu ñwáâ nrara a ce kwaè'shi káè a ce geèe faèa ka', a ba yi jáá efa beèe ce a ke geèe buu bbebep, Nyúè aè naa ye mbekïì.
English: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

Limbum: Btu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ca a m ce tañshi aè mnoèñ wááwá. Woweèe a m ce káè' be tañshi aètu yaèp buu bbebep wáá, ka' tañshi aètu buu bbebep beèe. Jisoès aè m tañshi tañshïì yi ba aè njáâá wa' ka'. E m tañshi yi nfeè' moè'sir yi ku mi wa'a. E m tañshi tañshïì anaè ba aè nfeè' ce e m fa yïì nyor, a kwe a seâe btuè naè.
English: who doesn't need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

Limbum: Ncir Musïìs yi byemi ená ñwáè ce aède' e gee faèa ba aè tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè leè' ce Nyúè a m ye, ce yi lor dïì' mncir naè, e m ce ba muu yïì aè ñwáè tañshi tañshïì. E m geèe ye e ba yáánïì nfeseè.
English: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath which came after the law appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

Limbum: Yuu tatap ce weèr ce laèa yi yu ená seèe túr tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce e ghááte neè seèe. E cu mbe buèu aè bo maè' kaèbaèraè' Nyúè ce e ke sa' li rsa' neè ñger-ñwáè.
English: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this. We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

Limbum: E yu ñwáè ce e ke faè' mbe dïû' rara ce yi yu mbe dïì' ce a ke loo neè Nyúè. Dïû' rara ca aè m geèe ñwáè ka', aè m geèe ba Nyúè. Yu dïì' rloo ce yi yu yáánïì.
English: a servant of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

Limbum: Rfaè' ce tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì e ke geèe li yu ená e koo buu ce beèe a fa, ker ba buu tañshïì, gee tañshïì aègho. Baná yi m ba boèñboñ ená tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce e táá a seâe btuè mbe buèu naè túr yuu mo' ce ye ye be fa neè Nyúè foñ.
English: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

Limbum: E m ba ba njep ñgoèñ na e m ba ba ñwáè tañshi tañshïì ka' njobeè' ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a yu njep ñgoèñ na wáá, a ce tañshi tañshïì aèmboè ncir Musïìs yi laèa.
English: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;

Limbum: Rfaè' ce ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ca a ce geèe li táá ba aètu yuu ce yi yu mbe buèu. Seèe rïìñ wa'a njobeè' aè m ba aè nfeè' ce Musïìs aè m ce tami nyor aè rbaè'ri taèp neè bcáè' naè, Nyúè aè laa neè ye enáê, “Loèr nfeè' ba'ri taèp ca tá yi ku ba aèmboè máè m suñ wáè mbe rtuèu Sinaèi ená aè ba'ri naè.”
English: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè rfaè' ce Jisoès ce geèe, li caèa rfaè' ce ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì mo' ca a ce geèe. Yi yu foñ ená leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye seèe woweèe, tañshïì efa gho aè ba Jisoès naè, yi boèñ a caa yïì ce yi m ba entombïì. Yi yu wa'a njobeè' Nyúè aè kaè' seèe buu ce vi boèñ a caa vïì ce vi m ba njo' leè' anaè.
English: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

Limbum: Leè' entoèmbïì anaè yi m ba ghááte aè rgeèe tá beèe a ba byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè, Nyúè aè m ba keèr ye leè' mo' ka'.
English: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m yá ená yi m ghááte ka'. Seèe rïìñ wa'a njobeè' e m laèa enáê, “Nfeè' moè' be keè ba ce m be ye leâ' fi weèr beèe Isráèl ba beèe Judaè. Nlaèa ca aè laèa máâ Tata Nyúè.
English: For finding fault with them, he said, Behold, the days come, says the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

Limbum: Leè' anaè yi be ba jáá efa yïì ce máè m ye weèr wap bta aè noèñ ce máè m jaè' woweèe, a fúr woweâe aè to' Ijïìp naè. Woweèe a m bú' leè' ce máè m ye weèr woweèe, máè beesïì njïì neè woweèe. Nlaèa ca aè laèa máâ Tata Nyúè.
English: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn't continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.

Limbum: Máâ Taèr, máè laèa mánáê, Leè' ce m be ye weèr beèe Isráèl aè mnoèñ ce vi bii ka' ba naè yi yu ená m be geèe tá woweèe a kupse yap ntee, ce yu' rboèñ aè rláè wa mncir. M be ba yaèp Nyúè tá woweèe a ba yaè beèe.
English: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel. After those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

Limbum: Mbuèu moè' be keèr ba aègho neè ñwáè aè ryá'ni bfúr vi, laèa neè woweèe enáê, ‘Rïìñ neè Taèr’ ka', njobeè' woweèe wááwá a be keè rïìñ máè, ká' embe beâe bká'ká' du ba' mbe beâe bgoèrgoèr.
English: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen, and every man his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' for all will know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them.

Limbum: Yi be ba wa'a njobeè' m be keè koosimnse neè woweèe, foèosi woweèe efa yaèp buu bbebep, keèr kuushi vi aè nfeè' moè' ka.”
English: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ce laèa aèmboè leâ' fi wa'a baná e m geèe leè' entoèmbïì yi kútïì yuu rúèú. Yuu yi ka' kúti rúèú, beeñger aè yuu cicïì, baná yuu anaè yi be bú.
English: In that he says, A new covenant, he has made the first old. But that which is becoming old and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ye leè' a yïì beèe aè nfeè' entombïì, a gee mncir ce vi m ba aèmboè aède' woweèe a loo neè ye. Dïì' mo' yi m ba ce a m ce loo neè Nyúè mbo.
English: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service, and an earthly sanctuary.

Limbum: A m beèe dïì' anaè neè bcáè', a ba'ri taèp neè bcáè' foñ mbe múè mo. A m baè'ri taèp anaè wa'a, yi ba brum bbaa. A m too yïì entombïì enáê, “Dïû' rara.” Buu ce a m láè mbe rum anaè aè m ba laêm, ba tábuèr ba bráâd yïû Nyúè.
English: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lampstand, the table, and the show bread; which is called the Holy Place.

Limbum: A m teni rum yïì enje mú ba neè cáè'. A m too rum yïì anaè ená, Dïû' rara ce yi caèa ñger.
English: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

Limbum: Dïû' ntoèo nráèá yi m ba mbo, a yo' neè guêl. Ñkuèp leè' Nyúè aè m ba mbe rum anaè foñ. A m yo' ñkuèp anaè neè gul foñ. A m láè ntúñ ce a m geèe neè guêl, a lá manaè njo, a lá njep ñkuèp anaè. Mbaèñ Ároèn ce e m loè a saa mmbar, aè m ba njep ñkuèp anaè. Bluèr ce Nyúè aè m sañ leè' mbo naè vi m ba njo foñ.
English: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron's rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

Limbum: A m kupshi buu mo' bbaa aèmboè bcïìndap Nyúè wa'a, ce vi m ce duèñshi foèo Nyúè, a tooshi mbenduè ñkuèp anaè aè rduèñshi ená Nyúè yu mbe dïì' anaè. Vi m táá aè bgeñ ñkuèp, a búr bbaèp vi tarteè a tá'shi ñkuèp ce Nyúè e ke foèosi buu bbebep beèe mbo. AÈde' weèr suñ weèe buu ca wááwá seè'ni ka'.
English: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can't speak now in detail.

Limbum: A m kupshi buu embe brum bbaa ca wa'a, ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a ce duè mbe rum yïû entombïì a ce geèe rfaè' mbo neè Nyúè aè mnoèñ wááwá,
English: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

Limbum: ñwáè ce e ce niñ mbe rum yïì embenjïì aè ku ba tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì. E ke niñ mbo nfeè' moè'sir njep feè'. E niñ wa'a, túr bláá mbú tá e bo ñwañshi aètu yïì buu bbebep ker ba buu bbebep ce beèe a m geèe a riñ ka' naè.
English: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for the errors of the people.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' ce geèe buu ca wa'a, Yú' Rara yi gee yi ba rara ená aèmboè dïû' rara ca yi ku bii aègho na, njïì yi yu neè beèe wááwá aè rniñ mbe dïû' rara ce yi caèa ñger naè ka'.
English: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn't yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing;

Limbum: Buu ca vi táá ba aètu buu ce vi yu seè'ni na. Yi duèñshi seèe ená mfa ba btañshïì ce a m ce geèe neè Nyúè naè vi túr ñger aè rgeèe ñwáè tá e riñ ená e yu nrara aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: which is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshipper perfect;

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a njobeè' buu anaè vi kuèu ba buu ce seèe ce yá neè mmir aèmboè byee ba buu mno, ker ba ndeèe ce e yu ba aèmboè aède' beèe a su'sïì buu ba nyor. Buu ca ku ba buu enjep ñgoèñ na ce vi be duè baè' aè nfeè' ce Nyúè be geèe buu wááwá tá vi kúti bfi naè.
English: being only with meats and drinks and various washings fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis aè vúè wáá aè tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a vú neè bghoènïì a fa neè seèe. E ce geèe li rfaè' ba mbe dïì' ce yi boèñ a caa dïû' rara ca njobeè' dïì' anaè yi yu yáánïì seê. Dïì' anaè aè m geèe ñwáè ka', baná yu yuu enjep ñgoèñ na ka'.
English: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' Jisos Kraâis aè m niñ mbe dïì' anaè, e m duè a ba' mbe dïû' rara ce yi caèa ñger naè nfeè' moè'sir, yi ku mi wa'a. E m duè mbo ba neè bláá mbú káè bláá muu naè' ka'. E m duè ba neè vi bláá. E m loèr vi bláá anaè a tee seèe efa ñgá' ce seèe aè m ce yá njo' buu bbebep ce seèe aè m ce geèe naè nfeseè.
English: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

Limbum: A m ce loèr bláá mbú ba bláá muu naè', ba bú efa muu naè' ce a toèo, ñwañshi beèe ce woweèe a m ba brara aè bsii Nyúè ka' aègho tá woweèe a bo ba brara.
English: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh:

Limbum: Bláá njáèá mnyaèa ca vi ka' ba túr ñger aè rgeèe mnyor beèe tá vi ba brara, yi ka' ba yi ká aèmboè bláá Jisos Kraâis ce vi túr ñger aè rgeèe viseèe mntee tá vi ba brara? E m loèr yïì nyor ce e m ba nrara a gee tañshïì aègho neè Nyúè a seâe btuè. E m geèe cena ba aè ñger Yú' Rara ce yi ku ba aègho aè nfeè' wááwá. Vi bláá vi túr ñger aè rgeèe tá seèe ba brara faè dïì' seèe bo geèe mfaâ' mcicïì ce aède' mi lo vúè neè rkwe ka'. E m geèe wa'a tá seèe bo faè' ba neè Nyúè ce e yu nteèe.
English: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' li rkwe ce e m kwe naè, e ba seè'ni ba ñwáè ce e táá mbetar Nyúè ba ñwáè, a gee leâ' fi, tá beèe ce Nyúè aè ce a bo koni buu bboèñboñ ce Nyúè aè kaè' neè woweèe naè, túr buu anaè nfeseè. Li rkwe anaè li geèe beèe ce a m ce geèe buu bbebep aè nfeè' ce leè' entombïì yi m kur woweèe naè, a ce luèñ.
English: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

Limbum: Ñwáè e ke laè' rkwe, baná beèe a be yá ená ñgaèñ aè kwe wáá tá a ka' geèe buu ce ñwáè anaè aè m laèa.
English: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

Limbum: Ñwáè anaè ka' ku bii nteèe, nlaè' rkwe anaè yi túr ñger ka'. Yi ku túr ñger ba aè nfeè' ce ñwáè anaè aè kwe.
English: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce a m kur leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye a beèe aè nfeè' entombïì naè ba neè bláá.
English: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' Musïìs aè m suñ beèe mncir ce Nyúè aè m fa neè woweèe wááwá, a lor mnyoâr njeèe ce vi m ce baèñ, a cúú aè fuè ce a too ená Hisoèp, a fúú njep bláá muu naè' ce a m fïìñshi neè mdip, a ñwañshi mbenduè ñwaè' mncir a ker ñwañshi beèe wááwá aègho.
English: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

Limbum: E ka' ñwañshi wáá a laa enáê, “Cena yu ba bláá ce vi kur leè' ce Nyúè aè ye weèe woweèe, a laa ená weèe gee yuu ce leè' yi laèa naè.”
English: saying, This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.

Limbum: E m ker ñwañshi bláá anaè aè dïû' rara caè, a ker ñwañshi aè buu mfaè' wááwá ce vi m ba mbo.
English: Moreover he sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

Limbum: Yi yu mini ená ncir yi laèa ená buu wááwá vi yu brara aè bsii Nyúè, ce a ka' ñwañshi neè bláá. Baná bláá vi ka' tá ba ka', a foosïì buu bbebep beèe ka'.
English: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

Limbum: Yi m ba yáánïì ená a lor ba bláá gee buu ce vi táá ba aètu buu ce vi yu mbe buèu naè gee tá vi ba brara aè bsii Nyúè. AÈ ka' ba aèmboè buu embe buèu anaè, yi yu yáánïì ená a gee njáèá tañshïì mo' ce yi caèa btañshïì ce a m ce geèe neè mnyaèa naè, aètu buu anaè.
English: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

Limbum: Kraâis aè m niñ ba mbe dïû' rara ce aè m kupshi ba beèe ka'. Dïì' ce aè m kupshi ba beèe anaè yi táá ba aètu dïì' ce Nyúè yu. E m niñ mbe buèu mbe dïì' ce Nyúè yu, tá e bo táá a seâe btuè aè bsii Nyúè aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: For Christ hasn't entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì yi m ce niñ mbe dïû' rara, du mbe dïû' rara ce yi m caèa ñger naè nfeè' moè'sir aè bfeè' wááwá. E m ce duè mbo wa'a, du ba neè bláá ce vi m fúú enje nyoèr nje ye ka'. Jisos Kraâis aè m duè yi ba mbe dïû' rara embe buèu, a lor yïì nyor a gee tañshi aègho nfeè' moè'sir caè'caè'.
English: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

Limbum: E m ba du mbe dïû' rara nfeè' aèñgoo, e m ba yá ñgá' foñ nfeè' aèñgoo ká' embe nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m geèe ñgoèñ. E m geèe wa' ka'. E vúè ba nfeè' moè'sir aè nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi ce mïì na, a lor yïì nyor a tañshi tañshïì aègho tá e bo siñsi buu bbebep ce beèe a geèe, nfeseè.
English: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá be kuè kwe ba nfeè' moè'sir. E loè embenjïìmo tá Nyúè sa' ye.
English: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis ye ye aè m kwe nfeè' moè'sir aètu beèe magoèr tá e bo siñsi yaèp buu bbebep. E be keè kúti njep ñgoèñ na, kúti tá e bo siñsi buu bbebep beèe ka'. E be keè kúti tá e bo geèe tá beèe ce a ce keè' ye a luêñ.
English: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, without sin, to those who are eagerly waiting for him for salvation.

Limbum: Mncir ce Nyúè aè m fa neè Jus vi m táá ba aètu buu bboèñboñ ce vi bii ka' ba. AÈde' vi duñshïì seèe buu bboèñboñ anaè seese ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, btañshïì ce ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì a ke tañshi njep feè' njep feè' vi túr ñger aè rgeèe beèe ce a ce vúè aègho naè tá a ba yáánïì ka'.
English: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

Limbum: Btañshïì anaè vi m ka' ba túr njáèá ñger ca, beèe a m ba keèr ce tañshi btañshïì ka' njobeè' woweèe a m ba baè raa mïìsi, keèr rïìñ ená woweèe a yu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep ka'.
English: Or else wouldn't they have ceased to be offered, because the worshippers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

Limbum: Yi yu ba ená btañshïì ce a ce tañshi njep feè' njep feè' anaè, vi geèe beèe a kuushi yaèp buu bbebep,
English: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

Limbum: njobeè' aède' bláá naè' ba bláá mbú vi siñsïì buu bbebep anaè ka'.
English: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce Jisos Kraâis aè m vúè njep ñgoèñ na a laa neè Nyúè enáê, “Wáè m koèñ btañshïì ba mfa ka'. Wáè m fa máè ba nyor tá m bo geèe yuu ce wáè koèñ aègho.
English: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire, but you prepared a body for me;

Limbum: Wá ke yu' rboèñ neè buu ce beèe a ke fa neè wáè, too neè mor vi she ji' naè ka'. Wá ke yu' rboèñ neè btañshïì ce beèe a ke geèe tá vi bo siñsi yaèp buu bbebep naè ka'
English: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a máè laa mánáê, ‘Tata Nyúè, a máè na. Máè tami nyor aè rgeèe buu wááwá ce wáè koèñ ená m geêe, aèmboè a sañ mbe yo ñwaè' mncir.’ ”
English: Then I said, 'Behold, I have come in the scroll of the book it is written of me to do your will, O God.'

Limbum: E m ce laèa mbo wa'a, a ce laèa ba ená Nyúè e ke yu' rboèñ neè btañshïì ca ka', ka' ncir yi ce laèa ená beèe a tañshi wa'a.
English: Previously saying, Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn't desire, neither had pleasure in them those which are offered according to the law,

Limbum: E m ker laa foñ enáê, “A máè na, máè tami nyor aè rgeèe buu wááwá ce wáâ koèñ ená m geêe.” E m laèa wa'a baná e siñsi btañshïû rúèú ca a kúúsi ba yïû fi.
English: then he has said, Behold, I have come to do your will. He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' Jisos Kraâis aè m vúè aè rgeèe yuu ce Nyúè koèñ, seèe yu seè'ni brara aè bsii Nyúè. E m loèr yïì nyor a tañshi tañshïì aègho nfeè' mo'sir, yi ku mi wa'a.
English: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

Limbum: Ñwáè tañshi tañshïì e ke táá mbekïì ce tañshi njáèá btañshïì ce e m be tañshi nfeè' aèñgoo wáá, aè mnoèñ wááwá. AÈde' njáèá btañshïì ca vi siñsïì buu bbebep ce beèe a geèe ka'.
English: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and often offering the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè Jisos Kraêis, e m ku tañshi tañshïì yi nfeè' moè'sir, Tañshïì anaè yi túr ñger aè rsiñsi buu bbebep ce beèe a geèe, nfeseè. E ka' tañshi tañshïì ca wáá, a du a cu aè bo ma' Nyúè.
English: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God;

Limbum: E cu wa'a a ce keè' ba nfeè' ce Nyúè be láè yi ñgaâa bbaèa njep yeâ tïìi tá e tár mi mkuèu mbe waâp nduè.
English: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

Limbum: E m ku tañshi ba tañshïì e mo'sir, a gee ená beèe ce e geèe woweèe a ba brara naè a ba byáánïì nfeseè.
English: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

Limbum: Yú' Rara yi duèñshi seèe ená tañshïì ce e m geèe nfeè' moè'sir naè yi m ghááte. Yi káè' a laa enáê,
English: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

Limbum: “Nyúè aè laèa enáê, ‘Nfeè' be gháá tá m ye leè' weèr woweèe. M be geèe tá woweèe a kupse yap ntee, ce yu' rboèñ aè rláè wa mncir.’ ”
English: This is the covenant that I will make with them: 'After those days,' says the Lord, 'I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;' then he says,

Limbum: Yi ker laa enáê, “M be keèr kuushi buu bbebep ba bsaèrbuu ce woweèe a geèe ka'.”
English: I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' foosi beèe efa yaèp buu bbebep, mbuèu moè' ker ba aègho neè woweèe aè rtañshi tañshïì tá yi bo siñsi yaèp buu bbebep ka'.
English: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, aè ka' ba njobeè' bláá Jisoès, seèe túr ñger seè'ni aè rniñ mbe dïû' rara ce yi caa ñger naè, keè' wáp yuu mo' ka'.
English: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

Limbum: Jisoès aè múè' nduunjïû fi tá seèe bo niñ mbe dïì' anaè, koni ryoèñ. E múè' nduunjïì anaè neè yïì nyor. Cena yi yu aèmboè e tii lá ndaèñ ce a m teni rum enje mú naè aègho wa'a.
English: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

Limbum: AÈmboè seèe túr yïìseèe ñwáè tañshi tañshïû ñgoèr ce e yu mbenduè beèe Nyúè na,
English: and having a great priest over the house of God,

Limbum: baná seèe lá ntee njep ye, ke' ce tarni yuu mo' ka', niñ mbe dïì' anaè neè ntee e mo'sir. AÈde' seèe gee wa'a njobeè' a ñwañshi viseèe mntee neè bláá Jisoès vi ba brara, seèe aè ker ce kwaè'shi ená seèe yu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep ka', a ba ba beèe ce a suè'si wap mnyor neè mdip mrara.
English: let's draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having our body washed with pure water,

Limbum: Baná seèe táá tatap, lá mmir ba mbenduè buu ce seèe aè byemi wáá ená vi be koni naè. Seèe fa tarni ka' njobeè' aède' Nyúè buu efa rgeèe yuu ce e m kaè' ka'.
English: let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

Limbum: Seèe kwa'shi aèmboè aède' seèe yáásïì mntee bfúr mo' tá seèe bo koèñ beèe keèr geèe buu bboèñboñ.
English: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

Limbum: Seèe fa borni efa rtarshi aèbee ce geèe rloo neè Nyúè aèmboè beèe mo' a ce geèe naè ka'. Seèe fa bfúr mo' ba ñger tá a bo táá tatap, ñgáè'ni mo' aèmboè seèe aè rïìñ war ená noèñ ce Tata Jisoès be vúè yi yu aètútú naè.
English: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.

Limbum: Seèe aè rïìñ buu ce vi yu mini war. Seèe aè ka' ker kani buu anaè gee ba buu bbebep baná tañshi mo' yi ker ba ce aède' yi siñsïì buu bbebep ce seèe aè geèe naè ka'.
English: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ku ce geèe ba buu bbebep wa'a, baná ñgaèñ aè ba káè' ce wáp njobeè' e be gweè mnsa' Nyúè. Ma njáèá mor mo' yi yu ce yi be keè yáèr beèe wááwá ce a teèe tuè neè Nyúè.
English: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè mncir ce Musïìs aè m vúè aègho naè, ñwáè aè m ka' bú' mncir anaè, beèe a mntaar káè beèe a mmbaa áè, a m ka' táá njïìnsa' ená a yá ñgaèñ aè gee yuu ce ncir yi kani, baná a be koosimnse efa ryú ñwáè anaè ka'.
English: A man who disregards Moses' law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, baná yi be ba aè njáâá ká neè ñwáè ce e nyúè' muu Nyúè, a loèr bláá ce a m ye leè' aègho aè ba bláá ce vi geèe ye e ba nrara naè aè yuu cicïì, a ker cáp Yú' Nyúè ce yi ke vúè neè bghoènïì naè?
English: How much worse punishment, do you think, will he be judged worthy of, who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ñwáè ce e m laèa enáê, “Ku ba máè ce m be kúúsi mcucu', m be laè' woweèe.” E m ker laèa foñ enáê, “Tata Nyúè be sa' yïì beèe.”
English: For we know him who said, Vengeance belongs to me, says the Lord, I will repay. Again, The Lord will judge his people.

Limbum: Yu yuu bwáp seê, ce ñwáè aè ka' táá ená Nyúè ce e yu nteèe teni mi mnsa'.
English: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

Limbum: Kuushi neè yuu ce yi m ba aè nfeè' ce weèe aè m káè' a yá rraa Nyúè naè. Ka' weèe aè m yá ñgá' aè nfeè' anaè se wa'a, weèe aè m ku kur ntee a táá tatap.
English: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' beèe a ce cáp weèe aèwañ a ker ce fa weèe ñgá'. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' weèe aè ba aè múè beèe moè' ce a m ce yá njáèá ñgá' ca foñ.
English: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

Limbum: Nse yi m koo weèe neè ñgaâa shañ, weèe aè ja' woweèe. Beèe a m faèpshi yeè buu, weèe aè ma'shïì, a ku ce lu'shi lu'shi njobeè' weèe aè m rïìñ ená weèe túr buu moè' ce vi boèñ a caa vïì anaè, aè ba buu ce vi be cu nfeseè.
English: For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

Limbum: Baná weèe fa káè' ce tarni ka' njobeè' beèe ce a ka' táá tatap ba' aè lúèsimbuèu, baná Nyúè be laè' woweèe boèñboñ seê.
English: Therefore don't throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

Limbum: Yi yu boèñboñ ená weèe kur ntee tá weèe bo geèe yuu ce Nyúè koèñ, koni yuu ce e kaè' ená e be fa weèe naè.
English: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ku báti nfeè' múcaèr, tá ñwáè ce e be vúè naè, vúê. E be caèasi nfeè' ka'.
English: In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.

Limbum: Yaè fwàè ce e yu yàànli a màá bsii njobee’ e byemi neè màá, be luèñ. E ka’ kùti njìnjì baná m be yu’ rboèñi neè ye ka’ ”
English: But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè seèe, seèe yu aèmboè njáèá beèe ce a be kúti njïìnjïì loè bú ka'. Seèe be byemi ba neè Nyúè, luèñ.
English: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

Limbum: Rbyemïì yu ba ená ká? Rbyemïì yu ená seèe aè rïìñ rara ená yuu ce seèe ce keè', seèe be koni. Rbyemïì yu ba ená seèe aè rïìñ ená yuu yi yu aègho neè mini-ñwáè, a ka' be yá yuu anaè neè mmir ka'.
English: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m yu' rboèñ neè beèe eluâuñgoèñ njobeè' woweèe a m byemi wa'a.
English: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li geèe seèe aè riñ rara ená Nyúè aè m ku laa laèa, ñgoèñ yi ba aègho. Baná yuu ce seèe ce yá neè mmir yi m loè ba efa yuu ce aède' seèe yá neè mmir ka'.
English: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe Ábáèl aè gee tañshïì neè Nyúè, yi ba boèñboñ aè bsii Nyúè a caa yi Káên. Yi tañshïì yi m boèñ wa'a, Nyúè aè lor ye aèmboè ñwáâ nyáánïì njobeè' e m byemi neè ye. Seèe aè rïìñ wa'a njobeè' Nyúè aè m koo buu ce e m fa neè ye. Ka' e m kwe eluâuñgoèñ wa'a, li rbyemïì li ku bii laèa.
English: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

Limbum: AÈ ka baè njobeè' rbyemïì, rkwe li m joo Ánoèk ka'. Nyúè aè m loèr ye a du aègho mbe buèu nteèe. Beèe a m ker yá ye ka' njobeè' Nyúè aè m loèr ye a du aègho. Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa ená tá Nyúè ka' keè loèr Ánoèk, yi ñgeèe yi m ba boèñboñ aè bsii Nyúè.
English: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn't see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' tá byemi ka', aède' Nyúè yu' rboèñ neè ye ka', njobeè' ñwáè aè ka' ce koèñ aè rvúè aètútú neè Nyúè baná ñgaèñ be byemi ená Nyúè yu aègho a ce laè' beèe ce a ce roèo ye neè ntee-ñwáè.
English: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe Nowa aè yu' yuu ce Nyúè aè m suñ ye ená yi be keè koni. Ka' e m be yá buu anaè neè mmir ka' wa'a, e m ku yu'ni neè Nyúè, a gee ma njáèá keñ moè', a beèe embe yeâ ndaèp wááwá a lo a niñ mbo a luñ efa mdip ce mi m cete ñgoèñ wááwá naè. E m geèe wa'a yi duñshïì ená ñgeèe beèe enjep ñgoèñ na yi m ba bebep. Nyúè aè m loèr yi ye aèmboè ñwáâ nyáánïì, aèmboè e ke loèr ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' byemi neè ye.
English: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe Abraèham aè yu'nïì neè Nyúè. Nyúè aè m ká' ye a laa neè ye ená e nati du faèdïì' ce e be fa neè ye. E lo efa yeâ to' a ce duè, a ke' riñ faèdïì' ce e ce duè ka'.
English: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e m byemi, e du a cu aèmboè kïìloè wa'a faèdïì' ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè ye naè. E m cu ba aè btaèp ce a m baè'ri ba neè bcáè' a muu yïû Aisïìk ker ba muu muu yïû Jakoèp ce Nyúè aè m kaè' neè woweèe wááwá ená e be fa woweèe ñgoèñ anaè.
English: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

Limbum: Abraèham aè m cu aè btaèp anaè a ce keè' nfeè' ce e be keè ce cu ba mbe ndaèp aè rla' ce aè m kupshi ba Nyúè a ba'rïî.
English: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe Sáèra ce e m ba ma nleeñwáè a caase efa rbi muu, aè lo a yeeti. Cena yi m ba wa'a njobeè' e m byemi ená Nyúè yu ñwáâ mini, e be geèe yuu ce e kaè'.
English: By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, Abraèham aè ba ma nleeñwáè, ka' yi m ba wa'a, yïì ñgúè aè m loè yaa, a ba aèmboè mkaèñsïì embe buèu, a ker ba foñ aèmboè nsaruñ yïû aèwaâa roè ce aède' ñwáè be' ka' naè.
English: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

Limbum: Beèe eluâuñgoèñ ca a m ku byemi neè Nyúè caar a kweñger, a koni buu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè woweèe naè ka'. Woweèe a m ku yá buu anaè aè njïìsaèp seê, a lu'shi, a laa ená woweèe a yu bkïìloè njep ñgoèñ na.
English: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ce laèa wa'a a geèe yi ba rara ená a roo ba rla' mo' ce be ba rlap.
English: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ker ce kwaè'shi aèmboè lap rla' ce a m loâ aèfo naè ka'. Woweèe a m ka' ba ce kwaè'shi aèmboè lap rla' anaè, a m ba túr njïì aè rkúti aèfo.
English: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce koèñ aè rduè ba aè rla' ce li boèñ a caa faèdïì' ce woweèe a m ce cu. Rla' anaè yu lïì embe buèu. Baná woweèe a ka' too Nyúè ená yaèp Nyúè, rïìtu yi ke' koo Nyúè neè woweèe ka'. Seèe rïìñ wa'a njobeè' Nyúè aè kupshi rla' a lá neè woweèe.
English: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m taase Abraèhaêm, a laa ená e lor Aisïìk ce aè m ku ba muu yïì ce e m túr caè'caè' tañshi tañshïì aègho neè ye naè, aè m ku ba ba rbyemïì ce li m geèe, Abraèham aè ka' yu'ni. E m tami nyor aè rtañshi tañshïì neè Aisïìk, ka' Nyúè aè m kaè' neè ye ená yïì ñgúè be yaa se wa'a.
English: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m suñ war Abraèham ená Aisïìk a ñwáè ce e be káè' geèe tá yïì ñgúè yaa.
English: even he to whom it was said, In Isaac will your seed be called;

Limbum: Abraèham aè m byemi ená Aisïìk aè ka' kwe, Nyúè ku túr ñger aè rgeèe tá e kúti nteèe. AÈde' seèe laa seená Aisïìk aè m ba aèmboè ñwáè ce e m kwe wáá, Nyúè aè fúr ye efa rkwe, yïì ta aè konïì lá ye wa'a.
English: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe Aisïìk aè ghonïì Jakoèp ba Ásoè, a suñ woweèe aèmboè bghoènïì ce woweèe a be loè koni.
English: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Jakoèp aè m ce kwe, rbyemïì li m geèe e ghonïì boo mmbañruè a baa ce Josáèf aè m túr. AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' anaè e too nyor aè mbaèñ a gú'shi neè Nyúè.
English: By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce Josáèf be kwe, rbyemïì li m geèe ye e laa ená beèe Isráèl a be keè loâ aè to' Ijïìp, a ker laa ená woweèe a ka' ke ce loè, a lor yi gúèú du aègho.
English: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe taèr ba ma yïì Musïìs a ka' bi Musïìs, a ke' yú ye ka', a súti mbe ndaèp aè mñwáá btaar. Woweèe a m yá ená muu waèp anaè boèñ seê, a ke' wáp yap yu aè rbú' ncir ñkúú ka'.
English: By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe Musïìs aè ka' kuè' gháá ñwáè, a kani ená a fa keèr too ye ená muu embe nto' ñkúú aè to' Ijïìp ka'.
English: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,

Limbum: E m laèa ená yi boèñ ená a beèe Nyúè weèe a yá ñgá' aèbee caa ce ená e gee buu bbebep ce yu' rboèñ aègho aè mú nfeè' múcaèr.
English: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God's people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;

Limbum: E m byemi yi yu ená beèe a ka' cáp ye njo' Kraâis ce Nyúè be loè tuu njep ñgoèñ na, cena yi boñ ye caa ce ená e túr bkuâ' aè to' Ijïìp wááwá. Yi m ba wa'a njobeè' e m ce keè' ba blaè' ce vi bii ka' ba.
English: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe e loâ aè to' Ijïìp a du yi yu a ke' wáp njobeè' ntee yi m bep ñkúú ka'. E m kur ntee a du aèmboè ñwáè ce e m ce yá lá Nyúè ce aède' ñwáè yá neè mmir ka' naè wa'a.
English: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe e ká' Ñkaâ' caèasi mndap. E m laèa neè beèe Isráèl ená a ñwañshi bláá aè ncúèúndúè' tá ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m ce yúshi boo mmbañruè ce a m ba boo rñgoèo naè, e caèa bo yá, yúshi boo rñgoèo ce beèe Isráèl a m túr ka'.
English: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe beèe Isráèl a tuu ma rdip ce a too ená rdip rbeer. A m tuu rli aèmboè a m ce jáèr lá ba mbe ñkúè wa'a. Beâe aè to' Ijïìp a ka' juèu a waâp mbuèu gheèter foñ ená a bo tuu, rdip anaè li kuñrïì woweèe a du aègho mbaè roè.
English: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe beèe Isráèl a jár a kaari to' Jáèrikuè aè noèñ aè noèñ, mnoèñ vi ka' ba saèambaê, ñka' aè to' anaè yi káátïì.
English: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe saèkïì ce a m ce too ená Rahaèp aè sútïì beèe Isráèl ce a m vúè aè rker ñgoèñ naè mbe yeâ ndaèp. AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' ce beèe ce a m teèe btu neè Nyúè aè m kweñger naè, e kwe ka'.
English: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn't perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

Limbum: AÈde' m suñ weèe buu wááwá ce rbyemïì li m geèe beèe mo' foñ a gee ka'. M ka' lo ená m ce suñ, m suñ du ba' fá? Nfeè' yu aègho ce m suñ weèe aèmboè Gidïìyoèn, ba Baraèk, ba Saâmsïìn, ba Jáptaè, ba Dávïìd, ba Saâmwáèl ker ba beèe wááwá ce a m ce cep ntuu Nyúè ka'.
English: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe beèe mo' efa woweèe a ma' bïìr a bto' mo', a so bto' anaè. Woweèe a m sa' beèe aè njïû yáánïì, a koni buu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè woweèe. Nyúè aè m cete bcuèu bbúrúè' njo' lap rbyemïì.
English: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

Limbum: Beèe mo' efa woweèe a m táá mbe múè mcuèñ mor, mor yi too woweèe ka'. Weèe mo' a m luèñ efa bïìr. Ka' woweèe a m ba bgoè'sïì wa'a, a m ku lo a gee buu btatap. Beèe mo' a m túr ñger aè rmaè' bïìr. Beèe mo' a m juèu ñgaâa maè' bïûr aè bto' mo'.
English: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

Limbum: Rbyemïì li m geèe bbyeèñge mo' a yá yaèp beèe moè' ce a m kweñger a lo a kúti bteèe. Beèe mo' a m yá mluè aè njáèá njïì ce ená a m fa ñgá' neè woweèe, a lip beèe mo' neè mmbaèñ, bvúp vi kepñgeèr, woweèe a kweñgeèr. Woweèe a m byemi ená a be beèesi njïì neè Nyúè tá a bo luèñ ka'. Woweèe a m geèe wa'a njobeè' woweèe a m rïìñ ená woweèe a be loè fúú efa rkwe, cu rcu ce li yu jáá.
English: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

Limbum: A m jaèasi beèe moè', a lip weèe mo', a kur weèe mo' mkoo a fa mbe shañ.
English: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

Limbum: A m túúshi beèe mo' efa woweèe neè bluèr a kweñgeèr, a gwate beèe mo' efa woweèe a teni bkúèkúâ bbaa. A m yúshi beèe mo' efa woweèe neè bkaèafaè'. Beèe ce a m ce yá ñgá' na a m ba ñgaâa fuèp. Woweèe a m ce yar ba mñgúp mbú. Beèe a m fa woweèe ñgá' a jar neè woweèe seê.
English: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce jáèr aè brïìñ ba aè mtuèu, a ce cu ba aè mmbúè' ba aè mntoèñ. Ñgoèñ ca yi m ba yáánïì neè woweèe aè rcu njo ka'.
English: of whom the world was not worthy, wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

Limbum: Beèe ca a m kweñger a lá rlii mbenjïì njobeè' woweèe a m byemi neè Nyúè. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, woweèe a m koni yuu ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be loè fa neè beèe ka'.
English: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn't receive the promise,

Limbum: Nyúè aè m kwaè'shi ená e be geèe yuu ce yi yu boèñboñ neè seèe ce seèe yu beâe seè'ni na, tá e bo geèe tá seèe beèe ca weèe ba aèbee, ba yáánïì a yeâ bsii.
English: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè seèe, beèe magoèr ca, ce a m byemi neè Nyúè na, a sïìr seèe a kaari a tarte a ce fyá' yuu ce seèe be geèe. Baná seèe ma' buu wááwá ce vi ce jepsi seèe, ker ba buu bbebep ce vi yu seèe njep bláá naè, kur ntee cañ mcañnïì ce Nyúè e koèñ ená seèe cañ naè.
