English: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

Limbum: Seèe ku lá miseèe mmir ba mbenduè Jisoès ce e m múè' njïì ená seèe lá ntee njep ye, aè ku ba ye ce e be keè loèr seèe duè aègho mbe buèu aèlúèsimbuèu. E m byemi a kwe rkwe rïìtu mbe kïìntaa. E m loèr rïìtu anaè aè yuu ka', tá e bo túr njáèá rlu'shïì ce Nyúè aè m kupshi a lá neè ye. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e m geèe wa'a, e cu seè'ni aè bo maè' kaèbaèraè' yïû Nyúè.
English: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

Limbum: Kwaè'shi ba aèmboè Jisoès ce e m byemi, a yá ñgá' mbaè mmbo beâe bbebep ce a m baèa ye, faè dïì' weèe lo koosi bsáè tá ntee yi lo kwe weèe ka'.
English: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don't grow weary, fainting in your souls.

Limbum: Bïìr ce weèe ce maè' weèe buu bbebep naè aè be ba' mbe dïì' ce weèe ma' wa'a kweñger ka'.
English: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;

Limbum: Weèe fa leèse blaâa Nyúè ce vi ke fa weèe ñger njobeè' weèe yu boo vi naè ka'. A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Muu waè, Nyúè aè ka' fa wáè ñgá' njo' yuu bebep ce wáè geèe, aè fa loèr aètáèr ka'. E ka' cep wáè, aè fa koosi bsáè ka'.
English: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, My son, don't take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

Limbum: Rïìñ neè ená Nyúè e ke fa njáèá ñgá' ca ba neè ñwáè ce e koèñ. E ke lïìp ba ñwáè ce e loèr ená a muu yïì.”
English: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.

Limbum: Baná njáèá ñgá' ce weèe ce yá na yu ba njïì ce Nyúè ce yá'ni weèe. Cena yi duèñshi ená Nyúè aè loèr weèe aèmboè boo vi. Waè' muu moè' aè m be ba ce e ka' gee yuu bebep, taèr ke' lip ka' a?
English: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn't discipline?

Limbum: Nyúè aè ka' tá fa weèe ñgá' njo' yuu bebep ce weèe aè geèe aèmboè e ke geèe neè boo vi wááwá naè ka', baná weèe yu boo bsuu.
English: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.

Limbum: Yi yu foñ ená viseèe bta a m ce fa ñgá' neè seèe njo' faèa ce seèe aè geèe, seèe yu'nïì neè woweèe. Baná yi yu boèñboñ ená seèe yu'ni neè yiseèe ta ce e yu mbe buèu boèñboñ seê, tá seèe bo koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?

Limbum: Viseèe bta enjep ñgoèñ na a m fa seèe ñgá' aè yuu bebep ce seèe aè geèe aè mú nfeè' aèmboè a m yá ená yi yu yáánïì. AÈ ka ba yi aèmboè Nyúè, e ke fa seèe ñgá' njo' yuu bebep ce seèe aè geèe tá ñgá' anaè bo jaè' seèe tá seèe ba rara aèmboè ye ye yu naè.
English: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

Limbum: E ke ba mbe nfeè' ce seèe ce yá njáèá ñgá' ca, seèe ce koosimnse, ke' ce lu'shi ka'. E ba embenjïì, beèe ce a yá'ni yuu efa njáèá ñgá' ca, a cu lap rcu neè rfúteè- ñwáè, gee ñgeâe yáánïì.
English: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.

Limbum: Baná weèe tapsi mkoo ce mi sáè naè, ke' ma'shi tá mkoo mi ce kaèñ weèe ka'
English: Therefore, lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

Limbum: Kuâu jár neè ba njep nduunjïì ce yi yu kuèyáá, tá kuèu ce weèe ce nyáèá ntáèñ aègho naè yi bo tap tap, ke' yañ goèr ka'.
English: and make straight paths for your feet, so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

Limbum: Gheèter yá ená wáè cu aè múè beèe neè rfúteè-ñwáè. Gheèter cu rcu rrara njobeè' ñwáè ka' tá cu njáèá rcu ca ka', e ke yá Nyúè ka'.
English: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

Limbum: Loèr neè nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú lo buu efa rkoni bghoènïì Nyúè ka'. Njáèá beèe ce a yu aèmboè ñgúè cece' a ke vúè yap ba neè ñgá', bepsi ñgeâe beèe magoèr.
English: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;

Limbum: Loèr neè nfeè' faè dïì' ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú lo geèe bsaèrbuu káè loèr buu Nyúè aètáèr loè ba aèmbo Ásoè ce e m fyeèni blee aètu baa naè ka'.
English: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ená Ásoè aè m ker lo a koñ ená yïì ta aè ba ghoèni ye, yi ta aè kanïì yi yu. Njïì moè' aè m ker ba neè Ásoè aè rkupse yuu ce e m geèe na ka', ka' e m ce war ená yïì ta ghoni ye, mñgoommir mi ce suèu wa'a.
English: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

Limbum: Rïìñ neè mbe dïì' ce weèe táá. Weèe táá ba mbe dïì' ce beèe Isráèl a m be táá naè ka'. Woweèe a m táá aègee rtuèu ce a m ce too ená Sinaèi. AÈ m ba rtuèu ce aède' ñwáè aè m ba joêo. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè mcuèñ mor mi ko' mbekïì, túè' aè sii bïìp, fu' yi ce caèa tatap seê.
English: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

English: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa wa'a, njobeè' yuu ce njeèndoñ anaè aè m laèa, yi m caèa yap ñger. Njeèndoñ anaè aè m laèa enáê, “Yuu mo' yi ka' joo rtuèu ca, káè yu ñwáè áè, káè yu nyaèa áè, baná a be túúshi neè bluèr tá e kwe.”
English: for they could not stand that which was commanded, If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned;

Limbum: Buu ce woweèe a m yá aèfo vi m wápsi woweèe seê. Musïìs ye ye aè m laèa enáê, “M ce wáp a ce kaèñ.”
English: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, I am terrified and trembling.

Limbum: Weèe táá ye ba aègee rtuèu ce a too ená Sayoèn. Weèe aè baè' aè rla' Nyúè ce e yu nteèe. A too rla' anaè enáê, “Jáèrusaláèm yïû mbekïì”. Bcïìndap Nyúè ce aède' ñwáè be' ka', a yu mbo a ce lu'shi.
English: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

Limbum: Weèe yu aè múè boo blee vïû Nyúè, ce Nyúè aè m sañ map mlii mbe ñwaè' embe buèu naè. Weèe táá ba aè bsii Nyúè ce e ke sa' beèe wááwá. Me myoèñ mi yu aè múè myoèñ beâe mini ce a geèe woweèe a ba yáánïì naè.
English: to the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

Limbum: Weèe aè duè aèmbuèu Jisoès ce e m loèr yïì nyor a fa neè Nyúè, Nyúè aè ye leè' aègho a ñwáè naè wáá. Weèe aè láè mmir ba mbenduè bláá Jisoès ce a m ñwañshi, yuu ce bláá anaè vi táá aètu mo yi caèa yuu ce bláá Ábáèl vi m táá aètu mo.
English: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

Limbum: Baná weèe lor nfeè' faè dïì' weèe lo kani efa ryu' blaèa ce ñwáè ce e ce laèa neè weèe naè aè m ce feè'shi naè ka'. English: See that you don't refuse him who speaks. For if they didn't escape when they refused him who warned on the Earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, njeèndoñ Nyúè aè gee ñgoèñ yi ci'tïì, aè ka' ba seè'ni, Nyúè aè ye leè' ená e be cïì' ñgoèñ ca seè'ni nfeè' moè'sir caè'caè', keèr cïì' rbuu foñ.
English: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.

English: This phrase, Yet once more, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

Limbum: Baná seèe yoñshi Nyúè ce e fa seèe dïû' kúú ce aède' ñwáè ci' ka'. Seèe yu'ni neè ye, gú'shi neè ye neè rbonïì-ñwáè aè njáèá njïì ce ye ye koèñ. Seèe wáp ye foñ.
English: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can't be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

Limbum: Yïìseèe Nyúè yu aèmboè mor ce yi be toèo buu wááwá naè wa'a.
English: for our God is a consuming fire.

Limbum: M ce koèñ aè rsuñ weèe ená weèe yu bfúr, baná weèe koñni.
English: Let brotherly love continue.

Limbum: Weèe fa leèse efa rkoni bkeèe ce a vúè aè rcaè'ni weèe ka', keè' neè woweèe boèñboñ. Beèe mo' a m koni bkeèe a ke' aè woweèe boèñboñ seê, a ke' riñ ená bkeèe anaè aè m ba bcïìndap Nyúè ka'.
English: Don't forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

Limbum: Kuushi beèe ce a yu mbe shañ, koosimnse neè woweèe aèmboè wá wáè yu lá mbe shañ wa' foñ. Kwaè'shi aèmboè beèe ce a ce yá ñgá', njobeè' aè ku túr nyor foñ aèmboè woweèe.
English: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

Limbum: Yi yu boèñboñ ená beèe wááwá a lá mncir ce vi yu nje múè bguèu. Tá mmbañruè a ba mini neè wap bbyeèñge tá bbyeèñge a ba mini neè wap mmbañruè. Nyúè be keè sa' beèe ce a ce koo bduu beèe mo', keèr sa' beèe ce a ce koo bbyeèñge beèe mo'.
English: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

Limbum: Loèr neè nfeè' efa rkoèñ mbaèa. Maè'shi tá buu ce wáè túr naè vi ghááte wáè, njobeè' Nyúè aè laèa ená aède' e ma'shïì wáè aè nfeè' moè' ka'. E be jaè' wáè aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.

Limbum: Baná aède' seèe laa neè ntee-ñwáè enáê, “Nyúè yu ñwáè ce e ce jaè' máè, aède' ñwáè gee yuu mo' neè máè ka'.”
English: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?

Limbum: Kuushi neè beèe ce a m ba btu neè wee, a fe'shi blaâa Nyúè neè weèe naè. Kwaè'shi neè aèmboè rcu beèe anaè li m ba, byemi neè Nyúè foñ aèmboè woweèe a m byemi naè.
English: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis ku ba ntïìni aèmboè e mú ba neèñkuèr, kuè ba wa' foñ aèyaèñseè. AÈde' e kupseè aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
English: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

Limbum: Fa maè'shi tá buu mo' ce beèe mo' a ce yá'ni, vi ba yi jáá naè, vi lo bo' weèe ka'. Yuu ce yi geèe viseèe mntee vi ka' tap, aè geèe ba bghoènïì ce vi vúè ese Nyúè. Mncir ce vi yu a kuu ba byee naè vi yu aè cicïì. AÈde' mncir anaè vi ja' beèe ce a ce láè vi ka'.
English: Don't be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

Limbum: Seèe túr dïì' ce a geèe tañshïì mbo neè seèe. Ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce a ke faè' ba mbe Tabáènakuèr naè, a túr ñger aè rye yuu embe dïì' tañshïì yiseèe na ka'.
English: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

Limbum: Tu neè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì efa múè Jus e ke tañshi tañshïì aètu buu bbebep beèe. E ke tañshi tañshïì ca, lor ba bláá caè'caè' niñ aègho mbe dïû' rara ce yi caèa ñger naè, lor nyaèa ce a ba sáá naè fúú aègho efa múè rla', too neè mor.
English: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

Limbum: Jisoès ye ye aè m fúú efa múè rla' a ka' kwe tá e bo siñsi buu bebep ce beèe a m geèe neè vi bláá.
English: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

Limbum: Baná seèe fúú efa múè rla' du yá ye tá a coosi seèe woweèe aèbee,
English: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

Limbum: njobeè' seèe túr rla' mo' njep ñgoèñ na ce li be cu nfeseè ka', seèe ce keè' ba rla' ce li bii ka' ba.
English: For we don't have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

Limbum: Baná seèe yoñshi Nyúè aè rlii Jisoès. Liseèe ryoèñshïìì anaè li be ba aèmboè tañshïì ce seèe aè geèe neè Nyúè wa'a. Seèe yoñshi ye neè viseèe mnjeèndoñ aè njïû yáánïì.
English: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

Limbum: Fa leèse efa rgeèe yuu boèñboñ keèr gaèp yoè buu ce wáè túr neè beèe ka', njobeè' njáèá ñgeâe boèñboñ ca yi yu aèmboè njáèá tañshïì ce Nyúè koèñ se wa'a.
English: But don't forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

Limbum: Yu'ni neè neè beèe ce a yu kuèntombïì neè weèe, gee yuu ce a ce laèa neè weèe. Woweèe a ce keè'ni me myoèñ, a ker ba foñ beèe ce a be keè táá aè bsii Nyúè, suñ aèmboè a m geèe rfaè' ca aè nfeè' ce woweèe a m ba njep ñgoèñ na. Seèe yu'ni neè woweèe tá woweèe a bo ce geèe lap rfaè' neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè, buwa'laèr woweèe a lo ce koosimnse, tá yuu anaè yi ja' weèe ka'.
English: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

Limbum: Loo neè neè weèr. Weèr rïìñ neè mini-ñwáè ená yer ntee yi yu rara.
English: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

Limbum: M ce bu' mmbo neè weèe seê, ená weèe loo neè weèr, tá m bo yaèñse koni fáñ keèr vúè yá weèe.
English: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

Limbum: Nyúè aè geèe Jisos Kraâis aè fúú efa rkwe. Bláá Jisoès a yuu ce yi m geèe leè' ce Nyúè aè m ye a ñwáè yi túr ñger nfeseè. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' rkwe Jisoès, Jisoès yu ñkúú gaèy ce e ce keè'ni yïì beèe.
English: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

Limbum: Baná, tá Nyúè ce e ke fa beèe cumúnyañ njep ntee, fa weèe buu bboèñboñ tá weèe bo geèe buu ce e ce koèñ ená weèe aè ba geèe. Tá e fa' njep viseèe mntee, gee tá seèe ba njáèá beèe ce e koèñ ená seèe aè ba ba, aè ñger Jisos Kraêis. Tá beèe a ku'si Jisos Kraâis nfeseè. Yi yu wa'a.
English: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ená weèe koo ncep ca mmbo mmbaa. Ñwaè' ce máè sañ neè weèe na yi saèp ka'.
English: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

Limbum: M ce koèñ ená weèe riñ ená Timotïì aè fúú embe shañ seè'ni. E ka' vú yá máè, tá m lor ye, weèr ye vú yá weèe.
English: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

Limbum: Caè'ni neè btu embe coêr, ker ca'ni beèe Nyúè wááwá neè máè. Beèe Nyúè ce aè to' Italeè a caè'ni weèe foñ.
English: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Nyúè ghoni weèe wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.
English: Grace be with you all. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Jáêms, ce m yu ñwáè rfaè' neè Nyúè ker ba neè Tata Jisos Kraêis. M ce sañ neè weèe ce beèe Isráèl ce aè mntáè' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ce a da'se mbe tunshe sïìp. M ce ca'ni weèe.
English: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, rmoèoshïì jáá jáèá jáá li ka' vú neè weèe njo' le rbyemïì baná weèe kuè ce lu'shi,
English: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

Limbum: njobeè' weèe yi ená weèe ka' so rmoèoshïì ca baná li be geèe tá weèe túr ñger aè rtáá tatap.
English: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

Limbum: Weèe gheter ená weèe táá tatap du kuèntombïì, tá weèe bo ba yáánïì aè buu wááwá, keè' buu yuu mo' ka'.
English: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' efa weâe mú aè ka' buu bfee, e loo ese Nyúè. Nyúè be fa ye, njobeè' e yu mmbo mtoo, ce fa neè ñwáè wááwá, ke' cápshi nyor ka'.
English: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' loo yuu ese Nyúè, ñgaèñ byemi neè yi ntee-ñwáè ená Nyúè be fa ye yuu anaè. E loo, e fa tarni ka' njobeè' ñwáè aè ka' loo ce tarni, baná ñgaèñ yu aèmboè rdip goèr ce fu' yi caèa ce cïì' wa'a.
English: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

Limbum: Njáèá ñwáè ce e túr mkwaè'shïì mmbaa wa'a ce koko koko. E fa kwaè'shi ená e be koni yuu mo' ese Tata ka'.
English: For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord. He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

Limbum: Nfúr ce e yu ñwáè fuèp aè ba ce lu'shi ená Nyúè aè naèa ye mbekïì,
English: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

Limbum: tá ñwáè mbaèa ye ye ce lu'shi ená Nyúè aè suèusi ye njep nsheè, njobeè' e be kuè loè ba aèmboè fúèlawaè ce e táá ntïìni ce foo, tú' e ce raa e banïì yuushi naè.
English: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

Limbum: Nyúè e sañ aè mjáá, mi yuushi, fúèlawaè efa gho yi karnger, gwe aè nshe, li rboèñ li bú aè cicïì. A mboè yi yu neè ñwáè mbaèa wa'a; yi ntaè'teè e ce duè kuèntombïì, e kwe, bár buu anaè.
English: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' táá tatap aè nfeè' ce rmoèoshïì li vúè neè ye, baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè rboâñtu. Rmoèoshïì li ka' vú neè ye, e so, baná Nyúè be fa ye ryoèñ ce yu blaè' ce Nyúè aè m kaè' ená e be fa neè beèe wááwá ce a koèñ ye.
English: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.

Limbum: Rmoèoshïì li ka' vú neè ñwáè, ñgaèñ fa laèa ená li loè ese Nyúè ka'. AÈde' yuu bebep yi mooshïì Nyúè ka', Nyúè ye ye e ke moèoshi ñwáè ka' foñ.
English: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted by God, for God can't be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

Limbum: Yu ba broñ ce ñwáè roñ aè buu ce vi ke geèe ñgaèñ ka' túr rmoèoshïì aè rgeèe yuu bebep.
English: But each one is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

Limbum: Broñ ca vi doèoshi ñwáè e gee yuu bebep; yuu bebep ca yi ku', vú neè rkwe.
English: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, brings forth death.

Limbum: Bfúr wa ce máè koèñ seê, fa byemi neè tá ñwáè moè' bo' weèe ka'.
English: Don't be deceived, my beloved brothers.

Limbum: Famáè wááwá ce e yu boèñboñ, a ba yáánïì, e ke vúè embe buèu ese Nyúè ce e m boo mraa wááwá ce mi ke raa embe buèu. Nyúè yu ñwáè ce e ke kupse yïì ndeèe, ma'shi yïì beèe aè túè'njïì ka'.
English: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

Limbum: E m co' seèe aè li rkoèñ, a laa yïì nlaèayá, a gee seèe aè ba boo vi, tá seèe bo ba entombïì neè buu wááwá ce e m boo naè.
English: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

Limbum: Bfúr wa ce máè koèñ seê, m ce cep weèe máná ñwáè wááwá ba cárcár aè ryu' buu, lor nfeè' ka' laa yuu, ker lor nfeè' ka' cápshi nyor.
English: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè ncápshi nyor gee yuu ce yi yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: for the anger of man doesn't produce the righteousness of God.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, máè ce laèa neè weèe seè'ni ená weèe ma' ndeâe mbembep ba bsaèrbuu. Nyúè ce byeè vi blaèa njep weâe mntee, baná weèe mú' wee mntee, yu' vi neè rbonïì-ñwáè. AÈde' vi gee weèe luêñ.
English: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

Limbum: Weâe yu' blaâa Nyúè anaè, weèe ce gee yuu ce yi suñ weèe ená weèe geêe. Weèe aè ka' ku ce yu' blaâa Nyúè yu', ke' ce geèe yuu ce vi laèa ka' baná weèe ce bo' wee btu.
English: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce yu' blaâa Nyúè, ke' ce geèe buu ce vi laèa ka', baná ñgaèñ yu aèmboè ñwáè ce e fyá' yïì nyor nje cárlïîr.
English: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

Limbum: E lá'si nyor, nfeè' múcaèr lese aèmboè li rfeese li ba ba.
English: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ce yu' ncir Nyúè ce yi boèñ du misïî, aè ba ncir ce yi fa ñwáè fáñ aè rgeèe buu bboèñboñ, a ker lá ncir anaè boèñboñ aè nfeè' sïìp, Nyúè be ghoèni yuu wááwá ce e ce geèe, njobeè' ñwáè anaè ku ce yu' yu' ka', e ce yu' ce geèe.
English: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ce laèa ená e byemi neè Nyúè, ke' ghashi li rlee ka', baná e bo' yi tu. Li rbyemïì anaè li yu aè cicïì.
English: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn't bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man's religion is worthless.

Limbum: Rbyemïì ce li yu rrara a ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê, li yu ená ñwáè ja' boo ñkú ba byepkúú ce a ce yá ñgá'. Li yu foñ ená ñwáè fa maè'shi tá ñgoèñ yi bo' ye ka'.
English: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe ce weèe aè byemi neè yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis ce e yu ñwáè foèo, weèe fa so'niñgoèñ ka'.
English: My brothers, don't hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.

Limbum: Ñwáè fuèp ba ñwáè mbaèa a ka' niñ mbe dïì' ce weèe ce geèe rloo neè Nyúè, ñwáè mbaèa yar tee ce e luèu ntaa, ma' bcáâ' bboèñboñ aè nyoèr, ñwáè fuèp caè yar bcáè' ce vi yu bjaèpri,
English: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;

Limbum: weèe aè ka' fa rgú'shïì neè ñwáè ce e suèsi nyor naè, laa neè ye enáê, “Vúè cu mbe nta' boèñboñ ca,” laa neè ñwáè fuèp ca yi ba enáê, “Táá yo mbonaè, buwa'laèr aè sárnïì aè nsheè mbe máâ geñ mkuèu na,”
English: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, Sit here in a good place; and you tell the poor man, Stand there, or Sit by my footstool;

Limbum: baná weèe aè duèñshi jáá jáá a weâe mú, a lá weêe mnyor aè ñgaâa nsa' mnsa' beèe neè mntee bbebep.
English: haven't you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

Limbum: Yu' neè, bfúr wa ce máè koèñ seê, mboè Nyúè aè m ce ñgaâa fuèp enjep ñgoèñ na ená woweèe a byemi neè Jisos Kraêis, koni sá' goèr, ye bti' embe dïû' kúú Nyúè ce e m kaè' neè beèe ce a koèñ ye a?
English: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn't God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe aè ku cu aè rjaèasïì ñgaâa fuèp. Mboè beèe ce a ke fa weèe ñgá', ker ce loèr weèe ce duè aègho mbe ndap mnsa' yu ñgaâa mbaèa a?
English: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don't the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

Limbum: Mboè yu woweèe ce a ce bepsi rlii rboèñboñ ce Jisoès aè m fa neè weèe na a?
English: Don't they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

Limbum: Baná yuu ce yi ghááte neè weèe aè rgeèe yi yu ená weèe lá ncir ce embe dïû' kúú Nyúè ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Koèñ nfúroè aèmboè wáè koèñ yoè nyor” naè.
English: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, You shall love your neighbor as yourself, you do well.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce so'niñgoèñ, baná weèe ce geèe ba yuu bebep, weèe aè bú' ncir Nyúè.
English: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' lá mncir Nyúè wááwá, ku bú' ba mo'sir, baná e bú' mncir wááwá.
English: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

Limbum: Weèe yi ená ñwáè ce e m laèa enáê, “Fa koo ñgwa ñwáè moè' káè nduu ñwáè moè' ka',” ku ba ye ce e m laèa foñ enáê, “Fa yú ñwáè ka'.” Wáè ka' tá koo ñgwa ñwáè moè' káè nduu ñwáè moè' ka', yú ñwáè, yi ku ba ená wáè bú' mncir wááwá.
English: For he who said, Do not commit adultery, also said, Do not commit murder. Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

Limbum: Baná weèe ce laa buu, ker ce gee ñgeèe ba aèmboè beèe ce Nyúè be keè sa' weèe neè ncir ce yi maè'shi ñwáè aèwaèa aè rgeèe buu ce e koèñ.
English: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.

Limbum: Nyúè be keè sa' beèe tá e kani efa rkoosimnse neè beèe ce a m buu efa rkoosimnse neè beèe mo'. Baná beèe ce a m ce koosimnse neè beèe mo' a be wáp mnsa' anaè ka'.
English: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, ñwáè aè ka' laa ená e byemi neè Nyúè, ke' ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ ka', baná sá' efa gho yu ká? AÈde' rbyemïì anaè li gee ye e luñ a?
English: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

Limbum: Nfúr moè' káè njaèr moè' ka' buu bcáè' ce e yar, ker buu byee ce e ye,
English: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

Limbum: moè' efa weèe ka' yá ye, laa neè ye enáê, “Duè neè rfúteè-ñwáè du ma' bcáè' ce yoè nyor bo luèu, yeñger boèñboñ,” e laèa wa'a ke' fa ye buu ce e buu na ka', e ja' ye a njáâá ká?
English: and one of you tells them, Go in peace, be warmed and filled; and yet you didn't give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

Limbum: A mboè rbyemïì li ku ba wa'a. Ñwáè aè ka' byemi, ke' ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ ka' baná rbyemïì anaè li yu gúâú yuu.
English: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè moè' laa yi enáê, “Wáè túr rbyemïì, máè túr ndeâe mboèñmboñ.” M be beèesi neè ñwáè ce e laèa wa' mánáê, “Duèñshi ka máè lo rbyemïì ce li buu ndeâe mboèñmboñ, tá m duñshi wáè yaè ndeâe mboèñmboñ tá aè yá wáná máè túr rbyemïì.”
English: Yes, a man will say, You have faith, and I have works. Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.

Limbum: To wáè byemi ená Nyúè ku ba moè'sir. Wáè geèe yáánïì. Kuushi wáná byú' mnyúâmkaè' vi ku byemi wa' foñ, a ce wáp a ce kaèñ.
English: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.

Limbum: Lúr caê, wáâ roèo ená m duñshi wáè ená rbyemïì ce li buu ñgeâe boèñboñ li yu aè cicïì a?
English: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

Limbum: Kuushi ená Nyúè aè m loèr yïìseèe ta Abraèham aè ñwáâ nyáánïì a yeâ bsii njobeè' e m loèr muu yïû Aisïìk tá e bo tañshi tañshïì aègho neè Nyúè.
English: Wasn't Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

Limbum: AÈde' weèe yá seè'ni ená rbyemïì Abraèham ba yïì ndeâe mboèñmboñ a m ku ce jáèr aèbee. Yuu ce Abraèham aè m geèe yi m geèe li rbyemïì li ghááteè.
English: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;

Limbum: Cena yi m geèe yuu ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Abraèham aè m ba ñwáâ nyáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njo' li rbyemïì,” naè yi ghááteè njo. A mbuèu ce a m ce too Abraèham enáê, “Ñkar Nyúè.”
English: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness; and he was called the friend of God.

Limbum: Weèe aè yá seè'ni ená ñwáè yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njo' yïì ndeâe mboèñmboñ, ke' ku ba njo' li rbyemïì caè' ka'.
English: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.

Limbum: Yi m ku ba wa'a foñ neè njeñwáè saèkïì ce a m ce too ená Rahaèp. E m ba yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njobeè' e m súèti ñgaâa ñker ce beèe Isráèl a m tuu, a duñshi woweèe nduunjïì mo', woweèe a cañ a kúti.
English: In the same way, wasn't Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

Limbum: Rbyemïì ce li buu ndeâe mboèñmboñ li ku ba aèmboè gúâú ñwáè wa'a.
English: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yi boèñ ená beèe magoèr efa weâe mú a ba ñgaâa ryá'nïì ka', njobeè' Nyúè be keè sa' seèe ce seèe yu ñgaâa ryá'nïì tatap caèa beèe mo'.
English: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá e ke geèe buu bbebep magoèr. Ñwáè aè ka' ba ce e ke laèa yuu bebep ka', baná ñgaèñ yu yáánïì aè buu wááwá, a ce loèr nfeè' aè buu wááwá ce e ce geèe.
English: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone doesn't stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' fa kwaèñ kuè cuâu nyaèabaèraè' tá e bo yu'ni neè seèe, aède' seèe gee e du aè dïì' seèe aè gwáá.
English: Indeed, we put bits into the horses' mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

Limbum: Keèr kwa'shi neè aèmboè ma keñ enjep rdip rgoèr. Fu' tatap yi ka' ce doèo ce duè aègho aè jáá, ñwáè rdoèo ku beesi ba mú co' mo' embe keñ anaè, e du aè njïì ce ñwáè rdoèo ce koèñ.
English: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

Limbum: A mboè rlee ñwáè li yu wa'a foñ. Li yu múcaèr wa'a a túr ñger seê. Kuè kwa'shi ka neè foñ aèmboè mú rcuèñ mor li ke toèo ma koèp láê.
English: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

Limbum: Rlee ñwáè li yu aèmboè mor, a ba aèmboè ñgoèñ ce yi ruu neè buu bbebep, a ce bepsi ñwáè dúèdúè. AÈde' li ku too ñwáè, ñgaèñ yá mluè caa kwe. Mor Sataèn a yuu ce e ke cúè' mor ca.
English: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

Limbum: Beèe a yá'ni mnyaèa ce aè rïìñ ba vïì enjep roè, ba bsiñ, vi ce geèe aèmboè beèe a koèñ;
English: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and thing in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.

Limbum: geewa'a, ñwáè aè ke' ba ce aède' e yá'nïì li rlee tá li ku ce laèa ba buu bboèñboñ ka'. Rlee yu njáèá yuu bebep mo' ce yi ke koèñ aè rcu múnyañ ka'. Li ke laèa yuu yi ba aèmboè nli' ce aède' e yú ñwáè wa'a.
English: But nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

Limbum: See ke loèr rlee yoñshi Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Tata aègho, ker lor ro' bfúr viseèe ce Nyúè aè m boo a feeseè ye aègho.
English: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.

Limbum: Ryoèñshïì ba mcáp mi ke kuè ce fúú ekuè cuâu mo'sir. Bfúr waê, yi boèñ wa' ka'.
English: Out of the same mouth comes forth blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

Limbum: Waè' aède' mdip mmboèñmboñ mi fúú embe dïû' mo'sir a mdip mmbembep a?
English: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

Limbum: Bfúr waê, aède' mmbïì mi yú mbe ce fer a? AÈde' fer yi yú mbe rtáá a? Yi yu foñ ená aède' aè tu' mdip mmboèñmboñ enjep dïì' ce mdip mgwañ mi ce fúú ka'.
English: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ba a weâe mú ce e túr bfee, a yi buu, baná li rcu rboèñboñ li be kuè ce duèñshi ená e túr bfee. E ka' ce cu wa'a, e ba múfáèá aè yi ñgeèe aèmboè ñwáè bfee aè ba ba.
English: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ba ne ñwáè ñko'ndoñ seê, ker ce tañ buu aè bwer, baná e fa ce naa- tu, ce jepsi mini neè mnde' ená e yu ñwáè bfee ka'.
English: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast and don't lie against the truth.

Limbum: Njáèá bfee ca vi vúè ese Nyúè ka'; yu ba bfee enjep ñgoèñ, aè ba bfee ñwáè ce vi vúè ba ese Sataèn.
English: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

Limbum: Faèdïì' ce ñko'ndoñ ba bwer vi yu, baná beèe a be kuè ba bcuèu jáá jáá, keèr ce geèe njáèá buu bbebep wááwá.
English: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

Limbum: Bfee ce vi vúè ba ese Nyúè vi ke geèe ñwáè, e ce geèe ñgeâe rara. Vi ke geèe ñwáè, e cu neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè, ba neè rbonïì-ñwáè, ker túr ntee aè ryu' yuu ce beèe mo' a ce laèa. Vi ke geèe ñwáè, e túr ñkoosimnse ker ce geèe buu bboèñboñ. Vi ke geèe ñwáè e ce so'niñgoèñ ka', ke' ce bo' beèe ka'.
English: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ñgeèe cumúnyañ a ka' bye cumúnyañ aè múè beèe, e ku', baná a be kep ba ñgeâe boèñboñ.
English: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

Limbum: Mlap ba bkoèr ce vi yu a weâe mú na vi loè efá? Mboè vi yu ba njobeè' weèe ce tañ buu njep weâe mntee a?
English: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don't they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

Limbum: Weèe ce yúshi beèe njobeè' weèe ce roèo aè rtúr buu ce weèe túr ka', weèe ce lapni, ker ce reè bkoèr njobeè' weèe ku ce gani buu gani ke' ce koni ka'. Weèe túr buu ce weèe ce koèñ aè rtúr ka' njobeè' weèe ce loo vi ese Nyúè ka'.
English: You lust, and don't have. You kill, covet, and can't obtain. You fight and make war. You don't have, because you don't ask.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' loo buu ese Nyúè ke' túr vi ka', baná weâe loo neè mkwaè'shïû mmbembep. Weèe ce loo aè rkoni buu ce weèe ce tañ aè rtúr njep weâe mntee.
English: You ask, and don't receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for your pleasures.

Limbum: Weèe ce bsaèkïì, mboè weèe yi weená ñwáè ce e ka' koo ñkar a ñgoèñ, baná ñwáè anaè yu ñwáè bbaèa neè Nyúè a? Baná ñwáè ce e ka' koèñ aè rkoo ñkar a ñgoèñ baná e geèe yi tu aè ñwáè bbaèa neè Nyúè.
English: You adulterers and adulteresses, don't you know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

Limbum: Ñwaâ' Nyúè yi laèa enáê, “Yú' ce Nyúè aè fa neè seèe yi koèñ magoèr ená seèe ku yu'ni ba neè Nyúè.” Waè' yi laèa ba aè cicïì a?
English: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously?

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyúè aè túr ntee boèñboñ neè seèe seê, a fa seèe ñger. Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Nyúè baèa ñgaâa naèatu, a ce fa ñger neè beèe ce a suèusi yaèp nyor njep nsheè.”
English: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

Limbum: Baná weèe fa wee btu mbe mmbo Nyúè. Weèe kani Sataèn tá e cañ weèe.
English: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

Limbum: Vúè neè aègee Nyúè tá ye ye bo vúè a weâe geñ, weèe ce ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep, fúr neè me mmbo enjep múè buu bbebep, ñgaâa rtarnïì, fa neè wee mntee neè Nyúè.
English: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

Limbum: Kuushi neè yeè buu bbebep ce weèe aè geèe, koosimnse, war neè Nyúè; fa keèr lu'shi neè ce vúèshi ka', ce war neè war ce koosi ba mnse.
English: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

Limbum: Suèusi neè wee mnyor njep nsheè aè bsii Tataê, tá e naa weèe mbekïì.
English: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe fa ce laèa bebep kuu beèe mo' ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' ce laèa bebep kuu nfúr yïì, ker ce sa' ye, baná e ce laèa bebep kuu ncir, a ker ce sa' ba yi. Weèe aè ka' ce sa' ncir baná weèe aè borni aè rláè ncir, a ká' a ce sa' yi sa'.
English: Don't speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

Limbum: Ku ba Nyúè ce e fa ncir, a ker túr ñger aè rsa' beèe, ku ba ye ce e túr ñger aè rjaè' beèe, a ker túr ñger aè rbepsi beèe. A wáè nda, ka' ce sa' bfúr wo?
English: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

Limbum: Yu' neè seè'ni, weèe ce weèe cu ce kaè' buu ce weèe be geèe, ce laèa enáê, “Weèr be loè ntïìni, buwa'laèr weèr lo aèyaèñseè duè cu aè to' mo' aèmboè feè', tá weèr bo geèe ntaa, koni mbaèa.”
English: Come now, you who say, Today or tomorrow let's go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ yuu ce yi be ba aèyaèñseè ka'. Le ryoèñ li yu aèmboè mmbaè' ce vi yááti, nfeè' múcaèr vi bú naè.
English: Whereas you don't know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce kaè' aè rgeèe yuu, weèe aè ba laèa ba enáê, “Tata ka' byemi baná seèe be geèe ca ba ca.”
English: For you ought to say, If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a weèe aè ku bii neè naèa-tu-ñwáè, a ce kwaè' ená aède' weèe gee buu wááwá a weâe ñger. Njáèá naèa-tu anaè boèñ ka'.
English: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

Limbum: Yi ba ená ñwáè ce e ka' riñ yuu boèñboñ ce aède' e geêe, ke' gee yuu anaè ka' baná ñgaèñ aè geèe yuu bebep.
English: To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn't do it, to him it is sin.

Limbum: Weèe ce weèe yu ñgaâa mbaèa, yu' neè yuu ce m be laèa neè weèe. War neè, ker koosimnse njo' ñgá' ce e be vúè neè weèe.
English: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

Limbum: Yeè buu aè búète, nsá' yi ye weèe bcáè' wááwá.
English: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

Limbum: Nlo aè ye ye mbaèa; nlo ca be keè fa weèe aè ñgá', ye weèe ba aèmboè mor ce yi toèo ñwáè wa'a. Weèe aè baashi ye mbaèa a lá aè nfeè' ce ñgoèñ yi ce mïì.
English: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you, and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

Limbum: Beèe a faè' neè weèe, weèe aè kanïì aè rlaè' woweèe. Yu' neè aèmboè woweèe a ce war ce gúèú weèe, woweèe a war teèteè, Nyúè ce e túr ñger mbenduè buu wááwá aè yu'.
English: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

Limbum: Weèe aè ye rboèñ enjep ñgoèñ, a cu neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè. AÈ m ba nyúè ce a m ce yúshi beèe, weèe aè ku cu aè rye byee, a ce kuè'ñger.
English: You have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

Limbum: Weèe aè fa beèe ce a geèe faèa ka' aè ñgá', a yúshi woweèe, woweèe a ke' gee yuu mo' ka'.
English: You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn't resist you.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, aèmboè yi yu wa' naè, m ce laèa neè weèe ená weèe kur ntee du ba' aè nfeè' ce yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis be keè vúè. Kwaè'shi ka neè aèmboè ñgaâa nfaè' mnsuu a ke kur ntee ce keè' mbeèñ kwaêa, ker keè' nfeè' ce kwaa be bi tá a ka' kep naè.
English: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

Limbum: Baná wee weèe kur ntee wa' foñ. Tami neè nyor, táá tatap ce ke', njobeè' nfeè' múcaèr tá yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraâis vúê.
English: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, weèe fa ce rúè'ñger ka', faè dïì' a bo sa' weèe ka'. Ñwáè ce e be teni viseèe mnsa' yu aètútú.
English: Don't grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won't be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

Limbum: Kuushi neè ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè ce a m cep aè rlii Tataê, bfúr waê. Yá'ni neè ese woweèe aè rtúr ntee tatap aè nfeè' ñgá' aèmboè woweèe a m túr naè.
English: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

Limbum: Seèe ce laèa seená woweèe a yu ñgaâa Mboâñtu njobeè' woweèe a m táá tatap aè nfeè' ñgá'. Weèe aè m yu' aèmboè Jup ce e m kur ntee aè nfeè' ce rmoèoshïì li m vúè neè ye, a ka' loè embenjïì mo, Nyúè aè fa ye ku' buu. Baná weèe riñ ená Taèr Nyúè boèñ ñgeèe, a ba ñwáè ñkoosimnse seê.
English: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, yuu mo' tatap ce m ker ce roèo suñ weèe yi yu ená wee ce suñ buu weèe fa kaèa ka'. Weèe fa kaèa ka' aè rlii Nyúè káè aè rlii nshe ka', káè aè rlii yuu mo' ka'. Kuè laèa neè enáê, “ÁÈno” ce weèe aè ka' byemi, laa enáê, “Kaka'” ce weèe aè ka' kani, tá yi mi wa'a, faè dïì' Nyúè bo keè sa' weèe ka'.
English: But above all things, my brothers, don't swear, neither by heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath; but let your yes be yes, and your no, no; so that you don't fall into hypocrisy.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, ñwáè moè' yu ce e ce yá ñgá' a? Ñgaèñ loo neè Nyúè. Ñwáè moè' yu ce e ce lu'shi a? Ñgaèñ yop yáá, nási Nyúè.
English: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' yu ce e ce yañ a? Ñgaèñ ká' btu embe coêr, tá a vú loo neè ye keèr yo' ye neè mgúr aè rlii Tata Jisos Kraêis.
English: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord,

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' loo neè rbyemïì-ñwáè, Tata ja' ñwáè yañ anaè. Ka' ba ená ñwáè anaè aè m geèe buu bbebep, baná Nyúè be foèosi ye.
English: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

Limbum: Yi ba seè'ni ená weèe to'shi yeè buu bbebep, ñwáè to'shi vi neè ñwáè; loo neè neè wee btu, ñwáè loo neè ñwáè, tá Yú' yi bo jaè' weèe tá weèe ke'si efa wee byañ. Ñwáâ mboèñmboñ ka' loo yuu ese Nyúè neè yi ntee-ñwáè, Nyúè yu' li rloo cárcár seê.
English: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

Limbum: AÈlajaè ce e m ku ba ñwáè aèmboè seèe aè m loo tatap ená mbeèñ fa gweè ka'. Nyúè aè m yu' li rloo, mbeèñ aè ke' gwe ka' aè bfeâ' btaar ba mñwáá ntuunfu.
English: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn't rain on the earth for three years and six months.

Limbum: Embenjïì mo AÈlajaè aè ker loo, mbeèñ aè gweê, byee vi ká' a ce kuè'.
English: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth brought forth its fruit.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, kuushi neè yuu ce m be laèa neè weèe na. Moè' efa weèe aè ka' ma'shi nduunjïì Nyúè, nfúr moè' ja', kúsi ye njep nduunjïì Nyúè, baná nfúr anaè aè tee yú' ñwáâ mbembep caè efa rkwe, a ker búsi ku' buu bbebep magoèr.
English: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth, and someone turns him back, let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death, and will cover a multitude of sins.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Pitaè ce m yu ñwáè ntuu Jisos Kraêis. M ce sañ neè beèe Nyúè ce a da'se a ba bkïìloè aè ñgoâñ Pontuès, ba Gaèláshaè, ba Kaèpaèdosïìyaè, ba Áshaè ker ba Bïìtinïìyaè.
English: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

Limbum: Nyúè Taèr aè m rïìñ weèe wáá, a ka' ce weèe, yi yú' yi gee weèe aè ba brara, tá weèe bo yu'ni neè Jisos Kraêis, tá Nyúè ñwañshi weèe neè bláá Jisoès. M ce loo máná Nyúè túr ntee boèñboñ neè weèe seê, ker gee tá weèe cu neè rfúteè-ñwáè boèñboñ seê.
English: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

Limbum: Seèe yoñshi Nyúè ce e yu Nyúè a ba Taèr neè yïìseèe Tata Jisos Kraêis. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' e m koosimnse neè seèe seê, e m geèe seèe aè ba beâe bfi njobeè' Jisos Kraâis aè m fúú efa rkwe. Ca yi geèe seèe aè ce keè' bti' ce aède' vi búteè, káè bep, káè kwe ncoèo ka', a ke' ce tarni ka'. A láè vi mbe buèu neè weèe,
English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy became our father again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn't fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

Limbum: ce weèe yu beèe ce weèe aè byemi, Nyúè aè ce keè'ni aè yi ñger, tá weèe bo koni rluèñ ce li be yááti aèwañ aè nfeè' elúèsimbuèu.
English: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

Limbum: Ca yi geèe weèe aè ce lu'shi seê, ka' weèe be yu' ryañ seè'ni na njo' rmoèoshïì ce li be vúè neè weèe aè mú nfeè' moè', aè mnduunjïì jáá jáèá jáá wa'a.
English: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been put to grief in various trials,

Limbum: Rmoèoshïì ca li be vúè neè weèe tá le rbyemïì li bo ba yáánïì. Ka' gul ce e ke cu nfeseè ka' naè, beèe a ke loèr too njep mor tá e bo ba yáánïì. A mboè le rbyemïì ce li luèu ntaa a caa gul naè li ku ba wa'a. A be moèoshi li tá li bo ba yáánïì, tá a bo yoèñshi weèe, kuè'si weèe, yu'ni neè weèe nyúè ce Jisos Kraâis be yááti aèwañ.
English: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ--

Limbum: Weèe aè m be yá Jisos Kraâis ka', a ku koñ ye. Weèe ce yá ye seè'ni na ka', a ku byemi neè ye, a ce lu'shi njáèá rlu'shïì ce aède' ñwáè suñ ka',
English: whom not having known you love; in whom, though now you don't see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory--

Limbum: njobeè' le rbyemïì li be lúèsi neè rluèñ ce weèe ce keè' aè rkonïì naè.
English: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m loèr nfeè' a fyá' njep múè rluèñ ca boèñboñ seê. Woweèe a m suñ beèe aèmboè rboâñntee Nyúè ce yi m ba ená weèe be koni.
English: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

Limbum: Yú' Kraâis ce yi m ba njep woweèe yi m suñ woweèe aèmboè ñgá' ce Kraâis be yá, tá beèe a ka' kuè'si ye. Woweèe a m gheèter aè rrïìñ nfeè' ce buu ca be koni, ker ba njáèá njïì ce vi be ba.
English: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ, which was in them, pointed to, when he predicted the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that would follow them.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m geèe woweèe a riñ ená buu ce woweèe a m ce suñ beèe aè m ba buu ce vi be koni aè nfeè' yaèp ka'. E m geèe woweèe a riñ ená vi be koni ba aè nfeâ' yïì. AÈ ka' ba seè'ni na, beèe ce a m feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ aèmboè Jisos Kraâis neè weèe aè ñger Yú' Rara, ce a m tuu embe buèu, a suñ weèe buu anaè. Bcïìndap Nyúè foñ a ce koèñ aè rfyá' nje múè buu ca.
English: To them it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to you, they ministered these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

Limbum: Baná weèe tami nyor, ke'ni wee btu, ce ke' ba rboâñntee Nyúè ce weèe be koni aè nfeè' ce Jisos Kraâis aè vúè.
English: Therefore, prepare your minds for action, be sober and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ--

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe yu boo ce weèe ce yu'ni na, weèe fa keèr raèasi nyor aè buu bbebep ce weèe aè m ce koèñ aè rgeèe aè nfeè' ce weèe aè m máñni buu naè ka'.
English: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

Limbum: AÈmboè ñwáè ce e ká' weèe yu ñwáâ nrara na, baná weèe ba rara aè buu wááwá ce weèe ce geèe,
English: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;

Limbum: njobeè' a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Ba neè brara njobeè' m yu nrara.”
English: because it is written, You shall be holy; for I am holy.

Limbum: Weèe ce loo, ce too Nyúè ená yeè Taê. E yu ñwáè ce e ke so'ni ñgoèñ ka', ce sa' beèe ba aè buu ce woweèe a geèe, baná aèmboè weèe ce cu njep ñgoèñ na aèmboè bkïìloè na, weèe ce wáp ye.
English: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man's work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear:

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ weená aè m ba aè nfeè' ce a m yuu weèe efa ndeèe to' ce weêe bta a m láè neè weèe, sá' aè ba njo ka' naè, a m yuu weèe ba neè buu ce nlo e ke koo aègho aèmboè mbaèa na ka'.
English: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

Limbum: A m yuu weèe ba neè bláá Kraâis ce vi luèu ntaa seê, a ba aèmboè bláá fuâu njeèe tañshïì ce yi yu yáánïì, já' yi ba aègho ka'.
English: but with precious blood, as of a faultless and pure lamb, the blood of Christ;

Limbum: Tá Nyúè ka' keè geèe ñgoèñ, e m rïìñ war yuu ce e be geèe neè Kraêis. AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' elúèsimbuèu e geêe, e yáátïì aèwañ njo' weèe.
English: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed at the end of times for your sake,

Limbum: Yu njo' ye ce ená weèe aè byemi neè Nyúè ce e m fúr ye efa rkwe, a ku'si ye. Yi ka' ba wa'a weèe aè ce byemi ba neè Nyúè, a lá mmir ba mbe yeâ nduè.
English: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe yu brara njobeè' weèe aè yu'ni a gee buu mini, a koñ bfúr wee neè mini-ñwáè na, m ce laèa máná weèe koñni neè ye ntee-ñwáè.
English: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently:

Limbum: Yi yu ená a ker bi weèe, weèe aè ke' ba boo beèe ce a ke loè ku kweñger naè ka'. Weèe yu ba boo ñwáè ce aède' e ke kwe ka'. Yu Nlaèa Nyúè ce yi yu teèe, a túr ñger nfeseè, ce yi geèe weèe aè ka' ba boo vi.
English: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a m sañ enáê, “Beèe wááwá a yu aèmboè mjáá, lap rboèñ li ku ba aèmboè fúèlawaè ce e ke kuè' aè rïìñ naè. Mjáá mi ke yopri, fúèlawaè karñgeèr.
English: For, All flesh is like grass, and all of man's glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

Limbum: Nlaâa Tata Nyúè yi cu yi aè nfeè' sïìp.” Nlaèa anaè yu Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce a feè'shi neè weèe naè.
English: but the Lord's word endures forever. This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

Limbum: Baná weèe ma' bsaèrbuu. Weèe fa keèr ce bo' beèe, káè ce bo' weâe btu, káè ce ko'ndoñ, káè ce sa'ni ka'.
English: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

Limbum: Weèe yu seè'ni aèmboè boo bbeer ce a bi wa'a. Baná weèe aè ba koèñ aè rnyoñ mmbee ce aè yú' ce mi yu mrara, tá weèe bo kuè', luèñ.
English: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that you may grow thereby,

Limbum: Weèe aè yá war ená Tata aè geèe yuu boèñboñ neè weèe.
English: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

Limbum: Weèe ko'shi aègee Tata ce e yu luèr ce nteèe. Beèe a m maè' luèr ana, aè ba luèr ce Nyúè aè m ce, e luu ntaa neè ye seê.
English: coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

Limbum: Wee weèe foñ yu aèmboè bluâr bteèe wa'a. Baná weèe ko'shi a yeâ geñ tá e bo loèr weèe baè'ri Ndap Nyúè yïû aè yú' aègho, tá weèe bo faè' mbo aèmboè ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì ce a yu brara, a ce tañshi btañshïì ce aè yú', ce vi yu byáánïì aè bsii Nyúè njo' yuu ce Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe.
English: You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

Limbum: A sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè enáê, “Yu' neè, m ce láè luèr rbuu ndap aè rla' Sayoèn. AÈ co' máè luèr anaè, e boñ neè máè seê. Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi neè ye, aède' rïìtu yi ke koo ñgaèñ ka'.”
English: Because it is contained in Scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.

Limbum: Baná e boèñ neè weèe ce weèe aè byemi. AÈ ka' ba yi neè beèe ce a byemi ka', “Luèr ce ñgaâa mboo mndap a m maè', aè kúti ba luèr rbuu ndap.”
English: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,

Limbum: A ker ba foñ, “Luèr ce beèe a ce kote aègho, a ce gweèñger.” Woweèe a ce kote aègho njobeè' woweèe a byemi Nlaâa Nyúè ka'. Nyúè aè m geèe ená yi ba wa'a.
English: and, a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense. For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, weèe yu ndúè' beèe ce Nyúè aè ce, a ba ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì, a ce faè' neè ñkúú, a ba to' rara, a ba beèe vi Nyúè, tá weèe bo suñ aèmboè buu bboèñboñ ce Nyúè aè geèe. Yu ye ce e ká' weèe a fúr weèe efa túè'nji, weèe aè ba seè'ni ba aè li rraa ce li boèñ seê.
English: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè' weèe aè m ba beèe Nyúè ka', aè ka' ba seè'ni na, weèe aè ba beèe Nyúè. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè', Nyúè aè m koosimnse neè weèe ka', aè ka' ba seè'ni na, e koosimnse neè weèe.
English: who in time past were no people, but now are God's people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

Limbum: Bkar waê, m ce bu' mmbo neè weèe ce weèe yu bkïìloè a ker ba beèe ce a ce caèa njep ñgoèñ na caèa, ená weèe borni buu ce wee bláá vi luèute aè rgeèe, aè ba buu ce vi ke jepsi wee mntee ce weèe aè láè neè Nyúè.
English: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

Limbum: Cu neè rcu rboèñboñ aè múè beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka' tá woweèe a ka' ba ce laèa ená weèe yu ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep áè, tá a bo yá buu bboèñboñ ce weèe ce geèe, kuè'si Nyúè aè noèñ ce e be vúè aè rsa' ñgoèñ.
English: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they see, glorify God in the day of visitation.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe yu beèe Tataê, baná weèe yu'ni neè neè ñgaâa rsa' wááwá ce beèe a láè ená a sa' weèe. Káè yu ñkúú áè, weèe yu'ni neè ye aèmboè ñwáè ce ñger bto' wááwá yi yu mba yeâ mmboè.
English: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

Limbum: Káè yu bgovanoè áè, weèe yu'ni neè woweèe aèmboè beèe ce ñkúú aè tuusi tá a bo fa ñgá' neè ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep, yoèñshi beèe ce a geèe buu bboèñboñ.
English: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

Limbum: Nyúè ce koèñ ená weèe gee boèñboñ wa'a tá blúr ce a máñni buu naè a bo yá, baate yap cuèu.
English: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

Limbum: Fa cu neè aèmboè bkwaèa neè ñwáè moè' ka'. Weâe cu wa'a, weèe fa loèr njáèá rcu anaè tá' aè mmïìr, ce geèe buu bbebep ka'. Cu neè ba aèmboè beèe ce a yu bkwaèa neè Nyúè.
English: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

Limbum: Yu'ni neè neè beèe wááwá, koñ bfúr ce weèe woweèe yu ñgaâa rbyemïì, wáp Nyúè, yu'ni neè ñkúú.
English: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

Limbum: Ñgaâa mfaè', yu'ni neè neè wee mmasaè boèñboñ, gú'shi neè woweèe. Weèe fa kuè geèe wa' ba neè beèe ce a ce geèe buu bboèñboñ neè weèe, a ce loèr weèe aè beèe ka', geèe neè wa' foñ neè beèe ce yap ñgeèe yi yu tatap.
English: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

Limbum: Yu yuu boèñboñ seê, ce aè ka' ce yá ñgá' aètu yuu ce wáè geèe ka', a kur ntee, a ce yá ñgá' anaè wa'a, njobeè' aè ce koèñ aè rgeèe yuu ce yi boèñ Nyúè.
English: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

Limbum: AÈde' a yoñshïì wáè aè njáâá ká, ce aè ka' gee yuu bebep, a lip wáè, aè kur ntee. Wáè ka' ce yá ñgá' njobeè' yuu boèñboñ ce wáè geèe, ku kur ntee, baná Nyúè be yu' rboèñ neè wáè.
English: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ká' weèe ená weèe ka' ce yá ñgá', weèe kur ntee, njobeè' Kraâis ye ye aè m yá ñgá' a weâe btuè. E m geèe wa'a, aè ba ncoèo ená weèe aè ba geèe wa'a foñ.
English: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

Limbum: E m be geèe yuu mo' bebep ka'. Mnde' mi m be fúú eku yeâ cuèu ka'.
English: who did not sin, neither was deceit found in his mouth.

Limbum: A m cáp ye, e ke' kúsïì ka'. A m fa ye ñgá', e ke' gee yuu mo' ka'. E m ku lá buu anaè ba mbe mmbo Nyúè ce e ke sa' mnsa' yáánïì.
English: Who, when he was cursed, didn't curse back. When he suffered, didn't threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously;

Limbum: E m kwe yïìseèe boo-bïìr aè nfeè' ce a m taa ye mbe kïìntaa naè, tá seèe bo keèr ce geèe buu bbebep ka', cu ce geèe ba buu byáánïì. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' a m báási ye, seèe aè luêñ.
English: who his own self bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

Limbum: Weèe aè m ba aèmbo njeèe ce yi daè', aè ka' ba seè'ni weèe aè kútïì a ce duè ba aèmbuèu ñwáè ncïìñ njeèe ce e ce keè'ni weèe.
English: For you were going astray like sheep; but now have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

Limbum: Bbyeèñge foñ a ba yu'ni neè bduu wap, bduu wap mo' a ka' ba ce a byemi blaâa Nyúè ka' tá yap ñgeèe yi bo geèe woweèe tá a byemi ce woweèe a laèa yuu mo' neè woweèe ka',
English: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any don't obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word;

Limbum: njobeè' a yá aèmboè woweèe a ce cu rcu rrara a ce yu'ni.
English: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

Limbum: Le rboèñ li fa loè ba efa btu ce weèe ce ba', ba bsa', ba bcáè' ce weèe ce suèsi nyor aègho tá beèe a bo yá naè ka'.
English: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;

Limbum: Le rboèñ li ba ba enjep ntee, ba neè rbornïì-ñwáè, ba neè rfúteè enjep ntee. Njáèá rboèñ ca li ke kwe ncoèo ka', a boñ aè bsii Nyúè seê.
English: but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.

Limbum: A njáèá njïì ce bbyeèñge brara eluâuñgoèñ ce a m láè map mmir mbenduè Nyúè, a m ce duèñshi lap rboèñ. Woweèe a m ce yu'ni neè bduu wap.
English: For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

Limbum: Sáèra ye ye aè m ce yu'ni neè Abraèhaêm, a ce yoèñ ye ená yïì masaè. Weèe yu boo vi ce weèe aè ka' ce geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ, ke' ce wáp yuu mo' ka'.
English: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

Limbum: Bduu foñ a ba cu a wap bbyeèñge weèe neè bfee-ñwáè. Woweèe a ba rïìñ ená bbyeèñge a yu yap bwáèni, yu'ni neè woweèe. Woweèe a ba geèe wa'a njobeè' woweèe bsïìp a be koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè ce li loè ese Nyúè njo' yi ntee boèñboñ. Woweèe a ba geèe wa'a faè dïì' yuu mo' yi bo jepsi lap rloo ka'.
English: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.

Limbum: Yuu ce m ce laèa neè weèe aèlúèsimbuèu seè'ni yi yu ená weèe ba cuâu mo'sir, ce koosimnse neè beèe, koñni aèmboè bfúr boo ma wa'a, gee ñgeâe boèñboñ neè beèe, ker lor yeè nyor njep nsheè.
English: Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

Limbum: Fa kúsi neè yuu bebep neè yuu bebep ka. Faè kúsi mcáp neè mcáp ka'. Loo neè ba ená Nyúè ghoni beèe ce a geèe buu ca neè weèe, njobeè' Nyúè aè m ká' weèe ená weèe bo geèe wa'a, tá e bo ghoèni weèe.
English: not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing; knowing that to this were you called, that you may inherit a blessing.

Limbum: Yi ku ba aèmboè a sañ enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' ce koèñ aè rcu ce yu' rboèñ, ce lu'shi, ñgaèñ fa laèa yuu bebep káè nya' mnde' ka'.
English: For, He who would love life, and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.

Limbum: Ñgaèñ be borni buu bbebep, geèe ba buu bboèñboñ. E be koèñ cumúnyañ, roèo mnduunjïì aè rkoni cumúnyañ anaè. Ñgaèñ aè ba geèe wa'a,
English: Let him turn away from evil, and do good. Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

Limbum: njobeè' Tata Nyúè ce keè'ni beèe ce a ce geèe buu byáánïì, a ce yu' lap rloo, a ce fa ñgá' neè beèe ce a ce geèe buu bbebep.”
English: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

Limbum: Ntee yi ka' ce luèu weèe aè rgeèe yuu boèñboñ, ñwáè ce aède' e gee yuu bebep neè weèe ba nda?
English: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good?

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, weèe aè ka' ce yá ñgá' ba njo' yuu boèñboñ ce weèe aè geèe baná weèe yu ñgaâa mboâñtu. Weèe fa wáp woweèe, maè'shi tá mluè mi ce koo weèe njo' woweèe ka'.
English: But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. Don't fear what they fear, neither be troubled.

Limbum: Yi yu ba ená weèe yu'ni ba neè Kraâis aèmboè Tataê, neè ye ntee-ñwáè. Tami neè nyor aè nfeè' wááwá aè rbeèesi ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' bipshi ená weèe suñ mbuèu efa yuu ce weèe cu ce keè'.
English: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:

Limbum: Geèe neè wa'a neè cumúnyañ-ñwáè ba ryu'nïì, lá ye ntee rara, tá beèe a ka' ce cáp weèe, tá rïìtu yi bo koo woweèe njo' wap blaâa bbebep ce a ce laèa njo' ye ñgeâe boèñboñ ce weèe ce geèe njo' weèe yu beèe Jisos Kraêis.
English: having a good conscience; that, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

Limbum: Yi yu aèndeèe ená aè yá ñgá' njo' yuu boèñboñ ce aè ce geèe ce Nyúè ka' koñ ená yi ba wa'a, neè ce ená aè yá ñgá' njo' yuu bebep.
English: For it is better, if it is God's will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.

Limbum: Kraâis ye ye aè m kwe aètu yïìseèe buu bbebep, a ku kwe ñkaèraè' moè'sir caè'caè'. Ye ce e m ba ñwáâ nyáánïì, aè m kwe aètu beèe ce a m ba byáánïì ka', tá e bo loèr seèe fa neè Nyúè. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' ce e m ba aè ñwáè, a yú ye. Nyúè aè ka' fúr ye efa rkwe, e ba aè yú'.
English: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

Limbum: E m duè aè yú', a du a fe'shi Nlaèa Nyúè neè byú' ce vi m ba mbe shañ,
English: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

Limbum: aè ba byú' ce vi m teèe tu eluâuñgoèñ aè nfeè' ce Nowa aè m ce baè'ri keñ, Nyúè aè kur ntee neè vi naè. Beèe ce a m niñ mbe keñ anaè a m ba múcaèr seê. AÈ m ku ba beèe nwaami caè'caè' ce a m luèñ embenjïì mdip anaè.
English: who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

Limbum: Mdip anaè mi yu aèmboè baèptir ce e ce geèe weèe ce luèñ seè'ni na. Baèptir anaè yu ba ená ñwáè ce suè'si mghaa efa nyoèr ka', yu ba ená ñwáè ce geèe mkaè'ni neè Nyúè neè ntee rara. E ce geèe weèe ce luèñ embenjïì rfúú ce Jisos Kraâis aè m fúú efa rkwe.
English: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you--not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

Limbum: E m duè mbe buèu, a cu aè rkoo maè' Nyúè, bcïìndap Nyúè ba byú' wááwá ce vi túr ñger a ba njep yeâ tïìi.
English: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

Limbum: Baná aèmboè Kraâis aè m yá ñgá' aè nfeè' ce e m ba aè ñwáè, a yu' ryañ se naè, wee weèe foñ aè ba túr ba njáèá ntee ce e m túr, njobeè' ñwáè ce e ka' yá ñgá' wa'a, baná ñgaèñ aè gaèpni a yuu bebep.
English: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;

Limbum: E gaèpni a yuu bebep, baná e be keèr cu li rcu enjep ñgoèñ na, ce geèe ba buu bbebep ce vi bláá vi ce luèute aè rgeèe ka'. E be cu ce geèe ba yuu ce Nyúè ce koèñ.
English: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

Limbum: Nfeè' ce weèe aè m ce geèe buu ce beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka' a ce geèe naè, aè gháá wa'a. Woweèe a ce geèe mnyáâr, a ce geèe yuu ce wap bláá vi ce luèute aè rgeèe. Woweèe a ce no buu vi ce koo woweèe, a ce geèe mñkaè' bghaa, a ce geèe mñkaè' no buu, a ce loo neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na ce Nyúè aè kani ená beèe a fa loo neè vi ka'.
English: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

Limbum: Woweèe a ka' yá ená weèe ker ce geèe ku' njáèá buu bbebep ce weèe woweèe aè m ce geèe naè ka', a bááñger, a ce cáp weèe.
English: They think it is strange that you don't run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming:

Limbum: Woweèe a be keè laèa yuu kuèu yuu ce woweèe a ce geèe na neè ñwáè ce e tami nyor aè rsa' beèe ce a cu bteèe ker ba beèe ce a kweñger.
English: who will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce a m feè'shi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ neè beèe ce a m kweñger, tá woweèe a bo cu aè yú' aèmboè Nyúè ce cu naè. Woweèe a be cu wa'a, ka' a m sa' woweèe aè nfeè' ce woweèe a m ba njep ñgoèñ na, woweèe a kwe aèmboè beèe wááwá a ke kwe naè wa'a.
English: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

Limbum: Nfeè' múcaèr tá buu wááwá mïî. Baná weèe cu neè bfee-ñwáè tá weèe bo rïìñ aè rloo boèñboñ.
English: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi yu tatap seê, yi yu ená weèe koñni neè mini-ñwáè njobeè' rkoèñnïì li ke tá'shi buu bbebep goèr.
English: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

Limbum: Koni neè beèe ce a ce niñ weèe, gá' neè woweèe boèñboñ. Wee geèe wa' weèe fa ce de'ñger ka'.
English: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

Limbum: Weèe wááwá aè koni bfee ese Nyúè. Baná weèe lor bfee anaè ja' wee mnyor aègho. Wee geèe wa'a baná weèe aè loèr yuu ce Nyúè aè m fa neè weèe aè ntee boèñboñ, a fa' aègho yáánïì.
English: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' ce feè'shi, e fe'shïì ba blaâa Nyúè. Ñwáè ka' ce faè' neè beèe, e lor ñger ce Nyúè aè fa neè ye fa' aègho, tá beèe a bo kuè'si Nyúè aè buu wááwá ce weèe ce geèe njo' weèe yu beèe Jisos Kraêis. Bkuè' wááwá vi ba neè ye aè nfeè' sïìp, ñger wááwá yi ba neè ye aè nfeè' sïìp foñ. Yi yu wa'a.
English: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Bkar waê, weèe fa ce báèáñger njo' rmoèoshïì ce li ce toèoshi weèe aèmboè mor na, aèmboè yu lá yuu ce yi búèú weèe wa' ka'.
English: Beloved, don't be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you, to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

Limbum: Weèe aè ba ce lu'shi lu'shi ená weèe ce yá ñgá' ce Kraâis aè m yá, tá weèe bo keè lu'shi ce yu' rboèñ aè nfeè' ce e be vúè duèñshi yi foèo.
English: But because you are partakers of Christ's sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

Limbum: Beèe a ka' ce cáp weèe njo' Jisos Kraêis, baná weèe yu ñgaâa mboâñtu, njobeè' yú' ce yi ke vúè neè foèo, ce yu yú' Nyúè naè, yi yu mbe weâe nduè.
English: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

Limbum: Moè' efa weèe fa yá ñgá' njobeè' e yu ñwáè nyúshi beèe, káè nyáèá, káè ñwáè ñgeèe buu bbebep, káè njobeè' e ce jepsi ntaè'teè beèe mo' ka'.
English: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men's matters.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' yá ñgá' ba njobeè' e yu ñwáè rbyemïì, rïìtu yi fa koo ñgaèñ ka', ñgaèñ yoñshi Nyúè ená e yu mbaèmba Kraêis.
English: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

Limbum: Nfeè' ce a be sa' mnsa' aè gháá. Beèe ce a be sa' entombïì yu beèe Nyúè. A ka' ká' mnsa' anaè ba neè seèe, yi lo ba eká neè beèe ce a byemi Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ ce e loè ese Nyúè naè ka'?
English: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don't obey the Good News of God?

Limbum: A sañ enáê, “Yi ka' ba tatap neè beèe ce a yu yáánïì aè rluèñ efa mnsa', beèe ce a ce wáp Nyúè ka', a ce geèe buu bbebep a lo ba yap ba fá?”
English: If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?

Limbum: Baná beèe ce a ce yá ñgá' aèmboè Nyúè aè koèñ, a ba fa waêp mnyor neè ñwáè ce e m boo woweèe, ce e yu ñwáè mini, kuè ce geèe buu bboèñboñ.
English: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

Limbum: M túr yuu aè rlaèa neè btu embe coêr. M ce laèa aèmboè tu foñ. M yu ñwáè ce máè m yá yuu ce a m geèe neè Kraâis aè nfeè' ce e m yá ñgá', a ba moè' efa múè beèe ce a be koni rboèñ ce Jisoès be keè vúè aègho naè.
English: I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed.

Limbum: Cïìñ neè kúr njeâe Nyúè ce yi yu mba weâe mmboè naè, ciñ yi neè rlu'shïì-ñwáè aèmboè Nyúè ce koèñ ená weèe ciñ naè, ke' ba ba aèmboè a taèa lá weèe taèa wa' ka'. Weèe fa faè' njobeè' weèe aè roñ mbaèa ka', faè' neè ba njobeè' weèe ce lu'shi aè rfaè'.
English: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

Limbum: Weèe fa sa' beèe ce Nyúè aè fa mba weâe mmboè aèmboè weèe yu lá waêp mmasaè wa' ka'. Weèe duñshi ba ndeâe mboèñmboñ, ce woweèe a yá, bo koni.
English: neither as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

Limbum: Be ba nyúè ce tu ñgaâa ncïìñ njeèe aè vúè tá weèe koni rtaa foèo ce aède' li ke kwe ncoèo ka'.
English: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn't fade away.

Limbum: M ce laèa neè boo mnsuènsuè foñ máná woweèe a yu'ni neè bleebeèe. Baná weèe wááwá lor weêe btu aèmboè bkwaèa, ce fa' a weâe mú. Nyúè e ke fa ñgá' neè ñgaâa naèatu, duñshi yi ntee boèñboñ neè beèe ce a ce naèa tu ka'.
English: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject yourselves to one another; for God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

Limbum: Baná weèe suusi yeè nyor njeptii Nyúè ce e túr ñger, nfeè' aè ka' gháá, tá e bo naèa weèe mbekïì.
English: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

Limbum: Fa neè yeè buu wááwá ce mluè mi ce koo weèe aègho mbe yeâ mmboè, njobeè' e túr ntee neè weèe.
English: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

Limbum: Cu neè neè bfee-ñwáè, ce ke'nïî, njobeè' Sataèn ce e yu yeè ñwáè bbaèa ce kashi aèmboè búrúè' ce e ce waa wa'a, a ce roèo ñwáè ce e bo koo, ye.
English: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

Limbum: Weèe fa fa yeè njïì ka', táá neè njep yuu ce weèe aè byemi, riñ weená bfúr wee ce a yu aè bdïì' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na, a ce yá njáèá ñgá' ce weèe ce yá na.
English: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' yá ñgá' aè mú nfeè' moè' wáá, tá Nyúè gee tá buu wááwá kúti ba yáánïì, keèr geèe tá weèe táá tatap ce cïì'ti ka'. Yu ye Nyúè ce bghoènïì wááwá vi loè ese ye, yu ye ce e m ká' weèe ená weèe bo koni bkuè' ce nfeseè njo' yuu ce Kraâis aè m geèe naè.
English: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

Limbum: Tá yi ñger yi cu nfeseè. Yi yu wa'a.
English: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e jaè' máè a sañ mú ñwaè' ca neè weèe a Sïìlïìvanoès. E yu nfúr ce m rïìñ máná e yu ñwáâ mini. Máè sañ tá m bo fa weèe ñger, keèr suñ weèe máná rboâñntee Nyúè li yu aèmboè máè m suñ weèe naè neè mini-ñwáè. Táá neè njo tatap.
English: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

Limbum: Ñgaâa rbyemïì embe cor ce aè rla' Babiloèn, ce Nyúè aè ce foñ aèmboè e ce weèe naè, a caè'ni weèe. Muu waâ Mak aè caè'ni weèe foñ.
English: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you; and so does Mark, my son.

Limbum: Weèe ca'ni wee mnyor, baani mnyor aè rduèñshi ená weèe koèñni. Tá weèe wááwá ce weèe yu beèe Kraêis, koni cumúnyañ.
English: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e sañ ñwaè' ca aè sañ máâ Saimún Pitaè. M yu ñwáè rfaè' a ker ba ñwáè ntuu neè Jisos Kraêis. M ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè beèe ce a byemi neè Jisos Kraâis aèmboè wer weèr foñ aè byemi naè. Rbyemïì ca li boèñ a caa buu wááwá. Jisos Kraâis aè fa seèe njïì ená seèe byemi neè ye njobeè' e ke geèe buu aè njïû yáánïì. E yu Nyúè a ker ba yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè'.
English: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

Limbum: M ce loo máná aèmboè weèe be ce yá'ni, rïìñ Nyúè boèñboñ, tá Nyúè túr ntee boèñboñ neè weèe, ker fa weèe cumúnyañ.
English: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

Limbum: Nyúè aè fa seèe buu wááwá ce seèe aè ba túr, tá seèe bo cu rcu ryáánïì. E m geèe yi ba aètáèr wa'a njo' yi ñger ce yi yu jáá. Njïì ce seèe aè rïìñ aè rcu wa'a yi yu ená seèe riñ ñwáè ce e m ká' seèe ená seèe ba bboèñboñ aèmboè e yu naè.
English: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue;

Limbum: E geèe wa'a a fa seèe buu bboèñboñ ce e m kaè' ená e be fa seèe naè, tá weèe bo túr ñger aè rcañ efa gee buu bbebep enjep ñgoèñ na, ce beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a koèñ se naè. Yi ka' ba wa'a tá weèe bo geèe ba ñgeèe ce yi yu aèmboè yïû Nyúè.
English: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

Limbum: Baná aèmboè weèe aè foèosi neè Jisoès na, gheèter neè kyese buu moè' ca mbenduè le rbyemïì. Geèe neè ñgeâe boèñboñ ker riñ buu foñ.
English: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

Limbum: Weèe fa kuè rïìñ ba buu caè'caè' ka', weèe kani wee mnyor efa rgeèe yuu bebep. Weâe ce kani wee mnyor efa rgeèe yuu bebep, weèe táá tatap aè buu bboèñboñ anaè. Weâe ce táá tatap aè buu ca, weèe gee ba ñgeèe ce yi yu aèmboè yïû Nyúè.
English: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control patience; and in patience godliness;

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe ce geèe ñgeèe ce yi yu aèmboè yïû Nyúè, weèe gee yuu ce aède' weèe gee neè nfúr embe weâe ndap neè nfúr moè' foñ. Weâe ce geèe wa'a weèe túr ntee boèñboñ neè beèe wááwá.
English: and in godliness brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

Limbum: Weèe aè ka' ce geèe ba njáèá ñgeèe ca, ce kuè' njo baná buu ce weèe aè rïìñ aèmboè Jisos Kraâis naè vi be bú aè cicïì ka'. Weèe be ye sá' efa gho.
English: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful to the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe njáèá ñgeèe ca ka' baná ñgaèñ yu aèmboè ñwáè ce e feèp wa'a, a ce yá buu ce vi yu aè njïìsaèp ka', a lese yi yu ená Nyúè aè suè'si ye efa faèa ce e m geèe.
English: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

Limbum: Bfúr waè, aèmboè yi yu wa'a, baná weèe gheter gee ba buu ce vi be duèñshi ghup ená Nyúè aè ce weèe. Weèe aè ka' ce geèe wa'a weèe ke gwe rmoèoshïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
