English: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, tá Nyúè bo lu'shi aè rfa weèe fáñ tá weèe bo niñ mbe nto' Tata Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe ñwáè rjaè', tá seèe woweèe bo cu mbo nfeseè.
English: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Baná m be kuè ce kuushi weèe buu ca aè nfeè' wááwá. Máè rïìñ máná weèe aè rïìñ war buu mini a táá njo tatap.
English: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them, and are established in the present truth.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, yi yu boèñboñ ená m kuushi weèe buu ca aè nfeè' wááwá aèmboè m ku bii nteèe na, tá m bo doèoshi weèe aègho.
English: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you;

Limbum: Máè rïìñ máná ku báti nfeè' múcaèr tá m buu aègho. Tata Jisos Kraâis aè m suñ máè wa'a.
English: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

Limbum: M be gheèter tatap seê, ka' m ka' kwe, tá weèe bo ku ce kuushi buu ca aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

Limbum: Buu ce weèr aè m suñ weèe aèmboè rvúè Jisos Kraâis ce e m vúè neè ñger Nyúè naè aè m ba ba mghaèghar ce beèe a sañ neè wap bfee naè ka'. Weèr aè m yá yi ñger neè mer mmir.
English: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

Limbum: AÈ m ba mbe nfeè' ce Nyúè Taèr aè m fa ñger ba foèo neè Jisos Kraâis naè, njeèndoñ Nyúè ce e túr foèo ce vi caèa ñger aè m laèa enáê, “Muu ca a muu waè ce máè koèñ seê. M ce yu' rboèñ neè ye.”
English: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

Limbum: Weèr Jisoès weèe aè m ba mbe rtuèu ce Nyúè aè m laèa mbo anaè, a yu' njeèndoñ ce e m laèa embe buèu naè.
English: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

Limbum: Baná weèr aè riñ neè mini-ñwáè ená blaèa ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m feè'shi naè vi yu mini njobeè' buu ce weèr aè yá neè mer mmir. Weèe aè ba yu' blaèa ca boèñboñ, njobeè' vi yu aèmboè lam ce e raa neètú', ku raa du baè' aè nfeè' ce túè' be raa naè. Be ba aè nfeè' ce mbeèr aè loè naè, tá weèe yá rraa njep weâe mntee.
English: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns, and the morning star arises in your hearts:

Limbum: Yuu ce yi yu tatap yi yu ená weèe riñ ená yu ba ñwáè moè'sir ce e be saèr blaâa ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè ce a m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè ka'.
English: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

Limbum: Yi yu wa'a njobeè' buu ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a m laèa anaè vi m loè ese ñwáè ka'. Yú' Rara yi m niñ njep ntee beèe Nyúè a gee woweèe a fe'shïì blaèa ce Nyúè aè m suñ woweèe.
English: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: AÈ m ba eluâuñgoèñ, beèe ce a m ce laèa ená a ce cep ntuu Nyúè, a ba ba ñgaâa mnde' naè, a m ku ba aè múè beèe Nyúè. Ñgaâa ryá'nïì ce a yu ñgaâa mnde' a be loè ba a weâe mú foñ aèmboè ñgaâa mnde' a m ba aè múè beèe Nyúè eluâuñgoèñ naè. Woweèe a be vúè neè ryá'nïû rbebep, bo' beèe, bepsi woweèe aègho. Woweèe a be kani yaèp masaè Kraâis ce e m tee woweèe efa bkwaèa naè. Yuu ce woweèe a be geèe na yi be geèe tá woweèe a bú aè cicïì cárcár.
English: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

Limbum: Beèe magoèr a be beè'ni ndeâe mbembep ca, geèe tá beèe a laa bebep aèmboè nduunjïì ce mini.
English: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

Limbum: Ñgaâa mnde' anaè a ku ce koèñ ená woweèe a koni sá' efa buu wááwá. Woweèe a be bo' weèe neè mnde' tá a bo ye sá' efa mnde' anaè. Yu nfeè' njïìsaèp aèmboè Nyúè ce e be sa' mnsa' beèe teni aè tami nyor aè rfa woweèe ñgá' njo' yaèp ndeâe mbembep anaè. Ku báti nfeè' múcaèr tá e misi woweèe nfeseè.
English: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn't linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

Limbum: Yá neè yuu ce Nyúè aè m geèe neè vi bcïìndap mo' ce a m geèe buu bbebep naè. Nyúè aè m buu efa rfa woweèe ñgá' ka'. E m maè' woweèe njep mor. Woweèe a noèñ njep ma beè'teè ce yi coomi neè bshañ aè mkoo. Njo yi ce sii mbïûñ mbïûñ. Woweèe a be cu njo duè baè' aè nfeè' ce Nyúè be sa' ñgoèñ.
English: For if God didn't spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved for judgment;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m buu foñ efa rfa ñgá' neè beèe eluâuñgoèñ ce a m ce geèe buu bbebep naè ka'. E m geèe mdip mi ruu a cete ñgoèñ wááwá, a yúshi beèe ce a m teèe tu neè ye anaè. E m ku ja' ba Nowa caè'caè' ce e m ce feè'shi neè beèe ená a ce gee ba buu bboèñboñ, ker ba beèe mo' beèe nsaèambaê.
English: and didn't spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly;

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aèmboè mla' Sodoèm ba Goèmoraè, mnsa' Nyúè mi m koo woweèe. Nyúè aè m toèo mla' anaè neè mor mi sheê, a kúti aè bú. E m geèe cena wa'a, a ce duèñshi ená a yuu ce yi be keè koni beèe ce a m teèe tu neè Nyúè.
English: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live ungodly;

Limbum: AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè e ja' Lot ce e m ba ñwáâ nyáánïì. Ntee yi m ce yañ ye njo' ndeâe mbembep ce beèe ce aè mla' ca a m ce geèe.
English: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

Limbum: E m cu aè múè beâe bbebep ca, a ce yá buu bbebep ce woweèe a m ce geèe aè mnoèñ wááwá, a ker ce yu' buu bbebep ce woweèe a m ce laèa. Ntee yi m yañ ye se njobeè' e m ce geèe ñgeâe yáánïì.
English: for that righteous man dwelling among them, was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds:

Limbum: Buu ca vi ce duèñshi ená Nyúè rïìñ njáèá njïì ce e be jaè' yïì beèe efa ñgá', a ker riñ njáèá njïì ce e be fa ñgá' neè beâe bbebep caar duè baè' aè nfeè' ce e be sa' ñgoèñ.
English: the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment;

Limbum: Beèe ce Nyúè be fa ñgá' ce e caèa ñger neè woweèe, yu beèe ce a ku ce geèe ba buu bbebep ce yaèp nyor ce koèñ, a ker ce kani efa ryu'nïì naè. Ñgaâa ryá'nïì ce a yu ñgaâa mnde' naè a ke wáp yuu ka'. Woweèe a teèe btu, a ke' ce wáp aè rcáp byú' ce vi túr ñger a caa woweèe naè ka'.
English: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries;

Limbum: Ka' bcïìndap Nyúè ce a caèa ñgaâa ryá'nïì ce a yu ñgaâa mnde' naè a ke laèa bebep aèmboè woweèe aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don't bring a railing judgment against them before the Lord.

Limbum: Beèe ca a ce laèa bebep aèmboè buu ce woweèe a rïìñ ka'. Woweèe a ce geèe ñgeèe blúr a ba aèmboè mnyaâa aè rïìñ ce beèe a ke koo, yú naè. Woweèe a be bepsi beèe mo' wa'a, bep foñ njep múè njáèá ñgeèe anaè, loè kwe bú aè cicïì.
English: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

Limbum: Nyúè be laè' woweèe ba neè ñgá' njobeè' woweèe a fa ñgá' neè beèe mo' foñ. Woweèe a yu' rboèñ aè rgeèe buu bbebep ce beèe a ke geèe neètú' naè ba neèmootïì. Yap ñgeèe yi coosi weèe. Weèe woweèe e cu aèbee ye byee, woweèe a kúti mbenjïì, ce yu' rboèñ njep múè buu bbebep.
English: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

Limbum: Woweèe a ku ce kwaè'shi ba aèmboè bbyeèñge aè nfeè' wááwá, a ke' sáè efa rgeèe buu bbebep ka'. Woweèe a ka' yá beèe ce a táá tatap ka', baná a be bo' woweèe tá woweèe a bo geèe buu bbebep foñ. Woweèe a weti a lááte nje múè ñgeèe bwer. Woweèe a gweè mnsa' Nyúè war.
English: having eyes full of adultery, and who can't cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed; children of cursing;

Limbum: Woweèe a maè'shi njïû yáánïì a du ba aè njïû mbembep. Woweèe a loèr ba njïì yïì Balaèm ce e m ba muu Beyoè. Balaèm ca aè m koèñ aè rgeèe yuu bebep tá e bo koni mbaèa.
English: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m lapni ye njo' yuu bebep ce e m koèñ aè rgeèe anaè. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' anaè, jaèaki' ce e ke laèa ka', aè laa aèmboè ñwáè wa'a, a gee ñwáè ntuu Nyúè ca aè ke' gee yuu ce yi m ba neè blúr-ñwáè ka'.
English: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A mute donkey spoke with a man's voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

Limbum: Njáèá beèe ce a maè'shi nduunjïû yáánïì na a yu aèmboè mntoèñ mdip ce vi yuushi wa'a, a ker ba aèmboè mmbaè' ce fu' yi ke caèa, lor naè. Nyúè aè kupshi dïì' mo' neè woweèe; faè dïì' anaè aè ku ba ba túè'nji.
English: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

Limbum: Woweèe a bu' cuèu aè cicïì, a ce boèose beèe ce a ce gheèter aè rfúú efa múè beèe ce a ce geèe yuu mini ka', a ce laèa ená woweèe a gee ba yuu ce yaèp nyor koèñ.
English: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

Limbum: Woweèe a ce suñ beèe ená yuu mo' yi be ker kur woweèe ka'. Ka' woweèe a ce suñ beèe wa'a, woweèe a ku bii faè' bkwaèa neè buu bbebep, njobeè' yuu ce yi ka' túr ñger mbenduè ñwáè, baná ñgaèñ yu ñkwaèa neè yuu anaè.
English: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

Limbum: Beèe a ka' riñ Jisos Kraâis ce e yu yïìseèe Tataê, a ker ba ñwáè ce e geèe seèe aè luêñ, ma'shi buu bbebep enjep ñgoèñ ce vi ke bepsi ñwáè naè, ker lo kúti aèmbuèu mo, baná woweèe a yu mbe dïû' bebep aè nfeè' anaè a caa aèmboè a m ba entombïì.
English: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

Limbum: Yi m ba ba aè ndeèe neè woweèe ce woweèe a m ka' ba riñ nduunjïû yáánïì ka', neè yïì ce ená woweèe a riñ nduunjïì anaè wáá, keèr loè borni efa rláè mncir ce Jisoès aè m fa neè woweèe.
English: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi koni beèe ca yi ce duèñshi ená mñgaèa ce a ke maè' enáê, “Ñgwe aè vú', a ker kúti aèmbuèu mo.” Ker ma' moè' enáê, “A suè'si ñkuânyaèm, e ka' raa wáá a ker biñri aè ncaè'” naè vi yu mini.
English: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, The dog turns to his own vomit again, and the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.

Limbum: Bkar waê, cena yu ñwaè' embenjïì ce máè sañ neè weèe. Máè sañ mñwaâ' bbaa ca a ce kuushi weèe buu ca tá weèe bo lá' efa mmirloè ce kwaè'shi buu Nyúè aè njïû yáánïì.
English: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you;

Limbum: M ce koèñ máná weèe kuushi buu ce ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè ce a m ba beâe brara a m ce laèa, ker ba yuu ce Tata Jisoès ce e geèe seèe aè luñ aè m laèa ená weèe geêe. E m tuu yi ñgaâa ntuu a vú a suñ weèe buu anaè.
English: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandments of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior:

Limbum: Yuu entombïì ce weèe aè ba rïìñ boèñboñ yi yu ená be keè ba aè mnoèñ elúèsimbuèu tá beèe mo' a fúú aè múè beèe, ce geèe ba yuu ce a koèñ. Beèe ca a be keè vúèshi blaèa ce weèe ce feè'shi aèmboè Jisoès,
English: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts,

Limbum: ce laèa enáê, “To e m kaè' ená e be duè kúti? E yuê? Wer bta a m kweñger war, buu wááwá aè ku cu aèmboè vi m ba káâ' aè nfeè' ce Nyúè aè m geèe ñgoèñ.”
English: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

Limbum: Beèe ca a ce laèa wa'a, a ce geèe aèmboè a máñni ená aè m ba eluâuñgoèñ Nyúè aè laa ená rbuu li ba, tá ñgoèñ yi ba, buu ca aè ku ba ghup ka' wa'a. E m gaèpse nshe a mdip, a gee nshe neè mdip.
English: For this they willfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water, by the word of God;

Limbum: Nyúè aè m bepsi ñgoèñ eluâuñgoèñ ba neè mdip aè nfeè' ce mi m ruu a cete ñgoèñ dúèdúè naè.
English: by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m ker laa laèa, yi ba ená rbuu ba nshe ce seèe ce yá na a be kuè cu duè baè' aè noèñ ce mor yi be toèo tá vi she dúèdúè. Buu ca be kuè cu duè baè' aè noèñ ce Nyúè be sa' beèe wááwá, geèe tá beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè ye ka' a kwe bú aè cicïì.
English: But the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

Limbum: Bkar waê, weèe fa leèse ená noâñ mo'sir yi yu aè bsii Nyúè aèmboè bfeè' ncúèkïì, bfeè' ncúèkïì vi ba aèmboè noâñ mo'sir ka'.
English: But don't forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

Limbum: Beèe mo' a ce kwaè'shi ená Tata e ke caèasi nfeè' efa rgeèe buu seê, a ce geèe yuu ce e m kaè' ka'. Yi yu ba ená Tata aè kur ntee neè weèe njobeè' e ce koèñ ená ñwáè moè' kwe bú aè cicïì ka'. E ce koèñ ená ñwáè wááwá kupse, borni yi ñgeâe bebep.
English: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but is patient with us, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

Limbum: Ka' yi yu wa'a, Tata be vúè tá e búú beèe búèú aèmboè nyáèá wa'a. Be keè ba aè nfeè' anaè tá rbuu li coêo, ce barñger aèmboè mor wa'a, bú. Buu embe buèu wááwá vi be keè she, tá ñgoèñ foñ ba buu wááwá enjep ñgoèñ vi bú.
English: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

Limbum: AÈmboè weèe aè rïìñ ená buu wááwá vi be keè bú na, baná njáèá ñgeèe ce weèe aè ba ce geèe yu njáèá yïû ká? Weèe aè ba fa weêe mnyor neè Nyúè, geèe ba ñgeèe ce Nyúè koèñ.
English: Therefore since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

Limbum: Ce ke' neè noèñ ce Nyúè be vúè, ker gheter foñ gee tá noèñ ca yi yañse ba. Be ba aè noèñ anaè tá rbuu ba nshe a bú, tá buu wááwá she dúèdúè.
English: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

Limbum: Nyúè aè kaè' seèe ená rbuu rfi ba nshe nfi be keè ba, tá buu wááwá vi ku ba byáánïì aè ñgoèñ anaè. A yuu ce seèe cu seè'ni a ce ke'.
English: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

Limbum: Bkar waê, baná aèmboè weèe cu a ce ke' buu anaè, weèe gheter geèe ñgeâe boèñboñ, e vúè, weèe bo túr faèa moè' a yeâ bsii ka', cu neè rfúteè-ñwáè.
English: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without blemish and blameless in his sight.

Limbum: Rïìñ neè ená mbuèu ce Tata aè kur ntee a ku cu caar a gháá seè'ni yu njobeè' e koèñ ená beèe a luêñ. Pol ce e yu nfúr yïìseèe ce seèe koèñ se naè aè m loèr bfee ce Nyúè aè m fa ye a sañ buu ca aègho mbe ñwaè' ce e m sañ neè weèe naè.
English: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you;

Limbum: E laèa buu ca mbe vi mñwaè' wááwá ce e sañ. Buu moè' yu mbe vi mñwaè' ce vi tap seê. Beèe ce a máñni buu a táá tatap ka', a loè beesi buu ca aè njáèá yaèp aèmboè a beèesi blaèa moè' embe Ñwaâ' Nyúè naè. Yuu ce woweèe a ce geèe anaè yi be maè' ñgá' mbe waâp btuè.
English: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

Limbum: Bkar waê, aè ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, weèe aè rïìñ buu ca war. Baná weèe lor nfeè' faè dïì' beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè Nyúè ka' a lo bo' weèe tá weèe lo kúti ñgaâa ñgeèe buu bbebep, gweè embe dïû' boèñboñ ce weèe yu na ka'.
English: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

Limbum: Kuè ce du neè ye yu ba aèmbuèu Tata Jisos Kraâis ce e geèe seèe aè luêñ, tá e bo túr ntee boèñboñ neè weèe, tá e bo ghoni weèe goèr, tá weèe riñ yïì buu boèñboñ. Tá beèe a ku'si ye seè'ni na ker ba aè nfeè' wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.
English: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi m ba efa rkáè' ce weèr aè yu', a yá neè mer mmir, a ke'shïî, a ker joo neè mer mmbo yu nlaèa ce e ce fa ryoèñ.
English: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

Limbum: A m duèñshi ryoèñ ca, weèr aè yáê, a ce suñ weèe aèmboè ryoèñ ca ce yu ryoèñ ce nfeseè ce li m ba a Taèr a duñshïì li neè weèr.
English: and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us;

Limbum: Yuu ce weèr aè yá a ker yu', weèr ce suñ weèe foñ tá seèe bo ba aèbee. Yu ba seèe Taèr ba Muu yïû Jisos Kraâis weèe, ce seèe yu aèbee.
English: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Weèr ce sañ buu ca tá seèe bo ruu neè rlu'shïì.
English: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

Limbum: Nsuñ ce weèr aè yu' ese ye, a ce suñ weèe, yu ená Nyúè yu rraa, túè'nji yu njep ye ka',
English: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

Limbum: Seèe ka' laa ená seèe woweèe yu aèbee, kúti ce jáèr aè túè'nji baná seèe ce nya' mnde', a ke' ce cu rcu ce li yu mini ka'.
English: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don't tell the truth.

Limbum: Geewa'a, seèe ka' ce jáèr aè rraa, aèmboè e yu aè rraa, seèe wááwá ba aèbee, bláá Jisoès ce Muu yïì vi su'sïì seèe efa yïìseèe buu bbebep.
English: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

Limbum: Seèe ka' laa ená seèe túr yuu bebep ka', baná seèe ce bo' viseèe btu, a ker buu mini.
English: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

Limbum: Seèe ka' suñ yïìseèe buu bbebep, baná Nyúè ce e ke láè yi nlaèa, a ker ba kuèyáá, be foèosi seèe yïìseèe buu bbebep, suè'si seèe efa buu wááwá ce vi yu yáánïì ka'.
English: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

Limbum: Seèe ka' laa ená seèe aè geèe yuu bebep ka', baná seèe ce loèr Nyúè aè ñwáè mnde', a buu yi nlaèa.
English: If we say that we haven't sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

Limbum: Boo waê, m ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè weèe faè dïì' weèe bo geèe buu bbebep ka'. Geewa'a yi ka' koni ená ñwáè moè' aè geèe yuu bebep, weèe yi ená seèe túr ñwáè njaè' beèe aègee Taèr. Ñwáè anaè yu Jisos Kraâis ce yu ñwáâ nyáánïì.
English: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

Limbum: E yu ñwáè ce a m geèe tañshïì aègho ená a bo foèosi seèe yïìseèe buu bbebep. A m ku gee wa'a a seâe tu caè' ka', aè m ba foñ aètu buu bbebep beèe wááwá.
English: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi ce duèñshi ená seèe rïìñ Nyúè yi yu ená seèe ce geèe yuu ce e laèa.
English: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ce laèa enáê, “M rïìñ ye”, ke' ce geèe yuu ce e laèa ka' yu ñwáè nya' mnde', a buu mini.
English: One who says, I know him, and doesn't keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn't in him.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ce láè nlaèa Nyúè yu ñwáè ce e koèñ Nyúè a misïî. Cena a njïì ce aède' seèe ba seèe Nyúè weèe.
English: But whoever keeps his word, God's love has most certainly been perfected in him. This is how we know that we are in him:

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e laèa ená e ce cu aèbee a Nyúè, ñgaèñ túr aè rcu aèmboè Jisoès aè m ce cu.
English: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

Limbum: Bkar waê, yuu ce m ce sañ neè weèe ená weèe gee na, yu yuu fi ka', yu yuu rúèú ce a m laèa neè weèe efa rkáè'. Yuu rúèú ca yu nlaèa ce weèe aè m yu' wáá.
English: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

Limbum: Geewa'a, m ce sañ nlaâa fi neè weèe ce yi ce duèñshi nyor njep Kraêis, ker ba njep weèe foñ. Yi yu wa'a njobeè' túè'nji ce fa njïì, rraa ce mini li ká' a ce raa.
English: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shines.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce laèa ená e cu aè rraa, baa nfúr yïì, baná ñgaèñ ku cu aè túè'nji.
English: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother, is in the darkness even until now.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e koèñ nfúr yïì, ñgaèñ cu aè rraa, yuu mo' yi yu njep ye ce aètaè yi gee ñgaèñ gee yuu bebep ka'.
English: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e baèa nfúr yïì yu aè túè'nji, a ce jáèr aè túè'nji, a ke' yi faèdïì' e ce duè ka', njobeè' túè'nji aè beèesi ye aè nfeèp.
English: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn't know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

Limbum: M ce sañ neè weèe boo waê, njobeè' a foèosi weèe ye buu bbebep wáá aè rlii Jisos Kraêis.
English: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

Limbum: M ce sañ neè weâe btaèr njobeè' weèe rïìñ ñwáè ce e m ba efa rkáè'. M ce sañ neè weâe mnsuènsuè njobeè' ce weèe aè so Sataèn.
English: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

Limbum: M ce sañ neè weèe boo waê, njobeè' weèe rïìñ Taèr. M ce sañ neè weâe btaèr njobeè' weèe rïìñ ñwáè ce e m ba efa rkáè'. M ce sañ neè weâe mnsuènsuè njobeè' weèe yu btatap, nlaèa Nyúè yi niñ weèe njep bláá, weèe aè so Sataèn.
English: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

Limbum: Weèe fa koèñ ñgoèñ ka'. Weèe fa koèñ buu enjep ñgoèñ ka'. Ñwáè ka' koñ ñgoèñ aètaè ñgaèñ koñ Taèr ka',
English: Don't love the world, neither the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father's love isn't in him.

Limbum: njobeè' buu enjep ñgoèñ vi loè ese Taèr ka', vi loè ese ñgoèñ. Buu enjep ñgoèñ ca yu buu bbebep ce nyor ce roèo, ba mbaèñ mmir aè rtúr buu wááwá ce aè ce yá, ker ba naèanyor aè buu ce aè túr.
English: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn't the Father's, but is the world's.

Limbum: Ñgoèñ yi be mïì, tá buu wááwá ce beèe a ce yá mbo, a ce roèo aè rtúr, vi mi foñ. Geewa'a, ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe yuu ce Nyúè ce roèo, baná ñgaèñ be cu nfeseè.
English: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God's will remains forever.

Limbum: Boo waê, nfeè' ca yu lúèsimbuèu nfeè'. Weèe aè m yu' ená ñwáè ce e baèa Kraâis ce vúè. Beèe ce a baèa Kraâis a vúè seè'ni aè ku' ñgoo, baná seèe yi seè'ni ená nfeè' anaè aè gháá.
English: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

Limbum: Woweèe a fúú efa seâe mú njobeè' woweèe a m ba aè ñgúè' yïìseèe ka'. Woweèe a m ba ba aè ñgúè' yïìseèe, a m ba cu seèe woweèe. Woweèe a fúú efa seâe mú tá yi bo ba rara ená woweèe wááwá a m ba aè ñgúè' yïìseèe ka'.
English: They went out from us, but they didn't belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, Kraâis aè fa weèe Yú' Rara, weèe wááwá aè yi buu ce mini.
English: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

Limbum: M ce sañ neè weèe ba aè njáèá ená weèe máñni mini ka'. M ce sañ njobeè' weèe yi mini wáá, a ker yi ená aètaè mnde' mi lo ese mini ka'.
English: I have not written to you because you don't know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

Limbum: Ñwáè nya' mnde' a nda? Yu ba ñwáè ce e kani ená Jisoès yu Kraâis anaè ka'. Ñwáè anaè yu ñwáè ce e baèa Kraêis. E ce kani Taèr ba muu.
English: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè kanïì muu, ba a Taèr ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi muu baná ñgaèñ yu aè Taèr foñ.
English: Whoever denies the Son, the same doesn't have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

Limbum: Yá neè ená buu ce weèe aè m yá'ni efa rkáè' vi cu njep weâe mntee. Buu ce weèe aè m yá'ni na vi ka' cu njep weâe mntee baná weèe be ba aèbee weèe muu ba Taèr.
English: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

Limbum: Yuu ce Kraâis aè kaè' seèe, yu ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

Limbum: M ce sañ cena neè weèe du kuu beèe ce a ce roèo aè rbo' weèe.
English: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

Limbum: Ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, Kraâis aè fa weèe Yú' Rara, yi ba neè weèe. Mbuèu moè' yu ce ñwáè moè' ker yá'ni weèe ka'. Yú' ce e m fa weèe naè yi be yá'ni weèe buu wááwá. Yú' ce e m fa yu yú' mini, aè ke' ba yú' mnde' ka'. Weèe ce cu aèbee weèe Kraâis weèe aèmboè yi m yá'ni weèe.
English: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don't need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

Limbum: Boo waê, ce cu neè aèbee weèe Kraâis weèe, tá e ba aè nfeè' ce e vúè naè, seèe bo lu'shi aè ryá ye, keè' ce koosi rïìtu ce súèni aè nfeè' ce e vúè ka'.
English: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

Limbum: Weèe ka' riñ ená Kraâis yu ñwáâ nyáánïì, baná weèe túr aè rrïìñ foñ ená ñwáè nsïìp ce e ce geèe buu byáánïì yu muu Nyúè.
English: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness is born of him.

Limbum: Yá neè aèmboè Taèr aè koèñ seèe seê, a ce too seèe aè boo vi naè. Neè mini- ñwáè, seèe yu boo vi. Mbuèu ce ñgoèñ yi máñni seèe yu njobeè' yi m máñni ye.
English: Behold, how great a love the Father has bestowed on us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn't know us, because it didn't know him.

Limbum: Bkar waê, seèe yu boo Nyúè seè'ni. Yuu ce seèe be keè ba yi be yááti neè seèe ka'. Geewa'a seèe yi ená be keè ba aè nfeè' ce e vúè tá seèe feese ye njobeè' seèe be keè yá ye aèmboè e yu.
English: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.

Limbum: Ñwáè nsïìp ce e cu ce keè' ye, ce lá yi ntee rara aèmboè Kraâis ye ye yu nrara naè.
English: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

Limbum: Ñwáè nsïìp ce e ce geèe yuu bebep aè bú' ncir. Yuu bebep yu aè rbú' ncir.
English: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

Limbum: Weèe rïìñ ená Kraâis aè m vúè aè rcaè'si buu bbebep. Yuu bebep yi yu njep yeâ ntee ka'.
English: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and in him is no sin.

Limbum: AÈde' ñwáè ce e ce cu aèbee a ye ker ce geèe yuu bebep ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe yuu bebep baná ñgaèñ aè be yá ye ka', a riñ ye ka'.
English: Whoever remains in him doesn't sin. Whoever sins hasn't seen him, neither knows him.

Limbum: Boo waê, weèe fa maè'shi tá ñwáè moè' bo' weèe ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe yuu yáánïì, baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáâ nyáánïì aèmboè Kraâis yu ñwáè nyáánïì.
English: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe yuu bebep baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè Sataèn njobeè' Sataèn aè m geèe yuu bebep efa rkáè'. Mbuèu ce Muu Nyúè aè m vúè aè m ba ená e bo búsi mfaè' Sataèn.
English: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e yu muu Nyúè e ke geèe yuu bebep ka' njobeè' Nyúè yu njep ye. AÈtaè e gee yuu bebep ka' njobeè' e yu muu Nyúè.
English: Whoever is born of God doesn't commit sin, because his seed remains in him; and he can't sin, because he is born of God.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi geèe seèe riñ ená beèe a yu boo Nyúè káè a yu boo Sataèn áè, yu ená ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe yáánïì ka' baná ñgaèñ yu muu Nyúè ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' tá koèñ nfúr yïì ka' baná ñgaèñ yu muu Nyúè foñ ka'.
English: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn't do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn't love his brother.

Limbum: Cena a nsuñ ce weèe aè m yu' efa rkáè' ená seèe koñni.
English: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;

Limbum: Weèe fa ba aèmboè Kán ce e m ba ñwáè Sataèn a yú nfúr yïì naè ka'. E m yú nfúr yïì ba njoká? AÈ m ba njobeè' buu ce e m geèe aè m ba buu bbebep, vïû nfúr yïì vi ba yáánïì.
English: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one, and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

Limbum: Bfúr waê, ñgoèñ yi ka' baa weèe, weèe fa ba neè rgha'nïì-ñwáè ka'.
English: Don't be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

Limbum: Seèe riñ ená seèe aè fúú efa ñgúè' rkwe a ba aè ñgúè' ryoèñ njobeè' seèe koèñ bfúr viseèe. Ñwáè ce e baèa bfúr yïì, ñgaèñ yu ñwáè ce e kwe.
English: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn't love his brother remains in death.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' baa nfúr yïì, baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè nyú beèe. Weèe yi weená ñwáè nyú beèe aè koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè ka'.
English: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi geèe seèe, seèe aè riñ aèmboè rkoèñnïì li yu, yu ená Kraâis aè m fa yi tu, a kwe njo' seèe. See seèe túr aè rfa viseèe btu njobeè' bfúr viseèe.
English: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' túr buu enjep ñgoèñ na, yá ená nfúr yïì buu yuu, tee mmbo, aètaè rkoèñnïì Nyúè li ba njep ye aè njáâá ká?
English: But whoever has the world's goods, and sees his brother in need, and closes his heart of compassion against him, how does the love of God remain in him?

Limbum: Boo waê, seèe fa kuè koèñ beèe ba ekuè cuèu ka'. Seèe duñshi rkoèñnïì neè mini-ñwáè aè yuu ce seèe ce geèe.
English: My little children, let's not love in word only, neither with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' gee wa'a, baná yi be geèe tá seèe yi ená seèe yu ñgaâa mini, keèr tapsi viseèe mntee aè bsii Nyúè
English: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,

Limbum: aè nfeè' ce viseèe mntee vi ce sa' seèe. Yi yu wa'a njobeè' Nyúè caèa viseèe mntee, a yi buu bsïìp.
English: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

Limbum: Bkar waê, viseèe mntee vi ka' tá sa' seèe ka', seèe wáp aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: Beloved, if our hearts don't condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, seèe ka' loo ka' njáèá ká, e be fa seèe njobeè' seèe ce geèe buu ce e ce laèa, ker ce geèe buu ce yi boèñ ye.
English: and whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

Limbum: Yi nlaèa yi yu ená seèe byemi neè Muu yïì ce Jisos Kraêis, ker koñni aèmboè e m laèa neè seèe.
English: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ce geèe yuu ce e laèa, a ce cu njep ye, ye ye ce cu njep woweèe. Yuu ce yi geèe seèe aè yi ená e cu seèe woweèe yu Yú' ce e fa neè seèe.
English: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

Limbum: Bkar waê, weèe fa byemi byú' bsïìp ka'. Weèe taase byú' aè ryá ená vi loè ese Nyúè lá, njobeè' beèe magoèr ce a bo'shi ená a yu ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, a yu aè ñgoèñ.
English: Beloved, don't believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

Limbum: Yuu ce aède' yi gee weèe riñ Yú' Nyúè yi yu ená, yú' wááwá ce yi byemi ená Jisos Kraâis aè m beèeñger aè ñwáè, a vú njep ñgoèñ, yi loè ese Nyúè.
English: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

Limbum: Yú' wááwá ce yi ka' tá byemi wa' ka', baná yi loè ese Nyúè ka'. Yú' cena yu yú' ñwáè ce e baèa Kraâis ce weèe aè m yu' ená yi ce vúè. Yi yu war njep ñgoèñ seè'ni.
English: and every spirit who doesn't confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God, and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

Limbum: Boo waê, weèe yu beèe Nyúè, a so njáèá beèe ca njobeè' ñwáè ce e yu njep weèe aè caèa ñwáè ce e yu njep ñgoèñ.
English: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

Limbum: Woweèe a yu beèe enjep ñgoèñ, baná a ce laèa yap ba buu enjep ñgoèñ, ñgoèñ yi ce yu' buu ce woweèe a ce laèa.
English: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

Limbum: Weèr yu yer beèe Nyúè. Ñwáè ce e rïìñ Nyúè ce yu' yuu ce weèr ce laèa. Ñwáè ce e yu ñwáè Nyúè ka', ce yu' yuu ce weèr ce laèa ka'. Cena a yuu ce yi ce geèe seèe ka' ce rïìñ yú' ce mini, ba yú' mnde'.
English: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn't listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

Limbum: Bkar waê, seèe koñni njobeè' rkoèñnïì li loè ese Nyúè. Ñwáè wááwá ce e koèñ beèe, yu muu Nyúè, a ker riñ Nyúè.
English: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves is born of God, and knows God.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e koèñ beèe ka', rïìñ Nyúè ka', njobeè' Nyúè yu rkoèñnïì.
English: He who doesn't love doesn't know God, for God is love.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m duèñshi li rkoèñnïì neè seèe aè njáèá ená e m tuu muu yïì ce e m ku ba moè'sir njep ñgoèñ ená seèe bo cu njo' ye.
English: By this God's love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

Limbum: Rkoèñnïì anaè li yu ba ená seèe aè m koèñ Nyúè ka', yu ba ená e m koèñ seèe, a tuu muu yïì ená e ba yuu geèe tañshïì aètu yïìseèe buu bbebep.
English: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

Limbum: Bkar waê, aèmboè Nyúè aè m koñ seèe se naè, see seèe túr aè rkoèñnïì foñ.
English: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè m be yá Nyúè ka'. Seèe ka' koñni, Nyúè cu njep seèe, seèe koñnïì seê, du misïî.
English: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ seená seèe cu njep ye, e cu njep seèe, njobeè' yi yú' ce e fa neè seèe.
English: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

Limbum: Weèr aè yá, a ce suñ beèe ená Taèr aè m tuu Muu yïì ená e ba ñwáè ce e be geèe tá ñgoèñ yi luêñ.
English: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' byemi ená Jisoès yu Muu Nyúè, baná Nyúè cu njep ye, ye ye aè cu njep Nyúè.
English: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba wa'a, seèe aè rïîñ, a byemi rkoèñnïì ce Nyúè aè túr neè seèe. Nyúè yu rkoèñnïì. Ñwáè ce e ka' cu njep rkoèñnïì, baná e cu njep Nyúè, Nyúè aè cu njep ye.
English: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

Limbum: Seèe aè koèñni a du a misi wa'a, tá seèe bo keè wáp yuu mo' aè noèñ mnsa' ka', njobeè' seèe cu njep ñgoèñ na, a ba aèmboè ye.
English: In this love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so are we in this world.

Limbum: Rwáp li yu njep rkoèñnïì ka'. Yi yu ená rkoèñnïì ce li mïìsi li ke juèu rwáp, njobeè' rwáp li ke ba ba aè nfeè' ce seèe aè rïìñ ená a be fa seèe ñgá' njobeè' seèe aè geèe yuu bebep. Baná rkoèñnïì lïû ñwáè ce e ce wáp buu li yu aè bábá'.
English: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

Limbum: Seèe aè koèñni njobeè' e m koèñ seèe entombïì.
English: We love him, because he first loved us.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ka' laa enáê, “M koèñ Nyúè,” baa nfúr yïì, baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè mnde' njobeè' ñwáè ka' baa nfúr yïì ce e ce yá, aède' e koñ Nyúè ce e ce yá ka' aè njáâá ká?
English: If a man says, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn't love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

Limbum: Nyúè aè laèa ca neè seèe, e laèa enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' koñ Nyúè, baná e be kuè koèñ nfúr yïì foñ.”
English: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá ce e byemi ená Jisoès yu Kraêis, ñgaèñ yu muu Nyúè. Ñwáè wááwá ce e koèñ tar muu, koèñ muu anaè foñ.
English: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

Limbum: Seèe ka' koñ Nyúè ker ce geèe buu ce e ce laèa, seèe yi ená seèe koèñ boo vi.
English: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

Limbum: Rkoèñnïû neè Nyúè li yu ená seèe gee buu ce e ce laèa. Buu ce e ce laèa vi gha' seèe aè rgeèe ka',
English: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

Limbum: njobeè' ñwáè wááwá ce e yu muu Nyúè e ke so ñgoèñ. Yuu ce yi so ñgoèñ yu liseèe rbyemïì.
English: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce aède' e so ñgoèñ yu nda? Ku ba ñwáè ce e byemi ená Jisoès yu Muu Nyúè.
English: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

Limbum: Jisos Kraâis aè m vúè njep ñgoèñ, a caa njep mdip ba bláá. E m caèa ba njep mdip caè'caè' ka', e m caèa ba njep mdip ba bláá. Yú' yi m suñ aèmboè ye foñ njobeè' Yú' yu mini.
English: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

Limbum: Baná buu ce vi ce suñ aèmboè ye vi yu vi btaar.
English: For there are three who testify:

Limbum: Buu vi btaar anaè yu Yú' ba mdip, ker ba bláá. Buu ca vi ce laèa yuu yi mo'sir.
English: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

Limbum: Seèe aè ka' byemi yuu ce beèe a laèa, baná yïì ce aè laèa Nyúè yi caèa yïì anaè, njobeè' cena a yïì ce aè laèa Nyúè kuu muu yïì.
English: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God's testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e byemi neè Muu Nyúè, ñgaèñ rïìñ wa'a njep yeâ ntee. Ñwáè ce e byemi ka' ce loèr Nyúè aè ñwáè mnde', njobeè' ce e byemi yuu ce Nyúè aè laèa kuu Muu yïì ka'.
English: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn't believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

Limbum: Yuu ce Nyúè aè laèa yi yu ená e fa seèe ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Ryoèñ ca li ce loè ese muu yïì.
English: The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e túr Muu Nyúè aè koni ryoèñ, ñwáè ce e túr Muu Nyúè ka', aè koni ryoèñ ka'.
English: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn't have God's Son doesn't have the life.

Limbum: Máè sañ buu ca neè weèe ce weèe aè byemi neè Muu Nyúè tá weèe bo yi ená weèe aè koni ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

Limbum: Yuu ce yi geèe weèr aè túr rtarnïì aè rbipshi yuu neè ye ka' yi yu ená weèr ka' loo ka' ká ce e koèñ ese ye, e be yu' weèr.
English: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

Limbum: Seèe ka' yi ená ka' njáèá ká ce seèe ce loo, e ce yu' seèe, baná seèe riñ ená seèe aè koni yuu ce seèe aè loo ese ye wáá.
English: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ka' yá nfúr yïì e ce geèe yuu bebep ce aède' e gee e kwe ka', ñgaèñ loo tá Nyúè fa ye ryoèñ. M ce laèa ba aèmboè beèe ce a geèe buu bbebep ce aède' vi gee woweèe a kweñgeèr ka'. Yuu bebep ce e geèe ñwáè kwe yu aègho, geewa'a m ce laèa máná e loo aè yuu bebep anaè ka'.
English: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is a sin leading to death. I don't say that he should make a request concerning this.

Limbum: Buu wááwá ce beèe a geèe ce vi yu yáánïì ka', yu buu bbebep. Geewa'a, yuu bebep mo' yi yu aègho ce aède' yi gee ñwáè kwe ka'.
English: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is a sin not leading to death.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená aède' ñwáè ce e yu muu Nyúè ku ce geèe yuu bebep ka', njobeè' Muu Nyúè ce keè'ni ye. AÈtaè Sataèn joo ñgaèñ ka'.
English: We know that whoever is born of God doesn't sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn't touch him.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ ená seèe yu boo Nyúè, a riñ ená ñgoèñ wááwá yi yu mbaè mmbo Sataèn.
English: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

Limbum: Seèe rïìñ foñ ená Muu Nyúè aè vúè, a fa seèe bfee tá seèe bo rïìñ Nyúè ce mini. Seèe yu njep Nyúè ce mini anaè aèmboè seèe yu njep Muu yïû Jisos Kraêis. Yu ye ce e yu Nyúè ce mini, a ker ba ryoèñ ce nfeseè.
English: We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

Limbum: Boo waê, loèr neè nfeè' weèe mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ weèe.
English: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca aè sañ máâ nleeñwáè neè njeñwáè ce a ce, ker ba boo vi ce m koèñ neè mini-ñwáè. Ku ba ba máè caè'caè' ce m koèñ weèe ka'. Beèe wááwá ce a rïìñ yuu mini a koèñ weèe foñ,
English: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all those who know the truth;

Limbum: njobeè' yuu mini yi yu njep seèe, yi be kuè ba njo nfeseè.
English: for the truth's sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

Limbum: AÈmboè seèe táá njep mini ba rkoèñnïì Nyúè, m ce loo máná Nyúè Taèr, ba Jisos Kraâis ce e yu Muu Taèr ghoni seèe, koosimnse neè seèe, ker fa seèe cumúnyañ.
English: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

Limbum: M ce lu'shi magoèr aè ryá máná boo wee mo' a ce táá njep yuu mini aèmboè Taèr aè m laèa neè seèe.
English: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

Limbum: Maamaê, m ce loo weèe seè'ni ená seèe koñni. M ce sañ wa'a a ce laèa ba yuu fi neè wáè ka', yu ba yi ce seèe a m yu' efa rkáè'.
English: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

Limbum: Rkoèñnïì li yu ená seèe ce gee buu ce Nyúè ce laèa. AÈmboè weèe aè m yu' efa rkáè', yuu ce e laèa yi yu ená weèe cu neè rkoèñnïì-ñwáè.
English: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

Limbum: Ku' ñgaâa mbo' beèe a yu njep ñgoèñ, a ce kani ená Jisoès aè m beèeñger aè ñwáè, a vú njep ñgoèñ ka'. Njáèá ñwáè anaè yu ñwáè mbo' beèe, a ba ñwáè baèa Kraêis.
English: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don't confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

Limbum: Loèr neè nfeè' faè dïì' weèe bá yuu ce weèe ce faè' aètu mo ka' tá weèe bo koni wee blaè' wááwá.
English: Watch yourselves, that we don't lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

Limbum: Ñwáè ka' ma'shi yuu ce Kraâis aè m yá'ni, ce geèe jáá, baná ñgaèñ yu aèbee a Nyúè ka'. Ñwáè ka' ku cu ba njep yuu ce Kraâis aè m yá'ni, baná ñgaèñ yu aèbee a Taèr a ker ba aèbee a Muu.
English: Whoever transgresses and doesn't remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn't have God. He who remains in the teaching, the same has both the Father and the Son.

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' ka' vú aè ryá weèe, ke' ce yá'ni ba njáèá ryá'nïì ca ka', weèe fa byemi tá e niñ mbe weâe ndaèp ka', fa fa neè ye bo foñ ka'.
English: If anyone comes to you, and doesn't bring this teaching, don't receive him into your house, and don't welcome him,

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' fa ye bo, baná a ñgaèñ a geèe bsaèrbuu anaè bsïìp.
English: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil works.

Limbum: M túr buu goèr ce m ba sañ neè weèe. M be keèr sañ sañ ka', m ce kwaè'shi máná m be vúè yá weèe, laèa neè ya cuèu tá seèe bo lu'shi duè mïìsi.
English: Having many things to write to you, I don't want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

Limbum: Boo nfúroè ce a ce naè, a caè'ni wáè.
English: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca aè sañ máâ nleeñwáè neè ñkaraâ Gayoès ce máè koèñ neè mini-ñwáè.
English: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

Limbum: Ñkaraè, m ce loo máná aè cu yáánïì, tá yoè buu wááwá ba yáánïì aèmboè yo ntee yi yu yáánïì foñ naè.
English: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

Limbum: Máè m lu'shi seê, aè nfeè' ce bfúr mo' a m vúè a ce suñ máè aèmboè aè ce cu rcu ce li yu neè mini-ñwáè. Yi ku ba mini wa'a.
English: For I rejoiced greatly, when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

Limbum: AÈde' yuu mo' yi gee m ker lu'shi caa aèmboè m ce lu'shi aè ryu' ená boo wa a ku cu njep mini na ka'.
English: I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children walking in truth.

Limbum: Ñkaraè, buu ce aè ce geèe neè bfúr na, aè ce geèe neè mini-ñwáè, lañlañ neè bkeèe.
English: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

Limbum: Woweèe a suñ ñgaâa cor aèmboè lo rkoèñnïì. Be ba yuu boèñboñ ce wáè ka' daasi woweèe aè njáèá njïì ce e yu yáánïì aè bsii Nyúè.
English: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

Limbum: Yu njo' rlii Kraâis ce ená woweèe a m fúú aè mbeè a ke' ce koo yuu mo' ese beèe ce a máñni Nyúè ka'.
English: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

Limbum: Baná seèe aè ba ce jaè' njáèá beèe ca tá seèe woweèe bo faè' aèbee aè rsuñ nsuñ ce mini.
English: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

Limbum: Máè m sañ yuu mo' neè coêr, geewa'a Daèyotráfáès ce e koèñ aè rba tu embe cor aè byemïì ka'.
English: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn't accept what we say.

Limbum: Baná m ka' vúê, m fúú neè ye aèwañ, suñ ku' buu bbebep ce e laèa a kuu weèr. E ce sa' weèr neè bsaèrbuu-ñwáè. E geèe ca wa'a, yi gháá ye ka', e kani aè rkoni bfúr, a kani beèe ce a ce koèñ aè rgeèe wa'a foñ, a fúr woweèe embe coêr.
English: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, neither does he himself receive the brothers, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

Limbum: Ñkaraè, fa beè'ni yuu bebep ka', beè'ni ba yuu boèñboñ. Ñwáè ce e ka' ce geèe yuu boèñboñ baná ñgaèñ yu ñwáè Nyúè. Ñwáè ce e ka' ce gee yuu bebep, baná ñgaèñ aè m yá Nyúè ka'.
English: Beloved, don't imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn't seen God.

Limbum: Ñwáè wááwá ce laèa boèñboñ kuu Dáèmitroès. Ka' yïì ndeâe mini foñ ce duèñshi wa'a. Wer weèr foñ ce laèa boèñboñ kuu ye. Wáè rïìñ wáná yuu ce weèr ce laèa yi yu mini.
English: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

Limbum: M túr buu magoèr ce m ba baè sañ neè wáè, m be keèr sañ sañ ka'.
English: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

Limbum: M ce kwaè'shi aè rvúè yá wáè, laèa neè ya cuèu. Cumúnyañ ba neè wáè. Bkar a ce caè'ni wáè. Caè'ni bkar aè mlii.
English: but I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca ce sañ máâ Jud ce m yu ñwáè rfaè' neè Jisos Kraêis, a ba nfúr Jáêms. M ce sañ ñwaè' ca neè beèe ce Nyúè Taèr aè ce, a koêñ, Jisoès aè ce keè'ni beèe anaè.
English: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

Limbum: M ce loo máná Nyúè koosimnse neè weèe, fa weèe cumúnyañ seê, ker koñ weèe seê.
English: Mercy to you and peace and love be multiplied.

Limbum: Bkar waê, máè m ce koèñ magoèr se aè rsañ neè weèe kuu liseèe rluèñ. Geewa'a, máè yá máná yi boèñ ená m sañ ñwaè' neè weèe seè'ni tá m bo fa weèe ñger tá weèe táá tatap njep rbyemïì ce Nyúè aè m fa neè yïì beèe. AÈde' nsuñ du kuu rbyemïì ca kee kupse ka'.
English: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

Limbum: Máè laèa wa'a njobeè' beèe mo' ce a ce yu'ni neè Nyúè ka', a súèni a niñ a weâe mú, a ce gheèter aè rkupse nsuñ ce e yu aèmboè ntee boèñboñ ce Nyúè túr neè beèe naè, tá weèe bo byemi ená aè rgeèe bsaèrbuu yi yu yáánïì. Woweèe a geèe wa'a, a ce kani Jisos Kraâis ce ku ba ba ye caè'caè' ce e yu yïìseèe masaè, a ker ba Tata neè seèe. A m sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè eluâuñgoèñ ená Nyúè be fa ñgá' neè njáèá beèe ca.
English: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

Limbum: M ce koèñ aè rkuushi weèe buu moè' ce weèe aè m rïìñ wáá. Nyúè aè m jaè' beèe Isráèl a fúr woweâe aè to' Ijïìp. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, e m ku lo a yúshi beèe efa waâp mú ce a m byemi neè ye ka'.
English: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn't believe.

Limbum: Kuushi neè foñ ená bcïìndap Nyúè ce a m kani efa rcu mbe dïì' ce Nyúè aè m fa woweèe, a ma'shi yap dïì' anaè naè, Nyúè aè ma' woweèe njep dïì' ce ku ba ba túè'nji tá woweèe a ku noèñ njo neè bshañ kuè mkoo caar duè baè' aè noâñ goèr ce Nyúè be sa' ñgoèñ naè.
English: Angels who didn't keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

Limbum: To' Sodoèm ba to' Goèmoraè foñ, ker ba mla' ce mi m ba aègee bto' ca a m ce geèe bsaèrbuu, a ce geèe mnyáâr seê. Woweèe a ce yá ñgá' njep mor ce aède' yi liitïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Cena yi ce duèñshi seèe yuu ce yi be koni neè beèe ce a ce geèe njáèá ñgeèe anaè foñ.
English: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around them, having, in the same way as these, given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè Nyúè ka', a ba a weâe mú naè, a ce geèe njáèá bsaèrbuu ca foñ. Woweèe a ce yá mlo, mlo anaè mi ce geèe woweèe a ce bepsi wap mnyor, a kani efa ryu'nïì, a ce laèa bebep kuu byú' ce a ba ce yu'ni neè vi se naè.
English: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

Limbum: Ka' Maikáèl ce e yu tu neè bcïìndap naè, e m laèa bebep neè Sataèn aè nfeè' ce a ye a m ce sár mnsár aèmboè gúâú Musïìs naè ka'. E m laèa ba enáê, “Tá Nyúè lapni wáè.”
English: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, May the Lord rebuke you!

Limbum: AÈ ka ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè Nyúè ka' na, woweèe a laèa bebep kuu yuu wááwá ce woweèe a rïìñ ka' naè. Woweèe a yu aèmboè mnyaèa efa rïìñ ce vi ke geèe buu neè bfee-ñwáè ka' naè. Buu ce woweèe a ce geèe na, a buu ce vi ce bepsi woweèe, woweèe a ce bú aè cicïì.
English: But these speak evil of whatever things they don't know. What they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, they are destroyed in these things.

Limbum: Ndoèo be co' woweèe. Woweèe a ce jáèr ba njep mkuèu Káên. Woweèe a ce geèe buu bbebep tá a bo koni mbaèa aèmboè Balaèm aè m geèe naè. Woweèe a ce kweñger njobeè' woweèe a teèe btu aèmboè Koraè aè m teèe tu a lo a kwe naè.
English: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah's rebellion.

Limbum: Weèe beèe ca weèe e ke ye byee aèbee aèmboè beèe Nyúè, yap ñgeèe yi ce coosi weèe. E ke ba aè nfeè' anaè, woweèe a ku ce tá' ba wap btu, rïìtu yi ce koo woweèe ka'. Woweèe a yu aèmboè mmbaè' ce vi ke ko', fu' yi caèa lor du aègho, mbeèñ ke' gwe ka' naè. Woweèe a yu aèmboè bce ce nfeè' e ke gháá ce vi ba yú, vi yú ka', a co'nïì, vi kwe dúèdúè naè.
English: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn leaves without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

Limbum: Woweèe a yu aèmboè ma rdip rgoèr ce li ke bañti, mdip mi ce ko' mbekïì ce gweè naè. Yaèp buu bbebep yu aèmboè mghaa ce rdip li fúr mbe waa ñkúè wa'a. Woweèe a yu aèmboè mkaèñsïì ce mi ke táá mbe dïû' mo'sir ka' naè. Nyúè aè kupshi dïì' mo' neè woweèe; faè dïì' anaè ku ba ba túè'nji, aè ba dïì' ce woweèe a be cu nfeseè.
English: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

Limbum: Ánoèk ce yïì ñgúè beèe aè m ba mbenjïì mñgúè beâe ntuunfu ká' embe ñgúè yïì Adaèm, aè m laèa yuu a kuu njáèá beèe ca. E m laèa enáê, “Tata be vúè a vi bcïìndap aè mncúèkïì aè mncúèkïì,
English: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

Limbum: tá e bo teni mnsa' beèe wááwá. Beèe wááwá ce a ce yu'ni neè Nyúè ka', a ce geèe buu bbebep, a ce laèa buu aè njïû mbembep a kuu Nyúè, a be gweè mnsa' Nyúè.”
English: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

Limbum: Beèe ca a ce rúè'ñger aè nfeè' wááwá. Yuu mo' yi ghááte woweèe ka'. Woweèe a geèe yuu ce yaèp nyor koèñ. Woweèe a ce laèa nlaèa naèa-nyor, a ce bu' cuèu tá a bo bo' beèe, koni yuu mo' enjo.
English: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts and their mouth speaks proud things, showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

Limbum: Bkar waê, aè ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, kuushi neè buu ce ñgaâa ntuu Tata Jisos Kraâis a m suñ weèe ená vi be loè koni naè.
English: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa neè weèe ená be ba aè mnoèñ elúèsimbuèu tá beèe a ba ce a be vúèshi weèe. Beèe anaè a be yu'ni neè Nyúè ka', ce geèe ba yuu ce a koèñ aè rgeèe.
English: They said to you that In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.

Limbum: Beèe ca a beèe ce a vúè neè ñgaèpni aè múè beèe, a túr ba mntee beèe enjep ñgoèñ. Yú' Rara yi yu njep waâp mntee ka'.
English: These are they who cause divisions, and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

Limbum: Bkar waê, aè ka' ba yi aèmboè weèe, weèe gheter ja' weêe mnyor tá weèe bo táá aè buu Nyúè ce weèe aè byemi, ce vi boèñ aè misïî. Ce loo neè aè ñger Yú' Rara aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

Limbum: Táá neè ba njep rkoèñnïì Nyúè aèmboè weèe ce keè' nfeè' ce Tata be koosimnse neè weèe, loèr weèe tá weèe woweèe cu nfeseè.
English: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

Limbum: Koosi neè mnse neè beèe ce a ce tarni, nashi woweèe.
English: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

Limbum: Beèe mo' a yu ce weèe aè ba fúr enjep mor, tá woweèe a luêñ. Beèe mo' a yu ce weèe aè ba koosi mnse neè woweèe, keèr ce wáp; káè yu wap bcáè' ce vi ce sii njobeè' yap ñgeâe bebep ce a ce geèe anaè áè, weèe fa joèo neè bo ka'.
English: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

Limbum: Seèe ku'si Nyúè ce e túr ñger aè rkeè'ni seèe faè dïì' seèe gwe ka'. E be loèr weèe tá weèe táá kuèntombïì neè ye mbe nfeè' ce e duèñshi yi ñger a ce sa' beèe naè, tá weèe táá wa'a, túr faèa ka', ce lu'shi.
English: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

Limbum: Seèe ku'si Nyúè ce e ku ba moè'sir caè'caè', moè' aè ker ba ka'. Yu ye ce e geèe seèe aè luñ njïì enjep Tata Jisos Kraêis. Tá beèe a yu'ni neè ye, ker ku'si ye. Tá e ba ñkúú ce e be sa' seèe, ká' efa rkáè' vú ba' seè'ni na, ker ba aè nfeè' wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.
English: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

Limbum: Cena yu buu ce Jisos Kraâis aè m geèe beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Nyúè a rïîñ. Nyúè aè m geèe Jisos Kraâis a riñ buu ca tá e bo geèe tá beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Nyúè a riñ buu ce vi be koni nfeè' múcaèr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisos Kraâis aè tuu yïì ncïìndap ená e du yá Joân ce e yu yïì ñwáè rfaè', gee tá e yá buu ca.
English: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

Limbum: Joân aè ka' yá, a suñ beèe. E m sañ ba blaèa ce vi m loè ese Nyúè, Jisoès aè suñ ye.
English: who testified to God's word, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' be' blaèa ca baná e yu ñwáè Mboâñtu. Beèe ce a ka' yu' blaèa ca, gee aèmboè vi laèa baná woweèe a yu ñgaâa Mboâñtu njobeè' nfeè' ce buu ca vi be koni ku báti múcaèr.
English: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.

Limbum: Ñwaè' ca aè sañ máâ Joân neè bcor saèambaê, ce vi yu aè ñgoâñ Ásïìyaè. M ce loo máná Nyúè túr ntee boèñboñ neè weèe ker fa weèe cumúnyañ. Ku ba ye ce e yu seè'ni na, aè ker ba Nyúè ce e m ba, aè ku ker ba ye ce e be keè vúè. Buu ca aè loè foñ ese Byú' saèambaê, ce vi táá kuèntombïì neè yi kaèbaèraè'.
English: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

Limbum: Vi loè foñ ese Jisos Kraâis ce e ke suñ buu ce vi yu mini, a ba ñwáè ce e m fúú efa rkwe entombïì, a ker ba ñwáè ce e ce sa' bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá. M ce yoèñshi ye ce e m koèñ seèe, a kwe a seâe btuè a fúr seèe efa buu bbebep neè vi bláá.
English: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood;

Limbum: E geèe seèe aè ba beèe ce e ce sa' seèe aèmboè ñkúú, a ker gee seèe aè ba ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì neè Nyúè ce e yu yïì Taê. Tá foèo yi ba neè Jisoès, tá ñger yi ba neè ye foñ aè nfeè' sïìp. Yi yu wa'a.
English: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

Limbum: Yáê, e ce vúè mbe múè mmbaè'. Beèe wááwá a be yá ye. Beèe ce a m soèp ye neè rkoèñ a be yá ye foñ. Beâe aè bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na a be war ená a m ba riñ a m ba byemi neè ye. ÁÈno, yi yu wa'a.
English: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

Limbum: Ñger wááwá yi yu mbaè mmbo Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Taê. E yu seè'ni na. E m ba, aè ku ba ye ce e be keè vúè. E m laèa enáê, “A máè Alfaè a ker ba OÈmágaè.”
English: I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.

Limbum: A máè Joân ce m yu nfúr weèe, seèe aè ba aèbee aètu Jisos Kraêis. Seèe yu aèbee aè ñgá' ce seèe ce yá. Jisos Kraâis yu yïìseèe ñkúú. Seèe ce yá ñgá' ca wa'a, a ke' ce sáè ka'. AÈ m ba aè nfeè' moè', a koo máè a du aègho aè dïì' mo' ce a m ce too ená Patmoès ce rdip rgoèr li m sïìr a kaari a tarte. A m koo máè a du aègho aèfo njobeè' blaâa Nyúè ce máè m ce feè'shi kuu Jisos Kraêis.
English: I John, your brother and partner with you in oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God's Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba nyúè mmbomntaa Nyúè, máè ba mbaè mmbo Yú' Nyúè, a yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ aè laèa embe máâ njïì aèmboè rsoèñ wa'a, enáê,
English: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

Limbum: “Loèr ñwaè', sañ buu ce wáè yá mbo, tuusi neè bcor ce aè rla' Áfásoès, ba Sïìmainaè, ba Págamoèm, ba Taèitiraè, ba Sadïìs, ba Fïìlaèdálfïìyaè ker ba aè rla' Laèodisïìyaè.”
English: saying, What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.

Limbum: Máè ka' yu' njeèndoñ ca a karsi nyor tá m bo yá ñwáè ce e ce laèa. Máè ka' karsi nyor a yá mú njáèá btábuèr ce a ke tooshi blam mbo vi saèambaê. A m geèe mú btábuèr ca neè bco' ce a too ená guêl.
English: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.

Limbum: Máè ka' fyá' a yá ñwáè moè' aè táá mbetar btábuèr ca a ba aèmboè muu ñwáè wa'a. E m maè' saèaro aè nyoèr, a cúú kúè cáè' ce a geèe neè guêl, nje ñguèñ.
English: And among the lampstands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

Limbum: Yi nyúè'tu yi m ce fúp aèmboè mmbaè', mi mmir mi ba aèmboè mcuèñ mor wa'a.
English: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

Limbum: Mi mkuèu mi m ce laè'ñger aèmboè bco' ce ñgaâa ntoèo nlaèa a kupshi wa'a. Yïì njeèndoñ aè m ba aèmboè njeèndoñ rdip ce li ke gweè aè rkoñ wa'a.
English: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

Limbum: E m túr mkaèñsïì saèamba mbaè bo maè', saè' mbyáèráñ aè fúú eku yeâ cuèu. Vi bsii vi m ce raa aèmboè nyúè ce e ke sañ neèmootïì naè.
English: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

Limbum: Máè ka' yá ye, a gwe a noñ njep yeâ tïìi aèmboè ñwáè ce e kwe wa'a. E lá yi bo maè' mbe máâ nduè a laa enáê, “Fa wáp ka', m yu ñwáè entoèmbïì a ba ñwáè elúèsimbuèu.
English: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, Don't be afraid. I am the first and the last,

Limbum: M yu ñwáâ nteèe. Máè m kwe a kúti nteèe, cu nfeseè. Rkwe ker ba ñgoèñ byir a yu mba máâ mmboè.
English: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

Limbum: Sañ buu ce wáè yá na mbe ñwaè'. Sañ buu ce vi be koni seè'ni ker ba buu ce vi bii ka' koni.
English: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter;

Limbum: Wáè yá mkaèñsïì ce m túr mbaè bo maè' a ker yá mú btábuèr saèamba ce a ke tooshi blam mbo naè. M be suñ wáè mbuèu efa buu ca. Mkaèñsïì saèamba ca mi táá aètu bcïìndap saèamba ce a ce keè'ni bcor saèambaê, mú btábuèr saèamba ca aè ba bcor saèambaê.”
English: the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lampstands are seven assemblies.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce máè m yá naè aè laa neè máè enáê, “Sañ ñwaè' neè ncïìndap embe cor aè rla' Áfásoès enáê, ‘Cena yu ba blaèa ce vi loè ese ñwáè ce e túr mkaèñsïì saèamba mbaè bo maè' a ce jáèr mbe múè mú btábuèr blam ce a geèe neè guêl.
English: To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lampstands says these things:

Limbum: Máè rïìñ ye ñgeèe. Máè rïìñ aèmboè weèe aè kur ntee a fa' a ke' ce sáè ka'. Máè rïìñ máná weèe ce maè'shi beâe bbebep a weâe mú ka'. Weèe aè fyá' beèe ce a ce laèa ená woweèe a yu ñgaâa ntuu Jisoès naè, a yá ená woweèe a ce bo'shi bo'shi.
English: I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can't tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ ñgá' ce weèe ce yá. Máè rïìñ fuèp ce e koo weèe. Yi yu mini ghup ená weèe yu ñgaâa fuèp ka'. Nyúè aè ghoèni weèe magoèr seê. Máè rïìñ buu bbebep ce beèe ce a ce loèr wap btu ená a woweèe Jus naè a ce laèa aèmboè weèe. Woweèe a yu Jus ka', a yu ba beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Sataèn.
English: I know your works, oppression, and your poverty but you are rich, and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ dïì' ce weèe ce cu, aè dïì' ce Sataèn cu mbe kaèbaèraè'. Weèe aè kani máè efa rba yeè ñkúú ka'. A m yú Antipaès ce e m byemi neè máè njobeè' e m suñ beèe ená e ce duè a máâ mbuèu. Ka' a m yú ye ba faèdïì' weèe ce cu, aè ba dïì' ce Sataèn ye ye ce cu wa'a, weèe aè ku túr ntee njep máè.
English: I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan's throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn't deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

Limbum: Máè rïìñ ye ñgeèe. Máè rïìñ máná weèe koèñ máè, a riñ máná weèe ku táá njep le rbyemïì, a riñ rfaè' ce weèe ce geèe, a riñ máná weèe ce kur ntee seê. Máè rïìñ máná ñgeèe ce weèe ce geèe seè'ni na yi boèñ a caa yïì ce weèe aè m ce geèe entoèmbïì.
English: I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

Limbum: Weèe fa buumi ka'. Lá' neè, tapsi ryoèñ cor ce li báti naè, faè dïì' li ba'si kwe ka'. Máè yá máná ye ñgeèe yi ghááte aè bsii Nyúè ka'.
English: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

Limbum: Baná weèe kuushi buu ce a yá'ni weèe, weèe aè byemïì naè. Geèe neè buu anaè, ker kupse ye ntee, buwa'laèr m lo búú weèe búèú aèmboè nyáèá wa'a. Weèe be rïìñ nfeè' ce m be vúè ka'.
English: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won't watch, I will come as a thief, and you won't know what hour I will come upon you.

Limbum: Mú beèe mo' a ku bii aè rla' Sadïìs, ce a siisi wap bcáè' ka'. Beèe ca a be maè' bcáâ' bbúú tá weèr woweèe ce jáèr njobeè' a beèe ce a ghááte aè rgeèe wa'a.
English: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' táá tatap, caa rmoèoshïì baná m be fa ñgaèñ bcáâ' bbúú aè nyor, keè' siñsi li rlii embe ñwaè' ryoèñ ka'. M be táá kuèntombïì neè yaè Ta ba vi bcïìndap, laèa aèwañ máná ñwáè anaè yu yaè.
English: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' túr btuè' ñgaèñ yu' yuu ce Yú' Nyúè yi ce laèa neè bcor wááwá.’ ”
English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce máè m yá naè aè laa neè máè enáê, “Sañ ñwaè' neè ncïìndap embe cor aè rla' Fïìlaèdálfïìyaè enáê, ‘Cena yu blaèa ce vi loè ese ñwáâ nrara, a ker ba ñwáè mini. E túr bki Dávïìd mba yeâ mmboè. E ka' mú' keèñ, ñwáè ceteè ka', e ka' cete, ñwáè mú' ka'.
English: To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

Limbum: Máè rïìñ ye ñgeèe. Máè rïìñ máná ka' weèe túr ñger goèr ka' wa'a, weèe aè yu' wa blaèa. Weèe aè m be máñni máè aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Yáê, máè múè' keèñ neè weèe, ñwáè moè' aè ba ce aède' e ker cete ka'.
English: I know your works behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut, that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn't deny my name.

Limbum: M rïìñ ye ñgeèe. Weèe ce fúte ka', a ke' ce luèu ka'. Máâ koèñ máná weèe aè ka' tá ce luèu ka', weèe ce fúte.
English: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

Limbum: Yïì anaè yi ka' mïì, máè ka' naèa mmir fyá' mbekïì, a yá aèmboè ncúèúndúè' embe buèu yi múè'ti. Máè ker yu' njeèndoñ ce e m laèa neè máè a ba aèmboè rsoèñ li ke laèa naè. Ñwáè anaè aè laa neè máè enáê, “Vúè mbena tá m duñshi wáè buu ce vi bii ka' koni.”
English: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba aè nfeè' anaè máè ba ba mbaè mmbo Yú' Nyúè. A ka' keè', a yá kaèbaèraè', ñwáè aè cu mbo.
English: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

Limbum: Bsii ñwáè anaè vi m ce laè'ñger aèmboè kwakwa' wa'a, a ce baèñ aèmboè nloèp wa'a. Ghuèghumbeèñ yi m kaari kaèbaèraè' anaè a tarte, ncoèo efa gho aè ba aèmboè ncoèo kaèkar wa'a.
English: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

Limbum: Bkaèbaèraè' mo' ce vi m ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mmbaa vi m kaari kaèbaèraè' ca a tarte. Beâe bgoèrgoèr ce a m ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mmbaa a m cute mbe bkaèbaèraè' anaè a yar bcáâ' bbúú. Woweèe a m soèp mtaa kúú ce a m geèe neè guêl.
English: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

Limbum: Máè yá aèmboè mbeèñ ce baèpñger a ce rúèúñger, a ce wañger embe kaèbaèraè'. Máè yá bturkañ saèamba aèmboè vi tááte kuèntombïì neè kaèbaèraè' a ce raa. Bturkañ anaè vi táá aètu byú' Nyúè ce vi yu saèambaê.
English: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

Limbum: Máè ka' keè' a yá ma rdip mo' li ce raa, ce tose aèmboè glaâs wa'a. Li m ba kuèntombïì neè kaèbaèraè'. Buu bteèe vi m táá bdïì' kyeèe a kaari kaèbaèraè' anaè a tarte. Buu bteèe anaè vi m túr mmir aèñgoo seê. Mmir mo' mi m ba kuèntombïì, mmo' mi ba mbenjïì.
English: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the midst of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

Limbum: Efa múè buu bteèe ca, yïì entombïì yi m feese búrúè'. Yïì embenjïì yi feeseè nduu naè'. Yïì embenjïì yïì ce e m feese nduu naè' naè aè túr bsii vi feeseè bsii ñwáè. Yïì elúèsimbuèu aè ba aèmboè waèawa mñkuèr ce e ce fáñ wa'a.
English: The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

Limbum: Buu bteèe ce vi m ba kyeèe anaè vi m túr bbaèp ntuunfu ntuunfu, mmir mi ba aègho aèñgoo seê. Mmo' mi m ba mbenduè bbaèp, mmo' mi ba nje múè bbaèp. Vi m ce yoèp yáá a ce buumi aè nfeè' moè' ka', káè neètú' áè, káè neèmootïì áè. Vi m ce yoèp enáê, “Nyúè yu nrara, Nyúè yu nrara, Nyúè yu nrara, ñger wááwá yi yu mbaè mmbo Tata Nyúè. E m ba, a ba aègho seè'ni na, aè ku ba ye ce e be vúè.”
English: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!

Limbum: Buu bteèe anaè vi yop yáá a ce kuè'si a ker ce yoèñshi ñwáè ce e m cu mbe kaèbaèraè', aè ba ñwáè ce e ku ba nteèe aè nfeè' wááwá naè.
English: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

Limbum: A ka' ce yoèp wa'a, beâe bgoèrgoèr ce ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mmbaa caè a ce gú'shi njeptii ñwáè ce e cu mbe kaèbaèraè' a ba nteèe aè nfeè' wááwá naè a ce kuè'si ye. Woweèe a co'nïì map mtaa kúú embe tuè, a lá njeptii ñwáè anaè, a yop yáá enáê,
English: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

Limbum: “Wáâ yeèr Tata Nyúè, wáè ghááte aè ñwáè ce beèe a ba kuè'si wáè, náèsi wáè, a ker ghááte aè rtúr ñger wááwá, njobeè' a wáè ce wáè m geèe buu wááwá, a kwa'shi ená buu anaè ba aègho.”
English: Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!

Limbum: Máè yá fuè ñwaè' mbaè bo maè' ñwáè ce e m cu mbe kaèbaèraè' naè. A m sañ ñwaè' mbo mbeèp bsïìp, a kar aèmboè a ke kar rwaèa naè, a siñ bcuèu efa gho neè nlaèadoñ bdïì' saèambaê.
English: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

Limbum: Máè yá ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m túr ñger magoèr seê. E m waa, a laa enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ghááte aè rnaèa nlaèadoñ ce a sïìñ bcuèu fuè ñwaè' aègho naè, búèr ñwaè' anaè yu nda?”
English: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?

Limbum: Ñwáè moè' aè ke' ba mbe buèu, káè njep ñgoèñ na, káè mbaè yir ce e m ghááte aè rbúèr ñwaè' anaè, fyá' mbo ka'.
English: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look in it.

Limbum: Máè war seê, njobeè' ñwáè moè' aè m ghááte aè rbúèr ñwaè' ca fyá' mbo ka'.
English: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look in it.

Limbum: Awá ñwáâ ñgoèr moè' efa múè beâe bgoèrgoèr ca aè laa neè máè enáê, “Fa war ka'. Yáê, ñwáè ce a too ená búrúè' ce yu yïû aè ñgoâñ Judaè, a ba muu rlii embe ndúè' Dávïìd naè, aè so. E be naèa nlaèadoñ ce a sïìñ bcuèu ñwaè' aègho bdïì' saèamba naè, búèr ñwaè' anaè.”
English: One of the elders said to me, Don't weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome; he who opens the book and its seven seals.

Limbum: Máè yá muu njeèe aègee kaèbaèraè' ca. Buu bteèe caè ba beâe bgoèrgoèr caè a sir njeèe anaè a kaari a tarte. Njeèe anaè aè m ce yááti aèmboè yïì ce a sáá wa'a. E m túr mndoñ saèambaê, a túr mmir saèambaê. Mndoñ ba mmir ca mi táá aètu byú' Nyúè ce vi yu saèambaê, a tuusïì vi aè bdïì' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na naè.
English: I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

Limbum: Njeèe anaè aè du a koo ñwaè' ca embaè bo maè' ñwáè ce e m cu mbe kaèbaèraè' naè.
English: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

Limbum: E ka' koo, buu bteèe caè ba beâe bgoèrgoèr caè a gwe njeptii njeèe anaè. Woweèe a m túr rluñ rmo'sir rmo'sir, a ker túr ghee ce a geèe neè gul yi mo'sir mo'sir, mgúr mo' ce mi m ce rúèú boèñboñ seê, mi ba njo, a táá aètu rloo beèe Nyúè.
