English: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

Limbum: Woweèe a yop yáá fi enáê, “Wáè ghááte aè rloèr fuè ñwaè', naèa nlaèadoñ ce a sïìñ bcuèu efa gho aègho naè, njobeè' a m sáá wáè, wáè lor wo bláá a yuu beèe aègho neè Nyúè. Wáè yuu woweèe aè mntáè' wááwá, ce vi yu aè bto' wááwá a ce laèa bli jáá jáèá jáá.
English: They sang a new song, saying, You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

Limbum: Wáè geèe woweèe a ba beèe ce aè ce sa' woweèe aè yaèp ñkúú, a ker gee woweèe a ba ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì tá a bo faè' neè Nyúè. Woweèe a be sa' beèe enjep ñgoèñ na.”
English: and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on earth.

Limbum: Máè ker fyá' a yu' njeèndoñ bcïìndap Nyúè ce a m ba aè mncúèkïì aè mncúèkïì. Bcïìndap Nyúè ca a sir kaèbaèraè' ba buu bteèe caè, ba beâe bgoèrgoèr caè a fa mbetar,
English: I saw, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands;

Limbum: a yop se enáê, “Muu Njeèe ce a m sáá naè aè ghááte aè rkoni ñger ba ku' buu ba bfee. E ghááte aè ñwáè ce a ba kuè'si ye, yoèñshi ye.”
English: saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè buu wááwá embe buèu ce Nyúè aè m geèe ba vïì enjep ñgoèñ wááwá, ba vïì embaè yir wááwá ba vïì enjep roè wááwá vi ce yoèp enáê, “Seèe yoñshi Nyúè ce e cu mbe kaèbaèraè', ker ba muu njeèe. Seèe yu'ni neè woweèe, ku'si woweèe, riñ ená woweèe a túr ñger wááwá. Seèe gee wa'a nfeseè.”
English: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, To him who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!

Limbum: Buu bteèe ce kyeèe caè vi laa enáê, “Yi yu wa'a.” Vi ka' laèa wa'a, beâe bgoèrgoèr caè a gú'shïì neè woweèe.
English: The four living creatures said, Amen! The elders fell down and worshiped.

Limbum: Máè ka' keè' a yá aèmboè muu njeèe aè naèa nlaèadoñ yïì entoèmbïì efa múè vïû saèambaê. E ka' naèa, máè yu' aèmboè moè' efa buu bteèe ce vi m ba kyeèe naè aè laèa, njeèndoñ aè rúúñgeèr aèmboè mbeèñ wa'a, a laa enáê, “Vúè!”
English: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, Come and see!

Limbum: Máè fyá' a yá nyaèabaèraâ' mbúú. Ñwáè ce e m cu mbe nduè mo aè túr ñgúú mbaè boè. A m fa ye rtaa ce a ke fa neè beèe ce a maè' bïìr a so naè. E cañ mbe nyaèabaèraè' anaè a ce maè' bïìr tá e bo keèr so.
English: And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.

Limbum: Muu jeèe ca aè ka' keèr naèa nlaèadoñ yïì embenjïì, máè yu' aèmboè yuu teèe mo' yi laèa enáê, “Vúè!”
English: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come!

Limbum: Máè yá aèmboè nyaèabaèraâ' mbeer aè vúè. A m fa ñwáè ce e m cu mbe nyaèabaèraè' anaè ñger ená e gee tá cumúnyañ mi enjep ñgoèñ na tá beèe a bo ce yúshi wap mnyor. A m fa ye ma kaèafaè'.
English: Another came forth, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

Limbum: Muu Njeèe ca aè ka' keèr naèa nlaèadoñ mo', máè yu' aèmboè yuu teèe mo' yi laèa enáê, “Vúè!” Máè ker fyá' a yá nyaèabaèraâ' nsii. Ñwáè ce e m cu mbo aè m túr ndoñ ce a ke feè' buu njo mbaè bo.
English: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come and see! And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

Limbum: Máè yu' yuu mo' yi fúú e mbetar buu bteèe anaè aèmboè njeèndoñ wa'a, a laa enáê, “Beèe a be loèr mbaèa ce a faè' aè noèñ, yuu ndoñ saèa aègho moè'sir, buwa'laèr a yuu mndoñ msañ vi btaar. Fa bepsi mgúr ba mruè' ka'.”
English: I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don't damage the oil and the wine!

Limbum: Muu Njeèe ca aè ka' naèa nlaèadoñ moè', máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ yuu teèe mo' aè laèa enáê, “Vúè!”
English: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, Come and see!

Limbum: Máè ka' keè' a yá nyaèabaèraè', ncoèo efa gho aè ba jïìpri. A m ce too rlii ñwáè ce e m cu mbo ená Rkwe. Ñwáè ce a m ce too ená Mbaè Yir aè ce vúè mbe yeâ njïì. A m fa woweèe ñger mbenduè ñgúè' moè'sir efa bdïì' kyeèe efa beèe enjep ñgoèñ na, ená a yúshi woweèe neè kaèafaè', gee tá woweèe a kwe njeè, kwe byañ, vúè neè mnyaèa efa rïìñ a waâp mú.
English: And behold, a pale horse, and he who sat on it, his name was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

Limbum: Muu Njeèe ca aè ker naa nlaèadoñ mo', máè yá myoèñ beèe ce a m yúshi njo' blaâa Nyúè ce woweèe a m ce feè'shi. Myoèñ anaè mi m ba njeptii dïì' ce a ke tañshi tañshïì neè nyaèa, sáá mbo.
English: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

Limbum: Woweèe a waa, enáê, “Wáâ Tata Nyúè ce aè túr ñger, a ba ñwáâ mini, a ba nrara, weèr be cu mbena duè baè' aè nfeè' efá tá aè ka' sa' beèe enjep ñgoèñ, fa woweèe ñgá' njobeè' woweèe a m yúshi weèr?”
English: They cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?

Limbum: A lor bcáâ' bbúú a fa woweèe e mo'sir mo'sir, a laa neè woweèe ená woweèe a táá nfeè' múcaèr njobeè' beèe mo' efa beèe Nyúè ce a be mïìsi yúshi aèmboè a m yúshi woweèe naè a ku báti.
English: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

Limbum: Máè ker yá aèmboè Muu Njeèe aè naèa nlaèadoñ mo'. E ka' naèa, ñgoèñ yi ci'tïì seê, nyúè aè sii aèmboè cáâ' sii wa'a, ñwáá yi bañ aèmboè bláá wa'a.
English: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

Limbum: Mkaèñsïì mi gweñgeèr aè nsheè aèmboè piya ce fu' tatap yi ke caèa ceni embe ce mber naè wa'a.
English: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

Limbum: Rbuu li karñgeèr aèmboè ñwáè ce kar lá rwaèa wa'a, a bú, mtuèu wááwá ba njáèá ñgoèñ ce rdip li ke sïìr kaari tarte naè, yi ci'tïì a nati embe dïì' yi m ba.
English: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m cañse a du a súnïî. Bkúú ba beâe bgoèrgoèr, ba beèe ce a m ba btu neè bsoogáè, ba ñgaâa mbaèa, ba beèe ce a m túr ñger aè rgeèe buu, ba bkwaèa ba boo a m cañse a du a súni aè mmbúè', beèe mo' a súnïì njeptii myáá.
English: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

Limbum: Woweèe a war a ká' mtuèu ba myáá a laa enáê, “Gweè neè mbe weâr nduè, cete weèr, faè dïì' ñwáè ce e cu mbe kaèbaèraè' yá weèr, tá Muu Njeèe bepsi ntee, fa weèr ñgá' aètu yeèr buu bbebep ka'.
English: They told the mountains and the rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

Limbum: Nfeè' aè gháá ce woweèe a be duèñshi lap rshentee. Ñwáè ce e be túr ñger aè rjaè' yi tu a nda?”
English: for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yá bcïìndap Nyúè vi kyeèe aèmboè a tááte aè mmbuu ñgoèñ kyeèe. A m táá wa'a, a cete fu' ce yi ke vúâ aè mmbuu ñgoèñ anaè, faè dïì' yi bo keèr ce caèa ka'. Fu' yi m ker caa mbenduè nshe káè mbenduè mdip enjep roè ka', a ker ce cïì' bce foñ ka'.
English: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

Limbum: Máè yá ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aèmboè e nyáá ekuè mbuèuntii, a túr rkáèá Nyúè ce e yu nteèe. AÈ m ba rkáèá ce a ke fa ncoèo beèe Nyúè aègho. E m fuñ bcïìndap Nyúè ce a m ba beèe ñkyeèe, ce Nyúè aè m fa woweèe ñger ená a bepsi buâu aè nsheè ba buu enjep roè naè.
English: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

Limbum: E m laèa neè woweèe enáê, “Weèe fa bepsi nshe káè mdip, káè bce ka', caar tá weèr fa mncoèo aè mnsaèpsi beèe ce a ce faè' neè yeèr Nyúè.”
English: saying, Don't harm the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!

Limbum: Máè yu' máná beèe ce a m fa woweèe ncoèo nje nsaèpsi naè a m ba ncúèkïì- rjeèe-neè-ncúèkïì-ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mñkyeèe. Beèe ca a m ba beèe efa mntáè' beèe Isráèl wááwá.
English: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

Limbum: Beèe embe ntáè' moè'sir ce a m fa woweèe ncoèo anaè a m ba ncúèkïì-ncoèp- baa-aè-rrúèú. Mntáè' anaè vi m ba aè njáèá enáê: ntáè' Judaè, ntáè' Rubáèn, ntáè' Gaêd,
English: of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

Limbum: Máè ka' keèr fyá' a yá ku' beèe ce aède' ñwáè be' ka'. Beèe anaè aè m ba beèe efa bto' jáá jáèá jáá, ba mntáè' jáá jáèá jáá, ce a m ce laèa bli jáá jáèá jáá enjep ñgoèñ na wáá. Woweèe a m táá kuèntombïì neè kaèbaèraè' ba Muu Njeèe, a yar bcáâ' bbúú, a túr bbaèp mtáá aè mmboè.
English: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

Limbum: Woweèe wááwá a ce yoèp mbekïì a ce laèa enáê, “Rluèñ li loè ese Nyúè ce e cu mbe kaèbaèraè', ker ba ese Muu Njeèe.”
English: They cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!

Limbum: Bcïìndap Nyúè wowo a m sïìr kaèbaèraè', ba beâe bgoèrgoèr, ba buu bteèe ce vi m ba kyeèe naèè, a kaari a tarte. A ka' sïìr, a gú'shi neè Nyúè,
English: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

Limbum: a ce laèa enáê, “Yi yu wa'a. Nyúè a ñwáè ce beèe a ba yoèñshi, kuè'si. E yu ñwáè ce e túr bfee wááwá. Beèe a ba yoèñshi ye aè nfeè' wááwá, yu'ni neè ye, keèr rïìñ ená e túr ñger wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.”
English: saying, Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.

Limbum: Moè' efa beâe bgoèrgoèr ca aè bipshïì neè máè enáê, “Wáè rïìñ njáèá beèe ce a yar bcáâ' bbúú na a? Woweèe a vúè efá?”
English: One of the elders answered, saying to me, These who are arrayed in white robes, who are they, and from where did they come?

Limbum: Máè beesïì a laa neè ye mánáê, “Masaè, ñwáè ce e rïìñ yu ba wáè.” E laa neè máè enáê, “Beèe ca yu beèe ce a fúú efa ku' ñgá' ce e caèa ñger. Woweèe a suè'si wap bcáè' neè bláá Muu Njeèe, vi ce fúp.
English: I told him, My lord, you know. He said to me, These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb's blood.

Limbum: A mbuèu ce woweèe a túr ñger aè rtáá kuèntombïì neè kaèbaèraè' Nyúè, ce faè' neè ye mbe yeâ ndaèp neètú' ba neèmootïì. Ñwáè ce e cu mbe kaèbaèraè' be ba a woweèe, súèti woweèe faè dïì' yuu mo' yi bo joèo woweèe ka'.
English: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

Limbum: Njeè be keèr yañ woweèe ka'. Ntee mdip yi be keèr luèu woweèe ka'. Nyúè ce e ke sañ na be toèo woweèe ka'.
English: They will never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them, nor any heat;

Limbum: Muu Njeèe ce e yu aègee kaèbaèraè' be cïìñ woweèe aèmboè gaèy wa'a. E be loèr woweèe duè aègho faè rdip ce li ke fúú aè nfeè' wááwá ce fa ryoèñ ce nfeseè. Nyúè be siñsi mñgoommir ese woweèe wááwá.”
English: for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne shepherds them, and leads them to springs of waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, Muu Njeèe aè naa nlaèadoñ yïì elúèsimbuèu efa vïû saèamba caè. E ka' naèa, ñgoèñ embe buèu yi noñ ená nyoèñ-ñ-ñ, yuu yi ce kaèra' ka' aè mú nfeè' moè'.
English: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

Limbum: Máè yá bcïìndap Nyúè saèamba ce a ke táá kuèntombïì neè Nyúè. A m fa woweèe msoèñ saèambaê.
English: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moâ' jáá aè vú a táá mbe dïì' ce a ke fa rfa neè Nyúè, a túr rkïûñ ntoèo nráèá ce a m geèe neè guêl. A lor ku' nráèá a fa ye, ye ye aè lor nráèá anaè a fiñshi aè múè mloo ce beèe Nyúè a ce loo, a fa neè Nyúè mbe dïì' rfa ce a geèe neè guêl, yi ba kuèntombïì neè kaèbaèraè'.
English: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

Limbum: E too nráèá anaè, nje efa gho yi natïì a mloo aèbee embaè bo ncïìndap Nyúè, a ko' kuèntombïì neè Nyúè.
English: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel's hand.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè koo mor embe dïì' ce a ke fa rfa, a lá njep rkïìñ anaè a ma' njep ñgoèñ. E ka' maè', mbeèñ aè rúúñgeèr, a bapñger, a wañger, nshe aè ci'tïì.
English: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. There followed thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, bcïìndap Nyúè saèamba ce a m túr msoèñ saèamba naè a tamïì nyor aè rfyáp msoèñ anaè.
English: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè yïì entombïì a fyáp rsoèñ li. E ka' fyáp, a lor mghoèo ba mor ba bláá, a tarshi a ma' njep nsheè. Ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa nsheè aè sheê. Ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa bce aè she foñ, mjáá mi she wááwá.
English: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burnt up, and one third of the trees were burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè yïì embenjïì aè fyáp rsoèñ li. E ka' fyáp, a lor yuu mo' ce yi m ce she a feese ma rtuèu, a ma' njep rdip rgoèr.
English: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

Limbum: A ka' maè', ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa rdip anaè aè beeñgeèr aè bláá. Ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa buu bteèe enjep roè vi kweñgeèr wááwá. Ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa bkeñ enjep roè vi bep wááwá.
English: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè embenjïì mo aè fyáp rsoèñ li. E ka' fyáp, ma rkaèñsïì ce li m ce káti aèmboè rsuèsuèñ wa'a, li gwe embe buèu. Li m gweè mbenduè ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa mdip ker ba faèdïì' mdip mi ke fúú.
English: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.

Limbum: Rlii rkaèñsïì anaè li m ba enáê, “Ñgúè cece'.” Rkaèñsïì anaè li m geèe ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa mdip mi ce'. Beèe magoèr a m no mdip anaè a kweñger njobeè' mi m ce ce'.
English: The name of the star is called Wormwood. One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè embenjïì mo aè fyáp rsoèñ li. E ka' fyáp, yuu mo' yi kuu nyúè, ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa gho aè sii, a ke' ker sañ ka', a kuu ñwáá, ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa gho aè sii, a ke' ker sañ ka', a kuu mkaèñsïì, ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa gho aè sii, a ke' ker raa ka'. Ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar e neèmootïì ba ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar e neètú' a ke' ker raa ka'.
English: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of them would be darkened, and the day wouldn't shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

Limbum: Máè ka' fyá' a yá waèawa mñkuèr aèmboè e ce fáñ mbe buèu. E ka' ce fáñ wa'a, a waa enáê, “Ñgá', ñgá', ñgá'.” Bcïìndap Nyúè ce a báti a taar naè a be loè fyáp msoèñ map tá yi ba bebep neè beèe ce a ce cu njep ñgoèñ.
English: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè embenjïì mo aè fyáp rsoèñ li. E ka' fyáp, máè yá rkaèñsïì aèmboè li suèu embe buèu a gwe aè nsheè. A fa bki ce rkaèñsïì anaè li bo múè' cuèu rwee aègho. Rwee anaè li m coomi seê, lúèsimbuèu aè ba aègho ka'.
English: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

Limbum: Rkaèñsïì anaè li ka' múè' rwee anaè, njemor yi fúú enjo aèmboè nje efa mor foèo wa'a. Njemor anaè yi ka' fúú wa'a, a cete rbuu wááwá, rlir nyúè li ke' ker yááti ka'.
English: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

Limbum: Mñguu vi fúú embe múè njemor anaè a suu njep ñgoèñ. A m fa mñguu anaè ñger ená vi tashi beèe aèmboè nyobsaa enjep ñgoèñ na wa'a.
English: Then out of the smoke came forth locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

Limbum: A m laèa neè mñguu ca ená vi fa joèo yuu ce yi fúú enjep nsheè a ce kuè' ka'. A m maè'shi ená vi fa ñgá' ba neè beèe ce a m buu ncoèo Nyúè nje nsaèpsi.
English: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don't have God's seal on their foreheads.

Limbum: A m maè'shi ená mñguu vi yú beèe ca ka'. A m laèa ená vi fa beèe ca ba ñgá' aè mñwáá taê. Ñgá' anaè aè m ba aèmboè njáèá ryañ ce ñwáè ce nyobsaa aè ta e ke yu' naè.
English: They were given power not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.

Limbum: Be ba aè mñwáá ta anaè tá woweèe a roo rkwe, yá ka'. Woweèe a be koèñ aè rkwe tá rkwe li táá woweèe.
English: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

Limbum: Mñguu anaè vi m ba aèmboè mnyaèabaèraè' ce a ba'shi tá a bo duè bïìr aègho wa'a. Mtaa ce mñguu anaè vi m soèp mi feeseè mtaa kúú ce a geèe neè guêl. Wap bsii vi m feese bsii ñwáè.
English: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people's faces.

Limbum: Yap nyúè'tu yi m feese nyúè'tu njeñwáè; map msoèñ mi feeseè msoèñ búrúè'.
English: They had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

Limbum: A m cete yaèp ñguèñ neè bco' ce ñgaâa maè' bïìr a ke cete ñguèñ aègho, wap bbaèp vi ce coèo aèmboè njáèá mutuè mntaañguu ce ñgaâa maè' bïìr a ke duè bïìr cu mbo, mnyaèabaèraè' vi ce súèñ naè.
English: They had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.

Limbum: Vi m túr mñkuèñ aèmboè mñkuèñ nyobsaa wa'a. Vi m tashi beèe neè mñkuèñ anaè, a fa woweèe ñgá' aègho aè mñwáá taê.
English: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

Limbum: Ñkúú ce e ce sa' woweèe yu ncïìndap mbembep ce e ce sa' njep rwee ce lúèsimbuèu yu aègho ka' naè. A too li rlii aè li Hibruè ená AÈbadoèn, too aè li Greâk ená AÈpolïìyoèn; mbuèu efa gho aè ba enáê, “Ñwáè rbepsïì.”
English: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, but in Greek, he has the name Apollyon.

Limbum: Cena a ñgá' entombïì efa mñgá' ce vi be koni. Mñgá' ce vi bii ka' koni vi báti vi bbaa.
English: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè embenjïì mo aè fyáp rsoèñ li. E ka' fyáp, máè yu' njeèndoñ aèmboè e vúâ aè mmbur kyeèe embe dïì' rfa ce a m geèe neè guêl, yi táá kuèntombïì neè Nyúè naè.
English: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

Limbum: Njeèndoñ anaè aè laa neè ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m túr rsoèñ naè enáê, “Baè'shi neè bcïìndap bbebep ce a m kur a lá aèwaâa roè ce a too ená Yufrátïìs naè efa bkúè.”
English: saying to the sixth angel who had one trumpet, Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!

Limbum: Njeèndoñ anaè aè ka' laèa wa'a, a ba'shïì woweèe efa bkúè tá woweèe a bo yú ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa beèe enjep ñgoèñ. A m kur bcïìndap bbebep ce a m ba kyeèe na a lá wa'a, woweèe a ce keè' ba nfeâ' aè noèñ anaè, embe ñwáá anaè, embe feè' anaè tá a bo geèe lap rfaè' aè nfeè' anaè.
English: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

Limbum: Máè m yá yap ñgaâa maè' bïìr ce a ke maè' bïìr yaèp cu ba mbe mnyaèabaèraè'. A m suñ máè ená woweèe a yu malaèr mjeâe mmbaa.
English: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

Limbum: Máè yá mnyaèabaèraè' anaè a yá aèmboè beèe ce a m ce cañ mbo a m ba. Woweèe a m yar bco' bbáèbár nje ñguèñ. Bco' anaè vi m ce baèñ aèmboè mor wa'a, a ce sii aèmboè ncoèororoè, a ce baèñ aèmboè cwa wa'a. Btuè' mnyaèabaèraè' anaè vi m ba aèmboè btuè' búrúè' wa'a. Mor ba njemor ba rúèú mkaèñ yi m ce fúú ekuè cuèu mnyaèabaèraè' anaè.
English: Thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of lions. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

Limbum: Ñgá' mor, ba ñgá' njemor, ba ñgá' rúèú mkaèñ ce yi m fúú ekuè cuèu mnyaèabaèraè' ca naè aè m yú ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa beèe enjep ñgoèñ.
English: By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

Limbum: Ñger mnyaèabaèraè' anaè yi m ba ku waâp cuèu, a ker ba aè wap mñkuèñ. Wap mñkuèñ vi m ba aèmboè mnyo, a túr btuè'. Vi tashïì beèe ba neè mñkuèñ anaè.
English: For the power of the horses is in their mouths, and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with them they harm.

Limbum: Bár beèe ce ñgá' ca a m yúshi woweèe ka' naè a m kupse yap ntee a borni efa rgeèe buu bbebep ka'. Woweèe a m ku ce gú'shi neè byú' mnyúâmkaè', ker ba mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na ce a m kupshi ba neè mmbo. A m kupshi mnyúè anaè ba neè bco' aèmboè gul ba selvaè, ba broên. A ker kupshi mmo' ba neè bluèr, ba mntaañguu. AÈde' mnyúè anaè vi yá buu, káè yu' buu, káè jár ka'.
English: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn't repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn't worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk.

Limbum: Woweèe a m kani efa kupse yap ntee, borni yaèp buu bbebep. Woweèe a m ku ce yúshi beèe, a ce geèe tú', a ce saèki, a ce yáèá.
English: They didn't repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè ker yá ma ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aèmboè e ce suèu embe buèu. Mmbaè' vi m cete ye aèmboè cáè' ce ñwáè aè maè' aè nyor wa'a, ghuèghumbeèñ yi ba mbe yeâ tuè. Vi bsii vi m ce raa aèmboè nyúè ce e ke sañ na, mi mkuèu mi ba aèmboè mntiti mor wa'a.
English: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

Limbum: E m túr mú ñwaè' mo' ce a búèr wáá mba yeâ boè. E m tár yi kuâu maè' mbenduè rdip rgoèr, a tár yi kuâu ñkoèp mbenduè nshe, a waa,
English: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

Limbum: njeèndoñ a rúúñgeèr aèmboè yïì búrúè' wa'a. E ka' waa, bsa'mbeèñ ce vi m ba saèamba vi beesïì neè rwañgeèr.
English: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

Limbum: Bsa'mbeèñ anaè vi ka' wañger, máè ce kwaè'shi máná m be sañ yuu ce bsa'mbeèñ anaè vi laèa. Máè ka' ce kwaè'shi wa'a, a yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ aè suu embe buèu enáê, “Fa geèe tá ñwáè moè' riñ yuu ce bsa'mbeèñ anaè vi laèa ka'. Fa sañ blaèa anaè mbe ñwaè' ka'.”
English: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don't write them.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m tár yi kuèu mbenduè rdip rgoèr, a tár mo' mbenduè nshe naè aè naa yi bo maè' mbe buèu.
English: The angel who I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky,

Limbum: E m naèa wa'a, a ye leè' aè rlii Nyúè ce e ce cu aè nfeè' wááwá, aè ba ye ce e m geèe rbuu ba buu wááwá ce vi yu mbo, a gee ñgoèñ ba buu wááwá ce vi yu njo, a ker gee mdip ba buu wááwá ce vi yu njo. E m ye leè' enáê, “A be keèr caèasi nfeè' ka'.
English: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

Limbum: Be ba aè nfeè' ce ncïìndap Nyúè yïì elúèsimbuèu yïì embenjïì bcïìndap ntuunfu aè fyáp rsoèñ li naè, tá rfaè' Nyúè li mïî, tá buu Nyúè ce vi m ba aè bsúèti naè vi yááti aèwañ, tá yi bo kuè ba aèmboè e m suñ yi ñgaâa ncep ntuu.”
English: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants, the prophets.

Limbum: Njeèndoñ ce máè m yu' e ce suèu embe buèu naè aè laa neè máè enáê, “Duè koo ñwaè' ce a búèr yi ba mbaè bo ncïìndap Nyúè ce e tár kuèu mbenduè rdip rgoèr, a tár mo' mbenduè nshe naè.”
English: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.

Limbum: Máè du a laa neè ncïìndap Nyúè anaè ená e fa máè ñwaè' anaè. E laa neè máè enáê, “Koè ye, aè be ye tá yi lee kuè cuèu aèmboè bluè wa'a, bep njep rbúè.”
English: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, Take it, and eat it up. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.

Limbum: Máè koo ñwaè' anaè emba yeâ boè, a ye. Máè ka' ye, yi lee kuè cuèu aèmboè bluè, a bep njep rbúè.
English: I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

Limbum: A m laèa neè máè enáê, “AÈ be keèr cep ntuu Nyúè kuu beâe aè bto' jáá jáèá jáá, ce a ce laèa bli jáá jáèá jáá, ker ba bkúú aè bto' anaè.”
English: They told me, You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, a fa máè ráèráñ ce a ke feè' buu aègho, a laa neè máè enáê, “Naèti duê, du fe' Ndap Nyúè, ker fe' dïì' ce a ke fa rfa mbo mbe Ndaèp Nyúè foñ. Beè' beèe ce a ce loo neè Nyúè mbe ndaèp anaè.
English: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, Rise, and measure God's temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

Limbum: Fa feè' mambe efa Ndap Nyúè anaè ka' njobeè' a maè'shi mambe anaè ba neè beèe ce a rïìñ Nyúè ka'. Woweèe a be nyúè'si rla' Nyúè aè mñwáá ncoèp-baa-aè- mñkyeèe.
English: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don't measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

Limbum: M be tuusi beèe a mmbaa tá a du suñ wa blaèa neè beèe. Woweèe a be yar bcáâ' njïì rkwe. M be fa woweèe ñger tá a cep ya ntuu aè mnoèñ ncúèkïì neè mnoèñ mjeèe-mmbaa ba mnoèñ mntuunfu.”
English: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.

Limbum: Beèe aè mmbaa ca a yu bce Oleâf bbaa ce a m sañ aèmboè vi naè, a ker ba mú btábuèr blam bbaa ce vi táá kuèntombïì neè Nyúè ce e túr ñgoèñ wááwá naè.
English: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

Limbum: Ñwáè aè ka' ce roèo aè rgeèe yuu bebep neè woweèe, baná mor yi be fúú eku waâp cuèu, toèo ñgaèñ. Baná ñwáè wááwá ce e ka' ce roèo aè rgeèe yuu bebep neè woweèe, baná ñgaèñ be kuè kwe.
English: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

Limbum: Be ba aè nfeè' ce woweèe a ce cep ntuu Nyúè anaè tá woweèe a túr ñger aè rgeèe tá mbeèñ ker gweè aè nfeè' anaè ka'. Woweèe a be túr ñger aè rgeèe tá mdip enjep ñgoèñ wááwá mi beeñger aè bláá. Woweèe a be túr ñger aè rgeèe tá mñgá' njáèá jáá jáèá jáá vi koni beèe enjep ñgoèñ aè nfeè' wááwá ce woweèe a ka' koêñ.
English: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

Limbum: Woweèe a be suñ beèe blaâa Nyúè mïìsi, tá nyaâa ntatap ce e m fúú enjep rwee ce lúèsimbuèu yu aègho ka' naè, ma' bïìr a woweèe. E maè' bïìr a woweèe wa'a, so woweèe, yúshi woweèe.
English: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

Limbum: Bgúâú beèe anaè vi be noèñ aè nduunjïì aè múè rla' Nyúè anaè, aè ba rla' ce li yu rgoèr, aè ba rla' ce a m taa yaèp ñkúú aèfo mbe kïìntaa naè. A m fa mlii mo' neè rla' anaè aè rduèñshi njáèá njïì ce li m ba. Rmo' li m ba ená Sodoèm, rmo' li ba ená Ijïìp.
English: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

Limbum: Beèe a be vúèse aè mntáâ' aè bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ. Be ba beèe ce wap bli vi yu jáá jáèá jáá. Woweèe a be vúè wa'a, fyá' bgúâú beèe anaè aè mnoâñ btaar ba bá', byemi ená ñwáè tuñ bgúâú beèe anaè ka'.
English: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

Limbum: Beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a be lu'shi njobeè' beèe anaè a kweñger. Woweèe a be geèe ñkaè', ce lu'shi, ce fa beèe buu njobeè' beèe a mmbaa ce a m geèe beèe enjep ñgoèñ a yá ñgá' naè a kweñger.
English: Those who dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

Limbum: Mnoâñ btaar ba bá' vi ka' caèa, Nyúè aè yoñseè mbenduè beèe a mmbaa anaè, a fa woweèe ryoèñ, woweèe a natïì a táá mbekïì. Beèe ce a m yá woweèe a wáp seê.
English: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

Limbum: Beèe a mmbaa ca a yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ ntatap aè suèu embe buèu, a laa neè woweèe enáê, “Vúè neè mbena.” Woweèe a ka' ce duè mbe buèu, mmbaè' vi sir woweèe a kaari a tarte. Beèe ce a m baèa woweèe naè a m yá aèmboè woweèe a ce duè.
English: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, Come up here! They went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies saw them.

Limbum: AÈ ka ba aè nfeè' anaè, nshe aè ci'tïì seê. Ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' rúêú, efa mndap efa ma rla' anaè aè gweñgeèr aè nsheè. Nshe anaè aè ka' cïì'ti wa'a, a yúshi beèe ncúèkïì saèambaê. Beèe ce a m báti naè a wáp seê. A ka' wáp wa'a, a ku'si Nyúè embe buèu.
English: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

Limbum: Cena a ñgá' embenjïì yïì entombïì. Yïì embenjïì mo be koni nfeè' múcaèr.
English: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, ncïìndap Nyúè yïì elúèsimbuèu aè fyáp rsoèñ li. E ka' fyáp, máè yu' mnjeèndoñ aèmboè vi suèu embe buèu. Mnjeèndoñ ca vi m laèa mbekïì enáê, “Nfeè' aè gháá ce yïìseèe Nyúè ba Kraâis ce e m tuusi njep ñgoèñ na, a be sa' ñgoèñ ca. Nyúè be sa' ñgoèñ ca nfeseè.”
English: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr ce a m ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mmbaa, a cute mbe bkaèbaèraè' kuèntombïì neè Nyúè naè, a gú'shïì neè Nyúè.
English: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God's throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

Limbum: Woweèe a m laèa enáê, “Wáâ Nyúè ce ñger wááwá yi yu mba wáâ mmboè, wáè m ba, a ba seè'ni na. Weèr ce yoèñshi wáè njobeè' wáè loèr ku' yo ñger anaè a ká' a ce sa' ñgoèñ aègho.
English: saying: We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was; because you have taken your great power, and reigned.

Limbum: Ntee yi m ce yañ bto' mo' neè wáè, nfeè' aè gháá ce ntee yi be yañ wáè foñ. Nfeè' aè gháá ce aè be sa' mnsa' beèe ce a kweñger. Nfeè' aè gháá ce aè be laè' ñgaâa mfaè' ce a m ce feè'shi wo blaèa, ker ba beèe ce a ce yu'ni neè wáè, káè yu beâe bgoèrgoèr áè, káè yu beâe bká'ká' áè. Nfeè' anaè yu nfeè' ce aè be bepsi beèe ce a m ce bepsi ñgoèñ ca.”
English: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints, and those who fear your name, to the small and the great; and to destroy those who destroy the earth.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr ca a ka' mïìsi, máè yá aèmboè Ndap Nyúè embe buèu aè múè'ti. E ka' múè'ti, máè yá ñkuèp leâ' Nyúè ce e m ba mbo. Mbeèñ aè bapñgeèr, a rúúñger, a wañger, nshe aè ci'tïì, ku' mghoèo mi gweê.
English: God's temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord's covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

Limbum: Máè lo a yá ma yuu mo' aèmboè yi yááti mbe buèu. AÈ m ba yuu báèá. Njeñwáè moè' aè m yááti mbo. E m maè' nyúè ce e ke sañ na aè nyoèr, a táá mbenduè ñwáá, a yar rtaa kúú ce a m geèe neè mkaèñsïì ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú.
English: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

Limbum: E m ba neè rbúè. A ka' káè' ce luuti, a ce war, njobeè' e m ce yu' ryañ.
English: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

Limbum: Máè ker yá yuu mo' aèmboè yi yááti mbe buèu. Máè yá njáèá nyaèa moè' e feeseè nyaèaroè. Nyaèa anaè aè m ce baèñ. E m túr btu saèambaê, a túr mdoñ rúêú. E m soèp mtaa kúú mbe btu saèamba anaè wááwá.
English: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

Limbum: E lor yi ñkuèñ a súñ ñgúè' moè'sir efa ñgúè' taar efa mkaèñsïì embe buèu, a ma' njep nsheè. Nyaèa anaè aè vú a táá kuèntombïì neè njeñwáè ce e m ce luuti muu naè ená njeñwáè anaè e bi muu tá e bo ye.
English: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ca aè bi muu mbañruè ce e be loèr mbaèñ kúú ce a geèe neè bco', sa' bto' wááwá aègho. E ka' bi muu anaè, a koo muu anaè ese ye a cañ a du aègho mbe dïì' Nyúè yu, yi kaèbaèraè' yi ba mbo foñ naè.
English: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God, and to his throne.

Limbum: Njeñwáè anaè aè natïì foñ a cañ a du aè ntee rïìñ faèdïì' ce Nyúè aè m kupshi neè ye, aè ba dïì' ce e be cu tá a ke'ni ye aè mnoèñ ncúèkïì neè mnoèñ mjeèe-mmbaa ba mnoèñ mntuunfu.
English: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

Limbum: A lo a ká' a ce maè' bïìr mbe buèu. Ncïìndap Nyúè ce a ce too ená Maikáèl ba bcïìndap ce a m ba njep yeâ tïìi a m maè' bïìr a nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè. Nyaèa anaè ba vi bcïìndap a m maè' bïìr a Maikáèl weèe tatap seê.
English: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

Limbum: A ka' maè' bïìr anaè, Maikáèl ba vi bcïìndap a so. A ker ma'shi ená nyaèa ca ba vi bcïìndap vi cu mbe buèu ka'.
English: They didn't prevail, neither was a place found for him any more in heaven.

Limbum: A m loèr ma nyaèa anaè a ma' njep ñgoèñ na. Ma nyaèa anaè foñ yu nyo eluâuñgoèñ ce a too li rlii ená ñwáè mnaèñ, too rmo' ená Sataèn. E yu ñwáè ce e ke bo' beèe enjep ñgoèñ na. A m maè' ye a vi bcïìndap weèe njep ñgoèñ na.
English: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

Limbum: Máè yu' ma njeèndoñ aèmboè e suèu embe buèu a laa enáê, “Yeèr Nyúè aè geèe weèr aè luêñ. Ñger Nyúè ba kúú Nyúè yi yááti aèwañ. Beèe a yá ñger Kraâis ce Nyúè aè m tuusi njep ñgoèñ naè. A fúr ñwáè ce e m ce tee mnde' mbe btu bfúr viseèe aè nfeè' wááwá naè embe buèu, a ma' njep nsheè.
English: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, Now is come the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

Limbum: Bfúr viseèe ca a so ye njo' bláá Muu Njeèe ker ba njobeè' blaâa Nyúè ce woweèe a m ce suñ beèe. Woweèe a m tami nyor ená aè ka' ba rkwe baná woweèe a be kwe njo' Jisos Kraêis.
English: They overcame him because of the Lamb's blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn't love their life, even to death.

Limbum: Tá rlu'shïì li ba mbe buèu, ker ba neè beèe wááwá ce a ce cu mbo. Yi yu bebep neè beèe enjep ñgoèñ na ba mdip wááwá, njobeè' a maè' Sataèn embe buèu, e suu a ce cu a woweèe. Ntee yi ce yañ ye, njobeè' e rïìñ ená yïì nfeè' ku báti ba múcaèr seê.”
English: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.

Limbum: Nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè aè ka' yá ená a maè' ye embe buèu, e gwe njep ñgoèñ, e ká' a ce juèu aèmbuèu njeñwáè ce e m bi muu mbañruè naè.
English: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

Limbum: A m fa njeñwáè anaè bbaèp vi bbaa. Bbaèp anaè vi m feese bbaèp waèawa mñkuèr. A m fa ye bbaèp ca tá e bo fáñ aègho cañ du aè dïì' ce a m kupshi neè ye aè ntee rïìñ naè, faè dïì' nyo ca bo koo ye ka'. E fáñ baè' aèfo, tá a bo keè'ni ye aè bfeâ' btaar ba nto'.
English: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

Limbum: Nyo anaè aè fúr mdip ekuè cuèu, mi ba aèmboè rdip wa'a. E m fúr mdip anaè tá mi bo loèr njeñwáè anaè duè aègho.
English: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

Limbum: E ka' fúr wa'a, nshe aè ja' njeñwáè ca, a sa'ti, a nyoñ rdip ce nyaèa ca aè m fúr ekuè cuèu naè wááwá.
English: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

Limbum: Ntee yi yañ nyaèa ca neè njeñwáè ca. E du a ma' bïìr a bár boo njeñwáè ca. Boo njeñwáè anaè yu beèe wááwá ce a ce láè mncir Nyúè, a ce suñ ená Jisoès yu yaèp Tataê. Nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè aè du a táá aèwaâa rdip rgoèr.
English: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, who keep God's commandments and hold Jesus' testimony.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yá nyaâa mbembep moè' aèmboè e ce fúú enjep roè. Nyaèa anaè aè m túr btu saèambaê, a túr mdoñ rúêú. E m túr mtaa kúú mbe mdoñ anaè wááwá. A m sañ mlii mbe btu anaè a ce cáp ba Nyúè aègho.
English: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

Limbum: Nyaèa ce máè m yá anaè aè m feese mbaa. Mkuèu efa gho mi feeseè mkuèu njáèá nyaèa moè' ce a ke too ená báêá, cuèu efa gho yi ba aèmboè yïû búrúè' wa'a. Nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè aè fa nyaèa ca ñger ba kúú.
English: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

Limbum: Tu mo' efa nyaèa anaè yi m túr ma nfur moè' aè ba ce e m ba yú ye; nfur anaè aè m ba neè ke'se yi yu. Ñgoèñ wááwá yi m báèá nyaèa anaè a ká' a ce yu'ni ba neè nyaèa anaè.
English: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m ce gú'shi neè nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè njobeè' e m fa ñger neè nyaèa moè' ca. Woweèe a m ce gú'shi neè nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep roè naè foñ, a ce laèa enáê, “Ñwáè moè' yu ce e túr ñger a caa nyaèa ca ka'. Ñwáè yu ce aède' a nyaèa ca a re bkoèr ka'.”
English: They worshiped the dragon, because he gave his authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?

Limbum: A m fa nyaèa ca ñger ená e naatu, cáp Nyúè. A m fa ye ñger ená e gee yuu ce e koèñ aègho aè mñwáá ncoèp-baa-aè-mkyeèe.
English: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

Limbum: E m káè' a ce cáp Nyúè, a laa buu bbebep a kuu rlii Nyúè ker ba faèdïì' Nyúè ce cu, ba beèe embe buèu wááwá.
English: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his dwelling, those who dwell in heaven.

Limbum: A m fa ñger ená nyaèa ca ma' bïìr a beèe Nyúè, so woweèe. A m ker fa ñger ená e sa' beèe ce a ce laèa bli jáá jáèá jáá, a ce cu aè mntáè' ce vi yu aè bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na.
English: It was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ce cu njep ñgoèñ a be gú'shi neè nyaèa ca. Beèe ce a be gú'shi ka' be ba beèe ce a m sañ map mlii mbe ñwaè' Muu Njeèe ce a m yú. A m sañ mlii ca tá ñgoèñ yi ka' keè ba aègho.
English: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' túr btuè', ñgaèñ yu'.
English: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

Limbum: Yi ka' ba ená a be koo ñwáè fa aè shañ baná aède' ñgaèñ buu efa rduè shañ ka'. Yi ka' ba ená a be yú ñwáè neè saè' baná a be kuè yú ye ba aègho. AÈmboè yi yu aè njáâá wa'a, baná beèe Nyúè a ba táá tatap, láè ntee ba neè Taèr Nyúè.
English: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yá nyaèa moè' aèmboè e fúú enjep nsheè. Nyaèa anaè aè m túr mdoñ mbe tuè aèmbo mdoñ ya' ce yi ku bii ká'. Mdoñ anaè mi m ba mi mmbaa. Yïì njeèndoñ aè m feese njeèndoñ nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè.
English: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.

Limbum: E m loèr ñger nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep roè a túr nfur ce e m keè'se wáá naè a gee buu aègho aè rlii nyaèa anaè. E m geèe beèe enjep ñgoèñ wááwá a gú'shïì neè nyaèa anaè.
English: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

Limbum: E m geèe buu bbáèá, a gee mor yi suu embe buèu foñ, beèe wááwá a yá.
English: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

Limbum: A ka' geèe ku' buu bbáèá ce Nyúè aè m maè'shi ená e gee aè rlii nyaèa ca naè, a bo' beèe enjep ñgoèñ wááwá aègho. E m laèa ená a woweèe a gee blañ tá a bo gú'shi neè nyaèa ce a m gwaèr neè kaèafaè' e ke' kwe ka' naè.
English: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast; saying to those who dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

Limbum: Nyúè aè m maè'shi ená nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep nsheè na, yoñse mbenduè blañ ca, fa ryoèñ aègho tá vi bo laèa. E m maè'shi ená blañ ca vi yúshi beèe ce a be gú'shi neè vi ka'.
English: It was given to him to give breath to it, to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn't worship the image of the beast to be killed.

Limbum: Nyaèa anaè aè m fa ñger ená a fa beèe wááwá ncoèo. Káè ñwáè aè m ba ñwáâ ñgoèr áè, káè e m ba ñwáâ ñká' áè, káè e m ba ñkwaèa káè muu áè, a m fa ye ncoèo. A m ka' tá fa ñwáè ncoèo ca aè rkoo maè' ka', a fa nje nsaèpsi.
English: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands, or on their foreheads;

Limbum: A m laèa ená ñwáè ce e ka' tá túr ncoèo ca ka' baná ñgaèñ be fyeèni yuu káè yuu yuu ka'. Ncoèo anaè yu nombaè efa rlii nyaèa anaè.
English: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell, unless he has that mark, the name of the beast or the number of his name.

Limbum: Beèe a ba kwaè'shi aèmboè yuu ca boèñboñ seê, neè bfee-ñwáè. Ñwáè ce e ka' túr bfee baná ñgaèñ riñ yuu ce nombaè ca táá aètu mo. Nombaè ca táá aètu ñwáè. Nombaè anaè yu mjeèe ntuunfu neè ncoèp-ntuunfu-aè-mntuunfu.
English: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

Limbum: Máè ka' keèr fyá' a yá Muu Njeèe aèmboè e táá mbe rtuèu Sayoèn. E m táá mbo a beèe ncúèkïì rjeèe neè ncúèkïì ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mñkyeèe. A m sañ li rlii ba rlii yïì ta nje mnsaèpsi beèe ca wááwá.
English: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ aè suèu embe buèu a coo aèmboè rdip ce li ce gweè aè rkoñ wa'a, a rúúñger aèmboè mbeèñ e ke wañger ce rúèúñger naè. Njeèndoñ anaè aè m laèa aèmboè mluñ ce beèe a ce bu' wa'a.
English: I heard a sound from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

Limbum: Beèe anaè a m táá kuèntombïì neè kaèbaèraè' ba buu bteèe ce vi m ba kyeèe naè, ker ba beâe bgoèrgoèr ce a m ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mmbaa naè a ce yoèp yáá fi. AÈde' ñwáè moè' aè m ba yá'ni yáá anaè caa efa beèe ce a m ba ncúèkïì rjeèe neè ncúèkïì ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mñkyeèe naè ka'. Beèe anaè a ba beèe ce muu njeèe aè m yuu neè vi bláá a fúr woweèe efa múè beèe enjep ñgoèñ naè.
English: They sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

Limbum: Beèe anaè yu beèe ce a láè wap mnyor brara, a ke' bepsi wap mnyor a bbyeèñge weèe ka'. Woweèe a yu beèe ce a ce duè aèmbuèu Muu Njeèe aè bdïì' wááwá ce muu njeèe ka' ce duè. Beèe ca yu beèe ce a yuu woweèe neè bláá, a fúr woweèe efa múè beèe, woweèe a ba beèe Nyúè, a ker a ba beèe Muu Njeèe foñ.
English: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

Limbum: Woweèe a m be nya' mnde' ka'. Yuu bebep mo' yi yu ce aède' ñwáè laa ená woweèe a geèe ka'.
English: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

Limbum: Máè yá ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aèmboè e ce fáñ mbe buèu. E m ce vúè neè Nsuñ Mboèñmboñ, aè ba nsuñ ce e be mïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'. E m ce vúè tá e bo suñ nsuñ anaè neè beèe wááwá ce a ce cu njep ñgoèñ na, a ba aè mntáè' wááwá ce vi yu aè bto' wááwá, a ce laèa bli jáá jáèá jáá.
English: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

Limbum: E m laèa neè njeèndoñ ntatap enáê, “Wáp neè Nyúè, ku'si ye, njobeè' nfeè' aè gháá ce e be sa' beèe wááwá. Baná weèe gú'shi neè ye. E m geèe rbuu ba nshe, ba mdip ce mi ce fúú enjep nsheè ba mdip mñgoèrñgoèr.”
English: He said with a loud voice, Fear the Lord, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aè ker vúê, a laa enáê, “Li gweè. Ma rla' rgoèr ce a too ená Babiloèn naè li gweè. AÈ m ba rla' ce li m geèe bto' wááwá vi no mi mruè' ce yu saèkïì, a ce saèki foñ aèmboè woweèe.”
English: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.

Limbum: Ncïìndap yïì embenjïì bcïìndap Nyúè vi bbaa ca aè laa neè njeèndoñ ntatap enáê, “Ñwáè ce e ka' gú'shi neè nyaèa ker ba blañ ca, byemi ená a fa ye ncoèo nje nsaèpsi káè mbe rkoo áè,
English: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead, or on his hand,

Limbum: baná rshentee Nyúè li be gweè mbe tu ñwáè anaè. Rshentee Nyúè anaè li be ba aèmboè mruâ' mtatap ce a fiñshi ka'. E be no mi wááwá. E be yá mluè njep mor ce yi ce she aèmboè a láè lá mkaèñ njo wa'a. E be yá ñgá' ca aè bsii bcïìndap Nyúè ba Muu Njeèe.
English: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb.

Limbum: Njemor ce yi be fa woweèe ñgá' yi be mïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'. Beèe ce a ce gú'shi neè nyaèa anaè ba vi blañ, a ker túr ncoèo rlii nyaèa anaè, a be yá mluè neètú' ba neèmootïì.”
English: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

Limbum: Baná yi yu boèñboñ ená beèe Nyúè ce a ce láè vi mncir, a lá ntee neè Jisoès naè, a táá tatap.
English: Here is the patience of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ aè suèu embe buèu a laa enáê, “Sañ blaèa ca: ‘Ká' e seè'ni, mboâñtu mi yu neè beèe ce a láè ntee neè Tata Jisoès wáá a ka' kwe.’ ” Yú' Nyúè yi beesïì enáê, “Yi yu wa'a, lap rfaè' li mïì. Woweèe a be lúèshi ce lu'shi, njobeè' sá' efa map mfaè' be duè a waâp mbuèu.”
English: I heard the voice from heaven saying, Write, 'Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.' Yes, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.

Limbum: Máè ka' fyá' a yá ku' mmbaâ' bbúú. Ñwáè moè' aè cu mbenduè mmbaè' anaè a ba aèmboè muu ñwáè wa'a. E m soèp rtaa kúú ce a geèe neè guêl, a túr saâ' ncáncáp mbaè boè.
English: I looked, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aè fúú embe Ndaèp Nyúè, a laa neè njeèndoñ ntatap neè ñwáè ce e m cu mbenduè mmbaè' naè enáê, “Nfeè' ce a be kep buu efa mñkúè aè gháá. Buu ce a byeè njep ñgoèñ na wááwá vi bi. Loèr saè' du kep aègho.”
English: Another angel came out from the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, Send forth your sickle, and reap; for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m cu mbenduè mmbaè' naè aè lor yïì saè' a kep buu enjep ñgoèñ aègho wááwá.
English: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

Limbum: Máè ker yá ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aèmboè e fúú embe Ndaèp Nyúè embe buèu, a túr saâ' ncáncáp mbaè boè foñ.
English: Another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

Limbum: Máè ker yá ncïìndap Nyúè moè'. AÈ m ba ncïìndap Nyúè ce e ke toèo mor mbe dïì' ce a ke fa rfa neè Nyúè. E vú embe dïì' rfa anaè a waa, a laa neè ncïìndap Nyúè moè' ca enáê, “Yáê, gráâp aè baèñ. Loèr yoè saè' anaè du ceni efa mñkwaa enjep ñgoèñ na.”
English: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, Send forth your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth's grapes are fully ripe!

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè cenïì gráâp enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá neè saè', a ma' njep beè'teè tá a bo nyáèñ tá mdip mi fúú enjo. Rnyáèñ efa gho anaè li táá aètu rshentee Nyúè.
English: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

Limbum: Beè'teè anaè yi yu ba aè múè rla' ka'. A ka' nyáèñ gráâp anaè bláá vi fúú enjo. Bsaèp efa gho vi m ba bkïìlomátaè mjeèe mtaar, rcoomïì efa gho li ba aèmboè rkoo rmo'sir.
English: The winepress was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out from the winepress, even to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè ker yá yuu báèá mo' mbe buèu. AÈ m ba yuu laèa ka'. Máè m yá bcïìndap Nyúè saèambaê. Woweèe a m vúè neè mñgá' saèambaê. Mñgá' saèamba ca aè m ba mñgá' ce elúèsimbuèu. Nyúè be mïìsi li rshentee ba neè mñgá' ca.
English: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God's wrath is finished.

Limbum: Máè yá yuu mo' yi feeseè rdip rgoèr ce a geèe neè glaâs ce a fïìñshi mor aè múè mo. Máè yá beèe ce a m so nyaèa ba blañ nyaèa caè, ba nombaè rlii nyaèa anaè aèmboè a tááte aèwaâa rdip rgoèr a túr mluñ Nyúè mbaè mmboè.
English: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

Limbum: Woweèe a m ce yoèp yáá ce Musïìs ce e m ce faè' neè Nyúè aè m yoèp, aè ba yáá Muu Njeèe foñ naè. Woweèe a m yoèp enáê, “Wáâ Nyúè ce aè yu yeèr taê, ñger wááwá yi yu mba wáâ mmboè. Mo mfaè' mi caèa ñger, aè ba foñ mfaâ' mmbáèá. AÈ yu ñkúú neè bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na, buu ce wáâ geèe vi ku ba yáánïì, a ba mini aè nfeè' wááwá.
English: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

Limbum: Yeèr taê, ñwáè ce aède' e wáp wáè ka', yu nda? Ñwáè ce aède' e buu efa rkuè'si lo rlii yu nda? Ñwáè ce e yu nrara ku ba wáè caè'caè'. Beâe aè bto' wááwá a be vúè gú'shi neè wáè, njobeè' a yá ená buu wááwá ce aè ce geèe vi yu yáánïì.”
English: Who wouldn't fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yá mbe buèu. A ka' fyá' mbo, dïû' rara ce yi caèa ñger ce yi yu mbe Ndaèp Nyúè embe buèu naè yi ba too.
English: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

Limbum: Bcïìndap Nyúè saèamba ce a m vúè neè mñgá' saèamba naè a fúú embe dïì' Nyúè anaè. Woweèe a m yar bcáâ' bbúú ce vi m ce fúp seê. Woweèe a m cúú kúè cáè' ce a geèe neè gul nje ñguèñ.
English: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.

Limbum: Moè' efa buu bteèe ce vi m ba kyeèe naè aè fa bcïìndap Nyúè saèamba ca bghee ce a geèe neè gul vi saèambaê. Rshentee Nyúè ce e ku ba nteèe aè nfeè' wááwá li m ba njep bghee anaè jiñ.
English: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

Limbum: Njemor yi tar mbe dïì' Nyúè anaè. Njemor anaè yi m vúè ese ñger ker ba foèo Nyúè. Ñwáè moè' aè m ba ce aède' e m ba du mbe dïì' Nyúè anaè ka'. AÈde' ñwáè aè m ba ku du mbo ba aè nfeè' ce mñgá' saèamba ce bcïìndap Nyúè a vúè aègho naè vi mïì.
English: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ aè laèa tatap embe dïì' Nyúè. E m laèa neè bcïìndap Nyúè saèamba caè enáê, “Cuè' neè rshentee Nyúè ce weèe túr aè bghee naè njep ñgoèñ.”
English: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè yïì entoèmbïì aè cu' ñgá' ce e m ba njep ghee yi naè njep ñgoèñ. E ka' cuè', bkoètá ce vi ke yañ se naè vi koo beèe ce a m fa woweèe ncoèo nyaèa caè, woweèe a ker ce gú'shi neè blañ nyaèa anaè naè.
English: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè yïì embenjïì mo aè cu' ñgá' ce e m ba njep ghee yi njep rdip rgoèr. E ka' cuè', rdip rgoèr li ghuptïì a ba aèmboè bláá gúâú ñwáè wa'a. Buu bteèe ce vi m ba njo vi kweñgeèr wááwá.
English: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aè cu' ñgá' ce e m ba njep ghee yi njep roè ba mdip ce mi ce fúú enjep nsheè. Mdip anaè mi beeñgeèr aè bláá.
English: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m túr ñger mbenduè mdip naè aè laèa enáê, “Wáè ce aè yu ñwáâ nrara, wáè m ba, a ba seè'ni na. Wáè teni mnsa' ca yáánïì.
English: I heard the angel of the waters saying, You are righteous, who are and who were, you Holy One, because you have judged these things.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m yúshi yoè beèe a ker yúshi yo ñgaâa ncep ntuu, bláá vi láñ naè, a beèe ce wáè fa bláá neè woweèe ená a no. Yu beèe ce a ba no bláá anaè ghup.”
English: For they poured out the blood of the saints and the prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ aè laèa embe dïì' rfa enáê, “Yi yu mini. Wáâ Nyúè ce aè yu yeèr taê, ñger wááwá yi yu mba wáâ mmboè. Wáè teni mnsa' aè njïû yáánïì.”
English: I heard the altar saying, Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aè cu' ñgá' ce e m ba njep ghee yi mbenduè nyúè ce e ke sañ na. E ka' cuè', Taâr Nyúè aè ma'shïì, ñgá' anaè aè she aèmboè mor wa'a, a too beèe.
English: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

Limbum: E ka' toèo woweèe, woweèe a cáp Nyúè ce e túr ñger mbenduè mñgá' ca wááwá. Woweèe a m kani efa rkupse yap ntee, kuè'si Nyúè.
English: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn't repent and give him glory.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aè cu' ñgá' ce e m ba njep ghee yi mbenduè kaèbaèraè' nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep roè naè. E ka' cuè', túè' aè sii aè ñgoèñ wááwá ce nyaèa anaè aè m ce sa'. Beèe a m luushi mlee njo' mluè ce woweèe a m ce yá.
English: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

Limbum: Woweèe a m cáp Nyúè embe buèu njo' ñgá' ce woweèe a m ce yá, ker ba njobeè' bkoètá ce vi m koo woweèe naè. Woweèe a m yá ñgá' ca wa'a, a ke' kupse yap ntee borni buu bbebep ce woweèe a m ce geèe ka'.
English: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn't repent of their works.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aè cu' ñgá' ce e m ba njep ghee yi njep ma rdip ce a too ená Yufrátïìs. E ka' cuè', rdip anaè li yuushïì tá bkúú ekuè mbuèuntii a bo caèa njïì enjo.
English: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

Limbum: Máè yá byú' bbebep vïû btaar, vi feeseè bja'. Vi m fúú ekuè cuèu nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè, ba nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep roè naè, ker ba ekuè cuèu ñwáè ce e mú ce nya' mnde' ená e yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè naè.
English: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

Limbum: Byú' anaè yu mnyúâmkaè', a túr ñger aè rgeèe buu bbáèá. Byú' anaè vi m duè a yá bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá, a baashi woweèe aèbee tá a bo maè' bïìr a Nyúè weèe aè noèñ ce Nyúè ce ñger wááwá yi yu mba yeâ mmboè be duèñshi yi ñger.
English: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go forth to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God, the Almighty.

Limbum: Yáê, “M be vúè aèmboè nyáèá wa'a. Rboâñtu li yu neè ñwáè ce e ce buumi ka', a ce keè'ni vi bcáè', faè dïì' a lor vi, tá e lo kar mbuèuriñ tá rïìtu yi koo ye aè múè beèe ka'.”
English: Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn't walk naked, and they see his shame.

Limbum: Byú' ca vi vúè neè bkúú ca aèbee aè dïì' ce a too aè li Jus ená AÈmaègádoèn.
English: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, Megiddo.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè yïì elúèsimbuèu aè ñwañ ñgá' enjep ghee yi mbekïì. E ka' ñwañ, njeèndoñ aè laa embe kaèbaèraè' ce yi m ba mbe Ndaèp Nyúè naè enáê, “Yi mïì.”
English: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came forth out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done!

Limbum: Njeèndoñ anaè aè ka' laèa wa'a, mbeèñ aè bapñgeèr, a rúúñger, a wañger, nshe aè ci'tïì. Ká' embe nfeè' ce beèe a m káè' ba njep ñgoèñ na, ñgoèñ yi m be ci'ti wa' ka'.
English: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since there were men on the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.

Limbum: Ma rla' rgoèr caè li tenïì nyor bdïû' btaar, mla' ce mi m ba aè bto' wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na mi gweñgeèr. Nyúè aè m kuushi ma rla' rgoèr ce a m ce too ená Babiloèn naè, li rshentee ba yïì ñgá' aè vú mbenduè rla' ca. Nyúè aè m geèe rla' ca li no li rshentee ce li m ba njep yeâ ndoñ aèmboè ndoñ mruâ' mtatap wa'a.
English: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

Limbum: Bto' ce mdip mi sïìr a kaari a tarte ker ba mtuèu a m káèáñger, a bú.
English: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

Limbum: Mghoèo mi suu embe buèu a gweñger aènduè beèe. Rghoâo rmo'sir li m ce rïìr aèmboè baèa msañ wa'a. Ñgá' anaè aè m báámi seê. Beèe a m cáp Nyúè njobeè' ku' ñgá' ce woweèe a m ce yá.
English: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague is exceedingly severe.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yá ncïìndap Nyúè moè' efa múè bcïìndap saèamba ce a m túr bghee saèamba naè. E m vúè a laa neè máè enáê, “Vúè tá m duñshi wáè ñgá' ce kwaèraè ce e caèa ñger na be yá. Kwaèraè ca táá aètu rla' ce a baè'ri mbetar mdip.
English: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

Limbum: Bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá a m noèñ a kwaèraè anaè weèe, beèe enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá a no mruè' saèkïì, a ce saèki foñ aèmboè kwaèraè ca.”
English: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.

Limbum: Máè m ba mbaè mmbo Yú' Nyúè, ncïìndap Nyúè aè lor máè a du aègho aè ntee rïìñ. Máè ka' baè' aèfo a yá njeñwáè aèmboè e cu mbenduè nyaâa mbembep, nyaèa anaè aè ba mbeer. A m sañ mlii aè nyor nyaèa anaè wááwá, aè ba ba mlii ce a m ce cáp ba Nyúè aègho. Nyaèa anaè aè m túr btu saèambaê, a túr mdoñ rúêú.
English: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored animal, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ca aè m yar bcáâ' bbeer, aè ba bcáè' ce vi m boèñ seê. E m suèsi yïì nyor neè buu jáá jáèá jáá. AÈ m ba buu aèmboè bkwaèñ, ba mncïìi ba byáèári. A m geèe buu anaè neè gul ker ba bluèr ce vi m ce laè'ñger seê. E m túr ndoñ ce a geèe neè gul mba yeâ boè, ndoñ anaè aè ruu neè bsaèrbuu efa yïì saèkïì.
English: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

Limbum: A m sañ rlii nje nsaèpsi njeñwáè ca. Rlii anaè li m táá ba aètu ñgaèa ce a m maè'. Rlii anaè li m ba enáê, “Babiloèn ce ñgoèr, ma ñwáè bsaèkïì, ba ma ñwáè bsaèrbuu enjep ñgoèñ na.”
English: And on her forehead a name was written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

Limbum: Máè m yá máná njeñwáè anaè aè m no bláá beèe ce a m yúshi njobeè' woweèe a m ce laèa aèwañ ená woweèe a ce duè aèmbuèu Jisoès naè. E m no, bláá anaè vi koo ye aèmboè mruè' mi ke koo ñwáè naè. Máè ka' yá wa'a, a bááñger seê.
English: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè aè laa neè máè enáê, “Wáè báèáñger njoká? M be to' wáè yuu ce njeñwáè ca ker ba nyaèa ce e túr btu saèamba a túr mdoñ rúú naè, a táá aètu mo.
English: The angel said to me, Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

Limbum: Nyaèa anaè aè m ba nteèe a ker bii nteèe seè'ni ka'. E be fúú enjeèp rwee ce lúèsimbuèu yu aègho ka' naè, tá a lo yú ye tá e kwe dúèdúè. Beèe ce a ce cu njep ñgoèñ na a be yá nyaèa ca, báèáñger seê. Beèe ca yu beèe ce a m sañ map mlii mbe ñwaè' ryoèñ ka', tá ñgoèñ yi ka' keè ba aègho. Woweèe a be báèáñger njobeè' nyaèa ca aè m ba nteèe a ker bii nteèe seè'ni ka, keèr loè kúti nteèe.
English: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.

Limbum: “Beèe a ba kwaè'shi aèmboè buu ca boèñboñ se neè bfee-ñwáè. Btu saèamba ca yu mtuèu saèamba ce njeñwáè ca cu mbenduè mo. Btu anaè vi táá aètu bkúú saèambaê.
English: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.

Limbum: Bkúú ta efa múè bkúú saèamba ca a bii mbe kúú ka'. Ñkúú moè' ku bii sa', moè' aè ku bii vúè. E be vúè kuè sa' ba nfeè' múcaèr seê.
English: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

Limbum: Nyaèa ce e m ba nteèe, a bii nteèe seè'ni ka' naè yu ñkúú embenjïì bkúú saèambaê. E yu ñkúú embenjïì bkúú saèamba wa'a, a ku ba aè múè bkúú saèamba ca. Ku báti nfeè' múcaèr tá e nati du faèdïì' ce a be yú ye tá e kwe dúèdúè.
English: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

Limbum: “Mdoñ rúú ce wáè yá naè, yu bkúú rúú ce a bii ka' ko' mbe kúú. A be ghar woweèe wáá, tá woweèe a sa' a nyaèa anaè weèe aèbee nfeè' múcaèr seê.
English: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.

Limbum: Bkúú rrúú ca a be kuè túr ba rkwaè'shïû rmo'sir. Woweèe a be fa wap mnyor neè nyaèa anaè, ce faè' ba neè ye.
English: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

Limbum: Woweèe a be maè' bïìr a muu njeèe Nyúè, tá Muu Njeèe Nyúè so woweèe. E be so woweèe njobeè' e yu ñkúú ce e caèa bkúú wááwá, a ker ba Taèr ce e caèa btaèr wááwá. Muu Njeèe a yïì beèe weèe a be so aèbee. Beèe ca yu beèe ce e ká', a ce, aè ba beèe ce a ce duè a yeâ mbuèu neè ntee e mo'sir.”
English: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings. They also will overcome who are with him, called and chosen and faithful.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè laa neè máè enáê, “Mdip ce wáè yá ma kwaèraè caè aè cu mbetar mo naè, mi táá aètu ku' beâe aè mntáè' wááwá aè bto' wááwá ce a ce laèa bli jáá jáèá jáá.
English: He said to me, The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

Limbum: Nfeè' moè' be ba ce mdoñ rúú ce wáè yá, ba nyaèa caè a be baèa kwaèraè ca, faèp buu ese ye wááwá tá e kar mbuèuriñ. A be sáá nyaèa efa yeâ nyoèr ye, keèr loèr mor toèo ye aègho.”
English: The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, and will make her desolate, and will make her naked, and will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

Limbum: Nyúè a ñwáè ce e geèe bkúú ca a túr ntee e mo'sir, a vú aèbee, a fa yap ñger neè nyaèa ca ená e sa' caar tá yuu ce e m laèa ená yi be keè ba, yi geetïî.
English: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, and to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

Limbum: Njeñwáè ce wáè m yá naè, yu rla' rgoèr ce li ce sa' bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá.
English: The woman whom you saw is the great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yá ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aèmboè e ce suèu embe buèu. E m túr ñger goèr seê. Yïì nyor aè m ce raa, rraa efa yeâ nyor anaè li raa aè ñgoèñ wááwá.
English: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

Limbum: E m waa neè njeèndoñ ntatap enáê, “Ma rla' Babiloèn li gweè. Li gweè dúèdúè. Rla' anaè aè kúti dïì' ce mnyúâmkaè' vi ce cu. Byú' bebep wááwá vi tarshi aèfo. Njáèá bsiñ ce beèe a koèñ ka' vi tarshi nyor aèfo.
English: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird!

Limbum: A fa rla' ca ñgá' njobeè' li m fa mruè' saèkïì neè bto' enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá, bto' ca vi no a ce saèki foñ aèmboè rli. Bkúú wááwá enjep ñgoèñ na a m ce ká' rla' ca ená a woweèe a sakïî. Li m geèe ñgaâa ntaa enjep ñgoèñ na a túr mbaèa njobeè' li m ce yuu ku' buu ese woweèe tá e bo ye rboèñ aègho.”
English: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ moè' aè suèu embe buèu a laa enáê, “Fúú neè efa múè rla' anaè yaè beèe. Fúú neè faè dïì' weèe rla' ca weèe lo cú' mmbo tá wee weèe foñ lo geèe buu bbebep ka'. Fúú neè faè dïì' wee weèe foñ lo yá ñgá' ce a be fa neè rla' anaè ka'.
English: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don't receive of her plagues,

Limbum: Ku' buu bbebep anaè aè kuè' a ba aèmboè rtuèu ce li saèp a ba' mbe buèu wa'a. Nyúè aè kuushïì buu bbebep anaè.
English: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

Limbum: Tá buu bbebep ce rla' ca li m geèe naè kúti mbe tu mo. Tá ñgá' ce a be fa neè rla' ca, caa yïì ce li m ce fa neè beèe naè ñkaèraè' baa. Loèr neè ndoñ ce rla' ca li m ce fa beèe mruè' njo ená a no naè fa li mruè' njo tá li no. Fa neè li ba mruè' ce mi tap a caa mruè' mi caè ñkaèraè' baa.
English: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

Limbum: Fa neè li ñgá', gee tá li koosimnse. Geèe neè tá ñgá' ba ñkoosimnse rla' anaè ku ba goèr foñ aèmboè ku' foèo ba ku' buu ce li m túr naè. Fa neè li ñgá' njobeè' li ce naèa tu ená li yu ñkúú. Li ce laèa ená li yu ñgwañkúñwáè ka', aède' li war aè nfeè' moè' ka'.
English: However much she glorified herself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, 'I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.'

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba njobeè' li ce laèa wa'a, baná ku' ñgá' ce li be loè yá naè, be gweè mbenduè mo. Be ba aè noèñ ñgá' anaè tá li yañ, koosimnse, tá njeè koo li, mor yi ker toèo li foñ. AÈ ka' ba njobeè' yïìseèe Ta Nyúè túr ñger, baná ku ba ye ce e be sa' mnsa' rla' ca teni.”
English: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

Limbum: Bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na ce a m ce ká' rla' ca ená a woweèe a sakïî, ce ye ñgoèñ naè, a be yá nje efa mor ce yi be toèo rla' ca, taa mmbo mbe tuè, war.
English: The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her, will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

Limbum: Woweèe a be yá aèmboè rla' ca li ce yá ñgá', wáp, táá aènjïìsaèp laèa enáê, “Ndoèo! Ndoèo! Ma rla' rgoèr ce a too ená Babiloèn ce li túr ñger foñ se naè, li ce yá ñgá'. A ku lor ba nfeè' múcaèr, a teni wo mnsa'.”
English: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.'

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntaa enjep ñgoèñ na a be yá aèmboè rla' ca li ce she tá a taa mmbo mbe tuè war, njobeè' ñwáè ce e yuu yaèp buu ntaa be keèr ba ka'.
English: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more;

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntaa ca a m ce geèe ntaa neè buu ce a m geèe neè gul ba selvaè ba bluèr ce vi m ce laè'ñger. Ntaa bcáè' ce vi m túr ncoèo jáá jáèá jáá a luu ntaa se naè aè ker ba aègho ka'. Ntaa buu embe ndaèp ce a m geèe neè mntaañguu ce vi m ce rúèú bboèñboñ seê, ba vïì ce a m geèe neè msoèñ juè', ba vïì ce a m soèp, ba buu ce a m geèe neè bco' bboèñboñ ba bluèr, aè ba aègho ka'.
English: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

Limbum: Ntaa mgúr ce mi m ce rúèú boèñboñ aè ba aègho ka'. Ntaa mruè' ba ntaa mgúr aè ba aègho ka'. Ntaa kwaa aè ba aègho ka'. Ntaa nyaèa aèmboè naè' ba njeèe ba mnyaèabaèraè' aè ba aègho ka'. Ntaa mutuè mntaañguu aè ba aègho ka'. Ntaa bkwaèa ba beèe ce a m koo aè rkoèñ aè ker ba aègho ka'.
English: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people's bodies and souls.

Limbum: Ñgaâa ntaa caè a be laèa enáê, “Buu wááwá ce wáè m koèñ naè vi mïì. Yo foèo ba ku' buu ce wáè m túr naè vi mïì. AÈde' aè ker túr buu anaè ka'.”
English: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

Limbum: Beèe ce a m ce geèe ntaa a túr ku' buu se naè, a be yá aèmboè rla' ca li ce yá ñgá', wáp, táá aènjïìsaèp, taa mmbo mbe tuè, war, laèa enáê,
English: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;

Limbum: “Ndoèo! Ndoèo aè co' rla' rgoèr ca. AÈ m ba entoèmbïì rla' ca li m ba aèmboè njeñwáè ce e yar bcáâ' bboèñboñ ce vi m ce fúp, mo' vi ce baèñ. E m suèsi yïì nyor neè buu ce a m geèe neè gul ba bluèr ce vi ce laè'ñger.
English: saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

Limbum: Ku' buu ce rla' ca li m túr wááwá vi ku mi ba njaè' moè'sir.” Beèe ce a yu btu mfaè' neè beèe ce a ke faè' mbe bkeñ bgoèrgoèr, ba beèe wááwá ce a ke yeñger ba enjep roè, a m táá foñ aènjïìsaèp,
English: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.' Every shipmaster, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

Limbum: a ka' yá njemor efa rla' ce li m ce she, a waa, a laa enáê, “Hábáê, rla' mo' li m be ba aèmboè rla' ca ka'.”
English: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, 'What is like the great city?'

Limbum: Woweèe a m gweè aè nsheè a biñri, a waa a laa enáê, “Ndoèo! Ndoèo aè co' rla' ca. AÈ m ba entoèmbïì, beèe ce a m túr bkeñ bgoèrgoèr a ku' njo' rla' ca. Ku' buu ce rla' ca li m túr wááwá vi ku mi ba njaè' moè'sir.”
English: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!' For in one hour is she made desolate.

Limbum: Tá beèe embe buèu wááwá a lu'shi njobeè' rla' Babiloèn li gweè. Tá beèe Nyúè wááwá, ba ñgaâa ntuu neè Jisoès, ker ba ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè a lu'shi njobeè' Nyúè aè bepsi rla' ca njo' ñgá' ce li m ce fa neè woweèe.
English: Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.

Limbum: Ma ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aè lor luèr ce e m kuè' aèmboè ñgoè' baa wa'a, a ma' njep roè a laa enáê, “A be koo ma rla' ce a too ená Babiloèn na aè ñger, geèe tá li gwe wa'a, tá ñwáè ker yá rli ka'.
English: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.
