Limbum: Ñwáè be keèr yu' aèmboè beèe a ce bu' mluñ, ce fyáp mdoñ ba msoèñ, káè ce yoèp byáá aèfo ka'. Beèe ce a ke fáèr buu enje mmboè a be keèr ba aèfo ka'. Ñwáè be keèr yu' aèmboè a ce goè' baa aèfo ka'.
English: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of whatever craft, will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

Limbum: Blam vi be keèr raa aèfo ka. Mñkaè' bguèu vi be keèr ba aèfo ka'. AÈ m ba entoèmbïì ñgaâa ntaa ce aè rla' Babiloèn a ba beâe bgoèrgoèr njep ñgoèñ na, ma rla' anaè li ce bo' beâe aè bto' wááwá aè tú'.
English: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you; for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

Limbum: Bláá ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè ba bláá beèe Nyúè moè' wááwá, ker ba bláá beèe wááwá ce a yúshi njep ñgoèñ na, vi yu mbe tu rla' anaè.”
English: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, yuu mo' yi coo máè mbaè tuè' embe buèu aèmboè mnjeèndoñ ma kúr beèe wa'a. A m ce yoèp yáá enáê, “AÈleèluyaè! Rluèñ ba foèo ba ñger wááwá yi ba mba yeâ mmboè.
English: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God:

Limbum: E yu ñwáâ mini. E ke sa' mnsa', teni aè njïû yáánïì. E fa ñgá' neè ma kwaèraè ce e m bepsi ñgoèñ neè saèkïì naè. E kúsi mcucu' neè kwaèraè ca njobeè' e m yúshi yïì beèe ce a m ce faè' neè ye.”
English: for true and righteous are his judgments. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

Limbum: Woweèe a ker yop enáê, “AÈleèluyaè! Rla' ca li ce she, tá njemor yi ko' mbekïì, mïì aè nfeè' moè' ka'.”
English: A second said, Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.

Limbum: Beâe bgoèrgoèr ce a m ba ncoèp-kyeèe-aè-mmbaa naè ker ba buu bteèe ce vi m ba kyeèe naè, a gú'shïì neè Nyúè ce e m cu mbe kaèbaèraè', a laa enáê, “Yi yu wa'a! AÈleèluyaè.”
English: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, Amen! Hallelujah!

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ aè laèa embe kaèbaèraè' enáê, “Beèe wááwá ce a yu ñgaâa mfaè' neè Nyúè, a ce wáp Nyúè foñ naè, a yoñshi yïìseèe Nyúè. Káè yu beâe bgoèrgoèr áè, káè yu beâe bká'ká' áè, yoèñshi neè Nyúè.”
English: A voice came forth from the throne, saying, Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!

Limbum: Máè yu' yuu mo' yi coo máè mbaè tuè' aèmboè njeèndoñ ma kúr beèe wa'a. Njeèndoñ anaè aè m ba aèmboè njeèndoñ rdip ce li ce gweè aè rkoñ wa'a, a ker wañger aèmboè mbeèñ wa'a. Njeèndoñ anaè aè m waa enáê, “AÈleèluyaè. Nyúè ce e yu yïìseèe Tataê, ce e túr buu wááwá mba yeâ mmboè, yu ñkúú enjep ñgoèñ na seè'ni.
English: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

Limbum: Seèe yu' rboèñ, lu'shi, ku'si Nyúè, njobeè' nfeè' aè gháá ce Muu Njeèe be tarshi bguèu. Ñgwa yïì aè tami nyor aè bguèu anaè foñ.
English: Let us rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let us give the glory to him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.

Limbum: Nyúè aè fa ñgwaguèu anaè bcáâ' bbúú ce vi ce raa a ce laè'ñger seê, ená e yar.” Bcáè' ca vi táá aètu mfaâ' mmboèñmboñ ce beèe Nyúè a geèe.
English: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m laèa neè máè naè aè ker laa enáê, “Sañ blaèa ca: ‘Mboâñtu mi yu neè beèe ce a be woweèe aè ñkaâ' bguèu yi Muu Njeèe.’” E ker laa neè máè enáê, “Blaèa ca aè laèa ba Nyúè seeseê.”
English: He said to me, Write, 'Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.' He said to me, These are true words of God.

Limbum: Máè ka' yu' wa'a, a gwe njeptii ncïìndap Nyúè anaè ená m bo gú'shi neè ye. E laa neè máè enáê, “Fa geèe wa' ka'. M ku ba ñwáè ce m ce geèe rfaè' Nyúè aèmboè wáâ geèe foñ naè. M ku ba ñwáè rfaè' neè Nyúè aèmboè weèe bfúr wo weèe yu naè. M ku ba aèmboè beèe wááwá ce a táá tatap, a ce laèa ená Jisoès yu yaèp Tataê. Gú'shi neè ba neè Nyúè caè'caè'. Nsuñ Jisoès yu ntee efa ntuu Nyúè.”
English: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, Look! Don't do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.

Limbum: Cena yi ka' mïì, máè yá aèmboè rbuu li múè'ti. Li ka' múè'ti, máè yá nyaèabaèraâ' mbúú. Rlii ñwáè ce e m cu mbe nyaèabaèraè' anaè li m ba enáê, “Ñwáè mini ce aède' beèe a foosïì.” E ke sa' mnsa' yáánïì, ku ma' ba bïìr ce e ba maè'.
English: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

Limbum: Mi mmir mi yu aèmboè mcuèñ mor wa'a. E soèp mtaa kúú mbe yeâ tuè aèñgoo. A sañ rlii mo' a yeâ nyoèr, aè ku riñ ba ye a riñ rlii anaè.
English: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

Limbum: E maè' saèaro ce a fúèú njep bláá. A too li rlii enáê, “Nlaèa Nyúè.”
English: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called The Word of God.

Limbum: Ñgaâa maè' bïìr embe buèu wááwá a m ce duè a yeâ mbuèu. Woweèe a m yar bcáâ' bbúú ce mú ncoèo moè' aè m ba aègho ka', a cute mbe mnyaèabaèraâ' bbúú.
English: The armies which are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.

Limbum: Saè' mbyáèráñ aè m fúú eku yeâ cuèu. AÈ m ba saè' ce e be so bto' ce a baèa ye aègho. E be loèr yïì mbaèñ kúú ce a geèe neè bco', sa' woweèe aègho. E be nyáèñ gráâp ce a m ceni naè njep beè'teè ce a ke nyáèñ. Rnyáèñ efa gho li táá aètu ku' rshentee Nyúè ce ñger wááwá yi yu mba yeâ mmboè.
English: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

Limbum: A m sañ rlii a yeâ cáè' ce e m maè' aè nyoèr ker ba a yi ká'shi. Rlii ce a m sañ anaè li m ba enáê, “Ñkúú ce e caèa bkúú wááwá. Tata ce e caèa btata wááwá.”
English: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

Limbum: Máè yá ncïìndap Nyúè moè' aèmboè e táá aè nyúè. E m waa a ká'shi bsiñ ce vi ke ye bgúâú buu, a laa neè vi enáê, “Vúè neè aèbee ye ku' ñkaè' ce Nyúè aè ká'.
English: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

Limbum: Vúè neè ye bgúâú bkúú, ba bgúâú beèe ce a m ba btu neè bsoogáè, ker ba bgúâú beâe bgoèrgoèr. Vúè neè ye bgúâú mnyaèabaèraè' ba bgúâú beèe ce a m ce cañ mbo. Vúè neè ye bgúâú beèe wááwá, káè yu bkwaèa áè, káè yu boo áè, káè yu beâe bgoèrgoèr áè, káè yu beâe bká'ká' áè, ye neè bgúèú efa gho.”
English: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, and small and great.

Limbum: Máè yá aèmboè nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep roè naè aè vúè aèbee a bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na ker ba bsoogáè ce a yu njeptii bkúú ca. Woweèe a m vúè aèbee tá a bo maè' bïìr a ñwáè ce e m cu mbe nyaèabaèraâ' mbúú naè ba bsoogáè ce a m ba njep yeâ tïìi.
English: I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse, and against his army.

Limbum: A m koo nyaèa ca ker ba ñwáè ce e m ce nya' mnde' ená e yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè, aè ker ba ñwáè ce e m ce geèe buu bbáèá aè bsii nyaèa ca naè. E m geèe buu bbáèá anaè a bo' beèe ce a m fa woweèe ncoèo nyaèa ca, woweèe a ker ce gú'shi neè blañ nyaèa ca naè. A m koo nyaèa ca ba ñwáè mnde' ca a ma' woweèe bteèe njep ma mor ce mkaèñ mi ce she njo.
English: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m cu mbe nyaèabaèraâ' mbúú naè aè lor saè' ce e m ba ku yeâ cuèu naè a yúshi bár beèe ce a m ce duè aèmbuèu nyaèa anaè aègho, bsiñ vi vú a ye bgúâú beèe ca, a sáê.
English: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came forth out of his mouth. All the birds were filled with their flesh.

Limbum: Máè yá aèmboè ncïìndap Nyúè moè' ce suèu embe buèu, a túr ki ce a ke mú' rwee ce lúèsimbuèu yu aègho ka' naè aègho. E m túr ma shañ ñgoèr mbaè boè.
English: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

Limbum: E m koo nyaèa ce e m feese nyaèaroè naè a kyáá neè shañ anaè, e cu aègho aè bfeè' ncúèkïì. Nyaèa ca yu nyo ce e m ba eluâuñgoèñ, aè ba nyaèa ce a ce too rlii efa gho ená nyúèrkaè', a ker ce too rmo' ená Sataèn naè.
English: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

Limbum: E m koo ye a ma' njep rwee ce lúèsimbuèu yu aègho ka'. A ka' maè' njo a li' cuèu efa gho, a siñ neè ncoèo Nyúè. E m geèe wa'a tá e bo cu njo aè bfeè' ncúèkïì, keèr túr njïì aè rbo' beèe enjep ñgoèñ ka'. Bfeè' ncúèkïì ca vi mïì, tá a ku fúr ye enjo aè mú nfeè' moè'.
English: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

Limbum: Máè yá bkaèbaèraè', a yá beèe ce a m cu mbe bkaèbaèraè' anaè. A m fa beèe anaè ñger ená a sa' beèe. Máè yá myoèñ beèe ce a m ceeshi woweèe btu njobeè' woweèe a m ce suñ beèe ená woweèe a byemi neè Jisoès, a ker ce feè'shi blaâa Nyúè naè. Beèe ca a beèe ce a m gú'shi neè nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep roè naè ka', a ker gú'shi neè blañ nyaèa anaè ka'. Woweèe a m kani foñ ená a fa fa woweèe ncoèo nyaèa anaè nje nsaèpsi káè aè boè ka'. Beèe ca a m kweñger, a fúú efa rkwe, a Jisos Kraâis weèe a sa' aèbee aè bfeè' ncúèkïì.
English: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus, and for the word of God, and such as didn't worship the beast nor his image, and didn't receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived, and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

Limbum: Cena yu nfúú efa rkwe ce entoèmbïì. Bár beèe ce a m kweñger naè a m ker fúú efa rkwe ka', caar tá bfeè' ncúèkïì ca vi mïî.
English: The rest of the dead didn't live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

Limbum: Beèe ce a ka' ke fúú efa rkwe entombïì baná woweèe a yu ñgaâa mboâñtu a ba beâe brara. Rkwe embenjïì li be joèo woweèe ka'. Woweèe a be ba ñgaâa tañshi tañshïì neè Nyúè ba Kraêis, sa' a Kraâis weèe aè bfeè' ncúèkïì.
English: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

Limbum: Bfeè' ncúèkïì ca vi be mïì tá a fúr Sataèn efa shañ,
English: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison,

Limbum: tá e du aè bto' ce vi yu aè mmbuu ñgoèñ wááwá, bo' bto' anaè. A too bto' anaè ená Gok ba Magoèk. E be vúè neè bto' ca aèbee tá vi bo maè' bïìr. Ñgaâa maè' bïìr anaè a be ba goèr aèmboè nsaruñ wa'a.
English: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war; the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

Limbum: Woweèe a be duè aè ñgoèñ wááwá, sïìr dïì' ce beèe Nyúè a yu, ce yu rla' ce Nyúè koèñ se naè, kaari tarte. Woweèe a be sïìr wa'a, tá mor yi suu embe buèu toèo woweèe.
English: They went up over the breadth of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God, and devoured them.

Limbum: A be koo Nyúèrkaè' ce e m bo' beèe anaè naè, maè' njep ma mor ce mkaèñ mi m ce she njo. A dïì' ce nyaèa ce e m fúú enjep roè naè ba ñwáè ce e m ce nya' mnde' ená e yu ñwáè ncep ntuu Nyúè naè a yu. Woweèe a be cu njo, yá mluè neètú' ba neèmootïì, kuè yá wa'a nfeseè.
English: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

Limbum: Máè yá ma kaèbaèraâ' búú, a yá ñwáè ce e m cu mbo. Ñwáè ca aè ka' nyáá, nshe ba rbuu a da' a bú, a ker yááti ka'.
English: I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found no place for them.

Limbum: Máè yá beâe bgoèrgoèr ba beâe bká'ká' ce a m kweñger aèmboè a táá kuèntombïì neè kaèbaèraè' anaè. A m múè' mñwaè'. A m ker mú' ñwaè' mo', ñwaè' anaè aè ba ñwaâ' ryoèñ. Ñwáè ce e m cu mbe kaèbaèraè' naè aè m fyá' mbe mñwaè' ce a m sañ mfaè' beèe ce a m kweñger anaè mbo, a teni mnsa' ñwáè wááwá aèmboè mi mfaè' mi m ba.
English: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

Limbum: Beèe wááwá a m ba aèfo. Beèe ce a m kweñger njep rdip rgoèr a m fúú enjo. Beèe ce a m kweñger, a ba mbaè yir a vú embaâ, a sa' woweèe, a teni mnsa' ñwáè wááwá aèmboè mi mfaè' mi m ba.
English: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

Limbum: A ka' teni mnsa' wáá, a lor rkwe ba ñgoèñ embaè yir a ma' njep ma mor caè. Ma mor anaè yu rkwe embenjïì.
English: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

Limbum: A m koo beèe ce a m sañ map mlii mbe ñwaâ' ryoèñ ka', a ma' njep ma mor anaè.
English: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

Limbum: Máè yá rbuu rfi ba nshe nfi. Rbuu ce li m ba entombïì ba nshe ce e m ba entombïì aè m bú, rdip rgoèr li bú foñ.
English: I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

Limbum: Máè yá rla' rrara ce a m ce too ená Jáèrusaláèm ce nfi aèmboè li ce suèu embe buèu. AÈ m suèusi Nyúè a suusi li. Li m boèñ aèmboè njeñwáè ce e suèsi nyor tá e bo duè mbe ndaèp nduu yïì wa'a.
English: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

Limbum: Máè yu' aèmboè njeèndoñ ntatap aè laèa embe kaèbaèraè' enáê, “Rla' Nyúè li yu seè'ni ba aè mú beèe. E be cu a woweèe tá woweèe a ba yïì beèe. Nyúè seese be ba a woweèe, ba yaèp Nyúè.
English: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, Behold, God's dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

Limbum: E be siñsi map mñgoommir wááwá. Rkwe li be keèr ba aègho ka', ñkoosimnse ba aègho ka', rwar li ba aègho ka', ryañ li ba aègho ka', njobeè' buu brúèú aè mïì dúèdúè.”
English: He will wipe away from them every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m cu mbe kaèbaèraè' naè aè laa enáê, “Yáê, m be geèe ba buu bfi seè'ni.” E m ker laa enáê, “Sañ blaèa ca njobeè' yu blaèa ce aède' vi caa aè cicïì ka', vi yu mini.”
English: He who sits on the throne said, Behold, I am making all things new. He said, Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.

Limbum: E m ker laa neè máè enáê, “La rfaè' li mïì. M yu Alfaè, a ba OÈmágaè. A máè ñwáè ce e m káè' buu wááwá, a ba ñwáè ce e be mïìsi buu anaè. Ñ wáè ce ntee mdip yi ka' ce luèu ye, baná m be sáp mdip enjep rdip ryoèñ fa ye tá e no aè cicïì.
English: He said to me, It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' so, baná ñgaèñ be koni buu ca wááwá. M be ba yïì Nyúè, tá e ba muu waè.
English: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

Limbum: AÈ ka' ba yi aèmboè beèe ce a yu ñgaâa bwáp, ba beèe ce a yu mini ka', ba ñgaâa bsaèrbuu, ba ñgaâa nyúshi beèe, a be fa woweèe ñgá'. Beèe ce a ce saèki, ba ñgaâa tú', ba beèe ce a ce gú'shi neè mnyúè enjep ñgoèñ na, ba ñgaâa mnde', a be fa woweèe ñgá' foñ. A be koo woweèe wááwá maè' njep ma mor ce mkaèñ mi ce she njo. Ñgá' ca yu rkwe embenjïì.”
English: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè moè' efa múè bcïìndap Nyúè ce a m túr bghee saèambaê, mñgá' vi ba njo naè aè vú a laa neè máè enáê, “Vúè tá m duñshi wáè ñgwaguèu ce e yu ñgwa Muu Njeèe.”
English: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, Come here. I will show you the wife, the Lamb's bride.

Limbum: Máè m ba mbaè mmbo Yú' Rara, ncïìndap Nyúè aè lor máè a du aègho mbe tu ma rtuèu ce li m saèp seê. Weèr ye aè ka' baè' mbo, e duñshïì máè Jáèrusaláèm ce yu rla' rrara ce li m loè ese Nyúè, aèmboè li ce suèu embe buèu.
English: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

Limbum: Rraa Nyúè li m ce sañ aè rla' anaè, rla' anaè li ce laè'ñger aèmboè luèr ce a too ená jaspaè, a ce raañger aèmboè kwakwa' wa'a.
English: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, as if it was a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

Limbum: A m boo ñka' ce yi m saèp seê, a sir rla' anaè aègho a tarte. Bcuèu efa ñka' anaè vi m ba ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú. Bcïìndap Nyúè ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú a m ce keè'ni bcuèu ñka' anaè. A m sañ mlii mntáâ' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúâú aè to' Isráèl aè bcuèu efa gho wááwá.
English: having a great and high wall; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

Limbum: Mñgúè' ñka' kyeèe anaè wááwá vi m túr bcuèu vi btaar btaar. Bcuèu vi btaar vi m ba aè ñgúè' ekuè mbuèuntii, bcuèu vi btaar vi ba aè yïì embaè mbuèuntii. Bár mñgúè' ñka' bbaa vi m túr bcuèu vi btaar btaar foñ.
English: On the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

Limbum: A m boo ñka' anaè mbenduè bluèr ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú. A m sañ mlii beèe ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú ce a m ba ñgaâa ntuu neè Muu Njeeè mbe bluèr anaè.
English: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m ce laèa neè máè naè aè m túr mú co' saèsap ce a m geèe neè guêl. AÈ m ba co' ce a m ce feè' buu aègho. E m túr co' anaè tá e bo feè' rla' ca, feè' ñka' ce a boo a sir rla' ca aègho, keèr feè' bcuèu ñka' anaè.
English: He who spoke with me had for a measure, a golden reed, to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

Limbum: Bsaèp ba bbáèr efa rla' anaè vi m ku ba yáánïì. Ncïìndap Nyúè aè ka' feè' rla' anaè, bsaèp efa gho vi ba bkïìlomátaè ncúèkïì-baa neè mnjeâe-mmbaa ba ncoèp- baa-aè-mmbaa. 2,222 Bbáèr efa gho vi ku ba wa'a. Bsaèp embekïì vi ku ba foñ wa'a.
English: The city lies foursquare, and its length is as great as its breadth. He measured the city with the reed, Twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, breadth, and height are equal.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè ca aè m ku fe' aèmboè beèe a m ce feè'. E m feè' bsaèp embekïì efa ñka' anaè vi ba mmátaè ncoèp-ta-aè-msaèambaê.
English: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

Limbum: A m boo ñka' anaè neè bluèr ce vi m ce raañger aèmboè kwakwa', a boo rla' mbe múè mo neè gul ce e m ce raañger aèmboè glaês.
English: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

Limbum: A m loèr bluèr ce vi m ba jáá jáèá jáá, a túr mlii jáá jáèá jáá a boo kuèu ñka' anaè aègho. Bluèr anaè vi m ba ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú. Mlii efa gho mi m ba enáê: jaspaè, ba safáèr, ba agáèr, ba emáraèl,
English: The foundations of the city's wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

Limbum: ba onïìk, ba kaèniliyaèn, ba kwoêt, ba báèrïîl, ba topaès, ba krisopráès, ba jasïìn, ker ba amátïìs.
English: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprasus; the eleventh, jacinth; and the twelfth, amethyst.

Limbum: A m geèe bcuèu ñka' ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú anaè neè njáèá bluèr mo' ce a m ce too ená, “Páêl.” Bluèr anaè vi m ba ncoèp-baa-aè-rrúèú a ghááte aè bcuèu efa gho wááwá. A m geèe mnduunjïû aè rla' ca neè gul ce e m ce raañger aèmboè glaês.
English: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

Limbum: Máè m yá Ndap Nyúè aè rla' anaè ka' njobeè' yïìseèe Ta Nyúè ce ñger wááwá yi yu mba yeâ mmboè, ba muu njeèe a m ba aè rla' anaè.
English: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb, are its temple.

Limbum: Mbuèu moè' aè m ker ba ená nyúè ce e ke sañ na ba ñwáá a sañ aè rla' anaè ka', njobeè' rraa Nyúè li m ce sañ aèfo, muu njeèe aè ba lam efa rla' anaè.
English: The city has no need for the sun, neither of the moon, to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

Limbum: Beèe enjep ñgoèñ na a be yá dïì' ce a ce duè, njo' rraa anaè. Bkúú enjep ñgoèñ na a be loèr bkuè' ce a túr wááwá duè aègho aè rla' anaè.
English: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

Limbum: Bcuèu ñka' ce a sïìr rla' anaè aègho vi be kuè táá btoo aè nfeè' wááwá. A be cete ka' njobeè' aède' túè' sii aè rla' anaè ka'.
English: Its gates will in no way be shut by day for there will be no night there,

Limbum: A be vúè neè ku' bkuè' enjep ñgoèñ na wááwá láè aè rla' anaè.
English: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

Limbum: AÈde' yuu bebep yi ba' aè rla' anaè ka'. Ñwáè ce e ka' ba ñwáè bsaèrbuu, káè ñwáè mnde' áè, aède' e niñ aè rla' anaè ka'. Beèe ce a be niñ aè rla' anaè ku ba ba beèe ce a m sañ map mlii mbe ñwaâ' ryoèñ muu njeèe.
English: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè m duèñshi máè rdip ce li ke fa ryoèñ, li ce laè'ñger aèmboè glaês. Rdip anaè li m ce fúú enje kaèbaèraè' ce túr Nyúè ba muu njeèe.
English: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

Limbum: Li m ce caèa mbe ntoèñ nduunjïì efa rla' anaè. Bce ce mbaèñ efa gho yi ke fa ryoèñ vi m táá aèwaâa rdip anaè, mo' aè bo ñkoèp, mo' aè bo maè'. Mbaèñ yi m ce yú mbo aè mñwáá ncoèp-baa enjep feè'. Bfuè efa gho aè m ba mcáèp. A m ce jaè' beâe aè bto' wááwá ce a m ce yañ aègho.
English: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

Limbum: AÈde' yuu ce yi yu bebep aè bsii Nyúè yi ker ba ka'. Yuu ce yi be ba aè rla' anaè be ba kaèbaèraè' ce túr Nyúè ba muu njeèe. Yïì beèe ce a ce duè a yeâ mbuèu a be gú'shi neè ye aè rla' anaè.
English: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants serve him.

Limbum: Woweèe a be yá bsii Nyúè, tá a sañ rlii Nyúè nje waâp mnsaèpsi.
English: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

Limbum: AÈde' túè' ker sii ka'. Mbuèu moè' be ba ená blam vi ba aèfo tá vi bo ce raa, káè ená nyúè sañ aèfo ka', njobeè' Taèr Nyúè be ba rraa neè woweèe. Woweèe a be sa' aèmboè bkúú nfeseè.
English: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè ca aè laa neè máè enáê, “AÈde' blaèa ca vi caa aè cici ka', vi yu mini. Taèr Nyúè ce e ke fa yi yú' neè yi ñgaâa ncep ntuu, a ñwáè ce e tuu yïì ncïìndap ená e vú yá beèe ce a ce faè' neè ye, duñshi woweèe buu ce ku báti nfeè' múcaèr tá vi koni.”
English: He said to me, These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.

Limbum: “Yáê, m ce vúè seè'ni seè'ni. Mboâñtu mi yu neè beèe ce a ce geèe buu ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' ca.”
English: Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e m yu' buu ca, a ker yá vi neè mmir a máâ Joân. Máè ka' yu' buu ca, yá vi, a gwe njeptii ncïìndap Nyúè ce e m duèñshi máè buu ca tá m bo gú'shi neè ye.
English: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

Limbum: Ncïìndap Nyúè anaè aè laa neè máè enáê, “Fa geèe wa' ka'. M ku ba ñwáè ce m ce geèe rfaè' Nyúè aèmboè wáâ geèe foñ naè. M ku ba aèmboè wáè ba bfúr wo ce a yu ñgaâa ncep ntuu Nyúè, a ker ba aèmboè beèe wááwá ce a ce geèe buu ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' ca. Gú'shi ba neè Nyúè.”
English: He said to me, See you don't do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.

Limbum: E m laèa neè máè enáê, “Fa súèti blaèa ce a sañ mbe Ñwaâ' Nyúè na ese beèe ka'. Geèe tá beèe wááwá a yu', njobeè' nfeè' ce buu ca be koni yu aètútú.
English: He said to me, Don't seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

Limbum: Maè'shi tá ñwáè ce e ce geèe buu bbebep ku ce geèe yïì buu bbebep anaè. Ñwáè ce e ce geèe bsaèrbuu ku ce geèe vi bsaèrbuu. Ñwáè ce e ce geèe ñgeâe yáánïì ku ce geèe yáánïì. Ñwáâ nrara ku cu aè ñwáâ nrara.”
English: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.

Limbum: Yáê, m ce vúè seè'ni seè'ni. M be vúè neè blaè' tá m bo laè' ñwáè wááwá aèmboè li rfaè' li yu.
English: Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

Limbum: Yú' Nyúè ba ñgwaguèu ce muu njeèe aè loèr a laèa enáê, “Vúè.” Ñwáè ce e ka' yu' blaèa ca baná ñgaèñ laa foñ enáê, “Vúè.” Ñwáè ce ntee mdip yi ka' ce luèu ye, e koñ ená e ba no mdip enjep rdip ce li ke fa ryoèñ, baná ñgaèñ vú no mdip anaè aè cicïì.
English: The Spirit and the bride say, Come! He who hears, let him say, Come! He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

Limbum: M ce báá weèe. Ñwáè ce e ka' yu' blaèa ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' ca, ce yu blaèa ce vi loè ese Nyúè, kyese yuu mo' mbenduè mo, baná Nyúè be loèr ku' ñgá' ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' ca, kyeèse mbenduè ñgá' ce ñgaèñ be yá.
English: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book, if anyone adds to them, may God add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e ka' co' yuu mo' efa gho, baná Nyúè be maè'shi tá e ye mbaèñ ce ce yi ke fa ryoèñ, ce a suñ mbe ñwaè' ca naè ka'. E be maè'shi tá ñgaèñ niñ aè rla' Nyúè ce a sañ mbe ñwaè' ca foñ naè ka'.
English: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, may God take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

Limbum: Ñwáè ce e suñ buu ca aè laèa enáê, “Yi yu mini, m ce vúè seè'ni seè'ni.” Yi yu wa'a. Vúè, Tata Jisoès.
English: He who testifies these things says, Yes, I come quickly. Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

Limbum: M ce loo máná Tata Jisoès túr ntee boèñboñ neè beèe Nyúè wááwá. Yi yu wa'a.
English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
